def:
vt.在…下面画线,加强，强调
n.下划线,下期节目预告,图下说明文字

adj.空白的,空的，无信息的，未填写的,茫然的,空虚的
n.空的空间或地点,填空处，空白表格,坯,无用的东西
vt.消失,挡住通路,[体育运动] 阻止（对手）得分,打孔，盖印
vi.走神,逐渐消失

ex.en: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
ex.cn: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

ex.en: Write your letter and seal it in a blank envelope.
ex.cn: 信写好后把它装进空白信封里封好。

ex.en: They drew a blank in their search for the driver.
ex.cn: 他们四处寻找那个司机，但一无所获。

def:
vt.识别，认出,确定,使参与,把…看成一样
vi.确定,认同

ex.en: The new technique has been used to identify the sex of foetuses.
ex.cn: 这一新技术已经被用来鉴别胎儿的性别。

ex.en: She wore a little nurse's hat on her head to identify her.
ex.cn: 她头戴一顶小护士帽，很容易辨认。

ex.en: The candidates all want to identify themselves with reform.
ex.cn: 候选人都想把自己与改革密切联系起来。

def:
n.方法（ mean的名词复数）,手段,收入,财富
v.意味着（ mean的第三人称单数）,引起,打算或注定要某人成为或做某事

ex.en: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
ex.cn: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

ex.en: A special locking system means the door cannot be opened accidentally.
ex.cn: 特殊的锁定系统使门不会被意外打开。

ex.en: This proposal is by no means a sure thing.
ex.cn: 这个提议绝不会理所当然地获得通过。

def:
n.国家,州,状况，情况,资格
vt.规定,陈述，声明
adj.国家的,国务的，公务的,正式的

ex.en: Centuries of statecraft had refined the concept of sovereignty.
ex.cn: 几个世纪的治国方法锤炼了民族主义哲学.

ex.en: Subtlety is one of the arts of both diplomacy and statecraft.
ex.cn: 微妙莫测是外交和政治手腕艺术之一.

ex.en: Up to what point does statecraft permIt'superstition to be destroyed?
ex.cn: 到什么程度国家机构才能消灭迷信 呢 ?

def: adv.大部分地，主要地,大规模地,丰富地

ex.en: It is a part of Britain as yet largely unaccustomed to tourists.
ex.cn: 英国的这一块地方还很不为游客所熟悉。

ex.en: Any calls for a new UN resolution are largely political posturing.
ex.cn: 任何要求联合国出台新决议的呼吁在很大程度上都只是一种虚伪的政治姿态。

ex.en: These crimes were committed largely by professional criminals who lived by crime.
ex.cn: 这些罪案大都是由以犯罪为生的职业罪犯制造的。

def: n.科技（总称）,工业技术,工艺学,[总称]术语
adv.因此,所以,故,乃

ex.en: The committee will examine the agreement and any problems arising therefrom.
ex.cn: 委员会将审查这项协议和由此引起的问题。

ex.en: Your side will be held responsible for all the consequences arising therefrom.
ex.cn: 由此产生的一切后果由你方负责.

ex.en: If they refrain therefrom, clothe them and feed them suitably.
ex.cn: 如果她们从此悔改,就适当地给她们衣食.

def: adj.可获得的,有空的,可购得的,能找到的

ex.en: They have only a vague idea of the amount of water available.
ex.cn: 他们只是大概知道可用水的总量。

ex.en: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room.
ex.cn: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。

ex.en: Cheap goods are available, but not in sufficient quantities to satisfy demand.
ex.cn: 有一些廉价的商品，但是数量不足以满足需求。

def: n.社区,社会团体,共同体,[生态] 群落

ex.en: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
ex.cn: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

ex.en: News of 160 redundancies had sent tremors through the community.
ex.cn: 将会裁员160人的消息在该团体中掀起了一阵骚动。

ex.en: He was now a teacher and a respectable member of the community.
ex.cn: 他现在是一位教师，并且是社区内受人尊敬的一员。

def: n.理解，理解力,包含的能力,[逻辑学]内涵

ex.en: It's a devastating and barbaric act that defies all comprehension.
ex.cn: 这种行为野蛮凶残、令人震惊，简直是不可理喻。

ex.en: The course also features creative writing exercises and listening comprehension.
ex.cn: 这门课程也包括写作练习和听力理解。

ex.en: What Jock had done was beyond my comprehension.
ex.cn: 我无法理解乔克的所作所为。

def:
adj.基本的,必要的,本质的,精华的
n.必需品,基本要素,必不可少的东西

ex.en: Jordan promised to trim the city budget without cutting essential services.
ex.cn: 乔丹承诺在不减少基本服务的前提下，缩减市政预算。

ex.en: Party membership was an essential prerequisite of a successful career.
ex.cn: 成为党员是事业有成必不可少的先决条件。

ex.en: "Aromatherapy oils" are not pure essential oils but dilutions.
ex.cn: “香薰精油”并非纯精油，而是经过稀释的。

def:
vt.拒绝,抛弃，扔掉,排斥,吐出或呕吐
n.被拒绝或被抛弃的人或事物

ex.en: We reject any suggestion that the law needs amending.
ex.cn: 对于任何暗示该法律需要修改的观点我们都拒绝接受。

ex.en: The United States is certain to reject the proposal as a non-starter.
ex.cn: 美国肯定会以无成功希望为由拒绝这项提案。

ex.en: Today its executive committee voted unanimously to reject the proposals.
ex.cn: 今天执行委员会投票一致否决了这些提案。

def:
vt.照料，照顾,护理,照管，管理
vi.倾向（于），趋向（于）,伺侯，招待,关心,注意
n.学说,理论,原理,推测

n.量，数量,总额,本利之和,全部效果，全部含义
vi.（在意义、价值、效果、程度等方面）等于,等同，接近,合计，总共,发展成为

ex.en: They have only a vague idea of the amount of water available.
ex.cn: 他们只是大概知道可用水的总量。

ex.en: The evaluation of conduct involves some amount of generalization.
ex.cn: 对操行的评价会含有一些泛泛之论。

ex.en: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
ex.cn: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

def:
n.利益，好处,救济金，津贴,义演，义卖,恩惠，恩泽
vt.有益于，有助于,使受益,得益，受益

ex.en: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements.
ex.cn: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。

ex.en: Each family farms individually and reaps the benefit of its labor.
ex.cn: 各家经营各自的农场，收获各自的劳动成果。

ex.en: In 1986 more than three million were receiving unemployment benefit.
ex.cn: 1986年，有300多万人领取失业救济金。

def:
n.支架，悬臂,括弧,类别，等级,[数]同类项
vt.为…装托架,把…括在一起,把…分类,排除

ex.en: Each bracket is fixed to the wall with just three screws.
ex.cn: 每个托架只用了3颗螺钉固定在墙上。

ex.en: Do you fall outside that age bracket?
ex.cn: 你不属于那个年龄段吗？

ex.en: He picked the telephone off the wall bracket.
ex.cn: 他从墙上的固定托架上摘下电话。

def:
vt.涉及，关系到,使关心，使担忧,参与
n.关心,关系，有关,顾虑,公司或企业

ex.en: Issues such as these were not really his concern.
ex.cn: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

ex.en: A good relationship involves concern and sensitivity for each other's feelings.
ex.cn: 一段美满的恋情需要彼此关心并体恤对方的情感。

ex.en: The technical aspects were the concern of the Army.
ex.cn: 技术方面由陆军负责。

def:
vt.要求，请求,需要,[法]召唤,询问，盘问
n.需求,需要,要求，请求,销路
vi.需要,请求,查问

ex.en: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
ex.cn: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

ex.en: He was much in demand as a lecturer in the US.
ex.cn: 他的讲座在美国很受欢迎。

ex.en: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
ex.cn: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

def: adj.经济的,经济学的,合算的,有经济效益的

ex.en: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
ex.cn: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

ex.en: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
ex.cn: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

ex.en: The country's economic plight is strangling its scientific institutions.
ex.cn: 该国的经济困境阻碍了其科研机构的工作进展。

def:
n.基金,储备,现款,特别基金管理机构
vt.积存,为…提供资金,提供资金偿付（债款等）的本息,把（短期借款）转为有固定利息的长期借款

ex.en: He's accused of misusing $17.5 million from a secret government slush fund.
ex.cn: 他被指控滥用秘密的政府行贿基金，金额达1,750万美元。

ex.en: He is possessed of an extraordinary fund of energy.
ex.cn: 他的精力异常充沛。

ex.en: Encourage her to get involved in fund-raising for charity.
ex.cn: 鼓励她参加慈善募捐活动。

def:
n.影响,势力,有影响的人（或事物）,[占星学]星力
vt.影响,感染,支配,对…起作用

ex.en: I fell under the influence of a history master.
ex.cn: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

ex.en: The Shropshire landscape was an influence on Owen too.
ex.cn: 什罗普郡的风景也对欧文产生了影响。

ex.en: The boss retains enormous influence by reason of his position.
ex.cn: 老板由于自身的地位而一直有极大的影响力。

def:
vt.解释,理解,诠释，体现,口译
vi.作解释,作口译

ex.en: They could interpret it that way if they'd a mind to.
ex.cn: 如果他们愿意的话，可以那样理解。

ex.en: Historians annotate, check and interpret the diary selections.
ex.cn: 历史学家对日记选篇进行加注、核查以及阐释。

ex.en: The students were asked to interpret the poem.
ex.cn: 学生们被要求诠释那首诗的意义。

def: vt.包含,使参与，牵涉,围绕，缠绕,使专心于

ex.en: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.
ex.cn: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。

ex.en: A retrofit may involve putting in new door jambs.
ex.cn: 房子翻新可能需要安装新的门框。

ex.en: A late booking may involve you in extra cost.
ex.cn: 预订晚了的话你可能要额外多花钱。

def:
adj.可能的,适合的,有希望的
adv.可能,或许,大概,多半

ex.en: Very likely he'd told them he had American business interests.
ex.cn: 很可能他已经告诉他们自己拥有美国商业利益.

ex.en: We aimed the microscope at a likely looking target.
ex.cn: 我们把显微镜对准了一个看起来合适的目标。

ex.en: The fires are likely to permanently deforest the land.
ex.cn: 这些火灾很可能会彻底毁掉这片土地上的森林。

def:
n.段落,分段符号
vt.将…分段,写短文报导

ex.en: Look at the information that precedes the paragraph in question.
ex.cn: 查看正在讨论的这段文字前面的信息。

ex.en: The length of a paragraph depends on the information it conveys.
ex.cn: 段落的长度取决于它所传达的信息。

ex.en: The second paragraph startled me even more than the first.
ex.cn: 第二段比第一段更让我吃惊。

def:
vt.离开,放弃，抛弃,停止，中断,偿清
vi.停止,放弃斗争,辞职
adj.自由的,摆脱了责任或义务的

ex.en: Well, parenthetically, I was trying to quit smoking at the time.
ex.cn: 嗯，插一句，我那时正在努力戒烟。

ex.en: He quit his job as an office boy in Athens.
ex.cn: 他辞去了在雅典当办公室勤杂工的工作。

ex.en: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.
ex.cn: 他辞去法国总理职务并非出于自愿。

def:
n.剩余物，残骸,残余,遗迹,遗体
vi.留下,保持,留待,依然
vi.& link-v.搁置,剩余，剩下,逗留,终属，归于

ex.en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
ex.cn: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

ex.en: It'd be better for a place like this to remain closed.
ex.cn: 像这种地方最好一直关闭。

ex.en: The $40 million-a-month aid payments will remain on ice.
ex.cn: 每月4,000万美元的援助款项将继续搁置下去。

def:
n.看法,风景,视域,[建筑学]视图
vt.看,看待

ex.en: The British public viewdata service.
ex.cn: 英国公用可视数据服务系统.

ex.en: In communications, the use of domestic terminal , e . g . , viewdata, to order goodsfrom a supplier.
ex.cn: 在通信技术中, 利用 家用终端, 如可视数据检索系统等, 向供应者订货.

def:
adj.适当的,恰当的,合适的
v.盗用,侵吞,拨（专款等）

ex.en: A sense of period was evoked by complementing pictures with appropriate furniture.
ex.cn: 给照片配上一些合适的家具，唤起了一种年代感。

ex.en: It is appropriate that Irish names dominate the list.
ex.cn: 名单上大部分是爱尔兰名字，这没什么不合适的。

ex.en: Most vacancies are at senior level, requiring appropriate qualifications.
ex.cn: 大多数空缺属于高层职位，要求具备相应的资历。

def: n.十年，十年间,十个一组,十年期

ex.en: These developments were foreseen in embryo more than a decade ago.
ex.cn: 这些发展早在十多年前的萌芽阶段就已预见到。

ex.en: Breakfast television arrived in British life precisely a decade ago.
ex.cn: 准确地说，早间电视节目于10年前进入英国人的生活。

ex.en: A decade later, the company has gone from strength to strength.
ex.cn: 十年后，该公司已经逐渐壮大。

def: adv.高度地,极，非常,非常赞许地

ex.en: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
ex.cn: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

ex.en: People at the club think very highly of him.
ex.cn: 俱乐部的人很佩服他。

ex.en: It is difficult to praise this immaculately researched work too highly.
ex.cn: 这项研究工作毫无瑕疵，怎样称赞都不过分。

def:
n.过程,工序,做事方法,工艺流程
vt.加工,处理,审阅,审核
vi.列队行进
adj.经过特殊加工（或处理）的

ex.en: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
ex.cn: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

ex.en: He said parliament and the process of democracy had been debased.
ex.cn: 他说议会和民主程序已遭贬值。

ex.en: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral.
ex.cn: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

def:
n.速度,比率,等级,（利息等的）费率
vt.估价,值得,责骂,定级
vt.& vi.认为，把…算作
vi.被评价,被认为,被列入,申斥

ex.en: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
ex.cn: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

ex.en: The rate of inflation is running at about 2.7 percent.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀率大约为2.7%。

ex.en: He is the least appealing character, to me at any rate.
ex.cn: 他是其中最没有吸引力的角色，至少对我来说是这样。

def:
n.部分,节,部件,部门
vi.切开,切断,做（动物或植物组织）切片,把（精神病患者）正式送入精神病院
vt.把…切成片（或段）,作…的切片,把…作成截面,制作…的剖面图

ex.en: the sectional interests of managers and workers
ex.cn: 管理层和广大工人的不同利益

ex.en: Perhaps the opposed parties will lay aside their sectional interests and rise to this challenge.
ex.cn: 也许各反对党会撇开派系利益，迎接这一挑战。

ex.en: He criticized the selfish attitude of certain sectional interests.
ex.cn: 他批评了某些利益团体自私自利的态度。

def: n.体系，系统,制度,身体,方法

n.账，账目,存款,记述，报告,理由
vi.解释,导致,报账
vt.认为,把…视作

ex.en: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.
ex.cn: 你必须将该处房产的资本增值考虑在内。

ex.en: He figured up the balance in their checking account.
ex.cn: 他算出了他们活期存款账户上的余额总和。

ex.en: The direction of the prevailing winds should be taken into account.
ex.cn: 应该将盛行风的方向考虑在内。

def:
n.有利条件,益处,优越（性）,处于支配地位
vt.有利于,有益于,促进,使处于有利地位
vi.得益，获利

ex.en: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
ex.cn: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

ex.en: She took advantage of him even after they were divorced.
ex.cn: 甚至在他们离婚后，她还在占他的便宜。

ex.en: The government have not been able to turn today'sdemonstration to their advantage.
ex.cn: 政府未能把今天的游行示威转为己用。

def:
vt.改变,更改,改建（房屋）,（人）变老
vi.改变,修改

ex.en: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.
ex.cn: 她首先是丈夫的知己。

ex.en: The current division of labor between workers and management will alter.
ex.cn: 当前工人与管理部门的分工将会改变。

ex.en: Barry Humphries's alter ego Dame Edna has taken the US by storm.
ex.cn: 巴里·汉弗莱斯凭借埃德娜夫人一角轰动全美。

def:
vt.& vi.接近，走近，靠近
vt.接近,着手处理,使移近,试图贿赂（或影响，疏通）
n.方法,途径,接近
vi.靠近

ex.en: We have a very communicative approach to teaching languages.
ex.cn: 我们在语言教学中非常强调交际教学法。

ex.en: At their approach the little boy scurried away and hid.
ex.cn: 他们走近时，小男孩急忙跑开藏了起来。

ex.en: The traffic on the approach road slowed to a crawl.
ex.cn: 引路上车辆行驶缓慢。

def: n.态度,看法,姿势,个人风格

ex.en: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
ex.cn: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

ex.en: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
ex.cn: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

ex.en: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
ex.cn: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

def: n.环境，外界,周围，围绕,工作平台,（运行）环境

ex.en: Outside the protected environment of institutional care he could not survive.
ex.cn: 离开福利机构的照顾，离开这种受保护的环境，他将难以生存下去。

ex.en: His independence had been forged on the anvil of a harsh environment.
ex.cn: 他的独立性是在艰苦的环境中锤炼出来的。

ex.en: The plans will be examined by EU environment ministers.
ex.cn: 欧盟各国环境部部长将仔细研究这些计划。

def:
n.专家，能手,权威,行家，高手,熟练者
adj.专家的,（技术）熟练的,老手,需要专门知识（或技术）的
vt.以专家身份研究（或检查），像专家那样研究（或检查）,由专家审读（书籍等）
vi.做专家工作，担任专家，成为高手（或能手）

ex.en: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition.
ex.cn: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

ex.en: I'm a limited and obtuse clergyman while you're the expert.
ex.cn: 你是专家，而我是个能力有限的愚笨牧师。

ex.en: His papers were proof against all but the most expert of scrutinies.
ex.cn: 他的论文几乎可以经受住最专业的审查。

def:
n.功能，作用,应变量，函数,职务,重大聚会
vi.有或起作用,行使职责

ex.en: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the agency's mission.
ex.cn: 要完成该机构的使命，他的作用至关重要。

ex.en: They were decked out in tracksuits, seemingly to dissimulate their true function.
ex.cn: 他们都穿着田径服，似乎想掩饰他们的真实职能。

ex.en: A complex engine has many separate components, each performing a different function.
ex.cn: 一个复杂发动机有很多独立零部件，每个零部件具有不同作用。

def:
adj.工业的，产业的,从事工业的,供工业用的,来自勤劳的
n.工业股票,工业工人

ex.en: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
ex.cn: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

ex.en: The functionalist model of industrial society was subjected to conceptual criticism.
ex.cn: 工业社会的实用主义模型在概念上遭到了批判。

ex.en: Its trade and industrial policies should be used more ambitiously.
ex.cn: 其贸易和工业政策的适用范围应该扩大。

def:
vt.意欲，计划,为特殊目的而设计,为特定用途而打算,意指或意味
vi.怀有某种意图或目的

ex.en: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
ex.cn: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

ex.en: It's only fair to let her know that you intend to apply.
ex.cn: 告诉她你打算申请，这才算公平嘛。

ex.en: They intend to claim for damages against the three doctors.
ex.cn: 他们打算向那3位医生索要损害赔偿。

def:
vt.预言，预测,预示，预告
vi.预言，预示：预言某事，预言

ex.en: The test can accurately predict what a bigger explosion would do.
ex.cn: 该试验能准确地预测一次更大爆炸的威力。

ex.en: There's no way to predict the future health of the banking industry.
ex.cn: 银行业未来是否会兴旺发达根本无法预测。

ex.en: Many predict 1991 will rival the great vintage of 1965.
ex.cn: 许多人预测1991年酿制的葡萄酒可以与1965年生产的佳酿相媲美。

def:
vt.& vi.（把…）联系起来,讲，叙述（故事等）
vt.讲述，叙述,使…有联系,建立或展示联系
vi.有联系,涉及,符合,发生共鸣

ex.en: Other recommendations relate to the details of how such data is stored.
ex.cn: 其他建议涉及此类信息储存方面的一些细节。

ex.en: There were officials to whom he could relate the whole story.
ex.cn: 有一些官员会听他讲述整个故事。

ex.en: Afternoon groups relate to the specific addictions and problems therein.
ex.cn: 下午的小组谈到具体的上瘾病例以及其中的问题。

def: n.行动，活动,功能，作用,手段,[法]诉讼

ex.en: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
ex.cn: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

ex.en: Now there is a dawning realisation that drastic action is necessary.
ex.cn: 现在人们开始意识到必须采取断然的行动。

ex.en: The lift started off, juddered, and went out of action.
ex.cn: 电梯开动了，接着剧烈震颤起来，然后就毫无反应了。

def:
vt.影响,假装,感动,（疾病）侵袭
n.感情，情感，心情,[精神病学]（表露或觉察到的）情绪反应

ex.en: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
ex.cn: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。

ex.en: Scientists call this the "it won't affect me" syndrome.
ex.cn: 科学家把这种现象称为“我无所谓”的典型表现。

ex.en: Price changes must not adversely affect the living standards of the people.
ex.cn: 物价变化一定不能给人们的生活水准带来负面影响。

def:
vt.坚决主张,提出理由证明,说服，劝告,表明，证明
vi.争论，辩论,提出理由

ex.en: Few would argue that this team has experience and proven ability.
ex.cn: 这个队伍的丰富经验和表现出来的实力是众所公认的。

ex.en: I don't think many people would argue with that.
ex.cn: 我认为多数人不会对此有异议。

ex.en: They egged each other on to argue and to fight.
ex.cn: 他们互相拱火，大打大闹。

def: n.通讯，通信,交流,书信,传达

ex.en: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
ex.cn: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

ex.en: She'd never received the merest hint of any communication from him.
ex.cn: 她从未得到他准备沟通的一丁点儿暗示。

ex.en: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
ex.cn: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

def: adj.电子的,电子操纵的,用电子设备生产的,用电子设备完成的

ex.en: All the royal cars are fitted with electronic homing devices.
ex.cn: 所有的皇家轿车都装有电子自导引装置。

ex.en: The company invested thousands in an electronic order-control system.
ex.cn: 公司耗资数千购买了一套电子订单管理系统。

ex.en: It was a seamless procession of wonderful electronic music.
ex.cn: 这是一曲优美流畅的电子乐曲。

def:
adj.自主的,不相关连的,无党派的,不相干的人所做的（或提供的）
n.独立自主的人,无党派人士

ex.en: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

ex.en: The Independent Labour Party was founded in Bradford on January 13, 1893.
ex.cn: 独立工党1893年1月13日在布拉德福德成立。

ex.en: If the clubs cannot conclude a deal, an independent tribunal will decide.
ex.cn: 如果俱乐部之间无法达成协议，将由一个独立的仲裁委员会来裁定。

def:
adj.个人的,独特的,个别的
n.个人,个体

ex.en: Tourism is up, jobs are up, individual income is up.
ex.cn: 旅游火了，工作机会多了，个人收入涨了。

ex.en: This was a matter for decision by the individual.
ex.cn: 这件事需要个人自己决定。

ex.en: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
ex.cn: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

def:
vt.推断,猜想，推理,暗示,意指
vi.作出推论

ex.en: People usually infer an unknown fact from a known fact.
ex.cn: 人们通常从已知的事实中推断未知的事实.

ex.en: From this study we can reasonably infer that this behaviour is inherited.
ex.cn: 根据这项研究我们可以合理地推断出这种行为是遗传的.

ex.en: What do you infer from the voting figures?
ex.cn: 你从选举数字中可以推出什么结论 呢 ?

def: vt.保持,保养,坚持,固执己见

ex.en: In New Zealand, the Maori people maintain a strong cultural tradition.
ex.cn: 在新西兰，毛利人保持着深厚的文化传统。

ex.en: The government was right to maintain interest rates at a high level.
ex.cn: 政府维持高利率的做法是正确的。

ex.en: The psychiatrist must learn to maintain an unusual degree of objectivity.
ex.cn: 精神科医生务必要学会保持超乎寻常的客观态度。

def:
n.模式,花样，样品,图案,榜样，典范
vt.模仿,以图案装饰
vi.形成图案

ex.en: She'll show you how to co-ordinate pattern and colours.
ex.cn: 她会教你如何搭配款式和颜色。

ex.en: The restructuring of the pattern of consumption in Britain also lagged behind.
ex.cn: 在消费结构重组方面，英国也落后于人。

ex.en: The kinked line in chart 1 represents this pattern.
ex.cn: 图表1中的曲线表现了这一模式。

def: n.产品,结果,乘积,作品

ex.en: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.
ex.cn: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

ex.en: Editorially, they never really became a unique distinct product.
ex.cn: 就立场和观点来说，它们从未真正做到树立起自己独具一格的视角。

ex.en: As the domestic market becomes saturated, firms begin to export the product.
ex.cn: 由于国内市场饱和，各公司开始外销。

def:
vt.放映,计划,发射,展现，使突出
vi.伸出，突出

ex.en: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
ex.cn: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

ex.en: The total cost of the project would be more than $240 million.
ex.cn: 该项目的总成本会超过2.4亿美元。

ex.en: The Channel Tunnel project is the biggest civil engineering project in Europe.
ex.cn: 英吉利海峡隧道是欧洲最大的土木工程。

def: adj.尽责的,承担责任,负有责任的,懂道理的

n.根源，本源,源头，水源,原因,提供消息的人
vt.（从…）获得,发起,向…提供消息,寻求（尤指供货）的来源
vi.原料来源,起源,寻求来源,寻求生产商（或提供商）

ex.en: It was first mentioned in a 1989 roleplaying game sourcebook.
ex.cn: 1989的一个角色扮演游戏资料设定集首次提到全息网.

ex.en: This story is expanded in The Truce of Bakura Sourcebook by Kathy Tyers and Eric S.
ex.cn: 这个故事在KathyTyers和EricS.Trautmann合著的《巴库拉停战资料书》中得到了扩展.

ex.en: A truly unique and inspirational sourcebook for all the design and advertising world.
ex.cn: 对于设计和广告界的从业人员是一本真正独特的富有创意的参考资料.

def:
n.标题,头衔,[体]冠军,[影视]字幕
vt.加标题,赋予头衔,把…称为
adj.头衔的,标题的,冠军的

ex.en: The second story in the book is titled "The Scholar"
ex.cn: 书中的第二个故事题为《学者》。

ex.en: Pirandello titled his play "Six Characters in Search of an Author"
ex.cn: 皮兰德娄把他的戏剧命名为《六个寻找作者的剧中人》。

ex.en: Volume Two, sub-titled "The Lawyers", will also attract considerable attention.
ex.cn: 副标题为“律师”的第二册也将获得广泛关注。

def: n.能力，资格,能耐，才能

ex.en: Few would argue that this team has experience and proven ability.
ex.cn: 这个队伍的丰富经验和表现出来的实力是众所公认的。

ex.en: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
ex.cn: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

ex.en: Depression lowers the human ability to cope with disease.
ex.cn: 抑郁症会降低人体对疾病的抵抗力。

def: n.争论，争吵,论据,[数]幅角,主题，情节

adj.平常的,平均的,典型的,（价值、比率等的）平均数的
n.平均水平,（速度等的）平均率,平均估价
vt.[数学] 计算…的平均值,调和，拉平,分摊,按比例（或平均）分配（利润等）
vi.平均：作为或达到一个中间值,维持（有利的）平均价格

ex.en: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
ex.cn: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

ex.en: In 1970 the average size of a French farm was 19 hectares.
ex.cn: 1970年，法国农场的平均规模为19公顷。

ex.en: Its profits are rising four times faster than the average company.
ex.cn: 它的利润增长速度比一般公司快4倍。

def: vt.避开，避免，预防,[法]使无效，撤销，废止

ex.en: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
ex.cn: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

ex.en: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision.
ex.cn: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

ex.en: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole.
ex.cn: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。

def:
adj.令人满意的,值得拥有的,可取的,性感的
n.称心如意的人[东西]

ex.en: The crowd moved indoors for what were deemed the most desirable items.
ex.cn: 人群为了被视为最值得拥有的物品涌入屋里。

ex.en: Rolls Royce produces around 1,000 extremely desirable cars a year.
ex.cn: 劳斯莱斯公司每年生产约1,000辆非常吸引人的汽车。

ex.en: The most desirable properties necessarily command astonishingly high prices.
ex.cn: 最值得拥有的财产必然要价不菲。

def:
n.详述,（照片、绘画等的）细部,细目，琐碎,各种细节
vt.详述，仔细汇报,选派,清晰地说明,给于细部装饰

ex.en: No detail was too small to escape her attention.
ex.cn: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

ex.en: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
ex.cn: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

ex.en: The painting had been executed with meticulous attention to detail.
ex.cn: 画这幅画的时候，画家非常注意细节。

def:
n.因素,<数>因子,代理人
vt.把…因素包括进去,[数学]分解…的因子，将…分解成因子,以代理商（或管家等）的身份行事，做代理商（或管家）
vi.做代理商（或管家）

ex.en: Stress, both human and mechanical, may also be a contributing factor.
ex.cn: 来自人的和机械方面的压力可能也是一个因素。

ex.en: Environmentalists say a critical factor in the city's pollution is its population.
ex.cn: 环境保护主义者说造成该城市污染问题的一个关键因素是其人口数量。

ex.en: This factor will come increasingly to the fore as election day nears.
ex.cn: 随着选举日的临近，这一因素将愈发重要。

def:
n.发现物,研究结果,调查（或研究）的结果,<律>（陪审团的）裁决
v.发现( find的现在分词)

ex.en: Bosses have a way of always finding out about such things.
ex.cn: 老板总喜欢把这类事情搞清楚。

ex.en: Once he knew his father's name, finding his whereabouts proved surprisingly easy.
ex.cn: 一旦他知道了父亲的名字，查找他父亲的下落就变得出奇地容易。

ex.en: Finding a volunteer to write the computer program isn't a problem.
ex.cn: 找个志愿者编这个计算机程序不成问题。

def: vt.& vi.暗示,意味,隐含,说明，表明

ex.en: Cheerfulness doesn't always imply happiness.
ex.cn: 快活并不总是意味着幸福.

ex.en: What did she imply in her words?
ex.cn: 她的话意味着什么?

ex.en: What do you imply by that statement?
ex.cn: 你那句话有什么含意?

def: adv.越来越多地,日益，格外,越来越…,愈

ex.en: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
ex.cn: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

ex.en: The baron became increasingly heated over the hypocrisy of it all.
ex.cn: 男爵对整件事的虚伪感到越来越生气。

ex.en: She felt nervous, increasingly lacking in confidence about herself.
ex.cn: 她感到紧张，对自己越来越没有信心。

def:
n.问题,（报刊的）期，号,发行物,流出
vt.发行,发布,流出
vi.发行,造成…结果,在…上挑起争论

ex.en: The key issue was whether the four defendants acted dishonestly.
ex.cn: 关键问题是4名被告是否存在欺诈行为。

ex.en: She avoided the issue by ordering a turkey sandwich.
ex.cn: 她点了份火鸡三明治，以此来避开这个重要问题。

ex.en: He said the issue was not a major irritant.
ex.cn: 他说那个问题不是什么大问题。

def:
n.标签,称标记，符号,[建] 门或窗户上面的线脚
vt.贴标签于,把…称为,把…列为,[化]用放射性元素使（元素或原子等）示踪

ex.en: "Eat before Jul 14" was stamped on the label.
ex.cn: 标签上印着“请于7月14日前食用”。

ex.en: "Eat before JULY 14" was stamped on the label.
ex.cn: 标签上盖有“7月14日前食用”的戳记。

ex.en: I can't bear people who make judgements and label me.
ex.cn: 我讨厌人们对我品头论足。

def:
adj.有限的,（君主权力）受宪法限制的,〈美〉乘客名额有限制的,（智力，能力等）有限的
n.高级快车,直达的火车或汽车

ex.en: So far we have had ringing declarations, but only limited action.
ex.cn: 目前，我们已经发表了一些有力的声明，但只采取了有限的行动。

ex.en: Nerve cells have limited ability to regenerate if destroyed.
ex.cn: 如果受到损伤，神经细胞再造的能力有限。

ex.en: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
ex.cn: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

def:
n.开幕，开始,空缺的职位,[商]开盘，交易开始时间,（职位的）空缺
adj.首次的，开始的
v.（打）开( open的现在分词),开始,睁开,启动

ex.en: He flipped through the post without opening any of it.
ex.cn: 他飞快地翻了一下邮件，但一封也没有打开。

ex.en: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
ex.cn: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

ex.en: Before opening the front door he lifted the cases experimentally.
ex.cn: 在打开前门之前，他试探性地提起了那些箱子。

def: n.<主英>组织，机构，团体

ex.en: We can't do without the help of your organisation.
ex.cn: 我们不能没有你们机构的帮助。

ex.en: Mr Dobson promised to widen the organisation's scope of activity.
ex.cn: 多布森先生许诺拓宽该组织的活动范围。

ex.en: My grumble is with the structure and organisation of the material.
ex.cn: 我所不满的是素材的结构和组织。

def:
n.组织,机构,团体
adj.有组织的

ex.en: The term "organization" often connotes a sense of neatness.
ex.cn: organization这个词常常让人想到整洁。

ex.en: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.
ex.cn: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。

ex.en: Deep down, she supported her husband'sinvolvement in the organization.
ex.cn: 在心底里，她支持丈夫参加这个组织。

def:
adj.潜在的，有可能的,[语法学]可能语气的，表示可能性的,有能力的
n.潜力，潜能,[物]电位，势能,潜能的事物,[语]可能语气

ex.en: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
ex.cn: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

ex.en: Many West Germans are anxious about the potential cost of unification.
ex.cn: 许多西德人都很担忧国家统一的潜在代价。

ex.en: We are aware of the potential problems and have taken every precaution.
ex.cn: 我们已意识到潜在的问题，并采取了全面的预防措施。

def:
adj.专业的,专业性的,职业的
n.专业人士

ex.en: He seemed fond of her in a strictly professional way.
ex.cn: 他似乎只是出于职业缘故而喜欢她。

ex.en: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
ex.cn: 中尉，做这些事情我是新手，你是行家。

ex.en: Support for monogamy and marriage was strongest among the professional classes.
ex.cn: 专业人士阶层最支持一夫一妻制。

def:
conj.如果,假如,在…的条件下
v.提供，供给( provide的过去式和过去分词)

ex.en: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
ex.cn: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

ex.en: Free room and board are provided for all hotel staff.
ex.cn: 宾馆的所有员工都可享受免费膳宿。

ex.en: Bob Marley provided them with their first taste of Reggae music.
ex.cn: 鲍勃·马利让他们首次接触到了雷盖音乐。

def:
vt.（使）散开，（使）分散，驱散
vi.撒开,分散
n.撒布，散播

ex.en: Aunt Mary is such a scatterbrain that she always forgets something.
ex.cn: 玛丽阿姨糊里糊涂的,她总是忘东忘西.

ex.en: He is a scatterbrain.
ex.cn: 他是一个注意力不集中的人.

def: adj.分散的,零散的,疏落的,到处都是…的

adj.重要的,有意义的,有重大意义的,值得注意的
n.有意义的事物,象征，标志

ex.en: She looked up at me significantly, raising an eyebrow.
ex.cn: 她抬起头，眉毛扬起，意味深长地看着我。

ex.en: Significantly, the company recently opened a huge store in Atlanta.
ex.cn: 值得注意的是，该公司最近在亚特兰大开了一家大型商店。

ex.en: America's airlines have significantly higher productivity than European ones.
ex.cn: 美国航空公司的工作效率比欧洲航空公司要高出很多。

def:
n.结构,构造,建筑物,体系
vt.构成，排列,安排

vi.幸存，活下来
vt.比…活得长，经历…之后还存在,幸存
vt.& vi.幸免于难,挺过,艰难度过

ex.en: Rafferty was the sole survivor from the successful Ireland team of 1988.
ex.cn: 拉弗蒂是1988年红极一时的爱尔兰队硕果仅存的球员。

ex.en: A survivor was knocked unconscious when the helicopter ditched.
ex.cn: 在直升机紧急迫降时，一名幸存者被撞昏过去。

ex.en: Above all Susie is a great survivor, with a bright, indomitable spirit.
ex.cn: 总之，苏茜不畏艰难，开朗乐观、不屈不挠。

def:
vi.消失,突然不见,消亡，消灭,[数]化为零
vt.使消失，使不见
n.[语音学]消失音，弱化音

vt.放弃，抛弃,离弃，丢弃,使屈从,停止进行，终止
n.放任，放纵,完全屈从于压制

ex.en: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
ex.cn: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

ex.en: The market might abandon the stock, and knock down its price.
ex.cn: 市场可能会抛售该股票，从而令其股价下跌。

ex.en: The scheme's investors, fearful of bankruptcy, decided to abandon the project.
ex.cn: 因为担心破产，该计划的投资者决定放弃这个项目。

def:
vt.提倡,拥护,鼓吹,为…辩护
n.（辩护）律师,提倡者,支持者

ex.en: He is a keen advocate of park-and-ride schemes.
ex.cn: 他是“停车再换乘”计划的热情拥护者。

ex.en: The group does not advocate the use of violence.
ex.cn: 该团体不支持使用暴力。

ex.en: Often the interviewer will need to play devil's advocate in order to get a discussion going.
ex.cn: 采访者常常需要故意唱唱反调以使访谈继续下去。

def:
n.平衡,天平,平衡力,（酿酒配料的）均衡
vt.& vi.（使）平衡,（使）均衡,（使）相抵,权衡
vt.结平（账目）,使（在某物上）保持平衡,使（各部分）协调,用天平称
vi.微微摇摆,倾斜后又复平衡,动摇,被补偿

ex.en: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
ex.cn: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

ex.en: He figured up the balance in their checking account.
ex.cn: 他算出了他们活期存款账户上的余额总和。

ex.en: I'd like to check the balance in my account please.
ex.cn: 请查一下我的账户余额。

def: n.结果，成果,[逻]结论,重要性,推论

adj.现在的,最近的,流行的,流传的
n.趋势,电流,水流,涌流

ex.en: The tidal stream or current gradually decreases in the shallows.
ex.cn: 浅滩上的潮水逐渐退去。

ex.en: He must sell the house for the current market value.
ex.cn: 他必须以目前的市价出售这座房子。

ex.en: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
ex.cn: 现行雇佣法要变，要奖勤罚懒。

def:
n.下降,（力量、健康、品格、权力、价值等的）衰退,下倾,（人、生命等的）衰退期
vt.& vi.辞谢，谢绝（邀请等）
vi.（道路、物体等）下倾,（太阳）落下,（在品格、价值上）降低,衰落，谢绝
vt.谢绝，婉拒

ex.en: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
ex.cn: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

ex.en: The electoral fortunes of the Liberal Democratic party may decline.
ex.cn: 自由民主党的选举运势可能会下降。

ex.en: He criticised the government for failing to halt economic decline.
ex.cn: 他批评政府未能遏止经济下滑。

def:
n.疾病,弊端,不安
vt.传染,使…有病

ex.en: The conditions are ripe for the spread of disease.
ex.cn: 这种疾病传播的条件已经成熟。

ex.en: The disease wiped out 40 million rabbits at a stroke.
ex.cn: 该疾病一下子就使4,000万只兔子丧命。

ex.en: Smoking places you at serious risk of cardiovascular and respiratory disease.
ex.cn: 吸烟会大大增加罹患心血管和呼吸道疾病的风险。

def: n.节约,经济,理财,秩序

ex.en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
ex.cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

ex.en: Their ultimate aim was a market economy for Hungary.
ex.cn: 他们最终的目标是为匈牙利建立起市场经济体制。

ex.en: International investors have become jittery about the country's economy.
ex.cn: 国际投资者已对该国的经济状况感到紧张不安。

def:
vt.吸引住,聘用,与…交战
vi.与…建立密切关系,衔接,从事,紧密结合

ex.en: You can engage in croquet on the south lawn.
ex.cn: 你可以参加南边草坪上的槌球游戏。

ex.en: Press the lever until you hear the catch engage.
ex.cn: 压下挡杆，直到听到挡挂好。

ex.en: They never learned skills to engage the attention of the others.
ex.cn: 他们从未学过吸引他人注意的技巧。

def: vt.建立，创建,确立或使安全,使被安排好,使成为

ex.en: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
ex.cn: 我们正努力在这些团体和金融机构之间建立联系。

ex.en: He explored the wound with his finger, trying to establish its extent.
ex.cn: 他用手指摸了摸伤口，想要确定受伤的程度。

ex.en: His opportunity to re-establish himself had been nobbled by the manager's tactics.
ex.cn: 他重新树立自己地位的机会因教练的战术而流产了。

def:
n.证词,证据,迹象,明显
vt.使明显,显示,表明,证实

ex.en: He found evidence of mutated forms of the gene.
ex.cn: 他找到了该基因出现了变异形式的证据。

ex.en: He based his conclusions on the evidence given by the captured prisoners.
ex.cn: 他根据被俘囚犯提供的证据得出了这个结论。

ex.en: This evidence supports their contention that the outbreak of violence was prearranged.
ex.cn: 这一证据证实了他们的观点，即此次突发暴力事件是有预谋的。

def: n.存在，实在,生活，生活方式,实体，存在物

ex.en: He had been a rock in the shifting sands of her existence.
ex.cn: 他一直是她曲折坎坷的生活中的主心骨。

ex.en: No reference to their existence appears in any literature of the period.
ex.cn: 这一时期的文学作品中都没有提及他们的存在。

ex.en: Temperature records have unequivocally confirmed the existence of global warming.
ex.cn: 气温记录清楚无疑地证实了全球气候正在变暖。

def:
vt.& vi.延伸,扩大,推广
vt.伸展,给予,延长,发出（邀请、欢迎等）
vi.伸出,延伸,增加

ex.en: The new territory would extend over one-fifth of Canada's land mass.
ex.cn: 这块新领土将会使加拿大陆地面积扩展1/5以上。

ex.en: This year they have introduced three new products to extend their range.
ex.cn: 今年他们发布了3种新产品，以扩大产品范围。

ex.en: It might be possible to extend the technique to other crop plants.
ex.cn: 也许可以将这种技术应用于其他农作物。

def: n.公路,公用通道,干线,途径，方法

ex.en: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
ex.cn: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

ex.en: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
ex.cn: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

ex.en: Chris crawled on his hands and knees out onto the highway.
ex.cn: 克里斯手脚并用爬上了公路。

def: n.管理,管理人员,管理技巧，处事的能力

ex.en: The governors were joined by Mr Hunter and his management team.
ex.cn: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

ex.en: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
ex.cn: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

ex.en: He is known for his political savvy and strong management skills.
ex.cn: 他以睿智的政治头脑和强势的管理手腕出名。

def:
n.信息,消息,要旨,教训
v.给…发消息,给…留言

ex.en: The delegation was carrying a message of thanks to President Mubarak.
ex.cn: 代表团向穆巴拉克总统转达了谢意。

ex.en: I got a message you were trying to reach me.
ex.cn: 我收到一条留言，说你想跟我联系。

ex.en: Stationery can be imprinted with your message or logo.
ex.cn: 可以把你的信息或标志印在信纸上。

def:
vt.获得，得到,流行,买到，达到（目的）
vi.通行，通用,流行,存在

ex.en: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
ex.cn: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

ex.en: Gregory'sfather had implanted in him an ambition to obtain an education.
ex.cn: 格雷戈里的父亲早就向他灌输了要接受教育的志向。

ex.en: Offshoring provides an opportunity to obtain I.T. services at low cost.
ex.cn: 离岸外包提供了以低成本获得信息技术服务的机会。

def: vt.认出，识别出某人[某事物],承认…有效[属实],认可,承认[认清]（某事物）

ex.en: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
ex.cn: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

ex.en: They only recognise badness when they perceive it in others.
ex.cn: 他们只看到别人身上的恶行。

ex.en: The machine can recognise hand-written characters and turn them into printed text.
ex.cn: 这种机器能够识别手写字体，并将其转化为打印文本。

def:
vt.认出,识别,承认
vi.承认，确认,[法律]具结，立保证书

n.股份，股票,库存,树干,家畜
adj.常备的，存货的,陈旧的
vt.提供货物,备有
vi.出新芽,囤积

ex.en: I had not gone a hundred yards when I reached the stockade.
ex.cn: 我跑了不到一百码,就到了木寨前.

ex.en: At length I thought I might return towards the stockade.
ex.cn: 我终于觉得可以折回来向木寨方向走去了.

ex.en: A heavy stockade around the cabin protected the pioneer from attack.
ex.cn: 小屋周围的厚厚的栅栏保护拓荒者免受攻击。

def: n.多样,种类,杂耍,变化，多样化

adv.到国外，在海外,广为流传地
adj.往国外的
n.海外，异国

ex.en: He rented out his house while he worked abroad.
ex.cn: 他在国外工作期间把自己的房子租了出去。

ex.en: He also collects things for the house on his travels abroad.
ex.cn: 他在国外旅游时也为家宅搜集物品作为摆设。

ex.en: Most of those who left the province to work abroad were unskilled.
ex.cn: 那些离开该省出国打工的人大部分都未经专门训练。

def: n.活动,活跃，敏捷,活动力,教育活动

ex.en: The military on both sides are involved in intense activity.
ex.cn: 双方的武装力量都有密集动作。

ex.en: There are signs of paramilitary activity supported from abroad.
ex.cn: 有迹象表明，非法军事组织的活动得到了国外势力的支持。

ex.en: Mr Dobson promised to widen the organisation's scope of activity.
ex.cn: 多布森先生许诺拓宽该组织的活动范围。

def: vt.向…保证,使…确信,<英>给…保险

ex.en: This may sound trivial, but I assure you it is quite important!
ex.cn: 这听上去也许微不足道，但是，相信我，它十分重要！

ex.en: He hastened to assure me that there was nothing traumatic to report.
ex.cn: 他急忙向我保证没有什么不快的事情要说。

ex.en: Mr Brownson, I assure you King's an old enemy of mine.
ex.cn: 布朗森先生，我向你保证金是我的老冤家。

def:
prep.在…的下方,（表示等级）低于,（表示状态）在…掩饰之下,（表示环境）在…影响之下
adv.在下面,在底下

ex.en: The doctor worked busily beneath the blinding lights of the delivery room.
ex.cn: 这位医生在产房刺目的灯光下忙碌着。

ex.en: Patterson pointed toward a plain cardboard box beneath a long wooden table.
ex.cn: 帕特森指着长木桌下的一个普通的纸板箱。

ex.en: Somewhere deep beneath the surface lay a caring character.
ex.cn: 在内心深处的某个角落里埋藏着一颗爱心。

def:
n.容量,才能,性能,生产能力
adj.充其量的，最大限度的

ex.en: Spending could outrun the capacity of businesses to produce the goods.
ex.cn: 消费有可能超出企业的产能。

ex.en: Grease 6 ramekin dishes of 150 ml (5-6 fl oz) capacity.
ex.cn: 将6个容量为150毫升（5至6液盎司）的烤盘涂上油。

ex.en: Her mental capacity and temperament are as remarkable as his.
ex.cn: 她的才智和气质和他一样出众。

def: n.结论,结局,断定，决定,推论

ex.en: It's almost a foregone conclusion that you'll get what you want.
ex.cn: 你将得到你想要的，这几乎是确定无疑的。

ex.en: They are hopeful of bringing the siege to a peaceful conclusion.
ex.cn: 他们希望能和平结束这次围困。

ex.en: Most voters believe the result is a foregone conclusion.
ex.cn: 多数投票者认为这个结果是意料之中的。

def: n.合同,契约,协议

ex.en: A formal contract is signed which is renewable annually.
ex.cn: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

ex.en: That contract proved to be a millstone around his neck.
ex.cn: 那个合同结果成了他的一个负担。

ex.en: The contract was awarded to a previously unknown company.
ex.cn: 合同签给了一个之前并不知名的公司。

def:
adj.相当的，对应的,通信的,符合的，符合。。,一致的
v.相符合( correspond的现在分词),类似(correspond的ing形式),相配

ex.en: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
ex.cn: 货币供应量的改变随即引起支出的相应改变。

ex.en: What we required you to do is corresponding to the contract.
ex.cn: 我们要你做的事情符合合同规定.

ex.en: It has name corresponding to the facts.
ex.cn: 它有着与事实相符的名称.

def: adj.批评的，爱挑剔的,关键的,严重的,极重要的

ex.en: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
ex.cn: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

ex.en: I hated my father. He was hyper-critical and mean.
ex.cn: 我讨厌我父亲。他吹毛求疵，刻薄无情。

ex.en: If someone says something critical I take it to heart.
ex.cn: 如果有人提出批评，我会十分介意。

def:
prep.不管,尽管（自己）不愿意,不在乎,虽有
n.侮辱,憎恨,怨恨,轻蔑的拒绝或不承认

vi.区分，辨别，分清,辨别是非
vt.区分，辨别，分清,辨别出，识别,引人注目，有别于,使杰出，使著名

ex.en: It is common to distinguish between personal and social ethics.
ex.cn: 个人道德准则和社会道德准则常常不一致。

ex.en: It is necessary to distinguish the policies of two successive governments.
ex.cn: 分清前后两届政府的政策很有必要。

ex.en: There were cries, calls. He could distinguish voices.
ex.cn: 有哭声、喊声——他能听出不同的声音。

def:
n.散文,随笔，杂记文,尝试，企图,试验
vt.尝试,试验

n.费用,花费的钱,消耗,花钱的东西
vt.向…收取费用,把…作为开支勾销

ex.en: Owen was against it, on the grounds of expense.
ex.cn: 欧文因费用问题对此表示反对。

ex.en: I'll try to save him the expense of a flight from Perth.
ex.cn: 我会设法替他省下要从珀斯飞来的机票费用。

ex.en: He put Elizabeth's motel bill and airfare on his expense account.
ex.cn: 他将伊丽莎白住汽车旅馆的费用和机票费用记在他的报销账目中。

def: adj.财政的,财务的,金融的,有钱的

ex.en: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
ex.cn: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

ex.en: The Government's financial squeeze had killed the scheme off.
ex.cn: 政府的财政困难已使这个计划成为泡影。

ex.en: They would like to hand over their financial affairs to another body.
ex.cn: 他们想把自己的财务移交给另一个机构管理。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）集中，（使）聚集,调整（镜头，眼睛）焦点[焦距]以便看清
vt.调整（眼睛或者镜头的）焦距,集中（光束于）,聚焦，注视,集中注意力
n.焦点,影象的清晰度,（活动、注意力、兴趣等的）中心,[医]病灶，病症

ex.en: In the background, in soft focus, we see his smiling wife.
ex.cn: 在背景部分，我们可以看到他妻子面带微笑的蒙影像。

ex.en: Their talks are expected to focus on arms control.
ex.cn: 他们的会谈预计会集中讨论军备控制问题。

ex.en: These issues were brought into sharp focus by the Gulf crisis.
ex.cn: 海湾危机让这些问题备受关注。

def: n.意图，目的,意向,意义，意旨,[医]愈合

ex.en: The president said he had no intention of deploying ground troops.
ex.cn: 总统称并不打算部署地面部队。

ex.en: Giovanni plied him with questions with the intention of prolonging his stay.
ex.cn: 乔瓦尼一个劲儿地问他问题，想要拖住他。

ex.en: Our intention was to demolish the rumours that have surrounded him.
ex.cn: 我们的目的是要彻底击破围绕他的那些谣言。

def:
n.接见,采访,面试,会谈
vt.& vi.面试
vt.采访,访问,会见,（私下）提问

ex.en: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
ex.cn: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

ex.en: As mentioned earlier, the University supplements this information with an interview.
ex.cn: 如前所述，大学将通过面试对这一信息进行补充。

ex.en: The interview reflected a growing rift between the President and the government.
ex.cn: 这段采访反映了总统和政府之间的裂痕越来越大。

def: n.多数,（获胜的）票数,成年,法定年龄

ex.en: Independent candidates won the majority of seats on the local council.
ex.cn: 无党派候选人在地方议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

ex.en: It's possible the Congress Party will scrape together a majority.
ex.cn: 国大党可能会勉强获得多数票。

ex.en: The men voted by a four-to-one majority to accept the pay offer.
ex.cn: 男雇员以4比1的多数票接受了工资条件。

def: n.方式，方法，做法,态度，样子，举止,礼貌，规矩,风俗，习惯，惯例，生活方式

ex.en: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
ex.cn: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

ex.en: Cross was a little taken aback by her abrupt manner.
ex.cn: 她鲁莽的态度让克罗斯感到有点吃惊。

ex.en: She seemed quite unaware of the sudden coolness of her friend's manner.
ex.cn: 她似乎完全没有意识到朋友的态度突然变得冷淡起来。

def:
vt.& vi.观察,研究
vt.遵守,观察,庆祝
vi.注意,说,评述,当观察员

ex.en: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
ex.cn: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

ex.en: Scientists observe the same dynamics in fluids.
ex.cn: 科学家们在液体中观察到了同样的驱动力。

ex.en: Let's observe a minute's silence in memory of the dead.
ex.cn: 让我们为死者静默一分钟.

def: adj.明显的,显著的,平淡无奇的,自明

ex.en: The ideological divisions between the parties aren't always obvious.
ex.cn: 政党之间的意识形态界线并不总是泾渭分明的。

ex.en: She persevered in her idea despite obvious objections raised by friends.
ex.cn: 虽然朋友们明确反对，她还是坚持己见。

ex.en: It's obvious that you need more time to think.
ex.cn: 显然你需要更多时间来思考。

def: n.可能，可能性,希望，可能发生的事物

ex.en: There is the possibility that hypothermia can go unrecognized.
ex.cn: 人们有可能察觉不到体温的过低。

ex.en: There is the strong possibility that such cooperation will prove unworkable.
ex.cn: 这种合作很有可能会行不通。

ex.en: He envisages the possibility of establishing direct diplomatic relations in the future.
ex.cn: 他设想在未来可以建立直接的外交关系。

def:
n.范围,射程,类别,（山脉，房屋等的）排列
vi.搜索,变化,延伸,漫游
vt.排列,（按一定位置或顺序）排序,把…分类,徘徊
adj.牧场的，放牧区的

ex.en: The company manufactures a range of innovative light-weight cycles.
ex.cn: 这家公司生产一系列的新型轻便自行车。

ex.en: The shooting-range is lit from underneath by rows of ruby-red light fittings.
ex.cn: 射击场被一排排深红色的灯光设备从下面照亮了.

ex.en: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
ex.cn: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

def: vt.替换,代替,把…放回原位,（用…）替换

ex.en: Who do you suppose will replace her on the show?
ex.cn: 你觉得谁会代替她参加这场演出？

ex.en: Around 1910 motorized carriages were beginning to replace horse-drawn cabs.
ex.cn: 大约从1910年起，机动车开始取代马车。

ex.en: Steel cable will be used to replace worn ropes.
ex.cn: 将用钢缆替换磨损的绳索。

def:
vt.& vi.回答，响应
vi.作出反应，响应,回报或回复
n.[建]（柱，拱基等的）对称，壁联

ex.en: Some cases of arthritis respond to a gluten-free diet.
ex.cn: 无麸质饮食对一些关节炎患者有疗效。

ex.en: Like any other public servants, police must respond to public demand.
ex.cn: 和其他所有公务员一样，警察必须服务于公众的需求。

ex.en: We must respond to well-founded criticism with a willingness to change.
ex.cn: 对于有根有据的批评，我们必须乐意作出改变。

def:
n.危险，冒险,保险额,被保险人或物
vt.冒…的危险,使…冒风险（或面临危险）

ex.en: I'm a blood donor; I can't risk any contagion.
ex.cn: 我是献血者，我不能冒任何接触传染的危险。

ex.en: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
ex.cn: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

ex.en: Smoking places you at serious risk of cardiovascular and respiratory disease.
ex.cn: 吸烟会大大增加罹患心血管和呼吸道疾病的风险。

def:
n.样品，华样,标本，榜样,（化验的）取样,[信]信号瞬时值
vt.取…的样品，尤指用样品来检验,品尝,抽样调查
adj.作为代表或范例的

ex.en: These figures were often spuriously computed by selecting particularly favorable sample groups.
ex.cn: 这些数字往往是用错误的方法计算出来的，所用的都是特别挑选出来的对自己有利的样本组。

ex.en: The sample was selected from the medical records of two general practices.
ex.cn: 样本选自两个全科诊所的病历档案。

ex.en: They asked me to do some sample drawings.
ex.cn: 他们请我画些样品图。

def: n.选择,被选中者,可供选择的事物

ex.en: The semantic meaning of a sentence is governed by rules called selectional restrictions.
ex.cn: 句子在语义上是否有意义是受被称为选择限制的规则支配的.

def: vt.解决,解答,解释,清偿（债务）

ex.en: Fears about the solvency of the banks precipitated the great economic crash.
ex.cn: 对银行偿付能力出现恐慌更加速了经济的崩溃.

ex.en: Their targets, including profitability ratios, solvency ratios, asset management ratios.
ex.cn: 其指标包括盈利比率 、 偿债能力比率 、 资产管理比率.

ex.en: We must demonstrate solvency in every project introduced from abroad.
ex.cn: 我们引进每一个项目都要做到必须具有偿付能力.

def:
n.走向,趋向,时尚，时髦
vi.倾向,趋势

ex.en: She's a very snappy dresser , ie She dresses very smartly and trendily.
ex.cn: 她衣着很入时.

def:
adj.广阔的,巨大的,大量的,巨额的
n.浩瀚,广大无边的空间

ex.en: The Brief Analysis of Marketing: The products as the healthy stuff , whose foreground is vastitude.
ex.cn: 市场简要分析: 所出产品属无公害、绿色食品市场前景广阔.

ex.en: Put forword vastitude exploring foreground of lathyrus sativus and some expectation in food process industry.
ex.cn: 并对山黧豆种子开发广阔前景及在食品加工中应用进行展望.

def:
adj.联邦（制）的,同盟的
n.联邦主义者,同盟盟友

ex.en: The federal government hiked the tax on hard liquor.
ex.cn: 联邦政府提高了烈性酒的税率。

ex.en: More vigorous action is needed to force the federal army to disengage.
ex.cn: 需要更强有力的行动来迫使联邦军队撤军。

ex.en: He does not believe in a federal Europe with centralising powers.
ex.cn: 他认为一个集权式联邦制在欧洲是不可行的。

def: adj.原子核的，原子能的,[细胞]细胞核的

ex.en: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
ex.cn: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

ex.en: Nuclear weapons plants across the country are heavily contaminated with toxic wastes.
ex.cn: 全国的核武器工厂均受到了有毒废弃物的严重污染。

ex.en: They have removed all tactical nuclear missiles that could strike Europe.
ex.cn: 他们已经拆除所有能够袭击欧洲的战术核导弹。

def:
n.挑战,盘问,质疑,怀疑
vt.质疑,向…挑战
vi.提出挑战，要求竞赛（或竞争）,驳斥

ex.en: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
ex.cn: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

ex.en: Online gaming allows players from around the world to challenge each other.
ex.cn: 网络游戏使得全球的玩家可以相互较量。

ex.en: This challenge will occupy Europe for a generation or more.
ex.cn: 这将是欧洲在未来二三十年或者更长的时间里所要面临的挑战。

def: n.部门,领域,防御地区,扇形

ex.en: The church can only go so far in secular matters.
ex.cn: 教会在世俗事务上只能做这么多。

ex.en: Ours is a secular society.
ex.cn: 我们的社会是个世俗社会。

ex.en: We live in an increasingly secular society.
ex.cn: 我们生活在一个日益非宗教的社会.

def:
n.时尚，时装,时装领域，时尚界,方式，方法
vt.制作，塑造,使适应

ex.en: Many of the clothes come from the world's top fashion houses.
ex.cn: 这些服装中有很多出自世界顶级时装设计公司。

ex.en: We are becoming one of the market leaders in the fashion industry.
ex.cn: 我们正在成为时装业的领军者之一。

ex.en: Queen Mary started the fashion for blue and white china in England.
ex.cn: 玛丽女王开启了青花瓷在英格兰的流行风尚。

def:
n.法院，法庭,院子，天井,宫廷,网球场
vt.招致,设法获得,向…献殷勤,追求
vi.求爱，求婚,寻求

vt.声称,断言,需要,索取
vi.提出要求
n.（根据权利而提出的）要求,声称,断言,索赔

ex.en: Jane is determined to stake her claim as an actress.
ex.cn: 简决心主张自己作为一名女演员的权利。

ex.en: You must claim your prize by telephoning our claims line.
ex.cn: 您必须通过拨打我们的领奖电话来领取奖品。

ex.en: Television censors are cutting out scenes which they claim may offend.
ex.cn: 电视节目审查官正在剪掉他们称有可能会令人反感的一些镜头。

def:
vi.凝视,盯着看,隐退，若隐若现,同等，比得上
n.同辈，同等的人,贵族,同伴，伙伴
adj.贵族的,（年龄、地位等）同等的,相匹敌的

ex.en: Lord Swan was made a life peer in 1981.
ex.cn: 斯旺勋爵于1981年受封终身贵族。

ex.en: He was made a life peer in 1991.
ex.cn: 他于1991年被封为终身贵族。

ex.en: She gets on well with her peer group.
ex.cn: 她和同龄人相处融洽。

def:
n.同盟，联盟,协会，工会,联合，团结
adj.工会的
n.正义,公正,法律制裁,审判员，法官

ex.en: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
ex.cn: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

ex.en: He was charged with conspiring to pervert the course of justice.
ex.cn: 他被控谋划妨碍司法公正。

ex.en: This courtroom battle has been a poor advert for English justice.
ex.cn: 这场法庭上的争论为英格兰的司法制度做了一次拙劣的广告。

def:
n.压（力）,压力,气压（或血压）（的缩略形式）,压（迫）感
vi.施加压力,迫使,使（机舱等）增压

ex.en: The government wilted in the face of such powerful pressure.
ex.cn: 政府面对如此大的压力，失去了信心。

ex.en: He is being constantly monitored with regular checks on his blood pressure.
ex.cn: 他被实时监测，定时量血压。

ex.en: He was under pressure to resign and was about to be sidelined.
ex.cn: 他承受着被迫辞职的压力，很快就要被排挤出去了。

def:
vt.创造，创作,产生,封爵，把…封为（贵族）
vi.[英][俚]大发脾气，大发牢骚

ex.en: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
ex.cn: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

ex.en: She asked her son, a graphic designer, to create letterheads and stationery.
ex.cn: 她请做平面设计师的儿子设计了信头和信笺。

ex.en: The superglue may not create a bond with some plastics.
ex.cn: 强力胶水可能无法粘住某些塑料。

def: vt.获得，取得,学到

ex.en: Perhaps we did acquire a somewhat fuddy-duddy image in the later years.
ex.cn: 可能在后来的几年里我们真的让人感到有些古板。

ex.en: Here is your opportunity to acquire a luxurious one bedroom home.
ex.cn: 现在正是购买一套豪华一居室住房的机会。

ex.en: He was the mastermind behind the plan to acquire the explosives.
ex.cn: 他就是密谋获取炸药的主谋。

def:
adj.成熟的,（智力、思想、行为）成熟的,成年人的,成年的
n.成年的人或动物

ex.en: I tried to understand the adult world and could not.
ex.cn: 我试着去了解成人世界，却无法猜透。

ex.en: Which adult in these children's lives will provide the nurturing they need?
ex.cn: 这些孩子生活中的哪个成人会为他们提供所需的养育呢？

ex.en: His adult life mirrored the downward course of his father's life.
ex.cn: 他成年后的生活反映出了他父亲的生活在走下坡路。

def:
n.帮助,助手,外援,辅助设备
vt.帮助,资助,救助,促进
vi.帮助

ex.en: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
ex.cn: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

ex.en: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered.
ex.cn: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。

ex.en: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.
ex.cn: 他不断出手相助这位落难女子。

def: n.分析，分解,梗概，要略,[数]解析,验定

ex.en: Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions.
ex.cn: 自始至终，她摘引讨论内容来阐明她的分析。

ex.en: As an impartial observer my analysis is supposed to be objective.
ex.cn: 作为中立的观察员，我的分析应该客观。

ex.en: The practice is to keep on record any analysis of samples.
ex.cn: 习惯上要把所有的样品分析记录在案。

def: vi.& vt.产生,出现,起身，起立,起源于，产生于

ex.en: Whatever troubles arise, we'll have peace of mind amidst seeming chaos.
ex.cn: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

ex.en: The charges arise out of a long-running fraud enquiry by Merseyside police.
ex.cn: 这些指控是默西赛德郡警方对诈骗案进行长期调查后提出的。

ex.en: The board acknowledges problems which arise from the newness of the approach.
ex.cn: 董事会承认使用新方法产生了种种问题。

def: n.信，信任,信念，意见,信条

ex.en: The Greeks accepted belief in the immortality of the soul.
ex.cn: 希腊人相信灵魂不灭。

ex.en: Sweden is lovely in summer— cold beyond belief in winter.
ex.cn: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

ex.en: America's belief in its own God-ordained uniqueness started to erode.
ex.cn: 美国人心中上帝赋予了他们独一无二的品质的信念开始逐渐丧失。

def:
n.性格,特点,字母,角色
vt.刻，印,使具有特征

ex.en: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.
ex.cn: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。

ex.en: Michael Fish is my favourite. He's a hoot, a real character.
ex.cn: 我最喜欢迈克尔·菲什。他滑稽逗趣，是个实实在在的人物。

ex.en: He is the least appealing character, to me at any rate.
ex.cn: 他是其中最没有吸引力的角色，至少对我来说是这样。

def:
n.环境，境遇,事实，细节,典礼，仪式
vt.使处于某种特定的情况之下

ex.en: You might say that we've been victims of circumstance.
ex.cn: 你可以说我们一直不走运吧。

ex.en: There are those, you know, who, by circumstance, end up homeless.
ex.cn: 您知道，会有那么一些人，因为命运捉弄而落得无家可归。

ex.en: Any unexpected circumstance that arises may catalyze a sudden escalation of violence.
ex.cn: 任何突如其来的情况都可能造成暴力骤然升级。

def: n.气候,氛围,状况,局势

ex.en: If climate changes continue, we will suffer the consequences.
ex.cn: 如果气候变化继续下去，我们将自食其果。

ex.en: In the present climate, owners are hanging on to old ships.
ex.cn: 在目前的形势下，船东们都不愿淘汰掉旧船。

ex.en: In this economic climate new ideas were few and far between.
ex.cn: 在这种经济环境下，新想法极为罕见。

def:
adj.复杂的,难懂的,复合的
n.建筑群,相关联的一组事物,情结,不正常的忧虑

ex.en: I had a persecution complex and thought people were conspiring against me.
ex.cn: 我有过被害情结，认为大家都在密谋暗算我。

ex.en: In this new book, Harrison brilliantly disentangles complex debates.
ex.cn: 在这本新作中，哈里森巧妙地理顺了那些纷繁复杂的争论。

ex.en: Today's complex buildings require close teamwork between the architect and the builders.
ex.cn: 如今的建筑结构复杂，需要建筑师和施工人员密切协作。

def: n.观念，概念,观点,思想，设想，想法,总的印象

ex.en: The snowcoach concept in Yellowstone provides low-impact, low-pollution access.
ex.cn: 在黄石公园里使用雪车这一想法，为人们提供了一种对环境低影响、低污染的游览方式。

ex.en: The concept of the Rose continued to inform the poet's work.
ex.cn: 玫瑰的概念持续贯穿于诗人的作品中。

ex.en: The Editor takes a cavalier attitude to the concept of fact checking.
ex.cn: 《编辑》杂志对于核对事实这一点采取无所谓的态度。

def:
adj.创造性的，有创造力的,有创意的，创新的，创造的
n.（非正式）创意人士

ex.en: Some thought must be given to the method of validation.
ex.cn: 一些想法必须通过验证法加以证实。

ex.en: For him, the rest of the decade was a creative write-off.
ex.cn: 对他来说，这个十年所余下的时间是一段创作空白。

ex.en: Creative people are usually very determined and thrive on overcoming obstacles.
ex.cn: 富有创造力的人一般都意志非常坚定，能不断克服困难，事业蒸蒸日上。

def: n.资料，材料,datum的复数,[计算机]数据，资料,从科学实验中提取的价值

ex.en: If they value these data, let them pay for them.
ex.cn: 他们要是看重这些数据，就让他们出钱买。

ex.en: We gained a rich supply of data which would normally be inaccessible.
ex.cn: 我们得到了通常难以获取的大量数据。

ex.en: Other recommendations relate to the details of how such data is stored.
ex.cn: 其他建议涉及此类信息储存方面的一些细节。

def: vt.查明，发现,洞察,侦察，侦查,[电子学]检波

ex.en: He conjectured that some individuals may be able to detect major calamities.
ex.cn: 他猜测说有些人也许能够察觉重大灾难。

ex.en: We are trying to detect and understand how the climates change.
ex.cn: 我们正努力探寻并理解气候是如何变化的。

ex.en: An observant doctor can often detect depression from expression, posture, and movement.
ex.cn: 善于观察的医生常常能从人的表情、姿势以及动作诊察出抑郁症。

def:
adv.直接地,不久，立即,正好地，恰好地,坦率地
conj.一…就…

ex.en: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
ex.cn: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

ex.en: Catherine saw to it that the information went directly to Walter.
ex.cn: 凯瑟琳确保这条消息直接传达给了沃尔特。

ex.en: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
ex.cn: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

def: vi.不见，消失,不复存在，灭绝

ex.en: She stood watching the car's tail-lights disappear down the drive.
ex.cn: 她站在那儿，望着小汽车的尾灯消失在车道尽头。

ex.en: He saw something dark disappear behind the curtain of leaves.
ex.cn: 他看到一个黑漆漆的东西从浓密的树叶后消失了。

ex.en: It was uncharacteristic of her father to disappear like this.
ex.cn: 就这样消失不像她父亲的一贯作风。

def: n.强调,着重,（轮廓、图形等的）鲜明,突出，重读

ex.en: The emphasis is on developing fitness through exercises and training.
ex.cn: 重点在于通过锻炼促进健康。

ex.en: His voice was angry and he spaced the words for emphasis.
ex.cn: 他的声音里透着愤怒，为了强调，他一字一顿。

ex.en: "I might have known it!" Miss Burnett said with emphasis.
ex.cn: “我早该料到了！”伯内特小姐加重语气说。

def:
adj.以前的，从前的,在前的,前任的
n.模型，样板,构成者，创造者,起形成作用的人,[无线]线圈架

ex.en: The unemployed executives include former sales managers, directors and accountants.
ex.cn: 被解雇的管理人员包括前销售经理、主管和会计。

ex.en: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
ex.cn: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

ex.en: The former owner had not left any forwarding address.
ex.cn: 以前的房主没有留下任何转递地址。

def:
vt.承认,同意,准许,授予
n.拨款,补助金,授给物（如财产、授地、专有权、补助、拨款等）
vi.同意

ex.en: She won a grant to develop her own business.
ex.cn: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

ex.en: Check whether you are entitled to a discretionary grant for your course.
ex.cn: 确定你是否有权酌情行事。

ex.en: "And he sure didn't help us," Grant said bitterly.
ex.cn: “他当然没有帮助我们，”格兰特愤愤不平地说。

def:
vt.通知,使活跃，使充满,预示
vi.通知,告发

ex.en: Teachers inform me that Tracey's behaviour has improved no end.
ex.cn: 老师们告诉我特雷西的行为大有改善。

ex.en: The concept of the Rose continued to inform the poet's work.
ex.cn: 玫瑰的概念持续贯穿于诗人的作品中。

ex.en: We simply want to inform people objectively about events.
ex.cn: 我们只是想如实地向人们通报事件情况。

def:
vt.插入,嵌入,（在文章中）添加,加插
n.添入物（尤指一页印刷品图中插入或套印的小图）,（书报的）插页,插入物,添加物

ex.en: Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
ex.cn: 把硬币放进投币口，按钮取票。

ex.en: I wish to insert an advertisement in your newspaper.
ex.cn: 我想在贵报上登一则广告.

ex.en: The newspaper had an insert of pages of pictures.
ex.cn: 该报带有数页插图.

def: n.判断，鉴定,辨别力，判断力,意见，看法,判决书

ex.en: I depended on his companionship and on his judgment.
ex.cn: 我信赖他的友情，也相信他的判断。

ex.en: Perhaps anger had clouded his vision, perhaps his judgment had been faulty.
ex.cn: 可能是愤怒蒙蔽了他的眼睛，也可能是他判断有误。

ex.en: By his own statement, there have been imperfections in his judgment.
ex.cn: 据他自己声称，他的判断存在不足之处。

def: n.判断，鉴定，评价，判断,审判，裁判，判决,看法，意见,判断力，见识

ex.en: A tide of emotion rose and clouded his judgement.
ex.cn: 心头涌起一阵强烈的感情，模糊了他的判断力。

ex.en: Jake has raised two smashing kids and I trust his judgement.
ex.cn: 杰克养大了两个了不起的孩子，我相信他的判断。

ex.en: I respect his judgement and I'll follow any advice he gives me.
ex.cn: 我尊重他的判断能力，会接受他提出的任何建议。

def:
vt.证明…有理,为…辩护,对…作出解释
vi.整理版面,证明合法

ex.en: Domestic conditions did not justify a loosening of monetary policy.
ex.cn: 国内的情况并不足以成为放松货币政策的正当理由。

ex.en: They justify every villainy in the name of high ideals.
ex.cn: 他们打着实现远大理想的幌子为他们的每件恶行开脱。

ex.en: This does not justify the denial of constitutional protection.
ex.cn: 这不能成为剥夺他人受宪法保护权利的正当理由。

def:
adj.有学问的,博学的,学术上的,精通某门学问的
v.学习(learn的过去式和过去分词),得知

ex.en: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
ex.cn: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

ex.en: I learned a lot from him about how to run a band.
ex.cn: 我从他那里学到了许多关于经营乐队方面的东西.

ex.en: She learned to draw by tracing pictures out of old storybooks.
ex.cn: 她通过描摹旧故事书上的图画学会了画画。

def:
adj.法律的,合法的,法定的,法律（上）的
n.法定权利,依法必须登报的声明

ex.en: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
ex.cn: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

ex.en: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department.
ex.cn: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

ex.en: Legal action is being taken to try to recover the money.
ex.cn: 正在进行诉讼以收回那笔钱。

def:
n.空闲时间,闲暇,悠闲,安逸
adj.空闲的,闲暇的

ex.en: The leisure facilities are there for the use of guests.
ex.cn: 这些休闲设施是供客人使用的。

ex.en: The Leisure Center is a long and low modern building.
ex.cn: 休闲中心是一个狭长而低矮的现代建筑。

ex.en: Reading books does not rate highly among Britons as a leisure activity.
ex.cn: 读书并非英国人很喜欢的休闲活动。

def:
n.大量，大多,块，堆，团,[物理学]质量,弥撒曲
vt.& vi.（使）集中，聚集
adj.群众的,大规模的,整个的,集中的
vi.聚集起来
vt.使集合

ex.en: On his desk is a mass of books and papers.
ex.cn: 他的书桌上有大堆的书籍和文件。

ex.en: In the spring, the meadow is a mass of daffodils.
ex.cn: 春天，草地上开满了黄水仙。

ex.en: Pope John Paul celebrated mass today in a city in central Poland.
ex.cn: 教皇保罗二世今天在波兰中部的一个城市主持了弥撒。

def:
adj.道德的，道义上的,精神上的,无疑的，当然的,教导道德的
n.寓意，教训,（尤指男女间的）品行,格言,〈古〉相对者

ex.en: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
ex.cn: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

ex.en: Her case falls within the ambit of moral law.
ex.cn: 她的案例属于道德法律的范畴。

ex.en: Bennett launched a crusade for "moral values" against decadent "liberal relativism."
ex.cn: 贝内特发起了一场捍卫“道德价值”、反对腐朽堕落的“自由相对论”的战争。

def: n.必要（性）,（迫切）需要,必需品,自然规律

ex.en: Some people have to lead stressful lifestyles out of necessity.
ex.cn: 一些人迫于生计不得不过着紧张忙碌的生活。

ex.en: There is agreement on the necessity of reforms.
ex.cn: 对改革的必要性已经达成了共识。

ex.en: The assembly line of necessity kept moving.
ex.cn: 生产线势必保持运转下去。

def:
adv.然而,尽管如此,不过,仍然
conj.然而,尽管如此

ex.en: The opening day of the battle was, nevertheless, accounted a success.
ex.cn: 不过，开战的首日仍被认为是成功的。

ex.en: He nevertheless completed the film with breathtaking speed.
ex.cn: 但他还是以惊人的速度拍完了这部电影。

ex.en: Our defeat was expected but it is disappointing nevertheless.
ex.cn: 我们的失败是意料中的事，尽管如此，还是令人失望。

def: n.现象，事件,奇迹,非凡的人

ex.en: This phenomenon is not as outrageous as it seems.
ex.cn: 这种现象并不像它看上去那样骇人。

ex.en: It's an interesting scientific phenomenon, but of no practical use whatever.
ex.cn: 这是一种有趣的科学现象，但没什么实用价值。

ex.en: This form of civil disobedience isn't a particularly new phenomenon.
ex.cn: 这种形式的非暴力反抗并不是特别新的现象。

def:
adj.自然（界）的,身体的,物质的,自然规律的
n.身体检查，体格检查

ex.en: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
ex.cn: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

ex.en: Character is not separable from physical form but is governed by it.
ex.cn: 性格和外表是分不开的，而且观其形知其性。

ex.en: My idea of physical perfection is to be very slender.
ex.cn: 在我看来，要拥有完美身材就要非常苗条。

def: n.[天]行星,[占星]（左右人命运的）星相

ex.en: The blue whale is the largest living thing on the planet.
ex.cn: 蓝鲸是地球上体型最大的生物。

ex.en: The chances of a planet surviving a supernova always looked terribly slim.
ex.cn: 行星躲过超新星爆发的几率总是十分渺茫。

ex.en: The planet is probably in orbit around a small star.
ex.cn: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。

def:
adj.强大的,权力大的,（药）有效地
adv.很,非常

ex.en: The government wilted in the face of such powerful pressure.
ex.cn: 政府面对如此大的压力，失去了信心。

ex.en: The social cachet of some form of qualification in India is powerful.
ex.cn: 在印度，具有某种资格享有巨大的社会威望。

ex.en: The once-powerful post unions have been cut down to size.
ex.cn: 一度很强势的邮政联盟已经威风不再。

def: n.原则，原理,准则，道义,道德标准,本能

ex.en: Observance of the law is a matter of principle for us.
ex.cn: 守法是我们的一个原则问题。

ex.en: Homeopathic treatment is based on the "like cures like" principle.
ex.cn: 顺势疗法是基于“以毒攻毒”的原理。

ex.en: The principle of hierarchy does not equate to totalitarian terror.
ex.cn: 等级制度在原则上并不等同于极权主义恐怖。

def: n.职业，专业,同行,宣称,信念，信仰

ex.en: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
ex.cn: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

ex.en: Catching colds is unfortunately an occupational hazard in this profession.
ex.cn: 不幸的是，容易感冒是这个行业的职业性风险。

ex.en: Acting is definitely a young person's profession in many ways.
ex.cn: 从许多方面来说，表演无疑是吃青春饭的行当。

def:
n.比，比率,[数学]比例（法）,面积,相称，平衡
vt.使成比例,使相称,使均衡

ex.en: We must keep a sense of proportion about all this.
ex.cn: 我们对所有的这些都要有轻重缓急之分。

ex.en: A substantial proportion of the population speak a French-based patois.
ex.cn: 人口中有一大部分说以法语为基础的混合语。

ex.en: The proportion of women in the profession had risen to 17.3%.
ex.cn: 从事该职业的女性比例已升高到17.3%。

def: adj.合理的，公道的,明白道理的,适当的,有理性的

ex.en: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
ex.cn: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

ex.en: It seems clear that he has no reasonable alternative.
ex.cn: 他没有其他合适的选择，这一点似乎很清楚。

ex.en: You get an interesting meal for a reasonable price.
ex.cn: 你花不多的钱就可以吃一顿很特别的饭。

def: n.反应,回答，答复,[宗]回应经文，应唱圣歌

ex.en: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
ex.cn: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

ex.en: I'm depressed by the bovine enthusiasm of the crowd's response.
ex.cn: 人群毫无热情的迟钝反应使我感到很沮丧。

ex.en: His response to attacks on his work was chiefly bewilderment.
ex.cn: 听到别人对自己工作的指责，他的反应主要是困惑。

def:
vt.& vi.改变,去掉,摆脱掉,换挡
vt.换…的衣服，更（衣）,卖，出售,[计算机]使（数据）位移
vi.（汽车）换挡,换衣服,蒙混,自己谋生
n.移动，转移，转换,变迁，变化，变换，替换，更换，掉换，更易，代用,（汽车等的）变速
n.物种,种类,类型,[逻辑] 个体

adj.明确的,特种的,具体的,[免疫学]特效的
n.特效药,特性,细节,显著的性质，特性

ex.en: Specifical - ly , engage others by identifyin - g their pain, fear and unfulfilled - d desire.
ex.cn: 具体地说,用对方的痛处 、 恐惧和没有满足的欲求来吸引他们.

ex.en: Hot forming of stainless steel elliptical head is specifical process.
ex.cn: 对不锈钢椭圆封头,其压制工艺过程特殊.

ex.en: You refuse all wisps ( no specifical wisper is refused ).
ex.cn: 你拒绝所有悄悄话 ( 没有特定悄悄话被拒绝 ).

def:
n.声明,（思想、观点、文章主题等的）表现,（文字）陈述,结算单
vi.（英国）对儿童进行特殊教育评估认定
vt.申请（小孩）有特殊教育需要

ex.en: The paper describes the distinguishing features of developing small - scale for group stater panel engine control room.
ex.cn: 论述船用组合启动盘小型化的发展特点,分析了启动盘组成部件的改造和国外产品的技术进展.

def: n.地位,情形，状态,身份

vi.受痛苦,受损害,变糟,变差
vt.忍受,容忍,容许,遭受

ex.en: All things are lowly, meek, sufferable and forbear one another in love.
ex.cn: 凡事谦虚 、 温柔 、 忍耐,用爱心互相宽容.

def: n.失业,失业率,失业状况,失业人数

vi.适应于，适应不同情况（或环境）(to)
vt.改编，改写,改变…以适合(for)

ex.en: The scriptwriter helped him to adapt his novel for the screen.
ex.cn: 编剧帮助他将其所著小说改编成电影。

ex.en: Buddhism had to adapt to the new world or perish.
ex.cn: 佛教必须适应新时代，否则将会消亡。

ex.en: Shelves were built to adapt the library for use as an office.
ex.cn: 为将图书馆改作办公室而做了一些架子。

def: vt.任命，委派,约定，指定,装设，布置

ex.en: "Why didn't you appoint Ron twelve months ago?"—"Good question."
ex.cn: “你为什么12个月前不任命罗恩呢？”——“问得好。”

ex.en: He promised to appoint an AIDS czar to deal with the disease.
ex.cn: 他许诺任命一位艾滋病大使来应对这种疾病。

ex.en: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appoint-ments.
ex.cn: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

def: n.方面,面貌,方位，方向,形势

ex.en: Antonio has a contagious enthusiasm for the beautiful aspect of food.
ex.cn: 安东尼奥对食品赏心悦目这一方面的热情非常有感染性。

ex.en: The existence of an emotional undertow is an aspect of all politics.
ex.cn: 具有情绪感召力是所有政治的一个方面。

ex.en: She has already expressed her dissatisfaction with this aspect of the policy.
ex.cn: 她对政策的这一方面已经表达了不满。

def: v.假定，认为,承担,装出,呈现

ex.en: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.
ex.cn: 不要想当然地认为你的宝宝一闹就是要吃奶。

ex.en: Civilians assume, wrongly, that everything in the military runs smoothly.
ex.cn: 老百姓以为军队中一切都运转正常,其实不然.

ex.en: People assume they know me through and through the moment we meet.
ex.cn: 人们一见到我，就自以为对我了如指掌了。

def: n.大气，空气,大气层,风格，基调,气氛

ex.en: He sets the atmosphere and shapes the scenes pleasingly.
ex.cn: 他把气氛和场面调动得轻松愉快。

ex.en: At least this second meeting had helped to thaw the atmosphere.
ex.cn: 这第二次会议至少起到了缓和气氛的作用。

ex.en: There's still an atmosphere of great hostility and tension in the city.
ex.cn: 强烈的敌对和紧张气氛依然笼罩着这座城市。

def:
vt.试图,尝试
n.进攻,尝试，冲击

ex.en: An attempt by anti-abortionists to tighten the rules was defeated.
ex.cn: 反堕胎者所作的加强法规的尝试失败了。

ex.en: Army officers plotted a failed attempt yesterday to seize power.
ex.cn: 军官们昨天夺权未遂。

ex.en: These feelings are likely to make people attempt to overthrow the system.
ex.cn: 这些情绪有可能促使人们想要推翻现行的体制。

def: n.笑，笑声,〈古〉好笑的事,〈美俚〉力量悬殊得可笑的体育比赛,大笑

ex.en: Behind the mocking laughter lurks a growing sense of unease.
ex.cn: 嘲笑声的背后潜伏着一种越来越强烈的不安。

ex.en: They heard a bottle being smashed, then more raucous laughter.
ex.cn: 他们听见酒瓶摔碎的声音，然后是一阵更喧闹的笑声。

ex.en: They laugh so hard they double up with laughter.
ex.cn: 他们捧腹大笑，直不起身来。

def: n.表演,演技,表现,执行

ex.en: At the highest executive levels earnings and performance aren't always correlated.
ex.cn: 在最高管理层，收入与工作表现并不总是相关的。

ex.en: The camera combines rugged reliability with unequalled optical performance and speed.
ex.cn: 这款相机既坚固耐用，又有超凡的光学性能和快门速度。

ex.en: There is no provision for funding performance-related pay rises.
ex.cn: 没有为与业绩挂钩的加薪预作资金准备。

def:
adj.（级别、地位等）较高的,资深的,年长的,<美>最高年级的
n.上级,<美>毕业班学生,较年长者,地位较高的，资历较深的

ex.en: He has said he will fire editorial employees without regard to seniority.
ex.cn: 他说过不管资历如何，任何编辑人员他都有可能解雇。

ex.en: They offered him a post befitting his seniority and experience.
ex.cn: 他们给他提供了一个同他资历相当的职位。

ex.en: a position of seniority
ex.cn: 高级职位

def:
n.网,（电视与计算机）网络,网状物,广播网
vt.& vi.将…连接成网络,建立工作关系
vt.把（地方节目）编排到广播网（或电视网）联播,使（全国）联播,（如）用网覆盖,广泛分布
vi.沟通，互助

ex.en: This film is the first British animation sold to an American network.
ex.cn: 这是第一部出售给美国电视网的英国动画片。

ex.en: An American network says it has obtained the recordings.
ex.cn: 美国一家广播网声称已经得到了那些录音材料。

ex.en: Now a special TV network gives live coverage of most races.
ex.cn: 现在有一个专门的电视网络对大部分比赛进行现场直播。

def:
vt.劫持,绑架,拦路抢劫,操纵（会议等，以推销自己的意图）
n.劫持,敲诈,威逼

ex.en: Every minute during the hijack seemed like a week.
ex.cn: 被劫持过程中，每一分钟都过得如同一周那么漫长。

ex.en: The front page is devoted to the continuing saga of the hijack.
ex.cn: 头版是对劫持事件的连续报道。

ex.en: Most countries refuse to give sanctuary to people who hijack aeroplanes.
ex.cn: 大多数国家拒绝对劫机者提供庇护.

def: v.抢劫（走私卡车等），劫持

ex.en: We certainly don't want a highjack happen on the plane today.
ex.cn: 我们当然不希望在今天的飞机上发生劫机事件.

ex.en: B : I think so. We certainly don't want a highjack to happen on the plane today.
ex.cn: 我想是的. 我们当然不希望在今天的飞机上发生劫机事件.

def:
n.国会,代表大会,（用于某些国家的政党名称）国民大会,社交
vi.开会，集合

ex.en: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
ex.cn: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

ex.en: The African National Congress threatened to withdraw from the talks.
ex.cn: 非洲国民大会威胁要退出会谈。

ex.en: The American Congress has agreed to forgive Egypt's military debt.
ex.cn: 美国国会同意免除埃及的军事债务。

def: n.观众,读者,接见,听众

ex.en: My audience certainly isn't the proverbial man in the street.
ex.cn: 我的观众当然不是街上的平头百姓。

ex.en: The offending comment was in fact a heckle from an audience member.
ex.cn: 这番冒犯性的话实际上是一名观众的诘难。

ex.en: They would always come out and warm up the audience.
ex.cn: 他们总是会出来调动观众情绪。

def: adj.意识到的,知道的,觉察到的

ex.en: He became more aware of the things that started that tension off.
ex.cn: 他越来越清楚地认识到引起紧张局势的原因。

ex.en: He must have been aware that my parents' marriage was breaking up.
ex.cn: 他一定已经知道我父母的婚姻即将破裂。

ex.en: Sometimes we are not consciously aware of these feelings.
ex.cn: 有时候我们没有意识到这些情感。

def:
vi.发出隆隆声,快速发展,暴涨
vt.以低沉而有回响的声音发出,使繁荣,使迅速发展
n.隆隆声,繁荣,激增

ex.en: The boom of the 1980s led to a taste for petrol-guzzling cars.
ex.cn: 20世纪80年代的经济繁荣使人们喜欢上高油耗的汽车。

ex.en: The stillness of night was broken by the boom of a cannon.
ex.cn: 夜晚的寂静被隆隆的炮声打破。

ex.en: This boom has been engineered by the Chancellor for short-term political reasons.
ex.cn: 这片繁荣景象是总理为了短期政治利益而精心安排的。

def:
adj.短暂的,（衣着）短的,简洁的,简明的
vt.向…介绍基本情况,（尤指事前）向…介绍基本情况,向…下达简令,在…事先向…做简要指点
n.概要,短文,简短声明,（争议一方的情况或论点）要点摘录

ex.en: A guide gives a brief talk on the history of the site.
ex.cn: 导游简要地介绍了那个遗址的历史。

ex.en: Now please be brief — my time is valuable.
ex.cn: 请长话短说——我的时间宝贵。

ex.en: This is a brief stop to take on passengers and water.
ex.cn: 这是一次短暂停靠，上上客，加加水。

def: n.癌症，恶性肿瘤,弊病，社会恶习,迅速蔓延的恶劣的或危险的事物,[天]巨蟹座，巨蟹宫

ex.en: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
ex.cn: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

ex.en: Scientists know that cancer may not show up for many years.
ex.cn: 科学家们知道癌症可能会潜伏多年。

ex.en: Decaffeinated coffee still contains some stimulants and other nasties linked with cancer.
ex.cn: 脱咖啡因的咖啡仍含一些刺激物和其他可能致癌的有害物质。

def: n.委员会

ex.en: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
ex.cn: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

ex.en: He had been on the Nobel Prize committee's list of possibles.
ex.cn: 他在诺贝尔委员会列出的获奖候选者名单之列.

ex.en: Today its executive committee voted unanimously to reject the proposals.
ex.cn: 今天执行委员会投票一致否决了这些提案。

def: n.作文，作曲,创作,构图，布置,妥协，和解

ex.en: The course is designed to help students with colour and composition.
ex.cn: 设置这门课程是为了指导学生如何运用色彩和构图。

ex.en: the chemical composition of the soil
ex.cn: 土壤的化学成分

ex.en: He played a piece of music of his own composition.
ex.cn: 他演奏了一首自己创作的曲子.

def:
prep.（表示论及）关于，就…而论
v.“concern”的现在分词,涉及,关心,顾虑，忧虑

ex.en: For more information concerning the club contact I. Coldwell.
ex.cn: 咨询俱乐部详情，请与I.科德维尔联系。

ex.en: Sikhs were expected to adhere strictly to the religious rules concerning appearance.
ex.cn: 锡克教徒应当严格遵守该教对外表的规定。

ex.en: The engineer and his son held frequent consultations concerning technical problems.
ex.cn: 工程师和他的儿子经常就技术问题互相征求意见。

def:
n.信心,信任,秘密
adj.骗得信任的,欺诈的

ex.en: He has never exhibited the self-confidence, bordering on arrogance, of his predecessor.
ex.cn: 他从未表现出他前任的那种近乎傲慢的自信。

ex.en: Hopes of an early cut in interest rates bolstered confidence.
ex.cn: 利率有望早日下调，从而增强了人们的信心。

ex.en: He walked towards the summerhouse, at first furtively, then with more confidence.
ex.cn: 他朝凉亭走去，开始还偷偷摸摸地，后来就壮大了胆子。

def: n.考虑，考察,照顾，关心,报酬,尊敬

ex.en: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
ex.cn: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

ex.en: The Board is scrupulous in its consideration of all applications for licences.
ex.cn: 委员会对所有申请许可证的人予以审慎考虑。

ex.en: The other fundamental consideration in the conception of a plan is function.
ex.cn: 在构思设计图时要考虑的另一个基本因素是功能。

def: vi.由…组成,在于,符合

ex.en: The division will consist of two tank companies and one infantry company.
ex.cn: 这个师的组成部队将包括两个坦克连和一个步兵连。

ex.en: A healthy diet should consist of wholefood.
ex.cn: 健康饮食应由全天然食物构成。

ex.en: The development will consist of 66 dwellings and a number of offices.
ex.cn: 新建楼区将由66栋住房和一些办公用房组成。

def: vt.构成，组成,制定，设立,等同于,指派

ex.en: Volunteers constitute more than 95% of The Center's work force.
ex.cn: 该中心95%以上的工作人员是志愿者.

ex.en: Motherhood did not constitute much of an interruption to her career.
ex.cn: 做母亲并没有在很大程度上中断她的事业。

ex.en: Testing patients without their consent would constitute a professional and legal offence.
ex.cn: 未经患者同意而对其进行检查被视为违反职业操守并触犯法律。

def: n.消费,肺病,耗尽,[医学]消耗性疾病

ex.en: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
ex.cn: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

ex.en: There has been a slight increase in the consumption of meat.
ex.cn: 肉类消费量略有增长。

ex.en: Ethiopia has almost the lowest oil consumption per capita in the world.
ex.cn: 埃塞俄比亚的人均石油耗费量几乎是全世界最低的。

def: vt.包含，容纳,克制，遏制,牵制,包括或由…构成

ex.en: Our range of herbal teas contain no preservatives, colourings or artificial flavourings.
ex.cn: 我们这一系列的药草茶不含防腐剂、色素以及人工调味品。

ex.en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
ex.cn: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

ex.en: She bought a travel-bag large enough to contain the film canisters.
ex.cn: 她买了一只能装得下那些胶卷筒的旅行包。

def: n.对比，对照,差异,对照物，对立面,[摄]反差

ex.en: The boy's room is a complete contrast to the guest room.
ex.cn: 这个男孩的房间和客房截然不同。

ex.en: The private sector, by contrast, has plenty of money to spend.
ex.cn: 相比之下，私营部门就有很多钱可供开销。

ex.en: Hungary, by contrast, reacted calmly to events in Yugoslavia.
ex.cn: 相比之下,匈牙利对南斯拉夫发生的一系列事件反应平静.

def: vt.使相信，说服，使承认,使明白,使确信,使悔悟，使认错[罪]

ex.en: I'm not going to believe it myself, never mind convince anyone else.
ex.cn: 我自己都不会相信，更别提说服别人了。

ex.en: It became clear that I hadn't been able to convince Mike.
ex.cn: 我显然没有能够说服迈克。

ex.en: You'll need to convince them of your enthusiasm for the job.
ex.cn: 你要使他们相信你殷切希望得到这份工作。

def:
n.信誉，信用,[金融]贷款,荣誉,学分
vt.相信，信任,归功于,[会]记入贷方,赞颂

ex.en: Make a note of credit card numbers and check expiry dates.
ex.cn: 记下信用卡卡号，核对有效期限。

ex.en: Buyers use different ruses to wring free credit out of their suppliers.
ex.cn: 买主们千方百计想从供货商那儿无息赊购。

ex.en: You're a nice girl, Lettie, and your kind heart does you credit.
ex.cn: 你是个好女孩儿，莱蒂，你的善良值得称赞。

def: adj.明确的,一定的,肯定,有把握

ex.en: Her Royal Highness has definite views about most things.
ex.cn: 女王陛下对大多数事情都有明确的观点。

ex.en: When you came away you made a definite effort to mix.
ex.cn: 你离开时一定要努力和大家搞好关系。

ex.en: Mary is very definite about this.
ex.cn: 玛丽对此非常肯定。

def: n.定义,规定，明确,[物]清晰度,解释

ex.en: It all depends on your definition of punk, doesn'tit?
ex.cn: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”

ex.en: The legal definition of "know" often presumes mental control.
ex.cn: “知晓”的法律定义通常假定存在思维控制能力。

ex.en: Give your brows extra definition with Outdoor Girl'sEyebrow Pencil in Brown.
ex.cn: 用“户外女孩”品牌的棕色眉笔更加清晰地勾勒出眉形。

def:
vt.证明，证实,论证,显示，展示,演示，说明
vi.示威游行

ex.en: The best and the brightest pupils competed to demonstrate their intellectual prowess.
ex.cn: 最出色、最聪明的学生们竞相展示他们的才智。

ex.en: These designs demonstrate her unerring eye for colour and detail.
ex.cn: 这些设计体现了她对颜色和细节的精准眼光。

ex.en: The government'sgoing to great lengths to demonstrate its military might.
ex.cn: 该政府正不遗余力地展示其军事力量。

def:
vt.训练,使有纪律,处罚,使有条理
n.训练,纪律,学科,符合行为准则的行为（或举止）

ex.en: To start a revolution, you need discipline, incisiveness and articulacy.
ex.cn: 要革命，就要守纪律、看得远、善表达。

ex.en: The aim of discipline is to teach children to behave acceptably.
ex.cn: 纪律的目的是教育儿童举止得体。

ex.en: The discipline of studying music can help children develop good work habits.
ex.cn: 音乐学习中的训练可以帮助孩子们培养好的工作习惯。

def:
adj.有效的,起作用的,实际的，实在的,给人深刻印象
n.[军]现役兵额，有生力量，精兵

ex.en: Condoms are an effective method of birth control if used with care.
ex.cn: 如果使用得当，避孕套是很有效的避孕手段。

ex.en: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
ex.cn: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

ex.en: Women are sometimes seen to be less effective as managers.
ex.cn: 女性有时被认为不善于管理。

def: n.效率，效能,实力，能力,[物]性能,功效

ex.en: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.
ex.cn: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。

ex.en: Revenues from "green taxes" could then be channelled back into energy efficiency.
ex.cn: 从“绿色税收”得来的收入便可回过头来用于提高能效。

ex.en: It was achieved with minimum fuss and maximum efficiency.
ex.cn: 事情事半功倍地完成了。

def: vt.使能够，提供做…的权利[措施],使可能,授予权利或方法

ex.en: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
ex.cn: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

ex.en: The vote will enable the Prime Minister to push through tough policies.
ex.cn: 这次投票将使首相能够力行强硬政策。

ex.en: The sessions will enable you to discuss problems with fellow asthma sufferers.
ex.cn: 这些环节让你和其他哮喘病患者一起讨论问题.

def: n.程度,长度,广大地域,扣押

ex.en: To an extent, that is the reason for the meeting.
ex.cn: 在某种程度上，那就是召开这次会议的原因。

ex.en: He explored the wound with his finger, trying to establish its extent.
ex.cn: 他用手指摸了摸伤口，想要确定受伤的程度。

ex.en: To a certain extent it's easier for men to get work.
ex.cn: 在一定程度上，男性更容易找到工作。

def:
n.特征，特点,容貌，面貌,（期刊的）特辑,故事片
vt.使有特色,描写…的特征,以…为号召物
vi.起主要作用,作重要角色

ex.en: The most arresting feature is the painted wall decoration.
ex.cn: 最醒目的特点是绘有图画的墙面装饰。

ex.en: Wanton violence is now becoming a regular feature of urban life.
ex.cn: 肆无忌惮的暴行在城市生活中越来越司空见惯。

ex.en: Television companies tend to censor bad language in feature films.
ex.cn: 电视公司往往会在审查故事片时删去其中的粗话。

def:
vt.想，设想,想像,料想，猜想,误认为
vi.想象,猜想，推测

ex.en: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
ex.cn: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

ex.en: I imagine they'll be tearing the building down sooner or later.
ex.cn: 我猜他们早晚会拆除这座楼的。

ex.en: Imagine long golden beaches where you can wander in solitude.
ex.cn: 想象一下那长长的金色海滩吧，在那里你可以独自徜徉。

def: vt.表明，标示，指示,象征，暗示，预示,[医]显示需要做…的治疗

ex.en: Ballpark estimates indicate a price tag of $90 million a month.
ex.cn: 大致的估计费用为每月9,000万美元。

ex.en: Surveys indicate that supporters of the treaty are still in the majority.
ex.cn: 调查表明，该条约的支持者仍然占大多数。

ex.en: The last figures so far this year indicate a rise of 13.8%.
ex.cn: 今年到目前为止的最新数据显示增长了13.8%。

def:
n.例子，实例,情况,要求，建议,[法]诉讼手续
vt.举…为例

ex.en: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
ex.cn: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

ex.en: It is not a unique instance , but has its counterpart.
ex.cn: 无独有偶.

ex.en: There are jobs more dangerous than truck driving; for instance, training lions.
ex.cn: 有的工作比驾驶卡车更危险, 例如驯狮.

def:
adj.智力的,有才智的,需用智力的,智力发达的
n.知识分子,脑力劳动者,有极高智力的人,凭理智（而非感情）办事的人

ex.en: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
ex.cn: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

ex.en: Sontag has always been that rarity, a glamorous intellectual.
ex.cn: 桑塔格一直是那种兼具美貌与智慧的人中龙凤。

ex.en: Without continued learning, graduates will lose their intellectual vitality.
ex.cn: 如果不继续学习，毕业生就会失去思想上的活力。

def: n.智力,聪颖,情报,情报机构

ex.en: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
ex.cn: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

ex.en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
ex.cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

ex.en: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.
ex.cn: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。

def: adj.聪明的,理解力强的,有智力的,[计]智能的

ex.en: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
ex.cn: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

ex.en: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
ex.cn: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

ex.en: All your arguments presuppose that he's a rational, intelligent man.
ex.cn: 你所有论点的前提都是他是一个理性而聪明的人。

def:
n.环，节,[计算机]链接,关联，关系
vt.连结,挽住，勾住
vi.用环连接,联系在一起

ex.en: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds.
ex.cn: 他认为7岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。

ex.en: Something must have gone wrong with the satellite link.
ex.cn: 卫星连接一定出了毛病。

ex.en: There's a good British Rail link at Clapham Junction.
ex.cn: 在克拉珀姆枢纽站有条很不错的英国铁路线。

def: adv.仅仅，只不过,只是,纯粹,全然

ex.en: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
ex.cn: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

ex.en: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league.
ex.cn: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。

ex.en: The King has merely given the politicians enough rope to hang themselves.
ex.cn: 国王只不过是给了这些政客自缚的绳子。

def:
n.运动,手势,动机，意向,请求
vt.打手势,向某人点头或摇头示意,打手势要求[指示]
vi.运动,打手势

ex.en: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
ex.cn: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

ex.en: Whenever recession strikes, a chain reaction is set into motion.
ex.cn: 只要经济不景气，连锁反应就开始了。

ex.en: Such a motion is considered a test of backbench opinion.
ex.cn: 这样的动议被视为对后座议员立场的考验。

def: n.概念，观念,意见，见解,奇想,打算

ex.en: The notion that art should be controlled by intellectuals sickened him.
ex.cn: 他讨厌艺术应由知识分子所掌控的观点。

ex.en: The very notion of price competition is foreign to many schools.
ex.cn: 价格竞争这个概念对于许多学校都很陌生。

ex.en: Their relationship turned the standard notion of marriage on its head.
ex.cn: 他们的关系完全颠覆了传统的婚姻观念。

def:
n.梗概，大纲，提纲，草稿，要点，主要原则,外形，轮廓，轮廓线，轮廓画法，略图（画法）
vt.概述,略述,画轮廓，打草图，描略图

ex.en: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.
ex.cn: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。

ex.en: Draw your child's outline with a heavy black marker.
ex.cn: 用浓黑色的毡笔画出你孩子的轮廓。

ex.en: Here we outline some of the some-times conflicting forces moulding the debate.
ex.cn: 在此我们概述一些有时影响争论的相互对立的力量。

def: n.生而为人,人格，人品，个性,人物,名人

ex.en: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
ex.cn: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

ex.en: The individual's whole personality appears to be permanently warped.
ex.cn: 这个人的整个人格似乎被永远地扭曲了。

ex.en: He is such a personality— he is so funny.
ex.cn: 他很有个性魅力——非常风趣。

def: n.哲学家，哲人,思想家，学者,豁达的人,爱卖弄大道理者

ex.en: the Greek philosopher Aristotle
ex.cn: 希腊哲学家亚里士多德

ex.en: He is a teacher by occupation but a philosopher by inclination.
ex.cn: 他的职业是教师,但他的本心是成为哲学家.

ex.en: The philosopher speculated about the future of the human race.
ex.cn: 那位哲学家考虑过人类的前途.

def: n.诗，诗歌,诗意，诗情,作诗,诗歌艺术

ex.en: I myself enjoy cinema, poetry, eating out and long walks.
ex.cn: 我本人喜欢电影、诗歌、外出吃饭和远途散步。

ex.en: I think that a lot of poetry published today is obscurantist nonsense.
ex.cn: 我认为当今出版的很多诗歌都是故弄玄虚的无病呻吟。

ex.en: Her editors wanted her to cut out the poetry from her novel.
ex.cn: 编辑们想让她把这首诗从她的小说中删去。

def: n.政策,策略,保险单,策略性

ex.en: It was not the policy of the government to repatriate genuine refugees.
ex.cn: 遣返真正的难民回国并非政府的政策。

ex.en: The White House quickly announced that the policy is under review.
ex.cn: 白宫很快宣布该项政策正在审核中。

ex.en: Responsibility and moderation were to be the keynotes of their foreign policy.
ex.cn: 责任和克制将是他们外交政策的核心。

def: vt.拥有,掌握，懂得,主宰,缠住，迷住

ex.en: This figure has long been held to possess miraculous power.
ex.cn: 这个数字长时间以来都被认为拥有神奇的力量。
