ex.cn: 这本文集是为配合在科隆举办的一场展览而出的。

ex.en: Barron invited her to accompany him to the races.
ex.cn: 巴伦邀请她陪他参加比赛。

ex.en: He took time out from campaigning to accompany his mother to dinner.
ex.cn: 他从竞选活动中挤出一点时间陪母亲吃饭。

def: adj.精确的，准确的,正确无误的

ex.en: Schools were told their exam information had to be spot-on and accurate.
ex.cn: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

ex.en: Her description of the nature and action of poisons is amazingly accurate.
ex.cn: 他对一些毒药的性质和作用的描述惊人地准确。

ex.en: I work very efficiently and am decisive, and accurate in my judgement.
ex.cn: 我工作非常有效率，处事果断，而且判断准确。

def: vt.使熟悉,使认识,把某事通知某人，告知

ex.en: The proprietor was an old acquaint-ance of his.
ex.cn: 业主是他的一位旧相识。

ex.en: Please acquaint me with the facts of the case.
ex.cn: 请把这事的实情告诉我。

ex.en: Acquaint him with your plans.
ex.cn: 把你的计划告知他.

def: n.准许进入,承认,坦白,入场费

ex.en: By his own admission, he evaded taxes as a Florida real-estate speculator.
ex.cn: 他亲口承认自己在佛罗里达从事房地产投机生意时逃过税。

ex.en: Open daily; admission £1.10 with concessions for children and OAPs.
ex.cn: 每天开放；门票1.10英镑，儿童和退休人士可享受票价优惠。

ex.en: Were you just trying to trap her into making some admission?
ex.cn: 你刚才是想诱使她供认吗？

def: n.飞机，航空器，

ex.en: The onslaught of orders should keep aircraft manufacturers busy for some time.
ex.cn: 纷至沓来的订单应该会让飞机制造商忙碌一段时间。

ex.en: Since its inception the company has produced 53 different aircraft designs.
ex.cn: 该公司自成立以来已经完成了53种不同样式飞行器的设计。

ex.en: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.
ex.cn: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。

def: n.航线,航空公司

ex.en: The airline had losses of $35m and was bailed out by Qantas.
ex.cn: 这家航空公司亏损达3,500万美元，而澳航出资帮助其摆脱了困境。

ex.en: The drop in travel is bad news for the airline industry.
ex.cn: 旅游热降温对航空业来说是个坏消息。

ex.en: The £85m programme will involve an extensive rebranding of the airline.
ex.cn: 这个8,500万英镑的项目将包括全面重塑该航空公司的形象。

def:
n.惊恐,警报,闹铃,动员令
vt.使惊恐,警告,给（门等）安装警报器

ex.en: Any escape, once it's detected, sets off the alarm.
ex.cn: 一旦发现有泄漏，警报就会响起来。

ex.en: He returned to the airport to find his car alarm going off.
ex.cn: 他回到机场时听到自己的汽车报警器响了。

ex.en: He expressed alarm about the government's increasingly bellicose statements.
ex.cn: 他对政府越来越具挑衅性的声明表示担忧。

def: n.乙醇，酒精,含酒精的饮料

ex.en: In 1985, he began to show signs of alcohol and drug dependency.
ex.cn: 在1985年，他开始表现出酗酒嗜毒的迹象。

ex.en: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
ex.cn: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

ex.en: He was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence of alcohol.
ex.cn: 他因涉嫌酒后驾驶被捕。

def:
adj.同样的，相似的
adv.同样地,两者都，同样地,类似于

ex.en: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
ex.cn: 达尔文的语言无论对专家还是非专业人士而言都明白易懂。

ex.en: Mr Bowles could engender delight in students and musicians alike.
ex.cn: 鲍尔斯先生能够让学生和音乐家都感到快乐。

ex.en: Exporters, farmers and industrialists alike are vexed and blame the government.
ex.cn: 出口商、农场主和实业家们都很恼火，纷纷谴责政府。

def: n.高度，海拔高度,高位，高等,[天]地平纬度,[数]顶垂线

ex.en: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
ex.cn: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

ex.en: The plane flew at an altitude of 20, 000 feet.
ex.cn: 这架飞机在两万英尺的高空飞行.

ex.en: The plane was flying at an altitude of 2000 meters.
ex.cn: 这时飞机的高度是2000公尺.

def:
vt.使大为吃惊，使惊奇
n.吃惊，好奇

ex.en: Neil's ability to utter banalities never ceased to amaze me.
ex.cn: 每次我都很惊讶，尼尔怎么能讲出这么索然无味的东西。

ex.en: He never ceases to amaze me.
ex.cn: 他总能给我惊喜。

ex.en: He stood in amaze at the sight.
ex.cn: 他看到那种景象,惊愕得呆呆地站在那里.

def:
vt.打扰,干扰,使烦恼,使恼怒
vi.惹恼，令人讨厌，打搅
n.烦恼（等于annoyance）

ex.en: As the years went by his nastiness began to annoy his readers.
ex.cn: 年深日久，他恶毒的文字开始让读者生厌。

ex.en: Try making a note of the things which annoy you.
ex.cn: 试着把烦心事写下来。

ex.en: His constant joking was beginning to annoy her.
ex.cn: 他不停地开玩笑，已开始惹她生气。

def: adj.易看见的，可看见的,显然的，明明白白的,貌似的，表面的,显见

ex.en: It rapidly became apparent that rock'n'roll was a very broad church indeed.
ex.cn: 摇滚乐实际无所不包，这一点很快就显而易见了。

ex.en: The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.
ex.cn: 这类人可能会莫名其妙地感到头晕。

ex.en: The presence of a star is already apparent in the early film.
ex.cn: 在早期影片中已经显露出了明星相。

def:
n.上诉,[体育]诉请,呼吁,（迫切的）要求（帮助、同情等）恳求
vi.（迫切）要求,有吸引力,求助（于）,提请注意
vt.将…移交上级法院审理

ex.en: Its new title was meant to give the party greater public appeal.
ex.cn: 新的党名意在使该党对公众具有更强的吸引力。

ex.en: The Appeal Court has quashed the convictions of all eleven people.
ex.cn: 上诉法庭已经撤销对所有11人的判决。

ex.en: The case is being referred to the Court of Appeal.
ex.cn: 该案件将移交上诉法院审理。

def: adj.艺术的,有美感的,风雅的,（尤指）有美术才能的

ex.en: What is missing, however, is an internal, artistic cohesion.
ex.cn: 不过，缺乏的是一种内在的艺术凝聚力。

ex.en: Her natural creativity and artistic talent make her home a real showstopper.
ex.cn: 她天生的创造力和艺术天赋让她的家不同凡响，令人叹服。

ex.en: She has just been appointed artistic director of Queensland Theatre Company.
ex.cn: 她刚刚被任命为昆士兰剧团的艺术总监。

def: n.立法机构,议会,集会,装配

ex.en: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
ex.cn: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

ex.en: The present assembly will be dissolved on April 30th.
ex.cn: 现在的议会将于4月30日解散。

ex.en: Sovereign power will continue to lie with the Supreme People's Assembly.
ex.cn: 最高统治权仍然掌握在最高人民会议手中。

def: vt.声称，断言,维护，坚持,坚持自己的主张,生效
n.协会，社团,联合，联系,联想

ex.en: The support of our members is of great importance to the Association.
ex.cn: 会员的支持对于我们协会来说非常重要。

ex.en: The association between the two companies stretches back thirty years.
ex.cn: 这两家公司的往来可以追溯到30年前。

ex.en: The National Collegiate Athletic Association introduced drug testing in the mid-1980s.
ex.cn: 美国大学体育联合会在20世纪80年代中期开始实行药物检测。

def: vt.使惊讶，使大为吃惊

ex.en: A matter of repeated occurrence like this will not astonish people.
ex.cn: 这样司空见惯的事,不会使人吃惊.

ex.en: My news will astonish you.
ex.cn: 我的消息会让你感到十分惊讶的。

ex.en: He purposed to both charm and astonish me by his appearance.
ex.cn: 他是想以他的外貌让我着迷,使我吃惊.

def:
vt.& vi.达到，获得,遂愿,经过努力到达某事物
vt.达到，实现,获得,到达
vi.达到,获得,到达

ex.en: Top-ranking sumo wrestlers attain superstar status.
ex.cn: 顶尖的相扑选手可获得超级明星的地位。

ex.en: The cheetah can attain speeds of up to 97 kph.
ex.cn: 猎豹的奔跑速度每小时可达97公里.

ex.en: The day is not far off when China will attain prosperity.
ex.cn: 中国的兴盛是可以计日程功的.

def:
vt.禁止，下令禁止,剥夺权利,[古]诅咒
n.禁止，禁令,谴责,诅咒，诅骂,革出教门

ex.en: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
ex.cn: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

ex.en: I certainly think there should be a ban on tobacco advertising.
ex.cn: 我确实认为应该禁止香烟广告.

ex.en: Top supermarkets are to ban many genetically modified foods.
ex.cn: 大品牌超市即将下架许多转基因食品。

def: n.谷仓，粮仓,牲口棚,（公共汽车、卡车等的）车库,一种特别大且空荡的房屋

ex.en: The barn was filled with the sour-sweet smell of fresh dung.
ex.cn: 谷仓里弥漫着新粪酸甜的气味。

ex.en: The rooster chased me across the dirt floor of the barn.
ex.cn: 公鸡追着我跑过谷仓的泥土地面。

ex.en: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.
ex.cn: 1979年，LiquorBarn烈酒折扣店的生意十分红火。

def:
vi.表现,举止端正,自然反应
vt.使守规矩

ex.en: The aim of discipline is to teach children to behave acceptably.
ex.cn: 纪律的目的是教育儿童举止得体。

ex.en: I'll behave toward them as I would like to be treated.
ex.cn: 我会以希望别人对待我的方式来对待他们。

ex.en: It is shocking that humans can behave with such bestiality towards others.
ex.cn: 令人震惊的是，人竟然能对同类下此毒手。

def:
adj.有偏见的,有偏的,结果偏倚的
v.使存偏见(bias的过去式和过去分词)

ex.en: He seemed a bit biased against women in my opinion.
ex.cn: 我认为他好像对女性有点儿成见。

ex.en: In Japan firms are biased towards growth rather than profits.
ex.cn: 在日本，公司偏重于发展，而不是一味追求利润。

ex.en: University funding was tremendously biased towards scientists.
ex.cn: 大学科研经费向科学家极大地倾斜。

def:
n.出价，投标,努力争取,喊价,叫牌
vt.& vi.出价， 投标
vt.恳求,命令,说（问候话）,邀请，致敬
vi.投标,力求，企图得到或赢得某物,企图(for)

ex.en: He certainly wasn't going to bid $18 billion for this company.
ex.cn: 他肯定不会出180亿美元来收购这家公司。

ex.en: Speculation centred on a likely bid price of 380p a share.
ex.cn: 大多数人猜测买方出价可能为每股380便士。

ex.en: Hanson made an agreed takeover bid of £351 million.
ex.cn: 汉森按协商出价3.51亿英镑接管该公司。

def:
adj.明显的，醒目的,勇敢的，无畏的,莽撞的,陡峭的
n.粗体字,黑体字

ex.en: Bold as you please, she grabbed me by the sleeve.
ex.cn: 她真够大胆的，竟抓住了我的衣袖。

ex.en: He believes that students should be encouraged to experiment with bold ideas.
ex.cn: 他认为应该鼓励学生们将大胆的观念付诸试验。

ex.en: The book's 85 colour lithographic plates look staggeringly fresh and bold.
ex.cn: 这本书的85张彩色平版看起来异常鲜艳醒目。

def: n.奖金，额外津贴,红利，额外股息,退职金,额外令人高兴的事情

ex.en: We felt we might finish third. Any better would be a bonus.
ex.cn: 我们感觉我们可能会获得第三名，要是能比这个名次更好那就是意外的惊喜了。

ex.en: The committee backtracked by scrapping the controversial bonus system.
ex.cn: 委员会改变主意，放弃了有争议的奖金制度。

ex.en: Bonus notices were issued each year from head office to local agents.
ex.cn: 分红通告每年由总公司发送至地方代理商。

def:
vt.令人厌烦,钻孔,用钻、挖或掘的方式打通
vi.挖洞,钻孔,稳步前进,挤过去
n.使人讨厌的人[物],高潮,膛径，口径,钻子

ex.en: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
ex.cn: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

ex.en: Hugo bore his illness with great courage and good humour.
ex.cn: 雨果以巨大的勇气和良好的精神状态面对疾病。

ex.en: This guy bore a really freaky resem-blance to Jones.
ex.cn: 这个家伙和琼斯长得惊人地相似。

def:
n.（大）体积,大块，大量,大多数，大部分,主体
vt.& vi.变得越来越大（或重要）
vi.显得庞大,形成大块,堆积起来
vt.使凝聚成一团或形成一堆
adj.大批的，大量的,散装的

ex.en: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
ex.cn: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

ex.en: Despite his bulk he moved lightly on his feet.
ex.cn: 尽管他身形庞大，移动起来还是很灵巧。

ex.en: Shopkeepers buy them in bulk and resell them for £150 each.
ex.cn: 店主们先大量购进，然后再以150英镑的单价将它们转卖出去。

def:
adj.偶然的,临时的,随便的,非正式的
n.临时工人,[军]待命士兵,没有固定工作的劳动者,不定期领取救济金的人

ex.en: I was wrong about it being a casual meeting.
ex.cn: 我误以为这是个非正式会议。

ex.en: A sharp dresser, Wyatt is never seen in casual clothes.
ex.cn: 怀亚特衣着入时，从未有人见过他穿便装。

ex.en: Lust now seems to be associated with casual sex and loose morals.
ex.cn: 色欲如今似乎与性生活随便和道德放纵联系在一起了。

def: n.典礼，仪式,礼仪，礼节,虚礼，客气

ex.en: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
ex.cn: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

ex.en: The appointed hour of the ceremony was drawing nearer.
ex.cn: 既定的典礼时间就快到了。

ex.en: There is a ceremony of prayer and flagellation before the dancing begins.
ex.cn: 舞蹈开始前会举行祈祷和鞭笞的仪式。

def: vt.使文明，使开化

vt.使文明,使开化,教化,启发
vi.变得文明

ex.en: We must civilize away the boy's bad habit.
ex.cn: 我们必须教育这孩子使其改掉恶习.

ex.en: "I think it would civilize people a bit more if they had decent conditions." — "I think you've hit the nail on the head."
ex.cn: “我认为，如果人们有良好的环境，就会更有教养一点。”——“我想你说到点子上了。”

ex.en: Those facilities are intended to civilize people.
ex.cn: 那些设施的目的在于教化民众.

def: vt.分类，归类,把…列为密件

ex.en: It is necessary initially to classify the headaches into certain types.
ex.cn: 首先，必须将头痛分为几个类型。

ex.en: Men in the post office classify mail according to places it is to go.
ex.cn: 邮局里的人员将信件按寄送地点分类.

ex.en: It is entirly proper to classify Kant as a transcendental idealist.
ex.cn: 把康德化为先驻的唯心主义者是完全正确的.

def:
n.行为准则,代码，密码,法典,信号
vt.将…译成电码,编码，加密
vi.为…编码,指定遗传密码

ex.en: "Tired and emotional" is a code word for being drunk.
ex.cn: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

ex.en: I think nationalism is just a code word for racism.
ex.cn: 我认为民族主义不过是种族主义的代名词。

ex.en: The newspaper breached the code of conduct on privacy.
ex.cn: 该报违反了保护隐私的行为准则。

def:
vi.折叠,倒塌,崩溃,（尤指工作劳累后）坐下
vt.使倒塌,使坍塌,使瓦解
n.垮台,（身体的）衰弱

ex.en: A few days after his collapse he was sitting up in bed.
ex.cn: 他病倒后没过几天就又能在床上坐起来了。

ex.en: He was short of cash after the collapse of his business.
ex.cn: 在公司倒闭后，他手头缺少现金。

ex.en: Do they realize we are racing towards complete economic collapse?
ex.cn: 他们意识到我们的经济马上要彻底崩溃了吗？

def: n.纵队，列,圆柱,专栏

ex.en: She also writes a regular column for the Times Educational Supplement.
ex.cn: 她也定期为《泰晤士报高等教育增刊》写专栏文章。

ex.en: Word went out that a column of tanks was on its way.
ex.cn: 有消息说一队坦克已经出动了。

ex.en: I ghosted his weekly rugby column for the Telegraph.
ex.cn: 我为他代写《电讯报》每周的橄榄球专栏。

def: n.商业,商务,贸易

ex.en: There were notable jousts with the Secretary of Commerce.
ex.cn: 和商业部长之间明显存在竞争。

ex.en: leaders of industry and commerce
ex.cn: 工商界领导人

ex.en: During the war, they laid an embargo on commerce with enemy countries.
ex.cn: 在战争期间, 他们禁止与敌国通商.

def: n.商品,日用品,有价值的物品,有利，有益

ex.en: Many brokers were charged with cheating customers in commodity trades.
ex.cn: 许多经纪人被指控在商品交易中欺骗顾客。

ex.en: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.
ex.cn: 钱对她来说就是个抽象的东西，她从不去想钱。

ex.en: The authorities took measures to roll commodity price back.
ex.cn: 当局采取措施使物价全面回降.

def:
vt.传达，表达,显示：清晰地揭示,表明,传染：扩散
vi.通讯,交际,相连,相通

ex.en: Family therapy showed us how to communicate with each other.
ex.cn: 家庭疗法指导我们彼此之间的沟通交流。

ex.en: He was unprepared to co-operate, or indeed to communicate.
ex.cn: 他不愿意合作，甚至拒绝交流。

ex.en: Group members have to communicate with each other through role-play.
ex.cn: 小组成员必须通过角色扮演互相交流。

def: adj.可比较的,比得上的

ex.en: In other comparable countries real wages increased much more rapidly.
ex.cn: 在其他具有可比性的国家，实际工资上涨更快。

ex.en: By contrast, the comparable figure for the Netherlands is 16 per cent.
ex.cn: 相反，荷兰的相对数字为16%。

ex.en: Published rates are not always directly comparable.
ex.cn: 公布的比率并不是每次都可以直接进行比较。

def:
adj.比较（上）的,按比较估计的,相当的，还可以的
n.[语]（形容词或副词的）比较级形式,可匹敌者，可比拟物

ex.en: The comparative of "pretty" is "prettier".
ex.cn: pretty的比较级形式是prettier。

ex.en: a comparative study of the educational systems of two countries
ex.cn: 两国教育制度的比较研究

ex.en: After many hardships, he now lives in comparative ease.
ex.cn: 经过许多困难之后, 他现在的生活相对舒适.

def: vt.强迫，迫使,强制发生，使不得不

ex.en: The law can compel fathers to make regular payments for their children.
ex.cn: 这项法律可强制父亲定期支付子女费用。

ex.en: Do you think you can compel obedience from me?
ex.cn: 你以为你能逼我服从 吗 ?

ex.en: The arguments are founded on facts and compel conviction.
ex.cn: 这些论点以事实为根据,令人不得不信服.

def: n.补偿，赔偿,修正,补救办法

ex.en: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
ex.cn: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

ex.en: The company announced a double-barreled investment and management-compensation plan.
ex.cn: 公司宣布了一份投资和管理补偿的双重计划。

ex.en: Haemophiliacs are seeking compensation for being given contaminated blood.
ex.cn: 血友病患者们因为被输入了受到污染的血液而正在寻求赔偿。

def:
adj.结构复杂的,混乱的，麻烦的
v.使复杂化( complicate的过去式)

ex.en: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
ex.cn: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

ex.en: His love life was complicated, and involved intense relationships.
ex.cn: 他的爱情生活很复杂，几段感情都是轰轰烈烈。

ex.en: The situation was complicated by the spread of a serious forest fire.
ex.cn: 一场严重的森林大火的蔓延使得形势更加复杂。

def:
adj.确信的，深信的,有信心的，沉着的,大胆的，过分自信的,厚颜无耻的
n.知己,心腹朋友

ex.en: He was confident the allies would make good on their pledges.
ex.cn: 他相信盟友们会履行他们的承诺。

ex.en: She has now changed into a happy, self-confident woman.
ex.cn: 如今她已经变成一个快乐、自信的女人。

ex.en: If there has to be a replay we are confident of victory.
ex.cn: 如果重新比赛，我们有信心取得胜利。

def:
vi.符合,遵照,适应环境
vt.使遵守,使一致,使顺从
adj.一致的,顺从的

ex.en: Taxis must conform to the rigorous standards laid down by the police.
ex.cn: 出租车必须遵守警方的严格规定。

ex.en: Like most "peacetime wars" it did not conform to preconceived ideas.
ex.cn: 如同大多数“和平时代的战争”一样，这与我们的预想不同。

ex.en: Many children who can't or don't conform are often bullied.
ex.cn: 很多不能或不按规矩行事的小孩常常被人欺负。

def: n.混乱,混淆,困惑

ex.en: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
ex.cn: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

ex.en: Use different colours of felt pen on your sketch to avoid confusion.
ex.cn: 用不同颜色的毡头笔画草图，以免搞混。

ex.en: His people had fallen further and further into a quagmire of confusion.
ex.cn: 他的人民在混乱不安的泥潭里越陷越深。

def:
n.准许，赞同,同意,（意见等的）一致
vi.同意,赞成，赞同,允许

ex.en: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
ex.cn: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

ex.en: He left the company by mutual consent last September.
ex.cn: 去年9月，经双方同意，他离开了公司。

ex.en: He should not commit American troops without the full consent of Congress.
ex.cn: 没有国会的完全同意，他不应该调遣美国军队。

def: adj.相当大（或多）的,该注意的，应考虑的

ex.en: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

ex.en: Shares and bonds can bring one quite a considerable additional income.
ex.cn: 股票和债券能给人带来不菲的额外收入。

ex.en: What'simpressed me has been his considerable firmness of purpose.
ex.cn: 令我印象深刻的是他对目标的坚定不移。

def:
n.接触,触点,[医]（传染病）接触人,门路
vt.使接触,与…联系,与…通讯（或通话）
vi.联系，接触

ex.en: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
ex.cn: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

ex.en: The college has brought me into contact with western ideas.
ex.cn: 上大学使我接触了西方的思想。

ex.en: He made contact with someone with an idea for reconditioning laser copiers.
ex.cn: 他联系了一个会修理激光复印机的人。

def: n.方便，便利,便利设施,个人的舒适或利益,（公共）厕所

ex.en: Like working women anywhere, Asian women are buying convenience foods.
ex.cn: 像其他地方的职业女性一样，亚洲女性也购买方便食品。

ex.en: Frozen fish is a very healthy convenience food.
ex.cn: 冻鱼是非常健康的方便食品。

ex.en: They may use a credit card for convenience.
ex.cn: 为了方便，他们可以使用信用卡。

def: n.会议,全体与会者,国际公约,惯例，习俗，规矩

ex.en: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
ex.cn: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

ex.en: Houston was chosen as the site for the convention.
ex.cn: 休斯敦被选作大会的会址。

ex.en: All new fashion starts out as a reaction against existing convention.
ex.cn: 所有新时尚都是从打破现有常规开始的。

def: adj.传统的,习用的，平常的,依照惯例的,约定的

ex.en: He hates the wheeling and dealing associated with conventional political life.
ex.cn: 他对传统政治生活中的权术钻营深恶痛绝。

ex.en: I want to reiterate that our conventional weapons are superior.
ex.cn: 我要再次重申，我们的常规武器是一流的。

ex.en: Alternative treatments can provide a useful back-up to conventional treatment.
ex.cn: 替代疗法能为传统的治疗提供有效的辅助。

def: vt.传达，传递,运送，输送,[法]让与，转让（财产等）,表达

ex.en: Euclid was trying to convey his idea of a geometrical point.
ex.cn: 欧几里得试图表达他的一个几何学观点。

ex.en: The speed at which we talk can also convey a great deal.
ex.cn: 我们的语速同样能传达许多信息。

ex.en: Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.
ex.cn: 红色之类的颜色可给人以充满活力与力量的感觉。

def: n.委员会,（郡、镇等）政务会,（尤指旧时讨论特定步骤的）协商会议,市政（或地方管理）服务机构

ex.en: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute.
ex.cn: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

ex.en: Today's Security Council resolution will be a significant success for American diplomacy.
ex.cn: 今天的安理会决议将是美国外交取得的一个重大成功。

ex.en: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
ex.cn: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

def:
n.协商，讨论,建议,策略,法律顾问，辩护人
vt.劝告，建议,提供专业咨询

ex.en: The defence counsel warned that the judge should stop the trial.
ex.cn: 被告辩护律师强烈建议法官应该休庭。

ex.en: It is wise to seek help and counsel as soon as possible.
ex.cn: 尽快寻求帮助和建议乃明智之举。

ex.en: Singleton's counsel said after the trial that he would appeal.
ex.cn: 审判结束后，辛格尔顿的律师表示他将会上诉。

def:
n.柜台,对立面,计数器,（某些棋盘游戏的）筹码
adj.相反的
vt.反击，还击,反向移动，对着干,反驳，回答
vi.逆向移动，对着干,反驳
adv.反方向地,背道而驰地

ex.en: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
ex.cn: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

ex.en: The army now appears to have launched a counter-offensive.
ex.cn: 军队现在似乎已经发起了反攻。

ex.en: The shop assistant received me indifferently while leaning on a counter.
ex.cn: 商店售货员靠在柜台上漫不经心地招呼我。

def: n.配对物,副本,相对物,极相似的人或物

ex.en: The Foreign Minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.
ex.cn: 外交部长与中国外交部长举行了会谈。

ex.en: It is not a unique instance , but has its counterpart.
ex.cn: 无独有偶.

ex.en: Night is the counterpart of day.
ex.cn: 黑夜与白天相辅相成.

def:
vt.破裂，打开,（使…）开裂,说（笑话）,开瓶
vi.断裂，折断,碎裂声，爆裂声,镜子破裂了,失去控制，衰退
n.裂缝,试图,缝隙,（可听到响声的）重击
adj.训练有素的,技艺高超的,优秀的,一流的

ex.en: She's calm and strong, and she is just not going to crack.
ex.cn: 她镇定而且坚强，绝不会垮掉。

ex.en: In severe cases, the skin can crack and weep.
ex.cn: 在恶劣的条件下，皮肤可能会开裂并流脓。

ex.en: Drug experts say it could spell the end of the crack epidemic.
ex.cn: 禁毒专家说它可能会结束强效可卡因吸食泛滥的局面。

def:
adj.粗糙的，粗杂的,粗鲁的,天然的，未加工的,简陋的
n.原[生]材料，天然物质,原油

ex.en: Oil majors need not fear being unable to sell their crude.
ex.cn: 大型石油公司无需担心原油销售不出去。

ex.en: A crude oil slick quickly spreads out over water.
ex.cn: 原油泄露后的浮油很快在水面上扩散开来。

ex.en: Don't be crude tonight, Bernard, it doesn't become you.
ex.cn: 今晚别说荤话，伯纳德，说荤话可不好。

def: adj.好奇的, 好求知的,奇妙的, 稀奇的

ex.en: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
ex.cn: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

ex.en: By a curious twist of fate, cricket was also my favourite sport.
ex.cn: 让人感到惊奇的是，板球碰巧也是我最喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Steve was intensely curious about the world I came from.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫非常想了解我以前生活的那个世界。

def:
vt.宣布,声明，声称,申报,[法]供述
vi.声明，发表宣言,宣称

vt.装饰,点缀,粉刷,授予（某人）勋章
vi.装饰,布置

ex.en: Use shells to decorate boxes, trays, mirrors or even pots.
ex.cn: 用贝壳来装点盒子、托盘、镜子甚至是花盆。

ex.en: How could we decorate the room to liven it up?
ex.cn: 我们怎么才能把这房间装饰得更有生气呢？

ex.en: Use any pastry trimmings to decorate the apples.
ex.cn: 用剩余的油酥面皮装饰苹果。

def: vt.奉献，献身,（为表示感情或敬意将著作、乐曲、艺术作品等）题献给（某人、某事业等）(to),（在书、音乐或作品的前部）题献辞,以…供奉

ex.en: He felt that medicine was the most important cause to which he could dedicate himself.
ex.cn: 他觉得医学是他能够为之献身的最重大的事业.

ex.en: She vowed to herself that she would dedicate her life to scientific studies.
ex.cn: 她默默地发誓要献身于科学研究.

ex.en: To my father I dedicate this volume in token of affection and gratitude.
ex.cn: 我谨以此书献给我的父亲,以表示对他的爱戴和感激之情.

def:
vt.认为，视为,主张，断定
vi.认为，视为，以为,作某种评价

ex.en: I deem it advisable to purchase the shares in the railway now.
ex.cn: 我认为现在购买铁路股票是明智的.

ex.en: Don't you deem that it is your duty to help?
ex.cn: 你不认为助人是你的责任 吗 ?

ex.en: I deem it an honour to accept your invitation.
ex.cn: 承蒙您的邀请,我觉得很荣幸.

def: n.传送，投递,[法]（正式）交付,分娩,讲演

ex.en: The doctor worked busily beneath the blinding lights of the delivery room.
ex.cn: 这位医生在产房刺目的灯光下忙碌着。

ex.en: His speeches were magnificently written but his delivery was hopeless.
ex.cn: 他的发言稿写得非常精彩，但他的演讲风格真是无可救药。

ex.en: Use recorded delivery for large cheques or money orders.
ex.cn: 对于大额的支票和汇款单要使用挂号邮寄。

def: n.民众,民主国家,民主主义,民主政治

ex.en: He said parliament and the process of democracy had been debased.
ex.cn: 他说议会和民主程序已遭贬值。

ex.en: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
ex.cn: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

ex.en: The person who embodies democracy at the local level is the mayor.
ex.cn: 在地方上代表民主的人是市长。

def: adj.绝望的,由绝望而引起的,铤而走险的，孤注一掷的,急切的，极度渴望的

ex.en: Car firms are desperate to achieve economies of scale.
ex.cn: 汽车厂商拼命想要实现规模经济。

ex.en: They admit they are now desperate for a lucky break.
ex.cn: 他们承认现在急盼幸运之神的降临。

ex.en: The company'sclosure has left many small businessmen in desperate financial straits.
ex.cn: 该公司的倒闭让很多小商人陷入了经济困境。

def: n.灾难,彻底的失败,不幸,祸患

ex.en: An airliner came close to disaster while approaching Heathrow Airport.
ex.cn: 一架大型客机在飞近希思罗机场时差点儿发生空难。

ex.en: We were in a disaster situation that defies description.
ex.cn: 我们陷入了难以言表的糟糕处境。

ex.en: The President described the disaster as an act of God.
ex.cn: 总统将这场灾难说成是天灾。

def:
vt.看出,理解，了解,识别，辨别
vi.辨明，分清

ex.en: Below the bridge we could just discern a narrow, weedy ditch.
ex.cn: 我们仅能依稀辨出桥下一条杂草丛生的窄沟。

ex.en: It is possible to discern a number of different techniques in her work.
ex.cn: 从她的作品中可以识别出许多不同的创作手法。

ex.en: Some people find it difficult to discern blue from green.
ex.cn: 有些人很难分辨蓝色与绿色.

def: vt.使气馁,使沮丧,阻碍,劝阻

ex.en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
ex.cn: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

ex.en: Many parents find it hard to discourage bad behaviour.
ex.cn: 很多父母觉得要孩子循规蹈矩是件很难的事情。

ex.en: His parents tried to discourage his interest in music, but he persisted.
ex.cn: 他的父母设法打消他对音乐的兴趣，但他始终坚持。

def:
vt.隐瞒，掩饰,伪装，假装,化装,掩盖
n.伪装,伪装品,用作伪装的东西,托辞，借口

ex.en: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success.
ex.cn: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。

ex.en: You'll have to travel in disguise.
ex.cn: 你只能乔装出行。

ex.en: He was wearing that ridiculous disguise.
ex.cn: 他一副滑稽的装扮。

def:
n.混乱，凌乱,动乱，骚乱,不正当行为,（身心机能的）失调
vt.使混乱，使凌乱,扰乱,使（身心等）失调,使（神经等）错乱

ex.en: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
ex.cn: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

ex.en: Inside all was disorder: drawers fallen out, shoes and boots scattered.
ex.cn: 屋内凌乱不堪：抽屉都掉落出来，鞋靴东一只西一只满地都是。

ex.en: The disorder in military policy had its origins in Truman's first term.
ex.cn: 军事政策的混乱可追溯到杜鲁门的第一届任期。

def:
vt.& vi.辩论，争论
vt.就…进行争论，辩论,对…的真实或有效进行争论，怀疑,争夺，竞争,抵抗，抵制
n.辩论,争端,（劳资）纠纷,罢工
vi.激烈争辩,争执,争吵,吵架

vt.不顾,不理会,漠视，忽视,蔑视，轻视
n.漠视，忽视,不理，不顾,不尊重

ex.en: He drove with blithe disregard for the rules of the road.
ex.cn: 他开车时全然不顾交通法规。

ex.en: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
ex.cn: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

ex.en: a wanton disregard for human life
ex.cn: 全然不顾人的死活

def:
vt.使溶解,使（固态物）溶解为液体，使液化,使消失，使消逝，消除,使终止
vi.溶解,融化，液化,解散，散去,分裂，分解

ex.en: Kaifu threatened to dissolve the Parliament and call an election.
ex.cn: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

ex.en: Substances such as ammonia give out heat when they dissolve.
ex.cn: 诸如氨气之类的物质在溶解时会释放出热量。

ex.en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker.
ex.cn: 先将糖稍稍加热，以使其溶解得更快些。

def: adj.明显的，清楚的,卓越的，不寻常的,有区别的,确切的

ex.en: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
ex.cn: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

ex.en: Editorially, they never really became a unique distinct product.
ex.cn: 就立场和观点来说，它们从未真正做到树立起自己独具一格的视角。

ex.en: Modern linguistics emerged as a distinct field in the nineteenth century.
ex.cn: 现代语言学在19世纪作为一个独立的领域出现。

def:
vt.歪曲，扭曲,曲解,使变形
vi.扭曲,变形

ex.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
ex.cn: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

ex.en: This caused the sound to distort.
ex.cn: 这导致了声音的失真。

ex.en: Exaggerated sections distort the shapes of folds as well as bed thickness.
ex.cn: 比例放大的剖面歪曲褶皱的形态和岩层厚度.

def: n.分开，分隔,[数]除法,部门,[军]师

ex.en: Villa had just been relegated from the First Division.
ex.cn: 维拉队刚刚从甲级联赛中降级。

ex.en: Hibernian clinched the First Division title when they beat Hamilton 2-0.
ex.cn: 希伯尼安队以2比0战胜汉密尔顿队，夺得了甲级联赛的冠军。

ex.en: The narrowness of the government's victory reflected deep division within the Party.
ex.cn: 政府的勉强获胜反映了党内的严重分歧。

def:
adj.钝的,迟钝的,呆滞的,阴暗的
v.缓和,减轻,使阴暗

ex.en: The evidence was read out to the court in a dull monotone.
ex.cn: 证据被当庭呆板地宣读了一遍。

ex.en: I found the characters very two-dimensional, not to say dull.
ex.cn: 我觉得那些人物形象即使不说是乏味无聊，至少也是毫无深度。

ex.en: Broadcast news was accurate and reliable but deadly dull.
ex.cn: 新闻广播准确可靠但却非常枯燥。

def:
adj.耐用的，耐久的,持久的,长期的
n.耐用品，耐久品

ex.en: The durable high-impact plastic case is water resistant to 100 feet.
ex.cn: 这种结实的高强度塑料盒子在水下100英尺以内是防水的。

ex.en: negotiations for a durable peace
ex.cn: 为持久和平而进行的谈判

ex.en: This varnish provides a durable finish.
ex.cn: 这种清漆可作耐久的罩面漆.

def: vt.排除，消除,淘汰,除掉,<口>干掉

ex.en: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
ex.cn: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

ex.en: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
ex.cn: 美国打算取消电子产品等的关税。

ex.en: Credit cards eliminate the need to carry a lot of cash.
ex.cn: 有了信用卡就用不着携带很多现金。

def: n.<法>精华,精锐，精英,上层集团,（统称）掌权人物

ex.en: They were, by and large, a very wealthy, privileged elite.
ex.cn: 他们基本上是一些非常有钱有势的精英。

ex.en: Only the educational elite go 〔 goes 〕 to Oxford or Cambridge.
ex.cn: 只有学业上的精英才能上牛津或剑桥大学.

ex.en: The power elite inside the government is controlling foreign policy.
ex.cn: 政府内部的一群握有实权的精英控制着对外政策.

def:
vt.& vi.拥抱
vt.包括,包含,接受,信奉
n.拥抱，怀抱

ex.en: I couldn't find it in me to embrace him.
ex.cn: 我打心眼里不想拥抱他。

ex.en: She broke loose from his embrace and crossed to the window.
ex.cn: 她从他怀抱里挣脱出来，走到窗前。

ex.en: John gently disengaged himself from his sister's tearful embrace.
ex.cn: 约翰轻轻推开抱着他哭泣的妹妹。

def:
vt.& vi.尝试，试图,尽力，竭力
n.努力，尽力

ex.en: Thereupon, we knew, our endeavor was valuable.
ex.cn: 于是, 我们知道, 我们的努力是有价值的!

ex.en: Implying that human endeavor could turn back the tides of fate.
ex.cn: 言下大有以人力挽回天命之意.

ex.en: We endeavor to make our customers satisfied.
ex.cn: 我们力图使顾客都满意。

def:
n.尽力，竭力
vi.&vt.努力，竭力
vt.启发，启蒙,开导，教导,〈古〉照耀

ex.en: She didn't enlighten him about her background.
ex.cn: 她未向他讲明自己的出身背景。

ex.en: Would you enlighten me on your plans for the future?
ex.cn: 请给我解释一下你将来的计划好 吗 ?

ex.en: Please favour [ enlighten ] me with your instructions.
ex.cn: 请不吝赐教.

def: n.同等，平等,[数]相等，等式

ex.en: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
ex.cn: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

ex.en: All our activities are premised on the basis of "Quality with Equality".
ex.cn: 我们所有活动都是以“优质、平等”为前提的。

ex.en: The Commission for Racial Equality teaches organisations not to discriminate.
ex.cn: 种族平等委员会告诫各家机构不要心存歧视。

def: vt.发挥,运用,使受（影响等）,用（力）

ex.en: We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
ex.cn: 我们都知道太卖命了会导致心跳加速。

ex.en: He likes to exert his authority.
ex.cn: 他喜欢行使自己的权力.

ex.en: Exert yourself to the utmost!
ex.cn: 子其勉之!

def: n.爆炸，炸裂,爆发,扩张，激增,（感情，尤指愤怒的）突然爆发

ex.en: A violent explosion seemed to jolt the whole ground.
ex.cn: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。

ex.en: A helicopter crashed in a fiery explosion in Vallejo.
ex.cn: 一架直升机在瓦列霍爆炸起火并坠毁。

ex.en: The house was unoccupied at the time of the explosion.
ex.cn: 爆炸发生的时候房子里没有人。

def: n.伸展，扩大,延长，延期,[医]牵引,电话分机

ex.en: After a further four-month extension of her probation period, she was sacked.
ex.cn: 在又试用了4个月后，她被开除了。

ex.en: For further information, please contact 414 3925, extension 2253.
Many Filipinos see the bases as an extension of American colonial rule.
ex.cn: 很多菲律宾人视这些基地为美国殖民统治的延续。

def:
n.眉毛
v.为…描眉

ex.en: He had sustained a cut on his left eyebrow.
ex.cn: 他左眼眉上留下了一道疤。

ex.en: She looked up at me significantly, raising an eyebrow.
ex.cn: 她抬起头，眉毛扬起，意味深长地看着我。

ex.en: He raised a questioning eyebrow.
ex.cn: 他探询地挑起了眉毛。

def:
vi.褪去，失去光泽,逐渐消逝,凋谢，衰老
vt.使褪色
adj.乏味的，平淡的

n.名声,名望,传闻,传说
vt.使闻名,使出名,使有名望,<古>盛传

vt.使着迷,使神魂颠倒,蛊惑
vi.入迷

ex.en: I believed devoutly in her power to fascinate him, in her dazzling loveliness.
ex.cn: 我由衷地相信她有使他神魂颠倒的力量, 相信她有令人眼花缭乱的姿色.

ex.en: How can the comets , asteroids and meteorites , which fascinate us , kill us?
ex.cn: 随着太阳的不断扩张, 太阳系中其它的星球将发生怎样的变化?

ex.en: The cute aspect that she read the cartoon book fascinate me.
ex.cn: 看到她上课时看漫画时可爱的样子我都着迷.

def:
vt.系牢，钉牢,使坚固或稳固,使合在一起：封合,集中：稳定地集中或指向：
vi.附着，扣紧,紧握，紧抱,集中：显著地注意，集中

ex.en: Builders must fasten down roofs of newly-built homes more securely.
ex.cn: 建造工人必须把新建房屋的屋顶固定得更牢靠些。

ex.en: They fasten with a drawstring.
ex.cn: 它们是用拉绳系紧的。

ex.en: Fasten your seatbelts, please.
ex.cn: 请系好安全带。

def: adj.肥沃的,可繁殖的,想象力丰富的

ex.en: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
ex.cn: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

ex.en: Aeons ago, there were deserts where there is now fertile land.
ex.cn: 现在是肥沃土地的地方在很久很久以前曾是一片片沙漠。

ex.en: This leaves fertile soil unprotected and prone to erosion.
ex.cn: 这会让肥沃的土壤暴露在外，使其容易受到侵蚀。

def: n.小说，虚构的文学作品,虚构的或想像出的事，并非完全真实的事,编造，虚构

ex.en: Fiction takes up a large slice of the publishing market.
ex.cn: 小说在出版市场上占了很大的份额。

ex.en: Naomi's mothering experiences are poignantly described in her fiction.
ex.cn: 娜奥米把她当母亲的经历字字辛酸地写进了小说。

ex.en: The line between fact and fiction is becoming blurred.
ex.cn: 事实和虚构之间的界限正变得模糊起来。

def: adj.灵活的,易弯曲的,柔韧的,易被说服的

ex.en: Times become more flexible off-season, especially in the smaller provincial museums.
ex.cn: 尤其是在规模较小的地方博物馆，开放时间在旅游淡季更加灵活。

ex.en: Because the work was voluntary it was flexible, time-wise.
ex.cn: 这项工作是自愿的，所以时间上很灵活。

ex.en: He shopped around for a firm that would be flexible.
ex.cn: 他到处寻觅一家可灵活变通的公司。

def: n.形成,构成，结构,形成物,编队，队形

ex.en: They saw a squadron of fifteen motorcycle policemen driving in V-formation.
ex.cn: 他们看见15名警察骑着摩托车排成V字形前行。

ex.en: He was flying in formation with seven other jets.
ex.cn: 他和其他7架喷气机一起列队飞行。

ex.en: the formation of a new government
ex.cn: 组成新政府

def:
n.缺口,分歧,间隔,美国休闲服饰品牌
vt.造成缝隙,使成缺口,使豁裂
vi.豁开,张开,有缺口,露出裂口

ex.en: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
ex.cn: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

ex.en: By 1973, this gap had narrowed almost to vanishing point.
ex.cn: 到1973年，这一差距已缩小到几乎为零。

ex.en: There is a credibility gap developing between employers and employees.
ex.cn: 雇主和雇员之间出现了信任危机。

def:
n.巨人，大汉,巨兽，巨物,卓越人物
adj.特大的，巨大的,伟大的

ex.en: A giant wildcat is being hunted after 58 lambs were butchered.
ex.cn: 一只大野猫在捕杀了58只羊羔后遭到猎捕。

ex.en: The result has been a giant leap in productivity.
ex.cn: 其结果是生产力的大幅提高。

ex.en: Fewer than a thousand giant pandas still live in the wild.
ex.cn: 只有不到1,000只大熊猫仍然在野外生活。

def:
n.一瞥，一看,（古语）闪光,隐约的闪现,模糊的感觉
vi.瞥见

ex.en: Several thousand supporters strained to catch a glimpse of the new president.
ex.cn: 几千名支持者翘首企盼能一睹新总统的风采。

ex.en: Crowds shouted and pushed to get a glimpse of their hero.
ex.cn: 为了一睹英雄的风采，人群喊叫着，推搡着。

ex.en: Below us you could glimpse the rooftops of a few small villages.
ex.cn: 我们可以瞥见脚下一些小村庄的屋顶。

def: adj.全球的，全球性的，有关全球大局的,全面的，整体的，全局的,球形的，球状的，球面的，球体的,[计]全程的

ex.en: Global ecological efforts can easily be at odds with local ecologies.
ex.cn: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

ex.en: Temperature records have unequivocally confirmed the existence of global warming.
ex.cn: 气温记录清楚无疑地证实了全球气候正在变暖。

ex.en: Newspapers seized on the results as proof that global warming wasn'treally happening.
ex.cn: 各报纸纷纷以此结果为证据来证明全球变暖并没有真正发生。

def:
n.球，球状物,地球，世界,天体,地球仪
v.（使）成球状

ex.en: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
ex.cn: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。

ex.en: Martin, 78, died yesterday. Tributes poured in from around the globe.
ex.cn: 马丁于昨天去世，享年78岁。世界各地的人们纷纷致以哀悼。

ex.en: America's media companies bestride the globe.
ex.cn: 美国的传媒公司称雄寰球。

def:
vt.抓住,了解,急忙抓住,急切（或贪婪）地抓住
n.控制,控制力,能力所及
vi.攫取（常与 at 连用）,急于接受,急切地寻求（常与 for 连用）

ex.en: He let the ball slip through his grasp and into the net.
ex.cn: 球从他的掌中滑出，钻进了球门。

ex.en: His hand was taken in a warm, firm grasp.
ex.cn: 他的手被热情地紧紧握住了。

ex.en: Attlee was extremely intelligent and his grasp of the situation was masterly.
ex.cn: 阿特利聪明过人，对局势的把握颇为高明。

def:
n.紧握，抓牢,握力,掌握，理解,能力，胜任
vt.握紧，抓牢,吸引住：吸引…的兴趣或注意力,引起
vi.抓牢，紧握：保持紧握

ex.en: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?
ex.cn: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

ex.en: Such cars, however, do grip the road well, even in the dry.
ex.cn: 不过，这种车即使在干燥路面上也表现出了良好的抓地性能。

ex.en: Luke answered by tightening his grip on her shoulder.
ex.cn: 卢克的回应就是把她的肩头抓得更紧了。

def: n.指导，引导,导航,领导

ex.en: I went down on my knees and prayed for guidance.
ex.cn: 我跪了下来，祈求得到指引。

ex.en: The couple have sought help from marriage guidance counsellors.
ex.cn: 这对夫妇已经向婚姻指导顾问寻求帮助。

ex.en: The guidance systems didn't work and the missile couldn't hit its target.
ex.cn: 导航系统失灵，导弹未能命中目标。

def:
n.海港,海湾,避难所,躲藏处
vt.& vi.心怀,庇护,避入安全地,（船）入港停泊

ex.en: He had jumped overboard in New York harbor and swum to shore.
ex.cn: 他在纽约港跳下船，游上了岸。

ex.en: The Harbor was replete with boats.
ex.cn: 港口里满是船只。

ex.en: The harbor lies to the south of the city.
ex.cn: 港口在城市的南边.

def:
n.海港，港口,港湾,避难所,藏身处
vt.&vi.隐匿,怀着,包含，聚藏,藏有
na.“harbor“的变体

ex.en: Sewage nutrients do increase algal growth in the harbour.
ex.cn: 污水中的营养物确实会加快港口的海藻生长。

ex.en: I waved goodbye and went down the stone harbour steps.
ex.cn: 我挥手告别，然后走下港口石阶。

ex.en: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
ex.cn: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

def:
n.直升机，直升飞机
vt.用直升飞机载送
vi.乘直升飞机

ex.en: A helicopter crashed in a fiery explosion in Vallejo.
ex.cn: 一架直升机在瓦列霍爆炸起火并坠毁。

ex.en: A black Mercedes screeched to a halt beside the helicopter.
ex.cn: 一辆黑色的梅赛德斯轿车在直升机旁嘎的一声刹住了。

ex.en: She served six months in prison for the helicopter caper.
ex.cn: 她因为直升机一案坐了6个月牢。

def:
vi.犹豫，踌躇,不愿,支吾,停顿
vt.对…犹豫,不情愿

ex.en: I might today hesitate to turn in a burglar.
ex.cn: 现在让我把入室窃贼送交警方，我可能会有所顾虑。

ex.en: Do not hesitate to laugh at anything you find amusing.
ex.cn: 只要觉得好笑就尽管笑。

ex.en: This could make your superiors hesitate to trust you with major responsibilities.
ex.cn: 这样会使上级不敢对你委以重任。

def:
n.（图画或照片的）强光部份,最重要的事情,最精彩的部分
vt.强调，突出,把…照亮,标示记号,为…中最突出的事物

ex.en: Once again, the "Free Press" prefers not to highlight these facts.
ex.cn: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。

ex.en: The surveyor's report didn't highlight anything untoward.
ex.cn: 勘测员的报告没有指明有任何麻烦问题。

ex.en: The presidential elections are the highlight of next year's political calendar.
ex.cn: 总统选举是明年政治日程表上的大事.

def: adj.历史的，历史上的,有关历史研究的,有根据的,基于史实的

ex.en: Two historical questions — you can answer them how you like.
ex.cn: 两个历史问题——你可以随便回答。

ex.en: The Telegraph puts the union in a historical perspective.
ex.cn: 《电讯报》从历史的角度对该工会进行了报道。

ex.en: We shall first look briefly at the historical antecedents of this theory.
ex.cn: 我们首先应大致看一下该理论在历史上的前身。

def:
n.[计算机]主机,主人，东道主,节目主持人,酒店业主
vt.当主人,主办宴会，主持节目,款待，做东
vi.做主人，做东道主

ex.en: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
ex.cn: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

ex.en: The new e-books will include a host of Rough Guide titles.
ex.cn: 新电子书将包括大量的简明指南。

ex.en: He left a host of other riders trailing in his slipstream.
ex.cn: 他把其他的摩托车手甩在身后。

def:
n.家庭，户,（集合词）全家人，（包含人在内的）家眷，家属，家里人,家庭,（英）王室
adj.家庭的，家内的，一家的,日常的，家常的，普通的,家喻户晓的,王室的

ex.en: Some barbecues can be plugged into a household electricity supply.
ex.cn: 有一些烧烤炉能直接插到家用电源上。

ex.en: Incineration plants should be built to burn household waste.
ex.cn: 应该建立焚烧厂以焚毁日常生活垃圾。

ex.en: The twins endorsed a line of household cleaning products.
ex.cn: 那对双胞胎为一系列家用清洁产品做广告。

def:
adj.谦逊的,简陋的,（级别或地位）低下的,不大的
vt.使谦恭,轻松打败（尤指强大的对手）,低声下气

ex.en: Now experts are extolling the virtues of the humble potato.
ex.cn: 现在专家们都在赞美其貌不扬的马铃薯的种种好处。

ex.en: There are restaurants, both humble and expensive, that specialize in them.
ex.cn: 专门做这些菜的餐馆既有毫不起眼的也有价格昂贵的。

ex.en: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
ex.cn: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

def: adj.想像中的，假想的，虚构的,[数]虚数的,幻,虚幻

ex.en: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
ex.cn: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

ex.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
ex.cn: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

ex.en: The unicorn is an imaginary beast.
ex.cn: 独角兽是幻想出来的动物.

def: adj.不耐烦的,热切的，渴望的,不能容忍的，恼火的

ex.en: He is impatient as the first hour passes and then another.
ex.cn: 一个小时、两个小时过去了，他不耐烦了。

ex.en: The big clubs are becoming increasingly impatient at the rate of progress.
ex.cn: 大牌俱乐部对缓慢的进展越来越不耐烦了。

ex.en: It's true she gets madly impatient with him, but what mother doesn't?
ex.cn: 她确实对他极其不耐烦，但哪个母亲不是这样呢？

def:
vt.实施，执行,使生效，实现,落实（政策）,把…填满
n.工具，器械,家具,手段,[法]履行（契约等）

ex.en: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.
ex.cn: 领导才能就是要有实施变革的能力。

ex.en: He tried to implement a technocratic economic policy.
ex.cn: 他力图实行技术统领一切的经济政策。

ex.en: The government has agreed to implement the recommendation in the report.
ex.cn: 政府已同意实施报告中的建议.

def:
vt.强加,征税,以…欺骗
vi.利用,欺骗,施加影响

ex.en: I didn't want to impose myself on my married friends.
ex.cn: 我不想打扰自己已婚的朋友。

ex.en: The law should impose penalties on companies that use energy wastefully.
ex.cn: 法律应当严惩浪费能源的公司。

ex.en: The House voted to impose a one-year moratorium on nuclear testing.
ex.cn: 众议院投票表决将核试验暂停一年。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）倾斜，弄斜,（使）偏向，倾向于,（使）认为,点（头）（以示同意、打招呼等）
n.斜坡,斜面,坡度,倾斜

ex.en: Those who fail incline to blame the world for their failure.
ex.cn: 那些失败者往往将他们的失败归咎于社会。

ex.en: The men had to slog up a steep muddy incline.
ex.cn: 人们只得在陡峭而泥泞的斜坡上艰难地行进。

ex.en: I incline to the view that we should take no action at this stage.
ex.cn: 我倾向于认为我们在这个阶段不应采取行动。

def: adj.不可思议的,惊人的,难以置信的,未必可能的

ex.en: It was an incredible display of motherly love and forgiveness.
ex.cn: 那是慈母般关爱与宽容的了不起的表现。

ex.en: "You're coming?" he said excitedly. "That's fantastic! That's incredible!"
ex.cn: “你要来么？”他激动地说，“那太好了！简直难以置信！”

ex.en: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent.
ex.cn: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。

def:
adj.不可缺少的,绝对必要的,责无旁贷的,不可避开的
n.不可缺少的人或物

ex.en: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
ex.cn: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

ex.en: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.
ex.cn: 汽车已成了我们生活中必不可少的一部分。

ex.en: He is indispensable to our work, we cannot do it without him.
ex.cn: 对于我们的工作来说,他是不可缺少的,没有他, 我们就做不了.

def:
n.婴儿，幼儿,未成年人,初学者，生手
adj.婴儿的，幼儿的,幼稚的，幼小的,初期的,未成年的

ex.en: The United States ranks 20th in its infant mortality rate.
ex.cn: 美国在婴儿死亡率方面排名第20。

ex.en: There was an infant squalling in the back of the church.
ex.cn: 有个婴儿在教堂后部大声啼哭。

ex.en: pioneering work on infant mortality
ex.cn: 婴儿死亡率方面的探索性研究工作

def: n.膨胀,通货膨胀,夸张,自命不凡

ex.en: Specialists see various reasons for the recent surge in inflation.
ex.cn: 专家们认为目前通货膨胀加剧有多种原因。

ex.en: The rate of inflation is running at about 2.7 percent.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀率大约为2.7%。

ex.en: He fears inflation will ratchet up as the year ends.
ex.cn: 他害怕通货膨胀会在年终更加严重。

def:
vt.开始，发起,传授,创始，开辟,接纳新成员
n.新加入某组织（或机构、宗教）的人，新入会的人,被传授初步知识的人
adj.被传授初步知识的,新入会的

ex.en: Chen was an initiate of a Chinese spiritual discipline.
ex.cn: 陈是某个中国神学领域的新入门者。

ex.en: to initiate legal proceedings against sb
ex.cn: 对某人提起诉讼

ex.en: A language teacher should initiate pupils into the elements of grammar.
ex.cn: 语言老师应该把基本语法教给学生.

def: vt.（给…）注射（药物等）,（给…）注射（液体）,（给…）添加,（给…）投入（资金）

ex.en: The result might inject more sense into future bargaining.
ex.cn: 其结果可能为未来的谈判注入更多的理性。

ex.en: She kept trying to inject a little fun into their relationship.
ex.cn: 她一直在设法为他们的关系增添一些情趣。

ex.en: We hope to inject new life into our work.
ex.cn: 我们希望给我们的工作注入新的活力.

def: vt.损害，毁坏,伤害（名誉、自尊等）,（尤指事故中）伤害,伤害（感情，自尊心等）

ex.en: I can say, with absolute truthfulness, that I did not injure her.
ex.cn: 我可以绝对坦率地说，我没有伤害她。

ex.en: You do not go out to injure opponents.
ex.cn: 你并非蓄意伤害对手。

ex.en: It can be no light matter for the Home Office that so many young prisoners should have wanted to kill or injure themselves.
ex.cn: 竟然有那么多的年轻囚犯试图自杀或自残，内政部决不可等闲视之。

def: n.改革，创新,新观念,新发明,新设施

ex.en: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
ex.cn: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

ex.en: His greatest innovation was the use of interchangeable parts.
ex.cn: 他最大的革新在于使用了可互换的零件。

ex.en: Capitalism stresses innovation, competition and individualism.
ex.cn: 资本主义强调的是创新、竞争和个人至上。

def:
vt.鼓舞,激励,赋予灵感,启迪
vi.吸，吸入

ex.en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
ex.cn: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

ex.en: These herbs will inspire you to try out all sorts of exotic-flavoured dishes!
ex.cn: 这些香草会激发你去品尝各种异国风味的菜肴！

ex.en: The caves cannot but inspire wonder in the beholder.
ex.cn: 这些洞穴让观者无不叹为观止。

def:
n.本能，天性,冲动,天资，天才
adj.深深地充满着

ex.en: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
ex.cn: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

ex.en: She hadn't followed her instinct and because of this Frank was dead.
ex.cn: 她没有听从自己心里的话，弗兰克因此死了。

ex.en: Farmers are increasingly losing touch with their instinct for managing the land.
ex.cn: 农民正在逐渐丢失经营土地的本领。

def: n.介绍,引言，导言,采用，引进,新采用的东西

ex.en: Millions of words have been written about the introduction of the euro.
ex.cn: 有关采用欧元的文章已经有很多。

ex.en: On balance, the book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
ex.cn: 总而言之，这是一本通俗而务实的物理入门书。

ex.en: The camera has undergone only two minor tweaks since its introduction.
ex.cn: 那款相机自从推出以来仅经过两次小的改进。

def:
n.果酱,拥挤，挤满,困境,[无线]干扰
vt.把…挤进,把…塞满，使挤紧,使堵塞,使卡住
vi.挤满，拥挤,堵塞,发生故障

ex.en: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.
ex.cn: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。

ex.en: His room was jam-packed with fruit, flowers, gifts etc.
ex.cn: 他的房间里堆满了水果、鲜花及礼品等。

ex.en: Did she do things like bottling fruit or making jam?
ex.cn: 她干过将水果装瓶或做果酱之类的活计吗？

def:
vt.发射,[计算机]开始（应用程序）,发动,开展（活动、计划等）
vi.投入,着手进行,热衷于…
n.投掷,大船上的小艇,大型敞篷摩托艇

ex.en: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.
ex.cn: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

ex.en: The ANC is about to launch a nationwide recruitment drive.
ex.cn: 非洲国民大会打算在全国范围内发起招募运动。

ex.en: This was enough to launch their careers into the stratosphere.
ex.cn: 这足以让他们的事业平步青云了。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）倾斜，屈身
vt.倚,依赖,使斜靠,使变瘦
adj.瘦的,贫瘠的,简洁的,精干的
n.瘦肉,倾向,倾斜,倾斜度
vi.倾向于（某种观点、意见或态度等）（与to 或 toward连用）

ex.en: She was feeling tired and was glad to lean against him.
ex.cn: 她正感到有些疲倦，因此很高兴可以靠在他身上。

ex.en: Lean the plants against a wall and cover the roots with peat.
ex.cn: 把植物靠墙摆放，用泥煤盖住根部。

ex.en: It is a beautiful meat, very lean and tender.
ex.cn: 这块肉很好，又瘦又嫩。

def: adv.同样地,也，而且

ex.en: These requests are ignored. His requests for rent are likewise sometimes ignored.
ex.cn: 这些要求被置之不理。他关于支付租金的要求有时也同样未被理睬。

ex.en: Will wanted to do likewise, but felt too discomfited.
ex.cn: 威尔也想照着做，但觉得太难堪了。

ex.en: He voted for the change and he expected his colleagues to do likewise .
ex.cn: 他投票赞成变革并期望他的同事投同样的票。

def: adv.逐字地,照字面地,确实地，真正地,[口语]差不多，简直（用于加强语意）

ex.en: Until next payday, I was literally without any money.
ex.cn: 到下个发薪日前，我真的没有一点儿钱了。

ex.en: To see my body literally wither away before my eyes was exasperating.
ex.cn: 眼见自己的身体日渐衰弱真是让人心烦。

ex.en: Windsor Castle is quite literally an antique treasure trove.
ex.cn: 温莎城堡确实是名副其实的古物宝藏。

def: adj.壮丽的,伟大的，高尚的,华丽的，高贵的,瑰丽的

ex.en: At 54 years old her energy and looks are magnificent.
ex.cn: 她54岁了，精力和气色都非常好。

ex.en: Originally released in 1957, the film was remade as "The Magnificent Seven".
ex.cn: 这部电影最早在1957年上映，后被翻拍为《七侠荡寇志》。

ex.en: It's going to be the most magnificent Thanksgiving dinner we ever had.
ex.cn: 这将是我们参加过的最盛大的感恩节晚餐。

def: n.巨大，广大,重大，重要,量级,（地震）级数

ex.en: The time delay would be smaller by eight orders of magnitude.
ex.cn: 如果按8个数量级来看，延时量会显得小一些。

ex.en: The San Francisco earthquake of 1906 had a magnitude of 8.3.
ex.cn: 1906年旧金山地震的震级为8.3级。

ex.en: Ministers underestimated the magnitude of the task confronting them.
ex.cn: 部长们低估了他们所面临的任务的艰巨性。

def: n.人类,男性，男子

ex.en: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure.
ex.cn: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

ex.en: His research is for the betterment of mankind.
ex.cn: 他的研究是为全人类造福。

ex.en: the history of mankind
ex.cn: 人类的历史

def:
vt.制造，生产,捏造，虚构,加工,从事制造
n.制造,制成品，产品,工业，工厂,（文学作品等的）粗制滥造

ex.en: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
ex.cn: 他们生产这类被称为热塑材料的塑料制品。

ex.en: The date of manufacture of the jewellery has not been authenticated.
ex.cn: 这些珠宝的制造日期尚未经证实.

ex.en: Now they lead in the manufacture of weapons of mass destruction.
ex.cn: 现在他们在制造大规模杀人武器方面领先.

def:
n.硕士,主人（尤指男性）,大师,男教师
vt.精通，熟练,作为主人，做…的主人,征服,使干燥（染过的物品）
adj.主要的,主人的,精通的，优秀的,原版的

ex.en: I fell under the influence of a history master.
ex.cn: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

ex.en: Jackson remained calm and always master of his passions.
ex.cn: 杰克逊镇定自若，始终克制着情绪。

ex.en: When his master's off traveling, Caleb stays with Pierre's parents.
ex.cn: 凯莱布在主人外出旅行时与皮埃尔的父母住在一起。

def:
adj.温柔的,温暖的,轻微的,（味道）不浓的
n.淡味麦芽啤酒

ex.en: His captaincy of the team was ended by mild eye trouble.
ex.cn: 他由于患轻度眼疾而不再担任队长一职。

ex.en: It wasn't anything serious. A mild stomach upset, that's all.
ex.cn: 没什么大不了的。只是胃有点不舒服，没别的。

ex.en: The wine goes with strong and mild cheese alike.
ex.cn: 喝这酒的时候可以搭配浓乳酪或淡乳酪。

def:
n.最低限度,最小量,最低消费,[数]极小值
adj.最低的,最小的,最少的

ex.en: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
ex.cn: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

ex.en: Twelve hours is the minimum, sixty hours the maximum.
ex.cn: 12小时为下限,60小时为上限.

ex.en: He reduced his needs to the minimum by simplifying his life.
ex.cn: 他过上了一种简单的生活，将自己的需求降到最低限度。

def:
adj.较小的，少数的，小…,未成年的,[乐]小调的，小音阶的,（两同姓男孩中）年幼的
n.未成年人,副修科目,小公司,[逻辑学]小前提
vi.[主美国英语]副修，选修，兼修

ex.en: He had a minor stroke in 1987, which left him partly paralysed.
ex.cn: 他1987年曾患轻度中风，之后就半身不遂了。

ex.en: He had a minor operation to remove a cyst.
ex.cn: 他做了个切除囊肿的小手术。

ex.en: Aloe may have an analgesic effect on inflammation and minor skin irritations.
ex.cn: 芦荟可能对发炎以及轻微的皮肤炎症具有镇痛作用。

def: n.方式,状况,时尚，风尚,调式

ex.en: The bicycle reigned supreme as Britain's most popular mode of transport.
ex.cn: 当时自行车是英国最流行的交通工具。

ex.en: Suddenly, the narrator speaks in his most rhetorically elevated mode.
ex.cn: 突然，解说员开始用高昂煽情的语调解说起来。

ex.en: Page Mode shows headers, footers, footnotes and page numbers.
ex.cn: 页面模式可以显示页眉、页脚、脚注和页码。

def: n.心情,语气,气氛,坏心境

ex.en: He faced the press, initially, in a somewhat subdued mood.
ex.cn: 他最初面对媒体时情绪有点忧郁。

ex.en: Collins was in a foul mood even before the interviews began.
ex.cn: 柯林斯在采访还没开始时就暴躁不安起来。

ex.en: In the union office, the mood gradually changed from resignation to rage.
ex.cn: 在工会办公室，情绪慢慢从顺从转变成愤怒。

def:
n.动机，主旨,（艺术作品的）主题，题材
adj.运动的,动机的,发动的
vt.促使

ex.en: Sheila had an ulterior motive for trying to help Stan.
ex.cn: 希拉想帮助斯坦是另有所图的。

ex.en: The motive of the executions would be to instil fear.
ex.cn: 执行死刑的动机是要灌输恐惧。

ex.en: Police have ruled out robbery as a motive for the killing.
ex.cn: 警方已排除因抢劫而杀人的可能。

def: adj.共有的,共同的,相互的,彼此的

ex.en: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
ex.cn: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

ex.en: He left the company by mutual consent last September.
ex.cn: 去年9月，经双方同意，他离开了公司。

ex.en: The campaign has abounded in mutual accusations of uncivilised behaviour.
ex.cn: 整个活动中双方频频指责对方粗野。

def: n.观察,观察力,评论,观察所得

ex.en: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
ex.cn: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

ex.en: The diaries are a mixture of confession and observation.
ex.cn: 这些日记既有自白，也有评论。

ex.en: She was undernourished, an observation that prompted yet another unasked question.
ex.cn: 她看上去营养不良，这一发现又引出了一个未被问及的问题。

def: n.职业，工作,占有，占领,（土地、房屋、建筑等的）使用

ex.en: Intellectual life in France was smothered by the occupation.
ex.cn: 在被占领期间法国思想界受到了压制。

ex.en: Social status is largely determined by the occupation of the main breadwinner.
ex.cn: 社会地位很大程度上是由家里经济支柱的职业决定的。

ex.en: Please state your name, age and occupation below.
ex.cn: 请在下面写明姓名、年龄和职业。

def: n.后代，子孙,产物，结果,（动物的）崽,幼苗

ex.en: Of course, not all alcoholics and drug abusers produce deviant offspring.
ex.cn: 当然，并不是所有的酗酒者和吸毒者都会生育出不正常的后代。

ex.en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
ex.cn: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

ex.en: the problems parents have with their teenage offspring
ex.cn: 父母与青少年子女之间的问题

def: adj.可选择的,随意的，任意的,非强制的,选修科目

ex.en: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro.
ex.cn: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。

ex.en: Optional extras include cooking tuition at a top restaurant.
ex.cn: 可选的额外项目包括在顶级餐厅学习厨艺。

ex.en: The course consists of ten core modules and five optional modules.
ex.cn: 这门课程包括十个必修单元和五个选修单元。

def: adj.有机（体）的,有组织的，系统的,器官的,根本的

ex.en: Today's organic wine producer is typically a small, quality-conscious family concern.
ex.cn: 现今的有机葡萄酒生产商一般是注重品质的小型家族企业.

ex.en: Organic food is unadulterated food produced without artificial chemicals or pesticides.
ex.cn: 有机食品是未使用人工化学制剂和杀虫剂的纯净食品。

ex.en: The Oxford Chemistry Primers aim to cover important topics in organic chemistry.
ex.cn: 《牛津化学初级读本》丛书旨在论述有机化学中的重要问题。

def:
vt.标定方向,使…向东方,以…为参照,使熟悉或适应
adj.东方的,（太阳等）上升的，新生的,闪闪发光的
vi.转向东方,使调整或者成为一条直线
n.东亚各国,珍珠光泽,好的珍珠,日出之处，东方

ex.en: The climbers stopped to orient themselves before descending the mountain.
ex.cn: 登山者先停下来确定所在的位置,然后再下山.

ex.en: The people in the Orient are mainly yellow or brown.
ex.cn: 东方国家的人种主要是黄色的或棕色的.

ex.en: They carried on trade in tea and spices with the orient.
ex.cn: 他们同东方国家做茶叶和香料的生意.

def: n.起源，根源,出身,[数]原点，起点,[解]（筋，神经的）起端

ex.en: There are some areas of wetland which are of ancient origin.
ex.cn: 有一些湿地在古代就形成了。

ex.en: If it's possible, track the rumour back to its origin.
ex.cn: 如果可能，应追查谣言的源头。

ex.en: Most of the thickeners are of plant origin.
ex.cn: 大部分增稠剂来源于植物。

def:
n.前景，展望,观点，见解,景色,眺望处
v.瞪着看，瞧,比…漂亮,用目光压倒

ex.en: He remained for some years avowedly radical in his political outlook.
ex.cn: 他多年来保持公然激进的政治观。

ex.en: The illness had a profound effect on his outlook.
ex.cn: 这场病对他的人生观产生了深刻的影响。

ex.en: The changed outlook entails higher economic growth than was previously assumed.
ex.cn: 观念的改变势必会使得经济增长高于之前预计的水平。

def: adj.势不可挡的，压倒一切的，巨大的,压倒一切的欢乐

ex.en: He has exhibited symptoms of anxiety and overwhelming worry.
ex.cn: 他表现出焦躁不安和过度忧虑的症状。

ex.en: The party won an overwhelming victory in Burma's general elections last May.
ex.cn: 去年5月，该党在缅甸大选中获得了压倒性的胜利。

ex.en: She needs and wants to be loved with overwhelming passion and adoration.
ex.cn: 她需要并想要被爱的滔滔激情和倾慕所包围。

def: n.[化]氧，氧气

ex.en: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
ex.cn: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。

ex.en: Ozone is produced by the reaction between oxygen and ultra-violet light.
ex.cn: 臭氧由氧气和紫外线发生反应而产生。

ex.en: Smoking and drinking interfere with your body's ability to process oxygen.
ex.cn: 抽烟与酗酒有碍身体处理氧气的能力。

def:
n.恐慌，惊慌,（金融方面）大恐慌,成功,〈俚〉非常滑稽的人
vt.使恐慌
vi.十分惊慌
adj.恐慌的，惊慌失措的

ex.en: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
ex.cn: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

ex.en: A wall collapsed and 39 people, were killed in the panic-stricken stampede.
ex.cn: 一堵墙倒了，慌乱中有39人死于踩踏事故。

ex.en: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
ex.cn: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

def:
adj.平行的,相同的，类似的,[电]并联的,[计]并行的
adv.平行地，并列地
n.平行线（面）,相似物,类比,纬线
vt.使平行,与…媲美,与…相比,与…相似

ex.en: Parallel lines will never meet no matter how far extended.
ex.cn: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。

ex.en: Farthing Lane's just above the High Street and parallel with it.
ex.cn: 法辛巷刚好在大街的北面，与大街平行。

ex.en: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect?
ex.cn: 情感与智力是并行发展的吗？

def: n.议会，国会

ex.en: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

ex.en: He said parliament and the process of democracy had been debased.
ex.cn: 他说议会和民主程序已遭贬值。

ex.en: Politicians say it could lead to a dissolution of parliament.
ex.cn: 政客们说这可能会导致议会解散。

def:
adj.部分的,偏爱的,偏袒的,钟爱的
n.[数学]偏微商

ex.en: The Partial Test-Ban Treaty bans nuclear testing in the atmosphere.
ex.cn: 《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止在大气层中进行核试验。

ex.en: I am partial to desserts that combine fresh fruit with fine pastry.
ex.cn: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

ex.en: He managed to reach a partial agreement with both republics.
ex.cn: 他设法与两个共和国都达成了部分协议。

def:
vi.参加某事,分享某事
vt.得到或接受某部分东西

ex.en: This in effect denied them their right to participate meaningfully in elections.
ex.cn: 这实际上是剥夺了他们正式参与选举的权利。

ex.en: Over half the population of this country participate in sport.
ex.cn: 这个国家一半以上的人口参加体育锻炼。

ex.en: The US was ready to train its troops to participate.
ex.cn: 美国准备训练军队参加。

def: v.意识到,察觉，发觉,理解

ex.en: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
ex.cn: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

ex.en: "Precisely what other problems do you perceive?" she asked.
ex.cn: “你究竟还发现了什么问题？”她问道。

ex.en: They only recognise badness when they perceive it in others.
ex.cn: 他们只看到别人身上的恶行。

def: v.坚持,固执,存留,继续存在

ex.en: If the symptoms persist, it is important to go to your doctor.
ex.cn: 如果这些症状持续存在，一定要去看医生。

ex.en: Mr Straw issued a stern warning to those who persist in violence.
ex.cn: 斯特劳先生向那些坚持进行暴力活动的人发出了严正警告。

ex.en: Why does Britain persist in running down its defence forces?
ex.cn: 为什么英国要坚持消减其军事防御力量？

def: n.汽油

ex.en: The crowds became violent and threw petrol bombs at the police.
ex.cn: 人群变得狂暴起来，并向警察投掷汽油弹。

ex.en: There's no petrol, so it's very difficult to transport goods.
ex.cn: 没有汽油，因此很难运输货物。

ex.en: The boom of the 1980s led to a taste for petrol-guzzling cars.
ex.cn: 20世纪80年代的经济繁荣使人们喜欢上高油耗的汽车。

def: n.医生，内科医生,<口>医学博士,（精神创伤的）医治者，抚慰者

ex.en: I'm a practicing physician trying to help people here and now.
ex.cn: 我是一名此时此刻只想治病救人的执业医师。

ex.en: I committed the physician's cardinal sin: I got involved with my patients.
ex.cn: 我犯了从医的大忌：跟病人有了感情纠葛。

ex.en: Broussais was the first physician to use leeches as a cure-all.
ex.cn: 布鲁赛是第一个把水蛭当成万灵药的医生。

def:
n.一部分,一份遗产（或赠与的财产）,嫁妆,分得的财产
vt.把…分成份额,分配,把…分给(to),命运注定

ex.en: A large portion of this cost devolves upon the patient.
ex.cn: 这笔费用的很大一部分落在病人身上。

ex.en: Damage was confined to a small portion of the castle.
ex.cn: 城堡仅有一小部分受损。

ex.en: I have spent a fairly considerable portion of my life here.
ex.cn: 我生命中相当长的一段时光是在这里度过的。

def: adv.实际上,几乎,事实上

ex.en: We all knew by then that the affair was practically over.
ex.cn: 到那时，我们都知道事情实际上已经结束了。

ex.en: The course is more practically based than the Masters degree.
ex.cn: 该课程比硕士学位课程更注重实践。

ex.en: I think racism is unconsciously inherent in practically everyone.
ex.cn: 我认为种族偏见固有地存在于几乎所有人的潜意识中。

def:
adj.宝贵的，珍贵的,贵重的,矫揉造作的,可爱的，宝贝的
adv.<口>很，非常
n.珍爱的人,可爱的人

ex.en: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
ex.cn: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

ex.en: The banks have had precious little to celebrate recently.
ex.cn: 银行最近没几件值得庆贺的事。

ex.en: After four months in foreign parts, every hour at home was precious.
ex.cn: 在国外呆了4个月后，在家的每一刻都是宝贵的。

def: adj.清晰的,精确的,正规的,精密

ex.en: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.
ex.cn: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。

ex.en: I seem to remember giving you very precise instructions.
ex.cn: 我好像记得给过你非常明确的指示。

ex.en: Each motion must be delicate and precise, involving tiny movements.
ex.cn: 每一个动作都必须小心、准确，一点点地移动。

def: adj.更好的，更可取的,略胜一筹的

ex.en: Anything was preferable to the tense atmosphere at home.
ex.cn: 什么都比家里的紧张气氛好。

ex.en: Health without riches is preferable to riches without health.
ex.cn: 有健康而无财富比有财富而无健康更好.

ex.en: Any principle is preferable to none.
ex.cn: 任何原则都比没原则好.

def: vi.流行，盛行,获胜，占优势,说服，劝说

ex.en: We must, each of us, prevail upon our congressman to act.
ex.cn: 我们每一个人都必须说服我们各自的国会议员采取行动。

ex.en: Political and personal ambitions are starting to prevail over economic interests.
ex.cn: 政治抱负和个人野心开始压倒经济利益。

ex.en: He appears to have the votes he needs to prevail.
ex.cn: 他似乎已经获得了取胜所需的选票。

def:
adj.先前的,以前的,过早的,（时间上）稍前的
adv.在先，在…以前

ex.en: Douglas was a 29-year-old journeyman fighter, erratic in his previous fights.
ex.cn: 道格拉斯29岁，是个技术不错的拳击手，在以前的比赛中发挥不太稳定。

ex.en: The man was known to the police because of previous convictions.
ex.cn: 因为有犯罪前科，警察们都认识这个人。

ex.en: CBS's ratings again showed huge improvement over the previous year.
ex.cn: 与前一年相比，哥伦比亚广播公司的收视率再次大幅提高。

def:
adj.优先的,占先的,在…之前
n.小修道院院长，大修道院的副院长,（隐修院）会长,[史]行政长官,普赖尔
adv.在前,居先

ex.en: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York.
ex.cn: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

ex.en: Just phone in your order three or more days prior to departure.
ex.cn: 在出发的三天之前打电话预订即可。

ex.en: For the prior year, they reported net income of $1.1 million.
ex.cn: 他们公布上一年度纯收入为110万美元。

def: n.优先，优先权,（时间，序上的）先，前,优先考虑的事,[数]优先次序

ex.en: Spain's top priority is the signing of an EMU treaty.
ex.cn: 西班牙的当务之急是签署《欧洲经济和货币联盟条约》。

ex.en: The government has pledged to give the promotion of democracy higher priority.
ex.cn: 政府已经保证把促进民主摆在更重要的位置。

ex.en: Protection of sites, habitats and landscapes is of uppermost priority.
ex.cn: 保护遗址、栖息地和风景区是重中之重。

def:
adj.深厚的,意义深远的,严重的,知识渊博的
n.〈诗〉深海，大洋,深渊,（灵魂）深处

ex.en: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
ex.cn: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

ex.en: The illness had a profound effect on his outlook.
ex.cn: 这场病对他的人生观产生了深刻的影响。

ex.en: It's a quite profound story, with powerful religious overtones.
ex.cn: 这个故事寓意深远，具有强烈的宗教色彩。

def:
v.购买,采购,换得,依靠机械力移动
n.购买,购买行为,购置物,紧握

ex.en: Purchase tax was not payable on goods for export.
ex.cn: 出口商品不需要交购买税。

ex.en: Investors can borrow an amount equal to the property's purchase price.
ex.cn: 投资者可以获得与房产购买价格相等的借款额。

ex.en: When her deal is done, the client emerges with her purchase.
ex.cn: 交易完成后，委托人会出现并将她购买的东西交给她。

def: n.资格，授权,条件，限制,合格证书

ex.en: That time with him is my qualification to write this book.
ex.cn: 我和他曾经相处过一段时间，所以才能写出这本书。

ex.en: The social cachet of some form of qualification in India is powerful.
ex.cn: 在印度，具有某种资格享有巨大的社会威望。

ex.en: Last year, one in five boys left school without a qualification.
ex.cn: 去年，五分之一的男孩没有获得资格证书就离校了。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）具有资格,有权,达标
vt.限定，修饰,描述，形容,使合适,证明…合格
vi.合格或成为合格,取得…的资格

n.探索,追求,远征,验尸陪审团
vt.寻找,探索
vi.进行探求,（猎犬等）跟踪搜寻

ex.en: I have not faltered in my quest for a new future.
ex.cn: 我对新的未来的追求从未动摇过。

ex.en: My quest for a better bank continues.
ex.cn: 我继续寻找一家更好的银行。

ex.en: Waite spent his life on a spiritual quest.
ex.cn: 韦特毕生都在进行精神探索。

def:
vt.饲养,养育,抚养,养育
vt.& vi.抬起
n.后部，背面，背后,臀部,（舰队或军队的）后方，后尾，殿后部队,〈英口〉厕所
vi.直立,高耸
adj.后面的，后部的

ex.en: Those electing to smoke will be seated at the rear.
ex.cn: 那些想吸烟的人将坐在后排。

ex.en: He settled back in the rear of the taxi.
ex.cn: 他靠坐在出租车的后排座上。

ex.en: Musicians played at the front and rear of the procession.
ex.cn: 乐师们在队前和队尾表演。

def:
vt.测算，估计,认为,计算,评定，断定
vi.计算,估计,猜想,料想

ex.en: I reckon I'm due one of my travels.
ex.cn: 我想我就要开始我的一次旅行了.

ex.en: Don't reckon upon your relatives to help you out of trouble.
ex.cn: 不要指望你的亲戚会帮助你摆脱困境.

ex.en: Don't reckon upon the weather being fine for your garden party.
ex.cn: 不要指望你举行游园会时会是好天气.

def:
adj.可靠的,可信赖的,真实可信的
n.可靠的人

ex.en: Broadcast news was accurate and reliable but deadly dull.
ex.cn: 新闻广播准确可靠但却非常枯燥。

ex.en: Both of them, I may say, are thoroughly reliable men.
ex.cn: 可以说，他俩都是绝对可靠的人。

ex.en: He was a sound businessman, totally reliable and incorruptible.
ex.cn: 他是个正直的商人，完全可靠，不会被收买。

def: vt.使想起，使记起,提醒
adj.反复的，再三的，重复的,累,频仍

ex.en: He looked back at the abject, silent girl and repeated his question.
ex.cn: 他转过头看着这个噤若寒蝉的女孩，又重复了一遍他的问题。

ex.en: With repeated applications of weedkiller, the weeds were overcome.
ex.cn: 经过反复施用除草剂，杂草得以彻底根除。

ex.en: During that time there have been repeated attempts to reintroduce capital punishment.
ex.cn: 在那段时期不断有人试图恢复死刑。

def: n.代替,归还，，复位,替代者,补充兵员

ex.en: Hormone replacement therapy is very important and should be instituted early.
ex.cn: 激素替代治疗非常重要，应该及早开始。

ex.en: Replacement parts couldn't be found for love or money.
ex.cn: 替换零件怎么都找不到。

ex.en: Sophie was not consciously seeking a replacement after her father died.
ex.cn: 父亲去世后，索菲并没有刻意地寻找替代他的人。

def: vt.对…感到愤怒,怨恨,愤恨,厌恶

ex.en: It is only natural that he should resent you.
ex.cn: 他怨恨你是很自然的事。

ex.en: Many conscripts resent having to do their military service.
ex.cn: 许多应征入伍者对被迫服兵役愤愤不平。

ex.en: They resent what they see as bossiness.
ex.cn: 他们对自己眼中那些专断蛮横的行为非常厌恶。

def: n.保留,预订，预约,保留地，专用地

ex.en: After three days, the strikers' demands were met almost without reservation.
ex.cn: 3天以后，罢工人员的要求几乎全部得到了满足。

ex.en: Seventeen thousand Indians live in Arizona on a reservation.
ex.cn: 1.7万印第安人生活在亚利桑那州的保留地。

ex.en: You make the reservation, and I'll confirm it in writing.
ex.cn: 你来预订，我会去函确认。

def:
adj.定居的，常驻的,[计]常驻的，常存于内存中的,[动]不迁徙的（鸟兽等）,固有的，内在的
n.居民,（旅馆的）住宿者,住院医师

ex.en: Similar arrangements apply to students who are ordinarily resident in Scotland.
ex.cn: 类似的安排适用于长期居住在苏格兰的学生。

ex.en: Non-resident guests are welcome to use the hotel swimming pool.
ex.cn: 欢迎非旅馆住客使用本旅馆的游泳池。

ex.en: a resident of the United States
ex.cn: 美国的居民

def:
v.抵抗，抗拒,忍耐,反对，抵制
n.防染剂,防腐剂

ex.en: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
ex.cn: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

ex.en: In her place I wouldn't have been able to resist it.
ex.cn: 如果我是她就可能抗拒不了。

ex.en: I cannot resist slipping in a word of advice.
ex.cn: 我忍不住想插上一句建议。

def:
vi.求助于或诉诸某事物，采取某手段或方法应急或作为对策
n.求助，凭借，诉诸,热闹场所，娱乐场，度假胜地,采用的办法,常去，人多，人群

ex.en: For a beach resort with a difference, try Key West.
ex.cn: 如果想去一个与众不同的海滨度假胜地，那就去基韦斯特吧。

ex.en: They would in the last resort support their friends whatever they did.
ex.cn: 无论他们的朋友做了什么，他们最终都会支持他们的朋友。

ex.en: The resort is surrounded by extensive national and regional parklands.
ex.cn: 那个度假胜地被广阔的国家和地区绿地所环绕。

def:
vt.归还,交还,使恢复,修复
vt.& vi.恢复（某种情况或感受）,使复原,使复位,使复职

vi.撤退，后退,撤销，作罢,（眼睛等）凹进,[航]向后倾斜
n.撤回,静居处,引退期间,静思，静修

ex.en: In June 1942, the British 8th Army was in full retreat.
ex.cn: 1942年6月,英国第八军全面撤退.

ex.en: It's a retreat into the adolescence they never really had.
ex.cn: 这是对他们从不曾真正拥有的青春时代的回归.

ex.en: Their soldiers had to retreat ignominiously after losing hundreds of lives.
ex.cn: 损失数百人之后，他们的士兵被迫灰溜溜地撤退。

def:
vt.& vi.使旋转,反复考虑,使循环
vi.旋转,循环出现,反复考虑

ex.en: Mars takes longer to revolve on its axis than the earth.
ex.cn: 火星自转一周的时间比地球长。

ex.en: Mars takes longer to revolve on its axis than the earth.
ex.cn: 火星自转一周的时间比地球长.

ex.en: The planets revolve around the sun.
ex.cn: 行星绕着太阳运转.

def:
n.常规,例行程序,生活乏味,（演出中的）一套动作
adj.例行的,常规的,日常的,普通的

ex.en: Jack had attended these meetings as a matter of routine for years.
ex.cn: 数年来，杰克把参加这些会议当成是例行公事。

ex.en: She was bored with the deadening routine of her life.
ex.cn: 她厌倦了自己生活令人窒息的一成不变。

ex.en: He continued to mow the lawn and do other routine chores.
ex.cn: 他继续剪草坪，并做些其他日常杂务。

def:
vt.破坏，毁灭,使破产,使没落，使堕落,变成废墟
n.毁灭，灭亡,废墟，遗迹,[灭亡]的原因，祸根,损失
vi.被毁灭,破产,堕落

ex.en: She wasn't going to let her plans go to ruin.
ex.cn: 她不会让她的计划破产的。

ex.en: "But we might ruin the stove." — "Who cares?"
ex.cn: “可我们会把炉子弄坏的!”——“我才不在乎呢！”

ex.en: We looked out upon a scene of desolation and ruin.
ex.cn: 我们放眼望去，眼前是一片荒凉的废墟。

def:
n.节约,节俭,储蓄金,挽救
v.拯救( save的现在分词),收集,保留,避免
prep.除…以外
adj.可取的，保存的,节省的，节约的,补偿的,救助的

ex.en: The company intends to squeeze further savings from its suppliers.
ex.cn: 公司试图从供货商那里再省下一笔费用。

ex.en: The film company collapsed, leaving Chris jobless and minus his life savings.
ex.cn: 电影公司垮了，克里斯没了工作，也失去了他一生的积蓄。

ex.en: Savings schemes are the best retail investment products on offer.
ex.cn: 储蓄方案是现有的最佳零售投资产品。

def:
vt.& vi.策划，图谋
n.计划,体系,阴谋
vt.设计，计划,谋划，图谋
vi.密谋，制定计划

ex.en: He's a schemer, and now his plot struck back.
ex.cn: 他是个阴谋家, 而现在他搞的阴谋却反过来害了他自己.

ex.en: According to Homer, Maia bore Mercury at the peep of day - a schemer subtle beyond all belier.
ex.cn: 荷马说, 迈亚在黎明时分生下墨丘利,他是个计谋过人的智多星.

ex.en: He who plots evil will be known as a schemer.
ex.cn: 8设计作恶的,必称为奸人.

def:
n.（处理、研究事务的）范围,眼界，见识,（活动或能力的）余地,广袤，地域
v.审视，仔细研究

ex.en: All were equipped with 20 - power scopes.
ex.cn: 全都装备有二十倍的望远镜.

ex.en: In the Scopes Monkey Trial a school teacher was arraigned for teaching evolution.
ex.cn: 在斯科普斯案中一位教师由于讲授进化论而被控告.

ex.en: Nickel naphthenate is used broadly in petrochemical and chemical scopes.
ex.cn: 环烷酸镍是石油化工领域内的重要助剂.

def:
n.[数]数列，序列,顺序,连续,片断插曲
vt.使按顺序排列，安排顺序,[生化]确定…的顺序，确定…的化学结构序列

ex.en: They are only available when playing a MIDI file by external sequencer!
ex.cn: 他们只用时由外部音序演奏MIDI文件!

ex.en: Full - function 768 ppt sequencer with 16 song and 16 arrangement tracks.
ex.cn: 全功能768西洋参多糖编曲的16首歌曲和16日安排轨道.

ex.en: In a multimedia system, the sequencer is a computer application.
ex.cn: 在多媒体系统中, 音序器是一个应用程序.

def: n.解决,结算,<律>金钱或财产的转让（契约）,沉淀,定居点

ex.en: The settler got the house at a nominal price.
ex.cn: 移居者象征性地花点钱买下了这栋房子.

ex.en: I was a guide , a pathfinder, an original settler.
ex.cn: 我成了领路人 、 开拓者 、 一个原始的移民.

ex.en: This Act gave 160 acres free to each settler family.
ex.cn: 这一法案规定为每一移民定居户无偿提供一百六十英亩土地.

def:
vt.& vi.收缩，皱缩,（使）缩水,退缩，畏缩
n.收缩,畏缩,<俚>精神病学家

ex.en: High molecular weight LDPE is resin for making the heat - shrinkable tube.
ex.cn: 反应挤出是制造硅烷交联聚乙烯热收缩管的新技术.

ex.en: By 1936 she was exhibiting at the Royal Academy.
ex.cn: 到1936年她已在皇家艺术学院展出作品。

ex.en: Father Auberon's Academy Club positively heaved with dashing young men.
ex.cn: 父亲奥伯龙的“学院俱乐部”里真的是有为青年济济一堂。

def:
vt.（使）加快，（使）增速,加速，催促,促进,速度增加
vi.加快，加速

ex.en: We need to accelerate the pace of change in our backward country.
ex.cn: 我们应当为落后的祖国加快变革的脚步。

ex.en: Perhaps the fact that the car was tailgating him made him accelerate.
ex.cn: 或许是因为那辆汽车跟得太紧，他才加速的。

ex.en: Inflation continues to accelerate.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀不断加速。

def:
vt.容纳,使适应,向…提供住处,帮忙
vi.[后面省去反身代词]适应于,（眼）作调节，调节眼球的晶状体（使其变得适应不同距离的物体）,调解，调停

ex.en: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers.
ex.cn: 他从未为了迎合摄影师而搂住妻子。

ex.en: Some animal and plant species cannot accommodate to the rapidly changing cond-itions.
ex.cn: 某些种类的动植物不能适应迅速变化的环境。

ex.en: There is usually room to accommodate up to 80 visitors.
ex.cn: 那里通常可以住得下80位来客。

def: n.住处,适应,便利,和解

ex.en: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists.
ex.cn: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

ex.en: The authority must make suitable accommodation available to the family.
ex.cn: 当局必须给这个家庭提供适当的食宿条件。

ex.en: Volunteers receive £21 pocket money each week, accommodation and expenses.
ex.cn: 志愿者每周领到21英镑的零用钱，免费住宿，还得到一笔生活费。

def: adv.因此，于是,依据,照着，相应地

ex.en: We have to discover his plans and act accordingly.
ex.cn: 我们得找出他的计划，照着办。

ex.en: Watch out for sharp bends and adjust your speed accordingly.
ex.cn: 当心急转弯并相应调整车速。

ex.en: Please inform us of your decision and we will act accordingly.
ex.cn: 请把你们的决定通知我们,我们会照着去办的.

def: n.会计人员，会计师

ex.en: He's not a bad chap—quite human for an accountant.
ex.cn: 这个家伙人不坏——就会计来说已经很有人情味了。

ex.en: Accountant John Talbot is a wizard with numbers.
ex.cn: 会计师约翰·塔尔博特精通数字。

ex.en: She has an appointment with her accountant.
ex.cn: 她和她的会计约好了见面。

def: v.指责，谴责,指控

ex.en: I hate it when people accuse us of that.
ex.cn: 我讨厌别人就那件事指责我们。

ex.en: Some people accuse the tax inspectors of bully-boy tactics.
ex.cn: 有些人指控税务稽查员使用了流氓手段。

ex.en: Talk things through in stages. Do not accuse or apportion blame.
ex.cn: 把事情按部就班地讲清楚。不要责难或归罪于人。

def: n.相识的人，熟人,相识,对…有了解,知识，心得

ex.en: Hammer's business pedigree almost gua-ranteed him the acquaintance of U.S. presidents.
ex.cn: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他能够结识美国总统。

ex.en: I am so pleased to make your acquaintance, Mr Tweed.
ex.cn: 很高兴认识您，特威德先生。

ex.en: On first acquaintance she is cool and slightly distant.
ex.cn: 初次相见时她表现冷淡并有点爱搭不理。

def:
n.有瘾的人,入迷的人,（吸毒）成瘾者
vt.使沉溺,使上瘾,使自己沾染（某些恶习）

ex.en: She is a TV addict and watches as much as she can.
ex.cn: 她是个电视迷，看起电视来没完没了。

ex.en: The self-confessed drug addict was arrested 13 months ago.
ex.cn: 那个自己坦白的瘾君子在13个月前被逮捕。

ex.en: He's only 24 years old and a drug addict.
ex.cn: 他只有24岁，却是个瘾君子。

def: vt.& vi.邻近，毗连,接，贴连,附加，使结合

ex.en: The two houses adjoin.
ex.cn: 这两座房子邻接.

ex.en: It is forbidden to adjoin to a postcard any sample of merchandise.
ex.cn: 在明信片上附贴商品的样品是不许可的.

ex.en: Canada and Mexico adjoin the United States of America.
ex.cn: 加拿大与墨西哥临近美国.

def:
n.少年，少女
adj.青春期的,青少年的,未成熟的

ex.en: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress.
ex.cn: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

ex.en: He spent his adolescent years playing guitar in the church band.
ex.cn: 他在教堂的乐队里弹吉他，度过了他的青少年时期。

ex.en: A little adolescent rebellion is commonly believed to be healthy.
ex.cn: 大家一致认为，青少年有点叛逆是正常的。

def: adj.明智的,可取的,能劝告的,适当的

ex.en: The paths are often very rocky so strong boots are advisable.
ex.cn: 路上通常石头很多，所以最好穿结实耐磨的靴子。

ex.en: Early booking is advisable.
ex.cn: 早订票是明智的。

ex.en: It was advisable for you not to mention that.
ex.cn: 你不提及那件事是明智的.

def:
vt.使隶属于，接纳…为成员,使紧密联系
vt.& vi.加入，与…有关,为…工作

ex.en: Our New York company has an affiliate in Los Angeles.
ex.cn: 我们的纽约公司在洛杉矶有一个下属企业.

ex.en: The Government will not allow the staff association to affiliate with outside unions.
ex.cn: 政府不会允许其公务员协会与外部工会有紧密联系。

ex.en: He said he wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed "expert advice and counsel in legal affairs".
ex.cn: 他说他因为需要“在法律事务上得到专家的意见和建议”，所以想与一家美国律师事务所建立合作关系。

def: n.代理,机构,力量

ex.en: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
ex.cn: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

ex.en: The advertising agency rang up 1.4 billion dollars in yearly sales.
ex.cn: 这家广告代理商每年销售额达14亿美元。

ex.en: The agency should reduce turnaround time by 11 per cent.
ex.cn: 该代理机构应削减11%的周转时间。

def: n.议事日程,待议诸事项一览表,日常工作事项,议程（ agendum的名词复数）

ex.en: Never before has a summit had such a crowded agenda.
ex.cn: 以前从来没有一次峰会的日程排得这么满。

ex.en: On arrival, a six-course meal was top of the agenda.
ex.cn: 他们到达之后要做的第一件事是吃一顿六道菜的大餐。

ex.en: Officials tussled over who had responsibility for the newly fashionable unemployment agenda.
ex.cn: 众官员为谁负责最近备受关注的失业议题一事争得不可开交。

def:
n.代理人,代理商,药剂,特工
vt.由…作中介,由…代理
adj.代理的

ex.en: The agent spied for East Germany for more than twenty years.
ex.cn: 该特工人员为东德做了20多年的间谍。

ex.en: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
ex.cn: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

ex.en: Cheap flights are available from budget travel agent from £240.
ex.cn: 收费低廉的旅行社可以提供240英镑起的低价机票。

def: n.字母表,字母系统,入门，初步

ex.en: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first.
ex.cn: 如果把所有的元音列在前面，字母表可能会更为合理一些。

ex.en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
ex.cn: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

ex.en: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
ex.cn: 英语字母表中，Q在P和R之间。

def:
adj.轮流的,交替的,间隔的,代替的
vi.交替,轮流
vt.使交替,使轮流
n.〈美〉（委员）代理人,候补者,替换物

ex.en: The three acts will alternate as headliners throughout the tour.
ex.cn: 这3个节目将在整个巡回演出中轮流打头牌。

ex.en: Now you just alternate layers of that mixture and eggplant.
ex.cn: 现在你只需把茄子和拌料一层层交替放好。

ex.en: His group was forced to turn back and take an alternate route.
ex.cn: 他的小组被迫返回并选择了另一条路线。

def:
n.业余爱好者,外行，生手
adj.业余的，非职业的,外行的

ex.en: Angela says she longs to join an amateur dramatics class.
ex.cn: 安杰拉说她渴望参加业余戏剧班。

ex.en: Taylor began his playing career as an amateur goalkeeper.
ex.cn: 泰勒的运动生涯是从一名业余守门员开始的。

ex.en: The Amateur Softball Association's roster of umpires has declined to 57,000.
ex.cn: 业余垒球协会的裁判员名单上的人数已经减少到了57,000名。

def: adj.有雄心的,有野心的,费力的,耗资的

ex.en: Chris is so ambitious, so determined to do it all.
ex.cn: 克里斯踌躇满志，决心要将它都做完。

ex.en: This is an ambitious and intriguing movie, full of striking imagery.
ex.cn: 这是一部气势恢宏、引人入胜的电影，充满了动人心魄的瑰丽意象。

ex.en: The plan may well be over-ambitious, and is clearly open to discussion.
ex.cn: 该计划可能太过好高骛远，势必要招致争论。

def: vt.& vi.改良，修改,修订

ex.en: The president agreed to amend the constitution and allow multi-party elections.
ex.cn: 总统同意修订宪法，允许多党选举。

ex.en: We would rather withdraw the draft resolution than amend it.
ex.cn: 与其修改决议草案,不如予以撤回.

ex.en: The teacher advised him to amend his way of living.
ex.cn: 老师劝他改变生活方式.

def: adj.足够的,充足的，丰富的,宽敞的，广大的,富裕的

ex.en: The equivalent of two tablespoons of polyunsaturated oils is ample each day.
ex.cn: 每天相当于两大汤匙多重不饱和油的量就足够了。

ex.en: There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun.
ex.cn: 将会有充足的机会去放松、游泳和晒太阳。

ex.en: Cook pieces of succulent chicken with ample garlic and a little sherry.
ex.cn: 烹饪鲜美滑嫩的鸡肉时多加些大蒜，并滴入少许雪利酒。

def: vt.使人发笑,逗乐,使消遣,娱乐

ex.en: Their antics never fail to amuse.
ex.cn: 他们滑稽的举止总是让人发笑。

ex.en: He could amuse us for hours with his stories of the theater.
ex.cn: 他能接连几小时地为我们讲戏剧故事逗我们发笑.

ex.en: Tom makes up stories to amuse his little brother.
ex.cn: 汤姆编故事逗他的小弟弟.

def: n.祖先，祖宗,被继承人,原型,（动物的）原种，先祖

ex.en: Her Chinese friends referred to the Empress as their venerable ancestor.
ex.cn: 她的中国朋友们说这位女皇是他们值得敬仰的祖先。

ex.en: The immediate ancestor of rock "n" roll is rhythm-and-blues.
ex.cn: 摇滚乐直接源自节奏布鲁斯。

ex.en: This machine is the ancestor of the modern computer.
ex.cn: 这台机器是现代电脑的始祖.

def:
n.锚,锚状物,靠山,压阵队员
vt.抛锚，抛锚泊船,使固定，使稳固,使稳定,在…任节目主持人
vi.抛锚，停泊,固定,[体]任主要运动员,主持节目
adj.最后一棒的，末捧的

ex.en: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
ex.cn: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

ex.en: Sailing boats lay at anchor in the narrow waterway.
ex.cn: 帆船停泊在狭窄的水道上。

ex.en: NATO remains the United States' chief institutional anchor in Europe.
ex.cn: 北大西洋公约组织仍然是美国在欧洲首要的支柱机构。

def:
adj.古代的，已往的,古老的，过时的,年老的,老式的
n.古代人,古文明国的国民,<古>高龄老人,<古>旗手

ex.en: The journey ends in the ancient city of Marrakesh.
ex.cn: 旅行的终点是马拉喀什古城。

ex.en: They held his fate in the palms of their ancient hands.
ex.cn: 他们这些老人将他的命运掌握在手心里。

ex.en: Ancient civilizations believed in the curative powers of fresh air and sunlight.
ex.cn: 远古文明相信新鲜的空气和阳光有治病的功效。

def: adj.无名的,假名的,匿名的,没有特色的

ex.en: He was surprised by the venomous tone of the anonymous calls.
ex.cn: 那些匿名电话的恶毒语气很令他吃惊。

ex.en: She's got too much dignity to descend to writing anonymous letters.
ex.cn: 她是个自尊心很强的人，绝不会自贬身份去写匿名信。

ex.en: Of course, that would have to be by anonymous vote.
ex.cn: 当然，那必须通过不记名投票的方式。

def: n.寓所，住房,房间,公寓楼,（有特殊用途或专属某人的）豪华寓所

ex.en: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
ex.cn: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

ex.en: Gerome tried to talk her into taking an apartment in Paris.
ex.cn: 杰罗姆试图说服她在巴黎买一套公寓。

ex.en: Stevens wrote him a note asking him to come to his apartment.
ex.cn: 史蒂文斯给他写了张便条，请他去自己的公寓。

def: n.仪器，器械,机器,机构，机关,器官

ex.en: They lacked the scientific personnel to develop the technical apparatus much further.
ex.cn: 他们缺少能够进一步研发这一技术装置的科研人员。

ex.en: a piece of laboratory apparatus
ex.cn: 一件实验室仪器

ex.en: A nuclear reactor is the apparatus in which atoms are split.
ex.cn: 核反应堆是分裂原子的装置.

def: adj.随意的，任性的，随心所欲的,主观的，武断的,霸道的，专制的，专横的，独断独行的,乱

ex.en: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
ex.cn: 看来这个队的队员完全是随意选定的。

ex.en: A good judge does not make arbitrary decisions.
ex.cn: 一个优秀的法官不会作武断的判决.

ex.en: You can make an arbitrary choice.
ex.cn: 你可以随便做选择.

def: n.建筑学,建筑风格,体系结构,（总体、层次）结构

ex.en: The economic gloom of the early 1980s was relieved by fanciful architecture.
ex.cn: 20世纪80年代初期的经济萧条气氛因各种奇异古怪建筑的出现而有所缓解。

ex.en: The house is a textbook example of medieval domestic architecture.
ex.cn: 这所房子是典型的中世纪民居。

ex.en: Columns are usually intended in architecture to add grandeur and status.
ex.cn: 圆柱在建筑中通常用来增添气势和显示地位。

def:
vt.把…（系统地）分类,整理,改编（剧本等）,达成…的协议
vi.（就某事与某人）达成协议，（与某人）商定（某事）(with a person about 或 for a thing),[音乐]（尤指专业）改编乐曲

ex.en: It is not for me to arrange such matters.
ex.cn: 我无权安排这些事情。

ex.en: Customers who arrange overdrafts will face a monthly charge of £5.
ex.cn: 透支的客户每月要缴纳5英镑的费用。

ex.en: I will arrange for someone to take you round.
ex.cn: 我会安排人带你转转。

def:
n.队列，阵列,数组,一大批,衣服
vt.排列,部署兵力,打扮，装饰

ex.en: I was confronted with an array of knobs, levers, and switches.
ex.cn: 我面对的是一大堆旋钮、控制杆和开关。

ex.en: As the deadline approached she experienced a bewildering array of emotions.
ex.cn: 随着最后期限的临近，她开始心绪纷乱，不知所措。

ex.en: A glance along his bookshelves reveals a bewildering array of interests.
ex.cn: 看一眼他的书架就知道他兴趣繁杂。

def: vt.评定,估价,对（财产、收入等）进行估价（作为征税根据）,确定（损害赔偿金、税款、罚款等）的金额

ex.en: We know some sex offenders dupe the psychologists who assess them.
ex.cn: 我们知道有些性犯罪者会愚弄给他们做测评的心理学家。

ex.en: She suggests you first assess your income and outgoings.
ex.cn: 她建议你先估算一下自己的收入和开销。

ex.en: The college has few ways to assess the quality of education overall.
ex.cn: 总体看来,这所大学评估教育质量的方法寥寥无几.

def: n.帮助，援助,〈古〉出席，出席者,辅助设备

ex.en: Any assistance you could give the police will be greatly appreciated.
ex.cn: 您提供的任何帮助警方都将万分感谢。

ex.en: He was of great assistance to me in researches for my books.
ex.cn: 在我为写书所作的研究中，他提供了很大的帮助。

ex.en: She can still come downstairs with assistance but she's very weak.
ex.cn: 在有人搀扶的情况下她还是能够下楼的，但是很虚弱。

def: n.出席，参加,出席率,出席者，出席人数

ex.en: Police with riot gear and several fire engines are in attendance.
ex.cn: 防暴警察和数辆消防车都到了。

ex.en: He would have a nurse in constant attendance day and night.
ex.cn: 会有一位护士日夜不间断地陪护着他。

ex.en: Average weekly cinema attendance in February was 2.41 million.
ex.cn: 2月份，平均每周的观影人数为241万。

def:
adj.自动的,不假思索的，无意识的,必然发生的
n.自动化机器或设备,自动手枪

ex.en: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
ex.cn: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

ex.en: An automatic weather station feeds information on wind direction to the computer.
ex.cn: 自动化气象站将风向信息输入计算机。

ex.en: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
ex.cn: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

def: adj.令人尴尬的,难对付的,不方便的,笨拙的

ex.en: Unfortunately, Grandma always seems to awaken at awkward moments.
ex.cn: 不幸的是，奶奶好像总是醒来的不是时候。

ex.en: Alexandra looked plump and awkward in her cast-off clothing.
ex.cn: 亚历山德拉穿着那身过时的衣裳，显得臃肿笨拙。

ex.en: I'm always being told off for being so awkward.
ex.cn: 我笨手笨脚的，总挨训。

def:
adj.向后的,反向的,怯生生的,落后的
adv.向后地,相反地,回溯地

ex.en: The car passed over the body twice, once backward and then forward.
ex.cn: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

ex.en: History may judge the enterprise to have been rather backward-looking.
ex.cn: 历史也许会证明这一雄心勃勃的计划过于保守了。

ex.en: We need to accelerate the pace of change in our backward country.
ex.cn: 我们应当为落后的祖国加快变革的脚步。

def:
n.气球,热气球,[建]球饰
vt.膨胀，涨大,乘热气球飞行,使激增
adj.气球状的,（货物等）分量轻而体积大的,（分期付款）最后一笔大数目的
vi.乘气球飞行,膨胀,激增

ex.en: They floated the trial balloon of actually cutting Social Security.
ex.cn: 他们推出了真正削减社会保障的试行方案。

ex.en: It wasn't a balloon — I'm certain of that.
ex.cn: 那不是气球，这点我敢肯定。

ex.en: The world's first transatlantic balloon race ended in chaos last night.
ex.cn: 昨晚世界第一届跨大西洋热气球比赛在一片混乱中收场。

def:
n.带,乐队,衣带,价值
vt.给…镶边,用带绑扎,（将价格、收入等）划分档次,把…联合起来
vt.& vi.结合起来，伙同
vi.聚集，联合（起来）（通常与together 连用）

ex.en: My underskirt had ridden up into a thick band around my hips.
ex.cn: 我的衬裙已经蹿到臀部，厚厚地卷成一圈。

ex.en: I learned a lot from him about how to run a band.
ex.cn: 我从他那里学到了许多关于经营乐队方面的东西.

ex.en: Kurt had started out playing bass in a rock band.
ex.cn: 库尔特起初在一个摇滚乐队弹低音吉他。

def:
n.胡须,[虫]口鬃，[动]颌毛,（牡蛎等的）鳃,[植]芒
vt.使有胡须（颌毛，芒刺）,抓（捋）住…的胡子，拔…的胡子,公然反对，勇敢地对抗

ex.en: His beard was just beginning to show signs of grey.
ex.cn: 他的胡子才刚有点泛白。

ex.en: Just because he has a beard doesn't necessarily mean he's a hippy.
ex.cn: 不能因为他蓄须就说他是嬉皮士。

ex.en: Bill preened his beard.
ex.cn: 比尔精心修剪了他的胡须。

def: adj.有利的，有益的,[法]可享受利益的

ex.en: It can be beneficial to share your feelings with someone you trust.
ex.cn: 向自己信任的人倾诉感情是很有益处的。

ex.en: An aptitude for computing is beneficial for students taking this degree.
ex.cn: 计算才能对于攻读这个学位的学生有益处。

ex.en: They have seen the change as unquestionably beneficial to the country.
ex.cn: 他们认为这个变革对该国无疑是非常有益的。

def:
n.偏见,偏爱，爱好,倾向,斜纹
vt.使倾向于,使有偏见,影响,加偏压于
adj.斜纹的,斜的，倾斜的,斜裁的
adv.偏斜地，倾斜地,对角地

ex.en: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
ex.cn: 各级司法机构普遍存在对女性的偏见。

ex.en: The pro-gramme's researchers are guilty of bias and misrepresentation.
ex.cn: 该项目的研究者们对心存偏见和误解感到非常内疚。

ex.en: There were fierce attacks on the BBC for alleged political bias.
ex.cn: 英国广播公司因被指具有政治偏见而遭到猛烈抨击。

def:
n.蓝图，设计图,计划大纲,原本
vt.为…制蓝图,为…制订计划

ex.en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
ex.cn: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。
