ex.en: The country's president will offer delegates his blueprint for the country's future.
ex.cn: 该国总统会向代表们展示他构想的国家未来发展的蓝图。

ex.en: a blueprint for the privatization of health care
ex.cn: 医疗保健私有化方案

def:
n.边,镶边,包边,边界
vt.& vi.与…接界，在…的边上
vt.沿…的边，环绕…，给…镶边
vi.近似，毗邻

ex.en: The stock market is convinced more cross-border deals will take place.
ex.cn: 股市相信跨境交易会越来越多。

ex.en: This very careful attitude to money can sometimes border on meanness.
ex.cn: 这种对待金钱的过分谨慎的态度有时几近于吝啬。

ex.en: He was never able to get past the border guards.
ex.cn: 他从未能够通过边防哨兵的检查。

def: n.弓,鞠躬,船头,艏

ex.en: We should not have to bow down to anyone.
ex.cn: 我们不必向任何人示弱。

ex.en: Add a length of ribbon tied in a bow.
ex.cn: 再用一段丝带，系个蝴蝶结。

ex.en: I untied the bow and unwrapped the small box.
ex.cn: 我解开蝴蝶结，拆开小盒子的包装。

def:
n.制动器，闸,刹车,阻碍
vt.& vi.刹（车）

ex.en: The harder the brake pedal is pressed, the greater the car's deceleration.
ex.cn: 刹车踩得越用力，车子减速越猛。

ex.en: Wade released the hand brake and pulled away from the curb.
ex.cn: 韦德松开手刹驶离路边。

ex.en: More than 3,000 cars were recalled yesterday because of a brake problem.
ex.cn: 3,000多辆汽车因为刹车问题昨天被召回。

def:
n.[商]商标，牌子,烙印,〈比喻〉污名，耻辱,燃烧着的木头
vt.污辱,铭刻于,加商标于,打烙印于

ex.en: But that doesn't mean this brand of politics is dead or dying.
ex.cn: 但那并不意味着这种政治主张已经或正在消亡。

ex.en: The Sunday Times remains the brand leader by a huge margin.
ex.cn: 《星期日泰晤士报》仍以巨大的优势稳居报业龙头的地位。

ex.en: It would be uneconomical to send a brand new tape.
ex.cn: 寄一盘新磁带过去不合算。

def: n.崩溃，倒塌,损坏，故障,分解,垮，衰竭

ex.en: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.
ex.cn: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

ex.en: The organisers were given a breakdown of the costs.
ex.cn: 向组织者提供了一份开支细目。

ex.en: Ms Carey appeared to blame her breakdown on EMI's punishing work schedule.
ex.cn: 凯丽女士似乎将她的精神崩溃归咎于百代唱片公司高度紧张的工作日程安排。

def: n.官僚主义,官僚机构,官僚政治

ex.en: People usually complain about having to deal with too much bureaucracy.
ex.cn: 人们经常抱怨不得不应付太多的繁文缛节。

ex.en: His firm must contend with the unwieldy Russian bureaucracy.
ex.cn: 他的公司必须与俄罗斯庞大的官僚机构周旋。

ex.en: They're making efforts to streamline their normally cumbersome bureaucracy.
ex.cn: 他们正努力精简本来繁冗复杂的官僚体制。

def: n.资本主义（制度）,资本（或财富）的拥有,资本（私人占有和生产盈利）的支配地位

ex.en: His article is, predictably, a scathing attack on capitalism.
ex.cn: 可想而知，他的文章是对资本主义的严厉抨击。

ex.en: Offe also challenges the postulate of an "organized capitalism".
ex.cn: 奥费也质疑“有组织的资本主义”的假设。

ex.en: It exposes capitalism in the raw.
ex.cn: 它暴露了资本主义的本来面目。

def:
n.总教堂，大教堂
adj.权威的,教堂的

ex.en: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
ex.cn: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

ex.en: The fourteenth century cathedral was reduced to a mass of rubble.
ex.cn: 这座14世纪的大教堂变成了一堆瓦砾。

ex.en: The cathedral was destroyed by the Great Fire of 1136 AD.
ex.cn: 大教堂在公元1136年的大火中被付之一炬。

def: n.人口普查，统计,人口财产调查

ex.en: Of these, 40% told census-takers they were Muslims.
ex.cn: 这些人当中，有40%的人告诉人口普查员说自己是穆斯林。

ex.en: A census of population is taken every ten years.
ex.cn: 人口普查每10年进行一次.

ex.en: A new pet census showed that cats now outnumber dogs by a whisker (7 million to 6.9 million).
ex.cn: 新的宠物普查显示出猫的数量略微超过了狗的数量（700万比690万）。

def:
n.许可证,纲领,宪章,包租
vt.发给…许可证,发给特许执照

ex.en: They described the Home Office scheme as a "charter for cheats"
ex.cn: 他们称内政部的方案是“对诈骗的纵容”。

ex.en: the European Union's Social Charter of workers' rights
ex.cn: 保障工人权利的欧盟社会宪章

ex.en: This new law amounts to a tax evader's charter.
ex.cn: 这项新法律简直成了为逃税者开的许可证.

def:
n.碎片,缺口,（作赌注用的）筹码,（足球）高球
vt.刻，削成,凿,从…上削下一小片
vi.剥落,碎裂

ex.en: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.
ex.cn: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。

ex.en: He used a hammer and chisel to chip away at the wall.
ex.cn: 他用榔头和凿子铲墙。

ex.en: The vacuum flask has a strong casing, which won't crack or chip.
ex.cn: 这种热水瓶瓶身坚固，不易断裂破碎。

def:
v.切碎，砍,向下猛击,降低,终止
n.砍，剁,排骨,掌劈,嘴周围的地方

ex.en: He won't say which programmes are for the chop.
ex.cn: 他不愿说哪些项目将被毙掉。

ex.en: Roughly chop the tomatoes and add them to the casserole.
ex.cn: 把西红柿大致切一切，然后放到炖锅里。

ex.en: Sometimes they have to chop down a tree for firewood.
ex.cn: 他们有时只好砍树当柴烧。

def:
n.基督教徒，信徒,克里斯琴,<口>人类，文明人，正派人,[电影]克里斯蒂安
adj.信基督教的，基督教的，基督教徒的,<口>人（类）的，文明的，<口>正派的，高尚的

ex.en: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
ex.cn: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

ex.en: He ignores the traditional Christian dualism between body and soul.
ex.cn: 他无视传统基督教的肉体与灵魂的二元论。

ex.en: The Christian right has been steadily gaining ground in state politics.
ex.cn: 基督教右翼组织在国家政治中逐渐获得越来越广泛的支持。

def:
vt.引用，引证,[法]传讯,表扬,[军事]传（或通）令嘉奖
n.<口>例证，引文

ex.en: His position does not empower him to cite our views without consultation.
ex.cn: 他的地位并没有给予他不经许可就引用我们观点的权力。

ex.en: It would be an endless task to cite such living examples.
ex.cn: 这样的实例举不胜举.

ex.en: I can cite quite a few instances to illustrate.
ex.cn: 我可以举出好几件事来说明.

def: n.分类,分级,类别,（动植物等的）分类学

ex.en: These things belong in a different classification.
ex.cn: 这些东西属于不同的类别.

ex.en: This is a good system for classification.
ex.cn: 这是一个很好的分类法.

ex.en: Compliance requirements are keyed to this classification scheme.
ex.cn: 依照这一分类计划来鉴定对这一规定的遵守.

def: n.顾客,当事人,诉讼委托人,[计算机]客户端

ex.en: Enviros Consulting has a client base of more than 2,000 organisations worldwide.
ex.cn: EnvirosConsulting公司在全世界拥有逾2,000家组织机构的客户群。

ex.en: When her deal is done, the client emerges with her purchase.
ex.cn: 交易完成后，委托人会出现并将她购买的东西交给她。

ex.en: If anyone wants me, I'm at lunch with a client.
ex.cn: 有人找我，就说我在跟客户吃午餐。

def:
vi.附着于，紧贴,抓紧或抱住,坚持,沿（岸）前进，贴着（墙）走
vt.依恋，依附于

ex.en: The birds cling to the wall and nibble at the brickwork.
ex.cn: 鸟儿们紧贴在墙上，啄着砖缝。

ex.en: She had to cling onto the doorhandle until the pain passed.
ex.cn: 她不得不抓紧门把手，直到那阵疼痛过去。

ex.en: She had to cling onto the door handle until the pain passed.
ex.cn: 她只好紧紧握住门把手，直到不疼了才松开。

def:
n.丛,簇，串,群,[语言]辅音群
vi.丛生,群聚
vt.使密集，使聚集

ex.en: Chinese waiters stood in a cluster, sharing a private joke.
ex.cn: 华人服务生们站在一起，讲着只有他们自己才懂的笑话。

ex.en: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
ex.cn: 插图上是一簇杏橙色的玫瑰，一共5朵。

ex.en: A cluster of vultures crouched on the carcass of a dead buffalo.
ex.cn: 一群秃鹫蹲伏在一具野牛的尸体上。

def: n.巧合,一致,同时存在,并存

ex.en: Does coincidence come under the umbrella of the paranormal?
ex.cn: 巧合属于超自然现象吗？

ex.en: What an odd coincidence that he should have known your family.
ex.cn: 他居然认识你的家人，真是太巧了。

ex.en: It was simply one of those things, pure coincidence.
ex.cn: 这是没办法的事，纯属巧合。

def: n.收集，采集,征收,收藏品,募捐

ex.en: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
ex.cn: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

ex.en: Hotels operate a collection service for their guests from the airports.
ex.cn: 宾馆为客人提供机场接机服务。

ex.en: Chris likes music and has a large collection of albums and cassettes.
ex.cn: 克里斯喜欢音乐，收集了大量的唱片和磁带。

def: n.殖民地,聚居地,群体,聚居人群

ex.en: The newly-occupied Italian colony of Libya rose in revolt in 1914.
ex.cn: 意大利新占领的殖民地利比亚于1914年发生叛乱。

ex.en: Different animals in the colony had different manifestations of the disease.
ex.cn: 在这一群体里，这种疾病在不同的动物身上有着不同的表现。

ex.en: the American colony in Paris
ex.cn: 聚居巴黎的美国侨民

def: n.结合,联合体,密码组合,连裤内衣

ex.en: You can cobble it together from any old combination of garments.
ex.cn: 把以前的衣服随便搭配一下就能拼凑出一套。

ex.en: They competed for power through a combination of parliamentary and extra-parliamentary methods.
ex.cn: 他们在议会内外同时下手争夺权力。

ex.en: The combination of sex and treachery proved a copper-bottomed circulation booster.
ex.cn: 事实证明，性和背叛的话题结合起来无疑大大增加了发行量。

def: vt.汇编,编辑,编制,编译

ex.en: The book took 10 years to compile.
ex.cn: 编这本书花了10年时间。

ex.en: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.
ex.cn: 我们在努力编制一份适合做这项工作的人员名单。

ex.en: It takes years of hard work to compile a good dictionary.
ex.cn: 编辑一部好词典需要数年的艰苦工作.

def:
vi.抱怨，诉苦,申诉，控诉，抗议
vt.诉说，申诉，控告[后面常跟从句]
n.抱怨，控诉,委屈，怨言,平平的来由,痛苦根源

ex.en: Eczema is a common skin complaint which often runs in families.
ex.cn: 湿疹是一种常见的皮肤病，通常具遗传性。

ex.en: Seeing how cleverly he had been outwitted he made no complaint.
ex.cn: 看到自己在计谋上完全不是对手，他甘拜下风。

ex.en: A united effort is always more effective than an isolated complaint.
ex.cn: 联合行动总是比单个人抱怨更有效。

def: vi.遵从,依从，顺从,应允，同意

ex.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with European directives on bathing water.
ex.cn: 有些海滩未能遵守欧洲有关浴场的指令。

ex.en: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire.
ex.cn: 指挥官说军队会遵守停火协议。

ex.en: They refused to comply with the UN resolution.
ex.cn: 他们拒绝遵守联合国的决议。

def:
n.成分,零件,[数]要素,组分
adj.组成的,合成的,构成的,成分的

ex.en: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.
ex.cn: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。

ex.en: Polish workers will now be making component parts for Boeing 757s.
ex.cn: 现在波音757飞机的组成部件将由波兰工人制造。

ex.en: Gorbachev failed to keep the component parts of the Soviet Union together.
ex.cn: 戈尔巴乔夫没能把苏联各成员国团结在一起。

def:
adj.广泛的,综合的,有理解力的，悟性好的,[保险业]总体担保的
n.[常用复数]专业综合考试,综合学校,综合性中学

ex.en: There are much brighter prospects for a comprehensive settlement than before.
ex.cn: 综合性的社区具有比以前更加光明的前景。

ex.en: The Rough Guide to Nepal is a comprehensive guide to the region.
ex.cn: 《尼泊尔概况》是一本全面介绍该地区的旅游指南。

ex.en: She taught French at Cheam Comprehensive in South London.
ex.cn: 她在伦敦南部的奇姆综合中学教法语。

def:
n.妥协,（名誉等的）损害,妥协（或折中）方案,折中物
vi.折中解决,妥协，退让
vt.违背（原则）,连累,（尤指因行为不很明智）使陷入危险

ex.en: Mr Clarke has shown himself to be resolutely opposed to compromise.
ex.cn: 克拉克先生已表示自己坚决反对妥协。

ex.en: He would rather shoot himself than compromise his principles.
ex.cn: 他宁愿一枪打死自己也不愿违背自己的原则。

ex.en: Their problem can only be solved in a spirit of compromise.
ex.cn: 他们的问题只能通过妥协来解决。

def:
vt.& vi.怀孕,构思,想像，设想,持有
vi.怀孕,设想,考虑

ex.en: Women, he says, should give up alcohol before they plan to conceive.
ex.cn: 他说女性在计划怀孕之前应该戒酒。

ex.en: You may conceive a new world in the atomic age.
ex.cn: 你可以设想出原子时代的新世界.

ex.en: I can hardly conceive of your doing such a thing.
ex.cn: 我很难想象你会做出这种事情.

def: n.受精，怀孕,胚胎,概念,设想，构想

ex.en: Conception occurs when a single sperm fuses with an egg.
ex.cn: 当一个精子和一个卵子结合时受孕就发生了。

ex.en: The other fundamental consideration in the conception of a plan is function.
ex.cn: 在构思设计图时要考虑的另一个基本因素是功能。

ex.en: The plan was brilliant in its conception but failed because of lack of money.
ex.cn: 尽管这计划构想绝妙，但终因资金不足而告流产。

def:
vt.授予，颁与,比较，对照
vi.商议，磋商

ex.en: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
ex.cn: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

ex.en: She withdrew to confer with her advisers before announcing a decision.
ex.cn: 她先去请教顾问然后再宣布决定.

ex.en: He withdrew to confer with his teacher before announcing a decision.
ex.cn: 他先去请教他的老师然后再宣布决定.

def: v.供认,坦白,承认,悔过

ex.en: You just go to the church and confess your sins.
ex.cn: 你干脆去教堂忏悔自己的罪过吧。

ex.en: Let us now confess our sins to Almighty God.
ex.cn: 现在让我们向上帝忏悔我们的罪恶。

ex.en: I must confess I'm not a great enthusiast for long political programmes.
ex.cn: 我必须承认自己对时间很长的政治节目不是很热衷。

def: adj.秘密的,机密的,表示信任的,亲密的

ex.en: National security is the stock excuse for keeping things confidential.
ex.cn: 国家安全常被用作对一些事情保密的挡箭牌。

ex.en: From time to time he passed on confidential information to him.
ex.cn: 他时不时告诉他一些机密信息。

ex.en: Police are investigating the disappearance from council offices of confidential files.
ex.cn: 警察正在调查市政办公室机密档案被盗一案。

def: vt.[法]确认，批准,证实,使有效,使巩固

ex.en: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.
ex.cn: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。

ex.en: Further scans are required to confirm the diagnosis of an abnormality.
ex.cn: 需要进一步扫描来确诊是否出现异常病变。

ex.en: Earlier reports were unable to confirm that there were any survivors.
ex.cn: 早先的报道无法证实是否有幸存者。

def:
vt.征服,攻克,打败（敌人）,克服
vi.得胜，胜利

ex.en: They feared that totalitarians might yet conquer the entire world.
ex.cn: 他们担心极权主义者会征服整个世界。

ex.en: They became overheated nationalists, militarists, and they were out to conquer.
ex.cn: 他们变成了过分狂热的民族主义分子和军国主义分子，并想要征服别国。

ex.en: I was certain that love was quite enough to conquer our differences.
ex.cn: 我相信爱足以克服我们的种种差异。

def: n.保存,保护,避免浪费,对自然环境的保护

ex.en: In time these new excavations will require conservation.
ex.cn: 这些刚发掘出来的物品需要及时保护。

ex.en: Even well-meaning attempts at conservation can bring problems.
ex.cn: 即使是出于善意想开展自然保护也可能会引来麻烦。

ex.en: He is founding director of The Conservation Foundation.
ex.cn: 他是自然资源保护基金会的创办负责人。

def: adj.一致的,连续的,不矛盾的,坚持的
adj.明显的,显而易见的,惹人注意的,显目

ex.en: You may feel tearful in situations where you feel conspicuous.
ex.cn: 觉得自己身处众目睽睽之下时，你可能会有想哭的感觉。

ex.en: Mary's red hair always made her conspicuous at school.
ex.cn: 玛丽的红头发在学校里总是很惹眼。

ex.en: It is conspicuous that smoking is harmful to health.
ex.cn: 很明显,抽烟对健康有害.

def: n.建立，组成,体格,构成方式,宪法
adj.不间断的,不停的,多次重复的,频繁的

ex.en: The school has been in continual use since 1883.
ex.cn: 自1883年以来，该校从未停办过。

ex.en: They felt continual pressure to perform well.
ex.cn: 他们不断感受到压力，促使他们好好表演。

ex.en: She finds the continual confrontation very wearing.
ex.cn: 她发现持续的对峙让人精疲力竭。

def:
vt.反驳，驳斥,否认,与…矛盾，与…抵触
vi.反驳,否认,发生矛盾

ex.en: The result seems to contradict a major U.S. study reported last November.
ex.cn: 这一结果似乎和去年11月美国研究人员发表的一项重要成果相矛盾。

ex.en: "Don't contradict your mother," was Charles's sharp reprimand.
ex.cn: “不要和你妈妈顶嘴，”查尔斯严厉地斥责道。

ex.en: She waxes righteously indignant if anyone tries to contradict her.
ex.cn: 如果有人想反驳她,她说起话来就会义愤填膺.

def: n.公开辩论,论战

ex.en: Legislation to that effect created fierce controversy both in Parliament and outside.
ex.cn: 那类立法在议会内外都引起了激烈的争论。

ex.en: Cabinet ministers signalled their determination to tough out the controversy.
ex.cn: 内阁大臣们表明他们将不顾争议坚持下去。

ex.en: He was a showman, an extrovert who revelled in controversy.
ex.cn: 他是个爱出风头、性格外向而且喜欢争论的人。

def: n.定罪,说服,确信,信念

ex.en: No amount of reasoning could shake him out of his conviction.
ex.cn: 再怎样跟他讲道理都不能让他放弃自己认准的事。

ex.en: He overturned the conviction, saying the defendant was entrapped.
ex.cn: 他声称被告是被诱骗的，从而推翻了有罪的判决。

ex.en: There was not sufficient evidence to secure a conviction.
ex.cn: 没有足够的证据来定罪。

def:
vi.合作，配合，协助
v.合群,互助,结合

ex.en: The two airlines will cooperate on ticketing and schedules.
ex.cn: 两家航空公司将在票务和航班安排上展开合作。

ex.en: We want to cooperate with both the admi-nistration and Congress.
ex.cn: 我们既想与政府合作，也想与国会合作。

ex.en: The two groups agreed to cooperate with each other.
ex.cn: 这两个组同意相互协作。

def:
n.〈俚〉警察,管纱,〈英方〉（山）顶
vt.偷盗,抓住，获得,取走

ex.en: Malone, a cop, felt as much an outsider as any of them.
ex.cn: 马隆是个警察，他跟他们一样都觉得自己像个外人。

ex.en: To decline to vote is a cop-out.
ex.cn: 拒绝投票就是一种逃避。

ex.en: The film's ending is an unsatisfactory cop-out.
ex.cn: 电影回避式的结局让人不满。

def:
n.中心，核心，精髓,果心，果核,[地质学]地核,[计] 磁心
vt.去（果）核，挖去…的果心,提取岩芯（样品）

ex.en: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
ex.cn: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

ex.en: A hard-core group of right-wing senators had hoped to sway their colleagues.
ex.cn: 一群骨干右翼参议员曾企图左右自己的同僚。

ex.en: We've got a hard core of customers that have stood by us.
ex.cn: 我们拥有一批一直支持我们的忠实顾客。

def: vi.符合，一致,相应,通信

ex.en: Her expression is concerned but her body-language does not correspond.
ex.cn: 她满脸关切之情，但她的肢体语言并非如此。

ex.en: Your account of events does not correspond with hers.
ex.cn: 你对事情的陈述与她说的不相符。

ex.en: The translation does not quite correspond to the original.
ex.cn: 译文不切原意.

def:
adj.堕落的，道德败坏的,贪污的，腐败的,腐烂的,（文献等）错误百出的
vt.使腐败,使堕落,使腐烂
vi.堕落,腐化,腐烂

ex.en: He has been scathing in his denunciation of corrupt and incompetent politicians.
ex.cn: 他抨击起那些腐败无能的政客来一直都很尖刻犀利。

ex.en: The mess was directly attributable to a corrupt and incompetent official.
ex.cn: 某个腐败无能的官员是导致这一烂摊子的罪魁祸首。

ex.en: He had accused three opposition members of corrupt practices.
ex.cn: 他指控3名反对派成员营私舞弊。

def: adj.宇宙的,极广阔的

ex.en: NASA plans to launch a satellite to study cosmic rays.
ex.cn: 美国国家航空航天局计划发射一颗卫星上天，对宇宙射线进行研究。

ex.en: Do you believe in a cosmic plan?
ex.cn: 你相信冥冥中的安排吗？

ex.en: His "cosmic vision" is to blend Christianity with "the wisdom of all world religions".
ex.cn: 他的“远大设想”就是将基督教和“全世界所有宗教的智慧”融为一体。

def:
vi.爬行,缓慢行进,巴结
n.缓慢的爬行,〈美俚〉跳舞，自由式游泳,养鱼（龟）池

ex.en: The traffic on the approach road slowed to a crawl.
ex.cn: 引路上车辆行驶缓慢。

ex.en: As he tried to crawl away, he was hit in the shoulder.
ex.cn: 他试图爬走时肩膀中枪了。

ex.en: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
ex.cn: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

def: n.生物，动物,人,创造物,（他人的）工具

ex.en: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
ex.cn: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

ex.en: This interesting and charming creature is unique to Borneo.
ex.cn: 这种有趣迷人的动物是婆罗洲独有的。

ex.en: What distinguishes homo sapiens from every other living creature is the mind.
ex.cn: 智人和其他生物的区别在于大脑。

def: vt.耕作，种植,教养，栽培,改善,交朋友

ex.en: Estonia has done much to cultivate the friendship of western European countries.
ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚努力发展与西欧国家的友谊。

ex.en: We should cultivate the good habits of diligence and frugality.
ex.cn: 我们要养成勤俭节约的好风气.

ex.en: He always tries to cultivate rich and famous people.
ex.cn: 他总是试图结交有钱有势的人.

def: n.好奇心，爱打听的癖性,奇人,奇物，古玩,奇特性

ex.en: She also stimulated his curiosity and opened his mind to other cultures.
ex.cn: 她还激发了他的好奇心，使他愿意了解其他文化。

ex.en: There was much curiosity about what manner of man he was.
ex.cn: 他究竟是什么样的人，大家都十分好奇。

ex.en: They are there only to satisfy their ghoulish curiosity.
ex.cn: 他们去那里纯粹是为了满足其病态的好奇心。

def:
vi.猛冲,赶紧离开
vt.猛撞,匆忙完成,泼溅,使…破灭
n.少量，些许,猛冲,破折号,短跑

ex.en: The Prince was driving with great fire and dash.
ex.cn: 王子潇洒威猛地驱车而行。

ex.en: He's in a dash to get Russia back into Europe.
ex.cn: 他急于让俄罗斯回归欧洲。

ex.en: Dash it all. It's just not playing the game, is it?
ex.cn: 可恶，那完全是不讲道义，是不是？

def:
adj.极端的，非常的,致命的，致死的,非常有效的,如死一般的
adv.极其，非常,死了一样地

ex.en: His mother's voice was one he knew; ice cold and deadly.
ex.cn: 母亲的声音是他很熟悉的：冰冷、无情。

ex.en: Broadcast news was accurate and reliable but deadly dull.
ex.cn: 新闻广播准确可靠但却非常枯燥。

ex.en: She took the gun and blazed away with calm and deadly accuracy.
ex.cn: 她拿起枪，冷静地连续射击，弹无虚发。

def: n.宣言，布告，公告，声明,（纳税品在海关的）申报,[法]（原告的）申诉，（证人的）陈述，口供,[牌]摊牌，叫牌

ex.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery.
ex.cn: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

ex.en: The resolution stopped short of an outright declaration of independence.
ex.cn: 这项决议几乎成为公开的独立宣言。

ex.en: Some delegates believe the final declaration is likely to be too timorous.
ex.cn: 一些代表认为最后的声明可能不够强硬。

def: adj.微妙的,熟练的,纤弱的,易损的

ex.en: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
ex.cn: 珊瑚虽然看上去坚固，实际上非常易碎。

ex.en: Their marriage is a delicate balance between traditional and contemporary values.
ex.cn: 他们的婚姻在传统和现代价值观之间保持着微妙平衡。

ex.en: Its large leaves often show a delicate purple tint.
ex.cn: 它的大叶子往往带点紫色。

def: vt.指代,预示,代表,意思是

ex.en: We often denote danger by red letters.
ex.cn: 我们常常用红字表示危险.

ex.en: Red eyes denote strain and fatigue.
ex.cn: 眼睛充血表明压力过大、身心疲惫。

ex.en: Sometime the term artesian is used to denote a confined aquifer.
ex.cn: 有时候人们也用自流含水层这一术语表示承压含水层.

def: n.密度,稠密，浓厚,[物]浓度，比重,愚钝

ex.en: the density of a gas
ex.cn: 一种气体的密度

ex.en: The population density of that country is 685 per square mile.
ex.cn: 那个国家的人口密度为每平方英里685人.

ex.en: Mercury has a much greater density than water.
ex.cn: 水银的密度比水大得多.

def: n.牙科医生

ex.en: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
ex.cn: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

ex.en: Think of the clammy hands you get when you visit the dentist!
ex.cn: 想想你去看牙医时那双黏糊糊的手！

ex.en: The dentist commenced to dig, drill and finally fill the offending tooth.
ex.cn: 牙医开始在那颗有问题的牙齿上挖洞，钻孔，直到最后把它补好。

def: n.依赖，依靠,信任，信赖,[物]依存关系,依靠之物

ex.en: his dependence on his parents
ex.cn: 他对父母的依赖

ex.en: Many sufferers have been reclaimed from a dependence on alcohol.
ex.cn: 许多嗜酒成癖的受害者已经被挽救过来.

ex.en: He was freed from financial dependence on his parents.
ex.cn: 他在经济上摆脱了对父母的依赖.

def:
adj.情绪低落的，沮丧的,萧条的,下陷的，低的,中间凹下的
v.压下(depress的过去式和过去分词),使愁苦,降低（价格）,使跌价

ex.en: When depressed, they dramatically overindulge in chocolate and sweets.
ex.cn: 情绪低落的时候，她们就疯狂地猛吃巧克力和糖果。

ex.en: My bulging thighs and flabby stomach made me depressed.
ex.cn: 我大腿太粗，肚子上也净是赘肉，让我很发愁。

ex.en: The construction industry is no longer as depressed as it was.
ex.cn: 建筑业不再像以往那样萧条了。

def:
n.绝望,使人绝望的人（或事物）
vi.绝望

ex.en: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse.
ex.cn: 不要想不开，这样只能使情况变得更糟。

ex.en: I would overcome any weakness, any despair, any fear.
ex.cn: 我要克服所有的软弱、绝望和恐惧。

ex.en: As his energy drained away, his despair and worry grew.
ex.cn: 当他的精力耗尽时，他的绝望和担心也增加了。

def: n.破坏，毁灭，消灭，灭亡，扑灭，驱除,摧毁,毁灭的原因，破坏手段,杀害

ex.en: There is worldwide concern about the destruction of the rainforests.
ex.cn: 全世界都在关注热带雨林遭到破坏的问题。

ex.en: To that extent they helped bring about their own destruction.
ex.cn: 他们正是如此推波助澜，导致了自己的毁灭。

ex.en: One eye-witness said the rioters were engaged in an orgy of destruction.
ex.cn: 一位目击者称暴徒肆无忌惮地到处进行破坏。

def:
v.设计,发明,策划,想出
n.遗赠,遗赠的财产,遗赠的条款

ex.en: Experts are trying to devise ways to clean up the huge slick.
ex.cn: 专家们正想方设法清除这片面积巨大的浮油。

ex.en: White supremacists devise new Methods: To disenfranchise Negroes.
ex.cn: 白人至上论者想出新的方法以剥夺黑人的公民权.

ex.en: It is not easy to devise means.
ex.cn: 筹措维艰.

def:
vt.诊断,判断
vi.做出诊断

ex.en: He could diagnose an engine problem simply by listening.
ex.cn: 他仅靠听就能判断发动机出了什么问题。

ex.en: The test is used to diagnose a variety of diseases.
ex.cn: 此项化验可用于诊断多种疾病。

ex.en: What more will you want to know to diagnose this problem?
ex.cn: 要弄清这个问题,你还需要知道些什么?

def:
adj.数字的,数据的,手指的,指状的
n.手指,（钢琴等的）琴键,数字

ex.en: The BBC has just successfully demonstrated a new digital radio transmission system.
ex.cn: 英国广播公司刚刚成功地演示了一套新的数字无线电传输系统。

ex.en: Filmmaking was transformed by digital editing, digital f/x, and digicams.
ex.cn: 数字剪辑、数码特效以及数码摄像机改变了电影摄制方式。

ex.en: Manufacturers are working on a new generation of cheaper digital radios.
ex.cn: 制造商正在研制价格更便宜的新一代数字收音机。

def: n.尊严,高尚,自豪,自尊

ex.en: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
ex.cn: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

ex.en: She's got too much dignity to descend to writing anonymous letters.
ex.cn: 她是个自尊心很强的人，绝不会自贬身份去写匿名信。

ex.en: He suffered a long series of illnesses with tremendous dignity and fortitude.
ex.cn: 他凭借超乎常人的保持生命尊严的信念和顽强意志力忍受着各种病痛的折磨。

def:
n.尺寸,[复]面积，范围,[物]量纲,[数]次元，度，维
adj.（石料，木材）切成特定尺寸的
vt.把…刨成（或削成）所需尺寸,标出尺寸

ex.en: There was undeniably a strong theoretical dimension to his thinking.
ex.cn: 不可否认，他的思想很有理论深度。

ex.en: This adds a new dimension to our work.
ex.cn: 这给我们的工作增添了新的内容。

ex.en: There is a political dimension to the accusations.
ex.cn: 这些指控含有政治方面的因素。

def:
vt.（使）减少，缩小,减弱…的权势,[乐]减半音
vi.变小或减少,逐渐变细

ex.en: Federalism is intended to diminish the power of the central state.
ex.cn: 联邦制旨在削弱中央政府的权力。

ex.en: We should try to diminish the cost of production.
ex.cn: 我们应尽力减少生产成本.

ex.en: As people approach old age, their energies may diminish.
ex.cn: 接近老年时, 人的精力就衰退了.

def: vt.使无能力,使残废，使伤残,使无资格,使不中用

ex.en: One bomb can disable a ship.
ex.cn: 一颗炸弹就能炸毁一艘船.

ex.en: Job applications from disable workers poured in at a staggering rate.
ex.cn: 残废工人求职申请书大批涌来、数量惊人.

ex.en: Disable menu items when they are not applicable.
ex.cn: 禁用不适用的菜单项.

def: vt.公开,揭露,使显露,使暴露

ex.en: They contend that the company failed to disclose material information.
ex.cn: 他们坚持认为该公司并未透露实质性的信息。

ex.en: I am afraid we are not at liberty to disclose that information.
ex.cn: 恐怕我们无权透露这一信息。

ex.en: The spokesman refused to disclose details of the takeover to the press.
ex.cn: 发言人拒绝向新闻界透露公司收购的详细情况。

def:
n.丢脸,耻辱,不光彩,丢脸的人（或事）
vt.使丢脸,使失宠,使受耻辱,贬黜

ex.en: Republican leaders called him a disgrace to the party.
ex.cn: 共和党领导人称他是全党的耻辱。

ex.en: What went on was a scandal. It was a disgrace to Britain.
ex.cn: 发生的一切是个丑闻，是给英国抹黑。

ex.en: Kinkel said the attacks had brought disgrace on Germany.
ex.cn: 金克尔声称这次袭击使德国蒙羞。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）分散，（使）散开,散播，传布（如知识）,使（光）色散,使粒子分散
adj.分散的

ex.en: Police fired shots and used teargas to disperse the demonstrators.
ex.cn: 警方鸣枪并使用催泪弹来驱散示威者。

ex.en: Seven people were wounded when soldiers fired rubber bullets to disperse crowds.
ex.cn: 士兵发射橡皮子弹驱散人群时有7个人受了伤。

ex.en: Police moved in to disperse the crowd.
ex.cn: 警察开进来驱散人群。

def:
n.地区,教区,〈美〉（各州众议员）选举区,行政区，市区
vt.把…分区

ex.en: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
ex.cn: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

ex.en: The district council agreed with the objectors and turned down the application.
ex.cn: 区政务委员会同意反对者的意见，拒绝了这一申请。

ex.en: The defense wants the district Judge to throw out the case.
ex.cn: 辩护律师希望区法官不受理那个案子。

def: vt.打扰，妨碍,使骚动,使不安，使烦恼,妨碍睡眠（休息等）

ex.en: The pictures were sensationalist and could seriously disturb younger readers.
ex.cn: 这些图片大肆渲染，会让一些比较年轻的读者们惶恐不安。

ex.en: She patted Mona, taking care not to disturb her costume.
ex.cn: 她轻轻拍了拍莫娜，小心翼翼地，生怕弄乱她的戏服。

ex.en: "I'm sorry to disturb you," Webb said gently.
ex.cn: “很抱歉打扰您。”韦布温和地说。

def: n.打扰,骚乱，变乱,困扰,烦闷

ex.en: The home would cause less disturbance to local residents than a school.
ex.cn: 养老院对当地居民造成的干扰会比学校小。

ex.en: Poor educational performance is related to emotional disturbance.
ex.cn: 糟糕的学习成绩与情绪失常有关。

ex.en: The building work is creating constant noise, dust and disturbance.
ex.cn: 建筑施工不断制造噪音、灰尘和干扰。

def: n.转移,分散注意力,消遣

ex.en: In 1766 he excommunicated the village for its "depraved diversion."
ex.cn: 1766年，他以“堕落地享乐”为由将那个村庄逐出教会。

ex.en: The whole argument is a diversion.
ex.cn: 这场辩论分散了人们的注意力。

ex.en: a river diversion project
ex.cn: 河流改道工程

def: vt.使转移,娱乐,转移注意力

ex.en: The President needed to divert attention away from his own economic record.
ex.cn: 总统需要将人们的视线从他以往在经济上的表现上转移开。

ex.en: He instructed switchboard staff to divert all Laura's calls to him.
ex.cn: 他让总机接线员将劳拉所有的电话都转给他。

ex.en: If you haul hard you will divert the fish.
ex.cn: 如果拉网太猛,鱼会被吓跑的.

def:
n.（计算机）文档，证件,公文
vt.证明,记录,为…提供证明

ex.en: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
ex.cn: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

ex.en: I invite every citizen to carefully study the document.
ex.cn: 我请每位市民都仔细研读该文件。

ex.en: The document was previously circulated in New York at the United Nations.
ex.cn: 这份文件先前在纽约的联合国总部传阅过.

def:
n.纪录片
adj.记录的,文书的,纪实的

ex.en: The documentary left me in a state of shock.
ex.cn: 那部纪录片使我大为震惊。

ex.en: She spent two years in South Florida researching and filming her documentary.
ex.cn: 她花了两年时间在佛罗里达州南部做研究，拍摄纪录片。

ex.en: She also narrated a documentary about the Kirov Ballet School.
ex.cn: 她还为一部关于基洛夫芭蕾舞学院的纪录片作过解说。

def:
n.圆屋顶,像圆屋顶一样的东西,圆顶体育场
vt.加圆屋顶于…上
vi.成圆顶状

ex.en: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
ex.cn: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

ex.en: the dome of St Paul's Cathedral
ex.cn: 圣保罗大教堂的穹顶

ex.en: A band of grey hair encircled his bald dome.
ex.cn: 他的秃头四周长着一圈灰白的头发.

def:
adj.家庭的，家的,国内的,驯养的,热心家务的
n.佣人,国货

ex.en: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
ex.cn: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

ex.en: A special dispensation may be obtained from the domestic union concerned.
ex.cn: 从国内相关的工会那儿或许能得到一项特许。

ex.en: As the domestic market becomes saturated, firms begin to export the product.
ex.cn: 由于国内市场饱和，各公司开始外销。

def:
n.命运,厄运,死亡,（尤指不利的、有罪的）判决，宣判
vt.注定,判定,使…的失败,宣判

ex.en: Why are people so full of gloom and doom?
ex.cn: 为什么人们如此沮丧悲观？

ex.en: A sense of impending doom came upon all of us.
ex.cn: 我们所有人都有一种大难临头的感觉。

ex.en: A sense of imminent doom was inescapable.
ex.cn: 一种即将来临的毁灭感无可逃避。

def:
n.汇票,草稿,选派,（尤指房间、烟囱、炉子等供暖系统中的）（小股）气流
vt.起草,制定,征募
vi.拟稿,绘样,作草图
adj.初步画出或（写出）的,（设计、草图、提纲或版本）正在起草中的，草拟的,以草稿形式的,草图的

ex.en: Officials have now been delegated to start work on a draft settlement.
ex.cn: 现在已经委派官员着手起草解决方案。

ex.en: When the first draft was completed, Nichols typed it up.
ex.cn: 当初稿完成以后，尼科尔斯将它打印了出来。

ex.en: The money was payable by a draft drawn by the home.
ex.cn: 这笔钱可凭国内承兑的汇票支付。

def:
vt.拖拽,吃力地往前拉,拖地而行
vi.沿地面拖动,落后,缓慢前进,打捞
n.拖，拉,累赘,阻力

ex.en: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
ex.cn: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

ex.en: There's no telling how long the talks could drag on.
ex.cn: 谁也说不准谈判还会拖多久。

ex.en: I find it really hard to drag myself out and exercise regularly.
ex.cn: 我发现要让我自己定期出门锻炼真的很难。

def: adj.激烈的,猛烈的,（法律等）严厉的,极端的

ex.en: Now there is a dawning realisation that drastic action is necessary.
ex.cn: 现在人们开始意识到必须采取断然的行动。

ex.en: There are going to have to be some drastic changes.
ex.cn: 一定得进行重大变革。

ex.en: Linda knew that for both their sakes she must take drastic action.
ex.cn: 琳达知道，为了他俩，她必须断然行事。

def: n.缺点，劣势,退税

ex.en: The main drawback to it is the cost.
ex.cn: 它的主要缺点是成本高。

ex.en: Everything has its drawback.
ex.cn: 事事不免有缺点.

ex.en: He felt the apartment's only drawback was that it was too small.
ex.cn: 他觉得这个公寓唯一的缺点就是太小了。

def:
vi.流动,随意移动,漂泊,浮现
vt.漂流,堆积成堆
n.漂移，偏移,趋势，动向,大意,放任自流

ex.en: There was a drift of smoke above the trees.
ex.cn: 树林上空飘浮着一股烟。

ex.en: As rural factories shed labour, people drift towards the cities.
ex.cn: 由于农村的工厂纷纷裁员，人们逐渐流向城市。

ex.en: Anybody who's listening will get the drift of what he was saying.
ex.cn: 任何一个在专心听的人都会领悟他所说的大意。

def: n.干旱（时期），旱季,旱灾,（长期的）缺乏,枯竭

ex.en: The path was dry and slithery from the drought.
ex.cn: 小路因干旱变得又干又滑。

ex.en: Experts believe that the coming drought will be extensive.
ex.cn: 专家们认为即将发生的旱灾将侵袭大片地区。

ex.en: In fact many food crops failed because of the drought.
ex.cn: 实际上，因为干旱，很多粮食作物歉收。

def: n.持续，持续的时间，期间,（时间的）持续，持久，连续,[语音学]音长，音延

ex.en: His wounds knocked him out of combat for the duration.
ex.cn: 他的伤病使他在整个期间都无法参赛。

ex.en: The school was used as a hospital for the duration of the war.
ex.cn: 战争期间这所学校被用作医院。

ex.en: The principal issues in dispute concern the duration of the future treaty.
ex.cn: 有争议的主要问题牵涉到将来条约的期限.

def: vi.居住,存在于,细想某事

ex.en: I shut out the memory which was too painful to dwell on.
ex.cn: 我不再去回忆那些痛苦不堪的往事了。

ex.en: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
ex.cn: 沉湎于虚幻的梦想而忘记现实的生活，是毫无益处的。

ex.en: Sometimes his mind would dwell on the horrors he had been through.
ex.cn: 有时他会老是想着他所经历过的种种恐怖.

def:
adj.动态的,动力的，动力学的,充满活力的，精力充沛的,不断变化的，充满变数的
n.动态,动力，推动变化的力量,动力学,活力

ex.en: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
ex.cn: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

ex.en: The company president, and my immediate superior, was the dynamic Harry Stokes.
ex.cn: 公司的董事长，也就是我的直接上司，是精力充沛的哈里·斯托克斯。

ex.en: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment.
ex.cn: 市场要有活力，需要不断地改变和调整。

def: adj.动力（学）的，有力量的

ex.en: A dynamical angular rigidity measuring method is given based on modal analysis.
ex.cn: 针对挠性接头角刚度的测量,提出了一种基于模态分析的动态角刚度测量方法.

ex.en: Knowledge on climate, atmospheric general circulation and dynamical meteorology.
ex.cn: 具备气候学 、 大气环流和动力气象学的基本知识.

ex.en: A new way to solve dynamical response of rotor blade in helicopter.
ex.cn: 提出了一种全新的计算旋翼桨叶动力响应的方法.

def:
adj.热心的,诚挚的，真挚的,重要的
n.热心,认真,定钱，保证金,诚挚

ex.en: It presented in satirical terms points made in earnest by Catholic writers.
ex.cn: 它用讽刺的语言呈现了天主教作家郑重其事表明的观点。

ex.en: While this conver-sation was going on, I was listening with earnest attention.
ex.cn: 这场对话进行的时候，我聚精会神地听着。

ex.en: On December 8 the media blitz began in earnest.
ex.cn: 12月8日，一场大规模媒体宣传活动轰轰烈烈地展开了。

def:
n.轻松，舒适,容易,安逸,不拘束，自在
vt.解除痛苦,减轻,延缓,松弛
vi.缓解，减少,轻松前进

ex.en: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
ex.cn: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

ex.en: Breathe out and ease your knees in toward your chest.
ex.cn: 呼气，膝部放松向胸部靠拢。

ex.en: They sprawl at ease across the sofa, arms draped over the back.
ex.cn: 他们惬意地躺在沙发上，胳膊搭在后面。

def: adj.节约的,经济的,合算的

ex.en: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
ex.cn: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

ex.en: Fans of electric cars say they are clean, quiet and economical.
ex.cn: 电动汽车迷们说，电动车清洁、无噪音而且经济。

ex.en: It is economical to run and ecologically sound.
ex.cn: 这样做比较经济，而且不会破坏生态。

def:
adj.编辑的，主笔的,〈美〉社论的
n.社论（美）

ex.en: A Wall Street Journal editorial encapsulated the views of many conservatives.
ex.cn: 《华尔街日报》的一篇社论概述了很多保守派人士的观点。

ex.en: He has said he will fire editorial employees without regard to seniority.
ex.cn: 他说过不管资历如何，任何编辑人员他都有可能解雇。

ex.en: In an editorial, The Independent suggests the victory could turn nasty.
ex.cn: 《独立报》在一篇社论中暗示这场胜利可能会变味。

def:
adj.上了年纪的,过了中年的,较老的
n.老人

ex.en: We usually think of a victim of mugging as being someone elderly.
ex.cn: 我们通常以为被拦路抢劫的受害者是老年人。

ex.en: The runaway car careered into a bench, hitting an elderly couple.
ex.cn: 那辆失控的车猛冲到一条长椅上，撞伤了一对老夫妇。

ex.en: Some of those artillery pieces look a little elderly.
ex.cn: 那些大炮中有些看起来有点老掉牙了。

def: adj.（人或其举止）优美的,漂亮的,简炼的,简洁的

ex.en: She produces elegant wedding gowns in a variety of sumptuous fabrics.
ex.cn: 她用各种华贵的布料制作高雅的婚纱。

ex.en: An elegant occasional table is framed in the window.
ex.cn: 一张雅致的供重大活动使用的餐桌被摆放在橱窗里。

ex.en: She brought in a tray heavy with elegant sandwiches, scones and cakes.
ex.cn: 她端进来一只盘子，里面盛满了精美的三明治、烤饼和蛋糕。

def: vt.举起,提高,提升,鼓舞

ex.en: Democracy might elevate the common man to a position of political superiority.
ex.cn: 民主也许能提升普通人的政治地位，让他们产生优越感。

ex.en: His energy and talent elevate him to godlike status.
ex.cn: 他因精力充沛、才华横溢而被尊为神人。

ex.en: He used a couple of bolsters to elevate his head.
ex.cn: 他用两个垫枕垫头.

def:
n.紧急情况,突发事件,非常时刻
adj.紧急的，应急的

ex.en: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
ex.cn: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

ex.en: He vociferously opposed the state of emergency imposed by the government.
ex.cn: 他激烈反对政府强行宣布进入紧急状态。

ex.en: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
ex.cn: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

def:
n.帝国，帝国领土,帝权，君权，最高统治权,大企业组织
adj.新古典风格的

ex.en: The Roman Empire was divided in the fourth century AD.
ex.cn: 罗马帝国于公元4世纪分裂。

ex.en: He now controls the largest retail development empire in southern California.
ex.cn: 他现在掌管着加州南部最大的零售发展企业。

ex.en: The empire had for years been falling into decadence.
ex.cn: 这个帝国走向腐朽堕落已经经年。

def: adj.精力充沛的，充满活力的,精力旺盛的，精神饱满的,（措施等）积极的，有力的,雄健

ex.en: We look for applicants who are numerate, computer-literate and energetic self-starters.
ex.cn: 我们对求职者的要求是具备运算能力，熟练使用电脑，精力充沛而且工作积极主动。

ex.en: British history of the 19th century is peopled by energetic reformers.
ex.cn: 19世纪英国史上积极改革者层出不穷。

ex.en: Aaron Copland was an energetic promoter of American music.
ex.cn: 阿伦·科普兰从来都是美国音乐的积极倡导者。

def:
n.发动机，引擎,工具,火车头,机车
vt.给…安装发动机

ex.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
ex.cn: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

ex.en: In 1941, the train would have been pulled by a steam engine.
ex.cn: 1941年，火车本可以由蒸汽机车拉动。

ex.en: Two of them got out to fiddle around with the engine.
ex.cn: 其中两人下车鼓捣引擎。

def: n.工程（学）， 工程师行业,操纵，管理,土木工程，工事,开车技术

ex.en: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
ex.cn: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

ex.en: The Channel Tunnel project is the biggest civil engineering project in Europe.
ex.cn: 英吉利海峡隧道是欧洲最大的土木工程。

ex.en: The percentage of girls in engineering has increased substantially.
ex.cn: 学工科的女孩的比例已经大大增加了。

def: vt.使富裕，使富有,给…添加肥料,使…美味,装饰

ex.en: People with disabilities are now doing many things to enrich their lives.
ex.cn: 残疾人士如今做很多事情来丰富他们的生活。

ex.en: He will drain, rather than enrich, the country.
ex.cn: 他会耗尽而不是增加该国的财富。

ex.en: The farmers ploughed the vegetable leaves back to enrich the soil.
ex.cn: 农夫们把蔬菜叶犁入土中作肥料.

def: adj.热心的,热情的,热烈的,狂热的

ex.en: Bob Dole seemed less than enthusiastic about the proposed move.
ex.cn: 鲍勃·多尔似乎对提议的这项行动不太感兴趣。

ex.en: The teachers are enthusiastic and have a sense of purpose.
ex.cn: 教师们很热情并且很有决心。

ex.en: Enthusiastic applause lent a sense of occasion to the proceedings.
ex.cn: 热烈的掌声给活动平添了几分隆重的色彩。

def: vt.装备，配备,使具备，使有准备

ex.en: Owners of restaurants would have to equip them to admit disabled people.
ex.cn: 餐厅老板将必须在餐厅里配备能够接纳残疾人的设施。

ex.en: Your education will equip you to earn a good living.
ex.cn: 你所受的教育会使你过上富裕的生活.

ex.en: We equip our children with a good education.
ex.cn: 我们使孩子们受到良好的教育.

def:
adj.相等的，相当的，等效的,等价的，等积的,[化学]当量的
n.对等物,[化学]当量

ex.en: His party has just suffered the equivalent of a near-fatal heart attack.
ex.cn: 他所在的政党刚刚经历了一次类似心脏病突发般几近致命的打击。

ex.en: The equivalent of two tablespoons of polyunsaturated oils is ample each day.
ex.cn: 每天相当于两大汤匙多重不饱和油的量就足够了。

ex.en: Eight kilometres is roughly equivalent to five miles.
ex.cn: 八公里约等于五英里。

def: n.纪元，年代,历史时期，时代,重大事件

ex.en: As the era wore on, she switched her attention to films.
ex.cn: 随着这个时代慢慢过去，她把目光投向了电影业。

ex.en: The end of an era presupposes the start of another.
ex.cn: 一个时代的结束意味着另一个时代的开始。

ex.en: In the mass production era multinational firms tended to centralize their operations.
ex.cn: 在大规模生产的时代，跨国公司往往实行集权化经营。

def:
vt.使直立，使竖起,建立，创立,安装,[医]使勃起
adj.直立的，垂直的,（头、手等）朝上举的,直竖的,[医]勃起的

ex.en: Her legs were long and fine, her hips slender, her carriage erect.
ex.cn: 她长腿细臀，身姿笔直。

ex.en: He has a military bearing, never failing to carry himself erect.
ex.cn: 他有一种军人的风姿，身板总是挺得笔直。

ex.en: Stand reasonably erect, your arms hanging naturally.
ex.cn: 挺身站直，双臂自然下垂。

def: n.企业,建立,（通常反对变革的）当权派,反对改革的保守当权派

ex.en: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
ex.cn: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

ex.en: Although things are changing the medical establishment is still overwhelmingly male.
ex.cn: 虽然世易时移，但医学界依然是男性的天下。

ex.en: Shopkeepers would once have been pillars of the Tory establishment.
ex.cn: 商店店主一度本该成为保守党统治集团的重要支柱。

def: adj.明显的，明白的,昭著,彰

ex.en: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

ex.en: The privations of monastery life were evident in his appearance.
ex.cn: 从他的外表来看可以明显看出修道院生活的清贫。

ex.en: The immense difficulties facing European businessmen in Russia were only too evident.
ex.cn: 在俄罗斯的欧洲商人所面临的巨大困难是显而易见的。

def: vt.&vi.（使）扩大,（使）增加,夸张

ex.en: There could be more unrest, but I wouldn't exaggerate the problems.
ex.cn: 可能会有更大的动荡，不过我想也不必夸大问题。

ex.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
ex.cn: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

ex.en: These figures exaggerate the loss of competitiveness.
ex.cn: 这些数字夸大了竞争力的丧失。

def: adv.非常，极其，特别，十分,极大地,过分地,极度地，极端

ex.en: Physical perfection in a human being is exceedingly rare.
ex.cn: 体貌完美的人极为罕见。

ex.en: Not being a mother, I found the chit-chat exceedingly dull.
ex.cn: 我没当母亲，所以觉得那样的闲谈无聊透顶。

ex.en: He drove exceedingly fast.
ex.cn: 他把车开得极快.

def:
vt.优于，擅长
vi.胜过

ex.en: Academically he began to excel.
ex.cn: 他开始在学术上超越他人。

ex.en: If your talent combines with diligence, you can excel in your pursuit.
ex.cn: 如果你把天赋与勤奋结合起来, 你所追求的事业便会出类拔萃.

ex.en: How can I read a Microsoft Excel file on a computer that only has Works installed?
ex.cn: 我怎样在只安装了Works软件的电脑上读取微软的Excel文件呢？

def: vt.排除，不包括,排斥,驱除，赶出

ex.en: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep.
ex.cn: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

ex.en: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything.
ex.cn: 要是有什么事情我不让她参加，她会非常难过。

ex.en: Further examination is needed to exclude the chance of disease.
ex.cn: 需要进一步检查以排除患病的可能。

def:
adj.专用的,高级的,排外的,单独的
n.独家新闻,专有物,独家经营的产品（或项目、设计等）,排外者

ex.en: People will always pay top dollar for something exclusive.
ex.cn: 人们总是会为绝无仅有的东西付出高价。

ex.en: Skiing weekends cost £58 (exclusive of travel and accommodation).
ex.cn: 周末滑雪价格为58英镑（不含交通和住宿费）。

ex.en: Many of their cheeses are exclusive to our stores in Britain.
ex.cn: 在英国，他们生产的奶酪很多只在我们商店出售。

def:
vt.陈列，展览,呈现,证明,[法]提交证据
vi.公开展览某物,展出
n.展览，陈列,展览品,公开展示,[法]证据

ex.en: Two cats or more in one house will also exhibit territorial behaviour.
ex.cn: 一家若有两只或更多的猫，也会表现出争夺地盘的行为。

ex.en: He seems to want to exhibit his shame.
ex.cn: 他似乎想要让大家知道自己感到羞愧。

ex.en: In this job you need to exhibit the wisdom of Solomon.
ex.cn: 做这份工作需要表现出所罗门王一样的才智。

def: n.扩大,扩张,扩张物,膨胀物

ex.en: This revolutionary expansion required energetic nation-building policies.
ex.cn: 这种跨越式的扩张需要有活力的国家建设政策。

ex.en: The memory expansion cards are useful adjuncts to the computer.
ex.cn: 内存扩充卡是计算机很有用的附件。

ex.en: the expansion and contraction of the metal
ex.cn: 金属的膨胀与收缩

def: adj.明确的，清楚的,直言的,详述的,不隐瞒的

ex.en: Criticism is hinted at, but never made explicit.
ex.cn: 批评总是含沙射影，但从未明说。

ex.en: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
ex.cn: 他清楚地向我说明了去那儿的路线。

ex.en: It's an explicit statement.
ex.cn: 这句话说得很明确.

def: adj.广阔的，广大的,范围广泛的,[物]广延的,[逻]外延的

ex.en: He has received extensive corrective surgery to his skull.
ex.cn: 他的头骨做过大面积的矫形手术。

ex.en: It's a fair guess to say that the damage will be extensive.
ex.cn: 说损失会很严重想必猜得不错。

ex.en: The blast caused extensive damage, shattering the ground-floor windows.
ex.cn: 爆炸造成了巨大的破坏，震碎了一楼的窗户。

def: adj.灭绝的,绝种的,消逝的,破灭的

ex.en: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.
ex.cn: 草药医术在西方已经成了一门几乎绝迹的技艺。

ex.en: Its tallest volcano, long extinct, is Olympus Mons.
ex.cn: 它最高的火山是早已熄灭的奥林波斯山。

ex.en: Servants are now almost extinct in modern society.
ex.cn: 在现代社会里奴仆已近乎不复存在。

def: n.设备,容易,能力,灵巧

ex.en: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
ex.cn: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

ex.en: Every facility was laid on to ease their homecoming.
ex.cn: 动用了一切设施以缓解他们的回乡之困。

ex.en: This facility is open to both new and existing borrowers.
ex.cn: 这套设备向新老借用者开放。

def: n.能力，才能,全体教职员,<英>（大学的）专科，系,特权，特许

ex.en: Faculty members complain that their students are unprepared to do college-level work.
ex.cn: 学院的老师们抱怨说他们的学生还很不适应大学的课业。

ex.en: She was Dean of the Science faculty at Sophia University.
ex.cn: 她是上智大学科学院的院长。

ex.en: Faculty members devote most of their time to scholarly research.
ex.cn: 全院教师大部分时间都用来从事学术研究。

def: adv.忠实地,诚心诚意地,如实地

ex.en: to follow instructions faithfully
ex.cn: 严格遵循指示

ex.en: They swore an oath to carry out their duties faithfully.
ex.cn: 他们宣誓忠实履行自己的职责.

ex.en: He has served the farm faithfully for 20 years.
ex.cn: 他为这个农场忠心耿耿地操劳了20年.

def: adj.极好的,很大的,怪诞的,不切实际的

ex.en: I got a fantastic new job and my salary tripled.
ex.cn: 我得到了一份非常好的新工作，薪水涨到了原来的3倍。

ex.en: "You're coming?" he said excitedly. "That's fantastic! That's incredible!"
ex.cn: “你要来么？”他激动地说，“那太好了！简直难以置信！”

ex.en: My mother, who had a sheltered upbringing, has fantastic memories of childhood.
ex.cn: 我妈妈在呵护下长大，对童年有着非常美好的回忆。

def: adj.空想的，捕风捉影的

ex.en: The book has many fantastical aspects.
ex.cn: 这本书有很多方面都十分精彩。

ex.en: Join her on her fantastical journey for a memorable adventure.
ex.cn: 加入她对她的荒诞旅程为您带来一个难忘的冒险.

ex.en: His room was tricked out with something fantastical.
ex.cn: 他的房间用一些奇形怪状的东西装饰起来.

def:
n.（加入组织或做某事付的）费,专业服务费，业务报酬,小费，赏钱,[法] 继承的产业
vt.付给报酬，给小费,〈英〉雇用，聘请

ex.en: He finally corrected his misstatement and offered to reduce the fee.
ex.cn: 他终于纠正了自己的错误说法，提出要减少费用。

ex.en: He responded positively and accepted the fee of £1,000 I had offered.
ex.cn: 他作出了肯定的答复，并接受了我给的1，000英镑的费用。

ex.en: Sometimes there's a flat fee for carrying out a particular task.
ex.cn: 有时执行某项特定的任务有固定的价码。

def: adj.凶猛的，残忍的,猛烈的,狂热的

ex.en: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months.
ex.cn: 这一地区3个月以来不断发生激战。

ex.en: Legislation to that effect created fierce controversy both in Parliament and outside.
ex.cn: 那类立法在议会内外都引起了激烈的争论。

ex.en: Such a policy would inevitably draw fierce resistance from farmers.
ex.cn: 这种政策必然会招致农场主的强烈抵制。

def:
vt.提出（离婚诉讼或其他讼案）,把…归档,用锉锉,发稿，寄给报社
vi.发送（报道给报社）,排成一行行走,提出申请
n.文件（夹）,档案,纵列,锉刀

ex.en: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
ex.cn: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

ex.en: I looked your address up in the personnel file.
ex.cn: 我在人事档案里找到了你的地址。

ex.en: We were walking in single file to the lake.
ex.cn: 我们正排成一列朝湖边走去。

def:
n.财政,金融,财源,资金
vt.为…供给资金， 从事金融活动,赊货给…,掌握财政

ex.en: The finance minister will continue to mastermind Poland's economic reform.
ex.cn: 财政部长将继续策划波兰的经济改革。

ex.en: The scheme offers seed corn finance with loans at only 4% interest.
ex.cn: 该方案提供种子基金融资，其贷款只收取4%的利息。

ex.en: Foreign Office officials assisted with transport and finance problems.
ex.cn: 外交部官员帮助解决运输和经费问题。

def:
vi.闪耀，闪光,燃烧,突然发怒,向外张开
vt.使闪耀,使张开,用光发出信号,使外倾
n.闪光,爆发,反射,太阳耀斑

ex.en: Don'tspill too much fat on the barbecue as it could flare up.
ex.cn: 不要在烤肉上浇太多的油，会烧起来的。

ex.en: There's been a flare-up of violence in South Africa.
ex.cn: 南非暴力冲突突然加剧。

ex.en: a flare-up of tension between the two sides
ex.cn: 双方剑拔弩张

def:
n.瑕疵，缺点,一阵狂风,短暂的风暴,裂缝，裂纹
v.使生裂缝，使有裂纹,使无效,使有缺陷
vi.生裂缝,变的有缺陷

ex.en: The only flaw in his character seems to be a short temper.
ex.cn: 他性格中的唯一缺点好像就是脾气急。

ex.en: The flaw in this stamp makes it less valuable.
ex.cn: 这张邮票因为有点缺陷,不那么值钱.

ex.en: It was a large diamond, but it had a flaw.
ex.cn: 这是颗大钻石, 但它有一点瑕疵.

def: n.[数]分数,一小部分，些微,不相连的一块，片段,[化]分馏

ex.en: If a stranger stops you, just wind the window down a fraction.
ex.cn: 如果有陌生人拦你的车，把车窗摇下一点点就行。

ex.en: These 50,000 arrears cases represent a tiny fraction of all home owners.
ex.cn: 这5万个欠款案例只代表所有业主中的一小部分人。

ex.en: The crop represents a tiny fraction of U.S. production.
ex.cn: 农作物仅占美国出产物极小的一部分。

def:
n.框架,眼镜框,组织,边框
vt.陷害,设计,表达,使适合（某一特殊用途）
adj.有木架的，有构架的

ex.en: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
ex.cn: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

ex.en: He learned how to draw the unclothed human frame.
ex.cn: 他学过如何画裸体。

ex.en: We painted our table to match the window frame in the bedroom.
ex.cn: 我们把桌子刷成与卧室窗框一致的颜色。

def:
n.边疆，边境,边界，边缘,尚待开发的领域
adj.边疆的，边界的,新垦地的，边地的,开拓的

ex.en: A "frontier-free" Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.
ex.cn: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。

ex.en: Until very recently Texas was an unsettled frontier.
ex.cn: 就在没多久之前，得克萨斯州还是一个荒无人烟的边远地区。

ex.en: the frontier between the land of the Saxons and that of the Danes
ex.cn: 撒克逊人土地和古斯堪的纳维亚人土地的边界

def: n.天才,天赋,天才人物,（特别的）才能

ex.en: I was hoping some of his genius might rub off.
ex.cn: 我希望他的才华也可以影响他人。

ex.en: At the time, his appointment seemed a stroke of genius.
ex.cn: 当时，对他的任命犹如神来之笔。

ex.en: Is he a nutter, or is he a genius?
ex.cn: 他是疯子，还是天才？

def: n.地质学,（某地区的）地质情况,地质学的著作

ex.en: We went on a geology field trip.
ex.cn: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

ex.en: the geology of the British Isles
ex.cn: 不列颠群岛的地质

ex.en: the keeper of geology at the museum
ex.cn: 博物馆地质资料的保管人

def: adj.巨大的，庞大的,巨人似的,硕大无比,排山倒海

ex.en: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
ex.cn: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

ex.en: He has a gigantic appetite and eats gigantic meals.
ex.cn: 他有很大的食量,能吃很多的食物.

ex.en: The earth may be thought of as a gigantic magnet.
ex.cn: 整个地球可以想像为一块硕大无朋的磁石.

def: adj.黑暗的,令人沮丧的,前景黯淡的,悲观的，阴郁的

ex.en: Some good might come of all this gloomy business.
ex.cn: 生意不景气也未必全是坏事。

ex.en: The country is currently obsessed with gloomy prognostications about its future.
ex.cn: 该国现在正弥漫着对未来的悲观预测。

ex.en: The short-term outlook for employment remains gloomy.
ex.cn: 近期的就业前景依然暗淡。

def:
vt.& vi.抢先，抢占
vt.夺取或抓住,抢夺，霸占,匆匆拿走,〈俚〉吸引注意力
vi.抓住，攫取,夺取
n.不法所得,被抓住的人,抓取装置

ex.en: He made a grab for her but she sidestepped him.
ex.cn: 他想要抓住她，但她侧步闪开了。

ex.en: He edged closer to the telephone, ready to grab it.
ex.cn: 他慢慢挪向电话机，准备抓起听筒。

ex.en: I grab George'sarm and dig my nails into his flesh.
ex.cn: 我抓住乔治的胳膊，指甲抠进了他的肉里。

def:
adj.渐进的，渐（升）降的,倾斜度小的,逐次的，逐渐的,平缓的
n.弥撒升阶圣歌,弥撒圣歌集

ex.en: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes.
ex.cn: 修建这些道路时考虑到了温度的逐渐变化。

ex.en: He hopes for a gradual disconnection from the federation.
ex.cn: 他希望能从联盟中逐渐抽身而出。

ex.en: The greatest hope for reform is the gradual spread of information.
ex.cn: 对改革的最大希望是信息能得以逐渐传播。

def:
adj.宏大的，宏伟的,（最）重要的,豪华的
n.一千美元,大钢琴

ex.en: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
ex.cn: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

ex.en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
ex.cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

ex.en: President Najibullah said he would call a grand council of all Afghans.
ex.cn: 纳吉布拉总统称他将召开阿富汗全民大会。

def: adj.感激的，感谢的,令人愉快的,宜人的,荷

ex.en: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
ex.cn: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

ex.en: We are grateful to you for permission to reproduce this article.
ex.cn: 非常感谢您允许我们复印这篇文章。

ex.en: He was grateful for a chance to relax and collect his thoughts.
ex.cn: 他很庆幸有机会放松放松，整理一下自己的思绪。

def:
adj.总的,粗俗的,显而易见的,恶劣的
n.总额
vt.总共收入

ex.en: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
ex.cn: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

ex.en: His gross misman-agement left the company desperately in need of restructuring.
ex.cn: 他管理上的重大失误使公司陷入亟须重组的境地。

ex.en: They were found guilty of acts of gross indecency.
ex.cn: 他们因存在严重猥亵行为而被判有罪。

def: n.指导方针,指导原则

ex.en: A written IQ test is merely a guideline.
ex.cn: 书面智商测试仅供参考。

ex.en: This is probably the most important interaction design guideline.
ex.cn: 这基本上是最重要的交互设计指导准则.

ex.en: Our guideline would be the prevailing world market prices.
ex.cn: 我们要以当时的国际市场的价格为准绳.

def:
n.（织物、毛皮等的）手感,手柄,举动,柄状物
vi.操作，操控,容易搬运
vt.用双手触摸、举起或握住,用手操作，操纵,处理或负责，管理,〈美〉买卖，经营

ex.en: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
ex.cn: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

ex.en: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appoint-ments.
ex.cn: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

ex.en: Don't take on more responsibilities than you can handle.
ex.cn: 不要承担过多的责任。

def: n.协调,融洽，一致,和谐,[音]和声

ex.en: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again.
ex.cn: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

ex.en: the need to be in harmony with our environment
ex.cn: 同我们的环境协调的必要

ex.en: The new agreement raised hopes for conditions of prosperity and harmony.
ex.cn: 新的协议唤起了人们对繁荣与和谐前景的期望.

def: adj.粗糙的,刺耳的,严厉的，严格的,残酷的

ex.en: His voice was harsh as he enunciated each word carefully.
ex.cn: 他一字一顿，听上去很生硬。

ex.en: The light's a bit too harsh. You can turn it off.
ex.cn: 灯光有点太刺眼了。你可以把灯关掉。

ex.en: I hope you won'tbe too harsh with the girl.
ex.cn: 希望你不要对那个女孩太严厉。

def:
n.匆忙，急忙,急速，紧迫,轻率
v.赶紧，匆忙,<古>使快，催促

ex.en: The pilot wisely decided to return to Farnborough post haste.
ex.cn: 飞行员明智地决定尽快返回法恩伯勒。

ex.en: Spelling mistakes are often just the result of haste.
ex.cn: 拼写错误经常是由于匆忙而造成的。

ex.en: The opposition says the legislation was drafted with indecent haste.
ex.cn: 反对人士认为该法律的起草太过草率。

def:
vt.冒险,使遭受危险
n.危险,冒险的事,机会,双骰子游戏

ex.en: Catching colds is unfortunately an occupational hazard in this profession.
ex.cn: 不幸的是，容易感冒是这个行业的职业性风险。

ex.en: Well, we can hazard a guess at the answer.
ex.cn: 噢，我们可以猜一猜答案。

ex.en: Poverty leads to slums, which are an eyesore and a health hazard.
ex.cn: 贫困产生了贫民窟，那里不仅有碍观瞻，而且卫生隐患严重。

def:
n.大字标题,新闻提要,头条新闻
vt.给…加标题,担任主角

ex.en: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
ex.cn: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

ex.en: If you are a celebrity, you are headline news.
ex.cn: 如果你是名人，你就是头条新闻。

ex.en: The newspaper's headline indicates that there was a trade-off at the summit.
ex.cn: 报纸的大字标题表明峰会上大家作出了妥协。

def: n.半球,地球的半球,[解]大脑半球

ex.en: This animal is to be found only in the Southern Hemisphere.
ex.cn: 这种动物只有在南半球才能找到.

ex.en: Your left cerebral hemisphere controls the right - hand side of your body.
ex.cn: 你的左半脑控制身体的右半身.

ex.en: They say God spoke to them and told them to go on a mission to the poorest country in the Western Hemisphere.
ex.cn: 他们说上帝让他们去西半球最贫困的国家传播教义。

def:
vt.& vi.阻碍，妨碍,成为阻碍
adj.后面的，后方的

ex.en: Does the fact that your players are part-timers help or hinder you?
ex.cn: 队员们都是兼职的，这对你有利还是不利？

ex.en: " Go and join the army,' said his wife. " I won't hinder you. "
ex.cn: “ 去参军吧, ” 他妻子说: “ 我不会阻拦你的. ”

ex.en: Don't hinder me in my work.
ex.cn: 不要妨碍我的工作.

def: adj.神圣的,值得尊敬的，值得推崇的,圣洁的，圣徒般的,宗教的

ex.en: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
ex.cn: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

ex.en: Every year they put a play on at Saint Holy Cross Church.
ex.cn: 他们每年在圣十字教堂上演一出剧目。

ex.en: At the festival, candles are blessed and sprinkled with holy water.
ex.cn: 在节日里，要对蜡烛祝圣，并洒以圣水。

def:
n.钩，铁钩,弯曲部分，有钩部分,圈套，陷阱,〈俚〉锚
vt.&vi.用钩挂,〈俚〉偷，扒
vt.钩，钩住,引上钩,牢牢抓住
vi.弯成钩状

ex.en: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.
ex.cn: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。

ex.en: Lewis desperately needs to keep clear of Ruddock's big left hook.
ex.cn: 刘易斯无论如何得躲开拉多克凌厉的左钩拳才行。

ex.en: He disconnected the IV bottle from the overhead hook.
ex.cn: 他把静脉滴注瓶从头顶的钩子上拿下来。

def: n.地平线,范围,界限,眼界

ex.en: She stared dreamily out of the small window at the blue horizon.
ex.cn: 她出神地看着小窗子外面的蓝色地平线。

ex.en: Johnson's smashing victory in 1964 changed the political horizon substantially.
ex.cn: 1964年约翰逊的大获成功给政界带来了翻天覆地的变化。

ex.en: At the horizon the land mass becomes a continuous pale neutral grey.
ex.cn: 陆地在地平线处变成了一片浅灰。

def: n.殷勤好客,招待，款待,（气候，环境等的）宜人，适宜

ex.en: He struck the ball straight into the hospitality tents.
ex.cn: 他将球直接打进迎宾帐篷里。

ex.en: Hospitality at the Presidential guest house was graciously declined.
ex.cn: 安排下榻总统宾馆的接待被婉拒了。

ex.en: The response of the audience varied from outright rejection to warm hospitality.
ex.cn: 观众反应不一，有人完全不能接受，也有人击掌叫好。

def:
adj.敌人的，敌对的,怀有敌意的,不利的
n.敌对者，敌对物,敌方

ex.en: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
ex.cn: 西方对这个颇具影响力的国家的敌视态度已逐渐缓和。

ex.en: Family control would prevent any hostile takeover or greenmail attempt.
ex.cn: 家族管理可以防止任何恶意收购或绿票讹诈的企图。

ex.en: It could engage the enemy beyond the range of hostile torpedoes.
ex.cn: 从这可以避开敌方鱼雷区对敌人发动进攻。

def: n.<化>氢

ex.en: Hydrogen is used extensively in industry for the production of ammonia.
ex.cn: 氢气在工业上广泛用于制氨。

ex.en: He mobilized public opinion all over the world against hydrogen-bomb tests.
ex.cn: 他动员全世界的舆论反对氢弹试验。

ex.en: A hydrogen leak forced NASA to ground the space shuttle.
ex.cn: 氢气泄漏迫使美国国家航空航天局停止了航天飞机的发射。

def:
adj.同一的,完全同样的，相同的,恒等的,同卵的
n.完全相同的事物,同卵双胞

ex.en: The identical treatment of such dissimilar items is totally illogical.
ex.cn: 对如此不同的东西用一模一样的处理方法是完全不合逻辑的。

ex.en: The two parties fought the last election on almost identical manifestos.
ex.cn: 两个政党以几乎完全相同的竞选宣言参加了上次竞选。

ex.en: A coral reef is built by the accretion of tiny, identical organisms.
ex.cn: 珊瑚礁是由许多相同的微生物不断堆积而成。

def: n.思想（体系），思想意识,意识形态,观念学,空想，空论

ex.en: To add spice to the debate, they disagreed about method and ideology.
ex.cn: 他们在方法和观念上都持不同意见，这使辩论精彩了很多。

ex.en: Such an approach accords with the principles of socialist ideology.
ex.cn: 这种方法与社会主义意识形态的原则相符。

ex.en: This encourages reductionist explanations of fascist ideology.
ex.cn: 这助长了对法西斯意识形态的简单化解释。

def: n.说明,例证,图解,插图

ex.en: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
ex.cn: 插图上是一簇杏橙色的玫瑰，一共5朵。

ex.en: Perhaps the accompanying illustration will explain it.
ex.cn: 可能所附的图表能对此作出解释。

ex.en: the art of book illustration
ex.cn: 书籍插图的艺术

def:
n.影像,肖像,概念，意向,镜像，映像
vt.反映,想像,作…的像,象征

ex.en: The European Parliament badly needs a president who can burnish its image.
ex.cn: 欧洲议会急需一位能改善其声望的主席。

ex.en: The outburst was inconsistent with the image he has cultivated.
ex.cn: 这样大发脾气与他所树立的个人形象不相称。

ex.en: Their healthy image disguises the fact that they are highly processed foods.
ex.cn: 它们看上去有益健康，实则掩盖了其为精加工食品这一事实。

def: adj.富于想像力的，运用想像力的,想象或创造出来的,沉溺于想象的,虚假的

ex.en: He's one of the most dynamically imaginative jazz pianists still functioning.
ex.cn: 他是当下仍旧活跃的最有闯劲、最具想象力的爵士乐钢琴师之一。

ex.en: Mahler's own imaginative orchestration was heard in the same concert.
ex.cn: 在同一场音乐会上还演奏了马勒自己改编的别出心裁的管弦乐曲。

ex.en: The house was always decorated with imaginative flower arrangements.
ex.cn: 这所房子总是摆放着富有创意的插花。

def:
adj.必要的，不可避免的,命令的，专横的,势在必行的,[语]祈使的
n.必要的事,命令,规则,[语]祈使语气

ex.en: It was imperative that he act as naturally as possible.
ex.cn: 最重要的是他要做到尽可能自然。

ex.en: It is absolutely imperative that we finish by next week.
ex.cn: 我们的当务之急是必须于下周完成。

ex.en: Job creation has become an imperative for the government.
ex.cn: 创造就业机会是政府必须做的事.

def: adj.不言明[含蓄]的,无疑问的，绝对的,成为一部份的,内含的

ex.en: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
ex.cn: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

ex.en: Implicit in his speech was the assumption that they were guilty.
ex.cn: 他话语中的言外之意是设定他们有罪。

ex.en: A soldier must give implicit obedience to his officers.
ex.cn: 士兵必须绝对服从他的长官.

def:
n.动机,刺激,诱因,鼓励
adj.刺激性的,鼓励性质的

ex.en: You get a big salary incentive and free board and lodging too.
ex.cn: 你们能获得大笔激励性薪水，还可享受免费膳宿。

ex.en: It's the biggest financial incentive ever dangled before British footballers.
ex.cn: 这是历来对英国足球运动员的最大经济诱惑.

ex.en: A little bonus will give the employees an incentive to work harder.
ex.cn: 一点奖金可以刺激雇员更加努力地工作.

def:
vt.组成公司,包含,使混合,使具体化
vi.包含,吸收,合并,混合

ex.en: Queensway Quay will incorporate shops, restaurants and other amenities.
ex.cn: 女王道码头将会融商店、餐馆以及其他生活便利设施为一体。

ex.en: We had to incorporate the company for tax reasons.
ex.cn: 由于纳税的原因,我们不得不把那家公司合并了.

ex.en: Paints incorporate with oil.
ex.cn: 颜料与油混合在一起.

def: n.指示,象征,表明,标示

ex.en: If she had noticed her father's entrance, she gave no indication.
ex.cn: 就算她已经注意到了父亲的到来，她也会不动声色。

ex.en: There is no indication which way the vote could go.
ex.cn: 没有迹象表明投票结果会怎样。

ex.en: He swore in Spanish, another indication that he was rattled.
ex.cn: 他用西班牙语破口大骂，这再次表明了他极为烦躁。

def:
adj.象征的,指示的，表示的,[语]陈述的，直陈的
n.[语]陈述语气

ex.en: Their failure to act is indicative of their lack of interest.
ex.cn: 他们未采取行动，这表示他们没有兴趣。

ex.en: His presence is indicative of his willingness to help.
ex.cn: 他的出席表示他愿意帮忙.

ex.en: Use the indicative mood to make a sentence.
ex.cn: 请用陈述语气造句.

def: adj.愤怒的，愤慨的,愤愤不平的,激愤

ex.en: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them.
ex.cn: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见，下院议员们感到很愤怒。

ex.en: She didn't know whether to feel flattered or indignant.
ex.cn: 她不知道应该感到高兴还是愤怒。

ex.en: She was very indignant at the way she had been treated.
ex.cn: 她对于自己受到的待遇大为光火。

def: n.愤怒，愤慨，气愤

ex.en: He bristled with indignation at the suggestion that he was racist.
ex.cn: 有人暗示他是个种族主义者，他对此十分恼火。

ex.en: Eva stood up and indignation blazed in her eyes.
ex.cn: 伊娃站了起来，眼睛里燃烧着愤怒。

ex.en: Local councillors have reacted with dismay and indignation.
ex.cn: 地方政务委员的反应是惊恐和愤怒。

def: n.推理,推断,推论

ex.en: The inference I've drawn from his lateness is he overslept.
ex.cn: 从他来晚我得出的结论是他睡过头了.

ex.en: You seemed to know about this book, and by inference I thought you had read it.
ex.cn: 你好像了解这本书, 因此我推断你已读过它了.

ex.en: From his manner, we drew the inference that he was satisfied with the exam.
ex.cn: 我们从他的态度来推断,他对这次测验很满意.

def:
adj.有影响的,有权势的
n.有影响力的人物

ex.en: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
ex.cn: 西方对这个颇具影响力的国家的敌视态度已逐渐缓和。

ex.en: He was one of the most influential perfor-mers of modern jazz.
ex.cn: 他是现代爵士乐最有影响力的表演者之一。

ex.en: This book was enormously influential.
ex.cn: 这本书极有影响力。

def: n.（混合物的）组成部分,（烹调的）原料,（构成）要素,因素

ex.en: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.
ex.cn: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。

ex.en: Speed is the essential ingredient of all athletics.
ex.cn: 速度是所有田径运动项目的关键要素。

ex.en: Coconut is a basic ingredient for many curries.
ex.cn: 椰子是多种咖喱菜的基本成分。

def:
vt.居住,在…出现,填满
vi.居住

ex.en: some of the rare species that inhabit the area
ex.cn: 生活在这个地区的一些罕见物种

ex.en: Wild tribes still inhabit part of the Philippines.
ex.cn: 菲律宾部分地区仍然居住着一些原始部落.

ex.en: Woodpeckers inhabit hollow trees.
ex.cn: 啄木鸟栖息在中空的树中.

def: adj.固有的，内在的,天生

ex.en: Mainline feminism was arguing for the inherent beauty of the natural woman.
ex.cn: 主流女权主义思想倡导女性天生的自然美。

ex.en: Individuality is a valued and inherent part of the British character.
ex.cn: 个性鲜明是英国人固有的、也是他们看重的特点。

ex.en: I think racism is unconsciously inherent in practically everyone.
ex.cn: 我认为种族偏见固有地存在于几乎所有人的潜意识中。

def:
n.虫，昆虫,卑鄙的人,微贱的人，小人
adj.昆虫的,卑劣的

ex.en: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
ex.cn: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

ex.en: Many kinds of insect find their mates by scent.
ex.cn: 许多昆虫通过气味找到交配对象。

ex.en: Chambers' voice droned, maddening as an insect around his head.
ex.cn: 钱伯斯一直在他耳边嗡嗡地说个不停，他都快疯了。

def: n.洞察力，洞悉,直觉，眼光,领悟,顿悟

ex.en: He got his first insight into how inhumane employers can be.
ex.cn: 他对雇主的冷酷无情第一次有了深刻认识。

ex.en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.
ex.cn: 他对这个神话的探讨揭示了美国人的心理。

ex.en: His autobiography provides an illuminating insight into his mind.
ex.cn: 他的自传可以让读者深入洞察他的精神世界。

def:
vt.使一体化,使整合,使完整,使结合成为整体
vi.成为一体,结合在一起,合并,[数学]作积分运算
adj.整体的,完整的,完全的,综合的

ex.en: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced.
ex.cn: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

ex.en: Encouraging teacher transfer would not, by itself, integrate the teaching corps.
ex.cn: 鼓励教师调动本身不会消弭教学队伍中的种族隔离。

ex.en: Little attempt was made to integrate the parts into a coherent whole.
ex.cn: 在把各部分结合成一个连贯的整体方面几乎未作任何尝试。

def: n.强烈,（感情的）强烈程度,强度,烈度

ex.en: The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment.
ex.cn: 预示危机严重程度的一个最显著的迹象就是失业情况。

ex.en: His intensity and the ferocity of his feelings alarmed me.
ex.cn: 他感情之激烈和狂暴都让我惊恐。

ex.en: He was watching her with an intensity that was unnerving.
ex.cn: 他用一种令她心慌的专注神情看着她。

def: v.相互作用,互相影响,互动

ex.en: After initiation, the youths started to interact with the older members.
ex.cn: 入会仪式后，这些小伙子与老成员开始互动。

ex.en: Atoms within the fluid interact with the minerals that form the grains.
ex.cn: 液体中的原子与形成颗粒的矿物质相互作用。

ex.en: Teachers have a limited amount of time to interact with each child.
ex.cn: 教师和每个孩子沟通的时间有限。

def:
n.内部,内地,内政,内心
adj.内部的,内地的，国内的,内面的

ex.en: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
ex.cn: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

ex.en: The interior flatlands and valleys are thickly planted with coconuts.
ex.cn: 内陆的平地和山谷中种着茂密的椰子树。

ex.en: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
ex.cn: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

def: n.间隔,幕间休息,（数学）区间

ex.en: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
ex.cn: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

ex.en: The goal that decided the match came just before the interval.
ex.cn: 决定本场比赛结果的进球是在中场休息前一刻打入的。

ex.en: England were two goals behind at the interval.
ex.cn: 中场休息时英格兰队落后两球。

def: vi.阻碍,出面,插嘴,介于…之间

ex.en: The Government is doing nothing to intervene in the crisis.
ex.cn: 政府没有采取任何行动对这次危机进行干预。

ex.en: The security forces had to intervene to prevent the situation worsening.
ex.cn: 安全部队不得不介入，以防止局势进一步恶化。

ex.en: He would ask Congress to intervene and head off a strike.
ex.cn: 他将要求国会进行干预，防止发生罢工。

def:
adj.亲密的，亲近的,私人的，个人的,内部的,直接的
n.至交,密友
v.暗示，提示,宣布，通知

ex.en: Mr Black went for the jugular, asking intimate sexual questions.
ex.cn: 布莱克先生直攻要害，问起了性方面的隐私问题。

ex.en: France has kept the most intimate links with its former African territories.
ex.cn: 法国与其前非洲属地一直保持着最密切的联系。

ex.en: He surprised me with his intimate knowledge of Kierkegaard and Schopenhauer.
ex.cn: 他对克尔恺郭尔与叔本华的深刻了解让我很吃惊。

def:
adj.无效的,不能成立的,有病的,病人用的
vt.使伤残,使退役,失去健康
n.病人，病号,残废者,伤病军人
vi.变得病弱,因病而奉命退役

ex.en: Margaret resides with her invalid mother in a London suburb.
ex.cn: 玛格丽特同她病弱的母亲住在伦敦郊区。

ex.en: At best Nella would be an invalid; at worst she would die.
ex.cn: 内拉往好里说会落下残疾，往坏处说可能会生命不保。

ex.en: The treaty was declared invalid because it had not been ratified.
ex.cn: 条约没有得到批准，因此被宣布无效。

def:
vt.刺激，使兴奋,使发怒,使感到不适,使疼痛，使发炎
vi.引起恼怒,引起不愉快

ex.en: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
ex.cn: 切辣椒时要戴橡胶手套，因为辣椒会刺激皮肤。

ex.en: Her uncritical acceptance of everything I said began to irritate me.
ex.cn: 我说什么她都不论对错一概接受，这倒惹我不耐烦起来。

ex.en: Don't irritate her, she's on a short fuse today.
ex.cn: 别惹她, 她今天动不动就发火.

def:
vt.使隔离，使孤立,[电]使绝缘,[化]使离析,[微]使细菌分离
vi.隔离，孤立
n.[微]分离菌,隔离种群
adj.隔离的，分离的,孤立的

ex.en: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
ex.cn: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论，使批评家们陷于孤立。

ex.en: A chemist can isolate the oxygen from the hydrogen in water.
ex.cn: 一个化学家能把水中的氧和氢分解.

ex.en: Do not isolate yourself from others.
ex.cn: 不要把自己孤立起来.

def:
n.喷嘴，喷雾,喷气式飞机,喷射流,煤玉
vi.乘喷气式飞机,射出
adj.黑玉制的或黑玉似的,象炭一般黑的
vt.喷射，喷出

ex.en: As he talked, an airforce jet screamed over the town.
ex.cn: 他谈话时，一架军用喷气式飞机在镇子上空呼啸而过。

ex.en: Workers at the plant build the F-16 jet fighter.
ex.cn: 这个工厂的工人建造F-16喷气式战斗机。

ex.en: Military historians may never know what brought down the jet.
ex.cn: 军事史学家们可能永远也不会知道是什么击落了这架喷气式飞机。

def:
n.陪审团,（展览会，竞赛等的）全体评审员,舆论的裁决,评判委员会
adj.应急的,[航]（船上）应急用的,暂时的

ex.en: The jury found that the NFL had violated antitrust laws.
ex.cn: 陪审团裁决全国橄榄球联盟触犯了反垄断法。

ex.en: The jury will retire to consider its verdict today.
ex.cn: 陪审团今天将退庭商议裁决结果。

ex.en: The six-person jury deliberated about two hours before returning with the verdict.
ex.cn: 6人陪审团认真商议了约两个小时后作出了裁定。

def:
adj.厉害的，强烈的,敏锐的，敏捷的,锐利的,热心的
vi.（为死者）恸哭，哀号
n.〈英〉号哭，恸哭

ex.en: He's been a keen supporter of the Labour Party all his life.
ex.cn: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。

ex.en: We were very keen when the 1954 Rally came round.
ex.cn: 1954年的集会开始时，我们都非常热切。

ex.en: He had retained a keen interest in the progress of the work.
ex.cn: 他对那项工作的进展一直很关心。

def:
n.结，绳结，结节，（装饰用的）花结，蝴蝶结,[航]节(=浬/小时)，浬，海里,（树木或木材上的）节疤，（人或动物身上的）硬块，节，瘤,难事，难题，麻烦事，（问题的）要点，（戏剧，小说的）情节的征结
vt.& vi.把…打结，把…连结，捆扎，包扎,使密切结合,使纠结,皱（眉）

ex.en: She wore a checked shirt tied in a knot above the navel.
ex.cn: 她身穿一件格子衬衫，衣角在肚脐上方打了个结。

ex.en: Len tied the knot with Kate five years ago.
ex.cn: 莱恩5年前和凯特结婚了。

ex.en: There was a knot of tension in his stomach.
ex.cn: 他紧张得心揪得紧紧的。

def: n.纬度,范围,[天]黄纬

ex.en: He would be given every latitude in forming a new government.
ex.cn: 他将可以不受任何限制地组建新政府。

ex.en: The latitude of the island is 20 degrees south.
ex.cn: 该岛的纬度是南纬20度.

ex.en: This city is close to the fortieth parallel of north latitude.
ex.cn: 这个城市靠近北纬40度.

def: n.洗衣店，洗衣房,洗好的衣服,待洗的衣服,洗熨

ex.en: She could ring for food and drink, laundry and sundry services.
ex.cn: 她可以打电话点餐，叫人来取要洗的衣服以及叫其他各种服务。

ex.en: He'd put his dirty laundry in the clothes basket.
ex.cn: 他会把自己的脏衣服扔进洗衣篮里。

ex.en: Before entering the bathroom, he emptied his dirty laundry into the hamper.
ex.cn: 进浴室前，他把脏衣服全都放进洗衣筐里。

def:
vi.跳,冲动的行动
vt.跳过，跃过,使跳跃
n.跳跃，飞跃,跳跃的距离

ex.en: Warwicks leap to third in the table, 31 points behind leaders Essex.
ex.cn: 沃里克队在排名中蹿升至第3名，落后领先的埃塞克斯队31分。

ex.en: The scale of migration took a quantum leap in the early 1970s.
ex.cn: 20世纪70年代初，移民的规模骤然扩大。

ex.en: The result has been a giant leap in productivity.
ex.cn: 其结果是生产力的大幅提高。

def: n.立法，制定法律,法律，法规

ex.en: They think that any legislation that involved putting down dogs was wrong.
ex.cn: 他们认为任何涉及捕杀狗的立法都是错误的。

ex.en: The legislation is expected to be passed in the next parliament.
ex.cn: 预计这项法案将在下一届议会中通过。

ex.en: Legislation to that effect created fierce controversy both in Parliament and outside.
ex.cn: 那类立法在议会内外都引起了激烈的争论。

def: conj.唯恐,以免,惟恐,生怕

ex.en: He gripped his brother's arm lest he be trampled by the mob.
ex.cn: 他紧抓着他兄弟的胳膊，怕他让暴民踩着。

ex.en: They decided to retreat lest they would be between two fires.
ex.cn: 他们决定撤退,否则就要受两面夹击.

ex.en: Be careful lest you ( should ) fall from the tree.
ex.cn: 小心,不要从树上掉下来.

def:
n.杠杆,操作杆,工具
vt.用杠杆撬动

ex.en: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
ex.cn: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

ex.en: Press the lever until you hear the catch engage.
ex.cn: 压下挡杆，直到听到挡挂好。

ex.en: I put the coin in the machine and pulled the lever.
ex.cn: 我把硬币投入机器，拉动控制杆。

def: n.责任,倾向,债务,<口>妨碍

ex.en: The company cannot accept liability for any damage caused by natural disasters.
ex.cn: 该公司对自然灾害造成的任何损失概不承担责任。

ex.en: Because of his injury Tom was just a liability to the team.
ex.cn: 汤姆的伤使他成为全队的累赘.

ex.en: Bad pronunciation is a liability in being a narrator.
ex.cn: 不良的发音是做解说员的不利条件.

def:
n.自由主义者,自由党党员
adj.开明的,自由的,慷慨的,不拘泥的

ex.en: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
ex.cn: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

ex.en: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
ex.cn: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

ex.en: The electoral fortunes of the Liberal Democratic party may decline.
ex.cn: 自由民主党的选举运势可能会下降。

def: n.可能，可能性,[数]似然，似真

ex.en: He faces growing unease among the Democrats about the likelihood of war.
ex.cn: 他面临民主党内对可能出现的战事不断滋长的不满情绪。

ex.en: The likelihood of infection is minimal.
ex.cn: 感染的可能性极小。

ex.en: There is very little likelihood of that happening.
ex.cn: 几乎没有发生那种事情的可能。

def: n.班轮，班机,衬垫，衬套,衬里,画线者

ex.en: It became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
ex.cn: 乘坐远洋班轮进行商务旅行变得不合时宜了。

ex.en: a luxury cruise liner
ex.cn: 豪华邮轮

ex.en: Jumbo jets somehow lack the glamour of the transatlantic liner.
ex.cn: 大型喷气式飞机不像橫渡大西洋的客轮那么引人注目.

def: adj.文学（上）的,精通文学的,爱好文学的,从事文学研究（或写作）的

ex.en: Her literary criticism focuses on the way great literature suggests ideas.
ex.cn: 她的文学批评集中关注的是伟大的文学作品表达思想的方式。

ex.en: Many literary academics simply parrot a set of impressive-sounding phrases.
ex.cn: 许多文人只是机械地模仿一套听上去令人印象深刻的说法。

ex.en: By the 1920's, he was lionised by literary London.
ex.cn: 到了20世纪20年代，他成为伦敦文学界的宠儿。

def: n.文学,文学作品,文献,著作

ex.en: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
ex.cn: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

ex.en: Her literary criticism focuses on the way great literature suggests ideas.
ex.cn: 她的文学批评集中关注的是伟大的文学作品表达思想的方式。

ex.en: Some companies have toned down the claims on their promotional literature.
ex.cn: 一些公司已降低了宣传资料中标榜之词的调门。

def:
n.逻辑，逻辑学,（做某事的）道理,推理方法,威力，压力，强制（力）
adj.逻辑的

ex.en: By now all logic had gone out of the window.
ex.cn: 到这时根本就不讲什么逻辑了。

ex.en: Apart from criminal investigation techniques, students learn forensic medicine, philosophy and logic.
ex.cn: 除罪案调查技巧外，学生们还要学习法医学、哲学和逻辑学。

ex.en: They asked her some searching questions on moral philosophy and logic.
ex.cn: 他们深入询问了她一些有关伦理学和逻辑学的问题。

def: n.肺,呼吸器官,[医]辅助呼吸的装置,〈英〉可供呼吸新鲜空气的地方

ex.en: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
ex.cn: 吸烟导致每年有1万人死于慢性肺病。

ex.en: Lung cells die and are replaced about once a week.
ex.cn: 肺细胞约每周新老更替一次。

ex.en: He was rushed to hospital last week after suffering a collapsed lung.
ex.cn: 上星期，他因出现肺萎陷而被火速送进医院。

def: n.维持，保持,保养，保管,维护,维修

ex.en: In the future the machines will need spare parts and maintenance.
ex.cn: 这些机器将来会需要备件和维修保养。

ex.en: She did none of the maintenance on the vehicle itself.
ex.cn: 她对车子本身没有进行半点养护。

ex.en: Other than blowing up a tyre I hadn't done any car maintenance.
ex.cn: 除了给轮胎充气外，我没做过任何汽车保养。

def: vt.操作，处理,巧妙地控制,操纵,[医] 推拿，调整

ex.en: She was unable, for once, to control and manipulate events.
ex.cn: 她仅有一次没能控制和处理好局势。

ex.en: She uses her charm to manipulate people.
ex.cn: 她利用自身的魅力来摆布别人。

ex.en: The treasurer was arrested for trying to manipulate the company's financial records.
ex.cn: 财务主管由于试图窜改公司财政帐目而被拘留.

def:
adj.用手的,手制的，手工的,[法]占有的,体力的
n.手册,指南,[乐]键盘,[军]刀枪操练

ex.en: Too often he only absorbs half the information in the manual.
ex.cn: 他对于说明书上所说的经常是一知半解。

ex.en: The worst part of the set-up is the poor instruction manual.
ex.cn: 安装时最糟糕就是操作指南讲述不够清楚。

ex.en: His manual dexterity and fine spatial skills were wasted on routine tasks.
ex.cn: 他灵巧的动手能力和杰出的空间识别能力都浪费在日常事务上了。

def: adj.大的，重的,大块的，大量的,魁伟的，结实的,大规模的

ex.en: Combined with other compounds, they created a massive dynamite-type bomb.
ex.cn: 将其与其他化合物结合，就制造出杀伤力极强的硝酸甘油炸弹。

ex.en: We needed to reskill our workforce to cope with massive technological change.
ex.cn: 我们得让工人学习新技能，以应对巨大的技术变革。

ex.en: Frank had been struck down by a massive heart attack.
ex.cn: 弗兰克的身体已经被一场严重的心脏病拖垮了。

def:
adj.最大值的，最大量的
n.最大的量、体积、强度等

ex.en: Twelve hours is the minimum, sixty hours the maximum.
ex.cn: 12小时为下限,60小时为上限.

ex.en: You have to develop your capabilities to the maximum.
ex.cn: 你必须尽你所能。

ex.en: It was achieved with minimum fuss and maximum efficiency.
ex.cn: 事情事半功倍地完成了。

def: n.市长,镇长,（英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰由议员选举产生的）镇长,（民选的）市长

ex.en: The person who embodies democracy at the local level is the mayor.
ex.cn: 在地方上代表民主的人是市长。

ex.en: Bradley will go down in history as Los Angeles' longest serving mayor.
ex.cn: 布拉德利将作为洛杉矶任期最长的市长被载入史册。

ex.en: For his dedication the Mayor awarded him a medal of merit.
ex.cn: 为表彰他的奉献精神，市长授予他荣誉奖章。

def: n.技工，机修工

ex.en: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
ex.cn: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

ex.en: He was a born mechanic with a flair for design.
ex.cn: 他生来就是个有设计天赋的机械师。

ex.en: He worked as a motor mechanic.
ex.cn: 他是一名汽车修理工。

def:
n.奖章，奖牌,勋章,纪念章,证章
vi.获奖：赢得一枚奖章
vt.授予…奖章

ex.en: It was an unbelievable moment when Chris won the gold medal.
ex.cn: 克里斯赢得金牌的那一刻令人不可思议。

ex.en: The United States will be at the top of the medal table.
ex.cn: 美国将在奖牌榜上位列第一。

ex.en: Theresa Zabell ran away with the women's gold medal.
ex.cn: 特雷莎·扎贝尔轻松获得了女子金牌。

def:
vi.熔化，溶解,逐渐融合,逐渐消失,感动，软化，感情上变得温和
vt.熔化，溶解,使混合在一起,逐渐消散,使变得温和或温柔

ex.en: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
ex.cn: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

ex.en: The crowd around the bench began to melt away.
ex.cn: 长椅周围的人群渐渐散去了。

ex.en: When he heard these words, Shinran felt his inner doubts melt away.
ex.cn: 听到这番话，欣兰感到他内心的疑虑顿时消散了。

def:
n.纪念碑，纪念物,纪念仪式
adj.纪念的,悼念的

ex.en: The Memorial seems almost ugly, dominating the landscape for miles around.
ex.cn: 那座纪念碑耸立在方圆数英里景致之中显得近乎难看。

ex.en: More than fifteen thousand people took part in the memorial service.
ex.cn: 有15,000多人参加了悼念仪式。

ex.en: Dear Madam, Thank you for your interest in our Memorial Scheme.
ex.cn: 尊敬的女士，感谢您对我们的纪念方案的关注。

def: n.显微镜

ex.en: We aimed the microscope at a likely looking target.
ex.cn: 我们把显微镜对准了一个看起来合适的目标。

ex.en: The microscope contains a few hundred dollars-worth of electronic bits and bobs.
ex.cn: 这架显微镜内有价值数百美元的电子元件。

ex.en: The media put their every decision under the microscope.
ex.cn: 媒体仔细研究了他们的每一个决定。

def: vt.把…带错路,把…引入歧途

ex.en: Ministers must not knowingly mislead Parliament and the public.
ex.cn: 大臣们不应该故意地误导议会与公众。

ex.en: Don't let his friendly words mislead you.
ex.cn: 别让他那友好的言词把你蒙混住.

ex.en: Macdonald accepted that such information could be used to manipulate, to obfuscate, and to mislead.
ex.cn: 麦克唐纳相信这样的信息可以用来操纵舆论，蒙蔽误导。

def: n.混合，混杂,混杂的事物[人群],混合（状态）

ex.en: Liquidize the mixture and then pass it through a sieve.
ex.cn: 将混合物打成泥状，然后用滤网滤一下。

ex.en: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
ex.cn: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

ex.en: The mixture can be used as a gargle several times a day.
ex.cn: 每天可用这种混合液漱几次口。

def:
n.模子,模式,类型,霉
vt.塑造,浇铸,用模子做,用泥土覆盖
vi.对…产生影响，形成,发霉

ex.en: Try to compact the sand into the mold.
ex.cn: 设法把这沙土堆积到模子里.

ex.en: The sweatful practice sessions mold mighty football teams.
ex.cn: 一连串汗流浃背的训练磨练出实力强大的足球队.

ex.en: The plastic was poured into the mold and left to set until it was firm.
ex.cn: 塑料被注入模子后,便放在一边让它慢慢凝结硬化.

def:
n.铸模,模型,性格,霉
vt.用模子做,形成,陶冶，训练（人格）,用土覆盖

ex.en: If damp, musty buildings make you ill, mould is probably the cause.
ex.cn: 如果潮湿发霉的建筑令你生病了，霉菌很可能是病因。

ex.en: Using 2 spoons, mould the cheese mixture into small balls or ovals.
ex.cn: 用两把小匙将奶酪混合物塑成圆球或椭圆球形状。

ex.en: Spoon the mixture carefully into the mould.
ex.cn: 用勺小心地把混合物舀起，倒入模具内。

def:
adj.可移动的,行动自如的,易变的,流动性的
n.风铃,手机

ex.en: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
ex.cn: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

ex.en: Most mobile robots are still in the design stage.
ex.cn: 大多数移动机器人仍处在设计阶段。

ex.en: The Party has been unable to attract upwardly mobile voters.
ex.cn: 该党一直不能吸引那些追求更高社会地位的选民。

def:
adj.巨大的，庞大的,（建筑物）巍峨的
n.怪物,恶魔，恶人,庞然大物,畸形，畸胎

ex.en: During the 1980s monster publishing houses started to swallow up smaller companies.
ex.cn: 20世纪80年代，一些出版巨头开始吞并一些较小的公司。

ex.en: She was a monster. For one thing, she really enjoyed cruelty.
ex.cn: 她是个恶魔。一方面，她确实以残忍为乐。

ex.en: The film will be a monster hit.
ex.cn: 这部电影将会非常卖座。

def: n.道德,道德准则,品德高尚的行为,道德观

ex.en: War turns morality inside out: killing and cruelty are virtues.
ex.cn: 战争颠倒是非：杀戮与残忍成了美德。

ex.en: Can all our efforts towards morality prevail over the forces of evil?
ex.cn: 我们为提倡伦理道德所做的努力能够战胜邪恶的力量 吗 ?

ex.en: He has overthrown the basic standards of morality.
ex.cn: 他已摒弃了基本的道德标准.

def: vt.使有动机，促动，激发，诱导,刺激,激发…的积极性

ex.en: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?
ex.cn: 你是怎样激励大家奋发高效地工作的？

ex.en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
ex.cn: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

ex.en: Never let it be said that the manager doesn't know how to motivate his players.
ex.cn: 绝对不要让人说这位主教练不知道如何激励他的队员。

def: adj.可以忽略的,微不足道的,无足轻重的,不足轻重

ex.en: The company says the cost of relocation will be negligible.
ex.cn: 公司称搬迁的费用可以忽略不计。

ex.en: Senior managers are convinced that the strike will have a negligible impact.
ex.cn: 高层主管们相信罢工的影响微不足道。

ex.en: The practical inconveniences of long hair are negligible.
ex.cn: 长发在实际生活中产生的不便可以忽略不计。

def:
n.神经,勇气，胆量,[植] 叶脉,中枢
vt.鼓励，激励,鼓起勇气

ex.en: Nerve cells have limited ability to regenerate if destroyed.
ex.cn: 如果受到损伤，神经细胞再造的能力有限。

ex.en: The mere mention of John had touched a very raw nerve indeed.
ex.cn: 提到约翰就真的让人心痛。

ex.en: He had the nerve to ask me to prove who I was.
ex.cn: 他竟敢要求我证明我自己的身份。

def: adv.虽然如此，但是

ex.en: The book is too long but, nonetheless, informative and entertaining.
ex.cn: 这本书篇幅太长，但是很有知识性和趣味性。

ex.en: Though he's fool, I like him nonetheless.
ex.cn: 虽然他很笨, 我仍然喜欢他.

ex.en: There was still a long way to go. Nonetheless, some progress had been made.
ex.cn: 路还很长，不过已经取得了一些进展。

def:
adj.值得注意的,显著的,著名的
n.名人,显要人物

ex.en: She became quite a notable director in the thirties and forties.
ex.cn: 她在三四十年代成了一位名导演。

ex.en: Several notable researchers are studying the effects of hyperventilation.
ex.cn: 几位著名的研究人员正在研究通气过度的后果。

ex.en: Tuesday's notable gainer was Sony, which reached a high of 9,070 yen.
ex.cn: 星期二的大赢家为索尼公司，其股票上涨至9,070日元的高点。

def: n.反对,反对的话，异议,反对的理由

ex.en: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
ex.cn: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

ex.en: Some managers have recently raised objection to the PFA handling these negotiations.
ex.cn: 一些主教练最近就英格兰职业足球运动员协会负责这些谈判提出了异议。

ex.en: The Prosecutor looked toward Napoleon, waiting for him to thunder an objection.
ex.cn: 检察官朝拿破仑望去，等他大声抗议。

def: n.义务，责任,证券，契约,债务,恩惠

ex.en: Co-operation was more than just an attractive option, it was an obligation.
ex.cn: 合作不仅仅是诱人的选择，它也是一种责任。

ex.en: They felt under no obligation to maintain their employees.
ex.cn: 他们觉得没有义务为员工提供生活费。

ex.en: When teachers assign homework, students usually feel an obligation to do it.
ex.cn: 当老师布置家庭作业的时候，学生们通常觉得做作业是分内之事。

def:
vt.触怒,得罪，冒犯,使反感令人不适
vi.犯规，触犯

ex.en: There can be little doubt that he will offend again.
ex.cn: 毋庸置疑他还会再犯的。

ex.en: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.
ex.cn: 我尽量少得罪人。

ex.en: Television censors are cutting out scenes which they claim may offend.
ex.cn: 电视节目审查官正在剪掉他们称有可能会令人反感的一些镜头。

def:
n.选择（的自由）,选项,选择权,选择能力
vt.得到或获准进行选择,调动球员

ex.en: It is not an unattractive option to make programmes for other companies.
ex.cn: 为其他公司制作节目也不失为一个好的选择。

ex.en: It is thought that a management buyout is one option.
ex.cn: 管理层收购被认为是一种选择。

ex.en: The menu changes weekly and usually includes a vegan option.
ex.cn: 菜单每周都有变化，通常包含可供严格的素食者选择的菜肴。

def:
n.轨道,势力范围,眼眶,（人生的）旅程，生活过程
vt.& vi.在…轨道上运行，环绕轨道运行
vi.盘旋,绕轨道运行
vt.绕轨道而行,进入轨道

ex.en: The planet is probably in orbit around a small star.
ex.cn: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。

ex.en: Yet bigger satellites will be sent up into orbit.
ex.cn: 更为大型的卫星将被送入轨道。

ex.en: The orbit of this comet intersects the orbit of the Earth.
ex.cn: 这颗彗星的轨道与地球的轨道交叉。

def: n.方向，定位，取向，排列方向,任职培训,（外交等的）方针[态度]的确定,环境判定

ex.en: They give their new employees a day or two of perfunctory orientation.
ex.cn: 他们对新员工进行了一两天例行公事的培训。

ex.en: His sexual orientation was a lot more gay than straight.
ex.cn: 从他的性取向来看，他不像异性恋，更像个同性恋。

ex.en: Suddenly I was cartwheeling down the slope, all orientation gone.
ex.cn: 突然，我骨碌碌地滚下坡，完全晕头转向了。

def: n.结果,成果,出路

ex.en: Jockeys are forbidden to bet on the outcome of races.
ex.cn: 职业赛马骑师禁止对赛马结果下注。

ex.en: Bankers are keeping a wary eye on the outcome.
ex.cn: 银行家们对结果保持高度警惕。

ex.en: Whatever the outcome, it's going to be one hell of a fight.
ex.cn: 不管结果如何，这都会是场艰苦的战斗。

def:
adj.外面的，外部的,远离内部（中心）的,[哲]客观外界的，物质的
n.环外命中

ex.en: There is room for infill between the new outer suburbs.
ex.cn: 在新建的远郊住宅区之间还有空地可以盖房。

ex.en: In 1957, the Soviets launched Sputnik 1 into outer space.
ex.cn: 1957年，苏联人将“斯普特尼克1号”人造卫星送入了外层空间。

ex.en: Taper the shape of your eyebrows towards the outer corners.
ex.cn: 把你的眉毛修剪成越往外眼角越细的月牙形。

def: n.出口，出路,批发商店,排水口，通风口,发泄（情感）的方法

ex.en: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
ex.cn: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的机会。

ex.en: She needed to find an outlet for her many talents and interests.
ex.cn: 她的多才多艺、兴趣广泛需要找个施展的机会。

ex.en: The riverbed is silted up , so there's no outlet for the floodwater.
ex.cn: 河道淤塞, 水无出路.

def:
vt.& vi.战胜，克服,压倒，制服，…不堪
vt.被（烟、感情等）熏[压]倒，使受不了
vi.受到…的极大影响

ex.en: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
ex.cn: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

ex.en: I would overcome any weakness, any despair, any fear.
ex.cn: 我要克服所有的软弱、绝望和恐惧。

ex.en: With repeated applications of weedkiller, the weeds were overcome.
ex.cn: 经过反复施用除草剂，杂草得以彻底根除。

def:
vt.忽视，忽略,瞭望,检查,远眺
n.从高处眺望到的景色,忽视，忽略,可眺望四周的高地

ex.en: The owners don't want to overlook any opportunity to make a buck.
ex.cn: 老板们不想错过任何可以赚钱的机会。

ex.en: You cannot live in a cocoon and overlook these facts.
ex.cn: 你不能自己缩在套子里而忽略这些事实。

ex.en: You overlook the pressure you're under and what it does to you.
ex.cn: 你忽视了你所承受的压力及它带给你的后果。

def: vt.淹没,压倒,覆盖,压垮

ex.en: After my lecture, the students began to overwhelm me with questions.
ex.cn: 讲课之后, 学生们开始问一系列问题,使我不知所措.

ex.en: No difficulty can overwhelm us.
ex.cn: 困难压不倒我们.
