ex.en: It was clear that one massive Allied offensive would overwhelm the weakened enemy.
ex.cn: 毫无疑问，盟军一次大规模的进攻就会击溃已是强弩之末的敌军。

def:
vt.包装,把…装箱,向…提出一揽子计划
n.包裹,包装袋,包装盒,一组建议

ex.en: Investors can apply for a package of shares at a set price.
ex.cn: 投资者可以申购固定价格的股票组合。

ex.en: It is listed among the ingredients on the package.
ex.cn: 它是包装盒标明的成分之一。

ex.en: Reports speak of Berlin putting together an aid package for Moscow.
ex.cn: 报告称柏林正在制订一揽子的莫斯科援助计划。

def:
n.激情，热情,热心，爱好,热恋,酷爱
vt.&vi.[诗歌用语]表露强烈感情，显示巨大热情

ex.en: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion.
ex.cn: 是艾伦为这场较量注入了激情。

ex.en: She needs and wants to be loved with overwhelming passion and adoration.
ex.cn: 她需要并想要被爱的滔滔激情和倾慕所包围。

ex.en: His abiding passion was ocean racing, at which he scored many successes.
ex.cn: 他一直酷爱海上赛艇，并多次在比赛中获胜。

def:
adj.被动的,消极的,不抵抗的,冷漠的
n.动词被动形式，被动语态

ex.en: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
ex.cn: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

ex.en: She hates playing the sweet, passive women that audiences identify her with.
ex.cn: 她讨厌扮演那些漂亮可爱、消极被动的女人，观众们已把她定型为这类角色。

ex.en: He played a passive role in the relationship.
ex.cn: 他在他们的关系中处于被动地位。

def: n.护照，通行证,手段

ex.en: Passport checks will remain the first line of defence against terrorists.
ex.cn: 护照检查仍将是对付恐怖分子的第一道防线。

ex.en: For foreign holidays you will need a valid passport.
ex.cn: 出国度假需持有效护照。

ex.en: Inside the passport was a folded slip of paper.
ex.cn: 护照里面有张折起的纸片。

def:
n.专利,专利品,专利权,专利证
adj.专利的,显然，显露,明摆着的
vt.获得…专利，给予…专利权,取得专利权

ex.en: He wore patent leather shoes.
ex.cn: 他穿着漆皮鞋。

ex.en: P&G applied for a patent on its cookies.
ex.cn: 宝洁公司为它的饼干申请专利权。

ex.en: It sued Centrocorp for patent infringement.
ex.cn: 它诉Centrocorp公司侵犯专利权。

def:
n.山峰,最高点,尖端,帽舌
vi.达到高峰，达到最大值,消瘦,变憔悴
adj.最高的,最大值的

ex.en: The news programme goes out four times a week at peak time.
ex.cn: 这档新闻节目每周在黄金时段播出4次。

ex.en: Calls cost 36p (cheap rate) and 48p (peak rate) per minute.
ex.cn: 电话每分钟36便士（优惠费率）和48便士（高峰费率）。

ex.en: The first episode occupies a peak evening viewing slot.
ex.cn: 第一集占据了傍晚的一个黄金收视时段。

def: n.允许,批准，正式认可，认可

ex.en: Police said permission for the march had not been granted.
ex.cn: 警方说游行并未得到批准。

ex.en: They had asked Hong Kong for permission to put into port there.
ex.cn: 他们请求香港允许他们在那里入港停留。

ex.en: He got permission from his commanding officer to join me.
ex.cn: 他得到指挥官的许可来与我会合。

def:
vt.许可，准许,默许，放任,允许，容许
vi.许可，允许
n.许可，准许,许可证，执照

ex.en: He can let the court's decision stand and permit the execution.
ex.cn: 他有权维持法庭判决，批准死刑生效。

ex.en: Will they permit you to sit in on a few classes?
ex.cn: 他们会同意你旁听几节课吗？

ex.en: Permit me to give you some advice.
ex.cn: 请允许我给你提点建议。

def: vt.使迷惑，使混乱,使复杂化

ex.en: We're dismal enough without conjuring up ghosts and visions to perplex us.
ex.cn: 用不着招神现鬼来缠我们,我们已够惨的啦.

ex.en: This problem is hard enough to perplex even the teacher.
ex.cn: 这个问题确实很难,以至于老师都迷惑不解.

ex.en: I have no wish to perplex the issue.
ex.cn: 我不想使问题复杂化.

def:
n.透镜，望远镜,观点，看法,远景，景色,洞察力
adj.（按照）透视画法的,透视的

ex.en: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
ex.cn: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

ex.en: The Telegraph puts the union in a historical perspective.
ex.cn: 《电讯报》从历史的角度对该工会进行了报道。

ex.en: It helps to put their personal problems into perspective.
ex.cn: 这有助于正确看待他们的个人问题。

def: n.劝说，说服（力）,信仰

ex.en: It didn't take much persuasion to get her to tell us where he was.
ex.cn: 我们没费什么口舌就让她说出了他的下落。

ex.en: If he dummies up, just try a little persuasion.
ex.cn: 如果他不说话, 稍微劝劝他就是了.

ex.en: Even administrative regulations must be accompanied by persuasion and education.
ex.cn: 就是行政命令也要伴以说服教育.

def: adj.丰富的,富产的,丰饶的,充沛

ex.en: There is a plentiful supply of arms on the black market.
ex.cn: 黑市上有大量武器出售。

ex.en: a plentiful supply of food
ex.cn: 充足的食物供应

ex.en: Best buys of the week are carrots, which are plentiful and cheap.
ex.cn: 本星期买胡萝卜最合算, 因为货源充足,价格低廉.

def:
n.地基，基址图,（戏剧、小说等的）情节,一块地,测算表
vt.以图表画出，制图,密谋,把…分成小块,为（文学作品）设计情节
vi.设计作品情节,标示于图表上,密谋，暗中策划

ex.en: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

ex.en: The Tories have lost the plot on law and order.
ex.cn: 保守党人在治安问题上不知所措。

ex.en: Ackroyd worked out this whole plot with one objective in view.
ex.cn: 阿克罗伊德制订出这一整套秘密计划就是为了达到一个目的。

def: n.从业者,执业医生,习艺者,专门人才

ex.en: She was a medical practitioner before she entered politics.
ex.cn: 从政前她是个开业医生.

ex.en: " Prithee , friend, leave me alone with my patient,'said the practitioner.
ex.cn: “ 朋友, 请让我和我的病人单独呆一会儿, ” 那医生说道.

ex.en: Socrates was the greatest practitioner of this analytical search for fundamental assumptions.
ex.cn: 苏格拉底是这种以理性分析法探求基本假设的最伟大的实践者.

def: vt.& vi.在…之前发生或出现，先于,在…之上，优于,给…作序,处于…前面的位置

ex.en: He gestured to Alice to precede them from the room.
ex.cn: 他给艾丽斯做手势，让她在他们前面离开房间。

ex.en: Attributive adjectives precede the noun.
ex.cn: 定语形容词位于名词前.

ex.en: Agricultural development simply must precede economic development.
ex.cn: 农业的发展必须在整个经济发展中处于领先地位.

def:
n.精确度，准确（性）,[语]精确
adj.精确的，准确的，细致的,严守标准的,行动精确的

ex.en: To minimize collateral damage maximum precision in bombing was required.
ex.cn: 为了尽量减低附带性破坏，轰炸须做到最大程度的精确。

ex.en: Her precision became a standing joke with colleagues.
ex.cn: 她事事讲究精确，同事们经常拿这事开玩笑。

ex.en: done with mathematical precision
ex.cn: 以数学般的精确完成的

def: n.前任，前辈,原有事物，前身,<古>祖先

ex.en: He has never exhibited the self-confidence, bordering on arrogance, of his predecessor.
ex.cn: 他从未表现出他前任的那种近乎傲慢的自信。

ex.en: His style could scarcely be further removed from that of his predecessor.
ex.cn: 他的风格几乎和他的前辈如出一辙。

ex.en: He's backing away from the policies and style of his predecessor.
ex.cn: 他正脱离其前任的政策和风格。

def:
n.序言，引语,开端，前奏,[宗]（弥撒的）序诵，序祷
vi.&vt.作为…的序言，作为…的开端,作序,给…作序,开始，导致

ex.en: He has written a fine preface to the play.
ex.cn: 他为这个剧本写了一篇精彩的序言.

ex.en: Several pages of closely reasoned argument preface her account of the war.
ex.cn: 她那部关于战争的著述之前有几页论证严谨的序言.

ex.en: The preface to this book is on the preceding page.
ex.cn: 前边一页是这本书的序言.

def:
adj.初步的，初级的,预备的,开端的,序言的
n.准备工作,预赛,初步措施,（对学生等的）预考

ex.en: The winner of each preliminary goes through to the final.
ex.cn: 每场初赛的获胜者进入决赛。

ex.en: We have had several preliminary sittings in various poses.
ex.cn: 我们进行了几次预拍摄，摆了各种不同的造型。

ex.en: Preliminary results show the Republican party with 11 percent of the vote.
ex.cn: 初步结果显示共和党获得了11%的选票。

def: n.准备，预备,准备工作,配制品,制剂

ex.en: You could never eliminate risk, but preparation and training could attenuate it.
ex.cn: 风险不可能完全消除，但可以通过防范和培训来降低。

ex.en: Rub the surface of the wood in preparation for the varnish.
ex.cn: 打磨木头的表面，为刷清漆做准备。

ex.en: Few things distracted the Pastor from the preparation of his weekly sermons.
ex.cn: 几乎没有什么事情能使牧师在准备每周的布道时分神。

def:
vt.指定，规定,指定，规定
vi.建立规定，法律或指示,开处方，给医嘱

ex.en: The law allows doctors to prescribe contraception to the under 16s.
ex.cn: 法律允许医生给16岁以下未成年人开避孕药。

ex.en: Therapists cannot prescribe drugs as they are not necessarily medically qualified.
ex.cn: 由于治疗师不一定具有行医资格，所以他们不可以开处方。

ex.en: The doctor prepared to prescribe a receipt.
ex.cn: 医生准备开个药方.

def: adv.据推测,大概,可能,想来

ex.en: He had gone to the reception desk, presumably to check out.
ex.cn: 他已经去前台了，可能是要办理退房手续。

ex.en: Presumably the front door was locked when you came down this morning?
ex.cn: 早上你下楼的时候，前门大概是锁上的吧？

ex.en: Presumably this is where the accident happened.
ex.cn: 这大概就是事故现场。

def:
adj.最好的,首要的,最初的,基本的
n.精华,初期,全盛时期,青年
vt.使准备好,填装,事先指导
adv.极好地
vi.（为枪炮）装火药,涂底漆,修剪树枝,注水入泵引起

ex.en: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
ex.cn: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

ex.en: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

ex.en: There is good news of a kind for the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 对总理来说也算是有个好消息。

def:
vi.进行,前进,（沿特定路线）行进,（尤指打断后）继续说
n.收入，获利

ex.en: This can be done if you proceed as follows.
ex.cn: 按照如下操作即可完成。

ex.en: The best way to proceed is by a process of elimination.
ex.cn: 继续进行下去的最佳方式是实行淘汰制。

ex.en: That's not a bad way to proceed, just somewhat different.
ex.cn: 以此方法进行并没有错，只是有些与众不同。

def:
n.队伍，行列,一列，一排,列队行进
vi.排队前进或列队而行

ex.en: It was a seamless procession of wonderful electronic music.
ex.cn: 这是一曲优美流畅的电子乐曲。

ex.en: The parson, heading the procession, had just turned right towards the churchyard.
ex.cn: 走在行进队伍最前面的教区牧师刚刚向右转弯，朝着教堂墓地走去。

ex.en: Musicians played at the front and rear of the procession.
ex.cn: 乐师们在队前和队尾表演。

def: vt.宣告，公布,表明,赞扬，称颂

ex.en: His classic boyish looks seemed to proclaim his good humour and openness.
ex.cn: 他的长相非常孩子气,显得性情很好且诚实坦率.

ex.en: The first Slav pope, John Paul, said that providence had chosen him to proclaim the spiritual unity of Europe.
ex.cn: 第一位斯拉夫教皇约翰·保罗声称上天选择了他来昭示欧洲的精神统一。

ex.en: " Now and here I proclaim -- "
ex.cn: “ 现在我宣布 —— ”

def: n.熟练，精通，娴熟

ex.en: His proficiency as a surgeon is well known.
ex.cn: 他作为一名外科医生的水平是有名的.

ex.en: He made little proficiency in literary accomplishments.
ex.cn: 他在文学方面成就不多.

ex.en: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admission requirement.
ex.cn: 英语基本熟练是入学条件之一。

def: adj.有前途的,有希望的,光明,有为

ex.en: How had this com-promising picture come into the possession of the press?
ex.cn: 这张令人难堪的照片是怎么落到媒体手中的？

ex.en: This small part was taken with elan by a promising young tenor.
ex.cn: 这一小段由一位大有前途的青年男高音倾情演绎。

ex.en: The future quality of West Indian cricket looks promising.
ex.cn: 西印度群岛的板球运动看起来前景光明。

def:
n.证明,校样,检验,（酒的）标准酒精度
adj.防…的,抗…的,能抵御,能防范
vt.给（织物）做防护处理，使防水（或防火等）,印…的校样
vi.[印刷术] 校对,发酵

ex.en: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.
ex.cn: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。

ex.en: His papers were proof against all but the most expert of scrutinies.
ex.cn: 他的论文几乎可以经受住最专业的审查。

ex.en: Training is worthless unless there is proof that it works.
ex.cn: 除非能证明训练有效，否则就是白搭。

def: n.提议,建议,求婚,〈美〉投标

ex.en: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
ex.cn: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

ex.en: This proposal is by no means a sure thing.
ex.cn: 这个提议绝不会理所当然地获得通过。

ex.en: The president was in full agreement with the proposal.
ex.cn: 总统完全赞同该提议。

def:
n.命题,建议,主张
v.提议,建议

ex.en: Making easy money has always been an attractive proposition.
ex.cn: 轻松赚钱总是件诱人的事。

ex.en: Even among seasoned mountaineers Pinnacle Ridge is considered quite a tough proposition.
ex.cn: 即使在经验丰富的登山者中，平纳克尔峰也被认为是很难攀登的。

ex.en: He had allegedly tried to proposition a colleague.
ex.cn: 据说他曾试图向一名同事求欢。

def: n.省份,大行政区,范围,职责

ex.en: Most of those who left the province to work abroad were unskilled.
ex.cn: 那些离开该省出国打工的人大部分都未经专门训练。

ex.en: The province was attacked a month ago after weeks of simmering tension.
ex.cn: 在紧张局势连续数周恶化后，这个省于一个月前遭到了袭击。

ex.en: It's felt there's no future for Anglophones in the province.
ex.cn: 让人感觉在这个省讲英语的人是没有前途的。

def:
n.规定，条项，条款,预备，准备，设备,供应，（一批）供应品,生活物质，储备物资
vt.& vi.为…提供所需物品（尤指食物）

ex.en: There is no provision for funding performance-related pay rises.
ex.cn: 没有为与业绩挂钩的加薪预作资金准备。

ex.en: This provision gives the president total and unchecked power.
ex.cn: 这条规定赋予了总统绝对及不受约束的权力。

ex.en: Local authority nursery provision covers only a tiny minority of working mothers.
ex.cn: 当地政府提供的保育服务只有少数上班族母亲才能够享受到。

def: n.出版,出版物,公布,发表

ex.en: The Tundra Times, a weekly newspaper in Alaska, ceased publication this week.
ex.cn: 阿拉斯加的周报《苔原时报》本周停刊了。

ex.en: The guide is being translated into several languages for publication near Christmas.
ex.cn: 该手册正被译成数种语言，将在临近圣诞节时出版。

ex.en: Three editors handled the work of revising the articles for publication.
ex.cn: 3位编辑负责文章的修订出版工作。

def: adj.严守时刻的， 准时的，正点的

ex.en: She has been reliable and punctual.
ex.cn: 她一直可靠守时。

ex.en: I have to go now because I must be punctual for class.
ex.cn: 我现在不得不走了,因为我得准时去上课.

ex.en: He stressed the point that we should be punctual.
ex.cn: 他强调的一点是我们必须准时.

def: n.半径（距离）,用半径度量的圆形面积,半径范围,桡骨

n.愤怒,激烈，猛烈,渴望，疯狂,〈口〉战争狂
vi.大发脾气，动怒,流行，风行

ex.en: I saw her in a towering rage only once.
ex.cn: 我只有一次见过她大发雷霆。

ex.en: The rage in his eyes made her blood run cold.
ex.cn: 他眼中的怒火吓得她汗毛倒竖。

ex.en: Our father's face had reddened with rage and he began to sputter.
ex.cn: 我们的父亲气得涨红了脸，说话开始语无伦次。

def:
n.围栏,轨道，钢轨,扶手,[动]秧鸡
vi.责备,抱怨,责骂
vt.将…围起来,铺铁轨,坐火车旅行,用围栏围

ex.en: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.
ex.cn: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。

ex.en: The rail strike is causing major disruptions at the country's ports.
ex.cn: 铁路罢工使该国港口陷入了一片混乱。

ex.en: The sudden onset of winter caused havoc with rail and air transport.
ex.cn: 冬天的突然降临让铁路和航空运输系统陷入混乱。

def:
n.阶层，等级,军衔,次序，顺序,行列
vt.& vi.排列，使成横排,把…分类
vt.排列,超过，高于,把…分等级
vi.位于,使成横排,抱怨,吹毛求疵，揭疮疤
adj.讨厌的,极端的,繁茂的,恶臭的

ex.en: Dense smoke swirled and billowed, its rank fumes choking her.
ex.cn: 滚滚浓烟盘旋翻腾，恶臭味呛得她喘不过气来。

ex.en: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
ex.cn: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

ex.en: There was widespread support for him among the rank and file.
ex.cn: 那些普通职员们都普遍支持他。

def:
n.比，比率,比例,系数
vt.求出比值，除，使…成比例,将（相片）按比例放大[缩小]

ex.en: In 1978 there were 884 students at a lecturer/student ratio of 1:15.
ex.cn: 1978年有884名学生，师生比为1比15。

ex.en: The adult to child ratio is 1 to 6.
ex.cn: 成人与儿童的比例为1比6。

ex.en: What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
ex.cn: 这个部门的男女比例是多少？

def:
adj.神智清楚的,理性的,理智的,合理的
n.合理的事物,[数]有理数,懂道理的人，人类,〈英〉合理的服装

adj.生的，未加工的,无经验的,新近完成的,发炎的，疼痛的
vt.擦伤,使赤身露体
n.（身体的）擦伤部位,红肿部位,半成品,原料

vi.反应，作出反应,影响,起反作用
vt.使发生相互作用,使起化学反应,反抗,再演，重演

ex.en: There'dbe no telling how John would react to such news as this.
ex.cn: 还不知道约翰听到这样的消息会作何反应。

ex.en: I don't react anymore when opponents try to niggle me.
ex.cn: 对手找茬惹我时，我不会再理他们。

ex.en: Someone allergic to milk is likely to react to cheese.
ex.cn: 对牛奶过敏的人可能对奶酪也有不良反应。

def:
vt.叫回，召回,使想起，回想,取消,调回工厂
n.召回，唤回,记忆力，回想,罢免,收回通告

ex.en: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.
ex.cn: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

ex.en: As far as I can recall, Patti was a Smith.
ex.cn: 我记得帕蒂是姓史密斯的。

ex.en: The old-timers used to recall how hot 1886 was.
ex.cn: 老人们常常回想起1886年的酷热。

def:
n.接受者,容器,容纳者
adj.容易接受的,感受性强的

ex.en: A suppressed immune system puts a transplant recipient at risk of other infections.
ex.cn: 接受器官移植的病人免疫系统受到抑制后很可能会感染其他疾病。

ex.en: The postman spent almost a whole day looking for the recipient of the letter.
ex.cn: 邮递员几乎花了整整一天时间寻找该信的收信人。

ex.en: The Phoumi regime became the recipient of American military aid.
ex.cn: 富米政权成了美国军事援助的接受者.

def:
vt.开拓，开垦,感化,取回,沙化
n.改造，感化,教化,回收再利用,收回，取回

ex.en: What I've tried very subtly to do is to reclaim language.
ex.cn: 我费尽心机在做的就是改造、拯救语言。

ex.en: "I've come to reclaim my property," she announced to the desk clerk.
ex.cn: “我来要求归还我的房产，”她向接待人员宣布。

ex.en: In 1986, they got the right to reclaim South African citizenship.
ex.cn: 1986年，他们取得了恢复南非公民身份的权利。

def: n.认识，识别,承认，认可,褒奖,酬劳

ex.en: But by the year 2020 business computing will have changed beyond recognition.
ex.cn: 但是到了2020年，商业计算会变得面目全非。

ex.en: His government did not receive full recognition by Britain until July.
ex.cn: 他的政府直到7月份才得到英国的正式承认。

ex.en: The situation in Eastern Europe has changed out of all recognition.
ex.cn: 东欧的形势经历了巨变。

def: vt.改正，校正,[化]精馏,[电]整流

ex.en: Only an act of Congress could rectify the situation.
ex.cn: 只有国会法案才能矫正这种形势。

ex.en: to rectify a fault
ex.cn: 改正缺点

ex.en: Please rectify the mistakes in my bill.
ex.cn: 请改正我账单上的错误.

def: vi.再发生,复发,重现,回想

ex.en: Economic crises recur periodically.
ex.cn: 经济危机周期性地发生.

ex.en: The same old favorites recur year in year out with monotonous regularity.
ex.cn: 相同的决心以单调的规律年复一年地出现.

ex.en: He did not recur in thought to New York or the flat.
ex.cn: 他再也没去想纽约或者他的公寓.

def:
vt.使恢复，使振作,使焕然一新，翻新,给（电池）充电
vi.恢复精神,补充给养

ex.en: They had stopped by a spring to refresh themselves.
ex.cn: 他们曾在一处泉边停歇休息。

ex.en: Allow me to refresh your memory.
ex.cn: 让我帮你回忆吧。

ex.en: I looked at the map to refresh my memory of the road.
ex.cn: 我看看地图以唤起对这条路的回忆.

def: n.提神，精神恢复,提神物,点心，茶点

ex.en: Would you care to partake of some refreshment?
ex.cn: 你想吃些东西吗？

ex.en: He needs to stop fairly often for refreshment.
ex.cn: 他须时不时地停下来喘口气.

ex.en: They will be laying on liquid refreshment to fortify brides-to-be for the shopping extravaganza ahead.
ex.cn: 他们将为准新娘们准备些酒，好让她们接下来有充沛精力疯狂购物。

def: n.避难者，难民

ex.en: Many of the refugee villages are in isolated areas.
ex.cn: 很多难民村落都在偏远地区。

ex.en: Troops tried to set up a lookout post inside a refugee camp.
ex.cn: 部队试图在难民营里设一个瞭望哨。

ex.en: Refugee workers said such action was a violation of medical ethics.
ex.cn: 难民工作者说那种行为是对医德的亵渎。

def:
prep.关于,就…而论,至于
v.regard的现在分词

ex.en: Gail was silent for a moment, regarding Harry with his steady gaze.
ex.cn: 盖尔镇定地注视着哈里，沉默了片刻。

ex.en: We often get complimentary remarks regarding the cleanliness of our patio.
ex.cn: 我们经常听人称赞我们的露台非常干净。

ex.en: She has said nothing regarding your request.
ex.cn: 关于你的要求，她什么也没说。

def: n.依靠，依赖,信任，信赖，信心,所信赖的人或物

ex.en: Reliance on sponsorship can have a malign effect on theatre groups.
ex.cn: 对赞助的依赖会给剧团带来不良的影响。

ex.en: The Prime Minister called for more economic self-reliance.
ex.cn: 首相呼吁加强经济上的自给自足。

ex.en: People learned self-reliance because they had to.
ex.cn: 人们被迫学会了自力更生。

def: adj.不情愿的，勉强的,顽抗的,难处理的,厌恶的

ex.en: We were reluctant to start the long trudge home.
ex.cn: 我们很不愿意踏上如此漫长艰辛的回家之路。

ex.en: Scientific institutions have been reluctant to take corrective action.
ex.cn: 科学机构一直不愿作出更正。

ex.en: I am reluctant to trust anyone totally, Your Excellency.
ex.cn: 我不想完全相信任何人，阁下。

def:
n.治疗法,补救办法,纠正办法,（硬币的）公差
vt.改正，纠正，改进,补救,治疗

ex.en: Camomile has long been used as a remedy for teething babies.
ex.cn: 春黄菊长期以来一直用作减轻婴儿出牙时的不适的药物。

ex.en: Their remedy lay within the range of existent technology.
ex.cn: 他们的治疗方法利用现有技术可以实现。

ex.en: I'll try a herbal remedy to calm him down.
ex.cn: 我来用草药试试，看能不能让他镇静下来。

def:
vt.重新开始,使更新,使恢复,补充
vi.重申，重复强调,重新开始

ex.en: Many hoped he would renew the country's atrophied political system.
ex.cn: 很多人都期望他能使该国萎靡的政治体系振作起来。

ex.en: Cells divide and renew as part of the human growth process.
ex.cn: 细胞不断地分裂更新，这是人体发育过程的一部分。

ex.en: People had to renew their motor vehicle registrations through the mail.
ex.cn: 人们必须以书信方式重新登记机动车辆。

def:
n.租金,地租,（意见等的）分裂，分歧,（衣服等的）裂缝
vt.& vi.出租,付地租,“rend”的过去式和过去分词,租借
adj.撕碎的,分裂的

ex.en: They actually moved down from upstairs because the rent's that expensive.
ex.cn: 他们确实从楼上搬到了楼下，因为房租太贵了。

ex.en: The monthly rent for a two-bedroom flat would be £953.33.
ex.cn: 双卧室的公寓每月房租是953.33英镑。

ex.en: He could take what was owing for the rent.
ex.cn: 他可以把自己欠的钱抵作对方的租金。

def: vt.击退,使厌恶,抵制,使不愉快

ex.en: Like poles repel, unlike poles attract.
ex.cn: 同极相斥，异极相吸。

ex.en: They prepared to repel the invaders.
ex.cn: 他们准备赶走侵略军。

ex.en: Two like electric charges repel each other.
ex.cn: 同性的电荷互相排斥.

def:
n.代表,继任者,议员,类似物
adj.典型的,有代表性的,代议制的,相当[类似]（另一种属）的

ex.en: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
ex.cn: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

ex.en: Voters are interested in the representative's ability to bring home the bacon.
ex.cn: 选民感兴趣的是代表能否兑现承诺。

ex.en: "The community are getting impatient," said a representative of the Residents' Association.
ex.cn: “社区居民开始不耐烦了，”居民协会的一位代表说。

def: v.辞职,放弃,屈从,勉强接受

ex.en: He was under pressure to resign and was about to be sidelined.
ex.cn: 他承受着被迫辞职的压力，很快就要被排挤出去了。

ex.en: It now seems only a matter of time before they resign.
ex.cn: 现在看来，他们辞职是早晚的事。

ex.en: I did not have any intimation that he was going to resign.
ex.cn: 我一点儿都不知道他要辞职。

def: n.抵抗,阻力,抗力,电阻

ex.en: In the end the Kurds surrendered without putting up any resistance.
ex.cn: 最后库尔德人没有作任何抵抗就投降了。

ex.en: Such a policy would inevitably draw fierce resistance from farmers.
ex.cn: 这种政策必然会招致农场主的强烈抵制。

ex.en: Generally speaking there was no resistance to the idea.
ex.cn: 一般说来，没有人会反对这个观点。

def:
adj.有抵抗力的，抵抗的,顽固的
n.抵抗者,有抵抗力的东西,防染剂，防腐剂

ex.en: The body may be less resistant if it is cold.
ex.cn: 天冷时，身体的抵抗力会下降。

ex.en: The durable high-impact plastic case is water resistant to 100 feet.
ex.cn: 这种结实的高强度塑料盒子在水下100英尺以内是防水的。

ex.en: The majority have a built-in Luddite mentality; they are resistant to change.
ex.cn: 大部分人天生有种反对技术进步的心理。他们抗拒变革。

def: n.抑制，克制,控制，限制,拘束,约束力

ex.en: The old sense of deference and restraint in royal reporting has vanished.
ex.cn: 在对皇室进行的新闻报道中，那种由来已久的尊重和收敛意识已经消失了。

ex.en: He sued them for restraint of trade and won.
ex.cn: 他控告他们实行贸易管制，并且胜诉了。

ex.en: Gandhi exemplified the virtues of renunciation, asceticism and restraint.
ex.cn: 甘地体现了克己、禁欲和自我约束的美德。

def: vt.保持,留在心中，记住,雇用,付定金保留

ex.en: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
ex.cn: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

ex.en: Disney will retain a 51 percent controlling interest in the venture.
ex.cn: 迪斯尼将保留该项目51%的控股权。

ex.en: Vegetables should retain some firmness and should not be soggy and waterlogged.
ex.cn: 蔬菜应保持一定的硬挺度，不应潮乎乎的浸透了水。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）反转,（使）颠倒,掉换，交换,[法]撤消，推翻
vi.倒退,[桥牌]逆叫
adj.反面的,颠倒的,倒开的,[生]倒卷的
n.倒转，反向,[机]回动,倒退,失败

ex.en: Amis tells the story in reverse, from the moment the man dies.
ex.cn: 埃米斯以倒叙的方式讲述了这个故事，从这个男人死去的时候开始讲起。

ex.en: The wrong attitude will have exactly the reverse effect.
ex.cn: 错误的态度会产生完全相反的效果。

ex.en: The company had to do something to reverse its sliding fortunes.
ex.cn: 这个公司不得不采取一些措施扭转下滑的运势。

def:
vt.使复活，使恢复,使振奋，复原,使再生，使重新流行,唤醒，唤起
vi.复苏，恢复,振作，恢复,再生，重新流行,再生效力

ex.en: He is seeking advice on how to revive the stagnant economy.
ex.cn: 他正在就如何振兴低迷的经济征求意见。

ex.en: Economists argued that freer markets would quickly revive the region's economy.
ex.cn: 经济学家认为更加自由的市场将使这个地区的经济迅速复苏。

ex.en: They failed to revive her sagging spirits.
ex.cn: 他们未能让她从萎靡消沉中振作起来。

def:
adj.革命的,革命性的，创新的,旋转的
n.革命者，革新者
n.[诗]节奏，韵律,[医]节律，规律,[乐]节拍,[艺]调和

ex.en: The ship adjusted herself to the roll and rhythm of the sea.
ex.cn: 船随着海水的起伏节奏时起时落。

ex.en: The immediate ancestor of rock "n" roll is rhythm-and-blues.
ex.cn: 摇滚乐直接源自节奏布鲁斯。

ex.en: They've revivified rhythm and blues singing by giving it dance beats.
ex.cn: 他们为节奏布鲁斯的歌曲中加入了舞曲的节奏，使之变得更加活跃。

def:
adj.王国的，王室的,高贵的，庄严的,盛大的,敕许的，敕定的
n.<口>王室成员,[航海]顶桅帆

ex.en: You can buy a formulation containing royal jelly, pollen and vitamin C.
ex.cn: 可以买一种含蜂王浆、花粉和维生素C的配方产品。

ex.en: Banks spent his national service in the Royal Navy.
ex.cn: 班克斯在皇家海军服过兵役。

ex.en: All the royal cars are fitted with electronic homing devices.
ex.cn: 所有的皇家轿车都装有电子自导引装置。

def:
n.<美>传闻,[古]名誉,咕哝,[古]喧嚷
vt.谣传,传说

ex.en: However, traders tended to discount the rumor.
ex.cn: 然而，商人往往不相信这一谣传。

ex.en: Rumor has it that he is having an affair with his secretary.
ex.cn: 谣传他和他的秘书有暧昧关系.

ex.en: Rumor has it that her husband has gone over the hill.
ex.cn: 谣传她丈夫偷偷离开了.

def:
n.传闻，谣言,流言
vt.谣传

ex.en: Rumour has it that tickets were being sold for £300.
ex.cn: 据谣传，票卖到了300英镑。

ex.en: Rumour, myth and hearsay obscure the truth after months of bloodshed.
ex.cn: 杀戮持续了数月后，真相在谣言、谎话和传闻的遮掩下变得模糊不清。

ex.en: There's a nasty sort of rumour going around about it.
ex.cn: 关于这件事正有一则恶意的谣言在流传。

def:
n.牺牲,献祭，供奉,牺牲行为,[宗]基督的献身
vt.& vi.牺牲，把…奉献给…,廉价卖出,牺牲，献祭,[棒]作牺牲打
vt.献祭,奉献,牺牲,亏本出售

ex.en: He was willing to make any sacrifice for peace.
ex.cn: 他愿意为和平作出任何牺牲。

ex.en: No one is worth a great deal of sacrifice.
ex.cn: 没有谁值得付出重大的牺牲。

ex.en: The great magicians of old always invoked their gods with sacrifice.
ex.cn: 旧时一些有名的巫师经常以祭品祈求他们所供奉神灵的助佑。

def: n.缘故,理由,日本米酒,目的

ex.en: "For heaven's sake!" Dot expostulated. "They're cheap and they're useful."
ex.cn: “拜托！”多特反驳道，“它们又便宜又管用。”

ex.en: Economic change for its own sake did not appeal to him.
ex.cn: 经济变化本身对他并没有吸引力。

ex.en: For God's sake shut up. I can't hear myself think!
ex.cn: 看在老天爷的份上，闭嘴吧。吵死我了！

def:
n.薪水，薪金，薪俸
vt.给…加薪,给…薪水,发…薪水,付…薪水

ex.en: You get a big salary incentive and free board and lodging too.
ex.cn: 你们能获得大笔激励性薪水，还可享受免费膳宿。

ex.en: I got a fantastic new job and my salary tripled.
ex.cn: 我得到了一份非常好的新工作，薪水涨到了原来的3倍。

ex.en: His salary was obscene for three 40-minute shows a week.
ex.cn: 他一周只有3次节目，每次40分钟，但他的薪水实在高得离谱。

def: adj.令人满意的,符合要求的,[神]赎罪的

ex.en: As a result, the satisfiable degree values of the given Methods: Were also greater titan 95 %.
ex.cn: 结果表明两种预报方法公众的满意度都在95%以上.

def:
vt.浸湿，浸透,使充满,[化]使饱和,使渗进，使湿透
adj.浸透的，渗透的,饱和的,颜色浓[深]的

ex.en: As the domestic market becomes saturated, firms begin to export the product.
ex.cn: 由于国内市场饱和，各公司开始外销。

ex.en: His work clothes, having become saturated with oil, had to be cleaned.
ex.cn: 他的工作服已经被油浸透，该洗洗了。

ex.en: The continuous rain had saturated the soil.
ex.cn: 连绵不断的雨把土地淋了个透。

def:
adj.未开化的,野蛮的,凶猛的,残忍的
vt.（动物）凶狠地攻击（或伤害）,残害,猛烈批评,激烈抨击
n.未开化的人，野蛮人,野兽,<美>有拘捕狂的警察

ex.en: "What do you want!" she whispered savagely. "Get out."
ex.cn: “你想干什么！”她粗野地低语道，“滚开。”

ex.en: He was savagely beaten.
ex.cn: 他遭到了一顿毒打。

def:
adj.外国的,相异的,异已的,不相容的
n.外国人,外侨,局外人,外星人
vt.让渡，转让,疏远,离间

ex.en: Leningrad was the third alien city to offer him a surrogate home.
ex.cn: 列宁格勒是他在异地安家的第三个外国城市。

ex.en: When war broke out, he was interned as an enemy alien.
ex.cn: 战争爆发时，他作为敌国人士遭到关押。

ex.en: His work offers an insight into an alien culture.
ex.cn: 他的作品能让人们对一种异域文化产生较深入的了解。

def: n.新奇,新奇的事物,新颖小巧而价廉的物品

ex.en: They're treating it like a game, a novelty. That's got to stop.
ex.cn: 他们把这件事当成了一个游戏，觉得很新鲜。不能再那样下去了。

ex.en: Having a mid-morning party certainly adds novelty value.
ex.cn: 在上午10点左右开派对一定会增加新鲜感。

ex.en: There's a certain novelty value in this approach.
ex.cn: 这种方法有一定的新意。

def:
n.香客，朝圣者,旅行者,追寻者,〈美〉新来移民，1620年移居美洲的英国清教徒
v.朝圣，参拜圣地,流浪

ex.en: This weekend course will be of value to everyone interested in the Pilgrim Route.
ex.cn: 这一周末课程对每一个对朝圣路线感兴趣的人来说都会很有用。

ex.en: They read stories about the Indians and the Pilgrim.
ex.cn: 他们阅读有关印第安人和那些朝圣者的故事。

ex.en: He went to Mecca as a pilgrim.
ex.cn: 他去麦加朝圣.

def:
vt.逃避，躲避,避开,规避,逃脱
vi.逃避,规避,逃脱

ex.en: They left their villages to evade being press-ganged into the army.
ex.cn: 为了不被抓去当兵，他们逃离了自己的村庄。

ex.en: He tried to evade the embarrassing question.
ex.cn: 他企图回避这令人难堪的问题.

ex.en: Delegates accused them of trying to evade responsibility for the failures of the past five years.
ex.cn: 代表们指责他们企图逃避过去5年中多次失败应负的责任。

def: n.虚荣，浮华,自负,空虚，无聊的事物,无价值的东西

ex.en: The IKEA vanman helped me dump the furniture.
ex.cn: 宜家的货车司机帮我卸下了家具.

def: n.特点，特性,少许

ex.en: They called him a traitor to his Afrikaner people.
ex.cn: 他们称他背叛了自己的族人南非白人。

ex.en: "Traitor!" she screamed. "Betrayer of England!"
ex.cn: “叛徒！”她尖叫道。“英格兰的叛徒！”

ex.en: He was arraigned for criminally abetting a traitor.
ex.cn: 他因怂恿他人叛国而受到传讯。

def:
vt.猜疑（是）,怀疑，不信任,怀疑…有罪
n.嫌疑犯
vi.怀疑

ex.en: Its motive and jumping - off place are very suspectable.
ex.cn: 其动机及出发点十分值得怀疑.

ex.en: The argument that the shortage of IP address can weaken Internet is suspectable.
ex.cn: IP地址的短缺会削弱互联网的说法值得怀疑.

def:
adj.永久（性）的，永恒的，不变的，耐久的，持久的，经久的,稳定的,常务的，常设的
n.电烫发，烫发

ex.en: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
ex.cn: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

ex.en: They had entered the country and had applied for permanent residence.
ex.cn: 他们已经入境该国，并申请了永久居留权。

ex.en: Don't get me wrong, it's interesting work. But it's not permanent.
ex.cn: 别误会我的意思，这个工作很有意思，可惜不是长期性的。

def:
vt.热情款待,使有兴趣,抱着，怀有,考虑
vi.热情款待

n.用具，装备,索具,阻挡,阻截队员
vt.着手处理,[橄榄球]擒住并摔倒（一名对方球员）,给（马）配上挽具
vi.擒住并摔倒一名对手

ex.en: a bottom-up approach to tackling the problem
ex.cn: 处理这个问题的自下而上的方法

ex.en: There are three essentially different ways of tackling the problem.
ex.cn: 解决这个问题有三种根本不同的方法。

ex.en: They were fearful of tackling him.
ex.cn: 他们害怕与他打交道.

def: adj.含糊的，不明确的,引起歧义的,有两种或多种意思的,模棱两可

ex.en: The manifesto is long-winded, repetitious and often ambiguous or poorly drafted.
ex.cn: 这份声明冗长繁复，多处存在歧义或行文拙劣。

ex.en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
ex.cn: 这份协议非常含糊，可以有多种解释。

ex.en: However, the evidence is thin and, to some extent, ambiguous.
ex.cn: 然而，这个证据难以令人信服，而且有点模棱两可。

def: adj.认知的,认识的

ex.en: a child's cognitive development
ex.cn: 儿童的认知开发

ex.en: As children grow older, their cognitive processes become sharper.
ex.cn: 孩子们越长越大，他们的认知过程变得更为敏锐。

ex.en: Cognitive consonance is a consistency between the knowledge , ideas and beliefs .
ex.cn: 认识一致是知识、思想和信念之间的一致。

def: n.限制,局限,极限,起限制作用的规则（或事实、条件）

ex.en: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
ex.cn: 这种药有一个严重缺陷：它的药力只能持续6个小时。

ex.en: There is to be no limitation on the number of opposition parties.
ex.cn: 反对党的数量没有限制。

ex.en: The meeting was merely an exercise in damage limitation.
ex.cn: 这次会议只是控制损失的一项举措。

def:
vt.开采,开拓,利用（…为自己谋利）,剥削
n.功绩,功劳,勋绩

ex.en: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways.
ex.cn: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

ex.en: What the media should not do is to exploit people's natural fears.
ex.cn: 媒体不应该利用人们天生的恐惧心理。

ex.en: Cary is hoping to exploit new opportunities in Europe.
ex.cn: 卡里希望好好利用欧洲的新机遇。

def: adj.怀孕的,孕育着…的,富于想象的,富于成果的

ex.en: The number of women who become pregnant after adopting children is legion.
ex.cn: 领养小孩后怀孕的妇女比比皆是。

ex.en: Pregnant women who are heavy drinkers risk damaging the unborn foetus.
ex.cn: 孕妇酗酒可能会危及腹中胎儿。

ex.en: This was a sickening attack on a pregnant and defenceless woman.
ex.cn: 这一起对毫无防御能力的孕妇的袭击，令人无比震惊。

def: adj.沉思的,体贴的,缜密思考过的，深思熟虑的

ex.en: I strolled up and down thoughtfully before calling a taxi.
ex.cn: 我踱来踱去仔细思量后叫了一辆出租车。

ex.en: Daniel nodded thoughtfully.
ex.cn: 丹尼尔若有所思地点了点头。

ex.en: He listened thoughtfully, interjecting only the odd word.
ex.cn: 他仔细地听着，只是偶尔插句话。

def:
n.民族,人们,〈口〉家属，亲戚,民间音乐
adj.民间的,普通平民的,流传民间的,普通百姓的

ex.en: The folk-song world was another of his abiding interests.
ex.cn: 民歌是他的另一个始终不渝的爱好。

ex.en: Jack was a folk hero in the Greenwich Village bars.
ex.cn: 在格林尼治村的酒吧里杰克是人们心目中的英雄。

ex.en: A military band played Russian marches and folk tunes.
ex.cn: 一支军乐队演奏了俄罗斯的进行曲与民乐。

def:
n.（未获学士学位的）大学生，大学肄业生
adj.大学生的，大学的

adj.合法的，合理的,正规的,合法婚姻所生的,真正的，真实的
vt.使合法,给予合法的地位,通过法律手段给（私生子）以合法地位,正式批准，授权

ex.en: Most doctors appear to recognize homeopathy as a legitimate form of medicine.
ex.cn: 大多数医生似乎都接受顺势疗法是一种合理的医疗手段。

ex.en: We only married in order that the child should be legitimate.
ex.cn: 我们结婚纯粹是为了给孩子一个合法身份。

ex.en: The empire could not cohere as a legitimate whole.
ex.cn: 这个帝国无法凝聚成一个合法的整体。

def:
adj.模糊的,（思想上）不清楚的,（表达或感知）含糊的,暧昧的
n.模糊不定状态

ex.en: He looked vaguely around the room as he spoke, his mind elsewhere.
ex.cn: 他边说话边茫然地打量着房间，心不在焉的样子。

ex.en: I vaguely remember snarling at someone who stepped on my foot.
ex.cn: 我隐约记得我曾向着那个踩了我一脚的人怒吼。

ex.en: Judith could vaguely remember her mother lying on the sofa.
ex.cn: 朱迪丝隐约记得她母亲躺在沙发上的情景。

def: vi.丰富，盛产,非常多，大量存在,充满

ex.en: Stories abound about when he was in charge.
ex.cn: 关于他在任时的传闻多不胜数。

ex.en: Stories about his travels abound.
ex.cn: 有关他游历的故事多得很。

ex.en: Questions abound as to the reasons for the president's decision.
ex.cn: 关于总裁作出这一决定的理由,人们提出了各种各样的疑问.

def: vt.& vi.扩大，放大,扩展，扩充,拉长说，详述

ex.en: Workmen were hired to remodel and enlarge the farm buildings.
ex.cn: 雇用了工人来改造和扩建农场建筑。

ex.en: Different states or groups can combine to enlarge their markets.
ex.cn: 不同的州或企业集团可以联合起来以扩大市场。

ex.en: I wish to enlarge upon a statement made by Gary Docking.
ex.cn: 我想就加里·多金的话再展开说一下。

def:
vt.联合抵制,抵制（货物等）,拒绝参加
n.联合抵制,联合拒绝购买,拒绝参加

ex.en: Opposition leaders had called for a boycott of the vote.
ex.cn: 反对党领袖已号召人们拒绝投票。

ex.en: Rosie Boycott was not involved editorially with Virago.
ex.cn: 罗西·博伊科特不属于维拉戈出版公司的编辑队伍。

ex.en: We are asking people to boycott goods from companies that use child labour.
ex.cn: 我们正呼吁大家抵制雇用童工的公司的产品。

def: vt.消耗，消费,耗尽，毁灭,吃光，喝光,烧毁

ex.en: Classically, overweight people underestimate the volume of food that they consume.
ex.cn: 一般来说，超重的人往往低估自己摄入食物的量。

ex.en: Earthworms consume large amounts of soil, and produce a rich humus, perfect in texture.
ex.cn: 蚯蚓吃下大量土壤，排出肥力丰富、物理结构理想的腐殖质。

ex.en: Some of the most efficient refrigerators consume 70 percent less electricity than traditional models.
ex.cn: 一些极为节能的冰箱比传统型号耗电减少70%。

def: vt.引起,唤醒,激起性欲,使行动起来

ex.en: There is nothing like a long walk to arouse the appetite.
ex.cn: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。

ex.en: Their persecution only serves to arouse the opposition of the people.
ex.cn: 他们的迫害只激起人民对他们的反抗.

ex.en: We must arouse them to fight for their own emancipation.
ex.cn: 我们必须唤起他们为其自身的解放而斗争.

def: n.细看，细阅,仔细的观察,监督

ex.en: Master, they've split up. I humbly suggest we scry on the leader.
ex.cn: 大人, 他们分头行动了. 在下谨建议集中探知那个队长.

ex.en: I humbly suggest we scry on the leader.
ex.cn: 在下谨建议集中探知那个队长.

def:
n.金字塔,角锥状物
vt.使…成塔尖形,使…节节建立,使…上涨
vi.成金字塔状,渐增,连续投机

ex.en: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza.
ex.cn: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

ex.en: a pyramid of cans in a shop window
ex.cn: 商店橱窗中摆成金字塔形的罐头

ex.en: Traditionally, the Brahmins, or the priestly class, are set at the top of the social pyramid.
ex.cn: 传统上，婆罗门，或称僧侣阶级，处于社会金字塔的顶端。

def:
adj.（人、树木、鸟或动物）成熟的,仔细考虑过的,到期（应该支付）的,成年人的
vi.成熟，长成,（票据等）到期
vt.使…成熟,使…长成,慎重拟定（计划等）

ex.en: These plants are then pollinated and allowed to mature and produce seed.
ex.cn: 然后，这些植物就被授粉，从而成熟结籽。

ex.en: Some adolescents might be more sexually mature and provocative than others.
ex.cn: 一些青少年可能相比同龄人在性方面更成熟、更具挑逗性。

ex.en: The caterpillars tunnel into the fruit to grow and mature.
ex.cn: 毛虫钻入果实，并在其中生长为成虫。

def: n.构架,框架,（体系的）结构,机构，组织

ex.en: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
ex.cn: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

ex.en: Wood roughed out a possible framework for their story.
ex.cn: 伍德为他们的故事勾勒出了一个合理的梗概。

ex.en: The show uses Zondo's trial and execution as its framework.
ex.cn: 这部戏以桑多的受审和被处决作为基本框架。

def:
n.限制，抑制,勒马绳，马衔索,（人行道的）镶边,（证券的）场外市场
vt.制止，束缚,给（马）扣上马衔,给…加路缘,在…处设井栏

ex.en: Wade released the hand brake and pulled away from the curb.
ex.cn: 韦德松开手刹驶离路边。

ex.en: A large, shiny black limo pulled up to the curb.
ex.cn: 一辆闪亮的黑色豪华大轿车在路边停下。

ex.en: You must curb your extravagant tastes.
ex.cn: 你必须控制自己铺张奢侈的嗜好。

def:
n.障碍,屏障,栅栏,分界线
vt.把…关入栅栏,用栅栏围住

ex.en: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
ex.cn: 我意识到我不得不克服语言障碍。

ex.en: England's World Cup hero is determined to play through the pain barrier.
ex.cn: 英格兰的世界杯英雄决定带伤上阵。

ex.en: A train plowed into the barrier at the end of the platform.
ex.cn: 火车撞上了月台尽头的栅栏。

def: n.热情，热忱,热衷的事物,宗教的狂热

ex.en: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does.
ex.cn: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。

ex.en: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

ex.en: She wrinkled her nose, piqued by his total lack of enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 她皱皱鼻子，为他毫无热情而感到不快。

def: n.统计，统计学，统计法，统计资料,统计数字,“statistic”的复数

ex.en: The synchronous hysteresis motor consists of a polyphase - wound stator and a magnetically hard rotor.
ex.cn: 同步磁带电动机由一个多相缠绕的定子和一个硬磁转子所组成.

ex.en: Also , in prior years, adjustment of the signal - generator and torque - generator stator mechanical radial positions was required.
ex.cn: 前些年对信号发生器和转矩发生器定子的机械半径位置也要进行调整.

ex.en: The diameters of the rotor and the stator are limited by mechanical stresses.
ex.cn: 转子和定子的直径受到机械强度的限制.

def: n.伦理，伦理观,道德体系,（复数）伦理学，道德学,（复数）行为准则

ex.en: Out of Puritanism came the intense work ethic.
ex.cn: 严格的职业道德源于清教主义。

ex.en: Will severe selection standards create elitism and threaten the Olympic ethic of participation?
ex.cn: 严格的选拔标准是否会造成精英主义，进而危及奥林匹克重在参与的理念呢？

ex.en: They also boldly championed the Christian ethic and Western Culture tradition.
ex.cn: 他们还勇敢地维护基督教道德伦理和西方文化传统.

def: vt.废除，废止,取消，革除,消灭,撤销

ex.en: The following year Parliament voted to abolish the death penalty for murder.
ex.cn: 议会于翌年表决对谋杀罪废除死刑。

ex.en: The Government of Jamaica consider it imprudent to abolish the death penalty.
ex.cn: 牙买加政府认为废除死刑是轻率之举。

ex.en: plans to abolish the monarchy
ex.cn: 废除君主政体的计划

def:
adj.绝对的，完全的,不受任何限制[约束]的,无条件的,有无上权力或权威的
n.绝对,绝对事物

ex.en: The industry minister described the affair as "an absolute scandal".
ex.cn: 工业部长将此事件形容为“绝对的丑闻”。

ex.en: I think he's an absolute stinker to do that to her.
ex.cn: 我认为他那样对待她真太缺德了。

ex.en: In absolute terms British wages remain low by European standards.
ex.cn: 根据欧洲标准，英国工资的绝对值依然很低。

def:
adj.抽象的，理论上的,难解的,抽象派的,茫然的
n.抽象概念,抽象派艺术作品,摘要,[化]萃取物
vt.提取，分离,转移（注意等）,概括，摘录,<婉辞>剽窃

ex.en: His painting went through both representational and abstract periods.
ex.cn: 他的绘画经历了具象风格和抽象风格两个阶段。

ex.en: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.
ex.cn: 钱对她来说就是个抽象的东西，她从不去想钱。

ex.en: In the exhibition, abstract paintings are juxtaposed with shocking photographs.
ex.cn: 展览会上抽象画与令人震惊的照片并列展出。

def:
adj.荒谬的,荒唐的,无理性的，杂乱无章的,荒诞主义的，荒诞的
n.无价值，无意义

ex.en: It is absurd to be discussing compulsory redundancy policies for teachers.
ex.cn: 讨论针对教师的强制裁员政策真是滑稽可笑。

ex.en: It can be done without following some absurd, off-the-wall investment strategy.
ex.cn: 不用遵照那套荒唐愚蠢的投资策略也可以做到。

ex.en: This is patently absurd.
ex.cn: 这显然荒唐透顶。

def: adj.大量的，充足的,丰富的，富有的,丰足,阜

ex.en: Birds are abundant in the tall vegetation.
ex.cn: 高大的植被中有着大量的鸟类。

ex.en: Fish are abundant in the lake.
ex.cn: 湖里鱼很多。

ex.en: Mosquitoes are extremely abundant in this dark wet place.
ex.cn: 这个阴暗潮湿的地方蚊子非常多.

def: n.一致,和谐,给予

ex.en: Cancellation charges will apply in accordance with paragraph 4 above.
ex.cn: 按照上面第四节条款内容应该支付注销费.

ex.en: One's opinion tends to differ in accordance with one's standpoint.
ex.cn: 不同的立场势必形成不同的见解.

ex.en: She was dismissed in accordance with the company's usual displinary procedures.
ex.cn: 按照公司一般纪律程序,她被解雇了.

def:
vt.& vi.堆积，积累
vi.（数量）逐渐增加，（质量）渐渐提高

ex.en: How can I accumulate enough cash to get out of debt?
ex.cn: 我怎么才能攒足钱还清债务呢？

ex.en: Lead can accumulate in the body until toxic levels are reached.
ex.cn: 铅会在体内积聚直至造成铅中毒。

ex.en: However, as evidence began to accumulate, experts felt obliged to investigate.
ex.cn: 然而, 由于证据开始增多了, 专家们感到必须进行调查了.

def:
adj.习惯的,通常的,独有的,适应的
v.使习惯于(accustom的过去式和过去分词)

ex.en: Possibly we are accustomed, biologically speaking, to this background radiation.
ex.cn: 从生物机理上说，我们可能已经习惯了这种本底辐射。

ex.en: Bradley is still accustomed to travelling everywhere in style.
ex.cn: 布拉德利仍然保持着每次出行必派头十足的习惯。

ex.en: The team has accustomed itself to the pace of first division rugby.
ex.cn: 球队适应了英式橄榄球甲级联赛的节奏。

def:
adj.酸味的,尖刻的,酸的,酸性的
n.<化>酸,酸味物质

ex.en: Acid rain is not straightforwardly attributable to the burning of coal.
ex.cn: 酸雨并非简单地由烧煤造成。

ex.en: Nor is acid rain always, and universally, a bad thing.
ex.cn: 酸雨也并非在任何情况下都是坏事。

ex.en: This comedy of contemporary manners is told with compassion and acid humour.
ex.cn: 这部当代风尚喜剧杂糅了悲悯的情怀和尖酸的幽默。

def: adj.尖的，锐的,敏锐的，敏感的,严重的，剧烈的,[医]急性的

ex.en: I was laid up in bed with acute rheumatism.
ex.cn: 我染上了急性风湿，卧病在床。

ex.en: In the dark my sense of hearing becomes so acute.
ex.cn: 黑暗中我的听觉变得异常灵敏。

ex.en: Into her nineties, her thinking remained acute and her character forceful.
ex.cn: 虽已年届九旬，她依然头脑敏锐，个性很强。

def: n.喜爱，慈爱,情感或感情,意向,疾病，病情

ex.en: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
ex.cn: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

ex.en: Their affection for her soon increased almost to idolatry.
ex.cn: 他们对她的喜爱不久就发展到了盲目崇拜的地步。

ex.en: Right now I'm in need of a little filial affection.
ex.cn: 此刻我需要的是一份孝心。

def: vt.加重，使恶化,使恼火,激怒

ex.en: Pollution can aggravate asthma.
ex.cn: 污染会使气喘加重。

ex.en: Men aggravate me when they go on about how impractical women are.
ex.cn: 男人们不断地谈论女人是如何不切实际的时候使我恼火.

ex.en: Threats will only aggravate her.
ex.cn: 恐吓只能激怒她.

def:
vt.搅动，摇动,使不安,激烈讨论
vi.鼓动，煽动

ex.en: The women who worked in these mills had begun to agitate for better conditions.
ex.cn: 在这些工厂里做工的妇女们开始抗议要求改善工作条件。

ex.en: All you need to do is gently agitate the water with a finger or paintbrush.
ex.cn: 你只需要用手指或刷子轻轻地搅动水。

ex.en: Don't agitate yourself over it.
ex.cn: 别为这件事焦虑.

def: n.极大的痛苦,苦恼，烦闷,临死的挣扎,（感情的）迸发

ex.en: The Aussie was in agony with a broken finger.
ex.cn: 这个澳大利亚人承受着断指之痛。

ex.en: He fell awkwardly and went down in agony clutching his right knee.
ex.cn: 他笨拙地摔倒了，痛苦地抱住右膝倒在地上。

ex.en: He staggered around the playground, screaming in agony.
ex.cn: 他绕着运动场跌跌撞撞地走着，并且痛苦地大叫。

def: adj.令人愉快的，惬意的,有礼貌的,同意的，接受的,适合的，一致的

ex.en: Lloyd George was most anxious to be agreeable and pleasant.
ex.cn: 劳埃德·乔治极力想表现得平易近人、和蔼亲切。

ex.en: "It's not an agreeable state of affairs," concurs Heitham.
ex.cn: “目前的事态并不令人满意。”海瑟姆赞同道。

ex.en: I'vegone out of my way to be agreeable to his friends.
ex.cn: 我已然特意地去讨好他的朋友们。

def: n.<美>铝

ex.en: Aluminum is made from bauxite.
ex.cn: 铝是从铝土矿中提炼出的.

ex.en: He had a house there and a dock and a little aluminum boat.
ex.cn: 他在那儿有一所房子、一个泊船的码头和一艘小铝船。

ex.en: He gave me an aluminum putter that I use to - day. "
ex.cn: 他送了我一根打高尔夫球的轻击棒,我到今天还在用. ”

def:
n.铝
adj.铝的

ex.en: Copper, brass and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.
ex.cn: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以进行再利用。

ex.en: All parts are machined from top grade, high tensile aluminium.
ex.cn: 所有零件都是用顶级高强度铝加工而成。

ex.en: The building is impeccably modernist: glass, aluminium and grey.
ex.cn: 这座楼完全是现代主义风格：采用玻璃和铝质材料，以灰色作为基调。

def: n.救护车,野战医院

ex.en: We gave the gate money to the St John Ambulance brigade.
ex.cn: 我们将门票收入都捐给了圣约翰急救队。

ex.en: He screamed for his wife to call an ambulance.
ex.cn: 他尖叫着让他老婆打电话叫救护车。

ex.en: Mrs Hardie had been taken to the infirmary in an ambulance.
ex.cn: 哈迪夫人被救护车送到了医院。

def: prep.（表示位置）在…中间,（表示环境）处于…环境中,由于存在…情况,（表示让步）尽管有…的情况

ex.en: They announced, amid much ballyhoo, that they had made a breakthrough.
ex.cn: 在一通大吹大擂中，他们宣布自己取得了突破。

ex.en: Dr Amid was assisted by a young Asian nurse.
ex.cn: 阿米德医生的助手是一位年轻的亚裔护士。

ex.en: Amid the trees the sea mist was dripping.
ex.cn: 林子里弥漫着湿漉漉的海雾。

def: n.类似，相似,比拟，类比,类推

ex.en: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
ex.cn: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

ex.en: It is not always reliable to argue by analogy.
ex.cn: 靠类推法论证并不总是可靠的.

ex.en: A close analogy with the art of singing can be made.
ex.cn: 可以用歌唱艺术作类比.

def: adj.解析的,分解的,善于分析的,<语>分析型的

ex.en: The analytic method is dialectical.
ex.cn: 分析的方法就是辩证的方法.

ex.en: The boy has an analytic mind.
ex.cn: 这男孩有分析的头脑.

ex.en: This sort of procedure is analytic in nature.
ex.cn: 这种方法从本质上讲是分析性的.

def: adj.分析的，分析法的,善于分析的

ex.en: All this questioning is so analytical and clinical — it kills romance.
ex.cn: 整个询问分析性和逻辑性太强，浪漫的气息荡然无存。

ex.en: All raw materials are subjected to our latest analytical techniques.
ex.cn: 所有的原材料都将用我们最新的分析技术进行解析。

ex.en: She has a clear analytical mind.
ex.cn: 她头脑清醒，善于分析。

def: n.趣闻，轶事,[复数]秘史

ex.en: He departed from the text to tell an anecdote.
ex.cn: 他偏离课文讲起了一则轶事.

ex.en: He introduced his speech with a humorous anecdote.
ex.cn: 他讲了一则幽默轶事作为讲演的引子.

ex.en: The image of the fox as a pest is grossly exaggerated in anecdote and folklore.
ex.cn: 狐狸的害人精形象在传闻和民间故事中遭到严重的夸大。

def:
n.角,[比喻]（考虑、问题的）角度,观点,轮廓鲜明的突出体
vt.使形成（或弯成）角度,把…放置成一角度,调整（或对准）…的角度,使（新闻、报道等）带有倾向性
vi.垂钓,斜移,弯曲成一角度,从（某角度）报道

ex.en: The helicopter turned at an awful angle before righting itself.
ex.cn: 直升机在恢复平稳之前倾斜得很厉害。

ex.en: Tourists were scrambling over the rocks looking for the perfect camera angle.
ex.cn: 游客们在正爬上岩石寻找最佳的拍摄角度。

ex.en: The tree was leaning at a low angle from the ground.
ex.cn: 那棵树倾斜得非常厉害。

def: n.器具，器械，装置,家用电器

ex.en: These advances were the result of the intellectual appliance of science.
ex.cn: 这些进步是巧妙应用科学的结果。

ex.en: He could have been trusted to drive another ten miles in search of some appliance.
ex.cn: 他可以被信任驾车再走十英里去寻找某种器械.

ex.en: The appliance alone island , whereas campus network can contribute more.
ex.cn: 应用校园网可发挥更大的作用.

def: adj.适当的,可应用的

ex.en: The section of the form is not applicable in your case.
ex.cn: 表格这一部分不适合你的情况.

ex.en: Read the text through and mark off the sections you find particularly applicable.
ex.cn: 通读全文，画出你认为最有用的段落。

ex.en: Appraisal has traditionally been seen as most applicable to those in management and supervisory positions.
ex.cn: 传统上认为业绩评定最适用于那些身处管理和监督职位之人。

def:
adj.约莫的，大概的,极相似的,[植]相近但不连接的
vi.接近于,近似于
vt.靠近,使接近,使结合
n.建筑师，设计师,创造者，缔造者,造物主

ex.en: Today's complex buildings require close teamwork between the architect and the builders.
ex.cn: 如今的建筑结构复杂，需要建筑师和施工人员密切协作。

ex.en: Ricardo Bofill, the Catalan architect, has designed the revamped airport.
ex.cn: 里卡多·博菲利是一名加泰罗尼亚的建筑师，这座整修过的机场就是他设计的。

ex.en: Call in an architect or surveyor to oversee the work.
ex.cn: 找个建筑师或监理员来监工。

def: n.算术，计算,算法

ex.en: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
ex.cn: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

ex.en: The budgetary arithmetic suggests that government borrowing is set to surge.
ex.cn: 预算数字表明政府借款将要大幅增加。

ex.en: He's not very good at arithmetic.
ex.cn: 他不太擅长算术。

def: n.矢，箭,箭状物,箭头记号,[天]天箭座

ex.en: An arrow pointed to the toilets.
ex.cn: 箭头指向卫生间。

ex.en: a bow and arrow
ex.cn: 弓箭

ex.en: He was armed with a bow and arrow .
ex.cn: 他佩带着弓箭。

def: adv.上岸,上陆,在岸上,在陆上

ex.en: I was pitched into the water and swam ashore.
ex.cn: 我被甩到水里后向岸边游去。

ex.en: He rowed her ashore and then continued trolling around the lake.
ex.cn: 他拢岸让她下船，然后继续悠闲地在湖上划着。

ex.en: He was rescued only when an exhausted friend swam ashore.
ex.cn: 当一个精疲力尽的友人游上岸后他才获救。

def: vi.渴望，立志，追求,〈诗，古〉登，升，高耸

ex.en: For us, it's something that we may aspire to but can never attain.
ex.cn: 对我们来说, 那是可望而不可即的.

ex.en: Mary is ambitious enough to aspire to conversational fluency in Chinese in four months.
ex.cn: 玛丽雄心很大,竟想在四个月里学会用汉语流利地会话.

ex.en: That is not something I particulary aspire to at this moment.
ex.cn: 目前,这不是我特别向往的.

def:
n.攻击,袭击，进攻,威胁，殴打,侵犯人身
vt.袭击,强暴,使（感官）难受
vi.发起攻击,动武

ex.en: At the police station, I was charged with assault.
ex.cn: 在警察局，我被指控殴打他人。

ex.en: US forces are poised for a massive air, land and sea assault.
ex.cn: 美国军队作好了发动大规模海、陆、空攻击的准备。

ex.en: The family tried to bring a private prosecution against him for assault.
ex.cn: 这家人试图以侵犯人身为由对他提起自诉。

def: n.资产，财产,有价值的人或物,有用的东西,优点

ex.en: From day one he's been a great asset to the company.
ex.cn: 从入职第一天开始，他就是公司难得的人才。

ex.en: Her leadership qualities were the greatest asset of the Conservative Party.
ex.cn: 她的领导才能是保守党最宝贵的财富。

ex.en: His Republican credentials made him an asset.
ex.cn: 他作为共和党人的资历成了他的一笔财富。

def:
vi.吸收， 消化,同化
vt.透彻理解,使吸收

ex.en: His family tried to assimilate into the white and Hispanic communities.
ex.cn: 他一家人试图融入白人和西班牙裔社区。

ex.en: The Vietnamese are trying to assimilate themselves and become Americans.
ex.cn: 这些越南人正在努力融入美国社会，成为美国人。

ex.en: The committee will need time to assimilate this report.
ex.cn: 委员会需要时间来吃透这个报告。

def: n.保证，担保,（人寿）保险,确信,厚脸皮，无耻
n.宇航员,太空人,航天员

ex.en: The astronaut was welcomed with joyous , resounding acclaim.
ex.cn: 人们欢声雷动地迎接那位宇航员.

ex.en: The rocket boosts the astronaut into space.
ex.cn: 这火箭能把宇航员送入太空.

ex.en: Astronaut Pierre Thuot tried to latch the 15-foot robotic arm onto the satellite.
ex.cn: 宇航员皮埃尔·索特想要把这个长15英尺的机械手安到人造卫星上。

def: n.天文学

ex.en: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
ex.cn: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

ex.en: Scientists are trying to pull together disparate ideas in astronomy.
ex.cn: 科学家们正试图将天文学中的各派观点整合在一起。

ex.en: Speaking generally, the space enterprise has served astronomy well.
ex.cn: 总的说来，航空企业很好地促进了天文学的发展。

def: n.原子,原子能,微粒，微量

ex.en: He patented the idea that the atom could be split.
ex.cn: 他获得了“原子可以再分”这一概念的专利权。

ex.en: the splitting of the atom
ex.cn: 原子的分裂

ex.en: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
ex.cn: 水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

def:
n.服务人员，侍者,随从，随员,伴随物
adj.伴随的，随之而产生的,出席的,护理的

ex.en: Tony Williams was working as a car-park attendant in Los Angeles.
ex.cn: 托尼·威廉斯在洛杉矶的一个停车场当服务生。

ex.en: Mr Branson's victory, and all the attendant publicity, were well deserved.
ex.cn: 布兰森先生的胜利，以及随之而来的关注度，都是理所应当的。

ex.en: The girl attendant has set about cleaning the room.
ex.cn: 那位女服务员已开始打扫房间.

def: n.观众席，听众席,礼堂，会堂

ex.en: Men in green army uniforms are sprinkled throughout the huge auditorium.
ex.cn: 穿着绿色军服的人星星点点地分布在整个大礼堂中。

ex.en: The Albert Hall is a huge auditorium.
ex.cn: 艾伯特音乐厅是一个大型音乐厅。

ex.en: The teacher gathered all the pupils in the auditorium.
ex.cn: 老师把全体同学集合在礼堂内.

def:
vt.增强，加强,增加，增添,（使）扩张，扩大
n.增加，补充物

ex.en: The government'sfirst concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
ex.cn: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

ex.en: They hit upon another idea to augment their income.
ex.cn: 他们又想出一个增加收入的办法。

ex.en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
ex.cn: 为了想法子增加家庭收入，她开始制作洋娃娃。

def: adj.真的，真正的,可信的，可靠的,有根据的,[法]认证了的

ex.en: I had obtained the authentic details about the birth of the organization.
ex.cn: 我已经掌握了有关该组织诞生的可靠的详细资料。

ex.en: It is crucial that all documents presented are authentic and easily verifiable.
ex.cn: 所有提交的文件必须真实且易于查证，这一点很关键。

ex.en: They have to look authentic.
ex.cn: 它们必须得看上去像真的。

def: n.自动化（技术），自动操作

ex.en: Automation revolutionized the olive industry in the early 1970s.
ex.cn: 自动化技术在20世纪70年代早期给橄榄油产业带来了一场革命。

ex.en: Automation would bring a shorter, more flexible working week.
ex.cn: 自动化会使工作周缩短，也更为灵活。

ex.en: Administrative staff may be deskilled through increased automation and efficiency.
ex.cn: 随着自动化程度和效率的不断提高，对管理人员的技能要求可能会大大降低。

def: n.自治，自治权,自主权,自治国，社区，或集团等,人身自由

ex.en: Activists stepped up their demands for local autonomy last month.
ex.cn: 上个月激进分子对地方自治的呼声更高了。

ex.en: She sets a high value on autonomy.
ex.cn: 她对自主权看得很重。

ex.en: a campaign in Wales for greater autonomy
ex.cn: 威尔士争取更大自治权的运动

def:
adj.辅助的,备用的，补充的,附加的,副的
n.助动词,辅助者，辅助人员,附属机构，附属团体,辅助设备

ex.en: The government'sfirst concern was to augment the army and auxiliary forces.
ex.cn: 政府关心的首要问题是扩充军队及辅助队伍。

ex.en: Esperanto was invented as an auxiliary language.
ex.cn: 世界语是作为辅助语发明的。

ex.en: The hospital has an auxiliary power system in case of blackout.
ex.cn: 这家医院装有备用发电系统以防灯火管制.

def:
n.效用，利益
vt.& vi.有益于，有益于,使对某人有利

ex.en: His efforts were to no avail.
ex.cn: 他徒劳无功。

ex.en: I apologized repeatedly, but to little avail.
ex.cn: 我一再道歉，但丝毫没有奏效。

ex.en: We tried to keep him alive but to no avail.
ex.cn: 我们全力抢救他,但却徒劳无功.

def: n.林荫路,大街,途径，手段,〈美〉（南北向）街道

ex.en: There is another avenue to pursue — it involves further negotiations.
ex.cn: 还有一个办法可用，但需要进一步的磋商。

ex.en: The party leader said the street should be renamed Freedom Avenue.
ex.cn: 政党领导人说这条街道应该重新命名为自由大道。

ex.en: A military parade marched slowly and solemnly down Pennsylvania Avenue.
ex.cn: 阅兵队列沿宾夕法尼亚大道缓慢而庄严地行进。

def: vt.等候,等待,期待

ex.en: I shall await your answer to my letter with eagerness.
ex.cn: 急盼复信.

ex.en: Numerous pitfalls await unsuspecting investors.
ex.cn: 数不清的陷阱等待毫无戒心的投资者.

ex.en: I shall await you at seven - thirty or thereabouts.
ex.cn: 我将在7:30分左右等着你.

def:
n.饵，诱饵,诱惑,（路上的）休息（或进食）
vt.置诱饵于…,引诱,纵犬袭击（野兽）,折磨
vi.中途休息

ex.en: Television programmes are essentially bait to attract an audience for advertisements.
ex.cn: 从根本上说，电视节目就是吸引观众看广告的诱饵。

ex.en: When she attempts to make you feel guilty, don't take the bait.
ex.cn: 如果她试图让你觉得内疚，不要上当。

ex.en: This type of trap uses no bait or other attractant.
ex.cn: 这种陷阱不用诱饵或其他引诱物。

def: n.芭蕾舞,芭蕾舞剧,芭蕾舞团,芭蕾舞音乐

ex.en: The London City Ballet has engaged two male dancers from the Bolshoi.
ex.cn: 伦敦市芭蕾舞团从波修瓦芭蕾舞团聘来了两名男舞蹈演员。

ex.en: He rejoined Sadler's Wells Royal Ballet as Assistant Administrator in 1988.
ex.cn: 他在1988年重回萨德勒的威尔斯皇家芭蕾舞团，任行政助理。

ex.en: Next door, 200 girls are limbering up for their ballet exams.
ex.cn: 隔壁屋里，200名女孩正在为她们的芭蕾考试做热身。

def:
n.投票,投票用纸,投票总数,投票权
vi.投票表决,抽签决定
vt.使投票表决,拉选票,通过投票[抽签]选出,抽签

ex.en: The ballot was re-run on Mr Todd's insistence after accusations of malpractice.
ex.cn: 因被控舞弊，在托德先生的坚持下重新进行了投票。

ex.en: I'm going to write him in on my ballot next year.
ex.cn: 明年我要在我的选票上写上他的名字。

ex.en: Martinez expressed confidence of victory at the ballot box.
ex.cn: 马丁内斯表示了对选举获胜的信心。

def:
n.猛击,猛撞,巨响,爆炸声
vt.猛击，猛撞
vi.发出砰的一声，砰砰作响，砰地敲[推，扔],男性和（女性）性交
adv.正好，完全地

ex.en: Dig a largish hole and bang the stake in first.
ex.cn: 挖一个大点儿的洞，先把木桩敲进去。

ex.en: Of course, slap-bang in the middle of town the rents are high.
ex.cn: 当然啦，市区正中心的租金是很高的。

ex.en: The trade secretary disagreed but promised to "bang the drum for industry".
ex.cn: 贸易部长并不同意，但是答应会“为产业界摇旗呐喊”。

def:
n.宴会，盛宴,筵席,宴请，款待
vt.宴请，设宴招待,饮宴，参加宴会
vi.参加宴会

ex.en: Last night he attended a state banquet at Buckingham Palace.
ex.cn: 昨晚他出席了在白金汉宫举行的国宴。

ex.en: The hotel amenities include health clubs, conference facilities, and banquet-ing rooms.
ex.cn: 饭店的便利设施包括健身俱乐部、会议设施和宴会厅。

ex.en: a state banquet in honour of the visiting President
ex.cn: 为来访总统举办的国宴

def:
n.条，棒,（门、窗等的）闩,障碍,酒吧间
vt.闩（门等）,阻碍，封锁,排除，去除
prep.除…之外

ex.en: They drink bitter on draught in the local bar.
ex.cn: 他们在当地的酒吧里喝桶装的苦啤酒。

ex.en: Felicity Maxwell stood by the bar and ordered a glass of wine.
ex.cn: 费利西蒂·马克斯韦尔站在吧台旁，要了一杯红酒。

ex.en: Michael was standing alone by the bar when Brian rejoined him.
ex.cn: 布赖恩回到迈克尔身边时，他正一个人站在吧台旁边。

def:
n.桶,一桶之量,圆筒，活塞筒，滚筒,圆筒
adj.桶状的
vt.装进桶里，放进桶里
vi.高速行驶

ex.en: To keep warm they burnt wood in a rusty oil barrel.
ex.cn: 他们在一只生锈的油桶里烧木柴来保暖。

ex.en: You'll eat so much your belly'll be like a barrel.
ex.cn: 你会吃得肚子鼓鼓的，像个大酒桶。

ex.en: Pork-barrel politicians hand out rents to win votes and influence people.
ex.cn: 搞分肥拨款的政客为获得选票、影响民情而发放房租补贴。

def:
n.湾，海湾,犬吠声,月桂树,吊窗，凸窗
vi.（尤指猎犬等）吠，叫，咆哮,筑堤遏（水）,穷追，使陷入绝境,阻止（敌人）不使前进
adj.赤褐色的，栗色的
vt.向…吠叫

ex.en: He was so happy communing with the dolphin in Dingle Bay.
ex.cn: 他在丁格尔湾与海豚交流的时候特别开心。

ex.en: Monstrously inflated prices are designed to keep people like us at bay.
ex.cn: 疯狂飞涨的价格会使像我们这样的人走投无路。

ex.en: The house commanded some splendid views of Delaware Bay.
ex.cn: 从这座房子可以俯瞰到特拉华湾壮丽的景致。

def:
n.[机]轴承，支座,关系,方位,态度，举止
v.忍受(bear的ing形式)

ex.en: He has a military bearing, never failing to carry himself erect.
ex.cn: 他有一种军人的风姿，身板总是挺得笔直。

ex.en: He took a used envelope bearing an Irish postmark.
ex.cn: 他拿了一个盖着爱尔兰邮戳的旧信封。

ex.en: How's Mary bearing up?
ex.cn: 玛丽现在怎么样？

def: n.野兽,人面兽心的人,讨厌的人（或事物）,老顽固，坏蛋

ex.en: Disney's "Beauty And The Beast" has won rave reviews.
ex.cn: 迪斯尼出品的电影《美女与野兽》赢得了众多好评。

ex.en: Bully! Hooligan! Beast! Let me go, let go!
ex.cn: 混蛋！流氓！王八蛋！放开我，放开！

ex.en: This man is an animal, a beast.
ex.cn: 这人是个畜生，是个野兽。

def: vt.对…不忠,背叛,出卖,泄露
vt.使迷惑,使为难,使手足无措,使变糊涂

ex.en: Again and again passages in his essays exasperate or bewilder.
ex.cn: 他的文章里使人忿然或困惑的章节屡见不鲜.

ex.en: So many questions bewilder me.
ex.cn: 这样多的问题使我困惑.

ex.en: The letter would only bewilder the mother.
ex.cn: 这信只会使妈妈惶惑不解.

def:
vt.约束,装订,捆绑,（用长布条）缠绕
vt.& vi.（使）结合
n.窘境，困境,捆绑,植物的藤蔓

ex.en: It is expensive to buy and a bind to carry home.
ex.cn: 买这个费用很贵，搬回家也费劲。

ex.en: These compounds bind with genetic material in the liver.
ex.cn: 这些化合物在肝脏中与遗传物质实现结合。

ex.en: These may bind to receptor molecules on the surfaces of cells.
ex.cn: 这些可能会在细胞表面和受体分子结合在一起。

def: n.传记,档案,传记体文学,个人简介

ex.en: He has written a speculative biography of Christopher Marlowe.
ex.cn: 他写了一篇关于克里斯托弗·马洛的推测性传记。

ex.en: Now she is busy finishing off a biography of Queen Caroline.
ex.cn: 现在她正忙着完成卡罗琳王后的传记。

ex.en: This book is a well balanced biography.
ex.cn: 此书是一部相当客观的传记。

def: adj.离奇的,奇特的（指态度，容貌，款式等）,奇怪的,奇幻

ex.en: The allegations ranged from the banal to the bizarre.
ex.cn: 从平淡无奇到离奇百怪的各种说法都有。

ex.en: His fast-paced novels are full of bizarre situations and madcap antics.
ex.cn: 他那些快节奏的小说里充满了怪诞的场景和荒唐的行为。

ex.en: It was a bizarre scene.
ex.cn: 那是怪诞的一幕。

def:
adj.钝的，不锋利的,迟钝的,直率的,呆板的
vt.使迟钝,使钝
n.钝的东西,小雪茄烟

ex.en: The blunt comment made Richard laugh in spite of himself.
ex.cn: 这番率直的话让理查德不由自主地大笑起来。

ex.en: This is Elizabeth Blunt, BBC, West Africa.
ex.cn: 英国广播公司的伊丽莎白·布伦特在西非为您报道。

ex.en: She couldn't stand his blunt, graceless manner.
ex.cn: 她无法忍受他的唐突和粗鲁。

def:
vt.自夸，自吹自擂,夸口说,以有…而自豪,自负有
n.夸口，自负,自负的事物，引以为傲的东西,自夸的话,扬言

ex.en: We remember our mother's stern instructions not to boast.
ex.cn: 我们谨记母亲不许我们在人前炫耀的严厉教诲。

ex.en: This year's festival can boast a decently long list of sponsors.
ex.cn: 今年该活动节将会拥有相当多的赞助商。

ex.en: His statement isn't merely an idle boast.
ex.cn: 他的话不仅仅是虚张声势的自夸。

def:
n.炸弹,彻底的失败,[橄榄球] 长传,高压贮罐
vt.轰炸，投弹于
vi.投弹,[俚语] 惨败,[俚语] 涂鸦

ex.en: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
ex.cn: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

ex.en: There were two bomb explosions in the city overnight.
ex.cn: 一夜之间城里发生了两起炸弹爆炸事件。

ex.en: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
ex.cn: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

def: n.售货棚，摊位,公用电话亭,隔开的小间,（选举）投票站

ex.en: Booth was a revivalist intent on his Christian vocation.
ex.cn: 布思是一个坚定不移地奉行其基督徒天职的宗教复兴运动者。

ex.en: Where can I find a telephone booth?
ex.cn: 我在哪儿可以找到电话亭?

ex.en: When you are there, in the polling booth, nobody can see where you put your cross.
ex.cn: 在投票间投票时，没人能看见你投给谁。

def: n.分界线,范围,（球场）边线

ex.en: Just before the town boundary fork left onto a minor road.
ex.cn: 快到城镇边界时要走岔路的左边一条小路。

ex.en: The ball was caught by a fielder standing just inside the boundary.
ex.cn: 那个球被正站在边界内的守场员接住了.

ex.en: A river forms the boundary between the two countries.
ex.cn: 一条河流成了两国的分界线.

def:
n.砖，砖块,砖块状物体,一砖的厚度,〈口〉大好人
vt.用砖建造、砌或铺,用砖围住或堵住
adj.用砖做的,似砖的

ex.en: Each brick also varies slightly in tone, texture and size.
ex.cn: 每块砖在色调、质地与大小上也都略有不同。

ex.en: On South Main Street, a huge brick building looms into view.
ex.cn: 在南大街上，一座巨大的砖砌建筑赫然出现在人们的视线中。

ex.en: He flattened himself against a brick wall as I passed.
ex.cn: 他紧贴一面砖墙站着好让我通过。

def:
adj.明亮的,<非正式>美好的,闪耀的,才华横溢的
n.宝石,钻石

ex.en: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
ex.cn: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

ex.en: Jackie was running around with all these brilliant people.
ex.cn: 杰姬混迹于这些才华横溢的人之间。

ex.en: He is a terrific athlete and a brilliant jumper.
ex.cn: 他是个出色的运动员，弹跳力非常好。

def:
adj.快的,轻快的,爽快而清新的,兴隆的
vi.活跃起来,变得轻快
vt.使…活泼,使…轻快

ex.en: She went for a brisk walk to work off her frustration.
ex.cn: 她快步走了一会儿，以排解心中的沮丧。

ex.en: As they started up again, the horse broke into a brisk trot.
ex.cn: 当他们又重新骑上马时，马突然轻快地小跑起来。

ex.en: He felt strangely exhilarated by the brisk, blue morning.
ex.cn: 那个凉爽而晴朗的早晨让他异常兴奋。

def: n.小册子，手册

ex.en: Every member will receive their own "Welcome to Labour" brochure.
ex.cn: 每个党员都将收到一本名为《欢迎加入工党》的小册子。

ex.en: For a copy of their brochure, write to the above address.
ex.cn: 欲索取其宣传册，请写信至以上地址。

ex.en: The brochure offers a wide choice of hotels, apartments and holiday homes.
ex.cn: 这本小册子提供了很多宾馆、公寓、度假屋供选择。

def: n.眉，眉毛,前额,容貌，表情,山脊

ex.en: His hair fell over his brow instead of being brushed straight back.
ex.cn: 他的头发没有整齐地往后梳，而是搭在前额。

ex.en: The Inspector took out a handker-chief and mopped his brow.
ex.cn: 检察员掏出手帕，擦了擦眉头。

ex.en: In a moment he was seated, diagonally opposite her, brow furrowed.
ex.cn: 很快他便眉头紧蹙地在她斜对面落座了。

def:
n.泡，水泡,冒泡，起泡,泡影，妄想,（欲表达的）一点感情
vt.& vi.起泡，使冒气泡
vi.使冒泡，发出冒泡的声音,洋溢着（某种感情）,滔滔不绝地讲,兴奋，欢闹

ex.en: As she spoke she felt a bubble of optimism rising inside her.
ex.cn: 当她讲话时，她感到内心的乐观情绪越来越高涨。

ex.en: a bubble of oxygen
ex.cn: 氧气泡

ex.en: News of the defeat quickly burst the bubble of our self - confidence .
ex.cn: 失败的消息使我们的 自信心 迅速破灭了.

def:
n.公告，公报,新闻快报,小报,期刊
vt.公布，公告,用公报发表

ex.en: The Internet is the largest computer bulletin board in the world.
ex.cn: 因特网是世界上最大的计算机公告系统。

ex.en: We'll be going live to Nottingham later in this bulletin.
ex.cn: 在本次新闻快报中,我们稍后将有来自诺丁汉的现场报道.

ex.en: Try browsing around in the network bulletin boards.
ex.cn: 试着在网络论坛上浏览信息。

def:
vt.& vi.碰撞，冲撞,颠簸
vi.颠簸着前进
n.碰撞，撞击,肿块,隆起物,鹭鸶的叫声
adv.突然地，猛烈地,扑通一声

ex.en: The child took five steps, and then sat down with a bump.
ex.cn: 小孩走了5步，接着扑通一声坐到了地上。

ex.en: He felt a heavy bump, but paid no attention to it.
ex.cn: 他觉得起了个大包，但是没有理会。

ex.en: Joanna heard him bump into the table and curse again.
ex.cn: 乔安娜听见他撞到了桌子上，又骂骂咧咧的。

def:
n.束，串，捆,一串，一群,一帮，一伙,[非正式用语]大量
vt.聚成一串，形成一串,聚成一组,使起褶：使（织物）起褶
vi.形成一串，形成一组,打褶,膨胀，凸出

ex.en: Joseph watched a shady-looking bunch playing cards aboard a Mississippi steamer.
ex.cn: 约瑟夫看到一群可疑的人在密西西比河的一艘轮船上打牌。

ex.en: We don't want to look like a bunch of cowboys.
ex.cn: 我们不想看上去像一帮奸商。

ex.en: They're just a bunch of leeches cadging off others!
ex.cn: 他们只不过是一帮伸手向人要这要那的寄生虫！

def:
n.旁道，支路,迂回管道,[电]分路迂徊,[医]导管
vt.疏通,忽视,管道运输

ex.en: A new bypass around the city is being built.
ex.cn: 一条新的绕城环路正在建设当中。

ex.en: A growing number of employers are trying to bypass the unions altogether.
ex.cn: 越来越多的雇主试图完全绕过工会行事。

ex.en: a triple bypass operation
ex.cn: 接三通管的手术

def:
n.<美>小木屋,客舱,（轮船上工作或生活的）隔间
vt.把…关在小屋里,使受拘束
vi.住在小屋里

ex.en: Dan was in his cabin, staring out of a porthole.
ex.cn: 丹在自己的船舱里朝舱外凝视着。

ex.en: He paid for and was assigned a cabin in first class.
ex.cn: 他付完钱后被安排到了头等舱。

ex.en: The cabin looked as if a maniac had been let loose there.
ex.cn: 小屋看上去像是被疯子在那撒过野一样。

def:
n.缆绳，绳索,[电学]电缆,（系船用的）缆绳,（船只、桥梁等上的）巨缆
vt.发电报至,电传,固定系牢
vi.拍发电报

ex.en: These strands of molecules twine around each other to form cable-like structures.
ex.cn: 这些分子链彼此缠绕，形成缆线状的结构。

ex.en: Steel cable will be used to replace worn ropes.
ex.cn: 将用钢缆替换磨损的绳索。

ex.en: The cable-TV and health-care industries are both being mauled by government.
ex.cn: 有线电视和保健业正在遭受政府的严厉批评。

def:
n.日历,历法,日程表,（一年之中的）重大事件（或重要日期）一览表
vt.把…记入日程表中,把…列入表中,为（文件等）作分类索引,将…排入日程表

ex.en: Winners will be selected at the end of each calendar month.
ex.cn: 每个月末都会选出优胜者。

ex.en: They tried to make a calendar of Spain's festivals.
ex.cn: 他们打算做个西班牙节日活动一览表。

ex.en: It is one of the British sporting calendar's most prestigious events.
ex.cn: 这是英国体坛大事表上最负盛名的赛事之一。

def: n.校园,校区

ex.en: From what I hear, half the campus is lusting after her.
ex.cn: 从我听到的来看，半个学校的人都想和她上床。

ex.en: The university refused to let Dick Gregory speak on campus.
ex.cn: 这所大学不让迪克·格雷戈里在校园里发表演说。

ex.en: The school occupies split-site accommodation on the main campus.
ex.cn: 该学院分散在主校区不同地点。

def:
n.运河，沟渠,管道,气管,食道
vt.建运河,疏导

ex.en: The rough rock walls were like the sides of a deep canal.
ex.cn: 凸凹不平的石墙就像一条很深的运河的河岸。

ex.en: Long-mothballed projects like widening the Suez Canal are being dusted off.
ex.cn: 诸如拓宽苏伊士运河等长期束之高阁的计划正被重新采用。

ex.en: Hearing can be affected by ear wax blocking the ear canal.
ex.cn: 耳垢堵塞耳道可能会影响听力。

def: n.小卖部,食堂，小饭馆,水罐,餐具盒，炊具箱

ex.en: Rennie had eaten his tea in the canteen.
ex.cn: 伦尼已经在餐厅吃过茶点了。

ex.en: After work they made a hearty meal in the worker's canteen.
ex.cn: 工作完了,他们在工人食堂饱餐了一顿.

ex.en: This is a much frequented canteen.
ex.cn: 这是一家就餐人数很多的食堂.

def: n.斗篷, 披肩,海角, 岬

ex.en: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
ex.cn: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

ex.en: The storms had abated by the time they rounded Cape Horn.
ex.cn: 他们绕过合恩角时，暴风雨已经减弱。

ex.en: Their first port of call will be Cape Town.
ex.cn: 他们的第一个停靠港将是开普敦。

def:
adj.被俘的,被监禁的,被关押的,无法逃离的
n.战俘，俘虏,被（爱情等）迷住的人,自保公司

ex.en: He described the difficulties of surviving for four months as a captive.
ex.cn: 他描述了被俘4个月里挣扎求生的艰难岁月。

ex.en: Children come to zoos precisely to see captive animals.
ex.cn: 孩子们到动物园就是为了看圈养的动物。

ex.en: Airlines consider business travellers a captive market.
ex.cn: 航空公司把商务旅行者视为垄断性市场。

def: n.碳水化合物，糖类,淀粉质或糖类食物

ex.en: Athletes usually eat a high carbohydrate diet.
ex.cn: 运动员通常吃高碳水化合物食物.

ex.en: Cashew nuts are rich in carbohydrate.
ex.cn: 腰果含丰富碳水化合物.

ex.en: Fill up on potatoes, bread and pasta, which are high in carbohydrate and low in fat.
ex.cn: 用碳水化合物含量高、脂肪含量低的土豆、面包和意大利面食填饱肚子。

def: n.搬运人,运输公司,搬运器,[医学]带菌者

ex.en: He had returned to England in an aircraft carrier no less.
ex.cn: 他竟然坐航空母舰回的英格兰。

ex.en: Deliveries are made by common carrier or van line.
ex.cn: 货物运输采用普通货车或厢式货车。

ex.en: The haulage company was a carrier of machine parts to Turkey.
ex.cn: 该公路货运公司负责将机械零件运往土耳其。

def:
vt.铸造,投掷,投射,脱落，脱皮
n.铸型,演员表,轻微的斜视,投，掷骰
vi.掷，投,计算，加

ex.en: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
ex.cn: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

ex.en: The cast of characters in the scandal is bewilderingly large.
ex.cn: 卷入丑闻的人多得让人眼花缭乱。

ex.en: This show has several strengths — notably a strong cast.
ex.cn: 这个表演有一些亮点——尤其是演员阵容特别强大。

def: n.伤亡（人数）,事故，横祸,受害者，死伤者,损坏

vt.& vi.提供饮食及服务
vt.满足需要，适合,投合，迎合
n.（骰子，纸牌的）四点

ex.en: The chef is pleased to cater for vegetarian diets.
ex.cn: 厨师非常乐意为客人做素食。

ex.en: Nunsmere Hall can cater for receptions of up to 300 people.
ex.cn: 纳恩斯米尔酒店最多可以同时接待300人。

ex.en: They maintain a database of hotels that cater for businesswomen.
ex.cn: 他们维护着一个服务于商界女性的酒店资料库。

def: adj.包罗万象的,广泛的普遍的,包容一切的

ex.en: It presented in satirical terms points made in earnest by Catholic writers.
ex.cn: 它用讽刺的语言呈现了天主教作家郑重其事表明的观点。

ex.en: Mr Thomas was taught by the Catholic nuns whose school he attended.
ex.cn: 托马斯先生是在天主教修女创办的学校接受的教育。

ex.en: A new Catholic bishop was installed in Galway yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天在戈尔韦任命了一位新的天主教主教。

def: adj.小心的，谨慎的,兢,恮,持重

ex.en: Australia, put in to bat, made a cautious start.
ex.cn: 轮到澳大利亚队出场击球，他们开始打得很谨慎。

ex.en: Investors are playing it cautious, and they're playing it smart.
ex.cn: 投资者审慎精明地行事。

ex.en: The policy was rejected in favour of a more cautious approach.
ex.cn: 这项政策未被采纳，取而代之的是一项较为谨慎的策略。

def:
n.水泥,胶合剂,胶接剂,粘固粉
vt.粘牢,巩固,（用水泥、胶等）粘结,在…上抹水泥

ex.en: The gym teachers lined us up against the cement walls.
ex.cn: 体育老师让我们靠着水泥墙排好。

ex.en: In the old days, television was the cement of society.
ex.cn: 过去，电视曾是团结社会的力量。

ex.en: A puppy stepped in the fresh cement.
ex.cn: 一只小狗踩在刚抹好的水泥面上。

def: n.确定性，确实性,确定的事，必然的事

ex.en: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
ex.cn: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和把握就毫无价值。

ex.en: Her return to the team now seems a certainty.
ex.cn: 她的归队现在似乎已成定局。

ex.en: I know for a certainty that the company has been bought up.
ex.cn: 我确实知道公司已经被人收购了.

def:
n.证明书,文凭，结业证书
vt.发给证明书,用证书证明（或认可）

ex.en: Wives will have to bring along their marriage certificate.
ex.cn: 已婚妇女必须携带结婚证。

ex.en: He did not hold a firearm certificate.
ex.cn: 他没有持枪许可。

ex.en: A senior certificate with matric exemption is required for entry to university.
ex.cn: 上大学需要有中学毕业的资格证书。

def:
n.室，卧室，会客室,内庭,[多用于英国]律师的办公室,议事厅
vt.限制，幽禁，封闭或限制,使备有房间

ex.en: More than 80 parties are contesting seats in the two-chamber parliament.
ex.cn: 有80多个党派在竞争两院的议席。

ex.en: She could hear the tinny strains of a chamber orchestra.
ex.cn: 她能听见室内管弦乐队尖细的旋律。

ex.en: He thought he saw someone lurking above the chamber during the address.
ex.cn: 他觉得自己看见有人在演讲时潜藏在会议厅顶上。

def: n.大臣,（某些美国大学的）校长,（德国或奥地利的）总理,（英国大学的）名誉校长

ex.en: The new Chancellor has the guts to push through unpopular tax increases.
ex.cn: 新总理有勇气推动不受欢迎的增税方案获得通过。

ex.en: They are pressing the Chancellor to reduce excise duty on beer.
ex.cn: 他们正给总理施压，要求降低啤酒的消费税。

ex.en: Chancellor Helmut Kohl was the leading cheerleader for German unification.
ex.cn: 赫尔穆特·科尔总理是德国统一的主要支持者。

def:
n.魔力,魅力,咒文,（表链等的）小装饰品
vt.使陶醉,诱惑,对…行魔法,令人陶醉

ex.en: She is very good at using her charm to get her way.
ex.cn: 她非常善于利用自己的魅力随心所欲。

ex.en: Fearey had all the charm and urbanity of the trained diplomat.
ex.cn: 费尔里具备一个训练有素的外交官的一切风度和优雅。

ex.en: Johnson's easy charm contrasted sharply with the prickliness of his boss.
ex.cn: 约翰逊的亲和力和他老板易怒的性格形成了鲜明的对比。

def:
n.基督,救世主
int.〈俚〉哎呀

ex.en: He looked at her watch. "Christ! We only have three minutes!"
ex.cn: 他看了看她的表：“天哪！我们仅剩3分钟了！”

ex.en: Christ died on the cross.
ex.cn: 耶稣死在十字架上。

ex.en: Christ! Look at the time—I'm late!
ex.cn: 天哪！看看时间，我迟到了！

def:
n.电路，线路,巡回,唤醒，环形道,〔电〕电流
vt.巡回，周游

ex.en: He was just starting to become known on the cabaret circuit.
ex.cn: 他在卡巴莱歌舞表演圈中刚刚开始有点名气。

ex.en: There is an internal circuit breaker to protect the instrument from overload.
ex.cn: 内置有断路器，防止设备过载。

ex.en: There's a closed-circuit television camera in the reception area.
ex.cn: 接待处有一个闭路电视摄像头。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）循环,（使）流通,（使）流传,散布
vi.传送，传递，传阅

ex.en: Merchandise can now circulate freely among the EU countries.
ex.cn: 商品现在可以在欧盟各国自由流通。

ex.en: Let me get you something to drink, then I must circulate.
ex.cn: 我给你找点喝的，然后我得去应酬一下。

ex.en: Leave a gap at the top and bottom so air can circulate.
ex.cn: 上下各留一个口子通风。

def: n.马戏，马戏团,马戏表演（常在大帐篷里进行）,环形广场，（用于某些地名）圆形广场,<口>乱哄哄的热闹场面

ex.en: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
ex.cn: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

ex.en: She dreamed of being a bareback rider in a circus.
ex.cn: 她梦想成为马戏团中的一名无鞍马骑手。

ex.en: It could well turn into some kind of a media circus.
ex.cn: 这很可能会演变成媒体的一场闹剧。

def: n.清楚，明晰,透明,明确,清晰度

ex.en: He always put his point of view with clarity and with courage.
ex.cn: 他总是清楚而勇敢地提出自己的观点。

ex.en: The style is marked by simplicity, clarity, and candor.
ex.cn: 这种风格的特点是简洁、清楚、直截了当。

ex.en: This remarkable technology provides far greater clarity than conventional x-rays.
ex.cn: 这项卓越技术的清晰度比常规的X光高得多。

def:
vt.发出撞击声
vi.争论,不合,交锋,撞击出刺耳的响声
n.冲突,不协调,撞击声

ex.en: The police said the clash was a sequel to yesterday'snationwide strike.
ex.cn: 警方说这场冲突是昨天全国大罢工的余波。

ex.en: They will televise both legs of Leeds' European Cup clash with Rangers.
ex.cn: 欧洲杯利兹联队与流浪者队的两场争夺战都将进行电视转播。

ex.en: Don't make any policy decisions which clash with official company thinking.
ex.cn: 所作的任何决策都不要和公司官方理念相冲突。

def:
adj.典型的,传统式样的,著名的,有趣的
n.文豪,文学名著,优秀的典范,古希腊与古罗马的文化研究（尤指对其语言与文学的研究）

ex.en: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
ex.cn: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

ex.en: During the festival, we'll be showing 13 classic oldie films.
ex.cn: 我们将在电影节期间展映13部经典老片.

ex.en: "They play classic rock'n"roll,' states her boyfriend, "My dad digs them too."
ex.cn: “他们演奏经典摇滚乐，”她的男朋友说道，“我爸爸也喜欢他们。”

def:
n.（动物的）爪,（蟹等的）钳,爪形器具
vt.& vi.用爪抓（或挖）

ex.en: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
ex.cn: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

ex.en: It has three pairs of legs, each ending in a large claw.
ex.cn: 它有3对腿，每条腿上都有一只巨爪。

ex.en: The Chancellor will try to claw back £3.5 billion in next year's Budget.
ex.cn: 财政大臣在明年的预算中将争取收回35亿英镑。

def:
n.喀哒声,爪，掣子,[计]（鼠标）点击,[语言学]吸气音
vt.使发出喀哒声
vi.发出喀哒声,极成功,合得来，一见如,[计]鼠击

ex.en: There was a metallic click and the gates swung open.
ex.cn: 随着一声金属碰击的咔嗒声，大门打开了。

ex.en: Double click on the icon to open the file.
ex.cn: 双击图标打开文件。

ex.en: Click the square icon again to minimize the window.
ex.cn: 再次点击正方形图标，把窗口最小化。

def: n.悬崖，峭壁

ex.en: A pall of oily black smoke drifted over the cliff-top.
ex.cn: 一团油腻的黑色烟雾飘到悬崖顶上。

ex.en: We hiked the Grand Canyon, exploring Indian cliff dwellings.
ex.cn: 我们去大峡谷徒步旅行，探究印第安人的崖居。

ex.en: A waterfall cascades down the cliff from the hills behind.
ex.cn: 一处瀑布从身后山崖上飞流直下。

def:
n.（动植物的）克隆,无性繁殖系,复制人（或动植物）,（不动脑筋）机械行事的人，机器人
vt.& vi.克隆，（使某物）无性繁殖,把…培养为纯种细胞,复制

ex.en: Tom was in some ways a younger clone of his handsome father.
ex.cn: 汤姆某些地方长得和他那帅气的父亲一模一样，只是年轻一些。

ex.en: A team from the UK were the first to successfully clone an animal.
ex.cn: 英国的一个小组率先克隆动物成功。

ex.en: At the outset they must contain several ramets of every selected clone.
ex.cn: 在开始时每个入选无性系必须包括几个无性繁殖后代.

def:
n.线索,提示,（帮助警方破案的）线索,（纵横填字谜、游戏或问题的）提示词语
vt.<非正>为…提供最新情况（消息等）

ex.en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
ex.cn: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

ex.en: That was the clue which clinched it for us.
ex.cn: 就是那个线索帮我们最终解决了问题。

ex.en: I hadn't a clue to the meaning of "activism"
ex.cn: 我根本不明白activism的意思。

def:
n.教练,（铁路）旅客车厢,长途客运汽车,四轮大马车
vt.& vi.训练,辅导
vt.训练,指导
vi.作指导,受训练[辅导],坐马车旅行
n.<药>可卡因,古柯碱

ex.en: The police moved in, arrested him and impounded the cocaine.
ex.cn: 警察冲进去将他拘捕并没收了可卡因。

ex.en: He spent a number of years hooked on cocaine, heroin and alcohol.
ex.cn: 他有好几年时间吸食可卡因和海洛因成瘾，还整日酗酒。

ex.en: She became a prostitute in order to pay for her cocaine habit.
ex.cn: 她以娼养吸。

def: vi.相撞,碰撞,冲突,抵触

ex.en: What happens when the two interests collide will make a fascinating spectacle.
ex.cn: 两种利益发生冲突时将会上演一场好戏。

ex.en: The interests of the two countries collide.
ex.cn: 两国的利益发生冲突.

ex.en: The aims of the negotiators in New York again seem likely to collide with the aims of the warriors in the field.
ex.cn: 看来，纽约谈判人员的目标可能会再次与战场上勇士们的目标发生冲突。

def: n.上校

ex.en: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
ex.cn: 士兵对上校报以震天的欢呼声。

ex.en: While he was gone she had tea with the Colonel.
ex.cn: 他不在时她跟上校一起喝了茶。

ex.en: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
ex.cn: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

def:
adj.殖民地的,殖民地化的,[生]群体的，集群的,英领殖民地时期的
n.殖民地居民,殖民时代建筑

ex.en: Many Filipinos see the bases as an extension of American colonial rule.
ex.cn: 很多菲律宾人视这些基地为美国殖民统治的延续。

ex.en: New states were born out of the wreckage of old colonial empires.
ex.cn: 新生国家从老殖民帝国的废墟中诞生。

ex.en: Her eventful life included holding senior positions in the Colonial Service.
ex.cn: 她一生经历丰富，曾在殖民服务局担任高级职位。

def:
n.格斗，搏斗，战斗,〈美〉竞赛，比赛,论战
vt.与…战斗,与…斗争,防止,减轻

ex.en: They demanded a more expansionary economy to combat rising unemployment.
ex.cn: 他们要求发展扩张性的经济以应对升高的失业率。

ex.en: The seagulls swirled in aerial combat over the barges.
ex.cn: 海鸥盘旋在驳船上方，展开空中的搏斗。

ex.en: He never expected to return home wearing US combat fatigues.
ex.cn: 他从没想到会穿着美国军服回家。

def: n.喜剧,喜剧性,喜剧体裁,有趣的事情

ex.en: Paul is a thoroughly likeable man with an unerring sense of comedy.
ex.cn: 保罗十分讨人喜欢，开玩笑时很有分寸。

ex.en: Actor Dom Deluise talks about his career in comedy.
ex.cn: 演员多姆·德卢西谈论自己的喜剧生涯。

ex.en: This comedy of contemporary manners is told with compassion and acid humour.
ex.cn: 这部当代风尚喜剧杂糅了悲悯的情怀和尖酸的幽默。

def: vt.推荐,表扬,托付,受到赞同

ex.en: I commend Ms. Orth on writing such an informative article.
ex.cn: 我对奥思太太写出内容如此翔实的文章表示赞许。

ex.en: The Prime Minister's initiative has much to commend it.
ex.cn: 首相的新方案有不少令人赞许之处。

ex.en: I can commend it to him as a realistic course of action.
ex.cn: 我可以把这作为一个切实可行的处理方法推荐给他。

def:
vi.通勤,代偿
vt.减刑,交换,用…交换,使…变成
n.通勤来往,通勤来往的路程
adj.兼容的，相容的,和谐的，协调的,[生物学]亲和的,可以并存的，能共处的

ex.en: Free enterprise, he argued, was compatible with Russian values and traditions.
ex.cn: 他认为自由企业制并不违背俄罗斯的价值观和传统。

ex.en: The new system will be compatible with existing equipment.
ex.cn: 新的系统将与现有的设备相互兼容。

ex.en: You should choose a roommate more compatible to your tastes.
ex.cn: 你应该挑个和你意气更相投的人同住一室.

def: adj.有能力的，能胜任的,能干的，称职的,足够的，充足的,有决定权的

ex.en: I had always considered myself a strong, competent woman.
ex.cn: 一直以来，我始终认为自己是个女强人。

ex.en: Make sure the firm is competent to carry out the work.
ex.cn: 要确保这家公司有能力完成这项工作。

ex.en: Her drawing is competent, but her composition is poor.
ex.cn: 她的画有功力, 但布局欠佳.

def: n.[医]并发症,错杂，纠纷,混乱，精神错乱

ex.en: An added complication is the growing concern for the environment.
ex.cn: 还有个问题就是对环境的日益关注。

ex.en: The age difference was a complication to the rela-tionship.
ex.cn: 年龄差异使得双方交往更加困难。

ex.en: One complication which can arise is a prolapse.
ex.cn: 可能出现的一种并发症是脱垂。

def:
n.恭维,敬意,道贺，贺词,致意
vt.向…道贺,称赞,向…致意

ex.en: We consider it a compliment to be called "conservative"
ex.cn: 我们认为被称作“保守分子”是对我们的一种赞赏。

ex.en: Saying she's improved comes over as a backhanded compliment.
ex.cn: 说她进步了听起来倒像是一种讽刺。

ex.en: His lips curved up in the obligatory smile, acknowledging the compliment.
ex.cn: 他嘴边礼节性地挤出一个微笑，以示对称赞致谢。

def: n.场地,复合物,（筑有围墙的）院子,复合词

ex.en: Police fired on them as they fled into the embassy compound.
ex.cn: 当他们逃进使馆大院时，警察向他们开了枪。

ex.en: The less stable compounds were converted into a compound called Delta-A THC.
ex.cn: 不太稳定的化合物被转换成了一种叫做Delta-ATHC的化合物。

ex.en: This sticky compound adheres well on this surface.
ex.cn: 这种黏性的化合物能牢牢地粘在这个表面上。

def: vt.理解，领会,包含

ex.en: They can neither read nor write, nor can they comprehend such concepts.
ex.cn: 他们不会读，不会写，也理解不了这样的概念。

ex.en: Whenever she failed to comprehend she invariably laughed.
ex.cn: 每当她听不懂的时候，她总是会笑。

ex.en: The infinite distances of space are too great for the human mind to comprehend.
ex.cn: 太空的无垠距离遥远得让人类的大脑无法理解。

def:
vt.压紧,压缩,精简
n.止血敷布,打包机

ex.en: He never understood how to organize or compress large masses of material.
ex.cn: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。

ex.en: You can compress huge amounts of data on to a CD-ROM.
ex.cn: 可以把大量的数据压缩到一张CD-ROM上。

ex.en: Wood blocks may compress a great deal under pressure.
ex.cn: 木块受压时可缩小很多.

def: vt.包含，包括,由…组成,由…构成

ex.en: The funds of the association shall comprise of members'subscriptions.
ex.cn: 协会的基金将由会员的捐款构成.

ex.en: Twelve departments comprise this university.
ex.cn: 12个系组成了这所大学.

ex.en: The notion that blacks comprise a problem is at the core of racist reasoning.
ex.cn: 黑人总爱惹事这一观念是种族主义论断的核心。

def: adj.必须做的，强制性的,义务的,必修的

ex.en: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
ex.cn: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

ex.en: It is absurd to be discussing compulsory redundancy policies for teachers.
ex.cn: 讨论针对教师的强制裁员政策真是滑稽可笑。

ex.en: Unions pledged to fight any compulsory redundancies "tooth and nail".
ex.cn: 工会许诺会“竭尽所能地”阻止任何强制裁员。

def: n.让步，迁就,（尤指由政府或雇主给予的）特许权,租借地,承认或允许

ex.en: We can not make heavy concession to the matter.
ex.cn: 我们在这个问题上不能过于让步.

ex.en: That is a great concession.
ex.cn: 这是很大的让步.

ex.en: As a concession to his reasonable demand, the doctor allowed him to work.
ex.cn: 医生向他的合理要求让步了, 允许他工作.

def: adj.简明的，简洁的,,简约,精炼

ex.en: Burton's text is concise and informative.
ex.cn: 伯顿的文章语言简洁，信息丰富。

ex.en: The explanation in this dictionary is concise and to the point.
ex.cn: 这部词典里的释义简明扼要.

ex.en: Be sure to make it clear and concise and avoid long - windedness.
ex.cn: 注意简明扼要,反对长篇大论.

def:
adj.具体的，有形的，实在的，实际的,固结成的，混凝土制的,图案诗歌的
n.混凝土,具体物,（图案式）有形诗,〔建〕钢筋混凝土
vt.使凝固,用混凝土修筑,萃取
vi.凝固,固结,变坚固,使用混凝土

ex.en: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
ex.cn: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

ex.en: Your decision must be translated into specific, concrete actions.
ex.cn: 你的决定必须转化为具体明确的行动。

ex.en: The hot liquid splashed down on the concrete and rebounded.
ex.cn: 滚烫的液体泼在水泥地面上又溅了起来。

def: vt.（通常因道义上的原因而）谴责,宣判,宣布…不能使用,迫使…陷于不幸的境地

ex.en: Bankers are quick to condemn retrospective tax legislation.
ex.cn: 银行家们立即声讨有追溯效力的税收立法。

ex.en: Like everyone else, I deplore and condemn this killing.
ex.cn: 我同所有人一样强烈谴责这桩凶杀案。

ex.en: Some praise him, whereas others condemn him.
ex.cn: 有些人赞扬他, 而有些人谴责他.

def: n.连词,连接,联合，结合物,（恒星、行星等的）合

ex.en: The conjunction of low inflation and low unemployment came as a very pleasant surprise.
ex.cn: 低通货膨胀与低失业的同时出现是一大惊喜。

ex.en: Two or more sentences may be joined together by a conjunction.
ex.cn: 两个或两个以上的句子可以用连词连接.

ex.en: The conjunction of heavy rains and strong winds caused flooding.
ex.cn: 大雨和大风加在一起造成了洪水泛滥.

def: n.一致,舆论,一致同意，合意

ex.en: I realize there's no consensus on what are male or female values.
ex.cn: 我意识到人们对什么是男性价值观和什么是女性价值观并无共识。

ex.en: Consensus need not be weak, nor need it result in middle-of-the-road policies.
ex.cn: 一致的意见不一定就没有影响力，也不一定就会导致走中间路线的政策。

ex.en: The consensus is that risk factors have an accumu-lative effect.
ex.cn: 危险因素会与日俱增已成为共识。

def:
n.选民,成分，构成部分,委托人
adj.构成的，组成的,选举的,有选举权的

ex.en: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
ex.cn: 宪法还赋予巴西的25个成员州很大的权力。

ex.en: Over time, the protein in the eggshell breaks down into its constituent amino acids.
ex.cn: 时间久了，蛋壳中的蛋白质就会分解为其构成成分氨基酸。

ex.en: Caffeine is the active constituent of drinks such as tea and coffee.
ex.cn: 咖啡因是茶、咖啡之类饮品中的活性成分。

def: vt.强迫,强使,限制,约束

ex.en: The police used horses to constrain the crowd from violence.
ex.cn: 警察骑着马阻止那群人诉诸暴力.

ex.en: It's the capacity of those roads which is going to constrain the amount of travel by car that can take place.
ex.cn: 制约驾车出行量的将会是那些道路的通行能力。

ex.en: If they can, constrain him to belong to their desperate odd - fellow society.
ex.cn: 要是可能, 还要强迫他参加他们无可救药的畸形社会.

def: n.（受人咨询的）顾问,会诊医生，（顾问）医生,求教者，（与人）商议者，征求意见者，查阅者，咨询者

ex.en: Shirley's brother is now a consultant heart surgeon in Sweden.
ex.cn: 雪利的兄弟现在在瑞典做心脏外科高级顾问医师。

ex.en: He set up shop as an independent PR consultant.
ex.cn: 他自己开公司，做起了独立公共关系顾问。

ex.en: He was consultant rheumatologist at the Royal Hampshire Hospital.
ex.cn: 他是皇家汉普郡医院的风湿病学顾问。

def: n.矛盾,否认，反驳
adj.有争议的，引起争议的，被争论的,好争论的

ex.en: The committee backtracked by scrapping the controversial bonus system.
ex.cn: 委员会改变主意，放弃了有争议的奖金制度。

ex.en: It is a controversial policy which has attracted international censure.
ex.cn: 这是一项颇有争议的政策，引起了国际社会的批评。

ex.en: She's not feminist with a capital F but she's fairly controversial.
ex.cn: 她不是个真正意义上的女权主义者，但却是个颇具争议的人物。

def:
vt.（使）转变,使皈依,兑换，换算,侵占
vi.经过转变,被改变,[橄榄球] 触地得分后得附加分
n.皈依者,改变宗教信仰者

ex.en: We would like to convert the loft into another bedroom.
ex.cn: 我们想把阁楼改造成又一间卧室。

ex.en: He was a recent Catholic convert, and very zealous.
ex.cn: 他最近才皈依天主教，是一名狂热的信徒。

ex.en: Christians were arrested for trying to convert people, to proselytise them.
ex.cn: 基督徒因为试图改变他人信仰而被捕。

def:
adj.合作的,协助的,共同的,〈美〉（大学文科）有关[包含]各种实习活动的
n.合作社，联合体

ex.en: Cooperative activity is essential to effective community work.
ex.cn: 要把社区工作做好，协作活动是必不可少的。

ex.en: The workmen are very cooperative, so the work goes on smoothly.
ex.cn: 工人们十分合作, 所以工作进展顺利.

ex.en: We thank you for your cooperative efforts.
ex.cn: 我们感谢你方努力合作.

def:
vt.使协调，使调和,整合,使（身体各部份）动作协调,（衣服、布料等）搭配
vi.协调,协同,成为同等,被归入同一类别

ex.en: They appointed a new manager to coordinate the work of the team.
ex.cn: 为协调这个队的工作，他们任用了一位新经理。

ex.en: You must coordinate what you said with what you did.
ex.cn: 你必须使你的言行一致.

ex.en: The army, navy and air forces are coordinate armed services.
ex.cn: 陆军 、 海军和空军是并行的军种.

def:
v.使互相关联,联系
n.相关物,相关联的人
adj.相关的,相应特点的

ex.en: The political opinions of spouses correlate more closely than their heights.
ex.cn: 配偶之间政治观点上的相似度要大于他们身高的相似程度。

ex.en: The figures do not seem to correlate.
ex.cn: 这些数字似乎毫不相干。

ex.en: Try to correlate your knowledge of history with your knowledge of geography.
ex.cn: 试着把你的历史知识和地理知识联系起来.

def: n.一致，符合,对应,通信，信件,[艺]通感

ex.en: A selection of correspondence from P G Wodehouse realised £ 1,232. P.G.
ex.cn: 沃德豪斯的书信选集卖了1,232英镑。

ex.en: No correspondence will be entered into.
ex.cn: 将不会和任何人建立通信联系。
