ex.en: Her papers included unpublished articles and correspondence.
ex.cn: 她的资料包括未发表的文章和信件。

def: adj.昂贵的,代价高的

ex.en: Psychometric tests can save organizations from grim and costly mistakes.
ex.cn: 心理测试能够使组织机构避免犯下损失惨重的大错。

ex.en: The proposed regulations are ill-defined and cumbersome and could be unnecessarily costly.
ex.cn: 提议的规章制度阐述不清、复杂低效，而且可能会带来不必要的过高花费。

ex.en: At the required level of visual verisimilitude, computer animation is costly.
ex.cn: 要使电脑动画的视觉效果达到要求的逼真程度，花费会十分昂贵。

def:
n.（戏剧或电影的）戏装，演出服,服装，衣服,泳装，常用于英式英语,（某地或某历史时期的）服装
vt.给…穿上服装,给…提供服装

ex.en: Even from a distance the effect of his fox costume was stunning.
ex.cn: 即使从远处看，他的狐狸戏服也很抢眼。

ex.en: I felt a bit self-conscious in my swimming costume.
ex.cn: 我穿着游泳衣觉得有点害羞。

ex.en: The performers, in costume and make-up, were walking up and down backstage.
ex.cn: 上了妆穿着戏服的演员在后台走来走去。

def: n.小屋，村舍,（农舍式的）小别墅,（郊外的）新式住宅，（大院内的）单幢住宅,乡下房子，小房子

ex.en: The studio is midway between his aunt's old home and his cottage.
ex.cn: 工作室就在从他姑姑的老宅到他的小屋的中途。

ex.en: Curtis got behind the wheel and they started back toward the cottage.
ex.cn: 由柯蒂斯开车，他们启程返回小屋。

ex.en: My sister Yvonne also came to live at Ockenden Cottage with me.
ex.cn: 姐姐伊冯娜也来到奥克肯登小屋和我一起住了。

def: n.优惠券,息票，通票,试样，试件,配给券

ex.en: To enter, simply complete the coupon on page 150.
ex.cn: 要想参加，只需填写第150页的参赛表格。

ex.en: Cut out the coupon and send those cheques off today.
ex.cn: 剪下优惠券，并于今天把支票寄出去。

ex.en: Bring the coupon below to any Tecno store and pay just £10.99.
ex.cn: 持下面的优惠券到任意一家Tecno专卖店，只需付10.99英镑。

def:
n.谦恭有礼，礼貌，请安,有礼貌的举止[言词],承蒙
adj.殷勤的,出于礼节的

ex.en: A courtesy shuttle bus operates between the hotel and the town.
ex.cn: 有免费班车往返于酒店和市区。

ex.en: The President paid a courtesy call on Emperor Akihito.
ex.cn: 总统对明仁天皇进行了礼节性的拜访。

ex.en: The air was fresh, courtesy of three holes in the roof.
ex.cn: 房顶有3个洞，所以空气很清新。

def:
n.胆小鬼，懦夫
adj.怯懦的，胆小的

ex.en: She shot to stardom on Broadway in a Noel Coward play.
ex.cn: 她因在百老汇出演了一部诺埃尔·科沃德的戏一炮而红。

ex.en: He's a coward and a bully who confuses physical strength with manhood.
ex.cn: 他是一个懦夫，一个分不清蛮力和大丈夫气概的恃强凌弱者。

ex.en: "You're a coward," Mark said very plainly and soberly.
ex.cn: 马克非常直率而严肃地说：“你是个懦夫。”

def:
v.碰撞,使发出巨响,暴跌,睡觉
n.碰撞,碰撞声,暴跌,崩溃
adj.应急的,速成的

ex.en: A light aircraft crash-landed on a putting green yesterday.
ex.cn: 一架轻型飞机昨天在一个高尔夫球场的球洞区紧急降落了。

ex.en: Investigators say that a fuel explosion may have caused the crash.
ex.cn: 调查员说燃料爆炸有可能是失事的根源。

ex.en: I just want to crash out on the sofa.
ex.cn: 我只想在沙发上睡会儿。

def:
vi.爬行，匍匐,缓慢地行进
n.爬行，蠕动,虫爬着似的感觉，毛骨悚然,卑鄙小人，谄媚者

ex.en: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
ex.cn: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

ex.en: I would creep in and with stealthy footsteps explore the second-floor.
ex.cn: 我会偷偷溜进去，轻手轻脚地查看一下二楼。

ex.en: Back I go to the hotel and creep up to my room.
ex.cn: 我回到旅馆，蹑手蹑脚地上楼回到房间。

def:
n.全体船员,全体乘务员,一群，一帮
vt.当（尤指船上的）工作人员,当（尤指船上的）工作人员
vi.当船员,当机务人员

ex.en: The ship's crew were now exhausted and utterly demoralized.
ex.cn: 这艘船上的船员现在都已精疲力竭，彻底丧失了信心。

ex.en: The crew of the ship gave them nothing but bread to eat.
ex.cn: 船上的工作人员除了面包什么也不给他们吃。

ex.en: That night she, Nicholson and the crew had a celebratory dinner.
ex.cn: 那天晚上，她、尼科尔森和全体工作人员吃了一顿庆功宴。

def:
vt.使跛,受伤致残,严重削弱,使陷于瘫痪
n.跛子，瘸子,瘫子，残疾,<美方>杂木丛生的沼地,脚蹬

ex.en: The national health system saved him from becoming a cripple.
ex.cn: 在国民医疗保健系统的救助下，他免于致残。

ex.en: A total cut-off of supplies would cripple the country's economy.
ex.cn: 全面切断物品供应会使该国经济陷入瘫痪。

ex.en: Let's try to cripple their communications.
ex.cn: 我们试着破坏他们的通讯设备吧。

def:
n.王冠,花冠（有时象征胜利）,王权,（某物的）顶部
vt.（尤指通过增添成就、成功等）使圆满,为…加冕,使圆满完成,给…以荣誉
vi.露顶

ex.en: She says the sovereignty of the Crown must be preserved.
ex.cn: 她说必须维护王国政府的主权。

ex.en: He laid his hand gently on the crown of her head.
ex.cn: 他把手轻轻放在她的头顶上。

ex.en: He appeared at Manchester Crown Court on Thursday on a drink-driving charge.
ex.cn: 他因被控醉酒驾车而于周四在曼彻斯特的刑事法庭受审。

def: n.黄瓜，胡瓜

ex.en: Cucumber is good for soothing tired eyes.
ex.cn: 黄瓜有助于舒缓眼部疲劳。

ex.en: Cut the cucumber into match-sticks.
ex.cn: 将黄瓜切成细条。

ex.en: Bess stabbed a slice of cucumber.
ex.cn: 贝丝叉起一片黄瓜。

def:
adj.狡猾的,奸诈的,灵巧的
n.狡猾,诡诈,狡黠

ex.en: His cunning and guile were not attributes I would ever underestimate.
ex.cn: 我从未对他的狡猾和奸诈掉以轻心。

ex.en: Intelligence and cunning emanated from him.
ex.cn: 他透着一种智慧和狡黠。

ex.en: Enrico was too good, an old fox, cunning.
ex.cn: 恩里科很有心计，是一只狡猾的老狐狸。

def: n.货币,通用，流通，流传，传播,市价，行情,流通时间

ex.en: You need hard currency to get anything halfway decent.
ex.cn: 你得有硬通货才能买到还算不错的东西。

ex.en: Inflation has turned the rouble into a toytown currency.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀使得卢布变成了毫无价值的货币。

ex.en: Currency-conversion costs remain one of the biggest obstacles to cross-border trade.
ex.cn: 货币兑换成本仍是跨境贸易的最大障碍之一。

def:
vt.& vi.诅咒,咒骂,使苦恼，使困苦,把（某人）逐出教门
n.诅咒,咒语,祸害，祸因,咒逐，逐出教门

ex.en: Apathy is the long-standing curse of British local democracy.
ex.cn: 冷漠是英国地方民主制度长期以来难以推广的祸根。

ex.en: Joanna heard him bump into the table and curse again.
ex.cn: 乔安娜听见他撞到了桌子上，又骂骂咧咧的。

ex.en: He shot her an angry look and a curse.
ex.cn: 他生气地看了她一眼，骂了一句。

def:
adj.习惯的,通常的,照惯例的
n.习惯法,风俗志

ex.en: They interrupted the customary one minute's silence with jeers and shouts.
ex.cn: 他们讥讽着，喊叫着，打破了惯常的那一分钟沉默。

ex.en: She found her customary self-possession had deserted her.
ex.cn: 她发现自己不像平时那样处事不惊了。

ex.en: The king carried himself with his customary elegance.
ex.cn: 国王保持着一贯的温文尔雅。

def:
n.水坝，堰,水库,（牙科用的）橡皮障,〈比喻〉障碍
vt.用水坝阻止,阻塞，抑制

ex.en: Breaking the dam could submerge downstream cities such as Wuhan.
ex.cn: 摧毁大坝可能会淹没下游城市，比如武汉。

ex.en: The dam will stand 600 feet high.
ex.cn: 大坝将高达600英尺。

ex.en: A dam burst and flooded their villages.
ex.cn: 堤坝决口，淹没了他们的村庄。

def:
adv.非常,（表示厌烦）该死,讨厌,十足
vt.诅咒,谴责，指责,使…失败,[永世受罚，定罪
vi.诅咒,咒骂
n.一点也不，丝毫
adj.该死的,（表示厌烦）可恶的

ex.en: "Wait a damn minute," Mindy spat. "Nobody said anything about staying overnight."
ex.cn: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

ex.en: I couldn't make head nor tail of the damn film.
ex.cn: 这部该死的影片我一点儿都看不懂。

ex.en: I couldn't get any purchase with the screwdriver on the damn screws.
ex.cn: 我用螺丝刀拧那些该死的螺丝钉时一点也使不上劲儿。

def: n.数据库,资料库,信息库

n.最后期限,截止期限,死线,原稿截止时间
vt.通过设定一时间期限来统治

ex.en: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
ex.cn: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

ex.en: We were not able to meet the deadline because of manufacturing delays.
ex.cn: 因为制造方面的延误，我们没能赶上最后期限。

ex.en: We were still right on target for our deadline.
ex.cn: 我们仍然有可能赶在最后期限前达成目标。

def: n.（大学的）学院院长，系主任,教务长,[宗]主任牧师,（大学，尤指牛津、剑桥大学的）学监

ex.en: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
ex.cn: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

ex.en: She was Dean of the Science faculty at Sophia University.
ex.cn: 她是上智大学科学院的院长。

ex.en: I'll lay odds that Dean is at your office right now.
ex.cn: 我敢打赌迪安现在就在你办公室。

def: v.欺诈,误导

ex.en: The boys, if my eyes did not deceive me, were praying.
ex.cn: 如果我没有看错的话，那些男孩子正在祈祷。

ex.en: I think this is just a government ploy to deceive the public.
ex.cn: 我认为这只是政府欺骗公众的手段.

ex.en: Don't try to deceive me.
ex.cn: 你别诳我.

def: adj.决定性的,坚定的,果断的，决断的

ex.en: They were outplayed by the Colombians' slick passing and decisive finishing.
ex.cn: 哥伦比亚队凭借流畅的传球和终场前的制胜进球击败了他们。

ex.en: The meeting between Molotov, Bidault and Bevin was decisive.
ex.cn: 莫洛托夫、皮杜尔和贝文之间的会晤起到了决定性作用。

ex.en: I work very efficiently and am decisive, and accurate in my judgement.
ex.cn: 我工作非常有效率，处事果断，而且判断准确。

def: n.缺乏，不足,缺点，缺陷,不足额

ex.en: Symptoms of anaemia include weakness, fatigue and iron deficiency.
ex.cn: 贫血的症状包括虚弱、疲劳和缺铁。

ex.en: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
ex.cn: 他们给他验了血，以检查是否有维生素缺乏的迹象。

ex.en: AIDS stands for Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome.
ex.cn: AIDS是获得性免疫缺损综合征的缩写。

def:
vt.不服从,公然反抗,蔑视,向…挑战
n.挑战,对抗

ex.en: Her criteria defy analysis.
ex.cn: 她的标准让人搞不明白。

ex.en: I wouldn't have dared to defy my teachers.
ex.cn: 我可不敢不听老师的话。

ex.en: The towering pine and cypress trees defy frost and snow.
ex.cn: 松柏参天傲霜雪.

def:
adj.故意的,蓄意的,深思熟虑的,慎重的
vt.权衡
vi.熟虑,商讨

ex.en: He got sent off for deliberate handball in the 32nd minute.
ex.cn: 他在第32分钟时因故意手球犯规被罚下场。

ex.en: The Deputy Commander has condemned this weekend's protest as deliberate provocation.
ex.cn: 副指挥官谴责本周末的抗议活动是蓄意挑衅。

ex.en: It's not clear whether the incident was an accident or deliberate.
ex.cn: 还不清楚这起事件是意外还是蓄意所为。

def: adj.密集的，稠密的,浓密的，浓厚的,愚钝的

ex.en: Dense smoke swirled and billowed, its rank fumes choking her.
ex.cn: 滚滚浓烟盘旋翻腾，恶臭味呛得她喘不过气来。

ex.en: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.
ex.cn: 他的散文文笔有力、内容庞杂，有时几近晦涩。

ex.en: They walked through the dense Mozambican bush for thirty six hours.
ex.cn: 他们花了36个小时穿过茂密的莫桑比克丛林。

def: n.离开，离去,起程,背离,东西距离

ex.en: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
ex.cn: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

ex.en: The minutes towards departure ticked by, until finally the pilot arrived.
ex.cn: 离出发的时间越来越近，最后飞行员终于到了。

ex.en: Just phone in your order three or more days prior to departure.
ex.cn: 在出发的三天之前打电话预订即可。

def: vt.描绘，描画,描述

ex.en: The media depict him as a left-wing bogeyman.
ex.cn: 媒体把他描述成一个左翼大反派。

ex.en: The author tried to depict the splendor of the sunset.
ex.cn: 作家试图摹写落日的光彩.

ex.en: Some nationalists would like to depict the British monarchy as a purely English institution.
ex.cn: 一些民族主义者喜欢把英国的君主政体描绘为纯粹的英格兰制度。

def:
n.储蓄，存款,保证金,沉淀物,寄存，寄存品
vt.&vi.储蓄,寄存,放置，安置,付保证金
vi.沉淀

ex.en: This is more like a downpayment, or a deposit, if you like.
ex.cn: 这更像是首付，也可以说是定金。

ex.en: Dermot's putting his money by, in a Deposit Account.
ex.cn: 德莫特把钱存在一个定期存款账户里。

ex.en: The undersigned buyers agree to pay a 5,000 pound deposit.
ex.cn: 已签名的买主同意支付5,000英镑的订金。

def: vt.压下，压低,使沮丧,使萧条,使跌价

ex.en: The rainy days always depress me.
ex.cn: 雨天总是使我沮丧.

ex.en: I know he is too optimistic but I don't want to depress him.
ex.cn: 我知道他太过乐观了，但我不想令他灰心丧气。

ex.en: When you depress a key of an organ, a note is sounded.
ex.cn: 你压下一个风琴键, 就会听到一个音符响.

def: v.下来，下降 ,下斜,降临,突然造访

ex.en: She's got too much dignity to descend to writing anonymous letters.
ex.cn: 她是个自尊心很强的人，绝不会自贬身份去写匿名信。

ex.en: As you descend, suddenly you see at last the hidden waterfall.
ex.cn: 一直往下走，最终你会突然看到那条隐秘的瀑布。

ex.en: Things are cooler and more damp as we descend to the cellar.
ex.cn: 当我们往下走去地窖时，四周愈见阴冷潮湿。

def:
n.后代,后裔,（由过去类似物发展来的）派生物,弟子
adj.下降的,祖传的

ex.en: His design was a descendant of a 1956 device.
ex.cn: 他的设计是从一个1956年的装置衍生而来的。

ex.en: She is a direct descendant of Queen Victoria.
ex.cn: 她是维多利亚女王的嫡系后代。

ex.en: He was an O'Conor and a direct descendant of the last High King of Ireland.
ex.cn: 他属于奥康纳家族，是爱尔兰最后一位君王的嫡系后裔。

def: n.下降,血统,倾斜
n.目的，目标,目的地，终点,[罕用语]预定，指定

ex.en: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
ex.cn: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

ex.en: St Lucia is still mercifully undeveloped as a tourist destination.
ex.cn: 作为一个旅游目的地，圣卢西亚所幸还未被开发。

ex.en: You can check your baggage right through to its final destination.
ex.cn: 你可以把行李直接托运到终点。

def: n.命运,天命，天数,命运的三女神,主宰事物的力量

ex.en: It is my destiny one day to be king.
ex.cn: 我命中注定有一天要成为国王。

ex.en: Destiny has ordained that they are who they are.
ex.cn: 命运已经决定了他们的性格为人。

ex.en: He departed this world with a sense of having fulfilled his destiny.
ex.cn: 他带着一种已完成使命的满足感离开了这个世界。

def: vt.分离，拆开,派遣,分派,使超然

ex.en: It helps them detach themselves from their problems and become more objective.
ex.cn: 这有助于他们从所面临的问题中跳出来，变得更客观一些。

ex.en: It is easy to detach the currants from the stems.
ex.cn: 很容易就能把醋栗从梗上摘下来。

ex.en: Detach the coupon and return it as soon as possible.
ex.cn: 将赠券撕下后尽快寄回。

def: n.探测器,检测器,发现者,侦察器

ex.en: Their approach is to scan every checked-in bag with a bomb detector.
ex.cn: 他们的方法是用炸弹探测器对每一个办理了登机手续的箱包进行扫描。

ex.en: "Do you have a metal detector?" — "No, I don't."
ex.cn: “你有金属探测仪吗？”——“不，我没有。”

ex.en: We are forced to use a multiplicity of separate detector arrays.
ex.cn: 我们要尽力用多个分离的检测器组成.

def:
vt.使恶化
vi.恶化，变坏

ex.en: The position of the have-nots in our society could deteriorate even further.
ex.cn: 穷人的社会地位可能会进一步恶化。

ex.en: Food is apt to deteriorate in summer.
ex.cn: 食物在夏天爱变质.

ex.en: Police, weary and increasingly sour in mood, wonder aloud why the situation has been allowed to deteriorate.
ex.cn: 警察们疲惫不堪，心情也越来越糟糕，他们不禁满腹狐疑地问：为什么听凭情况不断地恶化下去？

def: n.方言，土语,语调,[语]语支,专业用语

ex.en: In the fifties, many Italians spoke only local dialect.
ex.cn: 在20世纪50年代，许多意大利人只会说当地方言。

ex.en: Cockney is the colourful dialect spoken in the East End of London.
ex.cn: 伦敦方言是在伦敦东区讲的颇有特色的地方语.

ex.en: He wrote a play in a local dialect.
ex.cn: 他用当地方言写了一个剧本.

def:
vt.口述,命令，指示,使听写,控制，支配
vi.口述,命令

ex.en: He cannot be allowed to dictate what can and cannot be inspected.
ex.cn: 什么能检查什么不能检查不能由他说了算。

ex.en: What right has one country to dictate the environmental standards of another?
ex.cn: 一个国家有什么权力强行给另一个国家制定环境标准？

ex.en: It took him a long time to dictate this letter.
ex.cn: 口述这封信花了他很长时间.

def:
adj.四散的,散开的,冗长的,累赘的
vi.传播,四散
vt.漫射,发散,弥漫,舒缓

ex.en: A cold, diffuse light filtered in through the skylight.
ex.cn: 一道冰冷的光线透过天窗漫射进来。

ex.en: It allows nicotine to diffuse slowly and steadily into the bloodstream.
ex.cn: 它能使尼古丁平稳缓慢地渗透到血液里。

ex.en: a diffuse style of writing
ex.cn: 冗赘的文体

def:
vt.& vi.消化,整理
vt.吸收,领悟,玩味
vi.消化,吸收食物,[化学]加热
n.文摘,摘要,法律汇编,罗马法典

ex.en: The organization publishes a regular digest of environmental statistics.
ex.cn: 该组织定期出版一份环境统计数据摘要。

ex.en: All this has upset me. I need time to digest it all.
ex.cn: 所以这些都让我心烦。我需要时间来慢慢接受这一切。

ex.en: She couldn't digest food properly.
ex.cn: 她无法正常消化食物。

def: adj.勤奋的,勤勉的,用功的,费尽心血的

ex.en: He was careful and diligent. I was all over the place.
ex.cn: 他细心且勤奋，我则稀里糊涂。

ex.en: The historical research was impressively diligent.
ex.cn: 该项历史研究非常地认真、彻底。

ex.en: A spotless stove told us that his mother is a diligent housekeeper.
ex.cn: 炉子清洁无瑕就表明他母亲是个勤劳的主妇.

def:
vt.稀释，冲淡
adj.稀释的，冲淡的

ex.en: The poisons seeping from Hanford's contaminated land quickly dilute in the water.
ex.cn: 从汉福德受污染的土地里渗出的有毒物质很快就在水中稀释了。

ex.en: Dilute the paint with water until it is the consistency of milk.
ex.cn: 用水把涂料稀释到牛奶般的稠度。

ex.en: The water will dilute the wine.
ex.cn: 水能使酒变淡.

def:
adj.暗淡的，昏暗的,不光明的,看不清的,（性质和特征上）不显著的
vt.& vi.（使）变暗淡,（使）变模糊,（使）减弱,变淡漠
n.笨蛋，傻子

ex.en: A few are dim-witted drones, but most are talented, frustrated, wasted people.
ex.cn: 有几个是愚笨的寄生虫，但是大多数是有才能却不得志而自暴自弃的人。

ex.en: Alistair saw the dim figure of Rose in the chair.
ex.cn: 阿利斯泰尔看见了坐在椅子里的罗丝的模糊身影。

ex.en: His punishing schedule seemed to dim his fire at times.
ex.cn: 繁忙的日程似乎有时让他精力不济。

def:
n.人名地址录，（电话）号码簿,（计算机文件或程序的）目录
adj.指导的，指挥的,咨询的,管理的

ex.en: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.
ex.cn: 雅虎是最早且最知名的因特网目录服务网站。

ex.en: He dialled directory enquiries.
ex.cn: 他拨打了查号台的电话。

ex.en: Unzip the icons into a sub-directory.
ex.cn: 把图标解压到一个子目录里。

def:
vt.打折扣，减价出售,减息贷款,削价出售，打折,减价，减量
vi.折扣,贴现率,贴现
n.贴现,数目,（任何面值上的）扣除额,（考虑到故事、报告、报道等的夸张或偏见等）不全信

ex.en: I'll sell at a discount in return for a speedy sale.
ex.cn: 为了尽快售出，我会打折销售。

ex.en: Eagle Star offers a 10% discount to the over-55s.
ex.cn: 鹰星公司给予年龄在55岁以上的顾客10％的折扣。

ex.en: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.
ex.cn: 1979年，LiquorBarn烈酒折扣店的生意十分红火。

def:
n.论述，交谈,正式的讨论
vi.演说,谈论
vt.叙述,讨论

ex.en: Gates responds with a lengthy discourse on deployment strategy.
ex.cn: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

ex.en: Other forms of discourse have successfully been decoupled from politics.
ex.cn: 其他的话语形式已经成功地与政治分离开来。

ex.en: a discourse on issues of gender and sexuality
ex.cn: 关于性别和性行为的论文

def: vt.移动，移走,替换，取代,排水,撤职

ex.en: At present , obviously, nevertheless, he was not likely to displace himself.
ex.cn: 但时至今日, 很清楚, 他不可能再迁徙了.

ex.en: Removing an existing tariff would clearly displace workers in import - competing industries.
ex.cn: 免除某种现有关税显然会使与进口竞争的工业中的工人失业.

ex.en: They seldom displace the purely indicating thermometers for direct.
ex.cn: 它们很少能代替直读式温度计.

def: n.取代，替代,免职，停职,[船] 排水量,[化]置换

vt.& vi.处理，处置,安排
vt.排列,布置,使倾向于，使有意于

ex.en: He alleged that they had hired an assassin to dispose of him.
ex.cn: 他宣称他们已雇了刺客来除掉他。

ex.en: They have no way to dispose of the hazardous waste they produce.
ex.cn: 他们没有办法处理掉自己产生的有害废料。

ex.en: He doesn't know how to dispose of his spare time.
ex.cn: 他不知如何打发空余时间.

def: vt.分配，散布,散发，分发,把…分类,[电]配电

ex.en: We didn't understand how difficult it was to distribute a national paper.
ex.cn: 我们不了解分销一份全国发行的报纸有多难。

ex.en: Distribute the topping evenly over the fruit.
ex.cn: 将配料均匀地撒在水果上。

ex.en: Distribute these pamphlets among them before you leave, will you?
ex.cn: 请你在离开之前把这些小册子发给他们好 吗 ?

def: n.红利，股息，利息，（破产时清算的）分配金,,[数]被除数 opp. divisor,（足球彩票的）彩金

ex.en: dividend payments of 50 cents a share
ex.cn: 每股50分的股息支付

ex.en: The number 15 is the dividend.
ex.cn: 15是被除数.

ex.en: What dividend did you receive?
ex.cn: 你得到多少红利?

def: n.教条，教义,法律原则,声明,古语] 所教的东西，教育

ex.en: The doctrine of karma is inseparably linked with reincarnation.
ex.cn: 业的教义与轮回转世说紧密相关。

ex.en: It's the end of the doctrine in all but name.
ex.cn: 这实际上已是该学说的终结，只是未被道明罢了。

ex.en: The doctrine is unchangeable.
ex.cn: 这一信条不容改变。

def: n.范围，领域,领土，疆土,管辖范围,[计]域名

ex.en: The state of their marriage has been put into the public domain.
ex.cn: 他们的婚姻状况已公开。

ex.en: It is outrageous that the figures are not in the public domain.
ex.cn: 让人愤慨的是那些数字并未公开。

ex.en: Is the domain name already registered or still available?
ex.cn: 该域名已经被注册还是仍然可用？

def: n.门口，门道

ex.en: A brilliant shaft of sunlight burst through the doorway.
ex.cn: 一束耀眼的阳光从门口照射进来。

ex.en: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
ex.cn: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

ex.en: A figure in a blue dress appeared in the doorway.
ex.cn: 一个穿着蓝色连衣裙的身影出现在门口。

def:
n.剂量，药量,（药的）一服，一剂,（处罚等）一回，一次，一番,（酒中的）配料，增味剂
vi.服药
vt.给药,给…服药,把（药等）配分剂量,在（酒）中加料

ex.en: The West is getting a heavy dose of snow and rain today.
ex.cn: 西部今天将迎来一场大的雨夹雪。

ex.en: A good dose of tonic will help you to pick up.
ex.cn: 一剂好的补品将有助于身体康复。

ex.en: Someone had fed him a lethal dose of cyanide.
ex.cn: 有人给他下了致命剂量的氰化物。

def:
vi.排水,流干
vt.喝光，喝干,使（精力、金钱等）耗尽,使流出,排掉水
n.排水,下水道,排水系统,[医]引流

ex.en: I drain the pasta, then I share it out between two plates.
ex.cn: 我将意大利面滤干，然后平分到两个盘子里。

ex.en: Drain the beans thoroughly and save the stock for soup.
ex.cn: 将豆角彻底控干，并把滤出的豆汁留下做汤。

ex.en: And then, suddenly, the euphoria began to drain away.
ex.cn: 随后，狂喜的感觉突然开始消失了。

def: adj.戏剧的，戏剧性的,引人注目的,激动人心的

ex.en: Recent, more dramatic use of CGI was seen in "Walking With Dinosaurs".
ex.cn: 在纪录片《与恐龙同行》中可以看到最新的、更加生动的电脑特效技术。

ex.en: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
ex.cn: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

ex.en: The director employs sensuous, atmospheric camerawork and deft dramatic touches.
ex.cn: 导演在镜头运用上既富有美感又渲染了气氛，戏剧手法的运用也娴熟自如。

def: n.抽屉,开票人，出票人,起草者,酒馆侍者

ex.en: He folded the papers and stuck them in his desk drawer.
ex.cn: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。

ex.en: There's an extra blanket in the bottom drawer of the cupboard.
ex.cn: 壁橱最下面的抽屉里还有一条多余的毯子。

ex.en: He picked each lock deftly, and rifled the papers within each drawer.
ex.cn: 他熟练地撬开每一把锁，把每个抽屉里的文件都偷走了。

def: adj.半信半疑的，犹豫不决的,可疑的,暧昧的，含糊的,不可靠的

ex.en: They would now find some dubious pretext to restart the war.
ex.cn: 他们现在会找个蹩脚的借口重新发动战争。

ex.en: Soho was still a highly dubious area.
ex.cn: 索霍区仍然是个靠不住的地方。

ex.en: I was rather dubious about the whole idea.
ex.cn: 我对这整个想法持怀疑态度。

def:
n.住处，处所,寓所,居住
v.居住，住( dwell的现在分词)
n.地震,大变动,动乱

ex.en: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
ex.cn: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

ex.en: The shock waves of the earthquake were felt in Teheran.
ex.cn: 地震带来的冲击波在德黑兰也能感觉到。

ex.en: Several countries in eastern Europe are counting the cost of yesterday's earthquake.
ex.cn: 东欧的几个国家正在计算昨天的地震带来的损失。

def:
vt.剪辑（影片，录音）,编辑,校订,主编
n.编辑

ex.en: I used to edit the college paper in the old days.
ex.cn: 以前我曾经做过大学校报的主编。

ex.en: Three CBS cameramen were on site to shoot and edit taped reports.
ex.cn: 3名哥伦比亚广播公司的摄影记者在现场拍摄并编辑录像报道。

ex.en: When you edit the tape you can take out the giggles.
ex.cn: 你编辑录音时，可以把咯咯笑的部分删了。

def: n.版次，版本,（报纸、杂志的）一份,（广播、电视节目的）一期,（书、报、杂志等的）一版印刷总数

n.肘部,弯头，扶手,肘形管，弯管
vt.用肘推挤（另一人或另一些人）,用手肘推开
vi.用肘推搡着前进,在拐角处转弯

ex.en: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
ex.cn: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

ex.en: There was not much elbow room in the cockpit of a Snipe.
ex.cn: “沙锥鸟”战斗机的驾驶舱空间不太宽敞。

ex.en: He lay beside her awkwardly, propped on an elbow.
ex.cn: 他用一只胳膊肘支着身体，别扭地躺在她旁边。

def: adj.（指人）知名的，杰出的，卓越的,（指品质、特性）明显的，显着的，突出的,显赫的,闻达
vt.发出,发射,颁布,发表

ex.en: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
ex.cn: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

ex.en: It is unlawful for factories to emit black smoke into the air.
ex.cn: 现在,工厂往空气中排黑烟是违法的.

ex.en: She was heard to emit a cry of horror.
ex.cn: 人们听到她发出恐怖的叫声.

def: adj.凭经验的,经验主义的,以观察或实验为依据的

ex.en: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications.
ex.cn: 此处提及的实验证据有诸多限制条件。

ex.en: We now have empirical evidence that the moon is covered with dust.
ex.cn: 现在我们有实践经验证明月球上布满了灰尘.

ex.en: Much of her work is speculative, based on psychoanalytic theory rather than empirical data.
ex.cn: 她的著作中有相当一部分内容是推测性的，建立在精神分析理论之上而缺乏来自实际经验的数据。

def: n.耐久（力），持久（力）,忍耐，忍耐力

ex.en: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
ex.cn: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

ex.en: Goaded beyond endurance, she turned on him and hit out.
ex.cn: 她被气得忍无可忍，于是转身向他猛击。

ex.en: The recruits were put through a week of gruelling endurance tests.
ex.cn: 新兵要接受为期一周艰苦的耐力测试.

def:
vt.忍耐,容忍
vi.持续，持久,忍耐

ex.en: Then something seemed to snap in me. I couldn't endure any more.
ex.cn: 这时候，我的心里像有个东西突然绷断了——我再也忍受不了啦。

ex.en: They endure as masterworks of American musical theatre.
ex.cn: 它们作为美国音乐剧舞台上的杰作流芳于世。

ex.en: They had to endure a long wait before the case came to trial.
ex.cn: 在此案审理前他们只得忍受长时间的等待。

def: v.注册,登记,加入,招收

ex.en: I should like to enroll all my children in the swimming class.
ex.cn: 我愿意让我的孩子们都参加游泳班.

ex.en: I must enroll the children for piano lessons before next week.
ex.cn: 我必须在本周内给孩子们报名学钢琴课.

ex.en: They enroll him as a member of the club.
ex.cn: 他们吸收他为俱乐部会员.

def: vt.牵涉,需要,使必要,限定继承

ex.en: Selective aversion to certain risks may entail acceptance of other greater risks.
ex.cn: 有选择地回避某些风险可能招致更大的风险.

ex.en: Such a decision would entail a huge political risk.
ex.cn: 这样的决定势必带来巨大的政治风险。

ex.en: Thoughtcrime does not entail death: thoughtcrime IS death.
ex.cn: 思想罪并不会导致死亡.思想罪就是死亡.

def: adj.全部的,整个的,全体的,囫囵

ex.en: If the Commission has its way, the entire deal will be scuppered.
ex.cn: 如果委员会我行我素的话，整个交易将化为泡影。

ex.en: In his long career at BP, Horton turned around two entire divisions.
ex.cn: 霍顿在英国石油公司漫长的职业生涯中曾经让两个部门整体上起死回生。

ex.en: They feared that totalitarians might yet conquer the entire world.
ex.cn: 他们担心极权主义者会征服整个世界。

def: n.实体,实际存在物,本质

ex.en: The state is not a unified and internally coherent entity.
ex.cn: 该国不是一个统一的、内部团结的实体。

ex.en: These countries can no longer be viewed as a single entity .
ex.cn: 这些国家不能再被看成是一个单独的实体。

ex.en: The country is no longer one political entity.
ex.cn: 这个国家不再是一个统一的政治实体了.

def: n.<法>企业家,主办人,承包人

ex.en: The entrepreneur takes business risks in the hope of making a profit.
ex.cn: 企业家为追求利润而冒险.

ex.en: The entrepreneur at twenty-five is a different animal from the entrepreneur at fifty.
ex.cn: 25岁的企业家和50岁的企业家是两种不同的人。

ex.en: An entrepreneur is more than just a risk taker. He is a visionary.
ex.cn: 企业家不仅要能承担风险，还应富于远见。

def: n.进入，入场,入口处，门口,登记，记录,参加比赛的人

ex.en: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
ex.cn: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

ex.en: Like the old trouper he is, he timed his entry to perfection.
ex.cn: 作为一名老戏骨，他上场的时间把握得恰到好处。

ex.en: Out of the original 23,000 applications, 16,000 candidates meet the entry requirements.
ex.cn: 最初的2.3万份申请中有1.6万份满足入选的要求。

def:
n.嫉妒，妒忌,羡慕
vi.感到妒忌,显示出妒忌

ex.en: Unconscious envy manifests itself very often as this kind of arrogance.
ex.cn: 潜意识里的嫉妒常表现为这种傲慢自大。

ex.en: Glover thinks that Smith did him down, perhaps out of envy.
ex.cn: 格洛弗认为史密斯说他坏话，也许是出于嫉妒。

ex.en: Gradually he began to acknowledge his feelings of envy towards his mother.
ex.cn: 渐渐地，他开始承认自己羡慕母亲。

def:
n.流行病,迅速的传播、生长或发展,风尚等的流行
adj.流行性的,极为盛行的

ex.en: Drug experts say it could spell the end of the crack epidemic.
ex.cn: 禁毒专家说它可能会结束强效可卡因吸食泛滥的局面。

ex.en: Health officials have successfully confined the epidemic to the Tabatinga area.
ex.cn: 卫生官员成功地将疫情控制在塔巴廷加地区。

ex.en: The major impact of this epidemic worldwide is yet to come.
ex.cn: 这种传染病在世界范围内的重大影响还未完全显现。

def: n.插曲,片段,一集,一段经历

ex.en: Mr Butterfield denies having anything to do with the episode.
ex.cn: 巴特菲尔德先生否认和此事有关。

ex.en: "It's been a lovely day," she said, dismissing the episode.
ex.cn: “这是开心的一天，”她说，将那事抛到了脑后。

ex.en: The first episode occupies a peak evening viewing slot.
ex.cn: 第一集占据了傍晚的一个黄金收视时段。

def: n.赤道,（平分球形物体的面的）圆,（任何）大圆

ex.en: GPS operates best near the equator.
ex.cn: 全球定位系统在赤道附近性能最好。

ex.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
ex.cn: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球腰部的线。

ex.en: Singapore is near the equator.
ex.cn: 新加坡位于赤道附近.

def: n.本质，实质,精华，精髓,香精

ex.en: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
ex.cn: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

ex.en: Speed was of the essence in a project of this type.
ex.cn: 对于这种项目来说，速度至关重要。

ex.en: Others claim that Ireland's very essence is expressed through the language.
ex.cn: 其他人声称爱尔兰最精髓的东西是通过语言表现出来的。

def:
n.财产，遗产，房地产,个人财产,不动产权,（较高的）社会地位
adj.（汽车）连箱的（拥有较长的车身和后门，后座后面有较大的空间）

ex.en: By his own admission, he evaded taxes as a Florida real-estate speculator.
ex.cn: 他亲口承认自己在佛罗里达从事房地产投机生意时逃过税。

ex.en: The allowable deduction is apportioned between the estate and the beneficiaries.
ex.cn: 减免的税额在地产和受益人之间分摊。

ex.en: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
ex.cn: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

def:
vt.评价,求…的值（或数）,对…评价,[数学、逻辑学]求…的数值
vi.评价，估价

ex.en: Our research attempts to evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
ex.cn: 我们的研究试图对不同药物的疗效进行评估。

ex.en: I can't evaluate his ability without seeing his work.
ex.cn: 我没有看到他的工作情况,无法评论他的能力.

ex.en: Don't evaluate a person on the basis of appearance.
ex.cn: 不要以相貌取人.

def: vt.是…的典型,例示，举例证明,[法]复印，制成核正誊本

ex.en: I'm going to exemplify one or two of these points.
ex.cn: 我打算就论点中的一、两个方面举例说明.

ex.en: He turned out stories and sketches to exemplify the generalized jottings of his notebook.
ex.cn: 他根据笔记里归纳起来的东西写了一些短篇小说和小品文.

ex.en: We can best understand excellence by studying the products that exemplify it.
ex.cn: 通过学习这些誉满全球的产品的例证,我们就能更好地明白它良好的质量所在.

def:
adj.异国的,外来的,异乎寻常的，奇异的,吸引人的
n.舶来品，外来物,脱衣舞女

ex.en: He sent a basket of exotic fruit and a card.
ex.cn: 他送了一篮子异域水果和一张卡片。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly interested in the authentically exotic tastes.
ex.cn: 消费者对于真正的异国风味越来越情有独钟。

ex.en: A smuggling racket is killing thousands of exotic birds each year.
ex.cn: 走私活动每年都会导致数千只珍奇鸟类死亡。

def: n.专门知识或技能,专家的意见,专家评价，鉴定

ex.en: It's a team unrivalled in stature, expertise and credibility.
ex.cn: 这个团队的名声、专业技能和信誉都是无可匹敌的。

ex.en: The level of expertise and helpfulness is far higher in smaller shops.
ex.cn: 规模较小的商店专业得多，对顾客也体贴得多。

ex.en: Students' expectations were as varied as their expertise.
ex.cn: 学生们的期望根据他们的专业各有不同。

def: vi.期满,文件、协议等（因到期而）失效,断气,逝世

ex.en: When does your driving licence expire?
ex.cn: 你的驾照什么时候到期？

ex.en: His term of office as president will expire next year.
ex.cn: 他的总统任期明年将届满.

ex.en: When does your trade agreement with Japan expire?
ex.cn: 你们同日本签订的贸易协定何时期满?

def:
adj.爆炸的,易爆炸的,突增的,暴躁的
n.爆炸物，炸药,[语言学] 爆破音

ex.en: The strategy was too dangerous in the explosive circumstances of the times.
ex.cn: 在当时那种一触即发的形势下，采取那样的策略太危险了。

ex.en: New guns firing high explosive shells were incorporated into the battlefield.
ex.cn: 发射高爆弹的新型大炮在战场上得到了使用。

ex.en: Nobody knows what explosive arguments the future of Europe will bring.
ex.cn: 没有人知道欧洲的未来这一议题会引起怎样爆炸性的讨论。

def: vt.熄灭（火）,使（希望、爱情等）不复存在,偿清

ex.en: Firefighters tried to extinguish the flames.
ex.cn: 消防队员奋力救火。

ex.en: You may extinguish a nation, but not the love of liberty.
ex.cn: 你可以消灭一个国家, 但不能消灭对自由的热爱.

ex.en: It took about 50 minutes to extinguish the fire.
ex.cn: 大约花了50分钟才把火扑灭。

def: vt.提取,（费力地）拔出,选取,获得

ex.en: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
ex.cn: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

ex.en: This type of surgery could even be used to extract cancerous growths.
ex.cn: 这种外科手术甚至可以用来切除癌性肿瘤。

ex.en: Blend in the lemon extract, lemon peel and walnuts.
ex.cn: 调入柠檬汁、柠檬皮和核桃。

def: n.织物,布,构造,（建筑物的）结构（如墙、地面、屋顶）：质地

ex.en: He noticed that fabric was tearing away from the plane's wing.
ex.cn: 他注意到机翼在一块一块地断裂。

ex.en: Never dry underwear over direct heat; it will weaken the fabric.
ex.cn: 不要直接加热烘干内衣，那样会损坏布料。

ex.en: The fabric is strong enough to withstand harsh processing.
ex.cn: 这种织物非常结实，能经受粗加工。

def: vt.制造,装配,捏造

ex.en: They plan to fabricate a cinema next year.
ex.cn: 他们计划明年建造一座电影院.

ex.en: Tito had never had an occasion to fabricate an ingenious lie before.
ex.cn: 蒂托从前还没有机会制造一个货真价值的谎话.

ex.en: Compound surfaces are more difficult and expensive to fabricate.
ex.cn: 复合的表面在制造上更困难,花费也更大.

def: vt.促进，助长,使容易,帮助

ex.en: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
ex.cn: 新贸易协定应当会加快经济发展。

ex.en: It would not facilitate matters if you were uncooperative.
ex.cn: 如果你不合作,事情就不好办了.

ex.en: Both sides undertake to facilitate further cultural exchanges.
ex.cn: 双方承诺为进一步开展文化交流创造便利条件.

def:
vt.想像,设想,想要,猜想
n.设想,想像力,爱好,怪想
adj.（构思者）奇特的,昂贵的,（价格等）高价的,[美国俚语]真棒
vi.想象，幻想

ex.en: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
ex.cn: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

ex.en: She did not suspect that his interest was just a passing fancy.
ex.cn: 她相信这不过是他一时兴起。

ex.en: He owned a fancy house out on Lake Agawam.
ex.cn: 他在阿格瓦姆湖畔拥有一座豪宅。

def:
n.费,票价,乘客,食物
vi.吃,进食,进展,遭遇

ex.en: The round-trip fare to Havana is 550 Irish punts ($673).
ex.cn: 去哈瓦那的往返票价是550爱尔兰镑（673美元）。

ex.en: Yesterday he changed his tune, saying the fare increase was experimental.
ex.cn: 昨天他变卦了，说提价只是试行。

ex.en: In second class the fare is £85 one-way.
ex.cn: 二等车厢单程票价是85英镑。

def:
adj.流行的,时髦的，符合时尚的,时髦人物使用的,（尤指）有钱人常光顾的
n.时髦的人

ex.en: It's fashionable but wearable, and it's easy to look after.
ex.cn: 它既时尚又耐穿，而且容易打理。

ex.en: Radical feminism is currently the fashionable topic among the chattering classes.
ex.cn: 激进的女权主义是时下清淡阶层热议的话题。

ex.en: All shades of mauve, lilac, lavender and purple were fashionable.
ex.cn: 深深浅浅的各种木槿色、丁香色、熏衣草色和紫色都是流行色。

def:
n.疲劳，疲乏,劳务杂役,（士兵穿的）工作服
vt.使疲劳,使疲乏
vi.疲劳

ex.en: She continued to have severe stomach cramps, aches, fatigue, and depression.
ex.cn: 她仍然患有严重的胃痉挛，感觉疼痛、疲乏、抑郁。

ex.en: Coca is well-known for reducing hunger, thirst and fatigue.
ex.cn: 人们都知道可乐能消饿、止渴和解乏。

ex.en: Symptoms of anaemia include weakness, fatigue and iron deficiency.
ex.cn: 贫血的症状包括虚弱、疲劳和缺铁。

def: adj.错误的,有错误的，有过失的，有缺点的,不完美的
adj.害怕的，担心的,胆怯的,吓人的，可怕的,<口>极端的

ex.en: "It sounds the most fearful hard work," Sybil said later.
ex.cn: “这听起来是极为令人生畏的艰苦工作。”西比尔后来说。

ex.en: I had often been very fearful, very angry, and very isolated.
ex.cn: 我以前经常感到非常恐惧，非常愤怒，非常孤独。

ex.en: Our artillery opened up and we heard a fearful wailing and screeching.
ex.cn: 我们的炮弹一发，便听到可怕的哀号声和尖叫声。

def: adj.虚弱的，衰弱的,无效的，无意的,缺乏决心的，缺乏活力的

ex.en: He gave a feeble shrug and tried to squirm free.
ex.cn: 他无力地耸耸肩，扭动身体想要挣脱。

ex.en: The Observer found the play "a feeble rehash of familiar Miller themes"
ex.cn: 《观察家报》认为这部剧“是大家熟悉的米勒式主题的拙劣翻版”。

ex.en: This is a particularly feeble argument.
ex.cn: 这个论点尤其站不住脚。

def: n.反馈,反应,反馈噪音

ex.en: It would monitor traffic flows and provide feedback to motorists.
ex.cn: 它能监控交通状况，然后给司机提供反馈信息。

ex.en: I'd appreciate some feedback on my work.
ex.cn: 如果有人对我的工作提出意见我将感激不尽。

ex.en: The process is essentially dynamic with ideas and feedback flowing both ways.
ex.cn: 这个过程本质上是动态的,有各种建议与反馈的双向交流.

def: n.肥料，化肥,受精媒介物,促进发展者

ex.en: The organic fertilizer shall keep the soil in good heart.
ex.cn: 这有机肥一定会使土壤保持肥沃.

ex.en: How much fertilizer should be applied on one mu of land?
ex.cn: 一亩地要施多少肥?

ex.en: The state allotted them large quantities of chemical fertilizer.
ex.cn: 国家给他们调拨了大量化肥.

def: n.肥料，化肥

ex.en: The fertiliser releases nutrients gradually as bacteria decompose it.
ex.cn: 随着细菌的分解，肥料逐渐释放出各种营养成分。

ex.en: The peasant bought a bag of chemical fertiliser in the market place.
ex.cn: 这位农民在集市上买了一袋化肥.

ex.en: Get some more fertiliser for the garden.
ex.cn: 给花园再多施些肥料.

def:
n.节日,节期,贺宴，会演
adj.节日的，喜庆的

ex.en: The Jamaica Festival is planning a series of workshops and business seminars.
ex.cn: 牙买加节正在筹划一系列研习班和商务研讨会。

ex.en: During the festival, we'll be showing 13 classic oldie films.
ex.cn: 我们将在电影节期间展映13部经典老片.

ex.en: Plans are rolling full steam ahead for the Jamaica Festival.
ex.cn: 庆祝牙买加节的准备工作正开展得如火如荼。

def: n.光纤,（织物的）质地,纤维，纤维物质

ex.en: The muscle fiber of this animal is diseased.
ex.cn: 这个动物的肌肉纤维产生了病变.

ex.en: Eating cereals and fruit will give you plenty of fiber in your diet.
ex.cn: 吃谷类食物和水果能多摄取纤维质.

ex.en: Rayon rank second only to cotton as the most widely used fiber.
ex.cn: 人造丝是仅次于棉花的使用得最广泛的织物。

def: n.纤维,性格,硬纸板纤维板

ex.en: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
ex.cn: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

ex.en: In its untreated state the carbon fibre material is rather like cloth.
ex.cn: 原始的碳纤维材料很像布料。

ex.en: There is more fibre in wholemeal bread than in white bread.
ex.cn: 全麦面包纤维含量比白面包高。

def:
n.滤波器,滤光器,滤色镜,[化] 过滤器
vi.过滤,透过,渗透
vt.过滤,滤除

ex.en: Children should have glasses which filter out UV rays.
ex.cn: 儿童应该戴上滤除紫外线的眼镜。

ex.en: She gathered loose soil and let it filter slowly through her fingers.
ex.cn: 她捧起疏松的泥土，任其缓缓地从指间漏下。

ex.en: Change the filter cartridge as often as instructed by the manufacturer.
ex.cn: 按照生产厂家的使用说明，经常更换过滤筒。

def:
n.扁平物,[航] 襟翼,拍打，拍打声,〈口〉不安，恐慌
v.上下或左右移动、摆动,轻拍,振翅而飞

ex.en: They would flap bath towels from their balconies as they chatted.
ex.cn: 他们聊天时会在阳台上抖搂浴巾。

ex.en: Why did people get in a flap over nuclear energy?
ex.cn: 为什么人们对核能惶恐不安呢？

ex.en: He drew back the tent flap and strode out into the blizzard.
ex.cn: 他拉开帐篷的门帘，大步走进暴风雪中。

def: v.奉承,自命不凡,使显得更漂亮

ex.en: You flatter yourself. Why would we go to such ludicrous lengths?
ex.cn: 你真自以为是。我们为什么要费那么大的力气？

ex.en: You can make your stomach look flatter instantly by improving your posture.
ex.cn: 通过采取更好的坐姿，你的腹部马上就会看起来平坦一些。

ex.en: I flatter myself I've done it all rather well.
ex.cn: 我认为自己已经做得相当好了。

def:
vi.逃走，逃掉,消失
vt.逃离，逃避

ex.en: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
ex.cn: 难民开始三五成群地陆续逃离该国。

ex.en: Later, he suffered the indignity of having to flee angry protesters.
ex.cn: 后来，他不得不极不光彩地避开愤怒的抗议者溜走了。

ex.en: For an instant, Catherine was tempted to flee.
ex.cn: 有那么一会儿，凯瑟琳很想逃跑。

def:
n.兽群，鸟群,群众,棉束,大堆，大量
vi.群集，成群结队而行
vt.用棉束填

ex.en: A flock of birds flew towards us slowly from far away.
ex.cn: 一群鸟儿从远处朝我们缓缓飞来。

ex.en: A flock of birds was already warbling a cheerful morning chorus.
ex.cn: 一群鸟儿已经齐声唱起了欢快的晨曲。

ex.en: They kept a small flock of sheep.
ex.cn: 他们养了一小群羊。

def:
vi.波动,涨落
vt.使波动,使动摇

ex.en: Prices fluctuate from year to year.
ex.cn: 物价年年波动.

ex.en: Body temperature can fluctuate if you are ill.
ex.cn: 人患病后体温可能会上下波动。

ex.en: The actual cost may fluctuate above and below that standard.
ex.cn: 实际成本可在标准成本的上下范围内增减.

def:
vi.脸红,呈红色,奔流,冲刷
adj.满面红光的,富足的，丰富的,盈满的，没过的,水平的，同高的
n.奔流，涌出,脸红或发亮,发热,强烈情感的冲动
vt.发红或发亮,使兴奋或得意,（以水）冲刷，冲洗,冲掉，除掉

ex.en: Do you sweat a lot or flush a lot?
ex.cn: 你常出汗或是脸上常发烫吗？

ex.en: If we're feeling flush we'll probably give them champagne.
ex.cn: 等我们有钱了就可能会给他们喝香槟。

ex.en: Water is ideal to flush the kidneys and the urinary tract.
ex.cn: 用水清洗肾脏和尿道最理想不过。

def:
adj.第一流的，最重要的,最初的，最前面的
adv.首先，第一,居于首位地

ex.en: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.
ex.cn: 她首先是丈夫的知己。

ex.en: He was one of the world's foremost scholars of ancient Indian culture.
ex.cn: 他是世界上最杰出的古印第安文化研究者之一。

ex.en: I see myself, first and foremost, as a working artist.
ex.cn: 我首先还是把自己看作一名艺术工作者。

def:
n.锻造车间,熔铁炉，锻铁炉,铁匠铺，铁匠工场
vi.锻制，锻造,伪造,犯伪造罪
vt.锻造,伪造,捏造，编造,制订

ex.en: He again pledged to forge ahead with his plans for reform.
ex.cn: 他再次承诺会稳步推进自己的改革计划。

ex.en: The programme aims to forge links between higher education and small businesses.
ex.cn: 这个项目旨在为高等教育和小企业之间建立联系。

ex.en: The project will help inmates forge new careers.
ex.cn: 这项计划会帮助犯人开始新的职业。

def:
adj.即将到来的,现成的,唾手可得的,乐于助人的
n.来临,临近

ex.en: Both tracks are remixed versions of tracks from her forthcoming album.
ex.cn: 两首曲目都是她即将推出的专辑歌曲的混音版本。

ex.en: a list of forthcoming books
ex.cn: 近期将出版书籍的目录

ex.en: The party is all geared up for the forthcoming election campaign.
ex.cn: 该党为即将来临的竞选活动做好了准备.

def: n.论坛，讨论会，专题讨论节目,集会的公共场所,提供公开讨论的媒体,法庭

ex.en: The forum is now open to all budding entrepreneurs.
ex.cn: 这个论坛目前向所有企业家新秀敞开大门。

ex.en: This is the only forum where East and West can get together.
ex.cn: 这是东西方可以聚首的唯一论坛。

ex.en: Television is now an important forum for political debate.
ex.cn: 电视已成了政治辩论的重要擂台。

def: adj.易碎的，脆的,虚弱的

ex.en: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
ex.cn: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

ex.en: The fragile economies of several southern African nations could be irreparably damaged.
ex.cn: 一些南非国家的脆弱经济可能会被彻底破坏，无法挽回。

ex.en: She was small and fragile and looked incongruous in an army uniform.
ex.cn: 她又小又弱，穿一身军装看起来很不协调。

def:
n.碎片,片段，未完成的部分,（将文件内容）分段
vt.（使）碎裂，破裂，分裂
vi.破碎，碎裂

ex.en: This was only a fragment of a long conversation with John.
ex.cn: 这仅仅是与约翰长谈的一个片断.

ex.en: Do not let the discussion fragment into a desultory conversation with no clear direction.
ex.cn: 不要让讨论变得支离破碎,成为没有明确方向的漫谈.

ex.en: She read everything, digesting every fragment of news.
ex.cn: 她什么都看，对新闻的每个片段都细细品味。

def:
adj.坦白的，直率的,清楚表明的,明显的
n.弗兰克,免费邮寄权,免费邮戳或签名,免费邮寄的信件
vt.免费寄（邮件）,盖免费邮寄公章,盖邮戳,便于使（人）自由地来往

ex.en: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

ex.en: Frank is of the opinion that the 1934 yacht should have won.
ex.cn: 弗兰克认为本该是那艘1934年的帆船获胜。

ex.en: She hadn't followed her instinct and because of this Frank was dead.
ex.cn: 她没有听从自己心里的话，弗兰克因此死了。

def:
n.货运，货物,运费,船运货物,货运列车
vt.运输,装货于

ex.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery.
ex.cn: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

ex.en: The railways will carry a far higher proportion of freight traffic.
ex.cn: 铁路将承担比例高得多的货运量。

ex.en: Environmental pressures are strengthening the case for waterborne freight.
ex.cn: 环境的压力使人们更加认可水上运输。

def: n.频繁性,[数][物]频率，次数,频率分布

ex.en: Their instruments detected very faint radiowaves at a frequency of 3 kilohertz.
ex.cn: 他们的仪器检测到一个3千赫的微弱无线电波。

ex.en: Fatal road accidents have decreased in frequency over recent years.
ex.cn: 近年来致命交通事故发生率已经下降。

ex.en: If we can know their frequency we will monitor their talking.
ex.cn: 如果我们知道他们的频率,我们就能监听他们的谈话.

def: n.摩擦,冲突，不和,摩擦力

ex.en: The friction of the sheets against his skin was torture.
ex.cn: 被单摩擦着他的皮肤，简直像是酷刑。

ex.en: The pistons are graphite-coated to reduce friction.
ex.cn: 活塞上涂了一层石墨以减小摩擦力。

ex.en: the coefficient of friction
ex.cn: 摩擦系数

def:
vt.& vi.使结冰霜,冻坏,（在蛋糕上）撒糖霜
vi.结霜,受冻
n.霜冻，结霜,严寒，寒冷,冷淡

ex.en: The air was thin and crisp, filled with hazy sunshine and frost.
ex.cn: 空气稀薄清新，其间日光蒙眬，寒气逼人。

ex.en: We had 11 degrees of frost last night.
ex.cn: 昨天夜里气温降到了零下11度。

ex.en: It will be a clear night with some ground frost .
ex.cn: 今夜晴，部分地面有霜冻。

def:
vt.& vi.皱眉,不同意,蹙额
n.皱眉，蹙额

ex.en: The smile disappeared to be replaced by a doleful frown.
ex.cn: 笑容消失了，取而代之的是哀伤的蹙眉。

ex.en: There was a deep frown on the boy's face.
ex.cn: 男孩眉头紧锁.

ex.en: Billy's eyebrows knitted together in a little frown.
ex.cn: 比利眉头微皱。

def: adj.果实累累的,肥沃的,效果好的

ex.en: We had a long, happy, fruitful relationship.
ex.cn: 我们有过一段长久、愉快、双方都获益良多的关系。

ex.en: It was a fruitful meeting; we made a lot of important decisions.
ex.cn: 这是一次很有成效的会议, 我们做出了许多重大决定.

ex.en: Newton's laws were fruitful for the future development of science.
ex.cn: 牛顿定律对其后的科学发展起了很大作用.

def:
vt.挫败,阻挠,使受挫折
adj.无益的，无效的

ex.en: But this didn't frustrate Einstein. He was content to go as far as he could.
ex.cn: 但这并没有使爱因斯坦灰心, 他对能够更深入地研究而感到满意.

ex.en: Doesn't it frustrate you that audiences in the theatre are so restricted?
ex.cn: 观众在剧场里要受到如此多的限制，这难道不令人恼火吗？

ex.en: We will frustrate you, my friends, deep as you think yourselves.
ex.cn: 我的朋友呀, 尽管你们自以为高深莫测, 我们会挫败你们的.

def:
n.烟气，烟雾,愤怒，烦恼
vi.冒烟,发怒
vt.用烟熏,烘制（木材等）

ex.en: The pump exhaust should lead to the open air or a fume hood.
ex.cn: 抽气泵的排气管应该导向室外空旷处或导向一座通风橱.

ex.en: She was in a fume of impatience because she had to wait for the others.
ex.cn: 为了必须等别人,她非常不耐烦.

ex.en: Place the apparatus in a fume cupboard and cool the solution in ice.
ex.cn: 将仪器放在通风的橱中,用冰冷却溶液.

def:
n.毛皮,软毛,毛皮衣服,人造毛
adj.含羊毛的
vt.用毛皮覆盖,除去（锅上的）水垢

ex.en: We were amused to see how assiduously the animal groomed its fur.
ex.cn: 看着这只动物如此认真地梳理自己的毛，我们被逗乐了。

ex.en: Mrs Brown wrapped the thinly clad man in her fur coat.
ex.cn: 布朗夫人用自己的皮大衣把那个衣衫单薄的男子裹住。

ex.en: Fifty-five foxes were released from a fur farm by animal rights activists.
ex.cn: 动物权利保护主义者把55只狐狸从毛皮动物饲养场放了出来。

def: adj.狂怒的，暴怒的,激烈的,热烈兴奋的,喧闹的

ex.en: I am absolutely furious that he divorced me to marry her.
ex.cn: 他为了娶她而和我离婚，我愤怒至极。

ex.en: A furious player kicked his racket into the grandstand.
ex.cn: 一位愤怒的球员将他的球拍踢向了看台。

ex.en: Jack was furious with his London doctors for having misled him.
ex.cn: 杰克对伦敦的医生欺骗自己的行为感到非常生气。

def: n.熔炉，火炉,极热的地方,严峻的考验或磨难

ex.en: The flame in the furnace can be looked at through coloured glasses.
ex.cn: 可以通过有色眼镜观看高炉内的火焰.

ex.en: The furnace broke down and the entire office building has no heat.
ex.cn: 锅炉坏了,整栋办公大楼没有暖气.

ex.en: A blast of hot air came from the furnace.
ex.cn: 一股热风从火炉里吹出来.

def: vt.陈设，布置,提供，供应,装修（房屋）

ex.en: Can you furnish the committee with statements of the costs?
ex.cn: 你能把开支清单提交委员会 吗 ?

ex.en: We propose to furnish our own house according to our own taste.
ex.cn: 我们建议按自己的爱好布置自己的房子.

ex.en: His proposal shall furnish the basis for our discussion.
ex.cn: 他的提议成为我们讨论的依据.

def:
vi.熔化,融合
vt.使融合,使融化,给…装信管
n.保险丝,导火线,雷管,引信

ex.en: The fuse blew as he pressed the button to start the motor.
ex.cn: 他按下按钮启动马达的时候保险丝烧断了。

ex.en: I have a very short fuse and a violent temper.
ex.cn: 我容易发怒，脾气暴躁。

ex.en: The flakes seem to fuse together and produce ice crystals.
ex.cn: 雪花好像融合在一起形成了冰晶。

def: n.星系,银河系,一群显赫的（出色的）人物

ex.en: From this you can calculate the total mass in the Galaxy.
ex.cn: 由此你可以算出银河系的总质量。

ex.en: The Galaxy consists of 100 billion stars.
ex.cn: 银河系由1,000亿颗恒星组成。

ex.en: a galaxy of Hollywood stars
ex.cn: 好莱坞影星的荟萃

def:
vi.赌博,投机，冒风险,孤注一掷,打赌
vt.赌博，下赌注,使冒风险
n.赌博或其他投机,冒险

ex.en: They are not prepared to gamble their careers on this matter.
ex.cn: 他们不愿意把自己的事业押在这件事上。

ex.en: Most people visit Las Vegas to gamble their hard-earned money.
ex.cn: 大多数人拿着辛苦挣来的钱去拉斯维加斯赌博。

ex.en: Punters are expected to gamble £70m on the Grand National.
ex.cn: 预计众多赌马者会在国家大马赛上下注7,000万英镑。

def: n.垃圾,脏东西,丢弃的食物,无用的数据

ex.en: A bomb planted in a garbage can exploded early today.
ex.cn: 今天早些时候，安放在垃圾箱里的一枚炸弹爆炸了。

ex.en: Jeez, what garbage!
ex.cn: 天哪，这是什么破烂儿！

ex.en: Furious government officials branded her story "garbage".
ex.cn: 大发雷霆的政府官员称她的报道为“胡说八道”。

def:
n.齿轮,排挡,传动装置,衣服 
vi.接上,调和
vt.使适应,装上齿轮,用齿轮连接

ex.en: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear.
ex.cn: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。

ex.en: She selected a low gear and started down the track carefully.
ex.cn: 她选了低速挡小心翼翼地沿小径下行。

ex.en: With protective gear on you can spar with a partner.
ex.cn: 戴上护具后可以和对手练习轻拳出击。

def: n.<语>性某些语言的（阳性、阴性和中性，不同的性有不同的词尾等）,性别,某些语言的（名词、代词和形容词）性的区分

ex.en: Dara challenges our stereotypical ideas about gender and femininity.
ex.cn: 达拉对我们老一套的性别和女性特质观念提出了异议。

ex.en: Gender discrimination is a hotly contested issue.
ex.cn: 性别歧视是一个争论激烈的话题。

ex.en: a discourse on issues of gender and sexuality
ex.cn: 关于性别和性行为的论文

def: adj.慷慨的，大方的,丰盛的,肥沃的,浓厚的

ex.en: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
ex.cn: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

ex.en: It's the wages that count. Not over-generous, but there you are.
ex.cn: 重要的是工钱，不要过于慷慨，但也没办法。

ex.en: He's generous and, you know, very nice, very polite.
ex.cn: 他很大方而且，你知道，很友善，很有礼貌。

def: adj.遗传的,基因的,起源的，起因的,演变的

ex.en: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
ex.cn: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

ex.en: These compounds bind with genetic material in the liver.
ex.cn: 这些化合物在肝脏中与遗传物质实现结合。

ex.en: The whole population is so inbred that no genetic differences remain.
ex.cn: 整个族群都是同系繁殖，以至于根本不存在基因差异。

def: n.遗传学

ex.en: The study of psychology has recently been widely cross-fertilized by new discoveries in genetics.
ex.cn: 心理学研究最近从遗传学的新发现中受益匪浅。

ex.en: He gave me a piece of advice on how to learn genetics.
ex.cn: 他就如何学好遗传学给我提出了一条建议.

ex.en: Population genetics owes its origin to Francis Galton.
ex.cn: 体遗传学的创立应归功于弗朗西斯·高尔顿.

def: adj.真正的,坦率的，真诚的,血统纯粹的，纯种的,[医学]真性的
n.几何学,几何形状,几何图形,几何学著作

ex.en: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
ex.cn: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

ex.en: the geometry of a spider's web
ex.cn: 蜘蛛网的几何形状

ex.en: She is fond of geometry.
ex.cn: 她喜欢几何.

def:
n.鬼，幽灵,（尤指可怕事物的）记忆,隐约的一点点,（电视屏幕上的）重影
vt.悄悄地行进
vi.替人代笔

ex.en: They stumble across a ghost town inhabited by a rascally gold prospector.
ex.cn: 他们偶然来到一个居住着一位狡诈的淘金者的废墟之城。

ex.en: He doesn't stand a ghost of a chance of selling the house.
ex.cn: 那房子他根本不可能卖得出去。

ex.en: The battery in my car gave up the ghost.
ex.cn: 我的汽车电池报废了。

def:
vi.闪烁，闪耀,华丽夺目，炫耀
n.灿烂的光辉,闪烁,（表面的）诱惑力,吸引力

ex.en: Gary Glitter, 48, revealed the secret of his youthful looks.
ex.cn: 48岁的加里·格利特透露了他青春永驻的秘密。

ex.en: Decorate the tunic with sequins or glitter.
ex.cn: 用些圆形小金属片或发光小亮片装饰这件女式短上衣。

ex.en: The child was attracted by the glitter of the Christmas tree decorations.
ex.cn: 这孩子被圣诞树上闪耀的装饰物吸引住了.

def:
n.光荣，荣誉,壮观，壮丽,（对上帝的）赞颂,非常美的事物
vi.得意，自豪,骄傲

ex.en: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.
ex.cn: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。

ex.en: The crowd sang "Land of Hope and Glory" and other patriotic songs.
ex.cn: 人群高唱《希望和光荣之地》等爱国歌曲。

ex.en: What joy, what rapture, what glory to see him again!
ex.cn: 再见到他是多么高兴、多么欢欣、多么美妙的事啊！

def:
n.手套,棒球手套,拳击手套
vt.给…戴手套,用…的手套

ex.en: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.
ex.cn: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。

ex.en: It was time to consign his bat and glove to the cupboard.
ex.cn: 该把他的球棒和手套搁进柜子里了。

ex.en: She was repairing a glove when I came in.
ex.cn: 我进去时,她在补手套.

def:
vi.发光，灼热,脸红,洋溢，喜形于色
n.白热，炽热,色彩鲜艳，尤指红光,激情,热烈

ex.en: Give yourself a healthy glow on our detox diet.
ex.cn: 我们的解毒食谱将会让您容光焕发。

ex.en: He felt a glow of pride in what she had accomplished.
ex.cn: 他为她取得的成绩深感自豪。

ex.en: Exercise will give you a glow of satisfaction at having achieved something.
ex.cn: 运动将让你体会到一种有所成就的无比喜悦感。

def: n.主管人员,统治者，管理者,<美>州长,[机]节速器，调节器

ex.en: Duke was soundly defeated in this month's Louisiana governor's race.
ex.cn: 杜克在本月的路易斯安那州长竞选中大败而归。

ex.en: He is a candidate for the office of Governor.
ex.cn: 他是州长候选人之一。

ex.en: He was widely respected as a wise and statesmanlike governor.
ex.cn: 他作为一位睿智、具备政治家才干的州长而广受尊崇。

def:
adj.亲切的，和蔼的,（对王族及其行为的敬语）仁慈的，谦和的,雅致的,有礼貌的
int.（表示惊异）天哪，老天爷

ex.en: Good gracious, look at that specimen will you?
ex.cn: 哎呀，你快来瞧瞧那个标本！

ex.en: He has not yet learned how to be gracious in defeat.
ex.cn: 他还没有学会怎样豁达大度地面对失败。

ex.en: All this gracious living isn't for me; I prefer the simple life.
ex.cn: 这优裕的生活不适合我, 我宁愿过简朴的生活.

def: n.葡萄,深紫色，葡萄紫

ex.en: He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.
ex.cn: 他把一粒葡萄放入嘴里,整个吞了下去.

ex.en: Grape vines overarched the garden path.
ex.cn: 葡萄藤在花园小路上方形成了拱形.

ex.en: The grape vine climbed up along the wall.
ex.cn: 葡萄藤沿墙攀缘而上.

def:
n.图表，曲线图,词的拼法
vt.用曲线图表示，把…绘入图表,用胶版印刷

ex.en: We plot about eight points on the graph.
ex.cn: 我们在图表上绘制出大约8个点的曲线。

ex.en: Plot a graph of height against age.
ex.cn: 绘制一张身高与年龄对照的曲线图。

ex.en: the vertical axis of the graph
ex.cn: 图的纵轴

def: n.感激，感谢,感激的样子,谢意,恩义

ex.en: I owe a big debt of gratitude to her.
ex.cn: 我对她万分感激。

ex.en: She smiled, politely rather than with tenderness or gratitude.
ex.cn: 她只是出于礼貌地笑了笑，而非出于关心或感激。

ex.en: Relief and gratitude were written all over his face.
ex.cn: 他一脸释然与感激。

def:
adj.重大的，重要的,严重的,[音乐]沉重的,（颜色等）朴素的
adv.沉重地，庄重地,极慢地
n.坟墓，墓穴,埋葬…的地方,下场,死亡
vt.雕刻,铭记

ex.en: Universities are facing grave problems because of diminishing resources.
ex.cn: 由于资源的减少，大学正面临严峻的问题。

ex.en: Two men were standing by the freshly dug grave.
ex.cn: 两名男子站在新挖的坟墓边。

ex.en: He did die a pauper and is buried in an unmarked grave.
ex.cn: 他死的时候一文不名，葬在一处无名墓穴中。

def: adj.贪吃的,贪心的,贪婪的,渴望的

ex.en: Edith was seen as a conniving, greedy woman.
ex.cn: 人们认为伊迪丝是一个诡计多端的贪婪女人。

ex.en: You greedy pig! You've already had two helpings!
ex.cn: 你这个馋嘴！你已经吃了两份了！

ex.en: The greedy boss stopped at nothing to gain profit.
ex.cn: 贪婪的老板为了攫取利润无所不为.

def: n.温室，花房,[军]<俚>周围有玻璃的座舱，轰炸员舱

ex.en: Leonard pottered round the greenhouse, tying up canes for the tomatoes.
ex.cn: 伦纳德在温室里悠然自得地给西红柿绑上撑杆。

ex.en: The greenhouse effect is well and truly with us.
ex.cn: 我们完全处于温室效应中。

ex.en: The specific impact of the greenhouse effect is unknowable.
ex.cn: 温室效应的具体影响无法知道。

def:
vi.呻吟,发牢骚,抱怨,吱嘎声：因压力而发出声响
vt.呻吟着说，呻吟着表示
n.呻吟，叹息,呻吟般的声音

ex.en: She heard him let out a pitiful, muffled groan.
ex.cn: 她听到他发出一声令人悲悯的低沉的呻吟声。

ex.en: They glanced at the man on the floor, who began to groan.
ex.cn: 他们瞥了一眼躺在地上的男人，那人现在开始呻吟起来。

ex.en: The timbers groan and creak and the floorboards shift.
ex.cn: 这些木头在吱吱嘎嘎作响，木地板有些摇晃。

def: n.有罪，犯罪行为，罪恶,[法律] 轻罪，过失,内疚，知罪,自责

ex.en: The drinking and the guilt fed on each other.
ex.cn: 酗酒和犯罪彼此助长。

ex.en: His creative drive has been strangled by his sense of political guilt.
ex.cn: 他的创造欲望已被他的政治负罪感扼杀了。

ex.en: Too many women are like me, guilt ridden about the kids.
ex.cn: 很多女人都像我一样，对孩子充满了内疚。

def:
n.口香糖,树胶,黏胶,牙龈
vt.& vi.胶合,涂以树胶,使…有粘性

ex.en: When not removed, plaque causes tooth decay and gum disease.
ex.cn: 牙斑如果不清除就会导致牙齿蛀蚀和牙龈疾病。

ex.en: I've tried everything from herbal cigarettes to chewing gum.
ex.cn: 中草药香烟、口香糖之类的我统统都试过了。

ex.en: Deposits of plaque build up between the tooth and the gum.
ex.cn: 牙齿和牙龈之间会滋生牙斑。

def:
n.家伙，伙计,（架设天线、支撑帐篷等用的）牵索,[复数]各位,一群男人（或女人）
vt.（用牵索等）牵拉,（用拉索等）固定,开…的玩笑,取笑
vi.[俚语]逃亡，逃走,乱演某角色

ex.en: This guy, Jack Smith, does he go by the name of Jackal?
ex.cn: 这个叫杰克·史密斯的家伙是不是还有个名字叫杰凯尔？

ex.en: Guy Powell, defending, told magistrates: "It's a sad and disturbing case."
ex.cn: 盖伊·鲍威尔在进行辩护时对地方法官说道：“这是一件非常不幸、令人不安的案子。”

ex.en: He claims he was made the fall guy for the affair.
ex.cn: 他声称自己是这起事件的替罪羊。

def:
n.冰雹,一阵
vi.下冰雹,如冰雹般地降下
vt.致敬,打招呼,打信号示意（计程车等）停下,赞扬（或称颂）…为（尤用于报章等）

ex.en: The victim was hit by a hail of bullets.
ex.cn: 受害者被一阵弹雨击中。

ex.en: This is a film which seems to hail from the hippie era.
ex.cn: 这看起来是一部嬉皮士时代的影片。

ex.en: Hail to the new champion Bengali D'Albret.
ex.cn: 向新科冠军本·贾利·达阿尔布雷致敬。

def:
vt.妨碍，束缚，限制,使困累
n.（有盖的）大篮子,阻碍物，足械,[航]船具

ex.en: Before entering the bathroom, he emptied his dirty laundry into the hamper.
ex.cn: 进浴室前，他把脏衣服全都放进洗衣筐里。

ex.en: I hastily packed the hamper and lugged it to the car.
ex.cn: 我匆忙装好食品篮，吃力地把它拎上车子。

ex.en: The lobby is trying to hamper the policy of the U.S. government.
ex.cn: 院外集团企图牵制美国政府的政策.

def: n.少数，少量,一把（的量）,难以控制的人（或动物）,棘手事

ex.en: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity.
ex.cn: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

ex.en: One spring morning a handful of potential investors assembled in Quincy.
ex.cn: 春天的一个早上，几位有望投资者聚集在昆西。

ex.en: A handful of onlookers stand in the field watching.
ex.cn: 少数几个旁观者站在现场观看。

def:
n.障碍,缺陷,不利条件,给弱者增加的杆数（按击球次数计数，并随参赛者的进步而减少）
vt.妨碍，使不利,使（某人）行动和生活不正常

ex.en: I see your handicap is down from 16 to 12.
ex.cn: 我发现你的差点已从16杆降到了12杆。

ex.en: Some hearing-impaired children may work harder to overcome their handicap.
ex.cn: 一些有听障的儿童可能需要花更大的力气来克服这一缺陷。

ex.en: His golf handicap hovered between 10 and 12.
ex.cn: 他的高尔夫球差点一直在10杆到12杆之间徘徊。

def:
n.书法，手书,笔迹，字迹
v.亲手写(handwrite的ing形式)

ex.en: I have to admit that I have bad handwriting.
ex.cn: 我不得不承认自己的字写得不好看。

ex.en: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.
ex.cn: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。

ex.en: I've never come across hieroglyphics like the handwriting of Peter Smallwood.
ex.cn: 我从未见过像彼得·斯莫尔伍德那么难辨认的笔迹。

def: n.五金器具,计算机硬件,武器装备

ex.en: Hardware stores have sold out of water pumps and tarpaulins.
ex.cn: 五金店内水泵和防水油布已经卖光了。

ex.en: tanks and other military hardware
ex.cn: 坦克和其他军事装备

ex.en: He bought a pot and other hardware at the store.
ex.cn: 他从商店买了一个壶和其他金属制品.

def:
n.马具，挽具,背带,系带
vt.利用,给（马等）套轭具,控制

ex.en: He was almost strangled by his parachute harness straps.
ex.cn: 他差点被自己的降落伞吊带勒死。

ex.en: The vet had improvised a harness.
ex.cn: 兽医临时凑成了一副马具。

ex.en: to harness a horse
ex.cn: 给马上挽具

def: adj.仓促完成的,急忙的,草率的,轻率的

ex.en: So let's not be hasty. After all, he can't run away.
ex.cn: 所以我们不要鲁莽行事。毕竟他是跑不掉的。

ex.en: I made a hasty exit and managed to open the gate.
ex.cn: 我匆忙离开并设法打开了大门。

ex.en: The Government should not be pressured into making hasty decisions.
ex.cn: 政府不应该迫于压力仓促作出决定。

def: n.仇恨，憎恶,敌意

ex.en: The war sweeps up everyone in hatred and recrimination.
ex.cn: 战争让大家充满仇恨并相互指责。

ex.en: In that moment a surge of hatred flowed through my blood.
ex.cn: 那一刻，一股仇恨在我的血液中翻涌。

ex.en: Her hatred of them would never lead her to murder.
ex.cn: 她虽说仇恨他们，但绝不至于去杀人。

def: vt.& vi.（使）变高,（使）加强

ex.en: Use eye shadow to heighten your eyes.
ex.cn: 使用眼影可以增大你的眼睛.

ex.en: He took advantage of every opportunity to heighten racial tensions.
ex.cn: 他利用一切机会加剧种族间的紧张关系.

ex.en: The war games announcement is expected to futher heighten the nuclear dispute.
ex.cn: 预计这将进一步加剧核争端.

def:
n.头盔,钢盔,盔形物，盔状物,[植]盔状花冠
vt.给…戴上头盔

ex.en: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike.
ex.cn: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

ex.en: He pulled on a battered old crash helmet with a scratched visor.
ex.cn: 他戴上了一顶破旧的防护头盔，上面的面罩已有划痕。

ex.en: Miners wore a helmet as a guard against falling rocks.
ex.cn: 矿工头戴钢盔,防护落下的岩石.

def: n.遗产,继承物,传统,文化遗产

ex.en: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
ex.cn: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

ex.en: Manchester has a rich cultural, economic and sporting heritage.
ex.cn: 曼彻斯特有丰富的文化、经济和体育遗产。

ex.en: They take great pride in their heritage.
ex.cn: 他们为自己的历史传统深感自豪。

def: n.海洛因,吗啡,白面儿

ex.en: The US heroin market now appears to have reached a plateau.
ex.cn: 美国的海洛因市场现在似乎已到了停滞期。

ex.en: Withdrawal from heroin is actually like a severe attack of gastric flu.
ex.cn: 戒断海洛因的过程实际上就像患了一场严重的胃肠型流感。

ex.en: He spent a number of years hooked on cocaine, heroin and alcohol.
ex.cn: 他有好几年时间吸食可卡因和海洛因成瘾，还整日酗酒。

def:
n.臀部,[建筑学]屋脊,臀围（尺寸）,臀部…的
adj.（衣服、音乐等方面）时髦的，赶时髦的
vt.使…的髋关节脱臼，损伤…的髋部,[建筑学]给（房屋）建屋脊,使知晓，使了解，告诉,使消息灵通

ex.en: As I sidestepped, the bottle hit me on the left hip.
ex.cn: 我侧一步要躲闪的时候，瓶子打中了我的左髋部。

ex.en: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
ex.cn: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

ex.en: Her ear, shoulder and hip are in a straight line.
ex.cn: 她的耳朵、肩膀和髋部呈一条直线。

def: adv.到目前为止,迄今,至今

ex.en: a hitherto unknown species of moth
ex.cn: 迄今仍属未知种类的蛾

ex.en: Hitherto he had experienced no great success in his attempt.
ex.cn: 到目前为止,他的尝试还没获得成功.

ex.en: The polytechnics have hitherto been at an unfair disadvantage in competing for pupils and money.
ex.cn: 到目前为止，理工专科学校在争取生源和资金方面一直处于劣势。

def: n.支持物,持有者,（支票等）持有人,支托（或握持）…之物

ex.en: Her popular pot holder is also available in do-it-yourself kits.
ex.cn: 她那广受欢迎的防烫布垫也可以自己购买原料套装自己制作。

ex.en: He puffed constantly through an elegant cigarette holder.
ex.cn: 他嘴里叼着一个精致的烟嘴，一口接一口地喷云吐雾。

ex.en: Kasparov became the youngest world title-holder at 22.
ex.cn: 卡斯帕罗夫22岁时成为最年轻的世界冠军。

def: adj.可怕的,极不友好的,极讨厌的,令人震惊的

ex.en: They made sure that he died a horrible death.
ex.cn: 他们让他死得很惨。

ex.en: Loneliness can be horrible, but it need not remain that way.
ex.cn: 孤独可能会很可怕，但也并非一定如此。

ex.en: Unless you respect other people's religions, horrible mistakes and conflict will occur.
ex.cn: 如果不尊重别人的宗教信仰，就会祷下大错，酿成冲突。

def: n.房屋,供给住宅,掩护,外罩

ex.en: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
ex.cn: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

ex.en: Little of the existing housing is of good enough quality.
ex.cn: 现有的住房几乎少有质量过关的。

ex.en: Residents in general are poor and undereducated, and live in sub-standard housing.
ex.cn: 居民们普遍都很贫穷，受教育程度低，居住条件较差。

def:
vi.盘旋,徘徊,犹豫
n.徘徊,盘旋

ex.en: You don't hover over him.
ex.cn: 你不要威胁他.

ex.en: You don't hover round the table.
ex.cn: 你不要围着桌子走来走去.

ex.en: Seagulls hover over the surging waves.
ex.cn: 海鸥在惊涛骇浪上翱翔.

def:
vt.哼唱
vi.忙碌，活跃,发嗡嗡声,发出嘈杂声
n.嗡嗡声,杂音,哼唱的动作
int.哼,嗯

ex.en: Hum, I am sorry but I thought you were French.
ex.cn: 嗯，很抱歉，我以为你是法国人。

ex.en: There was a general hum of conversation around them.
ex.cn: 他们周围的人都在嗡嗡地低声交谈。

ex.en: My general reaction to this news might be summed up as "ho-hum"
ex.cn: 我对这条消息的总体反应可以用“哼儿哈儿”来概括。

def: vt.使蒙羞，使丢脸，使出丑,屈辱，羞辱

ex.en: There are people who want to humiliate you and grind you down.
ex.cn: 有一些人会想要让你难堪，欺负你。

ex.en: I didn't want to humiliate her in front of her colleagues.
ex.cn: 我不想当着她同事们的面令她难堪。

ex.en: What right had they to bully and humiliate people like this?
ex.cn: 凭什么把人欺侮到这个地步 呢 ?

def: adj.幽默的,滑稽的,风趣的,谐

ex.en: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
ex.cn: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

ex.en: Normally he asked questions, and had a humorous remark or two.
ex.cn: 通常都是他提问题，还不时地冒出一两句俏皮话。

ex.en: The writing is brutally tough and savagely humorous.
ex.cn: 该作品带有残酷的强悍和野性的幽默感。

def: n.伪善，虚伪

ex.en: The baron became increasingly heated over the hypocrisy of it all.
ex.cn: 男爵对整件事的虚伪感到越来越生气。

ex.en: They left themselves wide open to accusations of double standards and hypocrisy.
ex.cn: 他们使自己陷于被人指责搞双重标准和虚伪不实的境地。

ex.en: For them to attack the Liberals for racism is nauseating hypocrisy.
ex.cn: 他们攻击自由党搞种族歧视是令人作呕的虚伪行径。

def: n.假设，假说,[逻]前提

ex.en: The results confirmed his hypothesis on the use of modal verbs.
ex.cn: 结果证实了他的关于情态动词用法的假设.

ex.en: Her study is based on the hypothesis that language simplification is possible.
ex.cn: 她的研究基于语言可以简化这样一个假说.

ex.en: We have proved the hypothesis.
ex.cn: 我们已经证明了这种假设.

def: n.身份,[逻]同一性,个性,[数]恒等（式）

ex.en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
ex.cn: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

ex.en: They are a lost generation in search of an identity.
ex.cn: 他们属于迷惘的一代，想要找寻自我。

ex.en: There are conflicting reports about the identity of the hostage.
ex.cn: 有关人质身份的报道相互矛盾。

def: n.无知，愚昧,蒙

ex.en: Ignorance of people brings fear, fear of the unknown.
ex.cn: 人们的无知会带来恐惧，对未知事物的恐惧。

ex.en: Her ignorance of the area put her at a decided disadvantage.
ex.cn: 她对该地区一无所知，这显然对她不利。

ex.en: I was alarmed by his naivety and ignorance of international affairs.
ex.cn: 他对国际事务缺乏经验且无知，这很让我吃惊。

def:
vt.照亮，照明,阐明，说明,装饰,使灿烂
vi.照亮

ex.en: Our interesting teacher could illuminate almost any subject we studied.
ex.cn: 我们这位有趣的老师几乎能解释清楚我们所学的所有科目.

ex.en: We illuminate the enemy plane with searchlights in order to shoot at it.
ex.cn: 我们用探照灯照射敌机为的是向其射击.

ex.en: They use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.
ex.cn: 他们用游戏和图画来阐明他们的主题。

def: n.错觉,幻想,错误观念,假象

ex.en: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
ex.cn: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

ex.en: She laboured under the illusion that I knew what I was doing.
ex.cn: 她有一个错觉，以为我知道自己在做什么。

ex.en: This eerie calm is an illusion.
ex.cn: 这种怪诞的平静是一种假象。

def: vt.模仿，效仿,仿造，伪造

ex.en: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
ex.cn: 他能模仿大多数自己崇拜的偶像的讲话和写作风格。

ex.en: I'd make fun of her dress and imitate her speech.
ex.cn: 我会拿她的衣着开玩笑，并模仿她说话。

ex.en: Some parrots can imitate sounds and repeat words and sentences.
ex.cn: 有些鹦鹉能模仿(人的)声音,还能学人说一些单词和句子.

def:
n.模仿，仿效,仿制品,赝品,[生]拟态
adj.人造的,仿制的

ex.en: He gave his imitation of Queen Elizabeth's royal wave.
ex.cn: 他模仿伊丽莎白女王挥手致意。

ex.en: It's not real leather; it's only an imitation.
ex.cn: 那不是真皮, 只不过是仿制品.

ex.en: Young children learn how to speak by imitation.
ex.cn: 儿童通过模仿学说话.

def: adj.极大的，巨大的,浩瀚的，无边际的,〈口〉非常好的,弘道

ex.en: I'd seen it before in people who held immense power.
ex.cn: 我以前曾在掌握大权的人身上看到过这种情况。

ex.en: We are not in this to reap immense financial rewards.
ex.cn: 我们从事这一行不是为了获得巨大的经济回报。

ex.en: He said he retained immense regard and esteem for the prime minister.
ex.cn: 他说他一直极其尊重和敬仰首相。

def: n.动力,促进,势头,声势

ex.en: This is the primary impetus behind the economic recovery.
ex.cn: 这是促使经济复苏的主要动力.

ex.en: The treaty gave a fresh impetus to trade.
ex.cn: 这条约使双方的贸易又推进了一步.

ex.en: Children need an impetus to study.
ex.cn: 儿童学习需要动力.

def: adj.给人印象深刻的，感人的,引人注目的,可观的,显赫

ex.en: India while not racking up such an impressive score beat Japan 3-0.
ex.cn: 印度尽管没有大胜，却也以3比0击败了日本。

ex.en: He was well-built, but too fleshy to be impressive.
ex.cn: 他肌肉发达，但是太胖了，没给人留下好印象。

ex.en: The thoroughness of the evaluation process we went through was impressive.
ex.cn: 我们亲历的评估过程面面俱到，给人留下了深刻印象。

def: n.发生率,影响范围,[数]关联，接合,[物]入射，入射角

ex.en: an area with a high incidence of crime
ex.cn: 犯罪率高的地区

ex.en: This area has a high incidence of crime, disease, unemployment, etc.
ex.cn: 这个地区的犯罪率 、 发病率 、 失业率等很高.

ex.en: The report analyses the incidence of cancer among people aged 0 - 24.
ex.cn: 这份报告分析了从0 岁 到24岁的人的癌症发病率.

def: adv.顺便,偶然地，不经意地,附带,捎带

ex.en: "I didn'task you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
ex.cn: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么过来？”

ex.en: Incidentally, have you heard the news about Sue?
ex.cn: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？

ex.en: Incidentally, I think you still owe me some money.
ex.cn: 顺便说一句, 我想你还欠我一些钱.

def:
n.索引,<数>指数,指示,标志
vt.给…编索引,把…编入索引,[经济学]按生活指数调整（工资、价格等）
vi.[机械学]转位

ex.en: The FT 30 share index was up 16.4 points to 1,599.6.
ex.cn: 《金融时报》30股指上涨16.4点，收于1,559.6点。

ex.en: The index is the government's chief gauge of future economic activity.
ex.cn: 这一指数是政府判断未来经济活动的主要依据。

ex.en: He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.
ex.cn: 他右手食指骨裂。

def: adj.室内的，户内的,在室内使用的,待在家里的,救济院内的

ex.en: If the weather is wet or cold choose an indoor activity.
ex.cn: 如果碰上下雨天或是严寒天气，就选择一项室内活动。

ex.en: Earlier, it had been hoped to use the indoor track.
ex.cn: 之前曾经希望能使用室内跑道。

ex.en: an indoor swimming pool
ex.cn: 室内游泳池

def: n.<物>惯性，惰性,迟钝,不活动

ex.en: I can't seem to throw off this feeling of inertia.
ex.cn: 我好像无法摆脱这种无力的感觉。

ex.en: We had a feeling of inertia in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 下午我们感觉很懒.

ex.en: Inertia carried the plane onto the ground.
ex.cn: 飞机靠惯性着陆.

def: n.基础设施,基础建设

ex.en: The infrastructure, from hotels to transport, is old and decrepit.
ex.cn: 从宾馆到交通，所有的基础设施都已陈旧失修。

ex.en: Japanese proprietors are erecting a complex infrastructure of political influence throughout America.
ex.cn: 日本商人正在美国各地建立复杂的、具有政治影响力的基础结构。

ex.en: Vast sums are needed to maintain the infrastructure.
ex.cn: 保养基础设施需要巨额款项.

def: n.伤害，损害,受伤处,伤害的行为

ex.en: The victim suffered a dreadful injury and lost a lot of blood.
ex.cn: 受害者受了重伤，大量失血。

ex.en: He made a remarkable recovery from a shin injury.
ex.cn: 他的胫骨伤恢复得相当不错。

ex.en: He needed surgery to cure a troublesome back injury.
ex.cn: 他需要做手术来治好烦人的背伤。

def:
adj.内地的，内陆的,国内的
adv.向内地，在内地,向内陆，在内陆
n.内地，内陆,国内

ex.en: There are interesting hikes inland, but most ramblers stick to the clifftops.
ex.cn: 内陆地区有一些很有意思的徒步远足路线，但多数徒步者都去爬悬崖陡壁。

ex.en: Wind caught the sudden puff of dust and blew it inland.
ex.cn: 风猛地刮起一阵灰尘，将它吹往内陆。

ex.en: In the Balearics pockets of rural life and inland villages are undisturbed.
ex.cn: 在巴利阿里群岛上，零星散布在岛内的村庄和那里的生活平静而祥和。

def:
n.小旅馆，客栈,小饭店，小酒馆
vi.住旅馆

ex.en: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
ex.cn: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总有种宾至如归的感觉。

ex.en: The inn gift shop stocks quality Indian crafts and sundries.
ex.cn: 旅馆的礼品店里备有上好的印度手工艺品和其他一些特色礼品。

ex.en: A shuttle bus runs frequently between the Inn and the Country Club.
ex.cn: 一辆区间公交车频繁地往返于这家旅馆和那个乡村俱乐部。

def:
adj.内部的，内心的,精神的,秘密的
n.内部，里面,射中接近靶心部分的一发

ex.en: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems.
ex.cn: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。

ex.en: Once outside the inner breakwater, we began to unfurl all the sails.
ex.cn: 一驶出内防波堤，我们就扬起了所有的船帆。

ex.en: When he heard these words, Shinran felt his inner doubts melt away.
ex.cn: 听到这番话，欣兰感到他内心的疑虑顿时消散了。

def:
adj.无辜的，无罪的,清白的,天真无邪的,无知的
n.无辜者,头脑简单的人,天真无邪的人

ex.en: He was innocent and the victim of a frame-up.
ex.cn: 他是清白的，是受人诬陷的。

ex.en: Under all the innocent fun, there are hidden dangers, especially for children.
ex.cn: 在所有简单无害的娱乐项目背后都隐藏着危险，特别是对儿童而言。

ex.en: Both groups on either side are just picking off innocent bystanders.
ex.cn: 对峙双方都只是在瞄准射击无辜的旁观者。

def: adj.无数的，数不清的,指不胜屈,不可胜数,无可胜数

ex.en: Innumerable books have been written on the subject.
ex.cn: 已经有无数书籍写过这个主题。

ex.en: The innumerable stars in the sky are too far from us.
ex.cn: 天上无数的星星离我们太远了.

ex.en: In the endless flow of absolute truth there are innumerable relative truths.
ex.cn: 在绝对真理的长河中有无数相对真理.

def:
n.输入，投入,输入电路,<电>输入端,输入的数据
vt.把…输入电脑,[自][电子] 输入,输入，给料

ex.en: The Ministry of Agriculture commissioned a study into low-input farming.
ex.cn: 农业部委托对低投入耕作进行研究。

ex.en: Edit the input text and re-run the software.
ex.cn: 修改输入的文本，重新运行软件。

ex.en: We're getting input from gobs of sources.
ex.cn: 我们从多方渠道得到信息。

def: n.灵感,鼓舞人心的人或事,启发灵感的人（或事物）,吸气

ex.en: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions.
ex.cn: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

ex.en: His inspiration to fly came even before he joined the Army.
ex.cn: 他想开飞机的念头在参军之前就有了。

ex.en: He is a witty man, and an inspiration to all of us.
ex.cn: 他机智风趣，鼓舞激励着我们所有人。

def: adj.瞬间的,即刻的,猝发的

ex.en: Death was instantaneous because both bullets hit the heart.
ex.cn: 因为两颗子弹都击中了心脏，所以死亡是瞬间发生的。

ex.en: His hospitality was instantaneous and all-embracing.
ex.cn: 无论何时无论对谁他都是很好客的。

ex.en: Death was almost instantaneous.
ex.cn: 当时生命垂危。

def: adj.乐器的,仪器的,有帮助的,起作用的

ex.en: The last track on the CD is an instrumental.
ex.cn: CD上的最后一支曲目是一首器乐曲。

ex.en: Jesse Jackson was instrumental in the release of some of the hostages.
ex.cn: 其中一些人质得以获释多亏了杰西·杰克逊。

ex.en: He was instrumental in bringing about an end to the conflict.
ex.cn: 他在终止冲突的过程中起了重要作用。

def: vt.侮辱，凌辱,辱骂,损害

ex.en: She spat the name out like an insult.
ex.cn: 她像骂人似的说出了那个名字。

ex.en: Forgive me, I don't mean to insult you.
ex.cn: 请原谅，我并非有意侮辱你。

ex.en: He felt the smart of their insult for many days.
ex.cn: 他受到他们的侮辱后好多天都感到难受.

def: n.正直，诚实,完整,[计算机]保存,健全

ex.en: He inspires affection and respect as a man of unquestionable integrity.
ex.cn: 他无可争议的忠诚正直赢得了人们的爱戴和尊敬。

ex.en: Separatist movements are a threat to the integrity of the nation.
ex.cn: 分离主义运动对国家统一是个威胁。

ex.en: This is yet another slur on the integrity of the Metropolitan Police.
ex.cn: 这是对伦敦市警察局刚正廉明作风的又一次诽谤。

def:
adj.加强的，强烈的,[农]精耕细作的,[语]加强语意的,（农业方法）集约的
n.加强器,[语]强义词，强调成份

ex.en: She spent the night in intensive care after the operation.
ex.cn: 手术后的那个夜晚她在重症监护病房度过。

ex.en: Boren surprisingly led off the most intensive line of questioning today.
ex.cn: 博伦今天出人意料地一上来就开始连珠炮似地盘问起来。

ex.en: There have been intensive discussions between the two governments in recent days.
ex.cn: 近几天，双方政府一直在进行紧张的磋商。

def: n.干涉，干扰，冲突,介入,妨碍，打扰，阻碍物,冲突，抵触

ex.en: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs.
ex.cn: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

ex.en: It is hard to imagine her taking kindly to too much interference.
ex.cn: 很难想象她会喜欢被人过多地干涉。

ex.en: They have been accused of deliberately causing interference to transmissions.
ex.cn: 他们被指故意干扰信号传输。

def: adj.间歇的,，断断续续的,间歇性

ex.en: intermittent bursts of applause
ex.cn: 一阵阵的掌声

ex.en: Did you hear the intermittent sound outside?
ex.cn: 你听见外面时断时续的声音了 吗 ?

ex.en: It's a cold night here, with intermittent rain showers and a blustery wind.
ex.cn: 呆在这儿的那天晚上很冷，阵雨不断，还刮着大风。

def:
vt.& vi.打断（别人的话等）,阻止,截断
vt.暂停,中断,打扰,妨碍
vi.打断
n.中断,暂停

ex.en: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. "Sorry to interrupt, Colonel."
ex.cn: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下，上校。”

ex.en: "If I may interrupt for a moment," Kenneth said.
ex.cn: “能打搅一下吗，”肯尼思说。

ex.en: Taller plants interrupt the views from the house.
ex.cn: 稍高些的植物遮挡了房内的视线。

def: n.入侵，侵略,侵害，侵犯,侵袭,[医]发病

ex.en: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers.
ex.cn: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

ex.en: The secrecy and swiftness of the invasion shocked and amazed army officers.
ex.cn: 这次入侵的隐秘和迅速令陆军军官们大为震惊。

ex.en: There was a peaceful pitch invasion after Milan's eighth goal.
ex.cn: 米兰队攻入第八粒进球后，观众有序地涌进球场。

def:
adj.看不见的,不易为视线所见的，隐匿的,无形的（指银行、旅游等服务）,不引人注目的
n.看不见的人

ex.en: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
ex.cn: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。

ex.en: The invisible trade surplus was £200 million lower than reported.
ex.cn: 无形贸易盈余比报道所称的少2亿英镑。

ex.en: The container is invisible until you shine an ultraviolet light on it.
ex.cn: 那个柜子只有用紫外线照射才可以看见。

def: n.招待，邀请,请柬，请帖,引诱，吸引，诱惑

ex.en: "I can't pass this up." She waved the invitation.
ex.cn: “我不能错过这个机会，”她挥舞着请帖说。

ex.en: Elizabeth had a standing invitation to stay with her.
ex.cn: 伊丽莎白受到邀请，可以随时去她家住。

ex.en: I visited Japan in 1987 at the invitation of the Foreign Minister.
ex.cn: 应日本外相的邀请，我于1987年访问了日本。

def:
n.反语,讽刺，冷嘲,具有讽刺意味的事,[语]反语法
adj.铁的,似铁的,含铁的

ex.en: There is a delicious irony in all this.
ex.cn: 这一切中包含了一种绝妙的讽刺。

ex.en: The phrase is loaded with irony.
ex.cn: 此语满含讽刺意味。

ex.en: She said to him with slight irony.
ex.cn: 她略带嘲讽地对他说.

def: adj.不考虑的，不顾的,无关的

ex.en: Everyone is treated equally, irrespective of race.
ex.cn: 不分种族，每个人都受到公平对待。

ex.en: He is going to buy it irrespective of what you say.
ex.cn: 不管你说什么,他是买定了.

ex.en: He is going to buy it, irrespective of what you say.
ex.cn: 不管你说什么，他是买定了。

def:
vt.灌溉,冲洗（伤口）,使清新
vi.灌溉,冲洗

ex.en: He also wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
ex.cn: 他也想用这些水灌溉荒漠。

ex.en: The farmer dug several trenches to irrigate the rice fields.
ex.cn: 这个农民挖了好几条沟以灌溉稻田.

ex.en: They have built canals to irrigate the desert.
ex.cn: 他们建造成水渠以灌溉沙漠.

def: adj.妒忌的,羡慕的,精心守护的,吃醋的

ex.en: I worked myself into frenzy plotting ways to make him jealous.
ex.cn: 我绞尽脑汁，处心积虑，就是为了让他嫉妒。

ex.en: Pattie shot Tom in a fit of jealous rage.
ex.cn: 帕蒂妒火中烧，开枪击中了汤姆。

ex.en: I would be insanely jealous if Bill left me for another woman.
ex.cn: 如果比尔为了别的女人离开我，我会妒忌得发疯的。

def: n.牛仔裤,瘦腿紧身裤

ex.en: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger.
ex.cn: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

ex.en: His mother looked ten years younger in jeans and flats.
ex.cn: 他妈妈穿上牛仔裤和平跟鞋，看上去年轻了10岁。

ex.en: He peered at me like I'd just puked up on his jeans.
ex.cn: 他打量着我，好像我刚刚吐在了他的牛仔裤上似的。

def: n.<美>珠宝，首饰

ex.en: I spend a lot on expensive jewelry and clothing.
ex.cn: 我花很多钱购买昂贵的首饰和衣服。

ex.en: Jewelry and lace are mostly feminine belongings.
ex.cn: 珠宝和花边多数是女性用品.

ex.en: In her early fifties, she wears tons of jewelry.
ex.cn: 她50出头, 全身是珠光宝气.

def: n.首饰，饰物,等于jewelry,珍宝

ex.en: "It's a nice piece of jewellery though, isn't it?"
ex.cn: “可这是一件漂亮的首饰，不是吗？”

ex.en: A thousand pounds worth of jewellery and silver has been stolen.
ex.cn: 价值1,000英镑的珠宝和银饰被盗。

ex.en: The insurance company paid out for the stolen jewellery and silver.
ex.cn: 保险公司赔付了遭窃的珠宝和银器。

def:
adj.共同的，联合的,共享的,两院的,连带的，共同的
n.[解]关节,接合处,下流场所,一块烤肉（英式英语）
vt.结合，联合,为…装上接头，使…有接缝

ex.en: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
ex.cn: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

ex.en: They had come to the world's most famous pick-up joint.
ex.cn: 他们来到了全世界最有名的寻花问柳之地。

ex.en: She and Frank had never gotten around to opening a joint account.
ex.cn: 她和弗兰克还没有抽出时间去开联名账户。

def: n.连接，接合,会合点，接合点,（公路或铁路的）交叉路口,（电缆等的）主结点

ex.en: There's a good British Rail link at Clapham Junction.
ex.cn: 在克拉珀姆枢纽站有条很不错的英国铁路线。

ex.en: Leave the M1 at junction 25.
ex.cn: 在25号交叉路口驶离1号高速公路。

ex.en: The road ended at a T-junction.
ex.cn: 道路的尽头是一个丁字路口。

def:
adj.较年幼的，较年小的,三年级的，低年级的,资历较浅的,后进的
n.年少者，青少年,晚辈,三年级生,职位较低者

ex.en: She now lives with actor Denis Lawson, 10 years her junior.
ex.cn: 她现在与比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

ex.en: The vacant W.B.C. junior-lightweight title has been called off.
ex.cn: 空缺的世界拳击理事会次轻量级头衔被取消了。

ex.en: Our doctor diagnosed a throat infection and prescribed antibiotic and junior aspirin.
ex.cn: 我们的医生诊断是喉部感染，并且开了一些抗生素和小剂量阿司匹林。

def:
adj.少年的,幼稚的，年少无知的,幼稚的
n.青少年,扮演少年角色的演员,少年读物,羽毛未丰的鸟，雏鸟

ex.en: an increase in juvenile delinquency
ex.cn: 青少年犯罪的增加

ex.en: Don't be so juvenile!
ex.cn: 别那么孩子气！

ex.en: For a grown man he acted in a very juvenile manner.
ex.cn: 身为成年人,他的行为举止显得十分幼稚.

def: n.王国,界,领域

ex.en: It was infamous as a kingdom of brigands, scoundrels, and slave-traders.
ex.cn: 该地区因土匪、无赖和奴隶贩子猖獗而声名狼藉。

ex.en: This television program provoked a spirited debate in the United Kingdom.
ex.cn: 这个电视节目在英国引起了激烈的辩论。

ex.en: Roger Kingdom set the world record of 12.92 seconds.
ex.cn: 罗杰·金德姆创造了12.92秒的世界纪录。

def:
vi.走得极慢，落后
vt.落后于,给…加上外套,把…关进牢里,逮捕
n.滞后，（两事件之间的）时间间隔,囚犯,防护套,桶板

ex.en: There's a time lag between infection with HIV and developing AIDS.
ex.cn: 从感染艾滋病病毒到病发有一段滞后期。

ex.en: As conceit makes one lag behind, so modesty helps one make progress.
ex.cn: 骄傲使人落后, 谦虚使人进步.

ex.en: Ten minutes later, some of runners in the race began to lag.
ex.cn: 十分钟后, 有些参赛的人开始落后了.

def:
adj.侧面的,横向的,[语]边音的
n.侧部的东西,边音

ex.en: Jets of compressed air gave the aircraft lateral and directional stability.
ex.cn: 压缩空气的喷吐使飞机的左右和前后都能保持稳定。

ex.en: the lateral branches of a tree
ex.cn: 树的侧枝

ex.en: It may be caused by lack of compressive loads in the lateral trochanter in daily activity.
ex.cn: 这可能是由于日常活动减少导致外侧大转子的压力载荷减少。

def: n.草地，草坪,上等细麻布

ex.en: The windows overlooked a lawn of tall waving grass.
ex.cn: 窗户外边是一块草地，高高的草随风摇摆。

ex.en: He remembered mowing the lawn, lounging around the swimming pool.
ex.cn: 他还记得修剪草坪、在泳池边闲荡的情景。

ex.en: You can engage in croquet on the south lawn.
ex.cn: 你可以参加南边草坪上的槌球游戏。

def: n.停工，停止活动,临时解雇,操作停止,失业期

ex.en: His card joined the small pile of those spared from the layoff.
ex.cn: 他的登记卡被放到那一小叠免于被裁的人的卡片里面.

ex.en: But the layoff was fatal.
ex.cn: 没想到这一停竟成了致命伤.

ex.en: Remember firing is not the same as layoff or reduction in force.
ex.cn: 记得射击是不一样的裁员或削减部队.

def:
vi.漏出,透露,（指消息，秘密等）泄密,漏电，漏水
vt.使泄露,<非正式> 擅自公开
n.泄漏，漏洞,裂缝,漏出物,（俚语）撒尿

ex.en: The yacht has sprung a leak in the hull.
ex.cn: 帆船的船体上出现了一条裂缝。

ex.en: A hydrogen leak forced NASA to ground the space shuttle.
ex.cn: 氢气泄漏迫使美国国家航空航天局停止了航天飞机的发射。

ex.en: In May engineers found a leak in a hydrogen fuel line.
ex.cn: 5月份工程师们在一条氢燃料管线上发现一条裂隙。

def: n.传说,传奇人物,铭文,图例

ex.en: His pitching was a legend among major league hitters.
ex.cn: 他的投球在大联盟的击球员中是个传奇。

ex.en: He could not possibly have been poisoned as popular legend has it.
ex.cn: 他不可能像民间传说的那样被下了毒。

ex.en: He has become a legend in the annals of military history.
ex.cn: 他已成为军事史上的一个传奇。

def: n.自由,许可权,放肆，无礼,解放，释放

ex.en: He firmly believes liberty is inseparable from social justice.
ex.cn: 他坚信自由与社会正义是不可分的。

ex.en: I am afraid we are not at liberty to disclose that information.
ex.cn: 恐怕我们无权透露这一信息。

ex.en: The Puritans became fugitives in quest of liberty.
ex.cn: 清教徒变成了追求自由的逃亡者。

def: n.图书管理员,[计算机]库管理程序

ex.en: The old librarian illuminated some old books and manuscripts.
ex.cn: 这个老图书馆员把一些古书和旧抄稿加上各种装饰.

ex.en: His father is the librarian of our school library.
ex.cn: 他父亲是我们学校的图书馆馆长.

ex.en: The librarian entered a new book in the catalogue.
ex.cn: 图书管理员把一本新书编入目录.

def:
n.亚麻布，亚麻线,家庭日用织品
adj.亚麻的，亚麻布制的

ex.en: We're a bit low on bed linen. You'll have to make do.
ex.cn: 我们的床单有些次，您将就着用吧。

ex.en: Anna looked tanned and majestic in her linen caftan.
ex.cn: 安娜穿着亚麻长袍，衬出其棕色的皮肤，显得十分高贵。

ex.en: The bed linen is patterned in stylish checks, stripes, diagonals and triangles.
ex.cn: 床单有漂亮的方格形、条纹、斜纹和三角形图案。

def: vi.逗留，徘徊,缓慢消失

ex.en: When apartheid is over the maladies will linger on.
ex.cn: 废除了种族隔离政策后痼疾依然存在。

ex.en: Customers are welcome to linger over coffee until around midnight.
ex.cn: 客人尽可以喝着咖啡逗留到午夜左右。

ex.en: Don't linger away your holidays. Try to find something useful to do.
ex.cn: 不要虚度假日, 尽量找些有意义的事做.

def: adj.语言的,语言学的

ex.en: When a book goes into translation, all those linguistic subtleties get lost.
ex.cn: 当一部书被翻译成另一种语言后，所有那些语言上的精妙之处就都丢失了。

ex.en: Keep the conversation off linguistic matters.
ex.cn: 避谈语言学问题。

ex.en: linguistic and cultural barriers
ex.cn: 语言和文化上的障碍

def:
n.液体,流音
adj.液体的,清澈的,（声音）流畅的,易转换成现款的

ex.en: We found a cyst and I suctioned off the liquid within.
ex.cn: 我们发现了一个囊肿，我把其中的液体吸了出来。

ex.en: Some people moved in silky, liquid movements, others were jerky, probably drunk.
ex.cn: 一些人动作平稳流畅，其他人则跌跌撞撞，大概是喝醉了。

ex.en: The hot liquid splashed down on the concrete and rebounded.
ex.cn: 滚烫的液体泼在水泥地面上又溅了起来。

def:
n.酒，烈性酒,含酒精饮料
vt.浸泡,喝酒

ex.en: The federal government hiked the tax on hard liquor.
ex.cn: 联邦政府提高了烈性酒的税率。

ex.en: I saw what the liquor was doing to her.
ex.cn: 我发现烈酒对她伤害很大。

ex.en: They had liquor for the adults and sodas for the children.
ex.cn: 他们为大人准备了酒，为小孩准备了汽水。

def: n.识字,有文化,能读能写,精通文学

ex.en: Of course, literacy isn't the same thing as intelligence.
ex.cn: 当然，识字和智力是两码事。

ex.en: Political selection is more dependent on sophistry and less on economic literacy.
ex.cn: 政治选举更多地取决于诡辩的能力，而不在于是否懂经济。

ex.en: Six months later John had developed literacy and numeracy skills, plus confidence.
ex.cn: 6个月后，约翰已经渐渐能够识字和算数，也有了自信。

def:
n.贷款,借款,借用
vt.借，借给
vi.借出

ex.en: Now is the time to touch him for a loan.
ex.cn: 现在是向他借笔钱的时候了。

ex.en: The President is also expected to request a rescheduling of loan repayments.
ex.cn: 预计总统还会要求延长借款偿还期限。

ex.en: Frankly, Thomas, this question of your loan is beginning to worry me.
ex.cn: 老实讲，托马斯，你贷款的问题开始让我担心了。

def:
n.门厅，大厅,休息室,游说团,投票厅
vi.为了支持或抵制某项特定目标游说
vt.对…进行游说,陈情（试图努力影响某人采取有利行动）

ex.en: The union has attacked the plan and threatened to lobby against it.
ex.cn: 工会不但攻击该计划，而且还扬言要游说议员反对它。

ex.en: Council tenants around the country are planning a mass lobby of Parliament.
ex.cn: 全国各地的市政住房租户正在计划组建一个大的议会游说团。

ex.en: 3,000 city officials descended on Capitol Hill to lobby for more money.
ex.cn: 3,000名市政官员齐聚国会山，为筹集更多的款项进行游说。

def:
n.织布机，织布法,若隐若现的景象,桨柄,[航]翼肋腹部
vi.& link-v.朦胧出现
vi.隐约地出现,赫然耸现,迫在眉睫

ex.en: As such tensions increase, they loom larger in Russia's domestic politics.
ex.cn: 这种紧张关系的不断加剧使其在俄罗斯国内政治中愈发凸显。

ex.en: The old woman was weaving on her loom.
ex.cn: 那位老太太正在织布机上织布.

ex.en: He turned away from the messenger to work at his loom again.
ex.cn: 他撇下那两个捎口信的来者,又去织布.

def:
vt.解开或使松,放宽，放松,使（肠）通畅
vi.变松或变得更松

ex.en: Relax, smile; loosen up in mind and body and behaviour.
ex.cn: 放松，微笑。精神、身体和行为上都要放轻松。

ex.en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned.
ex.cn: 松一松插销，好转动门闩。

ex.en: Young people often loosen up on the dance floor.
ex.cn: 年轻人常在舞池中放松自己。

def:
n.主,领主,上帝,（英国用以称呼法官、主教或某些男性贵族成员，表示尊敬）大人
vi.逞威风

ex.en: "Good lord, that's what he is: he's a policeman."
ex.cn: “我的天哪，他原来是警察呀。”

ex.en: A few days earlier he had received a telegram from Lord Lloyd.
ex.cn: 几天前，他收到劳埃德勋爵发来的一封电报。

ex.en: His nine-month sentence was overturned by Appeal Court judge Lord Justice Watkins.
ex.cn: 上诉法院法官沃特金斯撤销了对他作出的9个月徒刑的判决。

def: n.彩票,碰运气的事

ex.en: Imagine winning the local lottery first prize of £5,000.
ex.cn: 想象一下中个5,000英镑的当地彩票头奖吧。

ex.en: She bought a lottery ticket and won more than $33 million.
ex.cn: 她买了张彩票，中了3,300多万美元。

ex.en: He won no less than ￡5000 in the lottery.
ex.cn: 他居然中了5000英镑的奖券.

def:
n.休息厅,客厅,（机场等的）等候室
vi.闲逛,懒洋洋地躺
vt.懒洋洋地打发（时间）,虚度光阴

ex.en: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
ex.cn: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

ex.en: Let's meet in the cocktail lounge at the Hilton.
ex.cn: 我们在希尔顿酒店的酒吧间碰头吧。

ex.en: Clara had been reading in a lounge chair under a shady tree.
ex.cn: 克拉拉一直坐在树阴下的躺椅上看书。

def:
adj.忠诚的，忠心的,忠贞的
n.效忠的臣民,忠实信徒

ex.en: I thanked them for their long and loyal service.
ex.cn: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。

ex.en: He has 20 years of loyal service to Barclays Bank behind him.
ex.cn: 他已经忠心耿耿地为巴克莱银行效力了20年。

ex.en: She was caustically brilliant, yet totally loyal, unpretentious, human and tolerant.
ex.cn: 她这个人才气逼人，可是绝对忠诚可靠，而且毫不做作，有人情味和宽容心。

def:
n.块，团,肿块,许多，大量,笨拙的人
vi.结成块,成团,笨重地行走
vt.使成团，使成块,使团结在一起,把…混在一起
adj.成团的，成块的
adv.很，非常

ex.en: They used to buy ten kilos of beef in one lump.
ex.cn: 他们过去常买10公斤重的整块牛肉。

ex.en: Howard had to have cancer surgery for a lump in his chest.
ex.cn: 霍华德不得不进行肿瘤手术以切除胸部的肿块。

ex.en: a lump of gristle
ex.cn: 一块软骨

def:
n.吸引力，魅力,诱惑物,诱饵
vt.吸引，引诱,用引诱物召回（猎鹰）

ex.en: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.
ex.cn: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。

ex.en: The company aims to lure smokers back to cigarettes.
ex.cn: 该公司旨在把吸烟人士诱回到香烟上来。

ex.en: the lure of filthy lucre
ex.cn: 不义之财的诱惑

def:
n.奢侈，豪华,奢侈品，美食，美衣,乐趣，享受,不常有的乐趣（或享受、优势）
adj.奢华的，豪华的

ex.en: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
ex.cn: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

ex.en: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.
ex.cn: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。

ex.en: He rode on the president's luxury train through his own state.
ex.cn: 他乘坐总统的豪华列车经过自己所在的州。

def: adj.有磁性的，有吸引力的,磁性的,有吸引力的,有魅力的

ex.en: The secondary current sets up a magnetic field inside the tube.
ex.cn: 二次电流在管子内部会产生磁场。

ex.en: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
ex.cn: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

ex.en: Her glacial beauty is magnetic.
ex.cn: 她冷若冰霜的美令人倾倒。

def: n.女仆，侍女,少女,处女，未婚女子

ex.en: The maid looked at him, a nervous smile on her face.
ex.cn: 女服务员看着他，脸上带着一丝局促不安的微笑。
