ex.en: They had a butler, a cook, and a maid.
ex.cn: 他们有一个男管家、一个厨师和一个女佣。

ex.en: I sent him a long fax, saying I didn't need a maid.
ex.cn: 我给他发了一份很长的传真，说我不需要女仆。

def:
n.大陆,本土
adj.大陆的,本土的

ex.en: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
ex.cn: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

ex.en: She was going to Nanaimo to catch the ferry to the mainland.
ex.cn: 她准备去纳奈莫乘渡船回大陆。

ex.en: Ischia was now connected to the mainland water supply.
ex.cn: 伊斯基亚这时已经通上了大陆的水。

def:
n.手稿,原稿,底稿,手写本
adj.手写的，手抄的

ex.en: These odd assertions were interpolated into the manuscript some time after 1400.
ex.cn: 这些奇怪的论断是于1400年后的某个时间被加入手稿的。

ex.en: The manuscript had already been sent off to the printers.
ex.cn: 原稿已经寄给印刷厂了。

ex.en: The finished manuscript ran to the best part of fifty double-sided pages.
ex.cn: 完成的手稿占了双面都写满字的足足50页纸。

def:
n.边缘，范围,极限,利润，盈余,（版心外）的空白
vt.留边,成为…的边,加边于，围绕,为…加旁注

ex.en: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
ex.cn: 去年，这个集团的纯利润率为30%。

ex.en: The Sunday Times remains the brand leader by a huge margin.
ex.cn: 《星期日泰晤士报》仍以巨大的优势稳居报业龙头的地位。

ex.en: They could end up with a 50-point winning margin.
ex.cn: 他们最终可能会以50分的优势获胜。

def:
adj.海的,海产的,海军的,海事的
n.水兵,海军陆战队士兵,海事，海运业

ex.en: The phosphate was deposited by the decay of marine microorganisms.
ex.cn: 海洋微生物腐烂后沉积形成磷酸盐。

ex.en: Marine insurance is governed by a strict series of rules and regulations.
ex.cn: 关于海险有一系列严格的规章制度对其作了规定。

ex.en: Bezanik is diving to collect marine organisms.
ex.cn: 贝扎尼奇正在潜水采集海洋生物。

def:
adj.男子气概的,阳性的，雄性的,男性化的，像男人的
n.[语]阳性,阳性词,男性

ex.en: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine.
ex.cn: 在多数语言中，形容词的阳性和阴性的拼法略为不同。

ex.en: Andrew describes her as a large, bony and masculine woman.
ex.cn: 安德鲁说她是一个瘦骨嶙峋、男人模样的大块头女人。

ex.en: He was handsome and strong, and very masculine.
ex.cn: 他英俊强壮，富有男子汉气概。

def:
n.面具,假面具,用作掩饰的事物,护肤膜
vt.掩饰,戴面具,用面具遮住，掩盖，掩饰
vi.戴面具,隐瞒，掩饰

ex.en: But as with other charitable bodies, these figures mask the true picture.
ex.cn: 但和其他慈善机构一样，这些数字掩盖了实情。

ex.en: This mask leaves your complexion feeling soft and supple.
ex.cn: 这种面膜能使你的皮肤变得柔软细嫩。

ex.en: Diane lit a cigarette, trying to mask her agitation.
ex.cn: 黛安娜点燃一根香烟，试图掩饰她的焦躁不安。

def:
n.大屠杀，残杀,（牲畜的）成批屠宰
vt.屠杀，残杀,损害，毁坏,<口>彻底击败,<口>惨败

ex.en: The massacre laid bare the moral bankruptcy of the regime.
ex.cn: 大屠杀使该政权的道德沦丧暴露无遗。

ex.en: In March 1770, there occurred what became known as the Boston Massacre.
ex.cn: 1770年3月在那里发生了后来闻名的波士顿惨案。

ex.en: Most of them had only heard of the massacre at second hand.
ex.cn: 他们中的大多数人只是听说了那次大屠杀。

def:
n.（工人间的）伙伴，同事，老兄，老弟〔工人，水手间的亲密称呼〕,配偶〔男女任何一方〕，动物之偶（尤指鸟类），（一对中的）一只，配对物,[医学]（军医等的）助手,[航海]（商船的）大副，驾驶员
vt.& vi.（使）成为配偶,（使）交配,（一对动物或鸟）交配,交尾(~ with sth)

ex.en: "How are you, mate?" — "Not bad, mate, how's yourself?"
ex.cn: “最近怎么样，老兄？”——“还不错，你呢？”

ex.en: They want the males to mate with wild females.
ex.cn: 他们希望这些雄性动物可以和野生的雌性动物交配。

ex.en: Kathy is a great mate, we are like sisters.
ex.cn: 凯茜是个很好的伙伴，我们亲如姐妹。

def: adj.中古的，中世纪的

ex.en: The house is a textbook example of medieval domestic architecture.
ex.cn: 这所房子是典型的中世纪民居。

ex.en: The East Window is a wonder of medieval glazing.
ex.cn: 东窗是中世纪玻璃安装工艺的奇迹。

ex.en: I had thought this was a medieval torture that had mercifully disappeared.
ex.cn: 我还以为这是中世纪的酷刑,早已令人庆幸地不复存在了.

def:
n.威胁,恐吓
vt.&vi.威胁,恐吓

ex.en: The European states retained a latent capability to menace Britain's own security.
ex.cn: 欧洲国家仍具有威胁英国自身安全的潜在能力。

ex.en: There is a pervading sense of menace.
ex.cn: 有一种危机四伏的感觉。

ex.en: You're a menace to my privacy, Kenworthy.
ex.cn: 肯沃西，你这人真讨厌，居然侵犯我的隐私。

def: n.[化]汞，水银,[天]水星,温度表,精神，元气

ex.en: That night the mercury fell to thirty degrees below zero.
ex.cn: 那天晚上温度计显示气温降到了零下30度。

ex.en: Freddie Mercury was a flamboyant star of the British hard rock scene.
ex.cn: 弗雷迪·摩克瑞是英国硬摇滚乐界一颗耀眼的明星。

ex.en: What's the chemical symbol for mercury?
ex.cn: 汞的化学元素符号是什么？

def: n.宽容,怜悯,幸运,侥幸

ex.en: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
ex.cn: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

ex.en: Ordinary people are at the mercy of faceless bureaucrats.
ex.cn: 普通人的命运任凭那些平庸刻板的官僚们摆布。

ex.en: They meant to finish her off, swiftly and without mercy.
ex.cn: 他们打算毫不留情地迅速结果了她。

def:
n.中部，中间，当中
prep.在…中间（等于amidst）
adv.在中间，在中央

ex.en: She stood preening in their midst, delighted with the attention.
ex.cn: 她得意洋洋地站在他们中间，为受人瞩目而高兴。

ex.en: We're lucky to have such a man in our midst.
ex.cn: 在我们中间有这样一个人是我们的幸运。

ex.en: In the midst of his feelings of impotence, a comforting thought arrived.
ex.cn: 正在他觉得很无奈的时候，一个令人欣慰的想法冒了出来。

def:
vi.迁移，移往,移动,随季节而移居
vt.使移居,使移植

ex.en: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
ex.cn: 人们为找工作而迁移到雅加达这类城市里。

ex.en: Swallows migrate south in winter.
ex.cn: 燕子在冬天迁徙到南方。

ex.en: These birds migrate northwards in spring and southwards in fall.
ex.cn: 这些鸟春天向北迁徙,秋天向南迁徙.

def:
adj.斗志昂扬的，富于战斗性的,激进的，好战的,战斗中的，交战中的,好斗者
n.激进分子，好斗分子,富有战斗精神的人，斗士

ex.en: The fiery right-wing leader toned down his militant statements after the meeting.
ex.cn: 言辞激烈的右翼领袖在会后收敛了他的好战言论。

ex.en: They have already been accused of appeasement by more militant organisations.
ex.cn: 已有更多的好战组织谴责他们采取姑息态度。

ex.en: The party threw out the Trotskyist Militant Tendency.
ex.cn: 该党开除了托洛茨基主义的激进派。

def: adj.悲惨的,令人痛苦的,太少的,卑鄙的

ex.en: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul.
ex.cn: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。

ex.en: There was nothing at all in this miserable place to distract him.
ex.cn: 这个鬼地方根本没有什么东西可以让他分心。

ex.en: Our speed over the ground was a miserable 2.2 knots.
ex.cn: 我们在接近地面时的航速仅为2.2节。

def: n.不幸,厄运,不幸的事,灾难

ex.en: He has known great misfortune in his life.
ex.cn: 他一生中经历过巨大的不幸。

ex.en: Some of my friends estranged themselves from me in my misfortune.
ex.cn: 我倒霉时,有些朋友就疏远了我.

ex.en: He had sympathy with those who were brought low by misfortune.
ex.cn: 对于那些因不幸而陷入贫困的人们他表示了同情.

def:
adj.有节制的,稳健的，温和的,适度的，中等的,<美俚>慢吞吞的
vt.使和缓,主持,节制
vi.变缓和,作主持人

ex.en: Futures prices recovered from sharp early declines to end with moderate losses.
ex.cn: 期货价格在早盘深幅下跌后出现反弹，收盘时未见严重损失。

ex.en: There were three moderate climbs to just below the 450 feet contour.
ex.cn: 刚好在450英尺的等高线之下有3个缓坡。

ex.en: The new centre-right government's radical objectives are often couched in moderate terms.
ex.cn: 新的中右翼政府经常以温和的语言表述其激进的目标。

def: n.现代化,现代化事物

ex.en: Successful agricultural reform is also a sine qua non of Mexico's modernisation.
ex.cn: 成功的农业改革也是墨西哥实现现代化的必要条件。

ex.en: The house was in need of modernisation when they bought it.
ex.cn: 他们买下时，这栋房子需要进行现代化改造。

ex.en: Custom forbids any modernisation.
ex.cn: 传统习惯阻碍着现代化的进程。

def: n.现代化，现代化的事物

ex.en: The modernization of the industry was phased over at 20 - year period.
ex.cn: 工业现代化分20年逐步实现.

ex.en: The railways have been deprived of the money they need for modernization.
ex.cn: 铁路系统被剥夺了那笔需要用于现代化的拨款.

ex.en: Modernization is the key to speed up our agricultural development.
ex.cn: 现代化是加快农业发展的关键.

def: n.分子,微小颗粒

ex.en: So tell me what this molecule does that makes it special.
ex.cn: 那么告诉我这个分子有何作用而使其与众不同。

ex.en: The chemical structure of this particular molecule is very unusual.
ex.cn: 这个特殊分子的化学结构很不寻常。

ex.en: A molecule of water consists of two atoms of hydrogen and one atom of oxygen.
ex.cn: 水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

def: adj.货币的，金钱的,钱的（尤指一国的金融）,金融的,财政的，财政（上）的

ex.en: The grand design of Europe's monetary union is already agreed.
ex.cn: 欧洲统一货币的宏伟构想已经获得认同。

ex.en: Domestic conditions did not justify a loosening of monetary policy.
ex.cn: 国内的情况并不足以成为放松货币政策的正当理由。

ex.en: U.S. authorities have not yet indicated their monetary policy plans.
ex.cn: 美国当局尚未透露他们的货币政策计划。

def:
vt.& vi.登上,骑上
vi.增加,上升
vt.安装，架置,镶嵌，嵌入,准备上演,成立（军队等）
n.山峰,攀，登,运载工具,底座

ex.en: America has enough firepower in the area to mount sustained air strikes.
ex.cn: 美国在该地区拥有足够的火力发动持续的空中打击。

ex.en: Mount Unzen has been spewing out volcanic ash, gas, and rock today.
ex.cn: 云仙山今天一直在向外喷涌火山灰、气体和火山岩。

ex.en: Mount Marcy is the highest mountain in the Adirondacks.
ex.cn: 马西山是阿迪朗达克山脉中最高的山。

def:
vt.& vi.乘,（使）相乘,（使）增加,（使）繁殖
adv.多样地,复合地,多倍地,[电学]并联地，多路地
adj.多层的,多样的,多股的

ex.en: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12.
ex.cn: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。

ex.en: Take the average of those ratios and multiply by a hundred.
ex.cn: 算出那些比率的平均值再乘以100。

ex.en: The children are already learning to multiply and divide.
ex.cn: 孩子们已经开始学习乘法和除法了。

def:
adj.市的，市政的,地方自治的,都市的，市营的，市制的,内政的
n.市政债券

ex.en: The decor was reminiscent of a municipal arts-and-leisure centre.
ex.cn: 这种布置让人想起都市里的艺术休闲中心。

ex.en: The municipal authorities have kept the roads up well.
ex.cn: 市政当局把道路保养得不错.

ex.en: The city is planning to build a municipal library.
ex.cn: 该市正计划建一座市立图书馆.

def:
adj.缄默的,哑的,无声的,（字母）不发音的
n.哑巴,（乐器上的）弱音器
vt.减轻（声音）,使…柔和

ex.en: He sat mute, speechless with ecstasy, gazing into the sky.
ex.cn: 他静静坐着，凝视天空，一言不发，心驰神往。

ex.en: I threw a mute look of appeal at Paula.
ex.cn: 我默默地向葆拉投去恳求的目光。

ex.en: Marianna, the duke's daughter, became mute after a shock.
ex.cn: 公爵的女儿玛丽安娜在遭受了一次电击后失声了。

def:
n.神话,神怪故事,奇人，奇事,虚构的人，虚构的事
v.使神话化

ex.en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.
ex.cn: 他对这个神话的探讨揭示了美国人的心理。

ex.en: I have been working on exploding the myth of fixity of meaning.
ex.cn: 我一直在致力于推翻有关意义恒定性的谬谈。

ex.en: Rumour, myth and hearsay obscure the truth after months of bloodshed.
ex.cn: 杀戮持续了数月后，真相在谣言、谎话和传闻的遮掩下变得模糊不清。

def: adj.幼稚的,天真的,单纯的

ex.en: The drama takes an idealistic, even a naive view of the subject.
ex.cn: 这部戏在对待这一主题上有些理想化，甚至是天真。

ex.en: Her colourful oils and works on paper have a naive, dreamlike quality.
ex.cn: 她那些色彩斑斓的油画与纸上作品给人一种天真、梦幻般的感觉。

ex.en: The simple concepts he had been taught now sounded trite and naive.
ex.cn: 他曾经被教导的简单观念如今听起来陈腐而幼稚。

def:
n.小睡，打盹,一种牌戏,绒毛,孤注一掷
vi.打瞌睡,疏忽
vt.使起毛

ex.en: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
ex.cn: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

ex.en: I might take a little nap.
ex.cn: 我可能会打个盹。

ex.en: The nap of the coat has been worn off.
ex.cn: 外衣上的绒毛已经磨掉了.

def:
n.记叙文,故事,叙述，记事,叙述手法
adj.叙述的，叙事体的,善于叙述的

ex.en: Their own lives already seemed to possess the symmetries of narrative art.
ex.cn: 他们自己的生活似乎已经拥有叙事艺术的对称性。

ex.en: Sloan began his narrative with the day of the murder.
ex.cn: 斯隆以发生谋杀案的那天作为故事的开端。

ex.en: The narrative pulls you along like a runaway train.
ex.cn: 这个故事就像一辆失控的高速列车，读起来惊险刺激。

def:
adj.肮脏的,下流的，令人讨厌的,恶劣的，艰险的,严重的
n.令人不愉快的事物

ex.en: They've picked up a really nasty infection from something they've eaten.
ex.cn: 他们因吃错东西而得了很严重的感染症。

ex.en: Though he had a temper and could be nasty, it never lasted.
ex.cn: 虽然他爱发脾气，而且有时还很讨厌，但向来都只是一阵儿。

ex.en: This was a nasty attack and the woman is still very shocked.
ex.cn: 这是一次恶意袭击，那女人仍然惊骇不已。

def: n.项链

ex.en: She was wearing the obligatory sweater and pearl necklace.
ex.cn: 她穿着那件经常穿的毛衣，戴着那串惯常戴的珍珠项链。

ex.en: A necklace set with aquamarines.
ex.cn: 项链镶嵌着海蓝宝石。

ex.en: The bold necklace flatteringly lightens her skin tone.
ex.cn: 这条光彩夺目的项链衬得她的肤色亮了起来。

def:
vi.谈判，协商，交涉
vt.谈判达成,成功越过,议价出售

ex.en: The driver failed to negotiate a bend and ran into a tree.
ex.cn: 司机没能顺利拐弯，撞到了树上。

ex.en: Western governments have this week urged him to negotiate and avoid force.
ex.cn: 西方各国政府本周敦促他进行谈判，避免使用武力。

ex.en: He has insisted that his organization will not negotiate with the government.
ex.cn: 他坚称他的组织将不会与政府谈判。

def:
n.（鸟）窝,温床,（套叠在一起的）一套物件,藏匿处
vt.筑巢,嵌套
vi.筑巢

ex.en: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
ex.cn: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

ex.en: The nest contained eight little mice that were naked and blind.
ex.cn: 窝里有8只还没长毛、眼睛尚未睁开的小老鼠。

ex.en: The actual nest is a work of art.
ex.cn: 真实的鸟巢十分精致。

def:
adj.中立的,（化学中）中性的,暗淡的,不带电的
n.（汽车或其他机器的）空挡位置,中立人士,中立国,素净色

ex.en: "I know you," he said flatly, matter-of-fact, neutral in tone.
ex.cn: “我认识你。”他平淡地说道，就事论事，不带任何感情。

ex.en: Graham put the van in neutral and jumped out into the road.
ex.cn: 格雷厄姆把货车挂到空挡，自己跳到马路上。

ex.en: At the horizon the land mass becomes a continuous pale neutral grey.
ex.cn: 陆地在地平线处变成了一片浅灰。

def:
n.绰号,诨名,昵称
vt.给…起绰号,用诨名[爱称]称呼,叫错名字

ex.en: The vital clue to the killer's identity was his nickname, Peanuts.
ex.cn: 查明杀手身份的重要线索是他的外号叫“花生”.

ex.en: Andrew roared with delight when he heard Rachel's nickname for the baby.
ex.cn: 安德鲁听到雷切尔给婴儿起的绰号时，不禁高兴得大笑起来。

ex.en: His family's Cantonese nickname for him translates as Never Sits Still.
ex.cn: 家人为他起的广东话绰号意思是NeverSitsStill（从来坐不住）。

def:
n.噩梦,<口>可怕的事情，无法摆脱的恐惧,泛滥成灾,紧张
adj.可怕的，噩梦似的

ex.en: Taking my son Peter to a restaurant was a nightmare.
ex.cn: 带我儿子彼得外出吃饭简直糟糕透了。

ex.en: In practice a graduate tax is an administrative nightmare.
ex.cn: 毕业税具体操作起来不啻一场行政噩梦。

ex.en: His abrasive wit and caustic comments were an interviewer's nightmare.
ex.cn: 他睿智刁钻，评论尖刻，对任何采访他的人而言都是梦魇。

def: n.[化]氮，氮气

ex.en: The atmosphere consist of more than 70 % of nitrogen.
ex.cn: 大气中含有70%以上的氮气.

ex.en: Every tonne of coal contains, on average, 30 kilograms of nitrogen.
ex.cn: 每吨煤平均含30公斤氮.

ex.en: The plant requires nitrogen in order to make proteins.
ex.cn: 植物需要氮以便制造蛋白质.

def:
n.胡说，废话,荒谬的念头,愚蠢的行为,胡闹
adj.无意义的,荒谬的
int.荒唐

ex.en: He had been unwittingly deluded by their mystical nonsense.
ex.cn: 他不知不觉被他们故弄玄虚的胡说八道给骗了。

ex.en: She saw herself as a direct, no-nonsense modern woman.
ex.cn: 她认为自己是个直截了当、不拖泥带水的现代女性。

ex.en: She is fascinated by algebra while he considers it meaningless nonsense.
ex.cn: 她对代数非常着迷，而他却认为代数毫无意义。

def: vt.通知,布告

ex.en: I don't suppose it occurred to you to notify the police.
ex.cn: 我看你没想过要去通知警察。

ex.en: The court clerk will notify the witness when and where to appear.
ex.cn: 法院办事员将通知证人出庭的时间及地点.

ex.en: He will notify us where we are to meet.
ex.cn: 他将通知我们在什么地方集合.

def: adj.臭名昭著的,臭名远扬的,声名狼藉的,恶名昭著

ex.en: The accident happened on a notorious black spot on the A43.
ex.cn: 事故发生在A43号公路上一个出了名的事故多发地段。

ex.en: He is notorious for making unexpected, often self-contradictory, comments.
ex.cn: 他发表的那些出人意料而且经常自相矛盾的评论令他臭名昭著。

ex.en: This town is notorious for chewing people up and spitting them out.
ex.cn: 这个城市恶名昭彰，它把人作践了，然后抛弃掉。

def: n.中心，核心,（原子）核,起点，开始,[微]细胞核

ex.en: The repulsive force within the nucleus is enormous.
ex.cn: 核子内部的斥力是巨大的。

ex.en: the nucleus of a cell
ex.cn: 细胞核

ex.en: These paintings will form the nucleus of a new collection.
ex.cn: 这些画将构成新的收藏系列的基础。

def: adj.很多的，许多的,数量庞大的数量庞大的,数不清的

ex.en: The doctors gave numerous examples of patients being expelled from hospital.
ex.cn: 医生们列举了大量病人被逐出医院的实例。

ex.en: Scientific development meant the growth of numerous professions ancillary to medicine.
ex.cn: 科技发展意味着许多医学衍生职业的增长。

ex.en: This year numerous bands are playing, as well as comedy acts.
ex.cn: 今年除了那些搞笑短剧外，还会有众多乐队登台献艺。

def:
vt.养育,培育,滋养,培植
n.教养，培育,营养物，食物,环境因素

ex.en: The human organism learns partly by nature, partly by nurture.
ex.cn: 人的学习能力部分是天生的，部分是后天培养的。

ex.en: The tree grows well in his nurture.
ex.cn: 在他的培育下这棵树长得很好.

ex.en: The two sisters had received very different nurture.
ex.cn: 这俩个姊妹接受过极不同的教育.

def: n.营养，滋养,营养品,营养学,食物

ex.en: advice on diet and nutrition
ex.cn: 有关饮食和增加营养的建议

ex.en: The nutrition plays a role in the prevention of nearsightedness.
ex.cn: 这种营养剂对预防近视有一定作用.

ex.en: Plants get the nutrition from the soil in which they grow.
ex.cn: 植物从它们赖以生存的土壤中吸收养分.

def: adj.顺从的，服从的,忠顺的,孝顺的,驯良的

ex.en: He was always obedient to his father's wishes.
ex.cn: 他一向顺从父亲的意愿。

ex.en: Their early training programmes them to be obedient and submissive.
ex.cn: 他们早期受过的教育把他们训练得俯首帖耳、唯命是从.

ex.en: Circus monkeys are trained to be very docile and obedient.
ex.cn: 马戏团的猴子训练得服服贴贴的.

def:
adj.废弃的,老式的，已过时的,[生]已废退的
n.废词,被废弃的事物
vt.淘汰,废弃

ex.en: With technological changes many traditional skills have become obsolete.
ex.cn: 随着技术的革新，许多传统技艺已被淘汰。

ex.en: These goods are obsolete and will not fetch much on the market.
ex.cn: 这些货品过时了,在市场上卖不了高价.

ex.en: Our service is obsolete, requiring root and branch reform.
ex.cn: 我们的服务业已过时, 需要彻底改革.

def: n.障碍（物）,障碍物（绊脚石，障碍栅栏）

ex.en: A further obstacle has presented itself, however.
ex.cn: 然而，突然又出现了一个障碍。

ex.en: A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
ex.cn: 学历不足可能成为谋职的主要障碍。

ex.en: She felt that her family was an obstacle to her work.
ex.cn: 她感到她的家庭妨碍她的工作.

def: adj.偶尔的，不经常的,特殊场合的,临时的

ex.en: She saw the occasional glimmer of a moth's wings.
ex.cn: 她看见蛾子的翅膀偶尔会泛光。

ex.en: An elegant occasional table is framed in the window.
ex.cn: 一张雅致的供重大活动使用的餐桌被摆放在橱窗里。

ex.en: The foggy streets were virtually empty, except for the occasional evening stroller.
ex.cn: 除了偶尔一两个傍晚出来散步的人，雾蒙蒙的街上空荡荡的。

def: vt.占领,使用，住在…,使从事，使忙碌,任职

ex.en: U.S. forces now occupy a part of the country.
ex.cn: 美国军队现在占领了该国的一部分。

ex.en: This challenge will occupy Europe for a generation or more.
ex.cn: 这将是欧洲在未来二三十年或者更长的时间里所要面临的挑战。

ex.en: I had other matters to occupy me, during the day at least.
ex.cn: 至少白天我还有别的事情要做。

def: n.发生，出现,遭遇，事件

ex.en: The greatest occurrence of coronary heart disease is in those over 65.
ex.cn: 65岁以上者是冠心病的最高发人群。

ex.en: For months at a time, air raids were a nightly occurrence.
ex.cn: 一度有几个月，每天晚上都会发生空袭。

ex.en: The occurrence of the disease is apparently related to standards of hygiene.
ex.cn: 这种病的发生率显然与卫生状况相关.

def: n.希望，可能性,几率，胜算,掣肘的事情,逆境

ex.en: He sweeps up and does a few odds and ends.
ex.cn: 他扫完地，又干了几样杂活儿。

ex.en: Global ecological efforts can easily be at odds with local ecologies.
ex.cn: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

ex.en: He reckoned the odds are against the scheme going ahead.
ex.cn: 他认为目前实施这项计划的希望渺茫。

def:
adj.无礼的，冒犯的，唐突的,讨厌的，令人不快的,进攻（性）的，攻击的，攻势的
n.进攻，攻势

ex.en: The army now appears to have launched a counter-offensive.
ex.cn: 军队现在似乎已经发起了反攻。

ex.en: They wanted me to change the title to something less gratuitously offensive.
ex.cn: 他们希望我将题目修改一下，以免显得太过冒犯。

ex.en: He would soon launch a second offensive, killing off the peace process.
ex.cn: 他不久将会再次发动进攻，彻底毁掉整个和平进程。

def:
vt.抵消,补偿,（为了比较的目的而）把…并列（或并置）,为（管道等）装支管
vi.形成分支，长出分枝,装支管
n.开端,出发,平版印刷,抵消，补偿
adj.分支的,偏（离中）心的,抵消的,开端的

ex.en: The decline in marriage has been offset by a rise in cohabitation.
ex.cn: 结婚人数的减少由于同居人数的增加而得以弥补。

ex.en: Prices have risen in order to offset the increased cost of materials.
ex.cn: 为补偿原料成本的增加而提高了价格。

ex.en: The slowdown in domestic demand was offset by an increase in exports.
ex.cn: 国内需求放缓和出口增长互相抵消了.

def: adj.即可使用的,（用于）操作的,经营的,军事行动的

ex.en: Exports have not been halted completely because another line is operational.
ex.cn: 出口并没有完全停止，因为另一条生产线还能运转。

ex.en: The new airport is now fully operational .
ex.cn: 新机场现在可全面投入运营。

ex.en: Operational Research is a newly emerging subject.
ex.cn: 运筹学是一门新兴的学科.

def:
vt.使烦恼，使意气消沉，使气馁，使无精神,压迫，压制
v.虐待，欺侮,〈古〉压倒,给与沉重的感觉

ex.en: He states uncompromisingly that he is opposed to any practices which oppress animals.
ex.cn: 他坚决声明反对任何虐待动物的行为。

ex.en: The imperialists exploit and oppress all the peoples of the world.
ex.cn: 帝国主义者剥削和压迫全世界人民.

ex.en: A good ruler will not oppress the poor.
ex.cn: 好的统治者不会压迫贫民.

def:
adj.口头的，口述的,口服的,属于或关于嘴的,构成或使用言语的
n.（尤指外语考试中的）口试

ex.en: The story of King Arthur became part of oral tradition.
ex.cn: 亚瑟王的故事成为口头传说的一部分。

ex.en: I spoke privately to the candidate after the oral.
ex.cn: 口试后，我私下里与那位考生谈了谈。

ex.en: a test of both oral and written French
ex.cn: 法语口试和笔试

def:
adj.整齐的，有秩序的,有组织的，有规则的,[军]值班的,安静的
n.[军]传令下士,传令兵,<英>街道清洁工
adv.依次地，顺序地,有规则地,有条理地

ex.en: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
ex.cn: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

ex.en: The senior leaders lined up behind him in orderly rows.
ex.cn: 高级将领整齐有序地在他身后站成几排。

ex.en: It's a beautiful, clean and orderly city.
ex.cn: 这是一座美丽清洁、秩序井然的城市。

def: n.机构,器官,风琴,元件

ex.en: The patient'simmune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
ex.cn: 病人的免疫系统会对移植器官产生异质排斥反应。

ex.en: We ended with Blake's Jerusalem, accompanied on the organ by Herbert Wiseman.
ex.cn: 在赫伯特·怀斯曼的风琴伴奏下，我们演唱了布莱克的《耶路撒冷》作为终曲。

ex.en: The most powerful organ of government in Scotland is the Scottish Office.
ex.cn: 苏格兰职权最大的政府部门是苏格兰事务部。

def: n.有机体,生物体,微生物,有机体系，有机组织

ex.en: The human organism learns partly by nature, partly by nurture.
ex.cn: 人的学习能力部分是天生的，部分是后天培养的。

ex.en: The army is an extremely complex organism.
ex.cn: 军队是一个极其复杂的组织.

ex.en: The amoeba is a very simple organism.
ex.cn: 变形虫是很简单的生物体.

def:
n.装饰,装饰物,[乐]装饰音
v.装饰,美化

ex.en: The clock is simply for ornament; it doesn't work any more.
ex.cn: 这架时钟纯属摆设，它再也不走了。

ex.en: The flowers were put on the table for ornament.
ex.cn: 花放在桌子上做装饰用.

ex.en: The baroque style is rich in ornament.
ex.cn: 巴罗克风格极具装饰性.

def:
n.义愤,愤慨,暴行,骇人听闻的事件
vt.引起…的义愤，激怒,凌辱，强奸,虐待，迫害,违反

ex.en: The decision provoked outrage from women and human rights groups.
ex.cn: 这一决定激起了妇女和人权组织的强烈愤慨。

ex.en: There have been cries of outrage about this expenditure.
ex.cn: 这项开支遭到了一些人愤怒的指责。

ex.en: Tom, this is an outrage!
ex.cn: 汤姆，这简直太过分了！

def: n.开始，开端

ex.en: Almost from the outset, the extravaganza was beset with difficulties.
ex.cn: 几乎从一开始, 这一盛事就被种种困难所困扰.

ex.en: He was not here at the outset of the experiment.
ex.cn: 实验开始时他不在这里.

ex.en: The novel fascinates the reader from the outset.
ex.cn: 这部小说一开头就把读者迷住了.

def:
adj.向外的,外面的,公开的,[宗]肉体上的
adv.向外（等于outwards）,在外
n.外表,外面,物质世界

ex.en: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
ex.cn: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

ex.en: The material can absorb outward-going radiation from the Earth.
ex.cn: 该物质可以吸收地球向外辐射的能量。

ex.en: Other poor countries looked outward, strengthening their ties to the economic superpowers.
ex.cn: 其他贫穷国家将目光投向国外，加强与经济强国的联系。

def:
adj.上面的，高架的,头顶上的,（费用等）经常的，管理的
n.天花板,管理费用，经常费用,船舱的顶板,[体]（网球等的）扣杀
adv.在头顶上,在空中,在楼上,向上

ex.en: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
ex.cn: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。

ex.en: Overhead, the chopper roared and the big blades churned the air.
ex.cn: 头顶上，直升机在呼啸，巨大的螺旋桨叶片搅动着空气。

ex.en: He disconnected the IV bottle from the overhead hook.
ex.cn: 他把静脉滴注瓶从头顶的钩子上拿下来。

def:
n.重叠部分,覆盖物，涂盖层,[数]交叠，相交
vt.重叠,与…部分相同
vi.互搭，重叠,部分相同,[数]有与…共同的某物

ex.en: The upper layer of felt should overlap the lower.
ex.cn: 毛毡的上层应与下层重叠。

ex.en: Social structures are not discrete objects; they overlap and interweave.
ex.cn: 社会结构之间不是离散的，他们相互重叠交织。

ex.en: The needs of patients invariably overlap.
ex.cn: 病人的需求总有一些是一致的。

def: vt.追上，赶上,压倒,（不愉快的事）突然降临

ex.en: Pulling out to overtake, the car collided head-on with a van.
ex.cn: 越线超车时，轿车和一辆厢式货车迎面相撞。

ex.en: He pulled out to overtake a truck.
ex.cn: 他驶出车流，以超过一辆卡车。

ex.en: I had to walk very fast to overtake you.
ex.cn: 我不得不快走才能赶过你.

def: n.[化]臭氧,清新空气

ex.en: Ozone is a highly reactive form of oxygen gas.
ex.cn: 臭氧是一种非常活跃的氧气形态。

ex.en: Ozone is produced by the reaction between oxygen and ultra-violet light.
ex.cn: 臭氧由氧气和紫外线发生反应而产生。

ex.en: Every spring the ozone is chewed up, and the hole appears.
ex.cn: 每年春天，臭氧遭到破坏，空洞就出现了。

def:
vt.给…装衬垫， 加垫子,填塞,踏平
vi.步行，放轻脚步走
n.垫，衬垫,护具,便签本,发射台

ex.en: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
ex.cn: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

ex.en: "Here's your ticket," he said, and he tore it off the pad.
ex.cn: “给你票，”他说着，从票本上把票撕了下来。

ex.en: I moved on round the big house to reach my pad.
ex.cn: 我绕过大房子走向我的公寓。

def: n.桶，提桶,一桶的量

ex.en: There is a quart of milk left in the pail.
ex.cn: 桶里还剩下一夸脱牛奶.

ex.en: The maid plunged the cloth into the pail and cleaned the floor.
ex.cn: 那个侍女把拖把放进桶里浸湿,用来擦地.

ex.en: There was a pail of water on the ground.
ex.cn: 地上有一桶水.

def: n.小册子,活页文选

ex.en: Over a thousand copies of the pamphlet have now been given out.
ex.cn: 现在已分发了一千多本小册子.

ex.en: The scholarly monographs were published as pamphlet.
ex.cn: 学术专著是以小册子形式出版的.

ex.en: The pamphlet went out in 6000 copies.
ex.cn: 这本小册子发行了六千本.

def: vt.使瘫痪，使麻痹,使不能正常活动

ex.en: The snake uses its venom to stun or paralyze its victims.
ex.cn: 蛇用其毒液使受害者失去知觉或瘫痪.

ex.en: If unsolved, the problem will sooner or later paralyze our strategy and our foreign policy.
ex.cn: 这个问题如果不解决, 它迟早会使我们的战略和我们的对外政策陷于瘫痪.

ex.en: The soviet Union believes that it can demoralize Western Europe and paralyze us.
ex.cn: 苏联相信它能使西欧丧失斗志,麻痹我们.

def: vt.使瘫痪[麻痹],使不能正常活动,[电]关闭

ex.en: Software invalidation has become the main cause of the system paralyse.
ex.cn: 软件失效已成为系统瘫痪的主要原因.

ex.en: Any one of the so - called P 5 can paralyse the world body.
ex.cn: 任何一个 所谓 的五大常任理事国都能瘫痪这个世界组织.

ex.en: The effect of the drug is to paralyse the nerves in the leg before the operation.
ex.cn: 手术前向患病的腿部注射这种药物,是为了麻痹腿部神经.

def:
n.包袱，包裹,（土地的）一块,一批，一群,（货物的）一宗
vt.分，区分,把…划成部分后分配,给…打成包裹,把…拼在一起

ex.en: It's all part and parcel— just a day's work really you know.
ex.cn: 这只是一部分——才一天的工作，你要知道。

ex.en: He had a large brown paper parcel under his left arm.
ex.cn: 他左臂下夹着一个大牛皮纸邮包。

ex.en: There's a parcel and some letters for you.
ex.cn: 有你的一个包裹和几封信。

def: n.微粒，颗粒,[数，物]粒子，质点,极小量,小品词

ex.en: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
ex.cn: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

ex.en: There's not a particle of truth in her story.
ex.cn: 她讲的没有一句实话.

ex.en: There is not a particle of truth in what you said.
ex.cn: 你所说的没有一句是实话.

def: n.消遣，娱乐

ex.en: Learning should no longer be an elitist pastime for the chosen few.
ex.cn: 学习不应再是少数人的高级消遣。

ex.en: Playing chess is his favourite pastime.
ex.cn: 下棋是他最喜爱的消遣.

ex.en: His favourite pastime is golf.
ex.cn: 他最喜欢的消遣是打高尔夫。

def: adj.爱国的，有爱国心的,爱国主义的

ex.en: The Patriotic Front took power after a three-month civil war.
ex.cn: 经过3个月内战，爱国阵线夺取了政权。

ex.en: The crowd sang "Land of Hope and Glory" and other patriotic songs.
ex.cn: 人群高唱《希望和光荣之地》等爱国歌曲。

ex.en: Haig's rise was fuelled by an all-consuming sense of patriotic duty.
ex.cn: 黑格非常强烈的爱国主义责任感使他的地位大大提高了。

def: n.付款，支付,报酬，报答,偿还,惩罚，报应

ex.en: The rate of disconnections following non-payment of water charges is rising.
ex.cn: 不缴水费引起的断水的比率正在上升。

ex.en: A clerk simply verifies that the payment and invoice amount match.
ex.cn: 职员只是核实付款和发票上的数额是否一致。

ex.en: He denounced what he called toytown revolutionaries advocating non-payment of taxes.
ex.cn: 他谴责他称为幼稚愚蠢的改革者鼓吹不缴纳税款。

def:
n.珍珠,珍品,人造珍珠,珠状物
vi.采珍珠
vt.使成珠状,用珍珠装饰

ex.en: "You don't need to do that," said Pearl assertively.
ex.cn: “你不需要那么做，”珀尔斩钉截铁地说道。

ex.en: And what is that pearl of wisdom supposed to mean?
ex.cn: 那番精辟见解到底是什么意思呢？

ex.en: On the table sat a box decorated with little pearl triangles.
ex.cn: 桌上有一只用珠子串成的小三角形作装饰的盒子。

def:
adj.奇怪的，古怪的,异常的,特有的，特殊的
n.专有特权，专有财产,[多用于英国]特殊教堂

ex.en: Flying at 1,000 ft. he heard a peculiar noise from the rotors.
ex.cn: 在1,000英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。

ex.en: The problem is by no means peculiar to America.
ex.cn: 这个问题绝对不只限于美国。

ex.en: She was a very peculiar-looking woman.
ex.cn: 她是个样貌怪异的女人。

def: n.惩罚,刑罚,害处,足球点球

ex.en: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.
ex.cn: 这是间谍罪，应判死刑。

ex.en: The prosecutors have warned they will seek the death penalty.
ex.cn: 检控方律师已警告说他们会努力争取判处死刑。

ex.en: Why should I pay the penalty for somebody else's mistake?
ex.cn: 为什么我要代人受过？

def:
n.退休金，养老金,膳宿费,生活津贴,寄宿学校
vt.发给…养老金[退休金],准予退休，强迫退休（并发给退休金）

ex.en: He lived on an invalidity pension which came as a weekly giro.
ex.cn: 他靠每周领取的作为病残养老金的直接转账救济支票过日子。

ex.en: He is moving ever closer to drawing his pension.
ex.cn: 他就要领取养老金了。

ex.en: The main beneficiaries of pension equality so far have been men.
ex.cn: 迄今为止，退休金均等政策的主要受益者一直是男性。

def:
n.胡椒,辣椒,胡椒粉
vt.在…上撒胡椒粉,使布满

ex.en: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
ex.cn: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

ex.en: She sprinkled pepper on my grub, watching me nosh.
ex.cn: 她在我的食物上撒了点胡椒粉，看着我吃。

ex.en: Roll the meat in coarsely ground black pepper to season it.
ex.cn: 将肉在粗研的黑胡椒粉里滚一下以调味。

def:
n.期刊,杂志
adj.周期的，定期的,时常发生的,定期发行的，期刊的

ex.en: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
ex.cn: 她定期去看牙医。

ex.en: The quarterly magazine is a periodical published every three months.
ex.cn: 季刊是每3个月出版一次的期刊.

ex.en: They have already put out a new periodical.
ex.cn: 他们已经出版了一种新的期刊.

def:
vi.死亡，丧生,毁灭,腐烂，枯萎,老化
vt.使麻木,使毁坏

ex.en: Buddhism had to adapt to the new world or perish.
ex.cn: 佛教必须适应新时代，否则将会消亡。

ex.en: Me a policeman! Perish the thought!
ex.cn: 我当警察！想都别想了，不可能！

ex.en: Crowns and thrones may perish.
ex.cn: 王权不会永存.

def: adj.永久的,不断的,无期限的,四季开花的

ex.en: Little by little she lost the taut, strained air of perpetual anxiety.
ex.cn: 长期焦虑带来的紧张而疲惫的神色从她脸上慢慢消失了。

ex.en: Nothing seems to dampen his perpetual enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 似乎没有什么能让他那持久的热情消退。

ex.en: Outdoors, mosquitoes and midges were a perpetual torment.
ex.cn: 在户外，蚊子和蠓虫永远让人不得安生。

def: adj.悲观的，厌世的,悲观主义的

ex.en: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.
ex.cn: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。

ex.en: They appeared surprisingly pessimistic about their chances of winning.
ex.cn: 他们对胜利的可能性显得出奇地悲观。

ex.en: There is no reason to be pessimistic about the future.
ex.cn: 没有理由对未来悲观.

def: n.石油

ex.en: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
ex.cn: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

ex.en: The purpose of oil refinery is to refine crude petroleum.
ex.cn: 炼油厂的主要工作是提炼原油.

ex.en: The Government of Iran advanced the price of petroleum last week.
ex.cn: 上星期伊朗政府提高了石油价格.

def: n.物理学家,唯物论者,<古>自然科学家,宇宙机械论者

ex.en: I think he's a physicist or something of that nature.
ex.cn: 我想他大概是物理学家或那一类的人.

ex.en: He is a physicist of the first rank.
ex.cn: 他是一流的物理学家.

ex.en: Her husband is a world - known physicist.
ex.cn: 她的丈夫是一位世界著名的物理学家.

def: n.生理学,生理机能

ex.en: The medicine chemically affects your physiology.
ex.cn: 这种药会通过化学作用影响生理机能。

ex.en: the department of anatomy and physiology
ex.cn: 解剖生理学系

ex.en: His new contribution to the advancement of physiology was well appreciated.
ex.cn: 他对生理学发展的新贡献获得高度赞赏.

def:
vt.捏，掐,挤痛，夹痛,使（植物）枯萎，凋谢,使紧缺，节制
vi.挤痛，压痛,吝惜，节约
n.匮乏,少量，一撮,困苦

ex.en: Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cayenne.
ex.cn: 调以盐、胡椒和少许辣椒粉。

ex.en: Pinch-hitter Francisco Cabrera lashed a single to left field.
ex.cn: 替补队员弗朗西斯科·卡布雷拉向左外场猛地击出一个一垒打。

ex.en: Consumers are spending less and traders are feeling the pinch.
ex.cn: 消费者支出在减少，商人感觉手头拮据。

def:
n.瘟疫,灾害，折磨
vt.使染瘟疫,使痛苦，造成麻烦

ex.en: Last year there was a plague of robbery and housebreaking.
ex.cn: 去年抢劫和入室行窃成灾。

ex.en: A plague on you and your damned percentages!
ex.cn: 你和你该死的百分比都见鬼去吧！

ex.en: I normally avoid cheap wine like the plague.
ex.cn: 我一般对廉价的葡萄酒敬而远之。

def:
n.塑料制品,〈口〉（使用）信用卡,整形,可塑体
adj.可塑的，塑性的，受范的，柔软的,造型的，塑造的，给与形态的,塑料[塑胶]的，塑料[塑胶]制的，合成树脂做的,有形成力的，有创造力的

ex.en: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
ex.cn: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

ex.en: She even had plastic surgery to change the shape of her nose.
ex.cn: 为改变鼻子的形状，她甚至接受了整形手术。

ex.en: Cover with plastic film and refrigerate for 24 hours.
ex.cn: 覆上保鲜膜，冷藏24小时。

def:
n.高原,平稳时期，稳定水平,停滞期
v.进入停滞期,达到平稳状态

ex.en: The US heroin market now appears to have reached a plateau.
ex.cn: 美国的海洛因市场现在似乎已到了停滞期。

ex.en: We took a plane south-west across the Anatolian plateau to Cappadocia.
ex.cn: 我们乘飞机向着西南方向越过安纳托利亚高原，前往卡帕多西亚。

ex.en: The road straightened and we were on a plateau.
ex.cn: 路变直了，我们驶上了高原。

def:
n.台,站台,平台,纲领
v.把…放在台上,为…设（平）台,（在台上）演讲

ex.en: PLATFORM is an alliance of more than 80 rail-user groups.
ex.cn: PLATFORM公司是80多个铁路用户组的联盟。

ex.en: The GM diesel engine shunted the coaches to Platform 4.
ex.cn: 通用柴油动力火车头将车厢转轨到了4号月台。

ex.en: Nick finished what he was saying and jumped down from the platform.
ex.cn: 尼克讲完后，从讲台上跳了下来。

def: adj.貌似真实的,貌似有理的,花言巧语的,有眉有眼

ex.en: Some of the ideas are very intriguing and sound intuitively plausible.
ex.cn: 有些想法非常吸引人，听起来觉得很有道理。

ex.en: Her story sounded perfectly plausible.
ex.cn: 她的说辞听起来言之有理。

ex.en: This explanation fits the facts and is psychologically plausible.
ex.cn: 这一解释与事实相符,从心理角度看也有理.

def: n.恳求，请求,（被告或被告律师的）抗辩，答辩,借口，托辞,请愿

ex.en: Her plea of guilty to manslaughter through provocation was rejected.
ex.cn: 她因受到挑衅而过失杀人的有罪答辩被驳回。

ex.en: Phillips murdered his wife, but got off on a plea of insanity.
ex.cn: 菲利普斯谋杀了他的妻子，但以精神错乱为由逃脱了惩罚。

ex.en: A guilty plea cuts out the need for a long trial.
ex.cn: 承认有罪就不需要长时间的审判了。

def:
vi.恳求,辩论
vt.以…为理由,陈述案情,申辩，认罪，辩护
vt.& vi.申诉，答辩，为…辩护

ex.en: It was no defence to plead that they were only obeying orders.
ex.cn: 辩称他们只是在服从命令站不住脚。

ex.en: They will plead with him to pull back from confrontation.
ex.cn: 他们将请求他退出冲突。

ex.en: He would plead the cause of Russian unity.
ex.cn: 他会公开支持俄罗斯的统一。

def:
n.塞子,插头,消防栓,（内燃机的）火花塞
vt.& vi.插上插头
vt.以（塞子）塞住,插入,〈俚〉枪击，殴打
vi.填塞，堵,〈俚〉勤苦工作，用功

ex.en: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
ex.cn: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

ex.en: Make sure the draining board, sink and plug hole are regularly disinfected.
ex.cn: 滴水板、水槽和塞孔一定要定期消毒。

ex.en: The banks have the power to pull the plug on the project.
ex.cn: 银行能让该工程下马。

def:
vt.用力插入,使陷入
vi.跳入,全心投入,突降，俯冲
n.投入，陷入,游泳，跳水

ex.en: Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into your career.
ex.cn: 抓住机会投身到事业中去。

ex.en: Local residents saw it plunge towards Earth with a deafening roar.
ex.cn: 当地的居民看见它伴着一声震耳欲聋的巨响撞向地面。

ex.en: He braced himself for the icy plunge into the black water.
ex.cn: 他做好了准备要跳进冰冷的脏水里。

def:
prep.（表示运算）加,（表示包容）外加,[口语]和,（表示数目）在零（度）以上
n.加号,[数学]正量,好处,附加物
adj.加的,正的,附加的,比所示数量多的

ex.en: There are only 35 staff to serve 30,000-plus customers.
ex.cn: 只有35名员工，却要为3万多顾客服务。

ex.en: All vessels were to be built on a cost-plus basis.
ex.cn: 所有的船只都将在成本加利润的基础上制造。

ex.en: Experience of any career in sales is a big plus.
ex.cn: 任何销售领域的工作经验都是一大优势。

def:
v.擦光,磨光,修改,润色
n.光泽剂，擦亮剂,擦亮，磨光,优美，优雅，精良

ex.en: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
ex.cn: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

ex.en: The president persuaded the West to write off Polish debts.
ex.cn: 总统说通西方免除波兰的债务。

ex.en: The opera lacks the polish of his later work.
ex.cn: 这部歌剧不及他晚期作品娴熟。

def:
n.民意调查,投票选举,投票数,头部
vt.得到（一定数目的）选票,对…进行调查,修剪,修剪
vi.投票,作民意调查

ex.en: He will have been heartened by the telephone opinion poll published yesterday.
ex.cn: 他会为昨天公布的电话民意调查结果感到鼓舞。

ex.en: The poll canvassed the views of almost eighty economists.
ex.cn: 民意调查征询了将近80位经济学家的意见。

ex.en: Labour was top of the poll with forty-six percent.
ex.cn: 工党以46%的得票数高居首位。

def:
vt.思索，衡量
vi.仔细考虑，沉思

ex.en: The visitor can ponder over the boomerangs used by aborigines at the time of Cook.
ex.cn: 来访者可以琢磨琢磨土著人在库克时期用的回飞镖.

ex.en: They would do well to pause and ponder upon their new responsibilities.
ex.cn: 人们最好还是停一停,好好地想一想自己所负的新责任.

ex.en: Face west, all you plump old men, and ponder your tropic fates.
ex.cn: 退休老人们啊, 面向西方, 为你们那莫测的祸福祈祷吧.

def: n.肖像，肖像画,模型，标本,半身雕塑像,人物描写

ex.en: Today his picture goes on show at the National Portrait Gallery.
ex.cn: 今天他的画作在国家肖像美术馆展出。

ex.en: He gives us a portrait of the real Gandhi, warts and all.
ex.cn: 他向我们描绘了真正的甘地，包括他的不足。

ex.en: "Elizabeth R", a TV portrait of the Queen, had record viewing figures.
ex.cn: 关于女王的电视专题片《伊丽莎白女王》创下了收视纪录。

def: vt.画像,描述,描绘,描画

ex.en: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
ex.cn: 最近几个月里他努力从更积极的角度来描绘纽约。

ex.en: That's what we tried to portray in the book, this feeling of opulence and grandeur.
ex.cn: 那就是我们在书中竭力描绘的——一种富丽堂皇的气派。

ex.en: It is still not considered proper to portray Christ in a play or film.
ex.cn: 人们仍然认为在戏剧或电影中再现基督的形象是不妥当的.

def:
vt.& vi.布道，讲道,宣扬,说教,讲（道）
n.〈口〉讲道，说教

ex.en: He denounced the decision to invite his fellow archbishop to preach.
ex.cn: 他痛斥了邀请其他大主教同仁布道的决定。

ex.en: "Don't preach at me," he shouted.
ex.cn: 他大喊道：“不要对我说教。”

ex.en: He realized that his calling was to preach the gospel.
ex.cn: 他体悟到宣讲福音是他的使命。

def:
adj.（时间或地点上）在先的，在前的，前面的,前述的,上述的
v.在…之前发生（或出现）,走在…前面,先于,“precede”的现在分词

ex.en: Industrial orders had already fallen in the preceding months.
ex.cn: 工业订单在前几个月就已减少。

ex.en: Repeat the exercises described in the preceding section.
ex.cn: 把前一节要求的练习重做一遍。

ex.en: the years preceding the war
ex.cn: 战前的几年

def: adj.主要的，占主导地位的,占优势的，卓越的,有影响的,特优种

ex.en: Yellow is the predominant colour this spring in the fashion world.
ex.cn: 黄色是今春时装界的流行颜色。

ex.en: Love of peace is the predominant feeling of many people today.
ex.cn: 爱好和平在今天是许多人的主要情感.

ex.en: The predominant feature of his character was pride.
ex.cn: 他的性格中主要的特点是骄傲.

def:
n.总理,首相
adj.第一的，首位的,首要的,最先的,最早的

ex.en: The Prime Minister played host to French Premier Jacques Chirac.
ex.cn: 首相接待了法国总理雅克·希拉克。

ex.en: He has acquired a reputation as this country's premier solo violinist.
ex.cn: 他已经赢得了该国首席小提琴独奏家的名誉。

ex.en: The club are on the brink of promotion to the Premier League.
ex.cn: 俱乐部即将晋级超级联赛。

def:
n.前提,[复数]房屋,[复数][合同、契约用语]上述各点,（逻辑学中的）大[小]前提
vt.预述（条件等）,提出…为前提,假设,作出前提

ex.en: Well, now just a second, I don't altogether agree with the premise.
ex.cn: 嗯，且慢，我并不完全同意这个前提。

ex.en: the basic premise of her argument
ex.cn: 她的论证的基本前提

ex.en: Let me premise my argument with a bit of history.
ex.cn: 让我引述一些史实作为我立论的前提.

def:
n.额外费用,保险费,附加费
adj.高昂的,优质的

ex.en: Callers are charged a premium rate of 48p a minute.
ex.cn: 打电话要支付每分钟48便士的附加费。

ex.en: He eventually sold the shares back to the bank at a premium.
ex.cn: 他最后以高价把股票回售给银行。

ex.en: They put a high premium on prevention and primary care.
ex.cn: 他们对预防和初级护理极为重视。

def: n.[医]药方，处方,处方药,训令，指示,法规

ex.en: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
ex.cn: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

ex.en: She made a mental note to have his prescription refilled.
ex.cn: 她记着要拿他的处方再配一回药。

ex.en: We had to wait for the pharmacist to make up her prescription.
ex.cn: 我们只得等药剂师给她配好药。

def: adv.目前,不久,马上

ex.en: "Just take it easy," David said. "You'll feel better presently."
ex.cn: “放松点，”戴维说，“你很快就会觉得更舒服些。”

ex.en: "You're not looking too well, Thomas," he said presently.
ex.cn: “托马斯，你看起来气色不太好，”他脱口而出。

ex.en: He is presently the medical director for the Fellowship of World Christians.
ex.cn: 他目前是世界基督徒团契的主任医师。

def: adj.流行的，盛行的,普遍存在的，普遍发生的

ex.en: This condition is more prevalent in women than in men.
ex.cn: 这种病症在女性当中比在男性当中更为普遍。

ex.en: Smoking is becoming increasingly prevalent among younger women.
ex.cn: 抽烟在年轻女性中变得越来越常见。

ex.en: These prejudices are particularly prevalent among people living in the North.
ex.cn: 这些偏见在北方人中尤为常见。

def:
n.被捕食的动物,捕食（习性）,受害者,受骗者
vi.捕食,（疾病等）使人慢慢衰弱,折磨,（人）靠欺诈为生

ex.en: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
ex.cn: 蜘蛛必须等待猎物被它的蛛网困住。

ex.en: Children in evacuation centres are falling prey to disease.
ex.cn: 疏散中心的孩子正受到疾病的折磨。

ex.en: On the flight from Paris to Toulon, Mechiche fell prey to panic.
ex.cn: 在从巴黎飞往土伦的航班上，梅希什惊慌失措。

def:
n.神父，牧师,司铎，司祭,领导者,神甫
vt.使成为神职人员

ex.en: The priest made the sign of the cross over him.
ex.cn: 神父在他上方画了个十字。

ex.en: The priest frowned into the light, his face puzzled.
ex.cn: 神父在亮光下皱起了眉头，一脸疑惑。

ex.en: The priest's eyes were squeezed shut against the light.
ex.cn: 牧师紧闭双眼，以避开强光。

def:
adj.最重要的,主要的,资本的,本金的
n.首长，负责人,主要演员，主角,[法]委托人，当事人,本金

ex.en: The two principal combustion products are water vapor and carbon dioxide.
ex.cn: 两种主要的燃烧产物是水蒸气和二氧化碳。

ex.en: City's principal marksman was Joe Harvey who scored seventeen goals.
ex.cn: 市队的头号射手是打进17粒进球的乔·哈维。

ex.en: The students passed a motion of no-confidence in the college principal.
ex.cn: 学生们通过了对校长进行不信任投票的动议。

def: n.隐私，秘密,隐居,私事,不受公众干扰的状态

ex.en: The newspaper breached the code of conduct on privacy.
ex.cn: 该报违反了保护隐私的行为准则。

ex.en: The least his hotel could do is provide a little privacy.
ex.cn: 他的酒店至少应该提供一点隐私保护。

ex.en: I do very much appreciate the quietness and privacy here.
ex.cn: 我的确非常喜欢这里宁静幽雅、不受打扰的氛围。

def: n.可能性,几率，概率,或然性

ex.en: Formal talks are still said to be a possibility, not a probability.
ex.cn: 据称正式会谈仍有可能，但可能性不大。

ex.en: The probability is that prices will rise rapidly.
ex.cn: 物价有可能会迅速上升。

ex.en: The probability that it will rain today is high.
ex.cn: 今天下雨的可能性很大.

def:
n.[医]（对伤处等的）针探，探查,[医]探针，取样器,探头,探测仪
vt.& vi.探索，调查,用探针（或探测器等）探查，探测
vt.盘问,（用试探性袭击等）侦察（敌情）,用尖物刺穿（物件）,用力使向前推进

ex.en: A doctor used a probe to remove metal fragments from a wound.
ex.cn: 医生用探针将伤口中的金属碎片取出.

ex.en: The police probe into organized crime led to several arrests.
ex.cn: 警方对有组织犯罪的调查使数人受到拘捕.

ex.en: They will probe deeply into the matter.
ex.cn: 他们将深入调查这件事.

def:
n.侧面，半面,外形，轮廓,[航]翼型,人物简介
vt.描…的轮廓,给…画侧面图,为（某人）写传略,[机]铣出…的轮廓

ex.en: The police deliberately kept a low profile in most places.
ex.cn: 警方在大多数地方有意保持低调。

ex.en: Tony has now been thrust into the limelight, with a high-profile job.
ex.cn: 托尼现在一下子成了众人关注的中心，因为他有一份经常出镜、见报的工作。

ex.en: This picture shows the girl in profile.
ex.cn: 这张照片照的是女孩的侧面。

def: vt.禁止，阻止，防止,不准许

ex.en: In most of the residence halls we visited, rules prohibit disorderly conduct.
ex.cn: 在我们走访的学生宿舍里，大多明令禁止胡作非为。

ex.en: Local zoning laws prohibit building near property lines.
ex.cn: 本地的规划法禁止在地产边界附近进行建筑施工。

ex.en: Prohibit the sale of alcoholic beverages.
ex.cn: 禁止出售含酒精的饮料.

def: adj.突出的，杰出的,突起的,著名的

ex.en: His stomach had grown more prominent with every passing year.
ex.cn: 他的肚子一年比一年鼓。

ex.en: In gardens, cankers are most prominent on apples and pear trees.
ex.cn: 花园里，苹果树和梨树患枯枝病最明显。

ex.en: Political trials were being used to keep prominent activists out of circulation.
ex.cn: 通过对著名活动家进行政治审判使其从公众视线中消失。

def: vt.推进,推动,驱动,驱使

ex.en: Paddles are used especially to propel canoes and kayaks.
ex.cn: 短桨特别用于划独木舟和小艇.

ex.en: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.
ex.cn: 小火箭捆绑在宇宙飞船上，用于推动飞船飞向火星。

ex.en: They use oars to propel boats.
ex.cn: 他们用浆推进船只.

def:
n.散文,单调，平凡,枯燥无味的话，无聊的议论
vt.用散文写，把…改写成散文,平淡无趣地写,啰啰唆唆地讲

ex.en: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.
ex.cn: 他的散文文笔有力、内容庞杂，有时几近晦涩。

ex.en: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
ex.cn: 她的行文风格并非总是恰到好处，往往爱重复。

ex.en: He discoursed for several hours on French and English prose.
ex.cn: 他花了几个小时讲述法国和英国的散文。

def:
vi.繁盛，成功
vt.使…成功,使…昌盛

ex.en: The high street banks continue to prosper.
ex.cn: 商业街上的银行仍旧一派繁荣景象。

ex.en: Ill - gotten gains never prosper.
ex.cn: 不义之财不发.

ex.en: He may have to become more conformist if he is to prosper again.
ex.cn: 要想再现辉煌，他可能得更多地依照习惯办事。

def: adj.繁荣的，兴旺的,富裕的,幸福的，运气好的,良好的

ex.en: Padua and Vicenza are prosperous, well-preserved cities, not overrun by tourists.
ex.cn: 帕多瓦和维琴察两市商业繁荣，建筑古迹保存良好，也没有蜂拥而至的游客。

ex.en: Rajneesh was the darling of a prosperous family.
ex.cn: 罗杰尼希是一个富有家庭的宠儿。

ex.en: Suburbs sprawled out to provide homes for the newly prosperous.
ex.cn: 市郊无规划地向外扩展以为新近富起来的人提供住房.

def: n.抗议,反对,申明

ex.en: Teachers staged a sit-down protest in front of the president's office.
ex.cn: 老师们在校长办公室门前举行了一场静坐抗议。

ex.en: Abidjan was thrown into turmoil because of a protest by taxi drivers.
ex.cn: 出租车司机的抗议使得阿比让陷入了混乱。

ex.en: The council is standing firm against the barrage of protest.
ex.cn: 委员会面对接二连三的抗议拒不让步。

def: adj.小心的，慎重的,精明的，节俭的,顾虑周到的，稳健的,世故的，精明的

ex.en: Tone down your kamikaze tendencies and take more prudent risks.
ex.cn: 别那么玩命，冒险时要谨慎些。

ex.en: Prudent people are not going to take a leap in the dark.
ex.cn: 小心谨慎的人是不会轻易冒险的。

ex.en: It might be more prudent to get a second opinion before going ahead.
ex.cn: 行动之前再征求一下意见也许更为慎重。

def: n.公众信息,宣传效用,宣传,公诸于众的状况

ex.en: The company was privatised with a fanfare of publicity.
ex.cn: 公司的私有化搞得沸沸扬扬。

ex.en: Now he plans to rev up publicity with a regional media campaign.
ex.cn: 现在他准备通过开展地区性的媒体活动加大宣传力度。

ex.en: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
ex.cn: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

def:
n.抽水机,打气筒,泵,轻软舞鞋
v. 用泵输送 ,涌出,急速摇晃,盘问

ex.en: They find it difficult to pump themselves up for the games.
ex.cn: 他们感到要为自己加油打气，自信满满地去打比赛并不容易。

ex.en: Somebody else lent me a pump and helped me mend the puncture.
ex.cn: 别人借给我一个打气筒，又帮我补好了轮胎。

ex.en: The lotion is dispensed by a handy pump action spray.
ex.cn: 洗液由一个使用方便的按压式皂液器提供。

def: n.木偶,傀儡,受他人操纵的人

ex.en: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers.
ex.cn: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

ex.en: The occupying forces set up a puppet government .
ex.cn: 占领军建立了一个傀儡政府。

ex.en: We watched a performance which included a puppet show and acrobatics.
ex.cn: 我们观看了一场演出,内容有木偶和杂技.

def: adj.定量的,数量（上）的

ex.en: That's the whole difference between quantitative and qualitative research.
ex.cn: 那就是定量研究和定性研究之间的重大差别。

ex.en: He said it was only a quantitative difference.
ex.cn: 他说这仅仅是数量上的差别.

ex.en: Business graduates must also be numerate, because most degrees will have courses in quantitative methods and statistics.
ex.cn: 商科专业大学毕业生也必须具备良好的数学能力, 因为大部分学位涉及定量研究法和统计学领域课程.

def: n.调查表,调查问卷

ex.en: Answer the questionnaire overleaf.
ex.cn: 请回答背面的问卷。

ex.en: We ask candidates to complete a psychometric questionnaire.
ex.cn: 我们让候选人填写一份心理测试问卷。

ex.en: to complete a questionnaire
ex.cn: 填好问卷

def:
n.（人或车辆）行列，长队,辫子
vi.（人、车等）排队等候
vt.（使）排队，列队等待
adj.种族的,人种的,存在或发生于种族之间的

ex.en: Marseilles has proved to be a better racial melting pot than Lyons.
ex.cn: 事实证明，与里昂相比，马赛是一个更好的种族大熔炉。

ex.en: Blacks have been hurt by racial inequalities in housing and education.
ex.cn: 住房与教育方面的种族不平等现象让黑人深受伤害。

ex.en: The detection rate for racial crimes is appallingly low.
ex.cn: 种族罪案的侦破率之低让人震惊。

def: n.雷达,雷达装置,无线电探测器

vt.辐射,发射,使向周围扩展
vi.射出,发散,发光
adj.辐射状的,射出的

ex.en: Callahan posits that chemical elements radiate electromagnetic signals.
ex.cn: 卡拉汉假定化学元素放射电磁信号。

ex.en: Stoves are meant to radiate heat.
ex.cn: 炉子就是要发热的。

ex.en: Avenues radiate from the Arc de Triomphe in Paris.
ex.cn: 在巴黎,街道以凯旋门为中心向四方伸展.

def:
n.（骑兵队等的）急袭，突然袭击，突击，（军舰等的）游击,劫掠，劫夺，（盗贼，狐等的）侵入,突然查抄[搜捕]，围捕
vi.对…进行突然袭击,进行奇袭
vt.突然袭击[抢劫],突然搜查,劫掠,打劫

vt.& vi.突然说出,（公开地）严厉批评,突然大声说出,连续敲叩
n.（轻快的）敲击（声）,说唱音乐,说唱歌,速度快的谈话

ex.en: He said statisticians gave them a bad rap by "lying with figures".
ex.cn: 他说统计学家“用数据说谎”，败坏了他们的名声。

ex.en: The rap on this guy is that he doesn't really care.
ex.cn: 这家伙据说并不怎么在乎。

ex.en: Britain gave them a diplomatic rap over the knuckles.
ex.cn: 英国对他们进行了外交上的谴责。

def: n.领域，范围,王国,（学术的）部门，界,（动植物分布的）圈，带

ex.en: This is a target which is surely within the realm of possibility.
ex.cn: 这是一个完全有可能实现的目标。

ex.en: in the realm of literature
ex.cn: 在文学领域内

ex.en: The king maintained order within the bounds of his realm.
ex.cn: 国王在其王国的疆界之内维持着秩序.

def:
n.反政府的人,反叛者,造反者,叛逆者
adj.反抗的,造反的

ex.en: The spokesman confirmed that the area was now in rebel hands.
ex.cn: 这位发言人证实该地区现已落入叛乱分子手中。

ex.en: If Douglas came down hard enough on him, Dale would rebel.
ex.cn: 如果道格拉斯对戴尔太过严厉，他就会反抗。

ex.en: The rebel forces simply bypassed Zwedru on their way further south.
ex.cn: 叛军在向南部挺进时直接绕过了绥德鲁。

def: n.接待,欢迎,招待会,接待处

ex.en: Mr Mandela was given a tumultuous reception in Washington.
ex.cn: 曼德拉先生在华盛顿受到热情的款待。

ex.en: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
ex.cn: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

ex.en: He recently did the catering for a presidential reception.
ex.cn: 他最近承办了一次总统招待会的宴席。

def: vt.使和好，使和解,调停，排解（争端等）,[宗]使（场所等）洁净,[船]使（木板）接缝平滑

ex.en: an attempt to reconcile the need for industrial development with concern for the environment
ex.cn: 协调工业发展的需要和环境保护之间关系的努力

ex.en: Must they reconcile themselves to their fate?
ex.cn: 难道他们甘心忍受这种命运 吗 ?

ex.en: Negotiators must now work out how to reconcile these demands with American demands for access.
ex.cn: 谈判人员现在必须想办法调和这些要求和美国人想要参与的要求。

def: n.消遣（方式）,娱乐（方式）,重建，重现

ex.en: There are plans to enlarge the recreation area.
ex.cn: 已经有了扩大娱乐场地的计划。

ex.en: the need to improve facilities for leisure and recreation
ex.cn: 改进消遣娱乐设施之必要

ex.en: There are excellent facilities for sport and recreation.
ex.cn: 有完善的体育娱乐设施。

def:
n.新兵,（机构中的）新成员,新学生
vt.招聘，征募,吸收某人为新成员,动员…（提供帮助）,雇用
vi.征募新兵,得到补充，得到补偿,恢复健康

ex.en: Firms are now keen to hold on to the people they recruit.
ex.cn: 各公司现在都急切地想要留住招聘来的员工。

ex.en: He helped to recruit volunteers to go to Pakistan to fight.
ex.cn: 他协助招募志愿者到巴基斯坦打仗。

ex.en: The police are trying to recruit more officers from ethnic minorities.
ex.cn: 警察机关正试图从少数民族中征募更多的新警员。

def: n.<主英>反射，反射光,反射作用（等于reflection）

ex.en: The dark areas of the reflexion map aren't really black.
ex.cn: 反射贴图的黑色部分其实并不全黑。

ex.en: FS Reflexion works with a seismic vibration system.
ex.cn: FS是由地震的震动工作原理.

ex.en: Using the dynamical reflexion theory, the selective reflection characters of cholesteric liquid crystals are analyzed.
ex.cn: 利用动态反射法对手性液晶材料的选择性反射特性进行了分析.

def: n.反映,（关于某课题的）思考,（声、光、热等的）反射,映像

ex.en: On reflection, he says, he very much regrets the comments.
ex.cn: 经过反省，他说自己对所作的评论感到非常后悔。

ex.en: I couldn't bear to see my reflection in the mirror.
ex.cn: 我不忍看镜子里自己的样子。

ex.en: After days of reflection she decided to write back.
ex.cn: 想了几天之后她决定回信。

def: n.拒绝,优先取舍权

ex.en: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home.
ex.cn: 他们引证了亚历克斯拒绝回到婚后的家中一事。

ex.en: Their refusal to compromise will inevitably invite more criticism from the UN.
ex.cn: 他们拒绝妥协必然会引发联合国的更多批评。

ex.en: I couldn't tell if his refusal to talk was simple stubbornness.
ex.cn: 我不清楚他拒绝说话是否只是因为他的顽固不化。

def: vt.驳斥，驳倒,否认真实性

ex.en: Isabelle is quick to refute any suggestion of intellectual snobbery.
ex.cn: 伊莎贝尔对于任何关于她恃才傲物的暗示都迅速予以否认。

ex.en: It goes without saying that we have the right to refute them publicly.
ex.cn: 不用说我们有权公开驳斥他们.

ex.en: The meeting was very lively and informal with everyone chipping to supplement or refute what the speakers said.
ex.cn: 会议开得很活跃,不拘束,每个人都能插话补充,或反驳发言者的讲话.

def:
adv.不顾后果地,不管怎样，无论如何,不惜费用地
adj.不重视的，不尊敬的,不顾虑的，不关心的,不受注意的，毫无价值的

ex.en: It takes in anybody regardless of religion, colour, or creed.
ex.cn: 任何人，不论宗教、肤色或信仰，都可以加入。

ex.en: The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless .
ex.cn: 天气非常恶劣，但我们并不理会，照常进行。

ex.en: The club welcomes all new members regardless of age.
ex.cn: 俱乐部对所有新成员不分年龄一律欢迎。

def:
vi.当政，统治,占主导地位
vt.想法、情感或氛围盛行，成为最显著的
n.君主的统治,君主统治时期,任期,当政期

ex.en: The commanders accused him of carrying out a reign of terror.
ex.cn: 指挥官们谴责他实行恐怖统治。

ex.en: More and more nobles made Moscow their home during Catherine's reign.
ex.cn: 在叶卡捷琳娜大帝统治时期，越来越多的贵族移居莫斯科。

ex.en: Archaeologists have dated the fort to the reign of Emperor Antoninus Pius.
ex.cn: 考古学家判定这个堡垒建于罗马皇帝安东尼·庇护统治时期。

def:
vi.高兴,欢庆
vt.使高兴,使欢喜

ex.en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
ex.cn: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

ex.en: We rejoice at every victory won by your people.
ex.cn: 我们为贵国人民取得的每一个胜利都感到高兴.

ex.en: I rejoice that you have recovered so quickly.
ex.cn: 听到你已很快痊愈了,我很高兴.

def:
vt.& vi.（使）轻松,（使）松弛,放宽,（使）放松
vt.缓和，减轻,（使大便等）通畅
vi.变得轻松,变得随和,变得和蔼,通便

ex.en: Massage is used to relax muscles, relieve stress and improve the circulation.
ex.cn: 按摩可以使肌肉放松，缓解压力和促进血液循环。

ex.en: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?
ex.cn: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

ex.en: Relax as much as possible and keep breathing steadily.
ex.cn: 尽量放松，保持平稳呼吸。

def: n.文艺复兴,文艺复兴时期,文艺复兴时期（欧洲 14、15 和 16 世纪时，人们以古希腊罗马的思想文化来繁荣文学艺术）,（某一学科或艺术形式等衰落后的）复兴

vt.翻新，修复，整修,革新，更新,恢复（精神）
adj.恢复的，革新的，翻新的

adj.共和国的,共和政体的,共和主义的,<美>共和党员
n.拥护共和政体者，共和主义者,<美>共和党的

ex.en: Amy's own Republican sympathies strengthened as the days passed.
ex.cn: 埃米个人对共和党的支持与日俱增。

ex.en: "I'll get the Republican nomination," he assured me. "It's in the bag."
ex.cn: “我会得到共和党提名的，”他向我保证，“这是十拿九稳的事。”

ex.en: Republican strategists are taking particular aim at Democratic senators.
ex.cn: 共和党的战略家正尖锐地攻击民主党的参议员。

def:
vt.营救，救援，使免遭损失,[法律] 非法劫回
n.营救，救援,营救[救援]行动

ex.en: Lights clipped onto life jackets improve the chances of rescue.
ex.cn: 别在救生衣上的灯提高了获救可能性。

ex.en: The air rescue operation has now been scaled down.
ex.cn: 空中救援行动的规模现在已经有所缩小。

ex.en: Paramilitary police units are taking part in rescue efforts.
ex.cn: 准军事警察部队正在参与营救行动。

def: n.蓄水池,贮液器,储藏,蓄积

ex.en: This reservoir was formed by damming the River Blith.
ex.cn: 这个水库是通过在布莱斯河上筑坝形成的。

ex.en: The villagers piped in drinking water from the reservoir.
ex.cn: 村民用管道从水库引来饮用水。

ex.en: The aircraft crashed after takeoff from Heathrow in a reservoir.
ex.cn: 飞机从希思罗机场起飞后坠毁在一个水库里。

def: n.住处，住宅,居住时间，居住,公馆,驻地

ex.en: They had entered the country and had applied for permanent residence.
ex.cn: 他们已经入境该国，并申请了永久居留权。

ex.en: In most of the residence halls we visited, rules prohibit disorderly conduct.
ex.cn: 在我们走访的学生宿舍里，大多明令禁止胡作非为。

ex.en: Wakoski is writer in residence at Michigan State University.
ex.cn: 瓦科斯基是密歇根州立大学的常驻作家。

def: n.决心,解决,坚决,分辨率

ex.en: "I think I'll try a hypnotist," I said with sudden resolution.
ex.cn: “我会找催眠师试试，”我突然坚决地说。

ex.en: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

ex.en: Today's Security Council resolution will be a significant success for American diplomacy.
ex.cn: 今天的安理会决议将是美国外交取得的一个重大成功。

def: vt.抑制，压抑,限定，限制,制止,监禁

ex.en: Unable to restrain herself, she rose and went to the phone.
ex.cn: 她没能克制住自己，起身走向电话。

ex.en: In the 1970s, the government tried to restrain corruption.
ex.cn: 在20世纪70年代，政府曾经试图打击腐败。

ex.en: If you can't restrain your dog you must lock it up.
ex.cn: 如果你无法管住你的狗,就必须把它关起来.

def: v.重新开始,继续,恢复职位

ex.en: They thought that he should resume his kingly duties.
ex.cn: 他们认为他应该继续履行君主的职责。

ex.en: I was given the all clear by the doctor to resume playing.
ex.cn: 医生准许我重新开始训练。

ex.en: Within hours, she was free to resume her journey westward.
ex.cn: 几小时以后她便抽出身来重新开始西行的旅程。

def:
n.零售
vt.零售,零卖,转述,传播
adj.零售的
adv.以零售方式

ex.en: There's nothing better than a bit of retail therapy.
ex.cn: 没有什么比花钱买点东西能让自己高兴起来了。

ex.en: The news from Body Shop rattled the rest of the retail sector.
ex.cn: 从“美体小铺”传来的消息令整个零售行业不安。

ex.en: He now controls the largest retail development empire in southern California.
ex.cn: 他现在掌管着加州南部最大的零售发展企业。

def:
n.报仇，报复
vt.为…报仇，报…之仇

ex.en: There are few things quite as sweet as revenge.
ex.cn: 几乎没有比复仇更爽的事情了。

ex.en: She took revenge on her ex-boyfriend by smashing up his home.
ex.cn: 为了报复，她砸了前任男友的家。

ex.en: She uses the media to help her exact a terrible revenge.
ex.cn: 她利用媒体帮助自己进行可怕的复仇。

def:
vt.（使）厌恶
vi.反叛，背叛,厌恶，反感
n.造反，起义

ex.en: Soon the entire armed forces were in open revolt.
ex.cn: 很快，整个武装部队开始公然抗命。

ex.en: The newly-occupied Italian colony of Libya rose in revolt in 1914.
ex.cn: 意大利新占领的殖民地利比亚于1914年发生叛乱。

ex.en: It was undeniably a revolt by ordinary people against their leaders.
ex.cn: 不可否认，这是一场平民百姓反抗领导人的起义。

def: adj.严格的,僵硬的,（规则、方法等）死板的,刚硬的，顽固的

ex.en: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
ex.cn: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

ex.en: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.
ex.cn: 他通过严格控制公共开支保持预算平衡。

ex.en: Andrew went rigid when he saw a dog, any dog, anywhere.
ex.cn: 安德鲁过去只要看见狗，无论在哪里，无论什么狗，都会吓得一动不动。

def: adj.严密的,缜密的,严格的,枯燥的

ex.en: Taxis must conform to the rigorous standards laid down by the police.
ex.cn: 出租车必须遵守警方的严格规定。

ex.en: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
ex.cn: 选拔过程是基于对能力和经验的严格测试。

ex.en: The work failed to meet their rigorous standards.
ex.cn: 工作没有达到他们的严格标准。

def: n.杆，拉杆,惩罚，体罚,（责打人用的）棍棒,手枪

ex.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
ex.cn: 操作杆进一步弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的吱吱声。

ex.en: Both Rod and Phil are football fanatics.
ex.cn: 罗德和菲尔两人都是足球迷。

ex.en: He is a lightning rod for controversy.
ex.cn: 他是个争议性人物。

def:
n.腐烂，腐朽
vt.& vi.（使）腐烂，（使）腐朽

ex.en: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.
ex.cn: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

ex.en: Condensation will eventually cause the fabric of the building to rot away.
ex.cn: 冷凝作用将最终使建筑结构腐朽掉。

ex.en: The trees were in bad shape from dry rot.
ex.cn: 树木得了干腐病，状况堪忧。

def:
vt.& vi.（使某物）旋转,使转动,使轮流，轮换,交替
adj.[植]辐状的,有辐射部分的

ex.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
ex.cn: 伴随着隆隆的低沉噪声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

ex.en: Rotate the head clockwise and counterclockwise.
ex.cn: 按顺时针方向转动头部，然后再逆时针旋转。

ex.en: Rotate the shoulders in their sockets five times.
ex.cn: 让肩膀绕臼部转动5次。

def: adj.乡下的，农村的,田园的,地方的,农业的

ex.en: The lure of rural life is proving as strong as ever.
ex.cn: 事实证明，乡村生活的魅力丝毫未减。

ex.en: Desegregation may be harder to enforce in rural areas.
ex.cn: 要废除农村地区的种族隔离可能会更困难一些。

ex.en: They announced the initiation of a rural development programme.
ex.cn: 他们宣布启动一项农村发展计划。

def:
n.圣人般的人（指特别善良、仁爱或有耐性的人）,圣…（冠于人名、地名之前）,（因其生死言行而被基督教会追封的）圣人,圣徒
vt.成为圣徒,把…视为圣徒

ex.en: I've had enough—there are limits even for the patience of a saint!
ex.cn: 我已经受够了——即使是圣人忍耐也是有限的！

ex.en: Chiswick church is dedicated to St Nicholas, patron saint of sailors.
ex.cn: 奇西克教堂为水手的守护神圣尼古拉而建。

ex.en: My girlfriend is a saint to put up with me.
ex.cn: 能够忍受我，我的女朋友真的很有耐心。

def:
vt.使惊恐，惊吓,使害怕，使恐惧,把…吓跑
vi.受惊吓,感到害怕
n.惊恐，惊吓,恐惧,恐慌
adj.骇人的，令人恐惧的,引起恐慌的,用以吓唬人的

ex.en: Then he took a poke at my hair, telling me I looked like a scarecrow!
ex.cn: 然后他开始嘲笑我的头发, 说我看起来像个稻草人!

ex.en: Look at you a regular scarecrow!
ex.cn: 你自己看看,谁像你这样特别!

ex.en: I don't mean to be married to that old scarecrow.
ex.cn: 我可不愿意嫁给那个老稻草人.

def:
n.香味，气味,嗅觉,（动物的）臭迹,痕迹，踪迹
vt.闻到,察觉，发觉,使充满…的气味,发出气味
vi.发出…的气味,有…的迹象,嗅着气味追赶

ex.en: Lie back and luxuriate in the scented oil.
ex.cn: 躺下来尽情享受精油的滋润。

ex.en: The white flowers are pleasantly scented.
ex.cn: 这些白花清香怡人。

ex.en: I let my lungs fill with the scented air.
ex.cn: 我呼吸着芬芳的空气.

def:
n.鄙视,轻蔑,不屑一顾,笑柄
vt.轻视,看不起,蔑视,不屑做
vi.表示轻蔑,表示鄙视,嘲笑

ex.en: He is deeply scornful of politicians.
ex.cn: 他非常看不起政客。

ex.en: He opened the door with a scornful look on his face.
ex.cn: 他面带轻蔑地开了门.

ex.en: She flung him a scornful look.
ex.cn: 她轻蔑地看了他一眼.

def:
vt.擦，刮,擦去,擦伤，刮破,挖空
vi.刮，擦,搔，抓,掏,发出刺耳的声音
n.擦，刮,刮痕,刮擦声,刮胡子，修面

ex.en: They started to kick around the idea of an electric scraper.
ex.cn: 他们开始讨论弄一个电铲。

ex.en: We removed the loose paint with a scraper.
ex.cn: 我们用刮刀将剥起的漆铲去.

ex.en: From time to time a scraper is passed through the pipeline to remove this corrosion.
ex.cn: 不时用清管器在油管内穿过,以清除这种锈蚀.

def:
vt.擦，刮,擦痛，擦伤,在…处搔痒,抓破
vi.发出刮擦声,擦红，擦伤,搔痒,抓，扒
n.擦，刮,刮擦声,搔痕,乱写乱画
adj.打草稿用的，随便写用的,碰巧的，侥幸的,东拼西凑的,平等比赛的

n.螺丝钉,螺旋桨，螺旋状物,（螺丝的）转，扭,吝啬鬼
vt.用螺丝拧紧,扭曲（某人的面孔）,〈俚〉占便宜，诈骗
vi.扭转，扭歪,旋紧,（和某人）性交

n.雕刻（术），塑像,雕刻品,刻纹
vt.雕塑,以雕刻装饰,侵蚀
vi.雕刻

ex.en: I was attracted by the sculpturesque beauty of David's face.
ex.cn: 我被大卫脸上精雕细凿的美所吸引.

def: adv.看来似乎,表面上看来,貌似

ex.en: For barrier and immunity of enteric, select seemliness time and composition enteral nutrition is very importance.
ex.cn: 由于肠道具有屏障、免疫等各项功能,因此恰当选择肠内营养的时机及给予合理营养成分是十分重要的.

ex.cn: 该影片受到了影评人和公众的高度评价。

ex.en: Angela Bassett has won critical acclaim for her excellent performance.
ex.cn: 安吉拉·贝塞特凭借其出色的表演赢得了评论界的好评。

ex.en: All this equipment has received international acclaim from the specialist hi-fi press.
ex.cn: 这套设备受到全球高保真音响专业报刊的赞誉。

def:
n.协议,条约,（色彩的）协调,和解协议
vt.给予,使和谐一致,使符合,使适合
vi.符合,一致
n.杂技演员,立场观点善变的人，主张、政见等变化无常的人

ex.en: The acrobat balanced a long pole on his left shoulder.
ex.cn: 杂技演员让一根长杆在他的左肩上保持平衡.

ex.en: The acrobat could bend himself into a hoop.
ex.cn: 这个杂技演员可以把身体蜷曲成圆形.

ex.en: An acrobat has to be agile.
ex.cn: 杂技演员必须身手敏捷.

def: adj.邻近的，毗邻的,（时间上）紧接着的,相邻

ex.en: The schools were adjacent but there were separate doors.
ex.cn: 这些学校紧挨着，但各自独门独户。

ex.en: The planes landed on adjacent runways.
ex.cn: 这些飞机在毗连的跑道上降落。

ex.en: These young students live in adjacent rooms.
ex.cn: 这些年轻的学生住在毗连的房间里.

def:
vt.管理,治理（国家）,给予,执行
vi.执行遗产管理人的职责,给予帮助,担当管理人

ex.en: Next summer's exams would be straightforward to administer and mark.
ex.cn: 明年夏天的考试在执行和评分上都将很简单。

ex.en: Paramedics are trained to administer certain drugs.
ex.cn: 护理人员们接受了配发某些药物的培训。

ex.en: He thinks the tax is impossible to administer.
ex.cn: 他认为税金没法管理。

def:
vt.爱慕,崇拜,非常喜欢,敬佩
vi.崇拜,爱慕

ex.en: I adore good books and the theatre.
ex.cn: 我爱读好书，也喜欢看戏。

ex.en: People adore him for his noble character.
ex.cn: 人们因他的高贵品质而敬爱他.

ex.en: We adore them for their generosity.
ex.cn: 我们钦佩他们的慷慨.

def: n.出现,到来,基督降临节（圣诞节前的四个星期）

ex.en: the advent of new technology
ex.cn: 新技术的出现

ex.en: Swallows come by groups at the advent of spring.
ex.cn: 春天来临时燕子成群飞来.

ex.en: The advent of the Euro will redefine Europe.
ex.cn: 欧元的出现将重新定义欧洲.

def: adj.不利的,有害的,逆的,相反的

ex.en: Despite the adverse conditions, the road was finished in just eight months.
ex.cn: 尽管存在种种不利情况，公路还是仅用8个月就完工了。

ex.en: Dirt and disease are adverse to the best growth of children.
ex.cn: 肮脏与疾病对儿童健康成长不利.

ex.en: My sister's taste in dresses is adverse to my own.
ex.cn: 我妹妹的服饰审美观完全与我相反.

def: vt.& vi.断言，肯定,证实，确实,[法]不经宣誓而庄严宣布,承认

ex.en: This report is positively denied in official circles, who affirm that nothing of the kind occurred , but that the story is made out of whole cloth.
ex.cn: 这篇报导为官方人士所断然否认, 他们断言根本没有这回事, 其内容纯属捏造.

ex.en: Everything I had accomplished seemed to affirm that opinion.
ex.cn: 我所取得的一切似乎都证明那个观点是对的。

ex.en: We gave them the opportunity to express their feelings, to affirm themselves.
ex.cn: 我们给了他们一个机会表达自己的感情, 他们可以借此挺一挺腰杆.

def:
adj.富裕的，富足的,流畅，滔滔不绝的
n.富裕的人,支流

ex.en: The Strand is one of London's busiest and most affluent streets.
ex.cn: 斯特兰德街是伦敦最繁华、最富足的街道之一。

ex.en: The diet of the affluent has not changed much over the decades.
ex.cn: 几十年来富人们的饮食习惯并未发生太大的变化。

ex.en: a very affluent neighbourhood
ex.cn: 富人区

def: n.过道，通道,侧廊，耳堂,狭长的通路

ex.en: He was in no hurry to walk down the aisle.
ex.cn: 他并不急于结婚。

ex.en: A quick movement across the aisle caught his eye.
ex.cn: 有个人影在走道里一闪而过，引起了他的注意。

ex.en: Caroline floated up the aisle on her father's arm.
ex.cn: 卡罗琳挽着父亲的手臂从过道上优雅地走过。

def: n.相册,集邮簿,签名册,唱片

ex.en: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
ex.cn: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

ex.en: They are recording a follow-up to their successful 1989 album.
ex.cn: 他们正在灌录他们1989年畅销专辑的续篇。

ex.en: Their first album was painfully frank to the point of being confessional.
ex.cn: 他们的第一张专辑是那么的坦率，近乎自白。

def:
adj.警觉的，警惕的，注意的,思维敏捷的,活泼的
n.警报,警戒状态
vt.向…报警

ex.en: The armed forces were on high alert to guard against any retaliation.
ex.cn: 武装部队保持高度戒备，以防发生任何报复行动。

ex.en: They want to be on the alert for similar buying opportunities.
ex.cn: 他们希望随时掌握有关类似购买机会的信息。

ex.en: The bank is alert to the danger.
ex.cn: 银行充分意识到了危险。

def: vt.断言，宣称，辩解,提出…作为理由

ex.en: Prosecutors in the trial allege the defendants plotted to overthrow the government.
ex.cn: 检方在审判中指称被告密谋推翻政府。

ex.en: To aver is to allege in a pleading.
ex.cn: 立证是在辩护中引例证明.

ex.en: The newspaper reporters allege that the man was murdered but they have given no proof.
ex.cn: 新闻记者们宣称这个男人是被谋杀的,但他们没提出证据.

def: vt.减轻，缓和

ex.en: Nowadays, a great deal can be done to alleviate back pain.
ex.cn: 如今，减轻背部疼痛可以有许多方法。

ex.en: Tranquillizers help alleviate the distressing symptoms of anxiety.
ex.cn: 镇静剂有助于缓解焦虑所带来的不安症状。

ex.en: A number of measures were taken to alleviate the problem.
ex.cn: 采取了一系列措施缓解这个问题。

def: n.（国家、政党等的）结盟，同盟，联盟，联合,联姻,同盟条约,同盟者

ex.en: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple?
ex.cn: 若IBM公司和苹果公司联合将会有什么效果呢？

ex.en: There are signs that the alliance is now fraying at the edges.
ex.cn: 有迹象表明该联盟现正分崩离析。

ex.en: Yet now he was here, in extremis, to seek an alliance.
ex.cn: 然而现在他就在这里，在绝境中寻求联盟。

def: vt.分配，分派,把…拨给

ex.en: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appoint-ments.
ex.cn: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

ex.en: They intend to allocate more places to mature students this year.
ex.cn: 今年他们打算给成人学生提供更多的名额。

ex.en: Local authorities have to learn to allocate resources efficiently.
ex.cn: 地方政府必须学会有效地分配资源.

def:
n.津贴，补贴，零用钱,限额,折扣,默许，默认
vt.给（某人）零用钱或津贴,按定量供给

ex.en: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
ex.cn: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

ex.en: He lives on a single parent's allowance of £70 a week.
ex.cn: 他靠每周70英镑的单亲家庭生活补助过日子。

ex.en: The personal allowance depends on your age and marital status.
ex.cn: 个人免税额的多少取决于年龄和婚姻状况。

def:
n.合金,（合金中的）劣等金属,搀杂品,成色
v.合铸，熔合（金属）,铸成合金,在…中搀以杂质，使（金属）减低成色

ex.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
ex.cn: 黄铜是铜锌合金。

ex.en: The worker worked in a little copper with the alloy.
ex.cn: 工人在合金里搀了一点铜.

ex.en: Last October the first batch of low - alloy channel steel was successfully rolled.
ex.cn: 去年10月,成功轧出第一批低合金槽钢.

def:
n.同盟国，同盟者,助手，支持者,协约国,联盟
vt.&vi.（使）联盟，（使）同盟,（使）结盟，（使）联姻

ex.en: The United States is a close ally of South Korea.
ex.cn: 美国是韩国的亲密盟友。

ex.en: He is a close ally of the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 他是首相的亲密支持者。

ex.en: a close ally and friend of the prime minister
ex.cn: 首相的一个亲密盟友和伙伴

def:
adv.在…的侧面,在…旁边,与…并排
prep.在…旁边,横靠,傍着

ex.en: A variety of heavy industries grew up alongside the port.
ex.cn: 各种重工业沿着港口逐渐发展起来。

ex.en: Daisy strode alongside her, breathing heavily but keeping pace.
ex.cn: 黛西在她身边大步走着，大口喘着气，但是没有落后。

ex.en: He crossed the street and walked alongside Central Park.
ex.cn: 他穿过街道，沿着中央公园走。

def: n.大使，使节,（派驻联合国等国际组织的）代表,特使,[比喻]使者

ex.en: The decision will be relayed to Iraq's ambassador at the UN.
ex.cn: 这个决定将会被传达给伊拉克驻联合国大使。

ex.en: Also among the speakers was the new American ambassador to Moscow.
ex.cn: 发言者当中还有驻莫斯科的新任美国大使。

ex.en: I've been invited to meet with the American Ambassador.
ex.cn: 我受邀会见美国大使。

def: adj.和蔼可亲的,温和的

ex.en: Sara, while remaining outwardly amiable toward all concerned, was inwardly furious.
ex.cn: 萨拉尽管表面上对所有相关的人依然和蔼可亲，内心却怒火中烧。

ex.en: an amiable tone of voice
ex.cn: 亲切的声调

ex.en: Do you really want to go or are you merely being amiable?
ex.cn: 你是真的想去呢,还是仅仅为了表示友好?

def: n.扩音器,放大器,扩大的人,详述者

ex.en: a 25 watt amplifier
ex.cn: 一台25瓦扩音器

ex.en: The amplifier exploded in a fountain of sparks.
ex.cn: 放大器爆炸，喷射出火星。

ex.en: All the speakers hook up to a single amplifier.
ex.cn: 所有喇叭都接在单一的扩音器上.

def:
vt.放大，扩大,增强,详述
vi.详述,引申,发挥

n.类似物，同源语,<电脑>模拟
adj.（钟表）有长短针的,<电脑>模拟的

ex.en: Its proposed signal is a hybrid, part analog and part digital.
ex.cn: 其拟议中的信号是一种部分模拟与部分数字的混合波导联结.

ex.en: The voltage may provides an analog representation of the temperature difference.
ex.cn: 电压可以成为温差的模拟表示.

ex.en: Digital networks are considerably less subjected to noise than analog networks.
ex.cn: 数字网络不象模拟网络那样易受噪音干扰.

def:
n.相似物,相似的情况，对应的人,<语>同源词
adj.模拟计算机的,类似的，相似物的

ex.en: The analogue signals from the video tape are converted into digital code.
ex.cn: 采自该录像带的模拟信号被转换成数字代码。

ex.en: Analogue computers are generalpurpose devices which employ laws of physics for performing mathematical operations.
ex.cn: 模拟计算机是用物理定律进行数学运算的通用装置.

ex.en: No model can ever be a perfect analogue of nature itself.
ex.cn: 任何模型都无法完全模拟自然本身。

def:
n.痛苦,苦恼,伤心,令人心酸
vt.使极度痛苦,使苦恼,悲痛万分
vi.感到极度的痛苦,苦恼

ex.en: Every line etched on her face told a story of personal anguish.
ex.cn: 她脸上的每条皱纹都讲述了一次痛苦的经历。

ex.en: No one suspected the anguish he carried on his shoulders.
ex.cn: 没人觉察出他所承担的痛苦。

ex.en: For a few brief minutes we forgot the anxiety and anguish.
ex.cn: 短短几分钟我们就忘记了焦虑与苦恼。

def: n.踝，踝关节,脚脖子

ex.en: He had wrenched his ankle badly from the force of the fall.
ex.cn: 他因摔倒而严重扭伤了脚踝。

ex.en: His teeth clicked as he snapped at my ankle.
ex.cn: 它猛地朝我的脚脖子咬下去，牙齿还咔咔直响。

ex.en: Her ankle caught on a root, and she almost lost her balance.
ex.cn: 她的脚踝被树根绊了一下，差点摔倒。

def:
n.周年纪念日
adj.周年的,周年纪念的,年年的,每年的

ex.en: Campaigners lit scores of bonfires in ceremonies to mark the anniversary.
ex.cn: 参加运动的人们在各种仪式上点起一垛垛篝火以纪念周年庆典。

ex.en: The Vietnamese government has fixed on May 19th to celebrate his anniversary.
ex.cn: 越南政府已经决定于5月19日庆祝他的诞辰。

ex.en: It was the fortieth anniversary of the death of the composer.
ex.cn: 这是该作曲家逝世40周年纪念日。

def: n.[生] 触角，触须,感觉，直觉,天线

ex.en: They erected a television antenna on the roof.
ex.cn: 他们在屋顶上架起了电视天线.

ex.en: In our village, there is an antenna on every roof for receiving TV signals.
ex.cn: 在我们村里, 每家房顶上都有天线接收电视信号.

ex.en: Extended the radio antenna.
ex.cn: 把收音机的天线拉到最长。

def:
adj.古老的，古代的,过时的，古董的,古时制造的,古风的
n.古玩，古董,古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格
v.仿古制作,使显得古色古香,寻觅古玩

ex.en: He finds material at auctions, antique shops and flea markets.
ex.cn: 他在拍卖行、古玩店和跳蚤市场中寻宝。

ex.en: Windsor Castle is quite literally an antique treasure trove.
ex.cn: 温莎城堡确实是名副其实的古物宝藏。

ex.en: This isn't a genuine antique ─ you've been done.
ex.cn: 这不是真正的古董——你上当了。

def: adv.总之,无论如何,不管怎样,随随便便

ex.en: "Anyhow," she added briskly, "it's none of my business."
ex.cn: “不管怎样”，她轻松地补充说，“这不关我的事。”

ex.en: Mother certainly won't let him stay with her and anyhow he wouldn't.
ex.cn: 母亲当然不会让他和她住在一起，再说他也不愿意。

ex.en: Where the hell was Bud, anyhow?
ex.cn: 巴德到底在哪儿？

def:
vt.使惊骇，使充满恐惧,惊吓
vi.减弱,变得苍白

ex.en: I was appal ( l ) ed at the news.
ex.cn: 我被这消息吓坏了.

ex.en: This " Hamlet " will appal some for being so resolutely unclassical.
ex.cn: 新版《哈姆雷特 》 如此违背经典,确实惊世骇俗.

ex.en: The new film will ambush the unwary, appal the squeamish and get unwanted attention the prurient.
ex.cn: 这部新片将出其不意地震撼粗心的观众, 令胆小的观众感到惊骇,并得到好色之徒讨厌的关注.

def: vt.<美>使惊骇，使充满恐惧
n.附录,阑尾,附加物

ex.en: We are not certain whether the appendix had already burst or not.
ex.cn: 我们不敢肯定阑尾是否已经破裂。

ex.en: I have recently had my appendix removed.
ex.cn: 我最近切除了阑尾.

ex.en: This prospect was the subject of an appendix to the development plan.
ex.cn: 这是发展计划附件的主题规划.

def: n.欲望,胃口，食欲,嗜好，爱好

ex.en: There is nothing like a long walk to arouse the appetite.
ex.cn: 没有什么比走很长的路更能激起食欲的了。

ex.en: Symptoms are a slight fever, headache and loss of appetite.
ex.cn: 症状包括低烧、头痛和食欲不振。

ex.en: The public has an insatiable appetite for stories about the famous.
ex.cn: 公众对名人有着难以满足的好奇心。

def:
vt.鼓掌欢迎，欢呼,称赞，赞许,赞成，同意
vi.夸赞，鼓掌

ex.en: Every person stood to applaud his unforgettable act of courage.
ex.cn: 所有人起立为他不可磨灭的英勇之举鼓掌。

ex.en: Thinking people on both sides will applaud this book.
ex.cn: 双方的有识之士都会称赞这本书。

ex.en: He started to applaud and the others joined in.
ex.cn: 他开始鼓掌，其他人也跟着鼓起掌来。

def: n.热烈鼓掌,喝彩,掌声

ex.en: I kept hearing the sound of applause in the background.
ex.cn: 我不断听到隐约的鼓掌声。

ex.en: His speech was greeted with a storm of applause.
ex.cn: 人们对他的演讲报以雷鸣般的掌声。

ex.en: Her dancing brought loud cheers, wolf whistles and applause.
ex.cn: 她的舞蹈赢来震耳的欢呼声、口哨声和掌声。

def: n.评价，估量,鉴定，估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）

ex.en: Self-appraisal is never easy.
ex.cn: 进行自我评价向来很难。

ex.en: What's your appraisal of the situation?
ex.cn: 你对局势是如何评估的?

ex.en: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation.
ex.cn: 在此类情况下需要对形势有一个冷静的评估。

def:
adj.恰当的，适当的,有…倾向的,易于…的,聪明的，灵巧的
abbr.(=automatically programmed tool)自动数控程序,(=automatic picture transmission)（人造卫星）自动图像传输,(=advanced passenger train)先进型旅客特快列车,(=automative professional training)汽车专业训练

ex.en: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.
ex.cn: 这份报告的措词用在今天和用在1929年一样贴切。

ex.en: She was apt to raise her voice and wave her hands about.
ex.cn: 她动不动就拔高嗓门，并挥舞双手。

ex.en: We are apt to wish for what we can't have.
ex.cn: 我们往往会祈求得不到的东西.

def:
n.弓形,拱门,拱形物,足弓，齿弓
vt.（使）弯成拱形,用拱连接,向后弯
vi.拱起,成为弓形
adj.主要的,首要的,调皮的,淘气的

ex.en: Neither he nor his arch-rival, Giuseppe De Rita, won.
ex.cn: 他和他的死对头朱塞佩·德里察双双落败。

ex.en: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
ex.cn: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

ex.en: They walked through the arch and into the cobbled courtyard.
ex.cn: 他们穿过拱门走进铺着鹅卵石的院子。

def:
vt.逮捕，拘捕,止住，阻止，抑制,吸引（注意）
vi.心跳停止
n.拘留,停止，阻止,制动（装置）

ex.en: Some magistrates have abused their powers of arrest to extort confessions.
ex.cn: 有些地方执法官滥用逮捕权进行逼供。

ex.en: The authorities will be legally bound to arrest any suspects.
ex.cn: 当局负有逮捕所有疑犯的法律责任。

ex.en: The police say he swallowed a cyanide capsule to avoid arrest.
ex.cn: 警察说他为了逃避逮捕就吞了一颗氰化物胶囊。

def: adj.傲慢的，自大的,带有傲慢，出自傲慢,骄慢,骄

ex.en: He is spoiled, arrogant and has a tendency towards snobbery.
ex.cn: 他被宠坏了，傲慢无礼，而且经常自命不凡。

ex.en: He said that the press had misrepresented him as arrogant and bullying.
ex.cn: 他说新闻媒体把他歪曲成了一个傲慢而又霸道的人。

ex.en: Kenneth is an arrogant, rude, social snob.
ex.cn: 肯尼斯是一个傲慢粗鲁只喜欢结交权贵的势利鬼。

def: n.[解剖]动脉,干线，要道

ex.en: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
ex.cn: 冠状动脉的肌肉痉挛可能导致心脏病。

ex.en: He had an operation last year to widen a heart artery.
ex.cn: 去年他接受了一个扩张心脏动脉的手术。

ex.en: He almost bled to death after the bullet severed an artery.
ex.cn: 子弹穿过动脉，他失血过多几乎性命不保。

def:
adj.发音清晰的,善于表达的,有关节的
vt.清晰地发（音）,言语表达,（用关节）连接
vi.清楚地和清晰地讲,发音,[解剖学] 连接

ex.en: He is polished, charming, articulate and an excellent negotiator.
ex.cn: 他文雅、迷人、能言善辩，是一名优秀的谈判人。

ex.en: She is clearly the most articulate and self-possessed member of her family.
ex.cn: 显然，她是全家口才最好、最沉着冷静的人。

ex.en: She is an articulate young woman.
ex.cn: 她是一个口才很好的年轻女子。

def:
vt.攀登,继承,占领
vi.上升,爬坡,追溯

ex.en: A number of staircases ascend from the cobbled streets onto the ramparts.
ex.cn: 一段石阶从鹅卵石路上一直向上直通城墙。

ex.en: Then we ascend steeply through forests of rhododendron.
ex.cn: 然后我们在杜鹃花丛中沿着陡坡向上爬。

ex.en: The path started to ascend more steeply.
ex.cn: 小径开始陡峭而上。

def: vt.弄清，确定，查明

ex.en: It can be difficult to ascertain the facts.
ex.cn: 可能难以查明事实真相。

ex.en: I'm going to ascertain the truth.
ex.cn: 我要查明真相.

ex.en: It's difficult to ascertain the coal deposits.
ex.cn: 煤储量很难探明.

def: adj.惭愧的，羞耻的，害臊的,难为情

ex.en: I felt incredibly ashamed of myself for getting so angry.
ex.cn: 我对自己发那么大的火而深感惭愧。

ex.en: He knew full well he'd be ashamed of himself later.
ex.cn: 他很清楚地知道自己过后会无地自容。

ex.en: I'm a lesbian and I'm not ashamed about it.
ex.cn: 我是个女同性恋，但我并不为此感到羞耻。

def: vt.暗杀，行刺,中伤,诋毁

ex.en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
ex.cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

ex.en: At the entry for " kill " , my thesaurus lists " murder " , " assassinate " and " waste " .
ex.cn: 我的同义词词典在kill条目中列出murder, assassinate, waste 词条.

ex.en: The police exposed a criminal plot to assassinate the president.
ex.cn: 警方侦破了一个行刺总统的阴谋.

def: n.代理人,律师

ex.en: Luckily, Nancy's father and her attorney were one and the same person.
ex.cn: 幸运的是，南希的父亲就是她的律师。

ex.en: The city attorney's office hasn't found any evidence of criminal wrongdoing.
ex.cn: 市检察官办公室尚未发现任何刑事犯罪的证据。

ex.en: An attorney is your employee, in a manner of speaking.
ex.cn: 律师也可以说是你的雇员。

def:
n.拍卖,竞卖,标售,（桥牌）拍卖玩法
vt.拍卖,竞卖

ex.en: The sale is a big coup for the auction house.
ex.cn: 这笔交易是该拍卖行的一大成功之举。

ex.en: The airline plans to auction its international routes to former competitors.
ex.cn: 这家航空公司打算把他们的国际线路拍卖给以前的竞争对手。

ex.en: Thirteen per cent of Christie's coin and banknote auction went unsold.
ex.cn: 佳士得13%的硬币和纸币拍卖流拍。

def:
adj.听觉的，声音的,音频的
n.声音回路,音响,可听到的声音,声音信号

n.审计，查账
vt.审计，查账,旁听
vi.审计

ex.en: The Audit Commission said that the ministry was in the clear.
ex.cn: 审计署称该政府部门没有问题。

ex.en: Why did the bank not conduct its own audit before lending still more?
ex.cn: 银行为什么不在贷出更多钱之前先审计自己的账目呢？

ex.en: The bank first learned of the problem when it carried out an internal audit.
ex.cn: 银行是在进行内部审计的时候首次发现了这个问题。

def: adj.耳的,听觉的,气味的,预兆的

ex.en: He became famous as an inventor of astonishing visual and aural effects.
ex.cn: 他因发明了神奇的视听效果而出名。

ex.en: aural and visual images
ex.cn: 视听图像

ex.en: The opera was an aural as well as a visual delight.
ex.cn: 这部歌剧对于听觉和视觉都是一种享受.

def: vt.防止，避免,转移

ex.en: He managed to avert suspicion.
ex.cn: 他设法避嫌.

ex.en: Efforts are being made to avert war and find a diplomatic solution.
ex.cn: 各方正在为避免战争、寻求外交解决途径而作出积极的努力。

ex.en: I would do what I could to avert it.
ex.cn: 我会尽力去避免发生这种情况.

def: n.航空,飞行术，航空学,飞机制造业,[集合词]飞机

ex.en: The civil aviation minister ordered all the planes to be grounded.
ex.cn: 民航部长下令所有飞机不得起飞。

ex.en: It's believed the affair was potentially harmful to British aviation.
ex.cn: 据信该事件可能对英国航空业造成不利影响。

ex.en: Ten years ago, they began to develop the aviation ( industry ).
ex.cn: 十年前, 他们开始发展航空工业.

def:
n.敬畏,惊惧,惊叹
vt.使敬畏,使惊惧,使惊奇

ex.en: The higher we climbed, the more awe-inspiring the scenery became.
ex.cn: 我们爬得越高，风景越是让人叹绝。

ex.en: He was in awe of her; she held him spellbound.
ex.cn: 他对她十分敬畏；她令他着迷。

ex.en: She filled me with a sense of awe.
ex.cn: 她让我心生敬畏。

def:
adj.糟糕的,可怕的,非常的,极坏的
adv.非常，极

ex.en: I don't know how often I heard the same awful jokes.
ex.cn: 这种千篇一律的烂笑话我不知道听过多少回了。

ex.en: I've got an awful lot of work to do.
ex.cn: 我有一大堆事情要做。

ex.en: The helicopter turned at an awful angle before righting itself.
ex.cn: 直升机在恢复平稳之前倾斜得很厉害。

def:
n.斧头
v.削减,解雇

ex.en: He struck off the branch with a single chop of the ax.
ex.cn: 他一斧子就砍掉了那根树枝.

ex.en: He cut a hole through the wall with an ax.
ex.cn: 他用斧子在墙上砍出一个洞.

ex.en: He took his ax and struck the trunk of the tree. Whack. Whack. Whack.
ex.cn: 他举起斧子砍树干，咔，咔，咔。

def:
n.斧子,<俚>解雇
vt.用斧砍,削除，解雇,大量削减（经费），精简（机构）

ex.en: Then the woodcutter let his axe fly— Thwack! Everyone heard it.
ex.cn: 然后那个伐木工脱手甩出了斧头。哐！每个人都听见了。

ex.en: St Bartholomew's is one of four London hospitals facing the axe.
ex.cn: 圣巴塞洛缪医院是伦敦4个面临关闭的医院之一。

ex.en: Up to 300 workers are facing the axe at a struggling Merseyside firm.
ex.cn: 艰苦挣扎的默西赛德公司有多达300名工人面临被解雇。

def: n.学士,单身汉,尚未交配的幼雄兽,侍从

ex.en: The flat contained the basic essentials for bachelor life.
ex.cn: 那套公寓配有单身生活的基本必需品。

ex.en: It wouldn't have occurred to me to get myself a bachelor pad.
ex.cn: 否则我不会想到给自己找一套单身公寓。

ex.en: I'm a confirmed bachelor.
ex.cn: 我抱定了独身的想法。

def: n.培根,熏猪肉,咸猪肉,腊肉

ex.en: Who brings up the baby and who brings home the bacon?
ex.cn: 是谁抚养孩子的，是谁赚钱养家的？

ex.en: Voters are interested in the representative's ability to bring home the bacon.
ex.cn: 选民感兴趣的是代表能否兑现承诺。

ex.en: Discard the bacon rind and cut each rasher in half.
ex.cn: 去掉熏肉的外皮，再把每一片熏肉切成两半。

def: n.细菌（复数为bacteria）

ex.en: They found a bacterium visible to the human eye.
ex.cn: 他们发现了一种肉眼可见的细菌。

ex.en: Treatment is supplemented with a course of antibiotics to kill the bacterium.
ex.cn: 治疗期间辅以一个疗程的抗生素注射来杀灭细菌。

ex.en: They have isolated the bacterium in its pure form.
ex.cn: 他们已经把细菌分离出来,使它们处于较纯的状态.

def:
n.徽章，像章，奖章,象征，标记,[美国俚语]警察
vt.以…为标志,使佩带像章（或徽章、标记）,给予…标记（或徽号）,授予…奖章（或徽章）
abbr.[空]<美>(=Base Air Defense Ground Environment)基地防空地面警备系统

ex.en: She glanced briefly at his lapel badge.
ex.cn: 她扫了一眼他翻领上的徽章.

ex.en: Every student should carry a school badge.
ex.cn: 每个学生都应该佩带校徽.

ex.en: The scepter is the king's badge of office.
ex.cn: 权杖是国王地位的象征.

def: n.羽毛球,羽毛球运动

ex.en: Barnaby may be 15, but he's nippy and suited to badminton.
ex.cn: 巴纳比可能15岁了，但他动作敏捷，适合打羽毛球。

ex.en: Try tennis, badminton or windsurfing. In short, anything challenging.
ex.cn: 试试网球、羽毛球或帆板运动吧。总之，只要是有挑战性的。

ex.en: Whilst playing badminton, I ruptured my Achilles tendon.
ex.cn: 打羽毛球时，我的跟腱撕裂了。

def: n.行李,辎重,精神包袱,荡妇

ex.en: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
ex.cn: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

ex.en: The passengers went through immigration control and collected their baggage.
ex.cn: 旅客通过入境检查后领取了自己的行李。

ex.en: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear.
ex.cn: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。

def: n.阳台,（电影院等的）楼厅，楼座,包厢

ex.en: Chris unhooked the shutters and went out on the balcony.
ex.cn: 克里斯拉开百叶窗，走到了阳台上。

ex.en: There were glass doors leading on to this balcony.
ex.cn: 有玻璃门通到这个阳台。

ex.en: She led us to a room with a balcony overlooking the harbour.
ex.cn: 她把我们领进了一个带阳台的房间，从那里可以俯瞰海港。

def: adj.秃头的,单调的，枯燥的,光秃的,赤裸裸的，毫无掩饰的

ex.en: He was short and bald and had a moustache.
ex.cn: 他个头不高，秃顶，留着八字胡。

ex.en: The announcement came in a bald statement from the official news agency.
ex.cn: 官方通讯社发表了直截了当的声明。

ex.en: The bald truth is he's just not happy.
ex.cn: 事实明摆着，他就是不开心。

def:
n.绷带
vt.用绷带绑扎

ex.en: Use a crepe bandage to support the affected area.
ex.cn: 用强力绷带托住伤处。

ex.en: Apply a dressing to the wound and bandage it.
ex.cn: 给伤口盖上敷料并用绷带包扎起来。

ex.en: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee.
ex.cn: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏并打上了绷带。

def:
adj.破产的，倒闭的,完全缺乏的,（名誉）扫地的，（智力等）完全丧失的,垮了的，枯竭的
n.破产者,无力偿还债务者,丧失（名誉，智力等）的人
vt.使破产，使枯竭，使极端贫困

ex.en: It was touch and go whether we'd go bankrupt.
ex.cn: 我们是否会破产还很难说。

ex.en: The company was adjudged bankrupt.
ex.cn: 该公司被宣判破产。

def:
n.横幅,旗，旗帜,标语,大字标题
adj.第一流的，第一位的,杰出的,领先的，为首的,突出地支持（某一政党）的

ex.en: Lucy had strung a banner across the wall saying "Welcome Home Daddy".
ex.cn: 露西在墙上挂了一条横幅，上面写着“欢迎爸爸回家”。

ex.en: All countries march as one nation under the banner of friendship.
ex.cn: 所有国家在友谊的旗帜下团结一致，共同前进。

ex.en: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions.
ex.cn: 当我们被推向相反的方向时，我感觉横幅被撕裂了。

def:
n.烤架,户外烧烤
v.烧烤

ex.en: Don'tspill too much fat on the barbecue as it could flare up.
ex.cn: 不要在烤肉上浇太多的油，会烧起来的。

ex.en: The sausages and burgers sizzled on the barbecue.
ex.cn: 香肠和牛肉饼在烤架上咝咝作响。

ex.en: I put another steak on the barbecue.
ex.cn: 我在烤架上又放了一块肉排。

def:
n.理发师,理发店(= barber's shop)
vt.为…理发剃须,修整
vi.当理发师,给人理发

ex.en: She had to call a barber to shave him.
ex.cn: 她不得不叫个理发师来给他刮脸。

ex.en: She asked the barber to crop her hair short.
ex.cn: 她叫理发师把她的头发剪短了.

ex.en: The barber gave him a shave and a haircut.
ex.cn: 理发师给他修面理发.

def:
adj.光秃秃的,（房间、柜子等）空的,赤裸的,刚好够的
vt.使赤裸,使露出,揭开,脱（衣服）

ex.en: They would have liked bare wooden floors throughout the house.
ex.cn: 他们本想在整个房间的木地板上都不铺地毯的。

ex.en: The room remains simple with bare, stippled green walls.
ex.cn: 房间仍然很简朴，四面都是饰有圆点的绿色空墙。

ex.en: The massacre laid bare the moral bankruptcy of the regime.
ex.cn: 大屠杀使该政权的道德沦丧暴露无遗。

def:
vi.吠叫,厉声说话
vt.大声喊出,厉声说出
n.犬吠声,似吠声,树皮

ex.en: He started to hack away at the tree bark.
ex.cn: 他开始砍树皮。

ex.en: I set the log on the ground and shaved off the bark.
ex.cn: 我将原木放到了地上，刨掉了树皮。

ex.en: This tree is always recognizable by its extremely beautiful silvery bark.
ex.cn: 这种树很容易辨认，因为它有着非常漂亮的银色树皮。

def:
adj.贫瘠的,不结果实的,不孕的,无价值的
n.荒原，不毛之地

ex.en: He prayed that his barren wife would one day have a child.
ex.cn: 他祈祷自己不孕的妻子有朝一日能怀上宝宝。

ex.en: He also wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
ex.cn: 他也想用这些水灌溉荒漠。

ex.en: The room was austere, nearly barren of furniture or decoration.
ex.cn: 房间非常简朴，几乎没有任何家具和装饰。

def: n.棒球,[体]棒球运动

ex.en: He was the fastest thing I ever saw on a baseball field.
ex.cn: 他是我在棒球场上见过的跑得最快的家伙。

ex.en: Casey Stengel was probably the most colorful character in baseball.
ex.cn: 凯西·施滕格尔可能是棒球界最有趣的人物。

ex.en: He maliciously damaged a car with a baseball bat.
ex.cn: 他用棒球棒恶意损毁了一辆汽车。

def: n.地下室,[建]基底，底部
