ex.en: In the basement fifteen employees are busy making bespoke coats.
ex.cn: 在地下室里，15名员工正在忙着缝制定做的外套。

ex.en: The basement hallway is painted a warm yellow.
ex.cn: 地下室的走廊漆成了暖黄色。

ex.en: Kitchen goods are sold in the basement.
ex.cn: 厨房用具在地下室出售。

def:
n.蝙蝠,短棍，（棒球等的）球棒，（网球等的）球拍,白话，口语，成语，俗话,（口）打击，猛击，（海上）导弹
vt.& vi.用球板击球，用球棒击球（尤指板球或棒球运动）

ex.en: Australia, put in to bat, made a cautious start.
ex.cn: 轮到澳大利亚队出场击球，他们开始打得很谨慎。

ex.en: I had bolted the door the instant I had seen the bat.
ex.cn: 我一看到蝙蝠就把门闩上了。

ex.en: He maliciously damaged a car with a baseball bat.
ex.cn: 他用棒球棒恶意损毁了一辆汽车。

def: n.一批,一炉,（食物、药物等的）一批生产的量,成批作业

ex.en: We're still waiting for the first batch to arrive.
ex.cn: 我们还在等着第一批货的到来。

ex.en: He has written a batch of very samey tunes.
ex.cn: 他写了一组非常单调枯燥的曲子。

ex.en: The spy returned to deliver a second batch of classified documents.
ex.cn: 那名间谍返回来递送第二批机密文件。

def: n.[电]电池，蓄电池,[军]炮台，炮位,一组,[法]殴打

ex.en: The battery in my car gave up the ghost.
ex.cn: 我的汽车电池报废了。

ex.en: He is using your mains electricity to recharge his car battery.
ex.cn: 他在用你家里的电源给他的车载蓄电池充电。

ex.en: Crack is part of a battery of drugs used by addicts.
ex.cn: 强效可卡因是瘾君子们吸食的众多毒品之一。

def:
n.梁，栋梁,束,光线,（电波的）波束
vi.发出光与热,面露喜色
vt.播送,以梁支撑,用…照射,流露
vt.& vi.笑容满面，眉开眼笑,发射电波，播送,放出束状的光（或热）

ex.en: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
ex.cn: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

ex.en: He directed the tiny beam of light at the roof.
ex.cn: 他把那一小束光对准了屋顶。

ex.en: She froze when the beam of the flashlight struck her.
ex.cn: 当手电筒的光照到她身上时她僵住了。

def:
n.豆,豆形种子,毫无价值的东西
vt.将（球）击中击球员头部
int.胡说！呸！不可能！

ex.en: It doesn't cost a bean.
ex.cn: 这一分钱也不用花。

ex.en: See p. 246 for Thom Bean's response.
ex.cn: 汤姆·比恩的答复见246页.

ex.en: Bean sprouts are also sold in cans.
ex.cn: 也有罐装豆芽出售。

def:
adv.事先，预先,提前
adj.提前的,预先准备好的

ex.en: How could she tell beforehand that I was going to go out?
ex.cn: 她怎么会事先知道我要出去？

ex.en: Saunas can be hazardous if misused. Avoid a big meal beforehand.
ex.cn: 洗桑拿浴如果方法不当会有危险，浴前切忌饱食。

ex.en: It wasn't a spur-of-the-moment decision. We discussed it in detail beforehand.
ex.cn: 这可不是头脑一热作出的决定。我们事先仔细地讨论过。

def:
n.肚子，腹部,（物体的）圆形或凸起部份,胃口，食欲,腹部…形的
vt.& vi.膨胀

ex.en: The middle button of his uniform jacket was strained over his belly.
ex.cn: 制服上装中间的纽扣在他的肚子上绷得紧紧的。

ex.en: He was short and fat, with a large beer belly.
ex.cn: 他又矮又胖，挺着个大啤酒肚。

ex.en: I really can't afford to see this company go belly up.
ex.cn: 我绝对不能眼睁睁地看着这家公司垮掉。

def:
adj.被热爱的,亲爱的,为…所爱的
n.心爱的人，可爱的人,情人,亲爱的教友
adj.温和的，仁慈的,善良的,有利于健康的,[医]良性的

ex.en: We're taking relatively benign medicines and we're turning them into poisons.
ex.cn: 我们服的药相对来说药性温和，但是我们却在把它们变成毒药。

ex.en: This plunge came in a time of relatively benign economic conditions.
ex.cn: 这次大跌出现在相对良好的经济环境下。

ex.en: They enjoyed an especially benign climate.
ex.cn: 他们那里的气候非常宜人。

def: n.饮料

ex.en: We were obliged, faute de mieux, to drink the local beverage.
ex.cn: 因为没有更好的饮料，我们只好将就着喝当地的。

ex.en: Coffee is a fragrant beverage.
ex.cn: 咖啡是一种香味浓郁的饮料.

ex.en: Beer is a beverage of the remotest time.
ex.cn: 啤酒是一种最古老的饮料.

def: v.当心,提防

ex.en: Holidaymakers should beware of using plastic cards in foreign cash dispensers.
ex.cn: 外出度假时，在外币取款机上使用银行卡一定要小心。

ex.en: I think the moral of the story is let the buyer beware.
ex.cn: 我想这个故事的寓意是提醒购物者当心。

ex.en: Beware, this recipe is not for slimmers.
ex.cn: 注意，本食谱不适用于减肥者。

def: n.圣经,有权威的书

ex.en: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer.
ex.cn: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

ex.en: She turned back to the Bible lying open in her lap.
ex.cn: 她将注意力又转回到摊放在腿上的《圣经》。

ex.en: He became a model of clean living and Bible Belt virtues.
ex.cn: 他成了洁身自好、恪守“圣经地带”德行的典范。

def: n.书目提要，书目,书志学，书志,文献，文献学

ex.en: There is a useful bibliography at the end of each chapter.
ex.cn: 在每一章后附有一份有用的参考书目.

ex.en: A scholastic work is to have a useful bibliography at the end of each chapter or the whole book.
ex.cn: 学术著作应该在每一章或全书之后附有一份参考书目.

ex.en: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
ex.cn: 本章末尾列有一份有用的精选书目。

def:
n.箱子，容器,二进制,垃圾箱,（地下室）葡萄酒贮藏库
vt.把…装进贮藏库,把…放入箱中

ex.en: His dismembered body was found in a rubbish bin.
ex.cn: 在垃圾桶里发现了他被肢解的尸体。

ex.en: He decided to bin his paintings.
ex.cn: 他决定把他的画扔掉。

ex.en: Do you need to keep these letters or shall we bin them?
ex.cn: 你需要保存这些信件吗，还是干脆把它们扔掉？

def:
n.敲诈，勒索,（盗匪征收的）保护费，免抢税
vt.胁迫，勒索，敲诈，讹诈

ex.en: She was a prime target for blackmail, don't you see?
ex.cn: 她是敲诈的主要目标。你难道看不出来吗？

ex.en: The tactics employed can range from overt bullying to subtle emotional blackmail.
ex.cn: 从公然威吓到微妙的情感胁迫，各种战术都用上了。

ex.en: That was a terrible case of blackmail in the paper today.
ex.cn: 今天报上登的那宗勒索案真可怕。

def: n.刀片，剑,（壳、草等的）叶片,桨叶,浮华少年

ex.en: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
ex.cn: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

ex.en: A sharp blade is likely to nick the skin and draw blood.
ex.cn: 锋利的刀刃可能会划伤皮肤，导致出血。

ex.en: The soil sticks to the blade and blocks the plough.
ex.cn: 土粘在犁铧上，卡住了犁。

def:
n.爆炸,一阵（疾风等）,（吹奏乐器、哨子、汽车喇叭等突然发出的）响声,突如其来的强劲气流
vt.击毁，摧毁,尖响,裁判高声吹哨,枯萎：使枯萎
vi.爆炸,吼叫,枯萎：枯萎,攻击：严厉批评或猛烈攻击

ex.en: The space shuttle had been scheduled to blast off at 04:38.
ex.cn: 航天飞机已经预定于凌晨4点38分发射升空。

ex.en: The blast caused extensive damage, shattering the ground-floor windows.
ex.cn: 爆炸造成了巨大的破坏，震碎了一楼的窗户。

ex.en: It's thought that the blast occurred when volatile chemicals exploded.
ex.cn: 人们认为，易挥发的化学物质爆炸时产生了冲击波。

def:
n.火焰,光辉,爆发,光彩
vi.猛烈地燃烧,发光，照耀
vt.在树片上刻痕指示（道路等）,公开宣布

ex.en: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
ex.cn: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

ex.en: Firemen tried to free the injured and put out the blaze.
ex.cn: 消防队员努力救出伤者并扑灭大火。

ex.en: It looks as if the blaze was started deliberately.
ex.cn: 看起来似乎是有人蓄意纵火。

def:
adj.暗淡的，昏暗的,没有指望的,寒冷的，刺骨的,无遮蔽的，荒凉的
n.欧鮊鱼，银鲤

ex.en: Her book paints a bleak picture of the problems women now face.
ex.cn: 她的书是女性当下所面临问题的凄凉写照。

ex.en: Many predicted a bleak future.
ex.cn: 很多人都预测前景暗淡。

ex.en: Alberg gave him a bleak stare.
ex.cn: 阿尔伯格沮丧地凝视着他。

def:
vt.使出血,勒索，敲诈
vi.流血
vt.& vi.散开,给（某人）放血,放掉气体或水（以使某物运行正常）,长期榨取（某人的钱）
n.[印]出血版

ex.en: If untreated, the gums recede, become swollen and bleed.
ex.cn: 如果不进行治疗，牙龈会开始萎缩、红肿和出血。

ex.en: They mean to bleed the British to the utmost.
ex.cn: 他们要最大限度地榨取英国人的财富。

ex.en: If you cut your finger, it will bleed.
ex.cn: 如果你割破手指, 它会流血.

def:
vt.混合,把…掺在一起,（使）调和,协调
vi.掺杂,结合,相配，相称
n.混合,混合色，合成语,混合物

ex.en: Blend the butter with the sugar and beat until light and creamy.
ex.cn: 把糖掺入黄油然后搅拌至滑软细腻。

ex.en: It must have reinforced my determination to blend into my surroundings.
ex.cn: 这势必让我更加下定决心融入周围环境。

ex.en: The causes are a complex blend of local and national tensions.
ex.cn: 原因很复杂，既有地方性冲突也有全国范围的紧张局势。

def:
adj.血腥的，残忍的,血一样的,血染的,嗜杀的，残忍的
adv.非常，很
v.血污，血染,使流血

ex.en: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
ex.cn: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

ex.en: This age-old struggle for control had led to untold bloody wars.
ex.cn: 这场由来已久的对控制权的争夺已经引发了无数流血的战争。

ex.en: They came to power in 1975 after a bloody civil war.
ex.cn: 在一场腥风血雨的内战之后，他们于1975年上台执政。

def:
n.（常指供观赏的）花,开花期,最盛期,健康有精神的面貌
vi.开花,使植物繁盛,发光，闪亮,大量出现

ex.en: The skin loses its youthful bloom.
ex.cn: 皮肤失去了年轻时的光泽。

ex.en: The park is a picture when flowers are in bloom.
ex.cn: 当鲜花盛开时,这个公园的景色美极了.

ex.en: The flowers in the garden are now in full bloom.
ex.cn: 花园里的花盛开.

def:
n.花，群花,开花时期，（发育的）初期,兴旺时期
vi.（植物）开花,繁荣，兴旺,长成

ex.en: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
ex.cn: 今年华盛顿的樱花开得很早。

ex.en: Why do some people take longer than others to blossom?
ex.cn: 为什么有的人比他人大器晚成？

ex.en: The trees are in blossom .
ex.cn: 树上鲜花盛开。

def:
n.宽松的上衣,女衬衫,短上衣,工装
vt.使…宽松下垂

ex.en: She was wearing a white ruffled blouse and a blue velvet skirt.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件有花边的白色上衣和一条蓝色天鹅绒裙子。

ex.en: I always spatter my blouse with gravy when I eat.
ex.cn: 吃饭的时候，我总是把肉汁溅到衬衣上。

ex.en: She had begun to unbutton her blouse.
ex.cn: 她开始解衬衣扣子。

def:
n.（因无知、粗心等造成）的错误,大错，失策，疏忽
vi.犯错误,踉踉跄跄地走,无意中说出，漏嘴说出,弄糟，弄错，做错，办错

ex.en: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assign-ment.
ex.cn: 当时把这项任务给他是大错特错了。

ex.en: The government committed a double blunder.
ex.cn: 政府重蹈覆辙。

ex.en: to make a terrible blunder
ex.cn: 犯大错

def:
n.污迹，污斑,模糊不清的事物,暧昧不明
vt.& vi.涂污，弄脏,（使）变模糊，（使）难以区分

ex.en: Her eyes, behind her glasses, began to blur.
ex.cn: 她藏在眼镜后面的双眼变得模糊起来。

ex.en: Her face is a blur.
ex.cn: 她的脸模糊不清。

ex.en: His arm was a rapid blur of movement as he struck.
ex.cn: 他出击时胳膊快速一晃，令人眼花缭乱。

def:
vi.脸红，惭愧,变红,害臊，怕羞
n.脸红，红色,<古>一见，一瞥

ex.en: I felt myself blush. Then I sniffed back a tear.
ex.cn: 我觉得自己的脸红了，接着我吸吸鼻子，不让眼泪掉下来。

ex.en: I felt myself blush.
ex.cn: 我不觉脸红了。

ex.en: His remark brought a blush into the girl's cheeks.
ex.cn: 他的话使这姑娘两颊红晕.

def:
n.螺栓，螺钉,闪电，雷电,门闩,弩箭
vt.筛选,囫囵吞下,（把门、窗等）闩上,突然说出，脱口说出
vi.（门窗等）闩上，拴住,冲出，跳出,（马等的）脱缰,囫囵吞下
adv.突然地,像箭似地,直立地

ex.en: Suddenly a bolt of lightning crackled through the sky.
ex.cn: 突然一道闪电划破长空。

ex.en: If the soil dries out the plants may bolt.
ex.cn: 如果土壤过干，植株可能会过早结实。

ex.en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned.
ex.cn: 松一松插销，好转动门闩。

def:
n.纽带,联系,债券,保释金
v.使结合,建立互信关系,与…紧密联系,与…黏合

ex.en: In graphite sheets, carbon atoms bond together in rings.
ex.cn: 石墨层中的碳原子相互连接形成碳环。

ex.en: The superglue may not create a bond with some plastics.
ex.cn: 强力胶水可能无法粘住某些塑料。

ex.en: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

def:
vt.促进，提高,增加,吹捧,向上推起
vi.宣扬,[美国俚语]（尤指在商店）行窃，偷窃
n.提高，增加,帮助,吹捧,加速[助推]器

ex.en: It did give me a boost to win such a big event.
ex.cn: 赢得如此重大的比赛确实使我信心倍增。

ex.en: Do what you can to give her confidence and boost her morale.
ex.cn: 尽你所能让她树立信心，提高士气。

ex.en: Without a major boost in tourism, the economy will suffer even further.
ex.cn: 旅游业如果没有大的起色，经济状况会每况愈下。

def:
n.长靴，皮靴,防护罩,[多用于英国]行李箱,[俚语]解雇，激动
vt.穿（靴）,踢,[俚语]解雇,[计算机科学]引导
vi.帮助或益处

ex.en: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
ex.cn: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

ex.en: They have to be thin, attractive and well-dressed to boot.
ex.cn: 她们必须得既苗条又迷人，而且一定要打扮漂亮。

ex.en: I helped her stow her bags in the boot of the car.
ex.cn: 我帮她将包放进汽车行李箱里。

def:
n.胸部，乳房,衣服的胸襟,家庭般的温暖,胸怀
vt.怀抱,把…藏在心中
adj.心爱的,亲密的

ex.en: The dress exaggerates her wasp waist and enlarges her bosom.
ex.cn: 那件连衣裙凸显了她的蜂腰，也让她的胸部看起来更丰满。

ex.en: She lay on the bed, her eyes closed and her bosom palpitating.
ex.cn: 她躺在床上，闭着眼，胸部起伏不定。

ex.en: We, at least, have taken her to our bosom.
ex.cn: 至少我们对她是关爱有加的。

def:
vi.跳，反弹,急促地动,拒付，退票
vt.弹跳,使弹起,（使）上下晃动
n.弹跳,弹性,活力

ex.en: It was good to bounce ideas off another mind.
ex.cn: 与别人谈谈自己的想法是有益的。

ex.en: She lets us do anything, even bounce on our beds.
ex.cn: 她放任我们随心所欲，甚至连我们在床上蹦跳她也不管。

ex.en: They watched the dodgem cars bang and bounce.
ex.cn: 他们看着那些碰碰车互相碰撞并弹开。

def: n.肠,内部,同情心，怜悯心

ex.en: The boy was suffering from a bowel obstruction and he died.
ex.cn: 这个男孩因患肠梗阻死去了。

ex.en: Try to make sure your bowel motions are regular and that you avoid any constipation.
ex.cn: 尽量保证大便规律，避免便秘。

ex.en: Irritable bowel syndrome seems to affect more women than men.
ex.cn: 女性比男性更易患肠易激综合征。

def:
n.保龄球运动,滚木球戏
v.打保龄球(bowl的现在分词)

ex.en: Everyone wanted to bowl, hence everyone wanted to open a bowling alley.
ex.cn: 大家都想玩保龄球，因此大家都想开保龄球馆。

ex.en: In any event, the bowling alley restaurant proved quite acceptable.
ex.cn: 无论如何，那个保龄球场的餐厅证明还是很不错的。

ex.en: I can't see the point of bowling a ball like that.
ex.cn: 我看不出那样投球用意何在。

def:
vt.支撑,系紧,准备，预备,振作起来
vi.准备好,支持,打起精神
n.支持物,铁钳，夹子,[语]大括号,绷紧（身体部位的）肌肉

ex.en: She wears a neck brace.
ex.cn: 她戴着颈托。

ex.en: My daughter has to wear a brace on her teeth.
ex.cn: 我的女儿得戴牙套以矫正牙齿.

ex.en: You had better brace yourself for some bad news.
ex.cn: 有些坏消息,你最好做好准备.

def:
n.白兰地酒
v.把…在白兰地酒中浸泡

ex.en: Pack the fruits and nuts into the jars and cover with brandy.
ex.cn: 把水果和坚果放进罐子里，用白兰地酒浸泡。

ex.en: Unlike wine, brandy matures only in wood, not glass.
ex.cn: 和葡萄酒不同的是，白兰地只能在木制容器而非玻璃容器里酿制。

ex.en: The brandy made him choke, but it restored his nerve.
ex.cn: 虽说白兰地呛了他一下，却让他恢复了勇气。

def:
n.黄铜,铜管乐器,钱,黄铜饰品（尤指马挽具上的黄铜圆片）
v.〈英〉付（款）,[冶]把…包铜,〈口〉无耻地胡搞

ex.en: He once again raised his baton and brought in the brass.
ex.cn: 他再次举起指挥棒，让铜管乐部加入进来。

ex.en: They are available in polished brass, antique brass or silver-plate.
ex.cn: 它们有哑铜的，古铜的和镀银的。

ex.en: Copper, brass and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.
ex.cn: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以进行再利用。

def:
n.破坏,破裂,缺口,违背
vt.攻破,破坏，违反

ex.en: Four men were found guilty of breach of the peace.
ex.cn: 四名男子被判扰乱治安罪名成立。

ex.en: She threatened legal action against the Sun for breach of copyright.
ex.cn: 她威胁说要对《太阳报》侵犯其著作权的行为采取法律措施。

ex.en: They have a case against their directors for breach of fiduciary duty.
ex.cn: 他们掌握了足够的证据控告董事违犯信托责任。

def: n.宽度,宽容,（知识、兴趣等的）广泛

ex.en: The dollar fell to within a hair's breadth of its all-time low.
ex.cn: 美元差一点跌到了最低点。

ex.en: She has travelled the length and breadth of Britain.
ex.cn: 她游历了英国各地。

ex.en: His breadth of knowledge filled me with admiration.
ex.cn: 他学识渊博，令我非常钦佩。

def:
n.乳房，乳腺,胸脯，胸部,心窝，胸怀
vt.升高，攀登,坚毅地面对，与…搏斗,挺胸迎…而上

ex.en: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
ex.cn: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

ex.en: Cancer of the breast in young women is uncommon.
ex.cn: 乳腺癌在年轻女子当中并不常见。

ex.en: The breast can be cut into portions for grilling.
ex.cn: 胸脯肉可以切成小块烧烤。

def:
vt.产（后代），生,产生，导致,优生交配,养育，训练
vi.产仔,繁殖，旺盛生长
n.属,种类,类型,血统

ex.en: If they are unemployed it's bound to breed resentment.
ex.cn: 如果他们失去工作，一定会产生怨恨。

ex.en: Many animals breed only at certain times of the year.
ex.cn: 很多动物只在一年的某个时候交配繁殖。

ex.en: a hardy breed of sheep
ex.cn: 适应力强的绵羊品种

def:
n.微风,轻而易举的事
vi.吹微风,逃走

ex.en: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
ex.cn: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

ex.en: The tops of the trees rippled in the breeze.
ex.cn: 树冠在微风中婆娑摇曳。

ex.en: The sun went in, and the breeze became cold.
ex.cn: 云层遮住了太阳，微风有了些凉意。

def: n.新娘，即将（或刚刚）结婚的女子,姑娘

ex.en: The bride'sfamily were scheming to prevent a wedding.
ex.cn: 新娘家人正密谋阻止婚礼。

ex.en: Brian winked at his bride-to-be.
ex.cn: 布赖恩向他的准新娘使了个眼色。

ex.en: a toast to the bride and groom
ex.cn: 向新娘新郎祝酒

def: n.公文包,手提包,公事包,手提箱

ex.en: I should not leave my briefcase and camera bag unguarded.
ex.cn: 我不该把我的公文包和相机包留在那儿无人看管。

ex.en: The beautifully made briefcase is a snip at £74.25.
ex.cn: 这个做工精美的公文包售价才74.25英镑，可谓物美价廉。

ex.en: The briefcase flopped onto the desk.
ex.cn: 公文包重重地落在桌上。

def:
n.（浅底容器的）边缘,突出的边沿
vi.充盈，满,溢出
vt.注满

ex.en: The toilet was full to the brim with insects.
ex.cn: 厕所里爬满了虫子。

ex.en: Richard filled her glass right up to the brim.
ex.cn: 理查德给她倒了满满一杯。

ex.en: The flowerbeds brim with a mixture of lilies and roses.
ex.cn: 花坛里长满了百合和玫瑰。

def: adj.易碎的,难以相处的，尖刻暴躁的,冷淡的,声音尖利的

ex.en: This may help to undermine the brittle truce that currently exists.
ex.cn: 这也许会火上浇油，破坏当前脆弱不稳的休战局面。

ex.en: The pizza base retains its crispness without becoming brittle.
ex.cn: 比萨饼的饼底依然酥脆，也没有变得易碎。

ex.en: These incidents suggest the peace in Northern Ireland is still brittle.
ex.cn: 这些事件表明北爱尔兰的和平仍然很脆弱。

def:
vt.容忍，忍受
n.小溪

ex.en: Ahead, he saw the side railings of First Bridge over Crooked Brook.
ex.cn: 他看见了克鲁克德河上第一大桥的桥栏就在前面。

ex.en: The army will brook no weakening of its power.
ex.cn: 这支部队不会容忍对其实力的削弱。

ex.en: In our room we could hear the murmur of a distant brook.
ex.cn: 在我们房间能听到远处小溪汩汩的流水声.

def:
vt.& vi.浏览,吃草,随意翻阅
n.浏览,吃草,放牧

ex.en: Slow music encourages supermarket-shoppers to browse longer but spend more.
ex.cn: 舒缓的音乐会促使超市购物者花更长的时间浏览商品的同时花更多的钱。

ex.en: I stopped in several bookstores to browse.
ex.cn: 我曾在几家书店停留，翻看里面的书。

ex.en: You are welcome to come in and browse.
ex.cn: 欢迎您光临本店随便看看。

def:
vt.使挫伤
vi.碰伤,擦伤
n.瘀伤，青肿,擦伤，伤痕,（感情受到的）伤害

ex.en: Be sure to store them carefully as they bruise easily.
ex.cn: 小心存放，因为它们很容易被碰伤。

ex.en: How did you get that bruise on your cheek?
ex.cn: 你脸上的淤伤是怎么搞的？

ex.en: The bruise on his stomach ached with a steady throb.
ex.cn: 他腹部的擦伤一直阵阵作痛。

def: adj.野蛮的,残忍的,不讲理的,无情的

ex.en: The dip in prices this summer will be brutal.
ex.cn: 今年夏天价格的大幅下跌将会很残酷。

ex.en: The 20th century brought brutal change to some countries.
ex.cn: 20世纪一些国家发生了无情的变化。

ex.en: Eddy finds himself plunged into a world of brutal violence.
ex.cn: 埃迪发现自己被抛入了一个野蛮、暴力的世界。

def:
n.芽，萌芽,蓓蕾，骨朵,未成熟的人，少男少女,〈美〉刚进社交界的姑娘
vi.发芽，长出蓓蕾,开始发育,<植>芽接

ex.en: The flowers are bronzy in bud and bright yellow when open.
ex.cn: 这些花的花蕾是青铜色，开放后呈明黄色。

ex.en: Six months after Bud died, the house burned down.
ex.cn: 巴德死后6个月，这座房子被烧毁。

ex.en: Bud turned the truck around, and started back for Dalton Pond.
ex.cn: 巴德把卡车掉头，开始返回多尔顿池。

def: n.自助餐,火车饮食柜台,车站快餐部

ex.en: At lunchtime, there's a choice between the buffet or the set menu.
ex.cn: 午餐可以吃自助餐，也可以选套餐。

ex.en: We sat in the station buffet sipping tea.
ex.cn: 我们坐在车站的自助餐厅里喝茶。

ex.en: Are you having a sit - down meal or a buffet at the wedding?
ex.cn: 你想在婚礼中摆桌宴还是搞自助餐?

def:
n.昆虫,陷，瑕疵,细菌，病菌,窃听器
vt.在…装窃听器,打扰，烦恼,折磨，使痛苦,（使眼球）暴突或变大
vi.变大,凸出

ex.en: He heard that they were planning to bug his office.
ex.cn: 他得知他们打算在他办公室安装窃听器。

ex.en: Don't bug private conversations, and don't buy papers that reprint them.
ex.cn: 不要窃听私人谈话，不要购买重印这些谈话的报纸。

ex.en: There was a bug going around at the club.
ex.cn: 这个俱乐部流行着一种轻微的传染病。

def: n.球茎，块茎植物,电灯泡,[解剖学]肿块

ex.en: A 40 watt bulb would be quite sufficient and would not obtrude.
ex.cn: 40瓦的灯泡完全够亮了，并且不会晃眼。

ex.en: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations.
ex.cn: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。

ex.en: This makes the total cost of the bulb and energy £27.
ex.cn: 这使灯泡与电费合计为27英镑。

def:
n.公牛,股市看涨的人,力大如牛的人,大型雄性动物
vt.[证券]从事投机使（证券等）价格上涨,推，强迫,强力实现,对…施加压力，强使…通过
vi.[证券]（证券、股票等）价格上涨,哄抬证券价格,走运，提高身价,猛推，猛挤，猛力向前
adj.公的，雄的,力大如牛的,价格上涨的

ex.en: I also met with Pollack again to kind of shoot the bull.
ex.cn: 我也再次和波拉克会面，两人闲聊了会儿。

ex.en: The origins of bull-riding, which serves no practical purpose, are murkier.
ex.cn: 骑牛赛没有实际意义，其起源比较令人费解。

ex.en: He was convicted of failing to muzzle a pit bull.
ex.cn: 他因没能给比特犬戴嘴套而被判有罪。

def: n.子弹，弹药,弹丸,[印]着重号

ex.en: Everywhere building facades are pitted with shell and bullet holes.
ex.cn: 任一处的建筑物正面都布满了弹洞。

ex.en: An 8-year-old boy was killed by a stray bullet.
ex.cn: 一名8岁男孩儿被流弹打死。

ex.en: The bullet slammed into the ceiling, spraying them with bits of plaster.
ex.cn: 子弹砰地射进了天花板，掉落的石膏碎片落了他们一身。

def:
vt.恐吓，威逼,盛气凌人，以强凌弱
vi.欺侮
n.仗势欺人者，横行霸道者,暴徒,打手,情人
adj.第一流的，特好的
int.好，妙（感叹词）

ex.en: Some people accuse the tax inspectors of bully-boy tactics.
ex.cn: 有些人指控税务稽查员使用了流氓手段。

ex.en: Our maths teacher was a bully and a complete barbarian.
ex.cn: 我们的数学老师是个坏蛋，一个彻头彻尾的野蛮人。

ex.en: The aggression of a bully leaves people feeling hurt, angry and impotent.
ex.cn: 暴徒的侵犯令人们感到痛心、愤怒却又无能为力。

def:
n.捆,一批（同类事物或出售的货品）,一大笔钱,风趣的人
vt.& vi.收集，归拢，把…塞入
vt.额外免费提供（设备等），（尤指出售计算机时）赠送软件
vi.匆匆送走,推搡,赶,（成群地）匆忙赶往

ex.en: Splitting the price six ways had still cost them each a bundle.
ex.cn: 即使把价钱平摊成6份，每人也还是要花一大笔钱。

ex.en: You can have it, but it'll cost you a bundle.
ex.cn: 你可以买下它，不过你要花一大笔钱。

ex.en: He confessed to having been a bundle of nerves.
ex.cn: 他承认自己一直神经极度紧张。

def: n.局,（提供某方面信息的）办事处,（美国政府部门）局,（附抽屉及活动写字台的）书桌

ex.en: the Federal Bureau of Investigation
ex.cn: 联邦调查局

ex.en: FBI demands its employees absolute allegiance to this bureau.
ex.cn: 联邦调查局要求其雇员对该局绝对忠诚.

ex.en: The auctioneer knocked the bureau down to a furniture dealer from York.
ex.cn: 拍卖者将写字台卖给从约克来的家具商.

def: n.窃贼,破门盗窃者,夜盗

ex.en: I might today hesitate to turn in a burglar.
ex.cn: 现在让我把入室窃贼送交警方，我可能会有所顾虑。

ex.en: This burglar thought old people are easy prey.
ex.cn: 这个夜贼觉得老人容易下手。

ex.en: The burglar alarm is activated by movement.
ex.cn: 这防盗警报器一动就会响。

def:
n.蝴蝶,蝶泳,轻浮的人,游手好闲的人
v.切开摊平

ex.en: She wore butterfly glasses and had a beehive hairdo.
ex.cn: 她戴着一副蝶形眼镜，顶着一头蜂窝式发型。

ex.en: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span.
ex.cn: 这是一只非常美丽的蝴蝶，翼展2英寸。

ex.en: She's like a butterfly. She flits in and out of people's lives.
ex.cn: 她像一只蝴蝶，每天在人前人后飞来飞去。

def:
n.出租车,（公共汽车、火车等的）司机室,驾驶室,出租马车
vi.乘出租车

ex.en: The cab pulled up and the driver jumped out.
ex.cn: 出租车减速停下，司机跳了出来。

ex.en: A Luton van has additional load space over the driver's cab.
ex.cn: 卢顿厢式货车的驾驶室上方有富余的装载空间。

ex.en: I rode to Lily's in a cab.
ex.cn: 我乘出租车去了莉莉家。

def: n.甘蓝（洋白菜、卷心菜）,<非正式、侮辱>植物人，常用于英式英语,<俚>钱，尤指纸币，常用于美式俚语,<俚>脑袋

ex.en: They ate a mash of 2 potatoes, 2 carrots & cabbage.
ex.cn: 他们吃了由两个土豆、两根胡萝卜和洋白菜做的糊。

ex.en: "It's corned beef and cabbage," said Malone. "Yuk," said Maureen.
ex.cn: “这是咸牛肉配卷心菜。”马隆说。“呃，”莫琳表示反感地说了一声。

ex.en: Cut the cabbage into fine long shreds.
ex.cn: 将卷心菜切成又细又长的丝。

def:
n.内阁,柜橱,（有特殊用途的）小房间,展览艺术品的小陈列室
adj.内阁的,秘密的,通常陈列于柜橱内的，可保存的,细木工制作的

ex.en: This issue, more than any other, has divided her cabinet.
ex.cn: 主要是这一问题使她的内阁产生了分歧。

ex.en: Cabinet Ministers are selfishly pursuing their own vested interests.
ex.cn: 内阁大臣们正在自私地追逐他们自己的既得利益。

ex.en: The announcement came after a three-hour Cabinet meeting in Downing Street.
ex.cn: 在唐宁街进行了长达3个小时的内阁会议后发布了这份公告。

def: n.食堂,自助餐厅

ex.en: People are sprawled on makeshift beds in the cafeteria.
ex.cn: 人们懒散地躺在食堂里搭起的临时床铺上。

ex.en: Does the college cafeteria provide a healthful diet?
ex.cn: 大学餐厅供应的膳食是否有益健康呢？

ex.en: In the cafeteria we serve ourselves.
ex.cn: 在自助餐馆我们是自己拿菜的.

def: n.<化>钙

ex.en: Be sure you get your daily quota of calcium.
ex.cn: 要确保每天的钙摄入量。

ex.en: Calcium may aid in the prevention of colon cancer.
ex.cn: 钙可能有助于预防结肠癌。

ex.en: Milk products are an excellent source of calcium and protein.
ex.cn: 奶制品富含钙与蛋白质。

def:
vt.& vi.计算,估计,打算，计划,旨在
vt.预测，推测

ex.en: Take a hundred and twenty values and calculate the mean.
ex.cn: 取120个值计算平均数。

ex.en: From this you can calculate the total mass in the Galaxy.
ex.cn: 由此你可以算出银河系的总质量。

ex.en: Use the formula to calculate the volume of the container.
ex.cn: 用公式计算容器的容积。

def: n.大卡,千卡（食物所产生的能量单位）,卡路里,卡（热量单位）

ex.en: Nutritionists say only 33% of our calorie intake should be from fat.
ex.cn: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33％来自脂肪。

ex.en: Reduced-calorie cheese is a great substitute for cream cheese.
ex.cn: 低卡路里干酪是奶油干酪的极佳替代品。

ex.en: a calorie-controlled diet for slimmers
ex.cn: 控制热量的减肥食谱

def:
n.糖果,冰糖,〈美俚〉古柯碱，可卡因,巧克力
vt.（用糖煮过以）保存,使结晶为砂糖
adj.〈美俚〉（服饰）花哨的,甜言蜜语的

ex.en: Joe's other peculiarity was that he was constantly munching hard candy.
ex.cn: 乔还有一个怪癖，就是喜欢不停地嚼硬糖。

ex.en: Back then, women on TV were mostly seen as eye candy.
ex.cn: 那时候，电视中的女性大多都被看作花瓶。

ex.en: She returns to the big screen to play Candy's overbearing mother, Rose.
ex.cn: 她又重返大银幕，扮演坎迪专横的母亲罗丝。

def:
n.大炮,机关炮,榴弹炮,加农炮
vi.与…猛撞,开炮
vt.炮轰

ex.en: The stillness of night was broken by the boom of a cannon.
ex.cn: 夜晚的寂静被隆隆的炮声打破。

ex.en: Max is a loose cannon politically.
ex.cn: 马克斯在政治上我行我素。

ex.en: The conscripts were treated as cannon fodder.
ex.cn: 应征入伍者被当做炮灰。

def:
n.独木舟，轻舟
vt.用独木舟运送
vi.划（乘）独木舟

ex.en: We beached the canoe, running it right up the bank.
ex.cn: 我们把独木舟径直划到岸边，并拖上岸。

ex.en: Let's fingerprint the canoe, see if we come up with anything.
ex.cn: 让我们提取一下独木舟上的指纹，看看能不能有什么发现。

ex.en: We attempted to manoeuvre the canoe closer to him.
ex.cn: 我们试图让独木舟靠他更近一些。

def:
n.帆布,油画（布）
vt.用帆布覆盖
adj.帆布制的

ex.en: She sat down cautiously on the red canvas cushions, knees modestly together.
ex.cn: 她小心翼翼地在红帆布垫上坐下，膝盖矜持地并拢着。

ex.en: First I applied a blue colour wash to the canvas.
ex.cn: 我先在画布上涂了一层蓝色水彩。

ex.en: The times that people used canvas boat have become history.
ex.cn: 人们用帆船的时代已成为历史.

def:
n.胶囊,航天舱,（植物的）荚,小容器
adj.压缩的,概要的
vt.压缩,简述,以瓶盖密封

ex.en: The police say he swallowed a cyanide capsule to avoid arrest.
ex.cn: 警察说他为了逃避逮捕就吞了一颗氰化物胶囊。

ex.en: A Russian space capsule is currently orbiting the Earth.
ex.cn: 一个俄罗斯太空舱目前正在绕地球轨道飞行。

ex.en: You are asked to swallow a capsule containing vitamin B.
ex.cn: 你要服一粒维生素B胶囊。

def:
n.基数,红衣主教,大红色，深红色,女式斗篷
adj.基本的，最重要的,大红色的，深红色的

ex.en: Bishop Daly said he was devastated by news of the Cardinal's death.
ex.cn: 戴利主教说他听到红衣主教去世的消息后感到极为震惊和难过。

ex.en: They were encouraged by a promise from Cardinal Winning.
ex.cn: 红衣主教温宁的许诺使他们受到鼓舞。

ex.en: I committed the physician's cardinal sin: I got involved with my patients.
ex.cn: 我犯了从医的大忌：跟病人有了感情纠葛。

def:
n.爱抚，抚摸,接吻,拥抱
vt.爱抚，抚摸,怜爱，宠爱,亲吻

ex.en: Margaret took me to one side, holding my arm in a gentle caress.
ex.cn: 玛格丽特将我拉到一边，轻轻地抚摸着我的胳膊。

ex.en: But when she tried to caress him, the boy shunned her.
ex.cn: 可是当她底手去抚摸他底时候, 他又躲闪开了.

ex.en: But who will understand me and caress away my tears?
ex.cn: 不过谁能了解我,抱我,抚慰我 呢 !

def: n.（船或飞机装载的）货物,负荷，荷重

ex.en: Fire may have breached the cargo tanks and set the oil ablaze.
ex.cn: 大火当时有可能把货船上的油罐烧漏了，从而引燃原油。

ex.en: A fishing vessel and a cargo ship collided in rough seas.
ex.cn: 一艘捕鱼船和一艘货船在波涛汹涌的海上相撞了。

ex.en: He loaded his vessel with another cargo and set sail.
ex.cn: 他给自己的船装上另一批货后便启航了。

def:
n.木工，木匠
v.当木匠,做木工活

ex.en: They are sleeping in the carpenter's shop directly above.
ex.cn: 他们正在正上方的木匠铺子里睡觉。

ex.en: He left school at 15 and trained as an apprentice carpenter.
ex.cn: 他15岁辍学，当上木工学徒。

ex.en: Mr Carpenter is obviously a devotee of Britten'smusic.
ex.cn: 很显然，卡彭特先生是布里顿音乐的狂热爱好者。

def: n.运输，输送,（旧时载客的）四轮马车,〈英〉火车客车车厢,运费

ex.en: He sat in the corner of a second-class carriage.
ex.cn: 他坐在一节二等车厢的角落里。

ex.en: Her legs were long and fine, her hips slender, her carriage erect.
ex.cn: 她长腿细臀，身姿笔直。

ex.en: A carriage door struck him as a train drew into Basildon station.
ex.cn: 当火车驶进巴斯尔登站时，一节车厢的门撞到他了。

def:
vi.切，切开,雕刻,创制，开创
vt.切片,雕塑

ex.en: He wanted to go into the street and carve someone's face up.
ex.cn: 他想上街去把别人的脸刮花。

ex.en: He is hoping to carve out a much greater role for himself.
ex.cn: 他希望能争取到更重要的角色。

ex.en: Andrew began to carve the chicken.
ex.cn: 安德鲁开始切鸡肉。

def:
n.出纳员
vt.解雇,抛弃

ex.en: The cashier dived for cover when a gunman opened fire.
ex.cn: 出纳员在持枪歹徒开枪时冲向藏身处。

ex.en: The cashier made a mistake and short-changed him.
ex.cn: 收银员弄错了，少找了他钱。

ex.en: One brother is a cashier and the other sells.
ex.cn: 两个兄弟一位当出纳,另一位当店员.

def: n.盒式录音带,摄影胶卷暗匣，弹夹,珠宝箱，宝匣

ex.en: I dis-covered a mutilated cassette stuffed in a waste-basket.
ex.cn: 我发现一盘被弄坏的盒式磁带丢在废纸篓里。

ex.en: I keep a stock of cassette tapes describing various relaxation techniques.
ex.cn: 我收集了一些介绍各种放松技巧的卡带。

ex.en: Each pack contains a book and accompa - nying cassette.
ex.cn: 每包内装书一本,并附盒式磁带.

def:
n.目录，目录册，目录簿,[美]大学概况一览,登记，记载,产品样本
vt.登记,为…编目,编目录,记载
v.把…按目录分类,把…编目

ex.en: The catalog includes helpful information on the different bike models available.
ex.cn: 目录中包括了在售的各种型号自行车的有用信息。

ex.en: The catalog is organized alphabetically by label name.
ex.cn: 这个目录按标签名的字母顺序排列而成。

ex.en: The Americans cut back the word " catalogue " and it became " catalog " .
ex.cn: 美国人把catalogue这个词加以缩短,成了 catalog.

def:
n.目录，一览表,（美）大学情况便览,展览目录,产品样本
vt.为…编目录,登记分类,记载，列入目录,登记（某人、某事的）详情

ex.en: Their full catalogue costs $5, redeemable against a first order.
ex.cn: 他们的完整目录售价5美元，第一次订购时可返还这5美元。

ex.en: The Royal Greenwich Observatory was founded to observe and catalogue the stars.
ex.cn: 当初创立皇家格林尼治天文台就是为了观察星体并对其进行编目。

ex.en: Send for your free catalogue today.
ex.cn: 今天寄信索要你们的免费目录。

def: n.大灾难,惨败,悲剧的结局,地表突然而猛烈的变动，灾变

ex.en: They suffered an electoral catastrophe, winning a paltry 3 seats.
ex.cn: 他们在选举中惨败，仅获得微不足道的3个席位。

ex.en: Early warnings of rising water levels prevented another major catastrophe.
ex.cn: 提前发出的洪水水位上涨警报防止了又一次的重大灾害。

ex.en: I owe it to you that I survived the catastrophe.
ex.cn: 亏得你我才大难不死.

def:
n.地下室，地窖,酒窖,<英>（都市住宅的）地下煤窖,[机]油盒
vt.把…藏入地窖（酒窖）

ex.en: He then dismembered her, hiding parts of her body in the cellar.
ex.cn: 他接着将她肢解，将部分尸体藏在了地窖里。

ex.en: Things are cooler and more damp as we descend to the cellar.
ex.cn: 当我们往下走去地窖时，四周愈见阴冷潮湿。

ex.en: The period of maturation is determined by the cellar master.
ex.cn: 酿熟期的长短由地窖的主人决定。

def: n.墓地，公墓

ex.en: We got arrested once, for singing bawdy songs in a cemetery.
ex.cn: 我们曾经因为在公墓唱下流歌曲而被拘留过一次。

ex.en: The whole area has been shocked by the desecration of the cemetery.
ex.cn: 对墓地的亵渎震惊了整个地区。

ex.en: He walked numbly into the cemetery.
ex.cn: 他糊里糊涂地走进了墓地。

def: n.厘米

ex.en: A centimeter can be infinitely divided into smaller units.
ex.cn: 一厘米可以无穷尽地分成更小的单位。

ex.en: Human brains have more than 100 million cells per cubic centimeter.
ex.cn: 人脑每立方厘米有一亿多个细胞.

ex.en: The scale of this map is one centimeter to the kilometer.
ex.cn: 这个地图的比例是用一厘米代表一公里.

def: n.厘米，公分,=“centimeter”（美）

ex.en: The snails are no larger than one centimetre across.
ex.cn: 这些蜗牛体宽不超过1厘米。

ex.en: One centimetre is equal to 10 millimetres.
ex.cn: 一厘米等于10毫米.

ex.en: Jupiter'smoon Io, whose density is 3.5 grams per cubic centimetre, is all rock.
ex.cn: 密度为每立方厘米3.5克的木星卫星木卫一上遍布岩石。

def:
n.谷类植物,谷物,粮食,荞麦食品
adj.谷物的，谷物制成的

ex.en: Fibre is found in cereal foods, beans, fruit and vegetables.
ex.cn: 谷类食品、豆类、水果和蔬菜中含有纤维素。

ex.en: They ate a large bowlful of cereal.
ex.cn: 他们吃了一大碗麦片粥。

ex.en: a bowl of cereal
ex.cn: 一碗麦片粥

def: vt.（尤指书面）证明,发证书给…,证明（某人）患有精神病,颁发（或授予）专业合格证书

ex.en: This swimming certificate is to certify that I swim one hundred metres.
ex.cn: 这张游泳证证明我可以游100米.

ex.en: Can you certify for his ability as a teacher?
ex.cn: 你可以保证他能胜任老师的工作 吗 ?

ex.en: I can certify to his good character.
ex.cn: 我可以证明他品德好.

def: n.香槟酒,香槟酒色,平原,平野

ex.en: We had a nice meal with a bottle of champagne.
ex.cn: 我们美餐了一顿，还喝了一瓶香槟。

ex.en: Eugene was concocting Rossini Cocktails from champagne and pureed raspberries.
ex.cn: 尤金当时正在用香槟和覆盆子酱调配罗西尼鸡尾酒。

ex.en: A moment or two later champagne in an ice-bucket materialized beside them.
ex.cn: 片刻之后，他们身边出现了一只装着香槟的冰桶。

def:
n.冠军,捍卫者，拥护者,战士
vt.为…而斗争，捍卫，声援
adj.优胜的,第一流的

ex.en: The heavyweight champion will be given a shot at Holyfield's world title.
ex.cn: 这名重量级拳击冠军将尝试挑战霍利菲尔德的世界冠军头衔。

ex.en: He was a champion for Latinos and blacks within the educational system.
ex.cn: 他一直致力于在教育系统内为美籍拉美人和黑人争取权益。

ex.en: Lewis is matched against the WBO's heavyweight champion, Tommy Morrison.
ex.cn: 刘易斯对决世界拳击组织的重量级拳王汤米·莫里森。

def: n.混乱，紊乱,（天地未出现的）浑沌世界,〈古〉无底深渊,一团糟

ex.en: Whatever troubles arise, we'll have peace of mind amidst seeming chaos.
ex.cn: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

ex.en: Many editorials express their anxieties about the economic chaos in the country.
ex.cn: 许多社论对该国经济的混乱状况表示忧虑。

ex.en: He needs them to stop the country sliding into chaos.
ex.cn: 他需要他们来防止这个国家陷入混乱。

def: n.慈善（行为）,施舍，捐助,慈善机关,仁爱，宽容

ex.en: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity.
ex.cn: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

ex.en: The magistrates granted that the charity was justified in bringing the action.
ex.cn: 地方法官承认该慈善机构有理由提起诉讼。

ex.en: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.
ex.cn: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。

def:
n.图表,航海图,排行榜
vt.绘制地图,记录,记述,跟踪（进展或发展）

ex.en: The chart can then display the links connecting these groups.
ex.cn: 这张图就会显示出这些群体之间的关联。

ex.en: The kinked line in chart 1 represents this pattern.
ex.cn: 图表1中的曲线表现了这一模式。

ex.en: Consult the chart on page 44 for the correct cooking times.
ex.cn: 翻到44页的图表，查一下正确的烹饪时间。

def:
vt.追捕,追求,追寻,镂刻
n.追捕,打猎,猎物（指鸟兽等）,槽
vi.追逐，追赶,追寻,追求（常与after连用）,[口语] 奔跑

ex.en: Ellery's return will help to chase away some of the gloom.
ex.cn: 埃勒里的归来可以驱散一些抑郁的情绪。

ex.en: Many farmers will then chase you off their land quite aggressively.
ex.cn: 许多农民然后就会凶巴巴地把你从他们的土地上撵走。

ex.en: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
ex.cn: 不管怎么说，追求的过程总比得手更为刺激。

def: n.厨师，大师傅

ex.en: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
ex.cn: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

ex.en: James works as assistant chef at a fast food restaurant.
ex.cn: 詹姆斯在一家快餐店当助理厨师。

ex.en: Anton the chef concocts a sensual coupling of lobster and asparagus.
ex.cn: 厨师安东用龙虾和芦笋搭配，制作出了一道口感很好的菜肴。

def: vt.珍爱,怀有,爱护,抚育

ex.en: The president will cherish the memory of this visit to Ohio.
ex.cn: 总统将铭记这次俄亥俄之行。

ex.en: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.
ex.cn: 这些人民珍视他们的独立和主权。

ex.en: I cherish for you the liveliest feeling of affection and gratitude.
ex.cn: 我对你怀有最强烈的爱和感激之情.

def: n.樱桃,樱桃树,樱桃色,处女膜

ex.en: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
ex.cn: 今年华盛顿的樱花开得很早。

ex.en: It's lovely in the spring when the cherry blossom is out.
ex.cn: 春天樱花开放,十分美丽.

ex.en: Mrs. Cherry seems altogether weighed down by her work plus parenthood.
ex.cn: 彻里夫人似乎被她的工作和母亲的责任累坏了.

def: n.棋，国际象棋

ex.en: "Do you play chess?" he asked, looking askance at Miguel.
ex.cn: “你会下棋吗？”他斜睨着米格尔问道。

ex.en: Great chess players have a reputation for being both eccentric and argumentative.
ex.cn: 国际象棋大师们以性格怪异和好与人争辩而闻名。

ex.en: One of the prisoners has carved a beautiful wooden chess set.
ex.cn: 有个犯人刻了一副漂亮的木头象棋。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）变冷,使很冷,使冰冷,使恐惧
n.寒冷，发冷,冷漠,扫兴,[冶金学]激冷
adj.冷的,冷漠的,令人失望的
vt.令失望,使沮丧,使扫兴,使消沉

ex.en: September is here, bringing with it a chill in the mornings.
ex.cn: 9月到了,早晨已有了寒意.

ex.en: The violence used against the students sent a chill through Indonesia.
ex.cn: 针对学生的暴力使得整个印度尼西亚不寒而栗。

ex.en: Wool traps your body heat, keeping the chill at bay.
ex.cn: 毛织品能够保暖御寒。

def:
n.（尤指人的）颏，下巴,聊天,引体向上动作
v.用下巴夹住,聊天,作引体向上动作

ex.en: He had long unkempt hair and a stubbly chin.
ex.cn: 他的头发又长又乱，脸上胡子拉碴。

ex.en: There he stood: hair in wild tangles, dark stubble shadowing his chin.
ex.cn: 他站在那儿，头发乱成一团，下巴上一片黑胡茬。

ex.en: He put his hand under her chin in an almost paternal gesture.
ex.cn: 他以近乎父亲的姿态用手托着她的下巴。

def:
vt.& vi.阻止，扼止,填塞,使窒息,哽咽
n.窒息，哽咽,拥塞,（车辆发动机的）阻风门

ex.en: It's enough to make them choke with apoplectic rage.
ex.cn: 足以气得让他们说不出话来。

ex.en: The brandy made him choke, but it restored his nerve.
ex.cn: 虽说白兰地呛了他一下，却让他恢复了勇气。

ex.en: They warned the Chancellor that raising taxes in the Budget could choke off the recovery.
ex.cn: 他们警告财政大臣说，预算中税收的提高将阻碍经济复苏。

def:
n.合唱,合唱队,（歌曲的）副歌,合唱歌（曲）
vt.合唱,齐声背诵,异口同声地说

ex.en: "All the best," called the other typists in chorus.
ex.cn: “祝万事如意，”其他打字员齐声喊道。

ex.en: Caroline sang two verses and the chorus of her song.
ex.cn: 卡罗琳唱了她歌曲中的两段和副歌部分。

ex.en: "I've got an idea," said Edward to a chorus of groans.
ex.cn: “我想到了一个办法，”爱德华在一片哼哼声中说道。

def: adj.慢性的,长期的,习惯性的,痼

ex.en: Those who suffer from narcissism become self-absorbed or chronic show-offs.
ex.cn: 被自恋症折磨的人会变得只专注于自己的事情，或者不断地自我炫耀。

ex.en: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
ex.cn: 吸烟导致每年有1万人死于慢性肺病。

ex.en: About 4% of the prison population have chronic psychiatric illnesses.
ex.cn: 大约4%的犯人有慢性精神疾病。

def: n.雪茄,叶卷烟

adj.圆形的,环行的,迂回的，绕行的,供传阅的，流通的
n.通知，通告,印制的广告，传单

ex.en: The work interposes a glass plate between two large circular mirrors.
ex.cn: 该艺术品在两面圆形大镜子中间插入一块玻璃板。

ex.en: a circular tour of the city
ex.cn: 环城游览

ex.en: The crater was two miles across and roughly circular.
ex.cn: 这个火山口2英里宽,差不多是一个圆形.

def:
n.平民，百姓,市民,文官,民法学者
adj.民用的,平民的

ex.en: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission.
ex.cn: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。

ex.en: They fell into that twilight zone between military personnel and civilian employees.
ex.cn: 他们成了军队人员与平民雇员之间身份界定不清的人。

ex.en: Attempts to find civilian volunteers have met with embarrassing failure.
ex.cn: 寻找平民志愿者的种种尝试都遭遇了令人难堪的失败。

def:
vt.& vi.拍手，鼓掌,轻轻拍打某人,急速放置,振翼，拍翅膀
n.鼓掌，拍手,拍手声,噼拍声,破裂声
vi.鼓掌，拍手,啪地关上

ex.en: Let's give the children a big clap.
ex.cn: 让我们为孩子们热烈鼓掌.

ex.en: The captain ordered his men to clap on more sail.
ex.cn: 船长命令船员多张帆.

ex.en: Let's give her a big clap.
ex.cn: 我们给她用力鼓掌.

def:
vt.& vi.使清楚，澄清
vt.（尤指通过加热使黄油）纯净,说明,使（头脑、神智等）清醒
vi.（液体）变得澄清,净化,变得清楚

ex.en: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.
ex.cn: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。

ex.en: The Foreign Secretary's remarks clarify an ambiguous statement issued earlier this week.
ex.cn: 外交大臣的话对本周较早时候发表的一份模棱两可的声明作出了澄清。

ex.en: I am happy to clarify any points that are still unclear.
ex.cn: 我愿意说明任何仍然不清楚的地方.

def:
n.扣钩，扣环,握紧,拥抱
vt.& vi.扣住,紧拥,紧握

ex.en: She had sat there twiddling nervously with the clasp of her handbag.
ex.cn: 她坐在那里紧张地摆弄着手提包的扣钩。

ex.en: Clasp the chain like so.
ex.cn: 像这样扣上链子。

ex.en: The clasp on his belt had broken.
ex.cn: 他的皮带上的钩子已经坏了.

def: n.从句，分句,条款，款项

ex.en: The sentence consists of a main clause and a subordinate clause.
ex.cn: 这句中有一个主句和一个从句.

ex.en: The third clause of the contract specifies steel sashes for the windows.
ex.cn: 合同的第三款指定使用钢窗.

ex.en: The intention of the clause is clear.
ex.cn: 那条款的含义是清楚的.

def:
n.黏土，泥土,（相对于灵魂而言的）人体，肉体,似黏土的东西,克莱（男子名， Clayton 的昵称）
vt.用黏土处理

ex.en: As the wheel turned, the potter shaped the clay.
ex.cn: 轮子一边转动，制陶工人一边拉坯。

ex.en: The clay court was slippery and he was unable to move freely.
ex.cn: 红土网球场很滑，他不能自如地移动。

ex.en: When the clay feels like putty, it is ready to use.
ex.cn: 黏土摸起来像油灰时，就可以用了。

def: n.（尤指基督教堂内的）牧师，教士,〈废〉学问

ex.en: Some of the clergy refused to acknowledge the new king'slegitimacy.
ex.cn: 一部分神职人员拒绝承认新国王的合法地位。

ex.en: Clergy and laity alike are divided in their views.
ex.cn: 神职人员和信众同样都观点各异。

ex.en: The military has accused the clergy of mixing religion and politics.
ex.cn: 军方指责该牧师将宗教与政治混为一谈。

def:
n.顶点，极点,高潮,层进法,[生物学]顶极群落
vt.& vi.达到顶点,达到巅峰,使达到高潮,使达到性高潮

ex.en: For Pritchard, reaching an Olympics was the climax of her career.
ex.cn: 对普里查德来说，参加奥运会是她事业上的巅峰。

ex.en: The business in hand was approaching some kind of climax.
ex.cn: 手头的生意似乎快到紧要关头了。

ex.en: Lambing is the climax of the sheep farmer's year.
ex.cn: 一年之中，产羔期最令羊农高兴。

def:
n.（塑料或金属的）夹子,回纹针,修剪,剪报
vt.& vi.用别针别在某物上，用夹子夹在某物上
vt.剪,剪掉,缩短,给…剪毛（或发）
vi.剪,修剪,剪下报刊上的文章（或新闻、图片等）,迅速行动

ex.en: They moved out from the airport at a brisk clip.
ex.cn: 他们迅速撤离机场。

ex.en: Don't forget to clip the token and stick it on your card.
ex.cn: 别忘了剪下标志，贴到你的卡上。

ex.en: The BBC World Service Television news showed the same film clip.
ex.cn: 英国广播公司对外电视频道的新闻节目播放了同样的电影剪辑片段。

def:
n.披风，斗篷,外套,借口，掩饰,覆盖物
vt.遮盖，掩盖,用外衣遮蔽

ex.en: She was released from prison in a cloak and dagger operation yesterday.
ex.cn: 在昨天的一次秘密行动中她从监狱获释。

ex.en: Preparations for the wedding were made under a cloak of secrecy.
ex.cn: 婚礼的准备工作是秘密进行的。

ex.en: They left under the cloak of darkness.
ex.cn: 他们在黑暗的掩护下离开了。

def:
adj.顺时针方向的,右旋的,正转的
adv.顺时针方向转动地,右旋地,正转地

ex.en: He told the children to start moving clockwise around the room.
ex.cn: 他让孩子们开始按顺时针方向绕着房间走。

ex.en: Rotate the head clockwise and counterclockwise.
ex.cn: 按顺时针方向转动头部，然后再逆时针旋转。

ex.en: The dance moves in a counter-clockwise direction.
ex.cn: 这支舞是按逆时针方向跳的。

def:
n.壁橱,盥洗室,议事室，密室,贮藏室
adj.隐蔽的，暗藏的,不公开的,秘密的，私下的,空谈的
vt.把…关在房间里,把…引入内室密谈

ex.en: I suspect he's a closet fascist.
ex.cn: 我怀疑他是秘密的法西斯分子。

ex.en: It's just an old rag I had in the closet.
ex.cn: 这只不过是我挂在壁橱里的旧衣服罢了.

ex.en: She packaged up the old clothes and put them in the closet.
ex.cn: 她把旧衣服包成一包放到衣橱里.

def:
vt.给…提供衣服，把衣服穿（在身上）,<文>覆盖,赋予
v.（用语言）表达,使蒙受（耻辱）,赋与…以（权力，特性等）,穿衣服

ex.en: They clothe their children in the latest fashions.
ex.cn: 他们给他们的孩子穿最时髦的服装。

ex.en: We clothe our thoughts in words.
ex.cn: 我们用语言表达思想.

ex.en: She was on her own with two kids to feed and clothe.
ex.cn: 她独自一个人要供两个孩子吃穿。

def: adj.笨拙的,复杂难懂的,得罪人的,（文体等）臃肿的

ex.en: The action seemed a clumsy attempt to topple the Janata Dal government.
ex.cn: 这一试图推翻人民党政府的行动似乎缺乏策略。

ex.en: He is still smarting over criticism of his victorious but clumsy performance.
ex.cn: 他还在为别人批评他尽管最终胜出但表现笨拙感到闷闷不乐。

ex.en: It was a clumsy looking aeroplane.
ex.cn: 那架飞机样子很难看。

def:
vt.抓紧,紧握,抓住,抓取
vi.试图抓住,踩离合器
adj.紧要关头的,没有手提带的
n.紧抓,控制,离合器,紧要关头

ex.en: Laura let out the clutch and pulled slowly away down the drive.
ex.cn: 劳拉松开离合器踏板，沿车道慢慢驶离。

ex.en: I staggered and had to clutch at a chair for support.
ex.cn: 我踉踉跄跄地，不得不抓住一把椅子稳住自己。

ex.en: The pedals seem a bit off-centre and the clutch is rather stiff.
ex.cn: 踏板似乎有点偏心，离合器也相当紧。

def: n.结合体,联合,同盟,（两党或多党）联合政府

ex.en: The Liberal leader has announced his party's withdrawal from the ruling coalition.
ex.cn: 自由党领袖已宣布该党退出执政联盟。

ex.en: It will be able to put together a governing coalition.
ex.cn: 它将可以组成一个执政联盟。

ex.en: Many of the coalition members could have their own political agendas.
ex.cn: 许多联盟成员可能会有他们自己的政治议题。

def: adj.粗鄙的,粗糙的,粗野的,粗制滥造的

ex.en: The voice, less coarse now, stirred her as it had then.
ex.cn: 现在那声音已不那么刺耳，它又如当年一样让她怦然心动。

ex.en: She spoke in a quiet voice but used remarkably coarse expressions.
ex.cn: 她说话声音很小，但是用了些特别粗俗的字眼儿。

ex.en: Using a pestle and mortar, pulverise the bran to a coarse powder.
ex.cn: 用杵和臼，将麸皮磨成粗粉。

def: adj.一致的,连贯的,条理分明的,清楚明白的

ex.en: He appeared hardly capable of conducting a coherent conversation.
ex.cn: 他好像连话都说不清楚。

ex.en: Little attempt was made to integrate the parts into a coherent whole.
ex.cn: 在把各部分结合成一个连贯的整体方面几乎未作任何尝试。

ex.en: The state is not a unified and internally coherent entity.
ex.cn: 该国不是一个统一的、内部团结的实体。

def: adj.有黏着力的,紧密结合的

ex.en: "Daring Adventures" from '86 is a far more cohesive and successful album.
ex.cn: 1986年发行的《勇于冒险》是一张风格更为统一也更为成功的专辑。

ex.en: the cohesive power of shared suffering
ex.cn: 共患难的内聚力

ex.en: The author skillfully fuses these fragments into a cohesive whole.
ex.cn: 作者将这些片断巧妙地结合成一个连贯的整体.

def:
n.（一）卷，（一）盘,盘卷之物,线圈,纷乱，纠缠不清
vt.盘绕,卷成一圈
vi.绕成盘状,卷绕成圈

ex.en: The heated gas is piped through a coil surrounded by water.
ex.cn: 受热气体通过水中的盘管输送。

ex.en: Coil the fibre into a helix.
ex.cn: 将纤维卷绕成螺旋形。

ex.en: a coil of copper wire
ex.cn: 一卷铜丝

def: vi.与…一致,想法、意见等相同,相符,极为类似

ex.en: A referendum next year would coincide explosively with the election campaign.
ex.cn: 明年的全民公决将和竞选活动同时进行，届时局势会十分紧张。

ex.en: It's a pity our trips to New York don't coincide.
ex.cn: 真遗憾我们不能同一时间去纽约旅行。

ex.en: His tastes and habits coincide with those of his wife.
ex.cn: 他的爱好跟习惯恰好和他的妻子相同.

def:
n.焦炭，焦煤
vt.& vi.转化或者被转化为焦炭

ex.en: "Steve, what do you want?" — "Coke, Pepsi, it doesn't matter."
ex.cn: “史蒂夫，你要喝点什么？”——“可口可乐，百事，随便啦。”

ex.en: He was still hanging around, swigging the Coke out of the can.
ex.cn: 他还在闲逛，拿着一罐可乐大口大口地喝着。

ex.en: The children kept dripping Coke on the carpets.
ex.cn: 孩子们老往地毯上滴可乐。

def: vi.合作，协作,（国家间的）协调，提携,勾结，通敌

ex.en: The two men met and agreed to collaborate.
ex.cn: 这两个人见了面，并同意进行合作。

ex.en: The work gets done more quickly when we collaborate.
ex.cn: 我们一旦合作,工作做起来就更快了.

ex.en: The government is urging Japan's firms to collaborate with foreigners.
ex.cn: 政府正在督促日本的公司进行更多的海外合作。

def: n.碰撞,冲突,（意见，看法）的抵触,（政党等的）倾轧

ex.en: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision.
ex.cn: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

ex.en: The two communities are now on a collision course.
ex.cn: 这两个社区之间现在有可能会发生冲突。

ex.en: It's the collision of disparate ideas that alters one's perspective.
ex.cn: 是迥然不同的观点之间的碰撞改变了人们的看法。

def:
adj.喜剧的,滑稽的，好笑的,连环画的
n.连环漫画,喜剧演员,滑稽人物,滑稽新闻

ex.en: A timeless comic actor—his simplicity and his apparent ease are matchless.
ex.cn: 作为喜剧界的常青树——他的简单淳朴与自然大方无人能及。

ex.en: She has carved a niche for herself as a comic actor.
ex.cn: 她作为喜剧演员已经闯出了一片天地。

ex.en: Grodin is a fine comic actor.
ex.cn: 格罗丁是一位优秀的喜剧演员。

def: vt.纪念， 庆祝,成为…的纪念

ex.en: A series of movies will be shown to commemorate the 30th anniversary of his death.
ex.cn: 为纪念他逝世30周年，有一系列的电影要上映。

ex.en: This building was built to commemorate the Fire of London.
ex.cn: 这栋大楼是为纪念“伦敦大火”而兴建的.

ex.en: A special version of "Casablanca" is being released on video to commemorate the film's 50th birthday.
ex.cn: 为纪念该片上映50周年，准备发行《北非谍影》的特别版录像带。

def: vt.& vi.开始,着手,获得学位

ex.en: The meeting is scheduled to commence at noon.
ex.cn: 会议定于午间召开。

ex.en: We will commence with this work.
ex.cn: 我们将开始这项工作.

ex.en: We commence building on March 18 th.
ex.cn: 我们于三月十八日开工.

def:
adj.平凡的，陈腐的,平庸的，普通的
n.寻常的事物,平常话，口头禅,老生常谈,备忘录

ex.en: It's commonplace to see people collapsing from hunger in the streets.
ex.cn: 在街上看见有人饿晕是很平常的事。

ex.en: Simpson's much vaunted discoveries are in fact commonplace in modern sociology.
ex.cn: 辛普森的那些被大肆称赞的发现在现代社会学中实际上都不足为奇。

ex.en: Wacky ideas are commonplace among space scientists.
ex.cn: 太空科学家想法古怪是不足为奇的。

def: n.共和国,联邦,团体,协会

ex.en: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
ex.cn: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

ex.en: In 1987 Canada played host to the Commonwealth Conference.
ex.cn: 1987年加拿大主办了英联邦大会。

ex.en: a member of the Commonwealth
ex.cn: 英联邦成员国

def:
vt.& vi.压紧，（使）坚实,把…弄紧密，把…弄结实,使（文体）简洁，简化,变紧密，变结实
adj.紧凑的,简洁的，（文体等）紧凑的,小巧易携带的,（物质）致密的，（体格）结实的

ex.en: He looked physically very powerful, athletic in a compact way.
ex.cn: 他看上去非常强壮，像个敦实的运动员。

ex.en: Compact discs have brought about a vast improvement in recorded sound quality.
ex.cn: 激光唱片极大地提高了录音的音质。

ex.en: Photos taken by compact cameras are often dark because they're slightly underexposed.
ex.cn: 袖珍相机所拍的照片往往比较暗，因为存在轻微的曝光不足。

def:
n.隔间（尤指火车车厢中的）,区划
vt.分隔,划分

ex.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
ex.cn: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

ex.en: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear.
ex.cn: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。

ex.en: The compartment is plenty big enough.
ex.cn: 这个隔间足够大了。

def: n.罗盘,指南针,圆规,界限

ex.en: You can go anywhere and still the compass points north or south.
ex.cn: 无论走到哪里，罗盘仍然指向北或南。

ex.en: We didn't have satnav, so the traditional map and compass took over.
ex.cn: 我们没有卫星导航系统，因此使用了传统的地图加指南针。

ex.en: Sightseers arrived from all points of the compass.
ex.cn: 观光者来自四面八方。

def: n.怜悯，同情,恻隐之心

ex.en: The president insisted that he was acting out of compassion, not opportunism.
ex.cn: 总统坚持说他如此做是出于同情而不是为了投机。

ex.en: This comedy of contemporary manners is told with compassion and acid humour.
ex.cn: 这部当代风尚喜剧杂糅了悲悯的情怀和尖酸的幽默。

ex.en: I feel more compassion and less anger than I used to.
ex.cn: 我觉得自己比过去多了些同情，少了些怒气。

def:
n.补充,补足语,补充物,补集（数）
vt.补足，补充,补助

ex.en: Nutmeg, parsley and cider all complement the flavour of these beans well.
ex.cn: 肉豆蔻、西芹和苹果酒都能很好地突出这些豆子的味道。

ex.en: The rational and the irrational complement each other. Individually, they are far less powerful.
ex.cn: 理性和非理性是互补的。两者分开的话，力量就会小很多。

ex.en: Rice makes an excellent complement to a curry dish.
ex.cn: 有咖喱的菜配米饭最棒.

def:
adj.混合成的，综合成的,[建]综合式的,[数]可分解的,[植]菊科的
n.合成物，混合物，复合材料,[植]菊科植物

ex.en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
ex.cn: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

ex.en: This composite illustration was made by putting together a number of drawings.
ex.cn: 这本综合说明书是集若干图片汇合而成的.

ex.en: English is a composite of many languages.
ex.cn: 英语是多种语言混合而成的.

def:
v.计算，估算,推断,用计算机计算
n.计算

ex.en: I compute my losses at 500 dollars.
ex.cn: 我估计我的损失有五百元.

ex.en: I tried to compute the cash value of the ponies and horse boxes.
ex.cn: 我试着算了算马驹和运马拖车的现金价值。

ex.en: The measures we compute for a sample are called statistics.
ex.cn: 根据样本计算的量叫做统计量.

def: vt.隐藏，隐瞒，遮住

ex.en: Frances decided to conceal the machine behind a hinged panel.
ex.cn: 弗朗西斯决定把机器藏在带铰链的嵌板的后面。

ex.en: He made no attempt to conceal his dislike of me.
ex.cn: 他毫不掩饰对我的厌恶。

ex.en: I shall conceal myself at a safe distance from the battlefield.
ex.cn: 我会躲在一个远离战场的安全地带。

def: v.承认,让步，容许,承让

ex.en: He will not concede what anything ails his business.
ex.cn: 他不允许任何事情来干扰他的工作.

ex.en: The organisers of the demonstration concede that they hadn't sought permission for it.
ex.cn: 游行示威的组织者承认他们并未申请批准这次活动。

ex.en: I concede that you are right.
ex.cn: 我承认你是对的。

def: v.（使）冷凝,（使）凝结,精简,压缩

ex.en: We have learnt how to condense serious messages into short, self-contained sentences.
ex.cn: 我们已经学会了如何把重要的信息压缩成简短独立的句子。

ex.en: Huge quantities of steam may be erupted and then condense.
ex.cn: 大量水气会喷发出来,然后冷凝成雨.

ex.en: Condense the mixture by boiling off some of the liquid.
ex.cn: 通过煮沸,蒸发掉一些液体,使混合液浓缩.

def:
vt.使困窘,使混乱,使困惑,使更难于理解
vi.使糊涂

ex.en: I think it's a serious mistake to confuse books with life.
ex.cn: 我认为把书本同生活混为一谈是大错特错。

ex.en: This is an attempt to confuse form and [ with ] substance.
ex.cn: 这是企图把形式同实质混 淆.

ex.en: People are apt to confuse the two issues.
ex.cn: 人们容易把这两个问题混淆起来.

def: vt.向（某人）道贺,祝贺,（为成就或成功）感到高兴

ex.en: He was generous enough to congratulate his successor on his decision.
ex.cn: 他十分大度地祝贺他的继任者做出了决定。

ex.en: Waterstone has every reason to congratulate himself.
ex.cn: 沃特斯通完全有理由为自己感到高兴。

ex.en: She could not but congratulate him.
ex.cn: 她只能祝贺他。

def: n.征服，击败,战利品,（尤指）爱情的俘虏,赢得（物）

ex.en: After the Norman Conquest the forest became a royal hunting preserve.
ex.cn: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

ex.en: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
ex.cn: 不管怎么说，追求的过程总比得手更为刺激。

ex.en: He was telling his tales of conquest in clubland.
ex.cn: 当时他正在大讲特讲自己在夜总会的征服史。

def: n.良心,道德心

ex.en: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
ex.cn: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

ex.en: I'm so glad he had a pang of conscience.
ex.cn: 我很高兴他会有负疚感。

ex.en: I would like your advice on a matter of conscience, Father.
ex.cn: 我想就一件有关良心的事征求您的建议，神父。

def: adj.认真负责的,本着良心的,谨慎的,正大光明

ex.en: He was quiet, conscientious, a bit of a plodder.
ex.cn: 他做事闷声不响，小心谨慎，有点死气沉沉的。

ex.en: Virginia was still struggling to be a conscientious and dedicated mother.
ex.cn: 弗吉尼娅还在尽力成为一位勤勤恳恳、全心奉献的母亲。

ex.en: The conscientious researcher is careful to avoid up the pole and omission.
ex.cn: 那位一丝不苟的研究人员总是小心谨慎地避免错误或疏漏.

def: adj.连续的，连贯的,[语]表示结果的

ex.en: Between 1940 and 1943 he had a string of 62 consecutive victories.
ex.cn: 他在1940年至1943年间连续62次获胜。

ex.en: She was within sight of Navratilova'srecord of seventy-four consecutive wins.
ex.cn: 她已经逼近了纳夫拉蒂洛娃74连胜的纪录。

ex.en: Connors reigned as the world No. 1 for 159 consecutive weeks.
ex.cn: 康纳斯连续159周排名世界第一。

def:
vt.安慰，慰问
n.控制台，操纵台,演奏台,悬臂,肘托

ex.en: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
ex.cn: 不是只有我一个人才这样，我可以用这一事实来安慰自己。

ex.en: This Christmas sees the launch of a new games console.
ex.cn: 这个圣诞节会有一款新型游戏机上市。

ex.en: Nothing could console him when his wife died.
ex.cn: 他妻子去世后，什么事情也不能使他感到宽慰。

def:
vt.把…合成一体，合并,巩固，加强,统一,合计金额
vi.统一,合并,联合

ex.en: The question is: will the junta consolidate its power by force?
ex.cn: 问题是：军政府会通过武力巩固其政权吗？

ex.en: We've made a good start, now it's time to consolidate.
ex.cn: 我们有了一个良好的开端, 现在应该加以巩固.

ex.en: Judge Charles Schwartz is giving the state 60 days to disband and consolidate Louisiana's four higher education boards.
ex.cn: 查尔斯·施瓦茨法官将给路易斯安那州60天时间来解散然后合并该州的4个高等教育委员会。

def: n.阴谋,反叛,共谋

ex.en: At first, he was blissfully unaware of the conspiracy against him.
ex.cn: 起初，他幸好不知道那些针对他的阴谋。

ex.en: Did you ever swallow the conspiracy theory about Kennedy?
ex.cn: 你有没有轻信过有关肯尼迪总统遇刺的阴谋论？

ex.en: He suspects there's a conspiracy to cover up the crime.
ex.cn: 他怀疑有人密谋掩盖犯罪事实。

def:
vi.商议，商量,[医]会诊,咨询,充当顾问
vt.请教,翻阅,求教于,顾及

ex.en: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
ex.cn: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

ex.en: It is recommended that you should consult your doctor.
ex.cn: 建议你去咨询医生。

ex.en: She began to consult doctors, and each had a different diagnosis.
ex.cn: 她开始四处寻医，但每个医生的诊断都不相同。

def: n.容器,箱，匣,集装箱，货柜

ex.en: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
ex.cn: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

ex.en: The container is invisible until you shine an ultraviolet light on it.
ex.cn: 那个柜子只有用紫外线照射才可以看见。

ex.en: Keep what's left in a covered container in the fridge.
ex.cn: 把剩下的食物装入带盖的容器，放进冰箱。

def:
vt.弄脏，污染,损害，毒害
vi.玷污，毒害，腐蚀（人的思想或品德）
adj.〈古〉污染的

ex.en: One secret military unit tried to contaminate the drinking water of the refugees.
ex.cn: 一个秘密军事分队企图污染难民的饮用水。

ex.en: All over the world, oil spills regularly contaminate coasts.
ex.cn: 在世界各地，油溢出物经常污染着海岸。

ex.en: The sources of organisms that may contaminate the wound are numerous.
ex.cn: 可以沾染伤口的细菌来源是很多的.

def:
vt.注视，凝视,盘算，计议,周密考虑
vi.沉思，深思熟虑

ex.en: The possibility of war is too horrifying to contemplate.
ex.cn: 战争的可能性太可怕了,真不堪细想.

ex.en: We don't contemplate his [ him ] opposing our plan.
ex.cn: 我们预料他不会反对我们的计划.

ex.en: The consequences would be too ghastly to contemplate.
ex.cn: 后果不堪设想.

def:
vt.设计，发明,创造,策划,设法做到
vi.计划或谋划

ex.en: Can you contrive to be here a little earlier?
ex.cn: 你能不能早一点来?

ex.en: How could you contrive to make such a mess of things?
ex.cn: 你怎么把事情弄得一团糟 呢 ?

ex.en: She found it difficult to contrive when prices of everything went up.
ex.cn: 百物涨价时,她觉得料理家务很难.

def: adv.相反地，颠倒地,倒地,反之,反过来

ex.en: You can add the fluid to the powder, or, conversely, the powder to the fluid.
ex.cn: 可把液体加入粉末，或者相反，把粉末加入液体。

ex.en: He placed the box conversely.
ex.cn: 他把箱子放倒了.

ex.en: In real life, nobody was all bad, nor, conversely, all good.
ex.cn: 在现实生活中，没有彻头彻尾的坏人，相反地，也没有完完全全的好人。

def: n.变换，转变,改装物,财产转换，兑换,[逻] 换位（法）

ex.en: Currency-conversion costs remain one of the biggest obstacles to cross-border trade.
ex.cn: 货币兑换成本仍是跨境贸易的最大障碍之一。

ex.en: These are the people who are doing our loft conversion for us.
ex.cn: 就是这些人在为我们改造阁楼。

ex.en: It is always worth having a loft conversion costed out.
ex.cn: 估算一下改建阁楼的费用总是很有必要的。

def:
vt.宣判有罪,证明…有罪,使知罪,定…的罪
n.罪犯

ex.en: I have all the evidence necessary to convict this young criminal now.
ex.cn: 我掌握一切必要的证据来给这个年轻犯人定罪.

ex.en: It was difficult to convict him of the falsity of his beliefs.
ex.cn: 难以使他认识到他信仰的虚假性.

ex.en: The convict was pardoned after serving five years of his sentence.
ex.cn: 罪犯服刑5年才获赦免.

def:
n.铜,铜币,紫铜色,警察
adj.铜制的
vt.镀铜

ex.en: The combination of sex and treachery proved a copper-bottomed circulation booster.
ex.cn: 事实证明，性和背叛的话题结合起来无疑大大增加了发行量。

ex.en: Copper, brass and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.
ex.cn: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以进行再利用。

ex.en: Miners in Zambia's northern copper belt have gone on strike.
ex.cn: 赞比亚北部铜矿带的矿工已经罢工了。

def:
n.版权，著作权
adj.受版权保护的,版权的
vt.获得…的版权

ex.en: She threatened legal action against the Sun for breach of copyright.
ex.cn: 她威胁说要对《太阳报》侵犯其著作权的行为采取法律措施。

ex.en: He warned that lifting copyright restrictions could beggar the industry.
ex.cn: 他警告说解除版权限制会使这个行业一贫如洗。

ex.en: A phrase jumped out at me in a piece about copyright.
ex.cn: 在一篇有关版权的文章中，有一个短语引起了我的注意。

def:
n.（细）绳,灯心绒裤
vt.用绳子捆绑,堆积（柴薪）

ex.en: Tack the cord around the cushion.
ex.cn: 用粗线沿着垫子边绷一圈。

ex.en: A quick-thinking ticket inspector yanked an emergency cord.
ex.cn: 一个反应迅速的查票员猛地拉下了紧急刹车索。

ex.en: Inflate your life jacket by pulling sharply on the cord.
ex.cn: 猛拽绳扣使你的救生衣充气。

def:
adj.热诚的,诚恳的,兴奋的
n.补品,兴奋剂,甘露酒

ex.en: The conversation was carried on in a cordial and friendly atmosphere.
ex.cn: 会谈是在亲切友好的气氛中进行的.

ex.en: The meeting of the old classmates was extremely cordial.
ex.cn: 老同学聚会在一起,分外亲热.

ex.en: We maintain cordial relations with our neighbors.
ex.cn: 我们与邻里保持亲切友好的关系.

def: n.通讯员，记者,通信者

ex.en: Frank Deford is a special correspondent for Newsweek magazine.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·德福特是《新闻周刊》杂志的特派记者。

ex.en: Our economics correspondent, James Morgan, is just back from Germany.
ex.cn: 我们的财经记者詹姆斯·摩根刚刚从德国回来。

ex.en: From Nairobi here's our East Africa correspondent, Colin Blane.
ex.cn: 以下是我们来自内罗毕的东非记者科林·布兰的报道。

def: n.走廊，通道,走廊（一国领土通过他国境内的狭长地带）,[建]覆道

ex.en: The young man led Mark Ryle along a corridor.
ex.cn: 那个年轻人领着马克·赖尔沿走廊而去。

ex.en: I noticed a chink of light at the end of the corridor.
ex.cn: 我注意到走廊尽头的一缕光线。

ex.en: They heard voices coming from outside in the corridor.
ex.cn: 他们听到外面的走廊上有人说话。

def: vt.& vi.使腐蚀，侵蚀

ex.en: The tools will corrode with rust if never used.
ex.cn: 这些工具如长期不用会长铁锈而损坏.

ex.en: An iron tool, if never used, will corrode with rust.
ex.cn: 铁制工具长期不用会锈损.

ex.en: Acid causes metal to corrode.
ex.cn: 酸使金属腐蚀.

def:
adj.舒适的，惬意的,畅快的,亲切友好的
n.有遮盖的双人座椅,保暖罩

ex.en: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
ex.cn: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

ex.en: Just think how snug and cosy we could be.
ex.cn: 想象一下，我们可以多么温暖舒适呀。

ex.en: The overall ambience of the room is cosy.
ex.cn: 房间整体的感觉是温暖舒适。

def:
adj.舒适的，安逸的，惬意的
n.保温罩

ex.en: He went in and glanced around. " Quite clean and cozy!
ex.cn: 进了屋,他四下里看了一眼: “ 小屋还怪干净呢!

ex.en: We spent a cozy evening chatting by the fire.
ex.cn: 我们在炉火旁聊天度过了一个舒适的晚上。

ex.en: The room has a nice cozy feel.
ex.cn: 这房间给人非常温暖舒适的感觉。

def:
n.长沙发椅，睡椅,（病人受检查时躺的）长榻,麦芽床,涂底，涂层
vt.表达,使躺卧,播撒谷物使发芽
vi.躺卧,隐蔽，埋伏,使成堆

ex.en: Roy swung his legs carefully off the couch and sat up.
ex.cn: 罗伊小心地把腿挪下沙发，坐了起来。

ex.en: We were sitting on the couch in the living room watching TV.
ex.cn: 我们就坐在客厅的沙发上看电视。

ex.en: She slipped out of the jacket and tossed it on the couch.
ex.cn: 她麻利地脱下夹克，扔在了沙发上。

def: n.县，郡,县民，郡民

ex.en: For a local bus timetable, contact Dyfed County Council.
ex.cn: 若要当地公共汽车时刻表，请与达费德郡政务委员会联系。

ex.en: He has been a Derby County supporter since boyhood.
ex.cn: 他从孩提时代起就是德比郡队的支持者。

ex.en: The riots will also mean lost income for Los Angeles County.
ex.cn: 暴乱还意味着洛杉矶县收入的损失。

def: n.庭院，院子,天井

ex.en: Dena took them into the courtyard to sit in the sun.
ex.cn: 德娜带他们到院子里晒太阳。

ex.en: The house itself is three stories high and arranged around a courtyard.
ex.cn: 房子本身有三层高，绕着一个庭院而建。

ex.en: They walked through the arch and into the cobbled courtyard.
ex.cn: 他们穿过拱门走进铺着鹅卵石的院子。

def:
n.蟹，蟹肉,阴虱,脾气乖戾的人,[植]沙果，沙果树
vi.捕蟹,发牢骚，抱怨,偏航
vt.发脾气,破坏,使偏航

ex.en: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.
ex.cn: 螃蟹虽然好吃，却容易让人感到饱足。

ex.en: the claws of a crab
ex.cn: 螃蟹的螯

ex.en: The claws of a crab are used for grasping things, especially food.
ex.cn: 螃蟹用钳抓东西, 特别是食物.

def:
n.摇篮,发源地，发祥地,吊架，支架,婴儿时期
vt.将…置于摇篮中,轻轻地抱或捧,抚养,把…搁在支架上

ex.en: Mali is the cradle of some of Africa's richest civilizations.
ex.cn: 马里是非洲一些最悠久的文明的发祥地。

ex.en: I dropped the receiver back in the cradle.
ex.cn: 我把听筒放回听筒架上。

ex.en: He fixed the towing cradle round the hull.
ex.cn: 他把牵引支架固定在船体上。

def:
n.吊车，起重机,鹤
vt.& vi.伸长，探头
vi.迟疑，踌躇

ex.en: Crane is a kind of bird with very long legs and neck.
ex.cn: 鹤是一种腿和脖子都很长的鸟.

ex.en: We used a crane to lift the piano into the theatre.
ex.cn: 我们使用起重机将钢琴搬进剧场.

ex.en: Must we wait till the crane arrives before we start loading?
ex.cn: 非要等起重机来了才能装运 吗 ?

def:
n.蟋蟀,板球,矮木凳
vi.打板球
adj.公平的

ex.en: The pity of it was that the Americans didn't play cricket.
ex.cn: 可惜的是美国人不打板球。

ex.en: By a curious twist of fate, cricket was also my favourite sport.
ex.cn: 让人感到惊奇的是，板球碰巧也是我最喜欢的运动。

ex.en: There was precious little about the cricket to animate the crowd.
ex.cn: 板球比赛能激起观众热情的地方很少。

def:
adj.脆的,干冷的,易碎的,新鲜的，爽快的
n.<英>炸马铃薯片,松脆物
vt.（使）变脆,卷曲,烘脆（面包等）
vi.卷曲

ex.en: The potato cakes should be crisp outside and meltingly soft inside.
ex.cn: 土豆饼应该外面酥脆,里面嫩软.

ex.en: The air was thin and crisp, filled with hazy sunshine and frost.
ex.cn: 空气稀薄清新，其间日光蒙眬，寒气逼人。

ex.en: Her house is light and airy, crisp and clean.
ex.cn: 她的房子光线充足，空气流通，清新整洁。

def: n.（批评、判断等的）标准，准则,规范

ex.en: Senior managers stipulated work-life balance as their main criterion when choosing jobs.
ex.cn: 高级经理人把工作与生活的平衡作为择业的主要标准。

ex.en: The main criterion is value for money.
ex.cn: 主要的标准是钱要用得划算。

ex.en: Only social practice can be the criterion of truth.
ex.cn: 只有社会实践才能是检验真理的唯一标准.

def:
n.乌鸦,雄鸡的啼声
vi.公鸡啼鸣，报晓,欢呼,（尤指在其他人不成功时）扬扬自得地夸口

ex.en: She gave a little crow of triumph.
ex.cn: 她轻轻地发出了胜利的欢呼声。

ex.en: I saw a man leveling a gun at a crow.
ex.cn: 我看见一个人正用枪瞄准一只乌鸦.

ex.en: The crow of the cock is a harbinger of dawn.
ex.cn: 鸡啼报晓.

def:
vi.巡游,漫游,巡航
n.（军舰等）巡逻，巡航,〈口〉游览，旅行，周游
vt.巡航,巡游,漫游

ex.en: Don's story unfolded as the cruise got under way.
ex.cn: 随着航行的开始，唐的故事也随之展开。

ex.en: The next stop on this cruise is likely to be in Cornwall.
ex.cn: 此次航游的下一站很可能是在康沃尔。

ex.en: He got a job as a singer on a cruise ship.
ex.cn: 他在一艘大型游轮上找了个歌手的差事。

def:
vt.压破，压碎,镇压,弄皱,挤榨，榨出
vi.挤,被压碎，被起皱
n.粉碎，被压碎的状态,（特指女子对男性的）迷恋,拥挤的人群,果汁饮料

ex.en: Put both vegetables into a bowl and crush with a potato masher.
ex.cn: 把这两样蔬菜都放进一个碗里，然后用捣土豆器把它们捣碎。

ex.en: Franklin and his thirteen-year-old son somehow got separated in the crush.
ex.cn: 富兰克林和他13岁的儿子在人群中被挤散了。

ex.en: Every-where he went he was mobbed by a crush of fans.
ex.cn: 他所到之处都有成群的歌迷簇拥着他。

def:
n.面包皮,外壳,硬外皮,地壳
vt.用外皮覆盖,在…上结硬皮,生痂儿
vi.结成外壳,结硬皮

ex.en: Sergeant Parrott normally spoke with an upper-crust accent.
ex.cn: 帕罗特军士说话通常带着上流社会的腔调。

ex.en: The pastry crust was always underdone.
ex.cn: 馅饼的壳皮常常烤得不透.

ex.en: The crust of the bread is burnt.
ex.cn: 这块面包的外皮烤焦了.

def:
n.结晶（体）,晶体,水晶,水晶饰品
adj.水晶的,水晶般的,透明的,清楚的

ex.en: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'lllove this movie.
ex.cn: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

ex.en: Some of the finest drinking glasses are made from lead crystal.
ex.cn: 一些最高档的酒杯是用铅晶质玻璃制成的。

ex.en: The cliffs, lapped by a crystal-clear sea, remind her of Capri.
ex.cn: 清澈的海水拍打着悬崖峭壁，令她想起了卡普里。

def:
n.立方形，立方体,立方，三次幂,小房间
vt.求…的立方,把（食物）切成小方块,测定…的体积

ex.en: She sucked an ice cube into her mouth, and crunched it loudly.
ex.cn: 她吸了块冰块到嘴里，嘎嘣嘎嘣地大声嚼着。

ex.en: Remove the seeds and stones and cube the flesh.
ex.cn: 把籽和果核弄掉，将果肉切成小方块。

ex.en: A dice is a cube.
ex.cn: 骰子是立方体.

def:
n.暗示，提示,线索,[台]球杆,情绪，心情
vt.把…插入演出,给…暗示

ex.en: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.
ex.cn: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。

ex.en: That was the cue for several months of intense bargaining.
ex.cn: 那意味着几个月的激烈谈判开始了。

ex.en: Kevin arrived right on cue to care for Harry.
ex.cn: 凯文到的正是时候，可以照顾哈丽。

def: n.橱柜,衣柜,食物柜,壁橱

ex.en: There's an extra blanket in the bottom drawer of the cupboard.
ex.cn: 壁橱最下面的抽屉里还有一条多余的毯子。

ex.en: It was time to consign his bat and glove to the cupboard.
ex.cn: 该把他的球棒和手套搁进柜子里了。

ex.en: The kitchen cupboard was stocked with tins of soup.
ex.cn: 厨房的橱柜里堆满了罐装汤。

def:
n.一绺鬈发,卷曲物,螺旋状物,（指头发）拳曲
vt.& vi.（使）弯曲,（使）卷曲,盘旋,缠绕
vt.撅起嘴唇,撇（嘴）,（使）呈螺旋（或卷曲）状移动,（使）旋绕

ex.en: A curl of black hair fell loosely across his forehead.
ex.cn: 他的额头上垂着一绺散开的黑色卷发。

ex.en: Raise one foot, curl the toes and point the foot down-wards.
ex.cn: 抬起一只脚，弯曲脚趾，使脚尖朝下。

ex.en: A thin curl of smoke rose from a rusty stove.
ex.cn: 生锈的炉子里冒出一缕青烟。

def: n.全部课程，课程

ex.en: The national curriculum must be a guide, not a straitjacket.
ex.cn: 国家课程设置必须是指导性的，而不是约束性的。

ex.en: All the schools have music and dancing as part of the curriculum.
ex.cn: 所有学校都设有音乐和舞蹈课。

ex.en: The staff should work together to revise the school curriculum.
ex.cn: 全体教职工应当齐心协力修订学校课程。

def:
n.弧线，曲线,曲线状物,弯曲物,[棒]曲线板
vt.使弯曲,使成曲线,使成弧形
vi.弯曲,弯成曲线，弯成弧形,沿曲线行进
adj.弯曲的,曲线形的

ex.en: Was it just a temporary blip on an otherwise healthy growth curve?
ex.cn: 这是否是原本良好的增长曲线中暂时的偏离？

ex.en: Both he and the crew are on a steep learning curve.
ex.cn: 他和组员们都学得很快。

ex.en: The slope increases as you go up the curve.
ex.cn: 上了弯道以后，路越来越陡。

def:
n.（隔离两个表面的）垫,垫子,起保护（或缓冲）作用的事物,（台球等运动）（台球桌内侧边缘的）弹性衬里
vt.使免遭损害,使免受令人不快的影响,（用垫子）使柔和,（跌倒或碰撞时）起缓冲作用

ex.en: Lie face upwards with a cushion under your head.
ex.cn: 头枕垫子仰卧。

ex.en: The subsidies are designed to cushion farmers against unpre-dictable weather.
ex.cn: 这些补助金用于减轻农民因难以预测的恶劣天气而遭受的损失。

ex.en: He sat on a tapestry cushion next to the hearth.
ex.cn: 他坐在壁炉边上的一块绣花软垫上。

def: n.（电子计算机创造的）通讯、信息空间

ex.en: She travels in cyberspace by sending messages to friends around the world.
ex.cn: 她利用电子空间给世界各地的朋友们发送信件.

ex.en: The teens spend more time in cyberspace than in the real world of friends and family.
ex.cn: 青少年花费在电脑上的时间比他们和真正的朋友及家人在一起的时间要多.

ex.en: The Cyberspace is regarded as a 　 goal of future virtual reality.
ex.cn: 这个Cyberspace被认为是未来虚拟现实的目标.

def: n.圆柱,圆筒,圆柱体,气缸

n.牛奶场,乳品店,牛奶及乳品业
adj.牛奶的,奶制的,乳品的,乳品业的

ex.en: The feeding of dairy cows has undergone a revolution.
ex.cn: 乳牛的喂养方法发生了巨大的改变。

ex.en: They ran the general store and the farm dairy.
ex.cn: 他们经营着杂货店和农场的乳品店。

ex.en: Non-fat dairy products supply the needed nutrients without excessive calories.
ex.cn: 脱脂乳制品能提供身体所需的营养，而不含过多的热量。

def:
adj.微湿的，潮湿的,消沉的，沮丧的,沉闷的,情绪低落的
n.潮湿,消沉，失望,矿井瓦斯,有毒气体
vt.使潮湿,使泄气，使沮丧,抑制，阻抑,使减弱
vi.[物]阻尼,减幅

ex.en: They all walked barefoot across the damp sand to the water's edge.
ex.cn: 他们全都光着脚走过潮湿的沙地来到水边。

ex.en: The bunk mattress was hard, the blankets prickly and slightly damp.
ex.cn: 这个铺位的床垫很硬，毯子也很扎人，而且还有点潮。

ex.en: If damp, musty buildings make you ill, mould is probably the cause.
ex.cn: 如果潮湿发霉的建筑令你生病了，霉菌很可能是病因。

def:
vt.使目眩,使惊异不已
n.耀眼,眩惑,灿烂
vt.& vi.目眩,赞叹

ex.en: The movie's special effects fail to dazzle.
ex.cn: 这部电影的特效未能出彩。

ex.en: The dazzle of stardom and status attracts them.
ex.cn: 明星的光彩和地位吸引着他们。

ex.en: It's a long time since I went out on the razzle - dazzle, but your birthday will be a wonderful excuse.
ex.cn: 我好久没出去找乐子了, 你过生日倒是一个好借口.

def: adj.聋的,不愿听的

ex.en: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears.
ex.cn: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。

ex.en: He has turned a resolutely deaf ear to American demands for action.
ex.cn: 他对美国提出的行动要求完全不理不睬。

ex.en: I'm quite deaf — you'll have to speak up.
ex.cn: 我耳背——你得大声说。

def: n.商人,发牌人，庄家,以某种方式待人的人,经销商

ex.en: His heir sold the painting to the London art dealer Agnews.
ex.cn: 他的继承人把这幅画卖给了伦敦艺术品经销商阿格纽斯。

ex.en: They aim to clear every dealer from the street.
ex.cn: 他们打算把街上所有的毒品贩子都清走。

ex.en: He's a dealer in second-hand cars.
ex.cn: 他经销二手汽车。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）腐烂，腐朽
vi.衰败，衰退，衰落
n.腐败、衰退的状态
n.欺骗，欺诈,诡计,谎言

ex.en: They accused him of weaving a web of lies and deceit.
ex.cn: 他们指控他编织了一个满是谎言和欺诈的骗局。

ex.en: He would have no truck with deceit.
ex.cn: 他不愿去骗人。

ex.en: He was accused of lies and deceit.
ex.cn: 他被指控撒谎和欺诈。

def: adj.正派的,得体的,（服装等）相称的，合宜的,相当好的

ex.en: I went to Brooks Brothers and bought myself a decent shirt.
ex.cn: 我去布鲁克斯兄弟专卖店给自己买了一件体面的衬衫。

ex.en: You need hard currency to get anything halfway decent.
ex.cn: 你得有硬通货才能买到还算不错的东西。

ex.en: He must make a decent living from other artists covering his songs.
ex.cn: 其他艺术家翻唱他的歌曲，一定使他过上了收入颇为可观的生活。

def:
adj.十进位的，小数的
n.小数

ex.en: In 1971, the 1p and 2p decimal coins were introduced in Britain.
ex.cn: 英国于1971年开始使用十进制的1便士和2便士硬币。

ex.en: A pocket calculator only works to eight decimal places.
ex.cn: 袖珍计算器只能计算到小数点后8位数。

ex.en: The decimal 0.61 stands for 61 hundredths.

def:
n.甲板，舱板,[建]平屋顶，桥面,[铁路]客车车顶,〈俚〉地面
vt.装饰,给…铺上甲板,打扮

ex.en: All deck fittings, windows, hatches and doors had been fastened.
ex.cn: 甲板上所有的装置、窗户、舱口盖和门都已经关牢了。

ex.en: Steamers tooted at us as sailors on deck waved in amusement.
ex.cn: 汽船向我们嘟嘟鸣笛时，甲板上的水手们饶有趣味地挥着手。

ex.en: This boat has a good deck layout making everything easy to operate.
ex.cn: 这艘船的甲板布局合理，使得所有操控都很方便。

def: vt.扣除，减去,演绎

ex.en: If you will just sign here, we will arrange for your bank to deduct your payments automatically.
ex.cn: 麻烦您在这里签一下字，我们将联系您的银行自动扣除您的付款。

ex.en: In special cases, a husband can deduct the travel expenses of his wife who accompanies him on a business trip.
ex.cn: 在特殊情况下，丈夫可以扣除陪同出差的妻子的旅费。

ex.en: It is not the bank's policy to deduct interest on withdrawals.
ex.cn: 提款需扣除利息这并非是本银行的政策.

def:
n.瑕疵，毛病,欠缺，缺点
vi.叛逃,背叛

ex.en: Stammering is probably an inherited defect.
ex.cn: 口吃很可能是一种遗传性缺陷。

ex.en: a defect in the glass
ex.cn: 玻璃杯的缺陷

ex.en: The defect in the drainage must be remedied.
ex.cn: 这排水系统的缺陷该设法补救.

def: n.不足额,赤字,亏空,亏损

ex.en: These will be very constrained budgets designed to get the deficit down.
ex.cn: 这些预算旨在减少赤字，将会大大受限。

ex.en: By 1973 the government deficit equalled thirty per cent of GNP.
ex.cn: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。

ex.en: He recovered from a 4-2 deficit to reach the quarter-finals.
ex.cn: 他在2比4落后的情况下实现逆转闯进1/4决赛。

def:
adj.退化的,堕落的,变质的,变性的
vt.使退化,恶化,使变质,衰减
vi.退化,堕落
n.堕落的人,腐化的人,精神变态者,退化的动物

ex.en: Will too much freedom make them degenerate?
ex.cn: 太多的自由会令他们堕落 吗 ?

ex.en: The newly emerging forces are bound to defeat what is corrupt and degenerate.
ex.cn: 新生力量必然战胜腐朽力量.

ex.en: Inactivity can make your joints stiff, and the bones may begin to degenerate.
ex.cn: 长期不活动会导致关节僵硬，骨骼也可能开始退化。

def:
n.代表，代表团成员
vt.委派代表,授权给,[法律]债务转移

ex.en: Horton's Achilles heel was that he could not delegate.
ex.cn: 霍顿的软肋在于他不懂得放权。

ex.en: The delegate moved for a reconsideration of the suggestion.
ex.cn: 这位代表提议重新考虑这一建议.

ex.en: The Chinese people delegate their power to the People's Congress.
ex.cn: 中国人民授权人民代表大会.

def: n.否认，否定,克制,拒绝，拒绝接受

ex.en: The denial was limited to rejecting the construction put on his remarks.
ex.cn: 这种否认仅限于不接受对他所说话语的阐释。

ex.en: This does not justify the denial of constitutional protection.
ex.cn: 这不能成为剥夺他人受宪法保护权利的正当理由。

ex.en: The Foreign Ministry has issued a flat denial of any involvement.
ex.cn: 外交部已经坚决否认参与过此事。

def: vt.公开指责,正式指控,告发,通告废除

adj.牙齿的,牙科的,（辅音）齿音的
n.齿音

ex.en: I know it's a good idea to use dental floss.
ex.cn: 我知道用洁牙线是一个好主意。

ex.en: The coroner recorded a verdict of acci-dental death.
ex.cn: 验尸官作出了意外死亡的结论。

ex.en: The fees offered by the NHS do not recompense dental surgeons for their professional time.
ex.cn: 国民医疗保健系统所支付的费用中不涵盖牙科诊疗费用。

def: v.离开，出发,去世,离职,脱轨

ex.en: My connecting plane didn't depart for another six hours.
ex.cn: 我搭乘的联运航班又过了6个小时才起飞。

ex.en: Lipton is planning to depart from the company he founded.
ex.cn: 利普顿打算离开他创立的那家公司。

ex.en: We do depart for Wales on the morrow.
ex.cn: 我们明天确实要前往威尔士。

def:
n.副手,代理人,代表
adj.副的,代理的

ex.en: She was so disloyal to her deputy she made his position untenable.
ex.cn: 她对她的副手很不守信义，使得他的职位岌岌可危。

ex.en: The Deputy Commander has condemned this weekend's protest as deliberate provocation.
ex.cn: 副指挥官谴责本周末的抗议活动是蓄意挑衅。

ex.en: He was given the title of deputy prime minister.
ex.cn: 他被授予副总理之职。

def:
vt.指明，指出,指派,表明，意味着,把…定名为
adj.指定而尚未上任的,选出而尚未上任的

ex.en: Japan'sPrime Minister-designate is completing his Cabinet today.
ex.cn: 日本的当选首相今日将完成组阁。

ex.en: Will you designate the flowers you wish?
ex.cn: 你能说出你想要的花 吗 ?

ex.en: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
ex.cn: 人们正在努力将这座桥定为历史遗迹。

def:
adj.无人的,荒凉的,孤独的，凄凉的,荒废的
vt.使荒无人烟，使荒芜,使凄凉，使孤单

ex.en: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.
ex.cn: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。

ex.en: a bleak and desolate landscape
ex.cn: 一片荒凉的景色

ex.en: The house was desolate, ready to be torn down.
ex.cn: 这房子没人居住, 等着拆除.

def:
n.& v.派遣
n.急件
vt.快递，调遣
vi.赶紧，匆匆离开

ex.en: He feels we should act with despatch.
ex.cn: 他觉得我们应该迅速行动。

ex.en: The fox takes his chance with a pack of hounds which may catch him and despatch him immediately.
ex.cn: 那只狐狸和一群随时可能置其于死地的猎狗冒险周旋。

ex.en: The despatch of the task force is purely a contingency measure.
ex.cn: 派出特遣部队纯粹是应急之举。

def:
vt.派遣，调度,（迅速地）发出,迅速处理，迅速了结,处决（罪犯等）
n.（使者等的）派遣,急件,迅速办理，快速处理,（记者发回的）新闻报道

ex.en: The victory inspired him to dispatch a gleeful telegram to Roosevelt.
ex.cn: 胜利促使他给罗斯福发了封喜报。

ex.en: We have 125 cases ready for dispatch.
ex.cn: 我们有125个待发的箱子。

ex.en: The three - man board manages its business with care and dispatch.
ex.cn: 这个三人董事会办事细心、麻利.

def: vt.鄙视，看不起
n.餐后甜食,甜点

ex.en: Scott was obviously inebriated by the time the dessert was served.
ex.cn: 到了上甜点的时候，斯科特显然已经喝醉了。

ex.en: "I really want some dessert," Keaton says, smacking his lips.
ex.cn: “我真的很想吃点儿点心，”基顿咂着嘴说。

ex.en: He finished his dessert and patted his paunch.
ex.cn: 他吃完甜点，拍了拍他的大肚子。

def: adj.破坏性的,毁灭性的,有害的

ex.en: He was unable to contain his own destructive feelings.
ex.cn: 他无法抑制自己消极的情绪。

ex.en: Tanks are heavy on fuel and destructive to roads.
ex.cn: 坦克要耗费大量的燃料，而且会破坏道路。

ex.en: Although not ideal, this attitude is not entirely destructive.
ex.cn: 这种态度虽然不够理想，但还不至于消极透顶。

def: vt.留住，阻住,耽搁,拘留，扣留

ex.en: He caught her arm in a subconscious attempt to detain her.
ex.cn: 他下意识地抓住她的胳膊想挽留她。

ex.en: Thank you. We won't detain you any further.
ex.cn: 非常感谢。我们就不再耽搁您的时间了。

ex.en: It is against the law to detain you against your will for any length of time.
ex.cn: 无论强制扣押多长时间都属违法。

def:
adj.侦探的,适于探测的,用于探测的
n.侦探

ex.en: "Once a detective, always a detective," he said lightly.
ex.cn: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

ex.en: I don't have to be a detective to figure that out.
ex.cn: 我不是侦探也想得出。

ex.en: Joan Smith's detective stories are a cut above the rest.
ex.cn: 琼·史密斯的侦探小说比其他侦探小说都要出色。

def:
v.脱离，越轨，违背，误入歧途,使脱离常轨
n.脱离常轨的人
adj.脱离常轨的

n.魔鬼,家伙,淘气鬼,冒失鬼
vt.虐待，折磨,（用扯碎机）扯碎,（替作家，律师等）做助手,抹辣味料烤制或煎煮

ex.en: Tim wondered how the devil they had managed it.
ex.cn: 蒂姆想知道他们究竟是怎么做到的。

ex.en: She even claimed the couple's daughter was possessed by the devil.
ex.cn: 她甚至宣称那对夫妇的女儿被魔鬼附了体。

ex.en: "I think he was a bit of a devil," Constance said.
ex.cn: “我想他有点儿淘气，”康斯坦丝说道。

def:
n.水珠，露水
vt.弄湿

ex.en: The grass was wet with early morning dew.
ex.cn: 清晨的露水使得青草湿漉漉的。

ex.en: Moisture in the atmosphere condensed into dew during the night.
ex.cn: 大气中的水汽在夜间凝结成了露珠.

ex.en: The green boughs glittered with all their pearls of dew.
ex.cn: 绿枝上闪烁着露珠的光彩.

def:
n.图表,图解,示意图,[数]线图
vt.用图表示,图解

ex.en: Like any such diagram, it is a simplification.
ex.cn: 像其他这种表格一样，这是简化了的。

ex.en: a diagram representing a cross section of the human eye
ex.cn: 表现人眼的剖面图

ex.en: a diagram of the wiring system
ex.cn: 线路系统图

def: n.直径，直径长,放大率

ex.en: This hole was a scant .23 inches in diameter.
ex.cn: 这个洞眼的直径只有0.23英寸。

ex.en: the diameter of a tree trunk
ex.cn: 树干的直径

ex.en: A diameter passes through the center of a circle.
ex.cn: 直径从圆心穿过.

def: n.口授，听写,听写测验,命令

ex.en: She is transcribing, from his dictation, the diaries of Simon Forman.
ex.cn: 她正根据他的口述记录西蒙·福曼的日记。

ex.en: We have a dictation every English class.
ex.cn: 每次上英语课我们都进行听写测验.

ex.en: The new secretary takes dictation very well.
ex.cn: 那位新秘书善于记录口授.

def:
vt.& vi.区分，区别，辨别
vi.区别对待
vt.表明…间的差别，构成…间差别的特征,[数学] 求…的微分：计算导数或（函数的）微分

ex.en: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
ex.cn: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

ex.en: It's difficult to differentiate between the two varieties.
ex.cn: 这两个品种很难辨别。

ex.en: You can differentiate between the houses by the shape of their chimneys.
ex.cn: 你可以凭借烟囱形状的不同来区分这两幢房子.

def: n.窘境，困境,进退两难

ex.en: Public policy on the family presents liberals with a dilemma.
ex.cn: 有关家庭的公共政策使自由主义者陷入了进退两难的境地。

ex.en: I didn't have a ready answer for this dilemma.
ex.cn: 我没有想出解决这个困境的现成答案。

ex.en: to face a dilemma
ex.cn: 面临左右为难的困境

def:
vi.吃饭，进餐
vt.设宴款待，请客

ex.en: They used to enjoy going out to dine.
ex.cn: 他们以前很喜欢出去吃饭。

ex.en: I wish I could afford to dine off fresh meat every day.
ex.cn: 我要是能天天吃到新鲜的肉就好了.

ex.en: Let's dine out tonight. I'm too tired to cook.
ex.cn: 我太累了,不想做饭, 今晚咱们到外面吃吧.

def:
n.毕业文凭,学位证书,公文,奖状
v.发毕业文凭

ex.en: a BTEC Higher National Diploma in Public Service Studies
ex.cn: BTEC公共服务科高等国家证书

ex.en: a two-year diploma course
ex.cn: 二年制的文凭课程

ex.en: The course leads to a diploma in psychiatric nursing.
ex.cn: 读完这门课程可以获得精神病护理文凭.

def: adj.外交上的,外交人员的,有手腕的,策略的

ex.en: The Kremlin is still insisting on a diplomatic solution to the crisis.
ex.cn: 俄罗斯中央政府依然坚持通过外交方式解决危机。

ex.en: He proposed a new diplomatic initiative to try to stop the war.
ex.cn: 他提出了一项新的外交计划以尽力阻止这场战争。

ex.en: My limited diplomatic skills were tested to the utmost.
ex.cn: 我有限的外交手腕儿受到了极其严峻的考验。

def: adj.灾难性的,损失惨重的,极坏的,悲惨的

ex.en: The first four years of government were completely disastrous.
ex.cn: 政府前4年的执政彻底失败。

ex.en: The effect on coffee prices has been disastrous for the producers.
ex.cn: 对咖啡价格的影响对生产商而言是灾难性的。

ex.en: Obree summed his weekend up in one word: "Disastrous."
ex.cn: 奥布瑞用一个词总结了他的周末经历：“灾难。”

def:
vt.下（客）,卸船,免除（自己的义务、负担等）,执行
vt.& vi.放出,流出,开枪,发射
n.（气体、液体如水从管子里）流出,排放出的物体
vi.（船、飞机等）卸货,（颜料、墨水或染料等）化开,卸掉负担（或负载）,下客

ex.en: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
ex.cn: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

ex.en: Discharge of raw sewage into the sea is unsanitary and unsafe.
ex.cn: 把未经处理的污水排放到海里既不卫生也不安全。

ex.en: They develop a fever and a watery discharge from their eyes.
ex.cn: 他们开始发烧，眼睛里分泌出一种水状物。

def: adj.谨慎的，慎重的,考虑周到的,小心的,持重

ex.en: She had meant to make a discreet entrance, but conversation stopped dead.
ex.cn: 她本打算悄悄进去，但谈话却突然中断了。

ex.en: She's making a few discreet inquiries with her mother's friends.
ex.cn: 她旁敲侧击地向她母亲的朋友们打听过几次。

ex.en: She wore discreet jewellery.
ex.cn: 她戴着素净的首饰。

def: n.矛盾,不符合（之处）

ex.en: At other times the discrepancy was of the order of 20%.
ex.cn: 往常的出入约为20%。

ex.en: The discrepancy in their ages seemed not to matter.
ex.cn: 他们之间年龄的差异似乎没有多大关系.

ex.en: A greater cause for resentment is the discrepancy in pay.
ex.cn: 导致愤怒的更主要原因是报酬上的差异.

def: vt.& vi.歧视,区别,辨出

n.反感，厌恶，嫌恶
vt.使反感，厌恶

ex.en: I turned to Jacky, my nostrils flaring in disgust.
ex.cn: 我转过身厌恶地看着杰基，鼻翼呼呼地翕动着。

ex.en: She told him that her first reaction was disgust.
ex.cn: 她告诉他自己的第一反应是厌恶。

ex.en: He rolled his eyes heavenward in disgust.
ex.cn: 他厌恶地翻着白眼。

def:
vt.使惊愕，使焦虑，使气馁
n.惊愕，气馁

ex.en: The ministers expressed dismay at the continued practice of ethnic cleansing.
ex.cn: 部长们表达了对持续进行的种族清洗的忧虑。

ex.en: The European Court's decision has been greeted with dismay by fishermen.
ex.cn: 渔民对欧洲法庭的裁决感到失望。

ex.en: The father's face stiffened with dismay.
ex.cn: 父亲因为悲痛而面部表情凝重。

def:
n.（事情的）处置,（自由）处置权,清理,排列
adj.处理（或置放）废品的

ex.en: He has said he will use all the weapons at his disposal.
ex.cn: 他放出话说他将使出十八般武艺。

ex.en: A few hours later bomb disposal experts defused the devices.
ex.cn: 几小时以后拆弹专家拆除了该爆炸装置的引信。

ex.en: They've stooped to using any and every weapon at their disposal.
ex.cn: 他们已经无耻到把能用的武器都用上了。

def: n.性情，性格,意向，倾向,安排，配置,<军>部署，战略（战术）计划

ex.en: He was a nice lad — bright and with a sunny disposition.
ex.cn: 他是个不错的小伙子——聪明伶俐而且性格开朗。

ex.en: Judge Stacks was appointed to oversee the disposition of funds.
ex.cn: 斯塔克斯法官被指定监督资金的分配。

ex.en: This has given him a disposition to consider our traditions critically.
ex.cn: 这使他倾向以批判眼光看待我们的传统。

def:
vt.使混乱,使分裂，使瓦解,破坏,使中断
adj.混乱的,分裂的，中断的,瓦解的

ex.en: The soldiers, for their part, agreed not to disrupt the election campaign.
ex.cn: 就士兵们而言，他们答应不去干扰竞选活动。

ex.en: The war seemed likely to disrupt the state.
ex.cn: 战争可能使这个国家分裂.

ex.en: The government will not seek to disrupt the legitimate business activities of the defendant.
ex.cn: 政府无意干扰被告的合法经营活动。

def:
vt.驱散,使消散,浪费，挥霍,耗尽
vi.消散,放荡，挥霍

ex.en: Don't dissipate your efforts.
ex.cn: 不要浪费你的精力.

ex.en: He wound down the windows to dissipate the heat.
ex.cn: 他摇下窗子来散热。

ex.en: The body must dissipate heat as fast as it produces it.
ex.cn: 人体散发热量必须和产生热量一样快.

def:
v.蒸馏，提取，滴下
vt.抽出…的精华,提炼,使渗出,使滴下
vi.蒸馏,精炼,作为精华产生,渗出

ex.en: The cool of the night distill the dew.
ex.cn: 深夜的寒气凝成露珠.

ex.en: We were asked to distill the crucial points of the book.
ex.cn: 我们被要求从这本书中提炼出关键点.

ex.en: Methods: The medicine materials is decoction distill and concentrate with liquid.
ex.cn: 方法: 药材共水煎煮提取、浓缩,制成安神汤.

def:
n.悲痛,危难，不幸,贫困,[法]扣押财物
vt.使痛苦，使忧伤,[法]扣押（财物）,使贫困

ex.en: He keeps coming to the aid of this damsel in distress.
ex.cn: 他不断出手相助这位落难女子。

ex.en: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress.
ex.cn: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

ex.en: The crew did not send out any distress signals.
ex.cn: 机组人员没有发出任何求救信号。

def:
n.沟渠,壕沟
vt.摆脱，抛弃,在…上掘沟,把…开入沟里,使（火车）出轨
vi.使（飞机）在海上紧急降落，（在海上）迫降,开沟

ex.en: I can't bring myself to ditch him and start again.
ex.cn: 我不忍心蹬掉他再觅新欢。

ex.en: Below the bridge we could just discern a narrow, weedy ditch.
ex.cn: 我们仅能依稀辨出桥下一条杂草丛生的窄沟。

ex.en: She underwent a heart transplant in a last-ditch attempt to save her.
ex.cn: 她动了心脏移植手术，这是为挽救她的生命而作的最后一次努力。

def:
vi.潜水,跳水,急剧下降,（头朝下）跳入水中
n.潜水,跳水,俯冲，（潜艇）下潜,（气温，股价等的）暴跌，跳水
vt.& vi.突然下降，暴跌

ex.en: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
ex.cn: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

ex.en: She was standing by a pool, about to dive in.
ex.cn: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。

ex.en: An attempt was then made to dive the sump.
ex.cn: 之后曾尝试潜入污水坑。

def:
adj.神的， 天赐的,极好的,神圣的
vt.&vi.占卜，预言,猜测， 预测,（用丫形杖）探测（地下水）
n.牧师,神学家

ex.en: A degree does not give you a divine right to wealth.
ex.cn: 拥有学位并不能保证你就能获得财富。

ex.en: Darling how lovely to see you, you look simply divine.
ex.cn: 亲爱的，见到你太让人高兴了，你看上去简直美极了。

ex.en: The whole system was based on divine revelation in the Scriptures.
ex.cn: 整个体系都建立在《圣经》的神圣启示的基础之上。

def:
adj.头昏眼花的,使人眩晕的，引起头晕的,昏乱的,愚蠢的
v.使头晕眼花,使发昏,使昏乱,使茫然

ex.en: The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.
ex.cn: 这类人可能会莫名其妙地感到头晕。

ex.en: He came over all dizzy when he stood up.
ex.cn: 他一站起身就觉得天旋地转。

ex.en: He felt sick and dizzy and then passed out.
ex.cn: 他感到恶心、眩晕，然后就昏了过去。

def:
n.码头,被告席,草本植物,尾巴的骨肉部份
vt.& vi.（使）船停靠码头,剪短（尾巴等）,削减，缩减（工资等）,在…设置船坞
vi.入船坞

ex.en: The truck left the loading dock with hoses still attached.
ex.cn: 卡车驶离装货月台时塑料水龙带还连在上面。

ex.en: He threatens to dock her fee.
ex.cn: 他威胁要扣掉她的服务费。

ex.en: To dock points would be wrong.
ex.cn: 扣分的判罚是错误的。

def:
vt.& vi.（尤指向慈善机构）捐赠,献（血）,捐（血）,捐献（器官）
n.捐赠,捐献

ex.en: Pictures of starving children have sent many people scurrying to donate money.
ex.cn: 看到一张张忍饥挨饿的孩子们的照片，许多人赶忙捐钱。

ex.en: This led Zagreb's twin town, Mainz, to donate £70,000-worth of high-quality equipment.
ex.cn: 这使得萨格勒布的友好城市美因茨捐赠了价值7万英镑的高品质装备。

ex.en: We are happy to donate to bona fide charitable causes.
ex.cn: 我们很乐意为真正的慈善事业捐献财物。

def:
n.（学校等的）宿舍,集体寝室,（在市内工作的人的）郊外住宅区
adj.住宅区的

ex.en: The students have barricaded themselves into their dormitory building.
ex.cn: 学生们把自己关在了宿舍楼里。

ex.en: It had become almost a dormitory suburb of the city.
ex.cn: 它几乎成为了城市的一个市郊住宅区。

ex.en: She lived in a college dormitory.
ex.cn: 她住在大学宿舍里。

def:
n.点，小圆点
vt.打点于,散布于,点缀,以小圆点标出

ex.en: He started for Dot's bedroom and Myrtle held him back.
ex.cn: 他正要去多特的卧室，被默特尔拦住了。

ex.en: "For heaven's sake!" Dot expostulated. "They're cheap and they're useful."
ex.cn: “拜托！”多特反驳道，“它们又便宜又管用。”

ex.en: You've wanted to be a barrister since the year dot.
ex.cn: 很久以前你就一直想成为一名辩护律师了。

def:
vi.打盹儿，打瞌睡,假寐
vt.打瞌睡度过
n.瞌睡

ex.en: In one room, young mothers weave while babies doze in their laps.
ex.cn: 在一间屋子里，年轻的母亲们在织布，而她们的孩子就在她们膝上打盹。

ex.en: After lunch I had a doze.
ex.cn: 吃过午饭，我小睡了会儿。

ex.en: I had a doze on the train.
ex.cn: 我在火车上打了个盹儿。

def: n.龙，龙船,[D-][天文学]天龙（星座）,[口语、贬义]脾气暴躁的人

ex.en: St George slew the dragon.
ex.cn: 圣乔治杀死了那条龙。

ex.en: The landscape of the Great Wall is like a dragon.
ex.cn: 长城的全景像一条龙.

ex.en: His wife is an absolute dragon!
ex.cn: 他的老婆是个十足的母夜叉!

def:
vt.害怕，担心,（古语）敬畏
n.恐惧，畏惧,令人恐惧的事物
adj.可怕的
vi.十分害怕

ex.en: I dread to think what our telephone bill is going to be.
ex.cn: 我不敢想象我们的电话费会有多少。
