ex.en: I've got to go home, but Lord knows I dread it.
ex.cn: 我必须得回家了，不过是个人都知道我很怕回去。

ex.en: The old dread knotted her stomach.
ex.cn: 从前那些可怕的经历让她的心都揪紧了。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）滴下
vi.滴出,含有,充满,充溢
n.滴答，滴答滴答的声音,水滴,[医]点滴,点滴（的信息等）

ex.en: He is on a saline drip.
ex.cn: 他正在输盐水.

ex.en: The faucet has developed a drip.
ex.cn: 那个水龙头已经开始滴水了.

ex.en: Everything he said drip ped acid.
ex.cn: 他的话里字字句句都带着刺.

def:
n.鼓,鼓状物,鼓声,石首鱼
vt.击鼓,连打,反复讲,鼓吹
vi.击鼓,连打,拍翅

ex.en: As he sang he kept time on a small drum.
ex.cn: 他边唱边和着节拍敲一个小鼓。

ex.en: The trade secretary disagreed but promised to "bang the drum for industry".
ex.cn: 贸易部长并不同意，但是答应会“为产业界摇旗呐喊”。

ex.en: The drum is one of the oldest musical instruments.
ex.cn: 鼓是最古老的乐器之一。

def: adj.哑的，无说话能力的,不说话的，无声的,沉默的，无言的,口齿不清的，（在政府中）无代言人的，政治上无发言权的

ex.en: The questions were set up to make her look dumb.
ex.cn: 问题这么设计，就是为了让她出丑。

ex.en: The snowy street, like the church, assumed a dumb, lifeless aspect.
ex.cn: 积雪覆盖的街道就像教堂一样，显得沉闷、毫无生气。

ex.en: An expression of dumb recognition wiggled across her features.
ex.cn: 她不语，从她脸上掠过的一丝表情可知她是认得的。

def:
vt.倾倒,丢下，卸下,摆脱，扔弃,倾销
vi.突然跌倒或落下,卸货,转嫁（责任等）
n.垃圾场,仓库,无秩序地累积

ex.en: I thought he was going to dump me for another girl.
ex.cn: 我以为他要为了另一个女孩而和我分手。

ex.en: The government declared that it did not dump radioactive waste at sea.
ex.cn: 政府宣称并未将放射性废料倾倒在海里。

ex.en: It's a bit much expecting me to dump your boyfriend for you.
ex.cn: 指望我替你甩掉你的男朋友，有点儿过分了吧？

def: v.复制,复印,重复

ex.en: Charles scored again, with an exact duplicate of his first goal.
ex.cn: 查尔斯梅开二度,与第一次破门如出一辙.

ex.en: His task will be to duplicate his success overseas here at home.
ex.cn: 他在海外取得了成功，现在的任务就是要在国内再创辉煌。

ex.en: He let himself in with a duplicate key.
ex.cn: 他用一把复制的钥匙打开门进去。

def:
n.黄昏，傍晚,幽暗
adj.微暗的,变暗的,〈诗〉同dusky
v.变暗,使变暗

ex.en: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
ex.cn: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

ex.en: Dusk was deepening as they drove back to the lights of Shillingham.
ex.cn: 他们驱车返回华灯初上的希灵汉姆时，暮色渐浓。

ex.en: As the dusk shaded into night, we drove slowly through narrow alleys.
ex.cn: 夜幕渐渐降临，我们驱车在狭窄的胡同里缓慢前行。

def:
n.侏儒，矮子,矮小的动物（植物）,[天]矮星
vt.（使）显得矮小,使（发育，智能等）受阻碍,使相形见绌
vi.变矮小
adj.矮小的

ex.en: The dwarf's long arms were not proportional to his height.
ex.cn: 那侏儒的长臂与他的身高不成比例.

ex.en: A dwarf going upstairs getting higher step by step.
ex.cn: 矮子上楼梯,步步登高.

ex.en: He is a dwarf.
ex.cn: 他是一个矮子.

def:
n.染料，染色,颜色
vt.染色,给…染色
vi.染上或粘上（颜色）

ex.en: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
ex.cn: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

ex.en: He is still vain enough to dye his hair red.
ex.cn: 他还是很虚荣，把头发染成了红褐色。

ex.en: The red dye on the leather is water-soluble.
ex.cn: 皮革上的这种红色染料可溶于水。

def: n.王朝,朝代

ex.en: The Seljuk dynasty of Syria was founded in 1094.
ex.cn: 叙利亚的塞尔柱王朝始建于1094年。

ex.en: Some missionaries came from England in the Qing Dynasty.
ex.cn: 清朝时,从英国来了一些传教士.

ex.en: Written records show that acupuncture dates back to the Song Dynasty.
ex.cn: 文字记载表明,宋朝就已经有了针灸.

def: n.<宗>复活节

ex.en: The word Easter derives from Eostre, the pagan goddess of spring.
ex.cn: Easter（复活节）一词由Eostre（多神教的春天女神）衍生而来。

ex.en: She spends her Easter holidays taking groups of children to France.
ex.cn: 她带领一群孩子去法国过复活节。

ex.en: In the end, we all decided to organize a concert for Easter.
ex.cn: 最终，我们一致决定组织一场复活节音乐会。

def:
vi.（指潮水）退,跌落,减少,衰落
n.退潮,落潮,衰退,减少

ex.en: We decided to leave on the ebb at six o'clock next morning.
ex.cn: 我们决定第二天早晨6点钟趁退潮时离开。

ex.en: The Government's popularity is at its lowest ebb.
ex.cn: 政府的支持率跌到了最低点。

ex.en: the ebb and flow of the tide
ex.cn: 海潮的涨落

def:
adj.古怪的，异常的,偏离轨道的,离心的
n.古怪的人,[物]偏心轮

ex.en: Great chess players have a reputation for being both eccentric and argumentative.
ex.cn: 国际象棋大师们以性格怪异和好与人争辩而闻名。

ex.en: "He's a bit of an eccentric old fatty," Thomas thought, unkindly.
ex.cn: “他是一个有点古怪的胖老头。”托马斯不厚道地想。

ex.en: Geniuses are supposed to be eccentric and hopelessly impractical.
ex.cn: 天才通常都被认为行为古怪而且毫无实践能力。

def:
n.回声，共鸣,（言语、作风、思想等的）重复,重复者,[无线电]回波
vt.重复，效仿,随声附和,类似,发射（声音等）
vi.被重复,产生回响,充满回声

ex.en: Pinks and beiges were chosen to echo the colours of the ceiling.
ex.cn: 选用了粉红色和米色，以跟从天花板的颜色。

ex.en: Many phrases in the last two chapters echo earlier passages.
ex.cn: 最后两章中的很多说法是对前面段落的呼应。

ex.en: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.
ex.cn: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

def:
n.[天]（日、月）食,消失，黯然失色,漆黑
vt.使黯然失色,形成日（或月）食

ex.en: Of course, nothing is going to eclipse winning the Olympic title.
ex.cn: 当然，没有什么能比得过赢得奥运会冠军。

ex.en: During the seventies, her acting career was in eclipse.
ex.cn: 在七十年代, 她的表演生涯黯然失色.

ex.en: The time when a solar eclipse will occur can be calculated.
ex.cn: 日食发生的时间可以推算出来.

def: n.生态学,社会生态学,个体生态学

ex.en: To keep ecology in balance is our duty.
ex.cn: 保持生态平衡是我们的职责.

ex.en: Development has been guided by a concern for the ecology of the area.
ex.cn: 该地区的发展以注重生态为指导原则。

ex.en: The Windermere Golf Club is proof positive that golf and ecology can co-exist in perfect harmony.
ex.cn: 温德米尔高尔夫俱乐部证明了高尔夫和生态能完全和谐共存。

def:
adj.可以吃的，可食用的
n.食物

ex.en: The food at the hotel was barely edible.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆的食物简直不能入口。

ex.en: Edible wild herbs kept us from dying of starvation.
ex.cn: 我们靠着野菜才没被饿死.

ex.en: This kind of mushroom is edible, but that kind is not.
ex.cn: 这种蘑菇吃得, 那种吃不得.

def: n.自我,自负,自尊心,自我意识

ex.en: She is, first and foremost, her husband's alter ego.
ex.cn: 她首先是丈夫的知己。

ex.en: Barry Humphries's alter ego Dame Edna has taken the US by storm.
ex.cn: 巴里·汉弗莱斯凭借埃德娜夫人一角轰动全美。

ex.en: She was a prisoner of her own ego.
ex.cn: 她为自己的自尊心所困。

def:
vt.喷出,驱逐,强制离开
vi.弹射出

ex.en: This safety invention will eject the pilot from a burning plane.
ex.cn: 这个安全装置会把飞行员从燃烧着的飞机中弹出.

ex.en: Some ants eject formic acid when irritated.
ex.cn: 有些蚂蚁受到刺激时会排出蚁酸.

ex.en: Officials used guard dogs to eject the protesters.
ex.cn: 官员们用警犬驱散抗议人群。

def:
vi.消逝,时间过去
n.（时间的）消逝

ex.en: A hundred long years must still elapse before Englishman could hear the name of Oliver Cromwell.
ex.cn: 离英国人听到奥利弗·克伦姆威尔的名字还有一百年之久呢.

ex.en: As time elapse and our effort, should can solve.
ex.cn: 随着时间推移和我们的努力, 应该能够解决.

ex.en: The return of the echo will elapse longer time.
ex.cn: 回声返回所耗的时间越长了.

def:
adj.有弹力的,可伸缩的,灵活的
n.松紧带，橡皮圈

ex.en: Pull the elastic tight and knot the ends.
ex.cn: 把橡皮筋拽紧，两头打上结。

ex.en: This skirt needs some new elastic in the waist.
ex.cn: 这条裙子需要换一根松紧腰带。

ex.en: The new policy was sufficiently elastic to accommodate both views.
ex.cn: 新政策充分灵活地适用两种观点.

def: n.电工，电气技师

ex.en: The only electrician we could get hold of was miles away.
ex.cn: 我们唯一能够联络到的电工离这里有好几英里远。

ex.en: She said she would find an electrician for us.
ex.cn: 她说她要给我们找一个电工技师.

ex.en: We need an electrician to mend the iron.
ex.cn: 我们要请电工修理熨斗.

def: n.电子

ex.en: The structure of molecules can be seen under an electron microscope.
ex.cn: 分子的结构可在电子显微镜下观察到.

ex.en: An electron has a negative charge, a proton has a positive charge.
ex.cn: 电子带负电荷, 质子带正电荷.

ex.en: Freedom, gravity, ego, and electron are constructs.
ex.cn: 自由, 万有引力, 自我中心以及电子都是概念.

def: n.电梯,升降机（美）,谷仓

adj.合适的,在（法律上或道德上）合格的,有资格当选的,称心如意的
n.合格者,合适者,称心如意的人,合乎条件的人（或东西）

ex.en: Millions of householders are eligible to claim the new council tax benefit.
ex.cn: 数百万房主都有资格申请新的市政税优惠。

ex.en: He is eligible now to file a motion for a new trial.
ex.cn: 他现在有资格提议重新进行审判。

ex.en: 96 per cent of the eligible employees took up the offer.
ex.cn: 符合条件的雇员有96%接受了这个条件。

def: adj.雄辩的，有口才的,有说明力的,富于表情的，逼真的,动人的

vi.上飞机，上船,着手，从事
vt.使…上船或飞机,使从事，使着手,投资于

ex.en: The fears have prompted several countries to embark on massive armament plans.
ex.cn: 几个国家开始实施大规模的军备计划，以防患于未然。

ex.en: Redundancy is the spur for many to embark on new careers.
ex.cn: 裁员促使很多人开始从事新事业。

ex.en: Bob ordered brigade HQ to embark.
ex.cn: 鲍勃命令旅指挥部登船。

def: vt.& vi.（使）窘迫，（使）局促不安,（使）困难

ex.en: I did not embarrass her with my effusions.
ex.cn: 我并没有太过热情而让她为难。

ex.en: She may embarrass you with her uncouth behavior.
ex.cn: 她的粗野行为可能会让你尴尬.

ex.en: He didn't mean to embarrass you.
ex.cn: 他不是成心让你难堪.

def: n.大使馆,大使馆全体成员,大使的职务（地位）,重任，差使

ex.en: Embassy security personnel refused to admit him or his wife.
ex.cn: 使馆保安人员不允许他和夫人进入。

ex.en: One young policeman stood guard outside the locked embassy gates.
ex.cn: 一位年轻的警察在大门紧闭的使馆外站岗。

ex.en: Light and water in embassy buildings were cut off.
ex.cn: 大使馆内的水电都被切断了。

def: vt.&vi.把…嵌入,栽种,深留（记忆中）

ex.en: They used to kind of embed it in the glass.
ex.cn: 他们往往把它嵌在玻璃里.

ex.en: My dear " duckling ", do you still embed in mind the dream of " white swan "?
ex.cn: 亲爱的 “ 小鸭子 ”, 还在做 “ 白天鹅 ” 的梦 吗 ?

ex.en: Create your own slideshow, then embed in your classroom blog.
ex.cn: 创建自己的幻灯片, 然后嵌入到教学博客中.

def: vt.表现，象征,包含，收录,使具体化,[军]组编

ex.en: Any incomes policy must embody the attributes of fairness and flexibility.
ex.cn: 任何收入政策都应该具有公平与灵活性之特征.

ex.en: The latest locomotives embody many new features.
ex.cn: 这些最新的机车具有许多新的特色.

ex.en: Words embody thoughts and feelings.
ex.cn: 言语具体表现各种思想和感情.

def: vt.移居国外

ex.en: The men emigrate to work as seamen.
ex.cn: 男人们移居国外当海员。

ex.en: Economists warn that enormous pressures could build up, forcing people to emigrate westwards.
ex.cn: 经济学家警告，迫使人们向西部迁移的压力可能会增至很大的程度。

ex.en: Everybody was flabbergasted when I announced I was going to emigrate to Australia.
ex.cn: 我宣布要移民去澳大利亚时，所有人都惊呆了。

def: vt.（用墙、篱笆等）把…围起来,把…装入信封,附入

ex.en: Please enclose your remittance, making cheques payable to Thames Valley Technology.
ex.cn: 请附上汇款，支票收款人为泰晤士河谷科技公司。

ex.en: Please remember to enclose a stamped addressed envelope when writing.
ex.cn: 请记得写信时在信封里放一个贴好邮票、写明地址的信封。

ex.en: Please enclose a stamped self-addressed envelope.
ex.cn: 请随信寄来一个贴好邮票的回信信封。

def: n.圈占,围绕,圈占地,附件

n.百科全书
na.“encyclopaedia”的变体

ex.en: The Encyclopedia is packed with clear illustrations and over 250 recipes.
ex.cn: 那本百科全书有很多清晰的插图和250多个食谱。

ex.en: The encyclopedia fell to the floor with a thud.
ex.cn: 那本百科全书砰的一声掉到地上.

ex.en: Geoff is a walking encyclopedia. He knows about everything.
ex.cn: 杰夫是个活百科全书, 他什么都懂.

def: n.百科全书，大全

ex.en: He was a walking encyclopaedia.
ex.cn: 他是一部活的百科全书。

ex.en: An encyclopaedia contains a lot of knowledge.
ex.cn: 百科全书包含很多知识.

ex.en: A splendid bookcase goes along with the complete encyclopaedia if you pay cash.
ex.cn: 如果你付现金购买全套百科全书,可免费获得一个极好的书柜.这是本哲学百科全书.

def: vt.捐赠，资助,赋予，赐予

ex.en: Herbs have been used for centuries to endow a whole range of foods with subtle flavours.
ex.cn: 数个世纪以来，香草一直被用于给各种食物增添淡淡的香味。

ex.en: Ramon had managed to endow the figurine with a primitive beauty.
ex.cn: 拉蒙已做到给予这个人像以一种原始的美.

ex.en: The polyphonic features endow Light in August with eternal vitality.
ex.cn: 复调性赋予《八月之光》不息的生命力.

def: vt.强迫服从,实施，执行,加强

ex.en: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
ex.cn: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

ex.en: The police don't make the laws, they merely enforce them.
ex.cn: 警察并不制定法律，只是负责执行。

ex.en: Desegregation may be harder to enforce in rural areas.
ex.cn: 要废除农村地区的种族隔离可能会更困难一些。

def: vt.& vi.打听，询问,查究

ex.en: Inspectors were appointed to inquire into the affairs of the company.
ex.cn: 督查员受委派调查该公司的事务。

ex.en: Elsie called to inquire after my health.
ex.cn: 埃尔茜打电话来问候我。

ex.en: You can inquire of your new neighbors where the post office is.
ex.cn: 你可以问问你的新邻居邮局在哪儿.

def: vt.想像，设想,正视，面对,观察，展望

ex.en: What level of profit do you envisage?
ex.cn: 你预计会有什么样的利润水平？

ex.en: Nobody can envisage the consequences of total nuclear war.
ex.cn: 没有人能够想像全面核战争的后果.

ex.en: When do you envisage being able to pay me back?
ex.cn: 你看你什么时候能还我钱?

def: n.纪元,时期,新时代,世

ex.en: It was meant to sound like an epoch-making declaration.
ex.cn: 有意让它听起来像是一个划时代的宣言。

ex.en: The death of the emperor marked the end of an epoch in the country's history.
ex.cn: 皇帝驾崩标志着该国历史上一个时代的结束。

ex.en: The Renaissance was an epoch of unparalleled cultural achievement.
ex.cn: 文艺复兴是一个文化上取得空前成就的时代.

def: n.方程式,等式,相等,[化学] 反应式

ex.en: The party fears the equation between higher spending and higher taxes.
ex.cn: 该党担心难以平衡更多支出和更高税率之间的综合关系。

ex.en: This figure is reached by a fiendishly clever equation.
ex.cn: 这个数字是通过一个精妙的方程式计算出来的。

ex.en: We can express that equation like that.
ex.cn: 我们可以这样表示那个等式。

def: n.腐蚀，侵蚀，磨损,烧蚀,磨蚀,糜烂

ex.en: More familiar landscapes have been sculpted by surface erosion.
ex.cn: 还有更多熟悉的地貌是因地表侵蚀形成的。

ex.en: This leaves fertile soil unprotected and prone to erosion.
ex.cn: 这会让肥沃的土壤暴露在外，使其容易受到侵蚀。

ex.en: Crop rotation helps prevent soil erosion.
ex.cn: 农作物轮作有助于防止水土流失.

def: adj.错误的,不正确的,秕谬,讹

ex.en: I thought my answer was correct, but it was erroneous.
ex.cn: 我原以为我的答案是对的, 可结果却是错的.

ex.en: The newspaper published a retraction of the erroneous report.
ex.cn: 那家报纸声明撤回那篇错误的报道.

ex.en: Proper measures were taken as soon as the erroneous ideas cropped up.
ex.cn: 错误思想一冒头,就及时采取了措施.

def:
vi.爆发,喷发,突然发生,出疹
vt.爆发

ex.en: He says it's like a volcano ready to erupt.
ex.cn: 他说这就像一座即将喷发的火山。

ex.en: The volcano could erupt at any time.
ex.cn: 这座火山随时可能爆发。

ex.en: An active volcano may erupt at any time.
ex.cn: 活火山会随时喷发。

def:
vt.使逐步升级,使逐步上升,乘自动梯上升
vi.逐步上升,（战争）逐步升级,逐步扩大,像乘自动梯上升

ex.en: Costs can escalate terrifyingly.
ex.cn: 成本的上涨速度会很惊人。

ex.en: Ground rents are likely to escalate over time.
ex.cn: 地租以后可能会逐渐上涨。

ex.en: Conditions are still very tense and the fighting could escalate at any time.
ex.cn: 局势仍然非常紧张，战斗随时可能升级。

def:
n.护送者,护航舰,陪同某人参加社交活动的人（尤指男人）,受雇陪同某人外出社交的人（尤指女人）
vt.护送，护卫

ex.en: My sister needed an escort for a company dinner.
ex.cn: 我妹妹需要一个陪她参加公司晚宴的男伴。

ex.en: He arrived with a police escort shortly before half past nine.
ex.cn: 快到9点半的时候，他在一名警察的护送下到达了。

ex.en: "He wants a police escort." — "Well, he can whistle for that."
ex.cn: “他希望有警卫护送。”——“那他是指望不上了。”

def:
vt.尊敬，敬重,认为，以为,考虑,估价
n.尊敬，尊重,意见，看法,评价,名声

ex.en: It was so humiliating, a terrible blow to my self-esteem.
ex.cn: 这件事如此丢脸，深深地挫伤了我的自尊心。

ex.en: He is held in high esteem by colleagues in the construction industry.
ex.cn: 建筑业的同行们都非常敬重他。

ex.en: He said he retained immense regard and esteem for the prime minister.
ex.cn: 他说他一直极其尊重和敬仰首相。

def:
adj.永恒的，永久的,似乎不停的，没完没了的,不朽的,永生的
n.永恒的事物,Eternal 上帝，与定冠词the 连用

ex.en: The series chronicles the everyday adventures of two eternal bachelors.
ex.cn: 这个系列剧按照时间顺序记述了两个老光棍每天的奇遇。

ex.en: In the background was that eternal hum.
ex.cn: 背景音是没完没了的嗡嗡声。

ex.en: the promise of eternal life in heaven
ex.cn: 在天国永生的许诺

def:
adj.种族的，部落的,某文化群体的
n.少数民族的成员

ex.en: They've been living and working peacefully with members of various ethnic groups.
ex.cn: 他们和不同民族的人们一起和睦地生活和工作。

ex.en: The ethnic populations are so intermingled that there's bound to be conflict.
ex.cn: 各民族人口如此杂居，肯定会发生冲突。

ex.en: There are still several million ethnic Germans in Russia.
ex.cn: 俄罗斯境内仍有数百万德国人。

def:
vt.撤离，疏散,排泄,腾出（房子等）,除清，抽空
vi.排空（胃肠）,疏散,撤退

ex.en: Army helicopters tried to evacuate the injured.
ex.cn: 军队直升机试图转移伤员。

ex.en: They agreed on how to evacuate the civilians from the island.
ex.cn: 他们就如何撤退岛上的居民取得了一致意见.

ex.en: Tell them you intend to evacuate the children.
ex.cn: 告诉他们你打算疏散儿童.

def:
vt.& vi.（使某物）蒸发掉
vi.消失,发散气体,蒸发
vt.使脱水,使蒸发,使挥发,使沉淀

ex.en: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate.
ex.cn: 向它喷射冷空气可以使水蒸发。

ex.en: Your dreams always seem to evaporate, and nothing ever quite matches expectations.
ex.cn: 你的梦想似乎总是逐渐破灭，从来没有什么事情能完全符合你的预期。

ex.en: Like many others, Handford was relieved to see the spectre of 15% interest rates evaporate by the end of the day.
ex.cn: 和其他很多人一样，当看到15%的利率的阴霾随着那天的结束而散尽时，汉德福感到一阵欣慰。

def: n.前夕，前夜,重要事件的前夕,傍晚

ex.en: Richard had turned up on Christmas Eve with Tony.
ex.cn: 理查德和托尼在圣诞夜一道露面了。

ex.en: Eve walked briskly down the corridor to her son's room.
ex.cn: 伊芙步履轻快地穿过走廊来到儿子的房间。

ex.en: "Send her away," Eve said in a cold, hard voice.
ex.cn: “把她打发走。”伊芙冷酷无情地说道。

def: vt.产生，引起,唤起

ex.en: These images are likely to evoke a strong response in the viewer.
ex.cn: 这些图像可能会在观众中产生强烈反响.

ex.en: Dickens's readers really wanted to feel the kind of bathetic sadness that he tried to evoke.
ex.cn: 狄更斯的读者非常希望感受到他试图唤起的那种虚假的悲伤。

ex.en: They evoke no ardor in the male breast.
ex.cn: 它激不起男人胸中的热情.

def:
n.摘录,引用,摘要,节录
vt.摘录,摘要,引用,节要
vi.摘录,引用

ex.en: The following excerpt is illustrative of her interaction with students.
ex.cn: 接下来的节选部分可以说明她与学生的互动情况。

ex.en: This is an excerpt from a novel.
ex.cn: 这是一部小说的摘录.

ex.en: Can you excerpt something from the newspaper?
ex.cn: 你能从报纸上选录些东西 吗 ?

def: vt.& vi.呼喊,惊叫,大声说

ex.en: The Munroe girls rushed up to exclaim over her dress.
ex.cn: 孟家的女孩子都跑过来为她的衣服喝彩.

ex.en: A closer look, you might exclaim that she is half - breed!
ex.cn: 再仔细看看, 或许你会惊叹原来她也是混血儿!

ex.en: Glory to you! We exclaim with a joyful soul.
ex.cn: 到你的光荣? 我们与欢乐的灵魂呼喊.

def: n.（尤指集体）远足,短途旅行，游览,离题,[机]冲程

ex.en: We unwisely chose not to go on a coach excursion to Trondheim.
ex.cn: 我们作出了不明智的选择，没有乘旅游大巴去特隆赫姆。

ex.en: Her husband had also been dragooned into the excursion.
ex.cn: 她的丈夫也被拉来参加远足了。

ex.en: She felt more than usually hungry after her excursion.
ex.cn: 远足后，她比平时感觉更饿。

def: vt.执行,处死，处决,履行,完成

ex.en: Make sure that you execute all movements smoothly and without jerking.
ex.cn: 一定要保证所有动作自然流畅，不要一顿一顿的。

ex.en: The Windows allows a computer user to execute multiple programs simultaneously.
ex.cn: Windows操作系统允许计算机用户同时运行多个程序.

ex.en: The Windows allow a computer user to execute multiple programs simultaneously.
ex.cn: Windows允许计算机用户同时运行多个程序.

def:
vt.使免除，豁免
adj.被免除的，被豁免的
n.被免除（义务，责任）的人,免税人

ex.en: The fund was in danger of losing its tax-exempt status.
ex.cn: 该基金面临不再享受免税待遇的风险。

ex.en: Soldiers were exempt from paying rates.
ex.cn: 士兵免缴地方税。

ex.en: Children under two years are exempt.
ex.cn: 两岁以下儿童免票。

def:
vt.放逐，流放,使背井离乡
n.流放，放逐，流亡,长期离家[出国],被流放者，背井离乡者

ex.en: Rovers lost 4-1 and began their long exile from the First Division.
ex.cn: 流浪者队以1比4落败，从此开始长期无缘甲级联赛。

ex.en: He was vilified, hounded, and forced into exile by the FBI.
ex.cn: 他遭到了联邦调查局的诬蔑和追捕，被迫流亡国外。

ex.en: During his exile, he also began writing books.
ex.cn: 在流放期间，他也开始写书。

def: n.考察，远航,考察队，远征军,（短途的）旅行,迅速（办理）

ex.en: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
ex.cn: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

ex.en: The South Pole expedition proved to be staggeringly successful.
ex.cn: 这次南极探险结果非常成功。

ex.en: He decided to postpone the expedition until the following day.
ex.cn: 他决定把探险推迟到第二天。

def: vt.驱逐,赶走,把…除名,排出（气体等）
n.花费，支出,费用，经费,（尤指金钱的）支出额,（精力、时间、材料等的）耗费

ex.en: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.
ex.cn: 他通过严格控制公共开支保持预算平衡。

ex.en: It is questionable whether the expenditure on this project is really justified.
ex.cn: 该项目的开支是否真的合理还未可知。

ex.en: Expenditure this year should be just under 15 billion pounds.
ex.cn: 今年的支出应正好低于150亿英镑。

def:
adj.实验的,根据实验的,试验性的
n.试验性的东西

ex.en: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages.
ex.cn: 但免疫疗法目前仍处于实验阶段。

ex.en: Yesterday he changed his tune, saying the fare increase was experimental.
ex.cn: 昨天他变卦了，说提价只是试行。

ex.en: They worked hard every day to keep their experimental plot up.
ex.cn: 他们天天埋头苦干,以把试验田种好.

def:
vi.爆[突]发，发怒,激增，迅速扩大
vt.（使）爆炸,突然（发出巨响，活跃起来，迸发感情）,推翻,驳倒

ex.en: Catherine was ready to explode. "I think you're contemptible!"
ex.cn: 凯瑟琳气得快要炸了。“我觉得你真是可鄙！”

ex.en: The car was juddering and vibrating as if it would explode.
ex.cn: 汽车剧烈地摇晃着、颤动着，就像要爆炸似的。

ex.en: The bomb must explode within less than a millionth of a second.
ex.cn: 炸弹必须在不到百万分之一秒的时间内爆炸。

def:
adj.精致的,细腻的,优美的,剧烈的
n.过分讲究穿戴的人

ex.en: Some of the instrumentation is exquisite, particularly for harp and flute.
ex.cn: 有些器乐段落谱写得非常优美，尤其是竖琴和长笛的部分。

ex.en: She dances with an exquisite fluidity of movement.
ex.cn: 她的舞姿细腻流畅。

ex.en: She peeled it with exquisite care.
ex.cn: 她小心翼翼地削皮。

def:
n.外部，外面，表面，外形，外观,外貌,[影视]外景，[戏，影视]户外布景
adj.外面的，外部的，外表上的，表面的

ex.en: His gruff exterior concealed one of the kindest hearts.
ex.cn: 他粗暴的外表下藏着一颗非常善良的心。

ex.en: Eventually, they had to reinforce the walls with exterior beams.
ex.cn: 最终，他们不得不通过增加外梁来对墙体进行加固。

ex.en: According to Mandy, Pat's tough exterior hides a shy and sensitive soul.
ex.cn: 据曼迪说，帕特彪悍的外表下隐藏着一颗害羞且敏感的心。

def: adj.非凡的,特别的,非常奇特的

ex.en: They testify to the extraordinary potency of his personality.
ex.cn: 这些事情证明了他非凡的人格魅力。

ex.en: She was a woman with extraordinary vibrancy and extraordinary knowledge.
ex.cn: 她是一位充满活力、博学多识的女子。

ex.en: Edwin H. Conger was envoy extraordinary and Minister Plenipotentiary.
ex.cn: 埃德温·H.康格是特命全权公使。

def: adj.过度的，过分的,奢侈的，浪费的,放肆的,大量的

ex.en: I can have a brainstorm and be very extravagant.
ex.cn: 我有时会头脑发热，挥霍无度。

ex.en: Who is footing the bill for her extravagant holiday?
ex.cn: 谁会为她奢侈的假日买单？

ex.en: The coronation was an occasion for extravagant myth and sentiment.
ex.cn: 加冕典礼是极尽奢华和怀旧的仪式。

def:
n.寓言，童话,传说,无稽之谈,人人谈论的话题
v.讲故事，编寓言,虚构，杜撰,煞有介事地讲

ex.en: The old fable continues to echo down the centuries.
ex.cn: 这则古老的寓言流传了数个世纪。

ex.en: Is reincarnation fact or fable?
ex.cn: 转世轮回是确有其事还是无稽之谈？

ex.en: a land rich in fable
ex.cn: 寓言之乡

def: adj.极好的，极妙的,（美貌）惊人的,寓言般的,难以置信的

ex.en: During each show we will be raffling a fabulous prize.
ex.cn: 每场表演期间，我们将以抽彩方法送出大奖。

ex.en: This is a fabulous album. It's fresh, varied, fun.
ex.cn: 这张专辑真棒，新颖、有趣且富于变化。

ex.en: Ordinarily it would be fun to be taken to fabulous restaurants.
ex.cn: 一般来说，跟别人去豪华餐馆吃饭会是件乐事。

def:
n.仙女,小仙子,小精灵
adj.美丽的，可爱的,仙女似的

ex.en: The story ascends from a gothic tragedy to a miraculous fairy-tale.
ex.cn: 故事从一个哥特式悲剧升华为神奇的童话。

ex.en: She was like a princess in a fairy tale.
ex.cn: 她就像童话里的公主。

ex.en: Fairy tales weren't just meant for children.
ex.cn: 童话故事不仅仅是写给孩子们的。

def:
adj.忠实的,忠诚的,正确的
n.信徒

ex.en: She insisted that she had remained faithful to her husband.
ex.cn: 她坚持说自己对丈夫一直是忠诚的。

ex.en: The Bishop directed the faithful to stay at home.
ex.cn: 主教要求信徒们呆在家中。

ex.en: Colin Welland's screenplay is faithful to the novel.
ex.cn: 科林·韦兰的电影剧本忠实于原小说。

def:
vt.伪造,篡改,对…做手脚,仿造
vt.& vi.假装
n.骗子,冒牌货，赝品,[体]假动作,冒充，诈骗
adj.假的，冒充的

ex.en: They said, after digging around, the photo was a fake.
ex.cn: 在搜集了有关情况后，他们说照片是伪造的。

ex.en: A sharp-eyed shop assistant spotted the fake.
ex.cn: 一个眼尖的售货员发现了假货。

ex.en: a fake American accent
ex.cn: 伪装的美国口音

def: n.饥荒,饥饿,极度缺乏

ex.en: The civil war is obstructing distribution of famine relief by aid agencies.
ex.cn: 内战阻碍着救援机构对饥荒赈济物资的配给。

ex.en: If there is a danger of famine, we should help.
ex.cn: 如果有可能出现饥荒，我们应该提供帮助。

ex.en: The famine turned the normal modulation of climate into disaster.
ex.cn: 正常的气候变化因饥荒而成了灾难。

def:
n.幻想,空想的产物,幻想作品,非正式的货币
vt.& vi.想像,幻想,奏幻想曲

ex.en: The film starts off realistically and then develops into a ridiculous fantasy.
ex.cn: 电影以写实开头，然后却发展成为荒诞的幻想。

ex.en: She clings to a romantic fantasy of wedded bliss.
ex.cn: 她沉醉于婚后幸福的浪漫幻想。

ex.en: She invents fantasy lives for her own vicarious pleasure.
ex.cn: 她幻想过着各种奇妙的生活，从想入非非中获得乐趣。

def:
n.告别，欢送,欢送会,告别辞
int.再见，再会,一路平安
adj.告别的，送行的

ex.en: She bade farewell to her son.
ex.cn: 她和儿子道了别。

ex.en: I bade farewell to all the friends I had made in Paris.
ex.cn: 我告别了我在巴黎结交的所有朋友。

ex.en: He bade his wife farewell and set out on his journey.
ex.cn: 他辞别了妻子便启程了.

def: n.命运,天意,命中注定的事（尤指坏事）

ex.en: They held his fate in the palms of their ancient hands.
ex.cn: 他们这些老人将他的命运掌握在手心里。

ex.en: The Casino, where she had often danced, had suffered a similar fate.
ex.cn: 她经常跳舞的赌场遭遇了相似的命运。

ex.en: By a curious twist of fate, cricket was also my favourite sport.
ex.cn: 让人感到惊奇的是，板球碰巧也是我最喜欢的运动。

def: adj.疲乏的

ex.en: Winter weather can leave you feeling fatigued and tired.
ex.cn: 冬季会让人感觉疲乏无力。

ex.en: The exercises fatigued her.
ex.cn: 操练使她感到很疲乏.

ex.en: The President smiled, with fatigued tolerance for a minor person's naivety.
ex.cn: 总统笑了笑, 疲惫地表现出对一个下级人员的天真想法的宽容.

def:
n.盛会,宴会,宗教节日,使人欢快的事物（或活动）
vi.大吃大喝，享用美食,参加宴会
vt.款待（某人），宴请（某人）

ex.en: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
ex.cn: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。

ex.en: Well we did have a midnight feast, me and my sister.
ex.cn: 我和姐姐的确在半夜大吃了一顿。

ex.en: On the following day a feast was given in King John's honour.
ex.cn: 第二天设宴款待约翰王。

def:
n.功绩，伟业,技艺表演,卓绝的手艺，技术，本领,武艺
adj.合适的,灵巧的,漂亮的，整洁的

ex.en: The feat won them a prize of £85,000.
ex.cn: 这一业绩为他们赢得了85,000英镑的奖金。

ex.en: He performed a sensational acrobatic feat.
ex.cn: 他表演了一套惊人的杂技功夫。

ex.en: The tunnel is a brilliant feat of engineering.
ex.cn: 这条隧道是工程方面的光辉业绩。

def: n.友谊，交情,会社，团体,研究员职位,学术奖金

ex.en: There was a great deal of soldierly good fellowship.
ex.cn: 这里充满了战友间才有的那种真挚友谊。

ex.en: At Merlin's instigation, Arthur founds the Fellowship of the Round Table.
ex.cn: 在梅林的建议下，亚瑟王创建了圆桌骑士团。

ex.en: He is presently the medical director for the Fellowship of World Christians.
ex.cn: 他目前是世界基督徒团契的主任医师。

def:
adj.有女性气质的,女子气的,[语]阴性的,阴柔的
n.女性,温柔的女性,[语]阴性，阴性词

ex.en: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine.
ex.cn: 在多数语言中，形容词的阳性和阴性的拼法略为不同。

ex.en: This is a smart, yet soft and feminine look.
ex.cn: 这是一张透着精明的面孔，但是线条柔和，女人味十足。

ex.en: Bead-work, applique and embroidery add a uniquely feminine touch.
ex.cn: 珠饰、嵌花和刺绣可增添一种独特的女人味。

def:
n.渡船,渡口,摆渡,用船渡运
vt.航海,渡运,（乘渡船）渡过（河等）
vi.摆渡

ex.en: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years.
ex.cn: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。

ex.en: She was going to Nanaimo to catch the ferry to the mainland.
ex.cn: 她准备去纳奈莫乘渡船回大陆。

ex.en: The ferry did not even have time to send out an SOS.
ex.cn: 渡船甚至连发出紧急呼救信号的时间都没有。

def: adj.封建的,领地的,世仇的

ex.en: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords.
ex.cn: 他天生擅长交际：他的祖先曾是封建领主。

ex.en: Feudal rulers ruled over the country several thousand years.
ex.cn: 封建统治者统治这个国家几千年.

ex.en: The feudal system lasted for two thousand years in China.
ex.cn: 封建制度在中国延续了两千年之久.

def: n.壁炉

ex.en: He had a bed and a fireplace and everything.
ex.cn: 他家里有一张床、一个壁炉及其他物品。

ex.en: I was forever dragging him away from the fireplace.
ex.cn: 我老是要把他从壁炉边拉开。

ex.en: The wall caved in to reveal a blocked-up Victorian fireplace.
ex.cn: 墙坍塌了，露出砌在里面的维多利亚时代的壁炉。

def: n.（房屋等的）固定装置,[商]定期放款，定期存款,固定在某位置的人或物,（定期定点举行的）体育活动

ex.en: The couple quickly became a fixture of society pages.
ex.cn: 夫妇俩很快便成为了报纸社交版上的常驻人物。

ex.en: The fixture ended in a goalless draw.
ex.cn: 这场比赛以零比零的平局收场。

ex.en: City won this fixture 3-0 last season.
ex.cn: 上个赛季曼城队在该项赛事中以3比0获胜。

def:
n.火焰,热情，激情,〈俚〉爱人，情人,激动
vi.燃烧，发出火焰,面红,闪光
vt.烧,激起，激怒

ex.en: Intense balls of flame rose up into the sky.
ex.cn: 炽热的火球冲上天空。

ex.en: The water was heated by a naked gas flame.
ex.cn: 水是用燃气明火加热的。

ex.en: The two sheets of flame clashed, soaring hundreds of feet high.
ex.cn: 两片火焰化作一处，腾起了几百英尺高的烈焰。

def:
n.舰队,船队,车队,港湾，小河
adj.快速的，敏捷的,转瞬即逝的
vi.疾驰,飞逝
vt.使（时间）飞逝,消磨

ex.en: A fleet of ambulances took the injured to hospital.
ex.cn: 一队救护车把伤者送往医院。

ex.en: He ordered the combined fleet to convoy troops to Naples.
ex.cn: 他命令联合舰队将军队护送到那不勒斯。

ex.en: Using an alias, he had rented a house in Fleet, Hampshire.
ex.cn: 他用化名在汉普郡的舰队街租了间房子。

def:
n.肉,肉体,果肉,皮肤
v.用肉喂养,长胖

ex.en: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
ex.cn: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

ex.en: I grab George'sarm and dig my nails into his flesh.
ex.cn: 我抓住乔治的胳膊，指甲抠进了他的肉里。

ex.en: There may even be some wire or nylon biting into the flesh.
ex.cn: 甚至可能有一些金属丝或者尼龙线勒到肉里。

def:
vt.（尤指生气地）猛扔,急派,放肆地投入,扔在一边，抛弃
vt.& vi.猛扑,猛冲,急伸
n.投掷,〈美俚〉尝试,恣意，一时的放纵

ex.en: She claims she had a brief fling with him 30 years ago.
ex.cn: 她声称在30年前曾和他有过一段短暂的风流韵事。

ex.en: I can fling off a poem in half an hour.
ex.cn: 我用半小时就可以作一首诗.

ex.en: It's good to fling off heavy clothing now that spring is here.
ex.cn: 春天到了,脱去笨重的冬装真让人高兴.

def:
n.面粉
vt.撒上粉

ex.en: Just how much kneading is required depends on the sort of flour.
ex.cn: 需要揉多久取决于用哪种面。

ex.en: Sift the flour and baking powder into a medium-sized mixing bowl.
ex.cn: 将面粉和发酵粉筛入中等大小的搅拌碗中。

ex.en: Shake off any excess flour before putting livers in the pan.
ex.cn: 将多余的面粉抖落干净，再把肝脏放进锅中。

def: adj.流畅的,流利的,液态的

ex.en: He is a fluent speaker of Hebrew.
ex.cn: 他说一口流利的希伯来语。

ex.en: She's fluent in French and German. She also speaks a little Italian.
ex.cn: 她的法语和德语讲得流利，也会说一点意大利语。

ex.en: She's fluent in Polish.
ex.cn: 她的波兰语很流利。

def:
n.液体，流体
adj.流体的，流动的，流体的，液体的,易变的，不固定的,（动作、设计、音乐等）流畅优美的

ex.en: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.
ex.cn: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。

ex.en: The fluid can be drawn off with a syringe.
ex.cn: 可用注射器将液体汲出。

ex.en: The forehand stroke should be fluid and well balanced.
ex.cn: 正手击球应该保证动作流畅和平稳。

def:
vi.起泡沫,吐白沫
n.泡沫,泡沫材料，泡沫状物
vt.使起泡沫,使成泡沫状物

ex.en: We had given him a large foam mattress to sleep on.
ex.cn: 我们给了他一张大海绵床垫用来睡觉。

ex.en: Bring a sleeping bag and foam mat.
ex.cn: 带上睡袋和泡沫垫。

ex.en: a glass of beer with a good head of foam
ex.cn: 上面有厚厚一层泡沫的一杯啤酒

def: n.脚步（声）,足迹

ex.en: A footstep in the snow. Madame Defarge.
ex.cn: 雪地里有脚步声, 是德伐日太太.

ex.en: Ruth listened and started nervously at every passing footstep.
ex.cn: 露丝谛听着,每次有脚步声过去她就心惊肉跳.

ex.en: I listened for a footstep.
ex.cn: 我留心听着脚步声.

def: n.额,前部

ex.en: She has a poor complexion and pock marks on her forehead.
ex.cn: 她满面菜色，额头上有些麻子。

ex.en: She dabbed iodine on the cuts on her forehead.
ex.cn: 她把碘酒轻搽在前额的伤口上。

ex.en: A curl of black hair fell loosely across his forehead.
ex.cn: 他的额头上垂着一绺散开的黑色卷发。

def:
n.（出版物的）版式,[自]（数据安排的）形式,电视节目的总安排（或计划）
vt.使格式化,安排…的格局,设计…的版面
vi.设计一个版式

ex.en: A new format would alienate its ageing readership without attracting young readers.
ex.cn: 新的版式会疏远上了年纪的读者群，并且也不会吸引年轻读者。

ex.en: The leaflet is in PDF format.
ex.cn: 宣传折页是PDF格式的。

ex.en: The format of the new quiz show has proved popular.
ex.cn: 新的智力竞赛节目的总体安排结果证明很受欢迎。

def: adj.可怕的,令人敬畏的,难以对付的

ex.en: They possess a formidable arsenal of rifles, machine guns, landmines and teargas.
ex.cn: 他们持有的步枪、机枪、地雷和催泪弹数量惊人。

ex.en: Marsalis has a formidable reputation in both jazz and classical music.
ex.cn: 马萨利斯在爵士乐和古典音乐领域都有极高的声望。

ex.en: He remained a formidable opponent.
ex.cn: 他依然是一个令人敬畏的对手。

def: n.公式，准则,客套话,方案,婴儿食品

ex.en: There is no magic formula for producing winning products.
ex.cn: 获奖电影的制作没有捷径可取。

ex.en: The foreign ministers have thrashed out a suitable compromise formula.
ex.cn: 外交部长们经过反复讨论，已经制订出合适的折中方案。

ex.en: They have thrashed out a compromise formula acceptable to Moscow.
ex.cn: 他们经过讨论达成了一项莫斯科可以接受的折中方案。

def: n.两星期，十四天

ex.en: in a fortnight's time
ex.cn: 在两周的时间内

ex.en: You need a break. Why not take a fortnight off from work?
ex.cn: 你需要休息, 为什么不休假两周 呢 ?

ex.en: I really feel in the pink after a fortnight's holiday.
ex.cn: 度了两星期假后,我的确感到身体非常舒适.

def:
n.化石,僵化的事物,老顽固，食古不化的人,习语中保存的旧词
adj.化石的,陈腐的，守旧的

ex.en: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
ex.cn: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

ex.en: Peter Forey is curator of fossil fishes at the Natural History Museum.
ex.cn: 彼得·福雷是自然历史博物馆鱼类化石展厅的负责人。

ex.en: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
ex.cn: 电力工业消耗大量的矿物燃料。

def:
v.培养,抚育,促进,代养
adj.寄养的,代养的

ex.en: The children were waiting for placement in a foster care home.
ex.cn: 这些孩子在抚育院等待安置。

ex.en: They suspected that Neville had traded secret information with Mr Foster.
ex.cn: 他们怀疑内维尔和福斯特先生交换了秘密情报。

ex.en: Mason was uninhibited in his questions about Foster's family.
ex.cn: 梅森就福斯特的家庭毫无顾忌地发问。

def:
adj.[体]违反规则的，犯规的,邪恶的,难闻的，有恶臭的,下流的
vt.& vi.纠缠，纠结,[体]违反规则的
vt.弄脏，使污秽,使纠缠,使阻塞
vi.腐烂,缠结
n.犯规,缠结,碰撞
adv.不正当地，犯规地,碰撞地,争执不和地

ex.en: A series of technical foul-ups delayed the launch of the new product.
ex.cn: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。

ex.en: Collins was in a foul mood even before the interviews began.
ex.cn: 柯林斯在采访还没开始时就暴躁不安起来。

ex.en: One of the judges thought it was a foul throw.
ex.cn: 有个裁判认为投球犯规.

def:
vt.& vi.（使）折断，破碎
n.破裂，断裂,骨折

ex.en: He suffered a hairline fracture of the right index finger.
ex.cn: 他右手食指骨裂。

ex.en: A doctor can reduce a fracture or dislocation.
ex.cn: 医生能使骨折或脱臼复位.

ex.en: Earthquakes happen when stresses in rock are suddenly released as the rocks fracture.
ex.cn: 当岩石碎裂时其承受的压力突然释放出来，地震就发生了。

def: adj.芳香的，香的,愉快的,喷香,芳菲

ex.en: It leaves your hair smelling deliciously fresh and fragrant.
ex.cn: 它会让头发闻起来清新、芳香，令人愉悦。

ex.en: Champenois wines can be particularly fragrant and perfumed.
ex.cn: 香槟酒的香味会特别浓郁。

ex.en: The air was fragrant with scents from the sea and the hills.
ex.cn: 空气中荡漾着山和海的芬芳气息。

def: n.欺诈,骗子,伪劣品,冒牌货

ex.en: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
ex.cn: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

ex.en: Her assistant was accused of theft and fraud by the police.
ex.cn: 她的助手被警方指控犯有盗窃和欺诈罪。

ex.en: No one article can ever do justice to the topic of fraud.
ex.cn: 没有哪一篇文章能把欺诈这一话题讲得恰到好处。

def: n.电冰箱,冷冻机

ex.en: The fridge door was open and food was scattered across the floor.
ex.cn: 冰箱门开着，食物散落在地板上。

ex.en: Keep what's left in a covered container in the fridge.
ex.cn: 把剩下的食物装入带盖的容器，放进冰箱。

ex.en: Defrost the fridge regularly so that it works at maximum efficiency.
ex.cn: 定期给冰箱除霜，以便它能发挥其最高效率。

def:
n.穗,边缘,刘海,次要
vt.作为…的边缘，围绕着,给…加穗饰
adj.边缘的，外围的,次要的，附加的

ex.en: The Front has often been dismissed as a cranky fringe group.
ex.cn: 艺术家联盟常被认为是一个古怪的边缘组织。

ex.en: The monarchists are a small fringe group who quarrel fiercely among themselves.
ex.cn: 君主主义者是一个内部争吵激烈的非主流的小团体。

ex.en: I also let my hair go darker and grew out my fringe.
ex.cn: 我还把头发颜色染深，并让刘海儿长长消失。

def: n.青蛙,〈侮辱〉青蛙佬，对法国人的蔑称,[交]铁路辙叉,饰扣，挂环

ex.en: They arrested the men and frog-marched them to the local police station.
ex.cn: 他们逮捕了这些人，并把他们押送到当地警察局。

ex.en: He was frog-marched through the kitchen and out into the yard.
ex.cn: 他被扭住双臂强推着走过厨房，来到院子里。

ex.en: A prince turns into a frog in this cartoon fairytale.
ex.cn: 在这个卡通童话里王子变成了一只青蛙。

def:
n.鱼苗，鱼秧,弗赖伊（姓氏）,油炸食物,（口语）烦恼，愤激
vi.用油煎,用油炸烤炒,油炸
vt.油炸,油煎,（美俚）使被处电刑,瓦解

ex.en: Fry remaining peppers, adding a little more dressing if necessary.
ex.cn: 用油炸一下剩下的辣椒，如果需要再加点调味汁。

ex.en: Fry for about 4 minutes, until the onion has softened.
ex.cn: 煎4分钟左右，直到洋葱变软。

ex.en: Drop the slices into the oil and fry until golden brown.
ex.cn: 将切片倒进油里，煎至金棕色。

def:
n.葬礼，丧礼,〈比喻〉不愉快的事，操心的事，有关系的事
adj.葬礼的,出殡用的，出殡时的

ex.en: Most of those attending the funeral stood silently showing little emotion.
ex.cn: 出席葬礼的人大多都面无表情地静静站着。

ex.en: I felt I ought to show my face at her father's funeral.
ex.cn: 我觉得我应该去参加她父亲的葬礼。

ex.en: None of my business, I guess. It's your funeral.
ex.cn: 我想是不关我什么事儿，你就自寻死路吧。

def:
n.忙乱,大惊小怪,大惊小怪的人,争吵
vi.忙乱,大惊小怪,抱怨
vt.使烦恼，使烦忧,使急躁
vt.& vi.瞎忙一气，过分关心

ex.en: Auntie Hilda and Uncle Jack couldn't fuss over them enough.
ex.cn: 希尔达姨妈和杰克姨父对他们宠爱有加。

ex.en: He accused me of making a great fuss about trivialities.
ex.cn: 他指责我为丁点琐事大惊小怪。

ex.en: Those customers who have kicked up a fuss have received refunds.
ex.cn: 那些大吵大闹的顾客得到了退款。

def: adj.无效的，无用的,没有出息的,琐碎的，无关紧要的,一场空

ex.en: They were killed, to the last man, in a futile attack.
ex.cn: 因为进攻失败,他们全部被杀, 无一幸免.

ex.en: Without microscopes and other modern equipment, attempts to teach science were futile.
ex.cn: 没有显微镜及其他现代化的设备, 想教授自然科学是不会有成果的.

ex.en: Their efforts to revive him were futile.
ex.cn: 他们对他抢救无效.

def:
n.厚度,直径,测量仪表,规格
vt.计量,度量,估计,判断

ex.en: Can you gage what her reaction is likely to be?
ex.cn: 你能揣测她的反应可能是什么吗？

ex.en: It's difficult to gage one's character.
ex.cn: 要判断一个人的品格是很困难的。

ex.en: The strain gage based on mechanical principles is the scratch gage.
ex.cn: 以机械原理为基础的应变计是刻痕应变计.

def:
n.测量的标准或范围,尺度，标准,测量仪器,评估
vt.（用仪器）测量,确定容量，体积或内容,评估，判断,采用

ex.en: The index is the government's chief gauge of future economic activity.
ex.cn: 这一指数是政府判断未来经济活动的主要依据。

ex.en: "The fuel gauge is broken." — "Broken? How do you mean?"
ex.cn: “燃油表坏了。”——“坏了？你说清楚点？”

ex.en: The fuel gauge reads below zero.
ex.cn: 燃油表显示油量在零以下。

def: n.加仑（容量单位）

ex.en: The price of petrol is coming down by four pence a gallon.
ex.cn: 汽油的价格每加仑降了4便士。

ex.en: Unleaded gasoline rose more than a penny a gallon.
ex.cn: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

ex.en: a five-gallon jug of beer
ex.cn: 五加仑装的啤酒罐

def:
n.（马等）疾驰，飞奔,（比喻）飞快
vt.& vi.（使马）飞驰,飞速传递
vi.快速做[说]某事

ex.en: I read the book at a gallop.
ex.cn: 我飞快地读完了这本书。

ex.en: I was forced to attempt a gallop.
ex.cn: 我被迫试着骑马飞奔。

ex.en: He saddled his horse, mounted, and rode away at a gallop.
ex.cn: 他给马套上鞍子, 跨上马背疾驰而去.

def:
n.帮派，团体,盗贼等的)一帮,（工具，机械等的）一套,〈美俚〉棒球队
vt.使结成一帮,成群地袭击
vi.结伙行动

ex.en: Come on over, we've got lots of the old gang here.
ex.cn: 过来吧，好多老朋友都在这儿。

ex.en: His family was subjected to a hideous attack by the gang.
ex.cn: 他的家人遭到了匪帮的恐怖袭击。

ex.en: There are problems of urban decay and gang violence.
ex.cn: 存在城市衰败和帮派暴力的问题。

def:
n.监狱，拘留所
vt.监禁

ex.en: He could wind up in gaol.
ex.cn: 他可能最后会进监狱。

ex.en: He was released from the gaol.
ex.cn: 他被释放出狱.

ex.en: You'll go to gaol if you touch the money.
ex.cn: 如果你碰这钱,你就会去坐牢.

def:
n.监狱,拘留所
vt.监禁,拘留

ex.en: Last night he was being held in solitary confinement in Douglas jail.
ex.cn: 昨晚他被单独监禁在道格拉斯的监狱里。

ex.en: He's probably going to finish up in jail for business fraud.
ex.cn: 他最后很可能会因为商业诈骗而入狱。

ex.en: In the end the "bad guys" are caught and sent to jail.
ex.cn: 最后，“坏人”都被抓住送进了监狱。

def: n.大蒜,蒜头

ex.en: Boil the chick peas, add garlic and lemon juice.
ex.cn: 把鹰嘴豆放在开水中煮，并加入大蒜和柠檬汁。

ex.en: Cook pieces of succulent chicken with ample garlic and a little sherry.
ex.cn: 烹饪鲜美滑嫩的鸡肉时多加些大蒜，并滴入少许雪利酒。

ex.en: I've not been sparing with the garlic.
ex.cn: 我总是用很多大蒜。

def: n.汽油

ex.en: Unleaded gasoline rose more than a penny a gallon.
ex.cn: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

ex.en: Certain truck gasoline tanks can rupture and burn in a collision.
ex.cn: 某些卡车的油箱在碰撞时可能发生爆裂并起火。

ex.en: What happens when food and gasoline supplies run low?
ex.cn: 如果食物和汽油供应减少，会出现什么情况呢？

def: n.汽油，挥发油

ex.en: A whole tankful of gasolene dropped away because of the tiny leak.
ex.cn: 由于这个小小的漏洞,整整一油箱的汽油都漏光了.

ex.en: A car is useless without gasolene.
ex.cn: 汽车没有汽油便无用.

def:
vi.喘气，喘息,倒抽气,渴望
vt.喘着气说出
n.喘气，喘息

ex.en: I heard myself gasp and cry out.
ex.cn: 我听到自己一边喘一边喊。

ex.en: She shrank back with an involuntary gasp.
ex.cn: 她不由得倒抽了口冷气，往后退了退。

ex.en: He snatched a last gasp winner.
ex.cn: 他在最后关头一举夺冠。

def:
vi.凝视，注视
n.凝视，端详

ex.en: Gail was silent for a moment, regarding Harry with his steady gaze.
ex.cn: 盖尔镇定地注视着哈里，沉默了片刻。

ex.en: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze.
ex.cn: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下，我感到极不自在。

ex.en: The interior was shielded from the curious gaze of passersby.
ex.cn: 屋子内部被挡住了，以防路人好奇地张望。

def:
vt.& vi.概括，归纳,推广，普及,使一般化,形成概念
vt.推广，普及,使一般化,概括
vi.形成概念

ex.en: It would be foolish to generalize from a single example.
ex.cn: 仅从一个事例进行归纳的做法是愚蠢的。

ex.en: When we use " he " , we generalize for both sex.
ex.cn: 当我们用 he 时, 我们泛指男女.

ex.en: It's impossible to generalize about children's books, as they are all different.
ex.cn: 儿童读物五花八门, 不可能一概而论.

def:
vt.& vi.概括，归纳，推论
vt.推广，普及

ex.en: It is customary for the teacher to provide grammar notes to help the student generalise what he has learned.
ex.cn: 教师经常给学生提供语法注释,帮助他归纳所学到的东西.

ex.en: Confidence regions generalise the confidence interval concept to deal with multiple quantities.
ex.cn: 置信区域产生了置信区间这个概念以处理各种不同的数量.

def: n.发电机，发生器,电力公司,生产者，创始者,[乐]基础低音

ex.en: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
ex.cn: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

ex.en: They have a generator when the electricity fails.
ex.cn: 他们有一台发电机，以备停电时所需。

ex.en: This is an alternating current generator.
ex.cn: 这是一台交流发电机.

def: n.[生]幼芽，胚芽,微生物,起源，萌芽

ex.en: The germ of an idea took root in Rosemary's mind.
ex.cn: 罗斯玛丽心里萌生了一个念头。

ex.en: This germ is found on things used by the patients.
ex.cn: 这种细菌附着在病人使用过的东西上.

ex.en: I have the germ of an idea.
ex.cn: 我有一个初步的想法.

def:
n.手势，姿势,举止，动作,〔古语〕仪态,[计算机]光笔指令
vt.做手势
vi.用手势表现，表达或指导

ex.en: Their handshake appeared to be a gesture of reconciliation.
ex.cn: 他们的握手似乎是和解的表示。

ex.en: He put his hand under her chin in an almost paternal gesture.
ex.cn: 他以近乎父亲的姿态用手托着她的下巴。

ex.en: She bowed her head in a gesture somehow reminiscent of royalty.
ex.cn: 她低头的姿势让人想起皇室风范。

def:
n.咯咯的笑,傻笑,<英·非正>玩笑,the giggles 止不住的格格笑
vi.咯咯地笑,傻笑,娇笑一下,情不自禁地笑出声来

ex.en: I might buy one for a friend's birthday as a giggle.
ex.cn: 我可能会买一件送给朋友当生日礼物，逗他开心。

ex.en: His hand shot to his mouth to stifle a giggle.
ex.cn: 他赶紧捂住嘴，不让自己笑出声来。

ex.en: I desperately fought the urge to giggle.
ex.cn: 我拼命地想忍住笑。

def:
n.魅力,诱惑力,魔力,迷人的美
v.迷惑,迷住

ex.en: "Basic Instinct" catapulted her to top status among Hollywood's glamour goddesses.
ex.cn: 《本能》使她跃至一线，成功跻身好莱坞耀眼的女明星之列。

ex.en: She is a perfect incarnation of glamour.
ex.cn: 她是魅力的完美化身。

ex.en: hopeful young actors and actresses dazzled by the glamour of Hollywood
ex.cn: 为好莱坞的魅力神魂颠倒、怀抱希望的年轻演员

def:
vt.& vi.怒目而视
vi.发强光
n.强光,怒视,瞪眼,炫耀

ex.en: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
ex.cn: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

ex.en: She attacked police in the full glare of TV cameras.
ex.cn: 她在电视摄像机的镜头聚焦下公然袭击了警察。

ex.en: The Duchess's glare was glacial.
ex.cn: 公爵夫人冷漠地看着。

def:
n.滑行，滑翔,[乐]滑音，延音,流逝，消逝,静悄悄的流水
vt.（鸟或飞机）滑翔，滑动,掠过,悄悄地走,消逝
vi.使滑行,使滑动

ex.en: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
ex.cn: 侍者们端着一盘盘意大利面在拥挤的餐桌之间自如穿行。

ex.en: We stood in silence watching the snake glide effortlessly.
ex.cn: 我们噤若寒蝉地站着,眼看那条蛇逍遥自在地游来游去.

ex.en: So graceful was the ballerina that she just seemed to glide.
ex.cn: 那芭蕾舞女演员翩跹起舞,宛如滑翔.

def: adj.辉煌的,荣誉的,极好的,<口>非常愉快的

ex.en: We opened the windows and let in the glorious evening air.
ex.cn: 我们打开窗户，让傍晚那沁人心脾的空气流进室内。

ex.en: The win revived glorious memories of his championship-winning days.
ex.cn: 这次胜利勾起了他对往昔那些夺冠岁月的美好回忆。

ex.en: What price a glorious repeat of last week's triumph?
ex.cn: 还有可能再次上演上周的辉煌胜利吗？

def:
vt.胶合,紧附于
n.胶水,胶粘物,粘聚力

ex.en: Stick them on using a small amount of glue.
ex.cn: 用少许胶水把它们贴上。

ex.en: The smell of sawdust and glue pervaded the factory.
ex.cn: 工厂里弥漫着锯屑和胶水的气味。

ex.en: Glue the mirror in with a strong adhesive.
ex.cn: 用强力胶将镜子固定到位。

def: adj.华丽的，艳丽的,极好的，称心的,美丽动人的，光彩夺目的,令人愉快的，令人享受的

ex.en: The cosmetics industry uses gorgeous women to sell its skincare products.
ex.cn: 化妆品行业常找一些性感美女来推销护肤产品。

ex.en: "Hey, you're gorgeous," he slurred.
ex.cn: “嗨，你真漂亮，”他含混地说。

ex.en: There were many gorgeous females busy browning themselves.
ex.cn: 有许多漂亮的女性忙着晒黑自己。

def:
n.流言蜚语，谣言,爱讲闲话的人,谈话，闲话,关系亲密的伙伴
vi.传播流言，说长道短

ex.en: It provided some juicy gossip for a few days.
ex.cn: 这制造了一些非常八卦的流言蜚语，足够说上几天的。

ex.en: We read the gossip written about them with prurient interest.
ex.cn: 我们翻看他们的八卦时带着不洁的想法。

ex.en: The jet-setting couple made frequent appearances in the gossip columns.
ex.cn: 这对穿梭于各国的富豪夫妇经常出现在八卦专栏。

def:
n.长袍，长外衣,女长服,罩袍,大学的学生和教师
vt.&vi.穿长袍

ex.en: She crept from the bed and fumbled for her dressing gown.
ex.cn: 她从床上蹑手蹑脚地爬起来，摸索着自己的晨衣。

ex.en: I was shoehorning myself into my skin-tight ball gown.
ex.cn: 我正拼命把自己塞进我的紧身晚礼服里。

ex.en: Wood was now comfortably enfolded in a woolly dressing-gown.
ex.cn: 伍德正舒服地穿着件羊毛晨衣。

def:
n.恩泽,优雅,慈悲,魅力
v.使优美,惠赐

ex.en: Grace tapped on the bedroom door and went in.
ex.cn: 格雷丝轻轻敲了敲卧室的门，走了进去。

ex.en: Grace laid out the knives and forks at the lunch-table.
ex.cn: 格雷丝把刀叉摆放在午餐桌上。

ex.en: Grace allowed her mind to wander to other things.
ex.cn: 格雷丝任由自己的思绪游走。

def: adj.优美的，优雅的,雅致的，美好的,得体的,飘逸

ex.en: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.
ex.cn: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。

ex.en: Aubrey could think of no graceful way to escape Corbet's company.
ex.cn: 奥布里想不出有什么得体的办法能摆脱科比特。

ex.en: He was charming, cheerful, and graceful under pressure.
ex.cn: 他在重压之下依然开朗迷人，风度优雅。

def: n.绿豆,鹰嘴豆,绿豆种子,克

ex.en: A few twentieths of a gram can be critical.
ex.cn: 即使重量仅有1克的二十分之几都可能是关键性的。

ex.en: A Chinese speech recognition method based on character - based N - gram model is proposed in this thesis.
ex.cn: 本文提出了基于字的N -gram 模型(characterbasedN -gram model) 的汉语语音识别方法,推导了模型参数的估值公式,并给出了模型的训练和识别算法.

ex.en: Gram laughed at the judge. That counted against him.
ex.cn: 克拉姆嘲笑法官, 那是对他不利的.

def: n.克

ex.en: The pro-gramme's researchers are guilty of bias and misrepresentation.
ex.cn: 该项目的研究者们对心存偏见和误解感到非常内疚。

ex.en: Sarita Sabharwal compered the pro-gramme.
ex.cn: 萨里塔·萨巴瓦尔主持了这个节目。

ex.en: So how did we end up at $10 a gramme?
ex.cn: 那么我们为什么能拿到每克10美元的价格呢？

def: adj.图解的，用图表示的,用文字表示的,形象的，生动的

ex.en: She asked her son, a graphic designer, to create letterheads and stationery.
ex.cn: 她请做平面设计师的儿子设计了信头和信笺。

ex.en: The book gave a graphic description of the war.
ex.cn: 这本书生动地描述了战争的情况.

ex.en: The Agriculture Department today released a new graphic to replace the old symbol.
ex.cn: 农业部今天发布了一个新图标以取代旧标志。

def:
vt.&vi.放牧,（让动物）吃草,轻擦，擦破
vt.擦过，掠过
n.放牧,擦伤

ex.en: Five cows graze serenely around a massive oak.
ex.cn: 5头奶牛在一棵大橡树旁悠闲自在地啃着青草。

ex.en: Nothing serious. Just a graze.
ex.cn: 没关系, 就破了一点皮.

ex.en: There is good grassland here for your cattle and horses to graze on.
ex.cn: 这里有很好的草地供你们放牧牛马.

def:
n.动物油脂,油膏，润滑油,〈俚〉贿赂
vt.涂油脂于，用油脂润滑,贿赂

ex.en: Grease 6 ramekin dishes of 150 ml (5-6 fl oz) capacity.
ex.cn: 将6个容量为150毫升（5至6液盎司）的烤盘涂上油。

ex.en: Grease two sturdy baking sheets and heat the oven to 400 degrees.
ex.cn: 在两块结实的烤板上抹些油，把烤炉加热到400度。

ex.en: The floor was covered in grease and filth.
ex.cn: 地板上满是油垢和污物。

def: n.悲伤,悲痛,悲伤的事

ex.en: "He's been arrested for theft and burglary." — "Good grief!"
ex.cn: “他因为偷窃和入室盗窃而被逮捕了。”——“我的天哪！”

ex.en: There was no grief in his expression, only deep resignation.
ex.cn: 他的表情里没有悲痛，只有深深的无奈。

ex.en: We all felt as if we were intruding on his private grief.
ex.cn: 我们都觉得似乎触及到了他内心的伤痛。

def:
vt.使伤心,使悲伤
vi.伤心,悲伤

ex.en: I didn't have any time to grieve.
ex.cn: 我没有时间伤心。

ex.en: What the eye does not see, the heart does not grieve over.
ex.cn: 眼不见, 心不烦.

ex.en: Be sure and not grieve.
ex.cn: 一定不要伤心.

def: adj.冷酷的，残忍的,严厉的,阴冷的,可怕的，讨厌的

ex.en: Psychometric tests can save organizations from grim and costly mistakes.
ex.cn: 心理测试能够使组织机构避免犯下损失惨重的大错。

ex.en: She was a grim woman with a turned-down mouth.
ex.cn: 她是个沉默寡言、令人畏惧的女人。

ex.en: The report paints a grim picture of life there.
ex.cn: 那则报道把那里的生活描绘得很凄惨。

def:
vi.露齿而笑
vt.露齿笑着表示
n.咧嘴笑，露齿而笑

ex.en: All at once, Mick's serious expression softened into a grin.
ex.cn: 米克严肃的表情一下子变成了笑脸。

ex.en: He had a grin on his face like a Cheshire Cat.
ex.cn: 他咧着嘴笑呵呵的。

ex.en: Bobby looked at her with a sheepish grin.
ex.cn: 博比望着她腼腆地咧嘴一笑。

def:
vt.& vi.磨碎，嚼碎,折磨
vt.磨快，磨光,咬牙
vi.嘎吱嘎吱地擦
n.碾，磨,苦差事，苦活儿,〈美〉刻苦用功的学生,研细的程度

ex.en: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service.
ex.cn: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

ex.en: There are people who want to humiliate you and grind you down.
ex.cn: 有一些人会想要让你难堪，欺负你。

ex.en: Life continues to be a terrible grind for the ordinary person.
ex.cn: 生活对于平头百姓而言依然是理不清的琐事。

def: n.食品商,杂货商

ex.en: Go down to the grocer's and get some sugar.
ex.cn: 去杂货店给我买点糖来.

ex.en: A grocer used to need to know how to blend tea.
ex.cn: 杂货商以往都必须知道如何混合茶叶.

ex.en: Send round to the grocer's for a tin of biscuits.
ex.cn: 叫人到食品店去买一听饼干.

def:
vi.触摸，试探着前进,探索，摸索
vt.摸索（路）,<俚>抚摸身体
n.摸索，探索

ex.en: He would try to grope her breasts and put his hand up her skirt.
ex.cn: 他会试图摸她的胸部，还把手从她的裙子上向上移。

ex.en: She even boasted of having a grope in a cupboard with a 13-year-old.
ex.cn: 她甚至吹嘘曾和一个13岁的男孩在衣橱里有过肌肤之亲。

ex.en: The great Greek grope growers grow great Greek grapes.
ex.cn: 这个伟大的希腊葡萄种植者种植了伟大的希腊葡萄.

def:
n.海湾,分歧,波斯湾,（地面的）裂口
vt.吞没,卷进

ex.en: These issues were brought into sharp focus by the Gulf crisis.
ex.cn: 海湾危机让这些问题备受关注。

ex.en: Hurricane Andrew was last night heading into the Gulf of Mexico.
ex.cn: 昨晚，飓风“安德鲁”进入了墨西哥湾。

ex.en: The Gulf has 65 per cent of the world's oil reserves.
ex.cn: 海湾地区拥有全世界65％的石油储藏。

def:
n.勇气,内脏,直觉,肠
adj.本能的，直觉的
vt.毁坏（建筑物等）的内部,取出…的内脏

ex.en: "Is it right she belted old George in the gut?" she asked.
ex.cn: “她真的把老乔治痛打了一顿？”她问。

ex.en: Let's have your gut reaction to the facts as we know them.
ex.cn: 请告诉我们你对我们所了解的这些事实的本能反应。

ex.en: His gut sagged out over his belt.
ex.cn: 他肚子上的赘肉堆在皮带上方。

def: n.健身房，体育馆,大学预科，高级中学

ex.en: Our school has a big gymnasium.
ex.cn: 我们学校有座大型体育馆.

ex.en: The game will be staged in the gymnasium.
ex.cn: 竞赛将在体育馆举行.

ex.en: The basketball nets hung down from the ceiling at either end of the gymnasium.
ex.cn: 篮筐分别从体育馆两头的天花板上悬吊下来。

def: n.<非正>健身房,体育馆,室内健身操,体操

ex.en: The gym can be used by both able-bodied and disabled people.
ex.cn: 这家健身房健全和残障人士都可使用。

ex.en: While the lads are golfing, I work out in the gym.
ex.cn: 小伙子们打高尔夫球的时候，我在健身房锻炼。

ex.en: The gym teachers lined us up against the cement walls.
ex.cn: 体育老师让我们靠着水泥墙排好。

def: n.（动物的）栖息地，住处,产地,经常发现某种事物的地方

ex.en: In its natural habitat, the hibiscus will grow up to 25ft.
ex.cn: 在原生境中，木槿能长到25英尺高。

ex.en: Few countries have as rich a diversity of habitat as South Africa.
ex.cn: 几乎没有哪个国家像南非那样拥有如此多样化的动植物栖生地。

ex.en: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
ex.cn: 大熊猫的天然栖息地是竹林。

def:
n.停止，中止,暂停,小火车站
vt.使停止,使中断,阻止,使立定
vi.停止，立定,犹豫

ex.en: The elevator creaked to a halt at the ground floor.
ex.cn: 电梯嘎吱一声停在了一层。

ex.en: He criticised the government for failing to halt economic decline.
ex.cn: 他批评政府未能遏止经济下滑。

ex.en: Operating systems can be brought to a halt by a Trojan Horse.
ex.cn: 操作系统可能会因为木马病毒的攻击而中止。

def: n.汉堡包,碎牛肉,牛肉饼

ex.en: Avoid unhealthy foods such as hamburger and chips.
ex.cn: 不要吃不健康食品，如汉堡和薯条。

ex.en: We stopped at a drive-in for a hamburger.
ex.cn: 我们在一家“免下车”餐馆停下来吃汉堡包。

ex.en: a hamburger with all the fixings
ex.cn: 有各种配料的汉堡包

def:
n.铁锤，榔头,链球,（拍卖时用的）木槌,音槌
vt.& vi.锤打,反复敲打，连续击打（尤指发出大声）
vt.击败,猛踢,猛击,轻易打败（对方）

ex.en: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole.
ex.cn: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。

ex.en: Hammer's business pedigree almost gua-ranteed him the acquaintance of U.S. presidents.
ex.cn: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他能够结识美国总统。

ex.en: She swung the hammer at his head with all her might.
ex.cn: 她使出全身力气抡起榔头砸向他的脑袋。

def: n.手册,指南

ex.en: This material has been extracted from "Collins Good Wood Handbook".
ex.cn: 这些材料摘自《柯林斯优秀木材手册》。

ex.en: The Association gives a free handbook to all new members.
ex.cn: 协会给新成员人手一本免费手册。

ex.en: Her mother bought a handbook of English grammar for her last Sunday.
ex.cn: 上星期天她母亲给她买了一本英语语法手册.

def: adj.方便的,手边的，附近的,便于使用的,手巧的

ex.en: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
ex.cn: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

ex.en: The lotion is dispensed by a handy pump action spray.
ex.cn: 洗液由一个使用方便的按压式皂液器提供。

ex.en: To make it easier to contact us, keep this card handy.
ex.cn: 把这张卡放在手边，以便于和我们联系。

def: n.骚扰，扰乱,折磨人的东西,烦恼，忧虑,袭扰

ex.en: They have a policy of zero tolerance for sexual harassment.
ex.cn: 他们对性骚扰采取绝不容忍的政策。

ex.en: The Chief Constable said that sexual harassment was deplorable.
ex.cn: 郡警察局长说性骚扰应受谴责。

ex.en: Sexual harassment, that's against the law. Something should be done about it.
ex.cn: 性骚扰是违法的，应该对此采取一些措施。

def:
vt.使硬化,使经得起考验,使无情,使轮廓鲜明
vi.变硬或更硬,变稳定,变习惯

ex.en: Give the cardboard two or three coats of varnish to harden it.
ex.cn: 在纸板上涂两三层清漆使其变硬。

ex.en: Their action can only serve to harden the attitude of landowners.
ex.cn: 他们的行动只会让土地拥有者的态度变得更坚定。

ex.en: The varnish takes a few hours to harden.
ex.cn: 清漆需要几个小时才能干透。

def:
vt.& vi.孵化,孵出，破壳而出
vt.秘密策划，（尤指）密谋,使（小鸟、小鱼、小虫等）孵出
n.（船甲板或飞机底部装货物的）舱口,开口,（飞机或宇宙飞船的）舱门,（尤指厨房和餐厅之间供传递食物的）两室之间的小窗口

ex.en: As soon as the two chicks hatch, they leave the nest burrow.
ex.cn: 两只小鸟一出壳就离开了巢穴。

ex.en: He stuck his head up through the hatch.
ex.cn: 他从舱口探出头来。

ex.en: The eggs quickly hatch into larvae.
ex.cn: 虫卵很快孵化成幼虫。

def:
vt.& vi.拖，拉
vt.运送,传讯
n.拖,大批赃物,一网的捕获量,拖运货物的距离
vi.强迫（某人）去某处

ex.en: Revitalising the Romanian economy will be a long haul.
ex.cn: 罗马尼亚经济的复兴将是一项长期而艰巨的工作。

ex.en: Another break-in yielded a £4,000 haul of jewellery.
ex.cn: 另一次入室盗窃偷得了价值4,000英镑的首饰。

ex.en: Short-haul flights operate from Heathrow and Gatwick.
ex.cn: 希思罗和盖特威克之间有短程航班。

def:
n.霍克,鹰,鹰派人物，主战派,掠夺别人的人，骗子
vt.通过叫卖主动兜售（货物）,清除嗓子中的（痰）
vi.清嗓，咳痰,用训练好的鹰狩猎,象鹰一样俯冲攻击,叫卖

ex.en: The hawk swooped and soared away carrying something.
ex.cn: 那只鹰向下猛冲，抓住东西后又展翅高飞了。

ex.en: A hawk hovered over the hill.
ex.cn: 一只鹰在小山的上空翱翔。

ex.en: The hawk poised in mid-air ready to swoop.
ex.cn: 老鹰在半空中盘旋，准备俯冲。

def:
n.标题，题名,信头,[航]航向,斩首
v.用头顶(head的现在分词)

ex.en: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
ex.cn: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

ex.en: Hurricane Andrew was last night heading into the Gulf of Mexico.
ex.cn: 昨晚，飓风“安德鲁”进入了墨西哥湾。

ex.en: By 09.30 we had cast off and were heading down-river.
ex.cn: 9点30分时我们就解缆向下游出发了。

def: n.（机构，企业等的）总部,总店,司令部,指挥部

ex.en: Its headquarters will soon be relocated from Westminster to the Greenwich site.
ex.cn: 其总部很快将从威斯敏斯特迁往格林尼治。

ex.en: We fixed for the team to visit our headquarters.
ex.cn: 我们安排了该工作组参观我们的总部。

ex.en: An alarm links the police station to the divisional headquarters.
ex.cn: 在部门总部和警察局之间连有警报器。

def:
vt.恢复健康的状态,使恢复正常,使（某人）精神恢复健康
vi.变得完整和健全

ex.en: They hope to heal the rift with their father.
ex.cn: 他们希望能够弥合和父亲之间的裂痕。

ex.en: You'll mend. The X-rays show that your arm will heal all right.
ex.cn: 你会康复的。X光照片显示你的胳膊能够较好地复原。

ex.en: The wounds may heal cleanly or they may ooze a clear liquid.
ex.cn: 这些伤口可能会利索地愈合，也可能会分泌出一种透明的液体。

def:
n.堆，堆积,<口>许多，大量,<俚>破车
vt.扔成一堆,完全填满，灌满,大量或奢侈的赠予

ex.en: Clothes were thrown in the luggage in an untidy heap.
ex.cn: 衣服被乱糟糟地扔进旅行箱里。

ex.en: Thousands of Europe's tanks and guns are going to the scrap heap.
ex.cn: 欧洲成千上万的坦克和枪支将被淘汰。

ex.en: The young footballer collapsed in a heap after a heavy tackle.
ex.cn: 年青的足球队员完成激烈的阻截后瘫倒在地动弹不得。

def:
vt.举起,投掷,使起伏,呕吐
vt.& vi.喘息,呕吐
vi.起伏,（山丘等）隆起,拖,气喘
n.举起,波动,隆起,呕吐

ex.en: It took only one heave to hurl him into the river.
ex.cn: 只一推，就把他推进了河里。

ex.en: Captain Cornish repeated his order to heave to.
ex.cn: 科尼什船长再次下达了停航的命令。

ex.en: I managed to heave the trunk down the stairs.
ex.cn: 我用力把箱子弄下楼梯。

def:
n.树篱,保护手段,防止损失（尤指金钱）的手段
vt.用树篱围起,受…的束缚
vt.& vi.回避，避免
adj.树篱下的，树篱旁的,偷偷摸摸的，名声不好的，低劣的

ex.en: Hawker Siddeley tried to hedge its bets by diversifying into other fields.
ex.cn: 霍克·西德利试图通过在其他领域进行多样化发展来规避风险。

ex.en: You can hedge against redundancy or illness with insurance.
ex.cn: 可以购买保险以防失业或患病。

ex.en: I saw an old man out clipping his hedge.
ex.cn: 我看见一位老人在外面修剪树篱。

def:
n.脚后跟，踵,（鞋、袜等的后跟）,（四足动物的）后脚,踵状物
vt.& vi.（使）倾斜
vt.给（鞋等）修理后跟

ex.en: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
ex.cn: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

ex.en: Horton's Achilles heel was that he could not delegate.
ex.cn: 霍顿的软肋在于他不懂得放权。

ex.en: She snagged a heel on a root and tumbled to the ground.
ex.cn: 她脚后跟被一个树根绊了一下，踉踉跄跄地摔倒在地上。

def: n.继承人,后嗣，嗣子

ex.en: His heir sold the painting to the London art dealer Agnews.
ex.cn: 他的继承人把这幅画卖给了伦敦艺术品经销商阿格纽斯。

ex.en: He was seen as Mr Olsen's heir apparent.
ex.cn: 他被视为奥尔森先生理所当然的继任者。

ex.en: He wanted to beget an heir.
ex.cn: 他想生个子嗣。

def: adv.从今以后，今后

ex.en: We were finally released with a formal warning that we were henceforth barred from the base.
ex.cn: 我们被正式警告从此不得进入基地后终于获得了释放。

ex.en: Henceforth, parties which fail to get 5% of the vote will not be represented in par-liament.
ex.cn: 从今以后，选票数量未达到总数5%的党派将不能在议会里占有席位。

ex.en: Henceforth I expect you to be punctual for meeting.
ex.cn: 我希望你今后准时到会。

def: n.草，草本植物,药草，香草,牧草

ex.en: The herb has been used for centuries to curdle milk.
ex.cn: 那种香草几个世纪以来都被用来制作酸乳。

ex.en: Bay leaf is an excellent herb for mackerel.
ex.cn: 干月桂叶是烹制鲭鱼肉极佳的调味料。

ex.en: chicken with herb dumplings
ex.cn: 芳草鸡肉饺子

def:
n.兽群,牧群,放牧人,<蔑>群众，民众
vt.& vi.群集，纠结
vt.放牧,（使）向…移动,使成群

ex.en: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep.
ex.cn: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

ex.en: A herd of elephants lolloped across the plains towards a watering hole.
ex.cn: 一群大象缓慢而笨拙地穿过平原，朝水潭走去。

ex.en: a herd of bison
ex.cn: 一群野牛

def:
adj.有英雄气概的，英雄的，英勇的,记叙英雄及其事迹的,夸张的
n.英雄诗，史诗,英勇行为,夸张的言行,咬文嚼字，文诌诌

ex.en: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
ex.cn: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

ex.en: He finally faltered in the last game of a heroic match.
ex.cn: 他在这场艰苦比赛的最后一局中踉跄结束。

ex.en: Their dogged single-mindedness is almost heroic.
ex.cn: 他们不屈不挠专心致志的劲头简直是一种壮举。

def: n.女主角,女英雄,女杰出人物

ex.en: The film concludes with the heroine's death.
ex.cn: 影片以女主角之死结束.

ex.en: The national heroine of the day was Xing Fen, winner of the first Gold medal of the Games.
ex.cn: 现今的民族英雄是在该运动会上获得首枚金牌的邢芬。

ex.en: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the Hyde Park Hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
ex.cn: 为了一睹女主角的风采，一些追星族已经在海德公园饭店外守候了24个小时。

def: n.[计]分层，层次,等级制度,统治集团,天使的级别或等级

ex.en: The principle of hierarchy does not equate to totalitarian terror.
ex.cn: 等级制度在原则上并不等同于极权主义恐怖。

ex.en: My ambition was to travel upwards in the ecclesiastical hierarchy.
ex.cn: 我的雄心是在教会中一步一步往上走。

ex.en: See how stupidly they kow-tow to persons higher in the hierarchy.
ex.cn: 瞧他们对上级唯命是从的样子是多么愚蠢啊。

def:
n.徒步旅行,远足,提高，涨价,<口>（数量、价格等）增加，上升
vi.徒步旅行,上升
vt.提高（价格等）,拉起,使…高涨

ex.en: They went on a ten-mile hike through the forest.
ex.cn: 他们做了一次穿越森林的十英里徒步旅行。

ex.en: After the hike to the river the soldiers camped for the night.
ex.cn: 士兵们步行到达那条河后露营过夜.

ex.en: The boys have gone on a long hike with the Boy Scouts.
ex.cn: 男孩们已经随童子军长途徒步旅行去了.

def:
n.铰链，折叶,关键，转折点,枢要，中枢
vt.& vi.用铰链连接,依…为转移,给…安装铰链,（门等）装有蝶铰
vi.依…而转移

ex.en: Fit hinge bolts to give extra support to the door lock.
ex.cn: 安上铰链插销，让门锁更牢靠。

ex.en: Running water is never stale and a door - hinge never gets worm - eaten.
ex.cn: 流水不腐,户枢不蠹.

ex.en: Does not success or failure hinge on this?
ex.cn: 成败之机,其在斯乎?

def:
n.线索，迹象,提示，注意事项,暗示,微量
vt.暗示
vi.暗示，提示

ex.en: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
ex.cn: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

ex.en: She'd never received the merest hint of any communication from him.
ex.cn: 她从未得到他准备沟通的一丁点儿暗示。

ex.en: Diana took the hint and left them to it.
ex.cn: 戴安娜会意，任由他们自己去解决。

def: adj.在历史上重要的，有历史影响的,历史的，历史上的

ex.en: Its historic buildings are being slowly and splendidly renovated.
ex.cn: 此处的历史建筑正被缓慢且精心地修复着。

ex.en: The summit was crowned by the signing of the historic START treaty.
ex.cn: 此次峰会以签订具有历史性意义的《削减进攻性战略武器条约》宣告圆满成功。

ex.en: The groups had historic scores to settle with each other.
ex.cn: 这两个集团之间有几笔旧账要了结。

def:
vt.升起，提起
vi.被举起或抬高
n.起重机，升降机,升起,<俚>推，托，举

ex.en: Materials are elevated to the top floor by the new hoist.
ex.cn: 材料由那台新起重机吊到楼顶.

ex.en: Hoist the flag to the top of the pole.
ex.cn: 把旗升到旗杆顶端.

ex.en: By using a hoist the movers were able to sling the piano to the third floor.
ex.cn: 搬运工人用吊车才把钢琴吊到3楼.

def:
adj.空的,空洞的,虚伪的,空腹的
n.洞，坑,山谷
vt.& vi.挖空（某物），变空,挖出（孔、洞）
adv.完全，彻底

ex.en: Bake some big red peppers and hollow them out.
ex.cn: 将几个大红甜椒烤一烤，再把它们掏空。

ex.en: He looked young, dark and sharp-featured, with hollow cheeks.
ex.cn: 他看起来很年轻，肤色黝黑，五官分明，双颊凹陷。

ex.en: The ersatz spontaneity of "Sunday Love" sounds especially hollow.
ex.cn: 对《星期天的爱情》这首歌的即兴模仿听起来尤其空洞。

def: adj.同性质的，同类的,由相同（或同类型）事物（或人）组成的,均匀的,[数]齐性的，齐次的

ex.en: They are homogeneous people.
ex.cn: 他们是同类人.

ex.en: Educators try to put pupils of similar abilities into classes because they believe that this homogeneous grouping is advisable.
ex.cn: 教育学家设法将学生按相近的能力分班,因为他们认为这种按同等水平划分班级的做法是明智的.

ex.en: The unemployed are not a homogeneous group.
ex.cn: 失业者不能一概而论。

def: adj.可敬的，荣誉的，光荣的

ex.en: He argued that the only honorable course of action was death.
ex.cn: 他认为唯一体面的行为就只有一死。

ex.en: An honorable Chinese citizen should be jealous of his own rights.
ex.cn: 一名光荣的中国公民应当珍惜自己的公民权利.

ex.en: His aim is honorable and praiseworthy.
ex.cn: 他的目的是高尚的,值得称赞的.

def: adj.诚实的，正直的,光荣的，荣耀的,尊敬的,高尚的

ex.en: My title, by courtesy only, is the Honourable Amalia Lovell.
ex.cn: 人们称我为，当然只是出于礼貌，尊敬的阿马利娅·洛弗尔夫人。

ex.en: Carrington did the honourable thing and resigned.
ex.cn: 卡林顿作出了令人敬佩的举动，辞了职。

ex.en: a long and honourable career in government
ex.cn: 长期而光荣的从政生涯

def:
vi.跳上[下],单足蹦跳,齐足（或双足）跳行,摘葎草花
vt.跃过,登上（飞机、汽车、火车等）,在…跳来跳去,加啤酒花于
n.跳舞,蹦跳,（棒球等的）弹跳,（非正式）舞会
vt.& vi.换来换去，不断更换

ex.en: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
ex.cn: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

ex.en: "Hop it", I snapped at the bloke. "She's with me."
ex.cn: “滚开，”我厉声对那家伙说，“她是和我一起的。”

ex.en: His plans almost caught security chiefs and hotel staff on the hop.
ex.cn: 他的计划几乎让安全主管和饭店工作人员都措手不及。

def:
adj.水平的，卧式的,地平线的,[植]（枝条）平层的,同一行业的，同阶层的
n.水平线,水平面,水平位置,水平的物体

ex.en: The frames are secured by horizontal rails to the back wall.
ex.cn: 框架用横杆牢牢固定在后墙上。

ex.en: Do not raise your left arm above the horizontal.
ex.cn: 左臂不要举过水平高度。

ex.en: He shifted his position from the horizontal.
ex.cn: 他从水平姿势变换成其他姿势。

def:
n.角，触角,号角，喇叭,角质,角状物
vi.不请自来,闯入

ex.en: The storms had abated by the time they rounded Cape Horn.
ex.cn: 他们绕过合恩角时，暴风雨已经减弱。

ex.en: The rains have failed again in the Horn of Africa.
ex.cn: 雨季又没有光顾非洲之角。

ex.en: We drove through red traffic lights, the horn blaring.
ex.cn: 我们鸣着喇叭，闯过红灯。

def: n.<物>马力

ex.en: a powerful car with a 170 horsepower engine
ex.cn: 发动机为170马力的大功率汽车

ex.en: The worshiper thinks that the worst is the insufficient horsepower.
ex.cn: 崇拜者认为最坏的事是马力不足.

ex.en: The engine puts out thirty horsepower.
ex.cn: 这台发动机可产生30马力.

def:
n.软管，胶皮管,长筒袜,男性穿的紧身裤
vt.用软管浇,痛打

ex.en: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
ex.cn: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管抽走。

ex.en: He uncoiled the hose and gave them a thorough drenching.
ex.cn: 他把软管铺展开来，把它们彻底冲洗了一下。

ex.en: Two inmates hurled slates at prison officers spraying them with a hose.
ex.cn: 两名囚犯朝着用水管向他们喷水的狱警们扔石板瓦。

def: n.人质,抵押品

ex.en: The class was held hostage by a hooded gunman.
ex.cn: 全班同学被一个蒙面的持枪歹徒劫为人质。

ex.en: The hostage release could clear the decks for war.
ex.cn: 人质的获释可能会为发动战争扫清障碍。

ex.en: The reporting of the hostage story was fair, if sometimes overblown.
ex.cn: 尽管这篇关于人质的报道有些夸大其词，但还算公正。

def:
n.女主人,（夜总会的）女招待,（电视或广播节目的）女主持人,（餐馆的）迎宾女招待
vt.作东，请客

ex.en: An air hostess was arrested and charged with drug smuggling.
ex.cn: 一名空姐被捕，并被控以走私毒品的罪名。

ex.en: "Well, dear," her hostess would reply with a frigid smile.
ex.cn: “噢，亲爱的，”她的女主人会笑容僵硬地回答。

ex.en: Mary was always the perfect hostess.
ex.cn: 玛丽总是最殷勤的女主人。

def:
n.猎狗，猎犬,卑劣的人,[动]角鲨，星鲨，弓鳍鱼,有…迷[瘾]的人
vt.追猎,不断侵扰，烦扰,激励,嗾使，煽动

ex.en: The police have promised to hound down those responsible for the explosion.
ex.cn: 警方已保证要追查此次爆炸事件有责任的人员.

ex.en: The hound found the trail of the rabbit.
ex.cn: 猎狗发现了兔子的踪迹.

ex.en: A hound yelped briefly as a whip cracked.
ex.cn: 鞭子一响,猎狗发出一阵嗥叫.

def:
vt.哀号，吼叫
vi.嚎叫，咆哮,哀嚎,<俚>开心地狂笑,<俚>狂欢
n.嗥叫,嚎哭,<俚>及其可笑的事物

ex.en: Traditionalists may howl, but in today's world, cultural relativism rules.
ex.cn: 传统卫道士们也许会叫嚣反对，但在当今世界，文化相对论确实是占据着统治地位。

ex.en: He tossed back his head in a howl of berserk laughter.
ex.cn: 他仰天狂笑。

ex.en: to howl in pain
ex.cn: 疼得直叫喊

def:
n.拥挤,杂乱一团,小型私人会议
vi.挤在一起,（因寒冷或害怕）蜷缩
vt.使聚集,使蜷曲起来,草率地行事

ex.en: Between plays the coach was talking to the offense in the huddle.
ex.cn: 中场时，这位教练对围拢一圈的进攻队员进行战术指导。

ex.en: I remembered a huddle of stone buildings with blind walls.
ex.cn: 我记得一片没有窗户的石头建筑。

ex.en: We lay there: a huddle of bodies, gasping for air.
ex.cn: 我们横七竖八地挤作一团躺在那里，大口喘着气。

def: n.（空气中的）湿度,潮湿，高温潮湿,湿热,[物]湿度

ex.en: As an asthmatic, he cannot cope with the heat and humidity.
ex.cn: 他患有哮喘病，经不起高温和潮湿。

ex.en: The humidity is relatively low.
ex.cn: 湿度相对较低。

ex.en: The house is not comfortable tonight because of the high humidity.
ex.cn: 由于湿度高,今晚屋子里不舒服.

def:
vt.丢下，用力投掷,大声叫骂，愤慨的说出,推到，推翻
vi.猛投，猛掷

ex.en: It took only one heave to hurl him into the river.
ex.cn: 只一推，就把他推进了河里。

ex.en: The best cure for unhappiness is to hurl yourself into your work.
ex.cn: 医治愁苦的最好办法就是全身心地投入工作.

ex.en: When you get to the top, hurl the rope down, will you ?
ex.cn: 你到了顶上把绳子扔下来好 吗 ?

def: n.飓风，十二级风,飓风般猛烈的东西,（感情等的）爆发,<英>飓风式战斗驱逐机

ex.en: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
ex.cn: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

ex.en: Hurricane Andrew was last night heading into the Gulf of Mexico.
ex.cn: 昨晚，飓风“安德鲁”进入了墨西哥湾。

ex.en: The eye of the hurricane hit Florida just south of Miami.
ex.cn: 飓风的风眼袭击了佛罗里达州迈阿密正南部。

def:
n.小屋,棚屋,临时营房,牢房
v.使住临时营房,驻扎

ex.en: The hut suddenly seemed strangely silent.
ex.cn: 小屋突然似乎安静得出奇。

ex.en: The hut isn't safe; it was just flung together.
ex.cn: 这个棚子不安全, 它不过是匆忙搭起来的.

ex.en: The hut hung half over the edge of the precipice.
ex.cn: 那间小屋有一半悬在峭壁边上.

def: adj.情绪异常激动的,歇斯底里般的,癔病的,癔病性

ex.en: Paul Mazursky was Master of Ceremonies, and he was pretty hysterical.
ex.cn: 保罗·马祖尔斯基担任司仪，他简直把人笑坏了。

ex.en: I suffered bouts of really hysterical depression.
ex.cn: 我曾患阵发的严重癔病性抑郁症。

ex.en: He made headlines and received hysterical hate mail.
ex.cn: 他成了新闻人物，收到了疯狂的攻击性邮件。

def: n.鉴定，识别,验明,身份证明,认同

ex.en: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
ex.cn: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

ex.en: I need your full, emotional identification with the problem and with me.
ex.cn: 我需要你对我、对此问题都有充分的情感认同与支持。

ex.en: Officials are awaiting positive identification before charging the men with war crimes.
ex.cn: 在以战争罪起诉这些人以前，官员们一直在等待他们身份的核实。

def: n.习语，成语,方言，土语,（语言）风格,惯用语法

ex.en: It was an old building in the local idiom.
ex.cn: 这是一座具有当地特色的古建筑.

ex.en: I like the idiom of modern popular music.
ex.cn: 我喜欢现代流行音乐的风格.

ex.en: And nothing was so irritating as the confident way he used archaic idiom.
ex.cn: 没什么比他使用过时的方言时那种自负的神态更气人的了。

def: n.傻瓜，笨蛋,白痴

ex.en: He snubbed her in public and made her feel an idiot.
ex.cn: 他当众冷落她，让她觉得自己像一个白痴似的。

ex.en: The original script was written with the idiot box in mind.
ex.cn: 剧本当初就是为电视而写的。

ex.en: Custer was an idiot and a brute and he deserved his fate.
ex.cn: 卡斯特是个白痴，是个残暴的家伙，他罪有应得。

def:
adj.无意义的,空闲的,懒惰的,无根据的
vi.虚度,空转,挂空挡,未熄火
vt.虚度,使空转
n.（尤指暂时地）关闭工厂，使（工人）闲着

ex.en: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.
ex.cn: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。

ex.en: It was more of an idle threat than anything.
ex.cn: 那其实是唬人的话。

ex.en: It would be idle to pretend the system is perfect.
ex.cn: 假装系统完美无疵是徒劳的。

def:
vt.点燃,使燃烧,使激动,使灼热
vi.点火,燃烧

ex.en: The recent fighting in the area could ignite regional passions far beyond the borders.
ex.cn: 最近该地区的战斗可能激发边境以外整个地区的激动情绪。

ex.en: The rocket rises and we can see the second stage ignite.
ex.cn: 火箭升高了,我们可以看到二级点火.

ex.en: Nothing less than a fission bomb can ignite a thermonuclear reaction.
ex.cn: 威力比一个裂变炸弹小的任何东西都不能点燃热核反应.

def:
adj.目不识丁的，文盲的
n.目不识丁者,文盲,无知

ex.en: A small but significant number of 11-year-olds are illiterate.
ex.cn: 数量不多但仍有相当一部分11岁孩子是文盲。

ex.en: There 50 percent or more of the population is illiterate.
ex.cn: 那里50%或更多的群众是文盲.

ex.en: There are still many illiterate people in our country.
ex.cn: 在我国还有许多文盲.

def: vt.浸没,施浸礼,沉迷…中，陷入

ex.en: Immerse the cloth in the dye for twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 把布浸在染料里20分钟.

ex.en: I immerse my clothes in the water.
ex.cn: 我把衣服浸在水里.

ex.en: Don't immerse yourself in the infliction too long.
ex.cn: 不要长时间沉浸在痛苦经历中。

def: vt.损害，削弱

ex.en: Tiredness can seriously impair your ability to drive.
ex.cn: 疲劳会大大影响你的驾驶能力.

ex.en: It can not impair the intellectual vigor of the young.
ex.cn: 这不能磨灭青年人思想活力.

ex.en: The author's half drunken state did not in the least impair his eminence in my eyes.
ex.cn: 在我的眼里,这位作家的醺醺醉态丝毫无损他的高尚.

def: vt.给予,告知，透露,传授

ex.en: A teacher's aim is to impart knowledge.
ex.cn: 教师的宗旨就是传授知识.

ex.en: Monosodium glutamate impart flavo ( u ) r to food.
ex.cn: 味素 使食品有味道.

ex.en: His production of Harold Pinter's play fails to impart a sense of excitement or danger.
ex.cn: 他所执导的哈罗德·品特的剧作没能表现出紧张、危险感。

def:
adj.帝国的，皇帝的,皇家的，庄严的,特级的,度量衡英制的
n.纸张尺寸，通常是23×23英寸,特大号，特级品,一小绺胡须,马车的车顶

ex.en: In 1959, Akihito broke with imperial tradition by marrying a commoner.
ex.cn: 明仁天皇在1959年打破皇室传统，娶了一位平民女子为妻。

ex.en: The Japanese Imperial family patronises the Japanese Art Association.
ex.cn: 日本皇室资助日本艺术协会。

ex.en: In 1527 Imperial troops sacked the French ambassador's residence in Rome.
ex.cn: 1527年，帝国军队洗劫了位于罗马的法国大使官邸。

def: vt.招致，引起,遭受

ex.en: Any expenses you may incur will be chargeable to the company.
ex.cn: 你的所有开销均由本公司支付。

ex.en: Any costs that you incur will be reimbursed in full.
ex.cn: 你的所有花费都将全额付还.

ex.en: While that option would incur fewer casualties, it would not be militarily effective.
ex.cn: 尽管那种选择造成的伤亡人数可能会更少，却并不能取得军事上的胜利。

def:
vt.迁就，纵容,使满足,使（自己）沉溺于,使快乐
vi.纵容,满足,沉溺

ex.en: Only rarely will she indulge in a glass of wine.
ex.cn: 她只是偶尔才喝杯红酒，让自己享受一下。

ex.en: You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune.
ex.cn: 你不必花大把钱就可以好好犒劳一下自己。

ex.en: They went into town to indulge in some serious shopping.
ex.cn: 他们进城去大肆购物。

def: adj.传染的,有传染性的,易传染的,有感染力的

ex.en: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
ex.cn: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

ex.en: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does.
ex.cn: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。

ex.en: Flu is highly infectious.
ex.cn: 流感的传染性很高。

def:
adj.极大的,无法衡量的, 无限的,无穷尽的
n.无限的事物,无穷尽的事物, 上帝

ex.en: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
ex.cn: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

ex.en: The whole universe exists eternally in that one infinite being.
ex.cn: 整个宇宙在无限的空间中永生。

ex.en: Human beings have an infinite capacity for self-deception.
ex.cn: 人类自欺的本事是无穷的。

def:
adj.<物>红外线的
n.红外线

ex.en: Infrared detectors have many uses.
ex.cn: 红外探测器有多种用途。

ex.en: Infrared is widely used in industry and medical science.
ex.cn: 红外线广泛应用于工业和医学科学.

ex.en: An achromatic conformal optical system working within infrared waveband was designed by him.
ex.cn: 他设计了一个红外波段消色差共形光学系统。

def: adj.灵巧的,精巧的,设计独特的,有天才的，聪明的

ex.en: ingenious ways of saving energy
ex.cn: 节约能源的巧妙方法

ex.en: The director used ingenious devices to keep the audience in suspense.
ex.cn: 导演用巧妙手法引起观众的悬念.

ex.en: Try to think of unusual and ingenious solutions.
ex.cn: 尽量想想不同寻常的、巧妙的解决方法.

def: n.居民，住户,（栖息在某地区的）动物

ex.en: Cairo has only thirteen square centimetres of green space for each inhabitant.
ex.cn: 开罗居民的人均绿地面积仅13平方厘米。

ex.en: the oldest inhabitant of the village
ex.cn: 这个村最老的居民

ex.en: The tapeworm is an inhabitant of the intestine.
ex.cn: 绦虫是栖居肠内的寄生虫.

def: vt.& vi.吸入,〈非〉狼吞虎咽,吸气

ex.en: Don't inhale dust into your lung.
ex.cn: 别把灰尘吸进肺里.

ex.en: Do you inhale when you smoke?
ex.cn: 你抽烟时是否把烟吸入肺里?

ex.en: Smokers who inhale are likely to become addicted to nicotine.
ex.cn: 吸烟的人容易对尼古丁上瘾.

def:
vt.& vi.继承
vt.经遗传获得（品质、身体特征等），继任

ex.en: Princess Alexandra was to inherit the title of Duchess of Fife.
ex.cn: 亚历山德拉公主将会继承法夫女公爵的爵位。

ex.en: The meek shall inherit the earth.
ex.cn: 谦卑的人必承受地土。

ex.en: They are to inherit 100,000 US dollars.
ex.cn: 他们将会继承10万美元。

def: v.抑制,禁止

ex.en: It could inhibit the poor from getting the medical care they need.
ex.cn: 那会使穷人得不到他们所需要的医疗保健。

ex.en: Wine or sugary drinks inhibit digestion.
ex.cn: 葡萄酒或含糖饮料抑制消化。

ex.en: Sore nipples can inhibit the milk supply.
ex.cn: 乳头发炎会抑制出奶。

def:
n.进口,[电]引入,插入物,水湾
v.引进,嵌入,插入

ex.en: There is an inlet to a parking lot.
ex.cn: 那儿有一个停车场的入口.

ex.en: They went to a fishing village on a small inlet of the sea.
ex.cn: 他们去了小海湾边的一个渔村.

ex.en: I mean to get into North Inlet, and beach her quietly there.'
ex.cn: 我要将船驶进北汊,让它在那里平稳地登上岸滩. ”

def: n.不稳定，不稳固,不坚决，反复无常,基础薄弱

ex.en: Much of the instability stems from the economic effects of the war.
ex.cn: 不稳定局面多半是由战争对经济的影响造成的。

ex.en: political and economic instability
ex.cn: 政治和经济的不稳定

ex.en: Racism causes political instability and violence.
ex.cn: 种族主义道致政治动荡和暴力事件.

def: n.安装,装置,永久性军事基地,就职

ex.en: Installation of the new system will take several days.
ex.cn: 新系统的安装需要几天时间。

ex.en: All large ships now have a wireless installation.
ex.cn: 所有的大型船舶现在都有无线电装置.

ex.en: He sent a letter inviting Naomi to attend his installation as chief of his tribe.
ex.cn: 他给娜奥米寄了封信，邀请她来参加他就任部落酋长的仪式。

def: n.部分,分期付款,（丛书杂志等的）一部，一期

ex.en: His car was repossessed because of default of monthly installment.
ex.cn: 因为拖欠按月应付的分期付款,他的汽车被收回了.

ex.en: I shall soon pay the last installment of my debt.
ex.cn: 不久我将偿付我的最后一期债款.

ex.en: Factoring in connection with automobile installment accounts is a big business today.
ex.cn: 代管汽车分期付款的到期帐目是当今一桩巨大的业务.

def: vt.使隔离，使孤立,使绝缘，使隔热

ex.en: He continues to insulate his country from the contagion of foreign ideas.
ex.cn: 他继续使本国远离外来思想的侵袭。

ex.en: Home owners are being encouraged to insulate their homes to save energy.
ex.cn: 当局鼓励房主给住房加隔热装置以节约能源。

ex.en: Asbestos can be used to insulate a cooking stove.
ex.cn: 石棉能用来使烹调用的炉灶绝热.

def:
vt.保证,确保,为…保险,投保
vi.买卖或卖保险

ex.en: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
ex.cn: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

ex.en: Think carefully before you insure against accident, sickness and redundancy.
ex.cn: 在为意外事故、疾病与失业投保之前一定要考虑清楚。

ex.en: Will it insure success to [ for ] you?
ex.cn: 这将保证你成功 吗 ?

def: adj.完整无缺的，未经触动的，未受损伤的,原封不动的,完好无缺,完好无损

ex.en: Most of the house remains intact even after two hundred years.
ex.cn: 虽然过了两百年，这房子的大部分还保持完好。

ex.en: He can scarcely survive this scandal with his reputation intact.
ex.cn: 他经此丑闻名誉很难不受损.

ex.en: When a bird's nest is overturned, no egg can remain intact.
ex.cn: 覆巢之下无完卵.

def:
adj.完整的,积分的,必须的
n.整体,积分

ex.en: Rituals and festivals form an integral part of every human society.
ex.cn: 仪式与节日构成了任何人类社会不可缺少的一部分。

ex.en: Community involvement is now integral to company strategy.
ex.cn: 参与社会活动如今已是公司战略中必不可少的内容。

ex.en: Music is an integral part of the school's curriculum.
ex.cn: 音乐是这所学校的课程中基本的一环。

def: adj.可理解的，明白易懂的，清楚的

ex.en: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
ex.cn: 达尔文的语言无论对专家还是非专业人士而言都明白易懂。

ex.en: His lecture was readily intelligible to all the students.
ex.cn: 他的讲课学生们都能轻松地听懂。

ex.en: This report would be intelligible only to an expert in computing.
ex.cn: 只有计算机运算专家才能看懂这份报告.

def: n.交流，交往，交际,[生]交合

ex.en: We didn't have intercourse.
ex.cn: 我们没有发生性关系。

ex.en: The prosecution stated that intercourse had occurred on several occasions.
ex.cn: 控诉方称发生过数次性交。

ex.en: The magazine becomes a cultural medium of intercourse between the two peoples.
ex.cn: 该杂志成为两民族间文化交流的媒介.

def:
n.界面,<计>接口,交界面
v.（使通过界面或接口）接合，连接,[计算机]使联系
vi.相互作用（或影响）,交流，交谈

ex.en: The different components all have to interface smoothly.
ex.cn: 不同的部件都必须能顺利接合。

ex.en: The system uses an impressive graphical interface.
ex.cn: 这一系统采用了特别好的图形界面。

ex.en: the interface between computer and printer
ex.cn: 计算机和打印机之间的接口

def:
adj.暂时的，临时的,期中的
n.间歇，过渡期间,临时协定

ex.en: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
ex.cn: 她3月份宣誓就任过渡政府首脑。

ex.en: He was to remain in jail in the interim.
ex.cn: 他在此期间将会继续被关押。

ex.en: This is the half-yearly meeting of the interim committee.
ex.cn: 这是临时委员会召开的年中例会。

def:
adj.中间的，中级的
n.中间物，中间分子，中间人
vi.调解：充当调解人，调解,干涉

ex.en: You should consider breaking the journey with intermediate stopovers at airport hotels.
ex.cn: 你应该考虑将旅程分为几段，中途在机场旅馆稍作停留。

ex.en: This country is now at an intermediate stage of development.
ex.cn: 这个国家目前正处于发展的中间阶段.

ex.en: Gray is intermediate between black and white.
ex.cn: 灰色介于黑色和白色之间.

def: n.横断，横切,交叉，相交,交叉点，交叉线,[数]交集

ex.en: The policeman regulated traffic at the intersection.
ex.cn: 警察在交叉路口指挥交通.

ex.en: The car stopped at a street intersection.
ex.cn: 这辆车停在十字路口.

ex.en: There is a stop sign at an intersection.
ex.cn: 在交叉路口处有停车标志.

def: vt.恐吓，威胁

ex.en: "You have no right to intimidate this man," Alison continued.
ex.cn: “你没有权利威胁这个人，”艾莉森接着说。

ex.en: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul.
ex.cn: 琼斯开始恐吓并控制保罗。

ex.en: Don't you try to intimidate people by pinning labels on them.
ex.cn: 别拿大帽子压人.

def: adj.错综复杂的,难理解的,曲折,盘错

ex.en: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.
ex.cn: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。

ex.en: He knows his way around the intricate maze of European law.
ex.cn: 他通晓错综复杂的欧洲律法。

ex.en: Her washing machine tends to fray edges on intricate designs.
ex.cn: 她的洗衣机经常会把织物上的一些复杂图案的边缘磨坏。

def:
n.密谋，阴谋,私通，奸情
vi.耍阴谋
vt.以谋略达成,激起…的好奇心

ex.en: They spiced their conversations and discussions with intrigue.
ex.cn: 他们的谈话和讨论透着些许的神秘。

ex.en: Qu Yuan suffered banishment as the victim of a court intrigue.
ex.cn: 屈原成为朝廷中钩心斗角的牺牲品,因而遭到放逐.

ex.en: The palace was a nest of intrigue.
ex.cn: 这座宫殿曾是阴谋诡计的策源地.

def:
vi.侵入，侵扰，打扰,闯入,打扰
vt.把观点强加于他人,[地质]侵入其他地层,把…硬挤

ex.en: There are times when personal feelings cannot be allowed to intrude.
ex.cn: 有些时候是不允许夹杂个人感情的。

ex.en: Do you feel anxious when unforeseen incidents intrude on your day?
ex.cn: 当意外事件干扰了你的生活时，你会感到焦虑吗？

ex.en: I'm sorry to intrude on you like this.
ex.cn: 很抱歉这样来打扰你。

def: n.直觉,凭直觉感知的知识,直觉力

ex.en: I had an intuition that something awful was about to happen.
ex.cn: 我直觉感到要出乱子了。

ex.en: I had an intuition that I would find you.
ex.cn: 我有一种直觉,我能找到你们.

ex.en: He knew this thing by intuition.
ex.cn: 他凭直觉了解这件事.

def:
vt.& vi.侵入，侵略,进行侵略,蜂拥而入，挤满,（疾病，声音等）袭来，侵袭
vt.涌入,侵袭,侵犯,干扰

ex.en: The press invade people's privacy unfairly and unjustifiably every day.
ex.cn: 新闻媒体每天都在不公正地且没有正当理由地侵犯人们的隐私。

ex.en: I don't want to invade your private life unnecessarily.
ex.cn: 我不想过多地干涉你的私生活.

ex.en: If the enemy dare to invade us, we'll deal them head - on blows .
ex.cn: 敌人胆敢进犯, 我们就给以 迎头痛击.

def: adj.非常宝贵的,无法估计的,无价的,金不换

ex.en: The research should prove invaluable in the study of linguistics.
ex.cn: 该调查研究在语言学研究领域的重要性应该会得到证实。

ex.en: The book is an invaluable aid to teachers of literature.
ex.cn: 这本书对于教授文学的老师来说帮助非常大。

ex.en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
ex.cn: 在那一年里我有幸获得了非常宝贵的经验。

def:
adj.恒定的，不变的，始终如一的
n.恒定,不变,始终如一

ex.en: It was his invariable custom to have one whisky before his supper.
ex.cn: 晚饭前来杯威士忌，这是他一直以来的习惯。

ex.en: Her routine was invariable.
ex.cn: 她的日常生活总是千篇一律。

ex.en: This process, however, was not invariable.
ex.cn: 但是, 这个过程并非始终不变.

def:
n.存货清单,财产目录，财产目录的编制,存货总值,清查
vt.编制…的目录,开列…的清单,盘存,总结

ex.en: They're likely to hold big fire sales to liquidate their inventory.
ex.cn: 他们可能会举行清仓大甩卖。

ex.en: an inventory of the museum's contents
ex.cn: 博物馆馆藏清单

ex.en: This is a detailed inventory of all the jobs to be done.
ex.cn: 这是一张待办事项的详表.

def:
adj.相反的,逆向的,倒转的
n.相反,倒转,相反的事物
vt.使倒转,使颠倒

ex.en: Evil is the inverse of good.
ex.cn: 恶是善的反面.

ex.en: There is no sign that you bothered to consider the inverse of your logic.
ex.cn: 你根本就不想把你的逻辑反过来考虑。

ex.en: The hologram can be flipped to show the inverse image.
ex.cn: 全息图可以通过反转显现出逆像。

def:
vt.使…前后倒置,使反转
n.颠倒的事物,变性者
adj.转化的

ex.en: Place a plate over the cake tin and invert it.
ex.cn: 在蛋糕烤模上盖一个盘子，然后将其翻倒过来。

ex.en: If you invert " I can " , you have " can I ".
ex.cn: 如果你把Ican两词前后颠倒一下,就成了 can I.

ex.en: They may be hoping to invert the presumption that a defendant is innocent until proved guilty.
ex.cn: 他们可能有望颠覆“被告在证实有罪之前是无辜的”这一假设。

def:
vt.调查,审查,研究
vi.作调查

ex.en: We were asked to investigate the alleged inconsistencies in his evidence.
ex.cn: 我们被要求对他证词中的前后矛盾之处进行调查。

ex.en: The two sides agreed to set up a commission to investigate claims.
ex.cn: 双方同意组建一个委员会来调查那些索赔要求。

ex.en: He felt impelled to investigate further.
ex.cn: 他觉得有必要作进一步调查。

def:
adj.向内的,内部的,本质上的,亲密的
adv.向内,内心里
n.内部,内脏

ex.en: A model of good manners, he has conquered any inward fury.
ex.cn: 作为一个非常懂礼貌的人，他已经学会了克制内心的任何愤怒情绪。

ex.en: Her calm expression hid her inward panic.
ex.cn: 她平静的外表掩盖了内心的恐慌。

ex.en: The door swung inward.
ex.cn: 门向内打开了.

def:
n.岛，小岛
vt.使成为岛屿,置…于岛上
vi.住在岛屿上,留在岛上

ex.en: Castle-hunters won't be disappointed with the Isle of Man.
ex.cn: 马恩岛不会让城堡探寻者失望的。

ex.en: After much cogitation, we decided to move to the Isle of Wight.
ex.cn: 经过慎重考虑后，我们决定搬到怀特岛去。

ex.en: the Isle of Skye
ex.cn: 斯凯岛

def: n.行话,行业术语,黑话

ex.en: APEC seems be drowning in an ocean of jargon.
ex.cn: 亚太经合组织似乎为一大堆空洞的胡言乱语所淹没。

ex.en: Their jargon is impenetrable to an outsider.
ex.cn: 他们的行话外人听不懂。

ex.en: The jargon in his talk was opaque to me.
ex.cn: 他谈话中使用的行话对我是一团迷雾。

def:
n.下巴,颌,唠叨,狭窄入口
vi.闲谈,唠唠叨叨，喋喋不休,教训

ex.en: His jaw was broken after he was hit on the head.
ex.cn: 他的头部受重击之后下颌骨折了。

ex.en: He thought for a moment, stroking his well-defined jaw.
ex.cn: 他摸着自己轮廓分明的下巴想了一会儿。

ex.en: They took my pulse, took my blood pressure, and X-rayed my jaw.
ex.cn: 他们给我量了脉搏、血压，还给我的下颌拍了X光片。

def:
vt.& vi.慢跑,轻推，轻撞,蹒跚行进,使颠簸
vt.慢跑,轻推,蹒跚行进,使颠簸
n.轻推，轻摇,慢跑,（线，面上的）参差不齐,突然的转向

ex.en: They set off at a jog up one street and down another.
ex.cn: 他们开始沿着一条又一条的街道慢跑。

ex.en: He went for another early morning jog.
ex.cn: 他又去晨跑了.

ex.en: Our lives just jog along from day to day.
ex.cn: 我们的生活安稳地过了一天又一天.

def:
adj.快活的,兴高采烈的,愉快的,有趣的
adv.很,非常
vt.使高兴，使愉快,打趣
vi.开玩笑,作乐
n.寻欢作乐,奉承，逢迎,皇家陆战队兵士,老富豪

ex.en: It was jolly hard luck on him, wasn't it?
ex.cn: 他可真倒霉，不是吗？

ex.en: It was jolly hard work, but I loved it.
ex.cn: 这可是件很苦的差事，不过我喜欢。

ex.en: She was jolly good at jigsaws.
ex.cn: 她拼图玩得很棒。

def: adj.司法的,法庭的,明断的,公正的

ex.en: The process of judicial selection was held up to ridicule.
ex.cn: 司法选举的过程成为了笑柄。

ex.en: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
ex.cn: 各级司法机构普遍存在对女性的偏见。

ex.en: The report accuses the judicial system of inconsistency and partiality.
ex.cn: 报告指责司法系统执法前后不一且有失公正。

def:
n.n.大罐，壶，一大罐（壶）的容量
vt.用陶罐或坛子煮，炖，煨,把…关进监狱

ex.en: She found a pretty yellow jug smashed to bits.
ex.cn: 她发现一个漂亮的黄色小罐被摔得粉碎。

ex.en: a five-gallon jug of beer
ex.cn: 五加仑装的啤酒罐

ex.en: He walked along with a jug poised on his head.
ex.cn: 他头上顶着一个水罐,保持着平衡往前走.

def: n.（热带）丛林,丛林音乐,乱七八糟的一堆事物,尔虞我诈的环境

ex.en: "Orchards would take the place of the jungle," he rhapsodized.
ex.cn: “要让这片丛林成为果园，”他无比兴奋地说。

ex.en: If you make aggression pay, this becomes the law of the jungle.
ex.cn: 如果你通过侵略谋取利益，这就成了弱肉强食。

ex.en: It held more mystery than even the darkest jungle.
ex.cn: 它甚至比最黑暗的丛林还更令人感到神秘。

def:
n.废旧物品，破烂物,中国式平底帆船,便宜货，假货,废话，哄骗
vt.丢弃，废弃,把…分成块

ex.en: The truth is that junk bonds were misnamed, and therefore misunderstood.
ex.cn: 事实上人们对垃圾债券的称谓有误，所以产生了误解。
