ex.en: The junk market has been unsettled for the past seven months.
ex.cn: 过去7个月中废旧货市场一直起伏不定。

ex.en: There was no mail except the usual junk addressed to the occupier.
ex.cn: 除了寄给业主的常见垃圾信件之外，再没有其他邮件了。

def:
n.键盘,琴键,电子琴
vt.用键盘输入,用键盘式排字机排字
vi.用键盘进行操作,作键盘式排字机排字

ex.en: To close your document, press CTRL+W on your keyboard.
ex.cn: 关闭文件时要同时按键盘上的CTRL键和W键。

ex.en: I was expected to familiarise myself with the keyboard.
ex.cn: 对我的要求是熟悉键盘。

ex.en: Tanya's hands rippled over the keyboard.
ex.cn: 塔尼娅的双手在琴键上翻飞。

def: vt.诱拐，绑架，劫持,拐骗

ex.en: He was charged with the kidnap of a 25 year-old woman.
ex.cn: 他被指控绑架一名25岁的女子。

ex.en: She was terrified that Ronnie would kidnap Sam.
ex.cn: 她吓坏了，生怕龙尼会绑架萨姆。

ex.en: Stewart denies attempted murder and kidnap.
ex.cn: 斯图尔特否认对其谋杀未遂和绑架的指控。

def: n.肾，肾脏,（可食用的动物的）腰子,脾气，性格

ex.en: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
ex.cn: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

ex.en: He had kidney cancer, with secondary tumours in the brain and lungs.
ex.cn: 他患有肾癌，还有脑部和肺部的继发性肿瘤。

ex.en: "Medicare" is available to victims of advanced kidney disease.
ex.cn: 老年医疗保险也适用于肾病晚期患者。

def: n.亲戚,家属,亲属

ex.en: We have notified the next of kin.
ex.cn: 我们已经通知了最近的亲属。

ex.en: I'm her next of kin.
ex.cn: 我是她的最近亲。

ex.en: He comes of good kin.
ex.cn: 他出身好.

def: n.幼儿园，学前班

ex.en: Children graduate to the kindergarten, then pre-school, and then school.
ex.cn: 孩子们先上幼儿园，然后上学前班，再接着上小学。

ex.en: She's in kindergarten now.
ex.cn: 她目前在上幼儿园。

ex.en: The kid was abducted at the gate of kindergarten.
ex.cn: 那小孩在幼儿园大门口被绑架走了.

def:
n.衣物和装备,成套用品,配套元件
vt.（为特定活动而）使某人装备起来

ex.en: I don't like taking my kit off on screen.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢在银幕上表演裸戏。

ex.en: Football kit relaunches are simply a way of boosting sales.
ex.cn: 成套足球用品的重新推出仅仅是一种促销的手段。

ex.en: Badly-built kit cars can be death traps.
ex.cn: 质量低劣的组装车可能会有安全隐患。

def: vi.跪，下跪

ex.en: The workers kneel on the ground and hammer the small stones in.
ex.cn: 工人们跪在地上，将小石子锤进去。

ex.en: In Heaven's name why should you kneel to me?'
ex.cn: 天啦!你为什么要向我跪下? ”

ex.en: Dad would kneel to receive her kisses while he scratched her ears.
ex.cn: 我爸便跪下去,搔弄着她的耳朵,同时接受她的亲吻.

def:
vt.& vi.编织，编结,接合（折骨等）,使皱起，使皱紧,使紧密相联
n.编织物,编织法

ex.en: During the war, Joan helped her mother knit scarves for soldiers.
ex.cn: 战争期间，琼帮妈妈给战士们织围巾。

ex.en: Events over the last year have created a close-knit community.
ex.cn: 去年发生的一些事让整个社会紧密团结在一起。

ex.en: I had endless hours to knit and sew.
ex.cn: 我整天无休止地编织缝纫。

def:
n.球形把手,（收音机等的）旋钮,小块,疙瘩
v.鼓起,使有球形突出物,给（门等）装球形把手

ex.en: Top the steaming hot potatoes with a knob of butter.
ex.cn: 在冒热气的马铃薯上放一小块黄油。

ex.en: The cutters are opened by turning the knob anticlockwise.
ex.cn: 逆时针转动旋钮可以开启切割机。

ex.en: He twiddled a knob on the dashboard.
ex.cn: 他转动着仪表板上的一个旋钮。

def:
n.蕾丝,透孔织品,鞋带,系带
vt.给（书、讲话等）润色,给（饮料等）掺（少量的酒、药、毒药等）,给（鞋、靴等）穿鞋带,使编织（或交织、缠绕）在一起
vi.以系带系紧

ex.en: I am wearing a plaid nightgown trimmed with white lace.
ex.cn: 我穿着一件带有白色蕾丝花边的格子呢睡衣。

ex.en: The nightdress has handmade lace round the armholes and neckline.
ex.cn: 这件女式睡衣的袖孔和领口都镶着一圈手织花边。

ex.en: Slip-on shoes are easier to put on than lace-ups.
ex.cn: 一脚蹬比系带鞋容易穿。

def: n.少年，小伙子,〈口〉伙伴，老朋友,〈英〉管赛马房的马夫,〈俚〉情人

ex.en: Come along, lad. Time for you to get home.
ex.cn: 来吧，小伙子。你该回家了。

ex.en: He was a nice lad — bright and with a sunny disposition.
ex.cn: 他是个不错的小伙子——聪明伶俐而且性格开朗。

ex.en: He's a sensitive lad and some of the criticism has stung him.
ex.cn: 他是个敏感的小伙子，有些批评刺痛了他。

def:
n.羔羊，小羊,羔羊肉,<宗>耶稣
vi.生小羊，产羊羔

ex.en: Allow an extra 10-15 min if you prefer lamb well done.
ex.cn: 如果想让羊羔肉完全熟透还需要再煮10到15分钟。

ex.en: I braised some beans to accompany a shoulder of lamb.
ex.cn: 我炖了些豆子，和羊肘子一块吃。

ex.en: You should have prepared something other than lamb and ratatouille.
ex.cn: 除了羊肉和蔬菜杂烩之外，你本应再准备点儿别的。

def:
adj.跛的，瘸的,僵痛的,差劲的，无说服力的,蹩脚的
vi.变跛
vt.使跛，使残废,把…弄残废
n.（金属）薄板，薄片,（古代护身甲上的）重叠金属片

ex.en: He mumbled some lame excuse about having gone to sleep.
ex.cn: 他含含糊糊地找了个蹩脚的借口，想要解释自己为什么睡着了。

ex.en: Scott's muscle atrophied, his leg became stunted, and he was left lame.
ex.cn: 斯科特的肌肉萎缩，一条腿发育不完全，成了个瘸子。

ex.en: Look, I'm not one of your lame ducks.
ex.cn: 听着，我可不像你手下的那些废物。

def: n.房东，地主,店主

ex.en: The landlord refused to serve him because he considered him too drunk.
ex.cn: 酒吧老板觉得他已经喝多了，拒绝再给他添酒。

ex.en: He was in an argument with his landlord downstairs.
ex.cn: 他与楼下的房东发生了争执。

ex.en: Larry's landlord threatened not to renew his lease.
ex.cn: 拉里的房东威胁说不跟他续租。

def: n.小路，小巷,航道，空中走廊，规定的单向行车道,车道,[篮球]罚球区

ex.en: The lorry was travelling at 20mph in the slow lane.
ex.cn: 卡车在慢车道上以20英里的时速行驶。

ex.en: Many people are comfortable with life in the slow lane.
ex.cn: 很多人满足于比别人慢半拍的生活。

ex.en: Sometimes they just drive slowly down the lane enjoying the scenery.
ex.cn: 有时他们只是沿着小路慢慢地开车，欣赏两旁的风景。

def: n.灯笼,灯塔,灯罩,灯饰

ex.en: I've been thinking I'd better have asked for a lantern.
ex.cn: 我一直认为我还不如要一个灯笼呢.

ex.en: There is an ice lantern show in Harbin every year in winter.
ex.cn: 每年冬天,哈尔滨有一次冰灯展.

ex.en: The child next door carried a lantern.
ex.cn: 隔壁的那个小孩提一个灯笼.

def:
vt.折叠,包裹，缠绕,使搭接,磨亮，磨平
vi.折叠,部分重叠,舔,包围
n.膝,下摆,一圈跑道,范围

ex.en: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
ex.cn: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

ex.en: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
ex.cn: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

ex.en: By half distance we held a comfortable two-lap lead.
ex.cn: 到半程时，我们轻松领先两圈。

def:
n.小错，疏忽,行为失检，失足,流逝,[法]（权利等的）失效，消失
vi.退步,陷入，堕入,失效，终止,[法]转归

ex.en: He knew that he might soon lapse into unconsciousness.
ex.cn: 他知道自己可能很快就会失去知觉。

ex.en: Ford allowed the name and trademark to lapse during the Eighties.
ex.cn: 福特在20世纪80年代废止了该名称和商标。

ex.en: a momentary lapse of concentration
ex.cn: 走神儿

def: n.便携式电脑

ex.en: She used to work at her laptop until four in the morning.
ex.cn: 她从前经常用手提电脑一直工作到凌晨4点。

ex.en: The device plugs into one of the laptop's USB ports.
ex.cn: 这个设备可以插入到笔记本电脑的一个通用串行总线接口。

ex.en: Simply power up your laptop and continue work.
ex.cn: 只需打开笔记本电脑继续工作即可。

def: n.激光,激光器，镭射器

ex.en: He made contact with someone with an idea for reconditioning laser copiers.
ex.cn: 他联系了一个会修理激光复印机的人。

ex.en: Ophthalmic surgeons are now performing laser surgery to correct myopia.
ex.cn: 眼科医生现在采用激光手术来矫正近视。

ex.en: The technical superiority of laser discs over tape is well established.
ex.cn: 激光影碟相对于磁带的技术优势早已牢牢确立。

def:
n.鞭挞，鞭子,责骂,讽刺,眼睫毛
vi.急速甩动,猛击,抽打,严厉谴责
vt.鞭打,摆动,激励，煽动,捆绑

ex.en: Never before had he felt the full lash of John's temper.
ex.cn: 他以前从未见识过约翰如此暴烈的脾气.

ex.en: He received a lash of her hand on his cheek.
ex.cn: 他突然被她打了一记耳光.

ex.en: Lash the piece of wood to the pole to make it longer.
ex.cn: 把这块木头绑到那根竿子上使它更长些.

def:
adj.潜在的,潜伏的,休眠的,潜意识的
n.指纹，指印

ex.en: It may also appeal to the latent chauvinism of many ordinary people.
ex.cn: 它可能也迎合了许多普通人心中的沙文主义情结。

ex.en: The European states retained a latent capability to menace Britain's own security.
ex.cn: 欧洲国家仍具有威胁英国自身安全的潜在能力。

ex.en: These children have a huge reserve of latent talent.
ex.cn: 这些孩子蕴藏着极大的潜在天赋。

def:
n.拉丁文,拉丁语，拉丁文学,拉丁美洲人,拉丁姆人
adj.拉丁的，拉丁语的,古罗马的,拉丁姆的,拉丁美洲的

ex.en: Carol is a tall, dark, Latin type of woman.
ex.cn: 卡萝尔身材高大，黑发棕肤，是个有着拉丁风情的女子。

ex.en: Latin and Greek will be squeezed out of school timetables.
ex.cn: 拉丁语和希腊语将退出学校的课程表。

ex.en: Above its doors was a Latin inscription: Non omnia possumus omnes.
ex.cn: 门的上方刻有拉丁文铭“人非万能”。

def: n.厕所,盥洗室,<宗>洗礼盆

ex.en: There's a bathroom and a lavatory upstairs.
ex.cn: 楼上有浴室和卫生间。

ex.en: Is there any lavatory in this building?
ex.cn: 这座楼里有厕所 吗 ?

ex.en: Is the lavatory vacant?
ex.cn: 厕所里没人 吧 ?

def: n.门外汉，外行,俗人,一般信徒

ex.en: These technical terms are difficult for the layman to understand.
ex.cn: 这些专门术语是外行人难以理解的.

ex.en: Where the law is concerned, I'm only a layman.
ex.cn: 就法律而言, 我只不过是一个门外汉.

ex.en: Where the law is concerned , I am only a layman.
ex.cn: 谈到法律, 我不过是门外汉.

def: n.布局，安排，设计,布置图，规划图

ex.en: This boat has a good deck layout making everything easy to operate.
ex.cn: 这艘船的甲板布局合理，使得所有操控都很方便。

ex.en: The layout should be clear and easy on the eye.
ex.cn: 版式应该清晰悦目。

ex.en: the layout of streets
ex.cn: 街道的布局

def:
n.传单，散页印刷品,小叶，嫩叶,复叶的一片,叶状器官
vt.& vi.散发传单

ex.en: Judy reached into her handbag and handed me a small printed leaflet.
ex.cn: 朱蒂把手伸进提包，拿出一张小的印刷传单给我。

ex.en: The leaflet is available free of charge from post offices.
ex.cn: 宣传单可以到邮局免费领取。

ex.en: The leaflet explains how to complain to the banking ombudsman.
ex.cn: 这份传单介绍了如何向银行意见调查官投诉。

def:
n.租约,租契,租赁物,租赁权
vt.出租,租借

ex.en: The operation has given me a new lease of life.
ex.cn: 手术使我重获新生。

ex.en: When the lease ran out the family moved to Campigny.
ex.cn: 租约到期后，这家人搬到了坎皮格尼。

ex.en: Tenants remain liable if they pass on their lease.
ex.cn: 如果房客将房子转租，他们仍承担责任。

def: n.遗产,遗赠

ex.en: She offered to settle a legacy on Katharine.
ex.cn: 她提出要把一笔遗产留给凯瑟琳。

ex.en: They are the most precious cultural legacy our forefathers left.
ex.cn: 它们是我们祖先留下来的最宝贵的文化遗产.

ex.en: The legacy of Ancient Rome represented the overwhelming influence on Romanesque architecture.
ex.cn: 古罗马的遗产体现在对罗马式建筑的巨大影响上.

def: n.透镜，镜头,眼睛中的水晶体,隐形眼镜,汽车的灯玻璃

ex.en: Why aren't all lenses supplied with a lens hood?
ex.cn: 为什么不给所有的镜头都配上遮光罩呢？

ex.en: The autoexposure button is awkwardly placed under the lens release button.
ex.cn: 自动曝光按钮安装在镜头脱卸按钮下面，十分不便。

ex.en: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
ex.cn: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

def:
n.征兵,征税
v.征收，索取,征税，征集

ex.en: It turns out Levy is talking in metaphorical terms.
ex.cn: 利维原来说的是一种比喻。

ex.en: A direct food levy was imposed by the local government.
ex.cn: 地方政府征收了食品税.

ex.en: They levy a tax on him.
ex.cn: 他们向他征税.

def: vt.解放,释放,释出，放出

ex.en: They did their best to liberate slaves.
ex.cn: 他们尽最大能力去解放奴隶.

ex.en: This will liberate him from economic worry.
ex.cn: 这将消除他经济上的忧虑.

ex.en: You should liberate the mind from prejudice.
ex.cn: 你该解除心中的偏见.

def:
vt.舔,<口>打败
vt.& vi.轻轻拍打,战胜
n.舔,一舐的量，少量

ex.en: You'll have four months in which to lick the recruits into shape.
ex.cn: 你将有4个月的时间把这些新兵训练出来。

ex.en: My room needed a lick of paint to freshen it up.
ex.cn: 我的房间只要刷一点油漆就能焕然一新。

ex.en: He might be able to lick us all in a fair fight.
ex.cn: 如果公平较量，他也许能将我们所有人都轻易打败。

def:
n.盖子,限制,[口]果盖,[口]遮盖
vt.给…盖盖子

ex.en: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
ex.cn: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

ex.en: The lid, turned upside down, served as a coffee table.
ex.cn: 那个盖子被翻过来当作咖啡桌。

ex.en: The soldiers' presence seemed to keep a lid on the violence.
ex.cn: 士兵的存在似乎抑制住了暴力活动。

def:
adj.闪电般的，快速的
n.闪电，雷电
vi.打闪

ex.en: It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
ex.cn: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

ex.en: Suddenly a bolt of lightning crackled through the sky.
ex.cn: 突然一道闪电划破长空。

ex.en: There was frequent thunder and lightning, and torrential rain.
ex.cn: 雷电交加，大雨倾盆。

def:
n.肢，翼,大树枝,分支,枝干
vt.割断…的四肢，肢解,砍树枝

ex.en: Try to rest the injured limb as much as possible.
ex.cn: 尽量不要活动受伤的手臂。

ex.en: She sat on a limb of the tree and looked down.
ex.cn: 她坐在一根大树枝上往下看.

ex.en: His refusal to agree left him out on a limb.
ex.cn: 他拒不表示同意,致使自己处于孤立地位.

def:
n.跛行,挣扎着慢慢前进,（诗的）韵律紊乱
vi.一瘸一拐地走,困难地航行
adj.无力的,无生气的,易弯的,松软的

ex.en: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
ex.cn: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

ex.en: He hit his head against a rock and went limp.
ex.cn: 他的头撞到一块岩石上，身子软了下来。

ex.en: She was told to reject applicants with limp handshakes.
ex.cn: 她被告知要回绝掉那些握手软弱无力的申请者。

def: adj.直线的，线形的,长度的,<数>一次的，线性的,通过单独的若干阶段来发展

ex.en: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
ex.cn: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

ex.en: He's making linear measurements.
ex.cn: 他正在进行长度测量.

ex.en: Her novel subverts the conventions of linear narrative. It has no neat chronology and no tidy denouement.
ex.cn: 她的小说颠覆了线性叙事的传统，没有清晰的时间线索，也没有简单明了的结局。

def: n.[计量] 公升（容量单位）

ex.en: Add 20 mg. of diatomaceous earth filter aid per liter of solution.
ex.cn: 对每升溶液加入20毫克硅藻土助滤剂.

ex.en: The bottle holds a liter of beer.
ex.cn: 这个瓶子装一升啤酒.

ex.en: This bottle holds one liter.
ex.cn: 这个瓶子装一升.

def: n.（容量单位）升

ex.en: New Japanese cars averaged 13 km to the litre in 1981.
ex.cn: 1981年，新型的日产汽车平均每升汽油能跑13千米。

ex.en: In that 2.7-litre form it really was a terrific racing car.
ex.cn: 其2.7升的车型确实是非常棒的赛车。

ex.en: This tax would raise petrol prices by about 3.5p per litre.
ex.cn: 这项税收会使每升汽油价格提高约3.5便士。

def:
n.杂物，垃圾,（一窝）幼崽,褥草,轿，担架
vt.& vi.使杂乱,乱丢杂物,乱扔,使饱含

ex.en: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.
ex.cn: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。

ex.en: Animals reject the runt of the litter.
ex.cn: 动物会丢弃最弱小的幼仔。

ex.en: Wear rubber gloves when handling cat litter.
ex.cn: 清理猫粪时要带上橡胶手套。

def:
n.肝脏,（食用）肝,深赤褐色,生活者
adj.肝味的,深赤褐色的

ex.en: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
ex.cn: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

ex.en: Liver cancer is linked to the hepatitis B virus.
ex.cn: 肝癌与乙肝病毒存在关联。

ex.en: These compounds bind with genetic material in the liver.
ex.cn: 这些化合物在肝脏中与遗传物质实现结合。

def:
n.一条（块）面包
v.游荡,游手好闲

ex.en: The proposal could put 3p on a loaf of bread.
ex.cn: 这项提议会使每个面包的成本增加3便士。

ex.en: The cost of a loaf of bread has increased five-fold.
ex.cn: 一条面包的价钱增长了4倍。

ex.en: Pick up a quart of milk or a loaf of bread.
ex.cn: 拿1夸脱牛奶或一条面包。

def: n.位置,地区,产地

ex.en: people living in the locality of the power station
ex.cn: 居住在发电站周围地区的人

ex.en: He surprised us with his knowledge of the locality.
ex.cn: 我们很惊讶他对那地方如此了解.

ex.en: This is the biggest hospital in the locality. It has 700 beds.
ex.cn: 这是本地最大的医院,该医院有七百张病床.

def: n.寄物柜,上锁的人,小橱,冷藏间

ex.en: At the swimming pool I put my clothes in a locker.
ex.cn: 在游泳池我把衣服锁在小柜里.

ex.en: A man in the gangway suddenly stood up to reach for something in the overhead locker.
ex.cn: 靠通道坐的一名男子突然起身去拿头顶上方行李舱里的什么东西。

ex.en: A woman reporter complained one of them sexually harassed her in the locker room.
ex.cn: 一名女记者投诉说，他们中有一人在更衣室里对她进行性骚扰。

def:
n.火车头,机车
adj.移动的,运动的

ex.en: The Locomotive Construction Company Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Trust.
ex.cn: 机车建筑有限公司是该托拉斯的全资子公司。

ex.en: He was killed by an onrushing locomotive.
ex.cn: 他被飞驰而来的火车头撞死了。

ex.en: A group of enthusiasts have undertaken the reconstruction of a steam locomotive.
ex.cn: 一群火车迷已担负起重造蒸汽机车的任务.

def:
vi.存放,暂住,埋入,（权利、权威等）归属
vt.提出（报告、要求、申诉等）,容纳,寄存,把（权利、权威等）授予
n.<古>小屋，草屋,（北美印第安人的）帐篷,（森林、猎场等的）看守小屋,（学校、工厂等的）传达室

ex.en: Authorities requisitioned hotel rooms to lodge more than 3,000 stranded Christmas vacationers.
ex.cn: 当局征用旅馆房间安顿了3,000多名无处落脚的圣诞度假者。

ex.en: I drove out of the gates, past the keeper's lodge.
ex.cn: 我驶出大门，经过守门人的小屋。

ex.en: My father would occasionally go to his Masonic lodge.
ex.cn: 我爸爸偶尔会到他的共济会分会那里去。

def: adj.高耸的，巍峨的,高尚的,傲慢的

ex.en: Victorian houses can seem cold with their lofty ceilings and rambling rooms.
ex.cn: 维多利亚式房屋屋顶高耸，房间布局凌乱，因此可能会显得较为阴冷。

ex.en: The room was light and lofty compared with our Tudor ones.
ex.cn: 跟我们都铎风格的房间比起来，这个房间显得素雅而大气。

ex.en: A mackerel sky and mares'tails make lofty ships carry low sails.
ex.cn: 鱼鳞天,马尾云,大船降帆莫航行.

def:
n.记录,日志,原木
v.伐木,把…载入正式记录,行驶

ex.en: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
ex.cn: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

ex.en: Customers pay to log on and gossip with other users.
ex.cn: 顾客付费后登录系统和其他用户聊天。

ex.en: I set the log on the ground and shaved off the bark.
ex.cn: 我将原木放到了地上，刨掉了树皮。

def: n.经度，经线,[天]黄经

ex.en: the longitude of the island
ex.cn: 那座岛的经度

ex.en: All places on the same meridian have the same longitude.
ex.cn: 在同一子午线上的地方都有相同的经度.

ex.en: The longitude of New York is 74 degrees west of Greenwich.
ex.cn: 纽约的经度是西经74度.

def:
n.圈，环,[医]宫内避孕环,回路,弯曲部分
vt.& vi.（使）成环，（使）成圈,以环连结,使翻筋斗

ex.en: I think that the vice president was in the loop.
ex.cn: 我认为副总统是局内人。

ex.en: These activists don't want to feel out of the loop.
ex.cn: 这些活跃分子不想做局外人。

ex.en: The road went in a huge loop around the lake.
ex.cn: 那条路环湖绕了一个大圈。

def:
adj.松的，宽的,模糊的,散漫的,自由的
vt.释放,不受约束地表达,松开,射出（子弹、箭等）
vi.变得松散,发射导弹,开火
adv.散漫地
n.解放,放任,发射

ex.en: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
ex.cn: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

ex.en: She gathered loose soil and let it filter slowly through her fingers.
ex.cn: 她捧起疏松的泥土，任其缓缓地从指间漏下。

ex.en: She was pretty and young, in a loose smocked sundress.
ex.cn: 她年轻貌美，一身宽松的刺绣太阳裙。

def: n.运货汽车，机动卡车

ex.en: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
ex.cn: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

ex.en: They used a lorry to ram the main gate.
ex.cn: 他们用卡车猛撞大门。

ex.en: The lorry driver escaped unhurt, but a pedestrian was injured.
ex.cn: 卡车司机安然脱险，但有一位行人受了伤。

def: n.扩音器，扬声器,喇叭,扬场器

ex.en: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
ex.cn: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

ex.en: Announcements were made over the loudspeaker system.
ex.cn: 通知通过喇叭广播。

ex.en: Their names were called over the loudspeaker .
ex.cn: 喇叭里叫着他们的名字。

def: n.忠诚，忠实,忠心,忠于…感情

ex.en: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
ex.cn: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

ex.en: There were too many other demands on his loyalty now.
ex.cn: 现在还有太多其他的事情也要求他忠心。

ex.en: In his diary of 1944 he proclaims unswerving loyalty to the monarchy.
ex.cn: 他在1944年的日记里声称对君主忠贞不贰。

def:
vt.加油润滑,使润滑
vi.润滑

ex.en: Franklin's task was to lubricate the discussions with the French.
ex.cn: 富兰克林的任务是促使与法国方面的会谈顺畅进行。

ex.en: Mineral oils are used to lubricate machinery.
ex.cn: 矿物油被用来润滑机器。

ex.en: Do not use emollients or oils to lubricate the skin.
ex.cn: 不要用润肤剂或油类来润滑皮肤。

def:
n.木材,隆隆声,废物
vt.& vi.砍伐,笨重地行进,胡乱堆积

ex.en: It was made of soft lumber, spruce by the look of it.
ex.cn: 其制作材料是软木，看起来像是云杉。

ex.en: The truck was sent to carry lumber.
ex.cn: 卡车被派出去运木材.

ex.en: He was going to have to purchase all his lumber at full retail price.
ex.cn: 他将不得不把所有木材按零售价分文不少地买下来。

def: adj.月的，月球的,阴历的,（光）苍白的，微弱的,银的，含银的

ex.en: The astronauts piloted their craft down to the lunar surface.
ex.cn: 宇航员驾驶太空飞船在月球表面降落.

ex.en: The lunar stone is different from earth's.
ex.cn: 月球的石头和地球的不同.

ex.en: The Spring Festival is the lunar New Year.
ex.cn: 春节即农历新年.

def:
n.魔法,巫术,戏法,不可思议的魔力
adj.魔术的,幻术的,不可思议的,有奇异魔力的
v.用魔法变出,用魔法摆脱,用魔法得到,使中邪

ex.en: It infected them with some of the magic of a lost age.
ex.cn: 逝去的岁月让他们平添了几分魅力。

ex.en: There is no magic formula for producing winning products.
ex.cn: 获奖电影的制作没有捷径可取。

ex.en: The picture will now appear, as if by magic!
ex.cn: 这幅画立刻就会出现，好像变魔术一般！

def: n.地方法官，治安官,文职官员,治安推事

ex.en: He was wanted for the murder of a magistrate.
ex.cn: 他因谋杀一名地方法官而被通缉。

ex.en: The crown court, however, upheld the magistrate's decision.
ex.cn: 然而，最高法院维持了地方法院的判决。

ex.en: The magistrate committed him to prison for a month.
ex.cn: 法官判处他一个月监禁.

def: n.磁铁，磁石,有吸引力的人或物,[物]磁体

ex.en: Open wounds act like a magnet to flies.
ex.cn: 裸露的伤口很招苍蝇。

ex.en: In the 1990s the area became a magnet for new investment.
ex.cn: 这个地区在20世纪90年代成了新的投资热点。

ex.en: He picked all the pins up with a magnet.
ex.cn: 他用磁铁捡起了所有的大头针.

def:
vt.放大,赞美,夸大,夸奖
vi.放大,有放大能力

ex.en: He tried to magnify the part he played in the battle.
ex.cn: 他试图夸大他在战斗中发挥的作用.

ex.en: My soul does magnify the Lord.
ex.cn: 我的心确实是赞美上帝的.

ex.en: Telescopes and microscopes magnify.
ex.cn: 望远镜和显微镜能放大.

def:
n.未婚女子,处女,断头机,未得分的投球
adj.处女的，少女的,首次的，初次的,没有经验的

ex.en: The prince fell in love with a fair young maiden.
ex.cn: 王子爱上了一位年轻美丽的少女.

ex.en: The aircraft makes its maiden flight tomorrow.
ex.cn: 这架飞机明天首航.

ex.en: Her maiden name is Li.
ex.cn: 她娘家姓李.

def: n.主权，统治权,陛下，王权,庄严，雄伟,光轮中的耶稣（圣母、上帝）圣像

ex.en: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service.
ex.cn: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

ex.en: After touring the hospital, Her Majesty unveiled a commemorative plaque.
ex.cn: 女王陛下巡视完这家医院后，为纪念匾揭了幕。

ex.en: I quite agree, Your Majesty.
ex.cn: 我十分赞成，陛下。

def:
adj.恶性的，致命的,恶意的，恶毒的
n.怀有恶意的人,<英史>保王党员

ex.en: She developed a malignant breast tumour.
ex.cn: 她长了一个恶性的乳房肿瘤。

ex.en: Alexander got a malignant slander.
ex.cn: 亚历山大受到恶意的诽谤.

ex.en: He was died of a malignant tumour.
ex.cn: 他死于恶性肿瘤.

def: n.哺乳动物

ex.en: Its hairy body suggests a mammal.
ex.cn: 它毛茸茸的身体表明它是哺乳动物。

ex.en: The function of a mammal's fur is to insulate the body.
ex.cn: 哺乳动物皮毛的功能在于使身体保温.

ex.en: A whale is a kind of mammal.
ex.cn: 鲸是一种哺乳动物.

def:
n.调遣，换防，对抗演习，操纵,技术动作,策略，巧计,花招，伎俩
vt.调遣,操纵，控制,诱使，策划

ex.en: With an election looming, he has little room for manoeuvre.
ex.cn: 随着大选临近，他几乎没有什么回旋的余地了。

ex.en: We attempted to manoeuvre the canoe closer to him.
ex.cn: 我们试图让独木舟靠他更近一些。

ex.en: Some analysts believe he has made a canny political manoeuvre.
ex.cn: 一些分析家认为，他的这一政治举措很高明。

def:
v.& n.机动，演习
n.策略，谋略，花招
vi.移动，用策略
vt.操纵

ex.en: She tried to maneuver her body into a more comfortable position.
ex.cn: 她试着把身子挪了挪，换了一个较为舒服的姿势。

ex.en: This maneuver of his is a diabolical conspiracy.
ex.cn: 他这一手是一个居心叵测的大阴谋.

ex.en: It's a maneuver to deflect the attention of the people from what is really happening.
ex.cn: 这是为将公众的注意力从真正发生的事情上转移开而耍的花招。

def:
n.大理石,大理石制品,弹子游戏,理智，常识
adj.大理石的,冷酷无情的,有大理石花纹的
v.把（书边）弄上大理石花纹

ex.en: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
ex.cn: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

ex.en: A marble entrance hall leads to a sitting room.
ex.cn: 大理石门厅通往起居室。

ex.en: They had to cross the large marble-floored hall.
ex.cn: 他们得穿过一个铺有大理石地面的宽敞大厅。

def: adj.婚姻的，夫妻（间）的

ex.en: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
ex.cn: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

ex.en: They cited Alex's refusal to return to the marital home.
ex.cn: 他们引证了亚历克斯拒绝回到婚后的家中一事。

ex.en: Caroline was keen to make her marital home in London.
ex.cn: 卡罗琳渴望婚后把家安在伦敦。

def: adj.引起惊异的,不可思议的,非凡的,神乎其神

ex.en: "Isn't this marvelous?" she cooed.
ex.cn: “这是不是太不可思议了？”她低声说。

ex.en: He was on fire with this marvelous sight.
ex.cn: 看到这一令人叹为观止的景象，他激动万分。

ex.en: The marvelous acting compensated for the play's weak script.
ex.cn: 本剧的精彩表演弥补了剧本的不足.

def:
n.马克思主义者
adj.马克思主义的

ex.en: He applies the Marxist world view dogmatically to all social phenomena.
ex.cn: 他将马克思主义的世界观教条地应用到所有的社会现象中去。

ex.en: This revisionist thesis departs even further from Marxist assertions.
ex.cn: 这篇修正主义的论文更加偏离了马克思主义的主张。

ex.en: The film retells the famous legend with a Marxist spin.
ex.cn: 这部电影用马克思主义的观点重述了那个著名的传说.

def: n.杰作，名作,杰出的事

ex.en: The whole thing was a masterpiece of crowd management.
ex.cn: 整件事情就是人群管理的典范。

ex.en: The coach was a masterpiece of Teutonic engineering.
ex.cn: 这种长途汽车是体现德国工程设计水平的杰作。

ex.en: The report is a masterpiece of brevity.
ex.cn: 那份报告是言简意赅的典范。

def:
n.席子，垫子,（体育运动用的）厚垫子,衬边,团，簇
vt.遮盖，用垫子作装饰,使…缠结,给（照片）镶框,使…表面无光
vi.缠结
adj.粗糙的,暗淡的，无光泽的

ex.en: She touched the thick mat of sandy hair on his chest.
ex.cn: 她摸着他那浓密的淡棕色胸毛。

ex.en: Bring a sleeping bag and foam mat.
ex.cn: 带上睡袋和泡沫垫。

ex.en: There was a letter on the mat.
ex.cn: 地毯上有一封信。

def: n.草地,牧场

ex.en: In the spring, the meadow is a mass of daffodils.
ex.cn: 春天，草地上开满了黄水仙。

ex.en: We punted up towards Grantchester and had a picnic in a meadow.
ex.cn: 我们乘坐平底长船溯河而上到格兰切斯特，在草地上举行野餐。

ex.en: lambs gambolling in the meadow
ex.cn: 在草地上蹦蹦跳跳的小羊羔

def:
n.其时，其间
adv.同时，其间

ex.en: In the meantime the war of nerves seems likely to continue.
ex.cn: 与此同时，心理战似乎还可能继续。

ex.en: I'll contact them soon. Meantime don't tell them I'm back.
ex.cn: 我会尽快和他们联系。在此期间，不要告诉他们我回来了。

ex.en: Meantime he was loading the pistols.
ex.cn: 而同时他在往手枪里装子弹.

def:
vi.沉思,打算
vt.深思,策划

ex.en: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
ex.cn: 这时我就会试着沉思或者做些深呼吸练习。

ex.en: It is important to meditate on the meaning of life.
ex.cn: 思考人生的意义很重要.

ex.en: It was only to sit in his own rooms in a neighbouring hotel and meditate.
ex.cn: 那不过是要坐在附近旅馆他自己的房间里沉思默想罢了.

def: n.默想,默念,沉思,冥想

ex.en: The title track is a pointed meditation on a continent gone wrong.
ex.cn: 主打歌是对一个误入歧途的大陆的深刻沉思。

ex.en: A study of yoga leads naturally to meditation.
ex.cn: 学习瑜伽自然会发展到进行冥想。

ex.en: She found peace through yoga and meditation.
ex.cn: 她通过瑜伽和冥想找到了宁静。

def: n.旋律，曲调,美妙的音乐，和谐的调子,好听的声音,歌曲

ex.en: The melody that ran through his brain was composed of bad notes.
ex.cn: 回荡在他脑海里的旋律都走调了。

ex.en: The melody is then taken up by the flutes.
ex.cn: 接着由长笛奏主旋律。

ex.en: She struck up a folk melody on the piano.
ex.cn: 她开始用钢琴演奏那首民歌.

def: n.甜瓜,圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西

ex.en: Next, she disembowelled a melon with a quiet fury.
ex.cn: 接着，她闷着头愤愤地掏空瓜瓤。

ex.en: Cut the melon into chunks.
ex.cn: 把瓜切块。

ex.en: a slice of melon
ex.cn: 一片瓜

def: n.备忘录,（美）内部通知

ex.en: The memo ends: "Please give this matter your most urgent attention."
ex.cn: 备忘录的结尾写道：“请将此事作为亟待处理事项。”

ex.en: She penned a short memo to his private secretary.
ex.cn: 她给他的私人秘书写了一份简短的备忘录。

ex.en: The entire memo took up all of two pages.
ex.cn: 整个备忘录写了满满两页纸。

def:
n.商品,货物
vt.买卖,销售
vi.经商

ex.en: The merchandise is reasonably priced and offers exceptionally good value.
ex.cn: 这些商品定价合理，很是划算。

ex.en: Merchandise can now circulate freely among the EU countries.
ex.cn: 商品现在可以在欧盟各国自由流通。

ex.en: They had shoplifted thousands of dollars' worth of merchandise.
ex.cn: 他们已经偷了商店价值好几千美元的商品。

def:
n.商人,批发商,店主,零售商
adj.商人的,商业的

ex.en: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake.
ex.cn: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

ex.en: "How many times have I heard that before?" Merchant complained angrily.
ex.cn: “我听过有多少次了？”麦钱特生气地抱怨道。

ex.en: They sent naval forces to protect merchant shipping.
ex.cn: 他们派出了海军保护商船。

def: vt.& vi.（使）混合,相融,融入,渐渐消失在某物中

ex.en: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background.
ex.cn: 他就像一条变色龙，可以神不知鬼不觉地隐藏在背景中间。

ex.en: The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system.
ex.cn: 就在一个重要的灌溉系统的北边，这些河流交汇在一起。

ex.en: Many companies merge and few demerge.
ex.cn: 有很多公司合并，而分立的却很少。

def: n.隐喻，暗喻,象征

ex.en: Despite the mixed metaphor, there is some truth in this judgement.
ex.cn: 尽管有混用的比喻，这个判断还是有些道理的。

ex.en: a game of football used as a metaphor for the competitive struggle of life
ex.cn: 用来喻指生活中的激烈斗争的一场足球比赛

ex.en: 'This vale of tears'is a metaphor for the human condition.
ex.cn: “ 眼泪的溪谷 ” 是尘世的比喻说法.

def:
adj.米制的，公制的，十进制的,度量的,距离的
n.度量标准,[数学]度量,诗体，韵文，诗韵

ex.en: The Wall Street Journal uses 220,000 metric tons of newsprint each year.
ex.cn: 《华尔街日报》每年用去22万公吨新闻纸。

ex.en: We are gradually changing over to a completely metric system.
ex.cn: 我们正逐渐过渡到完全使用公制。

ex.en: The Customs Service seized 27.2 metric tons of cocaine in 1986.
ex.cn: 1986年海关截获了27.2公吨的可卡因。

def: n.扩音器，麦克风,话筒

ex.en: He wore a hidden microphone to secretly tape-record conversations.
ex.cn: 他身上藏了一个传声器，打算偷偷录下谈话内容。

ex.en: All you need is a microphone, and you're in business.
ex.cn: 再来一只麦克风，你就万事俱备了。

ex.en: My hand shook so much that I could hardly hold the microphone.
ex.cn: 我的手抖得如此厉害，几乎都拿不住麦克风了。

def:
n.磨坊,磨粉机,榨汁机,工厂
vt.研磨，粉碎,搅拌,磨，铣,轧花边（在纸币上）
vi.惊跑，乱闯,经研磨

ex.en: I was just a very average run-of-the-mill kind of student.
ex.cn: 我只是一个普普通通的学生。

ex.en: They mill 1,000 tonnes of flour a day in every Australian state.
ex.cn: 澳大利亚各州每天都要磨1,000吨面粉。

ex.en: For many they clearly represent an alternative to run-of-the-mill estate cars.
ex.cn: 对于很多人来说，他们显然可以作为一般旅行车的替代品。

def:
n.百万富翁,大富翁,大财主,有钱人
adj.100万以上人口的

ex.en: His catering business made him a millionaire at 41.
ex.cn: 他的饮食服务公司使他在41岁成了百万富翁。

ex.en: By the time he died, he was a millionaire.
ex.cn: 到他去世的时候，他已经是一位百万富翁了。

ex.en: Jackie sees the comedy in her millionaire husband's thrifty habits.
ex.cn: 杰姬觉得自己的百万富翁丈夫的一些节俭习惯很是滑稽。

def:
vt.& vi.混合，混淆
vi.混进，与…交往

ex.en: Go out of your way to mingle with others at the wedding.
ex.cn: 去跟婚礼上的其他人聊聊。

ex.en: One of the hostess's duties is to mingle with the guests.
ex.cn: 女主人的职责之一是与客人们交际.

ex.en: Several streams mingle in this river on their way to the sea.
ex.cn: 几条小溪在注入大海的途中汇入这条河.

def:
adj.小型的，微小的
n.微型复制品,微小模型,微型画,微型人像画
vt.使成小型,把…画成纤细画,缩写

ex.en: He activated the door with the miniature sonic transmitter.
ex.cn: 他用微型声波发射器开启了门。

ex.en: His home in Bexley is tucked away in a miniature forest.
ex.cn: 他在贝克斯利的住宅坐落在一片小森林中。

ex.en: If it can be done full-size, I can do it in miniature.
ex.cn: 如果可以做成与原物相同大小的，我就可以做成缩微的。

def: vt.把…减至最低数量[程度],对（某事物）作最低估计，极力贬低（某事物）的价值[重要性],极度轻视

ex.en: Concerned people want to minimize the risk of developing cancer.
ex.cn: 相关人员希望尽可能降低罹癌风险。

ex.en: Click the square icon again to minimize the window.
ex.cn: 再次点击正方形图标，把窗口最小化。

ex.en: To minimize collateral damage maximum precision in bombing was required.
ex.cn: 为了尽量减低附带性破坏，轰炸须做到最大程度的精确。

def: n.（政府的）部,神职,牧师职位,神职任期

ex.en: The Ministry desperately tried to hush up the whole affair.
ex.cn: 部里拼命想隐瞒整个事件。

ex.en: People accused the ministry of failing to take adequate preventive measures.
ex.cn: 人们谴责该政府部门未能采取足够的预防措施。

ex.en: Efforts to reform the Interior Ministry have not yet proceeded very far.
ex.cn: 对内政部进行改革的尝试还没有取得很大进展。

def: n.少数,少数民族,未成年

ex.en: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.
ex.cn: 少数官员准备篡改规则。

ex.en: Only a minority of the people supported the Revolution.
ex.cn: 只有少数人支持这场革命。

ex.en: In the past conservatives have been in the minority.
ex.cn: 过去保守派一直占少数。

def:
prep.（表示否定）没有,缺少,（表示运算）减去,（表示数目）在零度以下
n.减号,负号,不利,不足
adj.负的,不利的,略低于某标准的

ex.en: The star's surface temperature is reckoned to be minus 75 degrees Celsius.
ex.cn: 这颗恒星的表面温度估计在零下75摄氏度左右。

ex.en: The film company collapsed, leaving Chris jobless and minus his life savings.
ex.cn: 电影公司垮了，克里斯没了工作，也失去了他一生的积蓄。

ex.en: None of these minus points will have been mentioned.
ex.cn: 这些不利因素都不会被提及。

def: n.奇迹，圣迹，神迹,令人惊奇的人（或事）

ex.en: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
ex.cn: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

ex.en: The 1981 budget was the springboard for an economic miracle.
ex.cn: 1981年的预算促成了一场经济奇迹的出现。

ex.en: The Italian economic miracle has always been a mystery.
ex.cn: 意大利的经济奇迹一直是个谜。

def: n.损害，危害,顽皮，淘气,恶作剧,祸根

ex.en: James Fox is best known as the author of White Mischief.
ex.cn: 詹姆斯·福克斯以《欲望城》一书最为出名.

ex.en: The letter had come from an unknown mischief-maker.
ex.cn: 这封信来自一个匿名的离间者。

ex.en: His eyes were full of mischief.
ex.cn: 他的眼中满是狡黠。

def:
n.导弹,投射物
adj.导弹的,可投掷的,用以发射导弹的

ex.en: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
ex.cn: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

ex.en: The guidance systems didn't work and the missile couldn't hit its target.
ex.cn: 导航系统失灵，导弹未能命中目标。

ex.en: They claimed to have shot down one incoming missile.
ex.cn: 他们声称击落了一枚来犯的导弹。

def:
n.传教士,宣传者
adj.传教（士）的

ex.en: An American missionary was released today after more than two months of captivity.
ex.cn: 一位美国传教士在被关押两个多月后于今天获释。

ex.en: She had a kind of missionary zeal about bringing culture to the masses.
ex.cn: 她对于向大众传播文化有着满腔的热忱。

ex.en: NB The opinions stated in this essay do not necessarily represent those of the Church of God Missionary Society.
ex.cn: 请注意：文中所述观点并不代表传教会的立场。

def:
n.薄雾,视线模糊不清,液体喷雾
vt.（使）蒙上薄雾,（使）模糊
vi.下雾,变模糊

ex.en: I stepped outside and pulled up my collar against the cold mist.
ex.cn: 我走出门，竖起衣领抵御冷雾。

ex.en: He recognized the coast of England through a veil of mist.
ex.cn: 透过薄雾他认出了那是英格兰的海岸线。

ex.en: With a thick mist now blanketing the trees, I got thoroughly lost.
ex.cn: 此时浓雾笼罩着林木，我彻底迷路了。

def: n.主妇，女主人,霸主，女统治者,情妇,<英>女教师

ex.en: Anthony sometimes felt that his mistress was his superior in will-power.
ex.cn: 有时安东尼感觉他的情妇比他更有意志力。

ex.en: She had always been mistress of her own destiny.
ex.cn: 她总是能够掌握自己的命运。

ex.en: We had a very good mathematics mistress who pulled me up.
ex.cn: 我们有个很出色的女数学老师，她帮我提高了水平。

def:
vt.以呻吟声说出,悲叹,抱怨,哀悼
n.呻吟声,悲叹声,（尤指风的）呼啸声
vi.呻吟,发出呻吟般的凄切声,悲叹,抱怨

ex.en: You can go see him and have a good old moan.
ex.cn: 你可以去看看他，好好地诉诉苦。

ex.en: Suddenly she gave a low, choking moan and began to tremble violently.
ex.cn: 突然，她发出了一声低沉而哽咽的呻吟，然后剧烈地颤抖起来。

ex.en: I loathe negativity. I can't stand people who moan.
ex.cn: 我厌恶消极态度，不能忍受唉声叹气的人。

def:
n.暴徒,犯罪团伙，黑手党,民众，乌合之众,〈美俚〉匪帮，一群罪犯
vt.聚众包围,大举包围，围攻,蜂拥进入

ex.en: An unruly mob broke down police barricades and stormed the courtroom.
ex.cn: 一伙暴徒捣毁了警察设置的路障冲进法庭。

ex.en: Bottles and cans were hurled on the terraces by the mob.
ex.cn: 暴徒向看台扔瓶子和罐子。

ex.en: A mob of women laid into him with handbags and pointed shoes.
ex.cn: 一帮女人用手提包砸他，用鞋尖踢他。

def: vt.& vi.动员起来，调动，鼓动起

ex.en: India is now in a better position to mobilise its forces.
ex.cn: 印度现在更有条件动员军队了。

ex.en: The purpose of the journey is to mobilise public opinion on the controversial issue.
ex.cn: 此行的目的就是动员公众对这个备受争议的问题发表意见。

ex.en: With its command economy, China is able to mobilise resources on a massive scale at speed.
ex.cn: 由于其相对集中的经济体系, 中国可以高速地大规模调用资源.

def:
vt.调动,动员,组织，动员起来
vi.动员起来

ex.en: Sudan even threat-ened to mobilize in response to the ultima-tums.
ex.cn: 作为对最后通牒的回应，苏丹甚至威胁说要动员军队。

ex.en: If you could mobilize the resources, you could get it done.
ex.cn: 如果你能够调集资源，就可以把这件事做成。

ex.en: He helped energize and mobilize millions of people around the nation.
ex.cn: 他帮助激励和动员了全国数百万人。

def:
vt.& vi.愚弄，嘲弄
vt.使受挫折,不尊重，蔑视
adj.仿制的,模拟的,虚假的,不诚实的
n.（英国）模拟考试

ex.en: He screwed his face into an expression of mock pain.
ex.cn: 他面部扭曲，假装疼痛。

ex.en: There's a mock-up of the high street where the Goodwins go shopping.
ex.cn: 古德温一家前往购物的那条大街有一个街景模型。

ex.en: "Flatterer," she said giving him a mock reproving look.
ex.cn: “马屁精，”她饱含嘲弄和责备地看了他一眼，说道。

def: n.模块,组件,（宇宙飞船上各个独立的）舱,测量流水等的单位

ex.en: They have docked a robot module alongside the orbiting space station.
ex.cn: 他们已经将一个自动操作舱与沿轨道运行的空间站并行对接上了。

ex.en: He has 250 students in his microeconomics module.
ex.cn: 他的微观经济学授课单元有250名学生。

ex.en: While one of the astronauts went round the moon in the command module, the other went down to the surface in the lunar module.
ex.cn: 当其中一名宇航员在指挥舱中环绕月球飞行时, 另一名宇航员在登月舱中降落到月球表面.

def: adj.潮湿的,微湿的,多雨的,含泪的

ex.en: The outside air was heavy and moist and sultry.
ex.cn: 外面的空气沉滞、潮湿而闷热。

ex.en: Leave a vent open to let some moist air escape.
ex.cn: 打开一个通风口，让潮气逸出一些。

ex.en: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
ex.cn: 保持土壤湿润，那样幼苗就能茁壮成长。

def: n.水分,湿气,潮湿,降雨量

ex.en: A thin, glistening thread of moisture ran along the rough concrete sill.
ex.cn: 在粗糙不平的水泥窗台上有一条细细的发光水印。

ex.en: When the soil is dry, more moisture is lost from the plant.
ex.cn: 土壤干燥时，植物会流失更多的水分。

ex.en: The cells will promptly start to soak up moisture.
ex.cn: 细胞会立即开始吸收水分。

def: n.[物]动量,势头,动力,要素，契机

ex.en: Demands for his dismissal have gathered momentum in recent weeks.
ex.cn: 最近几周，要求将他解职的呼声越来越高。

ex.en: The fight for his release gathers momentum each day.
ex.cn: 争取使他获释的斗争声势日益加强。

ex.en: The sledge gained momentum as it ran down the hill.
ex.cn: 雪橇从山上下冲时的动力越来越大.

def: n.君主，帝王,最高统治者,[动]黑脉金斑蝶

ex.en: a monarch without political power
ex.cn: 没有政治权力的君主

ex.en: The monarch's role is purely ceremonial.
ex.cn: 君主纯粹是个礼仪职位.

ex.en: The monarch was ousted by a military coup.
ex.cn: 那君主被军事政变者废黜了.

def: adj.（声音，话语）单调的，无抑扬顿挫的,枯燥无味的

ex.en: Closures and job losses are again being announced with monotonous regularity.
ex.cn: 倒闭和失业的消息又在一次次地反复宣布着。

ex.en: It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.
ex.cn: 与工厂大部分工作一样，这份工作也很单调乏味。

ex.en: Aircraft passed overhead with monotonous regularity .
ex.cn: 飞机一次又一次反复从头顶飞过。

def: n.纪念碑,遗迹,遗址,丰碑

ex.en: As Wren's epitaph famously declares, the cathedral itself is his monument.
ex.cn: 众所周知，雷恩的墓志铭中写道，大教堂本身就是他的纪念碑。

ex.en: By his international achievements he leaves a fitting monument to his beliefs.
ex.cn: 他在国际上的成就为其信念作出了最好的注解。

ex.en: The monument predates the arrival of the druids in Britain.
ex.cn: 这一遗迹在德鲁伊特来到不列颠前就已存在。

def:
adj.致命的,不共戴天的,终有一死的,极度的
n.凡人，人类

ex.en: When self-esteem is high, we lose our mortal fear of jealousy.
ex.cn: 自信心很强时，我们不再对妒忌感到极度惧怕。

ex.en: Adultery is a mortal sin.
ex.cn: 通奸是不可饶恕的罪孽。

ex.en: We are all mortal.
ex.cn: 我们都总有一死。

def:
n.抵押,抵押单据，抵押证明,抵押权，债权
vt.抵押

ex.en: Jennie took in a lodger to help with the mortgage.
ex.cn: 珍妮收了一个房客，以减轻按揭的负担。

ex.en: Thousands of its customers are in arrears with loans and mortgage payments.
ex.cn: 有数千客户拖欠其贷款和抵押贷款还款。

ex.en: The recent rebound in mortgage rates could snuff out the housing recovery.
ex.cn: 抵押贷款利率最近的回升可能会扼杀房地产的复苏。

def:
n.马赛克,镶嵌图案,镶嵌工艺,[植]花叶病
adj.摩西的,拼花的
vt.镶嵌,用马赛克装饰

ex.en: a design in mosaic
ex.cn: 马赛克图案

ex.en: The sky this morning is a mosaic of blue and white.
ex.cn: 今天早上的天空是幅蓝白相间的画面.

ex.en: I was admiring the exquisite workmanship in the mosaic.
ex.cn: 我当时正在欣赏镶嵌画的精致做工.

def: n.蚊子

ex.en: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.
ex.cn: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

ex.en: Avoiding mosquito bites is easier said than done.
ex.cn: 防蚊叮咬好说难做。

ex.en: A mosquito had bitten her and her arm had swollen up.
ex.cn: 蚊子叮了她,她的手臂肿起来了.

def:
n.苔藓,藓沼,莫斯（男子名）,泥炭沼
vt.以苔藓覆盖,使长满苔藓
abbr.[宇](=manned orbital space station)载人轨道航天站

ex.en: "We've got the car that killed Myra Moss." — "What!"
ex.cn: “我们已经找到撞死迈拉·莫斯的车了。”——“真的！”

ex.en: Moss had clamped an unexpectedly strong grip on his arm.
ex.cn: 莫斯突然紧紧抓住他的手臂。

ex.en: The moss was soft and furry to the touch.
ex.cn: 苔藓柔软，摸起来像绒毛。

def: n.汽车旅馆

ex.en: He took off at once and headed back to the motel.
ex.cn: 他立刻离开，回到汽车旅馆。

ex.en: His abhorrence of racism led him to write The Algiers Motel Incident.
ex.cn: 对种族主义的憎恨促使他写了《阿尔及尔汽车旅馆事件》一书。

ex.en: Motel owners and restaurant managers copped it for neglecting their clients.
ex.cn: 汽车旅馆老板和饭店经理因为冷落顾客而受到责骂。

def:
vi.哀痛,服丧,咕哝
vt.表示深深的遗憾,哀悼,悲哀地说

ex.en: When the government is finally brought down, no one will mourn its passing.
ex.cn: 当政府最终垮台之日，将不会有人为它的消亡而悲哀。

ex.en: As the nation continued to mourn, the new President of South Africa paid his own tribute.
ex.cn: 举国仍在哀悼之际，南非新任总统也表达了自己的怀念之情。

ex.en: Blessed are they that mourn, for they -- they -- "
ex.cn: 有福的人是那些哀恸的人, 因为他们 —— 他们 —— ”

def:
n.咕哝，发牢骚,低声的抱怨,低声说话
vt.& vi.小声说
vi.发出连续而低沉的声音,私下抱怨

ex.en: The piano music mixes with the murmur of conversation.
ex.cn: 钢琴的弹奏声混杂着低低的交谈声。

ex.en: The doctor said James had now deve-loped a heart murmur.
ex.cn: 医生说詹姆斯的心脏有杂音。

ex.en: The droning murmur of the doctor's voice in the bedroom had ceased.
ex.cn: 卧室里医生喋喋不休的低语声已经停下了。

def: adj.肌肉的,壮健的，肌肉发达的，强壮的

ex.en: He was wearing shorts which showed his long, muscular, hairy legs.
ex.cn: 他穿着短裤，露出自己强壮多毛的长腿。

ex.en: Foods and fluids are mixed in the stomach by its muscular contractions.
ex.cn: 通过胃部肌肉的收缩食物和流质在胃中混合。

ex.en: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
ex.cn: 冠状动脉的肌肉痉挛可能导致心脏病。

def:
n.蘑菇,蘑菇状物，蘑菇形物体,（女用）蘑菇形草帽,暴发户
adj.蘑菇的,蘑菇形的,迅速生长的,雨后蘑菇似的
vi.迅速增长,采蘑菇,迅速增加,（火）猛然的扩大

ex.en: cream of mushroom soup
ex.cn: 奶油蘑菇汤

ex.en: a cheese and mushroom omelette
ex.cn: 奶酪蘑菇蛋饼

ex.en: a ham and mushroom pizza
ex.cn: 火腿蘑菇比萨饼

def:
vt.& vi.轻声低语，咕哝地抱怨,含糊地说,自言自语地说
n.咕哝,小声低语，小声抱怨,怨言

ex.en: They make no more than a mutter of protest.
ex.cn: 他们只不过是低声抗议了一下。

ex.en: They shake their heads and mutter darkly.
ex.cn: 他们一边摇头，一边阴沉地小声嘀咕。

ex.en: I heard a mutter of discontent.
ex.cn: 我听到有人小声咕哝着表示不满.

def: n.羊肉,绵羊

ex.en: He likes to eat mutton which was seasoned with garlic.
ex.cn: 他喜欢吃用大蒜调味的羊肉.

ex.en: We had roast mutton for dinner.
ex.cn: 我们晚餐吃烤羊肉.

ex.en: I'll grill you some mutton.
ex.cn: 我来给你烤一些羊肉吃.

def: adj.裸体的，裸露的,率直的，赤裸裸的,缺乏保护,不加掩饰的

ex.en: The worms cannot be seen by the naked eye.
ex.cn: 这些虫子用肉眼看不见。

ex.en: The planet Mars will be visible to the naked eye all week.
ex.cn: 整周都可以用肉眼观察到火星。

ex.en: Her naked body was found wrapped in a sheet in a field.
ex.cn: 在田里发现了她的尸体，全身赤裸，裹在一条床单里。

def: adv.即，也就是,换句话说,亦即,就是说

ex.en: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.
ex.cn: 那本书的灵感源于一个真实人物，即塔玛拉·德特罗。

ex.en: One group of people seems to be forgotten, namely pensioners.
ex.cn: 有一类人似乎被遗忘了，就是那些领养老金的人。

ex.en: We need to concentrate on our target audience, namely women aged between 20 and 30.
ex.cn: 我们须针对我们的听众对象，即年龄在20到30岁之间的妇女。

def: n.餐巾，餐巾纸,尿布,（女士）卫生巾

ex.en: He wiped away the blood with a paper napkin.
ex.cn: 他用纸巾将血迹擦去。

ex.en: Michael mopped up quickly with his napkin.
ex.cn: 迈克尔迅速用餐巾将其揩干。

ex.en: He dabbed at his lips with the napkin.
ex.cn: 他用餐巾拭了拭嘴唇。

def: n.国籍,国家,民族性,部落

ex.en: Discrimination by employers on the grounds of race and nationality was illegal.
ex.cn: 雇主以种族或国籍为由歧视员工是非法的。

ex.en: Asked his nationality, he said British.
ex.cn: 被问及国籍时，他说是英国。

ex.en: Aggression by one nationality against another often leads to war.
ex.cn: 一个国家对另一国家的挑衅经常会道致战争.

def: adj.顽皮的,不听话的,淘气的,下流的

ex.en: I've even seen her shake Zara when she's been naughty.
ex.cn: 我甚至见过她在扎拉淘气的时候使劲摇晃她。

ex.en: You know what little boys are like with naughty words.
ex.cn: 你知道小男孩们说下流话是什么样子。

ex.en: You naughty boy, you gave me such a fright.
ex.cn: 你这调皮鬼，吓了我一跳。

def: adj.（有）海军的，军舰的，船的

ex.en: In a naval battle your aim is to sink the enemy's ship.
ex.cn: 在海战中目标就是击沉敌船。

ex.en: Sailors at a naval base had mutinied against their officers.
ex.cn: 某海军基地的士兵不服从军官领导，发生了兵变。

ex.en: The attack has caused severe damage to American naval and military forces.
ex.cn: 这次攻击给美国的海军和陆军都造成了重创。

def: n.航行（学）,航海（术）,海上交通

ex.en: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
ex.cn: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

ex.en: They will be helped by the very latest in navigation aids.
ex.cn: 他们将会受益于最新的导航系统。

ex.en: Pack ice around Iceland was becoming a threat to navigation.
ex.cn: 冰岛周围的浮冰群曾一度对船只航行构成威胁。

def: n.海军,船队

ex.en: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
ex.cn: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

ex.en: There was very little snobbery or class-consciousness in the wartime navy.
ex.cn: 战时的海军中很少有势利眼，阶级意识也不强。

ex.en: Banks spent his national service in the Royal Navy.
ex.cn: 班克斯在皇家海军服过兵役。

def: vt.使…成为必要，需要,强迫，迫使

ex.en: It is common that a single requirement will necessitate multiple interface elements.
ex.cn: 一个需求可以由多个界面元素来满足,这种情况比较普遍.

ex.en: To map 100 mutants by this method would necessitate nearly 5,000 crosses.
ex.cn: 用这种方法来绘制100个突变型的遗传图就要做5000个杂交.

ex.en: Moving the piano will necessitate taking the door off its hinges.
ex.cn: 搬钢琴就得把门从铰链上拿下来.

def:
n.[化]镍,五分镍币
vt.镀镍于

ex.en: Nickel can be used for making coins.
ex.cn: 镍可做成钱币.

ex.en: May I have a nickel?
ex.cn: 能给我五分钱 吗 ?

ex.en: In the squares place a penny, nickel, dime and quarter in that order. The object is to reverse the order of these coins.
ex.cn: 在这些方块中按顺序放置1分、5分、10分和25分的硬币各一枚。目标是颠倒这些硬币的顺序。

def: n.外甥女,侄女

ex.en: He looked affectionately at his niece.
ex.cn: 他慈爱地看着他的侄女。

ex.en: My niece was left in my trust for the weekend.
ex.cn: 我受托周末照顾我的外甥女.

ex.en: He adopts his niece as his heiress.
ex.cn: 他指定他的侄女为继承人.

def:
adj.名义上的,微不足道的,票面上的,名字的，列名的
n.名词性词

ex.en: All the ferries carry bicycles free or for a nominal charge.
ex.cn: 所有的渡船都免费或以极低的收费运载自行车。

ex.en: In 1990 personal incomes grew a nominal 6.8 per cent.
ex.cn: 1990年个人收入名义上增长了6.8％。

ex.en: I was brought up a nominal Christian.
ex.cn: 我成长为名不副实的基督徒。

def: vt.提名…为候选人,任命,挑选,指定（时间、日期、名称等）

ex.en: I nominate Tom to make the tea.
ex.cn: 我指派汤姆去沏茶.

ex.en: The public will be able to nominate candidates for awards such as the MBE.
ex.cn: 公众将可以推荐诸如英帝国勋章之类的奖项的候选人。

ex.en: Voters will choose fifty of the seventy five deputies. The Emir will nominate the rest.
ex.cn: 选民将选出75名代表中的50名，其余代表由埃米尔任命。

def: n.标准,规范,准则,（劳动）定额

ex.en: Families of six or seven are the norm in Borough Park.
ex.cn: 在区公园住宅区六口或七口之家十分普遍。

ex.en: a departure from the norm
ex.cn: 一反常态

ex.en: Of his age, the child is above the norm in arithmetic.
ex.cn: 在他那个年龄, 这个孩子的算术能力是超过标准的.

def: n.正常化,标准化,正态化

ex.en: The visIt ' signalled the normalization of relations between the two countries.
ex.cn: 这次 访问显示 两国关系已经正常化.

ex.en: The visit signalled the normalization of relations between the two countries.
ex.cn: 这次访问显示两国关系已经正常化。

ex.en: The relative contents in percentage were calculated with Area Normalization Method.
ex.cn: 面积归一化法计算相对含量.

def: adj.显而易见的，明显的,引人注目的，令人瞩目的,显著的，重要的,可以察觉的

ex.en: There's also been a noticeable rise in the political temperature.
ex.cn: 政治气氛也明显升温了。

ex.en: The carpet of leaves in my yard became more and more noticeable.
ex.cn: 我的院子里的落叶越来越厚。

ex.en: Many people in Minnesota and Tennessee have noticeable regional accents.
ex.cn: 明尼苏达州和田纳西州的许多人都有明显的地区口音。

def:
prep.尽管,虽然
adv.尽管如此，仍然,还是
conj.虽然，尽管

ex.en: He despised William Pitt, notwithstanding the similar views they both held.
ex.cn: 尽管他和威廉·皮特看法相似，却瞧不起他。

ex.en: His relations with colleagues, differences of opinion notwithstanding, were unfailingly friendly.
ex.cn: 尽管有意见分歧，他和同事们一直关系融洽。

ex.en: Notwithstanding some major financial problems, the school has had a successful year.
ex.cn: 虽然有些重大的经费问题，这所学校一年来还是很成功。

def: vt.滋养，施肥于,抚养，教养,怀抱（希望、怨恨）,使健壮

ex.en: They needed good food to nourish their bodies.
ex.cn: 他们需要好食品滋养身体.

ex.en: Journalists on the whole don't create public opinion. They can help to nourish it.
ex.cn: 大体说来记者不制造舆论。他们会助长舆论。

ex.en: We need good food to nourish the starving infants.
ex.cn: 我们需要好食品滋养这些挨饿的婴儿.

def: n.讨厌的东西（人，行为）麻烦事,非法妨害，损害,麻烦事

ex.en: He spent three days making an absolute nuisance of himself.
ex.cn: 他3天时间就把自己变成了个地地道道的“讨人嫌”。

ex.en: Back in the 1980s drug users were a public nuisance in Zurich.
ex.cn: 在20世纪80年代，吸毒者在苏黎世是被众人所唾弃的。

ex.en: It's a blooming nuisance because it frightens my dog to death.
ex.cn: 它真让人讨厌，快把我的狗吓死了。

def:
adj.麻木的，失去感觉的,无动于衷的，没感情的
vt.使麻木，使麻痹

ex.en: He could feel his fingers growing numb at their tips.
ex.cn: 他能感到指尖正在变得麻木。

ex.en: Numb with terror, she stared at the departing maraud-ers.
ex.cn: 她吓得呆若木鸡，眼睁睁地看着劫匪们离去。

ex.en: First he had been numb. Then the numbness gave way to anger.
ex.cn: 起初他只是麻木，接着转为了愤怒。

def: adj.数字的，用数字表示的，数值的

ex.en: This consolidation meant having to reduce the numerical strength of the Army.
ex.cn: 这次合并意味着不得不削减陆军的兵力。

ex.en: The results are expressed in descending numerical order .
ex.cn: 结果按数字降序列出。

ex.en: The numbers are in numerical order.
ex.cn: 这些号码是按数字顺序排列的.

def: n.婴儿室，幼儿园,苗圃,临时托儿所,温床，滋生地

ex.en: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services.
ex.cn: 我们已发起一场要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务的运动。

ex.en: Local authority nursery provision covers only a tiny minority of working mothers.
ex.cn: 当地政府提供的保育服务只有少数上班族母亲才能够享受到。

ex.en: Not all nursery schools make use of the opportunities open to them.
ex.cn: 并不是所有的托儿所都能抓住他们面临的机会。

def: n.[纺]尼龙,尼龙织品,〈口〉尼龙长袜

ex.en: I slowly zipped and locked the heavy black nylon bags.
ex.cn: 我慢慢地把那些沉重的黑色尼龙袋的拉链拉上并锁好。

ex.en: When it's dry, brush the hair using a soft, nylon baby brush.
ex.cn: 当头发干后，用柔软的婴儿用尼龙发刷梳理头发。

ex.en: Europe's largest producer of nylon is based in Belgium.
ex.cn: 欧洲最大的尼龙制造商总部设在比利时。

def:
n.栎树,橡木色,栎木，橡木,橡木家具
adj.栎树的,栎木制的

ex.en: The wind was bouncing the branches of the big oak trees.
ex.cn: 一棵棵高大橡树的枝条随风摇摆。

ex.en: He was a huge man, built like an oak tree.
ex.cn: 他是个大块头，结实得像棵橡树。

ex.en: Cartons of Chinese food were arrayed on a large oak table.
ex.cn: 在一张宽大的橡树桌上摆放着一盒盒中式食品。

def:
n.桨，橹,划手
vi.划（行）

ex.en: An oar often acts as rudder.
ex.cn: 桨常可起舵的作用.

ex.en: Kent must be kept out of this affair. He'll interfere and tries to have an oar in everyman's boat.
ex.cn: 这事可不能让肯特参与. 他一定会横加干涉,乱管闲事.

ex.en: Then he took up the oar with the knife lashed to it.
ex.cn: 然后他拿起上面绑着刀子的桨.

def: n.誓言，誓约,妄用神名，渎神的言词,[法]宣誓,诅咒，咒骂语

ex.en: His girlfriend had gone into the witness box and taken the oath.
ex.cn: 他的女朋友进入证人席并立了誓。

ex.en: Under oath, Aston finally admitted that he had lied.
ex.cn: 在宣誓的约束下，阿斯顿终于承认自己撒了谎。

ex.en: The constitution requires members of parliament to take an oath of allegiance.
ex.cn: 宪法规定，议员必须宣誓效忠。

def: n.遵守,顺从,服从,（教会的）权威

ex.en: Obedience by women towards men is a remnant of religious teaching.
ex.cn: 女人对男人的顺从是宗教教义的残迹。

ex.en: They command the respect and obedience of the armed forces.
ex.cn: 他们要求武装部队尊重上级，服从指挥。

ex.en: Isabella had been taught unquestioning obedience.
ex.cn: 伊莎贝拉被要求无条件服从。

def: n.着魔，萦绕,使人痴迷的人（或物）,摆脱不了的思想[情感等],妄想

ex.en: This government has developed an unhealthy obsession with secrecy.
ex.cn: 本届政府在保密方面做过了头。

ex.en: In therapy, she began to let go of her obsession with Mike.
ex.cn: 在心理治疗中，她开始逐渐放下对麦克的痴迷。

ex.en: His parents' obsession with keeping up appearances haunted his childhood.
ex.cn: 父母过于爱面子的做法在他儿时一直困扰着他。

def:
vt.阻塞,堵塞,阻碍,阻止
vi.阻塞,妨碍,（给…）设置障碍

ex.en: Claire positioned herself so as not to obstruct David's line of sight.
ex.cn: 克莱尔为了不挡住戴维的视线挪了一下位置。

ex.en: A number of local people have been arrested for trying to obstruct lorries loaded with logs.
ex.cn: 一些当地人因试图阻止满载原木的卡车通行而被逮捕。

ex.en: The defences are intended to obstruct any advance by tanks and other vehicles.
ex.cn: 这些防御工事用于阻止坦克等车辆前进。

def: n.障碍物,阻碍的行为或例子,阻碍，受阻,妨碍议事

ex.en: The boy was suffering from a bowel obstruction and he died.
ex.cn: 这个男孩因患肠梗阻死去了。

ex.en: the obstruction of justice
ex.cn: 妨碍司法公正

ex.en: The asylum seekers had to contend with continued bureaucratic obstruction.
ex.cn: 寻求政治庇护的人得不断地应付官僚主义的层层阻挠.

def: n.气味，名声

ex.en: He is in bad odor with his friends.
ex.cn: 他在朋友中声誉不佳.

ex.en: The dump sent out an offensive odor.
ex.cn: 垃圾堆散发出难闻的气味。

ex.en: The whole herb has a characteristic taste and odor.
ex.cn: 整株药草有种独特的味道和气味。

def: n.气味，臭气,声望，名誉

ex.en: The plant has an unpleasant odour and an acrid taste.
ex.cn: 这种植物闻着刺鼻，吃着辣口。

ex.en: He was acutely aware of the odour of cooking oil.
ex.cn: 他闻到一股浓浓的油烟味。

ex.en: The odour of vitamin in skin is repugnant to insects.
ex.cn: 昆虫很讨厌皮肤内维生素的气味。

def: vt.省略,遗漏,删掉,未（做）

ex.en: Please don't omit to lock the door when you leave.
ex.cn: 离开时不要忘了锁门.

ex.en: I'll not wish to omit this valuable book from my reading.
ex.cn: 我可不愿在自己的阅读书目中漏掉这本有价值的书.

ex.en: Don't omit locking [ to lock ] the door.
ex.cn: 别忘了锁门.

def: n.洋葱（头）

ex.en: Fry for about 4 minutes, until the onion has softened.
ex.cn: 煎4分钟左右，直到洋葱变软。

ex.en: Mix the meat with the onion, carrot, and some seasoning.
ex.cn: 把肉和洋葱、胡萝卜及一些佐料搅拌在一起。

ex.en: Add the onion and cook gently for about 5 minutes.
ex.cn: 把洋葱加进去，用文火煮大约5分钟。

def:
adj.不透明的,无光泽的，晦暗的,不传导性的,含糊的，迟钝的
n.不透明，晦暗,[建]遮檐,遮光涂料

ex.en: The jargon in his talk was opaque to me.
ex.cn: 他谈话中使用的行话对我是一团迷雾。

ex.en: The once clear mountain stream is now polluted and opaque.
ex.cn: 曾经是很清澈的山溪,现在受到污染变得混浊了.

ex.en: The complex administrative arrangements render the decision - making process somewhat opaque.
ex.cn: 复杂的行政协商使决策过程透明度不高.

def: n.经营者,操作员,电话接线员,运算符

ex.en: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
ex.cn: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

ex.en: I became a ham radio operator at the age of eleven.
ex.cn: 我在11岁时成了一名业余无线电操作员。

ex.en: The operator will put you through.
ex.cn: 接线员会为你接通电话。

def: vi.选择，挑选

ex.en: To keep the cost down, opt for a basic model.
ex.cn: 要想花钱少些，就选择基本的型号。

ex.en: Mr Wallace tries to co-opt rather than defeat his critics.
ex.cn: 华莱士先生竭力拉拢而不是击败他的批评者们。

ex.en: Under the agreement the Vietnamese can opt out at any time.
ex.cn: 依据该协定，越南有权随时选择退出。

def: adj.视觉的，视力的,眼睛的,光学的

ex.en: Sloping walls on the bulk of the building create an optical illusion.
ex.cn: 大楼主体的斜墙给人造成一种视错觉。

ex.en: The camera combines rugged reliability with unequalled optical performance and speed.
ex.cn: 这款相机既坚固耐用，又有超凡的光学性能和快门速度。

ex.en: These optical fibres may be used for new sorts of telephony.
ex.cn: 这些光缆可以用于新型电话通讯系统。

def:
adj.最适宜的
n.最佳效果,最适宜条件,[生物学] 最适度

ex.en: the optimum use of resources
ex.cn: 对资源的充分利用

ex.en: Do you know the optimum temperature for the growth of plants?
ex.cn: 你知道庄稼生长的最佳温度 吗 ?

ex.en: Now your advice is very optimum.
ex.cn: 现在你的建议是很适宜的.

def: n.（通常指围起来的）果园,果园里的全部果树,<俚>棒球场

ex.en: Each bamboo house was surrounded by a thriving orchard.
ex.cn: 每座竹楼周围都是茂密的果园.

ex.en: She hired out to the owner of an apple orchard.
ex.cn: 她受雇于一个苹果园主.

ex.en: My orchard is bearing well this year.
ex.cn: 今年我的果园果实累累.

def: n.矿,矿石，矿砂

ex.en: We dowse oil and ore in South America for big companies.
ex.cn: 我们在南美洲为一些大公司探测石油和矿石。

ex.en: They struck a rich seam of iron ore.
ex.cn: 他们开出一个富铁矿层。

ex.en: How many tons of ore can this machine crush in an hour?
ex.cn: 这机器每小时可以破碎多少吨矿石?

def:
adj.东方的,东方人的,东方文化的,优质的
n.东方人,东亚人

ex.en: It sells everything from hair ribbons to oriental rugs.
ex.cn: 这里出售各种商品，从发带到东方小地毯应有尽有。

ex.en: Parts of California are suffering from an infestation of oriental fruit flies.
ex.cn: 加利福尼亚的部分地区正遭受东方果蝇的大肆侵袭。

ex.en: The Oriental is a comfortable hotel, but rather inconveniently situated.
ex.cn: 东方大酒店是个舒适的宾馆，但地理位置却非常不方便。

def:
n.孤儿
vt.使成为孤儿
adj.孤儿的,无双亲的

ex.en: I'm an orphan and pretty much grew up on my own.
ex.cn: 我是个孤儿，差不多是靠自己长大的。

ex.en: He was an orphan and lived with his uncle.
ex.cn: 他是个孤儿，和他叔叔一起生活。

ex.en: When his parents were killed in an accident, he became an orphan.
ex.cn: 当他的父母在事故中丧生之后, 他便成了孤儿.

def: adj.规范的, 公认的, 普遍赞同的,正统的

ex.en: It doesn't sound exactly orthodox, if I may say so.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，那听起来不太符合常规。

ex.en: Payne gained a reputation for sound, if orthodox, views.
ex.cn: 虽然观点正统，但佩恩合乎情理的见解还是令他为人称道。

ex.en: Karouzos's poetry shows a profound preoccupation with the Orthodox Church.
ex.cn: 卡鲁佐斯的诗歌表明他对东正教的执着。

def: n.盎司,<口>少量，一点儿,雪豹

ex.en: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce.
ex.cn: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

ex.en: If only my father had possessed an ounce of business sense.
ex.cn: 要是我父亲有一点点经商的头脑就好了。

ex.en: There's not an ounce of truth in her story.
ex.cn: 她所说的一点都不真实。

def:
n.（战争，怒气等的）爆发,突然发生
vi.爆发

ex.en: This evidence supports their contention that the outbreak of violence was prearranged.
ex.cn: 这一证据证实了他们的观点，即此次突发暴力事件是有预谋的。

ex.en: The other unspoken fear here is of an outbreak of hooliganism.
ex.cn: 这其中另一个未言明的担忧是足球流氓可能突然闹事。

ex.en: Conditions were ripe for an outbreak of cholera.
ex.cn: 霍乱即将暴发。

def:
n.全套装备,一套服装,集体,组织
vt.装备,配置设备,供给服装
vi.得到装备

ex.en: You don't have to match your lipstick exactly to your outfit.
ex.cn: 你不一定非要让唇膏的颜色同礼服完全搭配。

ex.en: Beckham wore a fetching outfit in purple and green.
ex.cn: 贝克汉姆穿了一件抢眼的紫绿两色套装。

ex.en: She could change into a different outfit in two minutes.
ex.cn: 她能在两分钟内换上一套不同的行头。

def:
n.远足，郊游，短途旅行,散步
v.伸出( out的现在分词),揭露

ex.en: The gay and lesbian rights group, Stonewall, sees outing as completely unhelpful.
ex.cn: 男女同性恋权益组织“石墙”认为公开揭露同性恋者身份毫无益处。

ex.en: One evening, she made a rare outing to the local discotheque.
ex.cn: 她有天晚上破天荒地去了一次当地的迪斯科舞厅。

ex.en: The outing will do me good.
ex.cn: 这次远足对我会有所助益。

def: n.郊外,市郊，郊区,从外围经过,边缘

ex.en: From Wrexham centre take the Chester Road to the outskirts of town.
ex.cn: 从雷克瑟姆市中心出发，沿着切斯特路到达市郊。

ex.en: As they approached the outskirts of the city, Ella's mood visibly lightened.
ex.cn: 他们快到市郊时，埃拉的情绪明显好转。

ex.en: We bivouacked on the outskirts of the city.
ex.cn: 我们在市郊露营。

def:
adj.椭圆形的,卵形的
n.椭圆形,椭圆运动场（等）,椭圆，美式足球用球,[物]卵形线

ex.en: Congress is waiting to see how the Oval Office will react.
ex.cn: 国会正观望总统方面的反应。

ex.en: The shape of the earth is an oval.
ex.cn: 地球的形状是个椭圆形.

ex.en: The leaf is oval in shape.
ex.cn: 叶呈椭圆形.

def:
vt.& vi.溢出，淹没,挤满，充满,洋溢,资源过剩
n.泛滥，溢出物,溢流管,充溢，过多,超出额
vi.泛滥，溢出,充溢
adj.溢出的，满出的

ex.en: Tents have been set up next to hospitals to handle the overflow.
ex.cn: 医院旁搭起了帐篷以安置容纳不下的人员。

ex.en: The loch's overflow cascades into the waterfalls of a Japanese water garden.
ex.cn: 溢出的湖水倾泻而下，形成了一座日式水景花园的瀑布。

ex.en: There is an overflow of cheap ballpoint pens in the market.
ex.cn: 市场上圆珠笔泛滥.

def:
vt.偶然听到,无意中听到,偷听
vi.无意中听到,偷听到

ex.en: They were shut away in a little room where nobody could overhear.
ex.cn: 他们被关在一个小屋里，没人能听到他们的动静。

ex.en: The door is shut so that no one may overhear what is said.
ex.cn: 门关着，这样没人能听见说话的内容。

ex.en: They stepped aside so that their child could not overhear their conversation.
ex.cn: 他们走到一边去,不让孩子听见他们的谈话.

def:
adv.在晚上,在夜里,突然,很快
adj.一整夜的,晚上的,突然的,很快的
n.前一天的晚上,一夜的逗留
vi.过一夜

ex.en: There were two bomb explosions in the city overnight.
ex.cn: 一夜之间城里发生了两起炸弹爆炸事件。

ex.en: "Wait a damn minute," Mindy spat. "Nobody said anything about staying overnight."
ex.cn: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

ex.en: The supply of money in circulation was drastically reduced overnight.
ex.cn: 流通领域的货币供应量一夜骤减。

def: n.立交桥，天桥，高架道路

ex.en: The city built a pedestrian overpass over the highway.
ex.cn: 城里在公路上建了一座过街天桥.

ex.en: I walked through an overpass over the road.
ex.cn: 我步行穿过那条公路上面的立交桥.

ex.en: Each intersection point would have to be made into an overpass and underpass.
ex.cn: 在每一个交点处都有一条是地面通道,一条是地下通道.

def:
vt.打倒，推翻,使屈服，征服,使瓦解,撞倒
n.推翻，打倒,打翻,倾倒,[棒]投得过高的球

ex.en: These feelings are likely to make people attempt to overthrow the system.
ex.cn: 这些情绪有可能促使人们想要推翻现行的体制。

ex.en: Prosecutors in the trial allege the defendants plotted to overthrow the government.
ex.cn: 检方在审判中指称被告密谋推翻政府。

ex.en: The overthrow of the military regime was followed by a period of anarchy.
ex.cn: 军事统治政权被推翻以后，接着是一段时期的无政府状态。

def:
n.超出的时间，额外的时间,加班,加时赛,加班费
adv.超时地,加班地
v.使历时过久,使（曝光等）超过时间

ex.en: He would work overtime, without pay, to finish a job.
ex.cn: 他会为了完成工作无偿加班。

ex.en: The union issued an order instructing its members not to work overtime.
ex.cn: 工会发出指示,不让会员超时工作.

ex.en: These new orders for our manufactures will mean working overtime.
ex.cn: 这些订购我们产品的新订单意味着要加班.

def: n.猫头鹰,惯于晚上活动的人,夜猫子,（像猫头鹰一样）机警的人

ex.en: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
ex.cn: 对于很多加利福尼亚的印第安人而言，猫头鹰是圣物。

ex.en: Out in the garden an owl hooted suddenly.
ex.cn: 外面的花园里突然有一只猫头鹰呜呜地叫起来。

ex.en: An owl hooted nearby.
ex.cn: 一只猫头鹰在附近啼叫。

def: n.[化]氧化物

ex.en: an oxide of tin
ex.cn: 氧化锡

ex.en: Oxide is usually seen in our daily life.
ex.cn: 在我们的日常生活中氧化物很常见.

ex.en: Atoms of iron in the nail combine with atoms of oxygen from the air to form molecules of iron oxide, or rust.
ex.cn: 钉子里的铁原子与空气中的氧原子结合后形成氧化铁分子，也就是锈。

def: n.条约，公约,公约

ex.en: A non-aggression pact will be signed between the two countries.
ex.cn: 两国将签署互不侵犯条约。

ex.en: Police refused to say if the couple died in a suicide pact.
ex.cn: 警察拒绝回答这对夫妇是否是一起自杀的。

ex.en: He says this contract should not be patterned after the Deere pact.
ex.cn: 他说这个合同不应该模仿《迪尔协定》。

def:
n.[航海] 宽叶短桨,桨状物,搅拌金矿的铁器，类似铁铲的工具,洗衣板，扁板
vi.涉水,趟水,用桨划船,荡桨
vt.用浆划动，用船桨推动（船只）,搬运，运输,拍打,搅拌

ex.en: We might be able to push ourselves across with the paddle.
ex.cn: 我们也许可以用桨把自己推过去。

ex.en: Ruth enjoyed her paddle.
ex.cn: 露丝玩水玩得很开心。

ex.en: Wear sandals when you paddle.
ex.cn: 玩水的时候穿上凉鞋。

def:
n.手掌,手心,棕榈树 ,由Palm公司发明的一种PDA上的操作系统
v.将…藏于掌中

ex.en: He cupped her chin in the palm of his hand.
ex.cn: 他用手心托着她的下巴。

ex.en: Dornberg slapped the table with the palm of his hand.
ex.cn: 多恩伯格用手拍着桌子。

ex.en: She placed her hands palm uppermost in her lap.
ex.cn: 她把手掌心向上放在大腿上。

def: n.全景画,全景照片,一连串景象或事,概论

ex.en: There is a superb panorama of the mountains from the hotel.
ex.cn: 从旅馆可饱览峰峦叠嶂的雄伟景观。

ex.en: As I opened the scroll, a panorama of the Yellow River unfolded.
ex.cn: 我打开卷轴时, 黄河的景象展现在眼前.

ex.en: A vast panorama of the valley lay before us.
ex.cn: 山谷的广阔全景展现在我们面前.

def:
n.喘气，喘息,气喘,喷气声
vi.喘气，喘息,喘着气说，气喘吁吁地讲,热望，渴望，想,（机车等）喷气
vt.气喘

ex.en: You pant ( for breath ) after running hard for a time.
ex.cn: 拼命跑一阵后便会觉得气短.

ex.en: When he bent over, he split his pant.
ex.cn: 他一弯腰就把裤裆裂开了.

ex.en: From my place of ambush, I could hear him pant aloud as he struck the blows.
ex.cn: 我从藏身的地方可以听到他捅刀子时的喘息声.

def: n.平装本，平装书

ex.en: She flicked through a romantic paperback between occasional dips in the pool.
ex.cn: 用在泳池里游一阵后歇一阵的几个空当，她翻完了一本平装本言情小说。

ex.en: When is it coming out in paperback ?
ex.cn: 这本书的平装本什么时候出版？

ex.en: Many books that are out of print are reissued in paperback form.
ex.cn: 许多绝版的书籍又以平装本形式重新出现.

def:
n.降落伞,降落伞状物,[植]风散种子
vt.& vi.用降落伞投送,用降落伞降落
vi.跳伞

ex.en: The Parachute Regiment could be forced to admit women.
ex.cn: 伞兵团可能会被迫招收女性。

ex.en: He plunged 300ft to the ground when his parachute collapsed.
ex.cn: 降落伞突然瘪了，他从300英尺的高空跌落到地面。

ex.en: He was almost strangled by his parachute harness straps.
ex.cn: 他差点被自己的降落伞吊带勒死。

def:
v.游行,展览,招摇过市,接受检阅
n.检阅,游行,一系列,炫耀

ex.en: Morning parade was in progress on the parade ground.
ex.cn: 阅兵场正在进行早间检阅。

ex.en: A military parade marched slowly and solemnly down Pennsylvania Avenue.
ex.cn: 阅兵队列沿宾夕法尼亚大道缓慢而庄严地行进。

ex.en: People stood waiting for the kick-off of the parade.
ex.cn: 人们站着等候游行的开始。

def: n.天堂,伊甸园,乐园,极乐

ex.en: To the former Belgian colonizers, Rwanda was a paradise.
ex.cn: 对于以前的比利时殖民者来说，卢旺达就是个天堂。

ex.en: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
ex.cn: 《古兰经》将天国描述成一个乐园。

ex.en: They lived in an earthly paradise.
ex.cn: 他们生活在人间天堂。

def: n.反论，悖论,似非而是的论点,自相矛盾的人或事,[物]佯谬

ex.en: He was a paradox—a loner who loved to chat to strangers.
ex.cn: 他真是个矛盾人物，生性孤僻却又喜欢和陌生人闲聊。

ex.en: Although strictly illogical, Martin's interpretation of this paradox seems the best.
ex.cn: 马丁对于这一悖论的解释尽管严格说来不合乎逻辑, 卻似乎是最好的解释了.

ex.en: The paradox is that the region's most dynamic economies have the most primitive financial systems.
ex.cn: 矛盾之处在于这个地区最有活力的经济体却有着最落后的金融体系。

def: n.[数]参数,<物><数>参量,限制因素,决定因素

ex.en: It is the parameter of distribution.
ex.cn: 这就是分布参数.

ex.en: One parameter which always comes into play is the national economy.
ex.cn: 国民经济是一个经常起作用的参量.

ex.en: Static and dynamic displacement is another method of categorizing this parameter.
ex.cn: 静态和动态位移是这个参数的另一种分类方法.

def: n.寄生物，寄生虫,食客,寄生植物,天线反射器

ex.en: One of the ways the parasite spreads is through fecal matter.
ex.cn: 寄生虫传播的一种方式是通过排泄物。

ex.en: The lazy man was a parasite on his family.
ex.cn: 那懒汉是家里的寄生虫.

ex.en: The mistletoe plant is a parasite on trees.
ex.cn: 槲寄生是寄生于树上的植物.

def: n.过路人，行人

ex.en: The 23-year-old's screams alerted a passerby who went to her rescue.
ex.cn: 那个23岁女孩的尖叫引来了一位过路人前去营救。

ex.en: Their curtains are perpetually drawn , so a passerby cannot peer inside.
ex.cn: 他们的窗帘遮得严严实实,外人难以看清内情.

ex.en: You are no longer a passerby in my life.
ex.cn: 你不再仅仅是生命中的过客.

def:
n.面团,糨糊,肉（或鱼等）酱（作涂抹料或烹饪用）,（制作人造宝石的）铅质玻璃
vt.粘贴，张贴,以…覆盖于

ex.en: Make deep slashes in the meat and push in the spice paste.
ex.cn: 在肉上切出深深的口子，再把辣酱塞进切口中。

ex.en: Using a whisk, mix the yolks and sugar to a smooth paste.
ex.cn: 用打蛋器将蛋黄和糖打成均匀的糊状。

ex.en: Blend a little milk with the custard powder to form a paste.
ex.cn: 往蛋奶沙司粉里加入一点儿牛奶，搅成糊糊。

def:
n.牧草地，牧场,牲畜饲养，放牧
vt.& vi.放牧
vi.吃草

ex.en: Every summer the shepherds drive the sheep up to pasture.
ex.cn: 每年夏天牧羊人都将羊群赶到牧场去。

ex.en: I'm retiring next month. They're putting me out to pasture.
ex.cn: 我下个月退休。他们要我养老去了。

ex.en: It's about time this old sewing machine was put out to pasture.
ex.cn: 这部旧缝纫机大概到了被淘汰的时候了.

def:
vt.& vi.轻拍，爱抚,拍成，拍至
n.轻拍,轻拍某物发出的声音,小团，小块
adj.恰好的，适当的,熟练的,过于巧合的，人为的,快活的，活泼的
vt.表扬，称赞（某人/自己）

ex.en: Pat was a tower of strength to our whole family.
ex.cn: 帕特是我们全家人的主心骨。

ex.en: Pat refused to give her any information about Sarah.
ex.cn: 帕特拒绝向她提供任何关于萨拉的消息。

ex.en: If you do something well, give yourself a pat on the back.
ex.cn: 事情做得漂亮时，给自己一点表扬。

def:
n.补丁，补片,眼罩,斑点,小块
vt.修补，拼凑,暂时遮掩一下,修理，平息（吵架等）,用美人斑装饰（脸）
vi.打补丁

ex.en: The company I work for went through a rough patch.
ex.cn: 我所在的公司经历了一段困难时期。

ex.en: He's not a patch on the rest of the Cabinet.
ex.cn: 他远比不上内阁的其他成员。

ex.en: They tried digging in a patch just below the cave.
ex.cn: 他们试着在洞穴正下方的一块地上挖掘。

def: adj.令人同情的，可怜的,又笨又可怜的，无价值的,荡气回肠

ex.en: We encountered the pathetic sight of a family packing up its home.
ex.cn: 我们目睹了一家人正在收拾家当准备离开的凄惨景象。

ex.en: It's a pound for a small glass of wine, which is pathetic.
ex.cn: 一小杯葡萄酒要1英镑，真差劲。

ex.en: She now looked small, shrunken and pathetic.
ex.cn: 她现在看起来瘦小枯槁，很可怜。

def: n.耐心，耐性,忍耐,单人纸牌游戏

ex.en: Non-violence and patience are the central tenets of their faith.
ex.cn: 非暴力和忍耐是他们的信仰的核心原则。

ex.en: Her husband was sympathetic at first but his patience soon wore thin.
ex.cn: 一开始她丈夫还抱以同情，可不久就失去耐心了。

ex.en: It was exacting work and required all his patience.
ex.cn: 工作很艰巨，需要他有极大的耐心。

def:
n.巡逻，巡查,巡逻队，侦察队,童子军小队
vt.& vi.巡逻，巡查

ex.en: Security forces remained on patrol until late into the night.
ex.cn: 保安部队继续巡逻至深夜。

ex.en: He hurried through the rain, to the patrol car.
ex.cn: 他冒着雨急匆匆地跑到巡逻车前。

ex.en: The men apparently opened fire after they were challenged by a patrol.
ex.cn: 显然，那些人是在受到一支巡逻队的盘问后开的火。

def: n.赞助人，资助人,顾客，老主顾,保护人,[宗]守护神

ex.en: Catherine the Great was a patron of the arts and sciences.
ex.cn: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝资助发展艺术和科学。

ex.en: Chiswick church is dedicated to St Nicholas, patron saint of sailors.
ex.cn: 奇西克教堂为水手的守护神圣尼古拉而建。

ex.en: She is a patron of small businesses and trades.
ex.cn: 她是几个小企业和小手工艺者的资助人。

def: n.人行道,硬路面,铺过的路面,[动]铺石状构造[密生的齿列等]

ex.en: Crews stray outside to film the view from the pavement.
ex.cn: 工作人员移到人行道上拍摄这一景色。

ex.en: They made their getaway along a pavement on a stolen motorcycle.
ex.cn: 他们骑上偷来的摩托车沿着人行道逃走了。

ex.en: He was then shoved face down on the pavement.
ex.cn: 接着他被一把推倒，脸朝下趴在了人行道上。

def:
n.桃子,桃红色,极好的人（或物）
adj.桃红色的,粉红色的

ex.en: The following summer the peach tree was laden with fruit.
ex.cn: 第二年夏天桃树就结满了桃子。

ex.en: Frank was there and he is a perfect peach.
ex.cn: 弗兰克在那儿，他是个非常可爱的人。

ex.en: She had tied back her hair with a peach satin ribbon.
ex.cn: 她用一根桃色缎带把头发扎在脑后。

def:
n.花生,微不足道的人，小人物,很少的钱
adj.微不足道的

ex.en: The Orientals use no butter. They prefer the very healthful peanut oil.
ex.cn: 东方人不吃黄油，他们更喜欢对健康非常有益处的花生油。

ex.en: Add 2 tablespoons of peanut oil.
ex.cn: 加两汤匙花生油。

ex.en: a peanut butter and jelly sandwich
ex.cn: 一份花生酱加果酱三明治

def:
n.卵石,水晶,水晶透镜,卵石花纹
vt.用卵石铺,用石子扔,使纹理粗糙

ex.en: You throw a pebble in a pool and it ripples.
ex.cn: 往池塘里扔块鹅卵石就会激起一片涟漪。

ex.en: The bird mistook the pebble for egg and tried to hatch it.
ex.cn: 这只鸟错把卵石当蛋,想去孵它.

ex.en: You aren't the only pebble on the beach.
ex.cn: 你这样的人多得很.

def:
n.踏板,脚蹬子,垂足线
vt.& vi.踩自行车的踏板,骑自行车
adj.脚的,踏板的

ex.en: The harder the brake pedal is pressed, the greater the car's deceleration.
ex.cn: 刹车踩得越用力，车子减速越猛。

ex.en: Your foot falls off the pedal and you stall the car.
ex.cn: 你的脚离开踏板，汽车便会熄火。

ex.en: He refused to soft-pedal an investigation into the scandal.
ex.cn: 他拒绝降低对这起丑闻的调查力度。

def:
n.步行者,行人
adj.徒步的,平淡无奇的,一般的

ex.en: The lorry driver escaped unhurt, but a pedestrian was injured.
ex.cn: 卡车司机安然脱险，但有一位行人受了伤。

ex.en: More than a third of all pedestrian injuries are to children.
ex.cn: 所有受伤的行人中有1/3以上是儿童。

ex.en: I drove home contemplating my own more pedestrian lifestyle.
ex.cn: 我开车回家，一路上思考着自己更为乏味的生活方式。

def:
vt.剥皮,覆盖层脱落，剥落
vi.剥落,脱落,揭掉,表面起皮
n.果皮，蔬菜皮,长柄木铲,[英史]堡寨，堡宅

ex.en: Blend in the lemon extract, lemon peel and walnuts.
ex.cn: 调入柠檬汁、柠檬皮和核桃。

ex.en: Peel the onion and cut it in half lengthwise.
ex.cn: 剥掉洋葱皮并把它纵向切成两半。

ex.en: I'd peel potatoes and put them on to boil.
ex.cn: 我要削掉土豆皮然后把它们煮熟。

def:
v.窥视，偷看,（小鸟等）唧唧地叫,（从隐蔽处）出现
n.窥视,唧唧声,隐现,慢慢露出

ex.en: "Fourteen minutes," Chris said, taking a peep at his watch.
ex.cn: “14分钟,”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道.

ex.en: Children came to peep at him round the doorway.
ex.cn: 孩子们围在门口偷看他。

ex.en: You don't hear a peep from her once she's gone to bed.
ex.cn: 她一睡觉，就不会发出一点儿动静。

def: n.摆，钟摆,摇摆不定的事态（或局面）

ex.en: In education, the pendulum has swung back to traditional teaching methods.
ex.cn: 教育界又恢复了传统教学法。

ex.en: The ball which hung the roof is compound pendulum.
ex.cn: 悬挂在墙上的钟来回摆动.

ex.en: The pendulum has swung back and the American car companies have made dramatic advances in safety.
ex.cn: 三十年河东，三十年河西，美国汽车公司在安全方面已经取得了巨大进步。

def:
vt.穿透，刺入,渗入,秘密潜入,洞悉，明了
vi.穿透，穿过,进入，渗入,洞悉

ex.en: They are hoping to penetrate the Japanese market with their latest product.
ex.cn: 他们希望他们的最新产品能打进日本市场.

ex.en: I heard what you said, but it didn't penetrate.
ex.cn: 你的话我听见了, 但是没有听懂.

ex.en: She could penetrate what I was thinking.
ex.cn: 她了解我在想什么.

def: n.半岛,[史]伊比利亚半岛，（第一次世界大战中指）加利波利半岛,（第一次世界大战中指）加利波利半岛

ex.en: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
ex.cn: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

ex.en: Quiberon is set on an eight-mile peninsula.
ex.cn: 基伯龙位于一个8英里大小的半岛上。

ex.en: All the attractions of the peninsula beckon.
ex.cn: 半岛上的各处景点无不令人心驰神往。

def: n.完美,完善,最后加工,圆满

ex.en: Like the old trouper he is, he timed his entry to perfection.
ex.cn: 作为一名老戏骨，他上场的时间把握得恰到好处。

ex.en: My idea of physical perfection is to be very slender.
ex.cn: 在我看来，要拥有完美身材就要非常苗条。

ex.en: Madame Clicquot is credited with the perfection of this technique.
ex.cn: 这项技术的完善要归功于凯歌夫人。

def:
n.香水,香料,香味，香气
vt.使…充满香气,喷香水于…

ex.en: As she went past there was a gust of strong perfume.
ex.cn: 她走过时有一股浓烈的香水味。

ex.en: There were two lemon trees and I paused to enjoy their perfume.
ex.cn: 那里有两棵柠檬树，我不禁驻足品味柠檬的芬芳。

ex.en: She dabbed a drop of the musky perfume behind each ear.
ex.cn: 她在两耳后分别擦上一小滴麝香香水。

def:
vt.& vi.弥漫,遍布,渗入,渗透
vi.感染，传播,渗入，遍及,贯穿,穿透某物

ex.en: Eventually, the water will permeate through the surrounding concrete.
ex.cn: 最终，水会渗透进周围的混凝土中。

ex.en: Water will easily permeate a cotton dress.
ex.cn: 水很容易渗透棉布衣服.

ex.en: Water will permeate blotting paper.
ex.cn: 水能渗透吸水纸.

def: vt.（尤指宗教或政治信仰的）迫害,烦扰，困扰,强求，死缠着要

ex.en: They persecute those who do not conform to their ideas.
ex.cn: 他们迫害那些不信奉他们思想的人.

ex.en: If he had determined to persecute her he must take the consequences.
ex.cn: 如果他胆敢来逼迫她,他会自食恶果.

ex.en: Attack me! Hurt me! Torture me! Humiliate me! Mistreat me! Persecute me!
ex.cn: 打击我吧! 伤害我吧! 折磨我吧! 羞辱我吧! 虐待我吧! 迫害我吧!

def: vi.坚忍，熬住,坚持,百折不回，不屈不挠,支撑

ex.en: They are determined to persevere in the fight.
ex.cn: 他们决心坚持战斗.

ex.en: Persevere and you'll succeed.
ex.cn: 只要你坚持不懈,你自会成功.

ex.en: It took a generous helping of entrepreneurial confidence to persevere during this incident.
ex.cn: 在这一事件中坚持下来是有了充足的创业信心的。

def: n.讨厌的人或事,有害动植物,瘟疫

ex.en: One hundred million rats are killed each year by pest exterminators.
ex.cn: 每年灭鼠人员都会杀死1亿只老鼠。

ex.en: That disobedient boy is a pest.
ex.cn: 那不听话的男孩令人讨厌.

ex.en: The image of the fox as a pest is grossly exaggerated in anecdote and folklore.
ex.cn: 狐狸的害人精形象在传闻和民间故事中遭到严重的夸大。

def:
n.请愿书，,请愿，请求,上诉状
vi.祈求，请求,请愿
vt.（向法庭）申诉

ex.en: His lawyers filed a petition for all charges to be dropped.
ex.cn: 他的律师提请撤销所有指控。

ex.en: Public employees, teachers and liberals are circulating a petition for his recall.
ex.cn: 公务员、教师和自由派人士正在散发请愿书,要求将他召回.

ex.en: We recently presented the government with a petition signed by 4,500 people.
ex.cn: 最近我们向政府递交了有4,500人签名的请愿书。

def:
adj.不重要的,卑鄙的，小气的,小的，一点点,小规模的
n.[会]小额,佩蒂,厕所

ex.en: Petty crime is having a deleteri-ous effect on community life.
ex.cn: 轻微罪行正对社区生活产生有害影响。

ex.en: At 17, he had a criminal record for petty theft.
ex.cn: 他17岁就有了小偷小摸的犯罪前科。

ex.en: Donaldson was a petty crook with a string of previous offences.
ex.cn: 唐纳森有一系列小的犯罪前科，但没犯过大事。

def: n.药房,配药学，药学,制药业,一批备用药品

ex.en: Modern pharmacy has solved the problem of sleeplessness.
ex.cn: 现代制药学已经解决了失眠问题.

ex.en: She works at the pharmacy.
ex.cn: 她在药房工作.

ex.en: If your pharmacy doesn't stock the product you want, have them order it for you.
ex.cn: 如果药店没有你想要的药品，让他们为你订购。

def:
vt.刺穿，戳穿,刺破,洞察,深深打动
vi.进入,透入

ex.en: A former associate of Mr. Pierce's was among the project's boosters.
ex.cn: 皮尔斯先生的一个前合伙人是这个计划的热心支持者之一。

ex.en: Producers decided to end her on-screen romance with Pierce Lawton.
ex.cn: 制片人决定结束她在影片中与皮尔斯·劳顿的恋情。

ex.en: A tap on the door interrupted him and Sally Pierce came in.
ex.cn: 敲门声打断了他，萨莉·皮尔斯走了进来。

def: n.鸽子,<非正式>易受骗的人,<非正式>责任

ex.en: A pigeon emerges, wings flapping noisily, from the tower.
ex.cn: 一只鸽子从塔里钻出来，扑扑地拍打着翅膀。

ex.en: I don't care where the money comes from — that's not my pigeon.
ex.cn: 我不管钱从哪儿来,那不是我的事.

ex.en: The pigeon homed from a distance of 100 miles.
ex.cn: 鸽子从百英里之外返回窝巢.

def: n.柱，台柱，顶梁柱,墩，柱脚,（组织、制度、信仰等的）核心

ex.en: She strove to read the name on the stone pillar.
ex.cn: 她费劲地读着石柱上的名字。

ex.en: He was a pillar of the club for over thirty years.
ex.cn: 30多年来他一直是这个俱乐部的顶梁柱.

ex.en: There is a pillar box at the street corner.
ex.cn: 胡同拐角处有个邮筒.

def:
n.枕头,垫子,花边垫子
vt.搁于枕上,当作枕头用
vi.以…为枕

ex.en: I have a pillow with my name embroidered on it.
ex.cn: 我有一个绣着我名字的枕头。

ex.en: Sam snuggled down in his pillow and fell asleep.
ex.cn: 萨姆舒服地枕着枕头进入了梦乡。

ex.en: Tendrils of hair strayed to the edge of her pillow.
ex.cn: 她的几缕头发散落在枕边。

def:
n.松树,松木,凤梨，菠萝
vi.憔悴,痛苦,渴望
vt.为…悲哀,哀悼,消瘦,渴望，渴慕
adj.似松的,松木的

ex.en: Make sure your pet won't pine while you're away.
ex.cn: 要确保不在家时宠物不会想你。

ex.en: A thrush alighted on a branch of the pine tree.
ex.cn: 一只鸫落在松树的树枝上。

ex.en: Battered pine floors slanted down to a Georgian window.
ex.cn: 破旧的松木地板歪歪斜斜地铺到一个乔治王时代风格的窗户跟前。

def: n.品脱,一品脱的量器或容器,一品脱容器的东西

ex.en: Give Roger another pint, Imogen, and I'll have the same again.
ex.cn: 再给罗杰来一杯，伊莫金，我也再来一份同样的。

ex.en: He popped out to buy a pint of milk.
ex.cn: 他匆匆出门去买一品脱牛奶。

ex.en: Aim to have at least half a pint of milk each day.
ex.cn: 目标是每天至少喝半品脱的牛奶。

def:
n.海盗，强盗,海盗船,侵害版权者,盗版者
vt.抢劫（海上船只）,剽窃，盗用
vi.当海盗,从事劫掠行为

ex.en: Pirate copies of the video are already said to be in Britain.
ex.cn: 该录像带的盗版版本据说已在英国出现。

ex.en: Ed played at being a pirate.
ex.cn: 埃德扮海盗玩。

ex.en: a pirate radio station
ex.cn: 非法电台

def:
n.手枪
v.用手枪射击

ex.en: Philippe was in uniform, wearing a pistol holster on his belt.
ex.cn: 菲利普身着制服，腰带上别着手枪皮套。

ex.en: The two policemen were joined by another policeman also carrying a pistol.
ex.cn: 另一名持枪警察和那两名警察会合了。

ex.en: Flavell had accidentally discharged a pistol, firing it into the ceiling.
ex.cn: 弗拉维尔不小心扳动了一把手枪的扳机，子弹射入了天花板。

def: n.<机>活塞

ex.en: Let's get the lathe to turn the new piston.
ex.cn: 咱们用车床车[加工]新的活塞吧.

ex.en: They use a piston engine instead.
ex.cn: 他们改用活塞发动机.

ex.en: Tell the foundry to cast another piston.
ex.cn: 告诉铸铁间再铸一只活塞.

def:
n.井,煤矿,麻子,（赛车道旁的）修理加油站
vt.使有麻子,使有凹陷
vi.凹陷,起凹点

ex.en: A gold mine is not a bottomless pit, the gold runs out.
ex.cn: 金矿并非无底的宝藏，金子终究会被采光。

ex.en: He was convicted of failing to muzzle a pit bull.
ex.cn: 他因没能给比特犬戴嘴套而被判有罪。

ex.en: He had to make four pit stops during the race.
ex.cn: 他不得不在比赛过程中4次停车进站。

def:
n.场地,最高点,音高,说教
vt.用沥青涂,扔，投,树起，搭起,定位于
vi.抛，扔,[棒球]当投手,搭帐篷,向前跌或冲

ex.en: Footballers in whopping great studded boots walk over the pitch.
ex.cn: 脚蹬帅气钉靴的足球运动员走进了球场。

ex.en: Campaigning is reaching fever pitch for elections on November 6.
ex.cn: 为11月6日选举进行的竞选活动逐渐达到白热化。

ex.en: The ground staff do all they can to prepare the pitch.
ex.cn: 运动场管理员全力整备球场。

def: n.种植园，大农场,栽植,<史>殖民，殖民地

ex.en: On the left was a plantation of almond trees.
ex.cn: 左边是一个杏树园。

ex.en: Not all plantation work has been masculinized.
ex.cn: 种植园里的工作并非全是些男性化的工作。

ex.en: The plantation owner has possessed himself of a vast piece of land.
ex.cn: 这个种植园主把大片土地占为己有.

def:
n.灰泥，涂墙泥,石膏,膏药
vt.涂以灰泥,在…上敷贴膏药,减轻,黏贴

ex.en: One of the kids was peeling plaster off the wall.
ex.cn: 其中一个孩子在剥墙上的灰泥。

ex.en: The bullet slammed into the ceiling, spraying them with bits of plaster.
ex.cn: 子弹砰地射进了天花板，掉落的石膏碎片落了他们一身。

ex.en: Once the plaster was dry there was no room for correction.
ex.cn: 一旦灰泥一干，就没有机会修改了。

def:
n.保证，誓言,[法]抵押权,公约,（表示友谊的）干杯
vt.& vi.使发誓，保证,典当，抵押
vt.许诺,用…担保,以誓言约束,向…祝酒
vi.作出庄重有约束力的誓言,祝愿，祝酒

ex.en: His tax-cutting pledge brought a delirious crowd to their feet.
ex.cn: 他减税的承诺让亢奋的人群欢呼雀跃起来。

ex.en: In the treaty both sides pledge to respect human rights.
ex.cn: 双方在条约中都承诺将尊重人权。

ex.en: I pledge that by next year we will have the problem solved.
ex.cn: 我保证来年之前我们将解决这个问题。

def:
n.境况，困境,誓约
vt.保证，约定

ex.en: The country's economic plight is strangling its scientific institutions.
ex.cn: 该国的经济困境阻碍了其科研机构的工作进展。

ex.en: He just wants to draw attention to the plight of the unemployed.
ex.cn: 他仅仅是想引起人们对失业者困境的关注。

ex.en: They bore their plight with stoicism and fortitude.
ex.cn: 他们以坚忍刚毅的精神直面困境。

def: n.管子工，水暖工,<美><口>（防止泄密的）堵漏人员

ex.en: When the pipe leaked, we sent for a plumber.
ex.cn: 煤气或水管漏了的时候, 我们就派人去找一位管子工.

ex.en: A plumber's coming in to look at the boiler.
ex.cn: 有位水暖工要来看看热水器.

ex.en: The plumber's helper passes him tools.
ex.cn: 水暖工的助手把工具递给他.

def:
adj.复数的
n.复数,复数形式,复数词

ex.en: What is the plural of "person"?
ex.cn: person的复数形式是什么？

ex.en: "Data" is the Latin plural form of "datum".
ex.cn: data在拉丁文中是datum的复数形式。

ex.en: The word "you" can be singular or plural.
ex.cn: 单词you可以是单数也可以是复数。

def: n.[医]肺炎,急性肺炎

ex.en: In November 1941 Payne was seriously ill with pneumonia.
ex.cn: 1941年11月，佩恩得了严重的肺炎。

ex.en: The new drug lessens the severity of pneumonia episodes.
ex.cn: 新药减轻了肺炎发作时的痛苦。

ex.en: She had feared she was going down with pneumonia or bronchitis.
ex.cn: 她担心会得肺炎或支气管炎。

def:
n.毒药,酒,极糟的食物,极有害的思想（或心情等）
vt.毒死,污染,放毒于,对…有不良影响
adj.有毒的

ex.en: Markov died after being struck by a poison dart.
ex.cn: 马尔科夫身中毒镖而亡。

ex.en: Poison from the weaver fish causes paralysis, swelling, and nausea.
ex.cn: 龙的毒素会引起瘫痪、肿胀和恶心。

ex.en: If I was your wife I would poison your coffee.
ex.cn: 如果我是你老婆，我会在你的咖啡里下毒。

def:
vt.戳，捅,推,拨火,〈美俚〉打，殴
vi.刺，戳,刺探，干涉,伸出,闲逛
n.刺，戳,殴打,袋子,懒汉

ex.en: We don't like strangers who poke their noses into our affairs.
ex.cn: 我们不喜欢陌生人干预我们的事务。

ex.en: John smiled at them and gave Richard a playful poke.
ex.cn: 约翰冲着他们笑了笑，开玩笑地捅了理查德一下。

ex.en: He saw the dog's twitching nose poke out of the basket.
ex.cn: 他看到那只狗一抽一抽的鼻子从篮子里冒出来。

def:
adj.极地的，两极的,正好相反的,[化，物]磁极的，有磁性的
n.[几]极线，极面

ex.en: In many ways, Brett and Bernard are polar opposites.
ex.cn: 在许多方面，布雷特和伯纳德截然不同。

ex.en: polar bears, denizens of the frozen north
ex.cn: 北极熊，在冰天雪地的北方生活的动物

ex.en: The parents' position is often the polar opposite of the child's.
ex.cn: 父母的观点常与孩子的完全相反。

def:
n.瓷，瓷器
adj.瓷制的,精美的,脆的，易碎的

ex.en: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
ex.cn: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

ex.en: There were lilies every-where in tall white porcelain vases.
ex.cn: 高高的白色瓷瓶上绘满了百合花。

ex.en: Arlott squirrelled away books, pictures and porcelain plates.
ex.cn: 阿洛特将书本、图片和瓷盘瓷碟都藏起来。

def: n.门廊,游廊，走廊

ex.en: We'd eat during the hot summer evenings on the front porch.
ex.cn: 在炎热的夏夜，我们会在屋前走廊上吃晚饭。

ex.en: She huddled inside the porch as she rang the bell.
ex.cn: 她按门铃时身子在门廊里缩成一团。

ex.en: I went out there on the front porch.
ex.cn: 我出来走到前廊上。

def:
adj.手提的,轻便的
n.手提式打字机

ex.en: A small-screen portable TV can be a good investment.
ex.cn: 小屏幕的便携式电视机很值得买。

ex.en: He bellowed information into the mouthpiece of his portable telephone.
ex.cn: 他对着手机话筒吼了一通信息。

ex.en: There was a little portable television switched on behind the bar.
ex.cn: 柜台后面有一台开着的便携式小型电视机。

def: n.门童,搬运工人,（医院里护送病人的）护工,（尤指卧铺车厢的）列车服务员

ex.en: A porter relieved her of the three large cases.
ex.cn: 一个行李搬运工替她扛了3个大包。

ex.en: The porter put our scruffy rain-sodden luggage on a trolley.
ex.cn: 搬运工把我们那些被雨水浸透的脏兮兮的行李放上了手推车。

ex.en: The train stopped and a porter called out, "Middlesbrough!"
ex.cn: 火车停站，一名列车员喊道，“米德尔斯伯勒到了!”

def: n.邮费，邮资

ex.en: Send a cheque for £18.99 plus £2 for postage and packing.
ex.cn: 请寄上18.99英镑的支票，外加2英镑的邮资和包装费。

ex.en: Proof of postage will not be accepted as proof of receipt.
ex.cn: 邮资单据不能当作收据。

ex.en: For foreign orders postage is extra.
ex.cn: 国外订单邮费另计。

def: n.海报，招贴，公告,招贴画,张贴者,[古语]急行的人，匆忙赶路的人

ex.en: The current national poster child is a tiny, freckle-faced redhead.
ex.cn: 现在的那个全国广告代言人个头不高，红头发，脸上有雀斑。

ex.en: Washington looks like a poster boy for strength and athleticism.
ex.cn: 华盛顿看上去是个典型的体魄强健、崇尚运动的人。

ex.en: She went out with a Calvin Klein poster boy.
ex.cn: 她和卡尔文·克莱恩品牌的一个广告代言人谈过恋爱。

def:
vt.使延期，延缓,把…放在次要地位,把…放在后面
vi.延缓,延缓发作

ex.en: I had to postpone ideas of a career and stay at home.
ex.cn: 我不得不暂缓就业打算，呆在家里。

ex.en: Ministers are using delaying tactics to postpone the report yet again.
ex.cn: 部长们再次使用拖延战术来推后报告的时间。

ex.en: It is totally out of the question to postpone the midnight deadline.
ex.cn: 想要推迟午夜的最后期限是完全不可能的。

def:
n.姿势,看法, 态度,立场
vt.做出某种姿势

ex.en: You can make your stomach look flatter instantly by improving your posture.
ex.cn: 通过采取更好的坐姿，你的腹部马上就会看起来平坦一些。

ex.en: Poor posture, sitting or walking slouched over, compresses the body's organs.
ex.cn: 坐着或者走路的时候低头垂肩，这种不正确的姿势会压迫体内的器官。

ex.en: If bad posture becomes habitual, you risk long-term effects.
ex.cn: 不良姿势一旦定型，日后可就有你受的了。

def: n.〈集合词〉家禽

ex.en: Most poultry farmers have to rely on commercially manufactured feeds.
ex.cn: 多数饲养家禽的农场主不得不依赖商业化生产的饲料。

ex.en: Contaminants found in poultry will also be found in their eggs.
ex.cn: 家禽身上发现的污染物，在禽蛋里也会有。

ex.en: Dr Binger keeps poultry, pigs and goats.
ex.cn: 班热博士饲养家禽、猪和羊。

def:
n.粉，粉末,粉状物质
vt.在…搽粉
vi.涂粉，变成粉末

ex.en: Unless these questions are solved, the region will remain a powder keg.
ex.cn: 除非这些问题得到解决，否则该地区会一直是个火药桶。

ex.en: Sift the flour and baking powder into a medium-sized mixing bowl.
ex.cn: 将面粉和发酵粉筛入中等大小的搅拌碗中。

ex.en: Blend a little milk with the custard powder to form a paste.
ex.cn: 往蛋奶沙司粉里加入一点儿牛奶，搅成糊糊。

def:
vt.祈祷，祷告,请求，恳求,央求
vi.祈祷,请,恳求

ex.en: We have a beautiful city and we pray it stays that way.
ex.cn: 我们的城市很美丽，但愿它能保持下去。

ex.en: And what, pray, do you buy and sell, Major?
ex.cn: 梅杰，请问，你都买卖些什么？

ex.en: One can only pray that the team's manager learns something from it.
ex.cn: 大家也只能希冀球队教练从中汲取教训。

def: n.祈祷,祈祷（习惯）,祈祷文,经文

ex.en: The Colonel bowed his head and whispered a prayer of thanksgiving.
ex.cn: 这位上校低头轻声做感恩祈祷。

ex.en: She'd been caught from behind and hadn't a prayer of freeing herself.
ex.cn: 有人从后面抓住她，她不可能脱身。

ex.en: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer.
ex.cn: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

def:
n.预防，防备，警惕,预防措施,避孕措施
vt.使提防,预先警告

ex.en: We are aware of the potential problems and have taken every precaution.
ex.cn: 我们已意识到潜在的问题，并采取了全面的预防措施。

ex.en: I took the precaution of clearing out my desk before I left.
ex.cn: 我临走时特地事先把办公桌清理了一下。

ex.en: I took the precaution of locking money in the safe.
ex.cn: 我把所有的钱都锁在保险箱里以防万一.

def:
n.前例,先例
adj.在前的，在先的

ex.en: They're keenly aware that whatever they decide will set a precedent.
ex.cn: 他们深知无论他们的决定是什么，都将开创先例。

ex.en: Would it not set a precedent? Would it not open the floodgates?
ex.cn: 难道它不会成为先例吗？难道它不会引发更多类似的问题吗？

ex.en: They were determined to break from precedent.
ex.cn: 他们决心打破先例。

def: vt.阻止,排除,妨碍
