ex.en: We try to preclude any possibility of misunderstanding.
ex.cn: 我们努力排除任何误解的可能性.

ex.en: He would rebuff enquiries in such a way as to preclude any further discussion.
ex.cn: 他会断然拒绝询问，使得无法进行进一步的讨论。

ex.en: My present finances preclude the possibility of buying a car.
ex.cn: 按我目前的财务状况我是不可能买车的.

def: n.介词,前置词

ex.en: The word is compounded of a preposition and a verb.
ex.cn: 这个词是由一个介词和一个动词复合而成的.

ex.en: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
ex.cn: 语法规则中并没有规定句子以介词结尾是错误的。

ex.en: You should cancel this preposition in the sentence.
ex.cn: 你应该删去句子中的这个介词.

def: vi.主持，指挥,担任会议主席

ex.en: They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
ex.cn: 他们问我是否会主持委员会会议。

ex.en: The minister was asked to preside at the independence ceremonies of the small island state.
ex.cn: 那位部长被邀请去主持这个小岛国的独立仪式.

ex.en: Mr Smith will preside at the next meeting.
ex.cn: 史密斯先生将主持下一次会议.

def: n.威信，威望，声望,声誉,（财势的）显赫,信望

ex.en: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
ex.cn: 他在负责处理外交事务的过程中赢得了国际声望。

ex.en: Their prestige went sky high.
ex.cn: 他们名声大噪。

ex.en: There is a lot of prestige attached to owning a car like this.
ex.cn: 拥有这样一部汽车会显得很气派。

def:
vt.以为，认为,假定，假设,推测,意味着
vi.擅自行动,相信,敢于,放肆

ex.en: They're resentful that outsiders presume to meddle in their affairs.
ex.cn: 他们对外人擅自干预他们的事务非常愤慨。

ex.en: Dido's told you the whole sad story, I presume?
ex.cn: 我想狄多已经把这件伤心事全部告诉你了吧？

ex.en: I would not presume to censure Osborne for hating his mother.
ex.cn: 我不会擅自批评奥斯本恨他妈妈这件事。

def:
n.借口，托辞,假象，掩饰
vt.借口，假托

ex.en: They wanted a pretext for subduing the region by force.
ex.cn: 他们想找借口用武力征服这个地区。

ex.en: They would now find some dubious pretext to restart the war.
ex.cn: 他们现在会找个蹩脚的借口重新发动战争。

ex.en: The incident was used as a pretext for intervention in the area.
ex.cn: 这次事件成了干涉那个地区的借口。

def:
vt.& vi.刺，扎，戳,刺伤，刺痛
n.刺，扎,刺伤，刺痛,尖形器具

ex.en: Prick the potatoes and rub the skins with salt.
ex.cn: 将马铃薯戳一些洞，并用盐揉搓外皮。

ex.en: At the same time she felt a prick on her neck.
ex.cn: 同时，她觉得脖子上一阵刺痛。

ex.en: Davydd felt tears prick his eyes.
ex.cn: 大卫德觉得眼泪就要流出来了。

def:
n.进行，进程,行动,诉讼,会议记录
v.进行( proceed的现在分词),前进,（沿特定路线）行进,（尤指打断后）继续说

ex.en: It hasn't stopped the British Navy proceeding on its merry way.
ex.cn: 这没有阻止英国海军继续得意扬扬地前进的步伐。

ex.en: The counting of votes is proceeding smoothly.
ex.cn: 计票工作正在顺利进行。

ex.en: I couldn't assent to, much less participate in such proceeding.
ex.cn: 我对于这种举动并不赞成, 哪里还谈得上参与呢.

def:
adj.不断前进的,进步的,进行的
n.改革论者,进步分子

ex.en: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
ex.cn: 这种疾病的一个显著症状就是记忆逐渐丧失。

ex.en: These weaknesses negated his otherwise progressive attitude towards the staff.
ex.cn: 这些缺点抵消了他在其他方面对待员工还算开明的态度。

ex.en: a progressive reduction in the size of the workforce
ex.cn: 劳力数量的逐步减少

def: n.放映机，幻灯机,投影仪,设计者,放映技师

ex.en: You gave me back the projector.
ex.cn: 你将幻灯机还给我了。

ex.en: A light pointer is often useful with a slide projector.
ex.cn: 光指示器经常与幻灯片放映机一起使用.

ex.en: There is a new projector in my office.
ex.cn: 我的办公室里有一架新的幻灯机.

def: adj.易于…的,俯卧的,有…倾向的,倾斜的，坡陡的

ex.en: Bob slid from his chair and lay prone on the floor.
ex.cn: 鲍勃从椅子上滑下来，趴在了地板上。

ex.en: As they shorten, cells become more prone to disease and death.
ex.cn: 细胞变小后就会更容易感染疾病，也更容易死亡。

ex.en: He's prone to flit between subjects with amazing ease.
ex.cn: 他往往会轻松自如地转换话题。

def: n.<语>代词

ex.en: The position of the pronoun " his'shows that it is to be betoned.
ex.cn: 代词 “ his”在句中的位置表示此词应加强调.

ex.en: Here you should use plural pronoun.
ex.cn: 这里你应该用复数代词.

ex.en: The relative pronoun is often dropped if it is the subject.
ex.cn: 关系代名词做受词时常被省略.

def: n.宣传，宣传运动

ex.en: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
ex.cn: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

ex.en: They even set up their own news agency to peddle anti-isolationist propaganda.
ex.cn: 他们甚至设立了自己的通讯社来宣扬反孤立主义。

ex.en: The Front adopted an aggressive propaganda campaign against its rivals.
ex.cn: 该阵线采用激进的宣传手段对付它的对手。

def: n.预言家，先知,倡导者，主张者

ex.en: He holds the belief that he is a latter-day prophet.
ex.cn: 他深信自己是当代先知。

ex.en: The faithful revered him then as a prophet.
ex.cn: 那时，信徒们尊他为先知。

ex.en: A prophet made a prophecy that the kingdom would fall.
ex.cn: 一位预言家预言那个王国将要灭亡.

def: v.控告,起诉,继续从事,担任控方律师

ex.en: Will you be able to prosecute your responsibilities effectively?
ex.cn: 你能有效地履行职责 吗 ?

ex.en: The attorney who will prosecute the case says he cannot reveal how much money is involved.
ex.cn: 将对此案提起公诉的律师说他不能透露具体的涉案金额。

ex.en: The police have decided not to prosecute because the evidence is not strong enough.
ex.cn: 由于证据不足，警方已决定不起诉。

def: adj.预期的,未来的,可能的,有希望的

ex.en: Prospective buyers should study the small ads in the daily newspaper.
ex.cn: 打算购物的人应该研究研究日报上的小广告。

ex.en: A lot of money went on wining and dining prospective clients.
ex.cn: 很多钱都花在宴请潜在客户上了。

ex.en: A social worker is appointed to interview the prospective adopters.
ex.cn: 一名社工被任命对有意收养者进行面试。

def:
n.[化]朊，蛋白（质）
adj.蛋白质的

ex.en: Too much protein in the diet may advance the ageing process.
ex.cn: 饮食中摄入过量蛋白质可能会加速衰老。

ex.en: Researchers have isolated a new protein from the seeds of poppies.
ex.cn: 研究人员已经从罂粟种子里分离出一种新的蛋白质。

ex.en: Milk products are an excellent source of calcium and protein.
ex.cn: 奶制品富含钙与蛋白质。

def: n.原型，雏形，蓝本

ex.en: We plan to release a prototype this autumn for trial in hospitals.
ex.cn: 我们计划今年秋天在各医院推出一个模型进行试验。

ex.en: the prototype of the modern bicycle
ex.cn: 现代自行车的雏形

ex.en: Metal - wheeled chariots are the prototype of the tanks of modern warfare.
ex.cn: 金属轮战车是现代战争中坦克的原型.

def: n.精神病学,精神病治疗法

ex.en: Psychiatry is an accepted branch of medicine.
ex.cn: 精神病学是公认的医学分支。

ex.en: The condition is practically unknown outside psychiatry clinics.
ex.cn: 除了医院的精神病科外，这种病几乎不为人知。

ex.en: A physician is someone who specializes in psychiatry.
ex.cn: 精神病专家是专门从事精神病治疗的人。

def:
n.一阵（气味，烟雾等）,粉扑,酥皮点心,夸奖，吹嘘
vt.喷出,膨胀,吹捧,得意
vi.喷出,膨胀,夸张

ex.en: Wind caught the sudden puff of dust and blew it inland.
ex.cn: 风猛地刮起一阵灰尘，将它吹往内陆。

ex.en: He took a puff on his pipe and shook his head.
ex.cn: 他抽了口烟斗，摇了摇头。

ex.en: Can I tempt you with a little puff pastry?
ex.cn: 我能给你尝点泡芙点心吗？

def:
vt.用拳猛击,打孔,（用压穿器）穿孔，冲孔,用肘推
n.冲压机，冲床,打洞器,钻孔机,剪票铗
vi.用拳猛击

ex.en: W. Somerset Maugham's novel still packs an emotional punch.
ex.cn: 威廉·萨默塞特·毛姆的小说仍具有强烈的情感冲击力。

ex.en: The guards, he said, would punch them for no reason.
ex.cn: 他说警卫会无缘无故殴打他们。

ex.en: He managed to free one hand to ward off a punch.
ex.cn: 他设法挣脱出一只手来挡住了一拳。

def: vt.使纯净，净化,精炼,使（语言）纯正,给…赎罪，使纯洁

ex.en: I take wheat and yeast tablets daily to purify the blood.
ex.cn: 我每天服用干酵母片以净化血液。

ex.en: One tablet will purify a litre of water.
ex.cn: 一丸即可净化一升水。

ex.en: They open the windows to purify the air of the room.
ex.cn: 他们打开窗户清涤室内空气.

def:
adj.紫色的,帝王的,词藻华美的
n.紫色,紫（红）衣，紫袍,帝位，皇权,皇族
vt.使成紫色
vi.变紫

ex.en: "Get the guy in the purple shirt." — "All right, my man."
ex.cn: “把那个穿紫衬衫的家伙叫过来。”——“好的，老兄。”

ex.en: All shades of mauve, lilac, lavender and purple were fashionable.
ex.cn: 深深浅浅的各种木槿色、丁香色、熏衣草色和紫色都是流行色。

ex.en: The avenues lined with jacaranda trees burst into a carnival of purple.
ex.cn: 大街的两旁种着蓝花楹，绽放的花朵汇成一片紫色的海洋。

def: adj.定性的，定质的,性质上的,质量的

ex.en: That's the whole difference between quantitative and qualitative research.
ex.cn: 那就是定量研究和定性研究之间的重大差别。

ex.en: Qualitative analysis shows that water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.cn: 定性分析表明水是由氢氧结合而成的.

ex.en: There are qualitative differences in the way children and adults think.
ex.cn: 孩子和成年人的思维方式有质的不同。

def: vt.确定…的数量,[逻辑学] 用量词限定

ex.en: The risks to health are impossible to quantify.
ex.cn: 健康的风险是无法用数量表示的。

ex.en: The cost of the fire damage is impossible to quantify.
ex.cn: 这次火灾的损失是无法计算的.

ex.en: It is difficult to quantify an exact figure as firms are reluctant to declare their losses.
ex.cn: 由于各家公司都不愿意公布所受的损失，所以很难得出一个精确的数字。

def: n.夸脱（液体或固体的容积单位）

ex.en: Pick up a quart of milk or a loaf of bread.
ex.cn: 拿1夸脱牛奶或一条面包。

ex.en: There is a quart of milk left in the pail.
ex.cn: 桶里还剩下一夸脱牛奶.

ex.en: That glass will contain a quart of beer.
ex.cn: 那个杯子可容一夸脱啤酒.

def:
adj.季度的，按季度的,四分之一
adv.按季的,[农] 一季一次地,纵横四分地
n.季刊,季考

ex.en: In 1987 Congressional Quarterly published a series of guidebooks to American politics.
ex.cn: 1987年《国会季刊》出版了一系列美国政治指南读物。

ex.en: Clients normally pay fees in advance, monthly, quarterly, or yearly.
ex.cn: 客户通常按月、季度或年度预付费用。

ex.en: A full listing of the companies will be published quarterly.
ex.cn: 公司名录大全每季度出版一次。

def: n.[矿]石英

ex.en: The prospectors have discovered such minerals as calcite, quartz and asbestos here.
ex.cn: 探矿人员在这里发现了方解石 、 石英、石棉等矿藏.

ex.en: There is a great deal quartz in those mountains.
ex.cn: 那些山里蕴藏着大量石英.

ex.en: To this class of substance belong mica, porcelain, quartz, glass, wood, etc.
ex.cn: 属于这类物质的有云母 、 瓷器 、 石英 、 玻璃 、 木材等等.

def:
adj.古怪的,可疑的,不适的,〈俚〉同性恋的
n.<贬>同性恋者,怪人,伪造的货币
vt.搞糟,使陷于不利地位

ex.en: I could not help but think this is a very queer life.
ex.cn: 我忍不住会认为这是一种非常怪异的生活。

ex.en: His face was a queer pink colour.
ex.cn: 他满脸奇怪的粉红色。

ex.en: " Queer " is the word often used euphemistically for " mad ".
ex.cn: “ Queer ” 这个词常用作 “ mad ” 的委婉语.

def: vt.解（渴）,终止（某事物）,（用水）扑灭（火焰等）,将（热物体）放入水中急速冷却

ex.en: Firemen tried to quench the flames raging through the building.
ex.cn: 消防队员奋力扑救大楼中熊熊的火焰。

ex.en: The firemen were unable to quench the fire.
ex.cn: 消防人员无法扑灭这场大火.

ex.en: Having a bottle of soft drink is not enough to quench my thirst.
ex.cn: 喝一瓶汽水不够解渴.

def:
n.被子，棉被,被状物
v.缝（被）,用垫料填塞后缝拢,东拼西凑地做,用摘抄等方法编辑
vt.东拼西凑地编,加软衬料后缝制
vi.缝被子

ex.en: The quilt has pretty, scalloped edges and intricate quilting.
ex.cn: 这条被子有漂亮的荷叶饰边，而且绗缝活做得也很精致。

ex.en: Mary saved up pieces of cloth to make a quilt.
ex.cn: 玛丽存了几块布留作棉被用.

ex.en: The design on this quilt cover is quite elegant.
ex.cn: 这被面的花儿很大方.

def:
vt.& vi.微颤，抖动
vt.使震动
n.抖动,颤音,箭筒,箭筒

ex.en: Mack made his voice quiver with fear on these last two words.
ex.cn: 麦克说出最后这两个字时，吓得声音颤抖。

ex.en: I felt a quiver of panic.
ex.cn: 我内心感到一阵恐慌。

ex.en: Can you feel a quiver of her hands?
ex.cn: 你感觉到她的手在发抖 吗 ?

def:
n.提问，询问,小型考试,简单的小测验,恶作剧
vt.盘问,挖苦,进行测试,张望

ex.en: Below are printed the answers to the Brain of Soccer 1993 quiz.
ex.cn: 以下所印的是1993年“脑力足球”小测验的答案。

ex.en: We'll have a quiz at the end of the show.
ex.cn: 节目的最后我们要举行一次智力竞赛。

ex.en: We've also got a bonus quiz with crates of beer as prizes!
ex.cn: 我们还获得了一次参加有奖智力竞赛的机会，奖品是成箱的啤酒！

def: n.（正式限定的）定量，定额,配额,指标

ex.en: Be sure you get your daily quota of calcium.
ex.cn: 要确保每天的钙摄入量。

ex.en: They have the usual quota of human weaknesses, no doubt.
ex.cn: 毫无疑问，他们身上也有人所共有的弱点。

ex.en: The quota of four tickets per person had been reduced to two.
ex.cn: 每人可购买的票的限额已经由四张降至两张。

def:
n.行李架,支架,刑架,（羊、猪等带前肋的）颈脊
vt.使痛苦，使焦虑,剥削，榨取,用刑拘折磨

ex.en: My rucksack was too big for the luggage rack.
ex.cn: 我的背包太大了，行李架上放不下。

ex.en: Turn the cake the right way up on to a wire rack.
ex.cn: 把蛋糕翻到合适的方向对准金属丝架上。

ex.en: The old house soon went to rack and ruin.
ex.cn: 这所旧房子很快就毁坏了.

def:
n.（网球等）球拍,〈美俚〉勒索金钱，讹诈，敲诈，骗局,（四周有围墙的）拍打回力网球，硬壁回力球,喧骚，吵闹，嚷闹，扰嚷，喧骚嘈杂的集会，狂欢
v.嚷闹，吵闹，纵情欢闹,用球拍打

ex.en: Suspicious fans exposed the racket and police arrested a man in Nottingham.
ex.cn: 起了疑心的爱好者揭发了这一勾当，警察在诺丁汉逮捕了一名男子。

ex.en: A furious player kicked his racket into the grandstand.
ex.cn: 一位愤怒的球员将他的球拍踢向了看台。

ex.en: The racket of drills and electric saws went on past midnight.
ex.cn: 钻孔机和电锯的噪声过了半夜还继续响着。

def:
adj.照耀的,辐射的,容光焕发的
n.光点,[天]流星群的辐射点

ex.en: For 40 years she has captivated the world with her radiant looks.
ex.cn: 40年来，她那令人惊艳的美貌让全世界为之痴迷。

ex.en: Out on the bay the morning is radiant.
ex.cn: 海湾里的早晨阳光灿烂。

ex.en: Kathy smiled at her daughter's radiant face.
ex.cn: 凯茜对着女儿容光焕发的面孔微笑着。

def: adj.放射性的

ex.en: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
ex.cn: 废料被安全储存起来，直到其不再有辐射性。

ex.en: The government has been storing radioactive waste at Fernald for 50 years.
ex.cn: 政府在弗纳德存放放射性废料已达50年之久。

ex.en: Wine is radioactive but few people stop drinking it on that account.
ex.cn: 酒是有放射性的，可是很少有人因此而戒酒。

def:
n.破布,碎布,破旧衣服,碎片
vt.嘲笑，捉弄,糟蹋，欺负,指责，欺负人

ex.en: He was wiping his hands on an oily rag.
ex.cn: 他正在用一块满是油污的破布擦手。

ex.en: "This man Tom works for a local rag," he said.
ex.cn: “这个叫汤姆的人在一家地方小报社工作，”他说。

ex.en: We started out with a little rag-tag team of 30 people.
ex.cn: 我们最初只是一支由30人组成的散兵游勇的队伍。

def:
n.耙子,放荡的男人,倾斜度
v.耙,梳理,扫视,搜寻

ex.en: Rake the soil, press the seed into it, then cover it lightly.
ex.cn: 将土耙松，把种子种在土里，然后轻轻地盖上土。

ex.en: The privatisation allowed companies to rake in huge profits.
ex.cn: 私有化使许多公司大赚了一笔。

ex.en: Nobody wanted to rake over his past history.
ex.cn: 没人愿意重提旧事。

def:
vt.召集，集合,重整,重振，恢复
vi.聚集,集合,反弹，反败为胜,恢复（元气等）
n.集合,重新集合,重整的信号,反败为胜

ex.en: We were very keen when the 1954 Rally came round.
ex.cn: 1954年的集会开始时，我们都非常热切。

ex.en: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
ex.cn: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

ex.en: The immediate flashpoint was Wednesday's big rally in the city centre.
ex.cn: 星期三市中心的大集会成了直接的导火索。

def:
vt.掠夺，强夺,强奸
n.掠夺，强夺,[法]强奸,[植]油菜,葡萄渣

ex.en: It is an unpalatable fact that rape makes a good news story.
ex.cn: 强奸事件成了新闻报道的好素材，真是令人难以接受。

ex.en: Her party opposes abortion, except in cases of rape or incest.
ex.cn: 她的党派反对堕胎，但强奸或乱伦引起的怀孕除外。

ex.en: Most rape victims confess a feeling of helplessness.
ex.cn: 大部分强奸案受害者都承认有一种无助的感觉。

def:
adj.鲁莽的，轻率的,性急的,不顾后果的
n.（皮）疹,爆发,同时大量出现的事件

ex.en: He may break out in a rash when he eats these nuts.
ex.cn: 他吃了这些坚果可能会长皮疹。

ex.en: Don't do anything rash until the feel-ings subside.
ex.cn: 在冷静下来之前不要鲁莽行事。

ex.en: Mr. Major is making no rash promises.
ex.cn: 梅杰先生没有作出轻率的承诺。

def:
n.剃刀，刮面刀
vt.剃,用剃刀刮

ex.en: The camp is surrounded by razor-wire fences and guarded by military police.
ex.cn: 营地周围架着尖利的铁丝网，且有宪兵看守。

ex.en: He plugged his razor in to recharge it.
ex.cn: 他把剃刀插在插座上，给它充电。

ex.en: I want to buy an electric razor this weekend.
ex.cn: 这个周末我想买一个电动剃须刀.

def: adj.现实的,[艺] 现实主义的，[哲]实在论（者）的,逼真的,栩栩如生的

ex.en: He does not have any realistic chance of winning the election.
ex.cn: 他没有一点儿赢得选举的现实机会。

ex.en: These proposals represent a realistic starting point for negotiation.
ex.cn: 这些建议是谈判的现实出发点。

ex.en: I can commend it to him as a realistic course of action.
ex.cn: 我可以把这作为一个切实可行的处理方法推荐给他。

def: vt.& vi.收割,获得,得到（报偿）

ex.en: We are not in this to reap immense financial rewards.
ex.cn: 我们从事这一行不是为了获得巨大的经济回报。

ex.en: Cultivating a positive mental attitude towards yourself can reap tremendous benefits.
ex.cn: 培养一种自信的积极心态会让人受益匪浅。

ex.en: It is not easy to reap the harvest of my hard work.
ex.cn: 获得自己辛勤工作的成果是不容易的.

def: vt.使安心，使消除疑虑,再对…进行保险,再保证

ex.en: Banks are built to look solid to reassure their customers.
ex.cn: 银行往往建得看上去很坚固，好让顾客放心。

ex.en: They tried to reassure her, but she still felt anxious.
ex.cn: 他们设法让她放心，可她还是焦虑不安。

ex.en: I tried to reassure her, "Don't worry about it. We won't let it happen again."
ex.cn: 我试图使她安心，“不要担心。我们不会让它再次发生了。”

def: n.造反，叛乱,反抗

ex.en: A little adolescent rebellion is commonly believed to be healthy.
ex.cn: 大家一致认为，青少年有点叛逆是正常的。

ex.en: The rebellion is expected to further damage the country's image.
ex.cn: 预计叛乱将会进一步破坏这个国家的形象。

ex.en: He was prepared to suppress rebellion by shooting down protesters.
ex.cn: 他准备开枪射击抗议者以镇压叛乱。

def: vi.后退,减弱,（价值，品质等）跌落，低落，变坏,收回意见，退出（某种活动）

ex.en: If untreated, the gums recede, become swollen and bleed.
ex.cn: 如果不进行治疗，牙龈会开始萎缩、红肿和出血。

ex.en: Generally, warm colours advance in painting and cold colours recede.
ex.cn: 通常，绘画中暖色调为近感色，而冷色调为远感色。

ex.en: The mountain peaks recede into the distance as one leaves the shore.
ex.cn: 人离岸时,山峰向后退去.

def:
n.收据，发票,收入
vt.开收据,[美国英语]给…开收据，承认收到

ex.en: I'm going to make out a receipt for you.
ex.cn: 我开一张收据给你。

ex.en: Snape wrote a receipt with a gold fountain pen.
ex.cn: 斯内普用金笔开了一张收据。

ex.en: Proof of postage will not be accepted as proof of receipt.
ex.cn: 邮资单据不能当作收据。

def: n.食谱,处方,秘诀

ex.en: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used.
ex.cn: 每种菜谱都具体规定了所用鸡蛋的大小。

ex.en: The following recipe is a statement of another kind—food is fun!
ex.cn: 下面的食谱是另一种观点的表现——食物可以带来乐趣！

ex.en: Although this recipe looks long, it is actually very quick to prepare.
ex.cn: 尽管这个菜谱看上去很长，其实做起来很快。

def:
adj.相互的,互惠的,倒数的
n.倒数,互相关联的事物

ex.en: They expected a reciprocal gesture before more hostages could be freed.
ex.cn: 在更多人质获得自由之前他们期望看到对方也有相应的表示。

ex.en: Our relationship is based on reciprocal respect.
ex.cn: 我们的关系是以互相尊重为基础的.

ex.en: The department said many countries had reciprocal agreements for health care with Britain.
ex.cn: 该部门称许多国家和英国签订了医疗卫生互惠协议。

def:
vt.& vi.背诵,叙述,列举
vt.详述，列举,吟诵
vi.背诵,叙述

ex.en: All he could do was recite a list of Government failings.
ex.cn: 他能做的只是列举政府的种种不是。

ex.en: Each child had to recite a poem to the class.
ex.cn: 每个孩子都得在班上背诵一首诗。

ex.en: I do not doubt ( but ) that he can recite it.
ex.cn: 我相信他能把它背下来.

def: adj.鲁莽的，不顾危险的,粗心大意的,满不在乎的,胆大妄为

ex.en: Many people believe reckless drivers are treated too leniently.
ex.cn: 很多人认为对鲁莽驾驶的司机处罚过轻。

ex.en: The rap against Conn was that he was far too reckless.
ex.cn: 科恩被人们认为做事太不计后果。

ex.en: Contrary to the popular myth, women are not reckless spendthrifts.
ex.cn: 和人们的普遍观念恰恰相反，女性并不是胡乱挥霍者。

def:
vt.记起，想起
v.想起,回想，追忆，回忆，记忆,使（自己）想起一时忘掉的事,想到

ex.en: She could no longer recollect the details of the letter.
ex.cn: 她想不起那封信的细节了。

ex.en: He tried to recollect things and drown himself in them.
ex.cn: 他极力回想过去的事情而沉浸于回忆之中.

ex.en: Try hard to recollect what you saw before the accident.
ex.cn: 好好回想一下事故发生之前你看到的事情.

def: n.[数]长方形，矩形

ex.en: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
ex.cn: 设长方形的宽是x米.

ex.en: He handed me a little rectangle of white paper.
ex.cn: 他递给我一张小小的长方形白纸片。

ex.en: A squared rectangle is a rectangle dissected into at least two squares.
ex.cn: 方化矩形是指可以分割成至少两个正方形的矩形.

def:
vt.回收利用,使再循环
vi.重复利用

ex.en: The objective would be to recycle 98 per cent of domestic waste.
ex.cn: 目标是对98%的生活垃圾进行回收利用。

ex.en: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.
ex.cn: 德国环保运动的影响力使得该国率先发起了回收利用更多废品的运动。

ex.en: Chemical constantly circulate or recycle in the system.
ex.cn: 化学物质在系统中不断循环或回流.

def: adj.多余的，累赘的,（因人员过剩）被解雇的，失业的,重沓,衍

ex.en: Changes in technology may mean that once-valued skills are now redundant.
ex.cn: 技术上的革新可能意味着曾经被重视的技术现在已变得多余。

ex.en: My husband was made redundant late last year.
ex.cn: 我丈夫去年年底被裁了。

ex.en: to be made redundant from your job
ex.cn: 成为冗员而被裁减

def: n.芦苇,芦苇杆,[乐]舌簧

ex.en: Referee Michael Reed had no hesitation in awarding a penalty.
ex.cn: 裁判迈克尔·里德毫不犹豫地判了点球。

ex.en: Reed International is a curiosity in the international world of publishing.
ex.cn: 里德国际公司是国际出版界的一朵奇葩。

ex.en: The river banks were overgrown with reed.
ex.cn: 河岸长满了芦苇.

def:
n.卷轴,卷盘,卷筒,绕在卷轴上的线（或金属丝、胶卷等）
vt.卷,绕
vi.蹒跚，摇晃,来回旋转,眩晕

ex.en: The musicians burst into a rousing rendition of "Paddy Casey's Reel".
ex.cn: 这些音乐家激情演绎了《帕迪·凯西的里尔舞曲》。

ex.en: The rod bent double, the reel shrieked and ratcheted.
ex.cn: 操作杆进一步弯曲，线轴发出刺耳的吱吱声。

ex.en: a reel on a fishing rod
ex.cn: 钓鱼竿上的绕线轮

def: vt.提炼,改善,使高雅

ex.en: We shall have to refine on our methods of advertising.
ex.cn: 我们得进一步改进做广告的方法.

ex.en: The purpose of oil refinery is to refine crude petroleum.
ex.cn: 炼油厂的主要工作是提炼原油.

ex.en: Modern medical techniques refine on those of the past.
ex.cn: 现代医疗技术比过去的医疗技术要优越.

def:
vt.抑制，克制
n.（诗歌的）叠句，副歌,经常重复的评价（或抱怨）
vi.忍耐，节制

ex.en: Rosa's constant refrain is that she doesn't have a life.
ex.cn: 罗莎总是重复的一句话就是她没有像样的生活。

ex.en: Please refrain from smoking.
ex.cn: 请勿吸烟。

ex.en: I made a terrific effort to refrain from tears.
ex.cn: 我狠着心把泪止住.

def:
n.避难,避难所,庇护者,[医]救急疗法
vt.给予…庇护,接纳…避难
vi.躲避,避难

ex.en: We climbed up a winding track towards a mountain refuge.
ex.cn: 我们沿着一条蜿蜒的小道爬向山上的一处避难所。

ex.en: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
ex.cn: 4名在意大利大使馆寻求避难的人已经自愿离开了。

ex.en: His home became a place of refuge for the believers.
ex.cn: 他的家成了信徒们的避难之处。

def:
n.资金偿还,偿还数额
vt.退还,归还或偿还
vi.进行偿还
n.政治制度，政权，政体,管理，方法,[医]养生法,（病人等的）生活规则

ex.en: The military regime in power was unpopular and repressive.
ex.cn: 当权的军政府压制人民，不得人心。

ex.en: He has a new fitness regime to strengthen his back.
ex.cn: 他有一个增强背部力量的新健身计划。

ex.en: The massacre laid bare the moral bankruptcy of the regime.
ex.cn: 大屠杀使该政权的道德沦丧暴露无遗。

def: n.排练，排演,彩排，演习,复述，详述

ex.en: The sketch should be a kind of rehearsal for the eventual painting.
ex.cn: 草图应该是最终绘画的某种演练。

ex.en: The rehearsal studio is buzzing with lunchtime activity.
ex.cn: 大家在吃午饭，排练室里很是嘈杂。

ex.en: The rehearsal process also irked him increasingly.
ex.cn: 排练过程也让他越来越厌烦。

def:
n.驾驭（法）,统治手段,控制（权）,缰绳
vt.勒缰绳使（马）停步,驾驭,严格控制
vi.勒住马

ex.en: The government would try to rein back inflation.
ex.cn: 政府将努力控制通货膨胀。

ex.en: The horse answered to the slightest pull on the rein.
ex.cn: 只要缰绳轻轻一拉,马就作出反应.

ex.en: Her parents had kept her on a tight rein with their narrow and inflexible views.
ex.cn: 她的父母观念狭隘而僵化，对她管束很严。

def: n.<物>相对论,相关性,相对性

ex.en: Einstein formulated the Theory of Relativity in 1905.
ex.cn: 爱因斯坦于1905年创立了相对论。

ex.en: According to the theory of relativity, nothing can travel faster than light.
ex.cn: 根据相对论，任何东西都无法超越光速。

ex.en: Einstein's theory of relativity won for him universal esteem.
ex.cn: 爱因斯坦的相对论赢得了全世界对他的崇敬.

def:
n.接替人员，替班,传递,接力赛,继电器
vt.转播，传达,用驿马递送，使接替,分程传递

ex.en: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.
ex.cn: 英国要在接力赛中战胜美国，前景看上去并不那么乐观。

ex.en: This metal tower is used to relay television signals to distant villages.
ex.cn: 这个金属塔是用于向遥远的村子转播电视讯号的.

ex.en: Messengers will relay your letters.
ex.cn: 邮递员将接转你的信件.

def:
vt.品尝，品味,给…加佐料，调味,欣赏
vi.有滋味,有…的味道
n.味道，滋味,调味品,引起兴趣的东西

ex.en: She folded up her letter, licking the envelope flap with relish.
ex.cn: 她把信折好，用力舔了舔信封的折口。

ex.en: The three men ate with relish.
ex.cn: 这3个人吃得津津有味。

ex.en: She retailed the neighbours' activities with relish.
ex.cn: 她饶有兴趣地对邻居们的活动说三道四。

def:
n.剩余物,其他人员,差数,廉价出售的图书
vt.廉价出售（书）,廉价出售
adj.剩余的,留存下的

ex.en: I spent the remainder of the day feeling terrible.
ex.cn: 我那天余下的时间里心情都很糟糕。

ex.en: Efforts to persuade the remainder to follow suit have continued.
ex.cn: 说服其余人跟着效仿的努力仍在继续。

ex.en: I kept some of his books and gave away the remainder.
ex.cn: 我保留了一些他的书，其他的都送人了。

def:
n.剩余部分,残余,幸存者,零料，零头布
adj.剩余的,残留的

ex.en: Obedience by women towards men is a remnant of religious teaching.
ex.cn: 女人对男人的顺从是宗教教义的残迹。

ex.en: The Ainu settlers in Hokkaido are the last remnant of a prehistoric race.
ex.cn: 北海道的阿伊努人是史前某个种族的最后残存者.

ex.en: It matters little where we pass the remnant of our days.
ex.cn: 我们在什么地方度过我们的余年已经无关紧要.

def: n.免职,除去,移走,搬迁

vt.偿还,付还,报答,酬报
vi.偿还，补偿

ex.en: His main task is to raise enough finance to repay secured loans.
ex.cn: 他的主要任务是筹集足够的资金以偿还抵押贷款。

ex.en: He didn't have the wherewithal to repay the loan.
ex.cn: 他没有钱偿还贷款.

ex.en: I feel honor bound to repay the money I borrowed.
ex.cn: 我觉得有责任归还我借的钱.

def: n.全部节目,全部本领,（计算机的）指令表

ex.en: Meredith D'Ambrosio has thousands of songs in her repertoire.
ex.cn: 梅雷迪思·丹布罗西奥会唱几千首歌曲。

ex.en: His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
ex.cn: 他能演奏从巴赫到勋伯格的所有作品。

ex.en: a pianist with a wide repertoire
ex.cn: 能演奏很多曲子的钢琴师

def: n.重复，反复,背诵,复制品，副本,[乐]复唱，复奏，重奏

ex.en: Her prose style is not always felicitous; she tends to repetition.
ex.cn: 她的行文风格并非总是恰到好处，往往爱重复。

ex.en: It is real prayer, and not mechanical repetition.
ex.cn: 这是真正的祈祷，不是机械的重复。

ex.en: We do not want to see a repetition of last year's tragic events.
ex.cn: 我们不想看到去年的悲剧重演。

def: n.压抑,约束,抑制，镇压

ex.en: This argument is only too blatantly an alibi for domestic repression.
ex.cn: 这一辩解完全是在为国内的镇压活动开脱。

ex.en: Repression made him behave worse.
ex.cn: 受抑制使他表现得更糟.

ex.en: In a very real sense, post - war repression was the continuation of the war.
ex.cn: 就真正意义上来说, 战后经济衰退就是战争的继续.

def:
vt.责备，责骂,使丢脸,申斥,损伤…的体面
n.责备，责骂,耻辱，污辱,谴责,[宗]应答圣歌

ex.en: You've no reason to reproach yourself, no reason to feel shame.
ex.cn: 你没有理由自责，也没有理由感到惭愧。

ex.en: We begin to reproach ourselves for not having been more careful.
ex.cn: 我们开始自责起来，怪自己不够小心。

ex.en: It was a jest rather than a reproach.
ex.cn: 这与其说是责备，还不如说是句玩笑呢。

def:
vt.& vi.复制，重现，再版,生殖，繁殖
vt.使再次发生,再现

ex.en: He is not attempting necessarily to reproduce the cadence of speech.
ex.cn: 他不想刻意重复那种讲话的语调。

ex.en: We are grateful to you for permission to reproduce this article.
ex.cn: 非常感谢您允许我们复印这篇文章。

ex.en: The enclosed photograph is unfortunately not good enough to reproduce.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是，附寄的照片不够清晰，无法复制。

def:
n.爬行动物,卑鄙的人
adj.爬虫类的,卑鄙的
n.相似，形似,外表，外观,相似物，相似点,肖像

ex.en: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
ex.cn: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

ex.en: The hero, Danny, bears an uncanny resemblance to Kirk Douglas.
ex.cn: 主人公丹尼与柯克·道格拉斯出奇地相像。

ex.en: Any resemblance to actual persons, places or events is purely coincidental.
ex.cn: 如与真人、真实地点或真实事件有雷同之处，纯属巧合。

def: vt.与…相像，类似于

ex.en: Did it resemble the earth when this was destitute of an atmosphere?
ex.cn: 它同地球上还没有大气的时候一样 吗 ?

ex.en: The pattern so obtained will not resemble any of the others.
ex.cn: 所得到的这个图样将不同于其他各种特征图样.

ex.en: His nails resemble the ivory keys of the spinet.
ex.cn: 他的指甲象白色的琴键一样.

def: adj.坚决的，刚毅的,不动摇的

ex.en: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
ex.cn: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

ex.en: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
ex.cn: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

ex.en: He became even more resolute in his opposition to the plan.
ex.cn: 他更加坚决地反对这个计划。

def: adj.各自的，分别的

ex.en: It is important that we dovetail our respective interests.
ex.cn: 让我们各自的利益相吻合很重要。

ex.en: The duo set up a scam to settle their respective debts.
ex.cn: 那对搭档设了一计以消除各自的债务。

ex.en: Steve and I were at very different stages in our respective careers.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫和我在各自的职业生涯中处于迥然不同的阶段。

def: adj.焦躁不安的,不耐烦的,坐立不安的,难以入睡的

ex.en: The unity of our society is threatened by troublesome and restless minorities.
ex.cn: 我们社会的团结遭到了一小撮滋扰生事、不安分守己的群体的威胁。

ex.en: He felt restless and dissatisfied as he drove home.
ex.cn: 在开车回家的途中，他感到烦躁不安，很不高兴。

ex.en: Marian retains a restless, youthful spirit, in search of new horizons.
ex.cn: 玛丽安怀着一颗年轻、不断进取的心去寻求新的天地。

def:
adj.因而发生的，结果必然产生的,[物]组合的，合成的
n.结果，后果,合力，合成力，合成[运动]，[数]结式，消元式，[物]合量，组合，[化]生成物，（反应）产物,[数学] 合矢量：等价于一组向量的一个单个向量

ex.en: the growing economic crisis and resultant unemployment
ex.cn: 不断加剧的经济危机以及由此而产生的失业

ex.en: At least a quarter of a million people have died in the fighting and the resultant famines.
ex.cn: 至少25万人死于这场战斗和由此引发的饥荒。

ex.en: The resultant material was to be pored over by experts in psychology.
ex.cn: 这样的一份材料要由心理学专家精心研究.

def: n.保留,记忆力，保持力,滞留，扣留,闭尿

ex.en: He argues strongly for retention of NATO as a guarantee of peace.
ex.cn: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

ex.en: They supported the retention of a strong central government.
ex.cn: 他们赞成保留一个强大的中央政府。

ex.en: The company needs to improve its training and retention of staff.
ex.cn: 公司需要改进对员工的培训和留用工作。

def:
vt.反驳,报复,杀菌釜
vi.回嘴,反驳
n.反驳，回嘴,反驳的回答

ex.en: His sharp retort clearly made an impact.
ex.cn: 他尖刻的反驳显然起了作用。

ex.en: Her retort was mechanical.
ex.cn: 她的反驳是脱口而出的。

ex.en: He scored a bull's - eye in their argument with that witty retort.
ex.cn: 在他们的辩论中他那一句机智的反驳击中了要害.

def:
vt.取回,恢复,[计]检索,重新得到
vi.找回猎物
n.恢复，挽回,取回,[计]检索

ex.en: He is the one man who could retrieve that situation.
ex.cn: 他是唯一能挽回局面的人。

ex.en: Computers can instantly retrieve millions of information bits.
ex.cn: 计算机可以立即检索到数百万条信息。

ex.en: She bent to retrieve her comb from the floor.
ex.cn: 她弯腰从地上捡起她的梳子。

def:
n.回顾，回想
vt.&vi.回顾,追溯

ex.en: The debate seems, in retrospect, to have been fixed from the beginning.
ex.cn: 回想起来，这场辩论好像从一开始就被人操纵了。

ex.en: It was , in retrospect, the happiest day of her life.
ex.cn: 回想起来, 那是她一生最幸福的日子.

ex.en: In retrospect it's obvious how we went wrong.
ex.cn: 回想起来,我们是如何出的错就很明显了.

def: n.[宗]天启，启示,揭发，暴露,被揭露出来的事物,意外的发现

ex.en: I was shocked, brought down to earth by this revelation.
ex.cn: 真相的披露让我深感震惊，我被带回了现实。

ex.en: The noise, the buildings, the people, came as a revelation.
ex.cn: 这里的噪音、建筑物和人都令人出乎意料。

ex.en: For this revelation he was struck blind by the goddess Hera.
ex.cn: 由于揭露此事，他被女神赫拉弄瞎了眼。

def:
vt.修订,改变,修正,[主英国英语]复习
vt.& vi.复习
vi.修订，校订
n.修订,校订,[印刷]校样，清样,修订版，修订本

ex.en: The staff should work together to revise the school curriculum.
ex.cn: 全体教职工应当齐心协力修订学校课程。

ex.en: I'd better skip the party and stay at home to revise.
ex.cn: 我最好还是不去参加这个聚会，留在家里温习功课。

ex.en: I can see I will have to revise my opinions of his abilities now.
ex.cn: 我明白我现在不得不改变对他的能力的看法了。

def:
n.带,（打印机的）色带,绶带,带状物
v.把…撕成条带,用缎带装饰,形成带状

ex.en: Add a length of ribbon tied in a bow.
ex.cn: 再用一段丝带，系个蝴蝶结。

ex.en: Mrs. Haines stood nearby, holding scissors to cut a ribbon.
ex.cn: 海恩斯夫人站在旁边，手持剪刀准备剪彩。

ex.en: I covered the scroll in sealing wax, and affixed a red ribbon.
ex.cn: 我用封蜡将卷轴封好，并系上一根红丝带。

def:
n.粗筛,谜语,猜不透的难题，难解之谜
v.用筛分选（卵石等），筛分,用子弹把耙子打成蜂窝似的,精查（证据）,解（谜），猜

ex.en: He was on a caravanning holiday.
ex.cn: 他驾房车外出游玩去了。

ex.en: Russia is a riddle wrapped in a mystery inside an enigma.
ex.cn: 俄罗斯是被包藏在一个闷葫芦里面的神秘物体之中的谜.

ex.en: The riddle couldn't be solved by the child.
ex.cn: 这个谜语孩子猜不出来.

def:
n.背脊，峰，隆起线,山脊，山脉，海脊,高压脊,皱摺，田埂
vt.使成脊状，使隆起
vi.使成脊状

ex.en: Every man who could fight was now committed to defend the ridge.
ex.cn: 每个能够参加战斗的男子现在都决心要保卫这条山脊。

ex.en: Even among seasoned mountaineers Pinnacle Ridge is considered quite a tough proposition.
ex.cn: 即使在经验丰富的登山者中，平纳克尔峰也被认为是很难攀登的。

ex.en: The fawn ran to the top of the ridge.
ex.cn: 小鹿跑上山脊。

def: adj.可笑的，荒谬的,荒唐的，愚蠢的,胡枝扯叶

ex.en: The deal seems so attractive it would be ridiculous to say no.
ex.cn: 这笔交易看上去太诱人了，要是拒绝它简直是笑话。

ex.en: The film starts off realistically and then develops into a ridiculous fantasy.
ex.cn: 电影以写实开头，然后却发展成为荒诞的幻想。

ex.en: Ludlam was responsible for making Ridiculous Theatre something of a cult.
ex.cn: 荒诞派戏剧的风靡要归功于勒德拉姆。

def:
n.步枪,来福枪
vt.& vi.快速搜寻,匆忙翻找 ,偷窃,盗取

ex.en: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
ex.cn: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

ex.en: He fixed a bayonet to the end of his rifle.
ex.cn: 他在步枪口上安好了刺刀。

ex.en: Neighbours heard the sound of rifle fire and alerted the police.
ex.cn: 邻居们听到了步枪声，就报了警。

def:
n.（圆形器皿的）边，缘，框,轮缘
vt.环绕（圆形或环形物的）边缘,镶边
vt.& vi.形成…的边沿，给…镶边

ex.en: Far up the west rim of the canyon, a coyote yipped twice.
ex.cn: 远处峡谷的西缘，一只丛林狼嚎叫了两声。

ex.en: She sipped from her coffee mug, watching him over the rim.
ex.cn: 她端着咖啡杯小口地喝着，目光越过杯沿注视着他。

ex.en: I prised off the metal rim surrounding one of the dials.
ex.cn: 我把其中一个刻度盘的金属边撬开了。

def:
n.骚乱，暴动，暴乱，骚动，混乱,放荡，闹饮，嘈闹的宴会，喝酒狂闹,五色缤纷，喧嚣嘈杂,（想像，感情等的）奔放
vi.暴动，闹事,放荡
vt.浪费,挥霍

ex.en: Twelve inmates have been killed during a riot at the prison.
ex.cn: 12名犯人在一场监狱暴乱中被杀害。

ex.en: A conservatory offers the perfect excuse to let your imagination run riot.
ex.cn: 音乐学院让你有充分的理由任想象力自由驰骋。

ex.en: Riot police are being deployed throughout the city to prevent any trouble.
ex.cn: 正在全城部署防暴警察以防止发生骚乱。

def:
n.裂口,废物,[美国俚语]偷窃,浪子
vt.& vi.扯破，撕坏
vt.撕成,锯,猛地扯开,拆（衣服）
vi.裂开，绽线

ex.en: Underneath this image of normalcy, addiction threatened to rip this family apart.
ex.cn: 在这一切正常的表象下潜伏的是将使这个家庭四分五裂的毒瘾。

ex.en: "Yaaaaaaa," Carla let rip with the cry of the Valkyries.
ex.cn: “呀——”卡拉放开喉咙，发出女武神瓦尔基里一般的嘶喊声。

ex.en: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions.
ex.cn: 当我们被推向相反的方向时，我感觉横幅被撕裂了。

def:
n.（宗教等的）仪式,例行公事，老规矩,典礼
adj.作为仪式的一部分的,礼节性的,例行公事的

ex.en: What we see at Westminster is a tired old ritual.
ex.cn: 我们在威斯敏斯特教堂看到的是一种经年不变的古旧仪式。

ex.en: These ceremonies were already part of pre-Christian ritual in Mexico.
ex.cn: 这些仪式已经成为墨西哥基督教时期以前的宗教仪式的一部分。

ex.en: Cocktails at the Plaza was a nightly ritual of their sophisticated world.
ex.cn: 到广场饭店喝鸡尾酒是他们这个高雅时髦的圈子中的人每晚必做的事情。

def:
vi.咆哮,喧闹,吼叫,混乱或吵闹
vt.大声喊出,使…轰鸣,吼，咆啸
n.吼叫声，咆哮声，呼啸声,狂笑，大笑

ex.en: Now and then they heard the roar of a heavy truck.
ex.cn: 他们不时地听到大卡车的轰鸣声。

ex.en: A roar of approval resounded through the Ukrainian parliament.
ex.cn: 一片赞成声在乌克兰议会中回响。

ex.en: Local residents saw it plunge towards Earth with a deafening roar.
ex.cn: 当地的居民看见它伴着一声震耳欲聋的巨响撞向地面。

def:
vt.& vi.烤，烘，焙
vt.嘲讽，挖苦
n.烤肉,户外烧烤野餐
adj.烤好的，烤制的

ex.en: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
ex.cn: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

ex.en: A tantalising aroma of roast beef fills the air.
ex.cn: 空气中充满诱人的烤牛肉香味。

ex.en: Come into the kitchen. I've got to put the roast in.
ex.cn: 到厨房来。我得把烤肉放进去。

def:
n.礼服,法衣,睡袍,长袍
vt.& vi.（使）穿上长袍（或浴衣等）,覆盖、穿上

ex.en: He brought forth a small gold amulet from beneath his robe.
ex.cn: 他从袍子下面拿出一个不大的金护身符。

ex.en: He helped her off with her robe.
ex.cn: 他帮她脱去袍子。

ex.en: The emperor was clad in a rich robe encrusted with jewels.
ex.cn: 皇帝身穿一件镶满宝石的华贵礼袍.

def: adj.精力充沛的,坚定的,粗野的，粗鲁的,需要体力的

ex.en: The Neanderthals were very robust and quite different from us.
ex.cn: 尼安德特时期的人非常强壮，和我们迥然不同。

ex.en: He replied in characteristically robust style.
ex.cn: 像以往一样，他的回答铿锵有力。

ex.en: She was almost 90, but still very robust.
ex.cn: 她将近90岁了，但身体仍然十分强健。

def:
n.浪漫史,爱情小说,恋爱,传奇色彩
vt.& vi.虚构,渲染,谈情说爱,追求某人

ex.en: Producers decided to end her on-screen romance with Pierce Lawton.
ex.cn: 制片人决定结束她在影片中与皮尔斯·劳顿的恋情。

ex.en: She loved him so much: it was a fairytale romance.
ex.cn: 她深深爱着他：这是个童话般的浪漫故事。

ex.en: It is ridiculous to suggest we are having a romance.
ex.cn: 暗示我们正在谈恋爱的说法真是太荒谬了。

def:
adj.浪漫的，谈情说爱的，多情的，风流的，香艳的,空想的，虚构的，怪诞的，想入非非的，不实际的，难实行的（计划等）,传奇（式）的，小说般的，情节离奇的,浪漫主义的
n.富于浪漫气息的人,浪漫主义作家[画家等]，浪漫派诗人[艺术家],浪漫思想[行为]

ex.en: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
ex.cn: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

ex.en: She clings to a romantic fantasy of wedded bliss.
ex.cn: 她沉醉于婚后幸福的浪漫幻想。

ex.en: There's nothing like candlelight for creating a romantic mood.
ex.cn: 再没什么比烛光更能营造浪漫气氛了。

def:
adj.旋转的
n.旋转式机器,环行交叉路

ex.en: A rotary telephone has a wheel with holes for each number.
ex.cn: 转盘式电话有个带眼的轮子.

ex.en: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion.
ex.cn: 1951年发明的转缸式发动机是内燃机领域内的革命性概念。

ex.en: The central unit is a rotary drum.
ex.cn: 核心设备是一个旋转的滚筒.

def:
adj.腐烂的,恶臭的,堕落的,极坏的
adv.非常,极其

ex.en: Police corruption is not just a few rotten apples.
ex.cn: 警方的腐败不仅仅是几个害群之马造成的。

ex.en: Molly razzed me about my rotten sense of direction.
ex.cn: 莫利笑话我糟糕的方向感。

ex.en: They made the treacherous journey across stormy seas in rotten boats.
ex.cn: 他们乘着破旧的小船穿越风大浪急的海面，完成了这次危险之旅。

def:
n.绕道,环形交通枢纽,旋转木马
adj.绕圈子的,不直截了当的,间接的，迂回的

ex.en: The turn is about two kilometres before the roundabout.
ex.cn: 拐弯就在环岛前面约2公里处。

ex.en: Just past the Barlby roundabout there's temporary traffic lights.
ex.cn: 在刚过巴尔比环岛的地方，有一个临时红绿灯。

ex.en: At the roundabout, take the second exit.
ex.cn: 到环岛后，走第二个出口。

def:
v.叫醒，惊醒,鼓励，鼓舞,使发脾气,使振奋
n.觉醒,奋起,[军]<英>起床号,干杯
vi.醒来,奋起

ex.en: She seemed to be unable to rouse herself to do anything.
ex.cn: 她似乎打不起精神去做任何事情。

ex.en: He did more to rouse the crowd there than anybody else.
ex.cn: 他比其他任何人都更积极地鼓动那里的群众。

ex.en: The uproar was enough to rouse both the quick and the dead.
ex.cn: 这喧嚣声足以惊醒生者和死者.

def: n.王族成员,版税,王位，王权,堂皇，庄严

ex.en: She bowed her head in a gesture somehow reminiscent of royalty.
ex.cn: 她低头的姿势让人想起皇室风范。

ex.en: Royalty is regarded with unquestioned reverence.
ex.cn: 王室成员毫无争议地受到尊重。

ex.en: The gala evening was attended by royalty and politicians.
ex.cn: 王室成员和政坛要人参加了这个晚会。

def:
vt.擦，摩擦,用…擦,触怒,（使）相互磨擦
vi.接触，摩擦,擦伤,在困境中持续下去
n.摩擦的动作,表面不平,阻碍，困难

ex.en: I was hoping some of his genius might rub off.
ex.cn: 我希望他的才华也可以影响他人。

ex.en: Rub the surface of the wood in preparation for the varnish.
ex.cn: 打磨木头的表面，为刷清漆做准备。

ex.en: Nobody else believed that they had tried to rub out the pope.
ex.cn: 其他人都不相信他们试图杀死教皇。

def:
n.红宝石，红玉,红宝石色，深红色,<英>细铅字,红葡萄酒
adj.红宝石的,红宝石色的
vt.使带红宝石色,把…弄红,把…涂染成红色

ex.en: The shooting-range is lit from underneath by rows of ruby-red light fittings.
ex.cn: 射击场被一排排深红色的灯光设备从下面照亮了.

ex.en: They got misty-eyed listening to records of Ruby Murray singing "Danny Boy".
ex.cn: 聆听着唱片里鲁比·默里演唱《丹尼男孩》的时候，他们泪眼模糊。

ex.en: Ruby recalled getting stoned during her misspent youth.
ex.cn: 鲁比还记得，在虚度光阴的少女时代她曾经因为吸食毒品而飘飘欲仙。

def: n.小块地毯,〈英〉（围盖膝的）围毯，车毯,〈美俚男子假发

ex.en: His shoe had rucked up one corner of the pale rug.
ex.cn: 他的鞋子把浅色地毯的一角弄皱了。

ex.en: The multicoloured rag rug was chosen to liven up the grey carpet.
ex.cn: 选择这块五彩缤纷的碎呢小毯是为了给这灰色的地毯添些生气。

ex.en: A Berber rug makes a colourful wall-hanging.
ex.cn: 柏柏尔小地毯可以当色彩艳丽的壁毯。

def:
n.铁锈,锈病，锈菌,荒废，停滞,锈，锈色
vt.& vi.（使）生锈,[植]害锈病,变钝，荒废

ex.en: Rust and flaking paint mean the metalwork is in poor condition.
ex.cn: 生锈和掉漆说明金属配件损毁严重。

ex.en: Ray painted below the waterline with a special anti-rust paint.
ex.cn: 雷用专门的防锈涂料涂船的吃水线以下的部位。

ex.en: pipes covered with rust
ex.cn: 生了锈的管子

def: adj.无情的，冷酷的,残忍的,狠,辣

ex.en: Successfully merging two banks requires a fast and ruthless attack on costs.
ex.cn: 成功合并两家银行需要坚决快速地着手解决费用问题。

ex.en: The late newspaper tycoon is condemned for his ruthless treatment of employees.
ex.cn: 已故的报业大亨因为残忍地对待员工而遭到谴责。

ex.en: Her lawyers have been ruthless in thrashing out a divorce settlement.
ex.cn: 她的律师在讨论离婚协议的过程中表现得非常坚决。

def:
n.麻袋,洗劫,<英俚>解雇
vt.解雇,把…装进袋里,掠夺

ex.en: Other industries have had to sack managers to reduce administrative costs.
ex.cn: 其他行业只得精简管理人员以减少行政开支。

ex.en: Francis bundled up her clothes again into their small sack.
ex.cn: 弗朗西丝再次把她的衣服塞进了他们的小袋子里。

ex.en: Thieves ransacked the office, taking a sack of loose change.
ex.cn: 窃贼洗劫了办公室,拿走了一口袋散币.

def: adj.宗教的,神圣的,受崇敬的，值得崇敬的,有宗教性质的

n.马鞍,（自行车或摩托车的）车座,鞍形架，鞍状物,（动物的）脊肉
vt.& vi.给（马）装鞍
vt.使承担

ex.en: Naomi was given a pony and taught to ride side-saddle.
ex.cn: 别人给娜奥米一匹小型马并教会她如何侧骑马。

ex.en: He ran to the door and vaulted into the saddle.
ex.cn: 他跑到门口，飞身跃上马背。

ex.en: He threw the old cloth saddle across the donkey's back.
ex.cn: 他把旧布鞍搭在驴背上。

def:
n.保护，保卫,防护措施,安全设施
vt.保护，保卫,防护

ex.en: The problem was to safeguard sites from encroachment by property development.
ex.cn: 问题是要保护遗址免受房地产开发商的侵占。

ex.en: Many people took second jobs as a safeguard against unemployment.
ex.cn: 许多人为防失业都干两份工作。

ex.en: to safeguard a person's interests
ex.cn: 维护某人的利益

def:
vt.& vi.欢迎，致敬
vt.向…致意,赞扬，赞颂
vi.致意，打招呼,行礼
n.致敬，欢迎,敬礼,举枪，举刀（礼）

ex.en: As a second lieutenant, he had to salute damned near everybody.
ex.cn: 身为少尉，他几乎是逢人便得敬礼。

ex.en: He raised his hand in salute.
ex.cn: 他举手致意。

ex.en: The soldier gave the clenched-fist salute.
ex.cn: 士兵行握拳礼。

def: n.拯救，救助,救星，救世主,解救办法，救济措施,救济品

ex.en: The church's message of salvation has changed the lives of many.
ex.cn: 基督教中耶稣拯救灵魂的教义改变了很多人的生活。

ex.en: I consider books my salvation.
ex.cn: 我视书本为救星。

ex.en: to pray for the salvation of the world
ex.cn: 为世人得救而祷告

def:
n.制裁，处罚,批准，认可,约束力,鼓励
vt.批准,鼓励，容忍

ex.en: The Security Council will consider taking future actions against sanction-busters.
ex.cn: 安理会将考虑未来采取措施打击破坏制裁的人。

ex.en: As an ultimate sanction, they can sell their shares.
ex.cn: 作为最高的处罚，他们可以出售他们的股份。

ex.en: He seemed to be preparing to sanction an increase in public borrowing.
ex.cn: 他似乎正准备批准增加公共贷款。

def: adj.心智健全的,神志正常的,明智的,稳健的

ex.en: Did he come across as a sane rational person?
ex.cn: 他看起来是一个正常而理智的人吗？

ex.en: I alone was sane, I thought, in a world of crazy people.
ex.cn: 我认为，在一群疯子的世界里只有我自己是理性的。

ex.en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane.
ex.cn: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然心智健全。

def: adj.讥讽的，讽刺的，挖苦的

ex.en: "What a surprise!" Caroline murmured sarcastically.
ex.cn: “太神奇了!”卡罗琳轻声挖苦道。

ex.en: In certain conditions, answering back sarcastically is necessary.
ex.cn: 在某种情况下, 反唇相讥是必要的.

ex.en: " Full of lucky words , aren't you? " demanded the old man , sarcastically.
ex.cn: “ 什么话! 你倒先来发利市了!

def: n.讽刺,讽刺文学,讽刺作品

ex.en: Looking at her satiric parent she only gave a little laugh.
ex.cn: 她望着她那挖苦人的父亲,只讪讪地笑了一下.

ex.en: His satiric poem spared neither the politicians nor the merchants.
ex.cn: 政客们和商人们都未能免于遭受他的诗篇的讽刺.

ex.en: No need to use such satiric word.
ex.cn: 没必要用这么讽刺的言语.

def:
n.调味汁,酱汁,〈非〉莽撞无礼,〈俚〉烈酒
vt.调味或加沙司于…,给…增加趣味或风味,〈非〉对…无礼
n.茶杯托，茶碟,（放花盆的）垫盘（等）,浅碟形盆地,〈美〉拳击场
n.香肠，腊肠,〈口〉德国人

n.锯,谚语，格言
vt.& vi.往复移动,锯成,用锯,拉锯
v.看见（ see的过去式）,观看,领会,考虑

vt.<计>扫描,细看,细查,（雷达）对…进行扫描
n.扫描,浏览,审视,（雷达）（屏面上的）光点

n.嗡嗡声,电话,乱哄哄的说话声,醉酒

ex.en: Hundreds of flies buzz around us, and the workman keeps swatting them.
ex.cn: 数百只苍蝇围着我们转，工作人员不停地拍打。

ex.en: And I'll buzz over to talk some sense into old Ocker.
ex.cn: 我会不厌其烦地给那个固执己见的澳大利亚老头讲道理。

ex.en: We'll give him a buzz when we get to Maybury Street.
ex.cn: 我们到了梅贝里街的时候会给他打电话.

def: n.审查制度,审查机构,审察员的职权,[心]潜意识中的抑制力

ex.en: There was never an official institution of censorship in Albania.
ex.cn: 在阿尔巴尼亚从未设立过官方审查制度。

ex.en: The government today announced that press censorship was being lifted.
ex.cn: 政府今天宣布将取消新闻审查制度。

ex.en: The banning of his play decided him to write about censorship.
ex.cn: 他的戏剧被禁演，这促使他下定决心就审查制度的问题下笔。

def: n.[天]彗星,孛

ex.en: They observed the comet for 70 days before it faded from sight.
ex.cn: 他们观察了这颗彗星70天，直至其慢慢从视线中消失。

ex.en: Comet also sired the champion foal out of Spinway Harvest.
ex.cn: “彗星”还跟“斯平威·哈维斯特”生下了这匹出类拔萃的小马驹。

ex.en: We were not altogether sure that the comet would miss the Earth.
ex.cn: 我们不能完全肯定彗星不会与地球相撞。

def: adj.有传染性的,传染病的,有感染力的,会蔓延的

ex.en: Antonio has a contagious enthusiasm for the beautiful aspect of food.
ex.cn: 安东尼奥对食品赏心悦目这一方面的热情非常有感染性。

ex.en: Scarlet fever is highly contagious.
ex.cn: 猩红热的接触传染性很强。

ex.en: It's a highly contagious infection.
ex.cn: 这种病极易传染.

def:
vi.（线条、运动的物体等）会于一点,聚集,人或车辆汇集
vt.使聚集

ex.en: As they flow south, the five rivers converge.
ex.cn: 5条大河在南边交汇。

ex.en: Our previously opposed views are beginning to converge.
ex.cn: 我们原来相互对立的观点开始趋于一致.

ex.en: Parallel lines converge at infinity.
ex.cn: 平行线永不相交.

def: n.犯人，罪犯,肇事者，被告人

ex.en: He knows the culprit but is not letting on.
ex.cn: 他知道罪犯是谁，但却闭口不说。

ex.en: The culprit will be whipped when he is found.
ex.cn: 那个罪犯被找到后就要挨鞭子.

ex.en: The police are now on the scent of the culprit.
ex.cn: 警方正在追踪罪犯.

def: vt.使（某人）气馁，威吓

ex.en: Danger did not daunt the hero.
ex.cn: 危险并没有吓倒这位英雄.

ex.en: Even a greater natural calamity cannot daunt us.
ex.cn: 再大的自然灾害也压不垮我们.

ex.en: Danger didn't daunt the hero.
ex.cn: 危险并没有吓住那英雄.

def:
n.初次露面，初次表演，首次出场，处女秀
v.初次表演，初次登台
adj.首张的，首场的，首次的

ex.en: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
ex.cn: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

ex.en: She was scarcely 18 when she made her debut.
ex.cn: 首次出镜时，她刚满18岁。

ex.en: His debut album was hugely successful Stateside.
ex.cn: 他的首张专辑在美国获得了巨大成功。

def:
vi.未履行任务或责任,受传唤时未出庭,由于不到庭而败诉,弃权
vt.未履行，拖欠,未参加或完成（例如，比赛）,[法]因未到庭而败（诉）
n.未履行，拖欠,[法]未到庭,弃权,[计] 缺省，默认

ex.en: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
ex.cn: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

ex.en: The default is usually the setting that most users would probably choose.
ex.cn: 默认选项通常是大多数用户都会选择的设置。

ex.en: Death, not life, is the default state of cells.
ex.cn: 细胞的常态是死亡而不是存活。

def:
n.[法]被告人
adj.[法]被告的,辩护的

ex.en: He overturned the conviction, saying the defendant was entrapped.
ex.cn: 他声称被告是被诱骗的，从而推翻了有罪的判决。

ex.en: The defendant asked for 21 similar offences to be taken into account.
ex.cn: 被告要求考虑到类似的21起违法行为的情况。

ex.en: The defence pleaded insanity, but the defendant was found guilty and sentenced.
ex.cn: 辩方以精神错乱为由进行申辩，但被告被判有罪并获刑。

def:
vt.使推迟,使延期,拖延，推迟,[军]使延期入伍
vi.服从,延期,推迟

ex.en: We wish to defer our decision until next week.
ex.cn: 我们希望推迟到下星期再作出决定.

ex.en: I shall defer replying till I hear from home.
ex.cn: 我将等接到家信以后再给你答复.

ex.en: We will defer to whatever the committee decides.
ex.cn: 我们遵从委员会作出的任何决定.

def: vt.悲悼，哀叹,谴责，强烈反对

ex.en: We deplore this lamentably ill-advised decision.
ex.cn: 我们强烈反对这个拙劣的、欠考虑的决定。

ex.en: Like everyone else, I deplore and condemn this killing.
ex.cn: 我同所有人一样强烈谴责这桩凶杀案。

ex.en: We deplore the accident.
ex.cn: 我们对这一事故深感遗憾.

def: n.<医>糖尿病,多尿症,中消

ex.en: My doctor wants me to be tested for diabetes.
ex.cn: 我的医生要我去做个检查，看是否患有糖尿病。

ex.en: People with high blood pressure are especially vulnerable to diabetes.
ex.cn: 有高血压的人尤其易患糖尿病。

ex.en: He suffered from diabetes and gastric ulcers.
ex.cn: 他患有糖尿病和胃溃疡。

def: n.[生]恐龙,守旧落伍的人，过时落后的东西

ex.en: The fossils at Dinosaur Cove are embedded in hard sandstones.
ex.cn: 恐龙峡谷中的化石都嵌在坚硬的砂岩中。

ex.en: The largest brain possessed by any dinosaur weighed about a kilogram.
ex.cn: 最大的恐龙脑子大约有一公斤重.

ex.en: Have you ever seen a dinosaur?
ex.cn: 你看见过恐龙没有?

def: n.[化]二氧化物

ex.en: The two principal combustion products are water vapor and carbon dioxide.
ex.cn: 两种主要的燃烧产物是水蒸气和二氧化碳。

ex.en: Mars has an insubstantial atmosphere, consisting almost entirely of carbon dioxide.
ex.cn: 火星的大气层极其稀薄，几乎全部由二氧化碳构成。

ex.en: Carbon dioxide is a necessary result of the oxidation of carbon compounds.
ex.cn: 碳化合物氧化后必然会产生二氧化碳。

def: n.<生>胚，胚胎,胚芽,初期
vt.支票的背书，签名,签署，批准：签署（签名），,开发票，开证明文件,支持，核准

adj.（美）财政上的，会计的,国库的
n.财政年度，会计年度,财政部长，（苏格兰等的）检察官，（西班牙及葡萄牙的）检察长,印花税票

ex.en: The party was torn apart by wrangles over fiscal policy.
ex.cn: 该党内部因为在财政政策上争执不休而出现了分裂。

ex.en: The government brought itself to the brink of fiscal disaster.
ex.cn: 政府把自己推向了财政危机的边缘。

ex.en: The increase of taxation is an important fiscal policy.
ex.cn: 增税是一项重要的财政政策.

def:
n.选举权,参政权,特许权,经销权
vt.赋予特权,赋予公民权

ex.en: The diving school has acquired a franchise for scuba equipment.
ex.cn: 潜水学校获得潜水用水肺的特许经营权.

ex.en: Catering in the schools is run on a franchise basis.
ex.cn: 学校餐饮服务以特许权经营.

ex.en: The United States granted the franchise to women in 1920.
ex.cn: 美国于1920年给妇女以参政权.

def: n.类型，种类,体裁，样式,风俗画

ex.en: She emerges as a full, three-dimensional character in a way that few horror genre heroines ever do.
ex.cn: 她作为一个丰满而又鲜活的人物形象展现在读者面前，之前的恐怖体裁作品中，很少有女主人公给人这种感觉。

ex.en: My favorite music genre is blues.
ex.cn: 我最喜欢的音乐种类是布鲁斯音乐。

ex.en: Superficially, this Shakespeare's work seems to fit into the same genre.
ex.cn: 从表面上看, 莎士比亚的这个剧本似乎属于同一类型.

def: n.冰河，冰川

ex.en: The best bit was walking along the glacier.
ex.cn: 最好的部分就是沿着冰川走。

ex.en: The glacier calved a large iceberg.
ex.cn: 冰河崩解而形成一个大冰山.

ex.en: The upper surface of glacier is riven by crevasses.
ex.cn: 冰川的上表面已裂成冰隙.

def:
n.行会，协会,同业公会,[植]依赖植物集团
na.“gild”的变体

ex.en: the Screen Actors' Guild
ex.cn: 影视演员协会

ex.en: I belong to a guild of wine butlers.
ex.cn: 我属于主管酒类的男仆同业公会.

ex.en: The same thing holds for the guild member in the medieval towns.
ex.cn: 中世纪城市的行会市民,也是如此.

def:
n.使者，先驱，通报者,（旧时的）传令官
v.传达，通报,预告，预示…的到来,欢呼

ex.en: Their discovery could herald a cure for some forms of impotence.
ex.cn: 他们的发现可能预示着为某些类型的阳痿找到了医治方法。

ex.en: I welcome the report as a herald of more freedom, not less.
ex.cn: 我认为这份报告预示着会有更多、而不是更少的自由，因此对它表示欢迎。

ex.en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
ex.cn: 这些谈判可能预示着新的和平时代的来临。

def: n.荷尔蒙,激素

ex.en: Hormone replacement therapy is very important and should be instituted early.
ex.cn: 激素替代治疗非常重要，应该及早开始。

ex.en: Oestrogen is a female sex hormone.
ex.cn: 雌激素是一种雌性荷尔蒙。

ex.en: This hormone interacts closely with other hormones in the body.
ex.cn: 这种荷尔蒙与体內其他荷尔蒙紧密地相互作用.

def: n.卫生，卫生学,保健法

ex.en: Infection with head lice is no reflection on personal hygiene.
ex.cn: 头上生虱子并不说明不讲个人卫生。

ex.en: She's careless about her hygiene.
ex.cn: 她不注意个人卫生。

ex.en: Hygiene was non-existent: no running water, no bathroom.
ex.cn: 卫生根本谈不上：没有自来水、没有卫生间。

def: vt.开创,创始,举行开幕典礼,举行就职典礼

ex.en: To begin or inaugurate with a ceremony intended to bring good luck.
ex.cn: 以某种讨吉利的仪式着手做(某事)

ex.en: Fig 2 . Open - window envelopes, showing receivers'names & addresses, may inaugurate repeated printout.
ex.cn: 图 二: 使用开窗式信封来显示收信人的地址和姓名是重复打印的悲剧的开始.

ex.en: As manager of your agency, what skill - building program would you inaugurate if needed?
ex.cn: 经理的机构, 什么技能建设程序将启动,如果您需要的?

def:
n.象牙,象牙制品,象牙色,象牙质
adj.象牙制的,象牙色的

ex.en: He showed him how to blow into the ivory mouthpiece.
ex.cn: 他给他演示如何吹奏象牙吹口乐器。

ex.en: The Ivory Coast became the world's leading cocoa producer.
ex.cn: 象牙海岸成为世界上可可粉的主要产地。

ex.en: The rebels have opened the road from Monrovia to the Ivory Coast.
ex.cn: 叛乱分子已经开放了从蒙罗维亚到象牙海岸的道路。

def:
adj.抒情的，抒情诗的,感情丰富的,歌喉柔美的,音乐剧的
n.抒情诗,歌词

ex.en: The Lyric Theatre is presenting a new production of "Over the Bridge".
ex.cn: 利里克剧院正在上演新排的《桥对面》。

ex.en: This is a good example of Shelley's lyric poetry.
ex.cn: 这首诗是雪莱抒情诗的范例.

ex.en: This is a good example of his lyric poetry.
ex.cn: 这首诗是他抒情诗的范例.

def:
n.<体>马拉松赛跑,长距离比赛,需要长时间努力或耐力的事件或活动
adj.需要极大持久力的
vi.参加马拉松比赛

ex.en: Rodgers can also claim four victories in the New York Marathon.
ex.cn: 罗杰斯也能在纽约马拉松比赛中4次夺冠。

ex.en: Another Cup marathon between the two sides is now a distinct possibility.
ex.cn: 双方很可能再进行一场马拉松式的优胜杯比赛。

ex.en: A thirty-nine-year-old competitor collapsed half-way through the marathon and died shortly afterwards.
ex.cn: 一名39岁的马拉松参赛者跑到一半时瘫倒在地，没过多久就死了。

def: n.[外]照会，备忘录,[商]便笺，函,记录,[法]（契约等条文的）节略

ex.en: a detailed memorandum to the commission on employment policy
ex.cn: 呈交委员会的有关就业政策的详细报告

ex.en: The memorandum was dated 23 August, 2008.
ex.cn: 备忘录上注明的日期是2008年8月23日.

ex.en: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Commons on the blatant violations of basic human rights.
ex.cn: 代表团向下院呈交了有关公然侵犯基本人权的备忘录。

def: n.[物]中子

ex.en: A neutron star has a gravitational field strong enough to generate X-rays.
ex.cn: 中子星上存在强大的重力场，足以产生X射线。

ex.en: A neutron is simply a neutral particle in the nucleus of an atom.
ex.cn: 中子就是原子核里不带电的粒子。

ex.en: The dark star in Nova Muscae 1991 is a black hole rather than a neutron star.
ex.cn: 在1991年苍蝇座中的暗星其实是一个黑洞而非中子星。

def: adj.怀旧的,乡愁的,令人怀念的

ex.en: Many people were nostalgic for the good old days.
ex.cn: 很多人都很留恋过去的好时光。

ex.en: Somehow the place even smelt wonderfully nostalgic.
ex.cn: 不知为什么，这个地方竟透出一种浓郁的怀旧气息。

ex.en: He made a nostalgic return visit to Germany.
ex.cn: 他满怀怀旧之情重访德国。

def: n.肥胖，过胖,肥胖症

ex.en: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality.
ex.cn: 该研究还表明了肥胖症和死亡率之间存在直接的联系。

ex.en: Obesity correlates with increased risk for hypertension and stroke.
ex.cn: 肥胖会增加高血压和中风发作的几率。

ex.en: Obesity is a major risk factor in many diseases.
ex.cn: 肥胖是引发多种疾病的重要因素。

def:
vt.彻底检查,翻修，检修,赶上（他船）,解松（船的）绳索
n.检查,彻底检修,详细检查,大修

ex.en: The report recommends an overhaul of public finances.
ex.cn: 该报告建议对公共财政进行彻底改革。

ex.en: Overhaul your body with a cleansing detox.
ex.cn: 通过清洁排毒法对身体进行“大扫除”。

ex.en: It is generally appreciated that the rail network needs a complete overhaul.
ex.cn: 众所周知,铁路系统需要大检修.

def: n.<律>原告

ex.en: The plaintiff's sole witness, a gambler and layabout, was easily discredited.
ex.cn: 原告唯一的证人嗜赌成性，游手好闲，其证词一下子就被推翻了。

ex.en: The burden of proof lay on the plaintiff to prove negligence.
ex.cn: 证明对方犯有疏忽罪的举证责任落在原告身上.

ex.en: The plaintiff is aged 30 and has a normal expectation of life.
ex.cn: 原告30岁,预期有正常的寿命.

def: n.公文包,代表作品集,证券投资组合,部长[大臣]的职位

ex.en: He was appointed government leader in the senate, and minister without portfolio.
ex.cn: 他被任命为政府驻参议院领袖，政务委员。

ex.en: Each client's portfolio is tailor-made.
ex.cn: 每位客户的投资组合都是量身打造的。

ex.en: My stockbroker manages my portfolio for me.
ex.cn: 我的证券经纪人替我管理投资组合.

def: n.经济衰退，不景气,后退，撤退,凹处,退场

ex.en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
ex.cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

ex.en: Recession has simply accelerated changes that have been reshaping the industry anyway.
ex.cn: 经济萧条只不过加速了原本就在改变行业状况的变化。

ex.en: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.
ex.cn: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。

def: vt.赎回，挽回,履行,偿还,兑现

ex.en: The amount required to redeem the mortgage was £358,587.
ex.cn: 需要偿还的抵押贷款总计358,587英镑。

ex.en: The excellent acting wasn't enough to redeem a weak plot.
ex.cn: 精彩的表演不足以掩盖情节的拙劣。

ex.en: He had no way to redeem his furniture out of pawn.
ex.cn: 他无法赎回典当的家具.

def:
vt.& vi.排练，排演,公开练习
vt.详述,在排演中指挥,经训练使熟练掌握,复述，背诵

ex.en: We encouraged them to rehearse what they were going to say.
ex.cn: 我们鼓励他们默述一下他们要说的内容。

ex.en: Rehearse and role-play the interview with a friend beforehand.
ex.cn: 事先和朋友通过角色扮演排练一下面试。

ex.en: Anticipate any tough questions and rehearse your answers.
ex.cn: 预先考虑可能遇到的各种棘手问题，并且自己练习回答。

def:
adj.显著的，突出的,重要的，主要的,跳跃的,（指角）凸出的
n.凸角，[建]突出部,<军>进攻或防卫阵地的突出部分

ex.en: Chronic fatigue is also one of the salient features of depression.
ex.cn: 慢性疲劳也是抑郁症的显著特点之一。

ex.en: She pointed out the salient features of the new design.
ex.cn: 她指出新设计的几个显著特征。

ex.en: For the more salient remarks on the matter, cf. Isis Unveiled, Vol. I.
ex.cn: 关于这个问题的更重要的评论，参看《揭开面纱的伊希斯》第一卷。

def: n.（行动的）方案,剧情概要,分镜头剧本

ex.en: It is coexisted that if I am scenarist, I will let robot and mankind harmonious.
ex.cn: 如果我是编剧, 我将会让机器人与人类和谐共处.

def: adj.势利眼的,谄上傲下的,恃才傲物的,假充内行的

ex.en: We disdain a man for his snobbishness.
ex.cn: 我们鄙夷势利小人.

ex.en: Maybe you have social faults such as snobbishness, talkativeness, and, etc. which drive away new acquaintances.
ex.cn: 也许你有社交方面的缺点,诸如势利 、 饶舌 、 出语粗俗等,使你的新相识退避三舍.

ex.en: He disdained that man for snobbishness and was unwilling to talk to him.
ex.cn: 他鄙视那个势利小人,不愿和他说话.

def: adj.不流动的，停滞的,污浊的,不景气的,迟钝的，呆笨的

n.禁忌,忌讳,戒律,禁忌的事物（或行为）
adj.禁忌的，忌讳的
vt.把…列为禁忌，禁止

ex.en: Tabor took on the air of a knight of old.
ex.cn: 泰伯摆出一副古代那种骑士风度的样子.
