ex.en: The city has been flattened by heavy artillery bombardments.
ex.cn: 城市已被猛烈的炮火夷为平地。

ex.en: Enemy forces lobbed a series of artillery shells onto the city.
ex.cn: 敌军对该城发起连串炮轰。

ex.en: Some of those artillery pieces look a little elderly.
ex.cn: 那些大炮中有些看起来有点老掉牙了。

def: n.强烈的愿望,吸气，吸入,发送气音,发 h 音

ex.en: He nurses an aspiration to be a poet.
ex.cn: 他心怀当诗人的愿望.

ex.en: Taiwan will return to the embrace of the motherland; the whole country must be united. This is the general trend of development and the common aspiration of the people.
ex.cn: 台湾要回到祖国的怀抱, 全国一定要统一.这是大势所趋,人心所向.

ex.en: Man's aspiration should be as lofty as the stars.
ex.cn: 人的志气应当象天上的星星那么高.

def: n.阿司匹林,阿司匹林药片

ex.en: Our doctor diagnosed a throat infection and prescribed antibiotic and junior aspirin.
ex.cn: 我们的医生诊断是喉部感染，并且开了一些抗生素和小剂量阿司匹林。

ex.en: I bandaged the leg up and gave her aspirin for the pain.
ex.cn: 我把她的腿用绷带包扎起来，并给了她阿司匹林止痛。

ex.en: I don't take any drugs whatsoever, except aspirin for colds.
ex.cn: 我什么药都不吃，除了感冒时吃阿司匹林。

def:
vi.赞成：赞成，如某建议,赞同
n.同意，赞同：

ex.en: Without their assent a political settlement cannot be reached.
ex.cn: 没有他们的同意，不可能达成政治上的和解。

ex.en: He gave his assent to the proposed legislation.
ex.cn: 他批准了提请审议的法案。

ex.en: The director has given her assent to the proposals.
ex.cn: 负责人已表示同意提案。

def:
vt.把…分类
vi.相配,相称 ,交际,交往

ex.en: The new leader's statement does not assort with his Party's principles.
ex.cn: 这位新领导人物发表的声明与他所在的政党的一些原则不相称.

ex.en: My daughter will not assort with people of her own age.
ex.cn: 我女儿和她的同龄人不合群.

ex.en: These TV sets do not assort with the samples.
ex.cn: 这些电视机与样品不符.

def: n.天体物理学家

ex.en: When I grew up, I became a professional astrophysicist.
ex.cn: 长大之后, 我成了一名职业的天体物理学家.

ex.en: Experimental Astrophysicist George Smoot is an active researcher in observational astrophysics and cosmology.
ex.cn: 试验天体物理学家乔治-斯莫特是一位在活跃天体物理学和宇宙学领域非常活跃的科学家.

ex.en: Top astrophysicist Sasha Greenberg has spent the past 17 years working in the United States.
ex.cn: 顶尖天体物理学家萨莎格林伯格在美国工作了17年.

def: adv.聚精会神地,周到地,谛,凝神

ex.en: He questioned Chrissie, and listened attentively to what she told him.
ex.cn: 他询问了克里茜，并仔细聆听她所说的话。

ex.en: She listened attentively while I poured out my problems.
ex.cn: 我倾吐心中的烦恼时,她一直在注意听.

ex.en: She listened attentively and set down every word he said.
ex.cn: 她专心听着,把他说的话一字不漏地记下来.

def: vt.授权，批准，委托

ex.en: We are willing to authorize the president to use force if necessary.
ex.cn: 我们愿意授权总统在必要的时候使用武力。

ex.en: He said that he needed to get his supervisor to authorize my refund.
ex.cn: 他说必须让主管人员批准我的退款.

ex.en: It would certainly be within his power to authorize a police raid like that.
ex.cn: 他绝对有权批准那样的一次警方突袭行动。

def:
vt.为…复仇,为…报复
vi.报复,报仇

ex.en: He promised to avenge his father's murder.
ex.cn: 他发誓要报杀父之仇。

ex.en: He vowed to himself to avenge his martyred comrade.
ex.cn: 他暗暗发誓要为牺牲的同志报仇.

ex.en: He swore to avenge himself on the mafia.
ex.cn: 他发誓说要向黑手党报仇.

def: n.脊梁骨，脊椎,分水岭,支柱,决心，毅力

ex.en: Petty officers are the backbone of a navy.
ex.cn: 军士是海军的骨干。

ex.en: Agriculture forms the backbone of the rural economy.
ex.cn: 农业是农村经济的基础。

ex.en: The wounded soldiers showed much backbone before the enemy.
ex.cn: 受伤的士兵在敌人面前表现出了威武不屈的精神.

def:
vt.使受挫折,使困惑，使迷惑,用隔音板隔音,挡住（水流等）
n.隔板，挡板,迷惑,遮护物，阻碍体,[军]迷彩

ex.en: She had then offered him the chance to baffle his doom.
ex.cn: 当时她向他提供战胜厄运的机会.

ex.en: I do not therefore baffle the reader with disputable statistics.
ex.cn: 因此,我不想拿一些值得争论的统计数字来为难读者.

ex.en: He tried hard to baffle our plan.
ex.cn: 他力图阻挠我们的计划.

def: n.面包房，面包店,烘烤食品（面包、糕点等的总称）

ex.en: A smell of bread drifted from some distant bakery.
ex.cn: 一阵面包的香味从远处的面包房飘来。

ex.en: In November, Clean's bakery produced 50 percent more bread than normal.
ex.cn: 克林面包房11月份烤的面包比平常多50％。

ex.en: The baker bakes his bread in the bakery.
ex.cn: 面包师在面包房内烤面包.

def:
vt.& vi.作物物交换，以货换货,拿…进行易货贸易
n.换货，实物交易,交易品，互换品,[数]换算法,易货贸易
vi.进行易货贸易,[贸易]作物物交换,讨价还价

ex.en: Overall, barter is a very inefficient means of organizing transactions.
ex.cn: 总之，易货贸易是一种效率很低的交易形式。

ex.en: The market-place and street were crowded with those who'd come to barter.
ex.cn: 市场和街道上挤满了前来做物物交换的人。

ex.en: Chickens, goats and rabbits were offered for barter at the bazaar.
ex.cn: 在集市上,鸡 、 山羊和兔子被摆出来作物物交换之用.

def:
n.浆果,干种子，干果仁,子，卵
vi.寻找浆果，采摘浆果,结浆果

ex.en: This kind of jam is made of berry.
ex.cn: 这种果酱是由浆果做的.

ex.en: Mr. Berry said the timing was a coincidence and that his decision was unrelated to Mr. Roman's departure.
ex.cn: 贝里先生说这是时间上的巧合，他的决定与罗曼先生的离开没有关系。

ex.en: A little old woman with a wrinkled face as brown as a berry told us our fortunes for ten pence.
ex.cn: 一位满脸皱纹皮肤黝黑的小个儿老妇人向我们索取十便士,替我们算命.

def: vt.包围，为敌对势力包围,拥挤在周围，包围住,如被询问纠缠或强求,使感到丧气或焦虑

ex.en: The main part of the army moved to Sevastopol to besiege the town.
ex.cn: 军队主力转移到了塞瓦斯托波尔，对该城进行围攻。

ex.en: It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it.
ex.cn: 你要对面攻击这城, 使城被困.

ex.en: It's inevitable in China that the peasants besiege the cities.
ex.cn: 农民“包围城市”,是中国现代化进程中的必然.

def:
vt.使变白,使（植物）不见阳光而变白,[冶]酸洗（金属）使有光泽,[烹]用沸水煮白
vi.漂白,发白,变白
adj.漂白的,银白色的

ex.en: She felt herself blanch at the unpleasant memories.
ex.cn: 一回想起那些不愉快的事情，她觉得自己的脸刷地就白了。

ex.en: We blanch almonds by soaking off their skins in boiling water.
ex.cn: 我们把杏仁泡在沸水中去皮弄成白色.

ex.en: There are places you can take physically handicapped children where staff don't blanch at the sight of a wheelchair.
ex.cn: 有些地方你能带残疾儿童去，那里的工作人员不会一看到轮椅就退缩。

def: adj.温和的，和蔼的,平和的,味道温和的,无动于衷的

n.封锁,封锁部队,障碍物，阻碍物
vt.实行封锁,阻塞，挡住

ex.en: It's not yet clear who will actually enforce the blockade.
ex.cn: 目前还不清楚谁会真正执行这项封锁任务。

ex.en: There's been talk of a retaliatory blockade to prevent supplies getting through.
ex.cn: 有人在谈论实施报复性封锁，阻止供应物资通过。

ex.en: Protesters formed a human blockade to stop loggers felling trees.
ex.cn: 抗议者组成人墙阻止伐木者伐木.

def: n.堵塞，堵塞物,[医]（心理）阻滞,封锁（状态）,妨碍

ex.en: The logical treatment is to remove this blockage.
ex.cn: 合理的治疗方法就是清除堵塞物。

ex.en: If the blockage worked, they could retreat with dignity.
ex.cn: 如果封锁发生作用, 他们可以体面地撤退.

ex.en: The interview clears lines of communication of emotional blockage.
ex.cn: 访谈可以消除情感交流渠道上的障碍.

def:
n.污渍,墨渍,弱点,（十五子棋中）易被吃掉的孤立棋子
vt.玷污，弄脏,涂抹,吸掉
vi.（污点或污渍）溅出,被吸掉

ex.en: This drugs scandal is another blot on the Olympics.
ex.cn: 这次的兴奋剂丑闻又给奥林匹克运动会抹了黑。

ex.en: Her involvement in the fraud has left a serious blot on her character.
ex.cn: 她卷入了这次欺诈案，在她的品格上留下了一个很大的污点。

ex.en: That new factory is a blot on the landscape.
ex.cn: 那新建的工厂破坏了此地的景色

def:
vi.吓唬
vt.吓唬,愚弄,以假象欺骗,虚张声势
n.欺骗,恐吓,悬崖,虚张声势的人
adj.直率的,爽快的,陡峭的,肥型船首

ex.en: He tried to bluff his way through another test and failed it.
ex.cn: 他试图再次在考试中蒙混过关，但却露馅了。

ex.en: Wade was a hearty, bluff, athletic sort of guy.
ex.cn: 韦德是个精力充沛、率直、运动型的人。

ex.en: What we're at here is a game of bluff.
ex.cn: 我们此时陷入的是一场骗局。

def: n.勇敢，勇气,辉煌，华丽,刚毅

ex.en: They had faced one difficulty after another with bravery and dedication.
ex.cn: 他们以无畏和无私奉献的精神迎接了一个又一个的困难。

ex.en: She presented a bravery award to schoolgirl Caroline Tucker.
ex.cn: 她向女学生卡罗琳·塔克颁发了英勇奖状。

ex.en: He was decorated for bravery in battle.
ex.cn: 他因为作战英勇而被授予奖章。

def: n.脱逃，越狱，突围

ex.en: a mass breakout from a top security prison
ex.cn: 从防守高度严密的监狱的集体越狱

ex.en: The breakout tong should be snubbed , preferably to an anchor post.
ex.cn: 内钳必须安装钳尾绳并固定在钳尾桩上.

ex.en: Use the top of the false breakout as your stop - loss point.
ex.cn: 把假突破的最高点作为止损点.

def: n.突破,穿透,重要技术成就,炉衬烧穿

ex.en: The company looks poised to make a significant breakthrough in China.
ex.cn: 这家公司看来很有把握在中国取得重大突破。

ex.en: They announced, amid much ballyhoo, that they had made a breakthrough.
ex.cn: 在一通大吹大擂中，他们宣布自己取得了突破。

ex.en: This may have been an improvement, but "breakthrough" was an overstatement.
ex.cn: 这算得上是一个改进吧，但说是“突破”就言过其实了。

def:
vt.& vi.孵蛋,沉思,焦急地考虑
n.（雏鸡、鸟等的）一窝,一家的孩子

ex.en: I continued to brood. Would he always be like this?
ex.cn: 我一直不安：他会一直这样吗？

ex.en: The hen brought off a brood of young.
ex.cn: 母鸡孵出了一窝小鸡.

ex.en: There's Mrs. Brien taking her brood for a walk.
ex.cn: 布莱恩太太正领着她那群孩子散步呢.

def: n.兄弟关系,手足情谊,兄弟会,（总称）同行

ex.en: He believed in socialism and the brotherhood of man.
ex.cn: 他信仰社会主义，相信人与人之间有手足般的情谊。

ex.en: to live in peace and brotherhood
ex.cn: 生活在和平互爱中

ex.en: They live and work together in complete equality and brotherhood.
ex.cn: 他们完全平等和兄弟般地在一起生活和工作.

def: adj.佛教的,佛法的,佛教徒的

ex.en: The old lady fell down in adoration before Buddhist images.
ex.cn: 那老太太在佛像面前顶礼膜拜.

ex.en: On the extreme northwestern outskirts of the city stands the Buddhist temple.
ex.cn: 那所佛教寺院位于市郊的最西北角.

ex.en: In the eye of the Buddhist, every worldly affair is vain.
ex.cn: 在佛教徒的眼里, 人世上一切事情都是空的.

def:
vt.& vi.打破，打碎
n.半身雕塑像,妇女的胸部,胸围,突击搜捕
vt.突击搜查（或搜捕）,（使）降级，降低军阶
adj.破碎，毁坏,破产

ex.en: We must avoid the damaging boom-bust cycles which characterised the 1980s.
ex.cn: 我们必须避免出现20世纪80年代那样具有破坏性的繁荣萧条交替循环的局面。

ex.en: They will have to bust the door to get him out.
ex.cn: 他们将不得不撞破门把他弄出来。

ex.en: Good posture also helps your bust look bigger.
ex.cn: 优美的姿势也能让你的胸部看起来更丰满。

def: n.灾祸，灾难,不幸之事,困苦,不幸

ex.en: He described drugs as the greatest calamity of the age.
ex.cn: 他称毒品是这个时代最大的祸害。

ex.en: The frost last week was a great calamity to the citrus industry.
ex.cn: 上周的霜冻对柑橘种植业是一场大灾难.

ex.en: The marriage proved to be the greatest calamity of his life.
ex.cn: 事实证明这桩婚姻是他一生中最大的不幸.

def: n.[医]结石，石，积石，牙垢,[数]运算，演算，微积分（学）

ex.en: I'm specializing in differential and integral calculus.
ex.cn: 我正专攻微分学和积分学.

ex.en: After studying differential calculus you will be able to solve these mathematical problems.
ex.cn: 学了微积分之后,你们就能够解这些数学题了.

ex.en: All this leads up to the most fundamental of theorems of calculus.
ex.cn: 综上所述就导出了微积分学中的最基本的定理.

def: n.牛犊,犊皮,腓，腿肚子

ex.en: The snow, except where it drifted, was only calf-deep.
ex.cn: 除了吹得堆积起来的地方，雪只有小腿肚深。

ex.en: I rubbed the velvety grooves inside the calf's ears.
ex.cn: 我摩挲着小牛耳朵里面柔软的凹槽。

ex.en: Hillsden was complain-ing of cramp in his calf muscles.
ex.cn: 希尔斯登说他小腿抽筋。

def:
n.标题，说明文字，字幕,字幕,第三档
vt.给（图片、照片等）加说明文字,在（文件等）上加标题,在…上加字幕

ex.en: I didn't understand the drawing until I read the caption.
ex.cn: 直到我看到这幅画的说明才弄懂其意思.

ex.en: There is a caption under the picture.
ex.cn: 图片下边附有说明.

ex.en: On the back of the photo is written the simple caption, "Mrs. Monroe".
ex.cn: 照片背面只有简单的几个字——“梦露女士”。

def: adj.无忧无虑的，快乐舒畅的,逍遥自在,宽畅,闲逸

ex.en: She had made their childhood so joyous and carefree.
ex.cn: 她使他们的童年充满欢乐，无忧无虑。

ex.en: Chantal remembered carefree past summers at the beach.
ex.cn: 钱特尔记起了从前在海滩上度过的无忧无虑的夏日时光。

ex.en: He looked happy and carefree.
ex.cn: 他看起来轻松愉快。

def: vt.催化，促进

ex.en: Any unexpected circumstance that arises may catalyze a sudden escalation of violence.
ex.cn: 任何突如其来的情况都可能造成暴力骤然升级。

ex.en: They are highly specific for the reactions that they catalyze.
ex.cn: 它们对被它们催化的反应有很强的专一性.

ex.en: Any of a group of enzymes that catalyze transamination.
ex.cn: 对与分子氧反应起催化作用的一种酶.

def:
n.大瀑布，急瀑布,[医]白内障,暴雨，洪水,奔流
v.像瀑布似地注流

ex.en: He is an elderly gentleman who had had a cataract operation.
ex.cn: 他是一位曾经动过白内障手术的老人.

ex.en: The way is blocked by the tall cataract.
ex.cn: 高悬的大瀑布挡住了去路.

ex.en: Age is not a factor in cataract surgery.
ex.cn: 年龄并不是影响做白内障手术的因素。

def: adj.具有因果关系的，构成原因的

ex.en: the causal relationship between poverty and disease
ex.cn: 贫穷与疾病的因果关系

ex.en: He threaded several causal ideas into a charming essay.
ex.cn: 他把几段有关因果的概念穿插在一篇引人入胜的文章中.

ex.en: Rawlins stresses that it is impossible to prove a causal link between the drug and the deaths.
ex.cn: 罗林斯强调无法证明这种药物和多起死亡事件之间存在因果关系。

def:
n.监察官，检查员,（牛津大学等的）学监,[心理]潜意识压抑力,[心]抑制性潜意识
vt.审查，检查,审查（书刊等）,检查（信件等）,删改

ex.en: Television companies tend to censor bad language in feature films.
ex.cn: 电视公司往往会在审查故事片时删去其中的粗话。

ex.en: The censor struck out the next two lines.
ex.cn: 审查员划掉了下面两行。

ex.en: The film has not been viewed by the censor.
ex.cn: 这部影片还未经审查人员审查.

def: n.集中,集中化

ex.en: Nowhere in Britain has bureaucratic centralization proceeded with more pace than in Scotland.
ex.cn: 在英国，官僚集权化发展最快的就是苏格兰了。

ex.en: Two of the most important dimensions of structure are centralization and departmentalization.
ex.cn: 在组织结构中最关键的两个维度是集中化和部门化.

ex.en: Centralization: lower managers are not capable at making decisions.
ex.cn: 集权: 较低层次的管理者不能制定决策.

def: n.锦标赛,锦标，优胜，冠军称号,拥护者[支持者，提倡者]的身分,保持冠军称号的时期

ex.en: England's European Championship plans are in a right mess.
ex.cn: 英格兰队的欧洲锦标赛作战计划乱七八糟。

ex.en: He was in contention for a place in the European championship squad.
ex.cn: 他有望在欧洲锦标赛代表队中获得一席之地。

ex.en: Alain Prost finished third and virtually conceded the world championship.
ex.cn: 阿兰·普罗斯特以第三名的成绩结束比赛，实际上已经将世界冠军的位置拱手让人。

def: adj.可以控诉的，可记在某项账目上的，可充电的

ex.en: Any expenses you may incur will be chargeable to the company.
ex.cn: 你的所有开销均由本公司支付。

ex.en: He is chargeable with a fault or neglect.
ex.cn: 他可能因过失或疏忽而被控告.

ex.en: The day of departure is not chargeable if rooms are vacated by 12.00 noon.
ex.cn: 如果在中午12点前退房，当天不计费。

def: n.检查，核对,体格检查

ex.en: I had to go back for my checkup; they'd lost my X-rays.
ex.cn: 我得回去再做一次体检。他们把我的X光片弄丢了。

ex.en: I had a medical checkup before going abroad.
ex.cn: 我在出国前作了一次体格检查.

ex.en: The shopkeeper gave his store a final checkup before closing for the night.
ex.cn: 店主在晚上打烊前对商店作了最后检查.

def: adj.喜气洋洋的，兴高采烈的，欢乐的,愉快的,高兴的,快活的

ex.en: She was cheery and talked to them about their problems.
ex.cn: 她兴致很高，和他们谈了他们的难题。

ex.en: I'm a cheery sort of person, so I like cheerful tones.
ex.cn: 我是个活泼类型的人，因此喜欢明亮的色调。

ex.en: Paddy spotted Mary Ann and gave her a cheery wave.
ex.cn: 帕迪看到玛丽·安后高兴地冲她挥挥手。

def: n.胆固醇

ex.en: Many other medications have an influence on cholesterol levels.
ex.cn: 许多其他的药物治疗对胆固醇水平都有一定的影响。

ex.en: Oxidized cholesterol may be responsible for furring up the arteries.
ex.cn: 氧化胆固醇可能是造成动脉堵塞的元凶。

ex.en: See just how much fat and cholesterol you're eating.
ex.cn: 看看你究竟摄入了多少脂肪和胆固醇。

def: n.<生>染色体

ex.en: The scientists want to locate the position of the gene on a chromosome.
ex.cn: 科学家们希望找出该基因在染色体中的位置。

ex.en: At this point esch chromosome consist of a pair of chromatids and the two associated chromosomes are termed a tetrad.
ex.cn: 此时每条染色体由一对染色单体构成,这两条联合的染色体称为四分体.

ex.en: The Y chromosome is starting to yield other intriguing tales as well.
ex.cn: Y染色体开始讲出另一些令人神往的故事.

def: n.厚厚的一块,（某物）相当大的数量或部分,强壮、结实的马

ex.en: Harry inherited the house and a sizeable chunk of land.
ex.cn: 哈里继承了这座房子以及相当大的一片土地。

ex.en: Zurich's affluence came initially from cornering a sizeable chunk of the 14th Century silk trade.
ex.cn: 苏黎世的富足最初来自于14世纪对丝绸贸易的高度垄断。

ex.en: A great chunk of loose kerbing smashed into my left-front wheel, bursting the tyre and denting the rim.
ex.cn: 我车子的左前轮撞在一大块松动的路缘石上，导致车胎爆裂、轮辋凹陷。

def: n.流通，传播,血液循环,发行量,（某段时间的）社交活动

ex.en: Massage is used to relax muscles, relieve stress and improve the circulation.
ex.cn: 按摩可以使肌肉放松，缓解压力和促进血液循环。

ex.en: The supply of money in circulation was drastically reduced overnight.
ex.cn: 流通领域的货币供应量一夜骤减。

ex.en: Circulation is much more sluggish in the feet than in the hands.
ex.cn: 脚部的循环比手部的循环缓慢得多。

def:
n.棺材,蹄槽
vt.收殓

ex.en: The coffin had been draped in a Union Jack.
ex.cn: 灵柩上覆盖着英国国旗。

ex.en: A steady procession of people filed past the coffin.
ex.cn: 人们排成一队，一个接一个地从灵柩旁走过。

ex.en: Two reporters had to help lower the coffin into the grave.
ex.cn: 两名记者不得不帮忙把灵柩慢慢地放进墓穴中。

def:
vt.& vi.（用假骰子）欺骗，行贿,（大机构中的）无足轻重的成员
n.钝齿,雄榫

ex.en: Mr Lake was an important cog in the Republican campaign machine.
ex.cn: 莱克先生是共和党竞选机器中一枚重要的螺丝钉。

ex.en: The wheel engages with the cog and turns it.
ex.cn: 轮子咬住轮齿并带动它转动。

ex.en: The front cog has 44 teeth.
ex.cn: 前齿轮有44个齿。

def: adj.巨大的,<口语>异常的

ex.en: The singer earns a colossal amount of money.
ex.cn: 那歌手现在可赚大钱了。

ex.en: Some of the tall buildings in that city are colossal.
ex.cn: 那座城市里的高层建筑很庞大.

ex.en: Even by modern standards, the 46, 000 ton Titanic was a colossal ship.
ex.cn: 即使按照现代的标准看, 那46, 000吨的泰坦斯尼克号也是一艘巨轮.

def: n.恢复，复原,巧妙的回答或反驳,东山再起,回归

ex.en: Sixties singing star Petula Clark is making a comeback.
ex.cn: 60年代的歌星佩杜拉·克拉克复出了。

ex.en: Romance is making a comeback. Reality is out.
ex.cn: 浪漫主义正重新流行起来，而现实主义过时了。

ex.en: Tight fitting T-shirts are making a comeback.
ex.cn: 紧身T恤再度流行起来。

def: n.能力,技能,相当的资产

ex.en: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
ex.cn: 选拔过程是基于对能力和经验的严格测试。

ex.en: to gain a high level of competence in English
ex.cn: 获得高水平的英语能力

ex.en: This mess is a poor reflection on his competence.
ex.cn: 这种混乱情况说明他难当此任.

def: n.肤色，面色，气色,形式，局面

ex.en: She has a poor complexion and pock marks on her forehead.
ex.cn: 她满面菜色，额头上有些麻子。

ex.en: She was rather fat, and her complexion was muddy and spotty.
ex.cn: 她比较胖，脸色暗淡、多斑。

ex.en: Rain water was once considered to be good for the complexion.
ex.cn: 雨水曾一度被认为可以滋养皮肤。

def: n.强迫,强制,冲动,打动人的力量

ex.en: He felt a sudden compulsion to drop the bucket and run.
ex.cn: 他突然有一种想扔掉水桶撒腿就跑的冲动。

ex.en: It's a compulsion to write, more than talent, that makes a writer.
ex.cn: 成为作家要有天分，但更要有创作的冲动。

ex.en: You are under no compulsion to pay immediately.
ex.cn: 没有人强迫你立刻付款。

def: vt.使混淆，使混乱,挫败,诅咒

ex.en: The choice of Governor may confound us all.
ex.cn: 州长的选择可能会让我们所有人感到困惑。

ex.en: Don't confound the means with the ends.
ex.cn: 不要使手段与目的混淆不清.

ex.en: Are you going to lie there all day , confound it, you sow! "
ex.cn: 妈的,还躺着, 猪猡 ”!

def: n.拥挤，堵车,阻塞,充血,（人口）过剩，稠密

ex.en: Energy consumption, congestion and pollution have increased.
ex.cn: 能源消耗、交通堵塞以及污染状况愈加严重。

ex.en: traffic congestion and pollution
ex.cn: 交通拥塞和污染

ex.en: The congestion in the city gets even worse during the summer.
ex.cn: 夏天城市交通阻塞尤为严重.

def: n.内涵，含义,言外之意,[逻辑学]内涵

ex.en: "Urchin", with its connotation of mischievousness, may not be a particularly apt word.
ex.cn: urchin有淘气的含义，可能不是一个特别恰当的词。

ex.en: A possible connotation of " home " is a place of warmth, comfort and affection ".
ex.cn: “ 家 ” 的可能涵义是“一个温暖 、 舒适和爱的地方 ”.

ex.en: The connotation or sense of a sentence is a proposition.
ex.cn: 一个句子的内涵或意义是一个命题.

def:
adj.随之发生的,必然的，合乎逻辑的,继起的,[地]顺向的
n.结果,[逻]后件，结论,[数]后项,[语]（条件结构中的）结果子句

ex.en: Overproduction and consequent low market prices for wine caused economic tremors.
ex.cn: 葡萄酒生产过剩及由此造成的市价低迷引起了经济波动。

ex.en: The changes in social work consequent upon reorganization have been considerable.
ex.cn: 重组引起社会福利工作发生了重大变化。

ex.en: the lowering of taxes and the consequent increase in spending
ex.cn: 税收降低与随之引起的消费增长

def:
vt.保护，保藏，保存,[化，物]使守恒,将…做成蜜饯
n.果酱，蜜饯

ex.en: The republic's factories have closed for the weekend to conserve energy.
ex.cn: 为了节约能源，该共和国的工厂周末不开工。

ex.en: They had to conserve the candles now with winter upon them.
ex.cn: 冬天眼看就要到了，他们不得不把蜡烛省着用。

ex.en: Help to conserve energy by insulating your home.
ex.cn: 对房屋做隔热处理来帮助节约能源。

def: n.领事,（古罗马共和国时期）执政官

ex.en: the British consul in Miami
ex.cn: 英国驻迈阿密领事

ex.en: A consul's duty is to help his own nationals.
ex.cn: 领事的职责是帮助自己的同胞.

ex.en: The British Consul in Zurich has confirmed that a British man was among the people killed.
ex.cn: 英国驻苏黎世领事证实被害人中有一名英国籍男子。

def: n.竞争，争论,争夺,论点

ex.en: He was in contention for a place in the European championship squad.
ex.cn: 他有望在欧洲锦标赛代表队中获得一席之地。

ex.en: This evidence supports their contention that the outbreak of violence was prearranged.
ex.cn: 这一证据证实了他们的观点，即此次突发暴力事件是有预谋的。

ex.en: A particular source of contention is plans to privatise state-run companies.
ex.cn: 发生争执的一个根源就是国营公司的私有化方案。

def:
n.珊瑚,珊瑚虫,珊瑚色,龙虾卵
adj.珊瑚的,珊瑚色的

ex.en: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
ex.cn: 珊瑚虽然看上去坚固，实际上非常易碎。

ex.en: These snails do not occur on low-lying coral islands or atolls.
ex.cn: 在地势低平的珊瑚岛或环礁上没有这种螺。

ex.en: A coral reef is built by the accretion of tiny, identical organisms.
ex.cn: 珊瑚礁是由许多相同的微生物不断堆积而成。

def: adj.法人的，团体的，社团的,公司的，总体国家的,〈古〉团结的,共同的，全体的

ex.en: Increasingly, corporate clients are seeking to outsource the management of their facilities.
ex.cn: 越来越多的公司客户寻求将设施的管理外包出去。

ex.en: Her second husband was a steady, unimaginative, corporate lawyer.
ex.cn: 她的第二任丈夫是一位稳重、刻板的公司法律师。

ex.en: Coincident interests with the corporate rich and political directorate are pointed out.
ex.cn: 有人指出这合乎的是公司富豪和政治官员的利益。

def: n.死尸，尸体

ex.en: He identified the corpse as the criminal hunted after.
ex.cn: 他认出那具尸体就是那个被追捕的罪犯.

ex.en: We passed the desiccated corpse of a brigand hanging on a gibbet.
ex.cn: 我们路过一具悬在绞刑架上的土匪干尸.

ex.en: What she saw was just an unfeeling corpse.
ex.cn: 她见到的只是一具全无感觉的尸体.

def: n.范围，规模,保险项目,（新闻）报导,[植]优势度

ex.en: Now a special TV network gives live coverage of most races.
ex.cn: 现在有一个专门的电视网络对大部分比赛进行现场直播。

ex.en: Under his editorship, the Economist has introduced regular sports coverage.
ex.cn: 在他担任编辑期间，《经济家》开始定期刊登体育报道。

ex.en: Newspapers, television and radio are all providing saturation coverage.
ex.cn: 报纸、电视和电台全都在铺天盖地地报道。

def:
vt.填满,塞满,死记硬背,猛吃
vi.（为考试而）死记硬背,狼吞虎咽地吃东西
adj.填鸭式学的,临时学的
n.死记硬背,极度拥挤,填塞,<俚>压碎

ex.en: It's difficult to cram everything into a tight schedule.
ex.cn: 日程紧，很难把所有事情都安排进去。

ex.en: There was such a cram in the church.
ex.cn: 教堂里拥挤得要命.

ex.en: " Cram then if you want.
ex.cn: " 随你去抽筋吧.

def:
n.火山口，喷火口,弹坑,[天文学]巨爵座,（月球上的）环形山
vt.在…上形成坑,取消,毁坏
vi.形成坑,毁坏,消亡

ex.en: A huge crater marks the spot where the explosion happened.
ex.cn: 巨大的弹坑标明了爆炸发生的地点。

ex.en: When a large object impacts the Earth, it makes a crater.
ex.cn: 当巨大物体撞击地球时，就会产生凹坑。

ex.en: With a telescope you can see the huge crater of Ve - suvius.
ex.cn: 用望远镜你能看到巨大的维苏威火山口.

def: adj.可信的，可靠的,（因看似可能成功而）可接受的

ex.en: Mr Robertson would be a credible candidate.
ex.cn: 罗伯逊先生将是可能当选的候选人之一。

ex.en: Baroness Thatcher's claims seem credible to many.
ex.cn: 撒切尔女男爵的主张在很多人看来是可信的。

ex.en: Is there a credible alternative to the nuclear deterrent?
ex.cn: 是否有可以取代核威慑力量的可靠办法?

def: n.多瑙河（欧洲南部河流）

ex.en: Caesar marched north into the forests that border the Danube River.
ex.cn: 恺撒挥师北上，深入到多瑙河沿岸的森林地带。

ex.en: We drove via Lovech to the old Danube town of Ruse.
ex.cn: 我们开车经由洛维奇到达了多瑙河畔的古镇鲁塞。

ex.en: They established themselves between the Danube and Greece.
ex.cn: 他们在多瑙河和希腊之间定居下来.

def: vt.降低质量（地位、价格等）,降低（硬币的）价值，贬值

ex.en: You must not debase yourself by such behavior.
ex.cn: 你不可以这样的行为来降低自己的人格.

ex.en: Lower and debase myself for the amusement of strangers?
ex.cn: 丑化自己去娱乐那些我完全不认识的人?

ex.en: Lower and debase myself for the amusement total strangers?
ex.cn: 你这一步走得不错.-你 呢 ?

def: n.碎片，残骸,残渣,[地]岩屑,垃圾，破片

ex.en: Spencer waded through the debris of broken chairs and beer bottles.
ex.cn: 斯潘塞艰难地迈过一堆破椅子和碎啤酒瓶。

ex.en: The streets are still full of debris from two nights of rioting.
ex.cn: 街道上仍到处可见连续两晚的骚乱留下的残迹。

ex.en: He was buried under the debris for several hours.
ex.cn: 他被埋在废墟下面达好几个小时。

def: vt.译（码），解（码）,分析及译解电子信号

ex.en: About 60,000 subscribers have special adapters to receive and decode the signals.
ex.cn: 大约6万用户拥有特殊的适配器来接收和转换信号。

ex.en: You don't need a Ph.D to decode their work, but they do try to challenge audiences with unconventional material.
ex.cn: 解读他们的作品并不需要有博士学位，但他们的确在尝试用一些非传统素材来挑战观众的接受度。

ex.en: All he had to do was decode it and pass it over.
ex.cn: 他需要做的就是将它破译然后转给他人。

def: n.不法行为,少年罪犯,过失, 罪过

ex.en: an increase in juvenile delinquency
ex.cn: 青少年犯罪的增加

ex.en: The authorities are at their wits'end about juvenile delinquency.
ex.cn: 当局对青少年犯罪束手无策.

ex.en: We can curb juvenile delinquency by education.
ex.cn: 我们可以通过教育来控制少年犯罪.

def: n.人口统计学家

ex.en: Professor Antonio Golini is a demographer at the University of Rome.
ex.cn: 罗马大学安东尼奥教授是位人口统计学家.

ex.en: Demographer William Frey says immigrants with young families will help keep the United States competitive.
ex.cn: 人口统计学家佛瑞表示这些年轻的家庭会帮助美国保持竞争力.

def: n.消耗，用尽,耗减

ex.en: Increased consumption of water has led to rapid depletion of groundwater reserves.
ex.cn: 用水量的增加导致了地下水贮备迅速枯竭.

ex.en: What they find could provide clues to what might happen worldwide if ozone depletion continues.
ex.cn: 他们的发现可以揭示如果臭氧持续减少，世界范围内可能会出现什么情况。

ex.en: Other countries took measures to prevent depletion of their precious dollar supplies.
ex.cn: 其它国家都采取措施防止耗尽他们宝贵的美元储备.

def:
vi.贬值，跌价,轻视
vt.<正>贬低，轻视,使贬值

ex.en: New cars start to depreciate as soon as they are on the road.
ex.cn: 新车一上路就开始贬值。

ex.en: The car value will depreciate by 2000 dollars in the first year.
ex.cn: 汽车在第一年将减值大约2000美元.

ex.en: We must not depreciate the work she has done.
ex.cn: 我们不要轻视她所做的工作.

def:
adj.有害的,不利的
n.有害的人（或物）,不受欢迎的求婚者

ex.en: the sun's detrimental effect on skin
ex.cn: 日光对皮肤的有害影响

ex.en: Lime in the soil is detrimental to some plants.
ex.cn: 土壤里的石灰对某些植物有害.

ex.en: Poor eating habits are detrimental to health.
ex.cn: 不良的饮食习惯对健康有害.

def:
vt.使（货币）贬值,降低（某事物）的价值，贬低
vi.（货币）贬值

ex.en: They spread tales about her in an attempt to devalue her work.
ex.cn: 他们散布一些有关她的流言，企图贬低她的工作。

ex.en: We are not going to devalue the pound. I have made that crystal clear.
ex.cn: 我们不会让英镑贬值，这一点我已经说得很明白了。

ex.en: If we dig more diligently we must not devalue so - called routine reporting.
ex.cn: 如果我们能更加努力地去调查,我们就不应贬低所谓的例行报道的价值.

def: vt.狼吞虎咽地吃光,吞没，毁灭,全神贯注地看

ex.en: Finally, making a dreadful mess, they devour the fruit.
ex.cn: 最后，他们狼吞虎咽地吃起了水果，果汁滴得到处都是。

ex.en: Larger fish devour the smaller ones.
ex.cn: 大鱼吃小鱼.

ex.en: A medium-sized dog will devour at least one can of food per day.
ex.cn: 中型犬每天至少要吃掉一罐狗粮。

def:
adj.轻蔑的，毁谤的
v.轻视( disparage的现在分词 ),贬低,批评,非难

ex.en: He was critical of the people, disparaging of their crude manners.
ex.cn: 他对那些人很有看法，看不起他们粗俗的举止。

ex.en: The Minister was alleged to have made disparaging remarks about the rest of the Cabinet.
ex.cn: 据说这位部长发表了一些贬低其他内阁成员的言论。

ex.en: Halliday's comments grew daily more and more sparklingly disagreeable and disparaging.
ex.cn: 一天天过去,哈里代的评论越来越肆无忌惮,越来越讨人嫌,越来越阴损了.

def: vt.散布，传播

ex.en: The agency would collect and disseminate information.
ex.cn: 通讯社收集和传播讯息.

ex.en: We should disseminate science and promote the scientific spirit.
ex.cn: 普及科学知识,弘扬科学精神.

ex.en: It took years to disseminate information about Aids in Africa.
ex.cn: 在非洲传播关于艾滋病方面的知识耗时数年。

def:
vi.分开，叉开,分歧,偏离，背离,[数]发散，无极限
vt.使发散,使偏离

ex.en: When the aims of the partners begin to diverge, there'strouble.
ex.cn: 当合作伙伴的目标开始出现分歧时，麻烦就产生了。

ex.en: The parallel lines appear to diverge.
ex.cn: 这些平行线像是岔开了。

ex.en: This is where our opinions diverge from each other.
ex.cn: 这就是我们意见产生分歧之处.

def: vt.& vi.使多样化，多样化,进入新的商业领域

ex.en: Farmers are being encouraged to diversify into new crops.
ex.cn: 目前正鼓励农民兼种新的农作物。

ex.en: Our company is trying to diversify.
ex.cn: 我们公司正力图往多样化方面发展.

ex.en: Hills and woods diversify the landscape.
ex.cn: 山陵和树木点缀景色.

def: adj.潜伏的，蛰服的，休眠的,静止的,资金没有利用的,权利尚待争取的

ex.en: The virus remains dormant in nerve tissue until activated.
ex.cn: 病毒潜伏于神经组织里直到被激活。

ex.en: During the winter the seeds lie dormant in the soil.
ex.cn: 冬天种子在土壤中休眠。

ex.en: Many animals are in a dormant state during winter.
ex.cn: 在冬天许多动物都处于睡眠状态.

def: v.以较小尺寸设计（或制造），缩小（汽车等的）外部尺寸( downsize的现在分词 )

ex.en: American manufacturing organizations have been downsizing their factories.
ex.cn: 美国制造商们一直在缩小他们工厂的规模。

ex.en: The company has been downsizing.
ex.cn: 公司一直在缩小规模.

ex.en: But in today's economy, educated, white - collar workers also are vulnerable to downsizing.
ex.cn: 但是,在今天的经济中, 受过教育的 白领 工人也同样容易受到裁员的攻击.

def: n.苦工，贱役，单调沉闷的工作
n.动力学、力学,（音乐中的）力度变化,力度强弱法,动态,动力( dynamic的名词复数 ),力学,力度,活力

ex.en: The interchange of ideas aids an understanding of family dynamics.
ex.cn: 思想的交流有助于理解家庭动态。

ex.en: Scientists observe the same dynamics in fluids.
ex.cn: 科学家们在液体中观察到了同样的驱动力。

ex.en: His idea was to apply geometry to dynamics.
ex.cn: 他的想法就是将几何学应用在力学上。

def: vt.解放,解脱（疑虑，迷信，偏见等）,[法]使（孩子）脱离父母的管束（获得行动自主权）

ex.en: This new machine will emancipate us from the hard work.
ex.cn: 这部新机器将把我们从繁重劳动中解放出来.

ex.en: To emancipate all mankind, we will balk at no sacrifice . even that of our lives.
ex.cn: 为了全人类的解放, 即使牺牲生命也在所不惜.

ex.en: We must emancipate our thinking in a bold way.
ex.cn: 我们必须大胆解放思想.

def: n.余烬，余火

ex.en: Sarah Long and Steve Ember tell about Doctor Seuss.
ex.cn: 莎拉·朗和史蒂夫·安博来告诉我们他的故事.

ex.en: STEVE EMBER : Others praise hot soups prepared in their childhood homes.
ex.cn: 史蒂夫·恩伯: 另有一些人则对他们小时候喝过的热汤赞叹不已.

ex.en: And that's the VOA Special English Health Report. I'm Ember.
ex.cn: 这是美国之音特别英语健康报告. 我史蒂夫恩贝尔.

def: n.仿效,竞赛,努力追上并超越,竞争

ex.en: The young man worked hard in emulation of his famous father.
ex.cn: 这位年轻人努力工作,要迎头赶上他出名的父亲.

ex.en: His spirit of assiduous study is worthy of emulation.
ex.cn: 他刻苦钻研的精神,值得效法.

ex.en: The socialist emulation drive in our factory is really lively.
ex.cn: 咱们厂的社会主义劳动竞赛搞得真热火.

def: vt.围绕，包围,包含或包括某事物,完成

ex.en: Note that these contours do not encompass the crack tip.
ex.cn: 注意这些围道,都不包含裂信尖端.

ex.en: No single document could encompass all the shades of interpretation.
ex.cn: 但任何一项文件也不可能把各种细微的解释全部包括进去.

ex.en: The course will encompass physics, chemistry and biology.
ex.cn: 课程将包括物理 、 化学和生物学.

def:
vi.侵犯,侵占,蚕食,侵蚀
vt.侵入，侵犯,侵略，侵占,侵害,侵蚀

ex.en: I won't encroach on your time any longer.
ex.cn: 我不会再占用你的时间了。

ex.en: New housing is starting to encroach upon the surrounding fields.
ex.cn: 新住宅开始延伸到周围的田地.

ex.en: Any attempt to encroach upon presidential prerogatives in this domain was quickly and firmly resisted.
ex.cn: 任何试图挑战总统在这个领域的特权的举动都遭到了迅速而坚定的制止。

def: vt.（使）铭记,雕刻，镌刻,深印于（心上）,印刷

ex.en: Harrods will also engrave your child's name on the side.
ex.cn: 哈罗兹还会将你孩子的名字刻在侧面。

ex.en: It is difficult to engrave in marble.
ex.cn: 在大理石上雕刻是困难的.

ex.en: He has heard the words and they engrave a memory.
ex.cn: 不过话他还是听在耳里,留在记忆之中了.

def: vt.使纠缠，缠住,使卷入，使陷入，连累,使混乱

ex.en: Bureaucracy can entangle ventures for months.
ex.cn: 官僚体制会使风险投资搁置好几个月。

ex.en: His tactics were to entangle the opposition in a web of parliamentary procedure.
ex.cn: 他的策略是使反对派陷入错综复杂的议会程序之中。

ex.en: Don't entangle the fishing lines.
ex.cn: 不要让钓鱼线缠在一起.

def:
vt.恳求，乞求,〈古〉对待
vi.恳求，乞求

ex.en: Please help me, I entreat you.
ex.cn: 请帮帮我吧，求你了。

ex.en: However much you may entreat him, you will get little or nothing.
ex.cn: 无论你向他恳求多少, 你都不会得到什么东西的.

ex.en: She shouldn't entreat her elder like that.
ex.cn: 她不应那样对待长辈.

def: vt.委托，托付

ex.en: I couldn't entrust my children to strangers.
ex.cn: 我不能把孩子交给陌生人照看.

ex.en: He was forced to entrust an assistant with the important task of testing and demonstrating aircraft to prospective customers.
ex.cn: 他不得不将向潜在客户测试和展示飞行器的重任交托给一名助手。

ex.en: If parents wanted to entrust their child to the best surgeons, they traveled to Bologna's medical school.
ex.cn: 如果父母们想给孩子看最好的外科医生，他们会前往博洛尼亚的医学院。

def: n.[生化]酶

ex.en: Tampering with a single enzyme can lead to untoward effects elsewhere.
ex.cn: 破坏一种酶可能会导致在别处出现异常。

ex.en: This enzyme would make the filtration of beer easier.
ex.cn: 这种酶会使啤酒更容易过滤。

ex.en: This change is considered to be due to denaturation of the enzyme.
ex.cn: 据认为这种变化是由于酶的变性作用造成的.

def: n.（表示性质、特征等的）词语

ex.en: " I wonder what he'll find to match this epithet, commented another man.
ex.cn: “ 看他对上一句什么, ”又一个说.

ex.en: In ` Alfred the Great', ` the Great'is an epithet.
ex.cn: "阿尔弗雷德大帝"中的"大帝 " 是个称号.

ex.en: The specific epithet variously did or did not repeat a key word from the phrase - name.
ex.cn: 种加词不同程度地重复或不重复同片语名称的某个关键词.

def: n.侦察,间谍活动

ex.en: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.
ex.cn: 这是间谍罪，应判死刑。

ex.en: Espionage is a capital offence in this country.
ex.cn: 在这个国家，从事间谍活动是死罪。

ex.en: Some of the commercial activities were a cover for espionage.
ex.cn: 有些商业活动是为间谍活动提供掩护。

def: n.安乐死,安然去世，无苦痛的死亡

ex.en: Euthanasia is illegal in most countries.
ex.cn: 安乐死在大多数国家被认为是非法的.

ex.en: They canvassed the pros and cons of euthanasia.
ex.cn: 他们彻底讨论有关安乐死的正反两方面的意见.

ex.en: He was thankful euthanasia was not an option when he requested it.
ex.cn: 他很庆幸当他要求补执行安乐死的时候,安乐死却不可行.

def:
vt.挖掘,开凿,挖出,发掘
vi.发掘

ex.en: They plan to excavate a large hole.
ex.cn: 他们计划挖个大洞.

ex.en: A contractor was hired to drain the reservoir and to excavate soil from one area for replacement with clay.
ex.cn: 雇了一个承包商抽干水库的水，挖掉一个区域的泥土后再用黏土填上。

ex.en: They plan to excavate a large hole before putting in the foundations.
ex.cn: 他们计划打地基前先挖个大洞.

def: n.挖掘,开凿,开凿的洞穴（或山路等）,（发掘出来的）古迹

ex.en: Our new habitation was an excavation made in the earth.
ex.cn: 我们的新居是在地里挖出的一个洞。

ex.en: The bad weather has hung up the work of excavation.
ex.cn: 天气不好耽误了挖掘工作.

ex.en: The excavation of the buried city took a long time.
ex.cn: 发掘埋在地下的城市花了很长时间.

def:
adj.面部的,面部用的,表面的
n.美容,面部按摩

ex.en: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
ex.cn: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

ex.en: She had suffered severe facial mutilations after an accident.
ex.cn: 她在事故中被严重毁容。

ex.en: I ended up in hospital with facial injuries.
ex.cn: 我落得个面部受伤，进了医院。

def: n.谬误，谬见,谬论,错误

ex.en: It exposes the fallacy of short-term industrial gain at long-term environmental expense.
ex.cn: 这暴露了以长久的环境破坏为代价换取短期工业利益的错误。

ex.en: This is a common fallacy which has no basis in fact.
ex.cn: 这是一个没有事实依据的常见谬误。

ex.en: It is a fallacy to say that the camera never lies.
ex.cn: 说照相机绝不骗人，这是谬见。

def:
n.狂热者，入迷者
adj.狂热入迷的

ex.en: I am not a religious fanatic but I am a Christian.
ex.cn: 我不是宗教狂热分子，但我是基督徒。

ex.en: He is a fanatic jogger.
ex.cn: 他是一个极喜欢慢跑的人.

ex.en: Alexander is a football fanatic.
ex.cn: 亚历山大是个足球迷.

def: adj.牵强的,凿空

ex.en: He just cited a farfetched illustration.
ex.cn: 他举的例证有些勉强.

ex.en: Your explanation sounds farfetched.
ex.cn: 你的解释有些牵强.

ex.en: The analogy is rather farfetched.
ex.cn: 这个比方有点驴唇不对马嘴.

def: n.法西斯主义

ex.en: They heard the protesters shout:"No more fascism!"
ex.cn: 他们听见抗议者在喊：“打倒法西斯主义！”

ex.en: The uneasy coupling of fascism and conservatism spawned a new kind of political regime.
ex.cn: 法西斯主义和保守主义这种令人不安的结合产生了一种新政权。

ex.en: The spectre of neo-fascism, as he put it, was stalking the streets of Sofia and other big cities.
ex.cn: 用他的话来说，新法西斯主义的幽灵正在索非亚和其他大城市中游荡。

def: n.联邦，同盟,联盟，联合会,联邦，联邦政府

ex.en: The Russian Federation declared itself to be a sovereign republic.
ex.cn: 俄罗斯联邦宣布自己为主权独立的共和国。

ex.en: He hopes for a gradual disconnection from the federation.
ex.cn: 他希望能从联盟中逐渐抽身而出。

ex.en: The German sports federation said it would hold an investigation.
ex.cn: 德国体育联合会称它将进行调查。

def: n.男女平等主义者，女权扩张论者

ex.en: She's not feminist with a capital F but she's fairly controversial.
ex.cn: 她不是个真正意义上的女权主义者，但却是个颇具争议的人物。

ex.en: What does the word "feminist" conjure up for you?
ex.cn: “女权主义者”这个词会让你想到什么？

ex.en: She makes no reference to any feminist work other than her own.
ex.cn: 除了自己的之外，她没有提及其他女权主义著作。

def: adv.发热地,狂热地，兴奋地

ex.en: He slept feverishly all afternoon and into the night.
ex.cn: 他发着烧，睡了一下午，一直睡到晚上。

ex.en: He burrowed into the pile of charts feverishly.
ex.cn: 他非常紧张地在一堆图表中翻找。

ex.en: Feverishly he collected his data.
ex.cn: 他拼命收集资料.

def:
n.狭长裂缝或裂隙,裂伤,分歧, 分裂
vt.& vi.裂开

ex.en: Just ahead of us there was a huge fissure.
ex.cn: 离我们不远处,出现一个大裂缝.

ex.en: Though we all got out to examine the fissure, he remained in the car.
ex.cn: 我们纷纷下车察看那个大裂缝, 他却呆在车上.

ex.en: Ground fissure is the main geological disaster in Xi an city construction.
ex.cn: 地裂缝是西安市主要的工程地质灾害问题.

def:
n.小薄片，（尤指）碎片,火星，火花,晒鱼架，食品搁架,昏过去，不省人事
vi.（成小薄片）脱落，剥落
vt.把（鱼、食物等）切成薄片

ex.en: Skin, bone and flake the fish.
ex.cn: 去鱼皮、鱼骨，再把鱼肉片成薄片。

ex.en: Oiled wood is water-resistant and won't flake.
ex.cn: 上过油的木头防水而且不会剥落。

ex.en: A flake of bone had lodged itself in his knee.
ex.cn: 一块碎骨片留在他的膝盖里.

def:
v.轻弹，轻击,轻拂,忽然摇动
n.轻弹，轻拂,快速的轻打,轻弹声,电影

ex.en: The jockey said he tended to flick horses with the whip.
ex.cn: 骑手说他经常会用鞭子抽马。

ex.en: I'll just flick through the pages until I find the right section.
ex.cn: 我会快速地翻页，直到找到要找的那一部分。

ex.en: I thought I'dhave a quick flick through some recent issues.
ex.cn: 我想我得快速浏览一下最近发生的事情。

def:
v.闪烁,飘扬，摆动,昏倒
n.闪烁,闪光,电影,假装昏倒的乞丐

ex.en: Looking through the cabin window I saw the flicker of flames.
ex.cn: 透过船舱的窗户我看到了闪烁的火光。

ex.en: He looked at me, a flicker of amusement in his cold eyes.
ex.cn: 他看着我，冷酷的眼神里闪过一丝嘲笑。

ex.en: He felt a flicker of regret.
ex.cn: 他突然感到一丝悔意。

def:
vt.轻弹，轻击,按（开关）,快速翻转,急挥
vi.发疯,急动,捻,蹦蹦跳跳
n.浏览,空翻,（射击时枪管的）跳跃,轻抛
adj.[口语]无礼的，轻率的，油腔滑调的,冒失的，鲁莽的

ex.en: The tone of the book is sometimes too flip.
ex.cn: 这本书的笔调有些时候太不严肃了。

ex.en: The trade deficit is the flip side of a rapidly expanding economy.
ex.cn: 贸易赤字是经济快速发展带来的负面产物。

ex.en: He didn't flip on the headlights until he was two blocks away.
ex.cn: 他开出两个街区后才打开车头灯。

def:
vi.飘动,鼓翼
vt.& vi.振翼，拍翅膀,烦扰，坐立不安,（旗帜）飘扬
n.紧张，激动不安,颤振,飘扬,（身体部分的）病态阵跳

ex.en: The look in his eyes made my heart flutter.
ex.cn: 他的眼神让我心里扑通扑通直跳。

ex.en: I had a flutter on five horses.
ex.cn: 我在5匹马身上下了小赌注。

ex.en: Our surprise attack put the enemy into a flutter.
ex.cn: 我们的奇袭使敌人张皇失措.

def: n.敌人，仇敌,危害物,反对者

ex.en: He knew that Karl could be an implacable foe.
ex.cn: 他明白卡尔可能会成为他的死敌.

ex.en: With power and to spare we must pursue the tottering foe.
ex.cn: 宜将剩勇追穷寇.

ex.en: The stag at bay is a dangerous foe.
ex.cn: 穷寇勿追.

def:
n.狂乱，狂暴,极度的激动,狂怒
vt.使发狂,使狂乱,使狂怒

ex.en: I worked myself into frenzy plotting ways to make him jealous.
ex.cn: 我绞尽脑汁，处心积虑，就是为了让他嫉妒。

ex.en: "Get out!" she ordered in a frenzy.
ex.cn: “滚出去!”她狂怒地命令道。

ex.en: The cleverly designed speech lashed the audience into a frenzy.
ex.cn: 这篇精心设计的演说煽动听众使他们发狂.

def:
adj.寒冷的,极冷的,冷漠的,（尤指女人）性冷淡的
adv.寒冷地，冷漠地
n.寒冷，冷漠

ex.en: A snowstorm hit the West today, bringing with it frigid temperatures.
ex.cn: 暴风雪今天袭击了西部地区，导致气温骤降。

ex.en: "Well, dear," her hostess would reply with a frigid smile.
ex.cn: “噢，亲爱的，”她的女主人会笑容僵硬地回答。

ex.en: My husband says I am frigid.
ex.cn: 丈夫说我性冷淡。

def: n.真菌,霉，霉菌,[医]海绵肿

ex.en: If you have a tree stump, check it for fungus.
ex.cn: 要是有树桩的话，检查一下上面有没有长菌类。

ex.en: Mushrooms are a type of fungus.
ex.cn: 蘑菇是一种真菌.

ex.en: So how do you kill a fungus without harming its host?
ex.cn: 问题在于,我们如何才能做到不伤害宿主只杀死真菌 呢 ?

def: n.狂怒,[罗神]复仇三女神之一,暴怒,激怒者

ex.en: Newman fled barefoot as the cheated husband erupted in fury.
ex.cn: 被戴绿帽的丈夫勃然大怒，纽曼吓得光着脚逃走了。

ex.en: He was working himself up to a fury, his face reddening.
ex.cn: 他勃然大怒，脸涨得通红。

ex.en: He's only convincing when that inner fury manifests itself.
ex.cn: 只有在那内心的愤怒充分表露的时候，他才令人信服。

def: n.未来主义者，未来派艺术家

ex.en: Such a nanobot will never become more than a futurist's daydream.
ex.cn: 这种奈米机器人,永远只会出现在未来主义者的白日梦里.

ex.en: He is a futurist philosopher and neo con activist.
ex.cn: 他是一名未来派哲学家,一名新保守主义激进分子.

ex.en: This speeding up of life , says the Futurist, requires a new form of expression.
ex.cn: 未来派诗人声称,这种加速的生活节奏需要一种新的表达形式.

def: n.未来学家
adj.地球物理学的

ex.en: Geophysical exploration is a relatively new area of technology.
ex.cn: 地球物理勘探是一个较新的技术领域.

ex.en: One method used in a geophysical exploration is called seismic method.
ex.cn: 地球物理勘探的一种方法就是地震法.

ex.en: The distinction between geophysical and geological branches of earth science is not clear - cut.
ex.cn: 地质和地球物理这两个地球科学分支的差别并不泾渭分明.

def: n.小发明

ex.en: It's not naturaI to taIk into a pIastic gizmo to someone you can't even see!
ex.cn: 对着个塑料玩意和你看不见的人说话很不自然!

ex.en: That gizmo there is actually the key to move forward.
ex.cn: 那个小东西实际上是继续前进的钥匙.

ex.en: What is this silly little gizmo on the bottom for?
ex.cn: 底下这个小破玩意儿是干什么用的?

def:
n.魔法，迷人的美
vt.迷惑

ex.en: The glamor of the East was brought to international prominence by the Russion national school.
ex.cn: 俄罗斯民族乐派使东方的魅力产生了国际性的影响.

ex.en: Her beauty was never more resplendent than when she cast a parting glamor at the youth.
ex.cn: 最后,她向年轻人瞥了一眼,她从未有过象向他投过这一瞥时那么楚楚动人了.

ex.en: Since she start college, all of a sudden she's miss glamor.
ex.cn: 她上了大学后, 一下子变得很时髦.

def: n.<解>腺,[机]密封压盖，填料盖

ex.en: Her mother has an underactive adrenal gland.
ex.cn: 她的母亲肾上腺机能不全.

ex.en: This is a snake's poison gland.
ex.cn: 这就是蛇的毒腺。

ex.en: The duct that drains the entire gland is the main duct.
ex.cn: 整个腺体的导管汇总在一起称主导管.

def: vt.使高兴,使满意

ex.en: He did that to gratify his girlfriend's vanity.
ex.cn: 他做那事是要满足他女友的虚荣心.

ex.en: I do not think that young and amiable poets are bound to gratify its taste.
ex.cn: 我认为和善的青年诗人没有义务满足它的胃口.

ex.en: She dilated on the beauty of the park and the Hall to gratify him.
ex.cn: 她不断地夸奖园林和府第的美丽,让他高兴.

def:
n.沙砾，碎石,砾石,[医]结石
vt.以砾石铺路,使困惑,使（船）搁浅在沙滩上

ex.en: I signed in and crunched across the gravel to my room.
ex.cn: 我签到后嘎吱嘎吱走过石子路来到我的房间。

ex.en: Two young men were racing motorcycles on the loose gravel.
ex.cn: 两个小伙子正在松散的砾石路面上赛摩托车。

ex.en: She heard the crunch of tires on the gravel driveway.
ex.cn: 她听到轮胎轧过石子铺成的车道，发出嘎吱声。

def:
n.沟，槽,[俚语]常规，老套：确定的规范,[俚语]理想状况,[俚语]非常愉快的经历
vt.刻沟，刻槽
vi.极其快乐，极其满意，过得快活,受愉快的刺激影响,投合，契合

ex.en: They're happy to stay in the same old groove.
ex.cn: 他们乐于墨守成规.

ex.en: The cupboard door slides open along the groove.
ex.cn: 食橱门沿槽移开.

ex.en: My life seems to be in a groove. I do the same things day after day.
ex.cn: 我的生活似乎很单调, 日复一日地干着同样的事情.

def:
vi.（雷）作隆隆声,嘟哝,愤愤不平地抱怨
vt.低声咆哮着说,粗鲁地说出
n.低吼，狺狺声,咆哮，粗声大气

ex.en: Acceleration is accompanied by a resonating growl from the gearbox.
ex.cn: 变速箱随着加速传来一阵轰鸣。

ex.en: The bear exposed its teeth in a muffled growl.
ex.cn: 那只熊龇出牙齿，发出一声低沉的吼叫。

ex.en: a low guttural growl
ex.cn: 从喉咙里发出的低沉的吼声

def: n.监护人,保护者，维护者,法国修道院院长

ex.en: The Turkish situation makes the lead in tomorrow's Guardian.
ex.cn: 土耳其局势将成为明天《卫报》的头条。

ex.en: Before the Chronicle I used to take the Guardian.
ex.cn: 在订阅《纪事报》以前，我看的是《卫报》。

ex.en: The Guardian's front page carries a photograph of the two foreign ministers.
ex.cn: 《卫报》的头版刊登了两国外交部长的一张合影。

def: n.火药,有烟火药，黑色火药,中国珠茶

ex.en: The barrel of gunpowder blew up with a terrible noise.
ex.cn: 火药桶爆炸了,发出轰然一声巨响.

ex.en: Gunpowder was used in China as far back as the 11 th century.
ex.cn: 远在公元11世纪,中国已使用火药.

ex.en: This statement has a strong smell of gunpowder.
ex.cn: 这是一篇充满火药味的声明.

def: n.幻觉，幻想,错觉

ex.en: Hallucination is common in patients who have suffered damage to the brain.
ex.cn: 脑部受损的病人常会产生幻觉。

ex.en: Perhaps the footprint was a hallucination.
ex.cn: 脚印可能只是幻象。

ex.en: High temperatures can cause hallucination.
ex.cn: 高烧可使人产生幻觉。

def: vt.[军]扰乱，骚扰,使烦扰，折磨,反复袭击

ex.en: The harass-ment had become too much to tolerate and he decided to move out.
ex.cn: 骚扰越来越过分，他难以忍受，决定搬走。

ex.en: He has sent hither swarms of officers to harass our people.
ex.cn: 他委派大批的官员到这里骚扰我们的人民。

ex.en: Our mission is to harass the landing of the main Japaness expeditionary force.
ex.cn: 我们的任务是骚乱日本远征军主力的登陆.

def:
vt.时常萦绕心头，使困窘,常去,以鬼魂形式出现,时常出现在，弥漫
vi.尤指鬼魂重回或常去
n.〈方〉鬼或其它超自然物体,常去的地方

ex.en: The place is the haunt of off-duty policemen.
ex.cn: 这里是不当班的警察经常光顾的地方。

ex.en: The area was a haunt of criminals.
ex.cn: 这个地区是罪犯经常出没的地方.

ex.en: They say ghosts haunt this house.
ex.cn: 据说这所房子里常闹鬼.

def: n.公顷

ex.en: A hectare is equal to 15 mu.
ex.cn: 1公顷合15市亩.

ex.en: The lands were to be sold at $ 2.50 per hectare.
ex.cn: 土地的售价为每公顷2. 50美元.

ex.en: American farmers are known worldwide for their ability to produce a large yield per hectare.
ex.cn: 美国农民能在每公顷土地上生产出大量的作物,这使他们闻名世界.

def:
vt.注意，留心
n.留心，注意，听从
v.嘻笑（ te-hee的过去式）

ex.en: But what if the government takes no heed?
ex.cn: 但如果政府不理会该怎么办呢？

ex.en: I cautioned him many times but he paid no heed.
ex.cn: 我多次劝告,他都置若罔闻.

ex.en: Chris would have been well advised to heed the old saying "Never bite the hand that feeds you."
ex.cn: 克里斯本应听从那句老话——“千万不要恩将仇报”。

def: n.螺旋结构

ex.en: Coil the fibre into a helix.
ex.cn: 将纤维卷绕成螺旋形。

ex.en: Normal, double - helix DNA is spiral, like a loosely coiled spring.
ex.cn: 正常的双螺旋DNA是螺旋形的, 像一根松松地卷曲的弹簧.

ex.en: The helix makes a complete turn every 3.6 residues.
ex.cn: 每个3.6个残基,螺旋正好转一圈.

def: n.曲棍球,冰球

ex.en: Valerie earned letters in three sports: volleyball, basketball, and field hockey.
ex.cn: 瓦莱丽在排球、篮球和曲棍球三个项目上获得了佩戴校名首字母标志的荣誉。

ex.en: She played hockey for the national side.
ex.cn: 她在国家队打曲棍球。

ex.en: Great Britain's hockey players were outmanoeuvred by Germany.
ex.cn: 英国曲棍球队不敌德国队。

def: n.杀人（行为）,杀人犯,杀人罪

ex.en: Homicide is the leading cause of death among black men.
ex.cn: 谋杀是黑人死亡的主要原因。

ex.en: It was a clear case of homicide.
ex.cn: 这显然是一宗杀人案。

ex.en: The jury returned a verdict of justifiable homicide.
ex.cn: 陪审团作出了正当杀人的裁决.

def: n.诚实，真诚,正直,〈古〉贞洁,[植]一年生缎花

ex.en: We like him for his honesty, his lack of pretension.
ex.cn: 我们喜欢他的诚实、不浮夸。

ex.en: Her eyes stared into his with an expression of absolute honesty.
ex.cn: 她凝视着他的眼睛，一脸诚恳。

ex.en: The secret of success is honesty and fair dealing.
ex.cn: 成功的秘诀在于诚实和公平交易。

def: n.（宗教团体开办的）旅客招待所,（晚期病人的）安养院,收容所，救济院

ex.en: He died in March at St Julia's Hospice.
ex.cn: 他于3月在圣朱莉娅临终关怀医院去世。

ex.en: My definition of a good hospice is one where some of the patients start feeling too good to die.
ex.cn: 我对“好的晚期病人安养院”的定义是一个能让一些病人开始感到生有所恋的地方。

ex.en: They have started a hospice for terminal patients.
ex.cn: 他们为身患绝症的病人开办了一个安养所。

def: adj.好客的,热情友好的,（气候，环境）宜人的

ex.en: Even in summer this place did not look exactly hospitable.
ex.cn: 即使在夏天，这个地方看起来也不太舒适宜人。

ex.en: The local people are very hospitable to strangers.
ex.cn: 当地人对外来客人十分友好热情。

ex.en: Her neighbours spoke of her as kindly and hospitable.
ex.cn: 她的邻居都说她和蔼可亲、热情好客.

def: n.农业,资源管理，妥善管理

ex.en: The basin favours the development of farming and animal husbandry.
ex.cn: 这个盆地有利于农业和畜牧业的发展.

ex.en: To let the roof leak would be bad husbandry.
ex.cn: 屋漏不修,不是个好管家(的办法).

ex.en: Animal husbandry on the grassland is developing rapidly.
ex.cn: 草原上的畜牧业在迅速发展.

def: adj.水力发电的

ex.en: The soil washed from the hills is silting up the hydroelectric dams.
ex.cn: 从山上冲刷下来的泥土就要让水电大坝淤塞了。

ex.en: Plans are being drawn up to build a hydroelectric station here.
ex.cn: 这里正筹划建设一座水力发电站.

ex.en: This machine uses the hydroelectric power.
ex.cn: 这台机器使用的是水力发电的能量.

def: n.冰山,（事物全貌的）一小部分,冷若冰霜的人

ex.en: The above complaints are, I suspect, just the tip of the iceberg.
ex.cn: 我想，以上的抱怨只是冰山一角。

ex.en: The Titanic met her fate by crashing into a huge iceberg.
ex.cn: 泰坦尼克号客轮因撞上一个大冰山而沉没.

ex.en: But this is only the tip of the iceberg.
ex.cn: 然而,这仅仅是一种表面现象.

def: n.偶像，崇拜对象,图标，图符,[宗]圣像,肖像

ex.en: Double click on the icon to open the file.
ex.cn: 双击图标打开文件。

ex.en: Click the square icon again to minimize the window.
ex.cn: 再次点击正方形图标，把窗口最小化。

ex.en: Only Marilyn has proved as enduring a fashion icon.
ex.cn: 只有玛丽莲是常青的时尚偶像。

def:
adj.穷困的，无力的，用尽了的
v.使（某人）贫穷( impoverish的过去式和过去分词 ),使（某物）贫瘠或恶化

ex.en: The rural people have been impoverished by a collapsing economy.
ex.cn: 经济崩溃使农村地区的人们一贫如洗。

ex.en: the impoverished areas of the city
ex.cn: 这个城市的贫民区

ex.en: They were impoverished by a prolonged spell of unemployment.
ex.cn: 他们因长期失业而一贫如洗.

def:
n.盖印,痕迹,特征,版权标记
v.盖（印）,刻上（记号）,使铭记

ex.en: The city bears the imprint of Japanese investment.
ex.cn: 该市带有日本投资的深刻印记。

ex.en: The ceramics bore the imprint of Luca della Robbia.
ex.cn: 陶器上印有卢卡·德拉·罗比亚的字样.

ex.en: That dictionary is published under the Longman imprint.
ex.cn: 那本词典以朗曼公司的名义出版.

def: vt.关押，监禁,束缚，禁锢,使…不自由

ex.en: You can lock up a person physically, but you cannot imprison his heart.
ex.cn: 人的身体可以被囚禁, 人的心却不可以.

ex.en: There are thunderous explosions, fierce solar winds, and forces so strong that they imprison even light.
ex.cn: 有雷鸣般的爆炸和猛烈的太阳风, 威力之大,甚至能阻碍光的传播.

ex.en: Imprison your mash in a dark vat, so it can become wine.
ex.cn: 将你的乱七八糟的东西关进一个黑暗的大缸里, 所以它能够变成酒.

def: adj.不合适的，非正常的,不正确的,不正派的，不合礼仪的,不道德的

ex.en: He would never be improper, he is always the perfect gentleman.
ex.cn: 他总是举止得体，一直是个完美的绅士。

ex.en: Mr Matthews maintained that he had done nothing improper.
ex.cn: 马修斯先生坚称他没有做过非法的事情。

ex.en: It's considered improper to be unclothed in public.
ex.cn: 在公共场合赤身裸体被认为是不成体统的。

def: adj.天生的，先天的，固有的

ex.en: We have our native inborn talent, yet we hardly use it.
ex.cn: 我们有天生的才能，但我们却几乎未曾使用过。

ex.en: He is a man with an inborn love of joke.
ex.cn: 他是一个生来就喜欢开玩笑的人.

ex.en: When Alfred Adler first postulated in 1908 that there existed an inborn instinct of aggression Freud argued against it.
ex.cn: 当艾尔弗雷德·阿德勒于1908年首次提出人生来就有攻击性本能的假设时，弗洛伊德对此表示反对。

def:
adj.进来的，回来的,即将就任的,增殖的,（居民等）移来的
n.进来，到来,收入

ex.en: They claimed to have shot down one incoming missile.
ex.cn: 他们声称击落了一枚来犯的导弹。

ex.en: The airport was closed for incoming flights.
ex.cn: 机场对进港航班关闭了。

ex.en: We keep a tape of incoming calls.
ex.cn: 我们对来电进行录音。

def: adj.不完全的,未完成的,不完备的,片

ex.en: European political union would be incomplete without a defence element.
ex.cn: 如果没有防御体系，欧洲政治联盟就不完整。

ex.en: Some offices had incomplete information on spending.
ex.cn: 一些办事处的开支信息不全。

ex.en: an incomplete set of figures
ex.cn: 一组不完整的数字

def:
adj.不清楚的，模糊的
n.不清楚，模糊
adv.不清楚地，模糊地

ex.en: I saw other indistinct shapes that stayed out of vision.
ex.cn: 我看见另有一些模糊的影子晃了一下就不见了。

ex.en: The lettering is fuzzy and indistinct.
ex.cn: 书写的文字模糊难认。

ex.en: His indistinct speech makes it impossible to understand him.
ex.cn: 他口齿不清,无法听懂他的意思.

def: adv.不适当地，无能地

ex.en: Unless the tests are ineptly designed, removing tests will just remove power.
ex.cn: 除非测试用例是不熟练的设计, 否则去掉测试用例就是去除作用力.

ex.en: This function is ineptly left to a small voice.
ex.cn: 这项任务不适当地交给了一个声音小的人.

ex.en: He performed his functions ineptly.
ex.cn: 他履行职责不当.

def: adj.无情的，铁面无私的,不可动摇的，不屈不挠的,不能变更的,不可阻挡的

ex.en: His own career continues its inexorable ascent.
ex.cn: 他事业的上升势头锐不可当。

ex.en: the inexorable rise of crime
ex.cn: 阻遏不了的犯罪趋势

ex.en: This trend is inexorable.
ex.cn: 这种趋势是不可阻挡的.

def: n.<医>传染，感染,传染病，染毒物,影响

ex.en: A cold is an infection of the upper respiratory tract.
ex.cn: 感冒是上呼吸道的感染。

ex.en: They've picked up a really nasty infection from something they've eaten.
ex.cn: 他们因吃错东西而得了很严重的感染症。

ex.en: All blood products are now heat treated to kill off any infection.
ex.cn: 目前所有血液制品均经过热处理，以防止各种感染。

def: adj.天生的,特有的，固有的,内在的，直觉的

ex.en: Home ownership has been an overarching and innate desire of the British.
ex.cn: 拥有私宅是所有英国人心中压倒一切和根深蒂固的强烈愿望。

ex.en: Americans have an innate sense of fairness.
ex.cn: 美国人有一种天生的公平观。

ex.en: the innate conservatism of older people
ex.cn: 老年人固有的保守性

def: adj.疯狂的,精神病的,非常愚蠢的

ex.en: I couldn't decide whether he was incredibly brave or just insane.
ex.cn: 我不能判定他到底是英勇无畏还是精神失常。

ex.en: Some people simply can't take it and they just go insane.
ex.cn: 一些人完全承受不了，结果就精神失常了。

ex.en: My desire to be rich was an insane, unwholesome, oppressive desire.
ex.cn: 我对财富的渴望疯狂、病态，犹如心头的一块重石。

def: adj.隐伏的，潜在的,暗中为害的,阴险的,狡猾的

ex.en: They focus on overt discrimination rather than insidious aspects of racism.
ex.cn: 他们关注的是公开的歧视，而不是种族主义的一些潜在问题。

ex.en: the insidious effects of polluted water supplies
ex.cn: 供水系统污染的潜在恶果

ex.en: The changes are insidious, and will not produce a noticeable effect for 15 to 20 years.
ex.cn: 变化是悄然发生的,15到20年间不会产生明显影响。

def: n.吸入，进气,（液体等）进入口,摄入，摄取,纳入（数）量

ex.en: We are constantly being reminded to cut down our fat intake.
ex.cn: 不断有人提醒我们要减少脂肪的摄入量。

ex.en: Nutritionists say only 33% of our calorie intake should be from fat.
ex.cn: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33％来自脂肪。

ex.en: Add pasta to your salads to bump up your fibre intake.
ex.cn: 在色拉中加入意大利面条，增加你的纤维摄入量。

def:
n.意图，目的,意思，含义
adj.专心的，专注的,意愿坚决的,急切的,一心想…的

ex.en: A peaceful demonstration had been hijacked by anarchists intent on causing trouble.
ex.cn: 和平示威已遭到蓄意制造事端的无政府主义者的操控。

ex.en: Booth was a revivalist intent on his Christian vocation.
ex.cn: 布思是一个坚定不移地奉行其基督徒天职的宗教复兴运动者。

ex.en: The rebels are obviously intent on keeping up the pressure.
ex.cn: 叛乱分子显然决心继续施压。

def:
adj.联锁的
v.<计>互锁设备( interlock的现在分词 ),双螺纹针织品

ex.en: The Olympic symbol is the five interlocking rings.
ex.cn: 奥林匹克的标志是五个相连的圆环。

ex.en: The ecosystem can be redefined as interlocking life systems.
ex.cn: 生态系统可以再定义为相互关联的生命系统的综合.

ex.en: Twisting arises in boards through the presence of spiral or interlocking grain.
ex.cn: 翘曲多发生在螺旋或交错纹理的板材中.

def: n.内联网

ex.en: All employees can access the parts of the Intranet that are not ring-fenced.
ex.cn: 所有雇员都可进入内联网中无使用权限制的部分。

ex.en: Sites on the Internet will, by default, have tighter security imposed than those on an intranet.
ex.cn: Internet上的站点将默认有比intranet中的站点更严密的安全.

ex.en: An Intranet is simply the application of Internet technology within an internal or closed user - group.
ex.cn: 内部网(Intranet)是互联网(Internet)技术在内部或封闭的用户群内的应用.

def: adj.发明的,善于发明的,有创造力的,独出心裁的

ex.en: Miro is the most inventive and entertaining of surrealist painters.
ex.cn: 米罗是最具创造力和娱乐性的超现实主义画家。

ex.en: It inspired me to be more inventive with my own cooking.
ex.cn: 它激发我在自己烹饪时更富创造性。

ex.en: She has a highly inventive mind.
ex.cn: 她的头脑非常善于创新。

def:
n.发票,发货单
v.开发票,记清单

ex.en: We will be pleased to delete the charge from the original invoice.
ex.cn: 我们决定将这笔费用从原始发票上删去。

ex.en: A clerk simply verifies that the payment and invoice amount match.
ex.cn: 职员只是核实付款和发票上的数额是否一致。

ex.en: The seller has to issue a tax invoice.
ex.cn: 销售者必须开具税务发票.

def: n.灌溉,水利,[医]冲洗,冲注洗剂

ex.en: The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system.
ex.cn: 就在一个重要的灌溉系统的北边，这些河流交汇在一起。

ex.en: There the irrigation canal links up with the reservoir.
ex.cn: 这条灌溉渠在那里与水库连接起来.

ex.en: Irrigation is easy in the South because of the abundance of water.
ex.cn: 南方多水,利于灌溉.

def:
n.旅程，路线,旅行日程,旅行指南,旅行日记
adj.旅程的,巡回的，流动的,旅行途中的

ex.en: His itinerary is still unclear.
ex.cn: 目前仍不清楚他的行程安排。

ex.en: You will have time to other places than those on the itinerary.
ex.cn: 你将有时间参观计划行程之外的一些地方.

ex.en: A visit to Rome must be included in the itinerary.
ex.cn: 罗马之行必须列入预定行程.

def:
vt.& vi.嘲笑，戏弄
n.嘲讽,讥笑的言语

ex.en: Threats to reinstate the tax elicited jeer from the Opposition.
ex.cn: 恢复此项征税的威胁引起了反对党的嘲笑.

ex.en: Do not jeer at the mistakes or misfortunes of others.
ex.cn: 不要嘲笑别人的错误或不幸.

ex.en: Look at those saddos going to the Royal Opera House, I would jeer.
ex.cn: 看到那些去皇家歌剧院的蠢家伙，我会不屑一顾。

def: abbr.jeweller 宝石商,jewelry 珠宝（饰物）

ex.en: He was born a Jew in first century Palestine.
ex.cn: 他是出生于1世纪巴勒斯坦的犹太人.

ex.en: Shylock, the Jew, lived at Venice: he was an usurer.
ex.cn: 犹太人夏洛克住在威尼斯,他是个放印子钱的人.

ex.cn: 大型超市的掠夺性价格正威胁着小商店的生计。

ex.cn: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

ex.cn: 那些言论似乎从来没有被西方媒体报道过。

ex.en: Now he plans to rev up publicity with a regional media campaign.
ex.cn: 现在他准备通过开展地区性的媒体活动加大宣传力度。

ex.cn: 老年医疗保险也适用于肾病晚期患者。

ex.cn: 总统今天突然去看望了两位享受医疗保险的病人.

ex.cn: 接受药物治疗后，家里的生活还能一切如常。

ex.cn: 他仍然在服用能够让他放松下来的药物。

ex.cn: 他的演艺生涯开场时轰轰烈烈，然后就变得庸庸碌碌。

ex.en: His plays are distinguished only by their stunning mediocrity.
ex.cn: 他的戏剧与众不同之处就是平凡得出奇.

ex.en: The old poet decried the mediocrity of today's writing.
ex.cn: 老诗人抨击了现代文体的平庸无奇.

def:
n.欢乐，狂欢,欢庆活动

def: n.里程碑,划时代事件

ex.cn: 事实证明这部影片是电影史上的一个里程碑.

ex.cn: 新法对滥用枪支的处罚更为严厉。

ex.cn: 最终他因滥用公款被判有罪。

ex.cn: 任天堂希望将该外挂调制解调器的价格定在200美元以下。

ex.cn: 惊恐万分的通勤者们看见那辆卡车突然冲向高速公路另一侧，接着翻倒在地。

ex.en: The soft wind breathed their names to the newborn grass.
ex.cn: 轻风把他们的名字吹向刚刚长出的小草。

ex.en: Mild jaundice in the newborn is common and often clears without treatment.
ex.cn: 新生儿有轻微的黄疸较为常见，经常不需要治疗就能自愈。

def: n.（给特定读者定期寄发的）通讯,时事通讯,业务通讯

ex.en: The organization now has around 18,000 members who receive a quarterly newsletter.
ex.cn: 该组织现有大约18,000名成员，他们会收到一份内部通讯季刊。

ex.en: They keep in touch with their members by issuing a quarterly newsletter.
ex.cn: 他们印发内部季刊与会员保持联系.

ex.en: The newsletter was printed towards the end of June in readiness for mailing.
ex.cn: 快到6月底的时候，时事通讯印刷完毕准备投寄。

def: n.新闻编辑室,报刊阅览室

ex.en: With unusual docility, Nancy stood up and followed him as he left the newsroom.
ex.cn: 南希以难得的顺从站起身来,尾随着他离开了新闻编辑室.

ex.en: We have breaking news from the Channel 8 newsroom right now.
ex.cn: 我们现在有一条突发新闻来自8频道的新闻编辑室.

ex.en: They rev my engine, but they don't belong in the newsroom!
ex.cn: 她们是我的动力, 但她们不属于新闻组!

def: n.微妙,细微,细微之处,细节

ex.en: the nicety of his argument
ex.cn: 他那论证的精确严密

ex.en: The character of the hero is depicted to a nicety.
ex.cn: 男主人公的性格刻画得非常细腻.

ex.en: He figured out his program for the day to a nicety.
ex.cn: 他已经巧妙地排下了一天的工作程序.

def: n.（沙漠中的）绿洲,（困苦中）令人快慰的地方（或时刻）,乐土，宜人之地,慰藉物

ex.en: It hovered before his eyes like the mirage of an oasis.
ex.cn: 它在他眼前晃动，好像海市蜃楼里的绿洲。

ex.en: an oasis of calm
ex.cn: 宁静的一刻

ex.en: They stopped for the night at an oasis.
ex.cn: 他们在沙漠中的绿洲停下来过夜.

def: vt.使着迷,缠住，迷住,使困扰

ex.en: I must admit that maps obsess me.
ex.cn: 我得承认我对地图十分着迷。

ex.en: Do you find that you obsess much about things?
ex.cn: 你发现你着迷于某些事情 吗 ?

ex.en: People who obsess about clothes also obsess about shoes, particularly men.
ex.cn: 痴迷于服装的人也痴迷于鞋, 尤以男人为甚.

def:
adj.离开海岸的,近海的,海外的，国外的
adv.（指风）向海的，离岸的

ex.en: When they hit the rocks, they were just 500 yards offshore.
ex.cn: 他们触礁时离海岸仅有500码。

ex.en: The decision to allow more offshore oil drilling angered some Californians.
ex.cn: 允许进行更多近海石油钻探的决定激怒了一些加利福尼亚人。

ex.en: Andrews had stashed money away in secret offshore bank accounts.
ex.cn: 安德鲁斯已经将钱存到了秘密的海外银行账户中。

def:
n.橄榄,橄榄树,橄榄色,油橄榄
adj.橄榄色的,黄褐色的,淡褐色的,橄榄绿的

ex.en: He had a strong Greek nose and olive-black eyes.
ex.cn: 他有一个高挺的希腊式鼻子和一双墨橄榄绿色的眼睛。

ex.en: Soon we left the coolness of the olive groves.
ex.cn: 很快我们就离开了凉爽的橄榄树林。

ex.en: I found the scene in which Percy proposed to Olive tremendously poignant.
ex.cn: 我觉得珀西向奥利芙求婚的一幕太让人心酸了。

def: adj.迎面而来的，即将到来的

ex.en: He loosed off two shots at the oncoming car.
ex.cn: 他朝迎面开过来的车子放了两枪。

ex.en: Always walk facing the oncoming traffic.
ex.cn: 走路一定要面向驶来的车辆。

ex.en: He strayed into the path of an oncoming car.
ex.cn: 他偏到了一辆迎面驶来的汽车的行车路线上。

def: adj.在线的,联网的,联机的

ex.en: You can chat to other people who are online.
ex.cn: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

ex.en: Online gaming allows players from around the world to challenge each other.
ex.cn: 网络游戏使得全球的玩家可以相互较量。

ex.en: Go to the website today and you can unsubscribe online.
ex.cn: 今天上网就可以退订。

def: n.乐观,乐观主义

ex.en: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
ex.cn: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

ex.en: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism.
ex.cn: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

ex.en: Every day of sunshine strengthens the feelings of optimism.
ex.cn: 每天晒太阳让人心情更加开朗。

def: n.（蒸汽，怒气等的）爆发,破裂

ex.en: The outburst was inconsistent with the image he has cultivated.
ex.cn: 这样大发脾气与他所树立的个人形象不相称。

ex.en: Marcus remained placid in the face of her outburst.
ex.cn: 马库斯面对她的发作保持平静。

ex.en: Five people were reported killed today in a fresh outburst of violence.
ex.cn: 据报道在今天最新发生的暴乱中有5人丧生。

def: n.高声叫喊，尖叫,公开反对，强烈抗议,拍卖，叫卖

ex.en: The killing caused an international outcry.
ex.cn: 这起谋杀引起了国际社会的强烈抗议。

ex.en: an outcry over the proposed change
ex.cn: 对拟议的改革所发出的强烈抗议

ex.en: An increase in taxes produced an outcry from the voters.
ex.cn: 增加税收引起了选民们强烈抗议.

def:
adj.过时的，旧式的，落伍的，不流行的
v.使过时(outdate的过去式和过去分词)

ex.en: Sweden needs to cast aside outdated policies and thinking.
ex.cn: 瑞典必须摒弃过时的政策和思维。

ex.en: The tourists snigger at the locals' outdated ways and dress.
ex.cn: 游客们偷偷地取笑当地人落伍的做法和衣着。

ex.en: The image of art theft as a gentleman's crime is outdated.
ex.cn: 把盗窃艺术品看作是一种绅士犯罪的观念已经过时了。

def: vt.监督，监视,俯瞰,错过，宽恕，省略

ex.en: Judge Stacks was appointed to oversee the disposition of funds.
ex.cn: 斯塔克斯法官被指定监督资金的分配。

ex.en: Call in an architect or surveyor to oversee the work.
ex.cn: 找个建筑师或监理员来监工。

ex.en: He has vowed to oversee the elections impartially.
ex.cn: 他已宣誓公平公正地监督竞选。

def:
adj.（不辞）劳苦的，辛苦的,煞费苦心的,苦干的，辛勤的,小心的
n.苦干，刻苦,勤勉,辛苦,煞费苦心

ex.en: Forensic experts carried out a painstaking search of the debris.
ex.cn: 法医专家对残骸进行了极其仔细的搜索。

ex.en: The event had been planned with painstaking attention to detail.
ex.cn: 这次活动的细节是经过精心计划的。

ex.en: She is not very clever but she is painstaking.
ex.cn: 她并不很聪明,但肯下苦功夫.

def:
n.释义，意译,演释曲
vt.改述
vi.改述,意译

ex.en: Parents, to paraphrase Philip Larkin, can seriously damage your health.
ex.cn: 菲利普·拉金的意思是：父母可能会严重损害你的健康。

ex.en: The following is a paraphrase of what was said.
ex.cn: 下面是对刚才说过的话的阐释。

ex.en: Try to paraphrase the question before you answer it.
ex.cn: 先试解释一下问题再作回答。

def: adj.热烈的,激昂的,易怒的,易被情欲所支配的

ex.en: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。

ex.en: Mahler was also known for his passionate involvements outside marriage.
ex.cn: 马勒也因为其轰轰烈烈的婚外情而出名。

ex.en: The book is both a history and a passionate polemic for tolerance.
ex.cn: 这本书既是一段历史，也是一篇主张宽容的激情论辩。

def: n.路，道,途径，路径

ex.en: Diplomacy will smooth your pathway to success.
ex.cn: 为人圆通会让你成功的道路通畅无阻。

ex.en: During childhood each of us has to navigate a pathway through a series of developmental stages.
ex.cn: 我们每个人在童年时都要经历和应对不同的成长阶段。

ex.en: Richard was coming up the pathway.
ex.cn: 理查德正沿着小路走过来。

def: adj.家长的,族长的,父权的,父系

ex.en: I think marriage is used to uphold patriarchal control.
ex.cn: 我觉得婚姻是用来维系父权统治的。

ex.en: To feminists she is a classic victim of the patriarchal society.
ex.cn: 在女权主义者眼中，她是父权社会的典型受害者。

ex.en: His patriarchal generosity is counter-balanced by his ruthlessness.
ex.cn: 他有着族长式的慷慨大方，同时却又冷漠无情。

def: vt.& vi.传播，散播,兜售，叫卖,忙于做琐事

ex.en: They even set up their own news agency to peddle anti-isolationist propaganda.
ex.cn: 他们甚至设立了自己的通讯社来宣扬反孤立主义。

ex.en: She loves to peddle gossip round the village.
ex.cn: 她喜欢在村里到处说闲话.

ex.en: His attempts to peddle his paintings around London's tiny gallery scene proved unsuccessful.
ex.cn: 他到伦敦小画廊兜售自己的画作，结果碰了一鼻子灰。

def: n.企鹅

ex.en: He walked with an awkward gait like a penguin.
ex.cn: 他走路的步子难看得就像企鹅.

ex.en: The penguin is a flightless bird.
ex.cn: 企鹅是一种不会飞的鸟.

ex.en: There was this running gag about a penguin ( = they kept telling penguin jokes ).
ex.cn: 人们不断讲关于一只企鹅的笑话.

def: n.青霉素，盘尼西林

ex.en: I should have asked him for a shot of penicillin.
ex.cn: 我应当让他给我打一针青霉素的.

ex.en: She injected the patient with penicillin.
ex.cn: 她给病人注射了青霉素.

ex.en: Penicillin was an extremely significant medical discovery.
ex.cn: 青霉素是极其重要的医学发现.

def: adj.周期的,定期的,回归的,间歇的，时而发生的

ex.en: There may be periodic police "sweeps" of crime in the area.
ex.cn: 警方可能对该地区的犯罪活动进行定时的“扫荡”。

ex.en: Periodic checks are carried out on the equipment.
ex.cn: 设备定期进行检查。

ex.en: Long long ago, we knew the periodic motion of a planet.
ex.cn: 很久以前, 我们就知道行星的周期运动.

def:
adj.普遍的,扩大的,渗透的,弥漫的
adv.无处不在地,遍布地
n.无处不在,遍布

ex.en: She lives with a pervasive sense of guilt.
ex.cn: 她生活在深深的愧疚之中。

ex.en: a pervasive smell of damp
ex.cn: 四处弥漫的潮湿味儿

ex.en: It is knowledge directed to the fundamental and pervasive concerns of existence.
ex.cn: 它要回答的是人类生存的根本、普遍的问题.

def: vt.剽窃，抄袭

ex.en: Thus, please do not plagiarize my style or fake my username.
ex.cn: 因此, 请不要模仿我的风格或者假冒我的用户名.

ex.en: It's not a viable option to plagiarize someone else's work.
ex.cn: 剽窃他人作品的行为是不可取的.

ex.en: Others can try to show that they did not plagiarize.
ex.cn: 另一些人则试图证明他们没有剽窃.

def:
n.（厚）木板,支持物,政纲条目
vt.在…上铺板,重重放下,立即付款

ex.en: Frank put the first plank down and nailed it in place.
ex.cn: 弗兰克放下第一块厚木板，把它钉在合适的位置上。

ex.en: Clamp one end of the plank to the edge of the table.
ex.cn: 把厚木板的一端用夹具固定在桌子的边上。

ex.en: a plank of wood
ex.cn: 一块木板条

def: n.普及,流行,名气，名望，通俗性，大众性,人望

ex.en: Walking and golf increased in popularity during the 1980s.
ex.cn: 在20世纪80年代越来越多的人喜欢上了远足或是打高尔夫球。

ex.en: The president's popularity nationally is at an all-time low.
ex.cn: 总统在全国的人气目前正处于历史最低点。

ex.en: The president became more cautious as his popularity dipped.
ex.cn: 由于支持率有所下降，总统变得更加谨慎了。

def:
n.平民主义者,平民论者,平民党党员,民粹主义者
adj.平民主义的,平民化的

ex.en: The city of Memphis is promoting a populist approach to culture.
ex.cn: 孟菲斯市在推行文化的民粹主义道路。

ex.en: He co-opted many nationalist slogans and cultivated a populist image.
ex.cn: 他借鉴了很多民族主义标语，建立了一个平民主义者的形象。

ex.en: The populist party anointed him as its candidate.
ex.cn: 平民党选定他做候选人。

def:
n.序曲，前奏曲,开场戏，序幕,前兆，预兆
v.为…作序，开头,成为…的序曲,演奏序曲，唱开场戏

ex.en: Most unions see privatisation as an inevitable prelude to job losses.
ex.cn: 大多数工会认为私有化会不可避免地导致失业。

ex.en: The prelude to the musical composition is very long.
ex.cn: 这首乐曲的序曲很长.

ex.en: The prelude was as iridescent as a prism in a morning room.
ex.cn: 这个序曲就象清晨房间里的一块三棱镜一样灿烂辉煌.

def:
n.防腐剂,预防法,防护层
adj.防腐的，（能）保存的,储藏的,有保护力的

ex.en: The wood is treated with preservative to prevent decay.
ex.cn: 这块木头用防腐剂处理过以防止腐烂.

ex.en: Make sure the panels are treated with a wood preservative.
ex.cn: 确保镶板用木材防腐剂处理过.

ex.en: New timber should be treated with a preservative.
ex.cn: 新采的圆木应进行防腐处理.

def:
vt.取得，获得,实现，完成,导致
vi.取得,介绍娼妓，拉皮条

ex.en: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.
ex.cn: 他们把搞到手的肉拿来充饥。

ex.en: She managed to procure a ticket for the concert.
ex.cn: 她好不容易弄到一张音乐会入场券。

ex.en: It remained very difficult to procure food, fuel and other daily necessities.
ex.cn: 食物、燃料和其他日用必需品仍然很难得到。

def: vt.声称,宣称,公开表明,信奉

ex.en: Why do organisations profess that they care?
ex.cn: 为什么机构都谎称自己对此很关心？

ex.en: I profess that I was surprised at the news.
ex.cn: 我承认这消息使我惊讶.

ex.en: They have become what they profess to scorn.
ex.cn: 他们成了自己曾声称看不起的那种人.

def: adj.毫不吝惜的,慷慨的,挥霍的,浪费的

ex.en: He was so profuse with his money that he is now poor.
ex.cn: 他过去很挥霍,结果现在穷了.

ex.en: It was a mistake. My profuse apologies.
ex.cn: 这是一个错误. 我深表歉意.

ex.en: He is profuse in hospitality.
ex.cn: 他招待得十分周到.

def:
vi.增生，增殖,激增,扩散
vt.使激增,使扩散

ex.en: Rabbits proliferate when they have plenty of food.
ex.cn: 兔子有充足的食物就会繁衍得很快.

ex.en: There is a natural tendency for services to proliferate.
ex.cn: 各种服务大量产生就成为一种自然的趋势.

ex.en: Fantasies proliferate where factsare few.
ex.cn: 事实缺乏则幻想增多.

def: n.支持者，拥护者,提倡者,提出认证遗嘱者

ex.en: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
ex.cn: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的主要拥护者。

ex.en: The most important proponent of the former group was Mrs. Radcliffe.
ex.cn: 前者最重要的代表人物是德克利夫太太.

ex.en: Stapp became a strong early proponent of automobile seat belts.
ex.cn: 斯塔普是力主在汽车上采用座椅安全带的早期创导者.

def:
n.新教教徒
adj.新教教徒的,新教的

ex.en: He abjured the Protestant faith and became King in 1594.
ex.cn: 他放弃了新教信仰，于1594年登基为王。

ex.en: I am not completely at home in any Protestant Church.
ex.cn: 我在任何一个新教教会都不是特别自在。

ex.en: Most Protestant churches now have women ministers.
ex.cn: 如今大多数新教教会都有女牧师。

def:
adj.引起幻觉的，致幻觉的,迷幻的，幻觉的
n.迷幻剂

ex.en: Grof describes his research with psychedelic drugs and the experiences they triggered.
ex.cn: 格罗夫描述了他对迷幻药物及其带来的体验的研究情况。

ex.en: Is the dream of democracy in Hong Kong a psychedelic fantasy?
ex.cn: 香港的民主之梦是一场迷幻般的梦想 吗 ?

ex.en: Official, position resembles chair of a demon, always making psychedelic.
ex.cn: 官位 、 职位像一把魔椅, 总在制造幻觉.

def:
adj.四重的,四倍的,由四部份组成的
n.四倍
vt.& vi.使乘四或被四乘

ex.en: They could sell their merchandise for quadruple the asking price.
ex.cn: 他们能够以4倍于要价的价钱出售他们的商品。

ex.en: There was a proposal in the United States to quadruple its annual intake of immigrants.
ex.cn: 在美国有提案建议把每年移民的接收数量增加3倍。

ex.en: We have hope to quadruple the total industrial and agricultural output by the end of the century, which is a lofty aim.
ex.cn: 我们有雄心壮志,到本世纪末, 使工农业生产总值翻两番.

def:
n.大牧场，大农场,牧场工作人员
vi.经营牧场,在牧场工作
vt.经营牧场,在牧场饲养…

ex.en: They had to buy everything at inflated prices at the ranch store.
ex.cn: 他们不得不在农场商店以高价购买所有东西。

ex.en: He left his Montana ranch to his spinster sister.
ex.cn: 他把他在蒙大拿州的大牧场留给了他未婚的妹妹.

ex.en: The ranch is in the middle of a large plateau.
ex.cn: 该牧场位于一个辽阔高原的中部.

def:
n.等级,评估，评价,极限,收听率，收视率
v.估价( rate的现在分词),定级

ex.en: The president's approval rating had risen.
ex.cn: 总统的支持率上升了。

ex.en: Four restaurants have been awarded the highest accolade of a three - star rating .
ex.cn: 四家餐馆获授予 三星级 餐馆的最高荣誉称号.

ex.en: It is a ship with a rating of 500, 000 tons.
ex.cn: 这是一艘五十万吨级的船.

def: n.响尾蛇

ex.en: He had been bitten by a rattlesnake.
ex.cn: 他被响尾蛇咬过。

ex.en: Rattlesnake skin is used for fancy bags and purses.
ex.cn: 响尾蛇皮被用来制作精美的提包和钱包.

ex.en: The renegade is the first cousin to a rattlesnake.
ex.cn: 叛徒象响尾蛇一样地毒狠.

def: vt.彻底摧毁，将…夷为平地

ex.en: SS General Jurgen Stroop watches his troops raze Warsaw's ghetto.
ex.cn: 党卫队将军杰尔根.斯特如普注视着被他的部下一位平地的华沙犹太人区.

ex.en: The owners intend to raze the hotel and erect an office building on the site.
ex.cn: 业主打算夷平酒店和竖立一座办公大楼在网站上.

ex.en: The conquerors tried to raze the very name of the peoples national hero from their memories.
ex.cn: 征服者妄图把人民的民族英雄的名字从他们的记忆中抹去.

def:
vt.复得，重回,回收,恢复（失物、失地、健康等）
n.收复，取回

ex.en: She needs to regain a sense of her own worth.
ex.cn: 她需要重新认识到自我的价值。
