def: adj.可适应的,有适应能力的,适合的,可改编的

ex.en: Older workers can be as adaptable and quick to learn as anyone else.
ex.cn: 较年长的工人的适应能力和学习速度有时并不亚于其他任何人。

ex.en: Children are highly adaptable—they just need time to readjust.
ex.cn: 儿童的适应能力很强—他们只是需要时间重新适应。

ex.en: He is an adaptable man and will soon learn the new work.
ex.cn: 他是个适应性很强的人,很快就将学会这种工作.

def: adv.足够地,适当地

ex.en: Many students are not adequately prepared for higher education.
ex.cn: 许多学生并未做好接受高等教育的充分准备。

ex.en: "I think I've covered that business more than adequately," he said gravely.
ex.cn: “我想我已经把那件事说得够详细了，”他正色说道。

ex.en: Within this lecture I cannot pretend to deal adequately with dreams.
ex.cn: 在这一次讲座中，我不敢自诩能对梦境作透彻的分析。

def: adj.收养的,有收养关系的,被采纳的,装出来的

ex.en: They threatened to expel him from his adoptive country.
ex.cn: 他们威胁将他驱逐出他的移居国。

ex.en: Galway in Ireland is my adoptive home.
ex.cn: 爱尔兰的戈尔韦是我的第二故乡。

ex.en: Raised by adoptive parents , Hill received early encouragement in her musical proclivities.
ex.cn: 希尔由养父母带大, 从小,她的音乐爱好就受到了鼓励.

def: n.广告，宣传,公告,出公告，做广告

ex.en: That would not be a good advertisement for Hungary's emerging democracy.
ex.cn: 那并不能有效地体现匈牙利新兴的民主意识。

ex.en: The England team were a poor advertisement for European football tonight.
ex.cn: 英格兰队今晚为欧洲足球做了一次糟糕的宣传。

ex.en: Miss Parrish recently placed an advertisement in the local news-paper.
ex.cn: 帕里什小姐最近在本埠报纸上登了一则广告。

def: n.登广告的人

ex.en: The city directory showed no such return address as the advertiser had left.
ex.cn: 本市的住址簿上查不到登启事人留下的那个回信地址.

ex.en: As an advertiser today, you weigh new factors into your media mix.
ex.cn: 作为一个当今的广告主, 你须衡量媒体混合的新因素.

ex.en: How to better understand advertiser s media management matrix and process?
ex.cn: 如何深入了解广告主内部媒介管理规则与流程?

def:
adj.令人惊异的
vt.使大为吃惊，使惊奇( amaze的现在分词),使惊异：感到非常好奇
n.吃惊,好奇

ex.en: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
ex.cn: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

ex.en: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
ex.cn: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

ex.en: This small country has an amazing variety of landforms.
ex.cn: 这个小国家拥有令人惊叹的丰富的地貌类型。

def: n.分析家，化验员,〈美〉精神病医师

ex.en: Constance's husband is a financial analyst.
ex.cn: 康斯坦斯的丈夫是一名财政分析家.

ex.en: Gates is known to be a superb analyst with a sharp eye and an excellent memory.
ex.cn: 盖茨是公认的杰出分析家，他目光敏锐且记忆力超群。

ex.en: The latter studies are extremely useful to the analyst.
ex.cn: 后者的这些研究对于分析工作者极为有用.

def: n.通告,布告,预告,宣告

ex.en: Sir Robert made his announcement after talks with the President.
ex.cn: 在与总统会谈之后，罗伯特爵士发表了声明。

ex.en: The announcement came after a three-hour Cabinet meeting in Downing Street.
ex.cn: 在唐宁街进行了长达3个小时的内阁会议后发布了这份公告。

ex.en: The announcement dashed hopes of an early end to the crisis.
ex.cn: 这一宣告使得人们期盼危机早日结束的希望落了空。

def: adv.据…所知,看来,显然

ex.en: She was taken to hospital, apparently amnesiac and shocked.
ex.cn: 她被送往医院，好像是受了惊吓出现了失忆。

ex.en: Rudolph said no more. Apparently he was a man of few words.
ex.cn: 鲁道夫没再说话。看来他是个寡言少语的人。

ex.en: Apparently there's a very hush-hush project under way up north.
ex.cn: 貌似这里往北的地方有个非常机密的项目正在进行。

def: n.申请人，求职人,请求者

ex.en: Not every applicant had a degree.
ex.cn: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。

ex.en: The job applicant must have good verbal skills.
ex.cn: 应聘这份工作的人必须具有良好的语言表达技能。

ex.en: This applicant is by far the better than that one.
ex.cn: 这个申请者远比那一个好.

def: n.欣赏；鉴赏,感谢,评估,增值

ex.en: You have to take capital appreciation of the property into account.
ex.cn: 你必须将该处房产的资本增值考虑在内。

ex.en: They have a stronger appreciation of the importance of economic incentives.
ex.cn: 他们对经济激励的重要性有了更深的理解。

ex.en: They had rushed in without adequate appreciation of the task.
ex.cn: 他们还没有充分了解这项任务就仓促行动了。

def:
n.综合症状,弧（度）,天穹,电弧，弧光。
vi.形成拱状物,循弧线行进
abbr.American Red Cross. 美国红十字会

ex.en: A group of actors are rehearsing a play about Joan of Arc.
ex.cn: 一群演员正在排演一出关于圣女贞德的戏。

ex.en: Joan of Arc was finally canonized by Pope Benedict XV in 1920.
ex.cn: 圣女贞德终于在1920年由教皇本尼狄克十五世封为圣徒。

ex.en: His pass described a perfect arc through the leaden sky.
ex.cn: 他的传球在阴沉的天空中划出了一道完美的弧线。

def: n.安排,排列,约定,改编

ex.en: The arrangement presumes that both lenders and borrowers are rational.
ex.cn: 这一协议假定借贷双方都是在神志清楚的状态下签订的。

ex.en: There have been calls for a new kind of security arrangement.
ex.cn: 不少人呼吁出台新的安全措施。

ex.en: Subsequently the arrangement was terminated.
ex.cn: 后来这个计划被终止了。

def: n.声称,使用,主张,明确肯定

ex.en: These institutions have made the assertion of ethnic identity possible.
ex.cn: 这些制度使实现民族认同的主张成为可能。

ex.en: Self-assertion was not thought seemly in a woman.
ex.cn: 人们认为女性不应该过于自信。

ex.en: He was correct in his assertion that the minister had been lying.
ex.cn: 他认定部长说谎，事实果然如此。

def:
n.[天]小行星,海盘车,海星
adj.星状的

ex.en: There is an asteroid on a collision course with the Earth.
ex.cn: 有一颗小行星可能会与地球发生碰撞。

ex.en: The largest asteroid is Ceres, which is about a quarter the size of the moon.
ex.cn: 最大的小行星是谷神星,体积约为月球的1/4.

ex.en: Asteroid lies between Mars and Jupiter.
ex.cn: 小行星位于火星与木星之间.

def: n.有效,有益,可利用性,可得到的东西（或人）

ex.en: The nature and availability of material evidence was not to be discussed.
ex.cn: 实质性证据的性质和可用性毋庸讨论。

ex.en: The availability of nursery school places varies widely across London.
ex.cn: 伦敦幼儿园的分布非常不均衡。

ex.en: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
ex.cn: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿保育的可能性。

def: n.察觉，觉悟，意识

ex.en: He introduced radio to the school to increase the children's awareness.
ex.cn: 他在学校开通广播，以提高孩子们的警觉性。

ex.en: It is assumed that you are interested in achieving greater self-awareness.
ex.cn: 假定大家都想变得更有自知之明。

ex.en: Deep inside the awareness was stirring that something was about to happen.
ex.cn: 内心深处隐隐感觉到有什么事即将发生。

def: n.河狸,河狸毛皮,[印]海狸绒布,工作勤恳的人

ex.en: Ask young Harry to do it — he's still an eager beaver and wants to impress by his willingness.
ex.cn: 请年轻的亨利干吧——他仍然是个雄心勃勃的人,并努力使人对他的投入留下深刻印象.

ex.en: The hat is made of beaver.
ex.cn: 这顶帽子是海狸毛皮制的.

ex.en: These young people beaver away at school.
ex.cn: 这些年轻人在学校里用功苦读.

def: adj.动作的

ex.en: Were the behavioral variables ( see Chapter 4 ) you identified valid?
ex.cn: 你发现并确定的这些行为变量 ( 参见第4章 ) 是否有效?

ex.en: Hunting site is determined primarily by inherited behavioral characteristics.
ex.cn: 追逐的场所主要取决于捕食者内在的行为特点.

ex.en: There are few established behavioral conventions for them, particularly with respect to terminating commands.
ex.cn: 非模态对话框很少建立行为规范, 尤其是终止命令.

def: adj.动作的

ex.en: We do not know which behavioural traits are inherited and which acquired.
ex.cn: 我们不知道哪些行为特征是遗传的,哪些是后天养成的.

ex.en: Societies need to develop highly adaptive behavioural rules for survival.
ex.cn: 社会需要发展具有高度适应性的生存行为规则。

ex.en: The individual develops behavioural means to defend himself from the enticements to establish relations with others.
ex.cn: 个人会发展一些行为方法以使自己不受到与他人建立关系的诱惑.

def:
n.广告牌,告示牌
v.宣传

ex.en: He ploughed his energies into his father's billboard business.
ex.cn: 他把精力投入到父亲的广告牌业务中.

ex.en: The poem employs as its first lines a verse plagiarized from a billboard.
ex.cn: 这首诗开头的几行抄袭了一个广告牌上的一节诗。

ex.en: She knew every house - front, every street crossing, every billboard, every tree, every dog.
ex.cn: 每一幢房子门脸, 每一个十字路口, 每一块广告牌, 以至于每一棵树, 每一头狗,她全都知道.

def: n.传记作者

ex.en: As Frost's official biographer, I mentally filed this information.
ex.cn: 身为弗洛斯特指定的传记撰写人, 我将这事记在心上.

ex.en: Boswell was the biographer of Dr Johnson.
ex.cn: 鲍斯威尔是约翰逊博士的传记作者.

ex.en: We can begin to answer the question with a sentence by Irving's biographer.
ex.cn: 要解答这个问题,首先引用欧文传记作者的一句话.

def:
adj.生物学的,生物的,与生物学相关的,有血亲关系的
n.[药]生物制品，生物制剂

ex.en: The living organisms somehow concentrated the minerals by biological processes.
ex.cn: 生命体通过某种生物过程聚集矿物质。

ex.en: Biological systems have been doing this for billions of years.
ex.cn: 生物系统亿万年来一直都是这样。

ex.en: Most young women feel a biological need to procreate.
ex.cn: 大多数的年轻妇女都有生儿育女的生理需要。

def: adv.短暂地,简单地,简略地,略略

ex.en: He also talked briefly about the isolation he endured while in captivity.
ex.cn: 他还简单谈及了他被俘期间忍受的孤独。

ex.en: We shall first look briefly at the historical antecedents of this theory.
ex.cn: 我们首先应大致看一下该理论在历史上的前身。

ex.en: There are four basic alternatives; they are described briefly below.
ex.cn: 有4个基本的选项，简述如下。

def: n.浏览程序,浏览器（用于在互联网上查阅信息）,浏览图书报刊者,逛商店的人

ex.en: In your Web browser's cache are the most recent Web files that you have downloaded.
ex.cn: 网页浏览器的高速缓存区里有你最近下载的网页文件。

ex.en: Press the "reload" button on your web browser to refresh the site and get the most current version.
ex.cn: 点击网页浏览器上的“刷新”按钮来刷新页面，显示最新的版本。

ex.en: Another excellent approach is to abandon the browser entirely and, instead, create a non - browser - based , Internet - enabled application.
ex.cn: 另一个非常好的方法是干脆放弃浏览器, 取而代之, 创建一个不基于浏览器, 但却是基于互联网的应用.

def: n.阉牛，一岁半以下的小公牛

ex.en: He was sweating like a bullock.
ex.cn: 他正在辛苦地干活.

ex.en: And Governor Bullock never sets foot in this house again.
ex.cn: 还有,无论如何不要再让布洛克州长进我家的家门了.

ex.en: A bullock is a castrated bull.
ex.cn: 阉牛是去势的公牛.

def: n.官僚,官僚主义，官僚主义者

ex.en: He was just another faceless bureaucrat.
ex.cn: 他只不过是一个典型呆板的官员.

ex.en: He is a conservative bureaucrat who can be counted upon to follow a beaten path.
ex.cn: 他是一个保守的官僚,他准会循规蹈矩地办事.

ex.en: I suppose my application has been lost by some incompetent bureaucrat.
ex.cn: 我估计我的申请书不知道让哪个无能的官僚给弄丢了.

def: n.标准，准则,教规，宗规,（在大教堂任职的）教士,（某作家的）真作，真经

ex.en: Richard refused to trade in his old Canon cameras.
ex.cn: 理查德拒绝用他的旧佳能相机以旧换新。

ex.en: The Church's canon law forbids remarriage of divorced persons.
ex.cn: 该教派教规禁止离婚者再婚。

ex.en: The very first canon of nursing is to keep the air inside as fresh as the air outside.
ex.cn: 护理工作的首要原则是要保持室内空气像室外一样清新。

def:
vi.唠叨，喋喋不休,（鸟等）鸣，啁啾,（牙齿，机器等）振动，打颤,运动时摇摆或嘎嘎作响
vt.不加思索地说出
n.闲聊,咔哒声,（动物的）啁啾声,潺潺流水声

ex.en: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.
ex.cn: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。

ex.en: Lila kept up a steady stream of chatter.
ex.cn: 莉拉一直说个没完。

ex.en: Troy's chatter kept me from thinking dark thoughts.
ex.cn: 特洛伊的喋喋不休让我暂时收起了阴郁思绪。

def: adj.无儿女的,无儿无女

ex.en: a campaign to encourage childless couples to adopt
ex.cn: 鼓励无子女夫妇领养孩子的运动

ex.en: Many childless couples adopt children.
ex.cn: 许多无子女的夫妇收养孩子.

ex.en: Thousands of childless couples are to be given new hope by the government.
ex.cn: 政府将为数千对无子女的夫妇带来新的希望。

def:
n.谷歌浏览器,铬，铬合金
vt.镀以铬,用铬化合物印染

ex.en: There is a lot of chrome on cars of that model.
ex.cn: 那种牌子的汽车上涂有许多铬黄.

ex.en: The United States was vulnerable to shortages of chrome, bauxite, and platinum.
ex.cn: 美国的弱点是缺少铬 、 矾土和铂.

ex.en: Now, new models use nice, shiny chrome, hex - head screws.
ex.cn: 现在, 新的模型使用漂亮的, 有光泽的镀铬六角形镙丝.

def: n.公民身份,公民权

ex.en: Israel offers automatic citizenship to all Jews who want it.
ex.cn: 以色列为所有希望获得公民身份的犹太人敞开大门。

ex.en: In 1986, they got the right to reclaim South African citizenship.
ex.cn: 1986年，他们取得了恢复南非公民身份的权利。

ex.en: Their German peers had a more developed sense of citizenship.
ex.cn: 和他们同龄的德国人有着更强烈的公民归属感。

def:
vt.& vi.夹紧，夹住,锁住,把（砖等）堆高，堆存,脚步很重地走
n.钳，夹子,压板，压铁,车轮锁,（砖等的）堆
vt.紧紧抓住,紧夹住,被抓住,被夹紧

ex.en: Banking regulators failed to clamp down until earlier this month.
ex.cn: 银行监管机构直到本月初才开始严格管制。

ex.en: Ironically, the latest clamp-down has just led to renewed international criticism.
ex.cn: 让人哭笑不得的是，最近的制裁结果只是导致新一波国际社会的批评。

ex.en: Clamp one end of the plank to the edge of the table.
ex.cn: 把厚木板的一端用夹具固定在桌子的边上。

def:
adj.古典的，经典的,传统的,古典文学的,第一流的
n.古典音乐

ex.en: The images were Gothic or Byzantine rather than classical.
ex.cn: 这些形象属哥特式或者拜占庭式而非古典式。

ex.en: A performer in evening dress plays classical selections on the violin.
ex.cn: 一名身穿晚礼服的表演者用小提琴演奏了几段古典音乐。

ex.en: The radio station has to include a substantial proportion of classical music.
ex.cn: 该电台不得不播放大量的古典音乐。

def: n.渐变群（一种生态特征）

ex.en: Such a range of variation is termed a cline.
ex.cn: 这样一个变异区域称为梯度变异.

ex.en: Callaham and Liddicoet found an elevational cline in ponderosa pine from Northern California.
ex.cn: 卡拉汉和利狄柯特发现加利福尼亚北部产的黄松有一海拔渐变群.

ex.en: Often individuals at either end of a cline are reproductively isolated.
ex.cn: 通常,在两个变异群中的个体是繁殖隔离的.

def: adj.合作的,协作的

ex.en: "The First Day" is their first collaborative album.
ex.cn: 《第一天》是他们的首张合作专辑。

ex.en: Most wikis are collaborative websites.
ex.cn: 大多数维基网站属于协同工作网站。

ex.en: Large scale studies should be collaborative.
ex.cn: 大规模的研究应该是协作的.

def: n.承诺，许诺,委任，委托,致力，献身,承担义务

ex.en: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?
ex.cn: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

ex.en: He waxed lyrical about the skills and commitment of his employees.
ex.cn: 他津津乐道于员工的技能和敬业精神。

ex.en: The targets would not be achieved unless other departments showed equal commitment.
ex.cn: 除非其他部门同样努力，否则这些目标无法达成。

def: adv.对比地,相对地,比较地,有点

ex.en: The past few days have seemed comparatively flat and empty.
ex.cn: 过去这几天似乎比较平淡无聊。

ex.en: She has been comparatively successful in maintaining her privacy.
ex.cn: 在保护自己的隐私方面她一直都做得比较成功。

ex.en: The life of the troops was still comparatively austere.
ex.cn: 军队的生活还是相对清苦的。

def: adj.补偿性的,代偿

ex.en: Money should be spent on compensatory programmes for deprived pre-school and infant-school children.
ex.cn: 钱应该花在为不能享有学前班和幼儿学校教育的儿童设置的补偿教育项目上。

ex.en: The jury awarded $11.2 million in compensatory damages.
ex.cn: 陪审团裁定需要支付1，120万美元以赔偿损失。

ex.en: He also suggested that this is one of the compensatory mechanisms.
ex.cn: 他也提出,这是一种补偿的机制.

def: adv.完全地,完整地,完全，彻底，全部，一干二净,很，非常，充分，十分，万分

ex.en: "His memory must be completely back, then?" — "Just about."
ex.cn: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

ex.en: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective.
ex.cn: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。

ex.en: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered.
ex.cn: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。

def: n.复杂性，错综复杂的状态,复杂的事物,复合物

ex.en: an organization of byzantine complexity
ex.cn: 拜占庭式复杂诡秘死板的机构

ex.en: the increasing complexity of modern telecommunication systems
ex.cn: 日益复杂的现代电信系统

ex.en: a problem of mind-boggling complexity
ex.cn: 复杂得难以想象的问题

def: n.镇静，沉着,头脑镇定或沉着的状态

ex.en: For a minute he looked uncertain, and then recovered his composure.
ex.cn: 有一小会儿他看上去有些迟疑不定，之后又恢复了镇定。

ex.en: It took him a while to regain his composure.
ex.cn: 他过了一会儿才恢复镇定。

ex.en: Stopping only briefly to regain her composure, she described her agonising ordeal.
ex.cn: 她只停顿了一小会儿让自己恢复平静，然后讲述了她无比痛苦的经历。

def: adv.令人信服地

ex.en: The mission could conceivably be accomplished within a week.
ex.cn: 相信这个任务能在一个星期内完成。

ex.en: He couldn't conceivably have ( ie I don't believe he could have ) meant what he said.
ex.cn: 他的话想来不会是他的原意.

ex.en: So conceivably, this thing could be used to create a pandemic.
ex.cn: 因此可以想象, 这个仪器可以用来造成大瘟疫.

def: n.确认，认可,证实,证明,[宗]坚信礼

ex.en: Here, graphically displayed, was confirmation of the entire story.
ex.cn: 通过这里形象的展示证实了整件事的真实性。

ex.en: It was announced that the times were provisional and subject to confirmation.
ex.cn: 已宣布说这些时间是暂定的，还有待确定。

ex.en: They took her resignation from Bendix as confirmation of their suspicions.
ex.cn: 他们认为她从本迪克斯公司辞职证实了他们的怀疑。

def: n.对抗,面对,遭遇,对峙

ex.en: The King made major concessions to end the confrontation with his people.
ex.cn: 为了结束与其臣民的冲突，国王作出了很大的让步。

ex.en: He had ducked the confrontation with United Nations inspectors last summer.
ex.cn: 去年夏天他避开了与联合国核查人员的对峙。

ex.en: This could pitch the government into confrontation with the work-force.
ex.cn: 这有可能把政府推向与工人正面交锋的境地。

def: adv.不断地，时常地,时刻,常川,历来

ex.en: He is being constantly monitored with regular checks on his blood pressure.
ex.cn: 他被实时监测，定时量血压。

ex.en: We are constantly being reminded to cut down our fat intake.
ex.cn: 不断有人提醒我们要减少脂肪的摄入量。

ex.en: He developed a nervous twitch and began to blink constantly.
ex.cn: 他身体出现了神经性抽搐，开始不停地眨眼睛。

def:
adj.宪法的，符合宪法的,本质的,体质上的,保健的
n.保健运动,保健散步

ex.en: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
ex.cn: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

ex.en: It is only an Elastoplast solution to a far greater constitutional pro-blem.
ex.cn: 对于一个非常严重的宪法问题来说，这只是个暂时的解决方案。

ex.en: A constitutional amendment precludes any president from serving more than two terms.
ex.cn: 一项宪法修正案使得任何总统的任职不得超过两届。

def: n.强制,限制,约束
n.消费者，顾客,[生态]取食者，食物链中以其他生物为食物的生物

ex.en: Once wholesale prices are deregulated, consumer prices will also rise.
ex.cn: 一旦批发价格放开，零售价格也会随之上涨。

ex.en: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
ex.cn: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

ex.en: The Treasury has long been predicting an upturn in consumer spending.
ex.cn: 财政部早就预测消费者支出会出现上扬。

def: n.协调,和谐

ex.en: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
ex.cn: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

ex.en: Intoxication interferes with memory and thinking, speech and coordination.
ex.cn: 醉酒影响记忆、思考、语言与协调性。

ex.en: This exercise improves your coordination, balance, timing and footwork.
ex.cn: 这项锻炼可以提高协调能力、平衡力、把握时机的能力和脚法。

def: adv.正确地，得体地,实事求是

ex.en: When an accident happens, quite correctly questions are asked.
ex.cn: 当事故发生时，理所当然要询问一些情况。

ex.en: It is important to judge the weight of your washing load correctly.
ex.cn: 正确估计待洗衣物的重量很重要。

ex.en: My own mother was brought up very strictly and correctly.
ex.cn: 我母亲从小接受严格而规范的教育。

def: n.求爱期，追求期,求爱，求婚,[动]求偶（现象）
n.制造，创造,创造物，产物,（尤指<圣经>所述由上帝）创造天地，宇宙,（爵位等的）封授

ex.en: The manifesto gives pride of place to job creation.
ex.cn: 这项宣言将创造工作机会放在首位。

ex.en: He reiterated his opposition to the creation of a central bank.
ex.cn: 他重申了自己反对成立央行的立场。

ex.en: She finally found the perfect gown, a beautiful creation trimmed with lace.
ex.cn: 她终于找到了理想的礼服——一袭饰有蕾丝的美丽长裙。

def: n.可靠性，可信性,确实性

ex.en: There is a credibility gap developing between employers and employees.
ex.cn: 雇主和雇员之间出现了信任危机。

ex.en: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
ex.cn: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

ex.en: The president will have to work hard to restore his credibility.
ex.cn: 总统将不得不努力使公众恢复对他的信任。

def:
n.评论文章，评论,批评，批判
vt.发表评论,批判

ex.en: She had brought a book, a feminist critique of Victorian lady novelists.
ex.cn: 她带来了一本书，这本书从女性主义视角对维多利亚时代女性小说家进行了评论。

ex.en: a feminist critique of Freud's theories
ex.cn: 从女权主义的角度对弗洛伊德理论所作的批评

ex.en: a scorching critique of the government's economic policy
ex.cn: 对政府经济政策的严厉批评

def: n.教养,栽培,耕作,（关系的）培植

ex.en: Farmers with many acres under cultivation profited.
ex.cn: 耕种大片土地的农场主挣了钱。

ex.en: The cultivation in good taste is our main objective.
ex.cn: 培养高雅情趣是我们的主要目标.

ex.en: These high yields have been achieved largely through better methods of cultivation.
ex.cn: 这样高的产量主要是通过改良耕作方法取得的.

def: adj.文化的,教养的，修习的,耕作的，开垦的，栽培[培养]的

ex.en: In New Zealand, the Maori people maintain a strong cultural tradition.
ex.cn: 在新西兰，毛利人保持着深厚的文化传统。

ex.en: Traditionalists may howl, but in today's world, cultural relativism rules.
ex.cn: 传统卫道士们也许会叫嚣反对，但在当今世界，文化相对论确实是占据着统治地位。

ex.en: A rich and varied cultural life is essential for this couple.
ex.cn: 丰富多样的文化生活对这对夫妇而言至关重要。

def: adv.当前，目前,通常，一般，现在,容易，流畅,普遍地

ex.en: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
ex.cn: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

ex.en: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
ex.cn: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

ex.en: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
ex.cn: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。

def:
vt.抑制,使潮湿,使…沮丧,隔音，防音
vi.变得潮湿,丧气

ex.en: His equivocal response has done nothing to dampen the speculation.
ex.cn: 他模棱两可的回应丝毫没有消除人们的猜疑。

ex.en: Nothing seems to dampen his perpetual enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 似乎没有什么能让他那持久的热情消退。

ex.en: Don't dampen the enthusiasm of the masses.
ex.cn: 不要损伤大家的积极性.

def: adv.灿烂地，耀眼地

ex.en: The view was dazzlingly beautiful.
ex.cn: 景色美轮美奂。

ex.en: The loading bay seemed dazzlingly bright.
ex.cn: 装货区看上去灯火通明。

ex.en: They were dazzlingly white with long necks . They were swans.
ex.cn: 他们有长长的脖子,全身是令人眩目的白色.

def: n.瞒骗，欺诈,骗局

ex.en: Human beings have an infinite capacity for self-deception.
ex.cn: 人类自欺的本事是无穷的。

ex.en: Haskell did not live to discover the deception.
ex.cn: 哈斯克尔至死都没识破那个骗局。

ex.en: He was abetted in the deception by his wife.
ex.cn: 他行骗是受了妻子的怂恿。

def: n.装饰，装潢,装饰品,装饰图案，装饰风格,奖章

ex.en: Interior decoration by careful coordination seems to have had its day.
ex.cn: 精心搭配的室内装饰似乎已不再受欢迎了。

ex.en: The most arresting feature is the painted wall decoration.
ex.cn: 最醒目的特点是绘有图画的墙面装饰。

ex.en: His genius was not confined to the decoration of buildings.
ex.cn: 他的天赋不单体现在建筑物的装饰上。

def: adj.能防御的，能辩护的

ex.en: Her reasons for acting are morally defensible.
ex.cn: 她的举动从道义上来讲是合情合理的。

ex.en: Is abortion morally defensible?
ex.cn: 堕胎从道德上讲合乎情理吗？

ex.en: Economic activities were seen as the only defensible form of American involvement abroad.
ex.cn: 经济活动被认为是美国插手海外的唯一可以辩护的形式.

def: adv.故意地,深思熟虑地,从容不迫地

ex.en: It looks as if the blaze was started deliberately.
ex.cn: 看起来似乎是有人蓄意纵火。

ex.en: With almost evangelical fervour, Marks warns against deliberately seeking a tan.
ex.cn: 几乎是凭着一股疯狂的热情，马克斯警告人们不要刻意追求晒成一身古铜色。

ex.en: The police deliberately kept a low profile in most places.
ex.cn: 警方在大多数地方有意保持低调。

def: adj.人口统计学的,人口统计的

ex.en: Most of our listeners are in the 25-39 demographic.
ex.cn: 我们的大多数听众都属于25至39岁这个年龄段。

ex.en: The situation is analogous to Stage I of the demographic transition theory.
ex.cn: 这相当于人口过渡论的第一阶段.

ex.en: These demographic changes help to create a virtuous circle of growth.
ex.cn: 人口结构的变化有助于创造一个良性的增长循环.

def: n.道德败坏，纪律松弛，士气消沉

ex.en: Top military leaders say there have been reports of demoralization in the ranks.
ex.cn: 最高军事指挥说有报告称士兵中出现了士气低落。

ex.en: Now, the sight of so many buildings and people completed Prissy's demoralization.
ex.cn: 此刻, 这么多的建筑物和人进一步把她迷惑住了.

ex.en: Either the Soviets sensed an imminent victory or they feared the approaching demoralization of their clients.
ex.cn: 要么是苏联人感到胜利已经呼之欲出,要么是他们担心他们的被保护人的士气行将崩溃.

def: n.属国，属地,从属，从属物

ex.en: In 1985, he began to show signs of alcohol and drug dependency.
ex.cn: 在1985年，他开始表现出酗酒嗜毒的迹象。

ex.en: Ukraine is handicapped by its near-total dependency on Russian oil.
ex.cn: 乌克兰受制于对俄罗斯石油近乎完全的依赖。

ex.en: We worried about his dependency on his mother.
ex.cn: 我们担心他可能对母亲太过依赖。

def:
n.设计师,设计者,构思者
adj.由专门设计师设计的,标有设计师名字的,时尚的,时髦的

ex.en: People want to buy designer labels for snob value.
ex.cn: 人们想买名牌是为了满足虚荣心。

ex.en: She asked her son, a graphic designer, to create letterheads and stationery.
ex.cn: 她请做平面设计师的儿子设计了信头和信笺。

ex.en: She began a torrid love affair with a theatrical designer.
ex.cn: 她和一位舞台设计师开始了一场狂热的恋情。

def: n.开发者,<摄>显影剂，显像剂

ex.en: John Bardeen was also co-developer of the theory of superconductivity.
ex.cn: 约翰·巴丁也是超导电性理论的创立者之一。

ex.en: He was a very late developer.
ex.cn: 他发育相当晚。

ex.en: Tom is a real estate developer.
ex.cn: 汤姆是位房地产开发商.

def:
adj.失望的,沮丧的，失意的
v.使（人）失望( disappoint的过去式和过去分词),使破灭，使落空

ex.en: When things go wrong, all of us naturally feel disappointed and frustrated.
ex.cn: 出问题时，我们大家自然都感到失望和沮丧。

ex.en: She will be disappointed if her feelings are not returned.
ex.cn: 如果她的感情得不到回报，她会感到非常失望。

ex.en: I was disappointed whenever the cook found fault with my work.
ex.cn: 每当厨师挑剔我干的活儿时，我都非常沮丧。

def: n.不赞同，反对,非难

ex.en: Excessive conformity is usually caused by fear of disapproval.
ex.cn: 过于墨守成规通常都是由于担心得不到认可。

ex.en: He clucks in disapproval.
ex.cn: 他不满地咂咂嘴。

ex.en: Persistent disapproval or criticism can be highly demoralizing.
ex.cn: 一再的否定和批评可能会对信心造成严重打击。

def: n.不相信，怀疑

ex.en: We were amazed, shocked, dumbfounded, shaking our heads in disbelief.
ex.cn: 我们震惊、愕然、目瞪口呆，难以置信地摇着头。

ex.en: Tamara stared at him in disbelief, shaking her head.
ex.cn: 塔玛拉一边狐疑地盯着他看，一边摇着头。

ex.en: She looked at him in disbelief.
ex.cn: 她全然不信地看着他。

def: adj.可识别的,可辨别的

ex.en: There has been no discernible overall trend since 1975.
ex.cn: 自1975年以来一直没有一个明朗的大趋势。

ex.en: Night fell, but the outline of the factory buildings was still discernible.
ex.cn: 夜幕降临了, 但厂房还能看见个轮廓.

ex.en: The difference between the two is readily discernible.
ex.cn: 两者之间的差别不难看出.

def: adj.压抑不住的

ex.en: Jon's exuberance was irrepressible.
ex.cn: 乔恩朝气蓬勃，精力旺盛。

ex.en: An amusement park is the perfect locale for a bunch of irrepressible youngsters to have all sorts of adventures.
ex.cn: 游乐场是一帮精力过剩的年轻人寻求各种惊险刺激的绝佳场所。

ex.en: You cannot keep her quiet for long ; she's irrepressible!
ex.cn: 想让她多安静会儿可办不到, 她总是欢蹦乱跳的!

def: adj.纪律的,训练的,惩罚的
n.发现者

ex.en: The discoverer claimed the island for the nation.
ex.cn: 那个发现者宣布该岛属于他的国家.

ex.en: Tasmania was named after its discoverer, A . J . Tasman.
ex.cn: 塔斯曼尼亚岛是以其发现者塔斯曼的名字命名的.

ex.en: Tasmania was named after his discoverer, A . J . Tasman.
ex.cn: 塔斯曼尼亚岛是以它的发现者塔斯曼为名的.

def:
n.（票据的）拒付,侮辱,丢脸,丢脸的事（或人）
vt.拒付,侮辱,奸污,使丢脸

ex.en: She refuses to see her beloved boy die in such dishonor.
ex.cn: 她不愿看到她深爱的男友就这样不名誉地死去。

ex.en: What he had done brought dishonor to the family.
ex.cn: 他的所作所为败坏了他家的声誉.

ex.en: His desertion to the enemy was a dishonor to his family.
ex.cn: 他的投敌行为对他的家庭是耻辱.

def:
adj.一次性的，可任意处理的,用后就抛弃的,免洗的,可供使用的
n.〈美口〉使用后随即抛掉的东西（尤指容器等）

ex.en: The nation's disposable earnings in 1987 amounted to £86 billion.
ex.cn: 1987年国民可自由支配收入达到了860亿英镑。

ex.en: Gerald had little disposable income.
ex.cn: 杰拉尔德的可支配收入很少。

ex.en: Disposable nappies are fairly straightforward to put on.
ex.cn: 一次性尿布很容易穿上。

def: n.不满，不平,令人不满的事物

ex.en: She has already expressed her dissatisfaction with this aspect of the policy.
ex.cn: 她对政策的这一方面已经表达了不满。

ex.en: A recent open meeting of College members revealed widespread dissatisfaction.
ex.cn: 最近的一次学会成员公开会上，大家普遍流露出不满情绪。

ex.en: Voters wish to register their dissatisfaction with the ruling party.
ex.cn: 选民希望表达他们对执政党的不满。

def: adv.明显地,无疑地,确实地,逼真

ex.en: I distinctly remember wishing I had not got involved.
ex.cn: 我清楚地记得希望自己没有被牵扯进去。

ex.en: However, many customers found the smell of this product distinctly off-putting.
ex.cn: 然而，很多顾客觉得该产品有一股异味，非常难闻。

ex.en: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
ex.cn: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

def: n.分配，分布,[法]（无遗嘱死亡者的）财产分配,[无线]频率分布,[电]配电

ex.en: The civil war is obstructing distribution of famine relief by aid agencies.
ex.cn: 内战阻碍着救援机构对饥荒赈济物资的配给。

ex.en: The distribution of passports has been a slow process.
ex.cn: 颁发护照的过程非常缓慢。

ex.en: The cocaine was ready for distribution.
ex.cn: 那些可卡因已经准备好进行分销了。

def: n.多样化，（人在种族、民族、宗教等方面的）多样性,差异,分歧
adj.博士的

ex.en: His doctoral dissertation on differential equations connected itself with existence theorems.
ex.cn: 他论述微分方程的博士论文涉及到存在理论.

ex.en: He wrote his doctoral thesis on electromagnetism.
ex.cn: 他写有关电磁的博士论文.

ex.en: He was involved in writing his doctoral dissertation.
ex.cn: 他在聚精会神地写他的博士论文.

def: n.优势,支配,统治,优性

ex.en: These economies will no doubt maintain their dominance of financial markets.
ex.cn: 这些经济制度将毫无疑问地维持他们在金融市场上的主导权。

ex.en: He asserted his dominance over the other party members.
ex.cn: 他坚持对其他党员的支配.

ex.en: Ex - colonial countries began to challenge the cultural dominance of Europe.
ex.cn: 摆脫了殖民统治的国家开始挑战欧洲的文化统治.

def: adj.难以预测的,难以预料的，未定局的,怀疑的，拿不准的,不明不白

ex.en: For a time it seemed doubtful that he would move at all.
ex.cn: 有一段时间他似乎根本不会搬家。

ex.en: Forsyth is doubtful for tonight's game with a badly bruised leg.
ex.cn: 福赛斯腿部严重擦伤，不大可能参加今晚的比赛。

ex.en: Whether the authorities will allow inspection is highly doubtful.
ex.cn: 当局是否允许检查还是个大问号。

def:
adv.无疑地,确定地,多半
adj.无疑的,确定的

ex.en: Doubtless he was justified in some of his criticism of the media.
ex.cn: 他对媒体的一些批评性言论无疑是合乎情理的。

ex.en: Viruses and logic bombs can doubtless do great damage under some circumstances.
ex.cn: 病毒和逻辑炸弹在某些情况下无疑会造成巨大危害。

ex.en: His direct, often abrasive approach will doubtless ruffle a few feathers.
ex.cn: 他那直截了当、往往还粗鲁生硬的办事方式无疑会激怒一些人。

def: n.复制, 重复,复本 ,成倍

ex.en: Try to avoid wasteful duplication of effort.
ex.cn: 尽量避免无用的重复劳动。

ex.en: Duties have been reassigned to avoid wasteful duplication of work.
ex.cn: 为避免重复劳动浪费资源,任务已经重新分派.

ex.en: We will attempt to avoid duplication by appropriate cross references.
ex.cn: 将用适当的前后对照的方法来避免重复.

def: adv.有效地,实际上，事实上

ex.en: This effectively means that the government does not agree with the proposals.
ex.cn: 这实际上就意味着政府不赞同这些提议。

ex.en: She had effectively shut him out by refusing to listen.
ex.cn: 她拒不听他说话，并以此有效地将他排除在外。

ex.en: The management tries to produce the magazine as cost-effectively as possible.
ex.cn: 管理层试图尽可能地让杂志盈利。

def: n.有效，有力,有效性,效益,效用

ex.en: Our research attempts to evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
ex.cn: 我们的研究试图对不同药物的疗效进行评估。

ex.en: The drugs work well at first but gradually lose their effectiveness.
ex.cn: 这些药的效果起初非常好,但后来逐渐失效.

ex.en: To assert this is to denigrate the effectiveness of the police.
ex.cn: 坚持这一点就是贬低警方的办事能力.

def: adj.表现强烈情感的,令人动情的,易动感情的,感情脆弱的

ex.en: "Tired and emotional" is a code word for being drunk.
ex.cn: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

ex.en: How much emotional baggage is he bringing with him into the relationship?
ex.cn: 他背负着多重的感情包袱开始这段恋情？

ex.en: The emotional wounds of early childhood leave ineradicable scars.
ex.cn: 童年早期的情感创伤留下了难以抚平的伤痕。

def: vt.制定法律,规定,颁布，颁布,担任…角色

ex.en: The king could not enact laws without the sanction of Parliament.
ex.cn: 未经议会批准，国王不能制定法律。

ex.en: Members of the English Civil War Society will re-enact the battle.
ex.cn: 英格兰内战协会的成员将再次展现那场战争。

ex.en: They're trying to enact a " nationality " bill.
ex.cn: 他们正试图通过一项 “ 国籍 ” 法案.

def: n.强制，实施，执行

ex.en: We need to restore respect for the law-enforcement agencies.
ex.cn: 我们需要重塑执法机构的声望。

ex.en: MPs called for tougher enforcement of the existing laws on drugs.
ex.cn: 下院议员呼籲加强现行毒品法律的执行力度.

ex.en: The court is ineffective because it lacks the necessary enforcement machinery.
ex.cn: 法院效率低是因为缺乏必要的执行机制.

def: vt.激怒，使暴怒

ex.en: Those in his employ were careful never to enrage him.
ex.cn: 在他手底下干活的人都非常小心绝不去触怒他。

ex.en: As for the subjects that so enrage puritans, they will continue to form the focus of her work.
ex.cn: 那些使道学先生们勃然大怒的课题将继续成为她工作的重点。

ex.en: What I fancy I said to Melbury must have been enough to enrage any man.
ex.cn: 我相信我当时对麦尔布礼说的那些话足以激怒任何人.

def: adv.热心地，满腔热情地,起劲

ex.en: She worked indefatigably and enthusiastically to interest the young in music.
ex.cn: 为了激发年轻人对音乐的兴趣，她一直孜孜不倦、积极热情地工作。

ex.en: The announcement was greeted enthusiastically.
ex.cn: 公告受到人们的热烈欢迎。

ex.en: He studied conscientiously and enthusiastically.
ex.cn: 他一丝不苟、满怀热情地学习。

def: adj.（个人）环境的，由个人环境产生的，周围的,环境艺术的

ex.en: This commission would keep environmental scorecards on UN member nations.
ex.cn: 该委员会将对联合国的成员国采用环境记录卡制。

ex.en: He has attempted to align the Socialists with the environmental movement.
ex.cn: 他已试图争取社会党人支持环境运动。

ex.en: What right has one country to dictate the environmental standards of another?
ex.cn: 一个国家有什么权力强行给另一个国家制定环境标准？

def: adv.相等地,平等地,公正地,平均

ex.en: She is equally at home on the singles or doubles court.
ex.cn: 她单打和双打都能得心应手。

ex.en: Ministers can equally credibly claim that the opposition is to blame.
ex.cn: 部长们也能同样令人信服地宣称，反对派应该受到指责。

ex.en: They needed his help, but equally they did not trust him.
ex.cn: 他们需要他的帮助，但是同样地，他们并不信任他。

def:
vt.摧毁,完全根除
n.根除者,褪色灵

adj.伦理学的,道德的，伦理的,凭处方出售的
n.凭医师处方出售的药品

ex.en: The prime minister has a blind spot on ethical issues.
ex.cn: 这位首相无视道德问题。

ex.en: My involvement has not been altogether, shall we say, ethical.
ex.cn: 可以说，我的参与还不是完全合乎道德。

ex.en: The consultancy offers advice on ethical tax-shelters.
ex.cn: 这家咨询公司教人如何合理避税。

def: adj.进化的

ex.en: In choosing a partner we are subconsciously assessing their evolutionary fitness to be a mother of children or father provider and protector.
ex.cn: 在选择伴侣的时候,我们会在潜意识里衡量对方将来是否会是称职的母亲或者父亲,是否会是合格的一家之主.

ex.en: Their evolutionary rate does seem to have slowed down.
ex.cn: 它们的进化速度看来确实是慢下来了.

ex.en: Life has its own evolutionary process.
ex.cn: 生命有其自身的进化过程。

def: adv.过度地,过分地,极度地

ex.en: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

ex.en: His private demons drove him to drink excessively for many years.
ex.cn: 他个人的心魔让他多年以来酗酒度日。

ex.en: Hardy has often been criticised for an excessively pessimistic view of life.
ex.cn: 哈代由于对生活持过度悲观的态度而常常受到批评。

def: adv.唯一地,专门地，特定地,专有地,排外地

ex.en: Randolph's work was exclusively concerned with the effects of pollution on health.
ex.cn: 伦道夫的著作专门论述污染对健康的影响。

ex.en: Today he was able to focus his message exclusively on the economy.
ex.cn: 今天他得以将主题全部集中在经济方面。

ex.en: Mr Marr makes extensive use of exclusively Scottish words.
ex.cn: 马尔先生使用了大量苏格兰特有的词汇。

def: adj.解释的,说明的,解释性

ex.en: I hope the graphs on the following pages are self-explanatory.
ex.cn: 我希望后面几页的图表能一目了然。

ex.en: These statements are accompanied by a series of explanatory notes.
ex.cn: 这些陈述后面有一系列解释性注释。

ex.en: There are explanatory notes at the back of the book.
ex.cn: 书后有注解。

def: adv.明白地，明确地

ex.en: Their intention is not to become involved in explicitly political activities.
ex.cn: 他们无意参与到明显具有政治性的活动中。

ex.en: She has been talking very explicitly about AIDS to these groups.
ex.cn: 她一直都在非常坦诚地和这些群体谈论艾滋病问题。

ex.en: The play was the first commercially successful work dealing explicitly with homosexuality.
ex.cn: 该剧是第一部获得商业成功的公然以同性恋为主题的作品。

def: n.开发,利用,剥削,广告推销

ex.en: Mr Mendes was leading a campaign to save Brazil's rainforest from exploitation.
ex.cn: 门德斯先生正领导一场运动，以拯救遭到乱砍滥伐的巴西热带雨林。

ex.en: Almost without exception these women fall victim to exploitation.
ex.cn: 这些女性几乎无一例外都受到了盘剥。

ex.en: I think their crime is a blacker one than mere exploitation.
ex.cn: 我想他们的罪行比单纯的剥削更残忍。

def: n.探测，勘探，探险,搜索，研究,[医]探查术

ex.en: We set out on this voyage of exploration with an open mind.
ex.cn: 我们以开放的心态开始了这次探索之旅。

ex.en: His exploration of the myth brings insight into the American psyche.
ex.cn: 他对这个神话的探讨揭示了美国人的心理。

ex.en: Oryx is a Dallas-based oil and gas exploration and production concern.
ex.cn: 奥瑞克斯是一家设在达拉斯的石油和天然气勘探生产公司。

def: n.探险家,勘探者,探测器,[医]探针

ex.en: The explorer was ever awake for the dangers that surrounded him.
ex.cn: 这个探险家时刻提防着周围的危险.

ex.en: His father is an Arctic explorer.
ex.cn: 他父亲是一位北极探险者.

ex.en: The explorer was killed by barbaric people.
ex.cn: 那位探险家被野蛮人杀死了.

def: adv.赞成地,称赞地(favorably),有利地,顺利地

ex.en: Our road safety record compares favourably with that of other European countries.
ex.cn: 我们的道路安全纪录比欧洲其他国家要好。

ex.en: He was quite favourably impressed with the new French commander.
ex.cn: 他对新的法国指挥官印象很好。

ex.en: We would view favourably any sensible suggestion for maintaining the business.
ex.cn: 我们欢迎为维持业务稳定而提出的所有合理建议。

def: adj.可怕的，吓人的,害怕的，胆小的

ex.en: He had developed a fearsome reputation for intimidating people.
ex.cn: 他曾因恐吓他人而令人闻风丧胆。

ex.en: I drove for a while across this fearsome emptiness.
ex.cn: 我开车开了好一阵穿过这片可怕的空旷之地。

ex.en: Its fearsome appearance struck terror into their hearts.
ex.cn: 它那可怕的样子使他们胆战心惊.

def: adj.发烧的，有热病症状的,高度活跃或兴奋的,容易引起热病的,热病蔓延的

ex.en: He will be attending next week's American Grammy Awards in feverish anticipation.
ex.cn: 他将带着紧张兴奋的期待出席下周的美国格莱美奖颁奖。

ex.en: A feverish child refuses to eat and asks only for cold drinks.
ex.cn: 发烧的孩子不愿吃东西，只会要冷饮。

ex.en: On the chilly seas, Keats became feverish, continually coughing up blood.
ex.cn: 在寒冷彻骨的海上，基茨开始发烧，不断地咯血。

def: n.健康,适当，适合,合情理

ex.en: The emphasis is on developing fitness through exercises and training.
ex.cn: 重点在于通过锻炼促进健康。

ex.en: He has a new fitness regime to strengthen his back.
ex.cn: 他有一个增强背部力量的新健身计划。

ex.en: There is a debate about his fitness for the highest office.
ex.cn: 针对他是否能胜任最高职务展开了争论。

def:
n.试穿，试衣,设备，器材,装置,装修
adj.适合的，适宜的,适当的,相称的
v.使适合（fit的现在分词）,使合身,与…相符,安装

ex.en: By his international achievements he leaves a fitting monument to his beliefs.
ex.cn: 他在国际上的成就为其信念作出了最好的注解。

ex.en: A properly fitting bra should never leave red marks.
ex.cn: 合适的胸罩不会留下红色勒痕。

ex.en: Does responsibility end at the fitting of car seats?
ex.cn: 只负责安装好汽车座椅吗？

def: n.柔韧性，机动性，灵活性,伸缩性,可塑度,柔度

ex.en: Women have lost out in this new pay flexibility.
ex.cn: 在这一新的薪资弹性化政策中吃亏的是女性。

ex.en: The flexibility of distance learning would be particularly suited to busy managers.
ex.cn: 远程学习的灵活性对于日理万机的经理人来说特别适合。

ex.en: There has got to be a degree of flexibility.
ex.cn: 得有一点灵活性才行。

def: adv.频繁地，屡次地,往往,动,动辄

ex.en: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
ex.cn: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

ex.en: Many of these killers are frequently glib and superficially charming.
ex.cn: 这些杀手中，多数都是能说会道、外表迷人。

ex.en: Dry hair can be damaged by washing it too frequently.
ex.cn: 干性头发洗得太频繁容易受损。

def: n.完成,实现,满足（感）,实施过程

ex.en: He was willing to face any hardship in fulfillment of his duty.
ex.cn: 他愿意面对任何困难去履行他的职责.

ex.en: After many years, his plans have come to fulfillment.
ex.cn: 很多年之后, 他的计划实现了.

ex.en: People find fulfillment in working for a common goal.
ex.cn: 人们在为一个共同目标而努力的过程中得到满足.

def: adv.基础地,根本地,从根本上

ex.en: Fundamentally, women like him for his sensitivity and charming vulnerability.
ex.cn: 基本说来，女人喜欢他是因为他细腻的情感和迷人的文弱气质。

ex.en: I don't think it has fundamentally altered the sport.
ex.cn: 我认为它并没有从根本上改变这项运动。

ex.en: Language is something which fundamentally distinguishes humans from animals.
ex.cn: 语言是将人类与动物区分开来的基本特征。

def: n.画廊，走廊,（教堂，议院等的）边座,旁听席,大批观众

ex.en: Laura landed a plum job with a smart art gallery.
ex.cn: 劳拉在一家时尚画廊找到了份美差。

ex.en: Today his picture goes on show at the National Portrait Gallery.
ex.cn: 今天他的画作在国家肖像美术馆展出。

ex.en: He started working for a gallery sweeping up and making the tea.
ex.cn: 他开始在画廊做扫地沏茶的工作。

def:
adj.口的,张口的,敞口的,多洞穴的
v.目瞪口呆地凝视( gape的现在分词 ),张开，张大

ex.en: The aircraft took off with a gaping hole in its fuselage.
ex.cn: 飞机起飞了，机身上有一个裂开的口子。

ex.en: She was gaping at it, lost for words.
ex.cn: 她目瞪口呆地看着这场面，一时语塞。

ex.en: Ahead of them was a gaping abyss.
ex.cn: 他们面前是一个巨大的深渊。

def: n.园丁，园艺家,花匠,菜农,园艺爱好者

ex.en: He is a hard worker and a skilled gardener.
ex.cn: 他工作很努力，对园艺很在行。

ex.en: The gardener exploded with the rage that had simmered all morning.
ex.cn: 花匠憋了一个早上的愤怒终于爆发了。

ex.en: He reckons she's having it off with the gardener.
ex.cn: 他认为她和园丁有一腿。

def: adj.能生产的，有生产力的,生殖的

ex.en: This research has enriched the generative theory of multimedia learning.
ex.cn: 本研究丰富了多媒体学习的生成理论.

ex.en: It must be alloyed with more creative, generative processes to accomplish much.
ex.cn: 要想大有作为,就必须融入更富创造力和生产力的过程.

ex.en: Generative Semantics was developed as a reaction to Chomsky's syntactic - based TG Grammar.
ex.cn: 生成语义学的形成是对乔姆斯基以句法为基础的转换生成语法的反驳.

def: adj.富有魅力的,迷人的,富于刺激的,独特的

ex.en: Sontag has always been that rarity, a glamorous intellectual.
ex.cn: 桑塔格一直是那种兼具美貌与智慧的人中龙凤。

ex.en: Smoking is still attractive to many young people who see it as glamorous.
ex.cn: 吸烟对很多年轻人还是很有诱惑力，他们觉得这让自己显得魅力十足。

ex.en: I thought it would be glamorous but I just turned out to be a general dogsbody.
ex.cn: 我以为那会是个美差，结果我成了一个打杂的。

def: n.黑暗，沮丧

ex.en: He would laugh her out of her gloominess.
ex.cn: 他会用笑声使她摆脱忧郁的情绪.

ex.en: Gloominess is the patent of beautiful girls.
ex.cn: 周奔驰:忧郁是漂亮女孩的专利.

ex.en: Ur heavy breathing in the gloominess is familiar with the early morning lane's fog.
ex.cn: 黑暗中你沉重的呼吸是清晨弄堂里熟悉的雾.

def: adv.热情洋溢地,白热地，热心地

ex.en: Wallis spoke glowingly about players like Chapman.
ex.cn: 沃利斯对查普曼这样的选手大加赞赏。

ex.en: Archer looked at her glowingly.
ex.cn: 阿切尔用灼热的目光看着她.

ex.en: In her letter she praised him glowingly.
ex.cn: 她在信中热情地赞扬了他.

def: n.满足,满意,喜悦,使人满意之事

ex.en: "Gratification" and "gratitude" have the same etymological root.
ex.cn: gratification和gratitude的词源相同。

ex.en: A feed will usually provide instant gratification to a crying baby.
ex.cn: 喂食通常可使正在哭闹的婴儿立即得到满足。

ex.en: His son's success was a great gratification to him.
ex.cn: 他儿子的成功是令他深感快慰的事.

def:
n.港口，安全地方,避难所，安息所
vt.把（船）开进港,为…提供避难场所,掩护

ex.en: I hope I haven't said anything to upset you.
ex.cn: 但愿我没有说过让你不高兴的话。

ex.en: I haven't come all this way to bottle out.
ex.cn: 我一路走来不是为了在最后关头打退堂鼓。

ex.en: With respect, Minister, you still haven't answered my question.
ex.cn: 部长，恕我冒昧，您还没有回答我的问题。

def:
n.烟雾,迷蒙,迷糊,疑惑
vt.& vi.（使）笼罩在薄雾中,使变朦胧,使变糊涂
vt.戏弄,欺凌,骑马放牧

ex.en: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
ex.cn: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

ex.en: A thick haze of acrid smoke hung in the air.
ex.cn: 空气中弥漫着刺鼻的浓烟。

ex.en: Dan smiled at him through a haze of smoke and steaming coffee.
ex.cn: 丹透过烟雾和咖啡的热气朝他笑了笑。

def: n.猎头,物色人才的人,（原始部落中）割取敌人首级作为战利品的人,<俚>清除政敌者

ex.en: Nowadays a good headhunter is as important as good staff.
ex.cn: 在今天的社会,好的物色人才的人和好的员工一样重要.

ex.en: Nowadays a good headhunter is as important as good staffs.
ex.cn: 在今天的社会,好的猎头和好的员工一样重要.

ex.en: But one day a headhunter approached him with a very interesting proposition.
ex.cn: 但是有一天一位人力资源顾问提供他一个不错的工作机会.

def: adj.全盘的，整体的,功能整体性的

ex.en: a holistic approach to life
ex.cn: 对生命的全面探讨

ex.en: So, as I said to you, natural medicine is also known as holistic medicine.
ex.cn: 那么，正如我对你说过的那样，自然医学也被称为整体医学。

ex.en: There is a fundamental ambiguity in the use of word'whole'in recent holistic literature.
ex.cn: 在近代的整体主义著作中, “ 整体 ” 这个词的用法极其含混.

def: vt.使震惊，使感到恐怖

ex.en: Such things did not appear to horrify her.
ex.cn: 这样的事情她却不震惊.

ex.en: Such sentiments might horrify some corporate executives.
ex.cn: 这种热情可能会让一些公司高管大为惊骇.

ex.en: The monster cities of the future horrify planners struggling to cope with today's metropolises.
ex.cn: 未来的巨城使得正在努力应付目前大城市困难的设计人员感到恐惧.

def: n.理想主义,理想化,唯心主义

ex.en: She never lost her respect for the idealism of the 1960s.
ex.cn: 她对20世纪60年代的理想主义一直心怀崇敬。

ex.en: He was full of youthful idealism.
ex.cn: 他满脑子都是年轻人的理想主义。

ex.en: They're channelling the natural resources of youthful idealism into political action.
ex.cn: 他们正在把青年固有的那种充满理想的热情引导到政治活动中去.

def: n.理想主义,空想家,<哲>观念论者,唯心论者

ex.en: He is not such an idealist that he cannot see the problems.
ex.cn: 他并非看不见问题的理想主义者。

ex.en: He is a political pragmatist, not an idealist.
ex.cn: 他是政治上的实用主义者，而不是理想主义者。

ex.en: This is a heated debate which involves materialist as opposed to idealist views.
ex.cn: 这是一场唯物主义与唯心主义的大论战.

def:
vt.使理想化,使合于理想
vi.理想化,形成理想

ex.en: People idealize the past.
ex.cn: 人们爱把过去理想化。

ex.en: It is tempting to idealize the past.
ex.cn: 人都爱把过去的日子说得那么美好。

ex.en: I don't want to idealize life in small places.
ex.cn: 我不想理想化在小地方的生活.

def: adj.思想的,意识形态的

ex.en: The ideological divisions between the parties aren't always obvious.
ex.cn: 政党之间的意识形态界线并不总是泾渭分明的。

ex.en: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
ex.cn: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

ex.en: The party is likely to divide along ideological lines.
ex.cn: 该党有可能在意识形态上产生分歧。

def: adv.不法地

ex.en: I couldn'tfly illegally into a country in the dead of night.
ex.cn: 我不能在深夜乘飞机非法进入一个国家。

ex.en: They were yesterday convicted of illegally using a handgun.
ex.cn: 他们昨天被判犯有非法使用手枪罪。

ex.en: Some of the companies illegally sent the wherewithal for making chemical weapons.
ex.cn: 有些公司非法为制造化学武器提供所需的资金和设备等。

def: n.移居,移民人数,移民局检查站

ex.en: He spent 25 years campaigning against racist and unjust immigration laws.
ex.cn: 他用了25年的时间与带有种族歧视色彩和没有公正可言的移民法作斗争。

ex.en: The passengers went through immigration control and collected their baggage.
ex.cn: 旅客通过入境检查后领取了自己的行李。

ex.en: The literature on immigration policy is almost unrelievedly critical of the state.
ex.cn: 关于移民政策方面的著述几乎总是会一成不变地批评政府。

def: adj.不偏不倚的,公平的，公正的,无私的,持平

ex.en: As an impartial observer my analysis is supposed to be objective.
ex.cn: 作为中立的观察员，我的分析应该客观。

ex.en: He gave an impartial view of the state of affairs in Ireland.
ex.cn: 他对爱尔兰的事态发表了公正的看法.

ex.en: I shall be impartial, though I can not be neuter.
ex.cn: 虽然我不能保持中立, 我也不偏袒任何一方.

def: adj.冲动的,任性的,受感情驱使的,[物]瞬动的，冲击的

ex.en: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress.
ex.cn: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

ex.en: He is too impulsive to be a responsible prime minister.
ex.cn: 他容易冲动，很难成为值得依赖的首相。

ex.en: She was unpredictable, explosive, impulsive and easily distracted.
ex.cn: 她难以捉摸，脾气暴躁，冲动鲁莽，容易分心。

def: n.无能，无力,无才能,无能为力

ex.en: He was frustrated by his inability to wave down a taxi.
ex.cn: 连一辆出租车都打不到，他很沮丧。

ex.en: Her inability to concentrate could cause an accident.
ex.cn: 她无法集中精力可能会导致事故。

ex.en: a congenital inability to tell the truth
ex.cn: 生就的不会说实话

def: adj.不善辞令的,笨口拙舌,嘴笨

ex.en: Inarticulate and rather shy, he had always dreaded speaking in public.
ex.cn: 他不善言辞又相当害羞，一直害怕在公共场合讲话。

ex.en: His parents were dull and inarticulate.
ex.cn: 他的父母亲头脑愚钝又不善说话.

ex.en: Kempton made an inarticulate noise at the back of his throat as if he were about to choke.
ex.cn: 肯普顿嗓子眼里发出含混的声音，仿佛他要窒息了。

def: adj.错误的,不正确的,不能接受的,（说话或举止）不合规矩的

ex.en: Receding gums can be the result of disease or simply incorrect brushing.
ex.cn: 牙龈萎缩可能是疾病导致的，也可能仅仅是错误的刷牙方式引起的。

ex.en: Such a view rests on a number of incorrect assumptions.
ex.cn: 这样的观点建立在很多不正确的假设之上。

ex.en: We apologise unreservedly for any imputation of incorrect behaviour by Mr Taylor.
ex.cn: 我们为泰勒先生有关不当行为的非难表示诚挚道歉。

def: n.诉状，起诉书,<尤美>刑事起诉书,控告，起诉

ex.en: The government's indictment against the three men alleged unlawful trading.
ex.cn: 政府在对这三个人的起诉书中指控他们从事非法贸易。

ex.en: Prosecutors may soon seek an indictment on racketeering and fraud charges.
ex.cn: 检举官可能不久就会以敲诈勒索与欺诈罪名提起诉讼。

ex.en: The poverty in our cities is a damning indictment of modern society.
ex.cn: 我们的城市中贫民的苦况是现代社会的一大败象。

def: n.不重视，不在乎，漠不关心,中立，中性,冷淡,无差

ex.en: "Giles phoned this morning," Mirella said with feigned indifference.
ex.cn: “贾尔斯今早来电话了，”米雷拉装作若无其事地说。

ex.en: He displayed a sublime indifference to the distinction between right and wrong.
ex.cn: 他对是非之间的差别根本就无动于衷。

ex.en: He laughed it off with aristocratic indifference.
ex.cn: 他带着贵族式的漠然对其一笑置之。

def: n.沉溺,迁就，宽容,嗜好,溺爱，放纵

ex.en: The king's indulgence towards his sons angered the business community.
ex.cn: 国王对儿子们的纵容令商界恼火。

ex.en: He prayed to be saved from self-indulgence.
ex.cn: 他祈祷自己能从自我放纵中摆脱出来。

ex.en: to lead a life of indulgence
ex.cn: 过着放纵的生活

def: adv.逃不掉地

ex.en: It is inescapably clear that they won't turn round.
ex.cn: 显而易见，他们不会改变主意。

ex.en: A community - type, as a class - concept, is inescapably an abstraction.
ex.cn: 群落类型, 作为一个阶级概念, 无疑也是一种抽象.

ex.en: Early Christians thought marriage was inescapably tainted by the presence of sex.
ex.cn: 早期基督教徒认为,婚姻受到性爱的污染.

def: n.婴儿期，，幼年时代,初期，摇篮时代,[法]未成年

ex.en: Computing science was still in its infancy.
ex.cn: 计算科学仍然处于初期阶段。

ex.en: to die in infancy
ex.cn: 婴儿夭折

ex.en: He came to England in his infancy.
ex.cn: 他幼年时期来到英国.

def: n.劣势,下等,次级,自卑情绪

ex.en: Many mothers schooled their daughters in the myth of female inferiority.
ex.cn: 许多母亲把男尊女卑的错误观念传给了她们的女儿。

ex.en: a sense of inferiority
ex.cn: 自卑感

ex.en: They believe that submission in no way implies inferiority.
ex.cn: 他们认为服从决不意味着低人一等.

def: n.继承人，后继者

ex.en: Can I separate my father's twin - brother, joint inheritor, and next successor, from himself?'
ex.cn: 我能把我父亲的孪生兄弟 、 共同继承人, 也是现在的继承人跟他自己分开么? ”

ex.en: Later, the little monks became the inheritor of the master.
ex.cn: 后来, 这位小和尚成了师傅的衣钵传人.

ex.en: Who is the Inheritor of the Earth?
ex.cn: 谁是地球的继承者?

def: n.创始人,发起人,传授者,教导者

ex.en: Photo - initiator has played an important role in the UV curing fields.
ex.cn: 光引发剂在光固化领域里有着非常重要的作用.

ex.en: This paper discusses how iSCSI initiator implement on TOE.
ex.cn: 该文分析了基于TOE的iSCSIforinitiator的实现.

ex.en: Enoch's name signified in the Hebrew, Initiate or Initiator.
ex.cn: 以诺的名字在希伯莱尤为重要, 是传授或教导者.

def: adj.革新的,创新的,富有革新精神的,创新立异

ex.en: The company manufactures a range of innovative light-weight cycles.
ex.cn: 这家公司生产一系列的新型轻便自行车。

ex.en: Japanese companies have been pumping out plenty of innovative products.
ex.cn: 日本公司一直在生产大量富有创意的产品。

ex.en: For assistance, they turned to one of the city's most innovative museums.
ex.cn: 他们求助于该市最具创新风格的一家博物馆。

def: adj.富有洞察力的，有深刻见解的

ex.en: She offered some really interesting, insightful observations.
ex.cn: 她给出了一些非常有趣又富有洞察力的评论。

ex.en: The statute is hardly a masterpiece of insightful policymaking or incisive drafting.
ex.cn: 这个法案几乎不算一个有见识的杰作,也算不上是个透彻的草案.

ex.en: This is not an insightful article. It's all just filler , really.
ex.cn: 这不是一篇很有见地的文章. 只是一篇补白, 仅此而已.

def: n.坚持,强调,极力主张

ex.en: The ballot was re-run on Mr Todd's insistence after accusations of malpractice.
ex.cn: 因被控舞弊，在托德先生的坚持下重新进行了投票。

ex.en: She had attended an interview, at her boyfriend's insistence.
ex.cn: 在男友的坚持下，她去参加了一个面试。

ex.en: their insistence on strict standards of behaviour
ex.cn: 他们对严格行为规范的坚决主张

def: n.检查,检验,视察,检阅

ex.en: After an inspection, the inspectors must publish a report.
ex.cn: 在视察之后，视察者必须发表一份报告。

ex.en: He discovered, on closer inspection, that the rocks contained gold.
ex.cn: 经过更为仔细的探察，他发现这些岩石含金。

ex.en: Whether the authorities will allow inspection is highly doubtful.
ex.cn: 当局是否允许检查还是个大问号。

def: vt.& vi.（使）增强，（使）加剧,增加（照片图象）的对比度,变强或增强

ex.en: This could intensify the risk of a nuclear exchange.
ex.cn: 这可能会加剧爆发核战争的危险。

ex.en: The conflict is almost bound to intensify.
ex.cn: 冲突几乎注定会加剧。

ex.en: We must intensify our educational work among our own troops.
ex.cn: 我们必须加强自己部队的教育工作.

def: n.介入，干涉，干预,调解，排解

ex.en: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute.
ex.cn: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

ex.en: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention.
ex.cn: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。

ex.en: That does not require "massive" military intervention, as some have mischievously claimed.
ex.cn: 那并不需要像某些不怀好意者所主张的那样进行“大规模的”军事干预。

def: n.被接见者,被访问者

ex.en: It is counter-productive to address an interviewee in patronizing tones.
ex.cn: 以盛气凌人的语气同面试者讲话将会适得其反。

ex.en: The success depends on good rapport between interviewer and interviewee.
ex.cn: 成功取决于采访者与被采访者之间的良好沟通。

ex.en: Guide the interviewee towards examining problems and away from expressing solutions.
ex.cn: 引导访谈对象进行问题研究,但要避免寻求解决方案.

def: n.面试者,会见者,采访者

ex.en: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
ex.cn: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

ex.en: His abrasive wit and caustic comments were an interviewer's nightmare.
ex.cn: 他睿智刁钻，评论尖刻，对任何采访他的人而言都是梦魇。

ex.en: Often the interviewer will need to play devil's advocate in order to get a discussion going.
ex.cn: 采访者常常需要故意唱唱反调以使访谈继续下去。

def: vt.使无效,使作废,证明…错误,使站不住脚

ex.en: Any form of physical activity will invalidate the results.
ex.cn: 任何形式的物理活动都会证明这些结果是错误的。

ex.en: Such exceptions do not invalidate the rule.
ex.cn: 这些例外并不证明此规则无效.

ex.en: The invalidity of one clause does not invalidate the agreement.
ex.cn: 本协议任何一款无效不影响整个协议的效力.

def:
adj.吸引人的，诱人的,引人注目的
v.邀请(invite的现在分词)

ex.en: We hope the colour gives the house a warm and inviting feel.
ex.cn: 我们希望这种颜色能让房子给人一种暖意融融、宾至如归的感觉。

ex.en: There is an inviting restaurant with an outdoor terrace.
ex.cn: 有一家诱人的带露天阳台的饭馆。

ex.en: The Department is inviting applications from groups within the Borough.
ex.cn: 该部门欢迎本行政区内各团体提出申请。

def: adj.不相干的,不恰当,缺乏时代性的，落后于潮流的,牛头不对马嘴

ex.en: The government decided that their testimony would be irrelevant to the case.
ex.cn: 政府认定他们的证词与案件不相关。

ex.en: This involved the deletion of a great deal of irrelevant material.
ex.cn: 这包括删除很大一部分不相关的内容。

ex.en: A lot of nit-picking was going on about irrelevant things.
ex.cn: 对于毫不相干的事情进行大量吹毛求疵的批评。

def:
vt.猛拉,把（牛肉）切成薄片晒干
vt.& vi.（使…）猝然一动[颤动]
n.突然的拉[推，扭],<医>（肌肉的）痉挛，抽搐,蠢人,急促而猛烈的动作，猛地一拉

ex.en: He indicated the bedroom with a jerk of his head.
ex.cn: 他扭头指了指卧室的方向。

ex.en: He felt his head jerk reflexively.
ex.cn: 他感到他的头反射性地动了一下。

ex.en: Don't jerk me around, Mr Crook.
ex.cn: 别耍我，克鲁克先生。

def:
n.司法部,（总称）法官，审判官,司法制度
adj.法院的，审判员的,司法的

ex.en: The judiciary must think very hard before jailing non-violent offenders.
ex.cn: 司法部在将非暴力犯罪者投入监狱前必须经过审慎的考虑。

ex.en: The Senate Judiciary Committee is expected to vote momen-tarily on his nomination to the Supreme Court.
ex.cn: 参议院司法委员会有望很快就提名他进入最高法院进行投票。

ex.en: This is the fifth and probably final day of testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee.
ex.cn: 今天是在参议院司法委员会作证的第5天，很可能也是最后一天。

def: n.辩解,无过失,正当的理由

ex.en: To me the only justification for a zoo is educational.
ex.cn: 对我来说，动物园存在的唯一正当理由是其教育作用。

ex.en: His justification for the merger was just hot air.
ex.cn: 他提出的合并理由只是空话连篇。

ex.en: The justification of this chart is entirely spurious.
ex.cn: 这张图表的依据完全站不住脚。

def: adj.博学的，知识渊博的,有见识的,精明的,博洽多闻

ex.en: Mr Winchester is impressively knowledgeable about all manner of things.
ex.cn: 温切斯特先生知识广博，通晓万事。

ex.en: If you don't know much about cars, take a knowledgeable friend along.
ex.cn: 如果你不太了解汽车，带一个懂行的朋友一起去。

ex.en: We had a knowledgeable guide in the person of George Adams.
ex.cn: 我们有一位见识广博的导游乔治·亚当斯。

def: n.跛，残废，僵而疼痛,跛行

ex.en: Persistent damage or inadequate healing may lead to chronic lameness.
ex.cn: 反复受伤或治疗不当可导致长期跛足。

ex.en: Having been laughed at for his lameness, the boy became shy and inhibited.
ex.cn: 那男孩因跛脚被人讥笑, 变得羞怯而压抑.

ex.en: By reason of his lameness the boy could not play games.
ex.cn: 这男孩因脚跛不能做游戏.

def: n.资金[荣誉]获得者

ex.en: He was a Nobel laureate in physics.
ex.cn: 他是一位诺贝尔物理学奖获得者.

ex.en: For Holmes, society was Boston, the city of which he was poet - laureate.
ex.cn: 对霍姆斯而言, 社会就是波士顿, 他是这个城市里的桂冠诗人.

ex.en: For Holms, society was Boston, the city of which he was poet - laureate.
ex.cn: 对霍姆斯而言, 社会就是波士顿, 他就是这个城市里的桂冠诗人.

def: n.漏，漏出,泄露,[商]漏损率，漏损量,渗漏物，漏出量

ex.en: A leakage of kerosene has polluted water supplies.
ex.cn: 泄漏的煤油污染了水源。

ex.en: a leakage of toxic waste into the sea
ex.cn: 有毒废物的泄漏入海

ex.en: It's high time this leakage of information was put a stop to.
ex.cn: 是结束这种泄密现象的时候了.

def: n.立法机关,立法机构,立法部,（特指）州议会

ex.en: a democratically elected legislature
ex.cn: 民主选举产生的立法机关

ex.en: He is a member of the upper house of legislature.
ex.cn: 他是上议院的成员之一.

ex.en: They addressed a petition to the legislature.
ex.cn: 他们向立法机构提交了请愿书.

def: n.合法（性），正统（性）,合理

ex.en: The opposition parties do not recognise the political legitimacy of his government.
ex.cn: 反对党不承认他的政府在政治上的合法性。

ex.en: The newspaper was directly challenging the government's legitimacy.
ex.cn: 报纸直接质疑政府的合法性.

ex.en: As if to prove the legitimacy of these fears, the Cabinet of Franz von Papen collapsed on December 2.
ex.cn: 仿佛是要印证这些恐惧事出有因似的，弗朗茨·冯·巴本的内阁于12月2日倒台了。

def: adj.长的，漫长的,冗长的,啰唆的（演说，文章等）

ex.en: No mammals other than people may enter the country without lengthy quarantine.
ex.cn: 除人之外，所有的哺乳动物进入这个国家都必须经过长期隔离。

ex.en: There is a lengthy article on Spike Milligan in the Observer newspaper.
ex.cn: 《观察家报》上有一篇关于斯派克·米利根的长篇文章。

ex.en: Gates responds with a lengthy discourse on deployment strategy.
ex.cn: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

def:
n.杠杆作用,优势，力量,影响力,举债经营
v.举债经营,借贷收购

ex.en: The spade and fork have longer shafts, providing better leverage.
ex.cn: 锹和耙的手柄较长，可发挥较好的杠杆作用。

ex.en: We'll have to use leverage to move this huge rock.
ex.cn: 我们不得不借助杠杆之力来移动这块巨石.

ex.en: He has some leverage over the politician.
ex.cn: 他对这位政界人士有些影响.

def: n.血统，世系

ex.en: She has never traced back her lineage, but believes her grandparents were from Aberdeenshire.
ex.cn: 她从没有查考过自己的家系，不过她认为她祖父母来自阿伯丁郡。

ex.en: They can trace their lineage directly back to the 18th century.
ex.cn: 他们的世系可以直接追溯到18世纪。

ex.en: The heroes and heroines are of ancient and aristocratic lineage.
ex.cn: 男女主人都是家世渊源的贵族.

def: n.逻辑性

ex.en: Outstanding learning, coordinating and planning skills with good logicality.
ex.cn: 出色的学习, 理解与把握能力;出色的协调,计划与组织能力.

ex.en: On the other hand, modern lyric prose's special charming language also includes logicality.
ex.cn: 另一方面, 现代抒情散文独具魅力的话语也蕴含逻辑性.

ex.en: The design is characterized by logicality, flexibility, systematization and succinctness by case analysis.
ex.cn: 并通过实例证明设计上具有逻辑性 、 灵活性 、 系统性和简洁性等特点.

def:
vt.以私刑处死（被认为有罪的人）
n.私刑

ex.en: They also left a card, imprinted with the name Sean Lynch.
ex.cn: 他们还留下了一张名片，上面印着肖恩·林奇的名字。

ex.en: Despite attempts at resuscitation, Mr Lynch died a week later in hospital.
ex.cn: 虽经全力抢救，但林奇先生一周以后还是在医院去世了。

ex.en: He received praise for the atmospheric monochrome shots in David Lynch's The Elephant Man.
ex.cn: 他在大卫·林奇的电影《象人》中所拍摄的那些渲染气氛的黑白镜头受到了好评。

def: adj.易处理的,易控制的,可做到的,温顺的

ex.en: Keep your spending on luxuries down to manageable proportions.
ex.cn: 将你在奢侈品上的花费降至可控范围。

ex.en: The present flow of refugees was manageable.
ex.cn: 目前难民的流动尚可控制。

ex.en: Use conditioner regularly to make your hair soft and manageable.
ex.cn: 经常使用护发剂来使你的头发柔软而且易于梳理。

def: adj.经理的,管理上的

ex.en: We believe that this is a general model of managerial activity.
ex.cn: 我们认为这可以作为管理活动的普遍范例。

ex.en: He has also had managerial experience on every level.
ex.cn: 他还有各个层级的管理经验。

ex.en: Does she have any managerial experience?
ex.cn: 她有没有什么管理经验？

def: adv.显著地,引人注目地

ex.en: America's current economic downturn is markedly different from previous recessions.
ex.cn: 美国目前的经济滑坡与以往的经济衰退明显不同。

ex.en: The quality of their relationship improved markedly.
ex.cn: 他们的关系有了显著改善。

ex.en: The relations between our two countries have improved markedly in every aspect.
ex.cn: 我们两国的关系在各方面都有了显著的发展.

def: n.市场商人,市场营销人员,<美>在市场中买卖的人

ex.en: Practically as interesting – and much more practical, if you're a marketer.
ex.cn: 几乎一样的有趣——但实用得多, 假如你是营销人员的话.

ex.en: Huntsman is a global manufacturer and marketer of differentiated and commodity chemicals.
ex.cn: 亨斯迈是精细化学品及通用化学品的全球制造商及营销商.

ex.en: Our client is a world leading orthopedic medical device designer, manufacturer, & marketer.
ex.cn: 我们的客户是世界领先的整形医疗设备的设计者, 制造者 和 经销商.

def: n.市场，集市,商业界

ex.en: The marketplace was jammed with a noisy crowd of buyers and sellers.
ex.cn: 集市上熙熙攘攘挤满了买卖东西的人。

ex.en: Competition in the financial marketplace has eroded profits.
ex.cn: 金融市场的竞争降低了利润。

ex.en: products designed to meet the exacting standards of today's marketplace
ex.cn: 为符合当今市场严格的标准而设计的产品

def: adj.可量度的,可测量的，可预见的,重大的

ex.en: So far the effect is barely measurable.
ex.cn: 迄今为止，效果微乎其微。

ex.en: Economists emphasize measurable quantities — the number of jobs, the per capita income.
ex.cn: 经济学家看重的是可测定的量——岗位数量、人均收入等。

ex.en: Both leaders seemed to expect measurable progress.
ex.cn: 两位领导人似乎都期望取得显著的进展。

def: n.迷你短裙，超短裙

ex.en: She walked off the plane in a miniskirt and tight top.
ex.cn: 她身穿迷你裙和紧身上衣走下了飞机。

ex.en: When did the miniskirt first come in?
ex.cn: 迷你裙什么时候开始流行的?

ex.en: Sweetheart : I'm pulling up my miniskirt. Take off my panties.
ex.cn: 我拉起我的迷你裙, 脱下我的内裤.

def: n.误解,错觉,错误想法

ex.en: It is a misconception that Peggy was fabulously wealthy.
ex.cn: 人们误以为佩吉相当有钱。

ex.en: " To see every bush and tree on Mount Bagong as an enemy soldier " is an example of misconception.
ex.cn: “ 八公山上,草木皆兵 ”,是错觉之一例.

ex.en: It is a misconception to assume that the two continents are similar.
ex.cn: 关于这两块大陆相似的假设是一种误解。

def: n.误解，曲解

ex.en: The message left no room for misinterpretation.
ex.cn: 这则消息不可能被人曲解。

ex.en: Her anxiety has sprung from a misinterpretation of the report.
ex.cn: 她的不安是由于对这篇报道的错误理解而引起的.

ex.en: The term parts per million ( ppm ) was widely used but frequently led to misinterpretation.
ex.cn: 广泛使用百分之几 ( ppm ) 表示结果,但常常引起误解.

def: vt.把（感情等）寄托于不值得寄托的对象,忘记把…放在什么地方，把…放错位置

ex.en: I often misplace something that she should have put away.
ex.cn: 我经常把她本该放起来的东西放错了地方.

ex.en: Grandfather used to misplace his glasses.
ex.cn: 我的祖父从前总是把眼镜乱放,经常找不到.

ex.en: Biometrics promises identities that are virtually impossible to steal, impersonate or misplace.
ex.cn: 这种生物科技测量标准的特徵是近几乎不可能被偷取, 假扮,或误置.

def: n.修改，修正，变更，改良，改进，缓和，减轻，限制,[语]修饰，（用变音符号的）母音改变,[生]诱发变异，变态，变体，变型

ex.en: Considerable modification of the existing system is needed.
ex.cn: 需要对现有的系统进行相当大的改进。

ex.en: The law, in its present form, is unjust; it needs modification.
ex.cn: 现行的法律是不公正的; 它需要修改.

ex.en: The design requires considerable modification.
ex.cn: 这个设计需要作大的修改.

def: n.（外国人的）归化,（动植物的）移植,（外国的习惯、语言等的）移入,同化

ex.en: They swore their allegiance to the USA and received their naturalization papers.
ex.cn: 他们起誓忠诚于美国，随后就接到了批准他们入籍的文件。

ex.en: It was this man who pulled strings for Will to get his naturalization.
ex.cn: 就是这个人为威利幕后拉线,搞到了他的国籍证明.

ex.en: Naturalization Class — Assists immigrants in preparing for their naturalization exam.
ex.cn: 入籍班—协助移民准备入籍考试.

def: n.报摊，杂志摊

ex.en: There's one next to the newsstand.
ex.cn: 挨着报摊有一个.

ex.en: You can buy it at newsstand.
ex.cn: 你可以在书报摊买到.

ex.en: Is she also suing every newsstand that carries US Weekly?
ex.cn: 她是不是也控告了每一个出售《美国周刊》的报摊?

def: adj.非人类的

ex.en: It beautifully conveys the atmosphere of the nonhuman world.
ex.cn: 它优美地描写了一个非人类世界的气氛.

ex.en: Genetic control is an important component general management of nonhuman primate colonies.
ex.cn: 遗传学控制在非人灵长类动物人工繁殖种群诸多管理环节具有至关重要的作用.

ex.en: The algorithm of this system excludes other nonhuman objects to detect human.
ex.cn: 该系统算法通过排除非人体目标实现人体检测.

def:
adj.闻名的，著名的,[乐]附有乐谱的
v.注意，记下,“note”的过去式和过去分词

ex.en: Haig noted how he "looked pinched and rather tired".
ex.cn: 黑格注意到了他“看上去消瘦，非常劳累”的样子。

ex.en: Its books are noted for the quality of their paper and bindings.
ex.cn: 其图书以纸质优良、封面精美而闻名。

ex.en: Official handouts describe the Emperor as "particularly noted as a scholar".
ex.cn: 官方印发的材料将皇帝描述为“尤以学识渊博而著称”。

def: n.客观性，客观现实

ex.en: The psychiatrist must learn to maintain an unusual degree of objectivity.
ex.cn: 精神科医生务必要学会保持超乎寻常的客观态度。

ex.en: The objectivity of science is a mirage.
ex.cn: 所谓科学的客观性是一种幻想。

ex.en: The poll, whose objectivity is open to question, gave the party a 39% share of the vote.
ex.cn: 在这次投票中该党获得了39％的选票，但其客观性值得怀疑。

def: n.遵守者，观察者,观察团,观察员

ex.en: The current sole superpower is far from being a disinterested observer.
ex.cn: 当前唯一的超级大国远不是一个公正的旁观者。

ex.en: There is a lengthy article on Spike Milligan in the Observer newspaper.
ex.cn: 《观察家报》上有一篇关于斯派克·米利根的长篇文章。

ex.en: The Observer found the play "a feeble rehash of familiar Miller themes"
ex.cn: 《观察家报》认为这部剧“是大家熟悉的米勒式主题的拙劣翻版”。

def: adv.明显地

ex.en: Now, erm, obviously some of our listeners may have some ideas.
ex.cn: 嗯，对了，显然我们的一些听众可能会有些想法。

ex.en: She was very glum and was obviously missing her children.
ex.cn: 她郁郁寡欢，显然在惦念自己的孩子们。

ex.en: The reason for my visit had obviously slipped his mind.
ex.cn: 他显然已经忘掉了我的来意。

def: n.压迫,被压迫的状态,压迫物,沉闷，苦恼

ex.en: The main cause of women's and children's oppression is patriarchy.
ex.cn: 妇女儿童受压迫的主要原因是父权制。

ex.en: a victim of oppression and tyranny
ex.cn: 压迫和暴政的受害者

ex.en: When did they rise against oppression?
ex.cn: 他们什么时候起来反抗压迫的?

def: adj.管弦乐队（演奏）的，为管弦乐队演奏的,管弦乐队的

ex.en: Glen Bronka wrote his own orchestral arrangements.
ex.cn: 格伦·布朗卡把自己的曲子改编成了管弦乐曲。

ex.en: The orchestral playing is superb.
ex.cn: 这个管弦乐团的演奏棒极了。

ex.en: I had written quite a lot of orchestral music in my student days.
ex.cn: 我在学生时代创作过很多管弦乐作品。

def: vt.把（乐曲）编成管弦乐,和谐地安排,精心策划

ex.en: The colonel was able to orchestrate a rebellion from inside an army jail.
ex.cn: 这位上校得以在军队监狱里策动了一场哗变。

ex.en: It was a supernatural experience, that only God could orchestrate.
ex.cn: 这是一个惟有上帝能掌管的超自然经历.

ex.en: Some suggest that it has even helped to orchestrate some of the anger at Mr Zardari.
ex.cn: 部分人的建议甚至有助于静心策划一些针对扎尔达里总统的愤怒.

def: adv.起初，原来,独创地，独出心裁地,自来,本

ex.en: Originally released in 1957, the film was remade as "The Magnificent Seven".
ex.cn: 这部电影最早在1957年上映，后被翻拍为《七侠荡寇志》。

ex.en: The plane has been kept in service far longer than originally intended.
ex.cn: 这架飞机已经超期服役很长时间了。

ex.en: Shakespearean women's roles were originally written to be played by men.
ex.cn: 莎士比亚笔下的女性角色在创作之初是打算由男性来扮演的。

def: vt.在重量上超过,比…重要,胜过，强过,比…有价值

ex.en: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
ex.cn: 这笔交易的利远远大于弊。

ex.en: The medical benefits of x-rays far outweigh the risk of having them.
ex.cn: X光在医学上的益处远甚于它带来的风险。

ex.en: The minuses far outweigh that possible gain.
ex.cn: 弊端远远大于那可能获得的收益。

def:
v.（使）穿得太讲究
n.外衣

ex.en: One can overdress as well as appear sloppy.
ex.cn: 过度打扮以及显得邋遢都不好.

ex.en: Avoid the tendency to overdress. You will reduce unnecessary sweating which contributes to heat loss.
ex.cn: 不要对外套过于讲究, 你必须减少不必要的热量丧失引起的出汗.

def: vt.踏过，逾越，超出…的限度

ex.en: In male company, perhaps he did overstep the bounds of propriety.
ex.cn: 在清一色男性的公司里，可能他的举止确实有失得体。

ex.en: Parents fear they might overstep these invisible boundaries.
ex.cn: 父母担心他们可能会逾越这些无形的界限。

ex.en: to overstep your authority
ex.cn: 越权

def: n.漆刷，画刷，画笔

ex.en: Hand the paintbrush up to Father on the ladder.
ex.cn: 父亲在梯子上,把油漆刷子递给他.

ex.en: Can this brush go for a paintbrush?
ex.cn: 这把刷子可以用作画刷 吗 ?

ex.en: The paintbrush was too stiff to use.
ex.cn: 画笔太硬了,没法用.

def: n.亲子关系,父母身分

ex.en: She may feel unready for the responsibilities of parenthood.
ex.cn: 她可能觉得没有准备好承担为人父母的责任。

ex.en: Everyone has doubts about their readiness for parenthood.
ex.cn: 自己是否作好了为人父母的准备，人人都会感到疑虑。

ex.en: a romanticized picture of parenthood
ex.cn: 一幅理想化的为人父母的情景

def: adv.部分地,<古>偏袒地，偏爱地,一部分

ex.en: These plants will grow happily in a sunny or partially shaded spot.
ex.cn: 这些植物在阳光充足或有部分光线照射的地方长势良好。

ex.en: The road was partially blocked by a fallen tree.
ex.cn: 倒下的一棵树挡住了部分道路。

ex.en: Her partially clothed body was found in woods nearby.
ex.cn: 在附近的小树林里发现了她半裸的尸体.

def: adv.特别,尤其,异乎寻常地

ex.en: Be particularly fastidious about washing your hands before touching food.
ex.cn: 接触食物前尤其对洗手不能有半点马虎。

ex.en: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
ex.cn: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

ex.en: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
ex.cn: 他视力不好，算不上是一个出色的射手。

def: n.补缀品，拼缝物,混杂物

ex.en: For centuries, quilting and patchwork have been popular needlecrafts.
ex.cn: 几个世纪以来，缝被子和做布拼一直是许多人都会做的针线活儿。

ex.en: The low mountains were a patchwork of green and brown.
ex.cn: 低矮的群山上，绿色和棕色混杂着。

ex.en: a patchwork of different styles and cultures
ex.cn: 不同风格和文化的拼合

def: adj.有知觉力的,感知的,有理解力的

ex.en: He was one of the most perceptive US political commentators.
ex.cn: 他是美国最具洞察力的政治评论家之一。

ex.en: a highly perceptive comment
ex.cn: 见地高明的评论

ex.en: This is a very perceptive assessment of the situation.
ex.cn: 这是一个对该情况的极富洞察力的评价.

def: n.执行者,演奏者,演员，歌手,完成者

ex.en: Until 1987, Canada's industry had been the star performer.
ex.cn: 直到1987年，加拿大的工业一直成就斐然。

ex.en: She was no mean performer on a variety of other instruments.
ex.cn: 许多别的乐器她也演奏得相当出色。

ex.en: A performer in evening dress plays classical selections on the violin.
ex.cn: 一名身穿晚礼服的表演者用小提琴演奏了几段古典音乐。

def: n.坚持不懈,执意,持续,留存，（萤光屏上余辉的）保留时间

ex.en: Sandra was determined to become a doctor and her persistence paid off.
ex.cn: 桑德拉决心成为医生，她的坚持取得了成功。

ex.en: Chandra was determined to become a doctor and her persistence paid off.
ex.cn: 钱德拉决心做一名医生，她的坚持不懈得到了回报。

ex.en: Skill comes only with practice, patience and persistence.
ex.cn: 只有不断练习，有耐心有毅力，才能学会一门技艺。

def: adj.持续的,坚持不懈的,持久的,坚持不渝

ex.en: Shoppers picked their way through puddles caused by persistent rain.
ex.cn: 购物的人们小心翼翼地择路避开由于连续下雨形成的水坑。

ex.en: His cough grew more persistent until it never stopped.
ex.cn: 他咳嗽持续的时间越来越长，直到咳个不停。

ex.en: Persistent damage or inadequate healing may lead to chronic lameness.
ex.cn: 反复受伤或治疗不当可导致长期跛足。

def: adj.有说服力的,劝诱的,动听

ex.en: Michael Grade's persuasive powers overcame their objections.
ex.cn: 迈克尔·格雷德能言善辩，驳倒了他们的反对意见。

ex.en: He can be very persuasive.
ex.cn: 他有时很会说服人。

ex.en: His arguments in favour of a new school are very persuasive.
ex.cn: 他赞成办一座新学校的理由很有说服力.

def: n.花瓣

ex.en: Each white petal had a stripe of red.
ex.cn: 每一片白色的花瓣上都有一条红色的条纹.

ex.en: A petal fluttered to the ground.
ex.cn: 一片花瓣飘落到地上.

ex.en: Entering the grove, he strolled along the petal - strewn ground, pushing aside the lowhanging branches.
ex.cn: 他走进了梅林,踏着散落在地上的花瓣, 用手披开垂下的树枝,在梅林里面慢步闲走.

def:
adj.交响乐团的，音乐团体的,爱好音乐的
n.交响乐团,爱音乐的人,爱乐团体

ex.en: In a new recording, the Boston Philharmonic tried the original tempo.
ex.cn: 在新唱片中，波士顿爱乐乐团尝试了全新的节奏。

ex.en: The Lithuanian Philharmonic Orchestra played Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
ex.cn: 立陶宛爱乐交响乐团演奏了贝多芬的《第九交响曲》。

ex.en: He will conduct the Vienna Philharmonic in the final concert of the season.
ex.cn: 他将在演出季闭幕音乐会上指挥维也纳爱乐乐团演奏。

def: n.生理学者

ex.en: Russian physiologist who observed conditioned salivary responses in dogs ( 1849 - 1936 ).
ex.cn: ( 1849-1936 ) 苏联生理学家,在狗身上观察到唾液条件反射,曾获1904年诺贝尔生理学 - 医学奖.

ex.en: The physiologist recently studied indicated that evening exercises beneficially.
ex.cn: 生理学家新近研究表明,傍晚锻炼最为有益.

ex.en: Best: american - born Canadian physiologist noted for his work on the discovery and application of insulin.
ex.cn: 贝斯特: 美 裔 加拿大生理学家,因其对胰岛素的发现与应用方面的工作而著名.

def: v.水煮,偷猎,窃取,把…踏成泥浆

ex.en: Schools should not compete with each other or attempt to poach pupils.
ex.cn: 学校之间不应该相互竞争，也不应该企图挖走彼此的学生。

ex.en: Poach the pears in apple juice for perhaps ten minutes at most.
ex.cn: 把梨放入苹果汁中，最多煮10分钟左右。

ex.en: Poach the chicken until just cooked.
ex.cn: 用文火把鸡肉煮到刚刚熟。

def: adj.无力的，无能的,无权力的,虚弱的,无资源的

ex.en: They feel scared and powerless in conveyor-belt hospital wards.
ex.cn: 在千篇一律的病房里，他们感到恐惧而又无能为力。

ex.en: Despite its lack of formal power the nobility was not powerless.
ex.cn: 尽管没有正式的权力，贵族阶层并非没有权势。

ex.en: If you don't have money, you're powerless.
ex.cn: 如果你没有钱，就寸步难行。

def: adv.精确地,恰好地,严谨地，严格地,一丝不苟地

ex.en: Breakfast television arrived in British life precisely a decade ago.
ex.cn: 准确地说，早间电视节目于10年前进入英国人的生活。

ex.en: Children come to zoos precisely to see captive animals.
ex.cn: 孩子们到动物园就是为了看圈养的动物。

ex.en: "Precisely what other problems do you perceive?" she asked.
ex.cn: “你究竟还发现了什么问题？”她问道。

def:
n.先决条件，前提，必要条件
adj.必须先具备的，必要的,先决条件的

ex.en: Party membership was an essential prerequisite of a successful career.
ex.cn: 成为党员是事业有成必不可少的先决条件。

ex.en: A degree is an essential prerequisite for employment at this level.
ex.cn: 学位是做这级工作必备的先决条件。

ex.en: Stability and unity are a prerequisite to the four modernizations.
ex.cn: 安定团结是实现四个现代化的前提.

def: n.预防，预防法,阻止，制止，妨碍，阻碍物,[谚]治病不如防病

ex.en: Calcium may aid in the prevention of colon cancer.
ex.cn: 钙可能有助于预防结肠癌。

ex.en: For help on crime prevention, call our 24-hour advice line.
ex.cn: 若想获得预防犯罪方面的帮助，请拨打我们的24小时咨询热线。

ex.en: They put a high premium on prevention and primary care.
ex.cn: 他们对预防和初级护理极为重视。

def: adj.僧的，僧侣似的

ex.en: Priestly robes hang on the walls.
ex.cn: 教士袍挂在墙上。

ex.en: A man in priestly clothes offered spiritual guidance.
ex.cn: 一位身着牧师袍服的男子进行了宗教布道。

ex.en: The priestly caste does not normally intermarry with the warrior caste.
ex.cn: 教士阶级通常不与武土阶级通婚.

def: n.生产，生殖

ex.en: Early marriage and procreation are no longer discouraged there.
ex.cn: 那里不再反对早婚早育。

ex.en: Sterility is some permanent factor preventing procreation.
ex.cn: 不育是阻碍生殖的一种永久性因素.

ex.en: Procreation will be an annual formality like the renewal of a ration card.
ex.cn: 生殖的事要弄得像发配给证一样成为一年一度的手续形式.

def: n.生产者，制造者,制片人,煤气发生炉,自养有机体

ex.en: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
ex.cn: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

ex.en: Today's organic wine producer is typically a small, quality-conscious family concern.
ex.cn: 现今的有机葡萄酒生产商一般是注重品质的小型家族企业.

ex.en: The television producer today has to be part news person, part educator.
ex.cn: 今天的电视制片人必须既是新闻人，又是教育者。

def: n.职业水准或特性,职业化

ex.en: I was amazed by their discourtesy and lack of professionalism.
ex.cn: 他们的无礼和不专业让我震惊。

ex.en: I've impressed upon them the need for more professionalism.
ex.cn: 我已使他们深刻认识到提高专业素养的必要性。

ex.en: Good customer relations require courtesy, professionalism and effective response.
ex.cn: 良好的客户关系需要做到礼貌、专业，并提供有效的回复。

def: n.声明,公告,宣告,判决

ex.cn: 声明: 本工作室完全独立运作,不作为任何组织分支.

ex.en: Broad pronouncement of the week: We are entitled brats.
ex.cn: 本周特大号外: 我们都是自负的“牛人”

ex.en: Pronouncement: The company operates completely independently and hasn't any branch.
ex.cn: 声明: 本公司完全独立运作,不作为任何组织分支.

def: n.保护,护照,[经]保护贸易制，保护政策,（向歹徒缴纳的）保护费

ex.en: For added protection choose a lipstick with a sun screen.
ex.cn: 选择防晒护唇膏来增强保护。

ex.en: Protection of sites, habitats and landscapes is of uppermost priority.
ex.cn: 保护遗址、栖息地和风景区是重中之重。

ex.en: Your arms and legs need protection from light bouncing off glass.
ex.cn: 需要保护你的手臂和双腿免受玻璃反射光线的照射。

def:
adj.挑衅的,刺激性的
n.刺激物,兴奋剂

ex.en: Some adolescents might be more sexually mature and provocative than others.
ex.cn: 一些青少年可能相比同龄人在性方面更成熟、更具挑逗性。

ex.en: He doesn't really mean that—he's just being deliberately provocative.
ex.cn: 他不是真有此意，只不过是存心挑逗一下罢了。

ex.en: She wore a very provocative dress.
ex.cn: 她穿了一件非常性感的裙子.

def: adj.心理的,精神上的，精神（现象）的,心理学（上）的,关于心理学的

ex.en: John received constant physical and psychological abuse from his father.
ex.cn: 约翰不断遭到父亲身体和心理上的双重虐待。

ex.en: Psychological twists perk up an otherwise predictable story line.
ex.cn: 心理转折使原本老套的故事情节变得生动有趣。

ex.en: Even minor head injuries can cause long-lasting psychological effects.
ex.cn: 即使是轻微的头部创伤也会对心理产生长期影响。

def: n.心理学研究者，心理学家

ex.en: Ask your doctor for a referral to a clinical psychologist.
ex.cn: 让你的医生给你推荐一位临床心理学家。

ex.en: Last night a top criminal psychologist cast doubt on the theory.
ex.cn: 昨天晚上，一位顶级犯罪心理学家使人们对该理论产生了怀疑。

ex.en: An assessment by an independent educational psychologist was essential.
ex.cn: 由具有独立见解的教育心理学家进行评估至关重要。

def:
adj.可疑的，有疑问的
adv.可疑地，不真实地

ex.en: His best friend was killed by police under extremely questionable circumstances.
ex.cn: 他最好的朋友在极其可疑的情况下被警察打死了。

ex.en: It is questionable whether the expenditure on this project is really justified.
ex.cn: 该项目的开支是否真的合理还未可知。

ex.en: He has been dogged by allegations of questionable business practices.
ex.cn: 他一直被那些指控他有不正当商业行为的说法所困扰。

def: adv.随便地，未加计划地

ex.en: Within the hot gas chamber, molecules are moving randomly in all directions.
ex.cn: 在灼热的气体燃烧室内, 分子在各个方向上作无规运动.

ex.en: Transformed cells are loosely attached, rounded and randomly oriented.
ex.cn: 转化细胞则不大贴壁 、 圆缩并呈杂乱分布.

ex.en: The eight chromosomes were randomly distributed at metaphase I.
ex.cn: 在中期Ⅰ8对染色体的分布是无秩序的.

def: n.合理化，合于经济原则,文饰作用

ex.en: The main lines of the plan were a reduction in expenditure and the rationalization of government controls.
ex.cn: 该计划的主要内容是支出的缩减和政府控制的合理化改革。

ex.en: Certainly that was rationalization, but what is wrong with rationalization when -- the doorbell rang.
ex.cn: 当然,这是阿Q精神.然而, 阿Q精神又有何错呢 —— 突然,门铃响了.

ex.en: For Weber, the rational bureaucracy was the major element in the rationalization of the modern world.
ex.cn: 韦伯认为合理的官僚制度是现代世界合理化的主要因素.

def: n.反应,反作用力,反动,保守

ex.en: There has been a very mixed reaction to the decision.
ex.cn: 对于这个决定的反应非常不一致。

ex.en: Our instinctive reaction when someone causes us pain is to strike back.
ex.cn: 当被别人弄疼时我们本能的反应是反击。

ex.en: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress.
ex.cn: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

def: n.[化工]反应器,[核]反应堆,起反应的人,原子炉

ex.en: They shut down the nuclear reactor for safety reasons.
ex.cn: 出于安全原因他们关闭了核反应堆。

ex.en: Emergency cooling systems could fail and a reactor meltdown could occur.
ex.cn: 紧急冷却系统有可能失灵，核反应堆有可能发生堆芯熔毁。

ex.en: the core of a nuclear reactor
ex.cn: 核反应堆的活性区

def: vt.重申,再肯定

ex.en: I have come to this country to reaffirm that dedication.
ex.cn: 我这次到贵国来,就是为了重申这种献身的决心.

ex.en: He had ample opportunity to reaffirm his basic ideological commitment.
ex.cn: 他曾多次有机会重申他的基本思想信念.

ex.en: Oh their behalf I ask you to restate and reaffirm the timeless truth of our party.
ex.cn: 我代表他们请你们重申我们党永恒的真理.

def: n.推荐,推荐信,建议,可取之处

ex.en: Nearly 60% of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
ex.cn: 我们近60%的订单来自于回头客和熟人介绍。

ex.en: The decision was made on the recommendation of the Interior Minister.
ex.cn: 决议是根据内政部部长的提议作出的。

ex.en: The WHO recommendation has no legal status.
ex.cn: 世界卫生组织的建议不具备法律效应。

def: n.招聘人员，征兵人员
v.重新定义,再定义

ex.en: The advent of the Euro will redefine Europe.
ex.cn: 欧元的出现将重新定义欧洲.

ex.en: We will finally have to redefine our relationship with neighbouring states in north Africa.
ex.cn: 我们最终将不得不重新界定我们和北非邻国的关系。

ex.en: Your search returned no results. Redefine your query and search again.
ex.cn: 您的搜索未返回任何结果. 请重新定义查询并再次搜索.

def: n.驳斥

ex.en: He prepared a complete refutation of the Republicans' most serious charges.
ex.cn: 他准备全面反驳共和党人对他最严重的指控。

ex.en: The refutation is forceful and every word hits home.
ex.cn: 批驳有力,句句中的.

ex.en: Truth fears no refutation.
ex.cn: 真理不怕人驳.

def: n.规则性，规律性,整齐,正规,匀称

ex.en: Experimenters have succeeded in controlling the rate and regularity of the heartbeat.
ex.cn: 实验者已经成功控制了心跳的速度和频率。

ex.en: Closures and job losses are again being announced with monotonous regularity.
ex.cn: 倒闭和失业的消息又在一次次地反复宣布着。

ex.en: He continued to appear in the office with unfailing regularity thereafter.
ex.cn: 从那以后他照常出现在办公室，风雨无阻。

def: n.校准者，[机]调整器，校准器，调节器，[化]调节剂，[无线]稳定器，调节基因，（钟表的）整时器，标准钟,管理者，调整者，整理者,原则，标准,[英史]选举调查[监视]委员，监管者

ex.en: An automatic voltage regulator ensured a constant output from the generator.
ex.cn: 一个自动电压调节器保证了发电机电流输出的稳定。

ex.en: An independent regulator will be appointed to ensure fair competition.
ex.cn: 将会指定一个独立的管理机构来保证公平竞争。

ex.en: ... '>seems

def: adj.调整的,具有监管权的，监管的
adv.关系上地,相对地,比较地,较比

ex.en: As a group, today's old people are still relatively deprived.
ex.cn: 整体而言，当今的老年人依然相对贫困。

ex.en: We're taking relatively benign medicines and we're turning them into poisons.
ex.cn: 我们服的药相对来说药性温和，但是我们却在把它们变成毒药。

ex.en: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behaviour.
ex.cn: 这个实用的基础模型较为简略地解释了人类的行为。

def:
vi.食言,违例出牌
vt.否认,食言，违约,放弃,拒绝
n.出牌违例,[牌]有某种花色的牌可跟而违反规则不跟

ex.en: You said you'd come, why did you renege on your promise?
ex.cn: 你说你要来的, 为什么要背信弃义?

ex.en: Any more colourful candidate could renege on a deal.
ex.cn: 任何不同政见的候选人都可能就此交易而报复.

ex.en: If you renege again, I am going to gut you.
ex.cn: 如果你再食言, 我会挖出你的内脏!

def: adj.可继续的，可续订的,可更新的,可再生的,可翻新的

ex.cn: 正式签订了每年可续签的合同。

ex.en: Renewable sources of energy must be used where practical.
ex.cn: 必须在可行的地方使用可再生能源。

ex.en: The success of wind power represents a litmus test for renewable energy.
ex.cn: 风能作为动力的成功是对可再生能源一次立见分晓的检验。

def: vt.& vi.改组，重新组织,改编，整编

ex.en: It is the mother who is expected to reorganize her busy schedule.
ex.cn: 应该让母亲来重新安排自己紧张的日程。

ex.en: It's about time we started in to reorganize the department.
ex.cn: 到了该改组这个部门的时候了.

ex.en: " We must reorganize the strike committee!
ex.cn: “ 我们要改组罢工委员会!

ex.cn: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

ex.en: This policy had repeatedly come under strong criticism on Capitol Hill.
ex.cn: 该政策在美国国会屡遭强烈批评。

ex.en: He developed nervous problems after people began repeatedly correcting him.
ex.cn: 人们开始不停地纠正他的错误，之后他的神经就出现了问题。

def: adj.可代替的

ex.en: He would see I was not so easily replaceable.
ex.cn: 他会看到我不是那么容易被替代的。

ex.en: Most shredding machines are based on a revolving disc fitted with replaceable blades.
ex.cn: 大多数粉碎机都是基于一个装有可替换刀片的旋转圆盘来实现作业的。

ex.en: A person, unlike a machine, is not replaceable.
ex.cn: 人和机器不同, 是不可替代的.

def: n.研究员，调查者

ex.en: A market researcher called at the house where he was living.
ex.cn: 一位市场调查人员造访了他的住处。

ex.en: He chose to join the company as a market researcher.
ex.cn: 他选择到这家公司做了市场研究员。

ex.en: She has freelanced as a writer and researcher.
ex.cn: 她从事自由职业，一边写作，一边搞研究。

adj.可敬的,品行端正的,可观的，相当大的,体面的

ex.cn: 他现在是一位教师，并且是社区内受人尊敬的一员。

ex.en: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced, person.
ex.cn: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

ex.cn: 他在描述镇上体面人家时满是贬抑之词。

def: n.零售商，零售店,传播的人，处散布闲话的人

ex.cn: 这使得小零售商几乎不可能跟连锁店竞争。

ex.en: Top retailer Marks & Spencer has romped in with another set of sparkling results.
ex.cn: 零售巨头玛莎百货再次凭借一系列耀眼的成绩轻松胜出。

ex.en: Take the goods back to your retailer who will refund you the purchase price.
ex.cn: 把商品退还给你的零售商，他们会按原价退款的。

def: n.评论家，评论者

ex.cn: 评论家把这位年轻作者的第一部小说抨击得一无是处.

ex.cn: 评论者在他的评论中添加了冗长的作者生平以拉长篇幅。

ex.cn: 有个评论家把她的处女作称为 ‘ 超级浪漫小说 ’,这个美称就叫开了.

def: vt.使恢复元气,使新生,使复兴

ex.en: measures to revitalize the inner cities
ex.cn: 让市中心更加繁荣的措施

ex.en: Congress has tried dozens of approaches to revitalize decaying urban and rural areas.
ex.cn: 国会已试行过数十种方法来重振正在走向衰败的城乡地区。

ex.en: I think we have to revitalize our society.
ex.cn: 我觉得我们的社会需要新生.

def: adv.粗略地,大体上,大致上,粗暴地

ex.cn: 我们已经了解到各门功课差不多一样重要。

ex.en: He knew roughly what was about to be said.
ex.cn: 他大概知道要说些什么。

ex.en: Bihar had a population roughly the same as that of England.
ex.cn: 比哈尔邦的人口几乎和英国的一样。

def: n.悲哀，忧伤，忧愁，悲哀,令人悲哀或忧伤的事物,愁眉苦脸，心境恶劣，心情恶劣,认真

ex.cn: 那笔钱带来的只有伤心、痛苦和悲剧。

ex.en: I felt sick to my stomach with sadness for them.
ex.cn: 我为他们感到十分痛心。

ex.en: Levin sat there, an expression of sadness on his face.
ex.cn: 莱文坐在那里，神情悲伤。

def: n.游猎，陆路旅行（尤指在东非或中非）,类似游猎的假日旅行,旅行队

ex.en: He'd like to go on safari to photograph snakes and tigers.
ex.cn: 他想进行一次观兽旅行，拍摄一些蛇类和老虎的照片。

ex.en: He had been on safari in East Africa with his son.
ex.cn: 他曾和他儿子到东非游猎。

ex.en: When we go on safari we like to cook on an open fire.
ex.cn: 我们远行狩猎时,喜欢露天生火做饭.

def:

v.使满意( satisfy的过去式和过去分词)

n.话,说话,谚语，格言
v.说(say的ing形式)

ex.cn: 再见再见沙扬那拉. 再见再见沙扬那拉.

ex.en: The novel concludes with the lovers forlornly bidding each other sayonara.
ex.cn: 那部小说以一对情侣黯然互道再会结束.

ex.en: So sayonara, try tomorra, nice to know ya.
ex.cn: 所以再见, 试着明天, 很高兴的见到你.

vt.仔细检查
n.仔细或彻底检查
adj.季节的，季节性的,周期性的,随季节变化的

ex.en: Even among seasoned mountaineers Pinnacle Ridge is considered quite a tough proposition.
ex.cn: 即使在经验丰富的登山者中，平纳克尔峰也被认为是很难攀登的。

ex.en: Coat the fish with seasoned flour.
ex.cn: 用拌有佐料的面粉将鱼裹上。

ex.en: The author is a seasoned academic.
ex.cn: 作者是一位经验丰富的学者。

def: n.煽动行为或言论，煽动叛乱
adj.性的，有性别的,性欲的,生殖的,[生]有性的

ex.cn: 史密斯先生有条件地同意购买这家俱乐部的股份。

ex.cn: 股份制商业银行必须实行独立董事制度.

ex.cn: 资产重组: 对优质资产进行股份制改造.

def: n.类似,相像性,相仿性,类似性，相似物
