ex.en: Instead of snacking on crisps and chocolate, nibble on celery or carrot.
ex.cn: 不要把薯片和巧克力当零食来吃，要吃些芹菜和胡萝卜。

def:
vt.支撑,携带,输送,运载
vt.& vi.运送,搬运,具有
vi.（文学、戏剧等）对读者,扔（或踢）到…距离,（马等）具有某种姿势,传得很远
n.（枪炮、火箭等的）射程,运输，运送

ex.en: The indisputable fact is that computers carry out logical operations.
ex.cn: 不容置疑的事实是，电脑执行逻辑操作指令。

ex.en: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
ex.cn: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

ex.en: Many women know how to carry out repairs on their cars.
ex.cn: 许多妇女懂得怎样修自己的车。

def:
n.运货马车，手推车,一车之量
vt.用推车或卡车运送,费力搬运,强行带走，抓走

ex.en: Last night we hitched the horse to the cart and moved here.
ex.cn: 昨晚我们套上马车，拉着东西搬到了这里。

ex.en: Where we use tractors, obviously they used cart-horses in those days.
ex.cn: 显然，我们如今用拖拉机的地方，他们以前用的是役马。

ex.en: a horse and cart
ex.cn: 一套马车

def:
n.漫画,讽刺画,动画片,草图
vt.为…画漫画
vi.画漫画

ex.en: A prince turns into a frog in this cartoon fairytale.
ex.cn: 在这个卡通童话里王子变成了一只青蛙。

ex.en: a Walt Disney cartoon
ex.cn: 迪斯尼动画片

ex.en: the cartoon figure of the mad scientist working in his laboratory
ex.cn: 疯狂的科学家在实验室工作的卡通形象

def:
n.（实）例，事例,情况，状况,诉讼（事件），案件，判例,容器（箱，盒）
vt.把…装入箱（或盒等）内,加盖于,包围，围住,[俚语]（尤指盗窃前）探察，侦查，窥测

ex.en: He actually became convinced that the nurses had an unanswerable case.
ex.cn: 他实际上已经相信了护士们的情况确实如此。

ex.en: He put the case to the Saudi Foreign Minister.
ex.cn: 他把这起事件向沙特外长作了说明。

ex.en: The Government is anxious to keep the whole case out of court.
ex.cn: 政府迫切希望整件事能够在庭外解决。

def:
n.现金,支付金额
vt.支付现款,兑现
adj.现金的

ex.en: All the bills had the same serial number. The cash was counterfeit.
ex.cn: 所有钞票的序列号都是一样的。这些钱是伪钞。

ex.en: This, after all, is a company which is awash with cash.
ex.cn: 这毕竟是一家现金充裕的公司。

ex.en: The war against drug peddling is all about cash.
ex.cn: 禁毒斗争归根到底是钱的问题。

def:
n.城堡，堡垒,象棋中的车
vt.把…置于城堡中,（下国际象棋时）用车护（王）

ex.en: He was riding on his horse looking for the castle.
ex.cn: 他正骑着马寻找那座城堡。

ex.en: The Lawn Tennis Association suspended Mr Castle from the British team.
ex.cn: 草地网球协会暂停了卡斯尔先生在英国队的职务。

ex.en: The island is surmounted by a huge black castle.
ex.cn: 岛的最高处耸立着一座巨大的黑色城堡。

def:
vt.赶上,接住,引起,看见
vt.& vi.（使）被钩住，（使）被卡住
n.抓,隐情,捕获量,挂钩
vi.锁住,着火,[棒球]当接球手
adj.迷惑人的,令人容易上当的,引人注目的,令人感兴趣的

ex.en: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
ex.cn: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

ex.en: The teapot came with a stand to catch the drips.
ex.cn: 那把茶壶配有一个可以接滴水的茶托。

ex.en: The white sails billow with the breezes they catch.
ex.cn: 一张张白帆随着微风舞动。

def: n.（总称）牛，牲口,畜生,无价值的人,〈美俚〉女学生

ex.en: The old stone cattle trough still sits by the main entrance.
ex.cn: 陈旧的石制牛食槽仍然放在大门口。

ex.en: Outside, two old boys lingered on the street corner discussing cattle.
ex.cn: 两个老头儿在外面街角迟迟不走，聊着牛的事情。

ex.en: Cowboys drove covered wagons and rode horses, lassoing cattle.
ex.cn: 牛仔们有的赶着大篷车，有的骑着马，抛套索捕牛。

def:
n.原因,动机,理由,事业
vt.成为…的原因,导致,引起,使遭受

ex.en: His misunderstanding of language was the primary cause of his other problems.
ex.cn: 他对语言的误解是引起其他问题的主要原因。

ex.en: Accidents are still the number one cause of premature death for Americans.
ex.cn: 交通事故仍然是造成美国人过早死亡的头号因素。

ex.en: Investment could dry up and that could cause the economy to falter.
ex.cn: 投资可能会中断，而这会引起经济衰退。

def:
n.洞穴,〈方〉地窖
vt.& vi.（使）塌陷，倒塌,暗中破坏
vi.屈服

ex.en: But in some respects cave dwellers were far cleverer than us.
ex.cn: 但是在某些方面穴居人要比我们聪明得多。

ex.en: Most of the mouth of the cave was submerged in the lake.
ex.cn: 洞口大半都淹没在湖里。

ex.en: The force of the water washed him back into the cave.
ex.cn: 大水把他冲回到洞里。

def: n.天花板,最高限度,云幕高度,隔板，舱室垫板

ex.en: Flavell had accidentally discharged a pistol, firing it into the ceiling.
ex.cn: 弗拉维尔不小心扳动了一把手枪的扳机，子弹射入了天花板。

ex.en: The bullet slammed into the ceiling, spraying them with bits of plaster.
ex.cn: 子弹砰地射进了天花板，掉落的石膏碎片落了他们一身。

ex.en: Pinks and beiges were chosen to echo the colours of the ceiling.
ex.cn: 选用了粉红色和米色，以跟从天花板的颜色。

def: v.庆祝,祝贺,举行宗教庆典,歌颂

ex.en: The banks have had precious little to celebrate recently.
ex.cn: 银行最近没几件值得庆贺的事。

ex.en: She arrived in St Ives to celebrate the Queen's Silver Jubilee.
ex.cn: 她抵达了圣艾夫斯以庆祝女王登基25周年。

ex.en: The Vietnamese government has fixed on May 19th to celebrate his anniversary.
ex.cn: 越南政府已经决定于5月19日庆祝他的诞辰。

def: n.分,一分钱的硬币,零钱,（作单位的）百

ex.en: By 1973 the government deficit equalled thirty per cent of GNP.
ex.cn: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。

ex.en: Almost ninety per cent of all rapes and violent assaults went unreported.
ex.cn: 几乎90%的强奸案和暴力侵害案都没有报案。

ex.en: "Prices are down 40 per cent since Christmas," he lamented.
ex.cn: “圣诞节以来物价降了4成，”他悲叹道。

def:
adj.中央的，中心的,重要的，核心的
n.电话总局,电话转接员

ex.en: The central heating's been turned off. I've turned it on again.
ex.cn: 中央供暖系统已经关上。我又将它打开了。

ex.en: Non-violence and patience are the central tenets of their faith.
ex.cn: 非暴力和忍耐是他们的信仰的核心原则。

ex.en: What drew him to the area was its proximity to central London.
ex.cn: 吸引他到该地区的原因是那里靠近伦敦市中心。

def:
n.中心,（市镇的）中心区,中心点,中枢
vt.& vi.置于中央,集中,把…当作中心,（使）成为中心

ex.en: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
ex.cn: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

ex.en: The new shopping centre was constructed at a cost of 1.1 million.
ex.cn: 新的购物中心耗资110万建成。

ex.en: Now we live further away from the city centre.
ex.cn: 现在我们住得离市中心更远了。

def:
n.中心,（球队的） 中锋,中心区,中枢
adj.中央的，位于正中的,（在）中心的
vt.集中,使聚集在一点,定中心,居中
vi.居中，有中心，被置于中心

ex.en: Volunteers constitute more than 95% of The Center's work force.
ex.cn: 该中心95%以上的工作人员是志愿者.

ex.en: The Leisure Center is a long and low modern building.
ex.cn: 休闲中心是一个狭长而低矮的现代建筑。

ex.en: He is currently being held in a metropolitan correctional center.
ex.cn: 他现在被关在一个大城市的改造中心。

def: n.百年，一世纪,百个,（板球）一百分,<美>百元钞票

ex.en: The first British attempt to colonize Ireland was in the twelfth century.
ex.cn: 英国最早尝试在爱尔兰开拓殖民地是在12世纪。

ex.en: The brooch dates back to the fourth century BC.
ex.cn: 这枚胸针的历史可以追溯到公元前4世纪。

ex.en: The greatest polemicist of the 20th century must be Leon Trotsky.
ex.cn: 20世纪最了不起的辩论家非列昂·托洛茨基莫属。

def:
adj.某一,必然的,已确定的
pron.[动词用复数]某些

ex.en: There is a certain impatience among some of the soldiers.
ex.cn: 有些士兵有点儿不耐烦。

ex.en: Over the years he's demonstrated a certain prescience in foreign affairs.
ex.cn: 这些年来，他已经在外交事务方面表现出一定的预见性。

ex.en: I feel certain that it will all turn out well.
ex.cn: 我觉得最后肯定会皆大欢喜。

def: adv.无疑,当然,确定,肯定

ex.en: It is certainly worth checking up on your benefit entitlements.
ex.cn: 查清楚你可以享受哪些福利是绝对有必要的。

ex.en: My audience certainly isn't the proverbial man in the street.
ex.cn: 我的观众当然不是街上的平头百姓。

ex.en: He has almost certainly blown his chance of touring India this winter.
ex.cn: 他几乎肯定失去了今冬去印度旅行的机会。

def:
n.链子，链条,连锁，连续,拘束,连锁店或旅馆系列的事物
vt.用铁链锁住,监禁，束缚

ex.en: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
ex.cn: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

ex.en: The islands lie at the southern end of the Kurile chain.
ex.cn: 这些岛屿位于千岛群岛的南端。

ex.en: Whenever recession strikes, a chain reaction is set into motion.
ex.cn: 只要经济不景气，连锁反应就开始了。

def:
n.椅子,大学教授职位,主持会议的主席（的席位或职位）,讲座
vt.主持,使…入座,使就任要职

ex.en: He sat penitently in his chair by the window.
ex.cn: 他懊悔地坐在靠窗的椅子上。

ex.en: Bob slid from his chair and lay prone on the floor.
ex.cn: 鲍勃从椅子上滑下来，趴在了地板上。

ex.en: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
ex.cn: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

def:
n.（主持会议的）主席,委员长,（委员会的）委员长,（公司等的）董事长
vt.担任…的主席

ex.en: When the chairman of Campbell's retired, McGovern was named as his successor.
ex.cn: 坎贝尔公司的总裁退休后，麦戈文被选定为继任者。

ex.en: He picked up the phone expecting to hear the chairman's gruff voice.
ex.cn: 他拿起电话，心想会听到主席粗哑的嗓音。

ex.en: Candidates are urgently sought for the post of Conservative party chairman.
ex.cn: 保守党主席的职位急寻候选人。

def:
n.粉笔，白垩,用粉笔画的记号,〈英〉（比赛）得分纪录，记入借方的款项,〈美俚〉牛奶
v.用粉笔写（记下）,用白垩粉擦（桌球杆等）,使苍白,（英）把（酒钱）记于（某人）账上

ex.en: The two places, he insists, are as different as chalk and cheese.
ex.cn: 他坚持说那两个地方有天壤之别。

ex.en: With a stick of chalk he wrote her order on a blackboard.
ex.cn: 他用一截粉笔将她的指示写在黑板上。

ex.en: the chalk cliffs of southern England
ex.cn: 英格兰南部的白垩质峭壁

def:
n.机会，机遇,概率，可能性,偶然，运气
v.偶然发生,冒险,碰巧,偶然被发现
adj.意外的,偶然的,碰巧的

ex.en: They had met by chance at university and finished up getting married.
ex.cn: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。

ex.en: If cancers are spotted early there'sa high chance of survival.
ex.cn: 如果癌症在早期发现的话，存活的几率会很高。

ex.en: He did not get a chance to deepen his knowledge of Poland.
ex.cn: 他没有机会更深入地了解波兰。

def:
vt.改变，变更,交换，替换,兑换,换衣服（床单）
vi.改变，转变,交换，互换,换衣，更衣
n.变化，改变,交换，交替,零钱，找头,代替物

ex.en: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
ex.cn: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

ex.en: 1998 was an important year for everyone: a time of change.
ex.cn: 1998年对所有人来说都是重要的一年：那是个变革的时期。

ex.en: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
ex.cn: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

def:
n.章，回,（俱乐部、协会等的）分会,人生或历史上的重要时期
vt.把…分成章节

ex.en: Uncle Richard intoned a chapter from the Bible and improvised a prayer.
ex.cn: 理查德叔叔吟诵了《圣经》中的一章，又即兴作了一段祈祷文。

ex.en: We saw in Chapter 16 how annual cash budgets are produced.
ex.cn: 在第16章我们了解了年度现金预算是怎样制订的。

ex.en: This point is developed further at the end of this chapter.
ex.cn: 这一点在本章结尾处有进一步阐释。

def:
vt.装载,控诉,使充电,索（价）
vi.索价,向前冲,记在账上,充电
n.费用,指示,掌管,指责

ex.en: But legal experts are not sure if such a charge can stick.
ex.cn: 但法律专家们不能肯定这一指控是否成立。

ex.en: Customers who arrange overdrafts will face a monthly charge of £5.
ex.cn: 透支的客户每月要缴纳5英镑的费用。

ex.en: He has admitted the charge and will be sentenced later.
ex.cn: 他已经认罪，会在晚些时候宣判。

def:
vi.聊天,闲谈,参加网络闲聊
n.（尤指非正式的）谈话,鸣禽,[植] 柔荑花序（如柳絮）
vt.与…攀谈,与…搭讪（或调情）

ex.en: You can chat to other people who are online.
ex.cn: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

ex.en: Whatever you want to chat about, we'll do it tonight.
ex.cn: 不管你想聊些什么，我们今晚聊个够。

ex.en: I thought I'd, you know, have a chat with you.
ex.cn: 我想我应该，呃，和你谈谈。

def:
adj.便宜的，廉价的,劣质的，低劣的,小气的，可鄙的
adv.便宜地,卑鄙地

ex.en: We will end up living in a society where life is cheap.
ex.cn: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。

ex.en: Calls cost 36p (cheap rate) and 48p (peak rate) per minute.
ex.cn: 电话每分钟36便士（优惠费率）和48便士（高峰费率）。

ex.en: Cheap goods are available, but not in sufficient quantities to satisfy demand.
ex.cn: 有一些廉价的商品，但是数量不足以满足需求。

def:
vt.欺骗，诈骗,误导，愚弄,躲避，逃脱
vi.作弊，行骗,犯规,俚〉不忠,消磨，解（闷），消除（疲劳）
n.欺骗（行为）,骗子,雀麦,〈美俚〉反光镜

ex.en: I know it sounds unbelievable but I never wanted to cheat.
ex.cn: 我知道听上去难以置信，但我从不想撒谎。

ex.en: He raised his right fist and declaimed: "Liar and cheat!"
ex.cn: 他举起右拳高喊：“骗子，骗子！”

ex.en: She is accused of attempting to cheat the taxman.
ex.cn: 她被指控企图蒙骗税务员。

def:
vt.检查，核对,制止，抑制,在…上打勾
vi.核实，查核,中止,打勾,[象棋]将一军
n.<美>支票,制止，抑制,检验，核对

ex.en: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly.
ex.cn: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

ex.en: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
ex.cn: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

ex.en: Sex education is also expected to help check the spread of AIDS.
ex.cn: 人们还希望性教育有助于控制艾滋病的蔓延。

def:
n.脸颊，脸蛋,无礼而放肆的行为，厚颜,半边屁股,两侧相对的物体
vt.对…无礼地说话

ex.en: She knelt and brushed her lips softly across Michael's cheek.
ex.cn: 她跪了下来，轻吻迈克尔的脸颊。

ex.en: He kissed her on the cheek. "Best of luck!"
ex.cn: 他吻了吻她的脸颊。“祝你好运！”

ex.en: How did you get that bruise on your cheek?
ex.cn: 你脸上的淤伤是怎么搞的？

def:
vt.欢呼,使高兴,为…喝彩,为…加油
n.欢呼，喝彩,兴致勃勃，愉快,心情,令人愉快的事
vi.欢呼,感到高兴

ex.en: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
ex.cn: 士兵对上校报以震天的欢呼声。

ex.en: A thousand supporters packed into the stadium to cheer them on.
ex.cn: 1,000名支持者挤进体育馆里为他们加油。

ex.en: I wrote that song just to cheer myself up.
ex.cn: 我写那首歌是给我自己打气的。

def:
n.奶酪,<俚>微笑
vt.<俚>停止

ex.en: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
ex.cn: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。

ex.en: The two places, he insists, are as different as chalk and cheese.
ex.cn: 他坚持说那两个地方有天壤之别。

ex.en: She offered Molly tidbits: a chicken drumstick, some cheese.
ex.cn: 她给了莫莉一些吃的：一根鸡腿下段和一些奶酪。

def:
adj.化学的,用化学方法制造的，化学作用的
n.化学药品，化学制品

ex.en: Some of the companies illegally sent the wherewithal for making chemical weapons.
ex.cn: 有些公司非法为制造化学武器提供所需的资金和设备等。

ex.en: The chemical structure of this particular molecule is very unusual.
ex.cn: 这个特殊分子的化学结构很不寻常。

ex.en: The chemical companies had amalgamated into a vast conglomerate.
ex.cn: 那些化学品公司已经合并成一个庞大的企业集团。

def: n.化学家,药剂师,药商,药房

ex.en: She worked as a research chemist.
ex.cn: 她曾经是化学研究员。

ex.en: Chemist stores upped sales by 63 percent.
ex.cn: 药店销量增加了63％。

ex.en: There's a chemist's shop not a hundred miles from Dumfries.
ex.cn: 这儿有一家离邓费利斯不远的药店.

def: n.化学,物质的化学组成（或性质），化学作用（现象）,（常指有强烈性吸引力的）两人间的关系,〈比喻〉神秘的变化（过程）

ex.en: The Oxford Chemistry Primers aim to cover important topics in organic chemistry.
ex.cn: 《牛津化学初级读本》丛书旨在论述有机化学中的重要问题。

ex.en: He is more highly educated, with a PhD in Chemistry.
ex.cn: 他受过更高的教育，拥有化学博士学位。

ex.en: I wasn't too keen on physics and chemistry.
ex.cn: 我对物理和化学不是太感喜爱。

def:
n.<英>支票
na.“check”的变体

ex.en: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
ex.cn: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

ex.en: Send a cheque for £18.99 plus £2 for postage and packing.
ex.cn: 请寄上18.99英镑的支票，外加2英镑的邮资和包装费。

ex.en: Then I remembered the cheque, which cheered me up.
ex.cn: 然后我想起了那张支票，这让我精神大振。

def: n.胸部，胸腔,箱子,金库,资金

ex.en: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
ex.cn: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

ex.en: Breathe out and ease your knees in toward your chest.
ex.cn: 呼气，膝部放松向胸部靠拢。

ex.en: After more misses, they finally put two arrows into the lion's chest.
ex.cn: 又射偏了几次之后,他们终于把两支箭射入了狮子的胸膛.

def:
n.鸡,鸡肉,胆小鬼,懦夫
adj.胆怯的,幼小的,胆小的
vi.以畏缩的方式去做，失去勇气,在最后一刻因胆怯而退出了

ex.en: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
ex.cn: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

ex.en: I'm scared of the dark. I'm a big chicken.
ex.cn: 我怕黑，是个十足的胆小鬼。

ex.en: They tend to buy cheap processed foods like canned chicken and macaroni.
ex.cn: 他们往往会买便宜的加工食品，像鸡肉罐头和通心粉之类的。

def:
adj.级别最高的,总的,主要的,最重要的
n.族长,酋长,首领,主管人员

ex.en: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
ex.cn: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

ex.en: The Chief Constable's clipped tones crackled over the telephone line.
ex.cn: 电话线那头噼里啪啦地传来警察局长短促的声音。

ex.en: In the squash court his chief aim is to flatten me.
ex.cn: 在壁球场上他的主要目标就是击败我。

def: n.小孩，孩子,幼稚的人,产物,弟子

ex.en: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
ex.cn: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

ex.en: The child kept her eyes fixed on the wall behind him.
ex.cn: 这个小女孩眼睛一直紧盯着他身后的那堵墙。

ex.en: Don't leave a child alone in a room with an open fire.
ex.cn: 房间里有裸露的明火时，不要让孩子独处其中。

def: n.童年，儿童时代,早期

ex.en: His parents' obsession with keeping up appearances haunted his childhood.
ex.cn: 父母过于爱面子的做法在他儿时一直困扰着他。

ex.en: Her childhood was overshadowed by her mother's incarceration in a psychiatric hospital.
ex.cn: 她的母亲被关在精神病院，这给她的童年蒙上了阴影。

ex.en: They believe that a tough, materially poor childhood is character-building.
ex.cn: 他们认为一个艰难贫困的童年有助于性格的培养。

def: n.烟囱,玻璃灯罩,烟囱状东西,壁炉

ex.en: A thin twist of smoke curled from the cottage's single chimney.
ex.cn: 一缕盘旋的轻烟从农舍唯一的烟囱里缭绕升起。

ex.en: Smoke was curling up the chimney.
ex.cn: 烟从烟囱里袅袅升起。

ex.en: The chimney was smoking fiercely.
ex.cn: 烟囱里浓烟滚滚。

def: n.瓷器,瓷餐具,杯、盘、碟等的总称,陶器

ex.en: China enters a new five-year plan period next year.
ex.cn: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。

ex.en: Queen Mary started the fashion for blue and white china in England.
ex.cn: 玛丽女王开启了青花瓷在英格兰的流行风尚。

ex.en: He toyed with the idea of going to China.
ex.cn: 他动过去中国的念头，但并没当真。

def:
n.巧克力,巧克力糖,巧克力色
adj.（含有）巧克力的,巧克力色的

ex.en: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
ex.cn: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

ex.en: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
ex.cn: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

ex.en: When depressed, they dramatically overindulge in chocolate and sweets.
ex.cn: 情绪低落的时候，她们就疯狂地猛吃巧克力和糖果。

def:
n.选择,选择权,精选品,入选者
adj.上等的，精选的

ex.en: Helen's choice of lipstick was a good match for her skin-tone.
ex.cn: 海伦选择的唇膏很适合她的肤色。

ex.en: In many societies children still marry someone of their parents' choice.
ex.cn: 在许多社会，子女结婚仍然只能听从父母之命。

ex.en: Although he was only grumbling, his choice of words made Rodney angry.
ex.cn: 尽管他只是在咕哝，可是他的措词却让罗德妮恼火。

def:
vt.挑选,认为…比其它更可取,决定或选定
vi.选择,进行挑选

ex.en: For added protection choose a lipstick with a sun screen.
ex.cn: 选择防晒护唇膏来增强保护。

ex.en: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
ex.cn: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

ex.en: Knox had taken it on himself to choose the wine.
ex.cn: 诺克斯擅自作主，选了葡萄酒。

def: n.圣诞节

ex.en: "Prices are down 40 per cent since Christmas," he lamented.
ex.cn: “圣诞节以来物价降了4成，”他悲叹道。

ex.en: "Will Joe be here at Christmas?" — "I expect so."
ex.cn: “圣诞节时乔会来这里吗？”——“我想会的。”

ex.en: Authorities requisitioned hotel rooms to lodge more than 3,000 stranded Christmas vacationers.
ex.cn: 当局征用旅馆房间安顿了3,000多名无处落脚的圣诞度假者。

def:
n.[宗]教堂,[宗]教徒,[宗]教派,[宗]教会
adj.教会的,礼拜的
vt.领…到教堂接受宗教仪式

ex.en: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
ex.cn: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

ex.en: The building he was lodged in turned out to be a church.
ex.cn: 原来，他租住的那栋建筑是一座教堂。

ex.en: He maintained an ambivalent attitude to the Church throughout his long life.
ex.cn: 在他漫长的一生中，他对基督教信仰始终是一种摇摆不定的态度。

def: n.<美>纸烟，香烟

ex.en: He lit a cigaret in order to calm his mind.
ex.cn: 他点燃一支香烟，镇定一下情绪。

ex.en: I like having cigaret with my drink.
ex.cn: 我喝酒时喜欢抽烟。

ex.en: Put your cigaret out before you put the light out.
ex.cn: 在熄灯前要把雪茄烟弄熄.

def: n.纸烟，香烟

ex.en: Over coffee, she lit a cigarette, her eyes daring him to comment.
ex.cn: 喝咖啡时，她点燃了一支烟，用挑衅的眼神看着他，谅他也不敢吭声。

ex.en: The product looks and burns like a regular cigarette.
ex.cn: 这种产品看起来和点燃后都与常见的香烟没什么两样。

ex.en: Newman poured more black coffee and lit a cigarette.
ex.cn: 纽曼又倒了些黑咖啡，接着点了支烟。

def: n.电影院,电影艺术,电影业,电影

ex.en: Working with Ford closely, I fell in love with the cinema.
ex.cn: 与福特的密切合作开始令我爱上了电影。

ex.en: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer in its vitality and freshness.
ex.cn: 当代非洲电影在活力和新颖性上颇足称道。

ex.en: Many cinema-goers were stunned by the film's violent and tragic end.
ex.cn: 许多来看电影的人都被这部影片暴力而悲惨的结局所震惊。

def:
n.圆,圆状物,一圈,圈子
vt.圈出，包围,绕…运转
vi.环绕，盘旋

ex.en: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral.
ex.cn: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

ex.en: He is a cultured man with a wide circle of friends.
ex.cn: 他为人文雅，结交广泛。

ex.en: They formed a circle and sang "Auld Lang Syne"
ex.cn: 他们围成一个圆圈，唱起了《友谊地久天长》。

def: n.公民,国民,市民,平民

ex.en: I invite every citizen to carefully study the document.
ex.cn: 我请每位市民都仔细研读该文件。

ex.en: She's Italian by birth but is now an Australian citizen.
ex.cn: 她生于意大利，但现在是澳大利亚公民。

ex.en: She became a US citizen.
ex.cn: 她成了美国公民。

def: n.城市,全市居民,（由国王或女王授予特权，通常有大教堂的）特许市,（由政府授予特权的）特权市

ex.en: After years of neglect and decline the city was cleaning itself up.
ex.cn: 多年的玩忽职守和经济萧条过后，这个城市在进行自我整顿。

ex.en: The journey ends in the ancient city of Marrakesh.
ex.cn: 旅行的终点是马拉喀什古城。

ex.en: Leningrad was the third alien city to offer him a surrogate home.
ex.cn: 列宁格勒是他在异地安家的第三个外国城市。

def:
n.班,等级,阶级,种类
vt.把…归入某等级，把…看作（或分类、归类）,把…编入某一班级
adj.很好的，优秀的，出色的
vi.属于…类（或等级），被列为某类（或某级）

ex.en: The price includes two economy class airfares from Brisbane to Los Angeles.
ex.cn: 这一价格包括两张从布里斯班到洛杉矶的经济舱机票。

ex.en: There was very little snobbery or class-consciousness in the wartime navy.
ex.cn: 战时的海军中很少有势利眼，阶级意识也不强。

ex.en: He was not perhaps physically the strongest in the class.
ex.cn: 他可能不是全班身体最壮的。

def: n.（同班）同学,级友

ex.en: He made a profession of friendship to his classmate Mary.
ex.cn: 他向他的同学玛丽表白了他的友情.

ex.en: His classmate do not enjoy his company because he always backbite others.
ex.cn: 他的同学不喜欢和他在一起,因为他老是在背后诽谤别人.

ex.en: Can you recommend a classmate who can take up the job?
ex.cn: 你能不能推荐一位能承担这项工作的同学?

def: n.教室，课堂,教学活动，教学方法

ex.en: The classroom teacher must be sensitive to a child'sneeds.
ex.cn: 班主任必须对小学生的需求体察入微。

ex.en: School trips give children firsthand experience not available in the classroom.
ex.cn: 学校组织的出游能让孩子们获得在课堂上得不到的亲身体验。

ex.en: The people that she had in her classroom were beginning learners.
ex.cn: 她带的这班学生都是初学者。

def:
adj.干净的,无污染的,空白的,文明的
v.打扫,变干净,除去…的灰尘,清除内脏
adv.彻底地,完全地
n.打扫,清扫

ex.en: They were more concerned about the dogs' welfare than a clean getaway.
ex.cn: 他们更加关心那些狗的安危，而非自己如何干净利落地脱身。

ex.en: When he had finished washing he began to wipe the basin clean.
ex.cn: 他清洗完后开始把洗脸池擦拭干净。

ex.en: If you kept your nose clean, you had a job for life.
ex.cn: 如果你规规矩矩，就可以一辈子都捧着这个饭碗。

def:
adj.清楚的，明白的,清晰的，明亮的,清澈的,明确的
adv.完全地,清晰地,整整
vi.变明朗,变清澈
vt.扫除，除去,消除（嫌疑）,使清楚,使干净
n.空隙，空间

ex.en: It was clear Cohen didn't understand what Millard was driving at.
ex.cn: 看得出科恩并不明白米勒德想说什么。

ex.en: The rabbis try to steer clear of political questions.
ex.cn: 拉比们努力避开政治问题。

ex.en: Dig over any ground that is clear of crops and plants.
ex.cn: 把没种庄稼和植物的土地都深翻一遍。

def: adv.明亮地,明净地,明确地,显然地

ex.en: I clearly empathize with the people who live in those neighborhoods.
ex.cn: 我非常同情生活在那些地方的人们。

ex.en: He is clearly too partisan to be a referee.
ex.cn: 他倾向性过于明显，当不了裁判。

ex.en: The letter showed horribly clearly the workings of a twisted mind.
ex.cn: 那封信非常清楚地表明了一个变态者的思维方式。

def:
n.店员,办事员，职员,书记员,<古>牧师，教士
vi.当职员,当销售员

ex.en: A stupid medical clerk had slipped the wrong tab on his X-ray.
ex.cn: 一个蠢笨的医护人员一不留神在他的X光片上贴错了标签。

ex.en: "I've come to reclaim my property," she announced to the desk clerk.
ex.cn: “我来要求归还我的房产，”她向接待人员宣布。

ex.en: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
ex.cn: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。

def: adj.聪明的，灵巧的,英俊的，风采优雅的,性情温良的,油腔滑调的

ex.en: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
ex.cn: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

ex.en: Rowe does a very clever riff on the nature of prejudice.
ex.cn: 罗就偏见的本质讲了一番很精辟的话。

ex.en: Even clever people are not terribly clever when put on the spot.
ex.cn: 即便是聪明人在面对难题时也未必就能表现得特别聪明。

def:
v.攀登,爬,登山,上升
n.攀登,山，岩,增值,晋升

ex.en: In an embarrassing climb-down, the Home Secretary lifted the deportation threat.
ex.cn: 内务大臣尴尬地作出让步，解除了将其驱逐出境的威胁。

ex.en: She started once again on the steep upward climb.
ex.cn: 她又开始沿着陡峭的山路往上爬。

ex.en: The boys lifted up their legs, indicating they wanted to climb in.
ex.cn: 男孩们抬起腿，示意想要爬进来。

def: n.诊所，门诊部,特殊病例分析,临床讲授,临床实习课

ex.en: Charles was at the clinic recovering from an operation on his arm.
ex.cn: 查尔斯的胳膊动了手术，正在这家诊所进行康复治疗。

ex.en: She had an operation on her knee at the clinic.
ex.cn: 她在诊所做了个膝盖手术。

ex.en: He went to a clinic to cure his drinking and overeating.
ex.cn: 他去诊所戒酒并控制饮食。

def:
n.钟，时钟,计时器,秒表,仪表
vt.记录（时间或速度）,测…的速度
vi.打卡,记下时间

ex.en: It was just gone 7 o'clock this evening when I finished.
ex.cn: 今晚我做完的时候刚过7点。

ex.en: He sat listening to the tick of the grandfather clock.
ex.cn: 他坐在那儿，听着落地式大摆钟嘀嗒作响。

ex.en: Outside, Bruce glanced at his watch: "Dear me, nearly oneo'clock."
ex.cn: 出了门，布鲁斯瞥了一眼自己的手表，“天哪，快一点了。”

def:
adj.紧密的,亲密的,亲近的
vt.关,结束,使靠近
vi.关,结束,关闭
adv.紧密地
n.结束

ex.en: Three mortar shells had landed close to a crowd of people.
ex.cn: 3枚迫击炮弹落在人群旁。

ex.en: Warm weather has attracted the flat fish close to shore.
ex.cn: 煦暖的气候将比目鱼引到了近海。

ex.en: An airliner came close to disaster while approaching Heathrow Airport.
ex.cn: 一架大型客机在飞近希思罗机场时差点儿发生空难。

def: adv.接近地,紧密地,严密地,亲近地

ex.en: Working with Ford closely, I fell in love with the cinema.
ex.cn: 与福特的密切合作开始令我爱上了电影。

ex.en: Wherever they went they were closely followed by security men.
ex.cn: 不管上哪儿，保安人员都紧跟在他们身后。

ex.en: He had worked closely with the President during his governorship.
ex.cn: 他在任州长期间与总统紧密合作。

def: n.布，织物,一块布,用作某种用途的布，桌布，擦布，揩布,（统称）牧师

ex.en: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
ex.cn: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

ex.en: She passed the needle through the rough cloth, back and forth.
ex.cn: 她一针一针地缝那块粗布。

ex.en: In its untreated state the carbon fibre material is rather like cloth.
ex.cn: 原始的碳纤维材料很像布料。

def:
n.衣服，衣物,寝具
v.穿（衣）( clothe的第三人称单数),给…提供衣服,（用语言）表达,覆盖

ex.en: Her bed was crisply made, her clothes put away.
ex.cn: 她的床收拾得很整洁，衣服也收起来了。

ex.en: Many of the clothes come from the world's top fashion houses.
ex.cn: 这些服装中有很多出自世界顶级时装设计公司。

ex.en: His work clothes, having become saturated with oil, had to be cleaned.
ex.cn: 他的工作服已经被油浸透，该洗洗了。

def:
n.衣服,服装,[航]帆装
v.覆盖(clothe的现在分词),给…提供衣服

ex.en: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
ex.cn: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。

ex.en: The first plane-loads of food, children's clothing and medical supplies began arriving.
ex.cn: 首批飞机运送的食物、儿童衣物和药品开始抵达。

ex.en: Alexandra looked plump and awkward in her cast-off clothing.
ex.cn: 亚历山德拉穿着那身过时的衣裳，显得臃肿笨拙。

def:
n.云,云状物,一团,阴影
vi.布满云,显得阴沉,看起来忧愁）
vt.使难以理解,使…朦胧不清,使减少乐趣,混淆

ex.en: The powdery dust rose in a cloud around him.
ex.cn: 一团粉尘在他周围扬起。

ex.en: The American edition of "Cloud Street" is already in its third printing.
ex.cn: 美国版的《云街》已经是第三次印刷了。

ex.en: A sudden break in the cloud allowed rescuers to spot Michael Benson.
ex.cn: 天气的突然放晴帮助救援人员找到了迈克尔·本森。

def: adj.多云的,阴天的,朦胧的,愁容满面的

ex.en: a grey, cloudy day
ex.cn: 灰暗多云的天空

ex.en: Only a tiny patch of blue was visible in the cloudy sky.
ex.cn: 多云的天空中只见到一小块儿湛蓝.

ex.en: Bob always enjoys sailing, even though the weather is cloudy.
ex.cn: 鲍勃总是很喜欢航行, 即使空中乌云密布.

def:
n.俱乐部，会所,社团,夜总会,（纸牌的）梅花
vt.联合,募集,用棍棒打,[棒球]击球
vi.组成俱乐部,共同出资
adj.俱乐部的

ex.en: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
ex.cn: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

ex.en: This season the club has had 73,500 season-ticket holders.
ex.cn: 本赛季该俱乐部已经有73,500名持有季票的观众。

ex.en: People at the club think very highly of him.
ex.cn: 俱乐部的人很佩服他。

def:
n.煤,煤块,煤堆,木炭
vi.上煤,加煤
vt.给…加煤,把…烧成炭

ex.en: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
ex.cn: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

ex.en: The power stations burn coal from the Ruhr region.
ex.cn: 发电站烧的煤产自鲁尔地区。

ex.en: Acid rain is not straightforwardly attributable to the burning of coal.
ex.cn: 酸雨并非简单地由烧煤造成。

def:
n.海岸,滑坡
vi.（汽车或自行车）（尤指不用动力向山坡下）滑行,（做事）不出力,不费力地取得成功,（不用多少动力）快速平稳地移动
vt.沿海岸航行

ex.en: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
ex.cn: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

ex.en: The Atlantic coast is within sight of the hotel.
ex.cn: 从宾馆可以看见大西洋海岸。

ex.en: He recognized the coast of England through a veil of mist.
ex.cn: 透过薄雾他认出了那是英格兰的海岸线。

def:
n.上衣，外套
vt.给…穿上上衣[外套],盖上

ex.en: He cleaned the flakes away with his coat sleeve.
ex.cn: 他用大衣袖子把碎屑掸掉。

ex.en: A black coat always looks smart and will never date.
ex.cn: 黑色外套看起来总是很潇洒，而且永远也不会落伍。

ex.en: I opened my coat and let him see the belt.
ex.cn: 我解开外衣，让他看那条皮带。

def:
n.公鸡,成熟雄鸟,首领，领导,龙头
vt.使某物竖起,使某物倾斜,使朝上,扳上扳机
vi.翘起，竖起,大摇大摆

ex.en: His hands were too weak to cock his revolver.
ex.cn: 他的手没劲儿，扳不动左轮手枪的扳机。

ex.en: He was in danger of making a real cock-up of this.
ex.cn: 他很有可能会把这事弄得一团糟。

ex.en: This was just an administrative cock-up.
ex.cn: 这纯粹是管理上的混乱。

def: n.咖啡豆,咖啡粉,（一杯）咖啡,非正式的社交集会

n.硬币,金属钱币,[建筑]拐角，墙角石
vt.制造硬币,杜撰,创造

ex.en: I pulled a coin from my pocket and flipped it.
ex.cn: 我从口袋里掏出一个硬币，把它弹向空中。

ex.en: Thirteen per cent of Christie's coin and banknote auction went unsold.
ex.cn: 佳士得13%的硬币和纸币拍卖流拍。

ex.en: I put the coin in the machine and pulled the lever.
ex.cn: 我把硬币投入机器，拉动控制杆。

def:
adj.寒冷的,冷淡的，无情的,失去知觉的,[艺]有冷感的，冷色的
n.寒冷,感冒，伤风
adv.完全地

ex.en: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face.
ex.cn: 雾蒙蒙的寒冷空气使他脸上感觉很舒爽。

ex.en: Basal metabolism is much lower for creatures in cold water.
ex.cn: 冷水中生物的基础代谢速度要低很多。

ex.en: Victorian houses can seem cold with their lofty ceilings and rambling rooms.
ex.cn: 维多利亚式房屋屋顶高耸，房间布局凌乱，因此可能会显得较为阴冷。

def:
vt.收集,收藏,接走,聚积
vi.募捐,募集
adj.由受话人付费的

ex.en: Methane gas does collect in the mines around here.
ex.cn: 周围的矿井里的确有沼气聚积。

ex.en: He was grateful for a chance to relax and collect his thoughts.
ex.cn: 他很庆幸有机会放松放松，整理一下自己的思绪。

ex.en: Like a telescope it has a curved mirror to collect the sunlight.
ex.cn: 和望远镜一样，它有一个曲面镜可以积聚阳光。

def: n.大学,（英国）学院,学会,（尤指必须交费的）中学

ex.en: I've had the hots for him ever since he came to college.
ex.cn: 自从他来上大学后，我就对他春心萌动。

ex.en: We were in the same college, which was male-only at that time.
ex.cn: 我们那时在同一所学院，当时只招男生。

ex.en: The teacher training college put up a plaque to the college's founder.
ex.cn: 那所教师培训学院为该学院的创立者立了一块纪念牌匾。

def:
n.<美>颜色，色彩,肤色，脸色，血色,颜料，染料,本质
v.<美>给…涂颜色,改变…的颜色,粉饰，渲染，使带上色彩,脸红

ex.en: Nancy liked it well enough, but complained about the color.
ex.cn: 南希还蛮喜欢它，只是有点不满意它的颜色。

ex.en: He said he wanted a color-blind government where everybody's treated the same.
ex.cn: 他说想要一个对所有人一视同仁、没有种族偏见的政府。

ex.en: He denies making off-color remarks about women.
ex.cn: 他否认曾口出对女性不敬的污言秽语。

def:
n.颜色,肤色,彩色,（用于服装、旗帜等代表团队、学校、政党或国家的）色彩
vt.（用颜料、彩色笔等）为…着色,粉饰,歪曲,使脸红
vi.变色

ex.en: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
ex.cn: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

ex.en: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
ex.cn: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

ex.en: The only difference between us is the colour of our skins.
ex.cn: 我们之间唯一的差别就是肤色。

def:
n.梳子,梳棉机,鸡冠状的东西,蜂窝状的东西
vt.梳理,彻底搜查
vi.涌起，卷起

ex.en: We went over that area with a fine-tooth comb.
ex.cn: 我们对那个地区进行了彻底的搜查。

ex.en: Your hair needs a good comb.
ex.cn: 你的头发得好好梳理一下。

ex.en: She bent to retrieve her comb from the floor.
ex.cn: 她弯腰从地上捡起她的梳子。

def:
vi.来,开始,出现,发生
vt.做,装扮…的样子,将满（…岁）
int.嗨！

ex.en: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
ex.cn: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

ex.en: Come along, lad. Time for you to get home.
ex.cn: 来吧，小伙子。你该回家了。

ex.en: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
ex.cn: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

def:
n.安慰,舒适,使人舒服的事物,给予援助或安慰的人或事
vt.安慰，使舒适,使（痛苦等）缓和

ex.en: He began to comfort me with such unaccustomed gentleness.
ex.cn: 他开始以那种少有的温柔安慰我。

ex.en: This new design will offer undreamed-of levels of comfort, safety and speed.
ex.cn: 这种新设计将会给您带来意想不到的舒适、安全和快捷。

ex.en: He found comfort in Eva's blind faith in him.
ex.cn: 伊娃对他的盲目信任让他感到宽慰。

def: adj.舒适的,安逸的，处于轻松的,充裕的

ex.en: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
ex.cn: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

ex.en: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
ex.cn: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。

ex.en: Now sit down and make yourself comfortable. You must be very tired.
ex.cn: 现在坐下来，让自己舒服些，你一定很累了。

def:
adj.普通的,通俗的,[数学]公共的,共有的
n.[法律]（对土地、水域的）共有权,公共用地,普通,平民

ex.en: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
ex.cn: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

ex.en: Eczema is a common skin complaint which often runs in families.
ex.cn: 湿疹是一种常见的皮肤病，通常具遗传性。

ex.en: Canadian libel law is based on English common law.
ex.cn: 加拿大的诽谤法是以英国的习惯法为基础的。

def: n.共产主义,共产主义制度

ex.en: He was a politically conscious fighter for communism.
ex.cn: 在政治上,他是个自觉的共产主义战士.

ex.en: Our ultimate aim is to realize communism.
ex.cn: 我们的最终目的是实现共产主义.

ex.en: Tito forged a unique model of communism after breaking with Stalin in 1948.
ex.cn: 1948年铁托在和斯大林决裂后创建了一种独特的共产主义模式。

def:
n.同伴,[天]伴星(=~star),（用于书名）指南,同甘共苦的伙伴
vt.同行,陪伴

ex.en: He has been her constant companion for the last four months.
ex.cn: 4个月来，他一直陪伴在她身边。

ex.en: He was not a fit companion for their skipper that particular morning.
ex.cn: 那天早晨，他没能和队长配合好。

ex.en: You come over as a capable and amusing companion.
ex.cn: 你给人的感觉是一个能干、风趣的同伴。

def: n.公司，商号,作伴，伴侣，客人,连队，中队,（社交）集会，聚会

ex.en: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
ex.cn: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

ex.en: A changing world has put pressures on the corporation.
ex.cn: 日新月异的世界使这家公司感到了压力。

ex.en: The company I work for went through a rough patch.
ex.cn: 我所在的公司经历了一段困难时期。

def:
vt.& vi.比较，对照
vt.比拟，喻为,[语]构成
vi.相比，匹敌,比较，区别,比拟（常与to连用）
n.比较

ex.en: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
ex.cn: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

ex.en: How do the two techniques compare in terms of application?
ex.cn: 这两种手法实际运用起来哪个好一些？

ex.en: The more recent conifer plantations cannot yet compare with the old woodlands.
ex.cn: 年代较近的针叶树林场还比不上年代久远的林场。

def: vi.竞赛,竞争,比得上,参加比赛（或竞赛）

ex.en: They are now trying to compete on an equal footing.
ex.cn: 他们现在想要公平竞争。

ex.en: Until the matter is resolved the athletes will be ineligible to compete.
ex.cn: 除非这个问题得以解决，否则这些运动员没有资格参加比赛。

ex.en: Schools should not compete with each other or attempt to poach pupils.
ex.cn: 学校之间不应该相互竞争，也不应该企图挖走彼此的学生。

def: n.竞争,比赛,竞争者,[生]生存竞争

ex.en: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
ex.cn: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

ex.en: The very notion of price competition is foreign to many schools.
ex.cn: 价格竞争这个概念对于许多学校都很陌生。

ex.en: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
ex.cn: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

def: adj.竞争的，比赛的,（价格等）有竞争力的,（指人）好竞争的,[生化] 抑制酶作用的

ex.en: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
ex.cn: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

ex.en: The betting is that the experience will make Japan more competitive still.
ex.cn: 这场经历很有可能使日本更具竞争力。

ex.en: He did not particularly want to take up a competitive sport.
ex.cn: 他并不特别想从事竞技体育运动。

def:
adj.（用以强调）完全的,完成的,达到结尾的,完整的
vt.完成，使完满,完成或结束,填写（表格）

ex.en: It'll be two years before the process is complete.
ex.cn: 这个过程需要两年才能完成。

ex.en: Michael was given a complete going-over and then treated for glandular fever.
ex.cn: 迈克尔接受了全面体检，随后又进行了腺热治疗。

ex.en: Telling a complete stranger about your life is difficult.
ex.cn: 要对一个素昧平生的人谈自己的生活经历是比较困难。

def: n.（电子）计算机，电脑

ex.en: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
ex.cn: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

ex.en: Who wants to buy a computer from a failing company?
ex.cn: 谁愿意从一家要倒闭的公司买计算机呢？

ex.en: A toy store has marked down the Sonic Hedgehog computer game.
ex.cn: 一家玩具店降低了电脑游戏《刺猬索尼克》的售价。

def: n.同志,战友,忠实伙伴

ex.en: Mr Meridor's father was a comrade-in-arms of the party's founder.
ex.cn: 梅里多先生的父亲是该党创始人的战友。

ex.en: It goes without saying that we should help a comrade in difficulty.
ex.cn: 同志有困难当然要帮助.

ex.en: Whenever a comrade needs help, he is ready to give it.
ex.cn: 但凡同志们有困难, 他没有不热情帮助的.

def:
n.音乐会,一致，和谐
vt.通过双方协议来计划或安排,调整，解决
vi.协调一致行动

ex.en: He wants to act in concert with other nations.
ex.cn: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。

ex.en: Now his other major works are creeping back into concert programmes.
ex.cn: 现在他的其他主要作品又悄然出现在音乐会节目单上。

ex.en: In the end, we all decided to organize a concert for Easter.
ex.cn: 最终，我们一致决定组织一场复活节音乐会。

def:
n.状态,环境,健康状况,条款
vt.制约,限制,使习惯于,使适应
vt.& vi.对…具有重要影响,影响（某事发生的方式）,保持（头发或皮肤等的）健康,养护

ex.en: He was concerned with the enhancement of the human condition.
ex.cn: 他关心人类生存环境的改善。

ex.en: Rust and flaking paint mean the metalwork is in poor condition.
ex.cn: 生锈和掉漆说明金属配件损毁严重。

ex.en: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition.
ex.cn: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

def: n.祝贺，恭喜,贺词

ex.en: This is not a matter for self-congratulation.
ex.cn: 你不应该为此事沾沾自喜。

ex.en: We have received many letters of congratulation.
ex.cn: 我们收到了很多贺信。

ex.en: The letter arrived in congratulation of my graduation from the university.
ex.cn: 我收到了大学毕业的贺信.

def:
vt.连接，联结,使…有联系,为…接通电话,插入插座
vi.连接,建立关系,[体]成功击中

ex.en: Two cables connect to each corner of the plate.
ex.cn: 两条电缆连到金属板的每个角上。

ex.en: The fallopian tubes connect the ovaries with the uterus.
ex.cn: 输卵管连接着卵巢和子宫。

ex.en: You can connect the machine to your hi-fi.
ex.cn: 你可以把机器连在高保真音响上。

def:
vt.& vi.考虑,把（某人，某事）看作…，认为（某人，某事）如何,考虑，细想
vt.考虑,认为,看重,以为
vi.仔细考虑,深思

ex.en: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
ex.cn: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

ex.en: The jury will retire to consider its verdict today.
ex.cn: 陪审团今天将退庭商议裁决结果。

ex.en: Consider what your likes and dislikes are about your job.
ex.cn: 想想工作中哪些部分是自己喜欢的，哪些是不喜欢的。

def: n.建筑物,建造,解释,建造物

ex.en: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
ex.cn: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

ex.en: The construction industry is no longer as depressed as it was.
ex.cn: 建筑业不再像以往那样萧条了。

ex.en: Check the actual construction of the chair by looking underneath.
ex.cn: 看看椅子的下面，检查一下它的实际构造。

def: n.内容,（书等的）目录,满足,容量

ex.en: There are reports of widespread dis-content in the capital.
ex.cn: 有报道称首都弥漫着不满的情绪。

ex.en: Stricter controls were placed on the content of video films.
ex.cn: 对录像片内容实行了更为严格的监管。

ex.en: Not content with rescuing one theatre, Sally Green has taken on another.
ex.cn: 萨莉·格林不满足于挽救一家剧院，她又接手了另外一家。

def:
vt.竞争，为…而奋争,辩驳
vi.争斗,竞争,争夺

ex.en: The latest opinion polls are predicting a very close contest.
ex.cn: 最近的民意测验预测竞争将会非常激烈。

ex.en: This has stripped the contest down to its essentials.
ex.cn: 这就使比赛精简到最基本的环节。

ex.en: The contest was as much about personalities as it was about politics.
ex.cn: 竞赛比手段策略，也比个性。

def: n.上下文,背景,环境,语境

ex.en: I would qualify that by putting it into context.
ex.cn: 我会将它放入上下文中进行具体解释。

ex.en: It is important that we put Jesus into the context of history.
ex.cn: 我们将耶稣置于历史环境中来看是很重要的。

ex.en: Taxation is not popular in principle, merely acceptable in context.
ex.cn: 征税基本上是不受欢迎的，在一定情境中才勉强为人接受。

def:
n.大陆，陆地,欧洲大陆,<美>北美洲大陆
adj.自制的，克制的,节欲的,贞洁的,禁欲的

ex.en: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.
ex.cn: 其店铺跻身欧陆最时尚的店铺之列。

ex.en: The title track is a pointed meditation on a continent gone wrong.
ex.cn: 主打歌是对一个误入歧途的大陆的深刻沉思。

ex.en: The American continent's geography severely limited the lines of attack.
ex.cn: 美洲大陆的地形严重限制了进攻路线。

def: adv.不停地,持续地,屡屡地,一再地

ex.en: On the chilly seas, Keats became feverish, continually coughing up blood.
ex.cn: 在寒冷彻骨的海上，基茨开始发烧，不断地咯血。

ex.en: Sarah had been plagued continually by a series of minor illnesses.
ex.cn: 萨拉一直小病缠身。

ex.en: Japanese camera makers continually introduce whizzy new electronic models.
ex.cn: 日本的相机制造商不断推出最新的电子模型。

def:
vi.持续,逗留,维持原状
vt.延期,使延伸,使持续,继续说

ex.en: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
ex.cn: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

ex.en: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
ex.cn: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

ex.en: The President could continue to bash Democrats as being soft on crime.
ex.cn: 总统可能会继续抨击民主党人对待犯罪活动心慈手软。

def:
vt.控制,管理,限制,支配
n.支配权,操纵者,（对国家、地区、机构等的）管理权,（键盘上的）控制键

ex.en: The volume of scheduled flights is straining the air traffic control system.
ex.cn: 定期航班的数量正让空中交通指挥系统不堪重负。

ex.en: The passengers went through immigration control and collected their baggage.
ex.cn: 旅客通过入境检查后领取了自己的行李。

ex.en: Condoms are an effective method of birth control if used with care.
ex.cn: 如果使用得当，避孕套是很有效的避孕手段。

def: adj.方便的,[废语]适当的,[口语]近便的,实用的

ex.en: There wasn't even a convenient place for students to assemble between classes.
ex.cn: 在课间，学生们连一个方便凑在一起的地方都没有。

ex.en: "What time were you planning lunch?"—"Half past twelve, if that's convenient."
ex.cn: “你打算什么时候吃午饭？”“如果方便的话，12点半。”

ex.en: We cannot make this minority a convenient excuse to turn our backs.
ex.cn: 我们不能拿少数这几个人作为一种方便的借口而对此置之不理。

def: n.交谈，会话,交往，交际,会谈,（人与计算机的）人机对话

ex.en: He finished his conversation and stood up, looking straight at me.
ex.cn: 他说完话站起来，直视着我。

ex.en: They can't believe you can even hold a conversation.
ex.cn: 他们不敢相信你竟然能够把一场对话进行下去。

ex.en: I didn't let on to the staff what my conversation was.
ex.cn: 我没有将谈话内容向员工们透露。

def:
vt.& vi.烹调,编造,篡改,密谋
vt.烹调,煮
vi.烹调,做菜
n.厨师,厨子

ex.en: Captain Cook safely navigated his ship without accident for 100 voyages.
ex.cn: 库克船长驾驶的船安全出航100次无事故。

ex.en: He said that what they were up to would cook Krasky's goose.
ex.cn: 他说他们暗中进行的阴谋可能会使克拉斯基的计划流产。

ex.en: Put the onions in the pan and cook until lightly browned.
ex.cn: 将洋葱放入平底锅内，炒至略呈棕色。

def:
adj.冷静的,凉爽的,一流的,孤傲冷漠的
vt.& vi.（使）变凉,（使）冷静，使冷却,变凉，冷却,平息
n.凉气，凉快的地方,凉爽，凉爽的空气

ex.en: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
ex.cn: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

ex.en: She made a fanning motion, pretending to cool herself off.
ex.cn: 她做了个扇风的动作，假装想让自己凉快一点。

ex.en: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
ex.cn: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。

def:
n.复制品,一份,（报刊等的）稿件,准备排印的书面材料
vt.& vi.复制,抄写,容许复制的
vt.模仿,仿造…的样式或图案,抄写,复制

ex.en: I autographed a copy of one of my books.
ex.cn: 我在自己的一本书上签了名。

ex.en: The new copiers only copy onto one side of the paper.
ex.cn: 新复印机只能单面复印。

ex.en: The second-hand version is a poor copy of the original.
ex.cn: 盗版版本是对原版的低劣复制。

def: n.<英>谷物,<美>玉米,鸡眼

ex.en: They are offering farmers $2.15 a bushel for corn.
ex.cn: 他们向农民出价每蒲式耳2.15美元收购玉米。

ex.en: The scheme offers seed corn finance with loans at only 4% interest.
ex.cn: 该方案提供种子基金融资，其贷款只收取4%的利息。

ex.en: Here's a way of barbecuing corn-on-the-cob that I learned in the States.
ex.cn: 这是我在美国学的一种烤玉米的方法。

def:
n.角落，角,拐角,困境,[商]囤积
vi.驾车转弯,聚于角落
vt.垄断,逼入困境
adj.位于角落的

ex.en: Claire stared after him until he disappeared around a corner.
ex.cn: 克莱尔一直注视着他，直到他消失在拐角。

ex.en: She flicked a crumb off the corner of her mouth.
ex.cn: 她擦掉嘴角的面包屑。

ex.en: The man with the umbrella turned the corner again.
ex.cn: 拿伞的人又拐进了拐角处。

def:
adj.正确的,合适的,符合公认准则的,得体的
v.改正,批改,指出错误

ex.en: "That is correct, Meg," he answered in his cold, dead voice.
ex.cn: “没错，梅格。”他用冰冷、阴沉的声音答道。

ex.en: The club specialises in videoing its student golfers to correct their faults.
ex.cn: 俱乐部专门为高尔夫学员制作录像，以纠正他们的错误。

ex.en: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8.
ex.cn: 正确答案在第8页末尾。

def:
n.价钱，代价,花费，费用,牺牲,[用复数][法律]诉讼费
vi.价钱为，花费,估计成本
vt.付出代价,估价,使丧失,使付出努力

ex.en: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
ex.cn: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

ex.en: The new shopping centre was constructed at a cost of 1.1 million.
ex.cn: 新的购物中心耗资110万建成。

ex.en: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction.
ex.cn: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

def:
n.棉,棉线,棉织物,（其他植物所生的绒毛状的）棉状物
vi.喜欢,赞成,一致,交往

ex.en: Some of the food crops failed. However, the cotton did quite well.
ex.cn: 有些粮食作物歉收。但棉花的收成仍相当不错。

ex.en: Because it was warm, David wore only a white cotton shirt.
ex.cn: 因为天气暖和，戴维只穿了一件白色的棉衬衣。

ex.en: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton.
ex.cn: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。

def:
vt.& vi.咳嗽,（引擎等）发噗噗声,咳出
n.咳，咳嗽,咳嗽病,（机关枪等的）连续发射声

ex.en: Will this be enough to persuade Congress to cough up?
ex.cn: 这能说服国会掏钱吗？

ex.en: I'll have to cough up $10,000 a year for tuition.
ex.cn: 我每年将不得不付1万美元的学费。

ex.en: His cough grew more persistent until it never stopped.
ex.cn: 他咳嗽持续的时间越来越长，直到咳个不停。

def: aux.“can”的过去式,能够，打算,用于假设语气的条件句,用于虚拟语气的结论句

ex.en: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
ex.cn: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

ex.en: So, if we could just move onto something else?
ex.cn: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

ex.en: Northbridge is a cool, calculating and clever criminal who could strike again.
ex.cn: 诺思布里奇是个头脑冷静、诡计多端、阴险狡诈的罪犯，他可能还会犯案。

def:
n.总数,数数,罪状,论点
v.数数,计算总数,把…算入,重要
n.国家,国民,乡下,地区
n.乡村,郊野,乡下的全体居民

ex.en: They will be in raptures over the French countryside.
ex.cn: 他们会深深爱上法国的乡村。

ex.en: Motorways actually cover less than 0.1 percent of the countryside.
ex.cn: 高速公路的实际覆盖面积还不到农村地区的0.1%。

ex.en: The Moselle winds through some 160 miles of tranquil countryside.
ex.cn: 摩泽尔河在宁静的乡间蜿蜒穿行约160英里。

def:
n.对，双,配偶，夫妻,<口>几个，两三个
vt.&vi.连在一起，连接,成双，结婚,性交，交配

ex.en: The couple married in the Caribbean to avoid a media circus.
ex.cn: 为了摆脱媒体的关注，这对新人在加勒比喜结连理。

ex.en: Dave, the pianist, played it over a couple of times.
ex.cn: 演奏钢琴的戴夫将这支曲子反复弹了两三遍。

ex.en: She had hoped the couple would put on a show of unity.
ex.cn: 她曾经希望那对夫妇会表现出和睦相处的样子。

def: n.勇气,胆量,魄力,肝胆

ex.en: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
ex.cn: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

ex.en: He showed great courage by admitting that he is an alcoholic.
ex.cn: 他以极大的勇气承认自己酗酒。

ex.en: Every person stood to applaud his unforgettable act of courage.
ex.cn: 所有人起立为他不可磨灭的英勇之举鼓掌。

def:
n.课程,航线,行动方向,一道菜
vt.快速地流动,奔流,跑过,追逐
vi.沿…（方向）前进,指引航线,快跑,迅速移动

ex.en: She'd half expected him to withdraw from the course.
ex.cn: 她多少已经预料到他会中途就退出这门课程。

ex.en: He was charged with conspiring to pervert the course of justice.
ex.cn: 他被控谋划妨碍司法公正。

ex.en: She is currently doing a business studies course at Leeds.
ex.cn: 她目前在利兹大学修读一门商科课程。

def: n.堂[表]兄弟姊妹,远亲，同辈

ex.en: I tried again to get ahold of my cousin Joan.
ex.cn: 我再次尝试联系我的表妹琼。

ex.en: Her cousin, a hairdresser, was perming her hair as a special treat.
ex.cn: 她表兄是美发师，正在免费给她烫发。

ex.en: George ducked out of his forced marriage to a cousin.
ex.cn: 乔治逃脱了和他表亲的包办婚姻。

def:
v.遮盖,掩蔽,涉及,洒上
n.覆盖物,避难所,掩护,封面

ex.en: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.
ex.cn: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。

ex.en: Pack the fruits and nuts into the jars and cover with brandy.
ex.cn: 把水果和坚果放进罐子里，用白兰地酒浸泡。

ex.en: I should point out that these estimates cover just the hospital expenditures.
ex.cn: 我应该指出，这些估算仅包括医院的费用。

def:
n.奶牛，乳牛,母兽,雌（象，鲸等）,<侮辱>对女性的蔑称
vt.恐吓,吓唬,威胁

ex.en: Switzerland isn't all cow bells and yodelling, you know.
ex.cn: 你知道，瑞士不仅仅只有牛铃声和约德尔调歌声。

ex.en: Any product made from cow's milk made him vomit.
ex.cn: 任何乳制品都会让他呕吐。

ex.en: I'm not kidding, Frank. There's a cow out there, just standing around.
ex.cn: 我没有开玩笑，弗兰克。外面有一头母牛，就站在附近。

def:
adj.疯狂的,不理智的,离奇的,生气的
n.[俚语]疯子，怪人，政治狂人（尤指政治上持激进或极端主义态度、行为异常、不可思议的人）

ex.en: "That's crazy," I said. "Isn't it just?" he said.
ex.cn: “那简直是疯了，”我说。“谁说不是呢？”他说。

ex.en: Some people can diet like crazy and not lose weight.
ex.cn: 有些人拼命节食也不能减肥。

ex.en: None of that matters, because we're crazy about each other.
ex.cn: 那些都不重要，因为我们深深地爱着对方。

def:
n.乳霜,精英,奶油色,乳脂，奶油
vt.把…搅成糊状（或奶油状）混合物,彻底打败，狠揍

n.农作物,产量,庄稼,平头
vt.种植,收割,修剪,剪短
vi.收成,收获

ex.en: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
ex.cn: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

ex.en: Problems will crop up and hit you before you are ready.
ex.cn: 你还未准备好，问题就会突然出现并打击你。

ex.en: I decided to crop the picture just above the water line.
ex.cn: 我决定把这张照片水印以下的部分裁掉。

def:
n.十字架,十字形饰物,杂交品种,痛苦
vi.交错而行,横渡,越境
vt.杂交,横跨，穿越,划掉,使相交
adj.坏脾气的， 易怒的,相反的，反向的

ex.en: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
ex.cn: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

ex.en: The priest made the sign of the cross over him.
ex.cn: 神父在他上方画了个十字。

ex.en: I've never seen him get cross or lose his temper.
ex.cn: 我从未见过他生气或者发火。

def:
n.人群,群众,一群
vi.拥挤，聚集
vt.挤满,将…塞进,催逼

ex.en: The crowd in Robinson's Coffee-House was thinning, but only by degrees.
ex.cn: 鲁宾逊咖啡屋里的人正在变少，但也只是渐少而已。

ex.en: Three mortar shells had landed close to a crowd of people.
ex.cn: 3枚迫击炮弹落在人群旁。

ex.en: He charged into the crowd. "Break it up," he shouted.
ex.cn: 他冲进人群，大喊道：“散开。”

def: adj.残酷的，残忍的,使人痛苦的，让人受难的,无情的，严酷的

ex.en: He is still the butt of cruel jokes about his humble origins.
ex.cn: 他仍然因出身低微而被人无情嘲笑。

ex.en: These cruel devices are designed to stop prisoners bending their legs.
ex.cn: 这些残酷的刑具是用来阻止犯人弯腿的。

ex.en: Marion's father counter-attacked by saying that Blaze's claims were cruel and untrue.
ex.cn: 玛丽昂的父亲反击说布拉兹的说法冷酷无情，根本是在撒谎。

def:
vt.& vi.哭,喊，叫
vt.哭着说,叫卖,大声报道
n.哭,叫喊,要求,大喊
vi.鸣,啼叫,嗥叫,吠

n.文化,[生物学]（微生物等的）培养,修养,养殖
vt.培植，培养

ex.en: The city of Memphis is promoting a populist approach to culture.
ex.cn: 孟菲斯市在推行文化的民粹主义道路。

ex.en: Our culture is more complex than he knows. Wheels within wheels.
ex.cn: 我们的文化比他所知道的要复杂得多，相当庞杂。

ex.en: They no longer worry about the homogenization of culture.
ex.cn: 他们不再担心文化的同质化。

def:
n.杯子,一杯（的量）,（胸罩的）罩杯,优胜杯
vt.使（手）窝成杯状,使（双手）成圆状托起,为…拔火罐

ex.en: My wife was tucked up in bed with her cup of cocoa.
ex.cn: 我老婆端着一杯热可可窝在床上。

ex.en: Isabelle placed a wine cup on the table within his reach.
ex.cn: 伊莎贝尔把酒杯放在桌上他伸手可及的地方。

ex.en: His next job is to get us to the World Cup finals.
ex.cn: 他接下来的任务是带领我们闯入世界杯决赛圈。

def:
vt.治愈,矫正,解决,消除
vi.受治疗,被加工处理
n.治愈,药物,疗法,措施

ex.en: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
ex.cn: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

ex.en: He needed surgery to cure a troublesome back injury.
ex.cn: 他需要做手术来治好烦人的背伤。

ex.en: A permanent cure will only be effected by acupuncture, chiropractic or manipulation.
ex.cn: 只有针灸、脊椎指压治疗或者推拿术才能实现彻底治愈。

def:
n.窗帘，门帘,帐幕之物，幕布,启幕，落幕
vt.给（窗户或房间）装上帘子,掩蔽

ex.en: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
ex.cn: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

ex.en: A curtain acted as a divider between this class and another.
ex.cn: 帘子作为分隔物将这间教室和另一间分开。

ex.en: The shops also offer a keenly priced curtain-making service.
ex.cn: 这些商店也提供价格优惠的窗帘制作服务。

def:
n.习惯，惯例,海关，关税,经常光顾,[总称]（经常性的）顾客
adj.（衣服等）定做的，定制的

ex.en: It was his invariable custom to have one whisky before his supper.
ex.cn: 晚饭前来杯威士忌，这是他一直以来的习惯。

ex.en: Furniture can also be custom-made to suit your own requirements.
ex.cn: 你也可以按照自己的要求定制家具。

ex.en: The married women of Shitamachi maintained the custom of blackening their teeth.
ex.cn: 下町的已婚女性还保留着把牙齿涂黑的习俗。

def: n.顾客，客户,主顾,<口>家伙

ex.en: In some stores we were undermanned and customer service was suffering.
ex.cn: 有些店我们人手不足，对顾客照顾不周。

ex.en: It does not matter one whit to the customer.
ex.cn: 这对顾客来说一点关系都没有。

ex.en: Several manufacturers are also nibbling away at Ford's traditional customer base.
ex.cn: 几家制造商也在蚕食福特公司的传统客户群。

def:
vt.& vi.将（某物）切开（或分割）
vt.削减,剪切,切成,删剪
vi.电影,（为决定谁先出牌等）切牌,可被切割,可用于切割
n.切口,削减,剪裁,切片

ex.en: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
ex.cn: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

ex.en: When she had attempted to cut his nails he resisted.
ex.cn: 她试图给他剪指甲，他不让。

ex.en: Serve the cake warm or at room temperature, cut in squares.
ex.cn: 等蛋糕温热或凉至室温时切成四方块端上桌。

def: adj.漂亮的,娇小可爱的,机灵的，精明的,矫揉造作的

ex.en: She wasn't beautiful. But she was kind of cute.
ex.cn: 她不漂亮。但她有几分可爱。

ex.en: There was this girl, and I thought she was really cute.
ex.cn: 就是这个女孩，我认为她非常性感。

ex.en: I got off with a cute boy from Nottingham.
ex.cn: 我与诺丁汉的一位帅小伙儿交往过。

def:
adj.每日的，日常的,一日的,每日一次的,每个工作日的
n.日报,（不寄宿的）仆人，白天做家务的女佣
adv.每日,逐日,每周日,日复一日地

ex.en: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
ex.cn: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

ex.en: Be sure you get your daily quota of calcium.
ex.cn: 要确保每天的钙摄入量。

ex.en: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
ex.cn: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

def:
vt.& vi.损害，毁坏
n.损害，损毁,赔偿金

ex.en: It's a fair guess to say that the damage will be extensive.
ex.cn: 说损失会很严重想必猜得不错。

ex.en: The blast caused extensive damage, shattering the ground-floor windows.
ex.cn: 爆炸造成了巨大的破坏，震碎了一楼的窗户。

ex.en: The radiation can damage microprocessors and computer memories, causing them to malfunction.
ex.cn: 辐射会损坏微处理器和电脑内存，使之失灵。

def:
n.跳舞,舞会,舞蹈艺术,舞曲
vi.跳舞,手舞足蹈,摇晃,跳跃
vt.使跳舞

ex.en: It's really an amazing dance. It just always brings the house down.
ex.cn: 这真是一段精彩绝伦的舞蹈表演，每次总是博得全场喝彩。

ex.en: They will dance two performances of Ashton's "Romeo and Juliet".
ex.cn: 他们将表演阿什顿的《罗密欧与朱丽叶》中的两场舞。

ex.en: He got up to strut his stuff on the dance-floor.
ex.cn: 他起身到舞池里炫耀自己的舞技。

def: n.危险,危险物，威胁

ex.en: Subconsciously I had known that I would not be in personal danger.
ex.cn: 我潜意识里已经知道我不会有人身危险。

ex.en: The real danger is civil unrest in the east of the country.
ex.cn: 真正的危险是该国东部地区的民众动乱。

ex.en: If there is a danger of famine, we should help.
ex.cn: 如果有可能出现饥荒，我们应该提供帮助。

def: adj.危险的

ex.en: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
ex.cn: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

ex.en: Dangerous undertows make swimming unsafe along most of the coastline.
ex.cn: 由于存在着危险的下层逆流，在大部分海岸线附近游泳都不安全。

ex.en: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
ex.cn: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

def:
vt.敢,敢做,激（某人做某事）,问（某人）有没有胆量（做某事）
vi.敢,敢于,大胆,无畏于
aux.敢，竟敢
n.激将，挑战

ex.en: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
ex.cn: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

ex.en: Don't speak to me like that. Don't you dare.
ex.cn: 不要那样跟我讲话。我不允许！

ex.en: When found, the children said they'd run away for a dare.
ex.cn: 找到这些孩子时，他们说自己是受了激将才出走的。

def:
adj.黑暗的,乌黑的,忧郁的,神秘的
n.黑暗,暗色,暗处

ex.en: In the dark my sense of hearing becomes so acute.
ex.cn: 黑暗中我的听觉变得异常灵敏。

ex.en: I managed to keep my parents in the dark about this.
ex.cn: 我设法对父母瞒下了此事。

ex.en: He stared into the dark void where the battle had been fought.
ex.cn: 他凝望着那片漆黑的空旷之地，那次战役就是在这里进行的。

def:
n.（用作称呼）亲爱的,心爱的人,倍受宠爱的人,亲切友好的的人
adj.倍受喜爱的，可爱的，迷人的

ex.en: Oat bran became the darling of health freaks last year.
ex.cn: 燕麦麸在去年成为保健狂人的最爱。

ex.en: Darling Neville, I couldn't be more pleased for you.
ex.cn: 亲爱的内维尔，我真太为你高兴了。

ex.en: Oh dear, there's the doorbell. See who it is, would you, darling.
ex.cn: 哦，天哪，门铃响了。看看是谁好吗，亲爱的。

def:
n.日期，日子,约会,时代，年代,（北非和西亚常见的海枣树的）海枣
vt.过时,使…显老,显示出…时代（或年龄）,鉴定…的年代
vt.& vi.与人约会，相约
vi.属于某一特定时期,从某时起计算日期,记载日期,注有（或注明）日期

ex.en: The Labour government has to date resisted all supplications.
ex.cn: 到目前为止工党政府回绝了所有的请愿求情。

ex.en: The community's links with Syria date back to biblical times.
ex.cn: 这个团体与叙利亚的关系可以追溯到《圣经》时代。

ex.en: A black coat always looks smart and will never date.
ex.cn: 黑色外套看起来总是很潇洒，而且永远也不会落伍。

def:
n.女儿,产物，后代,（某地的）妇女,[生]子代
adj.女儿般的,[生]第一代的,子代的

ex.en: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
ex.cn: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

ex.en: His daughter was very active and noisy in the mornings.
ex.cn: 他的女儿一到上午就很好动，吵吵闹闹的。

ex.en: She even claimed the couple's daughter was possessed by the devil.
ex.cn: 她甚至宣称那对夫妇的女儿被魔鬼附了体。

def:
n.黎明，拂晓,开端,醒悟
vi.破晓，（天）刚亮,开始出现,变得明朗
vt.（开始）被理解，被领悟,被看清，被想到

ex.en: At dawn I woke him up and said we were leaving.
ex.cn: 黎明时分，我把他叫醒，告诉他我们要走了。

ex.en: I started work at dawn and returned only at nightfall.
ex.cn: 我披星戴月地工作。

ex.en: A breakfast will be served to those who last out till dawn!
ex.cn: 坚持到天亮的能吃上早餐！

def:
n.一天,白天,时期,节日
adj.日间的,逐日的
adv.每天,经常在白天地

ex.en: On Sunday Cohen lay around the house all day.
ex.cn: 科恩星期天一整天都在家无所事事。

ex.en: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
ex.cn: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

ex.en: Try these toning exercises before you start the day.
ex.cn: 在开始一天的活动之前，试着做做这些强身健体的体操。

def: n.日光，白昼,清早，黎明,公开，发表,<俚>眼睛，视力
n.白天，日间,昼日,昼

ex.en: Daytime television tended to remind her too forcefully of her own situation.
ex.cn: 日间电视节目往往使她深刻地认识到自身的境况。

ex.en: Mr Pearson said he knew nothing of his wife's daytime habits.
ex.cn: 皮尔逊先生说，他对妻子白天的生活习惯一无所知。

ex.en: Please give a daytime telephone number.
ex.cn: 请留一个日间的电话号码。

def:
adj.死去的,完全的,无感觉的,呆板的
adv.完全地,非常,绝对,极度
n.死者,（死一样的）寂静,极寒时候

ex.en: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
ex.cn: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

ex.en: But that doesn't mean this brand of politics is dead or dying.
ex.cn: 但那并不意味着这种政治主张已经或正在消亡。

ex.en: "That is correct, Meg," he answered in his cold, dead voice.
ex.cn: “没错，梅格。”他用冰冷、阴沉的声音答道。

def:
vt.[牌戏]分,分配,经营,施予
n.（一笔）交易,许多,待遇,发牌
vi.论述,（有效地或成功地）处理,惩处,交易
adj.冷杉木制的，松木制的

adj.亲爱的,敬爱的,昂贵的,严厉的
n.亲爱的人,宠物
int.哎
adv.高价地,疼爱地,贵

ex.en: Outside, Bruce glanced at his watch: "Dear me, nearly oneo'clock."
ex.cn: 出了门，布鲁斯瞥了一眼自己的手表，“天哪，快一点了。”

ex.en: "Could I have a word?" — "Oh dear, if you must."
ex.cn: “我能说一句吗？”——“亲爱的，如果你非说不可的话，好吧。”

ex.en: I made for the life raft and hung on for dear life.
ex.cn: 我游到救生筏前，死命地抓住它。

def: n.死亡,（某种）死法，死亡方式,病危,死神

ex.en: It was a crime of espionage and carried the death penalty.
ex.cn: 这是间谍罪，应判死刑。

ex.en: A young man plunged from a sheer rock face to his death.
ex.cn: 一名男青年从陡峭的岩壁上坠崖身亡。

ex.en: Bishop Daly said he was devastated by news of the Cardinal's death.
ex.cn: 戴利主教说他听到红衣主教去世的消息后感到极为震惊和难过。

def: n.12月

ex.en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
ex.cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

ex.en: There will be a run-off between these two candidates on December 9th.
ex.cn: 12月9日将举行这两位候选人的决胜选举。

ex.en: Last December they hunted down and killed one of the gangsters.
ex.cn: 去年12月他们追捕到其中一名匪徒并将其击毙。

def:
vt.决定,决心,解决,裁决
vi.决定,下决心

ex.en: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
ex.cn: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

ex.en: He might decide that it is best to induce labour.
ex.cn: 他也许决定最好引产。

ex.en: If the clubs cannot conclude a deal, an independent tribunal will decide.
ex.cn: 如果俱乐部之间无法达成协议，将由一个独立的仲裁委员会来裁定。

def:
n.决定,果断,决议,（法院的）判决
vt.[口语][拳击]靠判定击败（对手）

ex.en: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
ex.cn: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

ex.en: When the decision was read out Mrs Gardner thanked the judges.
ex.cn: 判决书宣读完，加德纳夫人向法官们表示感谢。

ex.en: There has been a very mixed reaction to the decision.
ex.cn: 对于这个决定的反应非常不一致。

def:
n.行为,行动,<律>契约,证书
v.立契转让

ex.en: The perpetrators of this evil deed must be brought to justice.
ex.cn: 必须将参与这一恶行的凶手绳之以法。

ex.en: Smith changed his name by deed poll to Jervis-Smith.
ex.cn: 史密斯通过单边契据将自己的名字更改为杰维斯&dash1;史密斯。

ex.en: A man's deed is the touchstone of his greatness or littleness.
ex.cn: 行动是一个人伟大或者渺小的试金石.

def:
adj.深的,深远的，深奥,重大的，深刻的,强烈的，痛切的，深厚的
n.深处，深渊
adv.深深地，深入地

ex.en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
ex.cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

ex.en: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
ex.cn: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

ex.en: Deep down, she supported her husband'sinvolvement in the organization.
ex.cn: 在心底里，她支持丈夫参加这个组织。

def:
vt.击败，战胜,挫败,[法]宣告无效，作废
n.战胜,失败,[法]废除

ex.en: After the pain of defeat passes, England have some thinking to do.
ex.cn: 失败的痛苦过去以后，英国人应该认真反思一下。

ex.en: Initially the government was unwilling to accept the defeat.
ex.cn: 最初政府不愿意承认失败。

ex.en: Sampdoria lost their unbeaten record with a 2-1 home defeat against Genoa.
ex.cn: 桑普多利亚队主场1比2负于热那亚队之后，终止了自己的不败纪录。

def: n.辩护,防御,防御工事,后卫

ex.en: The defence counsel warned that the judge should stop the trial.
ex.cn: 被告辩护律师强烈建议法官应该休庭。

ex.en: Defence soaks up forty per cent of the budget.
ex.cn: 国防耗去40%的预算。

ex.en: It is quite clear that we were firing in self defence.
ex.cn: 事实很清楚，我们开枪是出于自卫。

def: vt.& vi.辩护,保卫,（足球、曲棍球等）防守,进行辩护

ex.en: Those people who took up weapons to defend themselves are political prisoners.
ex.cn: 那些拿起武器自卫的人是些政治犯。

ex.en: Torrence expects to defend her title successfully in the next Olympics.
ex.cn: 托伦斯希望在下届奥运会上能够卫冕成功。

ex.en: Every man who could fight was now committed to defend the ridge.
ex.cn: 每个能够参加战斗的男子现在都决心要保卫这条山脊。

def: n.[乐]音阶，度,[数]度，度数,程度,学位

n.延迟，拖延,耽搁,被耽搁或推迟的时间
vt.延期，推迟,耽搁
vi.延缓，延期

ex.en: How much delay should we build into the plan?
ex.cn: 我们应该为这个计划预留多少富余的时间？

ex.en: The time delay would be smaller by eight orders of magnitude.
ex.cn: 如果按8个数量级来看，延时量会显得小一些。

ex.en: He hates delay and procrastination in all its forms.
ex.cn: 他讨厌任何形式的拖延和耽搁。

def: vt.& vi.删除

ex.en: We will be pleased to delete the charge from the original invoice.
ex.cn: 我们决定将这笔费用从原始发票上删去。

ex.en: Select "Delete all" from the drop-down list.
ex.cn: 在下拉列表项中选择“全部删除”。

ex.en: Delete what is dispensable and give more prominence to the essentials.
ex.cn: 可以不说的去掉,该说的就可以更突出.

def: adj.美味的，可口的,有趣的,,喷香

ex.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
ex.cn: 这种稍加变化的可口煎蛋卷做起来又快又容易。

ex.en: Traditional Spanish food is delicious and its specialities are worth searching out.
ex.cn: 传统的西班牙食品美味可口，其特色菜肴值得寻访。

ex.en: Chick peas have a distinctive, delicious and nutty flavour.
ex.cn: 鹰嘴豆有独特可口的坚果风味。

def:
n.快乐，高兴,使人高兴的东西或人
vt.使高兴，使欣喜
vi.感到高兴[快乐]

ex.en: The British team did not disguise their delight at their success.
ex.cn: 英国队毫不掩饰他们获胜的喜悦。

ex.en: Good day to you, Bernard! It's a positive delight to see you.
ex.cn: 你好，伯纳德！见到你真高兴。

ex.en: Psychotherapists often take a perverse delight in criticizing other psychotherapists.
ex.cn: 精神治疗师们经常幸灾乐祸地批评自己的同行。

def: n.部门，部,系，学部,知识范围,车间

ex.en: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department.
ex.cn: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

ex.en: Officials at the State Department say the issue is urgent.
ex.cn: 国务院官员说该问题很急迫。

ex.en: She appears nightly on the television news, speaking for the State Department.
ex.cn: 她作为国务院的发言人，每晚都会出现在电视新闻中。

def: vi.依靠,依赖,信赖,决定于

ex.en: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
ex.cn: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

ex.en: Whether such properties are a good deal will depend on individual situations.
ex.cn: 这样的地产是否可获得大笔收益还要视具体情形而定。

ex.en: They depend on the goodwill of visitors to pick up rubbish.
ex.cn: 他们相信游客会自觉捡起垃圾。

def: n.深度,深处，深海,深奥，奥妙,进深

ex.en: Mr Gibson is clearly intellectually out of his depth.
ex.cn: 吉布森先生显然才智不逮。

ex.en: White wines tend to gain depth of colour with age.
ex.cn: 白葡萄酒年头愈久，颜色愈深。

ex.en: The smaller lake ranges from five to fourteen feet in depth.
ex.cn: 小一些的湖深度从5英尺到14英尺不等。

def:
n.沙漠,荒地,应得的赏罚,功劳，美德
adj.沙漠的,荒芜的，不毛的,无人的

ex.en: The vehicles have been modified to suit conditions in the desert.
ex.cn: 车辆已改装过以适应沙漠的环境。

ex.en: The paper'sprice rise will encourage readers to desert in even greater numbers.
ex.cn: 报纸价格的上涨将导致更多的读者不再订阅。

ex.en: Young workers are more willing to desert jobs they don't like.
ex.cn: 年轻职工对不喜欢的工作更易擅自离职。

def:
vt.& vi.设计,绘制
vt.设计,计划,企图,决意（做）
n.设计,图案,结构,计划
vi.设计略图,（为工艺品、装潢项目等）设计,当设计师,构思

ex.en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
ex.cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

ex.en: They drew up the design for the house in a week.
ex.cn: 他们在一周内就画出了房子的图样。

ex.en: The grand design of Europe's monetary union is already agreed.
ex.cn: 欧洲统一货币的宏伟构想已经获得认同。

def:
vt.希望,渴望,要求,请求
n.愿望,欲望,希望,请求
vi.有希望,期望,愿望,想望

ex.en: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
ex.cn: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

ex.en: She confessed to her parents her desire to act.
ex.cn: 她向父母坦言了自己想演戏的愿望。

ex.en: I had a strong desire to help and care for people.
ex.cn: 我非常渴望能够帮助和照顾他人。

def:
n.书桌，办公桌,服务台,部门,（美）讲道台
adj.书桌的，书桌上用的

ex.en: He folded the papers and stuck them in his desk drawer.
ex.cn: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。

ex.en: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
ex.cn: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

ex.en: He gave the girl at the desk the message.
ex.cn: 他把便条递给了桌旁的女孩。

def: vt.破坏，摧毁,消灭，歼灭（敌人）,杀死,使失败

ex.en: They can't destroy truth without destroying each and every one of us.
ex.cn: 除非他们将我们赶尽杀绝，否则真理不灭。

ex.en: Frogs eat pests which destroy crops and carry diseases.
ex.cn: 青蛙吃破坏庄稼、传播疾病的害虫。

ex.en: After the killing, he calmly lit a fire to destroy evidence.
ex.cn: 杀人后，他镇定地点起火销毁罪证。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）下决心，（使）做出决定
vt.决定，确定,判定，判决,使决定,限定
vi.[主用于法律]了结，终止，结束

ex.en: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
ex.cn: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

ex.en: A debriefing would follow this operation, to determine where it went wrong.
ex.cn: 这次行动之后将会有一个任务执行情况报告会，以便确定是哪里出了问题。

ex.en: An astronomer can determine the brightness of each star.
ex.cn: 天文学家能够测定每颗恒星的亮度。

def:
vi.发展,生长,形成,发达 
vt.发展,开发,研制,冲洗（胶片）

ex.en: She won a grant to develop her own business.
ex.cn: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

ex.en: You have to develop your capabilities to the maximum.
ex.cn: 你必须尽你所能。

ex.en: We have to develop a less amateurish approach to our organisa-tions.
ex.cn: 我们必须使我们对待自己组织的态度变得较为专业。

def: n.发展，进化,被发展的状态,新生事物，新产品,开发区

ex.en: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
ex.cn: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

ex.en: What are your plans for the development of your company?
ex.cn: 你打算怎样来发展壮大自己的公司？

ex.en: The Commonwealth Development Corporation has agreed to reschedule Tanzania's debt.
ex.cn: 英联邦开发公司已经同意推迟坦桑尼亚的债务偿还时间。

def: vt.把…奉献（给），把…专用（于）,奉献

ex.en: Faculty members devote most of their time to scholarly research.
ex.cn: 全院教师大部分时间都用来从事学术研究。

ex.en: She had started to devote her energies to teaching rather than performing.
ex.cn: 她已经开始将精力从表演转移到教学中。

ex.en: She forsook her worldly possessions to devote herself to the church.
ex.cn: 她抛弃世上的财物而献身教会.

def:
n.日晷,钟（表）面，标度盘,拨号盘,表盘
vt.& vi.打电话，拨电话号码
vt.用标度盘测量,通过表针控制

ex.en: Simply dial the number and tell us your area.
ex.cn: 只需拨这个号码告诉我们你在什么地方。

ex.en: She picked up the phone, and began to dial Maurice Campbell's number.
ex.cn: 她拿起电话听筒，开始拨打莫里斯·坎贝尔的号码。

ex.en: At the center of the dial is a piece of smoky glass.
ex.cn: 表盘的中央是一块烟灰色的玻璃。

def:
n.会话，对话,问答，对白,问答题，对话体,“dialogue”的变体
v.对话,用对话表达

ex.en: At last there can be a reasonable dialog between our two governments.
ex.cn: 我们两国最后终于能理智地进行对话了。

ex.en: Modeless dialog boxes frequently have several buttons that immediately invoke various functions.
ex.cn: 不要忘记非模态对话框中经常会有几个按钮,可以立即激活不同的功能.

ex.en: There is probably no user - interface idiom more abused than the error dialog.
ex.cn: 在图形用户界面的世界里,可能没有比滥用错误对话框更多的习惯用法了.

def:
n.对话,（文学、戏剧、电影等中的）对话,对白,意见分歧者之间的意见交换
vt.用对话表达
vi.对话,进行非正式的意见交换

ex.en: The consulate will carryon a political dialogue with Indonesia.
ex.cn: 领事馆将和印度尼西亚举行政治对话。

ex.en: The dialogue and acting in Indecent Proposal are tired, cliched and corny.
ex.cn: 《桃色交易》中的对白和表演尽落俗套，毫无新意。

ex.en: The discussions were the beginnings of a dialogue with Moscow.
ex.cn: 讨论拉开了同莫斯科对话的序幕。

def:
n.钻石，金刚石,菱形,方块
vt.镶钻石于,用钻石装饰
adj.金刚石的,菱形的,用钻石装饰的

ex.en: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
ex.cn: 钻石切割靠的是工匠的技艺。

ex.en: The diamond towns are gradually being reclaimed by the desert.
ex.cn: 这些钻石城镇正逐渐重归沙漠。

ex.en: In industry, diamond can form a tough, non-corrosive coating for tools.
ex.cn: 在工业上，金刚石可以用作工具表面坚固、耐腐蚀的覆盖层。

def: n.日记，日志,日记簿

ex.en: In his diary of 1944 he proclaims unswerving loyalty to the monarchy.
ex.cn: 他在1944年的日记里声称对君主忠贞不贰。

ex.en: Ever since I saw the diary excerpts I've been cast down.
ex.cn: 自从看到日记摘录，我就一直非常沮丧。

ex.en: As I scribbled in my diary the light went out.
ex.cn: 我正草草地写着日记，灯灭了。

def: n.词典，字典,[自]代码字典

ex.en: The dictionary is a vast treasure trove of information.
ex.cn: 那本词典是个巨大的信息宝库。

ex.en: The translations were carried out with the assistance of a medical dictionary.
ex.cn: 这些翻译是借助一本医学词典完成的。

ex.en: He had to consult a pocket dictionary.
ex.cn: 他只好去查袖珍字典。

def:
vt.& vi.死亡，熄灭,凋零，枯萎,渴望，盼望
n.钢型，硬模,骰子

ex.en: He won his first Derby on the aptly named "Never Say Die".
ex.cn: 他驾驭着这匹名副其实的“永不言败”夺得了他的第一个德比马赛冠军。

ex.en: You stay here, you die. No two ways about it.
ex.cn: 你若留在这里，必死无疑。

ex.en: A new study proved conclusively that smokers die younger than non-smokers.
ex.cn: 一项新的研究确证了吸烟者比不吸烟者死得早。

def:
n.差别，差异,[数]差数，差额,意见分歧,特色
vt.辨别，区分

ex.en: The difference between who you are and who you want to be is what you do.
ex.cn: 你是什么样的人和你想成为什么样的之间的差距就是，你做了什么。

ex.en: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
ex.cn: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

ex.en: For a beach resort with a difference, try Key West.
ex.cn: 如果想去一个与众不同的海滨度假胜地，那就去基韦斯特吧。

def: adj.不同的,各式各样的,个别的,不平常

ex.en: Things might have been different if I'd talked a bit more.
ex.cn: 如果当时我再多说一点的话，结果或许会不一样。

ex.en: Since the birds interbreed they cannot be classed as different species.
ex.cn: 由于这些鸟进行杂交繁殖，不能把它们归为不同的物种。

ex.en: These expressions are often used interchangeably, but they do have different meanings.
ex.cn: 这些表达方式经常相互替代使用，但它们的含义确实有所不同。

def: adj.困难的,难做的,难解的,不易相处的

ex.en: He had a reputation for being bloody-minded and difficult.
ex.cn: 他为人刻薄、难相处是出了名的。

ex.en: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
ex.cn: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

ex.en: It would be difficult to find two men who were more dissimilar.
ex.cn: 很难找到彼此间差异更大的人了。

def: n.困难，麻烦，难事,难度,异议，争论，纠葛,财政困难，（经济）拮据

ex.en: He was going red in the face and breathing with difficulty.
ex.cn: 他涨红了脸，费力地喘着气。

ex.en: Many men still have difficulty accepting a woman as a business partner.
ex.cn: 许多男性仍然无法接受女性商业伙伴。

ex.en: Something gave me the strength to overcome the difficulty.
ex.cn: 有些事给了我克服困难的勇气。

def:
vt.（如用铲、锨或推土机等）挖掘,探究，发掘,刺，戳,喜欢，欣赏
vi.挖掘，松土,整理,〈俚〉已理解
n.一拳，一推,挖苦，讽刺,考古发掘

ex.en: Dig a largish hole and bang the stake in first.
ex.cn: 挖一个大点儿的洞，先把木桩敲进去。

ex.en: Dig over any ground that is clear of crops and plants.
ex.cn: 把没种庄稼和植物的土地都深翻一遍。

ex.en: The dentist commenced to dig, drill and finally fill the offending tooth.
ex.cn: 牙医开始在那颗有问题的牙齿上挖洞，钻孔，直到最后把它补好。

def: n.正餐，主餐,宴会,晚餐

ex.en: Guess what? I'm going to dinner at Mrs. Combley's tonight.
ex.cn: 你猜怎么着？今晚我要去康伯利夫人家里赴宴。

ex.en: "Let's invite her to dinner." — "Over my dead body!"
ex.cn: “我们请她来吃晚饭吧。”——“除非我死了！”

ex.en: He asked for a glass of port after dinner.
ex.cn: 晚饭后，他要了一杯波尔图葡萄酒。

def:
adj.直接的,直的,直系的,率直的
adv.直接地,径直地,直截了当地,正好
vt.（用建议、指示、有益的情报等）指导,导演（戏剧或电影）,指示方向,把…对准（某方向或某人）
vt.& vi.指导，导演，管理
vi.引路,当向导,领唱,领奏

ex.en: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
ex.cn: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

ex.en: He has direct experience of the process of privatisation.
ex.cn: 他对私有化过程有着切身体会。

ex.en: The direct marketing industry has become adept at packaging special offers.
ex.cn: 直接邮寄广告业在特卖品的包装方面已经变得非常熟练了。

def: n.方向,趋势,方面,用法说明

ex.en: Adjust the aerial's position and direction for the best reception.
ex.cn: 调整天线的位置和方向以达到最佳接收效果。

ex.en: The direction of the prevailing winds should be taken into account.
ex.cn: 应该将盛行风的方向考虑在内。

ex.en: Molly razzed me about my rotten sense of direction.
ex.cn: 莫利笑话我糟糕的方向感。

def: n.主管，主任,董事，理事,负责人，监督者,导演

ex.en: He was hauled before the managing director and fired.
ex.cn: 他被叫去见总裁，然后就被解雇了。

ex.en: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
ex.cn: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。

ex.en: The two officers were being investigated by the director of public prosecutions.
ex.cn: 两名警官正在接受检察官的审查。

def: n.泥土,污垢，污泥,下流想法,恶意中伤的话

ex.en: He claims Pasolini overtook and tackled him, pushing him into the dirt.
ex.cn: 他声称帕索利尼追上去打他，把他推倒在烂泥里。

ex.en: A group of riders came into view on the dirt road.
ex.cn: 一群骑车的人出现在那条土路上。

ex.en: They're always selling off stuff like that dirt cheap.
ex.cn: 他们总是以非常便宜的价格把类似那样的东西处理掉。

def:
adj.恶劣的,肮脏的,卑劣的,下流的
vt.弄脏，污染,使名声受玷污
vi.变脏，污染

ex.en: Michael gave him a dirty look and walked out.
ex.cn: 迈克尔狠狠地瞪了他一眼然后走开了。

ex.en: He'd put his dirty laundry in the clothes basket.
ex.cn: 他会把自己的脏衣服扔进洗衣篮里。

ex.en: They chased down the stairs into the narrow, dirty street.
ex.cn: 他们冲下楼梯，来到狭窄、肮脏的街上。

def: vi.不同意,不一致,不适合,不符

ex.en: You and I are going to have to agree to disagree then.
ex.cn: 那你我只能各自保留不同意见了。

ex.en: I disagree with Andrew Russell over his piece on British Rail.
ex.cn: 我不同意安德鲁·拉塞尔那篇关于英国铁路公司的文章。

ex.en: Rarely does a grand jury publicly disagree with a prosecutor.
ex.cn: 大陪审团公开反对公诉人意见的情况很少见。

def:
vt.使失望,使破灭，使落空
vi.使失望

ex.en: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
ex.cn: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

ex.en: He's building me up too much — I may disappoint him.
ex.cn: 他将我捧上了天,我可能会令他失望.

ex.en: I'm sorry to disappoint your hope.
ex.cn: 对不起,我使你失望了.

def: n.圆盘,唱片,磁盘

ex.en: Carl slipped a disc in his back while warming up.
ex.cn: 热身时卡尔腰椎间盘不慎错位了。

ex.en: Getting Hollywood's latest films released on laser-disc has also helped.
ex.cn: 通过激光视盘发行好莱坞最新电影也起到了一定作用。

ex.en: Today's floppy disc drives are tolerant of poor quality discs.
ex.cn: 现在的软驱对质量低劣的软盘也能读取。

def:
n.磁盘,唱片,圆盘,光盘
v.把…录成唱片,使成圆盘状,用圆盘耕地

ex.en: These files have been zipped up to take up less disk space.
ex.cn: 这些文档已经进行了压缩，以节省磁盘空间。

ex.en: I can boot up from a floppy disk, but that's all.
ex.cn: 我可以用一张软盘来启动，但其他的就无能为力了。

ex.en: One CD-ROM disk can hold over 100,000 pages of text.
ex.cn: 一张光盘可以存储十多万多页的文字资料。

def: vt.发现,碰见,撞见,获得知识

ex.en: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
ex.cn: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

ex.en: Discover the delights and luxury of a private yacht.
ex.cn: 体验私人游艇的乐趣和奢华。

ex.en: He was stunned to discover cost overruns of at least $1 billion.
ex.cn: 他震惊地发现花费至少超了10亿美元。

def: n.发现，发觉,（剧情的）发展,被发现的事物,[法]显示证据

ex.en: The discovery is being hailed as The Holy Grail of astronomy.
ex.cn: 这一发现圆了天文学界的一个梦想。

ex.en: This discovery led on to studies of the immune system.
ex.cn: 此发现使人们开始对免疫系统进行研究。

ex.en: This discovery seems to validate the claims of popular astrology.
ex.cn: 这个发现似乎能印证流行占星术的一些说法。

def: vt.讨论，谈论,论述，详述,商量

ex.en: The Politburo has been meeting in Peking to discuss the situation.
ex.cn: 政治局已在北京召开会议讨论形势。

ex.en: Senior politicians met today to discuss the future of European economic unity.
ex.cn: 高级政要今天会晤，探讨欧洲经济一体化的未来。

ex.en: The magazine's aim is to discuss topical issues within a Christian framework.
ex.cn: 该杂志的宗旨是在基督教框架下讨论时下的热门话题。

def:
n.盘,餐具,一盘食物,外貌有吸引力的人
vt.盛于碟盘中,分发,使某人的希望破灭,说（某人）的闲话
vi.成碟状

ex.en: The coded signal is received by satellite dish aerials.
ex.cn: 编码信号由碟形卫星天线接收。

ex.en: I'll dish up and you can grate the Parmesan.
ex.cn: 我来上菜，你把帕尔马干酪磨碎。

ex.en: Prepare the souffle dish before making up the souffle mixture.
ex.cn: 在搅拌做蛋奶酥的各种原料之前先要把盘子准备好。

def:
vt.不喜欢,厌恶
n.厌憎,讨厌

ex.en: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
ex.cn: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

ex.en: He may suddenly take a dislike to foods that he's previously enjoyed.
ex.cn: 对以前爱吃的食物，他兴许突然就没了胃口。

ex.en: Norma is said to dislike the glare of publicity.
ex.cn: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

def:
n.距离，路程,远处,疏远,（时间的）间隔，长久
vt.把…远远甩在后面,疏远,与…保持距离

ex.en: Jay had always tended to keep his girlfriends at a distance.
ex.cn: 杰伊一贯和他的女朋友们保持距离。

ex.en: He stares detachedly into the middle distance, towards nothing in particular.
ex.cn: 他漠然而漫无目标地注视着不远处。

ex.en: By half distance we held a comfortable two-lap lead.
ex.cn: 到半程时，我们轻松领先两圈。

def: adj.遥远的,冷漠的，冷淡的,远离的，远隔的,不太清晰的

ex.en: From somewhere distant he heard the clatter of a typewriter.
ex.cn: 他听见从远处什么地方传来打字机的嗒嗒声。

ex.en: I found her a rather austere, distant, somewhat cold person.
ex.cn: 我发现她相当严厉，拒人于千里之外，近乎冷漠。

ex.en: The rolls of distant thunder were growing more ominous.
ex.cn: 远处隆隆的雷声听着愈发惊心，要变天了。

def:
vt.& vi.分,划分,分离,（使）产生分歧
n.分水岭，分界线,分配

ex.en: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
ex.cn: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

ex.en: She has done more to divide the Conservatives than anyone else.
ex.cn: 她在分裂保守党这件事上所起的作用比任何人都大。

ex.en: Cells divide and renew as part of the human growth process.
ex.cn: 细胞不断地分裂更新，这是人体发育过程的一部分。

def:
aux.构成疑问句和否定句,代替动词,用于加强语气
vt.做,干,进行,从事
vi.表现,进展,引起,行过
n.社交聚会,社交活动,宴会

ex.en: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
ex.cn: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

ex.en: The best thing to do when entering unknown territory is smile.
ex.cn: 踏入未知地带最好的对策就是微笑。

ex.en: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
ex.cn: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

def:
n.医生，大夫,博士,神学家,医疗设备
vt.& vi.医疗，行医
vt.修理，装配,假造,搀杂,修改，修饰

ex.en: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
ex.cn: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

ex.en: Doctor believed that his low sperm count was the problem.
ex.cn: 医生认为他的精子数太低是问题所在。

ex.en: The athlete is checked by their physio or doctor.
ex.cn: 由专用理疗师或医生为运动员做检查。

def:
n.狗,蹩脚货,丑女人,卑鄙小人
v.困扰,跟踪

ex.en: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
ex.cn: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

ex.en: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
ex.cn: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二只狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

ex.en: As soon as he got inside, the dog shook himself.
ex.cn: 他一进来，狗就开始摇头摆尾。

def:
n.（口技演员使用的）木偶,玩偶,纨绔子弟,漂亮的姑娘
vt.把…打扮漂亮

ex.en: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
ex.cn: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

ex.en: "Yes, Mum," replied Cheryl as she slowly put away her doll.
ex.cn: “是的，妈妈。”谢里尔一边慢慢地收起布娃娃一边回答。

ex.en: It's a vinyl doll with movable arms and legs.
ex.cn: 这是一个四肢可以活动的乙烯基塑料玩具娃娃。

def: n.美元,一元纸[硬]币,金钱,财富

ex.en: In early trading in Tokyo, the dollar fell sharply against the yen.
ex.cn: 在东京市场早市开盘时，美元对日元的比价急剧下跌。

ex.en: The drop was caused partly by the pound's strength against the dollar.
ex.cn: 下降的部分原因在于英镑对美元的升值。

ex.en: The dollar fell to within a hair's breadth of its all-time low.
ex.cn: 美元差一点跌到了最低点。

def: n.驴，毛驴,笨蛋，傻瓜,（美国）民主党的象征

ex.en: He gave the donkey a whack across the back with his stick.
ex.cn: 他拿棍子朝驴背上狠狠打了一下。

ex.en: He gave the donkey a mighty prod in the backside.
ex.cn: 他用力捅了一下驴屁股。

ex.en: He threw the old cloth saddle across the donkey's back.
ex.cn: 他把旧布鞍搭在驴背上。

def: n.门，户,出入口,一家[户],通道

ex.en: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
ex.cn: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

ex.en: A special locking system means the door cannot be opened accidentally.
ex.cn: 特殊的锁定系统使门不会被意外打开。

ex.en: The savoury smell greeted them as they went through the door.
ex.cn: 他们进门时一阵香味扑鼻而来。

def:
adj.双的,两倍的,两面派的,双人用的
vt.使加倍,把…对折,重复
vi.加倍，加倍努力,快步走
adv.两倍地,双重地
n.两倍,双精度型

ex.en: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
ex.cn: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

ex.en: The newspaper used the neologism "dinks", Double Income No Kids.
ex.cn: 报纸使用了新词“丁克族”，即“双收入无子女”。

ex.en: Both offer excellent value at around £90 for a double room.
ex.cn: 两家的双人客房都报出了大约90英镑的超值价格。

def:
n.怀疑，疑虑,未确定
vt.怀疑，疑惑
vi.不确定，不能肯定或怀疑

ex.en: There can be little doubt that he will offend again.
ex.cn: 毋庸置疑他还会再犯的。

ex.en: They have the usual quota of human weaknesses, no doubt.
ex.cn: 毫无疑问，他们身上也有人所共有的弱点。

ex.en: This new information does throw doubt on their choice.
ex.cn: 这个新信息确实使人们对他们的选择产生了怀疑。

def:
n.鸽,纯洁的人，天真无邪的人,〈美〉（政界的）鸽派人士,德芙（巧克力品牌）
v.潜水( dive的过去式)

ex.en: A dove cooed softly.
ex.cn: 一只鸽子轻柔地咕咕叫。

ex.en: The dove is symbolic of peace.
ex.cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。

ex.en: A dove is often used as a symbol of peace.
ex.cn: 鸽常作为和平的象征.

pos: adv prep adj n vt vi
def:
adv.（坐、倒、躺）下,向下,（表示范围或顺序的限度）下至
prep.（从高处）向下,（表示位置）在…的下方,（表示方向）沿着…向下,（表示时间）自…以来
adj.向下的,沮丧的,计算机或计算机系统停机,（以…）落后于对手的
n.（鸟的）绒羽,绒毛,软毛,汗毛
vt.放下,（尤指大口或快速地）喝下,使摔倒,击落（敌机等）
vi.[常用于祈使句中]下去,下来,卧倒,下降

ex.en: She dusted herself down and left to build her own career.
ex.cn: 她重振旗鼓去开创自己的事业了。

ex.en: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down.
ex.cn: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。

ex.en: One of the office girls was down with the flu.
ex.cn: 一位女职员得了流感。

def:
adv.在楼下,向[往]楼下
adj.楼下的

ex.en: Sounds of voices and commotion could be heard downstairs now.
ex.cn: 现在能听见楼下人声鼎沸。

ex.en: The downstairs of the two little houses had been entirely refashioned.
ex.cn: 两栋小楼的底层已经彻底翻修过。

ex.en: He was in an argument with his landlord downstairs.
ex.cn: 他与楼下的房东发生了争执。

def:
n.市中心区,（市中）商业区
adj.商业区的，闹市区的
adv.在商业（闹市）区,到闹市区

ex.en: There is heavy traffic in the downtown area tonight.
ex.cn: 今夜闹市区交通繁忙。

ex.en: a downtown shopping plaza
ex.cn: 市中心的购物区

ex.en: The city is providing free transportation to the stadium from downtown.
ex.cn: 本市现在提供从市中心到体育场的免费交通。

def:
adj.向下的，往下的
adv.向下地，下行地

ex.en: His adult life mirrored the downward course of his father's life.
ex.cn: 他成年后的生活反映出了他父亲的生活在走下坡路。

ex.en: Each firm will face a downward-sloping demand curve.
ex.cn: 每一家企业都将面临需求曲线的下滑。

ex.en: the downward slope of a hill
ex.cn: 向下的山坡

def:
n.（一）打，十二个
adj.一打的

ex.en: Ernest Brown lives about a dozen blocks from where the riots began.
ex.cn: 欧内斯特·布朗住在离骚乱发生处几个街区远的地方。

ex.en: She loaded me down with around a dozen cassettes.
ex.cn: 她塞给我十几盒磁带。

ex.en: He sat behind a table on which were half a dozen files.
ex.cn: 他坐在一张放有6个文件夹的桌子后面。

def: n.戏剧，剧本,戏剧效果,戏剧文学[艺术],戏剧性事件[场面]

ex.en: "Kathleen" was, as its 1892 subtitle asserted, "An Irish Drama".
ex.cn: 正如1892年剧本的副标题所强调的，《凯瑟琳》是一部“爱尔兰戏剧”。

ex.en: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
ex.cn: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

ex.en: The drama takes an idealistic, even a naive view of the subject.
ex.cn: 这部戏在对待这一主题上有些理想化，甚至是天真。

def:
vt.& vi.绘画,拖，拉,招致,吸引
vt.画,拉,吸引
vi.移动,拔出剑,皱缩,汲取
n.平局,抽奖

ex.en: He was waving his arms to draw their attention.
ex.cn: 他正挥手以引起他们的注意。

ex.en: She learned to draw by tracing pictures out of old storybooks.
ex.cn: 她通过描摹旧故事书上的图画学会了画画。

ex.en: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
ex.cn: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

def:
n.绘画,制图,图画,图样
v.绘画(draw的现在分词),拖,拉,拔出

ex.en: He is moving ever closer to drawing his pension.
ex.cn: 他就要领取养老金了。

ex.en: The appointed hour of the ceremony was drawing nearer.
ex.cn: 既定的典礼时间就快到了。

ex.en: And all the time next spring's elections are drawing closer.
ex.cn: 明年春天的选举即将来临。

def:
vi.梦想,做梦,梦见,想到
vt.& vi.做梦，向往
vt.梦想,做梦,想到
n.梦想,愿望,梦
adj.梦的,理想的,不切实际的

ex.en: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
ex.cn: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

ex.en: In a dream you can be transported back in time.
ex.cn: 在梦里你可以回到过去。

ex.en: It's as if I'm living in a hazy dream world.
ex.cn: 我好像生活在缥缈的梦境里。

def:
n.衣服,装饰,连衣裙,礼服
vt.& vi.给…穿衣,穿着,打扮
adj.连衣裙的,须穿礼服的,适合于正式场合的,办公时（或半正式场合）穿戴的
vt.给…穿衣,给…提供衣服,装潢，装饰或装点,排成列
vi.穿衣,排列整齐

ex.en: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
ex.cn: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

ex.en: Maria wore a layered white dress that rustled when she moved.
ex.cn: 玛丽亚穿一袭白色节裙，一动裙子就窸窣作响。

ex.en: Each dress is hemmed and scrupulously checked for imperfections.
ex.cn: 每条连衣裙都缝上了褶边，并经过严格的检查，不允许有任何瑕疵。

def:
n.操练,钻头,军事训练,（应对紧急情况的）演习
vt.& vi.钻（孔）,打（眼）,操练,训练
vt.作…演习，操练

ex.en: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
ex.cn: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

ex.en: The drill should be slowly rotated to ensure a clean hole.
ex.cn: 钻头必须缓慢转动，以保证钻孔平整光滑。

ex.en: It took five years to drill down to bedrock.
ex.cn: 耗时五年才钻到了基岩。

def:
vt.& vi.喝（酒）,饮,喝酒,（尤指）酗酒
vt.吸收，吸入
n.酒，饮料,酒宴,一杯或一份酒

ex.en: They drink bitter on draught in the local bar.
ex.cn: 他们在当地的酒吧里喝桶装的苦啤酒。

ex.en: She lifted the last of her drink to her lips.
ex.cn: 她将最后一点饮料送到唇边。

ex.en: She could ring for food and drink, laundry and sundry services.
ex.cn: 她可以打电话点餐，叫人来取要洗的衣服以及叫其他各种服务。

def:
v.驾驶,开车,驱动,迫使
n.驱车旅行,驱动力,车道,驱动器

ex.en: I don't drive and the buses are quite hopeless.
ex.cn: 我不开车，公共汽车条件又太糟糕。

ex.en: There are certain things he does that drive me mad.
ex.cn: 他的某些举动让我很生气。

ex.en: The ANC is about to launch a nationwide recruitment drive.
ex.cn: 非洲国民大会打算在全国范围内发起招募运动。

def: n.驾驶员，司机,驱动器，驱动程序,驱逐者，驱赶者,（高尔夫球）球棒

ex.en: The lorry driver escaped unhurt, but a pedestrian was injured.
ex.cn: 卡车司机安然脱险，但有一位行人受了伤。

ex.en: The driver managed to escape from the vehicle and shout a warning.
ex.cn: 那名司机设法从车里逃了出来并大声警告别人。

ex.en: The driver failed to negotiate a bend and ran into a tree.
ex.cn: 司机没能顺利拐弯，撞到了树上。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）落下,投下,（使）降低,减少
vt.放弃,停止,（故意）降下,垂下（眼睛）
n.滴,空投,降落,少量
vi.（水或其他液体）滴,结束,（因受伤或死等）倒下,退出
