ex.en: Drop the dough onto a baking sheet with a teaspoon.
ex.cn: 用茶匙把生面团舀到烤盘上。

ex.en: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
ex.cn: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

ex.en: Daddy called and asked me to drop by his office.
ex.cn: 爸爸打来电话让我去他办公室一趟。

def:
vt.淹死,浸没,麻痹某人对…的意识,（一声音）淹没（另一声音）
vi.淹死

ex.en: He tried to recollect things and drown himself in them.
ex.cn: 他极力回想过去的事情而沉浸于回忆之中.

ex.en: It is cruel to drown the cat in the river.
ex.cn: 把猫淹死在河里是残忍的.

ex.en: The loud cheers drown out his shouts.
ex.cn: 欢呼声盖过了他的喊叫声.

def:
n.药物,药剂,麻醉药,毒品
vt.（在食物或饮料中）投放麻醉药，下麻醉药,掺麻醉药于,使服麻醉药,使服毒品
vi.使服麻醉药，用药麻醉，使服兴奋剂

ex.en: Doctors are complaining about being barraged by drug-company salesmen.
ex.cn: 医生们抱怨他们疲于应付医药公司的销售人员。

ex.en: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value.
ex.cn: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

ex.en: They have been treated with this drug in clinical trials.
ex.cn: 他们已在临床试验中接受过这种药物的治疗。

def:
adj.醉的,陶醉的,沉醉,飘飘然
n.醉汉，酒鬼，酗酒者
v.喝（酒）( drink的过去分词),饮,喝酒,（尤指）酗酒

ex.en: "Tired and emotional" is a code word for being drunk.
ex.cn: “又累又激动”是形容人喝醉酒的一种委婉说法。

ex.en: Some people moved in silky, liquid movements, others were jerky, probably drunk.
ex.cn: 一些人动作平稳流畅，其他人则跌跌撞撞，大概是喝醉了。

ex.en: The landlord refused to serve him because he considered him too drunk.
ex.cn: 酒吧老板觉得他已经喝多了，拒绝再给他添酒。

def:
adj.干的干燥的，干旱的,干旱的，口渴的,干咳的,无趣味的，枯燥的
vt.从…去掉水分，使…变干,脱水保存（如肉或其它食物）
vi.变干
n.干涸,[复数] drys [非正式用语]主张禁酒的人

ex.en: Investment could dry up and that could cause the economy to falter.
ex.cn: 投资可能会中断，而这会引起经济衰退。

ex.en: There were few dry eyes in the house when I finished.
ex.cn: 我说完后房间里没几个人不掉泪的。

ex.en: Dry hair can be damaged by washing it too frequently.
ex.cn: 干性头发洗得太频繁容易受损。

def:
n.鸭子，野鸭,鸭肉,（表示友好的称呼）乖乖,（板球）零分
vt.& vi.躲避，回避,潜入,忽然低下头（或弯下腰）,迅速行进

ex.en: Drizzle the remaining dressing over the duck and salad.
ex.cn: 将剩下的调料淋在鸭肉和色拉上。

ex.en: All the criticism is water off a duck's back to me.
ex.cn: 批评对我来说左耳进右耳出，毫无影响。

ex.en: She took to mothering like a duck to water.
ex.cn: 她很快就对母亲这一角色驾轻就熟了。

def:
adj.由于,适当的,预定,到期
n.应有的权利,应得到的东西,应缴款
adv.正向,正对着

ex.en: Council members are due to have informal discussions later on today.
ex.cn: 委员会成员定于今日晚些时候进行非正式讨论。

ex.en: He is due to face a court-martial on drugs charges.
ex.cn: 他将因毒品交易的指控受到军法审判。

ex.en: The Channel tunnel was due to open towards the end of 1993.
ex.cn: 海峡隧道预计1993年年底前开通。

def: prep.在…的时候,在…期间，当…之时,其间

n.灰尘,（建筑物内、家具或地板等上的）灰尘,遗骸，尸体，人体，人,〈口〉金粉，粉末，粉剂，花粉
vt.& vi.拂（一拂），掸（一掸）
vt.撒（粉）于,擦去…的灰尘,擦灰,撢去

ex.en: Lights reflected off dust-covered walls creating a ghostly luminescence.
ex.cn: 灯光照在满是灰尘的墙上，反射回苍白的冷光。

ex.en: The powdery dust rose in a cloud around him.
ex.cn: 一团粉尘在他周围扬起。

ex.en: In the last 30 years many cherished values have bitten the dust.
ex.cn: 在过去的30年中，许多珍贵的价值观已经消失殆尽。

def: n.职责，责任,义务,职责或工作,税收

ex.en: They clocked off duty and left at ten to three.
ex.cn: 他们打卡下班，于2点50分离开。

ex.en: The first duty of a director is to recce his location.
ex.cn: 主管的第一项任务是熟悉所在地区的情况。

ex.en: He had a third examination and was declared unfit for duty.
ex.cn: 他接受了第三次检查，被告知不宜上班。

def:
adj.每,各自的
pron.每个,各自

ex.en: His voice was harsh as he enunciated each word carefully.
ex.cn: 他一字一顿，听上去很生硬。

ex.en: She planted a kiss on each of his leathery cheeks.
ex.cn: 她在他粗糙的面颊上左右各吻了一下。

ex.en: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down.
ex.cn: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。

def: adj.渴望的,热切的，热情洋溢的,热心的,急切

ex.en: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
ex.cn: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

ex.en: Robert was eager to talk about life in the Army.
ex.cn: 罗伯特很想谈谈陆军生活。

ex.en: At first the eager young poet was a partisan of the Revolution.
ex.cn: 起初，那位满腔热忱的年轻诗人是革命的坚定支持者。

def:
n.鹰,鹰状标志,[高]比标准杆少两杆的分数
v.[高]低于标准杆数两杆

ex.en: Three cannabis plants were found by eagle-eyed police officers.
ex.cn: 火眼金睛的警官发现了3株大麻。

ex.en: Eagle Star offers a 10% discount to the over-55s.
ex.cn: 鹰星公司给予年龄在55岁以上的顾客10％的折扣。

ex.en: She knew the exact location of The Eagle's headquarters.
ex.cn: 她知道“飞鹰”总部的确切地点。

def:
n.耳朵,听觉，听力,耳状物,穗
vi.抽穗,（美俚）听见

ex.en: Her ear, shoulder and hip are in a straight line.
ex.cn: 她的耳朵、肩膀和髋部呈一条直线。

ex.en: Simon finished dialing and clamped the phone to his ear.
ex.cn: 西蒙拨完号，把听筒贴在耳边。

ex.en: She sat on Rossi's knee as he whispered in her ear.
ex.cn: 她坐在罗西的膝盖上，听他低声耳语。

def:
adj.早的,早期的,早日的,（果实等）早熟的
adv.早,在初期,先前,提早

ex.en: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
ex.cn: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

ex.en: Ethiopia'sart springs from her early Christian as well as her Muslim heritage.
ex.cn: 埃塞俄比亚的艺术起源于其早期的基督教和伊斯兰教文化遗产。

ex.en: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
ex.cn: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

def:
vt.& vi.赚得,获得,赢得,博得
vt.赚，赚得,获得,挣得,使得到

ex.en: Ray will earn his keep on local farms while studying.
ex.cn: 雷求学期间会在当地的农场干活赚取生活费。

ex.en: Players should be allowed to earn money from advertising.
ex.cn: 应该允许运动员拍广告挣钱。

ex.en: Young conductors earn their spurs in a small orchestra or opera house.
ex.cn: 年轻的指挥家们在小乐队或小歌剧院里崭露头角。

def:
n.地球,陆地,泥土,兽穴
vt.把（电线）接地,盖（土）,追赶入洞穴
vi.躲进地洞

ex.en: I was shocked, brought down to earth by this revelation.
ex.cn: 真相的披露让我深感震惊，我被带回了现实。

ex.en: They would move heaven and earth to stop me if they could.
ex.cn: 可能的话，他们会千方百计地阻止我。

ex.en: Weather satellites have observed a ring of volcanic ash girdling the earth.
ex.cn: 气象卫星观测到一个环绕地球的火山灰带。

def: adv.容易地,很可能,迅速地,频繁地

ex.en: Stan Dean, easily identifiable by his oddly-shaped hat, sat in a doorway.
ex.cn: 斯坦·迪安坐在门口，他那顶奇形怪状的帽子一下子就让人认出他来。

ex.en: He easily overcame Garcia, Saturday's conqueror of Ernie Els.
ex.cn: 他轻松战胜了星期六击败厄尼·埃尔斯的加西亚。

ex.en: Neat solutions are not easily found to these issues.
ex.cn: 很难找到解决这些问题的巧妙办法。

def:
n.东，东方,东方国家,〈诗〉东风
adj.东方的，向东方的,从东方来的
adv.向东方（地）

ex.en: Big credits were given to East Germany by successive West German governments.
ex.cn: 历届西德政府给予东德大量的贷款。

ex.en: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

ex.en: The river widens considerably as it begins to turn east.
ex.cn: 河流转向东流时河道大幅度变宽。

def:
adj.东方的，东部（地方）的,朝东的,来自东方的
n.东方人,（美国）东部地区的人,东正教信徒

ex.en: Physical and ideological barriers had come down in Eastern Europe.
ex.cn: 物质和意识形态上的障碍在东欧已不复存在。

ex.en: Two trains collided head-on in north-eastern Germany early this morning.
ex.cn: 今天早上德国东北部两列火车迎面相撞。

ex.en: Several countries in eastern Europe are counting the cost of yesterday's earthquake.
ex.cn: 东欧的几个国家正在计算昨天的地震带来的损失。

def:
adj.容易的,舒适的,宽裕的,从容的
adv.容易地,不费力地,悠闲地,缓慢地
vi.停止划桨（常用作命令）
vt.向（水手或划手）发出停划命令

ex.en: It is easy to appreciate the craftsmanship of Armani.
ex.cn: 阿玛尼的精致工艺很容易博得人们的赞誉。

ex.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
ex.cn: 这种稍加变化的可口煎蛋卷做起来又快又容易。

ex.en: Once he knew his father's name, finding his whereabouts proved surprisingly easy.
ex.cn: 一旦他知道了父亲的名字，查找他父亲的下落就变得出奇地容易。

def:
vt.& vi.吃，喝
vi.（食物）吃起来感到,咬,（人）感到苦恼（或烦恼）,侵蚀，腐蚀
vt.（如酸）腐蚀,吃完,吃得使,侵蚀成

ex.en: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
ex.cn: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

ex.en: Jovial ladies chivvy you into ordering more than you can eat!
ex.cn: 热情的女招待会一再推荐，最后点的餐多到吃不下!

ex.en: Because you're not burning calories, everything you eat turns to fat.
ex.cn: 由于没有消耗卡路里，你吃的所有东西都会变成脂肪。

def:
n.边,优势,（悬崖、峭壁的）边缘，端,锋利，尖锐
vt.在…上加边界,使渐进,给（刀刃）磨边，使锋利,修整
vi.慢慢向前移动，侧身移动

ex.en: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
ex.cn: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

ex.en: The standard of living today is on the edge of subsistence.
ex.cn: 现在的生活水平几乎快要无法维持生计。

ex.en: A spell of poor health took the edge off her performance.
ex.cn: 一度身体欠佳令她表现有失水准。

def: n.编辑，编者,校订者,[计]编辑软件，编辑程序

ex.en: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

ex.en: I think he was born to be editor of a tabloid newspaper.
ex.cn: 我觉得他天生就是当小报编辑的料。

ex.en: The Editor can give no guarantee that they will fulfil their obligations.
ex.cn: 《编辑家》无法保证他们会履行职责.

def:
vt.& vi.教育，教导,训练，培养
vt.使理解或接受

ex.en: Ruth's parents opted to educate her intensively at home.
ex.cn: 露丝的父母选择了在家对她进行集中教育。

ex.en: She tried to educate her son's taste in music.
ex.cn: 她试图培养她儿子对音乐的爱好.

ex.en: The television programme is designed to educate and not merely to entertain.
ex.cn: 这个电视节目不仅是为了娱乐而且是为了教育而设计的.

def: n.教育,教育学,培养,训练

ex.en: Sex education is also expected to help check the spread of AIDS.
ex.cn: 人们还希望性教育有助于控制艾滋病的蔓延。

ex.en: Many students are not adequately prepared for higher education.
ex.cn: 许多学生并未做好接受高等教育的充分准备。

ex.en: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
ex.cn: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

def:
n.影响,效果,印象,所有物
vt.使发生,引起,产生（效果）
n.努力，尝试,工作,成就,杰作

ex.en: McGregor's effort was enough to edge Johnson out of the top spot.
ex.cn: 麦格雷戈奋力一搏，成功地将约翰逊从第一的位置上挤了下来。

ex.en: He was making a visible effort to control himself.
ex.cn: 他明显是在努力控制自己的情绪。

ex.en: It is incumbent upon all of us to make an extra effort.
ex.cn: 我们所有人都必须加倍努力。

def:
n.鸡蛋，蛋,卵,<俚>家伙
vt.煽动，怂恿,用蛋烹调,<俚>向人扔鸡蛋

ex.en: As the egg whites cook, they coagulate and rise to the surface.
ex.cn: 蛋白一煮就会凝结，并且浮起来。

ex.en: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used.
ex.cn: 每种菜谱都具体规定了所用鸡蛋的大小。

ex.en: Whisk the egg whites until they are foamy but not stiff.
ex.cn: 把蛋清搅至起沫而不黏稠的程度。

def:
num.八,八个,第八
n.八,八人（或物）一组,八人划船队
adj.八个的

ex.en: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
ex.cn: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

ex.en: Charlie was earning eight pounds, I was earning five.
ex.cn: 查利赚了8英镑，我赚了5英镑。

ex.en: The French, who led 21-3 at half time, scored eight tries.
ex.cn: 上半场以21：3领先的法国队有8个达阵得分。

def:
num.十八,十八个
n.十八岁,十八的记号,十九世纪,是八点钟

ex.en: Their two faces were hardly more than eighteen inches apart.
ex.cn: 他俩的脸相隔还不到18英寸。

ex.en: Eighteen boats plied the 1,000 miles of river along a trading route.
ex.cn: 18艘船沿着贸易航线往返于1,000英里的河面上。

ex.en: The Honduran press published reports of eighteen cases of alleged baby snatching.
ex.cn: 洪都拉斯媒体报道了18起涉嫌偷拐婴儿的案件。

def:
num.八十
n.八十,八十年代,八十岁
adj.八十的,八十个的,八十岁的

ex.en: The poll canvassed the views of almost eighty economists.
ex.cn: 民意调查征询了将近80位经济学家的意见。

ex.en: The stadium has been fitted with seating for over eighty thousand spectators.
ex.cn: 这个体育场配备了8万多个观众座席。

ex.en: As a novel, Nineteen Eighty-four hardly ranks with the greats.
ex.cn: 作为一部小说，《一九八四》很难被列为杰作。

def:
pron.（两者之中）任何一个
adj.（两者中）任一的,非此即彼的，两者择一的
adv.（否定句中）也,[用于否定句或否定词组后]也（不…），亦，而且,[口语] [用于否定句或否定词组后以加强语气]根本,当然
conj.[通常用于“either…or…”结构中]或者，要么[在“either…or…”结构中，动词的人称和数一般与离得最近的主动响应，但有时用第三人称单数，在口语中也有把两个主语合在一起用作复数的]

ex.en: She had met both sons and did not care for either.
ex.cn: 两个儿子她都见了，一个都不喜欢。

ex.en: He seems either to fear women or to sentimentalize them.
ex.cn: 他似乎要么怕女人要么就对她们怀有浪漫想法。

ex.en: On either side of the tracks the ground fell away sharply.
ex.cn: 跑道两侧都是很陡的斜坡。

def:
n.长者,长辈,元老,比…年长的人
adj.年纪较大的,资格老的,老练的

ex.en: She made liberal use of her elder sister's make-up and clothes.
ex.cn: 她随便把姐姐的化妆品和衣服拿来用。

ex.en: He is now an elder of the village church.
ex.cn: 他现在是乡村教会的长老。

ex.en: She used to play games of make-believe with her elder sister.
ex.cn: 她过去常跟姐姐玩扮家家的游戏。

def:
vt.选举,挑出，挑选,决定
vi.选择，挑选,进行选举
adj.精选的，选出的,选中的，当选而尚未就职的
n.被选的人

ex.en: Councils should be answerable to the people who elect them.
ex.cn: 市政会成员应对推选他们的人负责。

ex.en: Concentrators in geological sciences elect either geology or geography.
ex.cn: 主修地质学的学生要选修地质学或地理课程.

ex.en: Austrian voters went to the polls this weekend to elect a successor to the President.
ex.cn: 奥地利选民这周末去投票中心选举下届总统。

def:
adj.电的，带电的,发电的，导电的,令人激动的,电动的
n.电动车辆,带电体

ex.en: All Dreamland's electric blankets are guaranteed for three years.
ex.cn: 所有的梦乡牌电热毯质保3年。

ex.en: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.
ex.cn: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。

ex.en: Hybrids, unlike pure electric cars, never need to be plugged in.
ex.cn: 与纯电动汽车不同，混合动力车永远不需要接电源。

def: adj.用电的，与电有关的，电学的,令人激动的，紧张的，惊人的

ex.en: This degree programme is fully accredited by the Institution of Electrical Engineers.
ex.cn: 这门学位课程经电气工程师学院鉴定完全合格。

ex.en: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
ex.cn: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

ex.en: There are consistent reports of electrical torture being practised on inmates.
ex.cn: 一直有报道称犯人被施以电刑。

def: n.电力,电流，静电,高涨的情绪,紧张

ex.en: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
ex.cn: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

ex.en: It should also look into the possibilities of wind-generated electricity.
ex.cn: 还会对风力发电的可能性进行研究。

ex.en: The cost of electricity from coal-fired stations is expected to fall.
ex.cn: 用煤作燃料的火力发电站的成本有望降低。

def: n.象，大象

ex.en: The pavilion has become a £4 million steel and glass white elephant.
ex.cn: 这个耗资400万英镑、用钢与玻璃所构筑起的亭子已经成了一个华而不实的摆设。

ex.en: His tour de force is an elephant sculpture.
ex.cn: 他的精心之作是一件大象雕塑。

ex.en: The new office block has become an expensive white elephant.
ex.cn: 这座新办公大楼成了昂贵的摆设。

def:
num.十一,十一个,第十一
n.十一,十一个
adj.十一的,十一个的

ex.en: The Appeal Court has quashed the convictions of all eleven people.
ex.cn: 上诉法庭已经撤销对所有11人的判决。

ex.en: It's, what, eleven years or more since he's seen him.
ex.cn: 打从他上次见他，已有，嗯，11年甚至更久了。

ex.en: I've got two Malaysians coming to see me at eleven thirty.
ex.cn: 11点半会有两名马来西亚人来看我。

def:
adv.其他,否则,另外
adj.别的,其他的

ex.en: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
ex.cn: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

ex.en: So, if we could just move onto something else?
ex.cn: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

ex.en: She has done more to divide the Conservatives than anyone else.
ex.cn: 她在分裂保守党这件事上所起的作用比任何人都大。

def: adv.在别处，到别处,他

ex.en: Almost 80 percent of the state's residents were born elsewhere.
ex.cn: 该州居民中几乎有80%出生在异地。

ex.en: External broadcasting soaks up more resources in Britain than elsewhere.
ex.cn: 英国花费在对外广播上的财力高于其他国家。

ex.en: Businesses are feeling the indirect effects from the recession that'sgoing on elsewhere.
ex.cn: 企业感受到了别处经济衰退带来的间接影响。

def: n.皇帝，君主

ex.en: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
ex.cn: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

ex.en: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
ex.cn: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

ex.en: The President paid a courtesy call on Emperor Akihito.
ex.cn: 总统对明仁天皇进行了礼节性的拜访。

def:
vt.雇用,使用，利用
n.受雇,服务,工作

ex.en: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.
ex.cn: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。

ex.en: Others hinted that he was in the employ of the KGB.
ex.cn: 其他人暗示他受雇于克格勃。

ex.en: It was the first commercially available machine to employ artificial intelligence.
ex.cn: 这是第一台作为商品出售的采用人工智能技术的机器。

def:
adj.空的，空虚的，空洞的,空闲的，无效的，徒劳的,无聊的，愚蠢的,言语或行动空洞的
vt.（使）成为空的， 把…弄空,把…腾出来
vi.成为空的,流空
n.空车,空的东西

ex.en: Empty the contents of the pan into the sieve.
ex.cn: 将锅里的东西倒到筛子上。

ex.en: She showed him around the ground floor of the empty house.
ex.cn: 她带他参观了这处空房子的底楼。

ex.en: She went to the sink and ran water into her empty glass.
ex.cn: 她走到水槽边，把空玻璃杯灌上水。

def: vt.鼓励，鼓舞,支持,促进,鼓动

ex.en: The idea is to encourage people to get to know their neighbours.
ex.cn: 其目的是促使人们结识邻居。

ex.en: How can faculty improve their teaching so as to encourage creativity?
ex.cn: 教师们如何才能改进教学以激发创造性呢？

ex.en: The paper'sprice rise will encourage readers to desert in even greater numbers.
ex.cn: 报纸价格的上涨将导致更多的读者不再订阅。

def:
n.<正>结果,端,终止,最后部分
vt.& vi.结束，终止

ex.en: The agreement has raised hopes that the war may end soon.
ex.cn: 那项协议使人们感到战争有望很快结束。

ex.en: Rationing had put an end to a surfeit of biscuits long ago.
ex.cn: 定量供应很久以前就结束了饼干过剩的状况。

ex.en: He had wandered to the far end of the room.
ex.cn: 他转到屋子的那一头。

def:
n.结局,结束,终结,最后部份
v.结束，终止(end的现在分词)

ex.en: I nearly died when I learned where I was ending up.
ex.cn: 得知自己到了哪里时，我简直要晕过去了。

ex.en: The first figure shows sales for week ending July 27.
ex.cn: 第一组数据显示截至7月27日的周销售量。

ex.en: So far little progress has been made towards ending the fighting.
ex.cn: 到目前为止，在结束交战方面还没取得什么进展。

def:
n.仇敌,敌军,危害物
adj.敌人的,敌方的,与敌对力量相关的

ex.en: The President spoke of the treacherous intentions of the enemy.
ex.cn: 总统谈及了敌人的奸诈用心。

ex.en: Our men wiped them out, but the enemy fought bravely and well.
ex.cn: 我们的部队歼灭了敌人，但敌人也进行了顽强的抵抗。

ex.en: This is something of a grudge match against a long-term enemy.
ex.cn: 这可以说是一场与宿敌你死我活的比赛。

def: n.[物]能量,活力,精力,精神

n.工程师，技师,（轮船的）机师,〈美〉（火车的）司机，,（陆军的）工兵
vt.设计，策划,安排或处理,改变…的基因（或遗传）结构

ex.en: The RAF recognized him as an out-standingly able engineer.
ex.cn: 英国皇家空军表彰他是一名非常能干的机械师。

ex.en: The product is still only a gleam in an engineer's eye.
ex.cn: 该产品还只是工程师头脑中尚未成形的想法。

ex.en: The engineer and his son held frequent consultations concerning technical problems.
ex.cn: 工程师和他的儿子经常就技术问题互相征求意见。

def:
vt.享有，享受,欣赏,喜欢,使过得快活
vi.使过得快活

ex.en: I enjoy pleasure as much as the next person.
ex.cn: 我和别人一样愉快。

ex.en: Boys and girls will enjoy messing about with any kind of machine.
ex.cn: 男孩和女孩会喜欢摆弄各种机械装置。

ex.en: I have been a shooter for 16 years and enjoy my sport.
ex.cn: 我从事射击运动已经16年了，很喜爱这项运动。

def: n.享受,令人愉快的事物,享有

ex.en: I apologise if your enjoyment of the movie was spoiled.
ex.cn: 如果破坏了你看电影的兴致，我道歉。

ex.en: Most patients derive enjoyment from leafing through old picture albums.
ex.cn: 大多数病人都很喜欢翻看旧相册。

ex.en: Livy ate the pasties greedily and with huge enjoyment.
ex.cn: 莉薇津津有味地大口吃着点心。

def:
adv.足够地，充足地,十分地
adj.充足的,足够的
n.充分，足够,满足
int.够了

ex.en: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
ex.cn: 3亿美元远远不够。

ex.en: The plan is good; the problem is it doesn't go far enough.
ex.cn: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。

ex.en: America has enough firepower in the area to mount sustained air strikes.
ex.cn: 美国在该地区拥有足够的火力发动持续的空中打击。

def: vt.& vi.进入,开始,参加,登记

ex.en: Two men answer-ing the description of the suspects tried to enter Switzerland.
ex.cn: 与描述的疑犯样子相符的两名男子试图进入瑞士。

ex.en: No mammals other than people may enter the country without lengthy quarantine.
ex.cn: 除人之外，所有的哺乳动物进入这个国家都必须经过长期隔离。

ex.en: "Enter-taining is something that everyone in the country can enjoy," she averred.
ex.cn: “娱乐消遣是每个国民都能享受的事，”她坚定地说。

def:
n.入口，进口,进入,进入方法，进入方式,入场权
vt.使出神，使入迷,使喜悦，使狂喜

ex.en: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots.
ex.cn: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

ex.en: There were people at the entrance giving out leaflets.
ex.cn: 有人在入口处散发传单。

ex.en: If she had noticed her father's entrance, she gave no indication.
ex.cn: 就算她已经注意到了父亲的到来，她也会不动声色。

def: n.信封，封皮,壳层，外壳,包裹物,[生物学]膜，包袋

ex.en: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
ex.cn: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

ex.en: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
ex.cn: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

ex.en: The envelope has been tampered with and then taped shut again.
ex.cn: 信封被人动过手脚，然后又用胶带封上了。

def:
adj.相等的，平等的,平稳的,势均力敌的,胜任的
vt.等于,比得上,使相等,同样看待
n.同样的人,相等的数量,能与之比拟的东西,（地位、实力等）相同的人
vi.相等，相平（与out连用）

ex.en: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
ex.cn: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

ex.en: They are now trying to compete on an equal footing.
ex.cn: 他们现在想要公平竞争。

ex.en: The targets would not be achieved unless other departments showed equal commitment.
ex.cn: 除非其他部门同样努力，否则这些目标无法达成。

def: n.错误，过失,[法]误审，违法,[数]误差

ex.en: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
ex.cn: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

ex.en: The hospital blamed the mix-up on a clerical error.
ex.cn: 医院方面将这一混乱归咎于一处笔误。

ex.en: You have to allow for a certain amount of error.
ex.cn: 你必须将一定量的误差考虑在内。

def:
v.逃脱,逃离,躲过,泄露
n.逃走,逃跑工具或方法,野生种,泄漏
adj.使逃避困难的,使规避问题的

ex.en: No detail was too small to escape her attention.
ex.cn: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

ex.en: Leave a vent open to let some moist air escape.
ex.cn: 打开一个通风口，让潮气逸出一些。

ex.en: He could not escape the massed ranks of newsmen.
ex.cn: 他没法躲开成群的记者。

def: adv.尤其地,主要地，格外地,显著地,异常地

ex.en: All colour fades— especially under the impact of direct sunlight.
ex.cn: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

ex.en: He was disinclined to talk about himself, especially to his students.
ex.cn: 他不喜欢谈论他自己，尤其是当着他学生的面。

ex.en: Try to view situations more objectively, especially with regard to work.
ex.cn: 要尽量客观地分析情况，尤其是在工作上。

def:
adv.甚至,更加, 即使,恰巧在…时候
adj.公平的,平坦的, 偶数的,平均的
vt.使平坦,使相等
vi.变平,成为相等

ex.en: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
ex.cn: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

ex.en: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
ex.cn: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

ex.en: Some girls may first ovulate even before they menstruate.
ex.cn: 一些女孩的第一次排卵甚至可能出现在初潮之前。

def:
n.傍晚,黄昏,晚会,晚年，衰退期，末期
adj.在晚上的,为晚上的,晚上用的
int.晚上好

ex.en: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
ex.cn: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

ex.en: It was just gone 7 o'clock this evening when I finished.
ex.cn: 今晚我做完的时候刚过7点。

ex.en: The evening show was terrible, with hesitant unsure performances from all.
ex.cn: 晚上的演出很糟，所有人都缩手缩脚，显得很不自信。

def: n.事件，大事,活动，经历,结果,运动项目

ex.en: The birth of a live healthy baby is a truly blessed event.
ex.cn: 一个健康活泼的婴儿的出生真是一件可喜的事情。

ex.en: The event will go ahead as planned in Sheffield next summer.
ex.cn: 这项活动将按计划于明年夏天在谢菲尔德举行。

ex.en: Olga Korbut single-handedly turned gymnastics into a major event.
ex.cn: 奥尔佳·科布特独自一人将体操变成了一项重要赛事。

def: adv.终于，最后,竟,总归,终究

ex.en: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
ex.cn: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

ex.en: Mobutu ascended through the ranks, eventually becoming commander of the army.
ex.cn: 蒙博托出身行伍，通过一级级晋升，最终成为了陆军司令。

ex.en: Eventually they reached a pair of ornately carved doors.
ex.cn: 他们最终来到一扇雕刻精美的对开门前。

def: adv.永远,曾经，这以前,究竟，到底,可能

ex.en: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
ex.cn: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

ex.en: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
ex.cn: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

ex.en: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him.
ex.cn: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

def: det.每个,每,所有可能的,充足的

ex.en: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
ex.cn: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

ex.en: You should wash your feet and your privates every day.
ex.cn: 应该每天洗脚，并清洗阴部。

ex.en: Naomi used to go to church in Granville every Sunday.
ex.cn: 娜奥米以前每个星期天都去格兰维尔的教堂做礼拜。

def: pron.每人，人人,大伙儿,各位

ex.en: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
ex.cn: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

ex.en: It was a courageous decision, and one that everybody admired.
ex.cn: 那是一个勇敢的决定，也是一个为所有人赞赏的决定。

ex.en: She showed me round and introduced me to everybody.
ex.cn: 她领着我四处看了看，将我介绍给每个人。

def: adj.日常的，平常的,普通的,每天的,经常

ex.en: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics.
ex.cn: 1/5的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。

ex.en: The film chronicles the everyday doings of a group of London schoolchildren.
ex.cn: 电影记载了一群伦敦小学生的日常活动。

ex.en: The series chronicles the everyday adventures of two eternal bachelors.
ex.cn: 这个系列剧按照时间顺序记述了两个老光棍每天的奇遇。

def: pron.每人，人人

ex.en: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
ex.cn: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

ex.en: 1998 was an important year for everyone: a time of change.
ex.cn: 1998年对所有人来说都是重要的一年：那是个变革的时期。

ex.en: By the time he's twenty he'll know everyone worth knowing in Washington.
ex.cn: 到20岁时，他就会认识华盛顿所有值得认识的人。

def: pron.每件事物,最重要的东西,（有关的）一切,万事

ex.en: You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest. And if you do, if you stay positive, then you have a shot at a silver lining.
ex.cn: 你需要尽你所能，最大限度地去努力。只要你这么做，只要你能保持乐观，你就会看见乌云背后的幸福线。

ex.en: Because you're not burning calories, everything you eat turns to fat.
ex.cn: 由于没有消耗卡路里，你吃的所有东西都会变成脂肪。

ex.en: In prison they'd taken away his watch and everything he possessed.
ex.cn: 在监狱，他们把他的手表和其他一切东西都搜走了。

def: adv.到处，处处，无论什么地方,四下里,漫,匝地

ex.en: Stars appeared everywhere, spinning round and round, faster and faster.
ex.cn: 满眼金星乱转，而且越转越快。

ex.en: Everywhere building facades are pitted with shell and bullet holes.
ex.cn: 任一处的建筑物正面都布满了弹洞。

ex.en: Compton was sending the ball here, there, and everywhere with each stroke.
ex.cn: 康普顿一会将球打到这里，一会打到那里，每一拍的落点都不同。

def:
adj.准确的,严密的,精密的，精确的
vt.要求,苛求,迫使,强求

ex.en: The exact locations are being kept secret for reasons of security.
ex.cn: 确切地点因为安全原因要保密。

ex.en: A small number — five, to be exact—have been bad.
ex.cn: 一小部分——确切地说是5个——已经坏了。

ex.en: Charles scored again, with an exact duplicate of his first goal.
ex.cn: 查尔斯梅开二度,与第一次破门如出一辙.

def: n.<口>考试,测验

ex.en: Schools were told their exam information had to be spot-on and accurate.
ex.cn: 各学校接到通知，要求考试信息必须准确无误。

ex.en: Teachers know that low exam results will reflect badly on them.
ex.cn: 老师知道考试成绩不好将对他们不利。

ex.en: Liam surprised his tutors by twice failing a second year exam.
ex.cn: 利亚姆两次都没能通过大二的一门考试，这让他的导师们很吃惊。

def: n.检查,考试,询问，审问

ex.en: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
ex.cn: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

ex.en: The events in Los Angeles have sparked a new national self-examination.
ex.cn: 发生在洛杉矶的事件再次引发了全国范围的反思。

ex.en: Did you have to get through an entrance examination?
ex.cn: 你必须要通过入学考试吗？

def:
vt.检查，调查,考试,诊察,审问
vi.检查,调查

ex.en: I'll start with some generalities and then examine a few specific examples.
ex.cn: 我首先进行概述，然后会分析几个实例。

ex.en: We examine the wording in detail before deciding on the final text.
ex.cn: 我们彻底仔细地检查了措词后才最终定稿。

ex.en: Doctors examine their patients thoroughly in order to make a correct diagnosis.
ex.cn: 为了作出准确的诊断，医生会对病人进行彻底的检查。

def:
n.例子,榜样,范例,先例
vt.作为…的例子,为…做出榜样
vi.举例,作为…的示范

ex.en: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?
ex.cn: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

ex.en: The house is a textbook example of medieval domestic architecture.
ex.cn: 这所房子是典型的中世纪民居。

ex.en: That's just one example of the kind of experiments you can do.
ex.cn: 这只不过是你可以做的各种试验中的一例罢了。

def: adj.卓越的,杰出的,优秀的,太好了

ex.en: The regions are interconnected by an excellent highway system.
ex.cn: 那些地区通过完善的公路系统相互连接。

ex.en: Both offer excellent value at around £90 for a double room.
ex.cn: 两家的双人客房都报出了大约90英镑的超值价格。

ex.en: Large overseas-based trusts are an excellent each way bet.
ex.cn: 大型海外基金的投资前景非常好。

def:
vt.把…除外,不计
prep.除…外
conj.[口语]要不是,除非,除…以外
vi.反对，表示异议（与 to 或 against连用）

ex.en: He hadn't eaten a thing except for one forkful of salad.
ex.cn: 除了一餐叉色拉，他什么都没吃。

ex.en: She sipped the wine. Everything was hazy now, except for Nick's face.
ex.cn: 她小口地抿着酒。现在一切都变得模糊起来，除了尼克的脸。

ex.en: Except for the remarkably tidy kitchen, the place was a mess.
ex.cn: 除了厨房特别干净外，这地方一片狼藉。

def: vt.使兴奋,激发,刺激,使紧张不安

ex.en: Reports of the plot of this unusual film tend to excite revulsion.
ex.cn: 有关这部不同寻常电影的情节的报道常常令人生厌。

ex.en: Daniel's early exposure to motor racing did not excite his interest.
ex.cn: 丹尼尔早期与摩托车赛的接触并没有激发他的兴趣。

ex.en: The speaker has been warned to excite violence in the crowd.
ex.cn: 演讲者曾受到警告,不要在听众中挑起暴力.

def:
adj.兴奋的，激动的,活跃的,激发的,受刺激的
v.使兴奋（ excite的过去式和过去分词）

ex.en: When angry or excited, however, he could be wild, profane, and terrifying.
ex.cn: 但愤怒或激动的时候，他也会发狂、会骂人、令人生畏。

ex.en: She makes you feel warm and comfortable, and maybe a little excited.
ex.cn: 她让人感觉温暖舒适，还可能有一点性欲高涨。

ex.en: I'm very excited about the possibility of playing for England's first team.
ex.cn: 想到可能为英格兰首屈一指的球队效力，我非常兴奋。

def: n.兴奋，激动,令人兴奋的事,刺激，振奋

ex.en: It had been a time of almost uncontrollable excitement.
ex.cn: 那是一个几乎难以抑制亢奋的时期。

ex.en: Its atmosphere is one of repose rather than excitement.
ex.cn: 那里气氛安宁而不热闹。

ex.en: She felt a strange excitement taking hold of her.
ex.cn: 她浑身感到一股莫名的兴奋。

def:
adj.使人兴奋的，令人激动的
v.刺激（excite的现在分词）

ex.en: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
ex.cn: 不管怎么说，追求的过程总比得手更为刺激。

ex.en: Working abroad should be an exciting and positive experience for all concerned.
ex.cn: 在海外工作对所有相关人员来说都应该是一段让人兴奋而愉快的经历。

ex.en: It'san exciting opportunity to learn what goes on behind the scenes.
ex.cn: 可以有机会了解幕后的工作，令人非常兴奋。

def:
vt.原谅,为…申辩,免除，宽免,给…免去
n.借口，托辞,道歉，歉意,辩解,请假条
vi.作为借口,请示宽恕,表示宽恕

ex.en: He'd telephoned with some phoney excuse she didn't believe for a minute.
ex.cn: 他找了某个她根本不会相信的借口给她打电话。

ex.en: National security is the stock excuse for keeping things confidential.
ex.cn: 国家安全常被用作对一些事情保密的挡箭牌。

ex.en: A conservatory offers the perfect excuse to let your imagination run riot.
ex.cn: 音乐学院让你有充分的理由任想象力自由驰骋。

def:
n.练习,运动，训练,运用,典礼
vi.锻炼，训练，练习
vt.锻炼（身体某部位）,使焦虑，使忧虑,实行，发挥（作用）,运用

ex.en: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks.
ex.cn: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

ex.en: Swimming is probably the best form of exercise you can get.
ex.cn: 游泳或许是现有的最佳锻炼方式。

ex.en: A bit of exercise will help lift his spirits.
ex.cn: 进行一点儿体育锻炼能帮助他改善情绪。

def: n.陈列，展览,展览品，陈列品,表明,[法]（证据等的）提出
vi.存在,生存,生活,继续存在

ex.en: I would have to learn, little by little, to exist alone.
ex.cn: 我得慢慢学会独自生活。

ex.en: For all practical purposes the treaty has already ceased to exist.
ex.cn: 实际上协议已经不复存在。

ex.en: He thought that if he couldn't see something, it didn't exist.
ex.cn: 他认为自己看不见的东西就不存在。

def:
n.出口，通道,退场,退去，退出,死亡
vi.离开,退出,退场,去世

ex.en: Go north on I-15 to the exit just past Barstow.
ex.cn: 沿着15号州际公路一直向北，一过巴斯托就从出口驶出。

ex.en: They escaped through an emergency exit and called the police.
ex.cn: 他们从紧急出口逃脱，并报了警。

ex.en: Our big task for tomorrow .Wed.. is to get them exit visas.
ex.cn: 明天（星期三）我们最重要的任务就是拿到他们的出境签证。

def:
vt.期望,预料,要求,认为（某事）会发生
vi.预期,期待,怀胎,怀孕

ex.en: Don't expect me to come and visit you there.
ex.cn: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

ex.en: "Will Joe be here at Christmas?" — "I expect so."
ex.cn: “圣诞节时乔会来这里吗？”——“我想会的。”

ex.en: How can you expect me to believe your promises?
ex.cn: 你怎能指望我相信你的承诺？

def: vt.花费,耗尽,用光

ex.en: Don't expend all your time on such a useless job.
ex.cn: 不要把时间消耗在这种无用的工作上.

ex.en: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.
ex.cn: 孩子们消耗很多能量，可能比成年人需要更多高能量的食物。

ex.en: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
ex.cn: 停止锻炼会使肌肉萎缩、脂肪增加。同样，如果花更多的精力锻炼，就会减掉脂肪。

def: adj.昂贵的，花钱多的,豪华的

ex.en: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
ex.cn: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

ex.en: The case against is twofold: too risky and too expensive.
ex.cn: 反对理由有两点：太冒险而且太昂贵。

ex.en: They actually moved down from upstairs because the rent's that expensive.
ex.cn: 他们确实从楼上搬到了楼下，因为房租太贵了。

def:
n.经验，体验,经历，阅历
vt.亲身参与，亲身经历,感受,发现

ex.en: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
ex.cn: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

ex.en: Few would argue that this team has experience and proven ability.
ex.cn: 这个队伍的丰富经验和表现出来的实力是众所公认的。

ex.en: His office was in keeping with his station and experience.
ex.cn: 他的办公室与其身份和阅历相称。

def:
n.实验，试验,尝试
vi.做实验，进行试验,尝试

ex.en: He is always eager for new experiences and ever-willing to experiment.
ex.cn: 他总是渴望拥有新的经历，而且永远愿意尝试。

ex.en: This was demonstrated in a laboratory experiment with rats.
ex.cn: 在实验室用老鼠进行的实验证明了这一点。

ex.en: Ellis bristles at accusations that Berkeley's experiment is ill-conceived.
ex.cn: 埃利斯对有人指责伯克利的实验考虑不够周密感到气愤。

def:
vt.& vi.讲解，解释
vt.说明…的原因，辩解
vi.说明，解释，辩解

ex.en: Her aggressiveness made it difficult for him to explain his own feelings.
ex.cn: 她咄咄逼人的态度让他难以解释自己的感情。

ex.en: Hospital discipline was broken. Amy would have to explain herself.
ex.cn: 破坏了医院的纪律，埃米将不得不为自己辩解。

ex.en: Doctors cannot be bothered to explain what they do.
ex.cn: 医生们才懒得解释他们所做的事情。

def: n.解释,说明,辩解,（消除误会后）和解

ex.en: Their water was turned off weeks ago without explanation.
ex.cn: 他们的水在几周以前就毫无理由地被切断了。

ex.en: Herr Kohler wanted an explanation for what he described as "slanderous" remarks.
ex.cn: 赫尔·科勒希望有人能够为那些他称之为“造谣中伤”的言辞作出解释。

ex.en: It is possible that there's an explanation for all this.
ex.cn: 也许，对于所有这一切，会有一种解释。

def:
v.表达,表示,显而易见,快递邮寄
adj.特快的,迅速的,用快递寄送的, 明确的
n.特快列车,快递服务
adv.使用快速服务

ex.en: He ran a newspaper stand outside the American Express office.
ex.cn: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。

ex.en: Many editorials express their anxieties about the economic chaos in the country.
ex.cn: 许多社论对该国经济的混乱状况表示忧虑。

ex.en: It was important for children to learn to express themselves clearly.
ex.cn: 孩子学会清楚地表达自己很重要。

def:
adj.额外的，补充的，附加的,特大的，特别的
n.附加物，额外的事物,临时演员,号外,上等产品，上品
adv.额外地,格外地，特别地

ex.en: She gave him an extra scoop of clotted cream.
ex.cn: 她多给他加了一勺浓缩奶油。

ex.en: The President is determined "to go the extra mile for peace".
ex.cn: 总统决心“为实现和平而加倍努力”。

ex.en: There's an extra blanket in the bottom drawer of the cupboard.
ex.cn: 壁橱最下面的抽屉里还有一条多余的毯子。

def:
n.眼睛,视力,眼状物,风纪扣扣眼
vt.定睛地看,注视,审视,细看

ex.en: He has a visual impairment in the right eye.
ex.cn: 他右眼视力有损伤。

ex.en: The worms cannot be seen by the naked eye.
ex.cn: 这些虫子用肉眼看不见。

ex.en: Bankers are keeping a wary eye on the outcome.
ex.cn: 银行家们对结果保持高度警惕。

def: n.视觉，视力,见解，观察,眼力

ex.en: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
ex.cn: 他视力不好，算不上是一个出色的射手。

ex.en: Until the beating, Cantanco's eyesight had been weak, but adequate.
ex.cn: 挨打前坎坦科的视力就一直很弱，不过也还勉强看得见。

ex.en: Her ambition to become an artist was thwarted by failing eyesight.
ex.cn: 她想成为艺术家的梦想由于视力衰减而破灭了。

def:
n.面容,表面,脸,方面
vt.& vi.面对,面向…,正视,承认
vt.（感到不能）对付,（明知不好办而）交谈,必须对付（某情况）,面临…

ex.en: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
ex.cn: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

ex.en: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face.
ex.cn: 雾蒙蒙的寒冷空气使他脸上感觉很舒爽。

ex.en: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
ex.cn: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

def: n.事实，实情,实际,真相，证据,犯罪行为
n.工厂，制造厂,<古>代理店

ex.en: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.
ex.cn: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。

ex.en: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another.
ex.cn: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

ex.en: The girl had found out about the goings-on in the factory.
ex.cn: 这个女孩已经发现了工厂里的勾当。

def:
vt.& vi.失败，不及格,倒闭，破产,缺乏,衰退
vi.衰退,失败，不及格,破产,不足
vt.不及格,使失望,忘记,舍弃
n.失败，失误,不及格,不及格者,[商]期货交割失期

ex.en: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
ex.cn: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

ex.en: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
ex.cn: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

ex.en: The various elements of the novel fail to cohere.
ex.cn: 这部小说的各部分之间缺乏连贯性。

def: n.失败，不及格,缺乏，不足,破产，倒闭,失败的事，失败者

ex.en: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
ex.cn: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

ex.en: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
ex.cn: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

ex.en: It is the easy way out to blame others for our failure.
ex.cn: 把我们的失败归罪到别人头上倒是省事。

def:
adj.微弱的，模糊的,软弱的,无勇气的,将昏倒似的
vi.头晕，昏过去,渐渐不明，消失
n.昏厥，昏倒

ex.en: It's a film about a serial killer and not for the faint-hearted.
ex.cn: 这部电影是讲一个连环杀手的，不适合胆小的人看。

ex.en: Their instruments detected very faint radiowaves at a frequency of 3 kilohertz.
ex.cn: 他们的仪器检测到一个3千赫的微弱无线电波。

ex.en: Don't be faint-hearted when things seem a bit slow or boring.
ex.cn: 事情变得有点沉闷无聊的时候，不要胆怯。

def:
adj.公平的,合理的,晴朗的,美丽的
adv.公平地,直接地,清楚地,正大光明地
n.集市，庙会,商品交易会，展览会,美人，美丽的事物
vt.（卡通制作）顺利接合,（动作）衔接协调,（飞机）装配平整,使（飞机接合部）平滑
vi.转晴

ex.en: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
ex.cn: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

ex.en: The team also won praise for sportsmanship and fair play.
ex.cn: 该队还因其良好的体育精神及公平竞争精神而受到了表扬。

ex.en: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

def: adv.适当，相当地,公平地,完全，简直,清楚地

ex.en: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
ex.cn: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

ex.en: We have a fairly good idea of what's going on.
ex.cn: 我们对正在发生的事有着相当清楚的认识。

ex.en: We've got a fairly unfavourable exchange rate at the moment.
ex.cn: 眼下汇率对我们不利。

def:
n.信用，信任,宗教信仰,忠诚,宗教
int.实在，确实

ex.en: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
ex.cn: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

ex.en: Non-violence and patience are the central tenets of their faith.
ex.cn: 非暴力和忍耐是他们的信仰的核心原则。

ex.en: His government is placing its faith in international diplomacy.
ex.cn: 他的政府对国际外交关系充满信心。

def:
v.落下,跌倒,减少,沦陷
n.落下,瀑布,秋天,减少

ex.en: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
ex.cn: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

ex.en: Over a given period, the value of shares will rise and fall.
ex.cn: 股票的价值在某一特定的时期内会有涨跌。

ex.en: I hope that our appeals will not fall on deaf ears.
ex.cn: 我希望我们的呼吁不会没人理睬。

def:
adj.虚伪的,不正的，非法的,假造的，摹造的,临时的
adv.欺诈地,叛卖地

ex.en: I was wearing false eyelashes and a sweater two sizes too small.
ex.cn: 我戴着假睫毛，穿着小了两号的毛衣。

ex.en: Look at the false police reports that omitted or misstated crucial facts.
ex.cn: 看看这份失实的警方报告吧，它忽略或歪曲了关键的事实。

ex.en: In the early seventies I wore false eyelashes, as was the fashion.
ex.cn: 70年代初我戴假睫毛，这在当时是时尚。

def:
adj.熟悉的,通晓的,冒昧的,随便的
n.常客，密友,高级官吏的家属,[天主]教皇[主教]的仆人

ex.en: Rose heard the familiar voice, but tuned out the words.
ex.cn: 罗斯听到了熟悉的声音，但没注意听说的是什么。

ex.en: She looks disconcertingly like a familiar aunt or grandmother.
ex.cn: 令人疑惑的是，她看上去就像一位面熟的邻家阿姨或是祖母。

ex.en: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
ex.cn: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

def:
n.家庭,家族,孩子,祖先
adj.家庭的,一家所有的,属于家庭的,适合全家人的

ex.en: The family was often in flight, hiding out in friends' houses.
ex.cn: 这一家人常常东躲西藏，在朋友家里避风头。

ex.en: Each family farms individually and reaps the benefit of its labor.
ex.cn: 各家经营各自的农场，收获各自的劳动成果。

ex.en: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.
ex.cn: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。

def: adj.著名的，出名的,〈古〉一流的，极好的

ex.en: The chalky soil around Saumur produces the famous Anjou wines.
ex.cn: 索米尔周围的白垩质土壤出产著名的安茹葡萄酒。

ex.en: The town of whitby was immortalised in Bram Stoker's famous Dracula story.
ex.cn: 惠特比镇因为布拉姆·斯托克著名的吸血鬼故事而名传后世。

ex.en: Later he was to become famous as a pacifist.
ex.cn: 后来他就变成了一位知名的和平主义者。

def:
n.扇子，风扇,迷，粉丝,扇形物,扬谷机
vt.扇动,吹拂，扬去
vi.成扇形

ex.en: As a boy he was a Manchester United fan.
ex.cn: 小时候，他是曼联队的球迷。

ex.en: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'lllove this movie.
ex.cn: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

ex.en: He has charmed most of them into membership of his fan club.
ex.cn: 他施展魅力，让他们大部分人都加入了他的支持者行列。

def:
adv.久远地,（问到或谈及距离时说）有多远,到很远距离,到很大程度
adj.远的,遥远的,（某方向的）最远的,远端的
n.远方

n.农场，农庄,农家,畜牧场,农田
vt.耕种,养殖,承包，包出,佃出（土地）
vi.经营农场

ex.en: His most prized time, though, will be spent quietly on his farm.
ex.cn: 不过，他最宝贵的时光将在自己的农场里平静地度过。

ex.en: I came to live at the farm by happenstance.
ex.cn: 我来到该农场住下纯属偶然。

ex.en: You lived on the farm until you came back to America?
ex.cn: 你回美国之前一直生活在农场吗？

def: n.农场主，农民,承包人

ex.en: Mr Farmer and Mrs Jones both admitted conspiring to murder her husband.
ex.cn: 法默先生和琼斯太太都承认密谋杀死了琼斯先生。

ex.en: A farmer is entitled to a certain particularized tax treatment.
ex.cn: 农民能够得到某种具体的税收待遇。

ex.en: Lambing is the climax of the sheep farmer's year.
ex.cn: 一年之中，产羔期最令羊农高兴。

def:
adv.更远地,较远地,在更大程度上,进一步
adj.更远的,远的( far的比较级),遥远的,（某方向的）最远的

ex.en: Both of my sisters moved even farther away from home.
ex.cn: 我的两个姐姐都搬得离家更远了。

ex.en: I can't see any farther than the next six months.
ex.cn: 6个月以后的事情我就无法预见了。

ex.en: She set her glass down and slid farther under the covers.
ex.cn: 她放下杯子，钻进被子里。

def:
adj.快的,走得快,感光快的,紧的
adv.（比准确的时间或宣布的时间）快,迅速地,紧紧地,彻底地
vi.禁食，（尤指）斋戒
n.禁食期，斋戒期,断食，节食

ex.en: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
ex.cn: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

ex.en: The auguries of death are fast gathering round his head.
ex.cn: 死亡凶兆迅速地在他脑海中盘旋。

ex.en: Word has been spreading fast of the incidents on the streets.
ex.cn: 有关街头骚乱的消息迅速传播开来。

def:
adj.肥的,胖的,厚的,大量的
n.脂肪,肥肉,动植物油
vt.养肥,在…中加入脂肪
vi.长肥

n.父亲,祖先,（尤指天主教和东正教的）神父,天父
vt.成为父亲,创立（新思想）,创造,发明（新方法）

ex.en: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
ex.cn: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

ex.en: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
ex.cn: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

ex.en: There was a long silence, and my father looked shamefaced.
ex.cn: 沉默持续了很长时间，而我父亲看上去面带愧色。

def:
n.缺点，缺陷,过错，责任,[电]故障,（猎狗的）失去嗅迹
vt.挑剔，找…的缺点,批评,做错，在…中出错,[地质学]产生断层
vi.找错误，挑剔,[地质学]变动从而产生断层

ex.en: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
ex.cn: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

ex.en: He could never accept that he had been at fault.
ex.cn: 他怎么也无法承认是他的错。

ex.en: I was disappointed whenever the cook found fault with my work.
ex.cn: 每当厨师挑剔我干的活儿时，我都非常沮丧。

def:
n.好感,宠爱,关切,欢心
vt.支持,赞成,照顾,促成

ex.en: Recent opinion polls show that 60 percent favor abortion under certain circumstances.
ex.cn: 最近的民意调查显示，60%的人赞成在某些情况下可以堕胎。

ex.en: Safire writes hilariously of being banished from presidential favor.
ex.cn: 萨菲尔笔锋幽默，描写了自己没能博取总统好感的事。

ex.en: Good old Bergen would do him the favor.
ex.cn: 好心肠的老伯根会帮他这个忙的。

def:
n.帮助,恩惠,赞同,善行
vt.喜爱,有利于,赞同,容貌像…

ex.en: You did us a great favour by disposing of that problem.
ex.cn: 你解决了那个问题，可算是帮了我们一个大忙。

ex.en: The newspaper is now weighted in favour of trivia.
ex.cn: 这份报纸如今倾向于报道一些花边消息。

ex.en: The vote passed with 111 in favour and 25 against.
ex.cn: 111票赞成，25票反对，表决通过。

def:
n.传真
vt.传真,传真传输

ex.en: The machine automatically downloads the required information to his or her fax.
ex.cn: 机器能自动将需要的信息下载到传真机上。

ex.en: Pop it in the post, or get your secretary to fax it.
ex.cn: 把它扔进邮筒，要不然就让你的秘书发份传真。

ex.en: These days, cartoonists send in their work by fax.
ex.cn: 现在卡通画家用传真机发送作品。

def:
n.害怕,可能性,（对神等的）敬畏,忧虑
vt.畏惧,害怕,为…忧虑（或担心、焦虑）,敬畏（神等）
vi.害怕,忧虑,感到害怕,惧怕

ex.en: His mind was a haze of fear and confusion.
ex.cn: 由于害怕和困惑，他当时处于一种混沌状态。

ex.en: He seems either to fear women or to sentimentalize them.
ex.cn: 他似乎要么怕女人要么就对她们怀有浪漫想法。

ex.en: Mack made his voice quiver with fear on these last two words.
ex.cn: 麦克说出最后这两个字时，吓得声音颤抖。

def:
n.羽毛，翎毛,状态，心情,种类,桨叶的水平运动
v.给装上羽毛，用羽毛装饰,使（桨）与水面平行,长羽毛

ex.en: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
ex.cn: 拔羽毛必须干净利落。

ex.en: She and my mother were birds of a feather.
ex.cn: 她和我妈妈是一个类型的人。

ex.en: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
ex.cn: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘在了天鹅绒上。

def: n.二月

ex.en: He was jailed in February 1992 and could be released next year.
ex.cn: 他于1992年2月入狱，可能明年获释。

ex.en: Sow the seed in a warm place in February/March.
ex.cn: 2月或3月里把种子播种在温暖的地方。

ex.en: Average weekly cinema attendance in February was 2.41 million.
ex.cn: 2月份，平均每周的观影人数为241万。

def:
vt.喂养,满足（欲望等）,向…提供,供…作食物
vi.吃，以…为食,流入，注入，进入（如油流入机器）,[电子学]馈入
n.饲料（尤指粗饲料），施肥,喂送,草料,（尤指向地方性电视台）馈送电视节目

vt.感觉,认为,触摸,试探
vt.& vi.感觉，觉得,认为，以为,触摸
n.感觉,触摸,感受,触觉
vi.觉得,摸索

ex.en: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
ex.cn: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

ex.en: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
ex.cn: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

ex.en: I've gotten my feet thoroughly soaked and feel frozen through and through.
ex.cn: 我双脚湿透，感觉都冻到骨头里了。

def:
n.感觉，知觉，情绪,感情,气氛
adj.富有感情的，有感觉的,有同情心的，仁慈的
v.感觉,认为(feel的现在分词)

ex.en: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down.
ex.cn: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。

ex.en: His wife wasn't feeling too well and she wanted to go home.
ex.cn: 他的妻子感到有些不舒服，想要回家。

ex.en: McKay walked slowly toward this screen, feeling a growing tenseness.
ex.cn: 麦凯缓缓地朝这个屏幕走来，每走一步心情都更加紧张。

def:
n.同伴,男子,（大学的）研究员,（某些学院或大学的）董事
adj.同伴的,同事的,同类的,同情况的
vt.使…与另一个对等,使…与另一个匹敌

ex.en: By all accounts, Rodger would appear to be a fine fellow.
ex.cn: 据说，罗杰是个好小伙。

ex.en: She shared her daughter's disdain for her fellow countrymen.
ex.cn: 她和女儿都瞧不起自己的同胞。

ex.en: He was a tall, thin fellow with a slight stoop.
ex.cn: 他是个瘦高个儿，有点驼背。

def:
n.栅栏，篱笆,围墙,防护物,剑术
vt.用篱笆围住,防护,练习剑术
vi.练习击剑,搪塞,围以栅栏,跳过栅栏

ex.en: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
ex.cn: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

ex.en: The first task was to fence the wood to exclude sheep.
ex.cn: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

ex.en: The small churchyard was surrounded by a rusted wrought-iron fence.
ex.cn: 不大的教堂墓地周边围着一圈生锈的熟铁栅栏。

def:
vt.接来（某人）,使发出,吸引,售得（若干价钱）
vi.抵达，到达,取来,卖得（好价钱）
n.拿取，拿来,诡计,风浪区

ex.en: The painting is expected to fetch between two and three million pounds.
ex.cn: 预计这幅画将售得两三百万英镑。

ex.en: He sent his driver to fetch him a strawberry shake.
ex.cn: 他让司机去给他买一杯草莓奶昔。

ex.en: Fetch me a glass of water.
ex.cn: 去给我拿杯水来。

def:
n.发热，发烧,热病,一时的狂热,激动不安
vt.引起发热,使狂热,使患热病
vi.发热或变得发热,狂热,患热病

ex.en: During fever a large quantity of fluid is lost in perspiration.
ex.cn: 发烧时，大量水分会通过排汗而丧失。

ex.en: Michael was given a complete going-over and then treated for glandular fever.
ex.cn: 迈克尔接受了全面体检，随后又进行了腺热治疗。

ex.en: Evans had rheumatic fever, missed school and fell behind.
ex.cn: 伊万斯得了风湿热，没去上课，功课也落下了。

def:
adj.很少的,很少,（与复数名词和复数动词连用）有些,几乎没有的
pron.很少,有些（人、事物、地方）,（与复数动词连用）少数人,不和…一般多
n.很少数

ex.en: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
ex.cn: 我尽量言简意赅。

ex.en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
ex.cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

ex.en: Few would argue that this team has experience and proven ability.
ex.cn: 这个队伍的丰富经验和表现出来的实力是众所公认的。

def:
n.田,（作某种用途的）场地,（学习或研究的）领域,运动场
vi.[棒球、板球等]担任外场员，担任守队队员,接守，接防,接，掷还（球）
adj.实地的,[体育]1)。 在田赛场地进行的2)。 田赛的,军事]野战的,在实地工作的
vt.保护,把（农作物等）晒在场上,[棒球、板球等]按（或截）（球）,即席圆满回答

ex.en: He was the fastest thing I ever saw on a baseball field.
ex.cn: 他是我在棒球场上见过的跑得最快的家伙。

ex.en: Pinch-hitter Francisco Cabrera lashed a single to left field.
ex.cn: 替补队员弗朗西斯科·卡布雷拉向左外场猛地击出一个一垒打。

ex.en: He was on the training field for some light work yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天他在训练场进行了一些强度较小的训练。

def: n.十五,十五个人组成的橄榄球队

ex.en: Fifteen-year-old Danny is on the run from a local authority home.
ex.cn: 15岁的丹尼从地方当局的收容所逃跑了。

ex.en: They had left school at fifteen and were quite untutored in writing.
ex.cn: 他们15岁就辍学了，几乎未接受过正式的写作训练。

ex.en: The incident brings the total of people killed to fifteen.
ex.cn: 这次事故使死亡总人数达到15人。

def:
n.五十个人,五十岁,五十年代,编号为五十的东西
num.五十,五十个
adj.五十的,五十个的,许多的

ex.en: The village is a settlement of just fifty houses.
ex.cn: 这个村子里只住了50户人。

ex.en: Forty or fifty women were sitting cross-legged on the ground.
ex.cn: 四五十个女人盘腿坐在地上。

ex.en: He came to a halt at a crossroads fifty yards further on.
ex.cn: 他在往前50码远的十字路口停了下来。

def:
vt.& vi.战斗,斗争,打架,吵架
n.打架,吵架,战斗,斗志

ex.en: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
ex.cn: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

ex.en: He had had a fight with Smith and bloodied his nose.
ex.cn: 他和史密斯打了一架，把后者的鼻子打出了血。

ex.en: We'll face a tough fight in the upcoming election.
ex.cn: 在即将到来的选举中，我们将面临一场恶斗。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）充满，（使）装满
vt.满足,配药,（按订单）供应,使充满（感情）
n.填满…的量,充分,装填物,路堤

ex.en: You don't need green fingers to fill your home with lush leaves.
ex.cn: 不是园艺大师也可以把自己的家里装点得绿意盎然。

ex.en: Kemp got out of his car. "Just fill her up, thanks."
ex.cn: 肯普下了车。“给它加满油，谢谢。”

ex.en: Fill a saucepan with water and bring to a slow boil.
ex.cn: 往平底锅里加满水，小火煮沸。

def:
n.影片,电影,胶片,薄层
vt.& vi.（把…）拍摄（成）电影[电视等],上镜头
vt.（给…）覆上一薄层,生薄膜,变得朦胧

ex.en: The criticisms will not stop people flocking to see the film.
ex.cn: 批评的声音不会阻止人们涌到影院观看这部电影。

ex.en: Originally released in 1957, the film was remade as "The Magnificent Seven".
ex.cn: 这部电影最早在1957年上映，后被翻拍为《七侠荡寇志》。

ex.en: The film starts off realistically and then develops into a ridiculous fantasy.
ex.cn: 电影以写实开头，然后却发展成为荒诞的幻想。

def:
adj.最后的，最终的,决定性的,不可更改的
n.结局,决赛,期末考试,〈口〉（报纸的）末版

ex.en: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.--Winston Churchill
ex.cn: 成功不是终点，失败也并非末日，最重要的是继续前进的勇气。

ex.en: The winner of each preliminary goes through to the final.
ex.cn: 每场初赛的获胜者进入决赛。

ex.en: The final word will still come from the Secretary of State.
ex.cn: 最后仍然要由国务卿来定夺。

def: adv.最后，终于,总算,末后,结果

ex.en: At approxi-mately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
ex.cn: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

ex.en: He finally corrected his misstatement and offered to reduce the fee.
ex.cn: 他终于纠正了自己的错误说法，提出要减少费用。

ex.en: Several long-awaited videos will finally arrive in the shops this month.
ex.cn: 几部让人翘首企盼的录像片终于将在这个月到货。

def:
v.发现,找到,查明,发觉
n.发现物,被发现的人

ex.en: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
ex.cn: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

ex.en: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
ex.cn: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

ex.en: It would be difficult to find two men who were more dissimilar.
ex.cn: 很难找到彼此间差异更大的人了。

def:
adj.好的，上等的,纤细的，精致的,健康的,晴朗的
n.罚款,[音乐]终止,晴天,地租
vt.罚款,澄清
adv.很好地,巧妙地

ex.en: "I want to send a telegram." — "Fine, to whom?"
ex.cn: “我想发份电报。”——“好的，发给谁？”

ex.en: She's going to be fine. She always was pretty strong.
ex.cn: 她会好的。她一直都很强壮。

ex.en: Before the race, he is fine. But afterwards he is worn out.
ex.cn: 赛前他状态很好，赛后就筋疲力尽了。

def:
n.手指,指状物,指针
vt.伸出,告发,用手指触摸
vi.用手指触摸,拨弄

ex.en: Isn't it about time that you pulled your finger out?
ex.cn: 现在到了你该赶紧动起来的时候了吧？

ex.en: He claims to have his finger on the pulse of the industry.
ex.cn: 他声称该对行业了如指掌。

ex.en: He explored the wound with his finger, trying to establish its extent.
ex.cn: 他用手指摸了摸伤口，想要确定受伤的程度。

def:
vt.& vi.完成,结束,吃光,使筋疲力尽
n.结尾,结束,最后阶段,抛光

ex.en: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
ex.cn: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

ex.en: They meant to finish her off, swiftly and without mercy.
ex.cn: 他们打算毫不留情地迅速结果了她。

ex.en: The game took her less than an hour to finish.
ex.cn: 她没用一个小时就拿下了这场比赛。

def:
n.火，燃烧物,火灾,射击，发射,热情
vt.& vi.开火，射击,燃烧,引爆炸药,充满热情
vt.<口>解雇,射（箭）,激励,射出（子弹）

ex.en: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
ex.cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

ex.en: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute.
ex.cn: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

ex.en: If something's a sure-fire hit then Radio One will play it.
ex.cn: 如果哪首歌一定会火，那么第一频道肯定会播出。

def: n.消防队员,[矿]救火员，爆破工,司炉工

ex.en: The fireman evacuated the guests from the burning hotel.
ex.cn: 消防队员把客人们从燃烧着的旅馆中撤出来.

ex.en: The fireman trained their hoses on the burning building.
ex.cn: 消防队员把水龙带对准燃烧的建筑物.

ex.en: The fireman demonstrated great courage in saving the child.
ex.cn: 那位消防队员在抢救孩子的过程中,表现了极大的勇气.

def:
adj.坚固的，坚牢的,坚定的，坚决的,严格的,确定的
vt.& vi.使坚固,使坚实
n.商号，商行,公司,企业,工作集体
adv.坚定地，稳固地
vt.使坚定，使牢固
vi.变坚实，变稳固

ex.en: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
ex.cn: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

ex.en: An oil executive swindled £50,000 out of his firm.
ex.cn: 一名石油公司主管从其公司骗取了5万英镑。

ex.en: "But Peter, it's not that simple," Goldstone countered in a firm voice.
ex.cn: “但是，彼得，事情并非那么简单，”戈德斯通语气坚决地驳斥道。

def:
n.第一，最初,头等,一号，,[乐]高音部
adv.最早，最初,首次,宁愿,优先
adj.第一流的,最初的，最早的,基本的，概要的,高音的
num.第一

ex.en: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
ex.cn: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

ex.en: I picked first all the people who usually were left till last.
ex.cn: 我先挑出了所有通常留到最后的人。

ex.en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
ex.cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

def:
n.鱼，鱼肉，鱼类,〈口〉（特殊的）人物，家伙，东西,[建]接合板，夹片，鱼尾板,[航]钓锚器，撑夹桅杆的加固夹箍
vt.& vi.捕鱼,钓鱼,摸出,掏出
vt.钓鱼，捕鱼,搜寻,[航]加夹箍夹牢,[工]用接合板连接[加固]
vi.捕鱼，钓鱼,用钩捞取

ex.en: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
ex.cn: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

ex.en: Butter, margarine, and oily fish are all good sources of vitamin D.
ex.cn: 黄油、人造黄油和多脂鱼都含有丰富的维生素D。

ex.en: Warm weather has attracted the flat fish close to shore.
ex.cn: 煦暖的气候将比目鱼引到了近海。

def: n.渔夫,食鱼动物,渔船,捞取者

ex.en: Delegates sat in rapt silence as Mrs Fisher spoke.
ex.cn: 费希尔夫人发言的时候，代表们都一言不发专心致志地听着。

ex.en: Fisher was behind bars last night, charged with attempted murder.
ex.cn: 费希尔被控谋杀未遂，昨晚入狱。

ex.en: If you have any queries, please call Anne Fisher during office hours.
ex.cn: 如有疑问，请在办公时间致电安妮·费希尔咨询。

def: n.渔夫，渔民

ex.en: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean.
ex.cn: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

ex.en: The fisherman cast off the rope and set the boat adrift.
ex.cn: 渔夫解开缆绳,让船漂流而去.

ex.en: Peter has become a judge but John remains a fisherman.
ex.cn: 彼得当了法官,但约翰仍是个渔民.

def:
n.拳，拳头,〈口〉笔迹,掌握,[印]指标参见号
vt.紧握,握成拳,用拳打

ex.en: Without warning, Bardo smacked his fist into his open hand.
ex.cn: 巴多没有任何预兆地一拳砸在自己摊开的手掌上.

ex.en: She shook her fist. "I'll show you," she said.
ex.cn: 她挥了挥拳头，“我要让你看看，”她说。

ex.en: My son had a tantrum and banged his fist on the ground.
ex.cn: 我儿子大发脾气，一拳捶在了地上。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）适合,安装,合身
adj.合适的,恰当的,合身的,健壮的
n.合身,适合,匹配,发作

ex.en: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
ex.cn: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

ex.en: She made a New Year's resolution to get fit.
ex.cn: 她的新年决心是要保持身材健美。

ex.en: There's something about the way he talks of her that doesn't fit.
ex.cn: 他谈论她的样子有点不对劲。

def:
num.五，五个,与某人击掌问候（或庆祝胜利）,第五
n.五，五个,5美元钞票,[板]得五分
adj.五的,五个的

ex.en: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
ex.cn: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

ex.en: He was jailed for five years as an alleged British spy.
ex.cn: 他被指控为英国间谍，入狱关押了5年。

ex.en: The average commuter journey there is five hours long.
ex.cn: 那里的通勤一族平均上下班要花5个小时。

def:
vt.固定,准备,修理,使牢固
vi.固着,变硬,安定
n.困境,定位于,受操纵的事,应急措施

ex.en: I wrote back to Meudon at once to fix up a meeting.
ex.cn: 我马上给缪顿回信安排会面。

ex.en: I need my fix of sugar, sweets, and chocolate.
ex.cn: 我离不开糖、甜品和巧克力。

ex.en: Fix your attention on the practicalities of financing your schemes.
ex.cn: 重点考虑为你的计划融资是否可行。

def:
n.旗,旗帜,信号旗,菖蒲
vt.标示
vi.疲乏，变弱，热情衰减

ex.en: On top of the gantry the American flag flew.
ex.cn: 台架顶上飞舞着美国国旗。

ex.en: They flew the flag of the African National Congress.
ex.cn: 他们升起非洲人国民大会的旗帜。

ex.en: He had unmistakably been waving his flag to attract the referee's attention.
ex.cn: 他显然一直在挥舞旗子吸引主裁判的注意。

def:
adj.平的,单调的,不景气的,干脆的
adv.（尤指贴着另一表面）平直地,断然地,水平地,直接地，完全地
n.平地,公寓,平面
vt.使变平,[音乐]使（音调）下降，尤指降半音
vi.逐渐变平,[音乐]以降调唱（或奏）

ex.en: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
ex.cn: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

ex.en: Warm weather has attracted the flat fish close to shore.
ex.cn: 煦暖的气候将比目鱼引到了近海。

ex.en: Two years later he is flat broke and on the dole.
ex.cn: 两年后，他一贫如洗，靠失业救济金生活。

def:
n.味,韵味,特点,香料
vt.给…调味,给…增添风趣

ex.en: Vegetables such as peppers can overpower the flavor of the stock.
ex.cn: 像甜椒这样的蔬菜会抢了原汤的味道。

ex.en: Add a splash of lemon juice to flavor the butter.
ex.cn: 加上一点柠檬汁给黄油调味。

ex.en: I think the flavor of fresh strawberries is out of this world.
ex.cn: 我认为新鲜草莓的味道鲜美无比.

def:
n.风味，情趣,味，滋味,香味，气味
vt.给…添风味[添情趣，添风趣],给…增加香气,给…调味

ex.en: The 1985 vintage has a stronger bouquet and slight caramelly flavour.
ex.cn: 这种1985年酿制的陈年佳酿味道更醇厚，带有一种淡淡的焦糖甜味。

ex.en: Too much salt masks the true flavour of the food.
ex.cn: 太多的盐会盖住食物本来的味道。

ex.en: Cognac is also used to macerate and flavour ingredients and casseroles.
ex.cn: 干邑白兰地也用于浸渍食材，给砂锅炖菜提味。

def:
n.（物体的）飞行,航班,飞翔,楼梯的一段
vi.成群地迁徙或飞行
vt.射击,使惊飞

ex.en: She made her first and only space flight last September.
ex.cn: 她第一次也是唯一一次宇宙飞行是在去年9月。

ex.en: The family was often in flight, hiding out in friends' houses.
ex.cn: 这一家人常常东躲西藏，在朋友家里避风头。

ex.en: I arrived just in time for my flight to London.
ex.cn: 我及时赶上了飞往伦敦的航班。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）浮动,（使）漂浮,自由浮动
vi.游荡
vt.提出，提请考虑,（股票）上市
n.彩车,漂浮物,浮板,浮有冰淇淋的饮料

ex.en: A fresh egg will sink and an old egg will float.
ex.cn: 新鲜鸡蛋会沉下去而不新鲜的会浮在上面。

ex.en: Empty things float.
ex.cn: 空的物体会在水中浮起。

ex.en: Strange thoughts float through my mind when I am nearly asleep.
ex.cn: 我快睡着时产生一种奇怪的念头.

def:
n.洪水,泛滥,溢流,探照灯
vi.涌出,为水淹没
vt.淹没

ex.en: Infectious diseases are spreading among many of the flood victims.
ex.cn: 传染病正在遭受洪灾的很多灾民中蔓延。

ex.en: The flood of cars has now slowed to a trickle.
ex.cn: 汹涌的车流现在已经变得稀稀拉拉。

ex.en: The sight of him entering a room could flood her with desire.
ex.cn: 见到他进入房间会让她心中欲望澎湃。

def:
n.地面，地板,楼层,底部,议员席
vt.铺地板,击败，打倒

ex.en: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule.
ex.cn: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

ex.en: There was constant jeering and interruption from the floor.
ex.cn: 议员席上不断有人在嘲讽和打岔.

ex.en: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
ex.cn: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

def:
vi.流,垂,流出,（谈话、文体等）流畅
n.流动,滔滔不绝,涨潮,连贯
vt.使泛滥,淹没,排出

ex.en: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
ex.cn: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

ex.en: These dams have restricted the flow of the river downstream.
ex.cn: 这些堤坝限制了河水顺流而下。

ex.en: A French-based pharmaceuticals company ran into cash-flow problems and faced liquidation.
ex.cn: 法国的一家制药公司陷入资金周转问题，面临清算的危机。

def:
n.花,精华,开花植物
vi.开花,繁荣,成熟
vt.使开花,用花装饰

ex.en: She now makes wonderful dried flower arrangements to order.
ex.cn: 现在她为顾客定做漂亮的干花插花。

ex.en: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
ex.cn: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

ex.en: Pickers are bent double, plucking each flower with lightning speed.
ex.cn: 采花人弓着身子飞快地摘着花。

def:
vi.飞,飞行,（旗）飘荡,过得快
vt.& vi.乘（…的）飞机,驾驶（飞机等）
vt.驾驶,空运,使飞翔,操作
n.苍蝇,（作钓饵的）苍蝇,（裤子的）前裆开口,门帘

ex.en: His inspiration to fly came even before he joined the Army.
ex.cn: 他想开飞机的念头在参军之前就有了。

ex.en: Then the woodcutter let his axe fly— Thwack! Everyone heard it.
ex.cn: 然后那个伐木工脱手甩出了斧头。哐！每个人都听见了。

ex.en: It was all pretty much done on the fly.
ex.cn: 那几乎都是匆忙之中完成的。

def:
vt.折叠,合拢,抱住,笼罩
vi.折叠起来,彻底失败
n.折痕,信徒,羊栏,（起伏地的）凹处，洼

ex.en: But as other shops fold, the march of the superstores continues.
ex.cn: 但在其他商店纷纷关门倒闭之时，大型超市的强劲扩张势头却依旧不减。

ex.en: Fold the ironing board up so that it is flat.
ex.cn: 把熨衣板折起放平。

ex.en: The cost of a loaf of bread has increased five-fold.
ex.cn: 一条面包的价钱增长了4倍。

def:
vt.& vi.跟随，接着
vt.继承,（按时间、顺序等）接着,从事,采用
vi.理解,发生兴趣,由此产生,跟着人（或物）去（或来）
n.追随，跟随,[台球]推球，跟球打法（使竿击的球在击中目的球后继续滚动的打法）

ex.en: "Wait there!" Kathryn rose. "No, on second thought, follow me."
ex.cn: “在那儿等着！”凯瑟琳站起身来，“不，我改主意了。跟我来。”

ex.en: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
ex.cn: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

ex.en: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
ex.cn: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

def:
adj.后面的，其次的,下列的,顺风的
n.崇拜者，拥护者,下列，如下,跟随,随球
prep.随后，在…以后
v.跟随，接着(follow的现在分词)

ex.en: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
ex.cn: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

ex.en: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
ex.cn: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

ex.en: The following summer the peach tree was laden with fruit.
ex.cn: 第二年夏天桃树就结满了桃子。

def: adj.喜欢的,多情的,溺爱的，宠爱的,盲目轻信的

ex.en: He seemed fond of her in a strictly professional way.
ex.cn: 他似乎只是出于职业缘故而喜欢她。

ex.en: I'm very fond of Maurice and I'd make him a good wife.
ex.cn: 我非常喜欢莫里斯，我会成为他的贤内助的。

ex.en: She was especially fond of a little girl named Betsy.
ex.cn: 她尤其偏爱一个名叫贝齐的小女孩。

def: n.食物，食品,粮食,养料,资料

ex.en: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
ex.cn: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

ex.en: Wash your hands thoroughly with hot soapy water before handling any food.
ex.cn: 在拿吃的之前，用热肥皂水把手好好地洗干净。

ex.en: The shallow sea bed yields up an abundance of food.
ex.cn: 浅海床提供了丰富的食物。

def:
n.愚人，傻瓜,受骗者,有癖好的人,受愚弄的人
vt.愚弄，欺骗,浪费，虚度,闹笑话,游手好闲
vi.开玩笑,欺骗,戏弄
adj.愚蠢的,傻的

ex.en: People always think I'm a fool, and I dare say they're right.
ex.cn: 人们总认为我是个傻瓜，想必他们是对的。

ex.en: I'd been a fool letting him snow me with his big ideas.
ex.cn: 我真蠢，居然被他的胡乱吹嘘给蒙蔽了。

ex.en: I was a fool to have let her talk me into it.
ex.cn: 我真笨，竟然听从了她的劝说。

def: adj.愚蠢的,鲁莽的,荒谬的，可笑的,混

ex.en: Any action on the basis of such fragmentary evidence would be foolish.
ex.cn: 基于如此不完整的证据采取的任何行动都是愚蠢的。

ex.en: Making people feel foolish is emphatically not my strategy.
ex.cn: 让人出丑显然不是我的策略。

ex.en: I just stood there feeling foolish and watching him.
ex.cn: 我只是傻傻地站在那里看着他。

def:
n.脚,底部,英尺(=12 英寸或 30。48 厘米),脚步
vt.走，踏
vt.& vi.结算，总计，共计

ex.en: I tried to reach the foot brakes but I couldn't.
ex.cn: 我试图去够脚刹，但是没能踩到。

ex.en: He lost a foot when he was struck by a train.
ex.cn: 他给火车撞伤，失去了一只脚。

ex.en: My hobbies are letter writing, foot-ball, music, photography, and tennis.
ex.cn: 我的业余爱好是写信、踢足球、听音乐、玩摄影和打网球。

def: n.足球〔美国通常指橄榄球〕,足球运动,屡屡引起争论（或分歧）的问题,被踢来踢去的难题

ex.en: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
ex.cn: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

ex.en: To stay fit off season, I play tennis or football.
ex.cn: 为了在休赛期间保持状态，我常打网球或踢足球。

ex.en: I was always picked last for the football team at school.
ex.cn: 在学校里分队踢足球时，我总是最后被挑的那一个。

def:
prep.为，为了,倾向于,关于,当作
conj.因为，由于

ex.en: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
ex.cn: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

ex.en: Do not wait for good things to happen to you. You need to walk towards happiness.
ex.cn: 不要等待好事降临，你要向幸福进发。

ex.en: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
ex.cn: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

def: vt.禁止,阻止,阻碍,妨碍

ex.en: Heaven forbid that he should leave because of me!
ex.cn: 但愿他不会因为我而离开！

ex.en: They'll forbid you to marry.
ex.cn: 他们不会准许你结婚。

ex.en: The bylaws forbid playing ball in the public garden.
ex.cn: 地方法规规定任何人不得在公园打球或踢球.

def:
n.力,武力,（社会）势力,魄力
vt.强迫,强行,促使，推动,强奸

ex.en: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
ex.cn: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

ex.en: He had wrenched his ankle badly from the force of the fall.
ex.cn: 他因摔倒而严重扭伤了脚踝。

ex.en: More vigorous action is needed to force the federal army to disengage.
ex.cn: 需要更强有力的行动来迫使联邦军队撤军。

def: adj.外国的，外交的,外来的,不相干的,[医]异质的

ex.en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
ex.cn: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

ex.en: He put the case to the Saudi Foreign Minister.
ex.cn: 他把这起事件向沙特外长作了说明。

ex.en: The Foreign Office in London has expressed surprise at these allegations.
ex.cn: 位于伦敦的英国外交部对这些说法表示惊讶.

def: n.外国人,外人，陌生人,外来物，进口货物,（非本土的）外来动植物

ex.en: You don't sound like a foreigner talking English.
ex.cn: 听你讲英语，不像是外国人。

ex.en: Being a foreigner was not a handicap.
ex.cn: 身为外国人并不是一个障碍。

ex.en: Her family disowned her for marrying a foreigner.
ex.cn: 她的家人因她嫁给了外国人而与她断绝关系。

def:
n.森林,丛林,（森林似的）一丛,一片
vt.在…造林，使长满树林，使成为森林

ex.en: The dampness of the forest did not agree with him physically.
ex.cn: 他的身体不能适应森林的潮湿。

ex.en: After the Norman Conquest the forest became a royal hunting preserve.
ex.cn: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

ex.en: Even carrying the camcorder while hiking in the forest was an effort.
ex.cn: 在森林中徒步旅行时，即便带的是便携式摄像机也非常费力。

def:
adv.永远,不断地，无休止地,老是，经常
n.永恒,极长的一段时间

ex.en: Although they're expensive, they last forever and never go out of style.
ex.cn: 尽管价格昂贵，但它们经久耐用，永不过时。

ex.en: To this end the young child is forever watchful.
ex.cn: 这个年纪不大的孩子为此始终保持警惕。

ex.en: I was forever dragging him away from the fireplace.
ex.cn: 我老是要把他从壁炉边拉开。

def:
vt.忘记，忘却,忽略，疏忽,遗落,忘掉
vi.忘记,忽视

ex.en: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
ex.cn: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

ex.en: Would they forgive and forget — or show him the door?
ex.cn: 他们会既往不咎吗——还是会对他下逐客令呢？

ex.en: I'm not ever going to forget what you've done for the nippers.
ex.cn: 我永远忘不了你为这些小孩子所做的一切。

def:
vt.& vi.原谅, 饶恕, 对不起,请原谅 
vt.免除

ex.en: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him.
ex.cn: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

ex.en: I do hope you'll forgive me but I've got to leave.
ex.cn: 我真的非常抱歉，我得走了。

ex.en: The American Congress has agreed to forgive Egypt's military debt.
ex.cn: 美国国会同意免除埃及的军事债务。

def:
n.叉（挖掘用的园艺工具）,餐叉,叉状物,（自行车或摩托车的）车叉子
vi.分叉,分歧
vt.走岔路,叉，耙

ex.en: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
ex.cn: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

ex.en: The road divides; you should take the right fork.
ex.cn: 路在这里分了岔；你应该走右边一条。

ex.en: The spade and fork have longer shafts, providing better leverage.
ex.cn: 锹和耙的手柄较长，可发挥较好的杠杆作用。

def:
n.形状，形式,外形,方式,表格
vt.形成,构成,组织,塑造
vi.形成，产生,排队，整队

ex.en: Generosity is its own form of power.
ex.cn: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

ex.en: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
ex.cn: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

ex.en: Swimming is probably the best form of exercise you can get.
ex.cn: 游泳或许是现有的最佳锻炼方式。

def:
adj.侥幸的，幸运的,带来幸运的，吉利的
n.有好运的人

ex.en: She is in the fortunate position of having plenty of choice.
ex.cn: 好在她有很多选择。

ex.en: Anna approached several builders and was fortunate to come across Eddie.
ex.cn: 安娜与几个建筑商有过接洽，并且很幸运地碰到了埃迪。

ex.en: I often think about those less fortunate than me.
ex.cn: 我经常想到那些没我这么幸运的人。

def:
n.（某人的）命运,富有,幸运,[常作复数]（人生事件中的）时运
vt.给予财富
vi.偶然发生

ex.en: She built up her fortune by cannily playing the stock market.
ex.cn: 她炒股有方，发了大财。

ex.en: Jane is determined to hold on to her fortune.
ex.cn: 简决心要守住自己的财产。

ex.en: When fortune smiled on him, he made the most of it.
ex.cn: 当好运来临时，他充分把握住了。

def:
n.四十,四十几
adj.四十的

ex.en: Forty or fifty women were sitting cross-legged on the ground.
ex.cn: 四五十个女人盘腿坐在地上。

ex.en: Defence soaks up forty per cent of the budget.
ex.cn: 国防耗去40%的预算。

ex.en: Labour was top of the poll with forty-six percent.
ex.cn: 工党以46%的得票数高居首位。

def:
adv.前进地,向前,至将来,提前地
adj.向前方的,迅速的,（社会、政治）进步的,早熟的
vt.促进，助长,（按新地址）转寄,发送
n.前锋

ex.en: The car passed over the body twice, once backward and then forward.
ex.cn: 那辆车把那人来回轧了两次，先是倒着轧的，再是往前开着轧的。

ex.en: She walked forward and embraced him and stroked his tousled white hair.
ex.cn: 她走上前拥抱他并轻抚他凌乱的白发。

ex.en: The one thing I look forward to is going punting in Cambridge.
ex.cn: 我期盼的一件事就是在剑桥乘坐平底船畅游。

def:
vt.创办，成立，建立
v.发现（ find的过去式）,找到,到达,发觉

ex.en: They found a labyrinth of tunnels under the ground.
ex.cn: 他们发现了一处迷宫似的地道。

ex.en: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
ex.cn: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

ex.en: He found evidence of mutated forms of the gene.
ex.cn: 他找到了该基因出现了变异形式的证据。

def: n.人工喷泉,喷水池,喷射,源泉

ex.en: Snape wrote a receipt with a gold fountain pen.
ex.cn: 斯内普用金笔开了一张收据。

ex.en: Located off-center in the irregularly shaped lake was a fountain.
ex.cn: 在这个形状不规则的湖泊的湖心以外的地方有一眼喷泉。

ex.en: You are a fountain of ideas.
ex.cn: 你就是思想的源泉。

def:
num.四,四个,第四
n. 四个人（或事物）的一组,得四分的一击,四人赛艇

ex.en: I went through about four years of being addicted to video games.
ex.cn: 我大约有4年时间沉迷在电子游戏中。

ex.en: The key issue was whether the four defendants acted dishonestly.
ex.cn: 关键问题是4名被告是否存在欺诈行为。

ex.en: She denied the murder of four children who were in her care.
ex.cn: 她否认杀害了她所照管的4个孩子。

def:
num.十四,十四个,第十四
n.十四的记号,十四岁,十四点钟,十五世纪

ex.en: "Fourteen minutes," Chris said, taking a peep at his watch.
ex.cn: “14分钟,”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道.

ex.en: He spent the last fourteen years of his life in retirement.
ex.cn: 他一生中最后的14年是在退休中度过的。

ex.en: A by-product of their meeting was the release of these fourteen men.
ex.cn: 他们会见的意外成果是释放了这14个人。

def:
n.狐,狐狸,狡猾的人,狐皮
vt.欺骗,迷惑,使困惑
vi.耍花招

ex.en: It shows a fox being disembowelled by a pack of hounds.
ex.cn: 画面中一只狐狸正被一群猎狗撕咬得肠子外流。

ex.en: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
ex.cn: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

ex.en: Fox, badger, weasel and stoat are regularly seen here.
ex.cn: 狐狸、獾、黄鼠狼和白鼬在这里很常见。

def:
adj.自由的,免费的,免税的,空闲的
adv.免费地,自由地，无拘束地,一帆风顺地
vt.免除,释放,使自由,解救

ex.en: I wasn't expecting you to do it for free.
ex.cn: 我并没有指望你白干。

ex.en: You get a big salary incentive and free board and lodging too.
ex.cn: 你们能获得大笔激励性薪水，还可享受免费膳宿。

ex.en: The shark was writhing around wildly, trying to get free.
ex.cn: 鲨鱼拼命挣扎，试图逃脱。

def: n.自由，自主,直率,特权，特许,自由权

ex.en: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word "freedom"
ex.cn: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

ex.en: The music brought him a feeling of plenitude and freedom.
ex.cn: 这音乐带给他一种完满和自由的感觉。

ex.en: The party leader said the street should be renamed Freedom Avenue.
ex.cn: 政党领导人说这条街道应该重新命名为自由大道。

def:
vt.使结冰，使冻僵,冷藏,吓呆,冻结（存款，工资等）
vi.凝固，结冰,冻伤，冻死
n.冻结,严寒时期

ex.en: A wage freeze was imposed on all staff earlier this month.
ex.cn: 这个月早些时候，所有员工的工资都被冻结了。

ex.en: Freeze it only until firm but not rock solid.
ex.cn: 把它冻硬，但是不要硬得像石头一样。

ex.en: The coffee is freeze-dried to seal in all the flavour.
ex.cn: 咖啡经冷冻干燥以保留原汁原味。

def: adj.频繁的，时常发生的，常见的,（脉搏等）急促的，快的

ex.en: Bordeaux is on the main Paris-Madrid line so there are frequent trains.
ex.cn: 波尔多位于巴黎到马德里的铁路主干线上，来往列车频繁。

ex.en: There was frequent thunder and lightning, and torrential rain.
ex.cn: 雷电交加，大雨倾盆。

ex.en: The jet-setting couple made frequent appearances in the gossip columns.
ex.cn: 这对穿梭于各国的富豪夫妇经常出现在八卦专栏。

def:
adj.新鲜的,淡水的,新的,无经验的
adv.刚,最新的
n.开始,新生,泛滥,淡水流

ex.en: Fresh fruits and vegetables are important and so is bran.
ex.cn: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很重要，麦麸也是。

ex.en: Grate a tablespoonful of fresh ginger into a pan.
ex.cn: 磨碎一汤匙鲜姜，放入平底锅。

ex.en: I tend to stick to fresh fruit for pudding.
ex.cn: 我一直坚持用新鲜水果做甜点。

def: n.星期五，周五，礼拜五,《鲁滨逊漂流记》中鲁滨逊的仆人,[人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 弗赖迪可能是德意志或犹太人人名的英译

ex.en: I shall be 26 years old on Friday next.
ex.cn: 下周五我就26岁了.

ex.en: He fled on Friday, saying he feared for his life.
ex.cn: 他星期五逃走了，说是担心自己有生命危险。

ex.en: The South African mailboat arrived on Friday mornings unless bad weather intervened.
ex.cn: 除非受恶劣天气干扰，南非邮船一般在星期五上午抵达。

def:
n.朋友，友人,资助者,助手,近亲
v.<诗>与…为友

ex.en: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
ex.cn: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

ex.en: How do we know you're not just covering up for your friend?
ex.cn: 我们怎么知道你不只是在为自己的朋友遮掩呢？

ex.en: I might buy one for a friend's birthday as a giggle.
ex.cn: 我可能会买一件送给朋友当生日礼物，逗他开心。

def:
adj.友好的，亲密的,有帮助的,互助的
n.友谊赛

ex.en: The spokesman said the tone of the letter was very friendly.
ex.cn: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。

ex.en: She was somewhat unapproachable but I'm sure she wanted to be friendly.
ex.cn: 她有些不好接近，但我确信她想表现得友好一些。

ex.en: Service was outstandingly friendly and efficient, falling down on only one detail.
ex.cn: 服务态度极佳，效率也蛮高，仅在一个小地方不尽人意。

def: n.友情，友谊,友善的关系,友善，好意

ex.en: Friendship means understanding, not agreement. It means forgiveness, not forgetting.It means the memories last, even if contact is lost.
ex.cn: 友情是理解，不是妥协；是原谅，不是遗忘。即使不联系，感情依然在。

ex.en: Friendship is much more important to me than a stupid old ring!
ex.cn: 友谊对我来说可比一个破戒指重要得多！

ex.en: Estonia has done much to cultivate the friendship of western European countries.
ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚努力发展与西欧国家的友谊。

def:
n.恐怖,惊吓,可怕的东西，难看的人
v.使惊恐

ex.en: Howard wanted to be a popular singer, but stage fright crippled him.
ex.cn: 霍华德想成为流行歌手，但因怯场而心生畏惧。

ex.en: An untrained horse had taken fright at the sound of gunfire.
ex.cn: 一匹未经训练的马听到枪响受了惊。

ex.en: One boy, aged about 11, looks frozen with fright.
ex.cn: 一个大约11岁的男孩吓得一动不动。

def:
vt.使惊恐，使恐慌,吓走，赶走
vi.害怕，惊恐

ex.en: Fairground rides are intended to frighten the life out of you.
ex.cn: 露天游乐场的飞车就是想把人吓丢了魂儿。

ex.en: I did not want to frighten or distress the horse.
ex.cn: 我并不想吓到马或惹怒它。

ex.en: It doesn't frighten them. They're used to it.
ex.cn: 这可吓不倒他们。他们已经习惯了。

def: prep.（表示时间）从…,（表示原因）因为,（表示来源）来自…,（表示分离）与…分离[隔开]

ex.en: He knew what he wanted to do from the age of 14.
ex.cn: 他14岁起就知道自己日后干什么了。

ex.en: He was fired from his job after roughing up a colleague.
ex.cn: 他因为对一位同事动粗而被开除了。

ex.en: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my team-mates.
ex.cn: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

def:
n.前面,正面,身体前部,前线
adj.前面的,正面的,舌前的
v.面向,在…前面,用…作正面,领导

ex.en: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
ex.cn: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

ex.en: Rue Guynemer begins at the front of the Fitzgerald site.
ex.cn: 吉内梅街始于菲茨拉德故居前。

ex.en: Teachers staged a sit-down protest in front of the president's office.
ex.cn: 老师们在校长办公室门前举行了一场静坐抗议。

def:
n.成果,水果,果实,（大地的）产物
vi.树或花草结果
vt.使…结果实

ex.en: I tend to stick to fresh fruit for pudding.
ex.cn: 我一直坚持用新鲜水果做甜点。

ex.en: The following summer the peach tree was laden with fruit.
ex.cn: 第二年夏天桃树就结满了桃子。

ex.en: Eleanor's work among the women will, I trust, bear fruit.
ex.cn: 我相信埃莉诺在妇女中所做的工作会见成效的。

def:
n.燃料,（为身体提供能量的）食物,（维持、增加感情的）刺激物,竞选提神（或兴奋）剂（一种健怡可乐，饮用后能使人精力充沛地从事竞选活动）
vt.给…加燃料，给…加油,激起
vi.补充燃料

ex.en: His comments are bound to add fuel to the debate.
ex.cn: 他的话必将为争论推波助澜。

ex.en: Investigators say that a fuel explosion may have caused the crash.
ex.cn: 调查员说燃料爆炸有可能是失事的根源。

ex.en: The rationale of reprocessing spent nuclear fuel is inevitably being questioned.
ex.cn: 对核废料进行再加工的理由不可避免地受到了质疑。

def:
adj.满的，装满的,完全的，完整的,丰富的,详尽的
adv.极其，十分,充分地，完全地,整整,直接地
n.充分，完全,全部,完整,极盛时
v.把衣服缝得宽大,把裙子缝出皱褶,[印]蒸洗，漂洗

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks.
ex.cn: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

ex.en: He pushed everyone full speed ahead until production hit a bottleneck.
ex.cn: 他催促所有人拼命干活，直到生产遭遇瓶颈。

def:
n.乐趣,娱乐活动,嬉戏，嬉闹,有趣的事
adj.使人愉快的,开心的
vi.嬉闹,开玩笑

ex.en: Surfing the Internet is fun, but it's also a time waster.
ex.cn: 上网很有意思，但也很浪费时间。

ex.en: Under all the innocent fun, there are hidden dangers, especially for children.
ex.cn: 在所有简单无害的娱乐项目背后都隐藏着危险，特别是对儿童而言。

ex.en: The following recipe is a statement of another kind—food is fun!
ex.cn: 下面的食谱是另一种观点的表现——食物可以带来乐趣！

def:
adj.有趣的，好笑的，滑稽的,（口）稀奇的，古怪的，奇异的,有病的，不舒服的,狡猾的，欺骗（性）的，可疑的，不光明的
n.滑稽人物,笑话，有趣的故事,滑稽连环漫画栏,（英）（比赛用）单人双桨小艇

ex.en: There's a reason why women don't read this stuff; it's not funny.
ex.cn: 女人不读这种东西是有原因的，它并不好笑。

ex.en: In a misguided attempt to be funny, he manages only offensiveness.
ex.cn: 他本想表现得风趣一点，却弄巧成拙地冒犯了别人。

ex.en: He is such a personality— he is so funny.
ex.cn: 他很有个性魅力——非常风趣。

def: n.家具,设备,附属品

ex.en: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
ex.cn: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

ex.en: The house is crammed with priceless furniture and works of art.
ex.cn: 房子里摆满了昂贵的家具和艺术品。

ex.en: We talk in her Belgrade flat, full of heavy old brown furniture.
ex.cn: 我们在她位于贝尔格莱德的公寓里进行了交谈，那屋里满是结实的老式棕色家具。

def:
adj.更远的，较远的,更进一步的，深一层的,更多的
adv.进一步地,更远地,而且
vt.促进，推动,增进

adj.将来的，未来的,[语法学]将来时的
n.前途,[美国俚语]未婚妻,期货

ex.en: Students all over the country are facing an uncertain future.
ex.cn: 全国各地学生前途未卜。

ex.en: I have not faltered in my quest for a new future.
ex.cn: 我对新的未来的追求从未动摇过。

ex.en: Both had successful careers and the future looked bright.
ex.cn: 两个人都事业有成，前程似锦。

def:
vt.& vi.获得,赢得,增加,（钟、表）走快
n.利润,[土木工程]腰槽,获益
vt.（在…上）开腰槽,吸引,（通过努力）到达,推进（一段距离）
vi.增进,增进健康,得益,（重量的）增加

ex.en: This is a cynical manipulation of the situation for short-term political gain.
ex.cn: 这是为了获取短期政治利益而损人利己地对局势进行操纵。

ex.en: White wines tend to gain depth of colour with age.
ex.cn: 白葡萄酒年头愈久，颜色愈深。

ex.en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
ex.cn: 在那一年里我有幸获得了非常宝贵的经验。

def:
n.游戏，运动,比赛，竞赛,诡计,猎物
adj.受伤的，瘸的,对…有兴趣的,雄赳赳的,关于野味的
v.打赌，赌输赢,赌输

ex.en: Game wardens were appointed to enforce hunting laws in New Hampshire.
ex.cn: 狩猎监督官被派到新罕布什尔州去执行狩猎法令。

ex.en: Argentina came to a virtual standstill while the game was being played.
ex.cn: 在比赛进行的时候，阿根廷全国几乎陷入了停顿状态。

ex.en: That programme will include live commentary on the England-Ireland game.
ex.cn: 那个节目将包括英格兰与爱尔兰比赛的实况报道。

def:
n.车库,汽车修理站,飞机库
vt.把…送入车库,把（汽车）开进车库

ex.en: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
ex.cn: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

ex.en: "Was the car inside the garage?" — "No, it was still outside."
ex.cn: “车在车库里吗？”——“不，还在外面。”

ex.en: He emerged from the dark recesses of the garage.
ex.cn: 他从车库的暗处走出来。

def:
n.花园，菜园,公园,供应点心的露天设施,大型公共礼堂
vt.造园，开辟（一小片土地）作为花园,以花园装饰
vi.从事园艺
adj.花园的，园艺的,普通的，平凡的

ex.en: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
ex.cn: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

ex.en: He tramped hurriedly round the lake towards the garden.
ex.cn: 他匆匆地迈着沉重的步伐绕过湖边向花园走去。

ex.en: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.
ex.cn: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。

def:
n.门,闸门,登机门,入场费
vt.给…装大门,[电子学] 电波传送

ex.en: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.
ex.cn: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。

ex.en: We gave the gate money to the St John Ambulance brigade.
ex.cn: 我们将门票收入都捐给了圣约翰急救队。

ex.en: They used a lorry to ram the main gate.
ex.cn: 他们用卡车猛撞大门。

def:
vt.收集,聚集，搜集,收紧，收缩,采集
vi.逐渐增加，积聚
n.聚集,衣褶

ex.en: I gather his report is highly critical of the trial judge.
ex.cn: 据我所知，他在报道中毫不留情地批评了初审法官。

ex.en: I suggest we gather enough firewood to last the night.
ex.cn: 我建议大家捡足够多的木柴来撑过这一晚。

ex.en: Heads of government from more than 100 countries gather in Geneva tomorrow.
ex.cn: 来自100多个国家的政府首脑明日将齐聚日内瓦。

def:
adj.快乐的，愉快的,同性恋的,艳丽的，华丽的,放荡的，无法无天的
n.同性恋者（尤指男性）

ex.en: Curiously, the word "gay" does not occur in the index.
ex.cn: 奇怪的是，gay这个词没有出现在索引当中。

ex.en: His sexual orientation was a lot more gay than straight.
ex.cn: 从他的性取向来看，他不像异性恋，更像个同性恋。

ex.en: The gay and lesbian rights group, Stonewall, sees outing as completely unhelpful.
ex.cn: 男女同性恋权益组织“石墙”认为公开揭露同性恋者身份毫无益处。

def:
adj.大致的,综合的,总的，全体的,普遍的
n.上将,一般,一般原则,常规

ex.en: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
ex.cn: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

ex.en: The Afro-Asian nations had approved the basic general principles of non-alignment.
ex.cn: 亚非国家已经同意了不结盟的基本通则。

ex.en: She had a confused idea of life in general.
ex.cn: 总的来说，她对生活非常困惑。

def: n.一代人,代（约30年），时代,生殖,产生

ex.en: A new generation of scientists became fascinated by dinosaurs.
ex.cn: 新一代科学家对恐龙研究着了迷。

ex.en: First-generation Americans view the United States as a land of golden opportunity.
ex.cn: 第一代美国人认为美国是一个充满了机遇的国度。

ex.en: This challenge will occupy Europe for a generation or more.
ex.cn: 这将是欧洲在未来二三十年或者更长的时间里所要面临的挑战。

def:
adj.温和的,文雅的,高尚的
vt.使温和,使驯服
n.蛆,饵

ex.en: The blustery winds of spring had dropped to a gentle breeze.
ex.cn: 呼啸的春风已经减弱，成了习习的微风。

ex.en: Place the omelette under a gentle grill until the top is set.
ex.cn: 将煎蛋饼放在烤架下用文火烘烤，直到表面凝固。

ex.en: It was too hot even for a gentle stroll.
ex.cn: 天太热，连慢慢散步都吃不消。

def: n.先生,绅士,有身份地位的人

ex.en: A gentleman should always be civil, even to his inferiors.
ex.cn: 绅士应该总是彬彬有礼,即便是对地位不及自己者.

ex.en: The gentleman, despite his advanced years, helped Kathryn back to her seat.
ex.cn: 这位绅士，尽管年事已高，仍然帮着凯瑟琳回到座位上。

ex.en: I got this phone call from a gentleman, who seemed sincere enough.
ex.cn: 这个电话是一位绅士打来的，他似乎非常诚恳。

def: adv.温柔地,轻轻地,有礼貌地,文雅地

ex.en: If your child's temperature rises, sponge her down gently with tepid water.
ex.cn: 如果你孩子的体温上升，就用海绵蘸上温水轻轻地擦拭她的身体。

ex.en: He gently opened the throttle, and the ship began to ease forward.
ex.cn: 他轻轻松开油门杆，轮船开始缓缓前行。

ex.en: Salt the stock to your taste and leave it simmering very gently.
ex.cn: 根据自己的口味给原汤加点盐，然后用文火慢炖。

def: n.地理（学）,地形，地势,布局

ex.en: Why are Geography, Drama, Art and English in the ascendant?
ex.cn: 为什么地理、戏剧、艺术和英语逐渐受宠？

ex.en: The American continent's geography severely limited the lines of attack.
ex.cn: 美洲大陆的地形严重限制了进攻路线。

ex.en: Geography was my weak subject.
ex.cn: 地理是我的弱项。

def:
vt.得到,抓住,说服,受到（惩罚等）
vt.& vi.到达，来
vi.成为,开始,设法对付,获得利益或财富
n.生殖，幼兽,赢利

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: If you wait, all that happens is that you get older.
ex.cn: 如果你等待，发生的只有变老。

ex.en: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
ex.cn: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

def:
n.赠品，礼物,天赋,赠送,天资
vt.赋予,向…赠送,天赋权力（或才能等）,授予

ex.en: Her grandmother had the gift of making people happy.
ex.cn: 她奶奶有逗人开心的本事。

ex.en: They are naturally good salesmen with the gift of the gab.
ex.cn: 他们天生就是能说会道的推销能手。

ex.en: The surprise gift is a thankyou for our help.
ex.cn: 这份意外的礼物是为了感谢我们给予的帮助。

def: n.女孩,姑娘，未婚女子,女职员，女演员,（男人的）女朋友

ex.en: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
ex.cn: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

ex.en: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
ex.cn: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

ex.en: They saw the man with a little girl skipping along behind him.
ex.cn: 他们看见那个男人身后还跟着一个蹦蹦跳跳的小姑娘。

def:
vt.& vi.给予,赠送,作出
vt.供给,产生,举办,（为购买某物或做某事而）支付
vi.（物体）塌下,让步
n.伸展性，弹性

ex.en: "I can't give you an answer now," he hedged.
ex.cn: “我现在不能回答你，”他闪避道。

ex.en: Give the cardboard two or three coats of varnish to harden it.
ex.cn: 在纸板上涂两三层清漆使其变硬。

ex.en: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
ex.cn: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

def:
adj.高兴的，乐意的,令人高兴的，使人愉快的,（风光）明媚的，（景色）美丽的,充满欢乐的，兴高采烈的
vt.使高兴

ex.en: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong.
ex.cn: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

ex.en: I'm so glad he had a pang of conscience.
ex.cn: 我很高兴他会有负疚感。

ex.en: I can't tell you how glad I was to leave that place.
ex.cn: 我无法形容自己离开那个地方心里有多高兴。

def:
vi.一瞥,闪微光,掠过，擦过,随便提到，简略地触及
n.浏览,闪光,歪斜，一掠

ex.en: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
ex.cn: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

ex.en: He stole a glance at the clock behind her.
ex.cn: 他偷偷地看了一眼她背后的钟。

ex.en: In those crowded streets her attire did not rate a second glance.
ex.cn: 在那些拥挤的街道她的穿着并未引起注意。

def:
n.玻璃,玻璃制品,镜子
vt.给某物加玻璃,反映,使平滑如玻璃
vi.成玻璃状

ex.en: The theatre is a futuristic steel and glass structure.
ex.cn: 这家剧院是钢筋和玻璃结构的未来派建筑。

ex.en: He asked for a glass of port after dinner.
ex.cn: 晚饭后，他要了一杯波尔图葡萄酒。

ex.en: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window.
ex.cn: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。

def:
vi.走,离开,去做,进行
vt.变得,发出…声音,成为,处于…状态
n.轮到的顺序,精力,干劲,尝试

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
ex.cn: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

ex.en: It's a long way to go for two people in their seventies.
ex.cn: 对于两个七十几岁的人来说，这段路太远了。

def: n.目标，目的,球门,终点,得分

ex.en: They were still arguing the toss about the first goal.
ex.cn: 他们仍在为第一个进球争论不休。

ex.en: It all started so promisingly when Speed scored a tremendous first goal.
ex.cn: 比赛开始的时候形势大好，斯皮德以一记精彩的进球先拔头筹。

ex.en: The clincher was City's second goal, scored minutes from the end.
ex.cn: 离比赛结束还剩几分钟的时候，曼城队的第二粒进球锁定了胜局。

def: n.山羊,色鬼,替罪羊

ex.en: Sheep's milk is produced in much the same way as goat's milk.
ex.cn: 绵羊奶和山羊奶的生产过程差不多。

ex.en: Some boys are always playing the giddy goat, behaving foolishly.
ex.cn: 有些男孩子常常胡闹, 举止荒唐.

ex.en: The young goat was just beginning to grow horns.
ex.cn: 这只小山羊刚开始长角.

def:
n.上帝，造物主,被极度崇敬的人[物],男神,戏院顶层楼座观众
vt.膜拜,崇拜

ex.en: Thank God they're not on my manor any more.
