ex.en: He did not like to be caught out on details.
ex.cn: 他不喜欢在细节上被人抓住把柄。

def:
n.限制,限量，限度,界限
vt.限制，限定

ex.en: In some cases there is a mini-mum age limit.
ex.cn: 有些情况下有最低年龄限制。

ex.en: They struggled to limit the cost by enforcing a low-tech specification.
ex.cn: 他们通过实施低技术规格拼命限制成本。

ex.en: The three month time limit will be up in mid-June.
ex.cn: 3个月的限期截至6月中旬。

def:
n.线条,排,行列,界线
vt.排队,用线标出,沿…排列成行,给…安衬里
vi.形成一层,排队,击出平直球

ex.en: Megamalls and fast food restaurants line the highway system.
ex.cn: 公路系统沿线有大型商场和快餐店。

ex.en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
ex.cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

ex.en: Elliott crossed the finish line just half a second behind his adversary.
ex.cn: 埃利奥特跨过终点线时仅比对手落后半秒钟。

def: n.狮子,名人,[天文学、占星术]狮子（星）座,勇士，名流

ex.en: A man-eating lion is on the loose somewhere in England.
ex.cn: 英格兰有一头吃人的狮子跑出来了。

ex.en: After more misses, they finally put two arrows into the lion's chest.
ex.cn: 又射偏了几次之后,他们终于把两支箭射入了狮子的胸膛.

ex.en: Military and nuclear research have received the lion's share of public funding.
ex.cn: 大部分公共资金都为军事与核研究所占。

def:
n.嘴唇,（杯，壶等的）口，边缘,〈俚〉无理的回答,〈美〉律师
adj.唇的,口头上的,唇音的
vt.用嘴唇接触,接吻,〈俚〉轻轻地说，唱,把高尔夫球打到穴边而未进去

ex.en: She had quite severe bruising and a cut lip.
ex.cn: 她身上有严重的淤伤，嘴唇也破了。

ex.en: He curled his upper lip in a show of scepticism.
ex.cn: 他撇嘴表示怀疑。

ex.en: With a lip pencil, outline lips and fill them in.
ex.cn: 用唇线笔勾出双唇的轮廓，然后涂上唇膏。

def:
n.清单，目录,倾斜,布边，布头,狭条
vt.列出，列入,把…编列成表,记入名单内
vi.列于表上

ex.en: A list of items is repeatedly flashed up on the screen.
ex.cn: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

ex.en: The duke was surprised by his wife's omission from the guest list.
ex.cn: 公爵对他的夫人未在获邀宾客之列感到意外。

ex.en: Every care has been taken in compiling this list.
ex.cn: 汇编这份清单时考虑得很充分。

def:
vi.倾听,留心听,听信,（让对方注意）听着
n.听，倾听

ex.en: When I asked him to stop, he would not listen.
ex.cn: 我叫他停下，可他不听。

ex.en: Listen here, young lady. Don't you call me that!
ex.cn: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！

ex.en: Listen to criticism but don't be crushed by it.
ex.cn: 听取批评意见，但不要被它击垮。

def:
adj.小的,琐碎的,娇小的,幼小的
adv.不多，略微,少许，一点,短时间地
n.（表示否定）微少,没有多少,短时间
det.（数量上）微少的，少到几乎没有的,（a little）少量的，一些

ex.en: It's not about making the amazing saves. It's the little things and small things that made great gatekeepers great.
ex.cn: 伟大的门将不是靠神奇的扑救成就，而是靠注重小事和细节成功。（Tim Howard美国国家队门将）

ex.en: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
ex.cn: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

ex.en: "I wish I had a little brother," said Daphne wistfully.
ex.cn: “我希望有个小弟弟。”达夫妮伤感地说。

def: v.生存,居住,活着,留存

ex.en: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
ex.cn: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

ex.en: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
ex.cn: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

ex.en: I clearly empathize with the people who live in those neighborhoods.
ex.cn: 我非常同情生活在那些地方的人们。

def:
adj.充满活力的,活泼的,充满趣味的
adv.轻快地：轻快地，富有活力地,轻快地跳起

ex.en: Their 4-1 win in Honduras was a particularly lively affair.
ex.cn: 他们在洪都拉斯以4比1获胜的那场比赛尤其激动人心。

ex.en: The papers also show a lively interest in European developments.
ex.cn: 论文对欧洲的动向亦表现出浓厚的兴趣。

ex.en: "Holidays That Don't Cost the Earth" is a lively, informative read.
ex.cn: 《绿色环保的假期》是本生动有趣、增长见闻的读物。

def:
adj.活（着）的,现存的,在使用中的,逼真的
n.生计,生活方式,生存之道
v.活( live的现在分词),居住,以…为生,（按照规矩）管理生活

ex.en: If you're not satisfied with the life you're living, don't just complain. Do something about it.
ex.cn: 对于现况的不满，不能只是抱怨，要有作出改变。

ex.en: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
ex.cn: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

ex.en: I took the phone, and she went discreetly into the living room.
ex.cn: 我拿起了电话，她知趣地进了客厅。

def:
n.负荷,负担,装载,工作量
vt.使担负,装填,把…装入或装上,装满，堆积
vi.加载,装载,装货

ex.en: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information.
ex.cn: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。

ex.en: I've never heard such a load of tripe in all my life.
ex.cn: 我一辈子还从没听到过这样一堆废话。

ex.en: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations.
ex.cn: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。

def:
adj.地方的,当地的，本地的,局部的,褊狭的
n.慢车,本地居民（律师、教士、医生）,住处附近的当地酒店,本地新闻

ex.en: There has been a busy start to polling in today's local elections.
ex.cn: 今天地方选举的投票一开始就人头攒动。

ex.en: Global ecological efforts can easily be at odds with local ecologies.
ex.cn: 全球性生态保护工作很可能会和地方生态系统存在矛盾。

ex.en: They drink bitter on draught in the local bar.
ex.cn: 他们在当地的酒吧里喝桶装的苦啤酒。

def:
n.锁,水闸，船闸,（机器部件等的）锁定,一把，一撮
vt.锁上,锁好，关好,使固定,隐藏
vi.卡住，不动,纠结,僵硬不动

ex.en: She shrugged a stray lock of hair out of her eyes.
ex.cn: 她把一缕散发从眼前甩开。

ex.en: He picked each lock deftly, and rifled the papers within each drawer.
ex.cn: 他熟练地撬开每一把锁，把每个抽屉里的文件都偷走了。

ex.en: That key will come in handy if you lock yourself out.
ex.cn: 要是你把自己锁在了屋外，那把钥匙就派上用场了。

def: adj.孤独的，孤单的,寂寞的,荒凉的，幽静的,在孤单中度过的

ex.en: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
ex.cn: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

ex.en: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul.
ex.cn: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。

ex.en: I feel lost and lonely in a strange town alone.
ex.cn: 在陌生的城镇里只身一人，我感到不知所措、孤单寂寞。

def:
adj.长的,长时间的,冗长的，过长的,长音的
adv.长久地,始终,遥远地
n.长时间，长时期,[语]长音节,（服装的）长尺寸,长裤
vi.渴望，极想

ex.en: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
ex.cn: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

ex.en: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
ex.cn: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

ex.en: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
ex.cn: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

def:
vt.& vi.看，瞧
vi.注意,面向,寻找,看起来好像
n.看,（尤指吸引人的）相貌,眼神,样子
int.（插话或唤起注意）喂，听我说

ex.en: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
ex.cn: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

ex.en: She had the look of someone deserted and betrayed.
ex.cn: 她一副遭人遗弃和背叛的样子。

ex.en: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
ex.cn: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

def:
vt.失去,错过,遗失,耽搁
vi.损失,输掉,走慢,降低价值

ex.en: Some battles you win, some battles you lose.
ex.cn: 胜败乃兵家常事。

ex.en: He appealed to his countrymen not to lose heart.
ex.cn: 他呼吁自己的同胞不要丧失信心。

ex.en: Torn muscles retract, and lose strength, structure, and tightness.
ex.cn: 撕裂的肌肉会收缩，丧失原来的力量、结构和紧实度。

def: n.损失，减少,丢失，遗失,损耗，亏损,失败

ex.en: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
ex.cn: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

ex.en: He always woke with a sense of deep sorrow and depressing loss.
ex.cn: 他醒来时总是满怀哀愁，抑郁惆怅。

ex.en: The gloom deepened after a thumping £45m loss at British Rail.
ex.cn: 英国铁路公司遭受了4,500万英镑的巨额损失后境况更加惨淡。

def:
n.份额,许多,命运,阄
adv.（与形容词和副词连用）很，非常,（与动词连用）非常
pron.大量，许多
vt.分组，把…划分（常与out连用）,把（土地）划分成块
vi.抽签，拈阄

ex.en: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my team-mates.
ex.cn: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

ex.en: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
ex.cn: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

ex.en: Do you sweat a lot or flush a lot?
ex.cn: 你常出汗或是脸上常发烫吗？

def:
adj.响亮的，大声的，高声的,响亮的，洪亮的，高亢的,高声的，激烈的,刺眼的，太招摇的
adv.大声地，高声地，响亮地

ex.en: There was a loud thump as the horse crashed into the van.
ex.cn: 马撞在货车上发出砰的一声巨响。

ex.en: Mr Jones received loud support from his local community.
ex.cn: 琼斯先生获得了他所在社区民众的热烈支持。

ex.en: I've always had a loud mouth, I refuse to be silenced.
ex.cn: 我一贯大声说出自己的想法，不会迫于压力而一言不发。

def:
vt.& vi.爱，热爱,爱戴,喜欢,赞美，称赞
vt.喜爱,喜好,喜欢,爱慕
n.爱情，爱意,疼爱,热爱,爱人，所爱之物

ex.en: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
ex.cn: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

ex.en: If you love life, life will love you back.
ex.cn: 热爱生活，生活也会厚爱你。(Arthur Rubinstein)

ex.en: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
ex.cn: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

def:
adj.可爱的,令人愉快的,亲切友好的,慷慨大方的
n.美女，美人，佳人,漂亮的东西

ex.en: Sweden is lovely in summer— cold beyond belief in winter.
ex.cn: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

ex.en: It was just one of those lovely old English gardens.
ex.cn: 那正是一个那种古老的英式花园，非常迷人。

ex.en: "Such lovely clothes. I'd no idea Milan was so wonderful," she raved.
ex.cn: “这些时装太漂亮了。我没想到米兰是如此的精彩，”她赞不绝口。

def: n.爱好者，嗜好者,情人,情妇，情夫,情侣

ex.en: She was dumped by her long-term lover after five years.
ex.cn: 5年后她被相恋多年的恋人抛弃了。

ex.en: He tried to throw police off the track of his lover.
ex.cn: 他努力让警方无法跟踪他的情人。

ex.en: Her lover walked out on her after she had aborted their child.
ex.cn: 她的情人在她打掉胎儿后甩了她。

def:
adj.低的，矮小的,楼下的，低洼的,沮丧的,下贱的
adv.低声地,谦卑地,底下地
n.低点,低水平,牛的叫声
vi.（牛）哞哞叫

ex.en: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
ex.cn: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

ex.en: Doctor believed that his low sperm count was the problem.
ex.cn: 医生认为他的精子数太低是问题所在。

ex.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
ex.cn: 伴随着隆隆的低沉噪声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

def:
adj.下方的,在底部的,较低级的
v.降低,减少,缩小

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
ex.cn: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Basal metabolism is much lower for creatures in cold water.
ex.cn: 冷水中生物的基础代谢速度要低很多。

ex.en: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
ex.cn: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

def:
n.运气,好运,机遇,命运
vi.交好运，走运,侥幸成功

ex.en: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
ex.cn: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

ex.en: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
ex.cn: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

ex.en: Wood has not had much luck in carving out a career.
ex.cn: 伍德想干出点名堂来，可是总不能如愿。

def: adj.运气好的，侥幸的,兆头好的，吉祥的,〈俚〉难得,很恰当的

ex.en: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
ex.cn: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

ex.en: I'm lucky really as I never put on weight.
ex.cn: 我很幸运，因为我的体重从来没有增加过。

ex.en: We're lucky to have such a man in our midst.
ex.cn: 在我们中间有这样一个人是我们的幸运。

def:
n.午餐
vt.& vi.吃午餐,供给午餐

ex.en: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
ex.cn: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

ex.en: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
ex.cn: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

ex.en: We had lunch the other day at our favorite restaurant.
ex.cn: 前两天我们在最喜欢的餐馆吃了午饭。

def:
n.机器，机械,机械般的人,核心
vt.用机器制造，用机器加工
vi.被机器切削

ex.en: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire.
ex.cn: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

ex.en: Parents can programme the machine not to turn on at certain times.
ex.cn: 父母可以设定这台机器的程序，使它在特定时间段无法开启。

ex.en: The repairs to the Hafner machine were near to completion.
ex.cn: 对哈夫纳机器的修理即将结束。

def:
adj.疯狂的,猛烈的,着迷的,〔口语〕愤怒的，生气的
vt.使疯狂

ex.en: There are certain things he does that drive me mad.
ex.cn: 他的某些举动让我很生气。

ex.en: She's not as mad about sport as I am.
ex.cn: 她不像我对体育那么痴迷。

ex.en: You are mad, Isabel. You should be locked up.
ex.cn: 你疯了，伊莎贝尔。应该把你关起来才是。

def: n.女士,小姐,喜欢指使他人的年轻妇女,（妓院的）鸨母

ex.en: Sue is a thoroughly precocious little madam if ever there was one.
ex.cn: 休确实是个少见的早熟的小丫头。

ex.en: Dear Madam, Thank you for your interest in our Memorial Scheme.
ex.cn: 尊敬的女士，感谢您对我们的纪念方案的关注。

ex.en: "Why, this is nothing but common vegetable soup!"— 'So it is. madam.'
ex.cn: “怎么回事，这只是普普通通的蔬菜汤!”——“夫人，确实如此。”

def: n.<法>（用于已婚妇女姓名前的尊称）太太，夫人，女士

ex.en: Madame Clicquot is credited with the perfection of this technique.
ex.cn: 这项技术的完善要归功于凯歌夫人。

ex.en: A plaster cast of Madame Fournier stood in the artist's studio.
ex.cn: 那位艺术家的工作室里立着一尊富尼埃夫人的石膏像.

ex.en: Madame Curie was the only famous woman scientist in the world.
ex.cn: 居里夫人是世界上唯一有名的女科学家.

def: n.弹药库,杂志,弹仓,胶卷盒

ex.en: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

ex.en: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
ex.cn: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

ex.en: I have been a subscriber to Railway Magazine for many years.
ex.cn: 我订阅《铁路杂志》已有很多年了。

def:
n.邮件，邮政,邮政（制度）,邮务员，邮递员,〈古〉袋，旅行包
vt.邮寄,给…穿盔甲
vi.投邮

ex.en: The Daily Mail has the headline "The Voice of Conscience"
ex.cn: 《每日邮报》的头版标题为“良知的声音”。

ex.en: Goods may be sent by surface mail or airmail.
ex.cn: 货物可通过平寄或空运发送。

ex.en: An e-mail is already circulating amongst news staff calling for voluntary redundancies.
ex.cn: 在新闻部员工中已经在转发一封电子邮件,呼吁大家自愿裁汰.

def:
adj.主要的，最重要的,全力的
n.最主要的部分，重点,主要管道,体力,[航海]公海

ex.en: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
ex.cn: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

ex.en: They used a lorry to ram the main gate.
ex.cn: 他们用卡车猛撞大门。

ex.en: Premature birth is the main cause of perinatal mortality.
ex.cn: 早产是临产死亡的主要原因。

def: adv.大部分地,主要地,基本上

ex.en: Thousands of people, mainly Zulus, assembled in a stadium in Thokoza.
ex.cn: 数以千计的人，主要是祖鲁族人，聚集在托考查的一个体育场里。

ex.en: Our survey revealed that these allergies were mainly one-offs.
ex.cn: 我们的调查显示这些过敏多为一次性反应。

ex.en: There were also several accidents mainly caused by engine failures on take-off.
ex.cn: 还有几次事故主要是起飞时引擎出现故障造成的。

def:
adj.主要的,重要的,大调的,主修的（课程）
n.主修科目,大调,陆军少校,成年的
vi.<美>主修，专攻,[美国英语][教育学]主修(in),专攻

ex.en: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
ex.cn: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

ex.en: He said the issue was not a major irritant.
ex.cn: 他说那个问题不是什么大问题。

ex.en: The rail strike is causing major disruptions at the country's ports.
ex.cn: 铁路罢工使该国港口陷入了一片混乱。

def:
vt.做，制造,生产，制定,使成为,使产生
vi.开始,尝试,行进,增大
n.制造,生产量,性格,形状，样式

ex.en: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
ex.cn: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

ex.en: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves.
ex.cn: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

ex.en: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
ex.cn: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

def:
adj.男性的,雄性的,有力的,[植]雄性的，仅有雄蕊的
n.男,雄性动物,[植]雄性植物,马累[马律]

ex.en: The army is still one of the last male bastions.
ex.cn: 军队仍然是男人占据的最后堡垒之一。

ex.en: We were in the same college, which was male-only at that time.
ex.cn: 我们那时在同一所学院，当时只招男生。

ex.en: The London City Ballet has engaged two male dancers from the Bolshoi.
ex.cn: 伦敦市芭蕾舞团从波修瓦芭蕾舞团聘来了两名男舞蹈演员。

def:
n.男人,人类,男子汉,雇工
vt.使振作,操纵,给…配置人员,在…就位
int.（表示惊讶、气愤等）嘿，天哪

ex.en: She ran away with a man called McTavish last year.
ex.cn: 去年，她和一个叫麦克塔维什的男人私奔了。

ex.en: Nora was deflowered by a man who worked in a soda-water factory.
ex.cn: 在汽水厂工作的一个男子夺去了诺拉的童贞。

ex.en: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
ex.cn: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

def:
vt.使用,完成（困难的事）,经营,明智地使用（金钱、时间、信息等）
vt.& vi.办理，设法对付
vi.能解决（问题）,应付（困难局面等）,凑合着活下去,支撑

ex.en: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will.
ex.cn: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

ex.en: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
ex.cn: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

ex.en: Did you ever wonder how the top supermodels manage to look stunning?
ex.cn: 难道你就没有想过那些超级名模是如何做到外表如此惊艳的吗?

def: n.处理者，经理，管理人,干事，理事,〈美〉（政党等的）领袖,策士，干才，干练的人

ex.en: I want the manager'sjob when he calls it a day.
ex.cn: 等到经理不干了之后，我想接替他的位子。

ex.en: I wouldn't lay bets on his still remaining manager after the spring.
ex.cn: 我看他的这个经理当不到春天之后了。

ex.en: When the great man arrived, the club's manager personally escorted him upstairs.
ex.cn: 那位要人到达时，俱乐部经理亲自陪他上楼。

def:
adj.许多，多的
pron.（与复数动词连用）大多数人

ex.en: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
ex.cn: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

ex.en: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.
ex.cn: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

ex.en: She has had many credits and name-checks in American Vogue.
ex.cn: 美国版《时尚》多次对她进行赞扬或是提到她的名字。

def:
n.地图，天体图,类似地图的事物,〈美俚〉脸，面孔,（染色体上基因排列的）遗传图
vt.绘制（一地区等的）地图,勘查,详细规划,[遗传学]比对

ex.en: We drove east to Rostock, where my map led me astray.
ex.cn: 我们驱车向东去罗斯托克，但地图却给我指错了方向。

ex.en: It was even marked on the map as a scenic route.
ex.cn: 它甚至还作为观光路线标在了地图上。

ex.en: All we had to do was follow the map.
ex.cn: 我们所要做的就是按照地图走。

def:
vi.（坚定地向某地）前进,行军，进军,游行示威,进展，进行
vt.使前进,使行军
n.行进，前进,行军,游行示威,进行曲

ex.en: The unevenly matched armies met at Guilford on 15 March 1781.
ex.cn: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

ex.en: Police said permission for the march had not been granted.
ex.cn: 警方说游行并未得到批准。

ex.en: The group proceeded with a march they knew would lead to bloodshed.
ex.cn: 这个团体继续示威游行，他们知道这将导致流血事件的发生。

def:
n.斑点,记号,成绩,标准
vt.作记号,表示,给…打分,在…留下痕迹
vi.评分,注意,（比赛中）记分

ex.en: Mark had for some time been making advances towards her.
ex.cn: 马克追她已经有一段时间了。

ex.en: Mark was condemned to do most of the work.
ex.cn: 马克被迫承担大部分工作。

ex.en: Mark was out of earshot, walking ahead of them.
ex.cn: 马克走在前面，听不见他们的声音。

def:
n.交易,市集,需求,交易情况，行情
vt.在市场上出售某物,推销
vi.<美>去市场买东西

ex.en: Like a good businessman, Stewart identified a gap in the market.
ex.cn: 像精明的商人一样，斯图尔特发现了市场上的一个空白。

ex.en: Pragmatically, MTV's survival depends on selling the youth market to advertisers.
ex.cn: 从务实角度来说，音乐电视网的生存依赖于把年轻人市场卖给广告商。

ex.en: We are becoming one of the market leaders in the fashion industry.
ex.cn: 我们正在成为时装业的领军者之一。

def: n.结婚,婚姻生活,密切结合,合并

ex.en: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
ex.cn: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

ex.en: After sixteen years of marriage they have grown bored with each other.
ex.cn: 结婚16年后，他们已经渐渐彼此厌倦了。

ex.en: Mr Olaechea has British residency by virtue of his marriage.
ex.cn: 奥拉伊奇先生通过结婚而取得在英国的永久居留权。

def:
vt.& vi.（使）结婚,娶,嫁,结合
vt.为…主持婚礼

ex.en: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
ex.cn: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

ex.en: In many societies children still marry someone of their parents' choice.
ex.cn: 在许多社会，子女结婚仍然只能听从父母之命。

ex.en: I think he wanted to marry her, if I am not mistaken.
ex.cn: 我觉得他曾经想娶她为妻，如果我没有弄错的话。

def:
n.比赛,对手,相配的人（或物）,火柴
vt.相同,适应,使较量,使等同于
vt.& vi.使相配，使相称

ex.en: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
ex.cn: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

ex.en: Charlton are about to play an important away match.
ex.cn: 查尔顿队即将在客场进行一场重要比赛。

ex.en: Poland provide the opposition for the Scots' last warm-up match at home.
ex.cn: 苏格兰队在国内最后一场热身赛的对手是波兰队。

def:
n.材料，原料,素材,布，织物,适当人选
adj.物质的,肉体的,重要的，决定性的,辩证的，推论的

ex.en: The material consisted only of already published, unclassified information.
ex.cn: 这份材料里只有一些已公开的、非保密性质的信息。

ex.en: This will give your promotional material individuality and style.
ex.cn: 这会让你的促销品显得个性十足、格调高雅。

ex.en: In its untreated state the carbon fibre material is rather like cloth.
ex.cn: 原始的碳纤维材料很像布料。

def: n.数学（等于mathematics）

ex.en: He studied math in college.
ex.cn: 他上大学时专业是数学。

ex.en: I flunked math in second grade.
ex.cn: 我二年级时数学不及格。

ex.en: The hard math problem tripped up most of the students.
ex.cn: 这道数学难题难倒了大多数学生.

def: n.数学,〈诗〉同“ripen”,算学

ex.en: The degree provides a thorough grounding in both mathematics and statistics.
ex.cn: 该学位课程将为数学和统计学打下扎实的基础。

ex.en: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics.
ex.cn: 1/5的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。

ex.en: We had a very good mathematics mistress who pulled me up.
ex.cn: 我们有个很出色的女数学老师，她帮我提高了水平。

def: n.数学,=mathematics（英）

ex.en: The papers in maths and English are very testing.
ex.cn: 数学试卷和英语试卷很难。

ex.en: While she sailed through her maths exams, he struggled.
ex.cn: 她顺利地通过数学考试，而他却异常地吃力。

ex.en: I got left behind at school with the maths.
ex.cn: 在校时我的数学跟不上。

def:
n.事件,（讨论、考虑等的）问题,重要性,物质
vi.要紧，重要,化脓,有重大影响,有重要性

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
ex.cn: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

ex.en: "Steve, what do you want?" — "Coke, Pepsi, it doesn't matter."
ex.cn: “史蒂夫，你要喝点什么？”——“可口可乐，百事，随便啦。”

def:
aux.可以,也许,会,但愿
n.[May]五月,山楂属植物,（五朔节装饰用的）绿枝花枝,（春天开花的）绣线菊属植物

ex.en: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
ex.cn: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

ex.en: The agreement has raised hopes that the war may end soon.
ex.cn: 那项协议使人们感到战争有望很快结束。

ex.en: Sightseers may be a little overwhelmed by the crowds and noise.
ex.cn: 拥挤的人群和喧闹的噪音可能会让游客有些茫然不知所措。

def:
adv.也许,可能,大概
n.不确定性

ex.en: Maybe I eat too much and that's what makes me dozy.
ex.cn: 也许我吃得太多了，所以昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: The men were maybe a hundred feet away and coming closer.
ex.cn: 那些人大约有100英尺远，正在向这里靠近。

ex.en: Maybe this guy isn't so squeaky clean after all.
ex.cn: 也许这个人说到底品行并非那么完美。

def:
pron.（人称代词I的宾格）我
n.自我,自我的一部分,极端自私的人,[音乐]固定唱法时的E音

ex.en: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
ex.cn: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

ex.en: He finished his conversation and stood up, looking straight at me.
ex.cn: 他说完话站起来，直视着我。

ex.en: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
ex.cn: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

def:
n.餐，饭,进餐（时间）,〈英〉一次挤奶量,谷物粗粉（用作饲料或加工面粉）
vi.进餐

ex.en: We had a nice meal with a bottle of champagne.
ex.cn: 我们美餐了一顿，还喝了一瓶香槟。

ex.en: The waiter offered him red wine or white wine with his meal.
ex.cn: 侍者为他端上佐餐的红葡萄酒或者白葡萄酒。

ex.en: You get an interesting meal for a reasonable price.
ex.cn: 你花不多的钱就可以吃一顿很特别的饭。

def:
v.表示…的意思,意思是,打算,产生…结果
adj.吝啬的,刻薄的,破旧的,残忍的
n.平均数,中间,几何平均,等比中数

ex.en: "What do you mean?" I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
ex.cn: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

ex.en: This will mean more remand prisoners being held in police cells.
ex.cn: 这将意味着更多候审犯人会被拘押在警局拘留室。

ex.en: Take a hundred and twenty values and calculate the mean.
ex.cn: 取120个值计算平均数。

def:
n.意思，意义,含义,意图
adj.有意思的,意味深长的
vt.意味(mean的现在分词),意思是

ex.en: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word "freedom"
ex.cn: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

ex.en: Art has real meaning when it helps people to understand themselves.
ex.cn: 当艺术有助于人们了解自身的时候才有真正的意义。

ex.en: People use scientific terms with no clear idea of their meaning.
ex.cn: 人们使用科学术语，但并非很清楚其含义。

def: adj.意味深长的,有意义的,有意图的,隽

ex.en: We entered into meaningful discussions with them weeks ago.
ex.cn: 几周前，我们和他们进行了意义深远的讨论。

ex.en: Instead of rushing at life, I wanted something more meaningful.
ex.cn: 我不想混日子，我想做点更有意义的事情。

ex.en: Arnold directed a meaningful look at Irma.
ex.cn: 阿诺德意味深长地看了艾尔玛一眼。

def:
adv.同时，其间
n.其时，其间

ex.en: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water.
ex.cn: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

ex.en: The media, meanwhile, has blown hot and cold on the affair.
ex.cn: 同时，媒体对这件事的态度表现得忽冷忽热。

ex.en: Meanwhile, sales of vinyl records halved in 1992 to just 6.7m.
ex.cn: 与此同时，黑胶唱片的销售量在1992年下降了一半，只有670万张。

def:
n.测量，测度,措施,程度,尺寸
vt.测量,估量
vi.测量,测量（大小，容量，尺寸等）

ex.en: The colonies were claiming a larger measure of self-government.
ex.cn: 殖民地正要求获得更大程度上的自治。

ex.en: The cushions, shown left, measure 20× 12 inches and cost $39.95.
ex.cn: 展示在左边的垫子，长20英寸宽12英寸，价格是39.95美元。

ex.en: The local administration says the curfew is a precautionary measure.
ex.cn: 地方当局说宵禁是一种预防措施。

def:
n.肉,食物,实质
adj.重要的,基本的

ex.en: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
ex.cn: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

ex.en: The government increased prices on several basic commodities like bread and meat.
ex.cn: 政府提高了面包、肉类等几种基本商品的价格。

ex.en: The meat they'd managed to procure assuaged their hunger.
ex.cn: 他们把搞到手的肉拿来充饥。

def:
adj.医学的,医药的,医疗的,内科的
n.体格检查

ex.en: Ann Bradley dispels the old wives' tales and gives the medical facts.
ex.cn: 安·布拉德利破除迷信，给出了医学事实。

ex.en: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
ex.cn: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

ex.en: The problem is compounded by the medical system here.
ex.cn: 这儿的医疗体制使问题进一步恶化。

def: n.医学,药物,有功效的东西，良药

ex.en: Traditionally young Asians in Britain have gravitated towards medicine, law and engineering.
ex.cn: 英国的亚裔年轻人通常被吸引到医学、法律及工程专业。

ex.en: Most doctors appear to recognize homeopathy as a legitimate form of medicine.
ex.cn: 大多数医生似乎都接受顺势疗法是一种合理的医疗手段。

ex.en: The 1990 Nobel Prize for medicine was won by two Americans.
ex.cn: 1990年诺贝尔医学奖由两位美国人获得。

def:
vt.& vi.相遇,相识,开会,接触（某物）
vt.满足,支付,迎接,经历（常指不愉快的事）
n.运动会，体育比赛,猎狐运动（尤其英式英语）
adj.适当的,合适的,恰当的

ex.en: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
ex.cn: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

ex.en: The three parties will meet next month to work out remaining differences.
ex.cn: 三方将在下个月会面，以解决余下的分歧。

ex.en: Many of Britain's beaches fail to meet minimum standards of cleanliness.
ex.cn: 英国许多海滩连最起码的卫生标准都达不倒。

def:
n.会议,聚会,汇合点,运动会
v.相遇( meet的现在分词),相识,开会,接触（某物）

ex.en: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
ex.cn: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

ex.en: The Politburo has been meeting in Peking to discuss the situation.
ex.cn: 政治局已在北京召开会议讨论形势。

ex.en: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd.
ex.cn: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

def: n.成员,分子,身体部位（尤指胳膊或腿）,构件，部件

ex.en: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
ex.cn: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

ex.en: He was now a teacher and a respectable member of the community.
ex.cn: 他现在是一位教师，并且是社区内受人尊敬的一员。

ex.en: This commission would keep environmental scorecards on UN member nations.
ex.cn: 该委员会将对联合国的成员国采用环境记录卡制。

def: n.会员资格,会员身份,会员全体

ex.en: The European Builders Confederation has a membership of over 350,000 building companies.
ex.cn: 欧洲建筑商联合会拥有逾35万家建筑公司会员。

ex.en: Party membership was an essential prerequisite of a successful career.
ex.cn: 成为党员是事业有成必不可少的先决条件。

ex.en: Their membership seems to have risen to something over 10,000.
ex.cn: 他们的会员似乎已经增加到约1万名以上。

def:
vt.修理，修补,改正，纠正,加强,使恢复健康
vi.康复，痊愈,修理，矫正
n.修补,补丁,痊愈

ex.en: I felt that might well mend the rift between them.
ex.cn: 我觉得那样做也许可以让他们冰释前嫌。

ex.en: Somebody else lent me a pump and helped me mend the puncture.
ex.cn: 别人借给我一个打气筒，又帮我补好了轮胎。

ex.en: More evidence that the economy was on the mend was needed.
ex.cn: 需要更多证据来证明经济正在好转。

def:
adj.内心的，精神的，思想的，心理的,智慧的，智[脑]力的,〈口〉精神病的，意志薄弱的，愚笨的
n.精神病患者

ex.en: The woman will be confined to a mental institution.
ex.cn: 这个女人将被关进精神病院。

ex.en: Attitudes to mental illness have shifted in recent years.
ex.cn: 最近几年对精神病的态度已有所改变。

ex.en: He hanged himself two hours after arriving at a mental hospital.
ex.cn: 在到精神病医院两小时后他就上吊自杀了。

def:
vt.提到，说起,提名表扬
n.提及

ex.en: His immediate superior has singled him out for a special mention.
ex.cn: 他的顶头上司特别提到了他。

ex.en: I believe he was concerned in all those matters you mention.
ex.cn: 我认为你提到的那些事都与他有关。

ex.en: The mere mention of John had touched a very raw nerve indeed.
ex.cn: 提到约翰就真的让人心痛。

def: n.菜单,菜，菜肴

ex.en: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
ex.cn: 伯克匆匆地瞥了一眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。

ex.en: At lunchtime, there's a choice between the buffet or the set menu.
ex.cn: 午餐可以吃自助餐，也可以选套餐。

ex.en: The menu changes weekly and usually includes a vegan option.
ex.cn: 菜单每周都有变化，通常包含可供严格的素食者选择的菜肴。

def:
n.价值，优点,[宗教]（行善得到的）功德,功绩，功勋,荣誉
vt.值得，应获得,[宗教]（因行善而）应得（善报）
vi.值得，应得,[宗教]积德

ex.en: Surely such weighty matters merit a higher level of debate?
ex.cn: 这样重大的事件谅必应进行更高级别的讨论吧？

ex.en: For his dedication the Mayor awarded him a medal of merit.
ex.cn: 为表彰他的奉献精神，市长授予他荣誉奖章。

ex.en: "It's of no great literary merit," he said, almost apologetically.
ex.cn: “它没多大的文学价值，”他近乎愧疚地说道。

def:
adj.愉快的，快活的,有趣的,[口]微醉的,生动的
n.甜樱桃,梅里（姓氏）

ex.en: I just wanted to wish you a merry Christmas.
ex.cn: 我只想祝福你圣诞快乐。

ex.en: The phantom of the merry-go-round is just a local superstition.
ex.cn: 旋转木马的幽灵只不过是当地的迷信说法。

ex.en: It hasn't stopped the British Navy proceeding on its merry way.
ex.cn: 这没有阻止英国海军继续得意扬扬地前进的步伐。

def:
n.混乱,食堂,肮脏,困境
vt.弄脏,搞砸,给…供膳
vi.把事情弄糟,制造脏乱

ex.en: England's European Championship plans are in a right mess.
ex.cn: 英格兰队的欧洲锦标赛作战计划乱七八糟。

ex.en: A waiter mopped up the mess as best he could.
ex.cn: 一名侍者尽力抹掉溅出的食物。

ex.en: Except for the remarkably tidy kitchen, the place was a mess.
ex.cn: 除了厨房特别干净外，这地方一片狼藉。

def:
n.金属,金属元素,成色,金色
vt.以金属覆盖

ex.en: Light fittings with metal parts should always be earthed.
ex.cn: 有金属部件的照明装置都应该走地线。

ex.en: Heavy Metal music really arose in the late 60s.
ex.cn: 重金属音乐真正形成于60年代后期。

ex.en: The car was left a mess of twisted metal.
ex.cn: 车子成了一堆扭曲的金属。

def:
n.计量器,计量仪
v.用仪表测量

ex.en: Only a third of these households thought it reasonable to meter water.
ex.cn: 这些家庭当中只有三分之一认为用水表计量是合理的。

ex.en: They have the right to come in and inspect the meter.
ex.cn: 他们有权进来查表。

ex.en: A man came to read the gas meter.
ex.cn: 有位男子来查过煤气表。

def: n.米，公尺,格律，韵律

ex.en: Prices start at £13.95 a metre for printed cotton.
ex.cn: 印花棉布以每米13.95英镑的价格起售。

ex.en: They must each compose a poem in strict alliterative metre.
ex.cn: 他们必须每人作一首严格押头韵的诗。

ex.en: The average UK coal seam is one metre thick.
ex.cn: 英国煤层的平均厚度为1米。

def: n.方法,条理

ex.en: He succeeded with the aid of a completely new method he discovered.
ex.cn: 借助于自己发现的一种全新的方法，他获得了成功。

ex.en: Condoms are an effective method of birth control if used with care.
ex.cn: 如果使用得当，避孕套是很有效的避孕手段。

ex.en: This is an ineffective method of controlling your dog.
ex.cn: 用这种方法控制你的狗不起作用。

def:
n.中部，中间,腰部,中央,正中
adj.中部的,中央的,正中的,中间的
vt.把…放在中间,把…对折
vi.放在中间,对折

ex.en: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

ex.en: Babearth regarded the middle classes as the betrayers of the Revolution.
ex.cn: 巴博施把中产阶级看作是革命的叛徒。

ex.en: She was born in the middle of a rain storm.
ex.cn: 她出生在一场暴风雨中。

def:
aux.表示可能,表示许可,表示询问情况
n.力气,力量,威力,权力
v.可以,应该

ex.en: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
ex.cn: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

ex.en: I might today hesitate to turn in a burglar.
ex.cn: 现在让我把入室窃贼送交警方，我可能会有所顾虑。

ex.en: Things might have been different if I'd talked a bit more.
ex.cn: 如果当时我再多说一点的话，结果或许会不一样。

def: n.英里,很远的距离,一英里赛跑

ex.en: The President is determined "to go the extra mile for peace".
ex.cn: 总统决心“为实现和平而加倍努力”。

ex.en: "How do you know he's Irish?" —"Sticks out a mile."
ex.cn: “你是怎么知道他是爱尔兰人的呢？”——“明摆的事嘛。”

ex.en: He closed his door and started the quarter-mile walk down the hill.
ex.cn: 他关上门,踏上了1/4英里长的下山路.

def:
n.奶,乳液,母乳
vt.挤奶,榨取

ex.en: As the baby suckles, a further supply of milk is generated.
ex.cn: 婴儿吮吸时，会有更多的奶水流出来。

ex.en: Usually a woman's breasts produce milk spontaneously after the birth.
ex.cn: 女性的乳房通常在产后会自然泌乳。

ex.en: So many things are unsafe these days—milk, cranberry sauce, what have you.
ex.cn: 现如今很多食品都不安全——牛奶、蓝莓酱等等。

def: n.毫米

ex.en: In the back of the truck was a 12.7 millimeter rapid-fire machine gun.
ex.cn: 在卡车后面有一只12.7毫米口径的速射机关枪。

ex.en: The silicon chips are less than a millimeter thick.
ex.cn: 这些硅片厚度不足一毫米.

ex.en: I commonly use the Olympus 100 millimeter telephoto lens.
ex.cn: i普遍使用奥林巴斯100毫米远摄镜头.

def: n.毫米

ex.en: 6-millimetre film was used because it offered clearer freeze frames than video tape.
ex.cn: 采用6毫米胶片是因为它的定格图像要比录像带更加清晰。

ex.en: The silicon chips are less than a millimetre thick.
ex.cn: 这些硅片厚度不足一毫米。

ex.en: The coats, made of polythene sheet 0.05 millimetre thick, are fitted on the sheep after shearing.
ex.cn: 这种绵羊穿的罩衣, 是用0.05毫米厚的聚乙烯薄膜制成的,在剪完羊毛之后给羊穿上.

def:
n.百万
adj.百万的,无数的

ex.en: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
ex.cn: 3亿美元远远不够。

ex.en: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.
ex.cn: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。

ex.en: The disease wiped out 40 million rabbits at a stroke.
ex.cn: 该疾病一下子就使4,000万只兔子丧命。

def:
n.心，精神，心力，知，智力，智慧,心胸，头脑，人,愿望，目的，意向，意志，决心，见解，意见,记忆，记性，记忆力，回想
vi.介意,注意
vt.专心于,介意,愿意做,照顾

ex.en: The opportunity had gone. His mind scrabbled for alternatives.
ex.cn: 机会已经失去。他苦苦思索别的方案。

ex.en: Jim Coulters will mind the store while I'm away.
ex.cn: 我不在的时候吉姆·库尔特斯会照看店铺的。

ex.en: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
ex.cn: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

def:
pron.(I的所有格)我的（东西）
n.矿,矿井,地雷,水雷
vt.& vi.在…中开采，开采
vt.在…中[下]布雷,以地雷[水雷]炸毁

ex.en: I shall have words with these stupid friends of mine!
ex.cn: 我真应该跟我这些愚蠢的朋友理论理论！

ex.en: She tells me her troubles. I tell her mine.
ex.cn: 我和她互相倾诉烦恼。

ex.en: A gold mine is not a bottomless pit, the gold runs out.
ex.cn: 金矿并非无底的宝藏，金子终究会被采光。

def:
n.矿物,矿石,矿物质,汽水
adj.矿物的，似矿物的

ex.en: The mineral is weakly magnetic.
ex.cn: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

ex.en: The rock is rich in mineral salts.
ex.cn: 该岩石中富含矿盐。

ex.en: The body is made of mineral-reinforced thermo-plastic.
ex.cn: 主体材料是矿物增强热塑性塑料。

def:
n.大臣,部长,公使,牧师
vi.辅助，服侍,执行牧师职务

ex.en: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
ex.cn: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

ex.en: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

ex.en: There is good news of a kind for the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 对总理来说也算是有个好消息。

def:
n.分，分钟,瞬间，片刻,备忘录,会议记录
vt.把…记录在案,为…测定时间

ex.en: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
ex.cn: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

ex.en: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
ex.cn: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

ex.en: He'd telephoned with some phoney excuse she didn't believe for a minute.
ex.cn: 他找了某个她根本不会相信的借口给她打电话。

def:
n.镜子，反光镜,真实的写照,反映，借鉴,榜样
vt.反映,反射

ex.en: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
ex.cn: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

ex.en: A mirror hung on a nail above the washstand.
ex.cn: 脸盆架上方用钉子挂着一面镜子。

ex.en: This is almost the mirror image of the situation in Scotland.
ex.cn: 这几乎就是苏格兰局势的翻版。

def:
n.（用于姓名或姓之前，对未婚女子的称呼）小姐,女士,失误
v.漏掉,错过（机会）,思念,没遇到

ex.en: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
ex.cn: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

ex.en: She looked at Miss Melville, snugly ensconced among her new friends.
ex.cn: 她看了看梅尔维尔小姐，她正舒适地安坐在新朋友中间。

ex.en: It would be just his luck to miss the last boat.
ex.cn: 他就这运气，误了最后一班船也毫不出奇。

def:
adj.失去的,下落不明的
v.错过( miss的现在分词)

ex.en: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.
ex.cn: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。

ex.en: She was very glum and was obviously missing her children.
ex.cn: 她郁郁寡欢，显然在惦念自己的孩子们。

ex.en: It is not unknown for valuable display items to go, ahem, missing.
ex.cn: 贵重的展品，呃哼，丢失的话，会众人皆知。

def: vt.误会，误解,曲解

ex.en: I'm not saying what he did was good, don't misunderstand me.
ex.cn: 别误会，我并不是说他所做的是好事。

ex.en: She no longer feared that they should misunderstand her.
ex.cn: 她不再害怕他们会误解她了.

ex.en: Don't misunderstand what I'm trying to say.
ex.cn: 别误解我要说的话.

def:
vt.& vi.混合,（使）结交,相容,平安相处
n.混录,食物混合配料,乐曲组合
vt.调配，配制
vi.混合录音，混录，混音

ex.en: Stewart has developed a tendency to mix it verbally with the opposition.
ex.cn: 斯图尔特现在变得只要和别人意见不合，就准备大吵一架。

ex.en: The song is a fiery mix of twanging guitar with relentless drumming.
ex.cn: 那是一首夹杂着撩拨的吉他声和密集的鼓点的激情四射的歌曲。

ex.en: For speed we used packets of pizza dough mix.
ex.cn: 为了节约时间，我们用了几包做比萨饼的混合面粉。

def:
n.模型,模特儿,模式,典型
vt.& vi.做模特儿
vt.模仿,制作模型，塑造,将…做成模型
adj.典型的，模范的

ex.en: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
ex.cn: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

ex.en: The functionalist model of industrial society was subjected to conceptual criticism.
ex.cn: 工业社会的实用主义模型在概念上遭到了批判。

ex.en: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behaviour.
ex.cn: 这个实用的基础模型较为简略地解释了人类的行为。

def:
adj.现代的,近代的,新式的,当代风格的
n.现代人，现代主义者,时髦人士,[印]现代字体，指印刷中所用的一种字体

ex.en: We are in one of the most severe recessions in modern times.
ex.cn: 我们正在经历现代最严重的一段经济衰退。

ex.en: In many ways, it was a very modern school for its time.
ex.cn: 从很多方面来说，这所学校在当时是非常先进的。

ex.en: This boxed collection captures 64 of the greatest modern love songs.
ex.cn: 这套盒装专辑收录了64首最好听的当代爱情歌曲。

def: n.瞬间，片刻,时刻,重要，紧要,[物]力矩

ex.en: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
ex.cn: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

ex.en: He's touring South America at this moment in time.
ex.cn: 他此刻正在南美旅游观光。

ex.en: Gail was silent for a moment, regarding Harry with his steady gaze.
ex.cn: 盖尔镇定地注视着哈里，沉默了片刻。

def: n.星期一,周一

ex.en: Wendy popped in for a quick bite to eat on Monday night.
ex.cn: 温迪周一晚上过来匆匆吃了点儿饭。

ex.en: The orchestra gave its first performance on Whit Monday.
ex.cn: 乐团在周一的圣灵降临节举行了首场演出。

ex.en: He expressed the hope that on Monday elementary schools would be reopened.
ex.cn: 他表示希望各小学星期一能复课。

def: n.钱,财富,薪水,款项

ex.en: I spent lots of money on smart new outfits for work.
ex.cn: 我花大笔钱购置了上班时穿的漂亮新套装。

ex.en: She'd do anything for a bit of pin money.
ex.cn: 为了挣点外快，她什么都肯做。

ex.en: Many of the leaders have become hooked on power and money.
ex.cn: 很多领导人都变得贪恋权力和金钱。

def:
n.显示屏，屏幕,[计]显示器,监测仪,监控人员，班长
vt.监控，监听,搜集，记录,测定,监督
vi.监视

ex.en: Officials had not been allowed to monitor the voting.
ex.cn: 以前不允许官员监督投票。

ex.en: Meetings are held periodically to monitor progress on the case.
ex.cn: 定期举行会议以监督案件的进展。

ex.en: It would monitor traffic flows and provide feedback to motorists.
ex.cn: 它能监控交通状况，然后给司机提供反馈信息。

def:
n.猴,猿,淘气鬼,小淘气
vi.胡闹,捣蛋
vt.嘲弄

ex.en: The woolly spider monkey is the largest primate in the Americas.
ex.cn: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长类动物。

ex.en: Come here, you cheeky little monkey!
ex.cn: 过来，你这没有教养的小捣蛋鬼！

ex.en: Look! It's a monkey's wedding!
ex.cn: 看！出着太阳还下雨！

def: n.月，月份,一个月的时间

ex.en: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
ex.cn: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

ex.en: The three parties will meet next month to work out remaining differences.
ex.cn: 三方将在下个月会面，以解决余下的分歧。

ex.en: He won last month's presidential election by a landslide.
ex.cn: 他以压倒性多数赢得上月的总统选举。

def:
adj.每月的,每月一次的,按月的
n.月刊,月经
adv.每月,每月一次

ex.en: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
ex.cn: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

ex.en: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
ex.cn: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

ex.en: Customers who arrange overdrafts will face a monthly charge of £5.
ex.cn: 透支的客户每月要缴纳5英镑的费用。

def:
n.月亮，月球,卫星,月状物，新月状物
vi.闲逛,出神,[俚语] 露出屁股以戏弄
vt.虚度

ex.en: June always rhymes with moon in old love songs.
ex.cn: 在老情歌中June总是和moon成韵。

ex.en: In Norse mythology the moon is personified as male.
ex.cn: 在斯堪的纳维亚神话里，月亮被赋予了男性身份。

ex.en: The half moon is hidden behind some wispy clouds.
ex.cn: 半轮月亮躲在淡淡的云彩之后。

def:
adv.更，更多,达到或处于更大的范围或程度,此外，更加
adj.更多的,(many)的比较级,附加的，额外的
pron.更多的或附加的人或事物
n.更多,附加，添加

ex.en: I don't want any more of that heavy stuff.
ex.cn: 我再也不想碰那种麻烦事了。

ex.en: Things might have been different if I'd talked a bit more.
ex.cn: 如果当时我再多说一点的话，结果或许会不一样。

ex.en: If you build more plastics into cars, the car lasts longer.
ex.cn: 如果汽车采用更多塑料元件，寿命会更长一些。

def: n.早晨,上午,黎明,早期，初期

ex.en: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
ex.cn: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

ex.en: They're freshly baked. I fetched them from the baker's this morning.
ex.cn: 它们是刚出炉的。我早上去面包房买回来的。

ex.en: The weather was unkind to those pipers who played in the morning.
ex.cn: 坏天气对上午那些风笛吹奏者毫不容情。

def:
adv.最，最多（大）,much的最高级,非常，很,几乎
adj.many的最高级,最多的，最大的,大概的,大多数的，大部分的
n.最大限度,大部分,大多数人

ex.en: The most pleasurable experience of the evening was the wonderful fireworks display.
ex.cn: 这个晚上最让人高兴的就是精彩的焰火表演。

ex.en: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
ex.cn: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

ex.en: Most of the wine was unfit for human consumption.
ex.cn: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

def:
n.母亲，妈妈,女修道院院长,大娘
vt.像母亲般地照顾,养育,溺爱

ex.en: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
ex.cn: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

ex.en: Did she usurp his place in his mother's heart?
ex.cn: 她取代了他在他母亲心目中的地位吗？

ex.en: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
ex.cn: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

def:
n.马达，发动机，[火箭]助推器,原动者，原动力,汽车,[解]运动肌，运动神经
vi.开[乘]汽车
vt.用汽车运送
adj.有引擎的,由发动机推动的,机动车的,肌肉运动的

ex.en: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
ex.cn: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

ex.en: It's very difficult being a woman in motor racing.
ex.cn: 做一名女赛车手很不容易。

ex.en: Stefano used a motor cycle to herd the sheep.
ex.cn: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

def: n.山，山岳,山脉,一大堆,大量

ex.en: I'll run over to Short Mountain and check on Mrs Adams.
ex.cn: 我会开车去肖特山看看亚当斯夫人。

ex.en: The truck sways wildly, careening down narrow mountain roads.
ex.cn: 卡车疯狂地左摇右晃，从狭窄的山路上急冲而下。

ex.en: Searchers have found three mountain climbers missing since Saturday.
ex.cn: 搜救人员已经找到了周六失踪的3名登山者。

def:
n.老鼠,鼠标,羞怯[胆小]的人,[非正式用语] 眼部青肿
vi.捕鼠,窥探，偷偷地寻找

ex.en: Use your mouse to drag the pictures to their new size.
ex.cn: 用鼠标拖动图片，将其调整为新的尺寸。

ex.en: It's a cat-and-mouse game to him, and I'm the mouse.
ex.cn: 在他看来，这是个猫捉老鼠的把戏，而我就是老鼠。

ex.en: You can check your email with a click of your mouse.
ex.cn: 鼠标轻轻一点，即可查看电子邮件。

def:
n.口,出入口,传闻
vt.装腔作势地说,喃喃地说，心不在焉地说，言不由衷地说
vi.装腔作势说话

ex.en: A thorough brushing helps to freshen up your mouth.
ex.cn: 彻底刷牙有助于口气清新。

ex.en: His mouth was a little open, as if he'd started to scream.
ex.cn: 他的嘴微微张开,似乎是要开始尖叫.

ex.en: I've always had a loud mouth, I refuse to be silenced.
ex.cn: 我一贯大声说出自己的想法，不会迫于压力而一言不发。

def:
vt.& vi.移动，搬动
vi.搬家,行动,进展,（机器等）开动
vt.提议,使感动,摇动,变化
n.改变,迁移

ex.en: So, if we could just move onto something else?
ex.cn: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

ex.en: They are selling their house to move to a smaller one.
ex.cn: 他们正打算卖掉房子，然后搬到一个小一点的住处。

ex.en: If the company was to relocate, most employees would move.
ex.cn: 如果这个公司要搬迁，多数员工也要搬家。

def: n.运动,活动,动作，举动,乐章

ex.en: Monks shave their heads, as do devotees of the Hare Krishna movement.
ex.cn: 和尚要剃度，克利须那派教徒也一样。

ex.en: In the 50s, Rauschenberg anticipated the conceptual art movement of the 80s.
ex.cn: 上世纪50年代时，劳申伯格就早早地预见到了80年代的概念艺术运动。

ex.en: They are accused of organising and financing an underground youth movement.
ex.cn: 他们被指控组织并资助地下青年运动。

def: n.电影,电影院,电影业

ex.en: The movie sees Burton psychoanalysing Firth to cure him of his depression.
ex.cn: 在电影中伯顿对弗思进行了精神分析，想要治愈他的抑郁症。

ex.en: This could be the feel-good movie of the autumn.
ex.cn: 这可以称得上是今秋令人赏心悦目的影片了。

ex.en: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'lllove this movie.
ex.cn: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

def:
adv.非常,差不多,很多地,很大程度上
adj.许多的，大量的
pron.很多,大量,很好的东西,（与不可数名词连用，尤用于否定句，或与 how 连用以询问数量，也可与 as、so 和 too 连用）许多

ex.en: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
ex.cn: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

ex.en: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
ex.cn: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

ex.en: He arrived on January 9, disheveled and much the worse for wear.
ex.cn: 他是1月9号到的，蓬头垢面，疲惫不堪。

def:
n.谋杀,杀戮,极艰难[令人沮丧]的经历
vt.凶杀,糟蹋,打垮
vi.杀人

ex.en: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
ex.cn: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

ex.en: She denied the murder of four children who were in her care.
ex.cn: 她否认杀害了她所照管的4个孩子。

ex.en: Mr Farmer and Mrs Jones both admitted conspiring to murder her husband.
ex.cn: 法默先生和琼斯太太都承认密谋杀死了琼斯先生。

def: n.博物馆

ex.en: The museum will have a permanent exhibition of 60 vintage cars.
ex.cn: 这个博物馆将长期展出60辆老爷车。

ex.en: Mr Morris feels the museum is using advertising to good effect.
ex.cn: 莫里斯先生认为博物馆作的广告卓有成效。

ex.en: At that instant the museum was plunged into total darkness.
ex.cn: 就在那时，博物馆陷入了一片漆黑。

def: n.音乐,乐曲,乐谱,乐队

ex.en: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
ex.cn: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

ex.en: "It's not one of my favourite forms of music." — "No."
ex.cn: “这不是我喜欢的音乐形式。”——“对，这不是。”

ex.en: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
ex.cn: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

def:
adj.音乐的，用于音乐的,喜爱[精通]音乐的,音调优美的,悦耳的
n.（社交性的）音乐会,[影视]歌舞片,音乐（喜）剧 = musical comedy

ex.en: London's musical life might become as exciting as Berlin's.
ex.cn: 伦敦的音乐生活可能会变得像柏林的一样令人兴奋。

ex.en: Which of them has more musical talent is open to debate.
ex.cn: 他们之中谁更有音乐天赋还未有定论。

ex.en: The drum is one of the oldest musical instruments.
ex.cn: 鼓是最古老的乐器之一。

def: n.音乐家

ex.en: He feels that he was destined to become a musician.
ex.cn: 他觉得自己注定会成为一名音乐家。

ex.en: He was a brilliant musician.
ex.cn: 他是一位才华横溢的音乐家。

ex.en: Rozhdestvensky is an extraordinary musician.
ex.cn: 罗日杰斯特文斯基是位出色的音乐家。

def:
aux.必须,必然要,（做出逻辑推断）,（表示坚持）
n.必须做的事，必不可少的事物,葡萄汁,霉臭,麝香
vt.& vi.（表示必要或很重要）必须,（提出建议）应该,得,（表示很可能或符合逻辑）一定
adj.不可或缺的,狂暴的

ex.en: You must have noticed how tired he sometimes looks.
ex.cn: 你一定注意到他有时候显得特别疲惫。

ex.en: "His memory must be completely back, then?" — "Just about."
ex.cn: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

ex.en: There must be any number of people in my position.
ex.cn: 一定有很多人处在我这种境况。

def:
adj.我的(I的所有格形式)
int.啊呀,天啊

ex.en: The vowel in words like "my" and "thigh" is not very difficult.
ex.cn: 单词my和thigh中的元音并不难发。

ex.en: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
ex.cn: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

ex.en: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
ex.cn: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

def: pron.我自己，亲自

ex.en: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend'swife.
ex.cn: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

ex.en: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
ex.cn: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

ex.en: I went to Brooks Brothers and bought myself a decent shirt.
ex.cn: 我去布鲁克斯兄弟专卖店给自己买了一件体面的衬衫。

def: n.秘密，谜,神秘，神秘的事物,推理小说，推理剧,常作 mysteries 秘技，秘诀

ex.en: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
ex.cn: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

ex.en: The Italian economic miracle has always been a mystery.
ex.cn: 意大利的经济奇迹一直是个谜。

ex.en: For years the teaching of acting has been shrouded in mystery.
ex.cn: 多年以来表演教学一直蒙着神秘的面纱。

def:
n.钉子,指甲，趾甲,钉状物,纳尔
vt.钉住,抓住,使固定,揭露

ex.en: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job.
ex.cn: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。

ex.en: A mirror hung on a nail above the washstand.
ex.cn: 脸盆架上方用钉子挂着一面镜子。

ex.en: One dip into the bottle should do an entire nail.
ex.cn: 往瓶子里蘸一下的量就应该能涂满整个指甲。

def:
n.名字,名声,有…名称的,著名的人物
vt.确定,决定,给…取名,说出…的名字
adj.著名的,据以取名

ex.en: She has had many credits and name-checks in American Vogue.
ex.cn: 美国版《时尚》多次对她进行赞扬或是提到她的名字。

ex.en: They also left a card, imprinted with the name Sean Lynch.
ex.cn: 他们还留下了一张名片，上面印着肖恩·林奇的名字。

ex.en: This guy, Jack Smith, does he go by the name of Jackal?
ex.cn: 这个叫杰克·史密斯的家伙是不是还有个名字叫杰凯尔？

def:
adj.狭隘的,狭窄的,（种类或数目）有限的,仔细的，精确的
vt.限制，限定,（使）变窄,变得更窄,收缩
n.海峡,狭路，隘路,狭窄的水道
vi.变窄

ex.en: Sailing boats lay at anchor in the narrow waterway.
ex.cn: 帆船停泊在狭窄的水道上。

ex.en: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
ex.cn: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

ex.en: He was criticised for being boring, strait-laced and narrow-minded.
ex.cn: 他被指无趣乏味，古板守旧，心胸狭窄。

def: n.国家,民族,国民,政府

ex.en: Albania is a small nation state of around 3 million people.
ex.cn: 阿尔巴尼亚是一个大约有300万人口的单一民族独立国家。

ex.en: Young people came from the four corners of the nation.
ex.cn: 全国各地的年轻人都来到这里。

ex.en: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?
ex.cn: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

def:
adj.国家的,国有的,国民的,民族主义的
n.[常用复数]全国性比赛,某国国民,全国性报刊,（机构等的）全国总部

ex.en: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
ex.cn: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

ex.en: He will soon be back in training for next year's National.
ex.cn: 他将很快回来为明年的全国联赛进行特训。

ex.en: The African National Congress threatened to withdraw from the talks.
ex.cn: 非洲国民大会威胁要退出会谈。

def:
adj.本国的,土著的,天生的,天真的，纯朴的
n.当地人,土著人,当地产的动（植）物

ex.en: We were forbidden, under pain of imprisonment, to use our native language.
ex.cn: 我们被禁止使用母语，违者将被关进监狱。

ex.en: It was his first visit to his native country since 1948.
ex.cn: 这是自1948年以来他首次回到自己的祖国。

ex.en: Before all this the island was populated by native American Arawaks.
ex.cn: 在所有这一切发生之前，这个岛上居住的是印第安阿拉瓦克人。

def:
adj.自然的,物质的,天生的,不做作的
n.自然的事情,（生来的）白痴,[乐]（风琴等的）白键

ex.en: The ball is made of rattan — a natural fibre.
ex.cn: 这个球是由一种天然纤维——省藤制成的。

ex.en: Vintage ports must be decanted to remove natural sediments.
ex.cn: 上等的波尔图葡萄酒必须倒入其他容器中以滤除自然沉淀物。

ex.en: Mainline feminism was arguing for the inherent beauty of the natural woman.
ex.cn: 主流女权主义思想倡导女性天生的自然美。

def: n.自然,天性,天理,类型

ex.en: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
ex.cn: 这一聚合物的性质目前是个商业机密。

ex.en: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
ex.cn: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

ex.en: Rowe does a very clever riff on the nature of prejudice.
ex.cn: 罗就偏见的本质讲了一番很精辟的话。

def:
adv.（空间）在近处,在附近,（时间）临近,（程度）几乎
prep.（表示程度）接近,（表示位置）靠近,（表示时间）将近,接近于（某种状态）
adj.近的,亲密的,近似,（亲属关系）近亲

ex.en: She is not herself. She came near to a breakdown.
ex.cn: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

ex.en: Southbound traffic tailed back for twenty miles on the M5 near Bristol.
ex.cn: 在布里斯托尔附近的5号高速公路上，南行的车辆排成了绵延20英里的长龙。

ex.en: He awoke to find Charlie standing near the bed.
ex.cn: 他醒了过来，发现查利正站在床边。

def:
adj.在附近的，位于附近的
adv.附近地，不远地

ex.en: At a nearby table a man was complaining in a loud voice.
ex.cn: 邻桌的一位男士当时正高声地抱怨着。

ex.en: Nearby, nestling in the hills, was the children's home.
ex.cn: 孩子们的家就在附近的山里。

ex.en: Nearby there is a stretch of white sand beach perfect for sunbathing.
ex.cn: 附近有一片白色沙滩，是沐日光浴的绝佳场所。

def: adv.几乎，差不多,险乎

ex.en: It is nearly always women who are the primary care givers.
ex.cn: 从事初级保健护理工作的几乎都是女性。

ex.en: Their countries had been at war for nearly six weeks.
ex.cn: 他们的国家陷入战争状态已将近6个星期了。

ex.en: New diet books appear at a rate of nearly one a week.
ex.cn: 新的饮食类书籍差不多一周出一本。

def: adj.整洁的，干净的,灵巧的,匀整的,未搀水的

ex.en: Neat solutions are not easily found to these issues.
ex.cn: 很难找到解决这些问题的巧妙办法。

ex.en: A rather neat option allows you to design your own fiendish puzzle.
ex.cn: 只要干净利落地做一个选择，你就能自己设计出难以解开的谜题。

ex.en: He poured himself a brandy and swallowed it neat.
ex.cn: 他给自己倒了一杯白兰地，没兑水就一饮而尽。

def: adv.整洁地,干净地,灵巧地,恰好地

ex.en: At the door was a neatly dressed, dignified man.
ex.cn: 门口站着一位穿戴整齐、仪态庄重的男子。

ex.en: His finger nails were square and cut neatly across.
ex.cn: 他的手指甲是方形的，修剪得很齐。

ex.en: He folded his paper neatly and sipped his coffee.
ex.cn: 他把报纸整齐地叠起来，然后抿了口咖啡。

def: adv.必要地,必需地,必定地,必然地

ex.en: He is not attempting necessarily to reproduce the cadence of speech.
ex.cn: 他不想刻意重复那种讲话的语调。

ex.en: Local feeling does not necessarily concur with the press.
ex.cn: 当地人的感受未必与媒体一致。

ex.en: Their success does not necessarily reflect a leftward shift in politics.
ex.cn: 他们的成功并不一定表示政治气候转向亲左。

def:
adj.必要的,强制的,必然的,不可避免的
n.必需品

ex.en: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread.
ex.cn: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

ex.en: Now there is a dawning realisation that drastic action is necessary.
ex.cn: 现在人们开始意识到必须采取断然的行动。

ex.en: Fry remaining peppers, adding a little more dressing if necessary.
ex.cn: 用油炸一下剩下的辣椒，如果需要再加点调味汁。

def:
n.颈，脖子,衣领,海峡,[地]岩颈
vi.搂着脖子亲吻，相拥互吻,变狭窄
vt.使变细,与…搂著脖子亲吻,割颈杀死（家禽等）

ex.en: He shouted at his brother, his neck veins bulging.
ex.cn: 他朝他的兄弟吼叫，脖子上青筋暴突。

ex.en: I shivered and pulled my scarf more tightly round my neck.
ex.cn: 我打了个寒战，用围巾把脖子围得更紧了。

ex.en: He had twined his chubby arms around Vincent's neck.
ex.cn: 他胖乎乎的双臂搂住文森特的脖子。

def:
vt.需要,必须
aux.必须,不得不
n.需要,需要的东西,责任,贫穷
vi.（表示应该或不得不做）有必要

ex.en: Do not wait for good things to happen to you. You need to walk towards happiness.
ex.cn: 不要等待好事降临，你要向幸福进发。

ex.en: You'll need to get on the right side of Carmela.
ex.cn: 你得讨卡梅拉的欢心。

ex.en: You will need a pot of broth for poaching.
ex.cn: 你需要一锅汤来煮。

def:
n.针,针状物,<口>刺激性言行
vt.用针缝，刺,刺激，激怒,<俚>增加（饮料的）酒精含量
vi.缝纫

ex.en: She passed the needle through the rough cloth, back and forth.
ex.cn: 她一针一针地缝那块粗布。

ex.en: At 240 mph the needle went off the clock.
ex.cn: 车速达到每小时240英里时，里程表上的指针显示超出了最高时速。

ex.en: I hyperventilate when they come near me with the needle.
ex.cn: 当他们拿着注射针走近我时，我的呼吸急速加快。

def: abbr.National Economic Growth and Reconstruction Organization 国家经济增长和重建组织

ex.en: The Negro minstrel is touring the country.
ex.cn: 那个黑人歌舞团正在全国各地巡回演出.

ex.en: He was the first Negro ever to enroll there.
ex.cn: 他是学院招收的第一个黑人学生.

ex.en: It's impolite to call the black people Negro.
ex.cn: 称呼黑人为Negro是不礼貌的。

def:
n.<美>邻居，邻国
adj.邻近的，邻接的
vi.友好,毗邻而居
vt.邻接

ex.en: And he said unto him, "Who is my neighbor?"
ex.cn: 他于是对他说道：“谁是我邻居？”

ex.en: A neighbor sheltered the boy for seven days.
ex.cn: 一个邻居收留了这个男孩在他家藏了7天。

ex.en: "Who is it?" he called.— 'It's your neighbor.'
ex.cn: “是谁啊？”他问道。——“是你的邻居。”

def:
n.邻居,邻近的人[物],邻国,世人
vt.接壤,邻接
vi.邻近,与…有睦邻关系
adj.邻居的,邻近的

ex.en: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
ex.cn: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

ex.en: Surprise a new neighbour with one of your favourite home-made dishes.
ex.cn: 做一道拿手的家常小菜，给你的新邻居一个惊喜。

ex.en: Are you a hundred per cent sure it's your neighbour?
ex.cn: 你百分之百肯定是你的邻居吗？

def: n.地区,某地区的人,与某处邻近的地区,临近街坊

ex.en: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems.
ex.cn: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。

ex.en: Her children had the best, most elaborate birthday parties in the neighborhood.
ex.cn: 她的孩子们的生日聚会在街坊四邻里是最好、最讲究的。

ex.en: The neighborhood is given over to performers, stilt walkers and drag queens.
ex.cn: 社区变成了玩杂耍的、踩高跷的和扮装皇后的天地。

def: n.居住区,周边地区,大约,在…附近

ex.en: He was born and grew up in the Flatbush neighbourhood of Brooklyn.
ex.cn: 他出生在布鲁克林的弗拉特布什一带，并在那儿长大成人。

ex.en: Its speed is probably in the neighbourhood of 380mph or even more.
ex.cn: 它的时速大约达到了380英里，或者更快。

ex.en: It seemed like a good neighbourhood to raise my children.
ex.cn: 它看起来像是一个有利于我的孩子们成长的理想居住区。

def:
adj.（两者）都不的
pron.两者都不
adv.两个都不,既不…也不
conj.也不,既不

ex.en: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
ex.cn: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

ex.en: They can neither read nor write, nor can they comprehend such concepts.
ex.cn: 他们不会读，不会写，也理解不了这样的概念。

ex.en: That, if you'll pardon my saying so, is neither here nor there.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，那根本就不重要。

def: n.侄子，外甥

ex.en: "Cut her out of your will," urged his nephew.
ex.cn: “把她从你的遗嘱中删去，”他的侄子催促道。

ex.en: She has a nephew who is just ten years of age.
ex.cn: 她有一个才10岁的侄子。

ex.en: Last month a shopkeeper's nephew was shot dead.
ex.cn: 上个月一名店主的侄子被枪杀了。

def: adj.焦虑的,紧张不安的,神经质的

ex.en: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
ex.cn: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

ex.en: He developed a nervous twitch and began to blink constantly.
ex.cn: 他身体出现了神经性抽搐，开始不停地眨眼睛。

ex.en: She felt nervous, increasingly lacking in confidence about herself.
ex.cn: 她感到紧张，对自己越来越没有信心。

def:
n.网,网状织物,球网,网罩
vt.用网捕,捕获,净赚,踢入球门
adj.净的,净得的,最后的

ex.en: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
ex.cn: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

ex.en: The group had a net profit margin of 30% last year.
ex.cn: 去年，这个集团的纯利润率为30%。

ex.en: There was a net outflow of about £50m in short-term capital.
ex.cn: 短期资金净流出额大约为5,000万英镑。

def: adv.从不，从来没有,一点也不，决不,<口>不会…吧，没有,不曾

ex.en: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
ex.cn: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

ex.en: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
ex.cn: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

ex.en: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
ex.cn: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

def:
adj.新的，崭新的,新鲜的，新到的,现代的,初次（听到）的
adv.新近，最近

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: In New Zealand, the Maori people maintain a strong cultural tradition.
ex.cn: 在新西兰，毛利人保持着深厚的文化传统。

ex.en: She was afraid in a way that was quite new to her.
ex.cn: 她感到从未有过的害怕。

def: adv.新近，最近,重新，又，再度,以新的方式,乍

ex.en: Builders must fasten down roofs of newly-built homes more securely.
ex.cn: 建造工人必须把新建房屋的屋顶固定得更牢靠些。

ex.en: The newly-occupied Italian colony of Libya rose in revolt in 1914.
ex.cn: 意大利新占领的殖民地利比亚于1914年发生叛乱。

ex.en: Officials tussled over who had responsibility for the newly fashionable unemployment agenda.
ex.cn: 众官员为谁负责最近备受关注的失业议题一事争得不可开交。

def: n.新闻,消息,（可当作新闻内容的）人,物

ex.en: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities.
ex.cn: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

ex.en: I use the short-wave radio to get the latest war news.
ex.cn: 我用短波收音机收听最新的战事新闻。

ex.en: News of 160 redundancies had sent tremors through the community.
ex.cn: 将会裁员160人的消息在该团体中掀起了一阵骚动。

def: n.报纸，报,旧报纸,新闻纸

ex.en: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
ex.cn: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

ex.en: He ran a newspaper stand outside the American Express office.
ex.cn: 他在美国运通公司办公大楼外经营一家报摊。

ex.en: The newspaper job had me doing the same thing day after day.
ex.cn: 这份报社的工作让我日复一日地做着同样的事。

def:
adj.紧接在后的,次于的,贴近的,紧邻的
adv.接下去,然后,居后地,依次的
n.下一位,下一个
prep.靠近,居于…之后,在…的隔壁

ex.en: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
ex.cn: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

ex.en: The three parties will meet next month to work out remaining differences.
ex.cn: 三方将在下个月会面，以解决余下的分歧。

ex.en: China enters a new five-year plan period next year.
ex.cn: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。

def: adj.美好的，愉快的,正派的,友好的，亲切的,细致的

ex.en: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
ex.cn: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

ex.en: She met Mr and Mrs Ricciardi, who were very nice to her.
ex.cn: 她见到了里恰尔迪夫妇，他们对她非常友好。

ex.en: We had a nice meal with a bottle of champagne.
ex.cn: 我们美餐了一顿，还喝了一瓶香槟。

def: n.夜,晚上,（举行盛事的）夜晚

ex.en: Two men were helping police with their inquiries at Salisbury last night.
ex.cn: 两名男子昨天夜里在索尔兹伯里接受了警方盘问。

ex.en: That was the first time Elliot stayed out all night.
ex.cn: 那是埃利奥特第一次彻夜未归。

ex.en: Last night he was being held in solitary confinement in Douglas jail.
ex.cn: 昨晚他被单独监禁在道格拉斯的监狱里。

def:
num.九,九个,第九
n.九，九个
adj.九的，九个的

ex.en: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
ex.cn: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

ex.en: The price of a single ticket is thirty-nine pounds.
ex.cn: 单程票的价格是39英镑。

ex.en: Some supernova researchers wondered if it might be just a nine-day wonder.
ex.cn: 有些超新星研究者怀疑，这可能只是昙花一现。

def:
num.十九,十九个,第十九
n.十九岁,十九点钟

ex.en: He set off for a nineteen-day moose hunt in Nova Scotia.
ex.cn: 他动身前往新斯科舍参加为时19天的驼鹿捕猎活动。

ex.en: As a novel, Nineteen Eighty-four hardly ranks with the greats.
ex.cn: 作为一部小说，《一九八四》很难被列为杰作。

ex.en: He was a kid really, not more than eighteen or nineteen.
ex.cn: 他实际上还是个孩子，最多不过十八九岁。

def:
num.九十
n.九十,九十年代,九十岁
adj.九十的,九十岁的

ex.en: Almost ninety per cent of all rapes and violent assaults went unreported.
ex.cn: 几乎90%的强奸案和暴力侵害案都没有报案。

ex.en: Ninety per cent of lone parent families are headed by mothers.
ex.cn: 90%的单亲家庭由母亲持家。

ex.en: Ninety-nine per cent of primary pupils now have hands-on experience of computers.
ex.cn: 现在，99%的小学生都亲手操作过电脑。

def:
adv.不,否,一点也没有
adj.没有的,不许的,一点儿也没有,决不是的
n.不,否定，否认,反对票,否决票
abbr.数字(number),元素锘(nobelium)的符号

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
ex.cn: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

ex.en: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
ex.cn: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

def:
adj.高尚的,贵族的,外表庄严和庄重的,表现出崇高的
n.尊贵的人,旧时在英国使用的金币

ex.en: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
ex.cn: 他对皇帝陛下高尚的动机深信不疑。

ex.en: Cockburn's arrival coincided with that of Sir Iain and Lady Noble.
ex.cn: 科伯恩到时正好伊恩爵士和诺布尔夫人也来了。

ex.en: We'll always justify our actions with noble sounding theories.
ex.cn: 我们总会用听起来非常高尚的理论为我们的行动辩护。

def:
pron.没有人，无人
n.小人物，无足轻重的人

ex.en: "Wait a damn minute," Mindy spat. "Nobody said anything about staying overnight."
ex.cn: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

ex.en: Nobody else believed that they had tried to rub out the pope.
ex.cn: 其他人都不相信他们试图杀死教皇。

ex.en: They were shut away in a little room where nobody could overhear.
ex.cn: 他们被关在一个小屋里，没人能听到他们的动静。

def:
vi.点头,打瞌睡,上下摆动,变得粗心大意
vt.点头示意,使弯曲，使屈服,点头答应
n.点头,点头同意,打瞌睡，打盹,粗心大意

ex.en: He turned with a little nod and I watched him walk away.
ex.cn: 他边点了点头边转过身，我看着他走了。

ex.en: "Probably," agreed Hunter, with a slow nod of his head.
ex.cn: 亨特慢慢点了点头,表示赞同地说:“很有可能.”

ex.en: A quick nod of approval would have done nicely.
ex.cn: 要是当时立即点头同意就好了。

def:
n.噪音,嘈杂声，喧闹声,声音，声响,杂音
vt.谣传,哄传,传说
vi.发出声音,大声议论

ex.en: Sightseers may be a little overwhelmed by the crowds and noise.
ex.cn: 拥挤的人群和喧闹的噪音可能会让游客有些茫然不知所措。

ex.en: Flying at 1,000 ft. he heard a peculiar noise from the rotors.
ex.cn: 在1,000英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。

ex.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
ex.cn: 伴随着隆隆的低沉噪声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

def:
adj.嘈杂的,喧闹的,充满噪音的,吵吵闹闹的
n.响声,嘈杂声

ex.en: Wind turbines are large and noisy and they disfigure the landscape.
ex.cn: 风力涡轮机个头大、噪音响，还会破坏周边风景。

ex.en: His daughter was very active and noisy in the mornings.
ex.cn: 他的女儿一到上午就很好动，吵吵闹闹的。

ex.en: A problem for manufacturers is that lighter cars tend to be noisy.
ex.cn: 制造商们遇到的一个问题是，重量较轻的汽车往往噪音大。

def:
pron.没有人，没有一人,没有一个,没有一部分，没有一点
adv.根本不,无法，绝不

ex.en: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
ex.cn: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

ex.en: She exhibited none of the narcissistic and nihilistic tendencies of her peers.
ex.cn: 她一点儿都没表现出同龄人那种自恋和虚无主义的性格倾向。

ex.en: None of these people will admit responsibility for their actions.
ex.cn: 这些人都不会愿意为自己的行为负责。

def:
n.面条,傻子， 笨蛋
vi.（乐师）弹拨乐器，（即兴）演奏,[口语]长时间地思考，反复酝酿

ex.en: They have two restaurants that purvey dumplings and chicken noodle soup.
ex.cn: 他们那里有两家供应饺子和鸡肉汤面的餐馆。

ex.en: Now, listen! Rice, noodle, porridge, water and tea.
ex.cn: 听着! 米饭 、 面条 、 粥 、 水和茶.

ex.en: Get some noodle for me when you go shopping.
ex.cn: 你上街买东西时替我买一些面条.

def: n.正午，中午,全盛期，顶点,〈古〉午夜,晌午

ex.en: There is a ceaseless struggle from noon to night.
ex.cn: 从中午到夜晚，争斗没有停歇。

ex.en: He expected the transfer to go through by today's noon deadline.
ex.cn: 他希望转账在今天中午的最后期限之前完成。

ex.en: Government workers were made to punch time clocks morning, noon and night.
ex.cn: 公务员早、中、晚都要打卡。

def: conj.也不,也不是,和 neither 或 not 连用,去甲

ex.en: The report concludes that I acted neither fraudulently nor improperly.
ex.cn: 报告最后认为我的行为既没有欺骗性也没有任何不妥。

ex.en: They can neither read nor write, nor can they comprehend such concepts.
ex.cn: 他们不会读，不会写，也理解不了这样的概念。

ex.en: That, if you'll pardon my saying so, is neither here nor there.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，那根本就不重要。

def:
adj.正常的,正规的，标准的,[数学]正交的,精神健全的
n.正常，常态,标准,[数学]法线

ex.en: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.
ex.cn: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。

ex.en: The device can discriminate between the cancerous and the normal cells.
ex.cn: 这台仪器可以辨别癌细胞和正常的细胞。

ex.en: This picture shows the view from a car using normal dipped lights.
ex.cn: 这幅图片显示的是从一辆使用正常近光灯的汽车上所看到的景色。

def:
n.北方,北部,（美国南北战争时与南方作战的）北部各州,北方发达国家（尤指欧洲和北美各国）
adj.北方的,北部的,朝北的,（风，光线）来自北方的
adv.在北方,自北地,向北方

ex.en: Two trains collided head-on in north-eastern Germany early this morning.
ex.cn: 今天早上德国东北部两列火车迎面相撞。

ex.en: The western-most part of north Wales is a stronghold of Welsh-speakers.
ex.cn: 北威尔士最西部是说威尔士语人的聚居区。

ex.en: Go north on I-15 to the exit just past Barstow.
ex.cn: 沿着15号州际公路一直向北，一过巴斯托就从出口驶出。

def:
n.东北，东北方向,东北部
adj.在东北的,东北部的,向东北的,（风、光线）来自东北方向的
adv.自东北地

ex.en: Snow in October is nothing strange in northeast China.
ex.cn: 10月下雪在东北不是什么希罕的事.

ex.en: I was born in the northeast.
ex.cn: 我出生于东北部.

ex.en: The wind blew northeast.
ex.cn: 风从东北方吹来.

def: adj.北方的，北部的,来自北方的,北风

ex.en: The film takes no position on the politics of Northern Ireland.
ex.cn: 这部电影未在北爱尔兰政治问题上选择站边。

ex.en: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula.
ex.cn: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

ex.en: These incidents suggest the peace in Northern Ireland is still brittle.
ex.cn: 这些事件表明北爱尔兰的和平仍然很脆弱。

def:
n.西北，西北方向,西北部
adj.在西北的,西北部的,向西北的,（风、光线）来自西北方的
adv.自西北地

ex.en: The address is 2025 M Street, Northwest, Washington, DC, 20036.
ex.cn: 地址为华盛顿特区，西北区，M大街2025号，邮政编码20036。

ex.en: Three people have been killed in a bomb explosion in northwest Spain.
ex.cn: 在西班牙西北部的炸弹爆炸事件中，已有3人死亡。

ex.en: Take the northwest road; it is the shortest way.
ex.cn: 走向西北的那条路, 那是最近的路.

def:
n.鼻子,嗅觉,芳香，香气,突出的部分
vt.嗅出，闻出,用鼻子触,用鼻子品评（酒）等,探出
vi.小心探索着前进,探问

ex.en: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
ex.cn: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

ex.en: He had had a fight with Smith and bloodied his nose.
ex.cn: 他和史密斯打了一架，把后者的鼻子打出了血。

ex.en: She wrinkled her nose, piqued by his total lack of enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 她皱皱鼻子，为他毫无热情而感到不快。

def: adv.不,[用以表示否定、否认、拒绝、禁止等]不是,几乎不,未必，没有[用于否定后面的词或短语]

ex.en: Success is not guaranteed. It is not handed to you. Success is earned.
ex.cn: 成功无法保证，并非唾手可得。成功必须靠自己去争取。

ex.en: Do not wait for good things to happen to you. You need to walk towards happiness.
ex.cn: 不要等待好事降临，你要向幸福进发。

ex.en: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
ex.cn: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

def:
n.笔记,便笺,音符,钞票
vt.注意,记录,对…加注释,指出

ex.en: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
ex.cn: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

ex.en: She scribbled a note to tell Mum she'dgone out.
ex.cn: 她匆匆写了个便条告诉妈妈她已外出。

ex.en: She had written him a note a couple of weeks earlier.
ex.cn: 她几周前给他写过一个便条。

def: n.笔记簿,笔记本电脑,手册,笔记本

ex.en: Tamsin materialized at her side, notebook at the ready.
ex.cn: 塔姆辛从她身旁冒了出来，且备好了笔记本。

ex.en: He took my name and address, scribbling it down in his notebook.
ex.cn: 他要了我的姓名和地址，匆匆写在他的笔记本上。

ex.en: Prue entered the passage in her notebook, then read it aloud again.
ex.cn: 普吕把那一段写在她的笔记本上，然后又大声念了一遍。

def:
pron.没有东西,没有事情,无关紧要的东西,毫无趣味的事
n.无关紧要的人[事],零,无
adv.毫不,决不

ex.en: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
ex.cn: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

ex.en: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
ex.cn: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

ex.en: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
ex.cn: 3亿美元远远不够。

def:
n.注意,布告,警告,预告
vt.& vi.注意
vt.通知,留心,关照,注意到
vi.引起注意

ex.en: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
ex.cn: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

ex.en: It's not a case of whether anyone would notice or not.
ex.cn: 这不是会不会有人注意到的问题。

ex.en: Interest is paid monthly. Three months' notice is required for withdrawals.
ex.cn: 利息按月支付。提款须提前3个月通知银行。

def: n.名词,名词性单词,名词词性

ex.en: The noun " mouse " is the singular form of " mice " .
ex.cn: 名词mouse是 mice 的单数形式.

ex.en: In " the black cat " the adjective " black " modifies the noun " cat " .
ex.cn: 在the black cat这一词组中,形容词 black 修饰名词cat.

ex.en: The word " person " is a countable noun.
ex.cn: person 这个词是个可数名词.

def: n.十一月,通讯中用以代替字母 n 的词

ex.en: Troops were sent to the islands to restore order last November.
ex.cn: 去年11月，军队被派往这些岛屿以恢复秩序。

ex.en: He was bailed to appear before local magistrates on 5 November.
ex.cn: 他获得保释，将于11月5日在地方法庭出庭受审。

ex.en: He only got a plurality on November 3rd, just 49 percent.
ex.cn: 他在11月3号的选举中仅获得了49%的相对多数票。

def:
adv.现在,其时,立刻,（改变话题或要对方做某事前，引起对方注意）喂
adj.现在的,当今的,现任的
n.现在,目前,目前
conj.由于,既然

ex.en: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
ex.cn: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

ex.en: A journalist all his life, he's now brought out a book.
ex.cn: 他当了一辈子新闻记者，如今已出了一本书。

ex.en: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
ex.cn: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

def:
adv.现在，当今
n.当今，现在

ex.en: You're miles better than most of the performers we see nowadays.
ex.cn: 你比当下我们见到的大多数表演者都强多了。

ex.en: People live longer nowadays, and they are better educated.
ex.cn: 当今，人们越来越长寿，受教育程度也提高了。

ex.en: The term "early retirement" is nearly always a euphemism for redundancy nowadays.
ex.cn: 现在“提前退休”几乎就是裁员的委婉说法。

def:
n.数字,数量,号码,编号
v.标号,总计,把…算作

ex.en: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
ex.cn: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

ex.en: There must be any number of people in my position.
ex.cn: 一定有很多人处在我这种境况。

ex.en: Accidents are still the number one cause of premature death for Americans.
ex.cn: 交通事故仍然是造成美国人过早死亡的头号因素。

def:
n.护士，看护,奶妈，保姆，阿妈，保育员,保护人，培养者，养成所，发祥地,[植]保护树，[虫]保护虫，保育虫，[动]世代交替的无性期的个体
vt.& vi.护理,照料,喂,吃奶
vt.培育,怀抱,搂抱,调治

ex.en: "Can you walk all right?" the nurse asked him.
ex.cn: “你走路有困难吗？”护士问他。

ex.en: We're going to go home and nurse our colds.
ex.cn: 我们打算回家调养感冒。

ex.en: She volunteered as a nurse in a soldiers' rest-home.
ex.cn: 她自告奋勇到士兵疗养院当护士。

def:
n.螺母，螺帽,坚果，坚果果仁,难对付的人,[乐]弓根
v.采坚果,拾坚果

ex.en: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.
ex.cn: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。

ex.en: Getting out there is in many ways the hardest nut to crack.
ex.cn: 从很多方面来说，出去交际是最难以做到的事了。

ex.en: There's some nut out there with a gun.
ex.cn: 外边有个拿着枪的疯子。

def:
vt.& vi.服从，听从
vt.遵守，遵循

ex.en: Clifford's only stipulation is that his clients obey his advice.
ex.cn: 克利福德唯一的要求就是客户必须听从他的建议。

ex.en: They obey the one unwritten rule that binds them all—no talking.
ex.cn: 他们都遵守着那条约束他们所有人的默认规则——要守口如瓶。

ex.en: He threatened to disinherit her if she refused to obey.
ex.cn: 他威胁说如果她拒绝服从就剥夺她的继承权。

def: n.物体,目标,宾语,客体，对象

ex.en: He thought of the baby almost as an inanimate object.
ex.cn: 他认为婴儿几乎就是毫无生命的物体。

ex.en: He made it his object in life to find the island.
ex.cn: 他把找到那座岛屿当成自己的人生目标。

ex.en: My object was to publish a scholarly work on Peter Mourne.
ex.cn: 我的目标是出版一本关于彼得·莫恩的学术著作。

def: vi.发生,出现,闪现

ex.en: If these drugs are stopped abruptly then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
ex.cn: 如果突然停服这些药，则可能出现一些戒断症状。

ex.en: Keep a pad handy to jot down queries as they occur.
ex.cn: 手边放一本便笺簿，以便有问题时随时记下。

ex.en: Nitrates are chemicals that occur naturally in water and the soil.
ex.cn: 硝酸盐是水和土壤中自然存在的化学物质。

def: n.洋,海洋,大海,（地球上划分出的）洋

ex.en: It became impractical to make a business trip by ocean liner.
ex.cn: 乘坐远洋班轮进行商务旅行变得不合时宜了。

ex.en: His abiding passion was ocean racing, at which he scored many successes.
ex.cn: 他一直酷爱海上赛艇，并多次在比赛中获胜。

ex.en: APEC seems be drowning in an ocean of jargon.
ex.cn: 亚太经合组织似乎为一大堆空洞的胡言乱语所淹没。

def: n.十月

ex.en: By October 1990, when arrested, he was hopelessly in debt.
ex.cn: 到1990年10月被捕时，他已经负债累累。

ex.en: The Association has put the event off until October.
ex.cn: 协会已把这次活动推迟至10月。

ex.en: The band have moved forward their Leeds date to October 27.
ex.cn: 乐队已把去利兹的日期提前至10月27号。

def:
prep.关于,属于…的,由…制成
aux.助动词  [非标准用语、方言] =have [主用于虚拟语气]

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: Generosity is its own form of power.
ex.cn: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

ex.en: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
ex.cn: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

def:
prep.从…落下,离开,从…去掉,下班
adv.离开,距，离,被取消,下班
adj.不新鲜的,不能接受,不礼貌
n.起跑
v.杀死

ex.en: I feel it's done me good to get it off my chest.
ex.cn: 我感觉吐吐苦水对我有好处。

ex.en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
ex.cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

ex.en: French soldiers squared off with a gunman at a road checkpoint.
ex.cn: 在一个公路检查站法国士兵摆开架势，准备迎战一名持枪者。

def:
vt.提供，给予,提出，提议,出价，开价,表示愿意
vi.提议,企图，想要,供奉
n.提议,出价，开价,试图,求婚

ex.en: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
ex.cn: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

ex.en: Leningrad was the third alien city to offer him a surrogate home.
ex.cn: 列宁格勒是他在异地安家的第三个外国城市。

ex.en: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer in its vitality and freshness.
ex.cn: 当代非洲电影在活力和新颖性上颇足称道。

def: n.办公室,办公楼,问询处,重要官职

ex.en: One of the office girls was down with the flu.
ex.cn: 一位女职员得了流感。

ex.en: His office was in keeping with his station and experience.
ex.cn: 他的办公室与其身份和阅历相称。

ex.en: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions.
ex.cn: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

def:
n.军官，警官,高级职员,公务员,船长
v.指挥,统率,管理,配置军官

ex.en: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
ex.cn: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

ex.en: Secret Service officer Robin Thompson spoke on behalf of his colleagues.
ex.cn: 特工处官员罗宾·汤普森代表他的同僚发表了讲话。

ex.en: The Night Duty Officer was ready to clock off.
ex.cn: 值夜班的警员准备打卡下班。

def:
n.行政官员,公务员,[体]裁判,高级职员
adj.官方的，法定的,公职的，公务的,官气十足,正式的

ex.en: You simply can't get a ticket through official channels.
ex.cn: 通过官方渠道是压根儿搞不到票的.

ex.en: The official number of people carrying the AIDS virus is low.
ex.cn: 艾滋病病毒携带者的官方数字并不高。

ex.en: There was never an official institution of censorship in Albania.
ex.cn: 在阿尔巴尼亚从未设立过官方审查制度。

def: adv.常常,经常,时常,再三

ex.en: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards.
ex.cn: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

ex.en: Students often travel hundreds of miles to get here.
ex.cn: 学生常常赶数百英里的路来到这里。

ex.en: If a baby is thirsty, it feeds more often.
ex.cn: 婴儿要是渴了，就会吃得更频繁。

def:
n.油,石油,油画,燃油
vt.给…加油
vi.化成油

ex.en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
ex.cn: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

ex.en: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly.
ex.cn: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

ex.en: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
ex.cn: 化石燃料（如煤和石油）属于有限资源。

def: abbr.ohne kosten (German=without cost) （德语）不计价,不受约束,ola kala (Greek=all is fine, all is good) （希腊语）都很好（古代希腊水手最早使用）,outer keel 外（平板）龙骨

ex.en: OK. Now, let's talk some business.
ex.cn: 好了，我们现在言归正传吧。

ex.en: His doctor wouldn't OK the trip.
ex.cn: 医生不会同意他去旅行。

ex.en: I shouted out "I'm OK"
ex.cn: 我大声喊道“我没事”。

def:
n.认可，同意
v.赞成或同意,批准
int.行，用以表达准许或同意之意
adj.可以，不错

ex.en: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
ex.cn: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

ex.en: "Are you okay?" I asked. She nodded and smiled.
ex.cn: “你没事吧?”我问她.她点点头,笑了.

ex.en: "Let me in, Di." — "Okay. Just a minute."
ex.cn: “让我进来，迪。”——“好的。稍等一下。”

def:
adj.老的,古老的,以前的,（用于指称被替代的东西）原来的
n.古时

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: As a group, today's old people are still relatively deprived.
ex.cn: 整体而言，当今的老年人依然相对贫困。

ex.en: Douglas was a 29-year-old journeyman fighter, erratic in his previous fights.
ex.cn: 道格拉斯29岁，是个技术不错的拳击手，在以前的比赛中发挥不太稳定。

def:
prep.（表示方向）向,（表示对象）对,（表示位置）在…上,（表示时间）在…之时
adv.（放，穿，连接）上,向前，（继续）下去
adj.活动着的情况，状态,使用着的,发生着的,计划中的

ex.en: Eventually, you'll learn to cry that on the inside.
ex.cn: 终有一天，你会学会让泪往心里流。

ex.en: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door.
ex.cn: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

ex.en: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
ex.cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

def:
adv.一次，一趟,一倍,曾经,一旦
conj.一旦…就…,一经
n.一次，一回

ex.en: It had once been the home of a wealthy nobleman.
ex.cn: 这里曾是一个有钱贵族的宅邸。

ex.en: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
ex.cn: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

ex.en: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
ex.cn: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

def:
num.（数字）一,一个,（基数）一，第一
n.一个人,一点钟,一体,独一
pron.一个人,任何人,本人，人家,东西
adj.某一个的,一体的,一方的

ex.en: I have $100m hidden away where no one will ever find it.
ex.cn: 我把1亿美元藏到了一个永远没人会找到的地方。

ex.en: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
ex.cn: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

ex.en: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
ex.cn: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

def: pron.自己，自身,亲自，自行,其,亲手

ex.en: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
ex.cn: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

ex.en: It is a very rewarding exercise to work this out oneself.
ex.cn: 独自解决这个问题是一次受益匪浅的锻炼。

ex.en: It is better to die oneself than to kill.
ex.cn: 宁可自亡，不可行凶。

def:
adj.唯一的,仅有的,最好的，最适当的
adv.只，仅仅,结果却，不料
conj.但是，可是,要不是

ex.en: His house was the only settled home I had as a child.
ex.cn: 他的房子是我儿时唯一固定的家。

ex.en: The arteries are diseased and a transplant is the only hope.
ex.cn: 动脉已经发生病变，移植是唯一的希望。

ex.en: The crowd in Robinson's Coffee-House was thinning, but only by degrees.
ex.cn: 鲁宾逊咖啡屋里的人正在变少，但也只是渐少而已。

def:
prep.到…之上,对…了解,[数]映射到…上
adj.映射的,自身的,映成的

ex.en: Drop the dough onto a baking sheet with a teaspoon.
ex.cn: 用茶匙把生面团舀到烤盘上。

ex.en: So, if we could just move onto something else?
ex.cn: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

ex.en: Lights clipped onto life jackets improve the chances of rescue.
ex.cn: 别在救生衣上的灯提高了获救可能性。

def:
adj.敞开的，开着的,公开的，公共的,坦率的,有议论余地的
vt.& vi.（打）开,开始,睁开,启动
n.户外，野外,空旷,公开
vi.使打开,展示，显现
vt.张开,开放,开张营业,为（建筑物）揭幕

ex.en: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention.
ex.cn: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

ex.en: Without warning, Bardo smacked his fist into his open hand.
ex.cn: 巴多没有任何预兆地一拳砸在自己摊开的手掌上.

ex.en: It's an open secret that the security service bugged telephones.
ex.cn: 安全部门窃听电话是人人皆知的秘密。

def: n.歌剧,歌剧艺术， 歌剧业,作品( opus的名词复数 ),砌

ex.en: The following year she joined the Royal Opera House.
ex.cn: 次年她加入了皇家歌剧院。

ex.en: Young conductors earn their spurs in a small orchestra or opera house.
ex.cn: 年轻的指挥家们在小乐队或小歌剧院里崭露头角。

ex.en: The opera lacks the polish of his later work.
ex.cn: 这部歌剧不及他晚期作品娴熟。

def:
vt.& vi.运转,操作,经营,管理
vi.开刀,（对…）动手术,动手术,（在某地）采取军事行动
vt.操作，控制，使运行

ex.en: Hotels operate a collection service for their guests from the airports.
ex.cn: 宾馆为客人提供机场接机服务。

ex.en: Trains will operate from Waterloo with a pick-up stop at Ashford.
ex.cn: 火车从滑铁卢站出发，途中会在阿什福德站停靠上人。

ex.en: They now own and operate a farm 50 miles south of Rochester.
ex.cn: 他们现在拥有并经营着一家位于罗切斯特以南50英里处的农场。

def: n.操作，经营,手术,[数]运算,作用

ex.en: The operation is carried out under a general anaesthetic.
ex.cn: 该手术是在全身麻醉情况下实施的。

ex.en: The formalization of co-operation between the republics would produce progress.
ex.cn: 正式确立合作关系将会促进共和国之间合作的顺利进展。

ex.en: He is recovering from an operation to reset his arm.
ex.cn: 他做了一个手臂复位手术，正在恢复。

def: n.意见，主张,评价,鉴定，判定

ex.en: And what of the effect on U.S domestic opinion?
ex.cn: 对美国国内的舆论有什么影响？

ex.en: He will have been heartened by the telephone opinion poll published yesterday.
ex.cn: 他会为昨天公布的电话民意调查结果感到鼓舞。

ex.en: The result reflects a modest rightward shift in opinion.
ex.cn: 结果显示舆论出现一定程度的右倾。

def: n.机会,适当的时机良机,有利的环境，条件

ex.en: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
ex.cn: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

ex.en: The opportunity had gone. His mind scrabbled for alternatives.
ex.cn: 机会已经失去。他苦苦思索别的方案。

ex.en: First-generation Americans view the United States as a land of golden opportunity.
ex.cn: 第一代美国人认为美国是一个充满了机遇的国度。

def:
adj.相对的,对面的,对立的,[数学]（顶、边等）对的
prep.（表示位置）在…的对面,[数学]（顶、边等）对的,与…在一排,（表示方式）与…联合主演
adv.在对面，对过
n.对立面，对立物，相反的人[事物]

ex.en: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
ex.cn: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

ex.en: A string of five rowing boats set out from the opposite bank.
ex.cn: 5只划艇排成一行从对岸出发了。

ex.en: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.
ex.cn: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。

def:
conj.或，或者,还是,不然，否则,左右
prep.<古、诗>在…之前，比…更早
n.[纹章]黑金色、黑色

ex.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
ex.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

ex.en: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
ex.cn: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

ex.en: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
ex.cn: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

def:
n.桔子，橙子,[植]桔树,橙色,桔色
adj.橙色的,橘色的,桔红色的

ex.en: Hybridising the two species will reduce the red to orange.
ex.cn: 将这两个物种杂交后颜色会由红色淡化成橙色。

ex.en: He moved around the country working in orange groves.
ex.cn: 他在乡村不断换工作，为不同的柑橘园干活。

ex.en: The illustration shows a cluster of five roses coloured apricot orange.
ex.cn: 插图上是一簇杏橙色的玫瑰，一共5朵。

def:
n.命令,秩序,规则，制度,次序
vt.命令,订购,整理
vi.下订单

ex.en: The waiter returned with their order and Graham signed the bill.
ex.cn: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

ex.en: Someone comes in every day to check all is in order.
ex.cn: 每天都有人来检查是否一切都井然有序。

ex.en: A point of order was raised in parliament by Mr Ben Morris.
ex.cn: 本·莫里斯先生在议会就程序问题提出质询。

def: adj.普通的,平常的,一般的,平庸的

ex.en: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune.
ex.cn: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

ex.en: Ordinary people are at the mercy of faceless bureaucrats.
ex.cn: 普通人的命运任凭那些平庸刻板的官僚们摆布。

ex.en: This Human Rights Act is enforceable in the ordinary courts.
ex.cn: 这项《人权法案》适用于普通法庭。

def:
adj.别的,其他的,（两个中的）另一个,其余的
pron.其他的,（指两个人或事物中的第二个）那个,（指一组中其余的人或事物）其余的,（指与说话人所在位置等相反的方向或地点）另一边
n.[the other]对立面；对立的事物

ex.en: You can chat to other people who are online.
ex.cn: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

ex.en: "All the best," called the other typists in chorus.
ex.cn: “祝万事如意，”其他打字员齐声喊道。

ex.en: Try to support each other when one of you is feeling down.
ex.cn: 当有人觉得情绪低落时，要努力相互打气。

def:
adv.否则,另外,别的方式
adj.别的，另外的,不同的
conj.否则，不然

ex.en: Was it just a temporary blip on an otherwise healthy growth curve?
ex.cn: 这是否是原本良好的增长曲线中暂时的偏离？

ex.en: Psychological twists perk up an otherwise predictable story line.
ex.cn: 心理转折使原本老套的故事情节变得生动有趣。

ex.en: Don't be mean with fabric, otherwise curtains will end up looking skimpy.
ex.cn: 别这么吝啬布料，不然做出来的窗帘会显得特寒酸。

def:
aux.应该（指道义上有责任）,应当（显示所采取行动正确或明智）,可能会,预料会做（某事）
vt.& vi.应该（指道义上有责任）,（表示愿望）应当（显示所采取行动正确或明智）,可能会,预料会做（某事）

ex.en: The money to build the power station ought to have been sufficient.
ex.cn: 建设电站的资金本该足够了。

ex.en: I think you ought to give football a rest for a time.
ex.cn: 我认为你应该暂时停止踢足球。

ex.en: You know, we really ought to get another car.
ex.cn: 要知道，我们真的应该换一辆车了。

def: pron.我们的，we的所有格形式,<口>我们家,敝

ex.en: For what do we live, but to make sport for our neighbours, and laugh at them in our turn?
ex.cn: 我们活着是为了什么？不就是给邻居当笑柄，再反过来笑他们。

ex.en: Drugs are a scourge that is devastating our society.
ex.cn: 毒品是破坏我们社会的一大祸害。

ex.en: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
ex.cn: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

def: pron.我们的

ex.en: The world of the gods is anthropomorphic, an imitative projection of ours.
ex.cn: 神界是拟人化的，是模仿我们人类世界的一个投影。

ex.en: Groups like ours are committed to eradicating homophobia, racism and sexism.
ex.cn: 一些像我们这样的团体致力于消除对同性恋的憎恶、种族歧视和性别歧视。

ex.en: I can't really tell the difference between their policies and ours.
ex.cn: 我真的看不出他们的政策和我们的有什么不同。

def: pron.“myself”的复数,我们自己,（把）我们自己

ex.en: We sat round the fire to keep ourselves warm.
ex.cn: 我们围坐在火边取暖。

ex.en: We splurged on Bohemian glass for gifts, and for ourselves.
ex.cn: 我们花了很多钱买波希米亚玻璃制品送人和自用。

ex.en: We're kidding ourselves, Bill. We're not winning, we're not even doing well.
ex.cn: 我们在自己骗自己，比尔。我们没有赢，我们甚至都没有发挥好。

def:
adv.出局,在外，在外部,完全，彻底,出版
prep.（表示来源）从,（从…里）出来,（表示不在原状态）脱离,离去
vt.使熄灭,揭露,驱逐
adj.外面的,出局的,下台的,外围的
n.不流行,出局

ex.en: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
ex.cn: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

ex.en: He did not like to be caught out on details.
ex.cn: 他不喜欢在细节上被人抓住把柄。

ex.en: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
ex.cn: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

def: adj.户外的，露天的,喜欢户外活动的,（医院等）院外的,室外

ex.en: There is an inviting restaurant with an outdoor terrace.
ex.cn: 有一家诱人的带露天阳台的饭馆。

ex.en: If you enjoy outdoor activities, this is the trip for you.
ex.cn: 如果你喜欢户外运动，这一旅行很适合你。

ex.en: Give your brows extra definition with Outdoor Girl'sEyebrow Pencil in Brown.
ex.cn: 用“户外女孩”品牌的棕色眉笔更加清晰地勾勒出眉形。

def:
adv.在外面,向外面,在户外,露天
