n.外面,（弯曲路面或轨道的）外道,（靠近路中央的）外侧,（建筑物等的）周围
adj.外部的,集团外的,（选择余地、可能性等）非常小,可能性最大的
prep.（表示位置）在[向]…的外面,（表示范围）超出…的范围,（表示排斥）除了（某人）

ex.en: The President's unescorted vehicle was ambushed just outside the capital.
ex.cn: 刚出首都，总统无人护卫的汽车就遭到了伏击。

ex.en: There was a scream of brakes from the carriageway outside.
ex.cn: 外面车行道上传来刺耳的刹车声。

ex.en: The outside air was heavy and moist and sultry.
ex.cn: 外面的空气沉滞、潮湿而闷热。

def: adj.杰出的,显著的,凸出的,未完成的

ex.en: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
ex.cn: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

ex.en: His citation says he showed outstanding and exemplary courage.
ex.cn: 颁给他的嘉奖令称他表现出非凡的勇气，堪为表率。

ex.en: Patrick Devlin was an outstanding judge and brilliant jurist.
ex.cn: 帕特里克·德夫林是一位杰出的法官和出色的法律专家。

def: n.烤箱，烤炉，灶

ex.en: You'll be amazed at the culinary creations possible in a Dutch oven.
ex.cn: 荷兰烤箱能够做的食物之多会让你感到惊奇。

ex.en: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
ex.cn: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

ex.en: Grease two sturdy baking sheets and heat the oven to 400 degrees.
ex.cn: 在两块结实的烤板上抹些油，把烤炉加热到400度。

pos: prep adv adj n int vt
def:
prep.（表示方向）越过,（部份或全部覆盖）在…上面,由于,（表示论及）关于
adv.结束,再,（倒）下,从一边至另一边
adj.过去的,外面的,在上的,上级的
n.额外,剩余,剩余（或多余）的量,剩余物
int.[电信学]报文完，请回复！
vt.走过，跳过,[美国方言]从…恢复过来

ex.en: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
ex.cn: 当有合适的女人出现时，这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

ex.en: Over a given period, the value of shares will rise and fall.
ex.cn: 股票的价值在某一特定的时期内会有涨跌。

ex.en: Dave, the pianist, played it over a couple of times.
ex.cn: 演奏钢琴的戴夫将这支曲子反复弹了两三遍。

def: n.大衣,外套,保护层，护膜

ex.en: It was freezing out there even in his buttoned-up overcoat.
ex.cn: 外面非常冷，即使穿上大衣扣上扣子也不顶事。

ex.en: She very nearly tore my overcoat.
ex.cn: 她差点把我的大衣扯破了。

ex.en: He picked off the burs that had stuck to his overcoat.
ex.cn: 他摘下粘在外衣上的刺果.

def: vt.欠…债,感激,应归功于,怀有情感

ex.en: I'm broke, Livy, and I owe a couple of million dollars.
ex.cn: 我破产了，莉薇，而且我欠了几百万美元的债。

ex.en: I owe a big debt of gratitude to her.
ex.cn: 我对她万分感激。

ex.en: You owe a certain person a sum of money.
ex.cn: 你欠某人一笔钱。

def:
n.自己的事物,自己人
vt.拥有,承认
vi.承认
adj.自己的,特有的

ex.en: Generosity is its own form of power.
ex.cn: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

ex.en: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
ex.cn: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

ex.en: Amy's own Republican sympathies strengthened as the days passed.
ex.cn: 埃米个人对共和党的支持与日俱增。

def: n.物主，所有人

ex.en: The former owner had not left any forwarding address.
ex.cn: 以前的房主没有留下任何转递地址。

ex.en: It is expected that the new owner will change the yacht's name.
ex.cn: 估计新主人会给游艇改名。

ex.en: The owner insisted on Cool Ground running in the Gold Cup.
ex.cn: 主人坚持要让“酷地”参加金杯赛马会。

def: n.牛，公牛,牛属动物

ex.en: Seize a horse by the mane, and lead an ox by the nose.
ex.cn: 马儿抓鬃牛牵鼻.

ex.en: The ox is never woe , till he to the harrow go.
ex.cn: 牛不耙地不知苦.

ex.en: I'm willing to be an ox serving the country all my life.
ex.cn: 我甘当孺子牛,终生为国家服务.

def:
n.一群,包裹,（纸牌的）一副,一组
vt.& vi.（把…）打包,塞进,拥进,（使）聚集成团
vt.挑选,压紧,携带,拧紧
vi.包装,紧挤在一起,便于折叠收藏的,匆忙离去（有时与 off 连用）

ex.en: I have tried to pack a good deal into a few words.
ex.cn: 我尽量言简意赅。

ex.en: It shows a fox being disembowelled by a pack of hounds.
ex.cn: 画面中一只狐狸正被一群猎狗撕咬得肠子外流。

ex.en: Pack the fruits and nuts into the jars and cover with brandy.
ex.cn: 把水果和坚果放进罐子里，用白兰地酒浸泡。

def:
n.小包,信息包,邮船,大笔款项
vt.包装，打包,用邮船运送

ex.en: You could save yourself a packet.
ex.cn: 你能为自己省一大笔钱。

ex.en: Someone's making a packet out of it.
ex.cn: 有人从中狠赚了一笔。

ex.en: He had smoked half a packet of cigarettes.
ex.cn: 他已经吸了半包香烟。

def:
n.页,（计算机的）页面,年史,<文>重要事件
vt.标记…的页数,翻页,喊出名字以寻找,（在公共传呼系统上）呼叫
vi.翻书页,浏览

ex.en: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8.
ex.cn: 正确答案在第8页末尾。

ex.en: Page is well versed in many styles of jazz.
ex.cn: 佩奇精通多种风格的爵士乐。

ex.en: Be sure to read about how mozzarella is made, on page 65.
ex.cn: 务必看看莫泽雷勒干酪是怎么制成的，在第65页。

def:
n.痛苦,刻苦,令人厌烦的人[事物],身体某部分的疼痛[不适]
vt.& vi.（使）疼痛，（使）痛苦，伤害
vt.使…痛苦,使…烦恼
vi.感到疼痛,引起疼痛

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
ex.cn: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

ex.en: After the pain of defeat passes, England have some thinking to do.
ex.cn: 失败的痛苦过去以后，英国人应该认真反思一下。

ex.en: We were forbidden, under pain of imprisonment, to use our native language.
ex.cn: 我们被禁止使用母语，违者将被关进监狱。

def: adj.痛苦的,（肉体）疼的,费力的，（工作）困难的,讨厌的，使人厌烦的

ex.en: Economic reform will continue to be painful and ineffective.
ex.cn: 经济改革仍将举步维艰，毫无成效。

ex.en: It is a painful experience having the boil lanced.
ex.cn: 把疖子切开是很痛的。

ex.en: He found the transition to boarding school excruciatingly painful.
ex.cn: 他发现转到寄宿学校极其痛苦。

def:
n.颜料，涂料,绘画作品,胭脂等化妆品,色彩，装饰
vt.涂色于,绘画,（用语言，文字等）描写,擦脂粉等
vi.描绘,绘画,化妆

ex.en: The walls have been horribly vandalized with spray paint.
ex.cn: 墙上被人用喷漆涂得乱七八糟。

ex.en: They pried open a sticky can of blue paint.
ex.cn: 他们撬开了一个黏糊糊的蓝色油漆桶。

ex.en: Rust and flaking paint mean the metalwork is in poor condition.
ex.cn: 生锈和掉漆说明金属配件损毁严重。

def: n.画家，着色者,油漆匠,（系船的）缆绳,破诡计

ex.en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
ex.cn: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

ex.en: Much of the film shows the painter simply going about his task.
ex.cn: 这部电影大部分都在描述那位画家如何完全沉溺于自己的工作。

ex.en: No one could imagine a great woman painter. None had existed yet.
ex.cn: 没有谁能想象出一位伟大的女画家是什么样子。这样的画家还没有出现过。

def:
n.绘画,油画,上色，着色,颜料，油漆
v.绘画（ paint的现在分词）,涂色于

ex.en: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window.
ex.cn: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。

ex.en: The painting had been executed with meticulous attention to detail.
ex.cn: 画这幅画的时候，画家非常注意细节。

ex.en: I lay the painting flat to stop the wet paint running.
ex.cn: 我把油画平放以防止未干的颜料流动。

def:
n.一副,一对男女,套在一起的两匹马,雌雄成对的动物
vt.& vi.（使…）成对，（使…）成双
vi.交配，交尾

ex.en: On the mantelpiece are a pair of bronze Ming vases.
ex.cn: 壁炉台上是一对明代的青铜花瓶。

ex.en: Eventually they reached a pair of ornately carved doors.
ex.cn: 他们最终来到一扇雕刻精美的对开门前。

ex.en: His surgical instruments were a knife and a pair of pincers.
ex.cn: 他的外科手术器械是一把刀和一把钳子。

def: n.宫，宫殿,（主教）邸宅，宏伟大厦,华丽的娱乐场所

ex.en: He recounted how heavily armed soldiers forced him from the presidential palace.
ex.cn: 他讲述了自己是怎样被全副武装的士兵从总统官邸里赶出来的。

ex.en: Everyone must be familiar with the old favourite among roses, Crystal Palace.
ex.cn: 大家一定都很熟悉玫瑰中的老牌名品“水晶宫殿”。

ex.en: He was transferred from Crystal Palace to Arsenal for £2.5 million.
ex.cn: 他以250万英镑的身价从水晶宫队转入阿森纳队。

def:
adj.苍白的,无力的,暗淡的,浅色的
vi.变得苍白,失色,变得暗淡
vt.用栅栏围,使失色,使变苍白
n.栅栏，围篱,桩,境界，范围

ex.en: In the background, dressed in pale green, stood Eunice.
ex.cn: 尤妮斯穿着浅绿色的衣服站在后面不起眼的地方。

ex.en: At the horizon the land mass becomes a continuous pale neutral grey.
ex.cn: 陆地在地平线处变成了一片浅灰。

ex.en: Pale colours are much more in vogue than autumnal bronzes and coppers.
ex.cn: 浅色比黄褐色和红棕色这些秋季色彩更流行。

def:
n.平底锅,盘状的器皿,淘盘子，金盘，秤盘
vt.淘金,在浅锅中烹调（食物）,[非正式用语]严厉的批评
vi.淘金,在淘洗中收获金子

ex.en: Put a pan of salted water on to boil.
ex.cn: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

ex.en: Grate a tablespoonful of fresh ginger into a pan.
ex.cn: 磨碎一汤匙鲜姜，放入平底锅。

ex.en: Empty the contents of the pan into the sieve.
ex.cn: 将锅里的东西倒到筛子上。

def: n.熊猫,猫熊

ex.en: It is well known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
ex.cn: 竹笋是熊猫的主要食物，这是人所共知的。

ex.en: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
ex.cn: 大熊猫的天然栖息地是竹林。

ex.en: Many goods in China have the trademarks of a panda.
ex.cn: 中国的许多商品都带有熊猫的商标.

def:
n.<英>（紧身的）短裤,<美> 裤子,喘气( pant的名词复数 )
v.喘气，喘息( pant的第三人称单数 ),喘着气说

ex.en: He put on a pair of short pants and an undershirt.
ex.cn: 他穿上了一条短裤和一件汗衫。

ex.en: They knock around on weekends in grubby sweaters and pants.
ex.cn: 他们周末穿着邋遢的毛衫和裤子到处闲逛。

ex.en: He was wearing cotton pants and an open-necked shirt.
ex.cn: 他穿着纯棉裤子和开领衬衫。

def:
n.纸,文件,论文,文章
vt.& vi.贴纸
vt.包装，用纸覆盖,贴壁纸,提供纸张,[俚语] 提供免费入场券
vi.贴糊墙纸,发交通违章传票
adj.纸制的,似纸的,有名无实的

ex.en: He wiped away the blood with a paper napkin.
ex.cn: 他用纸巾将血迹擦去。

ex.en: Under the newspaper, atop a sheet of paper, lay an envelope.
ex.cn: 在报纸下面的一张纸上放着一个信封。

ex.en: Stein rolled up the paper bag with the money inside.
ex.cn: 斯坦把装了钱的纸袋卷了起来。

def:
vt.宽恕,原谅,赦免,劳驾
n.饶恕，原谅,赦免,[宗]免罪符
int.（用于请求别人重复某事）什么，请再说一遍

ex.en: It's enough to make you wet yourself, if you'll pardon the expression.
ex.cn: 这足以吓得你尿裤子了，请原谅我这么说。

ex.en: That, if you'll pardon my saying so, is neither here nor there.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，那根本就不重要。

ex.en: I was impolite and I do beg your pardon.
ex.cn: 我失礼了，真对不起。

def: n.父亲（或母亲）,先辈,根源，起源,保护者

ex.en: Many children are now born into or raised in one-parent families.
ex.cn: 现在很多孩子在单亲家庭中出生或成长。

ex.en: Parent birds began to hunt for food for their young.
ex.cn: 亲鸟开始为幼鸟寻找食物。

ex.en: Ninety per cent of lone parent families are headed by mothers.
ex.cn: 90%的单亲家庭由母亲持家。

def:
n.公园,停车场
vi.泊车，停车
vt.将…放置在某处,停车

ex.en: The car park was absolutely packed solid with people.
ex.cn: 停车场被人挤得水泄不通。

ex.en: He staggered on the uneven surface of the car park.
ex.cn: 他摇摇晃晃地行走在停车场凹凸不平的地面上。

ex.en: I found a place to park beside a station wagon.
ex.cn: 我在一辆旅行车旁边找到了一个车位。

def:
n.部分,零件,参加,地区
vt.使分裂,拆移,使分开
vi.分开,分离,分岔
adv.不完全地，部分地
adj.不完全的，部分的

ex.en: These days work plays an important part in a single woman's life.
ex.cn: 现在，工作在单身女性的生活中起着重要作用。

ex.en: He was in large part a journalist and propagandist.
ex.cn: 他很大程度上是个新闻记者和宣传者。

ex.en: 673 private golf clubs took part in a recent study.
ex.cn: 673家私人高尔夫俱乐部参与了最近的研究。

def:
adj.特别的,详细的,独有的,挑剔的
n.特色，特点,（可分类，列举的）项目,详细情节，细情，细目,某一事项

ex.en: We are taught to construe these terms in a particular way.
ex.cn: 我们被教导要以特定的方式理解这些词语。

ex.en: Republican strategists are taking particular aim at Democratic senators.
ex.cn: 共和党的战略家正尖锐地攻击民主党的参议员。

ex.en: A particular source of contention is plans to privatise state-run companies.
ex.cn: 发生争执的一个根源就是国营公司的私有化方案。

def: adv.在一定程度上,部分地,不完全地,半

ex.en: I feel partly responsible for the problems we're in.
ex.cn: 我觉得应为我们遭遇的问题负部分责任。

ex.en: The drop was caused partly by the pound's strength against the dollar.
ex.cn: 下降的部分原因在于英镑对美元的升值。

ex.en: Mr Dunn's pleas of poverty are only partly justified.
ex.cn: 邓恩先生贫穷的托词只是部分成立。

def:
n.伙伴,同伙,同伴,配偶
vt.使合作,与…合伙
vi.合伙,合股,成为搭档

ex.en: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you.
ex.cn: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

ex.en: Hampton had been given the bills for safekeeping by a business partner.
ex.cn: 一个生意伙伴曾将账单交给汉普顿代为保管。

ex.en: He had all the qualities I was looking for in a partner.
ex.cn: 他具有我要找的伴侣应该具备的所有品质。

def:
n.社交聚会,党，党派,当事人,同类，伙伴
v.为…举行社交聚会,为…请客,参加社交聚会
adj.政党的，党派的,社交的，聚会的,共有的，共同的

ex.en: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
ex.cn: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

ex.en: He's been a keen supporter of the Labour Party all his life.
ex.cn: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。

ex.en: The party has been taking on staff, including temporary organisers.
ex.cn: 这个政党一直在招募工作人员，包括临时的组织人员。

def:
vt.& vi.走过,通过,批准,度过
vt.传球,及格,发生,不要
n.通道,通行证,关口,越过

ex.en: They will not allow your more way-out ideas to pass unchallenged.
ex.cn: 他们不会放过你这些古怪的念头的。

ex.en: He stood emotionless as he heard the judge pass sentence.
ex.cn: 他面无表情地站在那里，听法官宣布判决。

ex.en: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you.
ex.cn: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

def: n.（文章的）一段,经过,通路，通道,旅程，行程

ex.en: It's been 200 years since the passage of the Bill of Rights.
ex.cn: 《人权法案》通过已经200年了。

ex.en: The gaslights in the passage would be on, turned low.
ex.cn: 走廊里的煤气灯应该是开着的，调得比较暗。

ex.en: Two men suddenly elbowed a passage through the shoppers.
ex.cn: 两名男子突然用肘在购物者中挤出一条路。

def: n.乘客，旅客,行人，过路人,碍手碍脚的人

ex.en: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
ex.cn: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

ex.en: Mr Fullemann was a passenger in the car when it crashed.
ex.cn: 出车祸时，福勒曼先生正在那辆车上。

ex.en: They wrenched open the passenger doors and jumped into her car.
ex.cn: 他们使劲拽开后座车门，跳进了她的车子。

def:
adj.过去的，以前的,结束的,前任的
n.过去，过往,往事,[语]过去时
prep.超过，超出,远于,越过
adv.经过，超过

ex.en: I must have driven past that place thousands of times.
ex.cn: 我得有上千次开车经过那里。

ex.en: When Myra told Karp she'd expose his past, he blew up.
ex.cn: 当迈拉告诉卡普她会把他的过去全抖搂出去时，卡普大为光火。

ex.en: They had almost reached the boat when a figure shot past them.
ex.cn: 他们差不多快到船边时，一个人影从他们旁边飞奔而过。

def: n.小路，路,路线，路程,〈比喻〉（人生的）道路,（思想，行为，生活的）途径

ex.en: Stewart was trying to clear a path for the stretcher.
ex.cn: 斯图尔特在努力给担架开路。

ex.en: The path serves as an approach to the boat house.
ex.cn: 这条小路通往船屋。

ex.en: I narrowly missed a cyclist who wobbled into my path.
ex.cn: 我险些被一个摇摇晃晃迎面而来的骑车人撞倒。

def:
adj.有耐性的,能容忍的
n.患者,病人,病号

ex.en: A patient will usually listen to the doctor'sadvice and act on it.
ex.cn: 患者通常都会遵照医嘱行事。

ex.en: Occasionally a patient is so debilitated that he must be fed intravenously.
ex.cn: 偶尔会有病人过于虚弱，必须通过静脉注射进食。

ex.en: The patient is sedated with intravenous use of sedative drugs.
ex.cn: 静脉注射了镇静剂后病人安然入睡。

def:
n.暂时的停顿,犹豫,（诗中）节奏的停顿,[乐]延长号
vi.暂停，中止,逗留，停滞,（按暂停键）暂停放音,犹豫

ex.en: After a pause he asked, "You got any identification?"
ex.cn: 稍稍停顿了一下，他问道，“你有任何身份证明吗？”

ex.en: "We need proof, sir." Another pause. Then, "Very well."
ex.cn: “我们需要证据，先生。”又是一个短暂停顿。然后，“那好吧。”

ex.en: After a pause Alex said sharply: "I'm sorry if I've upset you"
ex.cn: 歇了一会儿后，亚历克斯毫不客气地说：“要是让你心烦了，那我很抱歉。”

def:
vt.& vi.付款,偿还,补偿,（对…）有利
vt.给予,支付
n.工资,薪水,报答
adj.收费的,需付费的

ex.en: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
ex.cn: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

ex.en: If they value these data, let them pay for them.
ex.cn: 他们要是看重这些数据，就让他们出钱买。

ex.en: You can pay to be upgraded to a business class seat.
ex.cn: 你可以付费升级到商务舱。

def: n.和平,和睦,治安,安心

ex.en: The road to peace will be long and drawn-out.
ex.cn: 通往和平的道路将很漫长。

ex.en: He argues strongly for retention of NATO as a guarantee of peace.
ex.cn: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

ex.en: One more question and I'll leave you in peace.
ex.cn: 再问一个问题，我就不打扰你了。

def: adj.和平的,爱好和平的,安静的,平静的

ex.en: Altogether, it was a delightful town garden, peaceful and secluded.
ex.cn: 总体上说，这是个令人愉快的城市花园，宁静而偏僻。

ex.en: A peaceful demonstration had been hijacked by anarchists intent on causing trouble.
ex.cn: 和平示威已遭到蓄意制造事端的无政府主义者的操控。

ex.en: He has attempted to find a peaceful solution to the Ossetian conflict.
ex.cn: 他试图寻求和平解决奥赛梯冲突的方案。

def: n.梨（树）,梨树

ex.en: In gardens, cankers are most prominent on apples and pear trees.
ex.cn: 花园里，苹果树和梨树患枯枝病最明显。

ex.en: Sweeten dishes sparingly with honey, or con-centrated apple or pear juice.
ex.cn: 加一点蜂蜜或浓缩苹果汁或梨汁，让菜带点甜味。

ex.en: He feared his career had gone a bit pear-shaped.
ex.cn: 他害怕自己的事业已经出了点儿问题。

def: n.农民,农夫,佃农,粗俗的人

ex.en: Economic reform has brought relative wealth to peasant farmers.
ex.cn: 经济改革给农民带来了相对的财富。

ex.en: He loved Gerard's peasant earthiness.
ex.cn: 他喜欢杰勒德身上那种农民的朴实。

ex.en: The old peasant is twisting pieces of straw into a rope.
ex.cn: 这位老农民正把稻草搓成绳子.

def:
n.笔，笔尖,笔法，文笔,作家,围栏
vt.写,把…关入栏中,关押，囚禁

ex.en: He won a head-to-head battle with NF leader Jean-Marie Le Pen.
ex.cn: 他在和国民阵线领袖让-马里·勒庞的正面交锋中获得了胜利。

ex.en: This cuttlefish has a horny internal shell like a pen.
ex.cn: 这只乌贼有一个笔状的角质内壳。

ex.en: Use different colours of felt pen on your sketch to avoid confusion.
ex.cn: 用不同颜色的毡头笔画草图，以免搞混。

def:
n.铅笔，彩色铅笔,笔状物,画风，画法,[物]光线锥
vt.用铅笔写,用画笔画

ex.en: He picked up a pencil and toyed with it idly.
ex.cn: 他捡起一支铅笔，无所事事地摆弄着。

ex.en: With a lip pencil, outline lips and fill them in.
ex.cn: 用唇线笔勾出双唇的轮廓，然后涂上唇膏。

ex.en: Give your brows extra definition with Outdoor Girl'sEyebrow Pencil in Brown.
ex.cn: 用“户外女孩”品牌的棕色眉笔更加清晰地勾勒出眉形。

def: n.便士,（美国、加拿大的）一分钱,少量的钱

ex.en: The directors of this company feel he's worth every penny.
ex.cn: 这家公司的主管们觉得他值得栽培。

ex.en: Unleaded gasoline rose more than a penny a gallon.
ex.cn: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了1分多。

ex.en: Government penny-pinching is blamed for the decline in food standards.
ex.cn: 政府吝啬被指责是食品标准下降的原因。

def:
n.人，人类,居民,人民,种族
vt.居住于，布满,使住满人，在…殖民,把动物放养在

ex.en: You can chat to other people who are online.
ex.cn: 你可以和其他在线的人聊天。

ex.en: As a group, today's old people are still relatively deprived.
ex.cn: 整体而言，当今的老年人依然相对贫困。

ex.en: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
ex.cn: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

def:
prep.由,（表示根据）依照,（表示比率）（尤指数量，价格，时间）每
adv.每次,每个,照常,按惯例
adj.高的，过的，全的

ex.en: He pronounced it Per-sha, the way the English do.
ex.cn: 他像英格兰人那样将它读成Per-sha。

ex.en: By 1973 the government deficit equalled thirty per cent of GNP.
ex.cn: 到1973年，政府财政赤字相当于国民生产总值的30%。

ex.en: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
ex.cn: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

def:
n.百分比，百分数,百分之一
adj.百分之…的，每一百中有…的,百分之…支付利息的
adv.以百分之…地，每一百中有…地

ex.en: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
ex.cn: 目前，30%的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

ex.en: The rate of inflation is running at about 2.7 percent.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀率大约为2.7%。

ex.en: Last year, economic growth tailed off to below four percent.
ex.cn: 去年，经济增长率下降到4%以下。

def:
adj.完美的,正确的,优秀的,极好的
n.[语]完成时

ex.en: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
ex.cn: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

ex.en: They call rowing the perfect sport. It exercises every major muscle group.
ex.cn: 他们称划船是最佳运动，它可以锻炼每一处主要肌肉群。

ex.en: He was not a paragon. He would never be perfect.
ex.cn: 他不是完人，永远不可能十全十美。

def:
adv.或许,（表示不确定）也许,（用于粗略的估计）或许,（表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许
n.假定,猜想,未定之事

ex.en: The horrors he experienced are imprinted, perhaps indelibly, in his brain.
ex.cn: 他经历的恐怖事件在他脑海中刻下了深深的，或许是难以磨灭的印记。

ex.en: He was not perhaps physically the strongest in the class.
ex.cn: 他可能不是全班身体最壮的。

ex.en: Perhaps he'd followed her suggestion of a stroll to the river.
ex.cn: 也许他已经听从了她的建议去河边散步了。

def:
n.时期,（一段）时间,学时,句号
adj.具有某个时代特征的,（关于）过去某一特定历史时期的,（家具、服饰、建筑等）某一时代的

ex.en: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer.
ex.cn: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

ex.en: Over a given period, the value of shares will rise and fall.
ex.cn: 股票的价值在某一特定的时期内会有涨跌。

ex.en: China enters a new five-year plan period next year.
ex.cn: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。

def: n.人,（语法）人称,身体,容貌

ex.en: She is a long way from being the richest person in Britain.
ex.cn: 比起英国首富，她还差得远呢。

ex.en: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views.
ex.cn: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

ex.en: He would be the last person who would do such a thing.
ex.cn: 他最不可能干这种事情。

def:
adj.个人的，私人的,身体的,亲自的,人身攻击的
n.（报刊上的）人事栏，分类人事广告版,人称代名词,关于个人的简讯

ex.en: My personal life has had to take second place to my career.
ex.cn: 我的私人生活不得不让位于事业。

ex.en: They siphon foreign aid money into their personal bank accounts.
ex.cn: 他们把国外救济金非法转入了个人银行账户。

ex.en: Every line etched on her face told a story of personal anguish.
ex.cn: 她脸上的每条皱纹都讲述了一次痛苦的经历。

def: vt.& vi.说服,劝说,使相信,使信服

ex.en: Somehow, he'd managed to persuade Kay to buy one for him.
ex.cn: 不知用了什么方法，他成功说服凯给他买了一个。

ex.en: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law.
ex.cn: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

ex.en: Ford never desisted from trying to persuade him to return to America.
ex.cn: 福特从未停止过劝说他返回美国。

def:
n.宠物,宠儿,受宠的人,生气
adj.宠爱的，溺爱的,表示亲昵的
vt.宠爱,爱抚，亲抚
vi.<非正>亲吻,爱抚

ex.en: They would sell the meat off as pet food.
ex.cn: 他们将把肉当作宠物食品卖掉。

ex.en: Make sure your pet won't pine while you're away.
ex.cn: 要确保不在家时宠物不会想你。

ex.en: For a child the death of a pet can be traumatic.
ex.cn: 对孩子来说，一只宠物的死亡可能会造成心理创伤。

def:
n.电话,听筒,（发声或使用声音的）工具,说某种语言的
vt.& vi.打电话（给某人）

ex.en: I took the phone, and she went discreetly into the living room.
ex.cn: 我拿起了电话，她知趣地进了客厅。

ex.en: Rather taken aback by such forwardness, I slammed down the phone.
ex.cn: 如此无礼的言语让我火冒三丈，我砰的一下把电话挂了。

ex.en: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
ex.cn: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

def:
n.照片，相片
vt.& vi.（给…）拍照

ex.en: The popular papers all have photo features on their inside pages.
ex.cn: 通俗报纸的内页都有照片专栏.

ex.en: They said, after digging around, the photo was a fake.
ex.cn: 在搜集了有关情况后，他们说照片是伪造的。

ex.en: I've got a photo of him on the wall.
ex.cn: 我在墙上挂了一张他的照片。

def:
n.照片，相片
vt.& vi.为…拍照,拍照，摄影,成为拍照对象，在照片上显得

ex.en: He tore down the girl's photograph, and crumpled it into a ball.
ex.cn: 他一把扯下那女孩的照片，将它揉成一团。

ex.en: He'd like to go on safari to photograph snakes and tigers.
ex.cn: 他想进行一次观兽旅行，拍摄一些蛇类和老虎的照片。

ex.en: Our photograph shows how the plants will turn out.
ex.cn: 我们的照片展示了植物的生长状况。

def:
n.<语>短语,成语,说法,乐句
vt.叙述，措词
vt.& vi.划分乐句，分乐节（尤指为奏乐或歌唱）

ex.en: A phrase from the conference floor set my mind wandering.
ex.cn: 会上发言者的一句话让我思绪飘远。

ex.en: The phrase was not meant to be taken seriously.
ex.cn: 此话不必当真。

ex.en: Rose's stories weren't bad; she had a nice turn of phrase.
ex.cn: 罗斯的故事写得不错，她的语言表达形象生动。

def: n.物理学,物理现象,物理成分

ex.en: Physics isn't just about pure science with no immediate applications.
ex.cn: 物理学并非只是一门不能直接运用的纯科学。

ex.en: On balance, the book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
ex.cn: 总而言之，这是一本通俗而务实的物理入门书。

ex.en: He was awarded the Nobel Prize for Physics in 1985.
ex.cn: 他于1985年被授予诺贝尔物理学奖。

def: n.钢琴,<美俚>囚犯工作席,轻奏乐段

ex.en: He started piano lessons at the age of 7.
ex.cn: 他7岁开始上钢琴课。

ex.en: The piano music mixes with the murmur of conversation.
ex.cn: 钢琴的弹奏声混杂着低低的交谈声。

ex.en: He won first prize at the Leeds Piano Competition.
ex.cn: 他在利兹国际钢琴比赛中荣获一等奖。

def:
vt.& vi.挑选，挑拣,挖，采，摘，剔，扒,挑剔
n.选择,收获,精华

ex.en: The economy remains deep in recession with few signs of a pick-up.
ex.cn: 经济仍深陷衰退之中，几乎没有好转的迹象。

ex.en: See our selection of autumn favourites and take your pick.
ex.cn: 看看我们的秋季精选，然后挑出你想要的。

ex.en: She would cleverly pick up on what I said.
ex.cn: 她会非常聪慧地领悟我所说的话。

def:
n.收集,<口>搭车（者）,唱机唱头,小卡车
adj.临时凑成的，偶然认识的

ex.en: He pulled to a stop behind a pickup truck.
ex.cn: 他在一辆皮卡货车后面停了下来。

ex.en: Frank Mariano negotiates the desert terrain in his battered pickup.
ex.cn: 弗兰克·马里亚诺驾驶他那辆破烂不堪的皮卡车成功穿越了沙漠地带。

ex.en: a pickup in the housing market
ex.cn: 房市景气的好转

def:
n.野餐郊游,供野餐吃的食品,猪的肩肉,轻松的工作
vi.去野餐，参加野餐,野餐式地用餐,在户外用餐
vt.用野餐招待

ex.en: I took the kids for a picnic in the park after school.
ex.cn: 放学后我带孩子们去公园野餐。

ex.en: They were tidying up the remains of their picnic.
ex.cn: 他们正在收拾野餐后剩下的东西。

ex.en: We punted up towards Grantchester and had a picnic in a meadow.
ex.cn: 我们乘坐平底长船溯河而上到格兰切斯特，在草地上举行野餐。

def:
n.照片，画像,图画，图片,影片,情景
vt.构想，想象,描绘，画,描述

ex.en: Police have released an E-fit picture of the suspected gunman.
ex.cn: 警方已公布持枪嫌犯的电子画像。

ex.en: The Sun had captioned a picture of Princess Diana "Princess of Veils"
ex.cn: 《太阳报》在黛安娜王妃的一张照片下写了一段说明文字——“披着面纱的王妃”。

ex.en: But as with other charitable bodies, these figures mask the true picture.
ex.cn: 但和其他慈善机构一样，这些数字掩盖了实情。

def:
n.馅饼，派,爱说话的人,[动]喜鹊,<美俚>容易得到的称心东西，容易的工作
vt.使杂乱,弄乱（铅字，版面）

ex.en: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
ex.cn: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

ex.en: He can't help thinking it's all just "pie in the sky" talk.
ex.cn: 他禁不住想所有这些不过是“画饼充饥”的空话而已。

ex.en: They have begun carving the country up like a pie.
ex.cn: 他们已经开始像切馅饼一样瓜分这个国家。

def:
n.块，片，段,部分，部件,文章，音乐作品
vt.修补,连接，接上

ex.en: How very thoughtless. I'll give him a piece of my mind.
ex.cn: 真是太没头脑了，我要告诉他我很生气。

ex.en: That's a beautiful piece of work. You should be proud of it.
ex.cn: 那件作品非常漂亮，你应当为之自豪。

ex.en: The piece was reduced in size by planing down the four corners.
ex.cn: 这块木头的4个角刨过后就变小了。

def:
n.猪,猪肉,令人不快（或讨厌）的人,金属块（锭）
vi.生小猪,像猪一样过活,举止像猪,贪吃
vt.吃得过量，大吃特吃,生小猪

ex.en: I'm afraid I made a pig of myself at dinner.
ex.cn: 恐怕我晚餐时吃得太多了。

ex.en: "A talking pig!" he exclaimed. "Well, I'll be darned."
ex.cn: “一只会说话的猪!”他大声叫道，“哎呀，真是怪事。”

ex.en: I am not sure whether this was courage or pig-headedness.
ex.cn: 我不能肯定这是一种勇气，还是一种固执。

def:
n.桩,一堆,绒头,摞
vt.堆起,堆叠,放置,装入
vi.蜂拥，拥挤

ex.en: On the table beside an empty plate was a pile of books.
ex.cn: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

ex.en: The entire pile shifted and slid, thumping onto the floor.
ex.cn: 那整整一摞东西动了一下后滑落下来，嘭的一声全掉到了地上。

ex.en: I've got a pile of questions afterwards for you.
ex.cn: 我有一大堆的问题等着过后问你。

def:
n.药丸,弹丸,口服避孕药,讨厌鬼
vt.使服用药丸,把…制成药丸,投票反对,抢劫
vi.服用药丸,制成药丸,起球

ex.en: The pill is the most efficient method of birth control.
ex.cn: 服用避孕药是最有效的避孕方法。

ex.en: She had been on the pill for three years.
ex.cn: 她吃口服避孕药已有3年。

ex.en: It was at that time she started taking the contraceptive pill.
ex.cn: 她就是从那个时候开始服用避孕药的。

def:
n.飞行员,引航员,向导,[机械学]导向器（或轴）
vt.驾驶,试验,试点,为（船舶）引航（或操舵）
adj.试验性的,导向的,驾驶员的,辅助的

ex.en: The minutes towards departure ticked by, until finally the pilot arrived.
ex.cn: 离出发的时间越来越近，最后飞行员终于到了。

ex.en: The pilot wisely decided to return to Farnborough post haste.
ex.cn: 飞行员明智地决定尽快返回法恩伯勒。

ex.en: How does a private pilot get access to the airways?
ex.cn: 私人飞行员如何进入航空路线呢？

def:
n.钉,别针，扣针，饰针,大头针,没价值的东西
vt.压住,（用钉等）钉住，钉住，别住，扣住,用障壁等)围住，关住（俚语）抓住,[军]牵制
adj.针的,钉的,销的,大头针的

ex.en: She'd do anything for a bit of pin money.
ex.cn: 为了挣点外快，她什么都肯做。

ex.en: It has taken until now to pin down its exact location.
ex.cn: 直到现在才确定了它的准确位置。

ex.en: Zita was herself unconventional, keeping a safety-pin stuck through her ear lobe.
ex.cn: 齐塔自己就不守传统，在一只耳垂上穿了一根别针。

def:
adj.粉红色的,淡红色的,略带左翼政治观点的,与同性恋者有关的
n.粉红色,典范,香石竹,顶点，极度
vt.刺、扎,打出小孔图案,戳

ex.en: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
ex.cn: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

ex.en: A glass of red wine keeps you in the pink.
ex.cn: 一杯红酒有益健康。

ex.en: Businesses are now more aware of the importance of the "pink pound".
ex.cn: 现在商家更加意识到同性恋族群消费力、即所谓“粉红英镑”的重要性。

def:
n.拓荒者,开发者,先驱者,创始者
vt.开拓，开发,做（…的）先锋,提倡

ex.en: She was a suffragette and a birth control pioneer.
ex.cn: 她参加争取妇女选举权的运动，也是节育倡导者。

ex.en: a pioneer in the field of microsurgery
ex.cn: 显微外科领域的创始人

ex.en: " We must learn from Uncle Lei Feng,'said the Young Pioneer.
ex.cn: 少先队员说道: “ 我们要向雷锋叔叔学习. ”

def:
n.管子,烟斗,管乐器,（管风琴的）音管
vt.以管输送,用管乐器演奏,尖声唱
vi.吹奏管乐器,尖叫,尖声地说（或唱），尖声啼鸣,[航海] 吹长哨

ex.en: Just pipe down and I'll tell you what I want.
ex.cn: 别说了，我来告诉你我想要什么。

ex.en: You could waste your whole life on a pipe-dream.
ex.cn: 白日梦会荒废你一生。

ex.en: He nodded and puffed on a stubby pipe as he listened.
ex.cn: 他边听边点头，还吸着一支粗短的烟斗。

def:
n.怜悯,同情,可惜的事,憾事
vt.对…表示怜悯,对…感到同情

ex.en: She summoned up all her pity for him, to smother her self-pity.
ex.cn: 她抑制着心中的自怜，将满腔的怜悯之情都倾注在了他的身上。

ex.en: Leo went on, his dark eyes wide with pity and concern.
ex.cn: 利奥接着说下去，他的黑眼睛瞪得大大的，充满怜悯和关切。

ex.en: Supposedly his last words to her were: "You must not pity me."
ex.cn: 据说他对她说的最后一句话是：“别怜悯我。”

def:
n.位,地方,职位,座位
vt.放置,获名次,投资,评价
vi.得名次,名列前茅,[美国英语][赛马]得第二名,准确把…推到预定地点

ex.en: The United States plans to tighten the economic sanctions currently in place.
ex.cn: 美国计划加大现有经济制裁的力度。

ex.en: He kept encouraging Rosie to find a place of her own.
ex.cn: 他不断鼓励罗茜为自己找个住处。

ex.en: Did she usurp his place in his mother's heart?
ex.cn: 她取代了他在他母亲心目中的地位吗？

def:
n.平原,平地,[纺织业]平针,朴实无华的东西
adj.平的,素的,清晰的,相貌平平的
adv.清楚地，明白地,平易地,[用以加强语气]显然,完全地
vi.发牢骚,诉苦

ex.en: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
ex.cn: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

ex.en: Patterson pointed toward a plain cardboard box beneath a long wooden table.
ex.cn: 帕特森指着长木桌下的一个普通的纸板箱。

ex.en: Pregnancy wasn't all plain sailing and once again there were problems.
ex.cn: 孕期并非一帆风顺，这不，又出现问题了。

def:
n.计划,打算,平面图,示意图
vt.& vi.计划，打算，设计

ex.en: The plan is good; the problem is it doesn't go far enough.
ex.cn: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。

ex.en: China enters a new five-year plan period next year.
ex.cn: 中国明年开始进入新一个五年计划期。

ex.en: The plan hinges on a deal being struck with a new company.
ex.cn: 该计划完全取决于正在和一家新公司洽谈着的一项交易。

def:
n.水平,平面,飞机,木工刨
adj.平的，平坦的
vt.用刨刨平,小船等擦着水面疾驶
vi.鸟滑翔

ex.en: The plane has been kept in service far longer than originally intended.
ex.cn: 这架飞机已经超期服役很长时间了。

ex.en: He noticed that fabric was tearing away from the plane's wing.
ex.cn: 他注意到机翼在一块一块地断裂。

ex.en: The plane had been cleared for landing at Brunswick's Glynco Airport.
ex.cn: 飞机获准降落于不伦瑞克的格林科机场。

def:
n.植物，草木,设备,工厂,庄稼
vt.种植,安，插,建设，布置,移民于

ex.en: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
ex.cn: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

ex.en: The plant acts as a sedative in treating neuralgia.
ex.cn: 这种植物被用作治疗神经痛时的镇静药。

ex.en: Her husband laboured at the plant for 17 years.
ex.cn: 她丈夫在厂里辛勤工作了17年。

def:
n.盘子，盆子,金属板,均匀厚度的片状硬物体,[摄]底片，感光版
vt.镀，在…上覆盖金属板,覆盖,电镀,[印]给…制铅板

ex.en: Garnish the plate with whipped cream rosettes and fresh fruits.
ex.cn: 用玫瑰花形的掼奶油和新鲜的水果作配菜点缀盘子。

ex.en: Visitors see the painting from behind a plate glass window.
ex.cn: 参观者隔着平板玻璃橱窗欣赏那幅画。

ex.en: On the table beside an empty plate was a pile of books.
ex.cn: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

def:
n.比赛,游戏,戏剧,赌博
vt.& vi.玩,演奏,演出,参加比赛
vt.扮演,担任，充当…的角色,演出,装扮
vi.玩耍，游戏,[游戏] 参加游戏,赌博,闹着玩

ex.en: Malvolio becomes, in default of competition, the play's moral centre.
ex.cn: 因为没有与其竞争者，马伏里奥自然成了该剧的道德核心。

ex.en: Charlton are about to play an important away match.
ex.cn: 查尔顿队即将在客场进行一场重要比赛。

ex.en: The Prime Minister has promised that Israel will play a constructive role.
ex.cn: 首相承诺以色列将发挥积极的作用。

def: n.演员,[体]运动员,[音]演奏者,播放机

ex.en: As a player he was unselfish, a true team man.
ex.cn: 作为一名选手，他毫无私念，真正把自己摆在团队中。

ex.en: His playing as a trumpet player was quite revolutionary.
ex.cn: 他的小号演奏独创一格。

ex.en: She can hold her own against almost any player.
ex.cn: 她几乎能和任何一名选手一较高下。

def: n.操场，尤指提供如秋千等设备的户外场地,游乐场,（某些集体聚会游乐的）园地

ex.en: There was a sandpit, a seesaw and a swing in the playground.
ex.cn: 游乐场上有一处沙坑、一块跷跷板和一个秋千架。

ex.en: He staggered around the playground, screaming in agony.
ex.cn: 他绕着运动场跌跌撞撞地走着，并且痛苦地大叫。

ex.en: We shot up heroin in the playground.
ex.cn: 我们在操场上注射海洛因。

def: adj.可爱的,令人愉快的,有趣的,晴朗的

ex.en: Lloyd George was most anxious to be agreeable and pleasant.
ex.cn: 劳埃德·乔治极力想表现得平易近人、和蔼亲切。

ex.en: The house allocated to them was pleasant and spacious, and well-staffed.
ex.cn: 分配给他们的房子舒适宽敞，并配齐了工作人员。

ex.en: Mrs Jones was a pleasant, homely person with a ready smile.
ex.cn: 琼斯夫人和蔼亲切，总是面带微笑。

def:
int.请
vt.& vi.使高兴,使满意,讨人喜欢,讨好

ex.en: "Please understand this," she began, a tremble in her voice.
ex.cn: “请理解这一点，”她开始说道，声音有些发颤。

ex.en: I'd like to check the balance in my account please.
ex.cn: 请查一下我的账户余额。

ex.en: I know this is an imposition. But please hear me out.
ex.cn: 我知道这是强人所难。但是请听我说完。

def:
n.愉快,娱乐,令人高兴的事
vt.使高兴,使满意
vi.觉得高兴，享受,寻欢作乐

ex.en: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way.
ex.cn: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

ex.en: I enjoy pleasure as much as the next person.
ex.cn: 我和别人一样愉快。

ex.en: It was a rare pleasure to see him in action.
ex.cn: 看他打球是一种享受。

def:
n.富裕,充裕
adv.大量,十分,很多,足够有余
det.很多,大量
pron.大量,众多,充足

ex.en: There were plenty of servants to wait on her.
ex.cn: 有很多仆人服侍她。

ex.en: She is in the fortunate position of having plenty of choice.
ex.cn: 好在她有很多选择。

ex.en: An important rule is to drink plenty of water during any flight.
ex.cn: 一条重要的原则就是每次坐飞机都要多喝水。

def:
n.耕作，耕地,犁,[天]北斗七星,〈英俚〉（主考人评定）不及格
vt.& vi.用犁耕田,开路,破浪前进,投（资）

ex.en: It would pay farmers to plough up the scrub and plant wheat.
ex.cn: 它会出钱雇农民开垦这块低矮丛林来种植麦子。

ex.en: This is early-20th-century rural Sussex, when horses still pulled the plough.
ex.cn: 这是20世纪早期的萨塞克斯乡村，那时还是用马拉犁。

ex.en: The soil sticks to the blade and blocks the plough.
ex.cn: 土粘在犁铧上，卡住了犁。

def:
n.犁,犁型铲雪机
v.耕,犁耕,费力穿过

ex.en: Better that I'd learned to plow or chop cotton like a darky.
ex.cn: 还不如当初象黑人那样学会犁田、摘棉花呢.

ex.en: A Texas farmer grumbled that he had to plow his field.
ex.cn: 有位得克萨斯州的农场主嘟嘟囔囔地说,他得耕自己的地.

ex.en: At this time of the year farmers plow their fields.
ex.cn: 每年这个时候农民们都在耕地.

def:
n.口袋，钱袋,金钱，财富,容器,凹处
vt.隐藏,放进口袋,私吞，盗用,忍受
adj.放在口袋里的,小的，迷你的,金钱上的

ex.en: He spends most of his pocket money on PlayStation games.
ex.cn: 他大部分零花钱都用来买PS游戏了。

ex.en: He took his flashlight from his jacket pocket and switched it on.
ex.cn: 他从夹克口袋里拿出手电筒，打开开关。

ex.en: We agreed to give her £6 a week pocket money.
ex.cn: 我们同意每周给她6英镑零花钱。

def: n.诗,韵文,诗一样的作品,富有诗意的东西

ex.en: At my brother's high school graduation the students recited a poem.
ex.cn: 在我弟弟的高中毕业典礼上，学生们朗诵了一首诗。

ex.en: Whatever its obscurities, the poem was clear on at least one count.
ex.cn: 这首诗再怎么晦涩，至少有一点是清楚的。

ex.en: To write and publish this poem was a daring, transgressive act.
ex.cn: 创作并发表这首诗是一个大胆越轨的举动。

def: n.诗人,空想家,古典芭蕾舞大师

ex.en: The concept of the Rose continued to inform the poet's work.
ex.cn: 玫瑰的概念持续贯穿于诗人的作品中。

ex.en: At first the eager young poet was a partisan of the Revolution.
ex.cn: 起初，那位满腔热忱的年轻诗人是革命的坚定支持者。

ex.en: He was determined to reinvent himself as a poet and writer.
ex.cn: 他下决心把自己重塑成一个诗人兼作家。

def:
n.点,要点,得分,标点
vt.（意思上）指向,削尖,加标点于,指路
vi.表明,指向

ex.en: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.--Max Lerner
ex.cn: 当你从内心深处找到一种可以忍受一切痛苦的坚强力量时，你的成长历程就会出现飞跃。

ex.en: I don't see the point in it really. It's just stupid.
ex.cn: 我真的不理解这到底有什么意义，简直是愚蠢透顶。

ex.en: It got to the point where he had to leave.
ex.cn: 到了他不得不走的地步。

def:
n.[物]极点，顶点,地极,杆,两极端
vt.& vi.用篙撑船，摆船
vt.[航海] 用一根杆来推动,以杆推进,以杆支撑（植物）,用杆子击打、戳、或搅拌
vi.用滑雪杖加速

ex.en: She is a pole dancer at London's famous Spearmint Rhino club.
ex.cn: 她是伦敦著名的“薄荷犀牛”夜总会的钢管舞舞者。

ex.en: The South Pole expedition proved to be staggeringly successful.
ex.cn: 这次南极探险结果非常成功。

ex.en: The north pole is slightly tipped towards the sun.
ex.cn: 北极略微向太阳倾斜。

def:
n.警察部门,警方,警察,治安
vt.（警察、军队等）巡查,维护治安,（委员会等）监督,管制
adj.警察的,有关警察的

ex.en: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
ex.cn: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

ex.en: He then held the man in an armlock until police arrived.
ex.cn: 然后他反扭住那名男子的手臂让他动弹不得，直到警察赶到。

ex.en: Police said permission for the march had not been granted.
ex.cn: 警方说游行并未得到批准。

def: n.（男）警察，警员,看守矿井的人,[化] 淀帚

ex.en: The two policemen were joined by another policeman also carrying a pistol.
ex.cn: 另一名持枪警察和那两名警察会合了。

ex.en: The policeman smiled at her. "Pretty dog."— "Oh well, thank you."
ex.cn: 警察冲她笑了笑，“这狗真漂亮。”——“哦，谢谢。”

ex.en: "Good lord, that's what he is: he's a policeman."
ex.cn: “我的天哪，他原来是警察呀。”

def: adj.有礼貌的,有教养的，文雅的,上流社会的,应酬的，客套的

ex.en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
ex.cn: 他话不多，很有礼貌，为人谦和。

ex.en: He's generous and, you know, very nice, very polite.
ex.cn: 他很大方而且，你知道，很友善，很有礼貌。

ex.en: I think English men are very polite and very correct.
ex.cn: 我认为英国人很有礼貌，举止非常得体。

def: adj.政治的,政党的,对政治有兴趣的

ex.en: It was time now to show more political realism.
ex.cn: 现在是拿出更多政治务实精神的时候了。

ex.en: The rabbis try to steer clear of political questions.
ex.cn: 拉比们努力避开政治问题。

ex.en: He is known for his political savvy and strong management skills.
ex.cn: 他以睿智的政治头脑和强势的管理手腕出名。

def: vt.污染,玷污，亵渎,破坏（品性），使堕落

ex.en: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest.
ex.cn: 采矿会污染湖水，毁掉森林。

ex.en: Factories are no longer allowed to pollute the air with black smoke.
ex.cn: 不再允许工厂的黑烟污染空气了.

ex.en: She thinks these books pollute the minds of children.
ex.cn: 她认为这些书腐蚀儿童的心灵.

def: n.污染（作用）,腐败,堕落,沾污

ex.en: Randolph's work was exclusively concerned with the effects of pollution on health.
ex.cn: 伦道夫的著作专门论述污染对健康的影响。

ex.en: Environmentalists say a critical factor in the city's pollution is its population.
ex.cn: 环境保护主义者说造成该城市污染问题的一个关键因素是其人口数量。

ex.en: The snowcoach concept in Yellowstone provides low-impact, low-pollution access.
ex.cn: 在黄石公园里使用雪车这一想法，为人们提供了一种对环境低影响、低污染的游览方式。

def:
n.池塘
v.筑成池塘

ex.en: Tourist numbers from across the pond have dropped dramatically.
ex.cn: 来自大西洋彼岸的游客数量已急剧减少。

ex.en: Usually, the presentation is made on the other side of the pond.
ex.cn: 通常，这样的展示是在大西洋另一边进行的。

ex.en: There was an unappealing film of slime on top of the pond.
ex.cn: 池塘表面有一层黏腻腻的污泥。

def:
n.水池,石油层,（液体等的）一滩,共同储金
vi.使形成池塘或水洼,淤积,合伙经营,采（煤等）

ex.en: She was standing by a pool, about to dive in.
ex.cn: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。

ex.en: He drank thirstily from the pool under the rock.
ex.cn: 他饥渴地喝着岩石下水潭中的水。

ex.en: He remembered mowing the lawn, lounging around the swimming pool.
ex.cn: 他还记得修剪草坪、在泳池边闲荡的情景。

def:
adj.贫穷的，贫乏的,令人怜悯的，可怜的,匮乏的,低劣的
n.the poor 贫困者，穷人

ex.en: Conditions for the poor in Los Angeles have not improved.
ex.cn: 洛杉矶穷人的境况仍未得到改善。

ex.en: This courtroom battle has been a poor advert for English justice.
ex.cn: 这场法庭上的争论为英格兰的司法制度做了一次拙劣的广告。

ex.en: The expedition was wrecked by bad planning and poor navigation.
ex.cn: 这次探险因计划不周和导航不利而失败。

def:
vi.（意外地、突然地）出现,突然出现,发出爆裂声,（突然地）行动
vt.（突然地）伸出,（突然地）提出问题,（把准备好的东西）突然拿出来,敲击
n.流行音乐,汽水,（尤用作称呼）爸,（迅速打上的）记号
adj.流行音乐的,通俗风格的,通俗的,现代的
adv.爆炸；砰地
abbr.邮局协议(post office protocol)

ex.en: The radio had fed him a diet of pop songs.
ex.cn: 他从广播里听到的都是千篇一律的流行歌曲。

ex.en: Somalia, pop. 7.9 million, income per head about £1.60 a week.
ex.cn: 索马里，人口790万，人均收入大约每周1.60英镑。

ex.en: I'll make the tea and you pop off for a while.
ex.cn: 我来备茶，你去歇一会儿吧。

def: adj.流行的，大众化的,民众的，大众的，公众的,通俗的，普通的，平易的,〈美俚〉自以为了不得的，骄傲的

ex.en: The military government has been unable to win popular support.
ex.cn: 军政府一直未能赢得广泛的支持。

ex.en: The fusty old establishment refused to recognise the demand for popular music.
ex.cn: 这一古板的老旧机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

ex.en: Some of the finer type-faces are corrupted by cheap, popular computer printers.
ex.cn: 有些比较优美的字体经过价廉、通用的电脑打印机处理后就面目全非了。

def: n.人口,全体居民,特定[生物]种群,[物]布居

ex.en: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population.
ex.cn: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

ex.en: Food production has already fallen behind the population growth.
ex.cn: 粮食生产已经跟不上人口增长。

ex.en: A substantial proportion of the population speak a French-based patois.
ex.cn: 人口中有一大部分说以法语为基础的混合语。

def: n.猪肉,〈美俚〉支持政党上台所分到的好处，政治分肥,〈古〉猪

ex.en: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
ex.cn: 在火上熏制猪腿。

ex.en: Stir the pork about until it turns white all the way through.
ex.cn: 不停搅动猪肉，直到它全部变白为止。

ex.en: Pork-barrel politicians hand out rents to win votes and influence people.
ex.cn: 搞分肥拨款的政客为获得选票、影响民情而发放房租补贴。

def:
n.港口,（事情的）意义,（计算机与其他设备的）接口,（船、飞机等的）左舷
vt.举枪,持枪,左转舵
vi.转向左舷
adj.左舷的，左侧的
vt.& vi.转舵（向左），把（舵）转向左边
adv.向左舷，向左

ex.en: He asked for a glass of port after dinner.
ex.cn: 晚饭后，他要了一杯波尔图葡萄酒。

ex.en: They had asked Hong Kong for permission to put into port there.
ex.cn: 他们请求香港允许他们在那里入港停留。

ex.en: Captain David Clement and 150 commandos stormed the port this morning.
ex.cn: 戴维·克莱门特上尉和150名突击队员今天早上对港口展开突袭。

def:
n.位置，方位,地位，职位,态度,状态
vt.安置,把…放在适当位置,给…定位,驻扎军队

ex.en: They may headhunt her for the vacant position of Executive Producer.
ex.cn: 他们可能会挖她去填补执行制片人这一空缺职位。

ex.en: There must be any number of people in my position.
ex.cn: 一定有很多人处在我这种境况。

ex.en: Mack seemed to uncoil slowly up into a standing position.
ex.cn: 麦克慢慢直起身站了起来。

def: n.有，所有，拥有,领地,财产，所有权，占有物，所有物,持有违禁物

ex.en: How had this com-promising picture come into the possession of the press?
ex.cn: 这张令人难堪的照片是怎么落到媒体手中的？

ex.en: Possession of cannabis will no longer be an arrestable offence.
ex.cn: 持有大麻将不再会被拘捕。

ex.en: He described the picture as his most cherished possession.
ex.cn: 他说那幅画是他最珍爱的财产。

def:
adj.可能的,可接受的,合理的，可以允许的,不坏的
n.可能性，潜在性,可能的人物，可能有的事,最高分

ex.en: He programmed his computer to compare all the possible combinations.
ex.cn: 他给他的计算机编制了一套程序，以比较所有可能的组合。

ex.en: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
ex.cn: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

ex.en: It was imperative that he act as naturally as possible.
ex.cn: 最重要的是他要做到尽可能自然。

def: adv.可能地,也许，或许,敢是,容许

ex.en: Do you think that he could possibly be right?
ex.cn: 你觉得他有可能是对的吗？

ex.en: Possibly we are accustomed, biologically speaking, to this background radiation.
ex.cn: 从生物机理上说，我们可能已经习惯了这种本底辐射。

ex.en: Could you possibly knock me up some scrambled eggs?
ex.cn: 你能尽快给我弄个炒鸡蛋吗？

def: n.明信片

ex.en: For more details about these products, send a postcard marked HB/FF.
ex.cn: 要了解这些产品的详细信息，请寄来标明HB/FF字样的明信片。

ex.en: The army sent me a postcard acknowledging my request.
ex.cn: 军队寄给我一张明信片告知我的申请书已收到。

ex.en: Send your answers on the back of a postcard.
ex.cn: 将答案写在明信片背面寄出。

def: n.邮递员，邮差

ex.en: I remembered a particular story about a postman who was a murderer.
ex.cn: 我记得有个故事，讲的是一个邮递员杀人的事情。

ex.en: The postman ran away with the dog nipping at his heel.
ex.cn: 邮递员跑开了,狗在身后紧追着要咬他.

ex.en: The postman argued away his misdelivery of the mail.
ex.cn: 那个邮递员为他误投邮件的事辩解.

def:
n.罐,一罐,（某种用途的）容器,陶盆
vt.把…栽入盆中,种盆栽,台球、普尔和斯诺克击（球）入袋,射杀
vi.随手射击

ex.en: You will need a pot of broth for poaching.
ex.cn: 你需要一锅汤来煮。

ex.en: Marseilles has proved to be a better racial melting pot than Lyons.
ex.cn: 事实证明，与里昂相比，马赛是一个更好的种族大熔炉。

ex.en: The republic is a melting pot of different nationalities.
ex.cn: 这个共和国是多民族的大熔炉。

def: n.马铃薯， 土豆，洋芋,土豆块茎

ex.en: The potato cakes should be crisp outside and meltingly soft inside.
ex.cn: 土豆饼应该外面酥脆,里面嫩软.

ex.en: Now experts are extolling the virtues of the humble potato.
ex.cn: 现在专家们都在赞美其貌不扬的马铃薯的种种好处。

ex.en: Left-handers have trouble using can-openers, scissors, and potato peelers.
ex.cn: 左撇子在使用开罐刀、剪刀和土豆削皮器时会有困难。

def:
n.英镑,磅,兽栏,重击声
vt.& vi.连续重击,咚咚地走
vi.（持续地）苦干,（驾舟时）拍打（水面）,（心脏）狂跳,脚步沉重地走（或跑）
vt.连续重击,捣碎，碾碎,强迫吸收,猛烈袭击

ex.en: The one thousand pound bomb was triggered by a wire.
ex.cn: 那颗重达1,000磅的炸弹是由一根导线引爆的。

ex.en: There was a sharp fall in the value of the pound.
ex.cn: 英镑大幅贬值。

ex.en: The drop was caused partly by the pound's strength against the dollar.
ex.cn: 下降的部分原因在于英镑对美元的升值。

def:
vt.涌出,倾，倒
vi.涌流,泛滥，涌出,斟，倒
n.倾泻

ex.en: Stir the sauce and pour it over the top.
ex.cn: 搅拌调味汁，把它浇在上面。

ex.en: Any day now, the Northern forces may pour across the new border.
ex.cn: 北方的军队现在随时都可能大批越过新边界。

ex.en: Pour the mixture into the cake tin and bake for 45 minutes.
ex.cn: 把混合物倒进烤模烤制45分钟。

def:
n.[机]动力，功率,力量,政权，权力,强国，大国
vt.运转,用发动机发动,使…有力量
vi.靠动力行进,快速行进
adj.权力的,机械能的，电动的,用电力（或动力）发动的

ex.en: Generosity is its own form of power.
ex.cn: 别低估了慷慨的力量。

ex.en: The military regime in power was unpopular and repressive.
ex.cn: 当权的军政府压制人民，不得人心。

ex.en: Many of the leaders have become hooked on power and money.
ex.cn: 很多领导人都变得贪恋权力和金钱。

def: adj.实践的，实际的,可实现的，实用的,注重实际的,可用的

ex.en: After half an hour's commis-eration, we turned to more practical matters.
ex.cn: 惺惺相惜了半个小时后，我们转而讨论一些更为实际的问题。

ex.en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
ex.cn: 从智识、道德和现实的角度来看，这一论点是站不住脚的。

ex.en: Renewable sources of energy must be used where practical.
ex.cn: 必须在可行的地方使用可再生能源。

def:
n.练习,实践,（医生或律师的）业务,惯例
vi.实行,惯常地进行,练习,实习
vt.实行，实践,执业,练习,惯常地进行

ex.en: His hands were rough and calloused, from years of karate practice.
ex.cn: 由于多年练习空手道，他的双手粗糙不平，布满老茧。

ex.en: The ministers expressed dismay at the continued practice of ethnic cleansing.
ex.cn: 部长们表达了对持续进行的种族清洗的忧虑。

ex.en: In practice a graduate tax is an administrative nightmare.
ex.cn: 毕业税具体操作起来不啻一场行政噩梦。

def:
vt.& vi.练习,实习,积极从事,执业
na.“practice”的变体

ex.en: To improve hand-eye co-ordination, practise throwing and catching balls.
ex.cn: 要想提高手眼协调能力，就练习投球和接球。

ex.en: They righteously maintain that they do not practise rationing.
ex.cn: 他们一本正经地坚称不实行定量配给制度。

ex.en: In Belgium only qualified doctors may practise alternative medicine.
ex.cn: 在比利时只有资质合格的医生才能从事非传统医学工作。

def:
n.赞扬，称赞,崇拜,赞词
v.赞扬，赞美,歌颂,崇拜

ex.en: The team also won praise for sportsmanship and fair play.
ex.cn: 该队还因其良好的体育精神及公平竞争精神而受到了表扬。

ex.en: It is difficult to praise this immaculately researched work too highly.
ex.cn: 这项研究工作毫无瑕疵，怎样称赞都不过分。

ex.en: Prince Sadruddin lavished praise on Britain's contributions to world diplomacy.
ex.cn: 萨德鲁丁王子大力赞扬英国对世界外交作出的贡献。

def:
vt.更喜欢,提升，提拔,给予（债权人）优先权,提出（控告）
vi.更喜欢，宁愿

ex.en: I would prefer him to be with us next season.
ex.cn: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

ex.en: I think more customers probably prefer a soft sell.
ex.cn: 我认为更多的顾客也许更喜欢软性推销。

ex.en: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash.
ex.cn: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。

def:
vt.准备,预备（饭菜）,配备,使（自己）有准备
vt.& vi.筹备，进行各项准备工作,做好思想准备,作出，制订,锻炼（身体等），训练

ex.en: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency.
ex.cn: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

ex.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
ex.cn: 这种稍加变化的可口煎蛋卷做起来又快又容易。

ex.en: Two leading law firms are to prepare legal actions against tobacco companies.
ex.cn: 两家很有名的律师事务所准备向烟草公司提起诉讼。

def:
adj.现在的,目前的,出席的,[语法学]现在时的
n.现在,礼物,瞄准

ex.en: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister.
ex.cn: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

ex.en: They said the present system of military conscription should be phased out.
ex.cn: 他们说，当前的征兵体系应当逐步废除。

ex.en: I pushed the problem aside; at present it was insoluble.
ex.cn: 我把问题抛在一边，目前它还无法解决。

def: n.校长,总统,总裁,董事长

ex.en: The President's speeches are regularly reproduced verbatim in the state-run newspapers.
ex.cn: 总统的讲话通常会被一字不差地刊登在国有报纸上。

ex.en: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
ex.cn: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

ex.en: The President's unescorted vehicle was ambushed just outside the capital.
ex.cn: 刚出首都，总统无人护卫的汽车就遭到了伏击。

def:
vt.压，按,逼迫,紧抱
vi.压,逼迫,重压
n.强迫征兵,新闻报道，出版物,压榨,印刷机（厂）

ex.en: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
ex.cn: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

ex.en: He faced the press, initially, in a somewhat subdued mood.
ex.cn: 他最初面对媒体时情绪有点忧郁。

ex.en: The government says it will not be bullied by the press.
ex.cn: 政府声称不会屈服于新闻媒体的压力。

def:
vt.假装，伪装,假称,装扮
vi.扮演,自称,假装，矫作
adj.仿制的

ex.en: The children pretend to be different animals dancing to the music.
ex.cn: 孩子们扮成不同的动物，随着音乐起舞。

ex.en: We won't pretend we savour the prospect of a month in prison.
ex.cn: 我们不会装作我们满心盼望着在监狱中度过一个月。

ex.en: It would be idle to pretend the system is perfect.
ex.cn: 假装系统完美无疵是徒劳的。

def:
adj.漂亮的,机灵的，聪明的
adv.相当，颇
n.漂亮的人（或东西）

ex.en: She's going to be fine. She always was pretty strong.
ex.cn: 她会好的。她一直都很强壮。

ex.en: She was a shy, delicately pretty girl with enormous blue eyes.
ex.cn: 她是一个害羞、娇美的女孩，长着一双大大的蓝眼睛。

ex.en: His new government looks pretty much like the old one.
ex.cn: 他的新政府看起来和旧政府没什么两样。

def:
vt.预防,阻碍,阻止,[宗教]引领
vi.阻挠，阻止

ex.en: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble.
ex.cn: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

ex.en: The security zone was set up to prevent guerrilla infiltrations.
ex.cn: 设立了安全区以防止游击队员的渗入。

ex.en: Smear Vaseline on to your baby's skin to prevent soreness.
ex.cn: 给孩子皮肤上抹些凡士林以防止肿痛。

def:
n.价格，价钱,代价,价值,赏金
vt.标价,定价,问…的价格,给…定价

ex.en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
ex.cn: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

ex.en: There are intangible benefits beyond a rise in the share price.
ex.cn: 除股价上升之外还有无形利益。

ex.en: The price depends on the intricacy of the work.
ex.cn: 价格取决于做工的复杂精细度。

def:
n.自尊,骄傲,自满,（狮）群
vt.以…而自豪， 得意于…
vi.自豪，骄傲，得意

ex.en: He wrote the word "pride" in huge letters on the blackboard.
ex.cn: 他在黑板上写了一个大大的单词pride。

ex.en: We definitely wanted to salvage some pride for British tennis.
ex.cn: 我们当然想为英国网球挽回一些尊严。

ex.en: The expectant mothers that Amy had encountered positively glowed with pride.
ex.cn: 埃米遇见的准妈妈们个个洋溢着自豪和喜悦。

def: n.王子,巨头,（某些欧洲国家的）贵族,小国的君主

ex.en: At tea-time, Victoria sang duets with her Consort, Prince Albert.
ex.cn: 喝下午茶的时候，维多利亚与其夫君艾伯特亲王表演了二重唱。

ex.en: The Prince was driving with great fire and dash.
ex.cn: 王子潇洒威猛地驱车而行。

ex.en: Prince Sadruddin lavished praise on Britain's contributions to world diplomacy.
ex.cn: 萨德鲁丁王子大力赞扬英国对世界外交作出的贡献。

def: n.公主,王妃（王族女性成员）,女巨头，女名家,<古>女王

ex.en: The Sun had captioned a picture of Princess Diana "Princess of Veils"
ex.cn: 《太阳报》在黛安娜王妃的一张照片下写了一段说明文字——“披着面纱的王妃”。

ex.en: The Princess Royal arrived at Gatwick this morning from Jamaica.
ex.cn: 长公主殿下从牙买加出发，今天早上抵达盖特威克机场。

ex.en: The Princess had been invited to ride in a charity race.
ex.cn: 公主受邀参加一场慈善性质的赛马比赛。

def:
n.（由底片印出的）照片,印刷字体,印痕,印成的图画
vt.（在松软的表面）压印,把…付印
vt.& vi.用印刷体写,冲洗（照片）,登载,在纸上印

ex.en: Many of their books have been in print for nearly 40 years.
ex.cn: 他们的很多书都印行将近40年了。

ex.en: I got a kick out of seeing my name in print.
ex.cn: 当看到我的名字印成铅字时，我感到无比兴奋。

ex.en: I paid a visit to my local print shop.
ex.cn: 我去了我们当地的照片冲洗店.

def:
n.印刷（术）,（书籍的）一次印刷,印刷字体,一次的印数
v.（在松软的表面）压印( print的现在分词 ),把…付印,用印刷体写,冲洗（照片）

ex.en: The American edition of "Cloud Street" is already in its third printing.
ex.cn: 美国版的《云街》已经是第三次印刷了。

ex.en: Community workers here are printing up pamphlets for peace demonstrations.
ex.cn: 这里的社区工作者正在为和平示威游行印刷小册子。

ex.en: The electronic and printing unit has annual sales of about $80 million.
ex.cn: 电子印刷部门每年销售额约为8,000万美元。

def: n.监狱,牢笼,监禁,入狱

ex.en: He was returned to prison in 1977 for impersonating a police officer.
ex.cn: 他1977年因冒充警官而再次入狱。

ex.en: In prison they'd taken away his watch and everything he possessed.
ex.cn: 在监狱，他们把他的手表和其他一切东西都搜走了。

ex.en: Williams faces life in prison if convicted of attempted murder.
ex.cn: 如被判谋杀未遂，威廉斯将面临终身监禁。

def: n.囚犯,犯人,俘虏,刑事被告

ex.en: His men made a sortie to Guazatan and took a prisoner.
ex.cn: 他的士兵袭击了瓜扎坦，擒获了一名俘虏。

ex.en: He was taken prisoner in North Africa in 1942.
ex.cn: 他于1942年在北非被俘。

ex.en: A prisoner collapsed and died yesterday, apparently from natural causes.
ex.cn: 一名囚犯昨天突然倒下死了，看上去像是正常死亡。

def:
n.奖赏,战利品,值得努力争取的东西
vt.珍视，珍惜,估价
adj.获奖的，有望获奖的,理应获奖的

ex.en: Each month the total prize kitty is £13.5 million.
ex.cn: 每个月的彩池奖金总额达1,350万英镑。

ex.en: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
ex.cn: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

ex.en: During each show we will be raffling a fabulous prize.
ex.cn: 每场表演期间，我们将以抽彩方法送出大奖。

def:
adj.可能的,大概的
n.很可能的事,可能入选者

ex.en: The Socialists united behind their probable presidential candidate, Michel Rocard.
ex.cn: 社会党人团结在他们很有希望当选的总统候选人米歇尔·罗卡尔周围。

ex.en: I fear that a land war now looks very probable.
ex.cn: 恐怕陆地战爆发的可能性很大。

ex.en: The probable outcome of the talks is a compromise.
ex.cn: 会谈的结果很可能是妥协.

def: adv.大概,或许,很可能,备不住

ex.en: She probably sensed that I wasn'ttelling her the whole story.
ex.cn: 她可能意识到了我并没有对她全盘托出。

ex.en: Swimming is probably the best form of exercise you can get.
ex.cn: 游泳或许是现有的最佳锻炼方式。

ex.en: If there was any disappointment it was probably temporary.
ex.cn: 即便有点儿失望，也肯定是暂时的。

def:
n.问题,疑难问题,习题,引起麻烦的人
adj.成问题的,难处理的,关于社会问题的

ex.en: The plan is good; the problem is it doesn't go far enough.
ex.cn: 计划不错；问题在于不够深入。

ex.en: I pushed the problem aside; at present it was insoluble.
ex.cn: 我把问题抛在一边，目前它还无法解决。

ex.en: The letter was short — a simple recitation of their problem.
ex.cn: 信写得很短——只是简单地说了一下他们的问题。

def:
vt.& vi.生产,产生,制作,创作
vt.制造,出示,引起,[经济学]生利
n.产品,产量,产额,结果

ex.en: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
ex.cn: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

ex.en: The formalization of co-operation between the republics would produce progress.
ex.cn: 正式确立合作关系将会促进共和国之间合作的顺利进展。

ex.en: Usually a woman's breasts produce milk spontaneously after the birth.
ex.cn: 女性的乳房通常在产后会自然泌乳。

def: n.生产，制作,产品,产量,夸张的行动或形象，小题大做

ex.en: Their first car rolls off the production line on December 16.
ex.cn: 他们的第一辆车于12月16日下线。

ex.en: He pushed everyone full speed ahead until production hit a bottleneck.
ex.cn: 他催促所有人拼命干活，直到生产遭遇瓶颈。

ex.en: Hydrogen is used extensively in industry for the production of ammonia.
ex.cn: 氢气在工业上广泛用于制氨。

def: n.教授,（大学的）讲师，教员,自称者，宣称者

ex.en: Professor Baker is unacquainted with the idea of representative democracy.
ex.cn: 贝克教授并不熟悉“代议制民主”这一思想。

ex.en: The Professor said that deep sleep allowed suppressed anxieties to surface.
ex.cn: 教授说深度睡眠可以使压抑的焦虑情绪得以释放。

ex.en: Professor Griffiths explained how the drug appears to work.
ex.cn: 格里菲思教授解释了那种药物的工作原理。

def:
n.程序,节目，节目单,计划，安排
v.[计]给…编写程序,为…制定计划,设计安排活动,编排

ex.en: He uses tapes of this program to teach English.
ex.cn: 他用这个节目的录像带教授英语。

ex.en: Finding a volunteer to write the computer program isn't a problem.
ex.cn: 找个志愿者编这个计算机程序不成问题。

ex.en: The reform program has brought unacceptably high unemployment and falling wages.
ex.cn: 改革计划造成了令人无法接受的高失业率和工资水平下降。

def:
n.（演出或活动的）程序,计划,节目,课程
vt.计划,训练,培养,预调
vi.编程序,制作节目

ex.en: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
ex.cn: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

ex.en: I had to admire David's vow that he would leave the programme.
ex.cn: 戴维发誓要离开这个项目，我不得不对他表示钦佩。

ex.en: That programme will include live commentary on the England-Ireland game.
ex.cn: 那个节目将包括英格兰与爱尔兰比赛的实况报道。

def:
n.进步,前进,[生物学]进化,（向更高方向）增长
v.（使）进步，（使）进行,发展,促进
vi.发展,（向更高方向）增进

ex.en: His remedial teacher sees signs of progress in his reading and writing.
ex.cn: 他的辅导教师发现了他在阅读和写作方面进步的迹象。

ex.en: Middle East peace talks in Washington showed signs of progress yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天在华盛顿举行的中东和谈有了取得进展的迹象。

ex.en: Social progress is normally a matter of struggles and conflicts.
ex.cn: 社会进步通常是斗争和冲突的结果。

def:
vt.允诺，许诺,给人以…的指望或希望
vi.许诺,有指望，有前途
n.许诺,希望，指望,允诺的东西

ex.en: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
ex.cn: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

ex.en: I'm hoping you'll keep your promise to come for a long visit.
ex.cn: 我希望你遵守诺言来这儿多呆几天。

ex.en: President Kaunda fulfilled his promise of announcing a date for the referendum.
ex.cn: 卡翁达总统兑现了他的承诺，宣布了全民公决的日期。

def:
vt.& vi.发音，读
vt.宣布，宣称,演讲，讲述
vi.宣判

ex.en: Men feel perfectly free to pronounce on the way women should look.
ex.cn: 男人随心所欲地对女性美的标准发表看法。

ex.en: Did I pronounce your name correctly?
ex.cn: 你的名字我念对了吗？

ex.en: The authorities took time to pronounce their verdicts.
ex.cn: 当局斟酌权衡再三才宣布他们的决定。

def: n.发音,读法,发音方法,发音方式

ex.en: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
ex.cn: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

ex.en: You're going to have to forgive my pronunciation.
ex.cn: 你得原谅我的发音。

ex.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
ex.cn: 她读出了该词的法语发音。

def:
adj.适当的，相当的，正当的，应该的，正式的，正常的,固有的，特有的，独特的,本来的，真正的，严格意义上的,〈古〉漂亮的，优美的
adv.〈方〉适当地，好好地，非常，很，完完全全地，彻底地
n.[宗教][常用P-]特定节日等用的仪式，弥撒（祈祷、礼仪等）书的章节，特赞

ex.en: He denied that he'd failed to keep a proper lookout that night.
ex.cn: 他否认当晚守望不力。

ex.en: Catherine demonstrated the proper way to cleanse the face.
ex.cn: 凯瑟琳演示了洁面的正确方法。

ex.en: Britain imposed fines on airlines which bring in passengers without proper papers.
ex.cn: 英国会对运载证件不齐全的乘客进入国内的航空公司课以罚款。

def: vt.保护，保卫,贸易保护,备款以支付

ex.en: Such laws could protect the consumer from harmful or dangerous remedies.
ex.cn: 这样的法规可以保护消费者免受有害或者危险药品的威胁。

ex.en: Namibian law permits ranchers to shoot cheetahs to protect their livestock.
ex.cn: 纳米比亚法律允许农场主射杀猎豹以保护家畜。

ex.en: Many manufacturers have policies to protect themselves against blackmailers.
ex.cn: 许多厂家都购买了保险，以防遭到敲诈。

def: adj.自豪的，得意的,光荣的，高尚的,傲慢的,有自尊心的

ex.en: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
ex.cn: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

ex.en: She noticed her own proud walk had become a shuffle.
ex.cn: 她意识到自己趾高气扬的步伐已变成了拖着脚走路了。

ex.en: The handles stand proud of the doors of the car.
ex.cn: 把手位于车门之外。

def:
vt.证明，证实,[法]验证，检定,显示
vi.显示出，证明是

ex.en: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced, person.
ex.cn: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

ex.en: If they prove ineffective they should be demoted or asked to retire.
ex.cn: 如果事实证明他们已无力胜任，应该将他们降级或让他们退休。

ex.en: There is the strong possibility that such cooperation will prove unworkable.
ex.cn: 这种合作很有可能会行不通。

def:
vt.& vi.提供，供给，供应
vt.规定,提供(+for),装备,预备
vi.抚养，赡养(+for),做准备,预约(for 或 against)

ex.en: Poland provide the opposition for the Scots' last warm-up match at home.
ex.cn: 苏格兰队在国内最后一场热身赛的对手是波兰队。

ex.en: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
ex.cn: 关节炎的新疗法可能是止痛药之外的另一种选择。

ex.en: Nursing auxiliaries provide basic care, but are not qualified nurses.
ex.cn: 助理护士只提供基本护理，不具备护士资格。

def: n.酒馆，酒店,客栈

ex.en: It was five long miles to the nearest pub.
ex.cn: 离最近的酒吧有长长的5英里的路程。

ex.en: After the row in a pub he drove off in a huff.
ex.cn: 在酒吧里吵了一架后，他气鼓鼓地开车走了。

ex.en: I'm off down to the pub for a quickie.
ex.cn: 我要去酒吧畅饮一杯。

def:
adj.公众的，公共的,公开的,政府的,人人知道的，知名的
n.大众,社会,公共场所,（文学家等的）爱读者

ex.en: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
ex.cn: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

ex.en: There needs to be a properly informed public debate.
ex.cn: 有必要让公众在充分知情的状况下展开辩论。

ex.en: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
ex.cn: 他是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

def:
vt.& vi.拉,扯,拉过来,划（船）
vt.赢得,吸引异性,取消,（耍手腕）得逞
n.拖,爬,影响力

ex.en: The pull-out of the army paves the way for independence.
ex.cn: 军队的撤出为独立铺平了道路。

ex.en: I only pull in 15,000 a year as a social worker.
ex.cn: 作为一名社工，我每年仅挣15,000。

ex.en: Suddenly all the men pull out pistols and begin blasting away.
ex.cn: 突然，所有人都拔出手枪，连续射击。

def: v.处罚,严厉对付,贪婪地吃喝

ex.en: Current employment laws will be changed to reward effort and punish laziness.
ex.cn: 现行雇佣法要变，要奖勤罚懒。

ex.en: I don't believe that George ever had to punish the children.
ex.cn: 我认为乔治根本没有必要处罚孩子们。

ex.en: Don't punish your child for being honest.
ex.cn: 不要因为你的孩子说了实话而处罚他。

def: n.学生,[解]瞳孔,未成年人,[法]被监护人

ex.en: After his education, Goldschmidt became a pupil of the composer Franz Schreker.
ex.cn: 学业结束后，戈尔德施米特成了作曲家弗朗兹·施雷克尔的学生。

ex.en: This can cause regression in a pupil's learning process.
ex.cn: 这可能会使学生在学习过程中退步。

ex.en: As a girl she had been a model pupil.
ex.cn: 还是个小女孩的时候，她就是一个模范学生。

def:
adj.纯的,单纯的,纯真的,干净的
prep.清晰的，纯正的

ex.en: Somehow she'd always been a child in his mind, pure and virginal.
ex.cn: 不知何故，她在他心里一直是个天真无邪的孩子。

ex.en: Hybrids, unlike pure electric cars, never need to be plugged in.
ex.cn: 与纯电动汽车不同，混合动力车永远不需要接电源。

ex.en: "Aromatherapy oils" are not pure essential oils but dilutions.
ex.cn: “香薰精油”并非纯精油，而是经过稀释的。

def:
n.意志,目的,作用,（进行中的）行动
vt.有意,打算,企图（做）,决意（做）

ex.en: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
ex.cn: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

ex.en: What'simpressed me has been his considerable firmness of purpose.
ex.cn: 令我印象深刻的是他对目标的坚定不移。

ex.en: The purpose of the visit was to navigate into an ice-filled fiord.
ex.cn: 这次出行是为了能驶入冰雪覆盖的峡湾。

def:
n.钱包，钱袋,财力，财源,和包或钱袋相似的东西,女用小提包
vt.使皱起，噘起

ex.en: She looked at me and then reached in her purse for cigarettes.
ex.cn: 她看看我，接着伸手去包里拿香烟。

ex.en: The bank has been too slow in loosening the purse strings.
ex.cn: 银行一直迟迟不愿放开资金。

ex.en: She folded it up, and tucked it into her purse.
ex.cn: 她将其折叠起来，塞进了钱包里。

def:
vt.& vi.推，推动
vt.推动，增加,对…施加压力，逼迫,按,说服
n.推，决心,大规模攻势,矢志的追求
vi.推进,增加,努力争取

ex.en: I saw her push the boulder down on you.
ex.cn: 我看见她将巨石推下砸向你。

ex.en: Information is called up at the push of a button.
ex.cn: 按一个键信息就会被调出来。

ex.en: The new Chancellor has the guts to push through unpopular tax increases.
ex.cn: 新总理有勇气推动不受欢迎的增税方案获得通过。

def:
vt.放,表达,给予（重视、信任、价值等）,使处于（某种状态）
vt.& vi.使感觉到,使受到…的影响
vi.说,猛推,将…送往,使与…连接
n.[方]笨蛋，怪人,对策
adj.固定的,不动的

ex.en: A changing world has put pressures on the corporation.
ex.cn: 日新月异的世界使这家公司感到了压力。

ex.en: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
ex.cn: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

ex.en: Her bed was crisply made, her clothes put away.
ex.cn: 她的床收拾得很整洁，衣服也收起来了。

def:
n.质量，品质,美质，优点,才能，能力，技能，素养,品种
adj.优质的，高质量的,上流社会的

ex.en: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style.
ex.cn: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

ex.en: Today's organic wine producer is typically a small, quality-conscious family concern.
ex.cn: 现今的有机葡萄酒生产商一般是注重品质的小型家族企业.

ex.en: Little of the existing housing is of good enough quality.
ex.cn: 现有的住房几乎少有质量过关的。

def: n.量，数量,定量，大批,数目,[语音学、韵律学]音量（指元音或音节的长短）

n.争吵，口角,反目,抱怨…的原因（理由）,[史]方镞箭，角镞箭
vi.争辩，争吵,不同意,挑剔,责备，埋怨

ex.en: They could quarrel quite legitimately with some of my choices.
ex.cn: 他们大有理由不同意我的一些选择。

ex.en: The monarchists are a small fringe group who quarrel fiercely among themselves.
ex.cn: 君主主义者是一个内部争吵激烈的非主流的小团体。

ex.en: It could have happened during a quarrel between them over Naomi.
ex.cn: 这件事可能是在他们为娜奥米争吵的过程中发生的。

def:
n.四分之一,一刻钟,地区,（美式足球的）一节
vt.把…四等分,供…住宿,使（士兵）驻扎

ex.en: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce.
ex.cn: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

ex.en: He recovered from a 4-2 deficit to reach the quarter-finals.
ex.cn: 他在2比4落后的情况下实现逆转闯进1/4决赛。

ex.en: The time was recorded at a quarter after five.
ex.cn: 时间显示是5点15分。

def:
n.女王,王后,杰出女性,（纸牌中的）王后， （国际象棋中的）后
vt.立…为王后（或女王）,使…成为国王的妻子,[国际象棋]使（兵）成为后

ex.en: Queen Mary started the fashion for blue and white china in England.
ex.cn: 玛丽女王开启了青花瓷在英格兰的流行风尚。

ex.en: She was surely the most distinguished queen consort we have had.
ex.cn: 毫无疑问她是我们拥有的最为出众的王后。

ex.en: Chefs at the St James Court restaurant have cooked for the Queen.
ex.cn: 圣詹姆斯皇家饭店的厨师们曾经为女王烹制菜肴。

def:
n.问题,疑问,怀疑,议题
vt.问（某人）问题,对（某事物）表示[感到]怀疑

ex.en: This brings us to the second question I asked.
ex.cn: 这就将我们带到了我所提的第二个问题。

ex.en: People want to dissect his work and question his motives.
ex.cn: 人们想仔细分析他的作品，并对他的动机提出质疑。

ex.en: One more question and I'll leave you in peace.
ex.cn: 再问一个问题，我就不打扰你了。

def:
adj.快的，急速的,聪明的，凌厉的,灵活的,短时间做成的
adv.迅速地，快速地
n.（指甲下的）活肉,感情的中枢，感觉最敏锐的地方,要害，核心

ex.en: Don't worry. We'll have you out of here double-quick.
ex.cn: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

ex.en: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
ex.cn: 这种稍加变化的可口煎蛋卷做起来又快又容易。

ex.en: I looked at what he'd given me and did a quick subtraction.
ex.cn: 我看着他给我的东西，快速做了个减法。

pos: adj vi vt prep n adv
def:
adj.清静的,僻静的,不起眼的,不激动的
vt.& vi.安静下来，使…安静，平静
vt.减轻（病痛、疑虑、恐惧等）,[法律]确定（产权等）
prep.克制的，稳重的，不张扬的
n.宁静,寂静
adv.安静地，平静地

ex.en: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
ex.cn: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

ex.en: Jeremy wants some peace and quiet before his big match.
ex.cn: 杰里米希望在大赛来临之前能享受到些许平静和安宁。

ex.en: The wine towns encountered are, on the whole, quiet and modest.
ex.cn: 所到的酒镇总的来说都是宁静祥和的。

def: adv.相当，很,非常,确实如此

ex.en: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
ex.cn: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

ex.en: I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
ex.cn: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

ex.en: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
ex.cn: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

def:
n.兔子，野兔,兔子皮毛,兔子肉,〈俚〉新手，弱手
vi.猎兔（通常作 go rabbiting）,（兔子似的）聚拢在一起,<英俚>唠叨，喋喋不休（常与on about连用）
vt.让…见鬼去吧

ex.en: Rabbit stew is one of chef Giancarlo Moeri's signature dishes.
ex.cn: 炖野兔是厨师詹卡洛·莫里的招牌菜之一。

ex.en: He'd snared a rabbit earlier in the day.
ex.cn: 那天早一点的时候，他设套捉了一只兔子。

ex.en: The rabbit population was decimated by the disease.
ex.cn: 这种疾病使大批兔子死亡。

def:
n.赛跑,人种,竞争,民族
v.参加比赛,快速移动,空转

ex.en: Before the race, he is fine. But afterwards he is worn out.
ex.cn: 赛前他状态很好，赛后就筋疲力尽了。

ex.en: Duke was soundly defeated in this month's Louisiana governor's race.
ex.cn: 杜克在本月的路易斯安那州长竞选中大败而归。

ex.en: Few jockeys continue race-riding beyond the age of 40.
ex.cn: 很少有职业赛马骑师超过40岁仍继续参加赛马的。

def:
n.无线电,收音机,无线电广播台,无线电收发报机
vt.& vi.用无线电发送讯息,作无线电广播,用X射线拍照

n.铁路，铁道,铁路系统，铁路公司
v.迫使…仓促行事,强使…草率通过 ,强迫…做,轻率判处

ex.en: The railroad finally reached Santa Barbara in 1877.
ex.cn: 铁路终于在1877年修到了圣巴巴拉。

ex.en: This town got a lot bigger when the railroad came in the 1860s.
ex.cn: 自从19世纪60年代通了火车之后，这座城镇变大了许多。

ex.en: Bridges over railroad tracks root danger out in crossing.
ex.cn: 铁轨上空的天桥排除了穿行中的危险.

def:
n.铁路,铁道,铁路系统,铁道部门
vi.乘火车旅行,在…铺设铁路

ex.en: Dozens of miles of railway track have been torn up.
ex.cn: 好几十英里的铁轨被毁坏了。

ex.en: The railway station smelt powerfully of cats and drains.
ex.cn: 火车站上有冲鼻的猫味和臭水沟味。

ex.en: Across the river the railway track ran up to the pithead.
ex.cn: 铁轨跨过这条河直达矿井口。

def:
n.雨,（热带地区的）雨季，雨天,雨点般降落的东西,<俚>电子流
vt.& vi.（雨）降下，（使）降落,大量地给，（使）大量落下

ex.en: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
ex.cn: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

ex.en: She was born in the middle of a rain storm.
ex.cn: 她出生在一场暴风雨中。

ex.en: He stared at the rain spattering on the glass.
ex.cn: 他凝视着雨点溅落在玻璃上。

def:
n.彩虹
adj.五彩缤纷的,彩虹状的
vt.&vi.使呈彩虹状

ex.en: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
ex.cn: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾上照出了一道彩虹。

ex.en: The Rainbow has not hosted live music since the end of 1981.
ex.cn: 1981年末之后，彩虹剧院就再没主办过现场音乐会。

ex.en: Oh look, a rainbow!
ex.cn: 看哪，彩虹！

def:
v.提升,增加,养育,筹集
n.提升,增加,高处,举起

ex.en: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.
ex.cn: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。

ex.en: Every year we have charity days to raise money for unfortunate people.
ex.cn: 每年我们都有慈善日来筹款帮助贫困人群。

ex.en: It seemed like a good neighbourhood to raise my children.
ex.cn: 它看起来像是一个有利于我的孩子们成长的理想居住区。

def:
adj.快速的,[摄]感光快的,险峻的
n.急流,高速交通工具，高速交通网

ex.en: The company made a rapid-fire series of settlements with 25 States.
ex.cn: 公司同25个州进行了一连串迅速的结算。

ex.en: Two rapid transit trains collided early this morning in Boston.
ex.cn: 今晨早些时候，两辆高速火车在波士顿相撞。

ex.en: Leonard made a rapid calculation: he'd never make it in time.
ex.cn: 伦纳德快速盘算了一下：他肯定赶不上了。

def: adv.很快地，迅速地,立即

ex.en: The film opened to healthy box office receipts before rapidly falling off.
ex.cn: 这部影片的票房收入开始的时候持续上涨，但是后来急剧下降。

ex.en: These ideas rapidly became the new orthodoxy in linguistics.
ex.cn: 这些观点迅速成为语言学中新的正统观念。

ex.en: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
ex.cn: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

def:
adv.稍微，有点,相当，颇,宁愿,相反地
int.当然啦，怎么不

ex.en: Rather taken aback by such forwardness, I slammed down the phone.
ex.cn: 如此无礼的言语让我火冒三丈，我砰的一下把电话挂了。

ex.en: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral.
ex.cn: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

ex.en: I gradually got rather disillusioned with the whole setup of the university.
ex.cn: 渐渐地，我对大学的整个体制感到相当失望。

def:
n.（热或其他能量的）射线,光束，光线,微量,伞形花序柄
vt.放射,照射,（思想，希望等）闪现,发光

ex.en: Ray was very giggly and joking all the time.
ex.cn: 蕾特别喜欢咯咯地笑，而且总是爱开玩笑。

ex.en: Ray and I ate our meal and reminisced about the trip.
ex.cn: 雷和我吃着饭，回忆起那次旅行。

ex.en: Ray will earn his keep on local farms while studying.
ex.cn: 雷求学期间会在当地的农场干活赚取生活费。

def:
v.到达，走到,够…，抓…,完成
n.手脚能够到的范围,范围，区域,影响的范围，管辖的范围

vt.& vi.阅读，朗读,显示,研究,看得懂
vt.显示,阅读,读懂，理解
n.阅读,读物,读书,里德（人名）
adj.被朗读的,博识的,博览的,有学问的

ex.en: I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
ex.cn: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

ex.en: In her spare time she read books on cooking.
ex.cn: 业余时间里她看一些烹饪方面的书籍。

ex.en: When the decision was read out Mrs Gardner thanked the judges.
ex.cn: 判决书宣读完，加德纳夫人向法官们表示感谢。

def: n.读者，朗读者,读本,讲读者，讲师,审稿人

n.阅读,宣读,读物,读数
v.读( read的现在分词),看懂,理解,显示，标明

ex.en: His remedial teacher sees signs of progress in his reading and writing.
ex.cn: 他的辅导教师发现了他在阅读和写作方面进步的迹象。

ex.en: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
ex.cn: 他们将集中教授阅读、写作和算术基础知识。

ex.en: Hopefully, you won't have any problems after reading this.
ex.cn: 希望你读完这个后就不会有任何问题了。

def:
adj.准备好的，现成的,即时的，敏捷的,情愿的,即将的
vt.做好…的准备
adv.预先,已完成地
n.现款

ex.en: Fraud squad officers had bugged the phone and were ready to pounce.
ex.cn: 反诈骗小组的警员们已在电话上安装了窃听器，并随时准备突击。

ex.en: Tamsin materialized at her side, notebook at the ready.
ex.cn: 塔姆辛从她身旁冒了出来，且备好了笔记本。

ex.en: Catherine was ready to explode. "I think you're contemptible!"
ex.cn: 凯瑟琳气得快要炸了。“我觉得你真是可鄙！”

def:
adj.真的,真实的，现实的,事实上的,真诚的
adv.真正，实在,确实地
n.实在，现实,实数

ex.en: Michael Fish is my favourite. He's a hoot, a real character.
ex.cn: 我最喜欢迈克尔·菲什。他滑稽逗趣，是个实实在在的人物。

ex.en: What we need is not manifestos of pious intentions, but real action.
ex.cn: 我们需要的不是善意但难以实现的宣言，而是实际行动。

ex.en: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world.
ex.cn: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

def:
vt.实现,了解，认识到
vt.& vi.变卖，赚得

ex.en: Various textile techniques will be explored to realise design possibilities.
ex.cn: 将尝试和探索纺织技巧来把这些设计变为现实。

ex.en: Now people are starting to realise that he means business.
ex.cn: 人们现在才开始明白他不是在开玩笑。

ex.en: I realise that an Englishman who generalises about Ireland invites trouble.
ex.cn: 我意识到英国人如果对爱尔兰问题加以泛化的话会招惹麻烦。

def:
vt.实现,了解，意识到,（所担心的事）发生,以…价格卖出
vt.& vi.变卖，赚得

ex.en: I didn't realize how heavy that shopping was going to be.
ex.cn: 我没想到买的东西会有多沉。

ex.en: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
ex.cn: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

ex.en: I realize there's no consensus on what are male or female values.
ex.cn: 我意识到人们对什么是男性价值观和什么是女性价值观并无共识。

def: adv.真，真正,实在，果真,实际上,事实上

n.理由,原因,理性,理智
vt.& vi.推理，思考,争辩,辩论,向…解释

ex.en: I really don't see any reason for changing it.
ex.cn: 我真的不明白为什么要改变它。

ex.en: There's a reason why women don't read this stuff; it's not funny.
ex.cn: 女人不读这种东西是有原因的，它并不好笑。

ex.en: To an extent, that is the reason for the meeting.
ex.cn: 在某种程度上，那就是召开这次会议的原因。

def:
vt.& vi.收到,接到,接纳,接待
vt.接收,受理,欢迎,承受
vi.接到，获得,接见，欢迎,[电子学] 接收,[橄榄球] 接球

ex.en: Children at school receive coloured stars for work well done.
ex.cn: 学校里的孩子表现得好会得到彩色星星。

ex.en: She went to New York to receive the award in person.
ex.cn: 她亲自前往纽约领奖。

ex.en: When we are off sick, we only receive half pay.
ex.cn: 我们请病假的时候只能拿一半薪水。

def: adj.最近的,新近的,近代的,[地]全新世的

ex.en: Specialists see various reasons for the recent surge in inflation.
ex.cn: 专家们认为目前通货膨胀加剧有多种原因。

ex.en: Recent, more dramatic use of CGI was seen in "Walking With Dinosaurs".
ex.cn: 在纪录片《与恐龙同行》中可以看到最新的、更加生动的电脑特效技术。

ex.en: In recent months many conservative politicians have jumped on the anti-immigrant bandwagon.
ex.cn: 最近几个月，很多保守政客都搭上了“反移民”这班车。

def: adv.最近，近来,不久以前,近日,新近

ex.en: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute.
ex.cn: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

ex.en: New $750,000 infomercials, featuring artists like Cher, have recently hit the screens.
ex.cn: 耗资75万美元、有雪儿等艺人出镜的新的名人电视促销节目近来播出了。

ex.en: He recently did the catering for a presidential reception.
ex.cn: 他最近承办了一次总统招待会的宴席。

def: n.记录，记载,档案，履历,唱片,最高纪录

ex.en: Exports in June rose 1.5% to a record $30.91 billion.
ex.cn: 6月份的出口额上升了1.5%，创下309.1亿美元的历史最高纪录。

ex.en: The water level in Lake Taihu has reached record levels.
ex.cn: 太湖水位达到了历史最高值。

ex.en: Australia's rugby union side enjoyed a record-breaking win over France.
ex.cn: 澳大利亚的英式橄榄球联盟队创纪录地赢了法国队。

def: n.录音机,直笛,记录员,刑事法院法官

ex.en: Two out of every three Britons already own a video recorder.
ex.cn: 每3个英国人中就有两个已经有了录像机。

ex.en: My tape recorder did not catch every last word.
ex.cn: 我的录音机并没有把每一个字都录下来。

ex.en: Miss Bennett whiled away the hours playing old films on her video-recorder.
ex.cn: 贝内特小姐用录像机播放老电影来消磨时间。

def:
n.记录，录音,唱片,录了音的磁带,录音的节目
adj.记录的，录音的，录影的,自记的,记录用的
v.记录，录音，拍摄( record的现在分词),显示，自动记下,标明,发表正式（或法律方面的）声明

vt.恢复,重新获得,找回,<正>恢复（适当的状态或位置）
vi.恢复健康（体力、能力等）
n.恢复开始时姿势

ex.en: Legal action is being taken to try to recover the money.
ex.cn: 正在进行诉讼以收回那笔钱。

ex.en: Firms need a breathing space if they are to recover.
ex.cn: 这些公司需要短暂休整才能恢复元气。

ex.en: We are taking advice on legal steps to recover the money.
ex.cn: 我们正在就追回该款项所需的法律程序咨询律师。

def:
adj.红色的,（脸）涨红的,烧红的,红头发的
n.红色,红衣服,红颜料,红葡萄酒

ex.en: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
ex.cn: 如果皮肤发红、瘙痒或脱皮，要向医生咨询。

ex.en: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks.
ex.cn: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

ex.en: Bake some big red peppers and hollow them out.
ex.cn: 将几个大红甜椒烤一烤，再把它们掏空。

def:
vt.减少,缩小,使还原,使变弱
vi.减少,节食,蒸发,（液体）浓缩变稠

ex.en: The job losses will reduce the total workforce to 7,000.
ex.cn: 职位减少后，在职工人总数将减至7,000人。

ex.en: He finally corrected his misstatement and offered to reduce the fee.
ex.cn: 他终于纠正了自己的错误说法，提出要减少费用。

ex.en: The plan is designed to reduce some of the company's mountainous debt.
ex.cn: 该计划旨在减少公司堆积如山的债务。

def:
vi.提到,针对,关系到,请教
vt.归因于…,使求助于,送交,认为…起源于
vt.& vi.参考，查阅

ex.en: He could refer the matter to the high court.
ex.cn: 他可以将此事交由高等法院裁决。

ex.en: Only your family doctor can refer you to a surgeon.
ex.cn: 只有你的家庭医生才能把你介绍给外科医生。

ex.en: But he then went on to refer very directly to the argument.
ex.cn: 不过接下来他就直切主题提到了那场争论。

def:
v.拒绝,回绝,推却
n.废弃物,垃圾

ex.en: The District Council made a weekly collection of refuse.
ex.cn: 区政务委员会每周收取一次垃圾。

ex.en: I've always had a loud mouth, I refuse to be silenced.
ex.cn: 我一贯大声说出自己的想法，不会迫于压力而一言不发。

ex.en: I refuse to act that way when my kids fight.
ex.cn: 我的孩子们打起架来时，我不会那样做。

def:
vt.认为,注视,涉及,尊敬
vi.凝视,留意
n.凝视,留意,尊敬,问候

vt.后悔，悔恨,遗憾，抱歉,悼念，哀悼
vi.感到后悔，感到抱歉
n.遗憾，惋惜,后悔，悔恨,哀悼

ex.en: Failure is never quite so frightening as regret.
ex.cn: 比失败更令人恐惧的是懊悔。

ex.en: From Cairo came expressions of regret at the attack.
ex.cn: 开罗对此次攻击表示遗憾。

ex.en: Her lack of co-operation is nothing new, I regret to say.
ex.cn: 很遗憾，我不得不说她缺少合作精神不是什么新鲜事。

def:
adj.有规律的,规则，整齐的,不变的,合格的
n.正规军,主力（或正式）队员,常客
adv.定期地,经常地

ex.en: Check the oil at regular intervals, and have the car serviced regularly.
ex.cn: 定期检查汽油，并对车辆进行定期维护。

ex.en: He is being constantly monitored with regular checks on his blood pressure.
ex.cn: 他被实时监测，定时量血压。

ex.en: George struggled wildly, going under and resurfacing at regular intervals.
ex.cn: 乔治疯狂地挣扎，不断在水面上浮浮沉沉。

def: n.关系,联系,关联,亲属

ex.en: Watercolour still seems somehow to be the poor relation of oil painting.
ex.cn: 水彩画似乎仍比油画略逊一筹。

ex.en: He had a relation who lived up the road.
ex.cn: 他有个亲戚住在这条马路上。

ex.en: For many software packages, the price bears little relation to cost.
ex.cn: 对于很多软件包来说，价钱和成本没有什么联系。

def:
adj.相关的,相对的,相互有关的,比较而言的
n.亲属，亲戚,相关物,亲缘植物（或动物）,[语法学]关系词

ex.en: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
ex.cn: 雇主可以要求出具书面证明，证实员工的亲人确实病了。

ex.en: Economic reform has brought relative wealth to peasant farmers.
ex.cn: 经济改革给农民带来了相对的财富。

ex.en: The person can transfer from wheelchair to seat with relative ease.
ex.cn: 那个人可以比较轻松地从轮椅上移到座位上。

def:
vt.& vi.记得,牢记
vt.记着,纪念,回想起,送钱[礼物]给…

ex.en: Remember, keep a positive attitude and good things will happen.
ex.cn: 记住：保持乐观的心态，好事自然会发生。

ex.en: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think.--Dale Carnegie
ex.cn: 请记住，幸福不在于你是谁或者你拥有什么，而仅仅取决于你的心态！

ex.en: I distinctly remember wishing I had not got involved.
ex.cn: 我清楚地记得希望自己没有被牵扯进去。

def:
vt.开除,去除,脱掉，拿下,迁移
vi.迁移，移居,离开
n.距离，差距,移动

ex.en: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates.
ex.cn: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

ex.en: Remove from the heat, add the parsley, toss and serve at once.
ex.cn: 端离炉子，加上欧芹，颠起翻面后就立刻上桌。

ex.en: Vintage ports must be decanted to remove natural sediments.
ex.cn: 上等的波尔图葡萄酒必须倒入其他容器中以滤除自然沉淀物。

def:
vt.修理,纠正,恢复,弥补
n.修理,修理工作,维修状态,经修理的东西

ex.en: If you are not happy about a repair, go back and complain.
ex.cn: 如果你对修理效果不满意，可以再找他们投诉。

ex.en: The monks of Ettal keep the abbey in good repair.
ex.cn: 埃塔尔的修道士把修道院维护得很好。

ex.en: It would be uneconomic to try and repair it.
ex.cn: 花钱修理不合算。

def:
vt.复述，背诵,重复
vi.重做,重复投票
n.（节目）重演,重复,重复的事物

ex.en: Nearly 60% of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
ex.cn: 我们近60%的订单来自于回头客和熟人介绍。

ex.en: What price a glorious repeat of last week's triumph?
ex.cn: 还有可能再次上演上周的辉煌胜利吗？

ex.en: I'll repeat that so you can commit it to memory.
ex.cn: 我会重复一下，好让你们记住。

def:
n.回答，答复,反应,报复（行动）,[法律]答辩
vi.[法律]（原告对被告）答辩,反响,作答,（以行动）做出反应
vt.回应，作出反应

ex.en: He said in reply that the question was unfair.
ex.cn: 他回答说这个问题不公平。

ex.en: They went ahead without waiting for a reply from the Germans.
ex.cn: 他们没等德国人答复就接着往下推进。

ex.en: I have received neither an acknowledgment nor a reply.
ex.cn: 我未收到任何复函或答复。

def:
n.报告,成绩报告单,传闻,流言蜚语
vt.& vi.报道,公布,宣告
vt.告发，举报,使报到

ex.en: I'll report back the moment I have located him.
ex.cn: 我一找到他就马上汇报。

ex.en: Many areas in the country'sinterior are unable to report Aids cases immediately.
ex.cn: 该国内地的很多地区无法即时报告艾滋病病例。

ex.en: Politicians want a lap-dog press which will uncritically report their propaganda.
ex.cn: 政客们想要的是不问是非、甘为他们搞宣传的哈巴狗一样的新闻媒体。

def: n.共和国,共和政体,（成员具有平等权利的）团体

ex.en: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
ex.cn: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

ex.en: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs.
ex.cn: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

ex.en: The republic is a melting pot of different nationalities.
ex.cn: 这个共和国是多民族的大熔炉。

def:
n.要求,需要,所请求的事物,申请书
vt.（下级对上级的）请求,请求得到,索取,邀请[常接不定式或从句]

vt.要求,需要,想要,命令
vi.要求，规定

ex.en: Today's complex buildings require close teamwork between the architect and the builders.
ex.cn: 如今的建筑结构复杂，需要建筑师和施工人员密切协作。

ex.en: Buyers might require further assurances before parting with their cash.
ex.cn: 买方在付现之前可能要求提供进一步的担保。

ex.en: That does not require "massive" military intervention, as some have mischievously claimed.
ex.cn: 那并不需要像某些不怀好意者所主张的那样进行“大规模的”军事干预。

def:
n.研究，追究,探讨，探测,调查,探索
vi.做研究,探究,（从市场调研中）得出所预测的结果
vt.从事…的研究，为…而做研究

ex.en: Research and technology are said to be chronically underfunded.
ex.cn: 据说为研究和技术方面提供的经费严重不足。

ex.en: Faculty members devote most of their time to scholarly research.
ex.cn: 全院教师大部分时间都用来从事学术研究。

ex.en: Research shows a wide difference in tastes around the country.
ex.cn: 研究表明全国各地的口味大有不同。

def:
vt.尊重,尊敬,关心,遵守
n.尊重，恭敬,敬意,某方面

ex.en: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
ex.cn: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

ex.en: We need to restore respect for the law-enforcement agencies.
ex.cn: 我们需要重塑执法机构的声望。

ex.en: I respect his judgement and I'll follow any advice he gives me.
ex.cn: 我尊重他的判断能力，会接受他提出的任何建议。

def:
n.休息,剩余部分,支持物,宁静，安宁
vt.& vi.（使）休息,（使）倚靠[支撑]
vi.休息,静止,停止,安心
vt.使休息,使轻松,使长眠,使依赖

ex.en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
ex.cn: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

ex.en: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
ex.cn: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

ex.en: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
ex.cn: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。

def: n.饭店,餐馆,饭馆,菜馆

ex.en: He insisted we stop at a small restaurant just outside of Atlanta.
ex.cn: 他坚持让我们在亚特兰大市外不远的一家小餐馆歇歇脚。

ex.en: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street.
ex.cn: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

ex.en: We had lunch the other day at our favorite restaurant.
ex.cn: 前两天我们在最喜欢的餐馆吃了午饭。

def:
n.结果,（尤指足球比赛的）胜利,[体]比分,成功实现的事
vi.发生，产生,归结为，导致,后果，终结,由…而造成[产生]

ex.en: The result reflects a modest rightward shift in opinion.
ex.cn: 结果显示舆论出现一定程度的右倾。

ex.en: Receding gums can be the result of disease or simply incorrect brushing.
ex.cn: 牙龈萎缩可能是疾病导致的，也可能仅仅是错误的刷牙方式引起的。

ex.en: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
ex.cn: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

def:
v.回转，返回,复发，又来,送还,言归正传
n.归来，返乡,来回，汇成,赢利,统计表

ex.en: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
ex.cn: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

ex.en: Ellery's return will help to chase away some of the gloom.
ex.cn: 埃勒里的归来可以驱散一些抑郁的情绪。

ex.en: Return the enclosed Donation Form today in the prepaid envelope provided.
ex.cn: 请于今日将随函附上的捐款表格用所提供的邮资预付的信封寄回。

def:
n.复习,回顾,（报刊的）评论,[法]复审
vt.检验,复查,复习,评论
vi.复习功课,写评论

ex.en: The White House quickly announced that the policy is under review.
ex.cn: 白宫很快宣布该项政策正在审核中。

ex.en: The president ordered a review of US economic aid to Jordan.
ex.cn: 总统下令对美国向约旦提供的经济援助进行审查。

ex.en: We've never had a good review in the music press.
ex.cn: 我们从未在音乐媒体获得过好评。

def: n.革命,彻底改变,旋转,运行，公转

ex.en: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
ex.cn: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

ex.en: Babearth regarded the middle classes as the betrayers of the Revolution.
ex.cn: 巴博施把中产阶级看作是革命的叛徒。

ex.en: The feeding of dairy cows has undergone a revolution.
ex.cn: 乳牛的喂养方法发生了巨大的改变。

def:
n.稻,稻米， 大米
vt.筛选

ex.en: Under these laws, he said, Mr. Rice's assets could have been frozen.
ex.cn: 他说根据这些法规，赖斯先生的资产可能已经被冻结了。

ex.en: The petals can be cooked with rice to colour it yellow.
ex.cn: 可以把这些花瓣跟米饭一起煮，使米饭变成黄色。

ex.en: Fish and rice were the mainstays of the country's diet.
ex.cn: 鱼和米是该国的主要食品。

def: adj.富有的,肥沃的,丰富多彩的,油腻的

ex.en: He hoped to strike it rich by investing in ginseng.
ex.cn: 他希望通过投资人参发大财。

ex.en: We gained a rich supply of data which would normally be inaccessible.
ex.cn: 我们得到了通常难以获取的大量数据。

ex.en: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A.
ex.cn: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

def: vt.使摆脱，解除，免除

ex.en: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption.
ex.cn: 这些提议试图使这个国家摆脱政治腐败。

ex.en: Why couldn't he ever rid himself of those thoughts, those worries?
ex.cn: 为什么他总是无法摆脱那些想法和担忧？

ex.en: You'll never quite get rid of every last bit of grit.
ex.cn: 无法把所有的沙砾都清除干净。

def:
vt.& vi.乘，骑，驾
n.（乘坐汽车等的）旅行,乘骑,（乘车或骑车的）短途旅程,供乘骑的游乐设施
vt.（骑马、自行车等）穿越,搭乘,飘浮

ex.en: If you want a cheap ride, take a minicab.
ex.cn: 要想出行便宜，就坐小型出租车吧。

ex.en: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake.
ex.cn: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

ex.en: Naomi was given a pony and taught to ride side-saddle.
ex.cn: 别人给娜奥米一匹小型马并教会她如何侧骑马。

def:
adv.立刻，马上,向右，右边,恰当地,一直
adj.右方的,正确的,合适的,好的，正常的
n.正确，正当,右边,权利,右手
vt.纠正,扶直，使正,整理,补偿
vi.（船舶等）复正，恢复平稳

ex.en: Instead of complaining about what's wrong, be grateful for what's right.
ex.cn: 别抱怨不好的事，要对美好的事心存感恩。

ex.en: You'll need to get on the right side of Carmela.
ex.cn: 你得讨卡梅拉的欢心。

ex.en: More people would be attracted to cycling if conditions were right.
ex.cn: 如果天气适宜，会有更多的人被吸引到骑自行车的行列中来。

def:
n.戒指，指环,铃声，钟声,环形物,拳击场
vt.形成环状,环绕,使（例如铃）响,打电话给
vi.按铃，敲钟,回响,成环形

ex.en: If you'd like more information, ring the Hotline on 414 3929.
ex.cn: 如果想了解更多信息，请拨打热线电话4143929。

ex.en: Friendship is much more important to me than a stupid old ring!
ex.cn: 友谊对我来说可比一个破戒指重要得多！

ex.en: Any minute now, that phone is going to ring.
ex.cn: 那部电话随时可能响。

def:
adj.成熟的,醇美可口的,老练的,时机成熟的
v.〈诗〉同“ripen“

ex.en: The conditions are ripe for the spread of disease.
ex.cn: 这种疾病传播的条件已经成熟。

ex.en: Haig's message was that victory was ripe for picking.
ex.cn: 黑格传达的意思是说胜利唾手可得。

ex.en: He lived to the ripe old age of 95.
ex.cn: 他活到了95岁高龄。

def:
vi.上升,增强,（数量）增加,休会
n.（数量或水平的）增加,兴起,（数量、价格、价值等的）增长,（日、月等的）升起
vt.使…浮上水面,使（鸟）飞起,复活,发酵

ex.en: Here's an inside tip: The faster you rise, the harder you fall.
ex.cn: 给你一个小忠告：爬得越快，摔得越疼。

ex.en: There are intangible benefits beyond a rise in the share price.
ex.cn: 除股价上升之外还有无形利益。

ex.en: Once wholesale prices are deregulated, consumer prices will also rise.
ex.cn: 一旦批发价格放开，零售价格也会随之上涨。

def: n.河，江,溪，巨流

ex.en: The river widens considerably as it begins to turn east.
ex.cn: 河流转向东流时河道大幅度变宽。

ex.en: It's easy to get a tummy upset from river water.
ex.cn: 喝河水很容易闹肚子。

ex.en: Across the river the railway track ran up to the pithead.
ex.cn: 铁轨跨过这条河直达矿井口。

def:
n.路,通路,途径,方法
vt.在…设置路障,（狗）沿臭迹追逐（猎物）,（狗）闻着臭迹追

vt.抢劫,抢夺，掠夺,非法剥夺,使丧失
vi.抢劫,掠夺

ex.en: They rob us, they infringe our rights, they kill us.
ex.cn: 他们劫掠我们，侵犯我们的权利，对我们实施杀戮。
